3d projection.context: 你和朋友在电影院排队，屏幕上写着今天全是3D版本，朋友纠结要不要戴眼镜看。
3d projection.translation: 朋友：今天这部新片好像只有三D版本 你：听说用立体放映效果会特别逼真 朋友：那我们要不要买票进去试试 你：当然要去，坐前排戴眼镜更震撼 朋友：那我现在就去排队买两张票 你：好呀，顺便再带一桶爆米花进场
3d projection.example: Friend: It seems the new movie today only has a 3D version. You: I heard the 3D projection makes the effect really lifelike. Friend: Should we buy tickets and go inside to give it a try? You: Of course, sitting in the front with glasses is more stunning. Friend: Then I'll go line up right now to buy two tickets. You: Great, and grab a bucket of popcorn to take inside with us.

7/24.context: 你跟朋友吐槽小区便利店通宵不关灯，朋友说那老板真是全天候守着店。
7/24.translation: 朋友：楼下那家便利店半夜居然还开着门 你：是啊，他们几乎全天都在营业 朋友：老板难道不用回家睡觉休息吗 你：听说是轮班制，所以随时都能买东西 朋友：那我半夜饿了也能下去买点吃的 你：当然啦，泡面和热包子都还卖着呢
7/24.example: Friend: The convenience store downstairs is still open in the middle of the night. You: Yeah, they basically run 7/24 without ever closing their doors. Friend: Doesn't the boss ever go home and get some proper sleep? You: Apparently it's shift work, so you can buy anything anytime. Friend: Then if I'm hungry at midnight I can go down for food too. You: Of course, they still sell instant noodles and hot steamed buns.

9 to 5.context: 老同学聚会，有人问你现在做什么工作，你说还是那份朝九晚五的办公室活。
9 to 5.translation: 朋友：毕业这么多年你现在还在上班吗 你：嗯，还是老样子做着固定的办公室活 朋友：每天准点上下班感觉会不会太无聊 你：稳定倒是稳定，就是很少出去旅游 朋友：你没想过换份更自由点的工作吗 你：暂时没有，我这个人就喜欢安稳一点
9 to 5.example: Friend: Are you still working a regular job all these years after graduation? You: Yeah, same as always, just a steady nine to five office job. Friend: Isn't it boring clocking in and out every single day? You: It's steady for sure, but I rarely get a chance to travel. Friend: Have you thought about switching to a freer job sometime? You: Not for now, I'm the kind of person who loves stability.

a barrel of laughs.context: 同事硬拉你去参加一个无聊的团建，你回来后跟朋友吐槽那活动毫无乐趣。
a barrel of laughs.translation: 朋友：昨天公司团建你玩得还开心吧 你：别提了，那个游戏环节真是没意思 朋友：不会吧，我还以为大家都玩得很嗨 你：说实话，整场活动根本不好笑 朋友：那你当时是怎么熬到结束的 你：硬着头皮撑着，就盼着早点散场
a barrel of laughs.example: Friend: Did you enjoy the company team building yesterday? You: Don't even ask, that game part was totally lifeless. Friend: Really? I thought everyone was having a blast there. You: Honestly, the whole thing was not exactly a barrel of laughs. Friend: Then how on earth did you survive until it ended? You: Just gritted my teeth through it, hoping it would finish soon.

a bunch of.context: 朋友来你家做客，看见桌上摆着一堆零食，随手抓了一把往嘴里塞。
a bunch of.translation: 朋友：你桌上怎么放了这么多小零食啊 你：都是昨天网购的，想找点东西垫垫 朋友：那我就不客气啦，先吃一包薯片 你：随便拿，反正我一个人吃不完 朋友：这饼干味道还不错，在哪买的 你：就在网上，链接我一会儿发你
a bunch of.example: Friend: Why do you have a bunch of snacks sitting on your desk? You: I ordered them online yesterday, wanting something to munch. Friend: Then I won't be polite, I'll grab a bag of chips first. You: Help yourself, I can't possibly finish them alone anyway. Friend: This biscuit tastes pretty good, where did you buy it? You: Online, I'll send you the shopping link in a moment.

a call of nature.context: 你和朋友在长途大巴上堵了两小时，你实在憋不住，委婉地说自己有点内急。
a call of nature.translation: 朋友：这车堵在高速上已经两个钟头了 你：我有点坐不住，突然想上厕所 朋友：那怎么办，前不着村后不着店的 你：再忍十分钟，看看前面有没有服务区 朋友：要不我问问司机能不能先停一下 你：好，你帮我说说，我实在憋得难受
a call of nature.example: Friend: This bus has been stuck on the highway for two whole hours. You: I can't sit still, nature is suddenly calling me right now. Friend: What can we do, there's no village or shop anywhere nearby. You: Hang on ten more minutes, let's see if there's a service area ahead. Friend: Should I ask the driver whether he can stop for a bit? You: Good, please tell him, I really can't hold it much longer.

a certain amount of.context: 朋友劝你学一门新语言别太急，说任何进步都需要一定量的时间沉淀。
a certain amount of.translation: 朋友：你学日语才一个月怎么就想放弃 你：感觉进步太慢，有点看不到希望 朋友：语言学习都需要一定时间的积累 你：你说得对，我应该多给自己一些耐心 朋友：每天坚持练半小时，效果自然会出来 你：行，那我就再咬牙坚持半年看看
a certain amount of.example: Friend: You've only studied Japanese a month, why want to quit? You: It feels too slow, I kind of lose hope seeing no progress. Friend: Language learning needs a certain amount of steady buildup. You: You're right, I should give myself a bit more patience. Friend: Keep practicing half an hour daily, results will naturally come. You: Fine, then I'll grit my teeth and stick with it for half a year.

a chain of.context: 朋友跟你聊起昨天那场车祸，说是一连串的失误凑到一起才酿成悲剧。
a chain of.translation: 朋友：昨天那条路上发生了一起严重车祸 你：到底是怎么突然就撞上去的呢 朋友：交警说是一连串的失误凑到了一起 你：真希望这种事情以后不要再发生 朋友：说到底还是开车的时候太分心了 你：是啊，大家上路真的都得专心点
a chain of.example: Friend: A serious car accident happened on that road yesterday. You: How on earth did they suddenly crash into each other? Friend: Police said it was a chain of mistakes piling up together. You: I really hope this kind of thing never happens again. Friend: In the end, they were just too distracted while driving. You: Right, everyone really needs to focus when they hit the road.

a chance to shine.context: 部门开会，领导让新人上台做项目汇报，说是给年轻人一个一展风采的机会。
a chance to shine.translation: 朋友：听说这次汇报轮到你上台主讲了 你：是啊，领导特意给了我表现的机会 朋友：那你可得好好准备，别在大家面前丢脸 你：放心，我已经把幻灯片练了好几遍 朋友：台下坐了好几个大领导，你紧张吗 你：有一点，但我更想趁这次好好露一手
a chance to shine.example: Friend: I heard it's your turn to present at the meeting this time. You: Yeah, the boss deliberately gave me a chance to shine. Friend: Then prepare well, don't embarrass yourself before everyone. You: Relax, I've practiced my slides over and over already. Friend: Several big bosses will sit out front, are you nervous? You: A bit, but I really want to show off on this occasion.

a change of pace.context: 你和朋友天天吃食堂腻了，周末想换个节奏，一起去郊外骑车散心。
a change of pace.translation: 朋友：最近天天加班，感觉生活都快发霉了 你：那我们找个周末换个节奏出去走走吧 朋友：你有什么好主意，总不能还待在家里 你：去郊外骑骑车，看看山，透透气 朋友：好啊，顺便在山脚下找家农家乐吃饭 你：行，我周六一早骑车到你楼下接你
a change of pace.example: Friend: Working overtime every day lately, life feels totally stale. You: Then let's take a change of pace this weekend and go out. Friend: What's your idea, we can't just stay at home again. You: Go cycling in the suburbs, see the hills, and breathe fresh air. Friend: Great, let's also find a farm restaurant at the foot of the hill. You: Fine, I'll ride over to your place and pick you up Saturday morning.

a cup of joe.context: 早上你困得睁不开眼，溜进楼下咖啡馆，想给自己点一杯热咖啡提神。
a cup of joe.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么肿得像核桃一样 你：昨晚熬夜赶方案，现在脑子转不动 朋友：要不先去买杯热咖啡提提神吧 你：好主意，我正想找杯咖啡醒醒神 朋友：顺便也帮我带一杯，我也困得不行 你：行，你要美式还是加奶的那种
a cup of joe.example: Friend: Why are your eyes swollen like walnuts this morning? You: I stayed up late finishing the proposal, my brain won't work. Friend: Why not grab a hot cup of coffee to wake you up? You: Good idea, I'm exactly looking for a cup of joe now. Friend: Bring me one too, I'm just as sleepy as you are. You: Okay, do you want it black or the kind with milk in it?

a dash of.context: 你在厨房给朋友做沙拉，往碗里加少许橄榄油，再撒一点黑胡椒调味。
a dash of.translation: 朋友：你这沙拉做出来味道怎么这么香 你：我在里面加了少许橄榄油和柠檬汁 朋友：难怪尝起来清爽，一点都不腻人 你：再撒点黑胡椒，味道层次会更丰富 朋友：那我要不要也照着这个方子试试 你：当然可以，关键就是油别倒得太多
a dash of.example: Friend: Why does your salad smell so amazing when you make it? You: I added a dash of olive oil and some fresh lemon juice in the bowl. Friend: No wonder it tastes refreshing, not greasy at all. You: Sprinkle a bit more black pepper, the flavors get richer. Friend: Should I also try following this exact same recipe then? You: Sure, the key is just don't pour in too much of the oil.

a dog’s chance.context: 朋友劝你别去报名那个竞争惨烈的比赛，说以你的水平根本毫无机会。
a dog’s chance.translation: 朋友：你真打算去参加那个全国比赛吗 你：我想试试，万一能进个决赛呢 朋友：说实话，你这样根本毫无胜算 你：就算没机会，我也想上去见识一下 朋友：报名的可都是各省挑出来的高手 你：那我更得去了，输了也能长点见识
a dog’s chance.example: Friend: Are you really planning to enter that national competition? You: I want to give it a shot, what if I make it to the final? Friend: Honestly, you don't have a dog's chance at all there. You: Even if there's no chance, I still want to see the stage. Friend: Everyone signed up is a top pick from each whole province. You: Then I must go even more, losing still teaches me something.

a dozen of.context: 朋友问你要买几个鸡蛋，你摆摆手说买一打就够了，反正大家都要吃。
a dozen of.translation: 朋友：晚上包饺子你打算买几个鸡蛋 你：直接买一打就行，反正人多吃得快 朋友：十二个会不会太多，吃不完浪费 你：不会的，再拿点韭菜一起包就刚好 朋友：那我顺路再买点姜和肉馅回来 你：好，你负责买料，我在家擀皮
a dozen of.example: Friend: How many eggs are you buying for the dumplings tonight? You: Just get a dozen of them, since there are plenty of people. Friend: Wouldn't twelve be too many, wasting what we can't finish? You: Not at all, grab some chives too and it'll be just right. Friend: Then I'll pick up some ginger and minced meat on the way. You: Good, you handle the ingredients, I'll roll the wrappers at home.

a drop of.context: 你感冒鼻塞，朋友递给你一杯热水，让你往里面滴一滴蜂蜜润润喉。
a drop of.translation: 朋友：你嗓子听起来哑得像砂纸一样 你：可能昨晚吹风着凉，有点咳嗽 朋友：我给你倒杯热水，加一滴蜂蜜 你：太感谢了，喝下去嗓子舒服多了 朋友：记得一天喝三四杯，好得快一点 你：行，我等会儿就再去倒一杯热的
a drop of.example: Friend: Your voice sounds as rough as sandpaper right now. You: Maybe I caught a cold from the wind last night, coughing a bit. Friend: Let me pour you hot water with a drop of honey in it. You: Thanks so much, my throat already feels much better after drinking. Friend: Remember to drink three or four cups a day, it heals faster. You: Fine, I'll go pour myself another hot cup in a little while.

a feeling of achievement.context: 你花了一个月终于拼完一幅一千片的拼图，望着成品心里满是成就感。
a feeling of achievement.translation: 朋友：你桌上那幅大拼图终于拼完了 你：对啊，今天早上刚盖上最后一块 朋友：坚持这么久是不是特别有成就感 你：当然，把它挂墙上看着就满足 朋友：那你下一幅准备拼个多大的 你：先歇歇，我可不想再对着碎片费眼了
a feeling of achievement.example: Friend: You finally finished that huge puzzle on your desk. You: Yeah, I just placed the very last piece this morning. Friend: Holding on this long, don't you feel a sense of achievement? You: Of course, hanging it on the wall makes me totally proud. Friend: Then how big is the next puzzle you plan to do? You: Let me rest first, I don't want to strain my eyes on pieces.

a few time.context: 朋友问那家新开的奶茶店好不好喝，你说你已经去过好几次了。
a few time.translation: 朋友：楼下那家奶茶店到底怎么样 你：我上周末已经去过好几次了 朋友：这么夸张，是真的特别好喝吗 你：也就一般般吧，主要是离公司近 朋友：那它家哪款最值得点来喝 你：招牌的芋泥波波还不错，不太甜
a few time.example: Friend: Is that milk tea shop downstairs actually any good? You: I've already been there a few times since last weekend. Friend: That's crazy, does it really taste that amazing then? You: Just so-so, mainly because it's close to the office. Friend: Then which drink of theirs is most worth ordering? You: Their signature taro bubble one is nice, not too sweet.

a fraction of.context: 朋友惊叹新款手机功能强大，你却说它的价格不过是上代旗舰的一小部分。
a fraction of.translation: 朋友：这款新手机看起来配置太豪华了 你：听说只要旗舰机几分之一的价格 朋友：这么便宜，那性价比也太高了吧 你：确实划算，我打算发了工资就换 朋友：你原来那台不是还能用吗 你：卡得不行，早该换一台新机了
a fraction of.example: Friend: This new phone looks like it has incredibly fancy specs. You: I heard it only costs a fraction of the flagship model's price. Friend: So cheap, the value for money must be amazing then. You: Really worthwhile, I plan to replace mine once I get paid. Friend: Isn't your old one still perfectly usable though? You: It's lagging badly, I really should get a new one soon.

a go.context: 朋友想学打台球却有点不敢上手，你鼓励他先来试一试，打不好也没关系。
a go.translation: 朋友：这台球杆拿在手里我总觉得别扭 你：别紧张，你来试一试手感就好了 朋友：万一一杆都打不进多丢人啊 你：没事，大家刚开始都是这样过来的 朋友：那你先示范一杆给我看看呗 你：好，你站旁边看我怎么架杆出球
a go.example: Friend: This pool cue just feels awkward in my hands. You: Relax, come on and have a go to get a feel for it. Friend: What if I can't sink a single ball, how embarrassing. You: It's fine, everyone went through this when they first started. Friend: Then show me a shot first as a quick demonstration. You: Okay, stand close and watch how I bridge and strike.

a great deal of.context: 朋友抱怨写论文查资料太费时间，你说那篇文献里有大量相关数据可以参考。
a great deal of.translation: 朋友：这篇毕业论文查资料查得我头大 你：我之前看过一篇文章，里面数据很多 朋友：真的吗，那我赶紧去翻出来看看 你：好，我把链接发给你，记得引用规范 朋友：你说我要不要也加个问卷分析 你：可以，有数据撑着论文就更扎实
a great deal of.example: Friend: Gathering sources for this thesis gives me a headache. You: I read an article before, it contains a great deal of data. Friend: Really, then I'd better go look it up right away. You: Fine, I'll send you the link, remember to cite it properly. Friend: Do you think I should also add a questionnaire analysis? You: That works, data backing it makes the thesis more solid.

a great many.context: 朋友带你去逛一个艺术展，你惊讶地发现展厅里竟然有那么多幅现代画。
a great many.translation: 朋友：周末我带你去看一个现代艺术展吧 你：行啊，里面大概能有多少作品 朋友：据说展出了很多画作，逛都逛不完 你：那我们早点出发，免得半天看不够 朋友：展馆挺大，记得穿双舒服的鞋 你：放心，我特意换了双运动鞋出门
a great many.example: Friend: Let me take you to a modern art exhibition this weekend. You: Sure, roughly how many pieces will they have inside? Friend: They're showing a great many paintings, too many to see. You: Then let's set off early, or half a day won't be enough. Friend: The hall is huge, remember to wear comfortable shoes. You: Relax, I deliberately changed into sneakers before leaving.

a growing number of.context: 你在新闻里看到，现在越来越多的年轻人选择回老家创业，而不是挤在大城市。
a growing number of.translation: 朋友：最近回老家的年轻人好像越来越多了 你：对啊，越来越多人都选择回乡创业 朋友：他们是觉得大城市压力太大了吧 你：也算一种新选择，机会哪里都有 朋友：你说我要不要也回老家试试 你：想清楚就去，反正年轻不怕失败
a growing number of.example: Friend: Lately more and more young people seem to be returning home. You: Yeah, a growing number of them choose to start businesses back home. Friend: They probably feel the pressure in big cities is too much. You: It's a new option after all, since opportunities exist everywhere. Friend: Do you think I should also go back home to give it a try? You: Go once you've thought it through, youth means no fear of failure.

a hair' breadth.context: 百米冲刺你以毫厘之差输给室友，冲线后两人扶着墙大口喘气。
a hair' breadth.translation: 朋友：刚才那场赛跑我们到底谁赢了 你：我也看不清，感觉就差了一点点 朋友：回放显示你只领先我一丝丝 你：太可惜了，下次我一定要赢你 朋友：你最后那几步明显提速了 你：运气好而已，下次可就不一定了
a hair' breadth.example: Friend: Who actually won that sprint race just now? You: I can't tell either, it felt like only a tiny difference. Friend: The replay shows you beat me by just a hair's breadth. You: Such a pity, next time I really have to beat you. Friend: You clearly sped up in those last few steps there. You: Just luck, it won't necessarily be the same next time.

a halfway house to.context: 朋友刚戒赌半年，你提醒他这只是通向彻底戒断的过渡阶段，千万别松懈。
a halfway house to.translation: 朋友：我最近好像已经不怎么想赌了 你：这说明你走到彻底戒断的过渡阶段了 朋友：那我是不是就算彻底成功了 你：还早，千万别在这个节骨眼上放松 朋友：可我现在总觉得心里有点痒 你：多找点别的事做，把那念头压下去
a halfway house to.example: Friend: Lately I barely feel like gambling at all anymore. You: That means it's a halfway house to fully quitting now. Friend: Does that then mean I've already completely succeeded in quitting? You: Too early, whatever you do don't let your guard slip. Friend: But lately I keep feeling a little itch inside my heart. You: Find other things to do, and push that craving back down.

a hand.context: 朋友搬一大堆书上楼卡在楼梯口，你路过顺手帮他抬了一把。
a hand.translation: 朋友：这箱书重得我一个人根本抬不动 你：别急，我来搭把手，咱们一起搬 朋友：太谢谢你了，不然我得累瘫在楼梯上 你：小事一桩，你搬到几楼 朋友：就三楼，拐个弯就到门口了 你：行，我帮你抬这头，你注意脚下
a hand.example: Friend: This box of books is too heavy to lift by myself. You: Don't worry, let me give you a hand, we'll carry it together. Friend: Thank you so much, otherwise I'd collapse on the stairs. You: No big deal, which floor are you carrying it up to? Friend: Just the third floor, one turn and it's at the door. You: Fine, I'll lift this end, you watch carefully where you step.

a handful of.context: 你从口袋里掏出一小把糖果，分给围过来的几个小孩子。
a handful of.translation: 朋友：你兜里怎么还装着糖块啊 你：早上出门随手抓了一小把放口袋 朋友：正好，那边有几个小朋友眼巴巴看着 你：那我分给他们，小孩子肯定开心 朋友：你这包里还剩多少颗糖啊 你：就剩几颗了，分完也就没了
a handful of.example: Friend: Why do you still have candies in your pocket? You: I grabbed a handful and dropped them in my pocket this morning. Friend: Perfect, there are some kids over there staring longingly. You: Then I'll share them, the little ones will surely be happy. Friend: Roughly how many candies are left in that bag of yours? You: Just a few left, once shared there won't be any more.

a healthy body leads a healthy mind.context: 朋友天天熬夜打游戏不运动，你劝他说身体好脑子才会好使。
a healthy body leads a healthy mind.translation: 朋友：我最近总觉得背书背不进去 你：那是因为你天天熬夜又不运动 朋友：难道运动真能提高记忆力吗 你：当然，身体好脑子才会跟着好使 朋友：可我一锻炼就觉得浑身没劲 你：先从每天散步半小时开始就行
a healthy body leads a healthy mind.example: Friend: Lately I always feel I can't memorize things well. You: That's because you stay up late every day and never exercise. Friend: Can regular exercise really improve one's memory and focus then? You: Of course, a healthy body leads a healthy mind, as they say. Friend: But whenever I exercise I feel totally drained. You: Just start with a half-hour walk every day to begin.

a host of.context: 你打开招聘网站，发现上面密密麻麻挂着一大群职位，看得眼花缭乱。
a host of.translation: 朋友：你最近投简历投得怎么样了 你：招聘网站上职位多得挑都挑不过来 朋友：那你有没有看上哪家合适的 你：有几家在犹豫，还没想好面试哪家 朋友：你别挑花了眼，赶紧定一家 你：我知道，这周就把简历投出去
a host of.example: Friend: How is your job application and resume going these days? You: There's a host of openings on the site, too many to choose from. Friend: Then is there any company you've taken a liking to? You: A few are on my mind, I haven't decided which to interview. Friend: Don't get dazzled by choices, just settle on one soon. You: I know, I'll send out my resume by the end of this week.

a huge number of.context: 你回老家过节，发现村口空地上竟然聚集了一大堆等着看戏的人。
a huge number of.translation: 朋友：今天村口怎么这么热闹啊 你：听说有演出，空地上挤了一大堆人 朋友：那我们也挤进去看看演的什么 你：走，晚了可就真挤不进去了 朋友：你带个板凳吧，不然站着太累 你：不用，我们就站后面远远看一眼
a huge number of.example: Friend: Why is the village square so lively today? You: I heard there's a show, a huge number of people packed the ground. Friend: Then let's squeeze in and see what's being performed. You: Come on, later we really won't be able to push our way in. Friend: Bring a small stool, or standing gets too tiring. You: No need, we'll just stand at the back and watch from afar.

a lack of.context: 朋友写方案总被领导退回，原因是缺少数据支撑，内容显得很空。
a lack of.translation: 朋友：我的方案怎么又被领导打回来了 你：是不是里面缺少数据和案例支撑 朋友：我光顾着写想法，忘了加证据 你：难怪被退，下次记得补上数字 朋友：可我去哪里找这些行业数据呢 你：去年报和行业报告里翻一翻
a lack of.example: Friend: Why did the boss send my proposal back again? You: Is it because there's a lack of data and case support in it? Friend: I only focused on ideas, forgot to add any evidence. You: No wonder it got rejected, remember to add figures next time. Friend: But where on earth do I find this industry data? You: Go dig through annual reports and industry research papers.

a large amount of.context: 你帮朋友算账，告诉他办这种健身年卡需要一次性掏出一大笔钱。
a large amount of.translation: 朋友：我想办一张那种一年期的健身卡 你：那种卡要一次性付一大笔钱 朋友：难道不能按月慢慢付吗 你：有些店可以，但年卡算下来便宜 朋友：那边离家近，我还是办年卡吧 你：行，你先问问有没有学生折扣
a large amount of.example: Friend: I want to get one of those yearly gym memberships. You: That kind of card requires a large amount of money upfront. Friend: Can't I just pay it month by month instead? You: Some places allow it, but the yearly plan works out cheaper. Friend: That branch is near home, I'll just get the yearly one. You: Fine, first ask whether they offer a student discount.

a large number of.context: 你在超市促销日去扫货，发现货架前排着长长的一队顾客。
a large number of.translation: 朋友：今天超市打折，你买了些什么 你：一进门就看见很多人在排队 朋友：这么多人，是不是东西特别划算 你：确实便宜，我推车都差点被挤翻 朋友：那你抢到那种限量特价的牛奶没 你：抢到两箱，晚去一步就没了
a large number of.example: Friend: The supermarket's on sale today, what did you buy? You: As soon as I walked in I saw a large number of people lining up. Friend: So many people, are the deals that good then? You: Really cheap, my shopping cart almost got knocked over. Friend: Did you grab that limited special-price milk then? You: I grabbed two cases, go late and it'd already be gone.

a little bit.context: 朋友嫌你做的菜太咸，你说那我再往里面加一点点水冲淡些。
a little bit.translation: 朋友：你这汤是不是盐放得有点多了 你：是吗，那我倒一点点水进去调一调 朋友：记得别加太多，不然味道就淡了 你：放心，我一小口一小口慢慢倒 朋友：你再加点葱花点缀一下会更好看 你：行，我切一点绿葱撒在上面
a little bit.example: Friend: Did you put a bit too much salt in this soup? You: Really? Then I'll add a little bit of water to tone it down. Friend: Remember not to add too much, or the taste gets bland. You: Relax, I'll pour it in slowly, sip by sip. Friend: Add some chopped scallions to make it look nicer too. You: Okay, I'll cut some green onion and sprinkle it on top.

a long period of time.context: 你跟朋友聊起爷爷，说他退休后在乡下住了很长一段时间，身体反而更硬朗。
a long period of time.translation: 朋友：你爷爷现在身体状况还不错吧 你：挺好，他退休后在乡下住了很久 朋友：农村空气好，难怪人看着精神 你：是啊，每天种种菜遛遛弯特别舒服 朋友：那你过年打算回去陪他住几天吗 你：当然，我想在乡下好好歇一歇
a long period of time.example: Friend: Is your grandfather still in decent health these days? You: Pretty well, after retiring he lived in the countryside for a long period of time. Friend: The country air is good, no wonder he looks energetic. You: Yeah, growing vegetables and strolling every day feels lovely. Friend: Are you going back to stay with him a few days for New Year? You: Of course, I want to take a good rest out in the country.

a long way off.context: 朋友问你那场演唱会什么时候开票，你说还早呢，离演出日期远得很。
a long way off.translation: 朋友：那场热门演唱会到底什么时候开 你：官方说还有三个月，现在还远着呢 朋友：这么久，那我不得等到花都谢了 你：没事，到时候我第一时间提醒你抢票 朋友：你说会不会一票难求啊 你：肯定难抢，咱俩定好闹钟一起守
a long way off.example: Friend: When exactly does that popular concert take place? You: Official says three more months, it's still a long way off now. Friend: So long, won't I be waiting until the flowers fade? You: Don't worry, I'll remind you the moment tickets go on sale. Friend: Do you think getting a ticket will be incredibly hard? You: Definitely, let's set alarms and guard the site together.

a loss of.context: 朋友在事故中伤到了腿，你惋惜地说那场意外让他失去了行走的能力。
a loss of.translation: 朋友：他现在康复训练做得怎么样了 你：那场车祸让他失去了基本行走能力 朋友：那以后还能像正常人一样走路吗 你：医生说坚持训练，恢复还是有希望的 朋友：他自己心态现在调整过来没有 你：还在慢慢缓，需要身边人多鼓励
a loss of.example: Friend: How is he doing with his rehabilitation training? You: That car crash caused him a loss of the basic ability to walk. Friend: Will he ever be able to walk like a normal person again? You: The doctor says with steady training, recovery is still possible. Friend: Has he adjusted his own mindset by now? You: Still slowly recovering, he needs encouragement from people around.

a majority of.context: 你们公司做问卷，结果显示大多数员工都赞成灵活上下班的制度。
a majority of.translation: 朋友：你们公司这次民意调查结果出来了吗 你：大多数员工都支持弹性上下班 朋友：那领导会不会真的采纳这个建议 你：听说方案已经在拟，应该快落地了 朋友：那你以后是不是能晚点再出门 你：是啊，终于不用赶早高峰挤地铁了
a majority of.example: Friend: Have the results of your company's survey come out yet? You: A majority of employees support flexible working hours. Friend: Will the management actually adopt this suggestion then? You: I heard the plan is already being drafted, it'll roll out soon. Friend: Then will you finally be able to leave home later? You: Yeah, no more squeezing onto the subway during morning rush.

a mass of.context: 下暴雨那天，你走出地铁站，看见马路上积了一大片浑浊的水。
a mass of.translation: 朋友：那场雨下得可真是太大了 你：我出地铁站时，看见路面一大片积水 朋友：那你是怎么蹚过那段积水的 你：脱了鞋光脚走的，水快没过脚踝 朋友：你没带伞就不怕淋成落汤鸡 你：嗨，反正都要蹚水，淋就淋呗
a mass of.example: Friend: That heavy rain really poured down incredibly hard last night. You: When I left the subway, I saw a mass of water pooled on the road. Friend: Then how on earth did you manage to wade across it? You: Took off my shoes and walked barefoot, water reached my ankles. Friend: You didn't bring an umbrella, aren't you afraid of getting soaked? You: Eh, I had to wade through water anyway, so whatever.

a matter of.context: 朋友急着问事情什么时候能办成，你安慰他说这只是时间问题，迟早会好。
a matter of.translation: 朋友：那个项目到底什么时候才能批下来 你：别着急，这只是时间问题而已 朋友：我已经等了快两个月，真熬人 你：再等等，流程走完自然就有结果 朋友：万一到时候被驳回了怎么办 你：先别自己吓自己，耐心等着就好
a matter of.example: Friend: When on earth will that project finally get approved? You: Don't be anxious, it's just a matter of time. Friend: I've already waited nearly two months, it's exhausting. You: Hang in there, once the process finishes there'll naturally be a result. Friend: What if it gets rejected by then after all this wait? You: Don't scare yourself, just wait patiently and it'll be fine.

a matter of life and death.context: 你在急诊室外等消息，朋友说里面那位病人的病情已经到了生死攸关的地步。
a matter of life and death.translation: 朋友：里面那位老人的情况到底危不危险 你：医生说已经到了生死攸关的地步 朋友：那家属现在是不是都在外面守着 你：是啊，所有人的心都悬在半空 朋友：希望里面的抢救能顺顺利利 你：大家都在默默祈祷，不敢出声
a matter of life and death.example: Friend: Is the elderly patient inside actually in danger? You: The doctor says it has become a matter of life and death now. Friend: Then are all the family members waiting outside now? You: Yeah, everyone's heart is hanging in midair with worry. Friend: I hope the rescue operation inside goes smoothly. You: Everyone's silently praying, not daring to make a sound.

a matter of minutes.context: 你在家突然肚子痛，打了个电话，医生说急救车几分钟内就能赶到。
a matter of minutes.translation: 朋友：你刚才打电话叫救护车了吗 你：打了，对方说短短几分钟就能到 朋友：那你现在别乱动，躺着等他们 你：我已经把门锁打开省得耽误时间 朋友：要不要我现在打车过去陪你 你：好，你直接来医院急诊这边找我
a matter of minutes.example: Friend: Did you already call an ambulance just now on the phone? You: I did, they said it'll arrive in a matter of minutes. Friend: Then don't move around now, just lie there waiting. You: I already unlocked the door so they don't waste time. Friend: Should I take a taxi over to stay with you right now? You: Good, just come straight to the emergency room to find me.

a mean to an end.context: 朋友不理解你为什么天天加班，你说这工作只是达成目标的手段，熬过去就好。
a mean to an end.translation: 朋友：你天天这么拼命到底图个什么 你：这份工作只是我达成目标的手段 朋友：难道不是因为喜欢才干的吗 你：也算吧，主要为了攒经验跳槽 朋友：那你目标公司定好了没 你：定了一家，等资历够了就投简历
a mean to an end.example: Friend: What on earth are you working this hard for every day? You: This job is just a means to an end for me. Friend: Aren't you doing it because you actually like it? You: Sort of, mainly to build up experience before I switch jobs. Friend: Have you already settled on a target company then? You: I have, once my experience is enough I'll send my resume.

a minimum of.context: 朋友问你做这份报告要预留多少时间，你说至少得三天才能做完。
a minimum of.translation: 朋友：你写这份报告大概要多久 你：至少得三天时间才能完成 朋友：这么久，不能再压缩一下吗 你：不行，数据整理这块急不来 朋友：那我帮你分担一部分资料吧 你：好，你帮我把去年的数据先列出来
a minimum of.example: Friend: Roughly how long will you take to write this report? You: It needs a minimum of three days to finish completely. Friend: That long, can't you squeeze it down a bit more? You: No way, sorting out the data part can't be rushed. Friend: Then let me share part of the research work with you. You: Good, help me list out last year's data first of all.

a multitude of.context: 你打开衣柜，发现里面挂着一大堆款式各异的衣服，却还是觉得没衣服穿。
a multitude of.translation: 朋友：你衣柜里不是塞满了衣服吗 你：可里面很多款式我都没怎么穿过 朋友：那你怎么还总喊没衣服穿 你：感觉好看的永远是下一件 朋友：要不咱俩周末去逛街买两件 你：行，正好我想添条秋天的长裤
a multitude of.example: Friend: Isn't your wardrobe stuffed full of clothes already? You: But there's a multitude of styles inside that I barely ever wore. Friend: Then why do you always complain you have nothing to wear? You: I feel the nice one is always the next piece I see. Friend: How about we go shopping this weekend to buy a couple? You: Fine, I happen to want a pair of autumn trousers.

a new lease of life.context: 朋友大病初愈，换了个新环境休养，整个人像重获新生一样精神焕发。
a new lease of life.translation: 朋友：你出院后状态看着比以前好多了 你：对啊，搬到海边住感觉重获新生 朋友：难怪人看着气色都红润了 你：每天吹海风晒太阳，心情也开朗 朋友：那你打算在那边长住下去吗 你：先住上半年，等彻底养好了再说
a new lease of life.example: Friend: You look in much better shape since leaving the hospital. You: Yeah, moving to live by the sea feels like a new lease of life. Friend: No wonder your complexion looks rosy again now. You: Breathing sea breeze and soaking up sun daily lifts my mood. Friend: Do you plan to keep living there long-term then? You: Stay half a year first, until I've fully recovered.

a period of time.context: 朋友问你在那个城市住了多久，你说自己在那儿待了不短的一段时间。
a period of time.translation: 朋友：你大学毕业后在上海待了多久 你：前后算起来住了大概五年时间 朋友：那你对那边应该熟得不能再熟了 你：闭着眼睛都能摸到常去的面馆 朋友：你最怀念那边的什么东西 你：当然是深夜还营业的那碗小馄饨
a period of time.example: Friend: How long did you stay in Shanghai after college? You: Altogether I lived there for a period of about five years. Friend: Then you must know that place like the back of your hand. You: I can even find my usual noodle shop with my eyes closed. Friend: What do you miss most about that city of all things? You: Definitely that bowl of wontons still open late at night.

a plethora of.context: 你帮朋友选手机，发现市面上可选的型号多到泛滥，挑得人眼花缭乱。
a plethora of.translation: 朋友：现在到底买哪款手机比较好 你：市面上型号太多，看得我都乱了 朋友：总得有个相对靠谱的推荐吧 你：你预算多少，我再帮你缩小范围 朋友：我就三千块左右，别太贵 你：那我帮你挑个性价比高的国产机
a plethora of.example: Friend: Which phone model is actually better to buy now? You: There's a plethora of models on the market, it's all confusing me. Friend: There must be at least one relatively reliable choice. You: What's your budget, then I can narrow it down for you. Friend: Around three thousand, don't let it be too expensive. You: Then I'll pick you a cost-effective domestic brand phone.

a pod of.context: 你和朋友出海游玩，水面上突然跃出一群海豚，大家兴奋地指着海面叫。
a pod of.translation: 朋友：你看那边水面上跳起来的是什么 你：哇，是一群海豚正跟着船游 朋友：太难得啦，快拿手机拍下来 你：它们一会儿往左一会儿往右，追不上 朋友：导游说这片海域经常能碰到海豚 你：今天运气真好，没白出来这一趟
a pod of.example: Friend: Look, what's jumping out of the water over there? You: Wow, it's a pod of dolphins swimming alongside our boat. Friend: So rare, quickly grab your phone and take a video. You: They dart left and right, I can barely keep up filming. Friend: The guide says this sea area often encounters dolphins. You: Today's luck is amazing, this trip was totally worth it.

a raft of.context: 年底公司发福利，同事说这次给大家准备了一大串奖励，从购物卡到体检都有。
a raft of.translation: 朋友：听说今年公司年终福利特别丰厚 你：行政说这次给了一大串奖励项目 朋友：都有些什么，能透露一下吗 你：购物卡、体检券还有旅游补贴 朋友：那你打算拿这些券去哪儿玩 你：先攒着，等过年和家人一起用
a raft of.example: Friend: I heard this year's year-end perks are really generous. You: HR says they've put together a whole raft of reward items this time. Friend: What are they, can you let me in on it? You: Shopping cards, health check vouchers, plus travel subsidies. Friend: Then where do you plan to go using these coupons? You: Save them up first, I'll use them with family over New Year.

a range of.context: 你在面包店柜台前，店员向你展示店里一整套不同口味的手工面包。
a range of.translation: 朋友：这家店的面包种类看着真不少 你：柜台里摆着各种口味的手工面包 朋友：那你推荐我先尝哪一种 你：来个蒜香的吧，烤得外脆里软 朋友：那我再要一个红豆馅的当早餐 你：好，我帮你一起结账打包
a range of.example: Friend: This shop seems to have quite a few kinds of bread. You: On the counter there's a range of different flavored handcrafted loaves. Friend: Then which one do you recommend I try first? You: Get the garlic one, it's crispy outside and soft inside. Friend: Then I'll also take a red bean one for breakfast. You: Okay, I'll help you check out and pack them all together.

a ray of.context: 朋友考试发挥失常心情低落，你安慰他说这次失败里总算还有一线希望。
a ray of.translation: 朋友：这次期末我感觉自己彻底考砸了 你：别灰心，成绩里好歹有一线希望 朋友：就我这分数，还能有什么指望 你：至少英语过线了，别的再补补 朋友：可我下学期还想拿奖学金 你：那更得把这几科都赶紧补回来
a ray of.example: Friend: I feel like I totally flunked this final exam. You: Don't lose heart, there's still a ray of hope in your results. Friend: With a score like mine, what hope is left anyway? You: At least you passed English, just brush up the other subjects. Friend: But I still want to get a scholarship next semester. You: Then you really have to catch up these subjects fast.

a result of.context: 朋友问你最近气色为什么这么差，你说这阵子熬夜太多是直接原因。
a result of.translation: 朋友：你最近脸色怎么看着蜡黄蜡黄的 你：主要是这阵子天天熬夜赶工 朋友：长期这样身体迟早会抗议的 你：我也知道，等项目结束就补觉 朋友：你中午记得趴桌上眯一会儿 你：好，下午我就定个闹钟歇二十分钟
a result of.example: Friend: Why does your complexion look so sallow lately? You: It's mainly a result of pulling all-nighters these days. Friend: Your body will protest sooner or later if you keep this up. You: I know, once the project ends I'll catch up on sleep. Friend: Remember to take a nap on your desk at noon. You: Fine, I'll set an alarm this afternoon and rest twenty minutes.

a roof over our head.context: 朋友刚到大城市打拼，租住在地下室，你安慰他说好歹有个遮风挡雨的地方。
a roof over our head.translation: 朋友：刚来这边工作，房子真难找 你：慢慢看，先有个落脚的地方再说 朋友：地下室又潮又暗，住着挺憋屈 你：先落脚要紧，等稳定了再换好点 朋友：那我要不要跟人合租分摊房租 你：可以，找个靠谱室友能省不少钱
a roof over our head.example: Friend: Just starting work here, finding a place to live is really hard. You: Take your time, first get a roof over your head. Friend: The basement is damp and dark, it feels really cramped. You: Getting settled matters most, once stable you'll move nicer. Friend: Should I share a place with someone to split rent? You: That works, finding a reliable roommate saves a lot of money.

a rough ride.context: 朋友刚创业就接连受挫，你安慰他说这条路注定不好走，会经历一段坎坷。
a rough ride.translation: 朋友：公司才开张两个月就接连赔钱 你：刚开始创业难免要走一段坎坷路 朋友：照这样下去我怕是要撑不住了 你：挺住，熬过这阵子客户自然来 朋友：可我现在连工资都快发不出 你：实在不行先找点兼职周转一下
a rough ride.example: Friend: My company has been losing money for two months straight. You: Starting a business inevitably means a rough ride at first. Friend: At this rate I'm afraid I won't be able to hold on. You: Hang tough, get through this stretch and customers will come. Friend: But right now I can barely even afford to pay salaries. You: If you really must, take some part-time work to tide over.

a run for its money.context: 校队选拔赛上，一名不起眼的新生给热门选手制造了不小的竞争压力。
a run for its money.translation: 朋友：那个新来的学弟打球还真挺厉害 你：是啊，他把老将逼得够呛 朋友：看来今年的冠军要易主了 你：不好说，两人实力其实咬得很紧 朋友：你更看好他们俩谁最后夺冠 你：我押这个新生，他冲劲特别足
a run for its money.example: Friend: That new junior freshman from our school actually plays basketball very well. You: Yeah, he's giving the veteran quite a run for his money. Friend: Looks like this year's champion might change hands. You: Hard to say, the two are actually very closely matched. Friend: Who do you prefer to win the title between them two? You: I bet on this freshman, he has tons of youthful drive.

a sense of.context: 你帮朋友读完一篇散文，合上书本说自己心里涌起一种说不出的惆怅感。
a sense of.translation: 朋友：你看完这篇短文怎么眼眶红红的 你：里面写的东西让我有种淡淡的惆怅 朋友：是不是被作者的情绪感染到了 你：对，那种离乡的感觉特别真实 朋友：我也想找来读一读这篇文章 你：好，书我借给你，你慢慢看
a sense of.example: Friend: Why are your eyes red after reading this short essay? You: It gives me a real sense of melancholy for some reason. Friend: Were you infected by the writer's emotions then? You: Yeah, that feeling of leaving home is incredibly vivid. Friend: I want to read this piece myself as well. You: Fine, I'll lend you the book, take your time reading.

a sense of achievement.context: 你第一次独立完成一份完整的项目报告，交到领导手里后，心里满是成就感。
a sense of achievement.translation: 朋友：你昨天交上去的报告领导满意吗 你：挺满意的，说可以直接拿去汇报 朋友：第一次独立完成是不是特别有成就感 你：对啊，熬了几个夜总算没白费 朋友：那领导有没有给你涨点工资 你：还没提，不过我已经很满足了
a sense of achievement.example: Friend: Was the boss happy with the report you handed in yesterday? You: Pretty happy, said I could take it straight to the briefing. Friend: Doing it fully on your own must give a real sense of achievement. You: Yeah, those all-nighters finally didn't go to waste. Friend: Did the boss give you a raise for it then? You: Not mentioned yet, but I'm already quite satisfied.

a sense of calm.context: 考前大家都很慌乱，你坐在窗边深呼吸，慢慢让自己找回一种平静的感觉。
a sense of calm.translation: 朋友：马上要考试了，你怎么一点都不慌 你：我坐在窗边深呼吸，心里很平静 朋友：你是怎么做到这么淡定的 你：我告诉自己紧张也没用，不如放松 朋友：那你教教我，我现在手心全是汗 你：你闭上眼睛，慢慢把气吐出来
a sense of calm.example: Friend: The exam is starting soon, why aren't you nervous at all? You: I sat by the window breathing slowly, feeling a real sense of calm. Friend: How on earth do you stay so composed like that? You: I tell myself being anxious is useless, just relax instead. Friend: Then teach me, my palms are full of sweat now. You: Close your eyes, and slowly breathe all the air out.

a sense of control.context: 你把家里收拾得井井有条，东西各归其位，这种整齐让你有种说不出的掌控感。
a sense of control.translation: 朋友：你把房间收拾得也太干净了吧 你：东西归好位，我才觉得心里踏实 朋友：这么整齐，是不是有种掌控感 你：对啊，乱糟糟的环境会让我烦躁 朋友：那你教教我怎么整理衣柜 你：按季节分类挂起来，最好找
a sense of control.example: Friend: You've tidied your room so incredibly clean now. You: When things have their place, I feel at peace inside. Friend: Being this neat must give you a real sense of control then? You: Yeah, a messy environment just makes me irritable. Friend: Then teach me how to organize my wardrobe. You: Hang clothes by season, that makes them easiest to find.

a sense of direction.context: 你和朋友在老城区迷路，朋友抱怨说你这人怎么一点方向感都没有。
a sense of direction.translation: 朋友：你刚才不是说认得路吗，怎么走反了 你：哎呀，我这人天生就没有方向感 朋友：那你平时出门不都靠手机导航吗 你：对啊，没导航我早就绕晕了 朋友：早知道就该我来带路了 你：行行，接下来听你的，你来走
a sense of direction.example: Friend: Didn't you say you knew the way, why did we go backwards? You: Oops, I just don't have a sense of direction at all. Friend: Don't you always rely on phone navigation when you go out? You: Right, without it I'd already be hopelessly lost. Friend: I should've been the one leading us, knowing this. You: Fine, I'll follow you now, you take the lead on foot.

a sense of discipline.context: 朋友天天熬夜刷剧管不住自己，你说做任何事都得有一点自律意识。
a sense of discipline.translation: 朋友：我每天都说要早睡，结果还是刷到半夜 你：你就是缺乏一点自我约束的意识 朋友：那我该怎么养成自律的习惯呢 你：先给自己定个雷打不动的睡觉时间 朋友：可我一躺下就想玩手机怎么办 你：睡前把手机放到房间外面去
a sense of discipline.example: Friend: I say every day I'll sleep early, yet still scroll till midnight. You: You just lack a bit of a sense of discipline in you. Friend: Then how should I build up a self-disciplined habit? You: First set yourself a firm bedtime that never moves. Friend: But what if I just want to play with my phone in bed? You: Put your phone outside the bedroom before you sleep.

a sense of humour.context: 聚餐时朋友讲了个冷笑话，大家都没笑，只有你捧场说他这人特别有幽默感。
a sense of humour.translation: 朋友：我刚才讲的笑话怎么没人笑啊 你：可能是他们没get到你的幽默感 朋友：真的吗，你觉得好笑吗 你：挺好笑的，就是有点冷而已 朋友：那下次聚会我还能再讲几个 你：行，不过你得先练练怎么铺垫
a sense of humour.example: Friend: Why did nobody laugh at the joke I just told? You: Maybe they just didn't catch your sense of humor. Friend: Really? Did you actually find it funny then? You: Pretty funny, it's just a bit of a cold joke. Friend: Then can I tell a few more at the next gathering? You: Sure, but first you need to practice the setup.

a sense of identity.context: 你刚换了新工作，每天穿着职业装上班，渐渐对自己的新身份有了认同感。
a sense of identity.translation: 朋友：你穿西装上班是不是特别不自在 你：一开始是，后来慢慢有了职业身份感 朋友：你现在对这份新工作适应了吗 你：挺适应的，每天都很有干劲 朋友：看来你是真的喜欢这个新角色 你：对啊，连说话都觉得自己专业了
a sense of identity.example: Friend: Isn't wearing a suit to work really uncomfortable for you? You: At first, but gradually I gained a sense of identity now. Friend: Have you adjusted to this new job by now? You: Pretty well, I'm full of energy every single day. Friend: Seems you really love this new role then. You: Yeah, I even feel more professional the way I talk.

a sense of self.context: 朋友总问自己到底适合做什么，你劝他先想清楚，建立稳定的自我认知最重要。
a sense of self.translation: 朋友：我到现在都不知道自己适合干什么 你：你得先弄明白自己到底是谁 朋友：可我越想越觉得自己很混乱 你：慢慢来，建立自我认知需要时间 朋友：那我从哪里开始想比较好 你：先列一张你擅长和喜欢的事情清单
a sense of self.example: Friend: I still don't know what kind of work actually suits me. You: You need to figure out who you really are first of all. Friend: But the more I think, the more confused I feel. You: Take it slow, building a sense of self takes real time. Friend: Then where on earth should I start thinking? You: First make a list of the things you're good at and love.

a sense of superiority.context: 同事刚升职就处处端架子，你私下跟朋友吐槽说这人优越感也太强了。
a sense of superiority.translation: 朋友：那个刚升主管的人怎么老摆架子 你：他现在优越感强得简直压人 朋友：大家是不是都挺讨厌他这样 你：是啊，谁也不想被人居高临下对待 朋友：那他这主管还能当得久吗 你：不好说，就看他能不能改改脾气
a sense of superiority.example: Friend: Why does that newly promoted supervisor always put on airs? You: His sense of superiority is so heavy it presses people down. Friend: Does everybody secretly dislike him acting like that? You: Yeah, nobody wants to be looked down on by others. Friend: Then do you think he'll stay a supervisor long? You: Hard to say, depends on whether he can change his temper.

a series of.context: 这一年你身边接连发生了一系列喜事，朋友笑着说你最近真是鸿运当头。
a series of.translation: 朋友：你今年可真是好事一桩接一桩 你：是啊，最近一连串的喜事凑到一起 朋友：先是升职，接着又买了新房 你：对啊，运气好得我都不敢相信 朋友：你是不是偷偷去拜了什么菩萨 你：哪有，纯粹就是努力赶巧了
a series of.example: Friend: You've really had good thing after good thing this year. You: Yeah, recently a whole series of happy events lined up. Friend: First the promotion, and then you bought a new apartment. You: Right, my luck is so good I can barely believe it. Friend: Did you secretly go pray to some Bodhisattva? You: Not at all, it's purely hard work meeting timing.

a short amount of time.context: 你约朋友在楼下咖啡店见面，说只需要一小会儿，你马上就下楼。
a short amount of time.translation: 朋友：你还要多久才下楼来啊 你：很快，我一小会儿就收拾好 朋友：我已经在咖啡店门口站着了 你：再给我一点点时间，我锁个门 朋友：那你快点，外面太阳晒得很 你：马上到，最多再等两分钟
a short amount of time.example: Friend: How much longer before you come downstairs? You: Very soon, I'll be ready in a short amount of time. Friend: I'm already standing right outside the coffee shop door. You: Give me just a moment more, I'm locking the door. Friend: Then hurry up, the sun out here is really scorching. You: Almost there, wait at most another two minutes for me.

a short period of time.context: 朋友问你能在这座城市待多久，你说自己只能短暂停留，过几天就走。
a short period of time.translation: 朋友：你来这边出差能待上几天 你：只能短暂停留，三四天就走 朋友：这么短，来得及逛逛这座城吗 你：抽晚上的时间出去随便转转 朋友：那我带你去吃几家本地馆子 你：好啊，正好我还没尝过本地菜
a short period of time.example: Friend: How many days can you stay here on this business trip? You: Only for a short period of time, leaving in three or four days. Friend: That short, will you have time to tour the city? You: I'll head out in the evenings for a casual stroll. Friend: Then I'll take you to a few local restaurants. You: Great, I haven't tried the local food yet anyway.

a shot in the arm.context: 团队连续加班士气低落，老板突然宣布发奖金，这消息像一针强心剂。
a shot in the arm.translation: 朋友：最近大家加班加得都快没干劲了 你：老板昨天突然宣布要发一笔奖金 朋友：真的假的，这可是一针强心剂 你：对啊，今天办公室气氛都不一样了 朋友：那咱们接下来是不是还得继续拼 你：当然，拿了奖金更得好好干
a shot in the arm.example: Friend: Lately overtime has everyone almost out of steam. You: The boss suddenly announced yesterday we'd get a bonus. Friend: Really? That's exactly a shot in the arm for everyone. You: Yeah, the office atmosphere feels totally different today. Friend: Then do we still have to keep grinding after this? You: Of course, with a bonus we should work even harder.

a slew of.context: 你打开邮箱，发现里面一下子涌进来一大堆未读邮件，看得人头皮发麻。
a slew of.translation: 朋友：你早上打开邮箱是什么感觉 你：一晚上堆进来一大堆未读邮件 朋友：这么多，你得看到什么时候 你：先挑要紧的回，剩下的慢慢处理 朋友：要不要我帮你分担几封 你：好，那封客户的邮件就拜托你了
a slew of.example: Friend: How did you feel opening your inbox this morning? You: A whole slew of unread emails piled up overnight. Friend: That many, how long will it take you to read them? You: Answer the urgent ones first, handle the rest slowly. Friend: Should I help you share a few of them? You: Good, then I'll leave that client email to you.

a small amount of.context: 你冲咖啡时朋友提醒你，这种豆子味道浓，每次只放一点点就够了。
a small amount of.translation: 朋友：你这咖啡是不是放太多粉了 你：是吗，那我倒掉一点重新冲 朋友：这种豆子味道重，少放些就好 你：那我每次大概放多少合适 朋友：就一小勺，刚好冲出一杯 你：行，我下次就按这个量来
a small amount of.example: Friend: Didn't you put too much powder in this coffee? You: Really? Then I'll pour some out and brew it again. Friend: These beans are strong, only use a small amount. You: So roughly how much should I use each time then? Friend: Just one small scoop, it'll brew a perfect cup. You: Fine, next time I'll stick to exactly this amount.

a small number of.context: 班级投票选代表，结果只有少数几个同学投了赞成票，大部分人都弃权了。
a small number of.translation: 朋友：这次班干部选举结果出来了吗 你：只有少数几个同学投了赞成票 朋友：怎么会这么少，大家都不关心吗 你：很多人觉得谁当都一样，就弃权了 朋友：那当选的人票数够不够 你：刚过最低要求，勉强算通过
a small number of.example: Friend: Have the results of the class election come out yet? You: Only a small number of students voted in favor. Friend: How could that be so few, is nobody interested? You: Many think it's all the same whoever wins, so they abstained. Friend: Did the winner even reach enough votes then? You: Just passed the minimum requirement, barely approved.

a spate of.context: 这个月城里接连发生了一连串盗窃案，派出所门口贴出了提醒居民防盗的告示。
a spate of.translation: 朋友：最近小区门口怎么贴了防盗告示 你：听说这一片接连发生了好几起盗窃 朋友：那咱们平时出门可得把门锁好 你：对啊，我最近都开始反锁两道门 朋友：要不要也装个家用的监控摄像头 你：好主意，回头我研究一下款式
a spate of.example: Friend: Why is there a theft-prevention notice at the gate lately? You: I heard a spate of burglaries happened around this area. Friend: Then we really need to lock the door well when we go out. You: Yeah, I've started double-locking my door recently too. Friend: Should we also install a home security camera? You: Great idea, I'll look into the models later.

a tall story.context: 朋友绘声绘色地讲他在路上遇到的奇遇，你听了半天觉得这故事夸大其词。
a tall story.translation: 朋友：我昨天在路上碰见一件特别神奇的事 你：你先说说看，我怎么觉得像编的 朋友：真的，我亲眼看见一只狗会开门 你：这故事也太夸张了，谁信啊 朋友：你怎么老觉得我在吹牛 你：不是，是你讲得太像假故事了
a tall story.example: Friend: I ran into something truly amazing on the road yesterday. You: Tell me first, why does it sound made up to me? You: Seriously, I saw a dog open the door with my own eyes. Friend: This story is such a tall story, who'd believe it? You: Why do you always think I'm bragging then? Friend: No, it's just that your story sounds too fake.

a tempting array of.context: 你推开甜品店的玻璃门，柜台里琳琅满目地摆着几十种诱人的小蛋糕。
a tempting array of.translation: 朋友：这家甜品店看着装修挺高级的 你：柜台里摆着琳琅满目的小蛋糕 朋友：这么多花样，我都不知道选哪个 你：那款草莓的卖得最好，你试试 朋友：那我再来一杯配茶的饮料 你：好，我帮你一起点单结账
a tempting array of.example: Friend: This dessert shop looks quite fancy in its decor. You: Inside the counter is a tempting array of little cakes. Friend: So many choices, I don't know which one to pick. You: That strawberry one sells best, give it a try. Friend: Then I'll also get a drink to go with the tea. You: Fine, I'll help you order and pay the bill together.

a thing of the past.context: 你跟朋友聊起小时候用的传呼机，感慨说这种东西早就成了过去时。
a thing of the past.translation: 朋友：你还记得咱们小时候用的传呼机吗 你：当然，那玩意儿现在早成了过去的东西 朋友：现在谁还会带个传呼机出门啊 你：早就被智能手机彻底取代了 朋友：你抽屉里还留着那台旧机子吗 你：留着呢，就当是个童年的纪念
a thing of the past.example: Friend: Do you still remember the pagers we used as kids? You: Of course, that thing is long a thing of the past now. Friend: Who on earth would still carry a pager out today? You: It's been completely replaced by smartphones long ago. Friend: Do you still keep that old device in your drawer? You: I do, just as a little souvenir of my childhood.

a ton of.context: 朋友帮了你一个大忙，你连连道谢，说这次可真是欠了对方一大堆人情。
a ton of.translation: 朋友：这点小事你还特意跑一趟 你：你帮我这么大的忙，我得好好谢你 朋友：咱俩之间还谈什么谢不谢的 你：那我可就欠了你一大份人情 朋友：下次我有事找你帮忙就行 你：一言为定，你随时打电话给我
a ton of.example: Friend: You even made a special trip for such a small thing. You: You did me such a huge favor, I must thank you properly. Friend: Between us two, why talk about thanks at all? You: Then I really owe you a whole ton of favors. Friend: Next time I need your help, just call it even. You: Deal, I'll come whenever you call me.

a trail of.context: 小偷偷完东西仓皇逃窜，身后留下一串凌乱的脚印，警察顺着脚印追了上去。
a trail of.translation: 朋友：昨晚小区进了小偷你知道吗 你：听说了，现场还留下一串脚印 朋友：警察是不是顺着脚印在追 你：对啊，一路追到了小区后门 朋友：那最后那个贼抓到了没有 你：还没，不过脚印没断，肯定跑不远
a trail of.example: Friend: Did you know a burglar broke into the compound last night? You: I heard, there was a trail of footprints left at the scene. Friend: Did the police follow the footprints to chase him? You: Yeah, they chased all the way to the back gate. Friend: Then did they catch the guy in the end? You: Not yet, but the trail isn't broken, he can't be far.

a trip down memory lane.context: 你翻旧相册，看到小学毕业照，忍不住拉着朋友一起坐下来重温往事。
a trip down memory lane.translation: 朋友：你手里那本旧相册里都是什么 你：都是我从小到大拍的老照片 朋友：翻着这些是不是特别怀旧 你：对啊，一下子回到了小时候 朋友：你看这张，你小时候可真胖 你：别笑，那时候谁还没点婴儿肥
a trip down memory lane.example: Friend: What's all in that old photo album in your hands? You: They're all old photos of me growing up. Friend: Looking through these must be a real trip down memory lane. You: Yeah, I'm suddenly back in my childhood again. Friend: Look at this one, you were really chubby as a kid. You: Don't laugh, everyone had some baby fat back then.

a vast majority of.context: 部门投票要不要弹性工作制，结果绝大多数同事都举手赞成，领导只好同意。
a vast majority of.translation: 朋友：你们部门这次投票结果怎么样 你：绝大多数同事都赞成弹性上班 朋友：领导最后松口同意了吗 你：反对的人太少，他只好顺水推舟 朋友：那你以后是不是就能晚起了 你：对啊，再也不用赶早高峰了
a vast majority of.example: Friend: How did the vote turn out in your department this time? You: A vast majority of colleagues supported flexible hours. Friend: Did the boss finally relent and agree then? You: Too few opposed it, so he just went along with it. Friend: Then can you finally sleep in from now on? You: Yeah, no more rushing through the morning rush hour.

a wad of.context: 发工资那天，同事从信封里掏出一沓厚厚的现金，啪的一声拍在桌上。
a wad of.translation: 朋友：你们公司还发现金工资啊 你：对啊，今天刚发了一沓现金 朋友：这么厚一沓，看着真过瘾 你：可惜到手没捂热就要还房贷 朋友：那你这个月还能存下钱吗 你：够呛，扣完房租就剩不下多少
a wad of.example: Friend: Does your company still pay wages in cash? You: Yeah, just got a thick wad of cash today. Friend: Such a thick wad, it looks really satisfying. You: Sadly it barely warms my hand before the mortgage. Friend: Then can you still save some money this month? You: Hardly, after rent there's not much left over.

a wealth of.context: 你请教一位老教授，他的书房里藏着丰富的藏书和一辈子攒下的经验。
a wealth of.translation: 朋友：你今天去拜访那位老教授收获大吗 你：很大，他书房里满是珍贵的藏书 朋友：那么多书他都一本本读完了吗 你：差不多，他肚子里藏着丰富的学问 朋友：那你以后是不是得多去请教 你：好，我打算每周去他那儿坐一会儿
a wealth of.example: Friend: Was your visit to that old professor rewarding today? You: Very, his study is packed with a wealth of precious books. Friend: Has he actually read all of those books? You: Mostly, his mind holds a wealth of lifelong knowledge. Friend: Then shouldn't you go consult him more often? You: Good, I plan to sit with him for a while every week.

a whole host of.context: 你帮朋友挑生日礼物，发现那家文具店竟然有大量新奇的小玩意。
a whole host of.translation: 朋友：你想好送朋友什么生日礼物了吗 你：还没，我在文具店里挑花了眼 朋友：那家店是不是东西特别多 你：对啊，里面有大量新奇的小物件 朋友：那你看没看中哪个特别的 你：有支钢笔不错，做工挺精致的
a whole host of.example: Friend: Have you decided what birthday gift to give your friend? You: Not yet, I'm dazzled choosing in the stationery shop. Friend: Does that shop have an especially large amount of stuff? You: Yeah, there's a whole host of novel little items inside. Friend: Then did you spot anything special you liked? You: There's a nice fountain pen, quite finely made.

a whole lot of.context: 朋友来你家借宿一晚，发现你衣柜里堆了一大堆从没穿过的新衣服。
a whole lot of.translation: 朋友：你衣柜里怎么塞了这么多衣服 你：都是之前冲动消费买回来的 朋友：这一大堆你到底穿过几件 你：大部分连吊牌都没来得及剪 朋友：那你下次可别再乱买了 你：知道了，我打算先把旧的穿完
a whole lot of.example: Friend: Why is your wardrobe stuffed with so many clothes? You: They're all impulse buys I brought back before. Friend: How many of this whole lot have you actually worn? You: Most still haven't even had their tags cut off. Friend: Then don't go buying randomly next time. You: I know, I plan to finish wearing the old ones first.

a whole range of.context: 你帮朋友配电脑，说这款主板支持一整套不同型号的处理器，选择很灵活。
a whole range of.translation: 朋友：我想自己装一台新电脑 你：那你得先选一块兼容性好的主板 朋友：这款主板支持哪些处理器 你：它能搭配一整套不同型号的芯片 朋友：那我以后想升级也方便了 你：对啊，这个平台扩展性挺强的
a whole range of.example: Friend: I want to build a brand new computer myself. You: Then you should pick a motherboard with good compatibility. Friend: Which processors does this motherboard support? You: It pairs with a whole range of different chip models. Friend: Then it'll be convenient when I want to upgrade. You: Exactly, this platform is quite strong on expandability.

a wide number of.context: 你去人才市场转了一圈，发现招聘墙上贴着大量的岗位，看得人眼花缭乱。
a wide number of.translation: 朋友：今天人才市场人是不是特别多 你：招聘墙上贴了一大把岗位信息 朋友：这么多，你有没有看中哪家 你：有几家公司看着还挺靠谱 朋友：那你赶紧投简历别拖着 你：行，我今晚就把简历改好发出去
a wide number of.example: Friend: Is the job market especially crowded today? You: A wide number of job postings line the recruitment wall. Friend: That many, is there any company you took a liking to? You: A few of the companies look fairly reliable. Friend: Then send your resume quickly, don't put it off. You: Fine, I'll polish and send my resume tonight.

a wide range of.context: 你帮朋友选相机，说现在市面上有多种多样的机型，按预算挑就行。
a wide range of.translation: 朋友：我想买台相机，完全不懂怎么选 你：现在市面上机型多种多样 朋友：那我这种新手该从哪里看起 你：先定预算，再按用途去挑 朋友：我就平时拍拍照记录生活 你：那选个微单，轻便又够用
a wide range of.example: Friend: I want to buy a camera, totally clueless how to choose. You: There's a wide range of models on the market now. Friend: Then where should a beginner like me start looking? You: First set your budget, then choose by your use. Friend: I just take photos in daily life to record moments. You: Then pick a mirrorless, light and good enough.

a wide selection of.context: 你带朋友去逛大型超市的进口零食区，发现货架上选择特别丰富。
a wide selection of.translation: 朋友：这家超市的零食区东西真多 你：进口货架上摆着丰富的各国零食 朋友：我都没见过这么多国外牌子 你：是啊，选择多到让人挑花眼 朋友：那你推荐我先尝尝哪一款 你：那个泰国的椰子片，挺好吃的
a wide selection of.example: Friend: This supermarket's snack section has so much stuff. You: On the imported shelf is a wide selection of snacks. Friend: I've never seen this many foreign brands before. You: Yeah, there are so many choices it dazzles you. Friend: Then which one do you recommend I try? You: That Thai coconut chip, it's pretty tasty.

a wide variety of.context: 学校社团招新那天，操场上摆着多种多样的摊位，新生们看得目不暇接。
a wide variety of.translation: 朋友：今天社团招新你逛得怎么样 你：操场上摆着多种多样的摊位 朋友：这么多社团，你报了哪个 你：我报了摄影社，还有个话剧社 朋友：你同时报两个忙得过来吗 你：先都试试，不合适再退掉
a wide variety of.example: Friend: How was the club recruitment fair you toured today? You: On the playground are a wide variety of booths. Friend: So many clubs, which one did you sign up for? You: I joined the photography club, plus a drama club. Friend: Can you handle two clubs at the same time? You: Try both first, quit whichever doesn't fit.

a wider range of.context: 你打算换个工作方向，朋友劝你最好把求职范围放得更宽一些，别只盯一家。
a wider range of.translation: 朋友：你最近找工作只盯着这一家吗 你：对啊，我特别想去他们家 朋友：别死磕一家，范围放宽一点 你：可我就喜欢他们家的氛围 你：但多投几家，机会总会多一些 你：行，那我再看看别的公司
a wider range of.example: Friend: Are you only focusing on this one company for work? You: Yeah, I really want to join their firm specifically. Friend: Don't fixate on one, cast a wider range of options. You: But I just love the atmosphere at their place. Friend: But applying to more firms means more chances overall. You: Fine, then I'll also look at other companies.

a&e department.context: 你晚上突然肚子剧痛，朋友连夜把你送到医院的急诊室挂号看病。
a&e department.translation: 朋友：你脸色这么难看，到底哪里疼 你：我肚子突然一阵一阵地绞痛 朋友：那我赶紧送你去医院挂急诊 你：好，你扶着我点，我走不动 朋友：到了，这边就是急诊室 你：麻烦你帮我先去挂号排队
a&e department.example: Friend: You look so pale, where exactly does it hurt? You: My stomach is suddenly cramping in waves. Friend: Then I'll rush you to the emergency department right now. You: Good, hold me up, I can barely walk. Friend: We're here, this is the A&E department over here. You: Please help me go register and queue first.

ability to perform.context: 教练说你最近体能不错，赛场上的运动表现明显比上赛季强了。
ability to perform.translation: 朋友：你最近打球怎么状态这么好 你：我练了一个冬天的体能和力量 朋友：难怪你场上表现比以前强 你：对啊，现在跑全场都不怎么喘 朋友：那你下一场比赛有信心赢吗 你：有信心，我现在状态正好
ability to perform.example: Friend: Why are you playing so well these days? You: I trained strength and endurance all winter long. Friend: No wonder your ability to perform on court improved. You: Yeah, now I barely huff running the whole court. Friend: Then are you confident of winning the next game? You: Yeah, I feel my form is just right now.

absence of.context: 朋友问你为什么没去成聚会，你说因为缺少一个靠谱的伴儿，就懒得动身了。
absence of.translation: 朋友：昨晚聚会你怎么没来啊 你：因为没人陪我，我就懒得去了 朋友：你一个人去不也一样吗 你：一个人去我总觉得不自在 朋友：那下次聚会我就陪你一起去 你：好，有你陪着我就不害怕了
absence of.example: Friend: Why didn't you come to the gathering last night? You: In the absence of a companion, I just couldn't be bothered. Friend: Wouldn't it be the same if you went alone? You: I always feel uneasy going by myself. Friend: Then next time I'll go with you together. You: Great, with you by my side I won't feel scared.

absorb content.context: 老师讲课节奏太快，你坐在台下觉得一节课下来根本吸收不了多少内容。
absorb content.translation: 朋友：今天这节课你听得明白吗 你：老师讲得太快，我根本消化不了 朋友：你是不是没提前预习课文 你：预习了，可还是跟不上节奏 朋友：那下课我把笔记借你抄 你：好，我抄完再慢慢琢磨
absorb content.example: Friend: Did you understand today's lecture well? You: The teacher spoke too fast, I can't absorb the content. Friend: Didn't you preview the text before class? You: I did preview, but I still can't keep up the pace. Friend: Then I'll lend you my notes after class to copy. You: Fine, I'll copy them and slowly figure it out.

absorb knowledge.context: 你小时候读书过目不忘，老师夸你天生就会轻松吸收各种知识。
absorb knowledge.translation: 朋友：你上学的时候成绩怎么那么好 你：我从小就比较容易记住东西 朋友：是不是你上课特别认真听讲 你：主要是我吸收知识比较快 朋友：那你有什么学习窍门教教我 你：多联想，把新知识和旧的串起来
absorb knowledge.example: Friend: How were your grades so good back in school? You: I've always been relatively quick at memorizing things. Friend: Was it mainly because you listened intently in class? You: Mostly I absorb knowledge quite easily and fast. Friend: Then teach me some study tricks, please. You: Associate a lot, link new knowledge with old.

abstain from.context: 体检报告说血脂偏高，医生劝你在接下来的几个月里彻底戒掉油炸食品。
abstain from.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么都不点炸鸡了 你：医生让我这段时间远离油炸食品 朋友：那你以前可是无炸鸡不欢啊 你：没办法，血脂高得吓人 朋友：那平时嘴馋的时候怎么办 你：就啃点水果，慢慢熬过去
abstain from.example: Friend: Why don't you order fried chicken these days? You: The doctor told me to abstain from fried food for a while. Friend: But you used to love fried chicken more than anything. You: No choice, my cholesterol is alarmingly high. Friend: Then what do you do when a craving hits? You: Just munch some fruit and tough it out slowly.

abundant with.context: 你去南方小城旅游，发现当地依山傍水，处处充满了灵秀的自然风光。
abundant with.translation: 朋友：你这次去南方玩得开心吗 你：那地方山清水秀，满是好风景 朋友：是不是空气也特别清新 你：对啊，走到哪儿都是满眼绿意 朋友：那这一趟你拍了多少张照片 你：内存卡都拍满了，舍不得删
abundant with.example: Friend: Did you enjoy your trip to the south this time? You: That place is abundant with lovely scenery and clear waters. Friend: Is the air especially fresh there too? You: Yeah, everywhere you go your eyes are full of green. Friend: Then how many photos did you take? You: My memory card is full, I can't bear to delete any.

abuse the system.context: 你发现有人钻公司报销的空子，把私人消费也拿来走公账，这种行为就是滥用制度。
abuse the system.translation: 朋友：最近公司是不是在查报销问题 你：对啊，有人把私人消费也拿来报销 朋友：这种钻空子的行为也太过分了 你：就是滥用制度，早晚要被查 朋友：那你平时报销可千万别乱报 你：放心，我每一笔都留好票据
abuse the system.example: Friend: Is the company auditing expense reports lately? You: Yeah, someone claimed private purchases on company costs. Friend: Exploiting loopholes like that is truly outrageous. You: That's abusing the system, they'll be caught sooner or later. Friend: Then you must never fudge your own reimbursements. You: Relax, I keep receipts for every single expense.

academic benefits.context: 孩子报了课外兴趣班，你跟朋友聊起，说长期坚持能带来不少学业上的好处。
academic benefits.translation: 朋友：你给孩子报那么多兴趣班有用吗 你：长期坚持下来对学业是有好处的 朋友：可孩子天天上课不也挺累的 你：学一门特长，对升学也有帮助 朋友：那他自己喜欢这些班吗 你：他喜欢画画，报这个不后悔
academic benefits.example: Friend: Is signing your kid up for so many hobby classes useful? You: Keeping it up long term brings clear academic benefits. Friend: But isn't the kid tired with classes every day? You: Learning a specialty also helps with school admissions. Friend: Does he even like these classes himself? You: He loves drawing, no regrets signing him up.

academic discipline.context: 你跟朋友聊大学专业，说哲学这门学科不仅教知识，还特别锻炼人的治学自律。
academic discipline.translation: 朋友：你大学读的到底是什么专业 你：我读的是哲学，一门挺古老的学科 朋友：这专业毕业能做什么工作啊 你：不一定对口，主要锻炼思维和自律 朋友：那你觉得读这个后悔吗 你：不后悔，它让我做事更有条理
academic discipline.example: Friend: What major did you actually study in college? You: I studied philosophy, quite an old academic discipline. Friend: What kind of jobs can this major even lead to? You: Not necessarily matching, it mainly trains thinking and discipline. Friend: Then do you regret studying it? You: No regrets, it made me far more organized.

academic failure.context: 你表弟高考发挥失常没能考上理想的大学，家里人一起安慰他说一次失利不代表全盘失败。
academic failure.translation: 朋友：你表弟今年高考考得怎么样 你：不太理想，没考上想去的学校 朋友：那他现在情绪是不是很低落 你：挺受打击的，觉得自己学业失败 朋友：你得好好去开导开导他才行 你：嗯，我打算陪他出去散散心
academic failure.example: Friend: How did your cousin do on the college exam this year? You: Not ideal, he didn't get into the school he wanted. Friend: Is he feeling really down right then? You: Pretty crushed, feels like an academic failure. Friend: You really need to talk him through it. You: Yeah, I plan to take him out to unwind.

academic life.context: 你跟朋友回忆大学时光，说那几年是你整个学术生涯里最自由的一段。
academic life.translation: 朋友：你大学时候是不是特别爱泡图书馆 你：对啊，那几年是我最自由的时光 朋友：现在回想起来是不是挺怀念 你：特别怀念，学术生涯里就数那会儿轻松 朋友：那你有没有后悔没好好读书 你：有点，早知道就多去听几堂课
academic life.example: Friend: Did you love hanging in the library back in college? You: Yeah, those years were my freest time of all. Friend: Do you feel nostalgic looking back now? You: Very, it was the most relaxed stretch of academic life. Friend: Then do you regret not studying harder? You: A bit, I wish I'd attended more lectures.

academic performance.context: 期末成绩出来，老师在家长会上重点表扬了你孩子这学期的学业进步。
academic performance.translation: 朋友：这次期末家长会你去了吗 你：去了，老师专门夸了我孩子的成绩 朋友：他这学期是不是特别用功 你：对啊，学业成绩比上学期进步很大 朋友：那你有没有奖励奖励他 你：有，答应带他去游乐园玩一天
academic performance.example: Friend: Did you go to the parent-teacher meeting this time? You: I went, the teacher specifically praised my kid's grades. Friend: Was he especially hardworking this semester? You: Yeah, his academic performance improved a lot over last term. Friend: Then did you reward him for it? You: I did, promised a full day at the amusement park.

academic success.context: 你侄子从小到大奖状拿到手软，亲戚们都说这孩子将来必定学业有成。
academic success.translation: 朋友：你侄子是不是年年拿三好学生 你：对啊，从小到大成绩一直拔尖 朋友：大家都夸他将来学业有成 你：他自己也挺争气，不用人催 朋友：那他有没有什么学习秘诀 你：没什么秘诀，就是坐得住静得下心
academic success.example: Friend: Does your nephew get an award every single year? You: Yeah, top of the grades all the way growing up. Friend: Everyone says he's bound for academic success. You: He's driven too, never needs pushing. Friend: Does he have any secret study trick? You: None, he just can sit still and focus deeply.

academic workload.context: 期末月作业论文扎堆，你跟朋友吐槽说这学期的课业负担实在太重了。
academic workload.translation: 朋友：最近你怎么天天熬到半夜 你：作业论文一大堆，课业负担太重 朋友：那你分得清轻重缓急吗 你：先赶deadline紧的，松的往后排 朋友：你可别把身体给累垮了 你：我知道，撑过这两周就好了
academic workload.example: Friend: Why have you been staying up till midnight lately? You: Loads of essays, the academic workload is crushing. Friend: Can you tell what's urgent vs important? You: Do the tight-deadline ones first, push loose ones back. Friend: Don't burn your body out. You: I know, once I survive these two weeks it's fine.

accelerated ageing.context: 你帮朋友看他那辆老车，说这车常年暴晒，漆面已经出现了过早老化的迹象。
accelerated ageing.translation: 朋友：我这车怎么漆面一块块发暗 你：你常年停在太阳下，加速老化了 朋友：那还有救吗，能不能翻新 你：抛个光能好点，但治标不治本 朋友：那我以后是不是得找个车库 你：对，有遮挡车漆能多撑几年
accelerated ageing.example: Friend: Why is my car's paint going dark in patches? You: You park it in the sun year round, it's accelerated ageing. Friend: Is it still salvageable, can it be restored? You: A polish helps a bit, but only treats symptoms. Friend: Then should I find a garage from now on? You: Yeah, shelter makes the paint last a few more years.

acceptance speech.context: 你在颁奖晚会上接过奖杯，站在话筒前，发表了一段真挚动人的获奖感言。
acceptance speech.translation: 朋友：你今晚上台是不是特别紧张 你：站在话筒前我手心全是汗 朋友：那你的获奖感言是提前准备的吗 你：对啊，我在家对着镜子练了好几遍 朋友：那你临场的时候有没有忘词 你：还好，一句都没卡住，挺顺利
acceptance speech.example: Friend: Were you especially nervous going on stage tonight? You: My palms were all sweaty standing before the mic. Friend: Was your acceptance speech prepared in advance? You: Yeah, I practiced it in front of the mirror at home. Friend: Did you blank out on stage in the end? You: Thankfully, not a single line stumbled, quite smooth.

accident statistic.context: 你在做交通安全报告，引用了最新发布的一组交通事故统计数据，提醒大家注意出行安全。
accident statistic.translation: 朋友：你今天做的交通安全报告挺专业 你：我查了最新的一组事故数据 朋友：这些数字看着是不是挺吓人 你：对啊，超速导致的事故特别多 朋友：那你最后有没有给大家提建议 你：有，提醒大家开车一定别抢速度
accident statistic.example: Friend: Your traffic safety report today was quite professional. You: I looked up a fresh accident statistic from the latest release. Friend: Aren't these numbers actually quite scary? You: Yeah, speeding causes an especially large number of crashes. Friend: Then did you give everyone advice at the end? You: Yes, I reminded everyone never to rush while driving.

accommodation cost.context: 你帮朋友算这趟旅行的总账，光住宿费就占了预算的一大半。
accommodation cost.translation: 朋友：这趟旅行你一共花了多少钱 你：连吃带住，住宿占了大头 朋友：住宿费用怎么这么高啊 你：旺季酒店都涨价，没办法 朋友：那下次是不是该提前订房 你：对，提前订能便宜不少
accommodation cost.example: Friend: How much did you spend in total on this trip? You: Including food and lodging, accommodation cost took the most. Friend: Why is the accommodation cost so high? You: Hotels hike prices in peak season, no way around it. Friend: Then should we book rooms in advance next time? You: Yeah, booking early saves quite a lot.

accompanied by.context: 你去参加朋友的婚礼，新郎挽着新娘，身后跟着一长串捧着花的花童。
accompanied by.translation: 朋友：今天婚礼现场布置得真漂亮 你：新娘挽着新郎，身后跟着花童 朋友：那场面是不是特别感人 你：对啊，看得我都差点掉眼泪 朋友：你有没有拍下那一瞬间 你：拍了，回头我发照片给你
accompanied by.example: Friend: The wedding scene today was really beautifully done. You: The groom, accompanied by the bride, walked in with flower girls. Friend: Was that scene especially moving? You: Yeah, it almost made me shed a tear. Friend: Did you capture that exact moment? You: I did, I'll send you the photos later.

accord with.context: 你做的实验结果和老师之前讲的理论完全对不上，朋友问这是不是不符合预期。
accord with.translation: 朋友：你这次实验结果出来了吗 你：出来了，可和理论完全对不上 朋友：那这结果和课本一致吗 你：根本不一致，差得还挺远 朋友：那你要不要重新做一遍 你：要，我怀疑是仪器没校准
accord with.example: Friend: Did your experiment results come out this time? You: They did, but they don't match the theory at all. Friend: Do these results accord with the textbook? You: Not at all, the gap is actually quite large. Friend: Then should you do it all over again? You: Yeah, I suspect the instrument wasn't calibrated.

accounts for.context: 你在做一份市场报告，分析线上销量在整体营收里到底占了多大比例。
accounts for.translation: 朋友：你这份销售报告写完了吗 你：快了，正分析各渠道占比 朋友：线上渠道占了多少份额 你：线上销量占了总营收的一半 朋友：那线下是不是越来越不行 你：对，这两年线下下滑很明显
accounts for.example: Friend: Have you finished that sales report yet? You: Almost, I'm analyzing each channel's share now. Friend: What share does the online channel make up? You: Online sales accounts for half the total revenue. Friend: Then is offline gradually becoming weaker? You: Yeah, offline has slid noticeably these two years.

accused of.context: 新闻里说那位高管被公司指控财务造假，一时间闹得满城风雨。
accused of.translation: 朋友：你看新闻里那个高管出事了吗 你：看了，他被指控财务造假 朋友：到底是真的还是有人诬陷他 你：公司已经正式发了公告 朋友：那他会不会因此丢掉饭碗 你：大概率会，事情闹得这么大
accused of.example: Friend: Did you see that executive in the news got into trouble? You: I saw, he's been accused of financial fraud. Friend: Is it actually true or did someone frame him? You: The company already issued a formal statement. Friend: Will he lose his job over this then? You: Most likely, the whole thing blew up so big.

ache and pain.context: 你搬了一整天家具，晚上躺下来，浑身关节酸痛，哪里都不得劲。
ache and pain.translation: 朋友：你今天搬了一天家，累坏了吧 你：躺下之后浑身酸痛，哪儿都不得劲 朋友：你是不是肌肉不小心拉伤了 你：不是，就是干重活累的 朋友：那你泡泡热水澡放松一下 你：好，我等会儿就去泡个澡
ache and pain.example: Friend: You moved house all day today, exhausted right? You: Lying down, I feel every ache and pain all over. Friend: Did you strain a muscle or something? You: No, just worn out from heavy work. Friend: Then take a hot bath to relax yourself. You: Good, I'll go soak in a tub in a bit.

aches and pains.context: 你陪老人去医院做体检，老人总抱怨说上了年纪，浑身这里那里都是小毛病。
aches and pains.translation: 朋友：你爷爷今天体检结果怎么样 你：没啥大病，就是浑身有些小酸痛 朋友：那老年人是不是都这个样子 你：对啊，各种小毛病不断 朋友：那平时让他多走动走动 你：嗯，我陪他每天在小区散步
aches and pains.example: Friend: How was your grandfather's checkup today? You: Nothing serious, just some aches and pains all over. Friend: Is this how all elderly people are? You: Yeah, all sorts of little ailments keep popping up. Friend: Then get him to move around more daily. You: Yeah, I walk with him around the compound daily.

achilles heel.context: 朋友打球几乎全能，可他一到关键比赛就紧张，这成了他致命的软肋。
achilles heel.translation: 朋友：你那朋友打球不是挺厉害的吗 你：他技术没话说，就是心理素质差 朋友：一到决赛他是不是就容易掉链子 你：对啊，紧张是他最大的致命弱点 朋友：那他平时练过心理素质吗 你：练过，可一到正式比赛还是垮掉
achilles heel.example: Friend: Isn't your friend quite good at playing ball? You: His technique is flawless, but his mentality is weak. Friend: Does he easily choke whenever it reaches a final? You: Right, nervousness is his real Achilles heel. Friend: Has he ever trained his mental toughness then? You: He has, yet he still falls apart in real matches.

acquire skill.context: 你刚入职跟着老师傅学手艺，半年下来总算掌握了一门能傍身的技能。
acquire skill.translation: 朋友：你这半年在新公司学得怎么样 你：跟着师傅，我总算学会一门手艺 朋友：掌握一门新技能是不是挺有成就感 你：对啊，现在独立干活也不慌了 朋友：那你打算接下来再学点儿什么 你：我想再学点编程，多一条出路
acquire skill.example: Friend: How have you been doing at the new company these six months? You: Following the master, I finally managed to acquire a skill. Friend: Acquiring a brand new skill feels quite rewarding, right? You: Yeah, now I don't panic working on my own either. Friend: Then what do you plan to learn next? You: I want to pick up some coding, giving myself another way out.

acquired taste.context: 朋友第一次尝臭豆腐皱眉头，你笑着说这东西属于后天养成的口味，吃几次就爱上了。
acquired taste.translation: 朋友：这臭豆腐闻着臭，吃着更怪 你：你第一次吃肯定不习惯 朋友：怎么会有人爱吃这种东西 你：这是后天养成的口味，多吃几次就爱上 朋友：那我再硬着头皮尝一小口 你：行，吃完你可能就真香了
acquired taste.example: Friend: This stinky tofu smells foul, and tastes even weirder. You: You definitely won't be used to it on your first try. Friend: How can anyone actually love eating this stuff? You: It's an acquired taste, eat it a few times and you'll fall for it. Friend: Then I'll force myself to take another tiny bite. You: Go on, after eating it you might just suddenly love it.

across the globe.context: 你跟朋友聊起那款热门游戏，说它的玩家遍布全球，连国外主播都在直播。
across the globe.translation: 朋友：你最近总玩的那款游戏有多少人 你：玩家遍布全球，哪儿都能碰到 朋友：这么火，国外也有人玩吗 你：对啊，世界各地都有主播在直播 朋友：那它靠什么吸引这么多人 你：玩法新颖，还支持全球联机
across the globe.example: Friend: Roughly how many players does that game you play have? You: Players are spread across the globe, you meet them everywhere. Friend: So popular, do people abroad play it too? You: Yeah, streamers across the globe are broadcasting it live. Friend: Then what makes it attract so many people? You: Novel gameplay, plus it supports worldwide online play.

act out.context: 话剧社排演一幕吵架戏，演员们把剧本里的情绪活生生表演出来，导演连连点头。
act out.translation: 朋友：你们话剧社这礼拜排得怎么样 你：正在排一幕吵架的重头戏 朋友：演员们能把情绪真的演出来吗 你：可以，他们演得特别投入 朋友：导演看完有没有拍手叫好 你：有，说这一段演得特别到位
act out.example: Friend: How is your drama club's rehearsal going this week? You: We're rehearsing a big argument scene right now. Friend: Can the actors actually act out the emotions truly? You: They can, they perform with total dedication. Friend: Did the director applaud after watching it? You: Yes, he said this bit was acted out really well.

action figure.context: 你侄子过生日，你送给他一个超人造型的可动公仔，他抱着玩了一整天。
action figure.translation: 朋友：你给你侄子买的什么生日礼物 你：我送了他一个超人的可动公仔 朋友：他收到是不是特别开心 你：对啊，抱着那个玩具玩了一整天 朋友：这种人形公仔小孩子都迷 你：可不是，他睡觉都要摆在床头
action figure.example: Friend: What birthday gift did you buy for your nephew? You: I gave him an action figure of Superman. Friend: Was he especially happy receiving it? You: Yeah, he held onto that toy and played all day. Friend: Kids are all crazy for these action figures. You: Exactly, he even puts it by his pillow to sleep.

action movie.context: 周末你不想出门，窝在沙发上，和朋友一起挑一部节奏快的动作片来看。
action movie.translation: 朋友：周末你打算窝在家里看电影吗 你：对啊，我想挑一部刺激的动作片 朋友：要不要我带点零食过来找你 你：好啊，边吃薯片边看最过瘾 朋友：那我顺便再带两罐可乐 你：行，我先把客厅收拾一下
action movie.example: Friend: Are you planning to curl up at home watching a movie this weekend? You: Yeah, I want to pick an exciting action movie. Friend: Should I bring some snacks over to join you? You: Great, eating chips while watching is the best. Friend: Then I'll also bring along two cans of cola. You: Fine, I'll tidy up the living room first.

activated charcoal.context: 你发现最近流行的黑色牙膏里居然加了活性炭，据说能吸附牙齿表面的色素。
activated charcoal.translation: 朋友：你这支黑色牙膏看着挺奇怪 你：里面加了活性炭，能吸附色素 朋友：用了真的能把牙刷白吗 你：多少管点用，主要靠吸附污垢 朋友：那它会不会把舌头染黑 你：刚开始有点，漱口就冲掉了
activated charcoal.example: Friend: This black toothpaste of yours looks quite strange. You: It has activated charcoal inside that absorbs stains. Friend: Does it really whiten the teeth when used? You: Sort of works, it mainly adsorbs the grime. Friend: Then will it dye your tongue black? You: A little at first, but rinsing washes it right off.

active participant.context: 课堂讨论时，别的同学都闷头记笔记，只有他一直主动发言，成了最活跃的参与方。
active participant.translation: 朋友：你们班讨论课谁最积极 你：就那个戴眼镜的男生最活跃 朋友：他是不是每次都抢着发言 你：对啊，他是讨论里最主动的人 朋友：老师是不是也特别喜欢他 你：当然，老师总点他名字提问
active participant.example: Friend: Who's the most active person in your seminar class? You: That guy wearing glasses is by far the most active. Friend: Does he always rush to speak up every time? You: Yeah, he's the most active participant in discussion. Friend: Does the teacher especially like him too? You: Of course, the teacher always calls on him by name.

active travel.context: 你为了锻炼身体又省地铁钱，坚持每天骑车上下班，这种通勤方式既环保又健康。
active travel.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天骑车来上班 你：我想锻炼锻炼，又想省点地铁钱 朋友：骑车上下班是不是挺累的 你：习惯了就好，这是很健康的出行 朋友：那下雨的时候你怎么办 你：下雨我就改坐地铁，看天气
active travel.example: Friend: Why do you ride a bike to work every day lately? You: I want to exercise, and save some subway money too. Friend: Isn't cycling to work rather exhausting? You: Once used to it, it's healthy active travel. Friend: Then what do you do when it rains? You: On rainy days I switch to the subway, depending on weather.

activity level.context: 医生看了你体检报告，说你日常运动量偏低，建议你每天多出去走几步。
activity level.translation: 朋友：医生今天怎么说你的身体 你：他说我平时活动量太低，得动动 朋友：你是不是一天到晚都坐着 你：对啊，除了上班就是躺着 朋友：那你每天得抽时间出去走走 你：好，我从今晚饭后散步开始
activity level.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about your body today? You: He said my activity level is too low, I need to move. Friend: Do you just sit all day long? You: Yeah, besides work I'm always lying down. Friend: Then you must spare time to walk every day. You: Fine, I'll start by walking after dinner tonight.

acts as.context: 你帮朋友装了个软件，说这个程序在系统里充当了防火墙，能挡住不少恶意攻击。
acts as.translation: 朋友：你给我电脑装的那个是什么程序 你：它在系统里起到防火墙的作用 朋友：那它能挡住那些病毒攻击吗 你：可以，能过滤掉大部分恶意软件 朋友：那我还用再单独装杀毒吗 你：不用，它本身就带防护功能
acts as.example: Friend: What program did you install on my computer? You: It acts as a firewall within the whole system. Friend: Then can it block those virus attacks? You: Yes, it filters out most of the malicious software. Friend: Then do I still need separate antivirus? You: No need, it comes with protection built in already.

acute toxicity.context: 实验室里研究某种化学物质，科学家要先测它的急性毒性，确认多少剂量会致命。
acute toxicity.translation: 朋友：你们实验室最近在研究什么 你：在测一种新化学物质的毒性 朋友：你们怎么判断它危不危险 你：先测急性毒性，看多少剂量致命 朋友：这实验做起来是不是挺危险 你：穿好防护，在通风柜里操作
acute toxicity.example: Friend: What is your lab researching these days? You: We're testing the toxicity of a new chemical substance. Friend: How do you tell whether it's dangerous or not? You: First test its acute toxicity, find the lethal dose. Friend: Is this experiment quite risky to do? You: Wear protection, work inside the fume hood.

ad hoc.context: 项目临时缺人，主管从别的部门临时调来几个同事，组成一个应急小组。
ad hoc.translation: 朋友：你们项目组最近是不是缺人手 你：对啊，临时从别的部门抽了几个人 朋友：这些临时安排的人靠谱吗 你：凑合用，都是为了应这个急 朋友：那项目完了他们是不是就回去 你：对，这只是临时抽调的队伍
ad hoc.example: Friend: Is your project team short of people lately? You: Yeah, we temporarily pulled a few from other departments. Friend: Are these ad hoc arranged people reliable at all? You: Makeshift, just to handle this urgent situation. Friend: Then once the project ends, they go back? You: Right, this is only an ad hoc team for the moment.

ad revenue.context: 你聊起自己做的自媒体频道，说频道做大了之后，主要靠广告收益来维持运转。
ad revenue.translation: 朋友：你那个自媒体频道靠什么赚钱 你：粉丝多了之后，主要靠广告收入 朋友：广告收益一个月能有多少 你：好的时候能抵得上一份工资 朋友：那你是不是打算全职做 你：再等等，等收入稳定再说
ad revenue.example: Friend: How does your self-media channel make money? You: Once fans grow, mainly through ad revenue. Friend: Roughly how much is the ad revenue per month? You: On good months it equals a full salary. Friend: Then do you plan to do it full time? You: Wait more, until the income stabilizes.

adapt from.context: 你和朋友去看一部新电影，看完后说这片其实改编自一本你读过的小说。
adapt from.translation: 朋友：今天这部电影剧情怎么这么熟 你：它改编自一本挺有名的小说 朋友：原著你之前是不是看过 你：对啊，我上学时就读过 朋友：电影和原著哪个更好看 你：原著更细，电影节奏更快
adapt from.example: Friend: Why does today's movie plot feel so familiar? You: It was adapted from a fairly famous novel. Friend: Did you read the original book before? You: Yeah, I read it back when I was at school. Friend: Which is better, the film or the original novel? You: The book is finer, the film moves faster.

add insult to injury.context: 你早上赶车迟到，到公司又被领导批评，真是祸不单行，雪上加霜。
add insult to injury.translation: 朋友：你今天脸色怎么这么差 你：早上赶车迟到，到公司又挨批 朋友：你这不是在雪上加霜吗 你：对啊，倒霉的事凑一块了 朋友：那你下午还是早点下班吧 你：好，我打算回去好好睡一觉
add insult to injury.example: Friend: Why do you look so worn out today? You: I missed the bus this morning, then got scolded at work. Friend: Isn't that just adding insult to injury? You: Yeah, all the bad luck piled up together. Friend: Then you'd better leave work early this afternoon. You: Good, I plan to go back and sleep properly.

add to bill.context: 在餐厅结账时，服务员说要在账单上额外加收一成的服务费，朋友觉得不划算。
add to bill.translation: 朋友：这顿饭最后一共多少钱 你：账单上还额外加了服务费 朋友：怎么吃饭还要加收服务费 你：听说这家店是自动算进去的 朋友：那这服务费能不能拒付 你：好像不能，默认就加上去了
add to bill.example: Friend: How much was this meal in the end? You: They added a service charge to the bill on top. Friend: Why do restaurants even add a service charge? You: I heard this place calculates it in automatically. Friend: Then can we refuse to pay that charge? You: Seems not, it's added by default.

add to one's locker.context: 你工作之余还考了个驾照，朋友说你这是又给自己的技能库添了一项本事。
add to one's locker.translation: 朋友：你最近是不是还去考驾照了 你：对啊，刚拿到驾照没多久 朋友：这又给你的本事添了新一项 你：对啊，以后出门开车也方便 朋友：那你下一个想学什么技能 你：我想再学一门外语，多储备点
add to one's locker.example: Friend: Did you also go take your driving test lately? You: Yeah, just got my license not long ago. Friend: That adds another skill to your locker now. You: Right, driving out will be more convenient. Friend: Then what skill do you want to learn next? You: I want to pick up another language, stock more skills.

add to this.context: 你向朋友抱怨工作累，接着又说自己房租还贵，房租这事儿更是雪上加霜。
add to this.translation: 朋友：你最近工作是不是压力挺大 你：本来就累，房租还一个劲涨 朋友：工作已经够烦了，房租还涨 你：对啊，开支一下子多了不少 朋友：那你要不要换个便宜点的房 你：我这阵子正看着别的房源呢
add to this.example: Friend: Is work pressure quite heavy for you lately? You: Already tired, on top of that the rent keeps rising. Friend: Work is annoying enough, and rent goes up too. You: Right, to add to this, my expenses jumped a lot. Friend: Then should you switch to a cheaper place? You: I'm already browsing other listings.

added bonus.context: 公司给员工涨工资的同时还发了节日礼品，这份额外福利让大家都很开心。
added bonus.translation: 朋友：你们公司最近是不是发福利了 你：涨了工资，还额外送了节日礼品 朋友：涨工资还送礼，这不是双份开心吗 你：对啊，这额外福利挺贴心的 朋友：你们公司这待遇真不错啊 你：还行，就是加班稍微多了点
added bonus.example: Friend: Did your company give out perks recently? You: They raised pay, plus added a festive gift. Friend: Raising pay and giving gifts, double happiness! You: Yeah, this added bonus feels quite thoughtful. Friend: Your company's treatment is really good. You: Not bad, just a bit more overtime.

added sugar.context: 你帮朋友看食品配料表，指着说这种饮料里额外加了不少糖，喝多了容易胖。
added sugar.translation: 朋友：这瓶饮料配料表你看得懂吗 你：里面额外加了不少的糖 朋友：那喝这种是不是容易长胖 你：对啊，添加糖太多对身体不好 朋友：那我以后还是买无糖的吧 你：对，无糖的相对健康一些
added sugar.example: Friend: Can you read the ingredient list on this bottle? You: There's quite a lot of added sugar inside. Friend: Then does drinking this easily make you fat? You: Yeah, too much added sugar is bad for health. Friend: Then I'll buy the sugar-free ones from now on. You: Right, sugar-free is relatively healthier.

added to.context: 你写年终总结，说这一年业绩大增之外，还额外被赋予了带新人的任务。
added to.translation: 朋友：你这一年工作总结写好了吗 你：业绩上去了，还多了带新人的任务 朋友：这是公司看重你才给的活吧 你：对啊，责任比以前更大了 朋友：那你带新人有没有觉得烦 你：不会，教别人我自己也长经验
added to.example: Friend: Is your year-end summary written yet? You: Sales went up, added to this I now mentor newcomers. Friend: The company gives you this because they value you, right? You: Yeah, the responsibility is bigger than before. Friend: Does mentoring newcomers annoy you? You: Not at all, teaching others also builds my own experience.

addicted to.context: 朋友一有空就刷短视频，你劝他别太沉迷，说这样下去眼睛和作息都要乱。
addicted to.translation: 朋友：你怎么又躺着刷手机了 你：我就是随便看看短视频 朋友：你是不是太沉迷这玩意儿了 你：确实有点，一刷就停不下来 朋友：再这样刷下去身体要出问题 你：我知道，今晚就定个限时
addicted to.example: Friend: Why are you lying down scrolling your phone again? You: I'm just casually watching short videos. Friend: Aren't you too addicted to this thing? You: A bit indeed, once I start I can't stop. Friend: Keep scrolling like this and your body breaks down. You: I know, I'll set a time limit tonight.

addictive content.context: 你发现某款手机应用特别容易让人停不下来，说这种易上瘾的内容就是设计来抢你时间的。
addictive content.translation: 朋友：这软件怎么越刷越停不下来 你：它就是设计成让人上瘾的 朋友：这种易上瘾的内容故意抢你时间 你：对啊，背后有算法一直在推 朋友：那我要不要干脆卸载它 你：想戒就卸，不然总被牵着走
addictive content.example: Friend: Why is this app so hard to stop scrolling? You: It's deliberately designed to keep you hooked. Friend: This addictive content is built to steal your time. You: Yeah, there's an algorithm always pushing content. Friend: Then should I just uninstall it altogether? You: Uninstall it if you want to quit, or you're led along.

additional resources.context: 老师在课上发了一些额外的学习资料，说这些是给想进一步深造的同学准备的补充资源。
additional resources.translation: 朋友：老师今天课上发的是什么材料 你：是给学有余力的同学准备的资料 朋友：这些补充资料有必要看吗 你：想继续深造的话很有帮助 朋友：里面有没有往年的真题 你：有，还附了几套模拟题
additional resources.example: Friend: What material did the teacher hand out in class today? You: Additional resources for students wanting to go further. Friend: Is it necessary to read these supplementary materials? You: Very helpful if you want to deepen your studies. Friend: Are there past exam papers inside? You: Yes, plus a few sets of mock questions attached.

adept at.context: 朋友特别擅长切菜，刀工又快又稳，你夸他说他在做饭这方面确实很熟练。
adept at.translation: 朋友：你这朋友切菜怎么这么利索 你：他常年做饭，刀工特别熟练 朋友：那他是不是很擅长做菜 你：对啊，煎炒烹炸样样都行 朋友：那改天让他露一手给咱们尝尝 你：行，我下周请他来家里做饭
adept at.example: Friend: Why is your friend so quick at cutting vegetables? You: He cooks year round, so he's adept at knife work. Friend: Then is he really adept at cooking? You: Yeah, pan frying, stir fry, all skills he masters. Friend: Then let him show off his skills for us sometime. You: Fine, I'll invite him over to cook next week.

adequate sleep.context: 医生叮嘱你说，想要身体好，最重要的是保证每天有充足的睡眠，别再熬夜了。
adequate sleep.translation: 朋友：医生今天跟你说了些什么 你：他让我保证每天充足的睡眠 朋友：你以前是不是总爱熬夜 你：对啊，熬得脸色都差了 朋友：那你现在打算几点睡觉 你：争取十一点前就躺下睡觉
adequate sleep.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you today? You: He told me to get adequate sleep every day. Friend: Did you used to always stay up late? You: Yeah, so much that my complexion turned bad. Friend: Then what time do you plan to sleep now? You: Aim to lie down and sleep before eleven.

adherence to.context: 你称赞这位老学者几十年如一日恪守学术规范，从不掺假，人品让人敬佩。
