adherence to.translation: 朋友：那位老教授为什么受人尊重 你：他几十年如一日恪守学术规范 朋友：这种对原则的坚持现在很少见 你：对啊，他从不搞学术造假 朋友：那年轻人是不是该向他学习 你：当然，这种坚守很可贵
adherence to.example: Friend: Why is that old professor respected by everyone? You: His adherence to academic standards spans decades. Friend: This kind of adherence to principle is rare now. You: Yeah, he never fakes his research. Friend: Then should young people learn from him? You: Of course, this kind of adherence is precious.

adheres to.context: 这家小饭店几十年一直坚持用老方子做菜，从不跟风，顾客吃着就是放心。
adheres to.translation: 朋友：这家小馆子为什么生意这么好 你：他们几十年一直守着老方子做菜 朋友：这种坚持不改配方很难得 你：对啊，从不跟风乱加调料 朋友：那他家哪道菜最拿手呢 你：招牌红烧肉，几十年没变过
adheres to.example: Friend: Why is this little eatery so busy? You: It adheres to its old recipe for decades straight. Friend: This kind of adherence to the recipe is rare. You: Yeah, it never follows fads or adds random seasoning. Friend: Then which dish is its signature? You: Signature braised pork, unchanged for decades.

adjust strategy.context: 你们球队上半场输得惨，教练中场休息时赶紧调整战术，下半场果然扳了回来。
adjust strategy.translation: 朋友：你们上半场怎么输那么多 你：对手太猛，我们打法没调整过来 朋友：那教练中场有没有改战术 你：有，他赶紧调整了防守策略 朋友：下半场是不是就扳回来了 你：对啊，最后还反超赢了
adjust strategy.example: Friend: Why did you lose by so much in the first half? You: Opponent was strong, our tactics weren't adjusted. Friend: Did the coach change tactics at halftime? You: Yes, he quickly adjusted the defensive strategy. Friend: Did you come back in the second half then? You: Yeah, we even overtook and won in the end.

administrative centre.context: 你去那座城市旅游，发现它虽然不是省会，却是全省的行政中心，政府机构都在这儿。
administrative centre.translation: 朋友：你旅游去的那座城市大不大 你：它虽然小，却是省里的行政中心 朋友：政府机关都集中在那边吗 你：对啊，各部门大楼都在市区 朋友：那它交通是不是很方便 你：高铁枢纽，去哪都方便
administrative centre.example: Friend: Is that city you traveled to quite big? You: Though small, it's the administrative centre of the province. Friend: Are all the government offices concentrated there? You: Yeah, every department building is downtown. Friend: Then is its transport very convenient? You: High-speed hub, easy to go anywhere.

adopt...as one's own.context: 听老人讲起当年下乡的往事，你听得入神，仿佛把那段经历当成了自己的。
adopt...as one's own.translation: 朋友：你爷爷年轻时候是不是下过乡 你：对啊，他讲起那段往事特别投入 朋友：你听他讲是不是也很入迷 你：对啊，听得我都快当成自己的经历 朋友：那你要不要把它记下来 你：好，我打算整理成一段文字
adopt...as one's own.example: Friend: Did your grandfather go to the countryside when young? You: Yeah, he tells those old stories with such feeling. Friend: Are you also fascinated listening to him? You: Yeah, it's like I adopted the story as my own. Friend: Then should you write it down? You: Good, I plan to compile it into a piece of text.

adorned with.context: 你走进老教堂，发现穹顶上装饰着精美的壁画，阳光透过彩窗洒下来，格外梦幻。
adorned with.translation: 朋友：这座老教堂里面看着真壮观 你：穹顶上装饰着一幅幅精美的壁画 朋友：那彩色玻璃窗是不是特别漂亮 你：对啊，阳光透进来格外梦幻 朋友：那你到底拍了多少张照片 你：内存都快装满了，舍不得删
adorned with.example: Friend: This old church looks spectacular inside. You: The dome is adorned with exquisite murals. Friend: Are those stained glass windows especially beautiful? You: Yeah, sunlight through them feels dreamy. Friend: How many photos did you take? You: Memory almost full, can't bear to delete.

adrenaline junkie.context: 你朋友一到周末就去蹦极、攀岩，你笑着说他真是个追求刺激不要命的人。
adrenaline junkie.translation: 朋友：你那朋友周末又去哪儿疯了 你：他又去蹦极攀岩了，停不下来 朋友：你这人怎么这么爱玩命 你：对啊，他就是个追求刺激的人 朋友：那他难道真的不怕出事吗 你：他说越刺激他就越过瘾
adrenaline junkie.example: Friend: Where did your friend go wild this weekend again? You: He went bungee jumping and climbing again, can't stop. Friend: Why is this guy so into risking his life? You: Yeah, he's a real adrenaline junkie. Friend: Isn't he afraid of accidents? You: He says the more dangerous, the bigger the rush.

adrenaline rush.context: 你第一次坐过山车，冲下去那一刻，心跳狂跳，整个人被一股兴奋感淹没。
adrenaline rush.translation: 朋友：你第一次坐过山车感觉怎么样 你：冲下去那一瞬间心都快跳出来 朋友：是不是浑身一阵兴奋啊 你：对啊，那种刺激让人上头 朋友：那你以后还想再坐一次吗 你：想，越刺激越想再来一次
adrenaline rush.example: Friend: How did your first roller coaster ride feel? You: The second it dropped my heart nearly jumped out. Friend: Was there a rush of excitement all over? You: Yeah, that thrill gives you an adrenaline rush. Friend: Do you want to ride it again later? You: Yes, the more thrilling, the more I want to ride.

adult offspring.context: 老两口都退休了，谈起他们的成年子女，说孩子们都在外地工作，一年才回一次家。
adult offspring.translation: 朋友：你爸妈现在退休生活过得怎么样 你：挺好，就是孩子们都在外地 朋友：他们的成年子女不常回来吗 你：对啊，一年才回来一趟 朋友：那他们会不会觉得孤单 你：会，所以天天盼着子女回家
adult offspring.example: Friend: How are your parents enjoying retirement now? You: Pretty well, just that the kids all work out of town. Friend: Don't their adult offspring come back often? You: Yeah, they return only once a year. Friend: Do they feel lonely then? You: They do, so they long for the kids to come home.

adult tooth.context: 你外甥换牙，新长出来的恒牙比乳牙大一圈，朋友笑说这孩子终于要长第二口牙了。
adult tooth.translation: 朋友：你外甥是不是正在换牙 你：对啊，新牙一颗颗冒出来 朋友：这新长出来的是恒牙吧 你：对啊，比乳牙要大一圈 朋友：那他以后得好好保护新牙 你：嗯，早晚刷牙都盯着他
adult tooth.example: Friend: Is your nephew currently losing baby teeth? You: Yeah, new teeth are popping out one by one. Friend: These newly grown ones are adult teeth, right? You: Yeah, an adult tooth is bigger than the baby one. Friend: Then he must protect his new teeth well. You: Yeah, I watch him brush morning and night.

adverse effect.context: 你帮朋友看药膏说明书，说这种外用药可能有副作用，皮肤敏感的人要小心。
adverse effect.translation: 朋友：这药膏涂了会不会过敏 你：说明书上说可能有些副作用 朋友：那皮肤敏感的人能用吗 你：最好先在小范围试一下 朋友：要是涂了皮肤发红怎么办 你：那就赶紧把药洗掉停掉
adverse effect.example: Friend: Will this ointment cause an allergy when applied? You: The leaflet says it may have some adverse effects. Friend: Then can people with sensitive skin use it? You: Better test it on a small patch first. Friend: What if my skin turns red after applying? You: Then wash it off quickly and stop using it.

adverse reaction.context: 你第一次打某种疫苗后胳膊又红又肿，医生说这是正常的不良反应，过两天就消。
adverse reaction.translation: 朋友：你打完疫苗胳膊怎么肿了一块 你：又红又肿，医生说是不良反应 朋友：这种反应到底正不正常 你：正常，过两天自己就消了 朋友：那你现在胳膊能使劲吗 你：能使劲，就是稍微有点酸
adverse reaction.example: Friend: Why did your arm swell after the vaccine? You: Red and swollen, the doctor said it's an adverse reaction. Friend: Is this kind of reaction normal? You: Normal, it'll fade away in a couple of days. Friend: Can you still put strength in your arm now? You: Yes, just a bit sore.

adverse situation.context: 你创业初期遇到资金困难、客户稀少等一连串逆境，但你咬牙撑了过来。
adverse situation.translation: 朋友：你刚创业那会儿是不是挺难 你：对，资金和客户都不顺 朋友：这种逆境你是怎么熬过来的 你：咬牙硬撑，一点点积累 朋友：现在公司是不是缓过来了 你：对，终于开始有稳定客户了
adverse situation.example: Friend: Was it hard when you first started your business? You: Yeah, funding and customers both went badly. Friend: How did you survive this adverse situation? You: Gritted teeth, built up slowly. Friend: Has the company finally recovered now? You: Yes, we finally have stable customers.

adversity quotient.context: 朋友一遇挫折就消沉，你劝他说在逆境里能不能扛住，靠的就是逆商。
adversity quotient.translation: 朋友：我一遇到挫折就提不起劲 你：你得练一练自己面对逆境的本事 朋友：这种抗打击能力能练出来吗 你：能，逆商就是一点点磨出来的 朋友：那我该从哪儿开始练起 你：先从小困难里硬着头皮扛
adversity quotient.example: Friend: Whenever I hit a setback I can't get motivated. You: You need to train your ability to face adversity. Friend: Can this resilience actually be trained? You: Yes, adversity quotient is built up bit by bit. Friend: Then where should I start training? You: Start by gritting through small difficulties.

aerial photography.context: 你帮朋友拍城市宣传片，用无人机在高空俯拍，这种航拍画面比地面拍照震撼多了。
aerial photography.translation: 朋友：你给城市拍宣传片用了什么手法 你：我用无人机在高空俯拍 朋友：这种航拍是不是特别震撼 你：对啊，比地面拍的视野广多了 朋友：那你飞无人机有执照吗 你：有，专门考了航拍执照
aerial photography.example: Friend: What technique did you use for the city promo film? You: I used a drone shooting aerial footage from high up. Friend: Isn't this aerial photography especially stunning? You: Yeah, the view is far wider than ground shots. Friend: Do you have a license to fly drones? You: Yes, I specifically got an aerial photography license.

aerobic activity.context: 医生建议你每周做三次有氧活动，比如慢跑或骑车，能有效提升心肺功能。
aerobic activity.translation: 朋友：医生让你做什么运动锻炼 你：他说每周做三次有氧活动 朋友：慢跑这种算不算有氧运动 你：算，慢跑骑车都算有氧 朋友：你打算什么时候开始练 你：我今晚就出去跑半小时
aerobic activity.example: Friend: What exercise did the doctor recommend? You: He said do aerobic activity three times a week. Friend: Does jogging count as aerobic? You: Yes, jogging and cycling both count as aerobic. Friend: When do you plan to start? You: Tonight I'll go out and run half an hour.

aerosol can.context: 你喷完灭蚊药，随手把那个喷雾罐放进柜子，朋友提醒说这东西是加压的，别暴晒。
aerosol can.translation: 朋友：你手里拿的那个是什么罐子 你：是灭蚊用的那种喷雾罐 朋友：这种加压的罐子别放太阳底下 你：对，暴晒容易炸开很危险 朋友：那你放柜子里阴凉处就好 你：好的，我这就收进柜子
aerosol can.example: Friend: What is that can in your hand? You: It's an aerosol can for killing mosquitoes. Friend: Don't leave this pressurized can in the sun. You: Right, sun exposure makes it dangerous to burst. Friend: Then just store it in a cool part of the cupboard. You: Fine, I'll put it in the cupboard now.

aerospace industry.context: 你学的是航空专业，说这个国家的航空航天产业近几年发展特别快，机会很多。
aerospace industry.translation: 朋友：你学的专业以后好就业吗 你：我学航空，航天产业发展很快 朋友：那你们这行岗位多不多 你：多，这几年国家大力投入 朋友：那你毕业打算去研究院吗 你：对，想去研究所搞研发
aerospace industry.example: Friend: Is your major easy to find a job in future? You: I study aviation, the aerospace industry grows fast. Friend: Are there many jobs in your field? You: Yes, the state invests heavily these years. Friend: Then do you plan to join a research institute? You: Yes, I want to do R&D at an institute.

affect development of social skills.context: 孩子总窝在家里不出门，你担心这样下去会影响他社交能力的发展，劝他多出去交朋友。
affect development of social skills.translation: 朋友：你家孩子怎么总一个人待着 你：他老窝家里，不爱出门 朋友：这样下去会影响社交能力发展 你：对啊，我也担心他不合群 朋友：那你得多带他去和别的孩子玩 你：好，周末带他去公园交朋友
affect development of social skills.example: Friend: Why does your kid always stay alone? You: He always holes up home, hates going out. Friend: This will affect the development of social skills. You: Yeah, I worry he won't fit in with peers. Friend: Then take him out to play with other kids more. You: Fine, I'll take him to the park to make friends on weekends.

affect one's mood.context: 天气阴沉沉的，你说一到下雨天自己情绪就低落，连做事都提不起劲。
affect one's mood.translation: 朋友：今天天气阴沉沉的，你心情好吗 你：一到下雨天我情绪就受影响 朋友：天气真的会左右你的心情吗 你：对啊，阴天我就提不起劲 朋友：那你放个明快的音乐试试 你：好，我放点开心的歌提提神
affect one's mood.example: Friend: The sky's gloomy today, are you in a good mood? You: Rainy days always affect my mood. Friend: Does weather really influence your mood that much? You: Yeah, on overcast days I just can't get motivated. Friend: Then try playing some upbeat music. You: Fine, I'll play some happy songs to lift me up.

affordable drugstore.context: 你帮朋友推荐平价护肤品，说那家开架药妆店东西便宜又大碗，学生党闭眼买。
affordable drugstore.translation: 朋友：我想买便宜点的护肤品 你：那家平价药妆店挺适合你 朋友：开架的东西会不会不好用 你：便宜大碗，学生党用着不心疼 朋友：那你说哪款面霜值得买 你：最基础的那保湿款就行
affordable drugstore.example: Friend: I want to buy cheaper skincare products. You: That affordable drugstore is quite suitable for you. Friend: Are drugstore products actually any good? You: Cheap and big tubs, students use without worry. Friend: Then which cream is worth buying? You: The most basic moisturizing one is enough.

affordable groceries.context: 你工资不高，每次都去那家平价超市买菜，说那里的食材便宜又新鲜，很适合过日子。
affordable groceries.translation: 朋友：你平时都去哪儿买菜呢 你：我去那家平价超市，菜便宜 朋友：那边的食材新不新鲜啊 你：又便宜又新鲜，很适合过日子 朋友：那你每周去采购几次呢 你：两次，周末和周三晚上
affordable groceries.example: Friend: Where do you usually buy groceries? You: I go to that affordable supermarket, food is cheap. Friend: Are the groceries over there fresh? You: Affordable groceries, cheap and fresh, great for living. Friend: Then how often do you shop there? You: Twice, weekends and Wednesday evenings.

after a time.context: 你和朋友在车站等车，过了好一会儿，远处才看见公交车慢慢晃过来。
after a time.translation: 朋友：咱们在这等车等多久了 你：过了好一阵子，车还没来 朋友：再等一会儿吧，别走开 你：过了一会儿，车总算远远开来了 朋友：太好了，终于不用站着了 你：对，赶紧招手把车拦下
after a time.example: Friend: How long have we been waiting for the bus here? You: After a time, the bus still hasn't come. Friend: Wait a bit more, don't walk away. You: After a time, the bus finally rolls into view. Friend: Great, finally no need to stand. You: Right, quickly wave to flag it down.

against one' better judgment.context: 你明知道熬夜不好，可还是违背自己的理智，半夜又爬起来看剧，看完就后悔。
against one' better judgment.translation: 朋友：你昨晚是不是又熬夜了 你：我明知道该睡，还是爬起来看剧 朋友：你这不是违背自己的判断吗 你：对啊，可就是控制不住自己 朋友：看完之后是不是又后悔了 你：对，今早起来特别的困
against one' better judgment.example: Friend: Did you stay up late again last night? You: I knew I should sleep, yet got up to watch a show. Friend: Isn't that against your better judgment? You: Yeah, but I just can't control myself. Friend: Do you regret it after watching? You: Yes, I was terribly sleepy this morning.

against your better judgment.context: 你本来打算拒绝朋友的邀约，可碍于情面，还是违背自己更明智的判断去了。
against your better judgment.translation: 朋友：你不是说今晚要早点休息吗 你：本来想拒绝聚会，还是去了 朋友：你这不是违背自己的判断吗 你：对啊，碍于情面不好推辞 朋友：那你去了是不是觉得没劲 你：对，其实我更想在家睡觉
against your better judgment.example: Friend: Didn't you say you'd rest early tonight? You: I meant to refuse the gathering, but I went anyway. Friend: Isn't that against your better judgment? You: Yeah, too hard to say no for politeness. Friend: Did you feel bored once you went? You: Yes, I actually wanted to sleep at home.

age group.context: 健身房里，你观察到不同年龄段的人锻炼方式不同，年轻人撸铁，老年人慢走。
age group.translation: 朋友：健身房里人是不是特别多 你：对啊，各个年龄组的人都有 朋友：那年轻人一般都练什么 你：他们大多举铁练肌肉呢 朋友：那老年人一般练什么呢 你：老年人就在跑步机上慢走
age group.example: Friend: Is the gym especially crowded? You: Yeah, people from every age group are there. Friend: What do young people usually train? You: Most lift weights to build muscle. Friend: What about the elderly? You: The elderly just walk slowly on the treadmill.

age-related decline.context: 你发现爷爷最近记性越来越差，医生说这是年纪大了带来的正常记忆衰退，让多动脑。
age-related decline.translation: 朋友：你爷爷最近记性怎么样 你：记性越来越差，老忘事 朋友：那医生说这是什么原因 你：说是年龄带来的正常记忆衰退 朋友：那这事还有办法改善吗 你：多陪他聊天，让他多动脑筋
age-related decline.example: Friend: How is your grandfather's memory lately? You: Getting worse, always forgetting things. Friend: What reason did the doctor give? You: He said it's normal age-related decline. Friend: Is there any way to improve it? You: Chat with him more, keep his mind active.

ageing marker.context: 科研人员通过检测血液里的某种指标，来判断一个人身体衰老到了什么程度。
ageing marker.translation: 朋友：你们怎么判断一个人老得快不快 你：我们抽血测一些衰老指标 朋友：这些指标能反映健康状况吗 你：能，是判断衰老程度的标志 朋友：那年轻人也需要去测吗 你：一般四十岁以后再关注
ageing marker.example: Friend: How do you tell if someone ages fast? You: We test certain ageing markers from blood. Friend: Can these markers reflect health? You: Yes, they're markers of how much someone has aged. Friend: Do young people need to test too? You: Generally after forty.

ageing population.context: 你聊起未来的社会，说随着老龄人口越来越多，养老和医疗系统压力会很大。
ageing population.translation: 朋友：你觉得未来社会最大的挑战是什么 你：人口老龄化，老人越来越多 朋友：那养老系统压力是不是很大 你：对啊，老龄人口多了负担重 朋友：年轻人以后还养得起老吗 你：所以才要提前规划养老
ageing population.example: Friend: What do you think is the biggest future challenge? You: An ageing population, more and more elderly. Friend: Then is the pension system under huge pressure? You: Yeah, an ageing population makes the burden heavy. Friend: Can young people still support the elderly later? You: That's why pension planning must start early.

ageing process.context: 外婆八十多了，你观察说人到了这个年纪，身体的衰老进程虽然慢但一直在往前走。
ageing process.translation: 朋友：那你外婆今年有高寿了 你：八十多了，精神还不错 朋友：她的身体衰老得明显吗 你：进程慢，但一直在往前走 朋友：那她平时是怎么保养的 你：每天早起散步，吃得清淡
ageing process.example: Friend: How old is your grandmother this year? You: Over eighty, still quite spirited. Friend: Is her ageing process obvious? You: The ageing process is slow but always moving forward. Friend: Then how does she stay well? You: Walks early daily, eats light.

agile workforce.context: 你公司项目多、变化快，靠一支灵活机动的团队哪里需要就往哪里顶，效率很高。
agile workforce.translation: 朋友：你们公司项目是不是特别多 你：对，所以我们用一支灵活团队 朋友：这种灵活用工有什么好处 你：哪里缺人就往哪里顶上 朋友：那这样大家是不是很累 你：忙是忙，但成长也快的
agile workforce.example: Friend: Does your company have especially many projects? You: Yes, so we rely on an agile workforce. Friend: What's the benefit of an agile workforce? You: Wherever there's a gap, the agile team fills in. Friend: Isn't everyone exhausted then? You: Busy, but growing fast too.

aging-related illness.context: 你陪爷爷去医院，医生说他这种高血压、关节病都属于典型的老年病，需要长期调养。
aging-related illness.translation: 朋友：你爷爷身体主要哪儿不舒服 你：就是血压高，关节也不好 朋友：那医生说这算什么病呢 你：医生说是典型的老年病 朋友：那他得长期吃药调养吗 你：对，定期复查，按时吃药
aging-related illness.example: Friend: What mainly bothers your grandfather's health? You: High blood pressure, bad joints too. Friend: What did the doctor call these? You: Said they're typical aging-related illnesses. Friend: Then does he need long-term medication? You: Yes, regular checkups, take meds on time.

agreed upon.context: 你和同事在会议室吵了半天，最后总算就项目 deadline 达成了一致。
agreed upon.translation: 朋友：你们昨天开会讨论出结果了吗 你：吵了一下午，总算把时间定下来了 朋友：那双方都同意这个方案吗 你：对啊，最后商定的日期大家都认可 朋友：那接下来可以按这个推进了 你：对，就按咱们达成一致的来执行
agreed upon.example: Friend: Did you finally reach a conclusion in yesterday's meeting? You: Argued all afternoon, we finally settled on a date. Friend: Then do both sides agree to this plan? You: Yeah, the agreed upon timetable won everyone's approval. Friend: Then we can move forward according to this. You: Right, just execute as we mutually agreed upon.

agricultural robotics.context: 你去农场参观，看到机械人自动采收果蔬，感叹农业机器人技术让种地都省人力了。
agricultural robotics.translation: 朋友：你今天去农场参观看到什么新鲜事 你：地里全是机器人在自动采摘蔬菜 朋友：现在种地都用上机器人了吗 你：对啊，农业机器人技术越来越成熟 朋友：那以后农民是不是轻松多了 你：当然，省下来的人力可以干别的
agricultural robotics.example: Friend: What new things did you see on the farm visit today? You: The fields are full of robots picking vegetables automatically. Friend: Is farming already using robots these days? You: Yeah, agricultural robotics keeps getting more mature. Friend: Then will farmers have a much easier life? You: Of course, the saved labor can do other work.

aid learning.context: 你发现孩子用那款学习软件后成绩进步，说这种工具确实能有效帮助学习。
aid learning.translation: 朋友：你家孩子最近成绩怎么进步了 你：他用了一款新的学习软件 朋友：这种软件真的能帮孩子学习吗 你：对啊，图文结合特别吸引他 朋友：那它具体是怎么助力学习的 你：把枯燥的知识点变成小游戏
aid learning.example: Friend: Why did your kid's grades improve lately? You: He started using a new learning app. Friend: Can this kind of app really aid kids' learning? You: Yeah, the mix of pictures and text really attracts him. Friend: Then how exactly does it aid learning? You: It turns boring knowledge points into little games.

aims to.context: 你聊起公司的新规划，说团队今年的目标是做出一款真正解决用户痛点的产品。
aims to.translation: 朋友：你们公司今年有什么新打算 你：团队今年打算做一款新产品 朋友：这个产品主要想解决什么问题 你：旨在帮用户省掉繁琐的操作步骤 朋友：那你们什么时候能做出来 你：争取年底之前推出测试版
aims to.example: Friend: What new plans does your company have this year? You: Our team aims to build a brand new product this year. Friend: What problem does this product mainly aim to solve? You: It aims to save users from tedious operation steps. Friend: Then when do you think you can finish it? You: We aim to release a test version before year's end.

air conditioning.context: 夏天屋里闷热，你一进门就赶紧把空调打开，朋友说这天气没空调可真活不下去。
air conditioning.translation: 朋友：今天这天气真是热得受不了 你：我一进门就赶紧把空调开上了 朋友：没空调的日子可真是没法过 你：对啊，这全靠空调续命 朋友：你家空调制冷效果怎么样 你：挺凉快，一会儿就降了好几度
air conditioning.example: Friend: This weather today is really unbearably hot. You: The moment I walked in I turned on the air conditioning. Friend: Life without air conditioning is truly impossible. You: Yeah, we're basically surviving on air conditioning. Friend: How well does your home unit cool the room? You: Pretty cool, it dropped several degrees in no time.

air fryer.context: 你买了一台空气炸锅，周末在家烤薯条，不用放多少油就能做出酥脆的口感。
air fryer.translation: 朋友：你新买的那个厨房电器是什么 你：是空气炸锅，专门烤东西的 朋友：用它做薯条是不是特别方便 你：对啊，放一点点油就很酥脆 朋友：那它和油炸的比哪个健康 你：当然这个，少油又不腻
air fryer.example: Friend: What's that new kitchen appliance you bought? You: It's an air fryer, specially for roasting food. Friend: Is making fries with it really convenient? You: Yeah, just a little oil and it gets crispy. Friend: Then which is healthier, this or deep frying? You: Definitely this, less oil and not greasy.

air hub.context: 你出差要转机，选了一个大型航空枢纽，说这里航线多，去哪都方便。
air hub.translation: 朋友：你这次出差怎么转机这么麻烦 你：我特意选了个大型航空枢纽 朋友：为什么不直飞目的地呢 你：那边航线多，去哪都方便 朋友：那你转机要等多久啊 你：还好，两个小时左右就接上了
air hub.example: Friend: Why is your business trip transfer so troublesome? You: I deliberately chose a major air hub. Friend: Why not fly directly to the destination? You: It's a big air hub, convenient to go anywhere. Friend: Then how long do you wait for the transfer? You: Not bad, picked up in about two hours.

air quality.context: 早上一出门就闻到一股煤烟味，你看了眼手机，说今天空气质量不太好，老人小孩尽量别出门。
air quality.translation: 朋友：今早一出门空气怎么灰蒙蒙的 你：我看了下，今天空气质量不太好 朋友：那是不是不适合出去锻炼了 你：对啊，老人小孩尽量少出门 朋友：那你开窗透气了吗 你：没敢，先关着窗等风来
air quality.example: Friend: Why does the air look so hazy stepping out this morning? You: I checked, today's air quality isn't very good. Friend: Then is it unsuitable for going out to exercise? You: Yeah, elderly and kids should stay indoors. Friend: Did you open the window for fresh air then? You: Didn't dare, closed the window waiting for wind.

air show.context: 你带朋友去看航展，天上飞机呼啸而过，还喷出彩色烟雾，大家都抬头惊叹。
air show.translation: 朋友：今天这个航展看着热闹吗 你：天上飞机飞来飞去，特别壮观 朋友：那些彩色烟雾是怎么回事 你：是飞行表演特意喷出来的效果 朋友：你有没有拍到飞机近距离照片 你：拍了好几张，飞得特别低
air show.example: Friend: Is today's air show lively to watch? You: Planes zooming across the sky, truly spectacular. Friend: What's up with those colored smoke trails? You: It's an effect the air show deliberately releases. Friend: Did you get any close-up photos of the planes? You: Took several, they flew really low overhead.

air travel.context: 你盘算着今年旅行的方式，说长途还是飞机最省时，短途才考虑高铁。
air travel.translation: 朋友：你今年打算怎么出去旅行 你：远途我一般还是选坐飞机 朋友：飞机现在是不是挺贵的 你：提前订折扣票其实不贵 朋友：那短途你坐什么交通 你：短途就坐高铁，又快又舒服
air travel.example: Friend: How do you plan to travel this year? You: For long trips I usually still choose air travel. Friend: Isn't flying quite expensive these days? You: Book discount tickets early and it's actually cheap. Friend: Then what transport do you use for short trips? You: Short trips take the high-speed rail, fast and comfy.

air-raid shelter.context: 你去老城区旅游，导游指着一个旧地道说那是抗战时期留下的防空洞。
air-raid shelter.translation: 朋友：导游指着的那个地道是干什么的 你：那是抗战时候留下的防空洞 朋友：里面现在还能进去参观吗 你：可以，改成了一个小型博物馆 朋友：那里面是不是挺潮湿阴冷 你：对啊，一走进去就觉得凉飕飕
air-raid shelter.example: Friend: What was that tunnel the guide pointed at? You: That's an air-raid shelter from the war period. Friend: Can you still go inside to visit it? You: Yes, it's been turned into a small museum. Friend: Is it damp and cold inside? You: Yeah, walking in feels chilly right away.

alien concept.context: 在老家亲戚聚会上，有人聊起区块链，长辈们听得一头雾水，觉得这概念特别陌生。
alien concept.translation: 朋友：昨天聚会他们聊的那个你听懂了吗 你：什么区块链，我听着也很陌生 朋友：这概念在咱们长辈圈里太新了 你：对啊，对他们来说完全是陌生理念 朋友：你有没有给大家解释一下 你：试着说了，越说越糊涂
alien concept.example: Friend: Did you understand what they chatted about at the gathering? You: What blockchain, it sounds alien even to me. Friend: This concept is way too new for our elders. You: Yeah, it's a completely alien concept to them. Friend: Did you try explaining it to everyone? You: Tried, but the more I explained the more confused.

align with.context: 你做的方案要和公司整体战略对齐，否则领导一看就说方向不对。
align with.translation: 朋友：你这份方案领导看完怎么说 你：他说方向得跟公司战略一致 朋友：那你的方案跟大方向吻合吗 你：我重新调整了，现在对齐了 朋友：这次再交上去能过吗 你：应该可以，逻辑都理顺了
align with.example: Friend: What did the boss say after reading your proposal? You: He said the direction must align with company strategy. Friend: Does your proposal now match the big direction? You: I readjusted it, now it aligns with the goal. Friend: Can it pass if you submit it this time? You: Probably, the logic is all sorted out.

aligns with.context: 你做的每一项决策都跟团队的长期目标保持一致，同事说你这人做事很靠谱。
aligns with.translation: 朋友：你做决策的时候一般怎么考虑 你：我都会让它跟团队目标保持一致 朋友：这样做有什么好处吗 你：对啊，每一步都和大方向对齐 朋友：那同事是不是觉得你靠谱 你：对，大家都信任我的判断
aligns with.example: Friend: How do you usually consider when making decisions? You: I always make sure it aligns with the team's long-term goals. Friend: What's the benefit of doing this? You: Yeah, every step aligns with the big direction. Friend: Do colleagues think you're reliable then? You: Yes, everyone trusts my judgment.

all about.context: 你朋友聊起他最近追的那部剧，说整部剧讲的全是关于青春和梦想的故事。
all about.translation: 朋友：你最近追的那部剧讲的什么 你：整部剧讲的都是青春和梦想 朋友：那它是不是特别励志 你：对啊，从头到尾都是关于成长 朋友：这种题材你最爱看了吧 你：没错，看得我热血沸腾
all about.example: Friend: What is that show you've been following about? You: The whole thing is all about youth and dreams. Friend: Then is it especially inspiring? You: Yeah, it's all about growing up through and through. Friend: This genre is your favorite, right? You: Exactly, it makes my blood boil with excitement.

all along.context: 你早就知道朋友暗恋那个女生，今天看他表白成功，你说其实你一直就看出来了。
all along.translation: 朋友：你知道我今天跟谁表白了吗 你：我早就猜到你喜欢那个女生 朋友：你怎么一直都没点破 你：我自始至终都看在眼里 朋友：那你之前为什么不告诉我 你：这种事得你自己开口才好
all along.example: Friend: Do you know who I confessed to today? You: I long guessed that you liked that girl. Friend: Why didn't you ever let it slip? You: I saw it all along from the very beginning. Friend: Then why didn't you tell me before? You: This kind of thing you must say yourself.

all at once.context: 你正走在路上，天上突然下起大雨，你和朋友一下子全被淋在原地。
all at once.translation: 朋友：这天刚才还好好的，怎么说变就变 你：雨一下子全浇下来了 朋友：我们赶紧找个地方躲一躲 你：这雨来得太突然了 朋友：你看那边有个便利店 你：快走，再晚就要全淋湿了
all at once.example: Friend: The weather was fine just now, why change so fast? You: The rain came pouring down all at once. Friend: Let's quickly find a place to shelter. You: This rain came all at once so suddenly. Friend: Look, there's a convenience store over there. You: Hurry, or we'll be soaked through soon.

all for it.context: 公司打算实行弹性工作制，你一听立刻举手说这个提议你完全赞成。
all for it.translation: 朋友：公司要试行弹性上下班制度了 你：真的吗，我举双手赞成 朋友：你这么支持这个新规定吗 你：对啊，这个提议我完全支持 朋友：那你以后就能晚点出门了 你：太好了，再也不挤早高峰了
all for it.example: Friend: The company will trial flexible working hours. You: Really? I'm totally all for it. Friend: You're that supportive of this new rule? You: Yeah, I'm completely all for this proposal. Friend: Then you can leave home later from now on. You: Great, no more squeezing the morning rush.

all kind of.context: 你走进那家小店，发现货架上摆着各种各样的小玩意，挑得人眼花。
all kind of.translation: 朋友：这家小店里东西多不多 你：货架上摆着各种各样的小物件 朋友：这么多，你看中哪个了 你：我看上了一个手工做的杯子 朋友：那它多少钱一个啊 你：不贵，几十块就能拿下
all kind of.example: Friend: Are there many things in this little shop? You: The shelves are full of all kinds of little items. Friend: That many, which one caught your eye? You: I took a liking to a handmade cup. Friend: Then how much is one of those? You: Not expensive, just a few dozen.

all or nothing.context: 朋友犹豫要不要辞职创业，你鼓励他说这事儿就得孤注一掷，要么成要么败。
all or nothing.translation: 朋友：我一直在纠结要不要辞职创业 你：这种事就得孤注一掷一把 朋友：万一失败了怎么办 你：要么大获成功，要么一无所有 朋友：可我就是怕输得精光 你：怕输就别开始，开始就别怕
all or nothing.example: Friend: I keep torn about quitting my job to start up. You: This kind of thing has to be all or nothing. Friend: What if I fail then? You: It's all or nothing, either big success or nothing. Friend: But I'm afraid of losing everything. You: Fear losing and don't start, start and don't fear.

all over the globe.context: 你聊起那款爆款游戏，说它玩家遍布全球，各地都有人在直播间讨论。
all over the globe.translation: 朋友：那款游戏现在到底有多火 你：玩家遍布全球，哪儿都有人玩 朋友：国外也有很多人喜欢吗 你：对啊，世界各地都在讨论 朋友：那它靠什么火成这样 你：玩法新颖，还支持全球联机
all over the globe.example: Friend: Just how popular is that game now? You: Players are all over the globe, playing everywhere. Friend: Do many people abroad love it too? You: Yeah, it's talked about all over the globe. Friend: Then how did it get this popular? You: Novel gameplay, plus global online play.

all that glitter is not gold.context: 你看到一个包装华丽但质量很差的东西，跟朋友说别被外表骗了，闪光的未必都是金子。
all that glitter is not gold.translation: 朋友：这东西包装看着挺高级的 你：可里面的质量特别差 朋友：真没想到外表这么唬人 你：记住，闪光的未必都是金子 朋友：那你以后买东西还得看品质 你：对，不能光被漂亮外表迷惑
all that glitter is not gold.example: Friend: This thing's packaging looks quite high-end. You: But the quality inside is especially poor. Friend: Didn't expect the exterior to be so deceiving. You: Remember, all that glitters is not gold. Friend: Then you must check quality when buying. You: Right, don't be fooled by pretty appearances.

all the better.context: 你本来就喜欢爬山，朋友说天气正好，你觉得能去户外走一走就更好了。
all the better.translation: 朋友：你不是一直想去爬山吗 你：对啊，这秋高气爽的正适合 朋友：今天天气这么好就更棒了 你：能出去走走那就再好不过了 朋友：那我们约个时间出发 你：就明天一早，带上水和点心
all the better.example: Friend: Don't you always want to go hiking? You: Yeah, this crisp autumn weather is just right. Friend: Today's weather makes it all the better. You: Being able to walk outdoors is all the better. Friend: Then let's pick a time to set off. You: Tomorrow morning, bring water and snacks.

all the more.context: 你本来就喜欢那本书，朋友又送了你一本签名版，你喜欢得更加厉害了。
all the more.translation: 朋友：你不是早就喜欢这本书吗 你：对啊，我读了好几遍 朋友：我送你一本作者签名的版本 你：真的吗，那我喜欢得更厉害了 朋友：你可得好好珍藏这本 你：当然，我专门放在书架最显眼处
all the more.example: Friend: Didn't you already love this book long ago? You: Yeah, I've read it several times. Friend: I got you an author-signed edition. You: Really? Then I love it all the more. Friend: You really should treasure this copy. You: Of course, I put it on the shelf's most visible spot.

all the rage.context: 你发现街上人人都穿那种宽松卫衣，说这种款式这阵子可真是风靡一时。
all the rage.translation: 朋友：你看街上怎么人人都穿卫衣 你：那种宽松款最近特别流行 朋友：这种款式现在真是风靡一时 你：对啊，走到哪儿都能看见 朋友：那你要不要也买一件穿 你：可以，我正想挑件灰色的
all the rage.example: Friend: Why is everyone on the street wearing hoodies? You: That loose style has been especially popular lately. Friend: This style is really all the rage these days. You: Yeah, you see it everywhere you go. Friend: Then should you also buy one to wear? You: Sure, I'm looking to pick a gray one.

all the way through.context: 你看那部纪录片，说它从头到尾都在讲同一件事，讲得特别深入。
all the way through.translation: 朋友：你昨天看的那部纪录片怎么样 你：从头到尾都在讲一个主题 朋友：它是不是讲得特别深入 你：对啊，贯穿始终都在深挖 朋友：那你看完有什么收获 你：对那段历史了解得更透了
all the way through.example: Friend: How was that documentary you watched yesterday? You: It goes all the way through on one single theme. Friend: Does it especially dig deep into it? You: Yeah, it pursues it all the way through. Friend: Then what did you gain from watching? You: I understand that period of history much better.

all the while.context: 你一边假装认真听讲，一边心里却一直在惦记晚上要去看的那场电影。
all the while.translation: 朋友：你今天上课怎么老走神 你：我人在教室，心却惦记着电影 朋友：那你一直在想晚上的场次吗 你：对啊，我一边听讲一边走神 朋友：那你到底买好票了没有 你：早买好了，就等下课冲出去
all the while.example: Friend: Why do you keep zoning out in class today? You: My body's in class, my mind's on the movie. Friend: Were you thinking about tonight's show all along? You: Yeah, I listened all the while dreaming of the film. Friend: Then did you already buy the ticket? You: Bought it long ago, just waiting to rush out after class.

all through.context: 你回忆起童年，说那时候整个暑假都是在奶奶家的院子里度过的。
all through.translation: 朋友：你小时候暑假都去哪儿过 你：整个暑假我都在奶奶家 朋友：那时候是不是过得特别开心 你：对啊，整个假期都无忧无虑 朋友：奶奶现在身体还好吗 你：挺好，我这周末就去看她
all through.example: Friend: Where did you spend summer holidays as a kid? You: All through the summer I stayed at grandma's. Friend: Weren't those days especially happy? You: Yeah, all through the holiday I was carefree. Friend: Is grandma still in good health? You: Pretty well, I'll visit her this weekend.

all too often.context: 你跟朋友吐槽上班迟到的事，说糟糕的是这种情况时常发生，自己都习惯了。
all too often.translation: 朋友：你今天上班是不是又迟到了 你：唉，这种事我常碰到 朋友：怎么迟到总发生在你身上 你：经常都是路上堵车堵的 朋友：那你不会早点出门吗 你：我也想，可早上就是起不来
all too often.example: Friend: Were you late for work again today? You: Sigh, this kind of thing happens all too often to me. Friend: Why is lateness always happening to you? You: All too often it's the traffic jam. Friend: Then won't you leave home earlier? You: I want to, but I just can't get up in the morning.

all walks of life.context: 你去参加一场大型公益活动，发现现场聚集了各行各业的人，特别热闹。
all walks of life.translation: 朋友：你昨天参加的那个活动人多吗 你：现场来了各行各业的人 朋友：都是些什么人啊 你：有老师、医生，还有个体户 朋友：这么多人聚在一起干嘛 你：一起捐书，给山区孩子凑图书角
all walks of life.example: Friend: Were there many people at that event you joined? You: People from all walks of life showed up. Friend: What kind of people were they? You: Teachers, doctors, and small business owners. Friend: Why gather so many people together? You: Donating books to build mountain kids' book corners.

all year long.context: 你家楼下那家水果店生意特别好，一年四季都人来人往，从没断过客。
all year long.translation: 朋友：楼下那家水果店生意怎么样 你：一整年都顾客盈门 朋友：他们家水果真的那么好吗 你：对啊，全年都卖得特别火 朋友：那你是不是常去他家买 你：对，水果新鲜又便宜
all year long.example: Friend: How is business at that fruit shop downstairs? You: Customers pour in all year long. Friend: Is their fruit really that good? You: Yeah, it sells great all year long. Friend: Then do you often buy from them? You: Yes, fresh and cheap fruit.

all year round.context: 你工作的城市气候宜人，一年到头都不冷不热，特别适合居住。
all year round.translation: 朋友：你待的那座城市气候怎么样 你：一年到头都不冷不热 朋友：那冬天是不是也不用穿厚外套 你：对啊，全年都是暖洋洋的 朋友：这种气候住着真舒服 你：没错，我都不想换城市了
all year round.example: Friend: How's the climate in the city you live in? You: It's mild all year round. Friend: Then you don't need thick coats in winter? You: Yeah, it's warm all year round. Friend: This climate is really comfortable. You: Exactly, I don't want to move cities.

alleviate anxiety.context: 你最近工作压力大老失眠，朋友劝你说睡前听点轻音乐能有效缓解焦虑。
alleviate anxiety.translation: 朋友：你最近是不是老睡不着 你：对啊，一躺下脑子就停不下来 朋友：那你试试睡前听点轻音乐 你：听音乐真能缓解焦虑吗 你：对啊，放松下来就容易入睡 朋友：那我今晚就放一首试试
alleviate anxiety.example: Friend: Have you not been able to sleep lately? You: Yeah, once I lie down my brain won't stop. Friend: Then try listening to soft music before bed. You: Can music really alleviate anxiety? You: Yeah, relaxing makes it easier to fall asleep. Friend: Then I'll play a tune tonight to try.

alleviate sadness.context: 你养的小猫生病走了，朋友陪在你身边说，时间和陪伴能慢慢抚平心里的悲伤。
alleviate sadness.translation: 朋友：你这几天心情一直不好 你：我家小猫走了，我特别难过 朋友：我知道，这种失去很痛 朋友：多出去走走，能慢慢缓解悲伤 你：可我一想到它就掉眼泪 你：我懂，我会一直陪着你的
alleviate sadness.example: Friend: You've been in low spirits these days. You: My cat passed away, I'm so sad. Friend: I know, this kind of loss hurts deeply. Friend: Going out more helps alleviate sadness gradually. You: But I tear up whenever I think of it. You: I understand, I'll stay by your side.

allow for.context: 你做旅行计划时特意多留了两天，考虑到路上可能会有突发情况，不能把行程排太满。
allow for.translation: 朋友：你这次旅行一共安排几天 你：路上留了富余，多算了两天 朋友：为什么要多留这么久啊 你：得考虑到路上可能出状况 朋友：那你行程排得满不满 你：不紧，留点余量好应对意外
allow for.example: Friend: How many days did you plan for this trip? You: Left buffer on the road, added two extra days. Friend: Why leave this much extra time? You: Must allow for possible delays on the road. Friend: Is your itinerary packed tight then? You: Not tight, leave margin to handle surprises.

allude to.context: 朋友在会上没有直接批评你，而是话里有话地暗指你这次报告做得不够认真。
allude to.translation: 朋友：他今天在会上是不是点你了 你：他没直说，话里有话地提了一下 朋友：他是不是在暗指你的报告 你：对啊，明显在说我做得不认真 朋友：那你打算怎么补救 你：我下班就把报告重做一遍
allude to.example: Friend: Did he call you out at the meeting today? You: He didn't say it directly, alluded to it indirectly. Friend: Was he alluding to your report? You: Yeah, clearly saying I wasn't careful enough. Friend: Then how do you plan to fix it? You: I'll redo the report after work.

almond milk.context: 你乳糖不耐受，每次喝咖啡都用杏仁奶代替牛奶，说这样喝起来也很香。
almond milk.translation: 朋友：你喝咖啡怎么从不加牛奶 你：我喝不了牛奶，改用杏仁奶 朋友：这种坚果奶喝着奇怪吗 你：不奇怪，反而有一种清香 朋友：那它和牛奶哪个更健康 你：杏仁奶低脂肪，挺适合我
almond milk.example: Friend: Why do you never add milk to your coffee? You: I can't drink milk, I use almond milk instead. Friend: Does this nut milk taste strange? You: Not strange, it actually has a light aroma. Friend: Then which is healthier, it or milk? You: Almond milk is low fat, suits me well.

along the line of.context: 你给朋友推荐一部电影，说它的风格有点像你之前喜欢的那部老片子。
along the line of.translation: 朋友：你推荐的那部电影讲什么 你：它的风格有点像你爱看的那种 朋友：是不是那种慢悠悠的文艺片 你：对，就像你上次夸的那部 朋友：那我今晚就找出来看看 你：好，看完咱们交流交流
along the line of.example: Friend: What is that movie you recommended about? You: Its style is along the lines of what you love. Friend: Is it that kind of slow art film? You: Yeah, along the lines of the one you praised last time. Friend: Then I'll find it tonight and watch. You: Good, let's discuss after watching.

along the way.context: 你骑车去郊外，一路上风景不错，沿途还遇到了好几个也在骑行的人。
along the way.translation: 朋友：你今天骑车骑了多远 你：一路骑到郊外，沿途风景挺好 朋友：路上有没有碰到其他骑友 你：碰到好几个，大家互相打气 朋友：那你骑完累不累 你：挺舒服的，出了一身汗
along the way.example: Friend: How far did you cycle today? You: Rode all the way to the suburbs, nice scenery along the way. Friend: Did you meet other cyclists on the road? You: Met several, everyone cheered each other on. Friend: Then are you tired after riding? You: Quite refreshing, broke a sweat.

alternate with.context: 你和朋友轮流值日打扫办公室，你一天他一天，工作和休息交替着来。
alternate with.translation: 朋友：办公室卫生是怎么排的 你：我和他轮流值日，一天换一个 朋友：那你俩不会累着吗 你：不会，工作和休息交替着来 朋友：那这周轮到你值哪天 你：今天轮到我，我刚拖完地
alternate with.example: Friend: How is the office cleaning schedule arranged? You: He and I alternate, swapping every other day. Friend: Then won't you two get exhausted? You: No, work alternates with rest. Friend: Then which day is your turn this week? You: Today's my turn, I just finished mopping.

alternative sources of.context: 你聊起能源话题，说我们不能只靠煤电，得大力发展太阳能这类替代能源。
alternative sources of.translation: 朋友：我们国家的电主要靠什么发 你：以前主要靠煤炭，现在要转型 朋友：那以后靠什么替代呢 你：得多开发太阳能这类替代来源 朋友：风能是不是也算一种 你：对啊，风光都是清洁能源
alternative sources of.example: Friend: What mainly generates our country's electricity? You: Mostly coal before, now we must transition. Friend: Then what will replace it later? You: Develop alternative sources like solar more. Friend: Does wind count as one too? You: Yes, wind and solar are clean energy.

alternative treatment.context: 你朋友西医看了很久不见好，后来尝试针灸这类替代疗法，身体反而舒服多了。
alternative treatment.translation: 朋友：你那个老毛病看好了吗 你：西医看了很久，效果不明显 朋友：那你后来换什么办法了 你：我试着用针灸这种替代疗法 朋友：效果怎么样，有好转吗 你：有，扎了几次身体轻松多了
alternative treatment.example: Friend: Did you get that chronic problem treated? You: Western medicine long, but no clear effect. Friend: Then what method did you switch to? You: I tried acupuncture, an alternative treatment. Friend: How's the effect, any improvement? You: Yes, after a few sessions my body feels much lighter.

amateur gamer.context: 你周末在家打游戏，水平一般，朋友说你就是个图个乐的业余玩家，别跟职业的比。
amateur gamer.translation: 朋友：你现在游戏打得怎么样 你：一般吧，就是图个乐子 朋友：你这水平顶多算个业余玩家 你：对啊，我又不打比赛 朋友：那你怎么还天天玩 你：放松放松，又不当职业
amateur gamer.example: Friend: How is your gaming these days? You: Average, just playing for fun. Friend: Your level is at most an amateur gamer. You: Yeah, I don't compete in tournaments. Friend: Then why do you still play every day? You: To relax, not going pro.

ambient temperature.context: 你做实验时要把试剂放在恒定的室温下，朋友问这个环境温度有没有特殊要求。
ambient temperature.translation: 朋友：你这个实验对温度有要求吗 你：得放在恒定的室温里 朋友：这个环境温度得控制在多少 你：大概二十度上下就行 朋友：那要不要用空调恒温 你：对，实验室有专门的恒温设备
ambient temperature.example: Friend: Does your experiment have temperature requirements? You: It must be kept at a steady room temperature. Friend: To what must the ambient temperature be controlled? You: Around twenty degrees Celsius is fine. Friend: Then use air conditioning to keep it constant? You: Yes, the lab has dedicated temperature-controlled equipment.

among other things.context: 你向朋友介绍新工作，说这份活除了工资高，还有培训、保险这些额外福利。
among other things.translation: 朋友：你新工作待遇都有什么 你：除了工资，还有培训和保险 朋友：这些额外福利挺不错啊 你：对啊，除了工资之外还有补贴 朋友：那你现在是不是挺满意 你：嗯，除了加班多点都挺好
among other things.example: Friend: What benefits does your new job have? You: Besides salary, there's training and insurance. Friend: These extra perks are quite nice. You: Yeah, among other things there are subsidies. Friend: Then are you quite satisfied now? You: Yeah, except for more overtime, all good.

amounts to.context: 你算了一下这个月的开销，说房租加上吃饭，差不多等于半个月工资了。
amounts to.translation: 朋友：你这个月花销大不大 你：房租加吃饭，顶我半个月工资 朋友：这么算下来不就所剩无几 你：对啊，杂七杂八凑一起不少 朋友：那你有没有考虑省点 你：在想，先从少点外卖开始
amounts to.example: Friend: Are your expenses big this month? You: Rent plus food amounts to half my salary. Friend: Doesn't that leave you with almost nothing? You: Yeah, miscellaneous stuff adds up a lot. Friend: Then have you considered saving more? You: Thinking about it, start with less takeout.

an abundance of.context: 你帮朋友推荐书，说那家图书馆里藏书特别丰富，各种资料应有尽有。
an abundance of.translation: 朋友：我想找几本参考书，去哪好 你：那家图书馆藏书特别丰富 朋友：里面资料是不是应有尽有 你：对啊，多到你看不过来 朋友：那我这周就去借书 你：好，记得带读者证去
an abundance of.example: Friend: Where should I go to find reference books? You: That library has an abundance of books. Friend: Are the materials inside really plentiful? You: Yeah, an abundance you can't finish browsing. Friend: Then I'll go borrow books this week. You: Good, remember to bring your library card.

an apple a day keeps the doctor away.context: 你每天下班都顺手买一个苹果吃，朋友笑说你这是照着那句老话说，一天一苹果医生远离我。
an apple a day keeps the doctor away.translation: 朋友：你怎么每天都买苹果吃 你：听说一天一苹果，医生远离我 朋友：你还真信这句老话啊 你：吃水果对身体总没坏处 朋友：那你坚持多久了 你：小半年了，体检指标都好了
an apple a day keeps the doctor away.example: Friend: Why do you buy an apple every day? You: I heard an apple a day keeps the doctor away. Friend: You really believe this old saying? You: Eating fruit can't be bad for health. Friend: Then how long have you kept it up? You: Half a year, checkup numbers all improved.

an array of.context: 你走进那家数码店，柜台上摆着一排最新款的耳机、音箱，琳琅满目。
an array of.translation: 朋友：那家数码店里面东西多吗 你：柜台上摆着一排新潮小电器 朋友：都有些什么类型的 你：耳机、音箱、充电宝一大堆 朋友：你有没有看中哪款 你：看中一副降噪耳机，就是有点贵
an array of.example: Friend: Are there many things in that digital shop? You: The counter displays an array of trendy gadgets. Friend: What kinds are there? You: Headphones, speakers, power banks, an array of them. Friend: Did you spot any model you liked? You: Liked a noise-canceling headphone, just a bit pricey.

an element of.context: 你评价朋友写的稿子，说虽然整体一般，但里面还是有那么一点可取之处。
an element of.translation: 朋友：我这篇稿子你觉得怎么样 你：整体一般，但有点可取之处 朋友：你说的是哪一部分 你：结尾那句还挺有道理 朋友：就只有这么一点吗 你：嗯，改改还能再出彩
an element of.example: Friend: What do you think of my draft? You: Overall average, but it has an element of merit. Friend: Which part are you talking about? You: The closing line actually makes some sense. Friend: Is that the only bit? You: Yeah, revise it and it can shine more.

an increasing number of.context: 你发现这几年选择回老家发展的年轻人越来越多，新闻里都在报道这个趋势。
an increasing number of.translation: 朋友：你有没有发现回老家的人多了 你：对啊，越来越多年轻人回乡 朋友：这是个什么新趋势吗 你：大家都想逃离大城市的压力 朋友：那你会不会也想回去 你：再看看，现在还舍不得这边
an increasing number of.example: Friend: Have you noticed more people returning home? You: Yeah, an increasing number of young people go back. Friend: Is this some kind of new trend? You: Everyone wants to escape big city pressure. Friend: Then do you also want to go back? You: Let's see, still reluctant to leave here.

an integral part of.context: 你说团队协作是这个项目成功不可或缺的一部分，缺了谁都不行。
an integral part of.translation: 朋友：这个项目成功主要靠什么 你：团队协作是不可或缺的一环 朋友：缺了某个人会影响大吗 你：对，谁都是这整体的一部分 朋友：那你们配合得怎么样 你：挺默契，分工明确
an integral part of.example: Friend: What mainly made this project succeed? You: Teamwork is an integral part of it. Friend: Would missing someone affect it a lot? You: Yes, everyone is an integral part of the whole. Friend: Then how well do you cooperate? You: Quite in sync, clear division of labor.

anaerobic fitness.context: 你为了练爆发力去举铁，朋友问你这种无氧体能训练跟跑步有什么不一样。
anaerobic fitness.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天去健身房 你：我在练一种无氧体能训练 朋友：这跟跑步有什么不一样 你：跑步是有氧，举铁是无氧 朋友：那你练这个想达到什么效果 你：增强力量，爆发力更足
anaerobic fitness.example: Friend: Why do you go to the gym every day lately? You: I'm training my anaerobic fitness. Friend: How is this different from running? You: Running is aerobic, lifting is anaerobic. Friend: Then what effect do you want from it? You: Build strength, more explosive power.

analyse mistake.context: 考试没考好，你没有沮丧，而是坐下来认真分析自己错在哪里，下次不再犯。
analyse mistake.translation: 朋友：这次没考好你没难过吗 你：没有，我坐下来分析失误的原因 朋友：你找出自己错在哪了吗 你：主要是审题不仔细丢的分 朋友：那下次怎么避免再错 你：我把错题都整理了一遍
analyse mistake.example: Friend: Weren't you sad about doing poorly this time? You: No, I sat down to analyse my mistakes. Friend: Did you find where you went wrong? You: Mainly lost points for not reading carefully. Friend: Then how to avoid it next time? You: I organized all the wrong questions.

ancestry dna test.context: 你网购了一个基因检测盒，寄去唾液后就能查到自己的祖先是从哪里来的。
ancestry dna test.translation: 朋友：你最近买的那个盒子是干嘛的 你：是做祖先基因检测用的 朋友：寄点唾液就能查出身世吗 你：对啊，能看出祖先来自哪 朋友：那你测出来结果如何 你：还在等报告，挺期待
ancestry dna test.example: Friend: What is that box you bought lately for? You: It's for an ancestry DNA test. Friend: Just send saliva and you can trace origins? You: Yeah, it shows where your ancestors came from. Friend: Then what did your test result show? You: Still waiting for the report, quite excited.

ancestry gene.context: 你看科普书说，每个人身上都带着一些来自远古祖先的基因，记录着人类的迁徙史。
ancestry gene.translation: 朋友：你看的那本科普书讲什么 你：说每个人都带着祖先的基因 朋友：这些基因能告诉我们什么 你：记录着人类迁徙的历史 朋友：那同一个民族的人基因像吗 你：大部分相似，也有差异
ancestry gene.example: Friend: What is that science book you're reading about? You: It says everyone carries an ancestry gene. Friend: What can these genes tell us? You: They record the history of human migration. Friend: Do people of the same ethnicity have similar genes? You: Mostly similar, with some differences.

and the like.context: 你帮朋友列购物清单，说买完米油盐醋这些，再买点纸巾、肥皂之类的日用品。
and the like.translation: 朋友：你让我帮忙买些什么 你：先买米油盐醋这些调料 朋友：还要不要买别的 你：纸巾肥皂之类的也来一点 朋友：那我顺便帮你把菜也买了 你：好，清单我发你手机上
and the like.example: Friend: What did you ask me to buy? You: First buy rice, oil, salt, vinegar and the like. Friend: Do you need anything else? You: Tissues, soap and the like, get some too. Friend: Then I'll buy vegetables for you as well. You: Good, I'll send the list to your phone.

andean condor.context: 你去南美旅游，在山上看见一只展翅翱翔的大鸟，导游说那就是安第斯神鹰。
andean condor.translation: 朋友：你在南美山上看到什么了 你：一只大鸟在天上盘旋 朋友：翅膀展开是不是特别大 你：对啊，导游说那是安第斯神鹰 朋友：这种鹰是不是特别少见 你：难得一见，飞得又高又远
andean condor.example: Friend: What did you see on the South American mountain? You: A giant bird circling in the sky. Friend: Isn't its wingspan especially huge? You: Yeah, the guide said it's an Andean condor. Friend: Is this kind of eagle especially rare? You: Rarely seen, flies high and far.

animal behaviourist.context: 你家的狗总爱乱叫，你请来一位动物行为学家，教你怎么纠正它的坏习惯。
animal behaviourist.translation: 朋友：你家狗最近是不是老乱叫 你：对啊，我专门请了个行为专家 朋友：他是怎么训练你家狗的 你：他是研究动物行为的专家 朋友：这方法管用吗 你：有用，狗现在安静多了
animal behaviourist.example: Friend: Does your dog keep barking lately? You: Yeah, I hired an animal behaviourist. Friend: How does he train your dog? You: He's an animal behaviourist by profession. Friend: Does this method work? You: It works, the dog is much calmer now.

animal psychologist.context: 你家猫突然开始乱抓家具，朋友建议你找一位动物心理学家来看看它是不是心里有问题。
animal psychologist.translation: 朋友：你家猫怎么开始乱抓沙发了 你：我也纳闷，行为突然反常 朋友：要不要找个专家来看看 你：我打算请位动物心理学家 朋友：他能看出猫是哪里不对劲吗 你：听说能，还会给矫正方案
animal psychologist.example: Friend: Why does your cat start scratching the sofa? You: I'm puzzled too, its behaviour suddenly off. Friend: Should you find an expert to look at it? You: I plan to hire an animal psychologist. Friend: Can he tell what's wrong with the cat? You: Apparently yes, plus a correction plan.

animal sanctuary.context: 你周末去郊外的动物庇护所做义工，那里收留了很多被人遗弃的猫狗。
animal sanctuary.translation: 朋友：你周末一般都去哪儿 你：我去郊外的动物庇护所做义工 朋友：那里都收留了些什么动物 你：大多是被人遗弃的猫狗 朋友：你在那儿具体做什么 你：帮忙喂食、打扫，再陪它们玩
animal sanctuary.example: Friend: Where do you usually go on weekends? You: I volunteer at an animal sanctuary in the suburbs. Friend: What animals do they shelter there? You: Mostly abandoned cats and dogs. Friend: What do you do there specifically? You: Help feed, clean, and play with them.

animal testing.context: 你和朋友聊起化妆品的成分，说很多护肤品在上市前要先做动物实验，动物保护者对此很反对。
animal testing.translation: 朋友：你买化妆品会看包装吗 你：我会看有没有做过动物实验 朋友：这种测试在法律上还允许吗 你：有些国家已经明令禁止了 朋友：那你以后支持哪种牌子 你：只买无动物实验的那种
animal testing.example: Friend: Do you check the packaging when buying cosmetics? You: I check whether they did animal testing. Friend: Is this kind of testing still legal? You: Some countries have banned it outright. Friend: Then which brands do you support? You: Only buy cruelty-free ones.

animal welfare.context: 你跟朋友聊起流浪动物，说养宠物不能只图一时新鲜，要懂得尊重动物福利。
animal welfare.translation: 朋友：你怎么看那些弃养宠物的人 你：太不负责任了，不顾动物福利 朋友：那养宠物之前该想清楚什么 你：能不能一直负责到底 朋友：你家养过宠物吗 你：养过一只猫，养到它善终
animal welfare.example: Friend: What do you think of people who abandon pets? You: So irresponsible, ignoring animal welfare. Friend: Then what should one think before getting a pet? You: Whether you can be responsible to the end. Friend: Have you kept pets? You: Kept a cat until its natural end.

annual increment.context: 你工作满一年，财务说你工资会自动涨一档，这就是所谓的年度加薪。
annual increment.translation: 朋友：你入职满一年工资涨了吗 你：财务说自动涨了一档 朋友：这就是你说的年度加薪吧 你：对啊，每年都会加一点 朋友：那你涨了多少 你：不多，几百块意思意思
annual increment.example: Friend: Did your salary rise after one year at work? You: HR said it went up a notch automatically. Friend: This is what you call an annual increment, right? You: Yeah, it rises a bit every year. Friend: Then how much did you get? You: Not much, a few hundred as a token.

annual review.context: 公司每年年底给你做一次绩效考评，根据结果来决定你明年的工资和晋升。
annual review.translation: 朋友：你们公司年底是不是要考核 你：对，每年都有一次年度考评 朋友：这个结果影响你涨工资吗 你：对啊，直接决定明年调薪 朋友：你今年表现怎么样 你：还不错，应该能涨一点
annual review.example: Friend: Does your company do an evaluation at year end? You: Yes, there's an annual review every year. Friend: Does this result affect your pay rise? You: Yeah, it directly decides next year's adjustment. Friend: How was your performance this year? You: Pretty good, should rise a bit.

annual sales.context: 你看公司年报，说这一年的年销售额比去年增长了两成，老板很满意。
annual sales.translation: 朋友：你们公司今年生意怎么样 你：年销售额比去年涨了两成 朋友：老板是不是特别高兴 你：对啊，在会上直夸大家 朋友：那你奖金会不会多发 你：应该会，就看年终了
annual sales.example: Friend: How is business at your company this year? You: Annual sales rose twenty percent over last year. Friend: Is the boss especially happy? You: Yeah, he praised everyone at the meeting. Friend: Then will your bonus be bigger? You: Probably, just depends on year end.

antarctic circle.context: 你在地理课上跟朋友说起，南极圈以南全是冰天雪地，几乎没有人长期居住。
antarctic circle.translation: 朋友：南极那边到底有人住吗 你：南极圈以南全是冰雪 朋友：那科考站算有人吗 你：只是短期去做研究 朋友：那边最冷能到多少度 你：零下几十度，想想都冷
antarctic circle.example: Friend: Do people actually live down in Antarctica? You: South of the Antarctic Circle is all ice and snow. Friend: Do research stations count as people living there? You: Just short-term research visits. Friend: How cold can it get there? You: Minus several tens of degrees, just thinking it's cold.

anti-smoking campaign.context: 你走在街上看见举着牌子劝人戒烟的志愿者，这就是当地政府搞的禁烟宣传活动。
anti-smoking campaign.translation: 朋友：街上那些举牌的人是干嘛的 你：是做禁烟宣传活动的志愿者 朋友：他们这样能劝得住人吗 你：多少有点提醒作用 朋友：那你身边有人戒烟成功吗 你：有，我爸就是被劝戒的
anti-smoking campaign.example: Friend: What are those sign-holding people on the street for? You: They're volunteers in an anti-smoking campaign. Friend: Can they actually persuade anyone to quit? You: A reminder effect, more or less. Friend: Do you know anyone who quit successfully? You: Yes, my dad was persuaded to quit.

antique shop.context: 你陪朋友逛老街，拐进一家卖旧钟表的古董店，里面摆满了上了年头的老物件。
antique shop.translation: 朋友：这条老街上那家店卖什么的 你：是家古董店，卖旧钟表的 朋友：里面的东西都有年头吧 你：对啊，很多都是老物件 朋友：有没有看中什么 你：看中一个老式座钟，就是太贵
antique shop.example: Friend: What does that shop on the old street sell? You: It's an antique shop selling old clocks. Friend: The things inside are quite old, right? You: Yeah, many are genuine old pieces. Friend: Did you spot anything you liked? You: Liked an old mantel clock, just too pricey.

any number of.context: 你帮朋友挑书，说那家图书馆里关于这个主题的资料多的是，随便借都借不完。
any number of.translation: 朋友：我想找点资料去哪好 你：那家图书馆这类书多的是 朋友：真有这么多吗 你：对啊，数都数不过来 朋友：那我直接去办借书证 你：行，带身份证就能办
any number of.example: Friend: Where should I go to find materials? You: That library has any number of books on this. Friend: Is there really that many? You: Yeah, too many to count. Friend: Then I'll just get a library card. You: Fine, bring your ID to get one.

any time soon.context: 朋友问你那家新开的餐厅什么时候能吃上，你笑说估计短期内是排不上队了。
any time soon.translation: 朋友：那家网红餐厅咱们啥时候去 你：短期内估计是排不上了 朋友：为什么，人很多吗 你：对啊，天天大排长龙 朋友：那咱们改天换一家 你：好，过阵子人少了再去
any time soon.example: Friend: When do we go to that trendy restaurant? You: Probably can't get in any time soon. Friend: Why, is it crowded? You: Yeah, long queues every day. Friend: Then let's pick another place another day. You: Good, go once it quiets down later.

anything and everything.context: 你搬家那天，朋友什么都来帮忙，从打包到扛箱，几乎所有的事都替你想到了。
anything and everything.translation: 朋友：搬家那天你都带了什么 你：他几乎什么事都替我想到了 朋友：真有这么夸张吗 你：对啊，打包到扛箱全包了 朋友：那你可得好好谢谢人家 你：请他吃顿大餐是必须的
anything and everything.example: Friend: What did he bring on moving day? You: He handled anything and everything for me. Friend: Is it really that exaggerated? You: Yeah, from packing to lifting boxes all done. Friend: Then you must thank him well. You: Treating him to a big meal is a must.

apartment block.context: 你指着窗外那栋高层，说那就是你住的居民楼，楼下还开了一排小商店。
apartment block.translation: 朋友：你住的地方好找吗 你：就窗外那栋居民楼 朋友：楼下有没有便利店 你：有，一排小商店 朋友：那你生活挺方便 你：对，买东西下楼就是
apartment block.example: Friend: Is your place easy to find? You: Just that apartment block outside the window. Friend: Is there a convenience store downstairs? You: Yes, a row of small shops. Friend: Then your life is quite convenient. You: Right, shopping is right downstairs.

app blocker.context: 你为了戒掉刷手机的毛病，在电脑上装了个专注插件，一到工作时间就把娱乐网站全屏蔽。
app blocker.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不刷网页了 你：我装了个软件管控插件 朋友：这插件是干什么用的 你：工作时间屏蔽那些娱乐网站 朋友：这样真能集中注意力吗 你：能，眼不见心不烦
app blocker.example: Friend: Why aren't you browsing the web lately? You: I installed an app blocker. Friend: What is this blocker for? You: It blocks entertainment sites during work hours. Friend: Can this really help focus? You: Yes, out of sight out of mind.

appeals to.context: 你跟朋友推荐一部动画片，说它色彩明亮、故事温暖，特别能吸引小孩子。
appeals to.translation: 朋友：你给你小侄女看什么动画片 你：那部色彩明亮、故事温暖的 朋友：它为什么能吸引孩子 你：对啊，剧情特别打动小朋友 朋友：那大人看了会觉得无聊吗 你：不会，大人也能看进去
appeals to.example: Friend: What cartoon do you show your niece? You: That one with bright colors and a warm story. Friend: Why does it appeal to kids? You: Yeah, the plot especially appeals to children. Friend: Will adults find it boring? You: No, adults can get into it too.

appearance anxiety.context: 朋友整天对着镜子嫌自己脸不够好看，你劝她说别太在意外表，这都是容貌焦虑在作怪。
appearance anxiety.translation: 朋友：我最近总觉得自己脸不够好看 你：你这是有点容貌焦虑了 朋友：可刷到别人的照片就对比 你：别跟别人比，自信点 朋友：那我该不该去整个容 你：没必要，自然美最好
appearance anxiety.example: Friend: Lately I always feel my face isn't pretty enough. You: You're having a bit of appearance anxiety. Friend: But I compare when I see others' photos. You: Don't compare with others, be confident. Friend: Then should I get plastic surgery? You: No need, natural beauty is best.

appears to be.context: 你远远看着那个人站在路边打电话，觉得他好像是在等出租车。
appears to be.translation: 朋友：路边那个人站着干嘛呢 你：他似乎在等出租车 朋友：你怎么知道的 你：看他一直朝着马路张望 朋友：那他到底是在等人还是打车 你：看着像是在打车
appears to be.example: Friend: What is that person standing by the road doing? You: He appears to be waiting for a taxi. Friend: How do you know? You: He keeps looking toward the road. Friend: Then is he waiting for someone or a cab? You: Looks like he's hailing a cab.

applied to.context: 你把学到的方法真正用到了工作上，效率一下提高了不少，同事都来问你诀窍。
applied to.translation: 朋友：你最近效率怎么高了这么多 你：我把新学的方法用上了 朋友：这些方法用到工作上管用吗 你：对啊，效率提高了一大截 朋友：那你教教我们呗 你：行，回头给大家分享
applied to.example: Friend: Why is your efficiency so much higher lately? You: I applied the newly learned methods. Friend: Do these methods apply to your work well? You: Yeah, efficiency jumped a lot. Friend: Then teach us. You: Fine, I'll share with everyone later.

applies to.context: 你看了公司新出的员工手册，问那条报销规定是不是对所有人都适用。
applies to.translation: 朋友：你看新手册了吗 你：看了，想问那条报销规定 朋友：它对所有人都适用吗 你：对啊，没有例外 朋友：那临时工也按这个来吗 你：对，这条规定适用于所有人
applies to.example: Friend: Did you read the new handbook? You: Yes, I want to ask about that reimbursement rule. Friend: Does it apply to everyone? You: Yeah, no exceptions. Friend: Do temp workers follow this too? You: Yes, this rule applies to all staff.

applying for.context: 你正在网上填一份表格，申请那所学校的研究生项目，心里既紧张又期待。
applying for.translation: 朋友：你最近在忙什么呢 你：我在网上填申请表格 朋友：你是要申请哪个项目 你：那所大学的研究生项目 朋友：申请材料准备得怎么样 你：差不多了，就差推荐信
applying for.example: Friend: What are you busy with lately? You: I'm filling out an application form online. Friend: Which program are you applying for? You: That university's graduate program. Friend: How are the application materials coming? You: Almost done, just missing recommendation letters.

aquatic creature.context: 你在海洋馆隔着玻璃看水母游来游去，说这种透明的水生生物看着特别梦幻。
aquatic creature.translation: 朋友：海洋馆里你最喜欢看什么 你：那些飘来飘去的水母 朋友：这种水生生物看着是不是很梦幻 你：对啊，通体透明的 朋友：你有没有拍照片 你：拍了好多，逆光下特别美
aquatic creature.example: Friend: What do you love most at the aquarium? You: Those jellyfish drifting around. Friend: Aren't these aquatic creatures especially dreamy? You: Yeah, completely transparent. Friend: Did you take photos? You: Took many, beautiful backlit.

aquatic environment.context: 你看纪录片讲珊瑚白化，说海水升温正在破坏原本脆弱的水生环境。
aquatic environment.translation: 朋友：你看的那部海洋纪录片讲什么 你：讲珊瑚怎么一点点变白 朋友：是什么破坏了它们的生存环境 你：海水升温破坏了水生环境 朋友：那这问题还能挽回吗 你：难，得全人类一起减排
aquatic environment.example: Friend: What is that ocean documentary about? You: It's about how coral slowly turns white. Friend: What damaged their living environment? You: Rising sea water ruins the aquatic environment. Friend: Can this problem be reversed? You: Hard, needs global emission cuts.

arctic circle.context: 你跟朋友说想去看极光，听说在北极圈以内的地方最容易看到。
arctic circle.translation: 朋友：你是不是一直想去看极光 你：对啊，得去北极圈附近 朋友：那边最冷的时候是几月 你：冬天最冷，也最容易看到 朋友：那咱们攒钱一起去 你：好，先把年假攒出来
arctic circle.example: Friend: Haven't you always wanted to see the aurora? You: Yeah, must go near the Arctic Circle. Friend: Which month is coldest there? You: Coldest in winter, also easiest to see. Friend: Then let's save and go together. You: Good, save up annual leave first.

arctic ocean.context: 你在地图上指给朋友看，说地球最北端那片冰封的大洋就是北冰洋。
arctic ocean.translation: 朋友：地图上最北边那片是什么海 你：那就是地球上的北冰洋 朋友：它上面是不是全是浮冰 你：对啊，一年到头冻着 朋友：那船怎么过去啊 你：得靠破冰船开路
arctic ocean.example: Friend: What is that sea at the very top of the map? You: That's the Arctic Ocean on Earth. Friend: Is it all floating ice on top? You: Yeah, frozen year round. Friend: Then how do ships get through? You: Need icebreakers to lead the way.

arctic tern.context: 你看自然纪录片，说有一种小鸟每年往返南北极，是世界上迁徙距离最长的。
arctic tern.translation: 朋友：纪录片里那种小鸟叫什么 你：是北极燕鸥 朋友：它为什么要飞这么远 你：每年往返两极，追着夏天跑 朋友：这种鸟是不是特别厉害 你：对啊，迁徙距离全球第一
arctic tern.example: Friend: What's that little bird in the documentary called? You: It's an Arctic tern. Friend: Why does it fly so far? You: It goes between poles yearly, chasing summer. Friend: Isn't this bird especially amazing? You: Yeah, longest migration on Earth.

argue against.context: 公司开会讨论要不要推行新制度，你站出来据理反对，说它会增加大家的负担。
argue against.translation: 朋友：昨天会上你为什么反对那个决定 你：我觉得那制度会增加负担 朋友：你当众反对领导，不怕吗 你：对啊，我据理力争反对 朋友：最后领导采纳谁的意见 你：暂时搁置，再研究研究
argue against.example: Friend: Why did you oppose that decision at the meeting? You: I felt the rule would add to everyone's burden. Friend: Aren't you afraid opposing the boss publicly? You: Yeah, I argued against it firmly. Friend: Whose opinion did the boss adopt? You: Shelved for now, to be studied further.

armed with.context: 你出差前把自己装备齐全，带着电脑、笔记本和充电宝，随时准备应对各种状况。
armed with.translation: 朋友：你出差都带些什么东西 你：电脑、本子、充电宝全带上 朋友：你这是装备有备无患 你：对啊，带齐了才踏实 朋友：那你路上睡得好吗 你：车上眯一会儿就行
armed with.example: Friend: What do you bring on a business trip? You: Laptop, notebook, power bank all brought along. Friend: You're armed with everything just in case. You: Yeah, only feel safe fully equipped. Friend: Do you sleep well on the road? You: Just nap a bit on the way.

around the clock.context: 医院急诊室的医生护士日夜不停地抢救病人，几乎是全天候连轴转。
around the clock.translation: 朋友：急诊室的医生是不是特别辛苦 你：他们几乎是二十四小时连轴转 朋友：这样日以继夜地熬受得了吗 你：对啊，换班轮着来 朋友：那他们有休息的时候吗 你：有，倒班的时候补觉
around the clock.example: Friend: Are ER doctors especially hard working? You: They work around the clock almost nonstop. Friend: Can they handle going around the clock like that? You: Yeah, rotating shifts. Friend: Then do they get time to rest? You: Yes, catch up on sleep between shifts.

around the globe.context: 你跟朋友说这款中国造的产品现在卖遍了全世界，哪儿都能看到它的身影。
around the globe.translation: 朋友：这牌子现在是不是特别火 你：它的产品卖遍了全球 朋友：真有那么多国的人买吗 你：对啊，世界各地都有卖 朋友：那它靠什么打开市场 你：性价比高，口碑传得快
around the globe.example: Friend: Is this brand especially hot now? You: Its products sell around the globe. Friend: Do people in that many countries buy it? You: Yeah, sold around the globe. Friend: Then how did it open the market? You: Great value, word spreads fast.

arrive on.context: 你赶早班飞机，天没亮就到了机场，踏上飞机时腿都软了。
arrive on.translation: 朋友：你几点到的机场啊 你：天没亮就到了，一路小跑 朋友：你是怎么赶上飞机的 你：一路狂奔，总算按时上了飞机 朋友：那你现在累不累 你：累，一坐下就想睡
arrive on.example: Friend: What time did you get to the airport? You: Before dawn, ran all the way. Friend: How did you make the flight? You: Ran hard, arrived on the plane just in time. Friend: Are you tired now? You: Tired, want to sleep sitting down.

art collection.context: 你去一位老艺术家家里做客，发现他书房摆满了几十年攒下来的艺术品收藏。
art collection.translation: 朋友：你去那位老艺术家家里看到什么 你：他书房摆满了艺术品 朋友：这些都是他几十年攒的吧 你：对啊，收藏了好几屋子 朋友：有没有哪件最值钱 你：他说值不值钱无所谓
art collection.example: Friend: What did you see at that old artist's home? You: His study is full of an art collection. Friend: Did he accumulate these over decades? You: Yeah, collected several rooms. Friend: Is any one especially valuable? You: He says value doesn't matter.

artificial flavour.context: 你帮朋友看零食配料表，说这个味道根本不是天然的，全靠人工香精调出来。
artificial flavour.translation: 朋友：这零食闻着怎么这么香 你：看配料表，全是人工香精 朋友：这种人工香精吃多了好吗 你：不好，能选天然的最好 朋友：那你平时买东西看配料吗 你：看，专挑添加剂少的
artificial flavour.example: Friend: Why does this snack smell so good? You: Check the list, all artificial flavour. Friend: Is too much artificial flavour bad for you? You: Bad, choose natural when possible. Friend: Do you check ingredient lists when buying? You: Yes, pick ones with few additives.

artificial intelligence.context: 你跟朋友聊起现在的手机，说人工智能已经能帮你写稿、订行程，越来越聪明了。
artificial intelligence.translation: 朋友：你最近用什么新奇工具 你：我在用人工智能帮我写东西 朋友：它写出来的东西靠谱吗 你：挺靠谱，写得还挺顺 朋友：那它会不会把你的活抢了 你：不会，我把它当助手
artificial intelligence.example: Friend: What new tool are you using lately? You: I'm using artificial intelligence to write things. Friend: Is what it writes reliable? You: Quite reliable, writes smoothly. Friend: Then will it take your job? You: No, I treat it as an assistant.

artificial intelligence (ai.context: 朋友问你天天聊的 AI 到底是什么，你通俗地解释说它就是让机器学会像人一样思考。
artificial intelligence (ai.translation: 朋友：你们天天说的 AI 是啥 你：就是人工智能嘛 朋友：它到底能干嘛 你：能帮人思考、说话、干活 朋友：那它比人聪明吗 你：看情况，某些方面强
artificial intelligence (ai.example: Friend: What is this AI you keep talking about? You: It's artificial intelligence. Friend: What can it actually do? You: Help people think, talk, and work. Friend: Is it smarter than humans? You: Depends, stronger in some ways.

artificial intervention.context: 你聊起那块自然保护区，说本来生态很好，后来人为干预太多，反而破坏了平衡。
artificial intervention.translation: 朋友：那片自然保护区现在怎么样 你：本来挺好，后来被人为干预多了 朋友：具体是怎么干预的 你：修路、建房，把野地占了 朋友：那生态还能恢复吗 你：难，得先停止人为干预
artificial intervention.example: Friend: How is that nature reserve now? You: Was fine, later artificial intervention got heavy. Friend: How exactly was it interfered with? You: Roads, buildings, occupying the wild land. Friend: Can the ecology recover? You: Hard, must stop artificial intervention first.

artificial light.context: 你为了拍一张有氛围的照片，专门等到傍晚，说那时候的自然光比人造光柔和多了。
artificial light.translation: 朋友：你拍照喜欢用什么光 你：我最爱傍晚的自然光 朋友：那人造光和自然光哪个好 你：自然光柔和，拍出来好看 朋友：那要不要买个补光灯 你：不用，有自然光就够了
artificial light.example: Friend: What light do you like for photos? You: I love natural light at dusk best. Friend: Which is better, artificial or natural light? You: Natural light is soft, looks great. Friend: Then should you buy a fill light? You: No need, natural light is enough.

artificial satellite.context: 你晚上抬头看天，跟朋友说那颗划过的亮点不是星星，而是一颗人造卫星。
artificial satellite.translation: 朋友：你看天上那是什么亮点 你：那不是星星，是人造卫星 朋友：它怎么会这么亮 你：它在反射太阳的光 朋友：那它在天上干嘛 你：帮我们导航、传信号
artificial satellite.example: Friend: Look, what's that bright point in the sky? You: That's no star, it's an artificial satellite. Friend: Why is it so bright? You: It's reflecting sunlight. Friend: What's it doing up there? You: Helping us navigate and transmit signals.

artistic freedom.context: 你跟一位年轻画家聊天，说他最难得的是能不受甲方约束，保持自己的艺术自由。
artistic freedom.translation: 朋友：那个年轻画家画得挺有特点 你：他最难得的是有艺术自由 朋友：不受约束是不是很难得 你：对啊，想画什么就画什么 朋友：那他靠什么养活自己 你：卖画，偶尔接个委托
artistic freedom.example: Friend: That young painter has a distinct style. You: What's rare is his artistic freedom. Friend: Isn't being unconstrained rare? You: Yeah, paints whatever he wants. Friend: Then how does he make a living? You: Selling paintings, occasional commissions.

artistic merit.context: 你评价朋友那幅画，说它虽然技巧一般，但在艺术价值上还是有可取之处的。
artistic merit.translation: 朋友：你看我这幅画怎么样 你：技巧一般，但有艺术价值 朋友：你说的价值指什么 你：是那种打动人的感觉 朋友：那我是不是还得接着练 你：对，多练感觉会更准
artistic merit.example: Friend: What do you think of this painting of mine? You: Technique average, but it has artistic merit. Friend: What value do you mean? You: The kind of feeling that moves people. Friend: Then should I keep practicing? You: Yes, practice makes the feel sharper.

as.context: 朋友问你以什么身份参加这次聚会，你说你是作为被邀请的嘉宾出席的。
as.translation: 朋友：你这次以什么身份去的 你：我是作为嘉宾被邀请的 朋友：那你要不要上台讲话 你：不用，坐台下当观众 朋友：你一个人去还是结伴 你：一个人，顺便见见老朋友
as.example: Friend: In what capacity did you go this time? You: I went as an invited guest. Friend: Do you need to speak on stage? You: No, sit in the audience. Friend: Do you go alone or with someone? You: Alone, also seeing old friends.

as a mean of.context: 你跟朋友说，骑自行车通勤既是一种锻炼方式，也是一种省钱的出行手段。
as a mean of.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天骑车上班 你：骑车是一种很好的锻炼手段 朋友：它还有别的好处吗 你：对啊，还能省地铁钱 朋友：下雨怎么办 你：下雨就改坐地铁
as a mean of.example: Friend: Why do you cycle to work every day? You: Cycling is a great means of exercise. Friend: Does it have other benefits? You: Yeah, also saves subway money. Friend: What about rain? You: On rain switch to subway.

as much.context: 你帮朋友搬书，他搬一摞，你搬的摞跟他一样多，两人累得满头大汗。
as much.translation: 朋友：你搬了多少摞书 你：跟你搬得一样多 朋友：咱俩谁也别嫌谁慢 你：对啊，都搬了差不多的量 朋友：那搬完歇会儿吧 你：好，我请你喝水
as much.example: Friend: How many stacks of books did you move? You: As many as you did. Friend: Neither of us can call the other slow. You: Yeah, both moved about as much. Friend: Then rest after moving. You: Good, I'll treat you to water.

as of.context: 你看公司通知说，从下个月开始实行新的考勤制度，大家都得注意打卡。
as of.translation: 朋友：公司通知你看了吗 你：看了，从下月起实行新考勤 朋友：那打卡有什么变化吗 你：开始要严格考勤 朋友：那迟到会不会扣钱 你：对，迟到一次扣一次
as of.example: Friend: Did you read the company notice? You: Yes, from next month new attendance starts. Friend: Any change to clocking in? You: Starting then, attendance gets strict. Friend: Will being late deduct pay? You: Yes, late once, deduct once.

as recently as.context: 你聊起一款老游戏，说就在前阵子它还出了个重制版，老玩家们都激动坏了。
as recently as.translation: 朋友：那款老游戏最近有动静吗 你：就在前不久还出了个重制版 朋友：老玩家是不是都激动坏了 你：对啊，纷纷掏钱支持 朋友：那重制得好不好 你：画面升级，剧情还和原来一样
as recently as.example: Friend: Any news about that old game lately? You: As recently as just now, a remake came out. Friend: Aren't old players thrilled? You: Yeah, happily paid to support. Friend: Is the remake good? You: Graphics upgraded, plot same as before.

as right as rain.context: 你病了一场，这两天休息过来，又能吃又能睡，感觉身体彻底恢复健康了。
as right as rain.translation: 朋友：你病了这两天好点了吗 你：好多了，又能吃能睡 朋友：看你气色是恢复健康了 你：对啊，跟正常人一样 朋友：那你可得注意别着凉 你：嗯，我这几天好好养着
as right as rain.example: Friend: Are you better after being sick these days? You: Much better, eating and sleeping well. Friend: You look as right as rain again. You: Yeah, like a normal person. Friend: Then don't catch a chill. You: Yeah, I'll rest up these days.

as safe as possible.context: 你带小孩过马路，紧紧牵着他的手，尽量让他处在最安全的状态下。
as safe as possible.translation: 朋友：你带孩子过马路牵得好紧 你：我得让他尽量安全 朋友：这路口车是不是特别多 你：对啊，所以更要小心 朋友：那你怎么保证他的安全 你：牵紧手，等绿灯再走
as safe as possible.example: Friend: You hold your kid's hand so tight crossing. You: I need to keep him as safe as possible. Friend: Are there many cars at this intersection? You: Yeah, so more careful. Friend: Then how do you ensure his safety? You: Hold tight, wait for green.

as significant as.context: 你跟朋友说，团队里每个人的贡献都同样重要，少了谁都不行。
as significant as.translation: 朋友：你们项目谁功劳最大 你：每个人的贡献都一样重要 朋友：真有这么平等吗 你：对啊，少了谁都不行 朋友：那你觉得自己排第几 你：不分先后，大家一起
as significant as.example: Friend: Who contributed most to your project? You: Everyone's contribution is as significant as the rest. Friend: Is it really that equal? You: Yeah, missing anyone breaks it. Friend: Then where do you rank yourself? You: No order, all together.

as such.context: 朋友问你是不是正式的会员，你说你只是注册了账号，本身并没有什么特殊待遇。
as such.translation: 朋友：你算他们的正式会员吗 你：我就注册了个账号而已 朋友：那你享受会员待遇吗 你：本身并没有什么特权 朋友：那你白注册了吗 你：也不算，能看免费内容
as such.example: Friend: Are you an official member of theirs? You: I just registered an account. Friend: Then do you enjoy member perks? You: As such, no special treatment. Friend: Then did you register for nothing? You: Not really, can see free content.

as the old saying goes.context: 你劝朋友别太急功近利，说正如老话说的那样，磨刀不误砍柴工，打好基础最重要。
as the old saying goes.translation: 朋友：我总想一下子把事情做成 你：老话说，磨刀不误砍柴工 朋友：你是让我别急着出成果 你：对啊，基础打牢最重要 朋友：那我该怎么慢慢来 你：一步一步，别贪快
as the old saying goes.example: Friend: I always want to get things done at once. You: As the old saying goes, sharpening the knife helps. Friend: You mean don't rush results? You: Yeah, a solid foundation matters most. Friend: Then how do I take it slow? You: Step by step, don't rush.

as with.context: 你评价朋友新做的菜，说跟往常一样，他做菜的手艺还是那么稳，味道一点没差。
as with.translation: 朋友：我今天这菜做得怎么样 你：跟以往一样，味道很稳 朋友：你是说跟平时差不多 你：对啊，跟你往常一个水准 朋友：那你觉得有进步吗 你：保持得很好，没退步
as with.example: Friend: How is the dish I made today? You: As with usual, the taste is steady. Friend: You mean about the same as usual? You: Yeah, same standard as always. Friend: Then do you think there's progress? You: Held well, no regression.

asham of.context: 朋友说错了话闹了个大红脸，你拍他肩膀说别难为情，谁都有嘴瓢的时候。
asham of.translation: 朋友：我刚才说错话好丢人 你：别觉得羞耻，谁都有 朋友：可大家都在笑我 你：笑过就忘了，别放心上 朋友：那我要不要道个歉 你：小事，提一句就过了
asham of.example: Friend: I said the wrong thing just now, so embarrassing. You: Don't feel ashamed of it, everyone does. Friend: But everyone's laughing at me. You: They'll forget, don't take it to heart. Friend: Then should I apologize? You: Small thing, mention it and move on.

ask around.context: 你想租附近的房子，于是逢人就打听，问这一片哪儿有便宜又好的房源。
ask around.translation: 朋友：你最近在忙找房子吗 你：对啊，我逢人就打听 朋友：你都问了些什么 你：问这一片哪儿有便宜房子 朋友：打听到合适的了吗 你：还没，再问问看
ask around.example: Friend: Have you been busy looking for a place? You: Yeah, I ask around wherever I go. Friend: What did you ask about? You: Asking where there are cheap apartments here. Friend: Found anything suitable yet? You: Not yet, keep asking around.

aspire to.context: 你跟朋友说起自己的理想，说你立志有一天能写一本真正属于自己的书。
aspire to.translation: 朋友：你一直以来的理想是什么 你：我渴望有天能写一本书 朋友：这本书你想好写什么了吗 你：写我自己这些年的经历 朋友：那你打算什么时候动笔 你：先攒素材，等成熟了写
aspire to.example: Friend: What's your long-held dream? You: I aspire to write a book one day. Friend: Have you decided what it's about? You: About my experiences over the years. Friend: Then when do you plan to start writing? You: Gather material first, write when mature.

assist with.context: 同事赶项目忙不过来，你主动过去帮忙整理数据，让他能早点交差。
assist with.translation: 朋友：你最近帮同事做什么呢 你：我在帮他整理项目数据 朋友：你这是协助他赶进度 你：对啊，他一个人忙不过来 朋友：那你自己的活干完了吗 你：干完了，顺便搭把手
assist with.example: Friend: What have you been helping your colleague with? You: I'm assisting with organizing project data. Friend: You're helping him catch up on progress. You: Yeah, he can't handle it alone. Friend: Then is your own work done? You: Done, so lending a hand.

assistance dog.context: 你在地铁上看见一只训练有素的导盲犬，正稳稳地陪着它的主人上下车。
assistance dog.translation: 朋友：地铁上那只狗是干嘛的 你：是辅助犬，陪着盲人主人 朋友：它是不是特别听话 你：对啊，过马路都稳得很 朋友：这种狗是不是专门训练的 你：对，经过严格训练才上岗
assistance dog.example: Friend: What is that dog on the subway for? You: It's an assistance dog, with its blind owner. Friend: Is it especially obedient? You: Yeah, steady crossing the road. Friend: Is this kind of dog specially trained? You: Yes, strictly trained before working.

associative memory.context: 你记电话号码时把它和熟悉的数字联系起来，说这种联想记忆法特别管用。
associative memory.translation: 朋友：你怎么记号码这么快 你：我用联想记忆法 朋友：怎么个联想记忆法 你：把号码跟熟悉的东西连起来 朋友：这样真的记得住吗 你：对啊，一串数字一下子就记住了
associative memory.example: Friend: How do you memorize numbers so fast? You: I use associative memory. Friend: How does this associative memory work? You: Link the number to something familiar. Friend: Can you really remember it this way? You: Yeah, a string sticks at once.

at.context: 你约朋友在咖啡馆门口见面，说老地方就是那家靠窗坐的小店。
at.translation: 朋友：咱们在哪儿碰面 你：在咖啡馆门口就行 朋友：是你常去的那家吗 你：对啊，靠窗坐的那个 朋友：那我提前到，帮你占座 你：好，我马上就到
at.example: Friend: Where shall we meet? You: At the cafe door is fine. Friend: Is it the one you always go to? You: Yeah, the one by the window. Friend: Then I'll arrive early to save you a seat. You: Good, I'll be right there.

at a disadvantage.context: 你刚进新团队，对业务不熟，开会时觉得自己总处于不利地位，插不上话。
at a disadvantage.translation: 朋友：你在新团队适应得怎么样 你：开会时总处于不利地位 朋友：是不是因为不熟业务 你：对啊，别人讨论你插不上嘴 朋友：那你得赶紧补业务 你：嗯，我每天都在看资料
at a disadvantage.example: Friend: How are you settling into the new team? You: I'm always at a disadvantage in meetings. Friend: Is it because you don't know the business? You: Yeah, can't chime in when others discuss. Friend: Then you must quickly learn the business. You: Yeah, I read materials daily.

at a discount.context: 你去奥特莱斯买过季衣服，发现这些名牌都在打折，价格比正价时便宜不少。
at a discount.translation: 朋友：你今天买的衣服便宜吗 你：都是打折处理的过季款 朋友：这些名牌是不是在打折 你：对啊，比正价便宜很多 朋友：那质量会不会有问题 你：不会，就是款式旧点
at a discount.example: Friend: Was the clothes you bought today cheap? You: All off-season items at a discount. Friend: Are these brands on sale? You: Yeah, much cheaper than regular price. Friend: Is there a quality problem? You: No, just older styles.

at a given time.context: 你和朋友约好每周固定时间打球，说在这个约定的时间大家基本都有空。
at a given time.translation: 朋友：咱们打球一般定在几点 你：就定在每周六下午 朋友：在这个约定的时间大家都方便吗 你：对啊，基本都能来 朋友：那临时有事怎么办 你：提前在群里说一声
at a given time.example: Friend: What time do we usually play ball? You: Every Saturday afternoon. Friend: Is everyone free at a given time like this? You: Yeah, basically everyone can come. Friend: What if something comes up last minute? You: Just say so in the group ahead.

at a glance.context: 你走进图书馆，一眼望去就看到书架上密密麻麻摆满了书，连过道都堆满了。
at a glance.translation: 朋友：你一进图书馆什么感觉 你：一眼望去全是书 朋友：人是不是特别多 你：对啊，连过道都站满了 朋友：你找到想看的书了吗 你：一眼就看到了，在最里面那排
at a glance.example: Friend: How did you feel stepping into the library? You: At a glance, shelves are packed with books. Friend: Are there especially many people? You: Yeah, even the aisles are full. Friend: Did you find the book you wanted? You: At a glance, it's on the innermost row.

at a moment of.context: 朋友在台上领奖的那一刻，坐在台下的你激动得差点鼓起掌来。
at a moment of.translation: 朋友：我上台领奖那一刻你在干嘛 你：我在台下激动得直鼓掌 朋友：你那一刻是不是特别高兴 你：对啊，比我自己得奖还开心 朋友：那你当时有没有哭 你：没有，就是眼眶有点热
at a moment of.example: Friend: What were you doing the moment I went up to receive the award? You: Down in the audience I clapped excitedly. Friend: Were you especially happy at that moment? You: Yeah, happier than if I'd won myself. Friend: Did you cry then? You: No, just eyes a bit warm.

at a premium.context: 旺季景区附近的酒店一房难求，价格也飙得老高，朋友说这时候住店真是又稀缺又贵。
at a premium.translation: 朋友：节假日那景区酒店好订吗 你：旺季一房难求，价格老高 朋友：这时候住店得多花多少钱 你：对啊，比平时贵好几倍 朋友：那咱们要不要错峰去 你：对，过了旺季再去
at a premium.example: Friend: Are hotels near the scenic spot easy to book on holidays? You: Peak season, scarce and at a premium. Friend: How much more does lodging cost then? You: Yeah, several times the usual price. Friend: Then should we go off-peak? You: Yes, go after peak season.

at a profit.context: 朋友开的小饭馆这两年总算扭亏为盈，你恭喜他说他的店终于开始赚钱了。
at a profit.translation: 朋友：我那小饭馆这两年终于活下来了 你：恭喜啊，现在开始盈利了吧 朋友：对啊，总算不赔本了 你：那你这店是以盈利的方式开着 朋友：勉强算，刚够回本 你：慢慢来，会越来越好
at a profit.example: Friend: My little eatery finally survived these two years. You: Congrats, now it's running at a profit? Friend: Yeah, finally not losing money. You: Then your shop runs at a profit now. Friend: Barely, just recouping costs. You: Take it slow, will get better.

at a young age.context: 你朋友十几岁就离开家独自打拼，说自己很小的时候就懂得要靠自己。
at a young age.translation: 朋友：你什么时候开始独立的 你：我很小就离开家自己拼了 朋友：这么年轻就独立不容易 你：对啊，十几岁就出来了 朋友：那你吃过不少苦吧 你：嗯，所以现在更珍惜
at a young age.example: Friend: When did you start being independent? You: I left home and struggled at a young age. Friend: It's hard to be independent so young. You: Yeah, came out in my teens. Friend: Then you suffered a lot, right? You: Yeah, so now I cherish more.

at an early age.context: 你女儿从小就爱画画，年纪很小时就拿着蜡笔在墙上涂，现在已经成了小画家。
at an early age.translation: 朋友：你女儿是怎么爱上画画的 你：她很小就拿蜡笔乱画 朋友：几岁开始的还记得吗 你：三四岁就在墙上涂了 朋友：那现在是不是画得有模有样 你：对，已经报了兴趣班
at an early age.example: Friend: How did your daughter fall in love with drawing? You: She drew with crayons at an early age. Friend: Remember how old she started? You: At three or four she scribbled on walls. Friend: Does she draw decently now? You: Yes, already in an art class.

at bay.context: 你感冒了硬是扛着不吃药，结果病没压住，反而拖成了发烧，朋友说你这是把病挡在门外失败了。
at bay.translation: 朋友：你感冒吃药了吗 你：没吃，想靠自己扛过去 朋友：结果呢，把病挡住没 你：没挡住，拖成了发烧 朋友：那你赶紧吃药吧 你：好，不能再硬撑了
at bay.example: Friend: Did you take medicine for your cold? You: No, wanted to tough it out. Friend: Result, kept the illness at bay? You: No, dragged into a fever. Friend: Then take medicine quickly. You: Good, can't tough it out more.

at birth.context: 你翻看家里的老相册，那张你小时候被抱着的照片，记录了你刚出生时的模样。
at birth.translation: 朋友：这张照片你多大拍的 你：我刚出生那会儿照的 朋友：那时候你长得像谁 你：我妈说像我爸 朋友：你还记得出生时的事吗 你：哪能记得，都是听大人说
at birth.example: Friend: How old were you in this photo? You: Taken at birth. Friend: Who did you look like then? You: My mom says I looked like my dad. Friend: Do you remember anything at birth? You: Can't remember, all from what adults said.

at death s door.context: 你爷爷一场大病差点没挺过来，当时医生都说他病危，现在总算从鬼门关走了回来。
at death s door.translation: 朋友：你爷爷上次那场病危险吗 你：当时都病得快不行了 朋友：医生怎么说 你：说是病危，让做好准备 朋友：现在是不是缓过来了 你：对，已经脱离危险了
at death s door.example: Friend: Was your grandfather's illness last time dangerous? You: Then he was nearly dying. Friend: What did the doctor say? You: Said at death's door, prepare for the worst. Friend: Has he recovered now? You: Yes, out of danger.

at death's door.context: 朋友连烧三天不退，你去看他时吓了一跳，说他这病得重，简直是病入膏肓了。
at death's door.translation: 朋友：你还好吗，脸这么白 你：连烧三天，浑身没劲 朋友：你这病得可真不轻 你：对啊，感觉都病入膏肓了 朋友：你去医院看过了吗 你：去了，正在挂水
at death's door.example: Friend: You okay, face so pale? You: Fever three days straight, no energy. Friend: You're really seriously ill. You: Yeah, feel at death's door. Friend: Did you go to the hospital? You: Yes, getting an IV.

at death’s door.context: 老邻居一场意外摔得不轻，家里人都急坏了，说当时看着真是生命危在旦夕。
at death’s door.translation: 朋友：楼下老人摔那回严重吗 你：当时看着特别危险 朋友：是不是生命都垂危了 你：对啊，送医院时都快不行了 朋友：现在救回来没有 你：救回来了，正在养
at death’s door.example: Friend: Was the downstairs elder's fall serious? You: Looked especially dangerous then. Friend: Was his life in danger? You: Yeah, nearly gone when sent in. Friend: Did they save him? You: Saved, recovering now.

at dusk.context: 你和朋友约定傍晚去山顶看日落，说那时候天色最美，拍照也最出片。
at dusk.translation: 朋友：咱们几点去爬山 你：傍晚去，正好赶上看日落 朋友：黄昏那会儿景色是不是最美 你：对啊，天边一片橙红 朋友：那咱们带件外套 你：好，山顶风大
at dusk.example: Friend: What time do we climb the mountain? You: Go at dusk, catch the sunset. Friend: Isn't the scenery prettiest at dusk? You: Yeah, sky all orange-red. Friend: Then bring a jacket. You: Good, windy on top.

at first glance.context: 你第一眼看到那个人穿着普通，乍一看毫不起眼，聊过才知道他是个深藏不露的高手。
at first glance.translation: 朋友：你认识的那位大叔厉害吗 你：一眼看去特别普通 朋友：乍一看是不是毫不起眼 你：对啊，穿着打扮都很朴素 朋友：聊过才知道他的本事吧 你：对，深藏不露的那种
at first glance.example: Friend: Is that uncle you know impressive? You: At first glance he's totally ordinary. Friend: At first glance he's unremarkable, right? You: Yeah, plain dress and all. Friend: Only after chatting know his skill? You: Yes, the low-key master type.

at odds with.context: 你和同事在方案方向上意见不合，两人各执一词，气氛有点僵。
at odds with.translation: 朋友：你跟同事怎么闹别扭了 你：我们对方案方向有分歧 朋友：是不是意见不一致 你：对啊，谁也说服不了谁 朋友：那领导怎么说 你：领导让我们折中
at odds with.example: Friend: Why are you and your colleague at odds? You: We disagree on the plan direction. Friend: Are your views inconsistent? You: Yeah, neither can convince the other. Friend: What did the boss say? You: Boss told us to compromise.

at one time.context: 你跟朋友说，这条街以前满是老字号，可现在都改头换面了，再也不是从前的样子。
at one time.translation: 朋友：这条街你熟吗 你：熟，它曾经特别热闹 朋友：你说它以前是啥样 你：曾经满街都是老字号 朋友：现在怎么都没了 你：都拆了，改建成商场了
at one time.example: Friend: Do you know this street well? You: Yes, it was once especially lively. Friend: What was it like once upon a time? You: At one time the street was full of old brands. Friend: Why are they all gone now? You: All demolished, rebuilt into malls.

at one with.context: 你一个人坐在湖边，看着水面发呆，忽然觉得整个人和这片景色融在了一起。
at one with.translation: 朋友：你一个人坐湖边想啥呢 你：啥也没想，就发发呆 朋友：是不是感觉特别静 你：对啊，整个人和风景合一了 朋友：那你以后常来这儿坐坐 你：好，这儿特别治愈
at one with.example: Friend: What are you thinking sitting by the lake alone? You: Nothing, just zoning out. Friend: Do you feel especially calm? You: Yeah, feel at one with the scenery. Friend: Then come here often later. You: Good, it's so healing.

at one with nature.context: 你周末躲进山里，远离城市噪音，整个人都放松下来，感觉和大自然融为了一体。
at one with nature.translation: 朋友：你这趟进山感觉怎么样 你：特别放松，和大自然合一了 朋友：是不是呼吸都畅快了 你：对啊，山里空气特别好 朋友：那你下次还去吗 你：去，有空就去住两天
at one with nature.example: Friend: How do you feel after this mountain trip? You: Super relaxed, at one with nature. Friend: Does even breathing feel easier? You: Yeah, mountain air is great. Friend: Will you go again later? You: Yes, go stay a couple days when free.

at one's fingertips.context: 你手机里存满了各种资料，什么信息都能随手查到，仿佛所有知识都在指尖上。
at one's fingertips.translation: 朋友：你查东西怎么这么快 你：我手机里存了好多资料 朋友：是不是信息都在你手边 你：对啊，随手一搜就出来 朋友：那你还用得着背吗 你：关键的得背，细节靠查
at one's fingertips.example: Friend: Why do you look things up so fast? You: I store lots of material on my phone. Friend: Is all information at your fingertips? You: Yeah, one search and it's out. Friend: Then do you still need to memorize? You: Key points yes, details by lookup.
