at one's own pace.context: 你学新东西不跟别人比进度，按照自己的节奏慢慢琢磨，反而学得更扎实。
at one's own pace.translation: 朋友：你学这门东西怎么不着急 你：我按自己的节奏慢慢学 朋友：跟别人比不会焦虑吗 你：对啊，按自己节奏来就好 朋友：那你学得扎实吗 你：扎实，不图快
at one's own pace.example: Friend: Why aren't you in a hurry learning this? You: I learn slowly at my own pace. Friend: Doesn't comparing with others cause anxiety? You: Yeah, just go at my own pace. Friend: Do you learn solidly then? You: Solid, not chasing speed.

at one's wits' end.context: 你被一道复杂的数学题困住，试了好几种办法都不行，最后简直束手无策。
at one's wits' end.translation: 朋友：那道题你解出来了吗 你：试了好几种办法都不行 朋友：是不是已经没辙了 你：对啊，简直束手无策 朋友：要不要去问问老师 你：好，明天去请教他
at one's wits' end.example: Friend: Did you solve that problem? You: Tried several ways, none worked. Friend: Are you at your wits' end already? You: Yeah, simply at my wits' end. Friend: Should you ask the teacher? You: Good, go consult him tomorrow.

at other time.context: 你平时爱熬夜，但周末的其他时候又会强迫自己早睡，作息在两种状态间来回切换。
at other time.translation: 朋友：你平时作息乱不乱 你：平时晚睡，其他时候早睡 朋友：你这样不矛盾吗 你：对啊，平时和周末两套 朋友：那你身体吃得消吗 你：还行，慢慢调
at other time.example: Friend: Is your schedule usually messy? You: Weekdays late, at other times early. Friend: Isn't that contradictory? You: Yeah, weekdays and weekends differ. Friend: Can your body take it? You: Fine, adjusting slowly.

at our fingertips.context: 你打开搜索引擎，发现任何问题都能马上查到答案，知识仿佛全都在指尖。
at our fingertips.translation: 朋友：你现在查资料方便吗 你：太方便了，一搜就有 朋友：是不是知识都在指尖 你：对啊，随手就能查到 朋友：那你是不是不爱背书了 你：关键的还背，细节靠搜
at our fingertips.example: Friend: Is looking up material convenient now? You: So convenient, one search and it's there. Friend: Is all knowledge at our fingertips? You: Yeah, readily available anytime. Friend: Then do you dislike memorizing? You: Key points still memorized, details by search.

at play.context: 你在公园里听到小孩嬉闹的笑声，说那就是孩子们在玩耍时发出的快乐声音。
at play.translation: 朋友：你听这笑声哪儿来的 你：是一群小孩在玩耍 朋友：他们玩得可真开心 你：对啊，到处都是他们的声音 朋友：咱们小时候不也这样吗 你：对，无忧无虑的
at play.example: Friend: Where's that laughter coming from? You: A group of kids at play. Friend: They're so happy playing. You: Yeah, their voices everywhere. Friend: Weren't we like this as kids? You: Yes, carefree.

at risk.context: 你长期不运动又熬夜，医生说你的身体其实正处在亚健康的危险状态。
at risk.translation: 朋友：医生最近怎么说你身体 你：他说我身体处在危险状态 朋友：你是不是天天熬夜 你：对啊，还不运动 朋友：那你得赶紧调整 你：嗯，从今晚早睡开始
at risk.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about your body? You: He says my body is at risk. Friend: Do you stay up every day? You: Yeah, plus no exercise. Friend: Then you must adjust quickly. You: Yeah, start sleeping early tonight.

at risk of.context: 你烟抽得厉害，朋友劝你说这样下去有得肺病的风险，趁早戒了吧。
at risk of.translation: 朋友：你烟抽得也太多了 你：压力大，没办法 朋友：你有得肺病的风险知道吗 你：知道，可就是戒不掉 朋友：那你要不要试试减量 你：好，先从每天少抽几根
at risk of.example: Friend: You smoke way too much. You: High stress, no way. Friend: You're at risk of lung disease, you know? You: Know, just can't quit. Friend: Then should you cut down? You: Good, start with fewer a day.

at same time.context: 你一边打电话一边收拾行李，两件事同时进行，忙得脚不沾地。
at same time.translation: 朋友：你这会在忙啥呢 你：我一边打电话一边收拾 朋友：你这不是同时干两件事吗 你：对啊，两不耽误 朋友：那你忙得过来吗 你：还行，就是有点乱
at same time.example: Friend: What are you busy doing now? You: I'm on the phone while packing. Friend: Aren't you doing two things at the same time? You: Yeah, both at once. Friend: Can you handle it? You: Fine, just a bit messy.

at sb' expense.context: 朋友请客抢着买单，结果这顿饭最后还是花了你自己的钱，让你哭笑不得。
at sb' expense.translation: 朋友：说好我请客的 你：最后还是我买的单 朋友：怎么变成你出钱了 你：对啊，这顿花我身上了 朋友：那下次我请回来 你：好，说定了
at sb' expense.example: Friend: We agreed I'd treat. You: In the end I paid the bill. Friend: How did it become your expense? You: Yeah, this meal at my expense. Friend: Then I'll treat back next time. You: Good, deal.

at some point.context: 你跟朋友说，这家店开了这么久，总有一天会再去光顾的，只是不知道具体什么时候。
at some point.translation: 朋友：那家老店你还会去吗 你：肯定会，迟早要去一趟 朋友：大概什么时候呢 你：在某一时刻吧，说不准 朋友：那你别拖太久 你：好，下个月就去
at some point.example: Friend: Will you still go to that old shop? You: Definitely, sooner or later a trip. Friend: Roughly when? You: At some point, can't say. Friend: Then don't drag too long. You: Good, go next month.

at some point or other.context: 你跟朋友抱怨，说自己这毛病时不时就犯，过一阵子又好了，反反复复。
at some point or other.translation: 朋友：你这毛病好利索了吗 你：时不时就犯一下 朋友：是不是时不时地反复 你：对啊，好一阵坏一阵 朋友：那你得去彻底看看 你：好，这周就挂号
at some point or other.example: Friend: Is that ailment fully gone? You: Now and then it flares up. Friend: Does it recur at some point or other? You: Yeah, good spell bad spell. Friend: Then get it checked thoroughly. You: Good, book a visit this week.

at that point.context: 你回忆起那场比赛，说就在那一刻，你一鼓作气反超了对手，全场都沸腾了。
at that point.translation: 朋友：那场比赛你怎么赢的 你：就在那一刻我反超了 朋友：当时全场都沸腾了吧 你：对啊，气氛特别热烈 朋友：那你是不是激动坏了 你：对，喊到嗓子都哑了
at that point.example: Friend: How did you win that match? You: At that point I overtook. Friend: The whole place erupted then, right? You: Yeah, atmosphere super hot. Friend: Were you thrilled then? You: Yes, shouted till hoarse.

at the end of one's rope.context: 你被工作压得喘不过气，连续加班一个月后，感觉自己已经到了忍无可忍的极限。
at the end of one's rope.translation: 朋友：你最近状态不太好啊 你：加班加得快撑不住了 朋友：是不是到极限了 你：对啊，简直忍无可忍 朋友：那你要不要请个假 你：好，我明天就提
at the end of one's rope.example: Friend: You don't seem well lately. You: Overtime till I can't hold on. Friend: Have you reached the limit? You: Yeah, at the end of my rope. Friend: Then should you take leave? You: Good, I'll ask tomorrow.

at the end of your rope.context: 朋友一边带孩子一边加班，两头忙得焦头烂额，你说她真是到了山穷水尽的地步。
at the end of your rope.translation: 朋友：我最近真是忙疯了 你：又带孩子又加班，谁受得了 朋友：我都快撑不下去了 你：你这是到了山穷水尽 朋友：那我该怎么办 你：请个人帮忙，别硬扛
at the end of your rope.example: Friend: I'm going crazy busy lately. You: Kids plus overtime, who can stand it. Friend: I can barely hold on. You: You're at the end of your rope. Friend: Then what should I do? You: Hire help, don't tough it alone.

at the forefront of.context: 你朋友在科研圈特别厉害，说他始终走在人工智能研究的最前沿。
at the forefront of.translation: 朋友：你那位同学现在混得怎样 你：他在AI研究里是领军的 朋友：是不是走在最前沿 你：对啊，一直处在前沿位置 朋友：那你跟他多聊聊 你：好，我常请教他
at the forefront of.example: Friend: How is that classmate of yours doing? You: He's a leader in AI research. Friend: Is he at the forefront? You: Yeah, always at the forefront. Friend: Then chat with him more. You: Good, I often consult him.

at the other extreme.context: 你评价两种极端的生活方式，说有人天天熬夜拼命，而在另一个极端有人又过于养生。
at the other extreme.translation: 朋友：你觉得年轻人该怎么活 你：有人拼命加班，有人过度养生 朋友：是不是两个极端 你：对啊，一个拼一个养 朋友：你觉得哪种好 你：中间最好，别太极端
at the other extreme.example: Friend: How should young people live? You: Some grind hard, some overdo wellness. Friend: Aren't they two extremes? You: Yeah, at one extreme, then at the other extreme. Friend: Which do you think is better? You: Middle best, don't overdo.

at the prospect of.context: 你一想到马上要上台演讲就紧张得手心冒汗，朋友说你这是对当众发言前景太敏感。
at the prospect of.translation: 朋友：你怎么一直搓手 你：一想到要演讲就紧张 朋友：是不是一想到上台就慌 你：对啊，手心全是汗 朋友：你多练几遍就好了 你：好，今晚对着镜子练
at the prospect of.example: Friend: Why do you keep rubbing your hands? You: The thought of a speech makes me nervous. Friend: Are you nervous at the prospect of speaking? You: Yeah, palms all sweaty. Friend: Practice a few more times. You: Good, practice in front of the mirror tonight.

at the push of a button.context: 你网购时感叹，现在买东西太方便了，坐在家里一键下单，第二天货就送到门口。
at the push of a button.translation: 朋友：你现在买东西方便吗 你：太方便了，一键下单就行 朋友：是不是点一下就送到家 你：对啊，第二天就到 朋友：那你还逛不逛实体店 你：大件才去，小件网购
at the push of a button.example: Friend: Is shopping convenient these days? You: So convenient, one tap and order placed. Friend: Is it delivered home at the push of a button? You: Yeah, arrives next day. Friend: Do you still visit physical stores? You: Big items only, small stuff online.

at the start.context: 你回忆起刚入职那会儿，说一开始什么都不懂，闹了不少笑话。
at the start.translation: 朋友：你刚进公司闹过笑话吗 你：一开始啥也不懂 朋友：刚开始是不是特别生涩 你：对啊，连系统都不会用 朋友：那现在适应了吧 你：对，熟了就好
at the start.example: Friend: Did you make a fool of yourself when starting? You: At the start I knew nothing. Friend: Weren't you awkward at the beginning? You: Yeah, couldn't even use the system. Friend: Settled in now? You: Yes, fine once familiar.

at the thought of.context: 你一想到周末能睡个懒觉就满心期待，连上班的疲惫都好像减轻了。
at the thought of.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天盼周末 你：一想到能睡懒觉就开心 朋友：是不是一想到休息就放松 你：对啊，连加班都不那么累 朋友：那你周末打算怎么过 你：睡到自然醒再说
at the thought of.example: Friend: Why do you look forward to weekends? You: The thought of sleeping in makes me happy. Friend: Do you relax at the thought of rest? You: Yeah, even overtime feels less tiring. Friend: Then how do you plan the weekend? You: Sleep till I wake naturally first.

at the time of.context: 你跟朋友说起当年毕业那时候，说那时大家都忙着找工作，谁也顾不上谁。
at the time of.translation: 朋友：你毕业那阵子忙不忙 你：当时大家都在找工作 朋友：那时候是不是特别焦虑 你：对啊，天天跑面试 朋友：那你们同学后来都联系吗 你：少了，各奔东西
at the time of.example: Friend: Were you busy around graduation? You: At the time everyone hunted jobs. Friend: Weren't you especially anxious then? You: Yeah, running interviews daily. Friend: Do you still keep in touch with classmates? You: Less, scattered.

at the top.context: 你爬上山脊，站在最高处俯瞰整座城市，说这就是山的顶端，风景独好。
at the top.translation: 朋友：你爬到顶了吗 你：对，现在站在最高处 朋友：山顶风景是不是特别好 你：对啊，整座城都在脚下 朋友：那你拍了全景照没 你：拍了，特别壮观
at the top.example: Friend: Did you reach the top? You: Yes, now at the top. Friend: Is the view from the top great? You: Yeah, whole city below. Friend: Did you take a panorama? You: Yes, spectacular.

at the very mention of.context: 你对猫过敏，一提到猫就开始打喷嚏，朋友笑说你这是一提猫就有反应。
at the very mention of.translation: 朋友：你怎么一说到猫就打喷嚏 你：我对猫过敏 朋友：是不是一提到就有反应 你：对啊，一提就鼻子痒 朋友：那你离猫远点 你：好，朋友家有猫我都少去
at the very mention of.example: Friend: Why do you sneeze when cats come up? You: I'm allergic to cats. Friend: Do you react at the very mention? You: Yeah, nose itches at the mention. Friend: Then stay away from cats. You: Good, avoid friends with cats.

at the very moment.context: 你刚想开口求助，朋友恰恰在那一刻把你需要的东西递了过来，默契十足。
at the very moment.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道我要递水给你 你：我刚想开口要 朋友：是不是恰恰在那一刻 你：对啊，咱们太默契了 朋友：那你还需要什么 你：不用了，正好
at the very moment.example: Friend: How did you know I'd hand you water? You: I just wanted to ask. Friend: Was it at the very moment? You: Yeah, we're so in sync. Friend: Then what else do you need? You: Nothing, just right.

at the wheel.context: 你第一次开长途车，握着方向盘手心冒汗，朋友坐在副驾提醒你别紧张。
at the wheel.translation: 朋友：你开车是不是特别紧张 你：第一次开长途，手都抖 朋友：坐在驾驶位上感觉怎样 你：对啊，眼睛都不敢眨 朋友：你慢点开，我相信你 你：好，我稳住
at the wheel.example: Friend: Are you especially nervous driving? You: First long trip, hands shaking. Friend: How does it feel at the wheel? You: Yeah, eyes don't dare blink. Friend: Drive slowly, I trust you. You: Good, I'll steady.

at their wits' end.context: 家长们被孩子的教育问题愁得不行，各种办法都试过了，简直智穷计尽。
at their wits' end.translation: 朋友：那些家长现在愁不愁 你：为孩子教育愁得不行 朋友：是不是已经没辙了 你：对啊，智穷计尽 朋友：那他们怎么办 你：只能多沟通，慢慢来
at their wits' end.example: Friend: Are those parents worried? You: Worried sick about kids' education. Friend: Have they run out of ideas? You: Yeah, at their wits' end. Friend: Then what can they do? You: Just communicate more, take it slow.

atmospheric burn-up.context: 你看航天新闻说，返回舱在穿过大气层时会因剧烈摩擦而燃烧烧毁掉大部分外层。
atmospheric burn-up.translation: 朋友：返回舱回来时什么样 你：穿过大气层时会剧烈燃烧 朋友：那外层不就烧没了 你：对啊，大部分在大气层焚毁 朋友：里面的人安全吗 你：安全，有隔热层保护
atmospheric burn-up.example: Friend: What's the return capsule like coming back? You: It burns fiercely crossing the atmosphere. Friend: Doesn't the outer layer burn off? You: Yes, most burns up in atmospheric burn-up. Friend: Are people inside safe? You: Safe, protected by heat shield.

atmospheric carbon.context: 你在环保讲座上听到，说空气中的二氧化碳浓度这些年一直在上升，和全球变暖直接相关。
atmospheric carbon.translation: 朋友：环保讲座讲了些啥 你：说大气中的碳浓度在上升 朋友：这跟全球变暖有关吗 你：对啊，正是主因 朋友：那我们能做什么 你：少开空调，多坐地铁
atmospheric carbon.example: Friend: What did the environmental talk cover? You: It said atmospheric carbon is rising. Friend: Is this linked to global warming? You: Yeah, it's the main cause. Friend: Then what can we do? You: Less AC, more subway.

atmospheric composition.context: 你看科普书说，空气是由氮气、氧气等按一定比例组成的，这种构成是地球生命的基础。
atmospheric composition.translation: 朋友：空气里都有些什么成分 你：主要是氮和氧，按比例配 朋友：这种构成是固定的吗 你：对啊，大气成分相对稳定 朋友：如果变了会怎样 你：变了人就没法呼吸了
atmospheric composition.example: Friend: What's in the air? You: Mainly nitrogen and oxygen, proportioned. Friend: Is this composition fixed? You: Yeah, atmospheric composition is stable. Friend: What if it changed? You: We couldn't breathe.

atmospheric particle.context: 雾霾天出门，你说空气里飘着很多细小的悬浮颗粒，吸进肺里对身体不好。
atmospheric particle.translation: 朋友：今天空气怎么灰蒙蒙的 你：飘着很多大气微粒 朋友：这种颗粒吸进去有害吗 你：对啊，对肺不好 朋友：那出门戴口罩没 你：戴了，还是少出门
atmospheric particle.example: Friend: Why is the air hazy today? You: Lots of atmospheric particles floating. Friend: Is inhaling these particles harmful? You: Yeah, bad for lungs. Friend: Did you wear a mask out? You: Yes, better stay in.

atmospheric pollution.context: 你站在城市街头，看着灰蒙蒙的天，说这种大气污染让晴朗日子越来越少。
atmospheric pollution.translation: 朋友：今天天怎么老是灰的 你：都是大气污染闹的 朋友：这种污染影响大吗 你：对啊，蓝天越来越少 朋友：那我们能做什么 你：少开车，多种树
atmospheric pollution.example: Friend: Why is the sky gray today? You: All due to atmospheric pollution. Friend: Is this pollution a big effect? You: Yeah, blue skies fewer. Friend: Then what can we do? You: Drive less, plant more trees.

atmospheric pressure.context: 你坐飞机爬升时耳朵发闷，朋友说这是因为高度变了，大气压也跟着变了。
atmospheric pressure.translation: 朋友：你耳朵怎么闷闷的 你：飞机爬升时气压变了 朋友：这种气压变化正常吗 你：对啊，高度越高气压越低 朋友：那怎么缓解 你：咽咽口水就通了
atmospheric pressure.example: Friend: Why do your ears feel stuffed? You: Pressure changed as the plane climbs. Friend: Is this pressure change normal? You: Yeah, higher altitude, lower pressure. Friend: How to relieve? You: Swallow and they pop.

atomic clock.context: 你跟朋友说起最精确的计时工具，说那种原子钟误差极小，是科学实验的时间标准。
atomic clock.translation: 朋友：世界上最准的钟是什么 你：是原子钟，误差极小 朋友：它能准到什么程度 你：几百万年都差不了一秒 朋友：这种钟用在哪儿 你：科学实验和卫星定位
atomic clock.example: Friend: What's the world's most accurate clock? You: An atomic clock, tiny error. Friend: How accurate can it be? You: Off less than a second in millions of years. Friend: Where is this clock used? You: Science experiments and satellite positioning.

attached to.context: 你在老房子住了很多年，说自己对这间小屋有着很深的感情，舍不得搬走。
attached to.translation: 朋友：你在这房子住多久了 你：住了好多年，有感情了 朋友：你是不是特别依恋这儿 你：对啊，搬走舍不得 朋友：那你以后还回来看看吗 你：当然，常回来转转
attached to.example: Friend: How long have you lived in this house? You: Many years, attached to it. Friend: Are you especially attached here? You: Yeah, hate to move away. Friend: Will you come back to visit? You: Of course, come around often.

attention span.context: 你看书十分钟就想刷手机，说自己现在注意力越来越短，很难长时间专注。
attention span.translation: 朋友：你看书能看多久 你：十分钟就想刷手机 朋友：你注意力时长是不是变短了 你：对啊，坐不住 朋友：那你怎么训练 你：每天多专注五分钟
attention span.example: Friend: How long can you read a book? You: Ten minutes then crave the phone. Friend: Has your attention span shortened? You: Yeah, can't sit still. Friend: Then how to train? You: Focus five more minutes daily.

attention to detail.context: 你夸朋友做事特别靠谱，说他做的方案每一处细节都考虑到了，让人放心。
attention to detail.translation: 朋友：大家怎么都那么信任他 你：他做事特别注重细节 朋友：是不是对细节要求很高 你：对啊，每处都想到 朋友：那你多跟他学学 你：好，我也学着细一点
attention to detail.example: Friend: Why does everyone trust him so much? You: He pays close attention to detail. Friend: Is he demanding on details? You: Yeah, every detail considered. Friend: Then learn from him. You: Good, I'll be more careful too.

attentive service.context: 你去那家餐厅吃饭，服务员添水、递纸巾特别周到，说这里的服务真是贴心。
attentive service.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅吃得舒服吗 你：服务员特别周到 朋友：是不是服务很贴心 你：对啊，添水递纸巾都及时 朋友：那你下次还去吗 你：去，服务好印象就好
attentive service.example: Friend: Was eating at that restaurant comfortable? You: Waiters were especially thoughtful. Friend: Is the service attentive? You: Yeah, water and napkins prompt. Friend: Will you go again? You: Yes, good service means good impression.

attributed to.context: 你分析这次销量下滑的原因，说它主要应归因于市场大环境不好，不是产品本身的问题。
attributed to.translation: 朋友：这次销量为啥下滑 你：主要是大环境不好 朋友：这能归因为产品质量吗 你：不能，是市场整体不行 朋友：那什么时候能好转 你：等大环境回暖
attributed to.example: Friend: Why did sales drop this time? You: Mainly poor market conditions. Friend: Can this be attributed to product quality? You: No, the overall market is bad. Friend: Then when will it improve? You: When the market warms up.

audience turnout.context: 你去看一场演出，发现全场坐满了人，朋友说这上座率比想象中高多了。
audience turnout.translation: 朋友：今晚演出的人多不多 你：全场都坐满了 朋友：这上座率是不是很高 你：对啊，比预想的旺 朋友：那票是不是难抢 你：对，我抢了半天才抢到
audience turnout.example: Friend: Are there many people at tonight's show? You: The whole venue is full. Friend: Is this audience turnout high? You: Yeah, busier than expected. Friend: Then were tickets hard to get? You: Yes, struggled to grab.

audio content.context: 你最近爱上听播客，说这种音频内容比刷视频更省眼睛，还能边干活边听。
audio content.translation: 朋友：你最近老戴耳机听什么 你：我在听各种播客 朋友：这种音频内容有意思吗 你：对啊，比刷视频省眼睛 朋友：那你一般什么时候听 你：做家务或者散步时听
audio content.example: Friend: What are you always listening to with headphones? You: I'm listening to various podcasts. Friend: Is this audio content interesting? You: Yeah, easier on eyes than videos. Friend: When do you usually listen? You: Doing chores or walking.

audio platform.context: 你跟朋友分享你常听的播客，说现在的音频平台特别多，想听什么随手就有。
audio platform.translation: 朋友：你都在哪儿听播客 你：几个音频平台来回换 朋友：是不是平台多得挑不过来 你：对啊，想听啥都有 朋友：你最常打开哪个 你：那个更新最快的
audio platform.example: Friend: Where do you listen to podcasts? You: Switch among a few audio platforms. Friend: Are there so many platforms to choose? You: Yeah, whatever you want is there. Friend: Which do you open most? You: The one with fastest updates.

audio track.context: 你帮朋友剪视频，说画面配的那段背景音乐特别带感，整条音轨一下子就活了。
audio track.translation: 朋友：你剪的这视频配什么音乐 你：我挑了一段节奏强的 朋友：那段音轨跟画面搭吗 你：对啊，配上就很带感 朋友：那版权没问题吧 你：用的免费素材，没事
audio track.example: Friend: What music did you edit into this video? You: I picked a strong rhythm track. Friend: Does that audio track match the visuals? You: Yeah, pairing it feels exciting. Friend: No copyright issues? You: Using free material, fine.

augmented reality.context: 你用手机对着家具一扫，屏幕上就能叠加上尺寸和颜色，这种增强现实技术让逛店特别方便。
augmented reality.translation: 朋友：你用手机对着墙在看啥 你：我在试它的增强现实功能 朋友：是不是能把家具摆进家里 你：对啊，叠加在实景上看效果 朋友：这技术挺酷啊 你：对，装修前先看个大概
augmented reality.example: Friend: What are you doing pointing your phone at the wall? You: I'm trying its augmented reality feature. Friend: Can it place furniture into your home? You: Yeah, overlay on the real scene to see effect. Friend: This tech is cool. You: Yeah, preview before renovating.

aural treat.context: 你听完那场音乐会，回到家还在回味，说那一晚的演奏简直是一场听觉盛宴。
aural treat.translation: 朋友：昨晚那场音乐会怎么样 你：简直是一场听觉享受 朋友：哪一段最打动你 你：小提琴独奏那段特别美 朋友：你是不是还想再听一次 你：对，好作品百听不厌
aural treat.example: Friend: How was last night's concert? You: It was a real aural treat. Friend: Which part moved you most? You: The violin solo was especially beautiful. Friend: Do you want to hear it again? You: Yes, great music never tires.

autobiographical memory.context: 你跟朋友聊起童年的一件件往事，说人对自己经历的这种记忆，是靠一连串具体的事拼起来的。
autobiographical memory.translation: 朋友：你还记得小时候的事吗 你：记得一些，都是具体的事 朋友：这种记忆靠什么串起来 你：就是靠自传体记忆把往事拼起来 朋友：那你最难忘的是哪件 你：第一次学骑车摔破膝盖
autobiographical memory.example: Friend: Do you remember childhood things? You: Some, all specific events. Friend: What links these memories together? You: It's autobiographical memory piecing them together. Friend: Which do you remember most? You: The first bike fall scraping my knee.

autoimmune conditions.context: 你朋友得了一种免疫系统攻击自身的病，医生说这属于自身免疫性疾病，需要长期调理。
autoimmune conditions.translation: 朋友：你那个老毛病是怎么回事 你：是免疫系统攻击自己身体 朋友：医生说这属于什么病 你：说是自身免疫类的毛病 朋友：能根治吗 你：难，得长期吃药调理
autoimmune conditions.example: Friend: What's that chronic ailment of yours? You: The immune system attacks the body itself. Friend: What did the doctor call this condition? You: Said it's among autoimmune conditions. Friend: Can it be cured? You: Hard, long-term medication.

automated admin.context: 公司里原来手工填表报销的活，现在都用软件自动处理，这种行政自动化省了大家不少时间。
automated admin.translation: 朋友：你们报销现在还手写吗 你：不用，都用软件自动处理 朋友：这种行政自动化省事吗 你：对啊，省了好多时间 朋友：那以前手工多麻烦 你：对，现在一键提交就行
automated admin.example: Friend: Do you still fill out reimbursements by hand? You: No, software handles it automatically. Friend: Does this automated admin save effort? You: Yeah, saves lots of time. Friend: Was handwork troublesome before? You: Yes, now one submit and done.

automatic reaction.context: 杯子快掉地上时，你手一伸就接住了，朋友说你这根本是来不及思考的本能反应。
automatic reaction.translation: 朋友：你手怎么那么快 你：杯子要掉时我一下接住 朋友：这反应是不是本能的 你：对啊，根本来不及想 朋友：你平时就这么敏捷吗 你：偶尔，全靠下意识
automatic reaction.example: Friend: Why are your hands so fast? You: Caught the cup as it was falling. Friend: Is this an automatic reaction? You: Yeah, no time to think. Friend: Are you usually this agile? You: Occasionally, purely reflex.

average out.context: 你算了下这几天在外吃饭的账，说把每顿加起来平均下来，一顿也就五十块。
average out.translation: 朋友：你这几天在外吃饭花多少 你：把每顿加起来平均下来 朋友：算下来一顿多少钱 你：一顿平均大概五十块 朋友：贵不贵啊 你：还行，偶尔出去吃
average out.example: Friend: How much did you eat out these days? You: Add every meal and it averages out. Friend: What's the average per meal? You: It averages out to about fifty per meal. Friend: Expensive? You: Fine, eating out occasionally.

average temperature.context: 你查了下那座城市的气候，说它夏天平均气温三十度，冬天也不太冷，很宜居。
average temperature.translation: 朋友：那城市夏天热不热 你：平均气温三十度上下 朋友：冬天冷不冷呢 你：冬天也十来度，挺舒服 朋友：那是不是特别适合住 你：对，四季都温和
average temperature.example: Friend: Is it hot in summer in that city? You: The average temperature is around thirty. Friend: Is it cold in winter? You: Winter is about ten degrees, comfortable. Friend: Then is it great to live? You: Yes, mild year round.

aviation company.context: 你出差要选航班，对比了好几家航空公司，最后挑了个价钱便宜时间又合适的。
aviation company.translation: 朋友：你出差订的哪家航班 你：我比了好几家航空公司 朋友：最后选了哪一家 你：选了那家便宜又合适的 朋友：服务怎么样 你：还行，反正就飞两小时
aviation company.example: Friend: Which airline did you book for the trip? You: I compared several aviation companies. Friend: Which did you choose? You: Picked the cheap and suitable one. Friend: How's the service? You: Fine, only a two-hour flight.

aviation expert.context: 你看新闻采访一位研究航空多年的专家，他说现在飞机安全系数已经非常高了。
aviation expert.translation: 朋友：新闻里那个专家是干嘛的 你：他是研究航空的专家 朋友：他怎么说现在坐飞机安全吗 你：他说安全系数已经很高 朋友：那我们还担心啥 你：对啊，听他这么说就放心了
aviation expert.example: Friend: What is that expert on the news? You: He's an aviation expert. Friend: What did he say about flying safety? You: He said safety is already very high. Friend: Then what are we worried about? You: Yeah, feel reassured hearing him.

avoid at all costs.context: 你肠胃本来就弱，朋友提醒你那种太辣的东西千万要极力避开，吃了准拉肚子。
avoid at all costs.translation: 朋友：这家火锅你吃得了吗 你：我肠胃弱，得避开太辣的 朋友：是不是要极力避开那种辣 你：对啊，吃了准拉肚子 朋友：那你点个清汤锅 你：好，我可不冒险
avoid at all costs.example: Friend: Can you handle this hot pot? You: My stomach is weak, avoid too spicy. Friend: Should you avoid that spice at all costs? You: Yeah, it guarantees diarrhea. Friend: Then order a clear broth pot. You: Good, I won't risk it.

avoid awkwardness.context: 你跟不太熟的同事一起等电梯，没话找话几句，就为了避免那几秒的尴尬。
avoid awkwardness.translation: 朋友：你在电梯里不闷吗 你：我特意找了几句聊 朋友：你是不是怕场面尴尬 你：对啊，不说话太僵了 朋友：你都聊了些啥 你：就天气、吃饭这些
avoid awkwardness.example: Friend: Aren't you stuffy in the elevator? You: I deliberately made small talk. Friend: Do you avoid awkwardness? You: Yeah, silence is too stiff. Friend: What did you talk about? You: Weather, meals, stuff like that.

avoid confrontation.context: 你跟合伙人意见不合，但你尽量憋着不吵，说能避免冲突就别撕破脸。
avoid confrontation.translation: 朋友：你俩昨天不是吵起来了吗 你：我尽量忍着，没正面刚 朋友：你是不是想避免冲突 你：对啊，撕破脸不好看 朋友：那分歧怎么解决 你：坐下来慢慢谈
avoid confrontation.example: Friend: Didn't you two clash yesterday? You: I held back, didn't fight head on. Friend: Are you avoiding confrontation? You: Yeah, ugly falling out looks bad. Friend: Then how resolve the disagreement? You: Sit down and talk it out.

avoid consumption.context: 你体检出尿酸高，医生让你忌口，海鲜和啤酒这段时间先别碰。
avoid consumption.translation: 朋友：你体检结果怎么样 你：尿酸高，医生让我忌口 朋友：哪些东西不能吃 你：海鲜啤酒这段先别碰 朋友：那你能坚持住吗 你：没办法，得管住嘴
avoid consumption.example: Friend: How's your checkup result? You: Uric acid high, doctor told me to avoid consumption. Friend: What can't you eat? You: Seafood and beer for now. Friend: Can you stick to it? You: No choice, must watch what I eat.

avoid crowds.context: 你周末不爱去人挤人的景点，专挑清净的地方待着，说能躲开人群才舒服。
avoid crowds.translation: 朋友：周末你都去哪儿玩 你：我专挑人少的地方 朋友：你是不是不爱凑热闹 你：对啊，躲开人群才舒服 朋友：那你一般去哪儿 你：郊外，人少清静
avoid crowds.example: Friend: Where do you go on weekends? You: I pick less crowded places. Friend: Do you dislike crowds? You: Yeah, avoiding crowds feels great. Friend: Then where do you usually go? You: Suburbs, quiet and sparse.

avoid excess.context: 你过生日请客，朋友说差不多就行，别铺张浪费，能省则省。
avoid excess.translation: 朋友：你生日准备摆几桌 你：就两三个朋友吃顿便饭 朋友：你是不是故意不铺张 你：对啊，避免过分铺张 朋友：那你这性格挺节俭 你：嗯，够花就行
avoid excess.example: Friend: How many tables for your birthday? You: Just two or three friends for a simple meal. Friend: Are you deliberately avoiding excess? You: Yeah, avoid overdoing the splurge. Friend: Then you're quite frugal. You: Yeah, enough is enough.

avoid livestock.context: 你最近开始吃素，朋友聚餐时你说自己不吃畜禽肉，让大家多点些青菜。
avoid livestock.translation: 朋友：这顿聚餐你想吃点啥 你：我最近不吃畜禽肉 朋友：你是想避开这些肉吗 你：对啊，我开始吃素了 朋友：那我们多点几个素菜 你：好，再来个豆腐就行
avoid livestock.example: Friend: What do you want at this meal? You: I've stopped eating livestock meat lately. Friend: Do you want to avoid this meat? You: Yeah, I've gone vegetarian. Friend: Then let's order more veg dishes. You: Good, plus a tofu dish.

avoid overexertion.context: 你刚跑完马拉松又想接着去健身，朋友劝你别太累着，运动要避免过度劳累。
avoid overexertion.translation: 朋友：你跑完马拉松还去健身 你：对，我想再练会儿 朋友：你可得避免过度劳累 你：我精神好，不累 朋友：身体迟早抗议的 你：行，那我今天歇着
avoid overexertion.example: Friend: You still gym after the marathon? You: Yeah, want to train a bit more. Friend: You should avoid overexertion. You: I feel great, not tired. Friend: Your body will protest sooner or later. You: Fine, I'll rest today.

avoid repetition.context: 你上次考试因为粗心丢了分，这次做题反复检查，就是为了避免重蹈覆辙。
avoid repetition.translation: 朋友：你这次做题怎么这么仔细 你：上次粗心丢分，这次得改 朋友：你是不是想避免再犯 你：对啊，同样的错不犯第二次 朋友：那你检查出问题没 你：查出两处差点错的
avoid repetition.example: Friend: Why are you so careful this time? You: Lost points on carelessness last time, must fix. Friend: Are you avoiding repetition of the mistake? You: Yeah, don't repeat the same error. Friend: Did you catch any problems? You: Caught two near-misses.

avoid wastage.context: 你食堂打饭总吃多少打多少，说剩菜剩饭挺可惜的，平时要杜绝浪费。
avoid wastage.translation: 朋友：你打饭怎么每次都打这么少 你：我吃多少打多少 朋友：你是不是怕剩下浪费 你：对啊，杜绝浪费才好 朋友：那你够吃吗 你：够，不浪费正好
avoid wastage.example: Friend: Why do you take so little food each time? You: I take as much as I eat. Friend: Are you avoiding wastage? You: Yeah, preventing waste is good. Friend: Then do you have enough? You: Enough, no waste is just right.

avoidance behaviour.context: 朋友一遇到开会发言就往后躲，你说他这种回避行为是因为太紧张了。
avoidance behaviour.translation: 朋友：他怎么一发言就躲后面 你：他太紧张，就爱往后躲 朋友：这是不是一种回避行为 你：对啊，怕当众说话 朋友：那他怎么练 你：先从小组发言开始
avoidance behaviour.example: Friend: Why does he hide back when speaking? You: Too nervous, loves hiding back. Friend: Is this avoidance behaviour? You: Yeah, fears public speaking. Friend: Then how does he practice? You: Start with small group talks.

aware of.context: 你提醒朋友，说你对花粉过敏这个事他可能没意识到，春天出门记得提一句。
aware of.translation: 朋友：你最近老打喷嚏咋回事 你：我对花粉过敏，你知道吧 朋友：你知道这事儿吗 你：对啊，我意识到春天要注意 朋友：那你出门戴口罩 你：好，我记着
aware of.example: Friend: Why do you keep sneezing lately? You: I'm allergic to pollen, you know. Friend: Are you aware of this? You: Yeah, I'm aware spring needs care. Friend: Then wear a mask out. You: Good, I'll remember.

awkward interaction.context: 你和朋友抢着付账，两个人推来推去，那个场面既尴尬又好笑。
awkward interaction.translation: 朋友：刚才结账那场面怪尴尬的 你：咱俩推来推去都不好意思 朋友：是不是那次互动特别别扭 你：对啊，谁都想买单 朋友：下次咱俩说定谁请 你：好，省得现场推
awkward interaction.example: Friend: Was the bill scene awkward just now? You: Pushing back and forth, both embarrassed. Friend: Was that interaction especially awkward? You: Yeah, everyone wanted to pay. Friend: Next time let's agree who treats. You: Good, avoid the tussle.

awkward situation.context: 你说错话冷了场，站在那里不知道怎么圆，那种尴尬的场面让你恨不得找个地缝钻。
awkward situation.translation: 朋友：你怎么不说话了 你：我刚才说错话，冷场了 朋友：那场面是不是特尴尬 你：对啊，大家都看着我 朋友：你怎么收场的 你：打个哈哈就过去了
awkward situation.example: Friend: Why aren't you talking? You: I said something wrong, dead air. Friend: Was that situation especially awkward? You: Yeah, everyone stared at me. Friend: How did you end it? You: Laughed it off.

axe throwing.context: 你和朋友去玩一种新出的解压运动，抡起斧子往木靶上扔，特别发泄。
axe throwing.translation: 朋友：你周末去玩的那是啥 你：是扔斧头，抡起来往木靶上砸 朋友：这运动解压吗 你：对啊，特别发泄 朋友：你扔得准不准 你：一般，玩个乐子
axe throwing.example: Friend: What did you play this weekend? You: Axe throwing, swing at a wood target. Friend: Is this sport stress-relieving? You: Yeah, really cathartic. Friend: Are you accurate? You: Average, just for fun.

axial length.context: 你带孩子去验光，医生说近视加深和眼轴变长有关，得定期复查眼轴长度。
axial length.translation: 朋友：你孩子近视加深了吗 你：医生说跟眼轴变长有关 朋友：他说要定期查这个长度吗 你：对啊，每半年量一次 朋友：那怎么控制 你：多户外活动，少看手机
axial length.example: Friend: Did your child's myopia deepen? You: The doctor says it relates to axial length growth. Friend: Did he say to check this length regularly? You: Yeah, measure every half year. Friend: Then how to control it? You: More outdoors, less phone.

baby schema.context: 你看到别人家的小宝宝，圆脸蛋大眼睛，说这种婴儿般的可爱模样让人忍不住想抱。
baby schema.translation: 朋友：那小宝宝长得真招人疼 你：圆脸大眼，特别可爱 朋友：是不是那种婴儿式的萌 你：对啊，谁看了都想抱 朋友：你是不是也想养一个 你：先算了，太费精力
baby schema.example: Friend: That baby is so endearing. You: Round face, big eyes, super cute. Friend: Is it that baby-schema cuteness? You: Yeah, everyone wants to hold it. Friend: Do you want to raise one too? You: Not yet, too much energy.

baby step.context: 你学新技能不贪多，说要一步一步来，小步走才能把基础打扎实。
baby step.translation: 朋友：你学新东西怎么这么慢 你：我喜欢循序渐进 朋友：是不是一小步一小步来 你：对啊，基础打牢再往下 朋友：那你学得扎实吗 你：对，稳扎稳打
baby step.example: Friend: Why so slow learning new things? You: I like gradual progress. Friend: Is it one baby step at a time? You: Yeah, solid foundation then move on. Friend: Do you learn solidly? You: Yes, steady as you go.

bachelor's degree.context: 你表弟今年大四，正在准备毕业论文，再过几个月就能拿到学士学位了。
bachelor's degree.translation: 朋友：你表弟今年快毕业了吧 你：对，在写毕业论文 朋友：他拿的是什么学位 你：学士学位，再过几个月 朋友：那他打算继续读研吗 你：先工作两年再说
bachelor's degree.example: Friend: Is your cousin graduating this year? You: Yes, writing his thesis. Friend: What degree is he getting? You: A bachelor's degree, in a few months. Friend: Does he plan grad school? You: Work two years first.

back garden.context: 你家房子后面有个小花园，你周末爱在那里种种花，喝喝茶，特别惬意。
back garden.translation: 朋友：你家后面那个院子是啥 你：是个后花园，种满了花 朋友：你周末在那儿干嘛 你：浇浇花，喝喝茶 朋友：这种日子真舒服 你：对啊，忙完就去待会儿
back garden.example: Friend: What's that yard behind your place? You: A back garden full of flowers. Friend: What do you do there on weekends? You: Water flowers, drink tea. Friend: This life is comfortable. You: Yeah, go relax after work.

back in the day.context: 你翻到老照片，跟朋友说从前那时候大家都用公用电话，哪有现在这么方便。
back in the day.translation: 朋友：你这张老照片啥时候拍的 你：好久以前，从前那时候 朋友：那时候大家都怎么联系 你：打公用电话，没手机 朋友：那现在多方便 你：对，一个微信就够
back in the day.example: Friend: When was this old photo taken? You: Long ago, back in the day. Friend: How did people contact back then? You: Pay phones, no mobiles. Friend: How convenient now. You: Yeah, a WeChat message is enough.

back out of.context: 你答应了朋友一起报名比赛，临到跟前又想反悔，朋友说你可别临时退出。
back out of.translation: 朋友：你不是答应跟我一起报名吗 你：我现在有点想打退堂鼓 朋友：你可别临阵退出啊 你：可我怕比不好丢人 朋友：报都报了，就当玩玩 你：行，那我不退出了
back out of.example: Friend: Didn't you promise to sign up with me? You: I kind of want to back out now. Friend: Don't back out of it at the last minute. You: But I fear losing face if I do badly. Friend: Signed already, just for fun. You: Fine, I won't back out.

backbreaking work.context: 你暑假回老家帮爷爷收麦子，干了一天就累得直不起腰，说这真是累断腰的农活。
backbreaking work.translation: 朋友：你回老家帮爷爷忙啥了 你：收麦子，干了一天 朋友：这种活是不是特别累 你：对啊，累得直不起腰 朋友：你干得了这活吗 你：勉强，干完就躺平
backbreaking work.example: Friend: What did you help grandpa with back home? You: Harvesting wheat, worked a day. Friend: Is this work especially backbreaking? You: Yeah, can't straighten up. Friend: Can you handle it? You: Barely, then collapse.

backup copy.context: 你每次写完重要文件都存两份，一份本地一份云端，说有备份才不怕电脑坏。
backup copy.translation: 朋友：你文件存了几份 你：本地一份，云端一份 朋友：是不是做了备份副本 你：对啊，就怕电脑突然坏 朋友：那你丢过文件没 你：没有，靠备份从没丢过
backup copy.example: Friend: How many copies of your files? You: One local, one cloud. Friend: Did you make a backup copy? You: Yeah, fear the computer breaking. Friend: Have you ever lost files? You: No, backups saved me.

backup planet.context: 你看科幻片说如果地球住不下去了，人类得找一个备选星球当第二个家。
backup planet.translation: 朋友：科幻片里人类为啥跑外星 你：地球坏了，得找个地方住 朋友：那他们找的是啥 你：一个备选的宜居星球 朋友：现实中这种星球存在吗 你：理论上有，太远去不了
backup planet.example: Friend: Why do humans flee to space in sci-fi? You: Earth broken, need a place to live. Friend: What did they find? You: A backup planet to live on. Friend: Does such a planet exist in reality? You: Theoretically yes, too far to reach.

bacterial growth.context: 夏天食物放久了容易长细菌，你提醒朋友这盒牛奶开了赶紧喝，别等细菌滋生。
bacterial growth.translation: 朋友：这牛奶还能喝吗 你：都放两天了，当心坏 朋友：是不是容易长细菌 你：对啊，放久了细菌就滋生 朋友：那我赶紧喝掉 你：好，别留到明天
bacterial growth.example: Friend: Is this milk still drinkable? You: Sat two days, watch it. Friend: Does bacteria easily grow? You: Yeah, left long, bacterial growth starts. Friend: Then I'll drink it now. You: Good, don't leave till tomorrow.

bacterial microbiome.context: 你看科普说，人的肠道里住着上亿细菌，这套微生物组影响着消化和免疫。
bacterial microbiome.translation: 朋友：你最近看的科普讲啥 你：讲肠道里的细菌群 朋友：这细菌群管什么用 你：它影响消化和免疫 朋友：那怎么养好它 你：多吃蔬菜，少喝奶茶
bacterial microbiome.example: Friend: What's the science you're reading? You: About gut bacteria. Friend: What does this bacterial microbiome do? You: It affects digestion and immunity. Friend: Then how to nourish it? You: More veg, less milk tea.

balance out.context: 你这个月花得多，但省下来的加班费刚好补上，说一进一出总算相抵了。
balance out.translation: 朋友：你这月是不是超支了 你：花得多，但加班费补上了 朋友：收支这不就相抵了 你：对啊，一进一出刚好拉平 朋友：那你还能存下钱吗 你：勉强，刚够平衡
balance out.example: Friend: Did you overspend this month? You: Spent a lot, but overtime pay covered it. Friend: Doesn't income and outgo balance out? You: Yeah, in and out evened out. Friend: Then can you still save? You: Barely, just balances.

balancing act.context: 你一边要忙工作一边要顾家，说每天在两者之间走钢丝，就像在表演平衡术。
balancing act.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么这么累 你：又要工作又要顾家 朋友：是不是在两头间走钢丝 你：对啊，每天都在平衡取舍 朋友：那你顾得过来吗 你：勉强，慢慢找节奏
balancing act.example: Friend: Why are you so tired lately? You: Work plus taking care of home. Friend: Aren't you juggling a tightrope? You: Yeah, a balancing act every day. Friend: Can you handle both? You: Barely, finding rhythm.

bamboo fabric.context: 你买的一件T恤摸起来特别软，店员说这是竹纤维面料，主打天然环保。
bamboo fabric.translation: 朋友：你这件衣服摸着真软 你：店员说是竹纤维面料 朋友：这种面料有啥好 你：主打天然，还挺透气 朋友：洗了会不会变形 你：暂时不会，我刚穿
bamboo fabric.example: Friend: This shirt of yours feels so soft. You: The clerk said it's bamboo fabric. Friend: What's good about this fabric? You: Natural claim, also breathable. Friend: Will it deform after washing? You: Not yet, just started.

ban from.context: 那个游客在景区乱涂乱画，被工作人员禁止再进入园区，说以后都不让他进了。
ban from.translation: 朋友：那个游客怎么被赶出来了 你：他乱涂乱画，被禁止进园 朋友：以后是不是都不让他进了 你：对啊，直接禁止进入 朋友：这种处罚挺重的 你：对，就该这样罚
ban from.example: Friend: Why was that tourist kicked out? You: He scribbled, banned from the park. Friend: Is he barred from entering from now on? You: Yeah, banned outright. Friend: This penalty is heavy. You: Yes, should penalize so.

ban from pavements.context: 你看到告示牌说共享单车不准骑上人行道，违者罚款，说这是为了行人安全。
ban from pavements.translation: 朋友：路边那个告示写的啥 你：说单车不准在人行道上骑 朋友：是不是禁止在人行道行驶 你：对啊，怕撞到行人 朋友：那骑错了会罚款吗 你：会，抓到就罚
ban from pavements.example: Friend: What does that roadside sign say? You: Says bikes can't ride on pavements. Friend: Are bikes banned from pavements? You: Yeah, fear of hitting pedestrians. Friend: Is it a fine if ridden wrong? You: Yes, fined when caught.

ban from store.context: 那个小偷被店家拉进了黑名单，说以后都不准他再进这家店购物。
ban from store.translation: 朋友：那人怎么进不了那家店 你：他以前偷过东西 朋友：是不是被禁止进店了 你：对啊，店家拉黑了他 朋友：那他以后怎么办 你：换别家买呗
ban from store.example: Friend: Why can't that person enter that shop? You: He stole things before. Friend: Is he banned from the store? You: Yeah, the shop blacklisted him. Friend: Then what does he do? You: Buy elsewhere.

band wagon.context: 你发现身边人人都在追那款新游戏，说这股跟风潮流挡都挡不住。
band wagon.translation: 朋友：最近大家都在玩啥 你：都在追那款新出的游戏 朋友：是不是赶上了跟风潮 你：对啊，不玩都落伍 朋友：你也跟着玩了吗 你：对，被大家拉进去的
band wagon.example: Friend: What is everyone playing lately? You: Chasing that new game. Friend: Is it riding the bandwagon trend? You: Yeah, not playing feels behind. Friend: Did you follow along? You: Yes, pulled in by everyone.

bang on time.context: 你约朋友见面，他每次都准点到，一分不差，你说这人真是守时得让人佩服。
bang on time.translation: 朋友：他约见从来都迟到吗 你：不，他每次都准点 朋友：是不是分秒不差 你：对啊，说几点就几点 朋友：这种人真难得 你：对，跟他约最省心
bang on time.example: Friend: Is he ever late for meetups? You: No, always bang on time. Friend: Is he right on the dot? You: Yeah, says when, is when. Friend: This kind of person is rare. You: Yes, meeting him is worry-free.

bang out.context: 你赶稿 deadline，一个下午就连写带改弄出三篇推文，朋友说你这速度真是一挥而就。
bang out.translation: 朋友：你一下午写了几篇 你：连写带改弄出三篇 朋友：你这速度是一挥而就啊 你：赶着交，没办法 朋友：质量还行吗 你：凑合，先交再说
bang out.example: Friend: How many did you write in one afternoon? You: Banged out three, writing and editing. Friend: You really banged them out fast. You: Rushing a deadline, no choice. Friend: Is the quality okay? You: Passable, submit first.

bank on.context: 你跟朋友说这事可全靠你了，我就指望你帮我办成，千万别掉链子。
bank on.translation: 朋友：这事儿你放心交给我 你：我可就指望你了 朋友：你能完全靠得住我吗 你：对啊，全指望你帮我 朋友：那你等我消息 你：好，我信得过你
bank on.example: Friend: Trust me with this matter. You: I'm banking on you now. Friend: Can you bank on me? You: Yeah, banking on your help. Friend: Then wait for my news. You: Good, I trust you.

bargain hunt.context: 你周末爱逛奥特莱斯，说专门挑打折的牌子买，这种淘便宜货的乐趣别人不懂。
bargain hunt.translation: 朋友：你周末都去哪儿逛 你：我专挑打折的店淘 朋友：你是不是爱淘便宜货 你：对啊，买到划算的特开心 朋友：你淘到过啥好东西 你：一件名牌外套，三折
bargain hunt.example: Friend: Where do you shop on weekends? You: I pick discount stores to hunt. Friend: Do you love bargain hunting? You: Yeah, happy when I find deals. Friend: What good finds? You: A designer jacket at seventy percent off.

base jumping.context: 你朋友胆子特别大，站在高楼上往下跳，说这种低空跳伞玩的就是心跳。
base jumping.translation: 朋友：你朋友刚才从哪跳下来的 你：从高楼上跳的 朋友：他玩的是不是低空跳伞 你：对啊，专跳高楼大桥 朋友：这也太吓人了 你：他就爱这种刺激
base jumping.example: Friend: Where did your friend jump from just now? You: Off a tall building. Friend: Is he base jumping? You: Yeah, jumps buildings and bridges. Friend: This is terrifying. You: He loves the thrill.

base out of.context: 你跟朋友说那家公司总部设在深圳，全国各地都有它的分公司。
base out of.translation: 朋友：那家公司总部在哪 你：总部设在深圳 朋友：它是总部设在深圳的吗 你：对啊，各地都有分公司 朋友：那你在哪个分部 你：我在广州这边
base out of.example: Friend: Where's that company's HQ? You: Based in Shenzhen. Friend: Is it based out of Shenzhen? You: Yeah, branches nationwide. Friend: Which branch are you in? You: The Guangzhou one.

basket case.context: 你朋友最近工作感情双不顺，人都快崩溃了，你说他现在简直是个情绪失控的人。
basket case.translation: 朋友：他最近状态咋这样 你：工作感情全不顺，人要垮了 朋友：他是不是快精神崩溃了 你：对啊，整个一个情绪崩溃的人 朋友：那你多陪陪他 你：好，我常拉他出去散心
basket case.example: Friend: Why is his state like this? You: Work and love both bad, breaking down. Friend: Is he almost a basket case? You: Yeah, a total emotional wreck. Friend: Then stay with him more. You: Good, I take him out often.

battery life.context: 你手机用了两年，一天得充两次电，说这电池续航是越来越不行了。
battery life.translation: 朋友：你手机电量够用吗 你：一天得充两回 朋友：是不是电池续航变差了 你：对啊，老机器不经用 朋友：那你要不要换手机 你：再撑撑，不行就换
battery life.example: Friend: Does your phone battery last? You: Charge twice a day. Friend: Has the battery life degraded? You: Yeah, old machine won't last. Friend: Then should you upgrade? You: Hold on, then swap.

battle to save the day.context: 比赛最后一分钟球队还落后，前锋一记绝杀，力挽狂澜帮全队赢了回来。
battle to save the day.translation: 朋友：最后那球咋赢的 你：前锋一记绝杀 朋友：是不是他力挽狂澜 你：对啊，一下就翻盘 朋友：全场是不是都沸腾了 你：对，喊到嗓子哑
battle to save the day.example: Friend: How did they win the last goal? You: Striker's last-second winner. Friend: Did he battle to save the day? You: Yeah, turned it around at once. Friend: Did the crowd erupt? You: Yes, hoarse shouting.

battle with.context: 你朋友跟失眠斗争了大半年，说每天晚上都在和睡意较劲，特别累。
battle with.translation: 朋友：他最近休息得好吗 你：还在跟失眠斗争 朋友：他是不是每晚都在挣扎 你：对啊，越想睡越睡不着 朋友：他没去看看医生吗 你：去了，正在调理
battle with.example: Friend: Is he resting well lately? You: Still battling insomnia. Friend: Is he struggling with it every night? You: Yeah, the more he wants sleep, the worse. Friend: Has he seen a doctor? You: Yes, getting treated.

bawl one's eyes out.context: 你看那部催泪电影，哭得稀里哗啦，走出影院时眼睛都肿了。
bawl one's eyes out.translation: 朋友：你眼睛咋肿了 你：看那电影哭的 朋友：你是不是哭得特别凶 你：对啊，哭得稀里哗啦 朋友：啥片子这么感人 你：讲亲情的，一看就想哭
bawl one's eyes out.example: Friend: Why are your eyes swollen? You: Cried watching that film. Friend: Did you bawl your eyes out? You: Yeah, cried buckets. Friend: What film is that moving? You: About family, makes you cry.

bawling your eyes out.context: 你送朋友去车站，车一开走他就站在原地号啕大哭，弄得你也红了眼。
bawling your eyes out.translation: 朋友：刚才那个人哭啥呢 你：他刚送走朋友，舍不得 朋友：他是不是号啕大哭 你：对啊，哭得停不下来 朋友：你也跟着难受吧 你：对，我也红了眼
bawling your eyes out.example: Friend: Why was that person crying? You: Just saw a friend off, can't bear it. Friend: Was he bawling his eyes out? You: Yeah, couldn't stop sobbing. Friend: You felt it too? You: Yeah, eyes welled up.

bay window.context: 你家客厅有一扇凸出去的窗，午后阳光洒进来，坐在窗边特别舒服。
bay window.translation: 朋友：你家那个凸窗是啥 你：就是凸出去的一扇窗 朋友：那儿坐着晒太阳舒服吗 你：对啊，午后阳光特别好 朋友：你是不是老坐那儿看书 你：对，那是我最爱待的地方
bay window.example: Friend: What's that bay window at your place? You: A window that juts out. Friend: Is it comfy sitting there in the sun? You: Yeah, afternoon sun is lovely. Friend: Do you always read there? You: Yes, my favorite spot.

be aimed at.context: 你看那则广告，说它主打年轻人，专门针对喜欢潮流的受众设计。
be aimed at.translation: 朋友：这广告是给谁看的 你：主打年轻人那拨人 朋友：它是不是专门针对年轻人 你：对啊，风格都是潮流款 朋友：那效果好不好 你：对年轻人特别管用
be aimed at.example: Friend: Who is this ad aimed at? You: Targeting young people. Friend: Is it aimed at young people? You: Yeah, all trendy style. Friend: Is the effect good? You: Especially works on the young.

be all the rage.context: 你发现那种网红饮品最近特别火，走到哪儿都有人捧一杯，真是风靡一时。
be all the rage.translation: 朋友：街上咋人人都拿那杯饮料 你：那饮品最近特别流行 朋友：是不是风靡一时了 你：对啊，走到哪儿都看见 朋友：你也去凑个热闹没 你：排过队，喝过一回
be all the rage.example: Friend: Why does everyone hold that drink? You: That drink's been all the rage lately. Friend: Is it all the rage? You: Yeah, see it everywhere. Friend: Did you join the craze? You: Queued, had it once.

be at fault.context: 你们俩都在那场误会里有错，朋友问到底是谁的责任，你说双方都有过错。
be at fault.translation: 朋友：那事到底怪谁 你：其实咱俩都有错 朋友：是不是双方都有责任 你：对啊，谁也别全推给谁 朋友：那这账怎么算 你：一人让一步就算了
be at fault.example: Friend: Who is to blame for that? You: Actually both of us were at fault. Friend: Is both sides at fault? You: Yeah, don't push it all. Friend: Then how settle the bill? You: Each step back and let it go.

be blamed.context: 项目出了纰漏，大家都盯着新来的实习生，说这锅怎么也不该他来背。
be blamed.translation: 朋友：项目出错谁背锅啊 你：大家都盯着那实习生 朋友：可这错真该他来负责吗 你：不该，他也是被人坑的 朋友：那最后怎么处理 你：主管出来替他担了
be blamed.example: Friend: Who takes the blame for the mess? You: Everyone's staring at the intern. Friend: Should he really be blamed for it? You: No, he was set up. Friend: Then how was it handled? You: The supervisor took the blame for him.

be careful to.context: 你开车出门前，朋友提醒你路上小心，务必把安全带系好再出发。
be careful to.translation: 朋友：你今天要开车出门啊 你：对，去趟郊区 朋友：路上一定小心开车 你：放心，我会慢点开 朋友：记得把安全带系好 你：知道，一上车就系
be careful to.example: Friend: You're driving out today? You: Yeah, to the suburbs. Friend: Be careful on the road. You: Relax, I'll drive slowly. Friend: Be sure to fasten your seatbelt. You: Know, on as soon as I get in.

be computer-savvy.context: 你修电脑、装软件样样都会，朋友说你这人可真是精通电脑的技术达人。
be computer-savvy.translation: 朋友：我电脑坏了找你行吗 你：行，我挺懂电脑的 朋友：你真是精通电脑的那种人 你：对啊，装系统修硬件都会 朋友：那你帮我看看这死机 你：好，重启一下试试
be computer-savvy.example: Friend: Can I ask you about my broken computer? You: Sure, I'm quite computer-savvy. Friend: You're really computer-savvy. You: Yeah, install systems and fix hardware. Friend: Then help me with this crash. You: Good, restart and try.

be concerned with.context: 你做这份工作主要关注用户体验，说比起赚不赚钱，你更在意产品好不好用。
be concerned with.translation: 朋友：你工作最在意啥 你：我主要关注用户体验 朋友：你是关心还是担心这个 你：对啊，产品好不好用最重要 朋友：那你平时都怎么调研 你：找用户访谈听意见
be concerned with.example: Friend: What matters most in your work? You: I'm mainly concerned with user experience. Friend: Do you care or worry about this? You: Yeah, product usability matters most. Friend: How do you research? You: Interview users for feedback.

be consumed by.context: 你因为说错一句话，整个人被愧疚感缠着，一整天都坐立不安。
be consumed by.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么心不在焉 你：我昨天说错话了 朋友：你是不是被愧疚感缠住了 你：对啊，一整天都不好受 朋友：那你去道个歉 你：好，我待会就去
be consumed by.example: Friend: Why are you distracted today? You: I said the wrong thing yesterday. Friend: Are you consumed by guilt? You: Yeah, awful all day. Friend: Then go apologize. You: Good, later.

be convicted of.context: 新闻里说那个诈骗犯最终被法院宣布有罪，听到结果你说真是大快人心。
be convicted of.translation: 朋友：那个骗子判了吗 你：判了，法院宣布他有罪 朋友：他被定的是什么罪 你：诈骗罪，判了好几年 朋友：这结果大快人心吧 你：对，早该这样
be convicted of.example: Friend: Was that scammer sentenced? You: Yes, the court found him guilty. Friend: What crime was he convicted of? You: Fraud, several years. Friend: Is this satisfying? You: Yes, long overdue.

be covered in.context: 你玩了一天泥巴，站起来一看，衣服上沾满了厚厚的泥点子。
be covered in.translation: 朋友：你衣服上咋这么多泥 你：今天玩泥巴弄的 朋友：是不是浑身沾满泥了 你：对啊，裤子袖子全是 朋友：你赶紧去洗洗 你：好，我这就换下来
be covered in.example: Friend: Why is your clothes so muddy? You: Playing with mud today. Friend: Are you covered in mud? You: Yeah, pants and sleeves all over. Friend: Go wash quickly. You: Good, changing now.

be credited with.context: 这位老工程师被大家誉为公司的技术奠基人，好几个重要产品都归功于他。
be credited with.translation: 朋友：那位老工程师牛在哪 你：几个重要产品都是他牵头 朋友：他是被归功于这些成果吗 你：对啊，大家都归功于他 朋友：他现在还在一线吗 你：退休了，偶尔回来指导
be credited with.example: Friend: Why is that old engineer so great? You: He led several key products. Friend: Is he credited with these achievements? You: Yeah, everyone credits him. Friend: Is he still on the front line? You: Retired, guides occasionally.

be cut out for.context: 你朋友天生一副好嗓子，唱歌好听，大家都说他就是天生适合吃这碗饭的。
be cut out for.translation: 朋友：你朋友唱歌咋这么好听 你：他天生就适合唱歌 朋友：他是不是有这方面天赋 你：对啊，嗓子天生好 朋友：那他没去当歌手可惜了 你：他业余玩，当爱好
be cut out for.example: Friend: Why does your friend sing so well? You: He's naturally cut out for singing. Friend: Is he cut out for it? You: Yeah, born with a good voice. Friend: Pity he didn't become a singer. You: He plays as a hobby.

be determined by.context: 你做这份工作能拿多少薪水，主要由你的经验和岗位级别决定，跟加班多少关系不大。
be determined by.translation: 朋友：你工资是谁定的 你：主要看经验和级别 朋友：这薪水是由经验决定的吗 你：对啊，级别高钱就多 朋友：那跟加班有关系吗 你：不大，主要看能力
be determined by.example: Friend: Who sets your salary? You: Mainly experience and level. Friend: Is pay determined by experience? You: Yeah, higher level, more money. Friend: Does overtime matter then? You: Not much, mainly ability.

be divided.context: 你们部门就是否远程办公吵了半天，最后大家意见还是分歧，谁也说服不了谁。
be divided.translation: 朋友：这事你们定下来没 你：没，大家意见不统一 朋友：是不是意见还在分歧 你：对啊，有人想在家有人想坐班 朋友：领导咋说 你：先维持现状
be divided.example: Friend: Did you settle this? You: No, opinions are divided. Friend: Are opinions still divided? You: Yeah, some want home, some office. Friend: What did the boss say? You: Keep status quo for now.

be down to.context: 你这阵子状态差，说全是因为前阵子连续熬夜，身体被熬垮了。
be down to.translation: 朋友：你最近咋没精神 你：前阵子熬了太多夜 朋友：这状态差是熬夜造成的吗 你：对啊，全赖那段熬夜 朋友：那你现在补回来没 你：在补，早睡了几天
be down to.example: Friend: Why are you low energy lately? You: Too many late nights recently. Friend: Is this slump down to that? You: Yeah, all down to that spell. Friend: Have you caught up? You: Catching up, slept early few days.

be engaged.context: 你约朋友吃饭，他说这会儿正忙着赶报告，等忙完这阵才能出来。
be engaged.translation: 朋友：你晚上有空聚聚吗 你：我这会儿正忙着赶报告 朋友：你现在是不是脱不开身 你：对啊，报告明天要交 朋友：那你后天再约 你：好，后天我闲
be engaged.example: Friend: Free to gather tonight? You: I'm engaged in rushing a report. Friend: Are you tied up now? You: Yeah, due tomorrow. Friend: Then set it the day after. You: Good, I'm free then.

be fit for purpose.context: 你买的那个便宜水壶用了两次就漏，说这种质量根本不符合使用要求。
be fit for purpose.translation: 朋友：你买的水壶好用吗 你：漏得厉害，根本不能用 朋友：它是不是不符合要求 你：对啊，质量太差 朋友：那你退了没 你：退了，换了个贵的
be fit for purpose.example: Friend: Is that kettle you bought good? You: Leaks badly, unusable. Friend: Is it fit for purpose? You: Yeah, quality too poor. Friend: Did you return it? You: Returned, got an expensive one.

be happy with the initiative.context: 公司推出弹性上下班的新规定，你试了一周，说对这一举措特别满意，太人性化了。
be happy with the initiative.translation: 朋友：公司那个新规定咋样 你：弹性上下班，我特满意 朋友：你对这举措满意吗 你：对啊，不用赶早高峰 朋友：同事们反应如何 你：都挺欢迎这政策
be happy with the initiative.example: Friend: How's the new company rule? You: Flexible hours, I'm very happy with it. Friend: Are you happy with this initiative? You: Yeah, no morning rush. Friend: How do colleagues react? You: All welcome this policy.

be high in.context: 你看食品标签说这种零食糖特别多，说它富含糖分，减脂期最好别碰。
be high in.translation: 朋友：这零食能多吃不 你：别，它含糖特别多 朋友：它是不是富含糖分 你：对啊，吃了容易胖 朋友：那减脂期咋办 你：忍住，别碰它
be high in.example: Friend: Can I eat much of this snack? You: No, it's high in sugar. Friend: Is it high in sugar? You: Yeah, fattening. Friend: Then what during diet? You: Resist, don't touch.

be hooked.context: 你刷短视频刷得停不下来，朋友说你这下彻底上瘾了，得管管自己。
be hooked.translation: 朋友：你咋又刷上了 你：停不下来，已经上瘾 朋友：你这下是彻底上瘾了吧 你：对啊，一刷就一小时 朋友：你得定个限时 你：好，我装个专注软件
be hooked.example: Friend: Why are you scrolling again? You: Can't stop, I'm hooked. Friend: Are you totally hooked now? You: Yeah, an hour per scroll. Friend: Set a time limit. You: Good, install a focus app.

be hooked on.context: 你迷上了攀岩，一到周末就往岩馆跑，说自己彻底入了这行的迷。
be hooked on.translation: 朋友：你最近周末都去哪 你：往岩馆跑，迷上攀岩了 朋友：你是不是对攀岩入迷了 你：对啊，一周不去就难受 朋友：你不怕摔吗 你：有保护，别怕
be hooked on.example: Friend: Where do you go weekends? You: To the climbing gym, hooked on it. Friend: Are you hooked on climbing? You: Yeah, ache if I skip a week. Friend: Aren't you afraid of falling? You: Protected, don't fear.

be into.context: 你朋友特别爱看老电影，说他就热衷于那些黑白经典，新片反而不太感冒。
be into.translation: 朋友：你朋友爱看点啥 你：他就爱看老电影 朋友：他是不是热衷老片子 你：对啊，新片他不怎么看 朋友：他最爱哪一部 你：说得出一堆
be into.example: Friend: What does your friend love? You: He loves old movies. Friend: Is he into old films? You: Yeah, rarely watches new ones. Friend: Which is his favorite? You: He can list many.

be it.context: 你劝朋友说，不管成功还是失败，都得先试了再说，别在还没开始时就打退堂鼓。
be it.translation: 朋友：我怕做不好不敢试 你：成与不成都得先试 朋友：你是说无论如何都试吗 你：对啊，不试怎么知道 朋友：那我就鼓起勇气上 你：对，别先退缩
be it.example: Friend: I fear failing, afraid to try. You: Win or lose, try first. Friend: Do you mean try either way? You: Yeah, how know without trying. Friend: Then I'll pluck up courage. You: Right, don't shrink first.

be littered with.context: 你交上去的初稿被老师划得满是红字，说整篇文章到处都是错漏，得重写。
be littered with.translation: 朋友：你那稿子老师咋说 你：划得满是红圈 朋友：是不是错漏遍地都是 你：对啊，到处是问题 朋友：那你得重写吗 你：对，从头改
be littered with.example: Friend: What did the teacher say about your draft? You: Covered in red marks. Friend: Is it littered with errors? You: Yeah, problems everywhere. Friend: Must you rewrite? You: Yes, redo from start.

be mindful of.context: 你提醒身边人走路看路，说在人多的地方要特别留心扒手。
be mindful of.translation: 朋友：这地方人真多 你：所以要留心扒手 朋友：你是不是在提醒我注意 你：对啊，包往前背 朋友：我记住了 你：好，别大意
be mindful of.example: Friend: This place is crowded. You: So watch for pickpockets. Friend: Are you telling me to be mindful? You: Yeah, bag in front. Friend: I'll remember. You: Good, don't let guard down.

be on to something.context: 你试了好几种办法都不行，忽然换了个思路一试就成，朋友说你这下是找到门道了。
be on to something.translation: 朋友：你这题咋做出来的 你：换了个思路，一下就通了 朋友：你是不是找到窍门了 你：对啊，路子对了 朋友：快教教我 你：好，我讲给你听
be on to something.example: Friend: How did you solve this? You: Switched approach, clicked at once. Friend: Are you on to something? You: Yeah, right track. Friend: Teach me quick. You: Good, I'll explain.

be open to.context: 你这人特别听得进意见，朋友说不管是批评还是建议，你都乐于接受。
be open to.translation: 朋友：你这人咋这么好说话 你：我乐意听别人意见 朋友：你是不是乐于接受建议 你：对啊，多听听没坏处 朋友：那我说你两句不生气 你：不会，说吧
be open to.example: Friend: Why are you so easy to talk to? You: I'm open to others' opinions. Friend: Are you open to suggestions? You: Yeah, listening does no harm. Friend: Then I won't get mad criticizing you? You: No, go ahead.

be passionate about.context: 你朋友一说起旅行就眼睛发亮，说他特别热衷这件事，一年要出去好几趟。
be passionate about.translation: 朋友：你朋友最爱干啥 你：他一说旅行就来劲 朋友：他是不是对旅行很有热情 你：对啊，一年出去好几趟 朋友：他去过多少地方了 你：数不过来
be passionate about.example: Friend: What does your friend love most? You: He lights up talking travel. Friend: Is he passionate about travel? You: Yeah, several trips a year. Friend: How many places has he been? You: Too many to count.

be provided with.context: 你入职新公司，发现工位上电脑、耳机、显示器一应俱全，说装备挺齐全的。
be provided with.translation: 朋友：你新公司工位咋样 你：电脑耳机显示器全配了 朋友：是不是装备很齐全 你：对啊，啥都给你备好 朋友：那你还需要自己带啥 你：啥都不用，直接干活
be provided with.example: Friend: How's your new desk? You: Computer, headset, monitor all provided. Friend: Are you well provided with gear? You: Yeah, everything ready. Friend: Then what must you bring? You: Nothing, just work.

be ranked.context: 你看学校排名，说你母校今年在全国排进了前十，比去年又升了几名。
be ranked.translation: 朋友：你母校今年排第几 你：进了全国前十 朋友：它是被排进前十了吗 你：对啊，比去年升了几名 朋友：那你是不是挺自豪 你：对，沾光
be ranked.example: Friend: Where does your alma mater rank this year? You: Top ten nationally. Friend: Is it ranked in the top ten? You: Yeah, up a few spots. Friend: Aren't you proud? You: Yes, sharing the glory.

be short of.context: 你赶项目还差半天就交，可偏偏时间不够用，说这真是时间紧张。
be short of.translation: 朋友：你报告写完没 你：还差一半，时间不够 朋友：你是不是缺时间了 你：对啊，今天就得交 朋友：那我帮你弄点 你：好，帮我整理数据
be short of.example: Friend: Is your report done? You: Half left, short on time. Friend: Are you short of time? You: Yeah, due today. Friend: Then let me help. You: Good, help sort data.

be subjected to.context: 你做新药测试的小白鼠得经受好几种实验，说这种实验动物真是吃了不少苦。
be subjected to.translation: 朋友：那些实验动物可怜吗 你：它们要经受好几种测试 朋友：它们是不是遭受不少实验 你：对啊，挺可怜的 朋友：那有没有替代办法 你：在研究，但还没普及
be subjected to.example: Friend: Are those lab animals pitiful? You: They're subjected to several tests. Friend: Are they subjected to many experiments? You: Yeah, quite pitiful. Friend: Any alternatives? You: Researching, not widespread.

be sure.context: 你出门前把煤气、门窗都检查一遍，说务必做到心里有数，才能安心离开。
be sure.translation: 朋友：你出门还检查煤气啊 你：对，我得确保安全 朋友：你是不是特别小心 你：对啊，怕出事 朋友：那你检查一遍再走 你：好，门窗煤气都看
be sure.example: Friend: You check gas before leaving? You: Yeah, must be sure it's safe. Friend: Are you being careful? You: Yeah, fear of accidents. Friend: Then check before leaving. You: Good, doors, gas all checked.

be viewed as.context: 你这人做事踏实靠谱，同事都把你看成是团队里最值得信赖的那个人。
be viewed as.translation: 朋友：大家为啥都信你 你：可能我做事比较稳 朋友：你是不是被看成最靠谱的 你：对啊，大事都交给我 朋友：那你压力大不大 你：习惯了，反而踏实
be viewed as.example: Friend: Why does everyone trust you? You: Maybe I'm steady. Friend: Are you viewed as the most reliable? You: Yeah, big things given to me. Friend: Is the pressure big? You: Used to it, feels steady.

be wired to.context: 你朋友天生就爱跟人打交道，说他这种人就是天生适合做销售的料。
be wired to.translation: 朋友：他咋这么会聊天 你：天生就爱跟人打交道 朋友：他是不是天生会来事 你：对啊，做销售最合适 朋友：那他现在做啥工作 你：正是销售，如鱼得水
be wired to.example: Friend: Why is he so good at chatting? You: Born to deal with people. Friend: Is he wired to socialize? You: Yeah, perfect for sales. Friend: What does he do now? You: Exactly sales, in his element.

be worth.context: 你看那款限量手办被炒到天价，说这玩意儿到底值不值这个价，真说不准。
be worth.translation: 朋友：这手办卖多少钱 你：炒到几千了 朋友：它到底值这个价吗 你：对真爱粉就值 朋友：那你买不买 你：不买，不值
be worth.example: Friend: How much is this figure? You: Flipped to thousands. Friend: Is it worth that price? You: For true fans it is. Friend: Will you buy? You: No, not worth it.

beat the clock.context: 你赶在截稿前最后一分钟交上方案，说这真是争分夺秒，差点就来不及了。
beat the clock.translation: 朋友：你赶上 deadline 没 你：赶上了，最后一分钟 朋友：你这是争分夺秒啊 你：对啊，差点就来不及 朋友：你以后早点干 你：好，这次是教训
beat the clock.example: Friend: Did you beat the deadline? You: Yes, last minute. Friend: You really beat the clock. You: Yeah, almost too late. Friend: Start earlier next time. You: Good, lesson learned.

beautiful scenery.context: 你爬到山顶，眼前是一片绝美的湖光山色，说这风景美到让人舍不得走。
beautiful scenery.translation: 朋友：山顶风景咋样 你：湖光山色，特别美 朋友：这风景是不是很美 你：对啊，看了不想走 朋友：你拍照片没 你：拍了一堆，太美了
beautiful scenery.example: Friend: How's the view from the top? You: Lakes and mountains, stunning. Friend: Is this scenery beautiful? You: Yeah, don't want to leave. Friend: Did you take photos? You: Took a pile, gorgeous.

beauty is in the eye of the beholder.context: 你朋友觉得红头发特别美，你却觉得一般，说审美这东西真是因人而异，各人有各人的眼光。
beauty is in the eye of the beholder.translation: 朋友：你看她红头发好看吗 你：我觉得一般般 朋友：可有人觉得美翻了 你：对啊，情人眼里出西施 朋友：你是不是也觉得美很主观 你：对，各人眼光不同
beauty is in the eye of the beholder.example: Friend: Do you think her red hair looks good? You: I find it average. Friend: But some think it's stunning. You: Yeah, beauty is in the eye of the beholder. Friend: Do you think beauty is subjective? You: Yes, tastes differ.

beauty regime.context: 你朋友每天雷打不动护肤，说她那一套美容流程下来，得花上好长时间。
beauty regime.translation: 朋友：你每天护肤多久 你：一套流程下来半小时 朋友：你这美容流程挺讲究啊 你：对啊，一步都不能少 朋友：你累不累 你：习惯了，护肤是享受
beauty regime.example: Friend: How long do you skincare daily? You: Half an hour a full routine. Friend: Your beauty regime is elaborate. You: Yeah, no step skipped. Friend: Aren't you tired? You: Used to it, skincare is a treat.

beauty regimen.context: 你研究了一套美容养生法，每天按摩加敷面膜，说坚持下来皮肤真的变好了。
beauty regimen.translation: 朋友：你最近皮肤咋这么好 你：我有一套美容养生法 朋友：你这养生法管用吗 你：对啊，坚持就有效果 朋友：都做些啥 你：按摩、敷膜、早睡
beauty regimen.example: Friend: Why is your skin so good lately? You: I have a beauty regimen. Friend: Is this beauty regimen effective? You: Yeah, persistence pays. Friend: What do you do? You: Massage, masks, early sleep.

beauty salons.context: 你周末陪妈妈去美容院做脸，说那些美容院一到周末就挤满了人。
beauty salons.translation: 朋友：你周末陪阿姨去哪了 你：陪她去美容院做脸 朋友：那些美容院人多吗 你：对啊，周末全是做脸的 朋友：你妈常去吗 你：对，一周一次
beauty salons.example: Friend: Where did you accompany aunt this weekend? You: To a beauty salon for a facial. Friend: Are those beauty salons crowded? You: Yeah, full on weekends. Friend: Does your mom go often? You: Yes, once a week.

beauty spot.context: 你跟朋友推荐一处郊外的风景区，说那里山清水秀，是当地人私藏的好去处。
beauty spot.translation: 朋友：周末去哪儿玩好 你：我知道一处风景区 朋友：那儿风景咋样 你：山清水秀，人还少 朋友：远不远 你：开车一个小时
beauty spot.example: Friend: Where to go this weekend? You: I know a beauty spot. Friend: How's the scenery there? You: Green hills, sparse crowds. Friend: Is it far? You: An hour's drive.

becoming more of a thing.context: 你发现身边人越来越流行飞盘，说这项运动这两年是越来越成气候了。
becoming more of a thing.translation: 朋友：最近大家爱玩啥 你：都在玩飞盘 朋友：这是不是越来越流行了 你：对啊，这两年特别火 朋友：你也去玩过没 你：玩过一回，挺好玩
becoming more of a thing.example: Friend: What is everyone playing lately? You: Frisbee. Friend: Is it becoming more of a thing? You: Yeah, hot these two years. Friend: Have you tried it? You: Once, fun.

bed sheet.context: 你周末在家大扫除，把床单被罩全拆下来洗了一遍，说晒完太阳闻着都是阳光味。
bed sheet.translation: 朋友：你周末忙啥呢 你：大扫除，把床单洗了 朋友：你换床单这么勤啊 你：对啊，晒完太阳特别香 朋友：那你这是爱干净 你：对，住着舒服
bed sheet.example: Friend: What are you busy with weekend? You: Cleaning, washing bed sheets. Friend: Do you change sheets this often? You: Yeah, sun-dried smells nice. Friend: You love cleanliness. You: Yeah, comfy.

beep horn.context: 你开车被前面的堵得走不动，忍不住摁了一下喇叭提醒前面的车。
beep horn.translation: 朋友：你刚才咋按喇叭 你：前面堵着不走 朋友：你是在提醒前面车吗 你：对啊，按喇叭催一下 朋友：人家走了吗 你：走了，慢慢挪了
beep horn.example: Friend: Why did you honk just now? You: Car ahead not moving. Friend: Were you beeping the horn at them? You: Yeah, to urge them. Friend: Did they move? You: Yes, slowly.

beg the question.context: 你看一篇讨论，说这现象引出一个关键问题：我们到底该怎么平衡工作和生活。
beg the question.translation: 朋友：那篇文章讲啥 你：它引出了一个关键问题 朋友：它问了个什么问题 你：工作和生活怎么平衡 朋友：这问题重要吗 你：对啊，人人都得面对
beg the question.example: Friend: What's that article about? You: It begs an important question. Friend: What question did it raise? You: How to balance work and life. Friend: Is this question important? You: Yeah, everyone faces it.

begin again on a clean slate.context: 你上次创业失败亏了一大笔，朋友劝你别灰心，从头再来，翻过旧账重新开始。
begin again on a clean slate.translation: 朋友：你上次创业亏了还想干吗 你：有点不敢了 朋友：那就翻篇从头再来 你：真能东山再起吗 你：能，这次更有经验
begin again on a clean slate.example: Friend: After losing money last time, want to try again? You: A bit scared. Friend: Start over on a clean slate. You: Really can turn it around? You: Yes, more experience now.

beginner level.context: 你刚学摄影没多久，说自己还处于入门阶段，先把基础构图练扎实再说。
beginner level.translation: 朋友：你摄影水平咋样 你：还在入门阶段 朋友：你是初学者水平吗 你：对啊，先练构图 朋友：那你用啥相机 你：先拿手机练
beginner level.example: Friend: How's your photography level? You: Still at beginner level. Friend: Are you at beginner level? You: Yeah, practice composition first. Friend: What camera do you use? You: Phone first.

behavioural changes.context: 你发现室友自从换了工作之后，整个人早睡早起，行为习惯发生了明显变化。
behavioural changes.translation: 朋友：你室友最近咋变了 你：换了工作，作息全改了 朋友：他这是行为变化吗 你：对啊，早睡早起 朋友：这变化好还是坏 你：好，精神多了
behavioural changes.example: Friend: Why has your roommate changed lately? You: Switched jobs, all habits changed. Friend: Are these behavioural changes? You: Yeah, early to bed and rise. Friend: Is this change good or bad? You: Good, more energetic.

behavioural cue.context: 你看面试的人一直搓手、眼神躲闪，说从这些行为线索就能判断他特别紧张。
behavioural cue.translation: 朋友：你咋看出他紧张 你：他老搓手眼神飘 朋友：你从这些行为线索看的 你：对啊，一看就慌 朋友：那他面试能过吗 你：悬，得放松点
behavioural cue.example: Friend: How do you tell he's nervous? You: He keeps rubbing hands, eyes darting. Friend: Do you read this from behavioural cues? You: Yeah, obviously flustered. Friend: Will he pass the interview? You: Doubtful, must relax.

behavioural question.context: 你面试时被问了一道行为题，让你讲一次你解决冲突的经历，你愣了半天才答。
behavioural question.translation: 朋友：面试难不难 你：被问了道行为题 朋友：啥叫行为面试题 你：让我讲一次过去的经历 朋友：你答得顺吗 你：愣了一下，才想起来
behavioural question.example: Friend: Was the interview hard? You: Asked a behavioural question. Friend: What's a behavioural question? You: Told to talk about a past experience. Friend: Did you answer smoothly? You: Paused, then remembered.

behavioural scientist.context: 你看节目请来一位研究人为什么会拖延的专家，说这位行为科学家讲得特别有道理。
behavioural scientist.translation: 朋友：节目里那个专家干啥的 你：他是研究行为的科学家 朋友：他讲拖延讲得咋样 你：对啊，说得很有道理 朋友：你听懂了没 你：听懂一点，还挺有意思
behavioural scientist.example: Friend: What does that expert on the show do? You: He's a behavioural scientist. Friend: How does he explain procrastination? You: Yeah, very convincing. Friend: Did you understand? You: A bit, quite interesting.

behavioural trait.context: 你朋友做事总是有条有理，说这种爱规划的行为特征是他从小养成的。
behavioural trait.translation: 朋友：你朋友做事咋这么有条理 你：他从小就爱规划 朋友：这是他的行为特征吗 你：对啊，走到哪都列清单 朋友：你能学得来吗 你：学不来，我随性
behavioural trait.example: Friend: Why is your friend so organized? You: He loved planning since childhood. Friend: Is this his behavioural trait? You: Yeah, lists everywhere. Friend: Can you learn it? You: No, I'm spontaneous.

behind the scenes.context: 你看完美食节目，说那些镜头背后其实拍了无数遍，大厨才端出一盘好看的菜。
behind the scenes.translation: 朋友：那菜咋拍得那么好看 你：镜头背后拍了好多遍 朋友：幕后都干些啥 你：重来重来，直到满意 朋友：你以后想去干这个吗 你：想，挺有意思
behind the scenes.example: Friend: Why is that dish shot so nicely? You: Behind the scenes many takes. Friend: What happens behind the scenes? You: Retake till satisfied. Friend: Do you want to do this? You: Yes, interesting.

behind the times.context: 你朋友还用着十年前的老手机，说他这人一点也不追新，有点落伍了。
behind the times.translation: 朋友：你朋友咋还用老手机 你：他一点不追新 朋友：他是不是有点落伍了 你：对啊，软件都装不了 朋友：你劝他换没 你：劝了，他说能用就行
behind the times.example: Friend: Why does your friend still use an old phone? You: He doesn't chase new things. Friend: Is he behind the times? You: Yeah, can't install apps. Friend: Did you urge him to switch? You: Yes, he says fine.

behind time.context: 你开会又迟到了十分钟，朋友说你今天又是慢吞吞的，比约定时间晚了。
behind time.translation: 朋友：你咋又来晚了 你：路上堵了会儿 朋友：你今天是不是又迟到了 你：对啊，晚了十分钟 朋友：你以后早点出门 你：好，这次真早出门
behind time.example: Friend: Why late again? You: Road was jammed. Friend: Are you behind time again today? You: Yeah, ten minutes late. Friend: Leave earlier next time. You: Good, really early.

believing in.context: 你做什么都很踏实，朋友说你一直相信努力就有回报，这种信念支撑着你。
believing in.translation: 朋友：你咋这么拼 你：我相信努力有用 朋友：你一直相信这个吗 你：对啊，相信就有动力 朋友：那你信不信运气 你：运气靠努力攒
believing in.example: Friend: Why are you so driven? You: I believe hard work pays. Friend: Do you keep believing in this? You: Yeah, belief drives me. Friend: Do you believe in luck? You: Luck built by effort.

belt out.context: 你朋友在KTV里拿着麦克风放声高歌，唱得整间屋子都是他的声音。
belt out.translation: 朋友：你朋友唱得咋这么大声 你：他一拿麦就放歌 朋友：他是不是在引吭高歌 你：对啊，整首都扯着嗓子 朋友：他唱得好听吗 你：挺有激情
belt out.example: Friend: Why does your friend sing so loud? You: He belts it once he grabs the mic. Friend: Is he belting out the song? You: Yeah, full voice all through. Friend: Does he sing well? You: Full of passion.

bending down.context: 你弯腰捡起掉在地上的笔，起来时腰咔地响了一声，说太久不运动了。
bending down.translation: 朋友：你刚才弯腰干啥 你：捡掉地上的笔 朋友：你弯腰捡东西费劲吗 你：对啊，腰还响了一声 朋友：你得多运动 你：对，坐太久了
bending down.example: Friend: Why did you bend down just now? You: Picked up the pen on the floor. Friend: Is bending down hard for you? You: Yeah, back even cracked. Friend: You should exercise more. You: Yes, sat too long.

benefits from.context: 你坚持每天跑步，说这段时间下来身体明显受益，精神比以前好多了。
benefits from.translation: 朋友：你最近精神咋这么好 你：天天跑步，身体受益 朋友：你从跑步里得到啥 你：睡眠好了，人也精神 朋友：那你坚持多久了 你：小半年了
benefits from.example: Friend: Why are you so energetic lately? You: Running daily, benefiting from it. Friend: What do you gain from it? You: Better sleep, more energy. Friend: How long have you kept it? You: Half a year.

bento box.context: 你中午懒得出去吃，便从冰箱拿出昨晚做好的日式便当，微波炉一热就开吃。
bento box.translation: 朋友：你中午吃啥 你：昨晚做的便当热一下 朋友：你这日式便当挺讲究 你：对啊，菜摆得好看 朋友：你自己做的吗 你：对，昨晚顺手做的
bento box.example: Friend: What's for lunch? You: Heat up last night's bento. Friend: This bento box is elaborate. You: Yeah, nicely arranged. Friend: Did you make it? You: Yes, last night.

bereavement support.context: 你朋友刚失去亲人，你陪他去社区参加了丧亲帮扶小组，大家互相安慰、抱团取暖。
bereavement support.translation: 朋友：你朋友最近咋样 你：刚失去亲人，情绪很差 朋友：你们陪他去做啥 你：去了社区的丧亲帮扶 朋友：这帮扶管用吗 你：对啊，大家互相安慰
bereavement support.example: Friend: How's your friend lately? You: Just lost a loved one, low mood. Friend: What did you take him to? You: To bereavement support in the community. Friend: Is this support helpful? You: Yeah, everyone consoles each other.

bespoke items.context: 你结婚要定做西装，裁缝说这些定制商品都得量体裁衣，提前半个月来量尺寸。
bespoke items.translation: 朋友：你结婚西装哪买的 你：找裁缝定做的 朋友：这些定制商品贵不贵 你：贵，但合身 朋友：你提前多久量的尺寸 你：提前半个月，改了三回
bespoke items.example: Friend: Where did you get your wedding suit? You: Tailor-made. Friend: Are these bespoke items expensive? You: Yes, but fits well. Friend: How early did you measure? You: Two weeks early, altered three times.

bespoke tour.context: 你不想跟大团挤着走，找旅行社做了一条只属于你们两人的定制旅行路线。
bespoke tour.translation: 朋友：你这次旅游跟团还是自由行 你：找旅行社定制了一条线 朋友：这是定制旅行吗 你：对啊，只带我们两人 朋友：比跟团贵不少吧 你：贵，但玩得舒服
bespoke tour.example: Friend: Group or independent trip this time? You: Customized a route with the agency. Friend: Is this a bespoke tour? You: Yeah, just us two. Friend: More expensive than a group? You: Yes, but comfortable.

best before date.context: 你拿了盒牛奶看包装，说这个最佳食用期过了三天，喝之前最好先闻闻有没有坏。
best before date.translation: 朋友：这牛奶还能喝吗 你：你看包装上那个日期 朋友：这是最佳食用期吗 你：对啊，过了三天了 朋友：那还能喝吗 你：先闻闻，没坏就能喝
best before date.example: Friend: Is this milk still drinkable? You: Check the date on the package. Friend: Is this the best before date? You: Yeah, three days past. Friend: Then can I drink it? You: Smell first, fine if not off.

best bet.context: 朋友赶不上飞机急得不行，你告诉他这时候最快的办法就是打车直奔机场，别等地铁了。
best bet.translation: 朋友：我赶不上飞机了咋办 你：现在最快就是打车去 朋友：这是最佳选择吗 你：对啊，别等地铁了 朋友：那来得及吗 你：快点走，应该来得及
best bet.example: Friend: I'll miss my flight, what to do? You: Fastest bet now is a taxi. Friend: Is this the best bet? You: Yeah, don't wait for the subway. Friend: Will it be in time? You: Hurry, should make it.

best course of action.context: 项目出了乱子，你召集大家开会，问现在这情况最该采取的行动方案是什么。
best course of action.translation: 朋友：现在项目出乱子了 你：咱得想想最佳行动方案 朋友：你说该咋办呢 你：先稳住客户，再查问题 朋友：这是最明智的吗 你：对，先止损
best course of action.example: Friend: The project's gone wrong now. You: We need the best course of action. Friend: What do you say we do? You: Stabilize the client, then find the problem. Friend: Is this wisest? You: Yes, stop losses first.

best foot forward.context: 你第一次去见对象家长，特意收拾得干净利落，说这次可得全力以赴，留下个好印象。
best foot forward.translation: 朋友：你今天见家长紧张不 你：特意收拾得干干净净 朋友：你是不是想拿出最好一面 你：对啊，给人家留个好印象 朋友：那你准备了啥礼物 你：带了茶叶和水果
best foot forward.example: Friend: Nervous meeting the partner's parents today? You: Dressed up neat and clean. Friend: Are you putting your best foot forward? You: Yeah, make a good impression. Friend: What gift did you bring? You: Tea and fruit.

best of all.context: 这房子地段好、户型棒，最重要的是，它价格还特别便宜，你一听就心动了。
best of all.translation: 朋友：这房子咋样 你：地段好，户型也正 朋友：最好的是哪一点 你：最重要的是价格还便宜 朋友：那你赶紧下手 你：对，我这就约看房
best of all.example: Friend: How's this place? You: Great location, good layout. Friend: What's best of all? You: Best of all, it's cheap too. Friend: Then act fast. You: Yes, book a viewing now.

better late than never.context: 朋友想学钢琴却一直拖着，你劝他说现在开始也不晚，迟做总比不做强。
better late than never.translation: 朋友：我想学钢琴但一直没动 你：现在开始也不晚 朋友：会不会太迟了 你：对啊，迟做总比不做好 朋友：那我这周就报班 你：对，别再拖了
better late than never.example: Friend: I want to learn piano but never started. You: Start now, not too late. Friend: Isn't it too late? You: Yeah, better late than never. Friend: Then I'll sign up this week. You: Yes, stop delaying.

better off.context: 你换了新工作之后工资涨了一截，说自己现在的经济状况比以前好多了。
better off.translation: 朋友：你最近咋舍得花钱了 你：换了份工作，工资涨了 朋友：你现在是不是境况更好 你：对啊，比以前宽裕多了 朋友：那你要不要犒劳自己 你：买了块表奖励自己
better off.example: Friend: Why can you splurge lately? You: Switched jobs, pay rose. Friend: Are you better off now? You: Yeah, more comfortable than before. Friend: Then reward yourself? You: Bought a watch as a treat.

beyond all doubt.context: 你朋友连续十年坚持跑步，说他的健康毫无疑问是这些年锻炼换来的。
beyond all doubt.translation: 朋友：你朋友身体咋这么好 你：他跑了十年步 朋友：这健康是毫无疑问的吧 你：对啊，锻炼带来的 朋友：那你也去跑呗 你：我懒，羡慕他
beyond all doubt.example: Friend: Why is your friend so healthy? You: Ten years of running. Friend: This health is beyond all doubt, right? You: Yeah, from exercise. Friend: Then you run too. You: I'm lazy, envy him.

beyond control.context: 你看着堵车长龙纹丝不动，说这种路况你是彻底没办法了，只能干等。
beyond control.translation: 朋友：这车咋一点不动 你：全堵死了 朋友：这是不是没法控制了 你：对啊，只能干等 朋友：那你要迟到了吧 你：对，先跟领导说一声
beyond control.example: Friend: Why isn't this car moving? You: Totally gridlocked. Friend: Is this beyond control? You: Yeah, just wait. Friend: Then you'll be late? You: Yes, tell the boss first.

beyond saving.context: 你那台老电脑摔了一下，开机都开不了，说这玩意儿估计修不好了，只能换新的。
beyond saving.translation: 朋友：你电脑咋不修了 你：摔了一下开不了机 朋友：是不是修不好了 你：对啊，估计救不回来了 朋友：那只能换新的了 你：对，买台新的划算
beyond saving.example: Friend: Why aren't you fixing your computer? You: Dropped it, won't boot. Friend: Is it beyond saving? You: Yeah, probably can't save it. Friend: Then you have to buy new? You: Yes, new is cost-effective.

big business.context: 你聊起那些在广告上砸大钱的公司，说大企业一旦出手，小品牌根本竞争不过。
big business.translation: 朋友：那牌子咋那么有钱打广告 你：它是大企业，有钱 朋友：这种大企业厉害在哪 你：一砸钱小品牌就拼不过 朋友：那小品牌咋办 你：得找差异化
big business.example: Friend: Why can that brand afford big ads? You: It's big business, rich. Friend: Where is big business strong? You: Once it spends, small brands can't compete. Friend: Then what do small brands do? You: Find differentiation.

big cat.context: 你去动物园看老虎狮子，说这些大型猫科动物一吼起来，整个馆都在震动。
big cat.translation: 朋友：动物园里啥最震撼 你：老虎狮子那些大猫 朋友：这些大型猫科吓人吗 你：对啊，一吼地都震 朋友：你敢靠近看吗 你：隔着玻璃，不怕
big cat.example: Friend: What's most striking at the zoo? You: Tigers, lions, the big cats. Friend: Are these big cats scary? You: Yeah, a roar shakes the floor. Friend: Dare you get close? You: Through glass, no fear.

big cheese.context: 你公司年会上那个发言的老板，说他可是这行业里说了算的大人物。
big cheese.translation: 朋友：台上讲话那个是谁 你：是咱行业里的大人物 朋友：他很厉害吗 你：对啊，说话管用 朋友：你能跟他说上话不 你：不能，远着呢
big cheese.example: Friend: Who's that speaking on stage? You: A big cheese in this industry. Friend: Is he powerful? You: Yeah, his word counts. Friend: Can you talk to him? You: No, far off.

big kid.context: 你朋友三十多了还爱去游乐场坐旋转木马，说他这人心里其实住着个长不大的小孩。
big kid.translation: 朋友：你朋友咋还爱去游乐场 你：他特别喜欢旋转木马 朋友：他是不是童心未泯 你：对啊，心里住着小孩 朋友：你陪他去过没 你：去过，挺好玩的
big kid.example: Friend: Why does your friend still love the amusement park? You: He loves the carousel. Friend: Is he a big kid at heart? You: Yeah, a kid inside. Friend: Have you been with him? You: Yes, fun.

big moment.context: 你今天上台领奖，说这可是你大学四年里最重要的一个时刻，值得好好记住。
big moment.translation: 朋友：你今天咋这么激动 你：要上台领奖了 朋友：这是你重要时刻吗 你：对啊，四年就这一回 朋友：你准备说两句没 你：准备了，昨晚背的
big moment.example: Friend: Why are you so excited today? You: Going on stage to receive an award. Friend: Is this a big moment for you? You: Yeah, once in four years. Friend: Did you prepare a speech? You: Yes, memorized last night.

big name.context: 那场演出请了一位好莱坞大牌明星，票一开卖就被抢光，说这就是明星效应。
big name.translation: 朋友：那场演出票难抢吗 你：请了个好莱坞大牌 朋友：是大牌艺人吗 你：对啊，一开卖就光 朋友：你抢到没 你：没，秒没
big name.example: Friend: Were those show tickets hard to get? You: Invited a Hollywood big name. Friend: Is it a big-name star? You: Yeah, sold out in seconds. Friend: Did you get one? You: No, gone in a second.

big-screen experience.context: 你特地去影院看大片，说那种大屏配上环绕音响的观影体验，手机上根本比不了。
big-screen experience.translation: 朋友：你咋非要去影院看 你：大屏看片爽多了 朋友：这是大屏观影体验吗 你：对啊，手机比不了 朋友：那你多花的值不值 你：值，画面震撼
big-screen experience.example: Friend: Why insist on the cinema? You: Big screen is way better. Friend: Is it a big-screen experience? You: Yeah, phones can't match. Friend: Is the extra cost worth it? You: Yes, stunning visuals.

binding agreement.context: 你签了一份租房合同，说双方签了字之后，这就是一份有约束力的协议，谁也不能反悔。
binding agreement.translation: 朋友：你租房合同签了吗 你：签了，双方都画押了 朋友：这是有约束力的协议吗 你：对啊，签了不能反悔 朋友：里面有啥要注意的 你：提前退租要赔钱
binding agreement.example: Friend: Did you sign the lease? You: Yes, both signed. Friend: Is this a binding agreement? You: Yeah, can't back out. Friend: Anything to watch in it? You: Early exit costs money.

binge drink.context: 朋友一到周末就约人喝酒，喝到半夜才回，你说他这是周末狂饮，对身体太不好。
binge drink.translation: 朋友：你朋友周末又去哪了 你：又约人喝酒去了 朋友：他这是在狂饮吗 你：对啊，喝到半夜 朋友：这样身体受得了吗 你：肯定受不了
binge drink.example: Friend: Where did your friend go again this weekend? You: Out drinking again. Friend: Is he binge drinking? You: Yeah, till midnight. Friend: Can his body take it? You: Definitely not.

biodiversity loss.context: 你看环保纪录片说，这些年城市扩张让很多动植物失去了家园，生物多样性正在快速丧失。
biodiversity loss.translation: 朋友：那纪录片讲啥 你：讲物种在减少 朋友：这是生物多样性丧失吗 你：对啊，好多动物没家了 朋友：那咋保护 你：少开发，建保护区
biodiversity loss.example: Friend: What is that documentary about? You: Species declining. Friend: Is this biodiversity loss? You: Yeah, many animals lost homes. Friend: Then how protect? You: Less development, reserves.

biological ageing.context: 你看起来才四十，可体检说你细胞状态比实际年龄老，说这就是生理老化在作怪。
biological ageing.translation: 朋友：你看着咋这么年轻 你：可体检说我生理年龄大 朋友：这是生理老化吗 你：对啊，细胞老得快 朋友：那咋办 你：多运动，少熬夜
biological ageing.example: Friend: Why do you look so young? You: But the checkup says my biological age is high. Friend: Is this biological ageing? You: Yeah, cells age fast. Friend: Then what? You: More exercise, less late nights.

biological function.context: 你看科普说，人老了以后睡眠、消化这些生理机能都会慢慢衰退，得好好养护。
biological function.translation: 朋友：人老了身体咋变差 你：各种机能都在退 朋友：这是生理机能衰退吗 你：对啊，睡眠消化都差 朋友：那咋保养 你：规律作息，多锻炼
biological function.example: Friend: Why does the body worsen with age? You: All functions declining. Friend: Is this biological function decline? You: Yeah, sleep and digestion both worsen. Friend: Then how care? You: Regular routine, more exercise.

biophilic design.context: 你那家办公室满墙绿植，说这是一种亲自然设计，待在里面心情都特别好。
biophilic design.translation: 朋友：你办公室咋这么多植物 你：是一种亲自然设计 朋友：这种设计有啥好 你：对啊，待着心情好 朋友：那你上班不累吗 你：看着绿，舒服多了
biophilic design.example: Friend: Why so many plants in your office? You: It's biophilic design. Friend: What's good about this design? You: Yeah, mood improves in it. Friend: Then isn't work tiring? You: Green view, much better.

bird dog.context: 你朋友专门帮公司到处挖人才，说他就是个替人搜罗好苗子的搜寻高手。
bird dog.translation: 朋友：你朋友干啥工作 你：他到处帮公司找人 朋友：他是人才搜寻的人吗 你：对啊，专挖好苗子 朋友：他能找到厉害的人吗 你：对，人脉广
bird dog.example: Friend: What does your friend do? You: He hunts talent for companies. Friend: Is he a bird dog for talent? You: Yeah, digs out good prospects. Friend: Can he find impressive people? You: Yes, wide network.

birth rate.context: 你看新闻说最近这个城市出生率连年下降，年轻人都不爱生孩子了。
birth rate.translation: 朋友：那新闻说啥 你：说出生率在降 朋友：现在年轻人不爱生吗 你：对啊，越来越少 朋友：那国家咋办 你：发补贴鼓励
birth rate.example: Friend: What did that news say? You: Birth rate is falling. Friend: Young people don't want kids now? You: Yeah, fewer and fewer. Friend: Then what does the country do? You: Subsidies to encourage.

bite one's fingernails.context: 等面试结果时你坐立不安，手指不自觉地啃起了指甲，自己都没察觉。
bite one's fingernails.translation: 朋友：你咋老啃指甲 你：等结果紧张 朋友：你是不是紧张就咬指甲 你：对啊，自己都没察觉 朋友：这样指甲都咬坏了 你：对，我得改
bite one's fingernails.example: Friend: Why do you keep biting your nails? You: Nervous waiting for results. Friend: Do you bite your fingernails when anxious? You: Yeah, don't even notice. Friend: This ruins your nails. You: Yes, I must stop.

biting cold.context: 冬天夜里出门，一阵寒风刮脸，说这种冷是刺骨的冷，不戴帽子耳朵都冻掉。
biting cold.translation: 朋友：今晚冷不冷 你：风刮脸，刺骨冷 朋友：这是刺骨严寒吗 你：对啊，不戴帽子冻耳朵 朋友：那你多穿点 你：穿了，还是冷
biting cold.example: Friend: Is it cold tonight? You: Wind stings, biting cold. Friend: Is this biting cold? You: Yeah, ears freeze without a hat. Friend: Then dress warmer. You: Did, still cold.

bizarre appearance.context: 你走进那家主题餐厅，里面摆着各种造型古怪的道具，说这外形真是怪得出奇。
bizarre appearance.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅啥风格 你：摆的道具都怪怪的 朋友：外形怪异吗 你：对啊，看着挺奇特 朋友：你敢坐吗 你：就是图个新鲜
bizarre appearance.example: Friend: What style is that restaurant? You: Weird props everywhere. Friend: Is it bizarre in appearance? You: Yeah, quite strange. Friend: Dare you sit there? You: Just for novelty.

blare out.context: 隔壁把音响开得老大，那种咚咚的声音隔着墙都大声放出来，你根本没法看书。
blare out.translation: 朋友：你咋没法看书 你：隔壁音响开太大 朋友：声音是大声放出来的吗 你：对啊，咚咚响 朋友：你去找他们没 你：找过，关了一半
blare out.example: Friend: Why can't you read? You: Neighbors' speakers too loud. Friend: Is the music blaring out? You: Yeah, thumping. Friend: Did you talk to them? You: Yes, they halved it.

blast off.context: 你在电视上看火箭发射，倒数几秒后那枚火箭拖着长焰直冲云霄。
blast off.translation: 朋友：你看火箭发射没 你：倒数完它就飞了 朋友：那是火箭升空吗 你：对啊，拖着大火舌 朋友：你激动不 你：对，特别震撼
blast off.example: Friend: Did you watch the rocket launch? You: After countdown it shot up. Friend: Did it blast off? You: Yeah, trailing a flame. Friend: Exciting? You: Yes, stunning.

blend in with.context: 你刚到国外留学，一开始努力模仿当地人的穿着说话，想尽快融入周围的人群。
blend in with.translation: 朋友：你到国外适应得咋样 你：我学当地人穿着说话 朋友：你在努力融入人群吗 你：对啊，想不显眼 朋友：融入得顺利吗 你：慢慢就好了
blend in with.example: Friend: How are you adapting abroad? You: I mimic how locals dress and talk. Friend: Are you blending in with the crowd? You: Yeah, want to stand out less. Friend: Is blending in going well? You: Slowly getting better.

blind purchase.context: 你在网上没看实物就买了个包，说这叫盲购，收到才知道好不好看。
blind purchase.translation: 朋友：你这包在哪买的 你：网上没看实物就下单了 朋友：这是盲购吗 你：对啊，收到才知道 朋友：好看不 你：还行，赌对了
blind purchase.example: Friend: Where did you buy this bag? You: Bought online without seeing it. Friend: Is this a blind purchase? You: Yeah, only know on arrival. Friend: Is it nice? You: Fine, lucky guess.

block off.context: 那条路因为施工被封住了，你开车走到头才发现，得绕一大圈才能过去。
block off.translation: 朋友：你咋绕这么远 你：那路被堵上了 朋友：是被封锁了吗 你：对啊，施工封的 朋友：那你咋办 你：绕了一大圈
block off.example: Friend: Why did you detour so far? You: That road was blocked off. Friend: Is it blocked off? You: Yeah, construction. Friend: Then what did you do? You: Took a big detour.

blocked nose.context: 你感冒了鼻子不通气，说话嗡声嗡气，朋友问你是不是鼻子堵住了。
blocked nose.translation: 朋友：你说话咋嗡嗡的 你：鼻子堵了不通气 朋友：你鼻塞了吗 你：对啊，晚上更厉害 朋友：吃药没 你：吃了，还得两天
blocked nose.example: Friend: Why do you sound nasal? You: Blocked nose, can't breathe. Friend: Do you have a blocked nose? You: Yeah, worse at night. Friend: Took medicine? You: Yes, two more days.

blood circulation.context: 你久坐久站腿发麻，朋友劝你多走走，说这样能让血液循环起来。
blood circulation.translation: 朋友：你腿咋老发麻 你：坐久了不动 朋友：你得多走动让血液循环 你：对啊，起来走走就好 朋友：那你别老坐着 你：好，我每小时起来一次
blood circulation.example: Friend: Why do your legs keep going numb? You: Sitting too long. Friend: You should walk to get blood circulation going. You: Yeah, moving helps. Friend: Then don't sit all day. You: Good, get up hourly.

blood glucose level.context: 你糖尿病，每次饭前都扎手指测血糖值，说看那个数字才能决定打多少胰岛素。
blood glucose level.translation: 朋友：你饭前扎手指干啥 你：测血糖值 朋友：这是测血糖吗 你：对啊，看数字打针 朋友：你习惯了吗 你：习惯了，不疼
blood glucose level.example: Friend: Why do you prick your finger before meals? You: Test blood glucose level. Friend: Is this blood glucose testing? You: Yeah, decide the dose by the number. Friend: Used to it? You: Used to, doesn't hurt.

blood oxygen level.context: 你感冒喘得厉害，朋友拿指夹式血氧仪一测，说你血氧含量偏低，得去医院看看。
blood oxygen level.translation: 朋友：你喘得咋这么厉害 你：胸口闷，上不来气 朋友：我给你测测血氧 你：测完说含量偏低 朋友：那你得去医院 你：对，我这就去
blood oxygen level.example: Friend: Why are you breathing so hard? You: Chest tight, can't get air. Friend: Let me test your blood oxygen. You: It says your blood oxygen level is low. Friend: Then you must go to hospital. You: Yes, going now.

blood oxygenation levels.context: 你看体检报告上写着血氧水平，说这个数越高，说明身体供氧越好。
blood oxygenation levels.translation: 朋友：你体检报告上那是啥 你：写的是血氧水平 朋友：这数多少算正常 你：九十以上才算正常 朋友：你正常不 你：正常，放心
blood oxygenation levels.example: Friend: What's that on your checkup report? You: It says blood oxygenation levels. Friend: What's normal for this number? You: Above ninety is normal. Friend: Are you normal? You: Yes, reassured.

blood pressure.context: 你爷爷上了年纪，每次量血压都偏高，医生说得天天吃药控制，不能随便停。
blood pressure.translation: 朋友：你爷爷身体咋样 你：血压一直偏高 朋友：他有高血压吗 你：对啊，天天吃药 朋友：能随便停吗 你：不能，得长期吃
blood pressure.example: Friend: How's your grandfather's health? You: Blood pressure always high. Friend: Does he have high blood pressure? You: Yeah, meds daily. Friend: Can he stop anytime? You: No, long-term use.

blood sugar.context: 你体检查出血糖偏高，医生让你少吃甜的，说不然血糖一直降不下来。
blood sugar.translation: 朋友：你体检咋了 你：血糖有点高 朋友：医生让你少吃甜吗 你：对啊，不然降不下来 朋友：那奶茶还喝不喝 你：先戒了吧
