blood sugar.example: Friend: What's wrong with your checkup? You: Blood sugar a bit high. Friend: Did the doctor tell you less sugar? You: Yeah, or it won't drop. Friend: Then still milk tea? You: Cut it out first.

blood sugar control.context: 你糖尿病多年，说平时通过控制饮食和运动，把血糖控制在正常范围内。
blood sugar control.translation: 朋友：你糖尿病多久了 你：好些年了 朋友：你咋稳住的 你：靠饮食和运动控制 朋友：这是血糖控制吗 你：对啊，一直在范围内
blood sugar control.example: Friend: How long have you had diabetes? You: For years. Friend: How do you keep it steady? You: Diet and exercise control. Friend: Is this blood sugar control? You: Yeah, always in range.

blood sugar level.context: 你每次测完血糖都把那个数记在小本子上，说长期记录才能看出血糖水平的变化趋势。
blood sugar level.translation: 朋友：你小本子记的啥 你：每次测的血糖值 朋友：你在记血糖水平吗 你：对啊，看变化趋势 朋友：这习惯好啊 你：对，医生让记的
blood sugar level.example: Friend: What do you write in that little book? You: Every blood sugar reading. Friend: Are you tracking blood sugar levels? You: Yeah, to see trends. Friend: Good habit. You: Yes, the doctor told me to.

blow dry.context: 你洗完头发，拿吹风机一边吹一边抓造型，说这样吹完头发蓬松有型。
blow dry.translation: 朋友：你在浴室干啥呢 你：吹头发做造型 朋友：你在吹风造型吗 你：对啊，抓一抓更蓬 朋友：这样吹伤头发不 你：低温还好
blow dry.example: Friend: What are you doing in the bathroom? You: Blow drying to style. Friend: Are you blow drying your hair? You: Yeah, scrunch for volume. Friend: Does this damage hair? You: Low heat, okay.

blue light.context: 你睡前还在刷手机，朋友劝你说屏幕发的蓝光最伤眼，睡前一小时别玩了。
blue light.translation: 朋友：你睡前还刷手机啊 你：再看一会儿就睡 朋友：那屏幕蓝光伤眼 你：对啊，越看越精神 朋友：那你睡前关掉 你：好，我开个护眼模式
blue light.example: Friend: Still scrolling before bed? You: A bit more then sleep. Friend: That blue light hurts your eyes. You: Yeah, the more I see, the more awake. Friend: Then switch it off before bed. You: Good, I'll use night mode.

blue monday.context: 你周一早上起床特别难受，说这种状态就是媒体说的那个蓝色星期一，一年里最丧的一天。
blue monday.translation: 朋友：你周一咋蔫蔫的 你：起床特别难受 朋友：这是蓝色星期一吗 你：对啊，一年最丧的一天 朋友：那你干点啥提精神 你：先喝杯咖啡
blue monday.example: Friend: Why so glum Monday? You: Waking up is awful. Friend: Is this blue Monday? You: Yeah, the gloomiest day of the year. Friend: Then what to perk up? You: First a coffee.

blue-green roof.context: 你那家公司楼顶铺了一层绿化，说这种蓝绿屋顶能隔热还能下雨时存水。
blue-green roof.translation: 朋友：你公司楼顶咋全是草 你：是种了绿化的屋顶 朋友：这是蓝绿屋顶吗 你：对啊，能隔热存水 朋友：夏天凉快不 你：比楼下凉快好几度
blue-green roof.example: Friend: Why is your rooftop all grass? You: A planted green roof. Friend: Is this a blue-green roof? You: Yeah, insulates and stores rain. Friend: Cooler in summer? You: Several degrees cooler than downstairs.

blue-sky thinking.context: 你们开会不聊具体数字，专想那些天马行空的点子，说这种创意讨论越离谱越好。
blue-sky thinking.translation: 朋友：你们开会都聊啥 你：专想各种怪点子 朋友：这是天马行空创意吗 你：对啊，越离谱越好 朋友：那能落地吗 你：先放开想，再筛
blue-sky thinking.example: Friend: What do you talk about at meetings? You: All sorts of wild ideas. Friend: Is this blue-sky thinking? You: Yeah, the wilder the better. Friend: Can it be applied? You: First free brainstorm, then filter.

board and lodging.context: 你找的那份包食宿的工作，说公司管吃管住，每个月工资几乎能全攒下来。
board and lodging.translation: 朋友：你那份工作管吃住吗 你：对，包食宿 朋友：这是提供食宿吗 你：对啊，工资都能存下 朋友：那你省不少 你：对，吃住不花钱
board and lodging.example: Friend: Does your job cover food and lodging? You: Yes, board and lodging included. Friend: Is this board and lodging provided? You: Yeah, save all the salary. Friend: Then you save a lot. You: Yes, food and housing free.

board game.context: 你周末不下雨就和朋友在家摆开棋盘，说几个人围一起玩桌游比看手机有意思多了。
board game.translation: 朋友：周末下雨你在家干啥 你：和朋友玩桌游 朋友：你爱玩哪种桌游 你：几个人围一盘那种 朋友：好玩吗 你：比看手机有意思
board game.example: Friend: What do you do at home on rainy weekends? You: Play board games with friends. Friend: Which board game do you like? You: The kind around a table. Friend: Is it fun? You: More fun than scrolling.

board member.context: 你公司开董事会，那个坐在主位的人就是新来的董事，说他是代表股东来的。
board member.translation: 朋友：坐主位那个是谁 你：是新来的董事 朋友：他是董事会成员吗 你：对啊，代表股东 朋友：你能跟他说上话不 你：不能，级别差太多
board member.example: Friend: Who's that in the main seat? You: The new board member. Friend: Is he a board member? You: Yeah, represents shareholders. Friend: Can you talk to him? You: No, too big a gap.

bodily function.context: 你年纪大了以后，连翻身、咳嗽这些身体机能都变迟钝了，医生说这是自然衰老。
bodily function.translation: 朋友：你爷爷身体哪不好 你：翻身咳嗽都费劲 朋友：这是身体机能退化吗 你：对啊，老了就这样 朋友：那咋照顾 你：多扶着，慢一点
bodily function.example: Friend: What's wrong with your grandfather's body? You: Turning over, coughing all hard. Friend: Is this bodily function decline? You: Yeah, that's aging. Friend: Then how to care? You: Support more, go slow.

body fat.context: 你体测发现自己体脂率偏高，说这几年久坐不动，肚子上的脂肪越来越多。
body fat.translation: 朋友：你体测结果咋样 你：体脂偏高 朋友：你肚子脂肪多吗 你：对啊，久坐不动长的 朋友：那得减减 你：对，开始跑步
body fat.example: Friend: How's your fitness test? You: Body fat too high. Friend: Do you have a lot of belly fat? You: Yeah, from sitting all day. Friend: Then you must reduce it. You: Yes, starting running.

body image.context: 你朋友总嫌自己胖，天天对着镜子不满意，说她这是对自己身材太在意了。
body image.translation: 朋友：你朋友咋老嫌自己胖 你：她对身材不满意 朋友：她这是身体意象问题吗 你：对啊，老觉得不够瘦 朋友：那你劝劝她 你：让她多接纳自己
body image.example: Friend: Why is your friend always dissatisfied with her body? You: She's unhappy with her shape. Friend: Is this a body image issue? You: Yeah, never thin enough. Friend: Then advise her. You: Tell her to accept herself.

body neutrality.context: 你不纠结胖瘦，说你现在信奉一种身体中立的理念，不吹不黑，健康最重要。
body neutrality.translation: 朋友：你咋不减肥了 你：我不纠结身材了 朋友：你这是身体中立吗 你：对啊，健康最重要 朋友：那你还在乎胖瘦吗 你：不太在乎
body neutrality.example: Friend: Why did you stop dieting? You: I don't obsess over body shape. Friend: Is this body neutrality? You: Yeah, health matters most. Friend: Then do you still care about slim or fat? You: Not really.

body odour.context: 你夏天运动完一身汗，朋友说你这体味有点重，赶紧去冲个澡吧。
body odour.translation: 朋友：你身上咋这味道 你：刚运动完出了汗 朋友：你这体味有点重啊 你：对啊，出了一身汗 朋友：那赶紧洗澡 你：好，我这就去冲
body odour.example: Friend: Why do you smell like this? You: Just exercised, sweaty. Friend: Your body odour is a bit strong. You: Yeah, all sweaty. Friend: Then shower quickly. You: Good, going now.

body positivity.context: 你在网上看到那种鼓励各种身材都可爱的理念，说这种身体自爱的风气让女生们更自信了。
body positivity.translation: 朋友：你看那种身材自信的帖子没 你：看了，鼓励各种身材 朋友：这是身体自爱吗 你：对啊，让大家更自信 朋友：你觉得这风气好吗 你：对，比羞辱好
body positivity.example: Friend: Did you see those body confidence posts? You: Yes, encouraging all shapes. Friend: Is this body positivity? You: Yeah, makes people more confident. Friend: Is this trend good? You: Yes, better than shaming.

body shaming.context: 你朋友因为身材被同事取笑，说这种拿别人身材开玩笑的行为太不厚道。
body shaming.translation: 朋友：你朋友咋不高兴 你：她被同事笑身材 朋友：这是身材羞辱吗 你：对啊，拿人外形开玩笑 朋友：那你咋办 你：让他们别乱讲
body shaming.example: Friend: Why is your friend unhappy? You: Teased by colleagues about her body. Friend: Is this body shaming? You: Yeah, joking about looks. Friend: Then what do you do? You: Tell them to stop.

body shape.context: 你试衣服时发现自己胖了一圈，说这段时间吃得多又不运动，体型都变了。
body shape.translation: 朋友：你穿这衣服咋这么紧 你：最近胖了一圈 朋友：你体型变了吗 你：对啊，腰粗了 朋友：那你赶紧动起来 你：对，开始控制饮食
body shape.example: Friend: Why does this fit so tight? You: Put on a ring lately. Friend: Has your body shape changed? You: Yeah, waist thicker. Friend: Then get moving. You: Yes, start dieting.

bog down.context: 你写方案越写越卡，说这种细节讨论让人陷入泥沼，半天推不动。
bog down.translation: 朋友：你方案写得咋样 你：越写越卡，推不动 朋友：是不是陷入泥潭了 你：对啊，光抠细节 朋友：那你先把骨架列出来 你：好，先别纠结细节
bog down.example: Friend: How's your proposal going? You: Stuck, can't move. Friend: Are you bogged down? You: Yeah, nitpicking details. Friend: Then list the skeleton first. You: Good, stop obsessing over details.

boil down to.context: 你们吵了半天，最后说其实问题归根结底就是一句话：钱没给到位。
boil down to.translation: 朋友：你们吵半天到底为啥 你：归结起来就一件事 朋友：是不是钱的问题 你：对啊，钱没给够 朋友：那把钱补上不就完了 你：对，谈这个就行
boil down to.example: Friend: What were you arguing about so long? You: It boils down to one thing. Friend: Is it about money? You: Yeah, not enough paid. Friend: Then just make up the pay? You: Right, just talk this.

boil over.context: 锅里的汤煮得溢出来，你一边关火一边说，这火太大都扑出来了。
boil over.translation: 朋友：厨房咋有响声 你：汤煮沸溢出来了 朋友：这是煮沸溢出吗 你：对啊，火开太大 朋友：那赶紧关火 你：好，擦干净
boil over.example: Friend: What's that noise in the kitchen? You: The soup boiled over. Friend: Is it boiling over? You: Yeah, flame too high. Friend: Then turn off the heat. You: Good, wiping clean.

boils down to.context: 你分析一堆数据，说最后问题归根结底就是用户觉得贵，其他都是借口。
boils down to.translation: 朋友：你分析出啥结论 你：归结起来就是用户嫌贵 朋友：这是问题的根源吗 你：对啊，别的都是借口 朋友：那降价不就好了 你：对，价格得调
boils down to.example: Friend: What conclusion did you find? You: It boils down to users finding it pricey. Friend: Is this the root of the problem? You: Yeah, rest are excuses. Friend: Then lower the price? You: Yes, adjust price.

bolted onto.context: 你家楼梯扶手上装了个小夜灯，说那是用螺丝直接固定在木头上的，特别牢。
bolted onto.translation: 朋友：那小灯咋固定在墙上 你：用螺丝钉在木头上 朋友：是固定在木头上吗 你：对啊，钉得牢牢的 朋友：会掉吗 你：不会，钉死了
bolted onto.example: Friend: How is that little light fixed on the wall? You: Screwed onto the wood. Friend: Is it bolted onto the wood? You: Yeah, bolted tight. Friend: Will it fall? You: No, bolted firm.

bombarded with.context: 你一打开邮箱，几十封未读邮件、通知全涌进来，说每天都被信息轰炸得喘不过气。
bombarded with.translation: 朋友：你今天邮箱咋这么多未读 你：几十封全涌进来 朋友：你是被信息轰炸了吗 你：对啊，看都看不过来 朋友：那你先挑要紧的回 你：好，其他的晚点再说
bombarded with.example: Friend: Why so many unread emails today? You: Dozens flooded in. Friend: Are you bombarded with messages? You: Yeah, can't keep up reading. Friend: Then reply to urgent first. You: Good, rest later.

bond over toys.context: 你朋友带孩子来你家，俩小孩一起拼积木玩得特别好，说大人和小孩借玩具一下就拉近了。
bond over toys.translation: 朋友：你朋友家小孩跟你熟吗 你：我俩一起拼积木 朋友：你们借玩具增进感情吗 你：对啊，玩着玩着就熟 朋友：那小孩喜欢你不 你：对，拉着我不放
bond over toys.example: Friend: Does your friend's kid get close to you? You: We build blocks together. Friend: Do you bond over toys? You: Yeah, playing brings us close. Friend: Does the kid like you? You: Yes, won't let go.

bond with.context: 你刚养的小猫一开始怕你，后来你天天喂它，慢慢就跟你熟起来了。
bond with.translation: 朋友：你家猫现在黏你不 你：一开始怕，现在黏 朋友：你是怎么跟它熟的 你：天天喂它，慢慢拉近 朋友：它现在跟你亲吗 你：对，会蹭我腿
bond with.example: Friend: Is your cat clingy with you now? You: Shy at first, now clingy. Friend: How did you bond with it? You: Fed daily, slowly got close. Friend: Is it affectionate now? You: Yes, rubs my leg.

bond with others.context: 你性格内向，朋友劝你多参加集体活动，说这样才能跟别人慢慢拉近关系。
bond with others.translation: 朋友：你咋老一个人待着 你：我不太会跟人打交道 朋友：你得学着跟人拉近关系 你：对啊，多参加活动 朋友：那你报个社团 你：好，慢慢练
bond with others.example: Friend: Why do you always stay alone? You: I'm not good at socializing. Friend: You need to bond with others. You: Yeah, join more activities. Friend: Then join a club. You: Good, practice slowly.

bone density.context: 你体检查骨密度，医生说数值偏低，得多喝牛奶晒太阳，不然老了容易骨质疏松。
bone density.translation: 朋友：你体检那项咋说 你：骨密度有点低 朋友：医生让你咋办 你：多喝牛奶多晒太阳 朋友：不然会咋样 你：老了容易骨折
bone density.example: Friend: What did that checkup item say? You: Bone density a bit low. Friend: What did the doctor tell you? You: More milk and sun. Friend: Or else what? You: Easily fracture when old.

bone strength.context: 你常年跑步，医生说你骨骼强度比同龄人好，说这都是运动带来的好处。
bone strength.translation: 朋友：你身体哪项最好 你：医生说我骨骼强 朋友：你骨骼强度不错吧 你：对啊，比同龄人好 朋友：这是跑步跑的吗 你：对，运动的好处
bone strength.example: Friend: Which part of your body is best? You: Doctor says my bones strong. Friend: Is your bone strength good? You: Yeah, better than peers. Friend: Is this from running? You: Yes, exercise benefit.

bonus payment.context: 你年底拿到那笔奖金，说这是公司按业绩发的，正好给自己换个新手机。
bonus payment.translation: 朋友：你年底发钱了吗 你：对，发了奖金 朋友：这是按业绩发的吗 你：对啊，干得多拿得多 朋友：那你打算怎么花 你：换台新手机
bonus payment.example: Friend: Did you get money at year end? You: Yes, got a bonus payment. Friend: Is this paid by performance? You: Yeah, more work more pay. Friend: Then how will you spend it? You: Get a new phone.

book.context: 你周末去图书馆借了两本书，又顺手在网上订了一张演出票，说现在啥都能提前约。
book.translation: 朋友：你周末忙啥 你：借书，还订了票 朋友：你是在预订演出吗 你：对啊，提前约好 朋友：借的啥书 你：两本小说
book.example: Friend: What are you busy with weekend? You: Borrow books, booked tickets. Friend: Are you booking a show? You: Yeah, booked ahead. Friend: What books did you borrow? You: Two novels.

book reviews.context: 你挑书前爱先翻几篇书评，说看大家怎么评价，才知道值不值得买。
book reviews.translation: 朋友：你买书前看啥 你：先看几篇书评 朋友：这些书评有用吗 你：对啊，看了才知道好不好 朋友：那你照着买吗 你：对，挑好评多的
book reviews.example: Friend: What do you check before buying books? You: First read a few book reviews. Friend: Are these book reviews useful? You: Yeah, tells you if it's good. Friend: Then do you buy based on them? You: Yes, pick highly rated.

book up.context: 那家网红餐厅周末早早就订满了，说你不提前一周预约根本排不上。
book up.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅订到没 你：早订光了 朋友：是订满了吗 你：对啊，不提前一周不行 朋友：那咱换一家 你：好，下周再约
book up.example: Friend: Did you book that restaurant? You: All booked up early. Friend: Is it fully booked up? You: Yeah, a week ahead needed. Friend: Then pick another. You: Good, book next week.

boom out.context: 礼堂里喇叭一响，那种低沉洪亮的声音一下就传遍整个大厅，大家立刻安静下来。
boom out.translation: 朋友：礼堂里啥声音这么响 你：喇叭一打开了 朋友：那是喇叭在响吗 你：对啊，一声大家都静了 朋友：效果挺好啊 你：对，全场都听得到
boom out.example: Friend: What's that loud sound in the hall? You: The speaker came on. Friend: Is it booming out? You: Yeah, one word and all went quiet. Friend: Good effect. You: Yes, whole hall hears.

boomerang child.context: 你表弟毕业没出去工作，搬回了爸妈家，说这种成年后又回家住的孩子现在特别多。
boomerang child.translation: 朋友：你表弟咋又回家住了 你：毕业没找到合适工作 朋友：这是回旋子女吗 你：对啊，搬回爸妈家 朋友：这样的人多不多 你：现在特别多
boomerang child.example: Friend: Why is your cousin living back home? You: Graduated, no suitable job. Friend: Is this a boomerang child? You: Yeah, moved back to parents. Friend: Are there many like this? You: Very common now.

boost immunity.context: 你这两年坚持喝温水、睡够觉，说身体的免疫力上来了，换季都很少感冒。
boost immunity.translation: 朋友：你最近咋不生病了 你：我天天运动睡够 朋友：你免疫力是不是提高了 你：对啊，换季都不感冒 朋友：咋做到的 你：早睡多锻炼
boost immunity.example: Friend: Why don't you get sick lately? You: Exercise daily, sleep enough. Friend: Did you boost your immunity? You: Yeah, no colds in season change. Friend: How? You: Early bed, more exercise.

boost memory.context: 你说吃核桃和鱼能帮脑子转得更快，朋友笑你是不是在吃补品提升记忆力。
boost memory.translation: 朋友：你咋天天吃核桃 你：听说能帮脑子 朋友：这是提升记忆力吗 你：对啊，多吃点好 朋友：管用吗 你：心理作用也是作用
boost memory.example: Friend: Why do you eat walnuts daily? You: Heard it helps the brain. Friend: Is this boosting memory? You: Yeah, eat more good. Friend: Does it work? You: Placebo works too.

boost mood.context: 你心情低落时就去逛花店，说买一盆鲜花回来，整个人的情绪立马就好了。
boost mood.translation: 朋友：你咋老逛花店 你：看了花心情就好 朋友：这是在提振心情吗 你：对啊，买盆花回家 朋友：花这么贵值得吗 你：值，心情好最重要
boost mood.example: Friend: Why do you always browse flower shops? You: Flowers lift my mood. Friend: Is this boosting your mood? You: Yeah, buy a pot home. Friend: Are flowers worth it? You: Worth it, mood most important.

boost resume.context: 你刚考完那个证书，说简历上又能多一行，这下找工作更有底气了。
boost resume.translation: 朋友：你这阵子在忙啥 你：刚考完一个证 朋友：这能丰富你简历吗 你：对啊，多一行亮点 朋友：找工作有用吗 你：对，更有底气
boost resume.example: Friend: What have you been busy with? You: Just finished a certificate. Friend: Does this boost your resume? You: Yeah, another highlight. Friend: Useful for job hunting? You: Yes, more confident.

borrow words.context: 你学英语发现很多词其实是从别的语言借来的，说这些外来词用久了就成了自己的。
borrow words.translation: 朋友：英语里咋这么多法语词 你：很多是借来的 朋友：这些是外来借词吗 你：对啊，借久了就熟 朋友：你能举个例子不 你：比如餐厅那个词
borrow words.example: Friend: Why so many French words in English? You: Many are borrowed. Friend: Are these borrowed words? You: Yeah, borrowed long, familiar. Friend: Can you give an example? You: Like the word for restaurant.

bottled water.context: 你出门旅游总带两瓶瓶装水，说路上买水贵，自己带划算又方便。
bottled water.translation: 朋友：你包里咋塞这么多水 你：出门旅游带的 朋友：你是自带瓶装水吗 你：对啊，路上买贵 朋友：沉不沉 你：还行，渴了方便
bottled water.example: Friend: Why so much water in your bag? You: Brought for the trip. Friend: Do you carry bottled water? You: Yeah, buying on the way is pricey. Friend: Heavy? You: Fine, handy when thirsty.

bottled-up feelings.context: 你憋了一肚子委屈，跟朋友喝了两杯后终于把积压的情绪全倒了出来。
bottled-up feelings.translation: 朋友：你今天咋话这么多 你：我憋太久了 朋友：是不是把积压情绪倒出来了 你：对啊，说出来好受 朋友：你这藏了多久 你：小半年了
bottled-up feelings.example: Friend: Why are you talking so much today? You: Held it in too long. Friend: Did you let out bottled-up feelings? You: Yeah, better to say it. Friend: How long did you hide this? You: Half a year.

bottoms up.context: 朋友聚会举杯，你一仰头把杯中酒一口干了，说这就叫干脆利索。
bottoms up.translation: 朋友：来，咱干一杯 你：走，我一口闷 朋友：这是干了吗 你：对啊，一口喝光 朋友：你酒量行吗 你：行，一杯没事
bottoms up.example: Friend: Come, let's toast. You: Go, I'll down it. Friend: Is this bottoms up? You: Yeah, one gulp. Friend: Is your alcohol tolerance okay? You: Fine, one glass.

bounce back.context: 你上次创业失败，没过半年又重新站起来开了个新摊，朋友说你这人恢复得真快。
bounce back.translation: 朋友：你上次失败了咋又干上了 你：休息了半年就缓过来 朋友：你这是受挫后复原了吗 你：对啊，跌倒就爬起来 朋友：你心态真好 你：对，愁也没用
bounce back.example: Friend: Why restarted after failing last time? You: Rested half a year, bounced back. Friend: Did you bounce back after the setback? You: Yeah, fall then rise. Friend: You have a great mindset. You: Yes, worrying is useless.

bounce off.context: 你在空房间里说话，声音撞到墙又弹回来，朋友说你听这回声多大。
bounce off.translation: 朋友：你在空房间里喊啥 你：听听回声 朋友：声音是从墙上弹回来的吗 你：对啊，撞墙就弹回来 朋友：这屋子回声真大 你：对，没家具吸音
bounce off.example: Friend: Why shout in the empty room? You: Hear the echo. Friend: Does the sound bounce off the walls? You: Yeah, hits the wall and bounces. Friend: This room echoes a lot. You: Yes, no furniture to absorb.

bounces off.context: 你有个新点子，先在朋友这试探试探，说把想法说给别人听，才知道行不行。
bounces off.translation: 朋友：你嘀嘀咕咕想啥呢 你：我有个新点子 朋友：你是把想法说给人听吗 你：对啊，先试探试探 朋友：你觉得行不 你：先说说看
bounces off.example: Friend: What are you muttering about? You: I have a new idea. Friend: Are you bouncing it off someone? You: Yeah, test it first. Friend: Do you think it works? You: Let's talk it out first.

bound to.context: 你说这事拖到现在，早晚得暴露，纸包不住火，肯定瞒不住。
bound to.translation: 朋友：这事儿能一直瞒吗 你：瞒不住的 朋友：是注定会暴露吗 你：对啊，早晚得露 朋友：那你早点坦白吧 你：对，主动点好
bound to.example: Friend: Can this be hidden forever? You: Can't hide it. Friend: Is it bound to come out? You: Yeah, sooner or later. Friend: Then confess early. You: Yes, proactive is better.

boundary dispute.context: 你家跟邻居为了一道围墙争了好几年，说这种地界纠纷最伤和气。
boundary dispute.translation: 朋友：你跟邻居咋闹僵了 你：为一道围墙争了几年 朋友：这是地界纠纷吗 你：对啊，谁都不让 朋友：最后咋解决的 你：找了居委会调解
boundary dispute.example: Friend: Why did you fall out with the neighbor? You: Fought over a fence for years. Friend: Is this a boundary dispute? You: Yeah, neither gives in. Friend: How was it finally solved? You: Neighborhood committee mediated.

bowed head tribe.context: 你在地铁上放眼望去，人人都低着头刷手机，说这就是传说中的低头族。
bowed head tribe.translation: 朋友：地铁上大家都在干嘛 你：全低头看手机 朋友：这是低头族吗 你：对啊，一人一屏幕 朋友：你也这样吗 你：我也看
bowed head tribe.example: Friend: What is everyone doing on the subway? You: All heads down on phones. Friend: Is this the bowed head tribe? You: Yeah, one screen each. Friend: Are you like this too? You: I look too.

box jellyfish.context: 你去海边游泳，导游提醒说这片海域有箱型水母，被蜇了特别疼，得穿防蜇服。
box jellyfish.translation: 朋友：你下海游泳安全吗 你：导游说有水母 朋友：是那种箱型水母吗 你：对啊，蜇一下可疼了 朋友：那你还敢游吗 你：穿防蜇服才敢
box jellyfish.example: Friend: Is it safe to swim in the sea? You: Guide said there are jellyfish. Friend: Are they box jellyfish? You: Yeah, sting really hurts. Friend: Dare you swim then? You: Only with a stinger suit.

box office.context: 那部电影一上映票房就破纪录，说现在观众用脚投票，好片自然卖座。
box office.translation: 朋友：那电影票房咋样 你：一上映就破纪录 朋友：是卖座好吗 你：对啊，场场满 朋友：你看了没 你：看了，确实好看
box office.example: Friend: How's that movie's box office? You: Broke records on release. Friend: Is it doing well at the box office? You: Yeah, every show full. Friend: Did you see it? You: Yes, really good.

boxing glove.context: 你看拳击比赛，选手戴着厚厚的拳套上场，说这玩意儿既能打人又能护自己。
boxing glove.translation: 朋友：拳击选手手上戴的啥 你：是拳击手套 朋友：这手套厚不厚 你：对啊，又厚又软 朋友：戴了还疼吗 你：还是疼，但轻点
boxing glove.example: Friend: What do boxers wear on their hands? You: Boxing gloves. Friend: Are these gloves thick? You: Yeah, thick and padded. Friend: Still hurt when worn? You: Still hurts, but lighter.

bragging rights.context: 你们俩打赌他赢了，说这下他可有得炫耀了，这就是所谓的夸耀资本。
bragging rights.translation: 朋友：这次打赌谁赢了 你：他赢了 朋友：他这下有啥可炫耀 你：对啊，到处说 朋友：这不就是夸口的资本吗 你：对，他可得意了
bragging rights.example: Friend: Who won the bet this time? You: He won. Friend: What can he brag about now? You: Yeah, telling everyone. Friend: Isn't this bragging rights? You: Yes, he's so smug.

brain cell.context: 你熬夜一周后感觉自己脑子都迟钝了，说熬夜最伤脑细胞，越熬越笨。
brain cell.translation: 朋友：你最近脑子咋不好使 你：熬夜熬的 朋友：你这是伤了脑细胞吗 你：对啊，越熬越迟钝 朋友：那你赶紧睡 你：好，今晚早睡
brain cell.example: Friend: Why isn't your brain working well lately? You: Staying up late. Friend: Did you lose brain cells? You: Yeah, duller the later. Friend: Then sleep soon. You: Good, early tonight.

brain chemistry.context: 你运动完那种开心，其实是大脑里分泌了多巴胺，说这就是大脑化学物质在起作用。
brain chemistry.translation: 朋友：你运动完咋这么开心 你：身体分泌了多巴胺 朋友：这是大脑化学物质在起作用吗 你：对啊，越运动越爽 朋友：那你坚持得住 你：对，上瘾
brain chemistry.example: Friend: Why are you so happy after exercise? You: Body released dopamine. Friend: Is this brain chemistry at work? You: Yeah, more exercise, more thrill. Friend: Then can you keep it up? You: Yes, addicted.

brain development.context: 你说小朋友小时候多接触自然、多动手玩，对他们的大脑发育特别有好处。
brain development.translation: 朋友：小孩咋变聪明的 你：多玩多接触自然 朋友：这是在促大脑发育吗 你：对啊，小时候最关键 朋友：那你陪孩子玩不 你：天天陪
brain development.example: Friend: How do kids get smarter? You: Play and touch nature more. Friend: Is this boosting brain development? You: Yeah, childhood is key. Friend: Do you play with your kid? You: Daily.

brain fog.context: 你换季时老觉得脑子昏昏沉沉，说这种脑雾状态，喝杯咖啡就清醒多了。
brain fog.translation: 朋友：你今天咋反应慢半拍 你：脑子昏沉沉的 朋友：这是脑雾吗 你：对啊，不清醒 朋友：喝杯咖啡试试 你：好，喝完就灵
brain fog.example: Friend: Why are you half a beat slow today? You: Mind all foggy. Friend: Is this brain fog? You: Yeah, not clear. Friend: Try a coffee. You: Good, works after.

brain function.context: 你说年纪大了以后，记忆力、反应这些脑功能都会慢慢下降，得靠多动脑来保养。
brain function.translation: 朋友：老人老了咋记性差 你：脑功能在退 朋友：这是脑功能下降吗 你：对啊，反应也慢 朋友：那咋保养 你：多动脑，多看书
brain function.example: Friend: Why do old people lose memory? You: Brain function declining. Friend: Is this brain function decline? You: Yeah, reactions slow too. Friend: Then how to maintain? You: Use brain more, read books.

brain maturation.context: 你说十几岁的孩子虽然个子蹿得快，但脑部成熟还没到位，做事容易冲动。
brain maturation.translation: 朋友：你家小孩咋老冲动 你：个子高了脑子没熟 朋友：这是脑部没成熟吗 你：对啊，容易上头 朋友：那咋引导 你：多讲道理，别急
brain maturation.example: Friend: Why is your kid so impulsive? You: Tall but brain not mature. Friend: Is this brain maturation lagging? You: Yeah, easily heated up. Friend: Then how to guide? You: Reason more, don't rush.

brain power.context: 你夸朋友脑子转得快，说这人真是有脑力，什么难题到他手里都能解开。
brain power.translation: 朋友：他脑子咋这么好使 你：他有脑力 朋友：这是脑力好吗 你：对啊，啥题都能解 朋友：你咋不向他学 你：学不来，天生的
brain power.example: Friend: Why is his mind so sharp? You: He has brain power. Friend: Is this great brain power? You: Yeah, any problem solved. Friend: Why not learn from him? You: Can't learn, born with.

brain receptor.context: 你看科普说，大脑里的受体就像小锁，得用对钥匙才能让情绪稳定下来。
brain receptor.translation: 朋友：那科普讲啥稀奇 你：讲大脑里的受体 朋友：这受体是啥 你：像小锁，得配钥匙 朋友：听懂了吗 你：大概懂
brain receptor.example: Friend: What's that science doc about? You: Brain receptors. Friend: What are these receptors? You: Like little locks, need the right key. Friend: Did you understand? You: Roughly.

brain temperature.context: 你发烧时额头发烫，说测的这个头部温度比体表其他地方要高一些。
brain temperature.translation: 朋友：你额头咋这么烫 你：发烧了 朋友：这是头部温度高吗 你：对啊，比别处烫 朋友：量体温没 你：量了，三十八度
brain temperature.example: Friend: Why is your forehead so hot? You: Fever. Friend: Is your brain temperature high? You: Yeah, hotter than elsewhere. Friend: Did you take your temp? You: Yes, 38 degrees.

brain training.context: 你退休后天天玩数独、背单词，说这种脑力训练能让人脑子一直不生锈。
brain training.translation: 朋友：你退休咋还学这学那 你：玩玩数独背单词 朋友：这是在做脑力训练吗 你：对啊，防脑子生锈 朋友：管用不 你：对，越用越灵
brain training.example: Friend: Why do you study after retiring? You: Sudoku, vocabulary. Friend: Is this brain training? You: Yeah, prevent rust. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, the more you use, the sharper.

brain workout.context: 你不满足只跑步，还每周玩两次拼图，说这种脑力锻炼跟跑步一样让人精神。
brain workout.translation: 朋友：你咋又玩上拼图了 你：脑子也得锻炼 朋友：这是脑力锻炼吗 你：对啊，跟跑步一样 朋友：你不嫌累吗 你：不累，还上瘾
brain workout.example: Friend: Why are you doing puzzles now? You: The brain needs exercise too. Friend: Is this a brain workout? You: Yeah, like running. Friend: Aren't you tired? You: No, even addictive.

brake failure.context: 你开车下坡忽然刹不住，吓出一身冷汗，说这种刹车故障太危险，得赶紧检修。
brake failure.translation: 朋友：你刚才咋急刹 你：刹车有点不灵 朋友：这是刹车故障吗 你：对啊，吓死人 朋友：那赶紧去修 你：对，明天就去
brake failure.example: Friend: Why did you brake hard just now? You: Brakes a bit unresponsive. Friend: Is this brake failure? You: Yeah, scary as hell. Friend: Then fix it soon. You: Yes, tomorrow.

brand awareness.context: 你说那家新牌子虽然东西不错，但没人知道，得先砸钱做广告把品牌认知做起来。
brand awareness.translation: 朋友：那新牌子有人听说过吗 你：没啥人知道 朋友：得先做品牌认知 你：对啊，砸广告 朋友：钱花得值吗 你：不花没人认
brand awareness.example: Friend: Has anyone heard of that new brand? You: Hardly anyone. Friend: Must build brand awareness first. You: Yeah, spend on ads. Friend: Is the money worth it? You: Or nobody knows you.

brand collaboration.context: 那家国货牌子跟知名 IP 联名出了新款，说这种品牌合作一上架就卖光。
brand collaboration.translation: 朋友：那新联名款你买了没 你：跟知名IP合作的 朋友：这是品牌合作吗 你：对啊，一上架就光 朋友：这么火吗 你：对，粉丝抢
brand collaboration.example: Friend: Did you buy that new collab? You: It's with a famous IP. Friend: Is this a brand collaboration? You: Yeah, sold out on release. Friend: That popular? You: Yes, fans grab it.

brand habit.context: 你买牙膏从来只挑同一个牌子，说用久了成了习惯，想换都懒得换。
brand habit.translation: 朋友：你牙膏咋老用这牌子 你：用久了成习惯 朋友：这是消费惯性吗 你：对啊，懒得换 朋友：为啥不试试别的 你：懒得选
brand habit.example: Friend: Why do you always use this toothpaste brand? You: Used long, habit formed. Friend: Is this brand habit? You: Yeah, too lazy to switch. Friend: Why not try others? You: Too lazy to choose.

brand image.context: 你说那家手机牌子虽然不便宜，但大家提起它都觉得高档，说这就是品牌形象好。
brand image.translation: 朋友：那手机贵不贵 你：贵，但大家觉得高档 朋友：这是品牌形象好吗 你：对啊，提起来就有面 朋友：你用它有面子不 你：对，喜欢
brand image.example: Friend: Is that phone expensive? You: Expensive, but feels high-end. Friend: Is this good brand image? You: Yeah, prestigious mention. You: Do you feel proud using it? You: Yes, love it.

brand loyal.context: 你买东西认准那一家，用了十年都不换，店员说你真是他们家的忠实老顾客。
brand loyal.translation: 朋友：你咋老在那家买 你：用惯了不换 朋友：你是忠实老顾客吗 你：对啊，十年了 朋友：店家认识你不 你：对，熟客了
brand loyal.example: Friend: Why do you always buy there? You: Used to it, won't switch. Friend: Are you brand loyal? You: Yeah, ten years. Friend: Does the shop know you? You: Yes, regular.

brand loyalty.context: 你说那家咖啡店你只认那一家，说这种忠诚不是偶然，是味道一直没让你失望。
brand loyalty.translation: 朋友：你咋只喝那一家咖啡 你：味道一直好 朋友：这是品牌忠诚吗 你：对啊，喝惯了 朋友：别家你试都不试 你：不试，信任这家
brand loyalty.example: Friend: Why only that coffee shop? You: Taste always good. Friend: Is this brand loyalty? You: Yeah, used to it. Friend: Don't even try others? You: No, trust this one.

brand marketing.context: 那家美妆牌子每年砸大量钱做广告，说这种品牌营销一停销量就掉。
brand marketing.translation: 朋友：那美妆广告咋这么多 你：靠营销撑着 朋友：这是在做品牌营销吗 你：对啊，停了就掉 朋友：产品本身好不 你：一般，全靠广告
brand marketing.example: Friend: Why so many beauty ads? You: Propped by marketing. Friend: Is this brand marketing? You: Yeah, sales drop if stopped. Friend: Is the product itself good? You: Average, all ads.

branded products.context: 你说给孩子买文具，还是认准那些大牌货，说品质有保证，用着放心。
branded products.translation: 朋友：你给孩子买啥文具 你：买的是名牌货 朋友：是品牌产品吗 你：对啊，品质放心 朋友：贵不贵 你：贵点，但耐用
branded products.example: Friend: What stationery do you buy the kid? You: Branded ones. Friend: Are these branded products? You: Yeah, quality assured. Friend: Expensive? You: Pricier, but durable.

brave the cold.context: 你零下几度还坚持早起跑步，朋友说你真是敢跟严寒较劲。
brave the cold.translation: 朋友：这么冷你还去跑步 你：对，穿厚点就出去 朋友：你是在不畏严寒吗 你：对啊，越冷越跑 朋友：你不怕冻着 你：动起来就不冷
brave the cold.example: Friend: You still run in this cold? You: Yes, dress warm and go. Friend: Are you braving the cold? You: Yeah, colder, harder run. Friend: Aren't you afraid of freezing? You: Moving makes it warm.

break.context: 你跟朋友约好周末出游，可临时被拉去加班，你说这下只能爽约，怪不好意思的。
break.translation: 朋友：周末咱不是说好出去玩吗 你：临时要加班 朋友：你这是要爽约吗 你：对啊，实在抱歉 朋友：那咱改下周 你：好，下次请你吃饭
break.example: Friend: Didn't we plan a trip this weekend? You: Asked to work overtime last minute. Friend: Are you going to break the plan? You: Yeah, really sorry. Friend: Then move to next week. You: Good, treat you next time.

break away.context: 你从家族的小作坊里出来单干，说老待在爸妈手下，迟早得自己脱离出去闯一闯。
break away.translation: 朋友：你咋不在家里干了 你：我想自己出去闯 朋友：你是要脱离出去吗 你：对啊，老待着没出息 朋友：你想好了吗 你：对，出去试试
break away.example: Friend: Why aren't you working at home? You: Want to venture out myself. Friend: Are you breaking away? You: Yeah, staying is no growth. Friend: Have you thought it through? You: Yes, go try.

break free of.context: 你说那段低气压的日子终于过去了，自己总算从坏情绪里挣脱出来，重新有了精气神。
break free of.translation: 朋友：你最近状态咋好多了 你：我从坏情绪里挣脱了 朋友：你是摆脱出来了吗 你：对啊，人也精神了 朋友：咋做到的 你：多出门走走
break free of.example: Friend: Why are you in better shape lately? You: Broke free from bad moods. Friend: Did you break free of it? You: Yeah, spirited again. Friend: How did you do it? You: Go out more.

break friendship.context: 你跟最好的朋友为一件小事闹翻，谁也不理谁，说这种绝交比分手还难受。
break friendship.translation: 朋友：你俩咋不说话了 你：为件小事闹翻了 朋友：你们是绝交了吗 你：对啊，谁也不理谁 朋友：你不打算和好 你：等他先开口
break friendship.example: Friend: Why aren't you two talking? You: Fell out over a small thing. Friend: Did you break the friendship? You: Yeah, neither speaks. Friend: Not planning to reconcile? You: Wait for him to speak first.

break into a sweat.context: 你上台演讲前手心冒汗，说一紧张就开始出汗，下来才缓过来。
break into a sweat.translation: 朋友：你刚才上台咋满头汗 你：一紧张就出汗 朋友：你是紧张得冒汗了吗 你：对啊，手心全湿 朋友：下来好了没 你：下来就缓过来了
break into a sweat.example: Friend: Why were you sweating on stage? You: I break into a sweat when nervous. Friend: Did you break into a sweat? You: Yeah, palms all wet. Friend: Better after coming down? You: Recovered once off.

break the bank.context: 你看那款限量包价格惊人，说这玩意儿真是贵到能把钱包刷爆，但咬咬牙还是买了。
break the bank.translation: 朋友：那包多少钱 你：贵到吓人 朋友：是贵到能刷爆卡吗 你：对啊，花了小两万 朋友：值不值啊 你：喜欢，值
break the bank.example: Friend: How much is that bag? You: Scary expensive. Friend: Does it break the bank? You: Yeah, nearly twenty thousand. Friend: Is it worth it? You: Love it, worth.

break the fast.context: 你早上起床先喝一杯温水，说这叫开斋，让肠胃慢慢醒过来再吃东西。
break the fast.translation: 朋友：你早上先喝温水干啥 你：让肠胃醒一醒 朋友：这是吃早饭前开胃吗 你：对啊，先开斋再吃 朋友：你习惯挺好 你：对，胃舒服
break the fast.example: Friend: Why drink warm water first in the morning? You: Wake up the stomach. Friend: Is this breaking the fast? You: Yeah, break fast before eating. Friend: Good habit. You: Yes, stomach feels good.

break the ice.context: 你刚到新部门，大家都不说话，你主动聊了句天气，说先开个头打破尴尬。
break the ice.translation: 朋友：你新部门气氛咋样 你：刚来都不说话 朋友：你得先破冰 你：对啊，聊了句天气 朋友：大家接话了吗 你：接了，慢慢就熟
break the ice.example: Friend: How's the atmosphere in your new department? You: Nobody talks when I arrive. Friend: You have to break the ice. You: Yeah, chatted about the weather. Friend: Did people respond? You: Yes, slowly warm up.

break the mould.context: 你在一家人人守旧的公司里搞起了弹性办公，说不破先例就永远改不了老规矩。
break the mould.translation: 朋友：你公司咋允许在家上班 你：我打破了老规矩 朋友：这是打破惯例吗 你：对啊，以前都坐班 朋友：同事们反应咋样 你：一开始反对，后来喜欢
break the mould.example: Friend: Why does your company allow working from home? You: I broke the old mould. Friend: Is this breaking the mould? You: Yeah, everyone used to office. Friend: How do colleagues react? You: Objected at first, then liked it.

breaking down of stereotypes.context: 你说那些刻板印象得靠真实故事一点点打破，让大家看到不同的人其实都一样。
breaking down of stereotypes.translation: 朋友：那些偏见咋消除 你：得靠真实故事 朋友：这是在打破刻板印象吗 你：对啊，让大家看见 朋友：见效快吗 你：慢慢来
breaking down of stereotypes.example: Friend: How to remove those stereotypes? You: Through real stories. Friend: Is this breaking down of stereotypes? You: Yeah, let people see. Friend: Quick to work? You: Slowly.

breaking through.context: 你搞科研熬了好几年，终于在一个老难题上有了突破，说这种突破比什么都让人高兴。
breaking through.translation: 朋友：你那项目有进展没 你：终于突破了 朋友：这是取得突破了吗 你：对啊，熬了好几年 朋友：这下能发论文了 你：对，终于见光
breaking through.example: Friend: Any progress on your project? You: Finally broke through. Friend: Is this breaking through? You: Yeah, years of grinding. Friend: Now you can publish? You: Yes, finally.

breast augmentation.context: 你说现在整形医院广告满天飞，说隆胸这种手术得慎重考虑，不能光听广告吹。
breast augmentation.translation: 朋友：那些整形广告你看了吗 你：看了，吹得天花乱坠 朋友：隆胸这种手术靠谱吗 你：对啊，得慎重 朋友：你敢做吗 你：不敢，风险大
breast augmentation.example: Friend: Did you see those plastic surgery ads? You: Yes, hyped everywhere. Friend: Is breast augmentation reliable? You: Yeah, must be cautious. Friend: Dare you do it? You: No, risky.

breathable air.context: 你去高原玩，说那里空气稀薄，得大口喘气才能吸到能呼吸的空气。
breathable air.translation: 朋友：高原上啥感觉 你：喘不上气 朋友：是不是空气稀薄 你：对啊，得大口喘 朋友：你适应得了吗 你：慢慢就好
breathable air.example: Friend: How does it feel on the plateau? You: Can't catch breath. Friend: Is the air thin? You: Yeah, must breathe hard for breathable air. Friend: Can you adapt? You: Slowly better.

breathe new life into.context: 那家老店本来快倒闭，来了个年轻老板重新装修，说这下给小店注入了新活力。
breathe new life into.translation: 朋友：那老店咋又火了 你：换了个年轻老板 朋友：是给小店注入活力了吗 你：对啊，重新装修 朋友：生意好起来没 你：对，又排队了
breathe new life into.example: Friend: Why is that old shop popular again? You: New young owner. Friend: Did it breathe new life into the shop? You: Yeah, renovated. Friend: Did business pick up? You: Yes, queuing again.

breathing exercise.context: 你紧张时就做几次深呼吸，说这种呼吸练习能让心跳慢慢稳下来。
breathing exercise.translation: 朋友：你紧张时咋调节 你：做几次深呼吸 朋友：这是呼吸练习吗 你：对啊，心跳就稳了 朋友：你常用吗 你：对，上台前必做
breathing exercise.example: Friend: How do you calm down when nervous? You: Do a few deep breaths. Friend: Is this a breathing exercise? You: Yeah, heart steadies. Friend: Do you use it often? You: Yes, before every stage.

breathing exercises.context: 你说每天睡前做几分钟呼吸锻炼，能帮助入睡，比数羊管用多了。
breathing exercises.translation: 朋友：你咋睡得这么香 你：睡前做呼吸锻炼 朋友：这是呼吸锻炼吗 你：对啊，比数羊管用 朋友：你坚持多久了 你：小半年
breathing exercises.example: Friend: Why do you sleep so well? You: Breathing exercises before bed. Friend: Are these breathing exercises? You: Yeah, better than counting sheep. Friend: How long have you kept it? You: Half a year.

breathing rate.context: 你跑步后喘得厉害，看手表说自己呼吸频率一下子快了好多，得慢慢走缓一缓。
breathing rate.translation: 朋友：你跑完喘成这样 你：呼吸特别快 朋友：你呼吸频率是不是加快了 你：对啊，得慢慢走 朋友：歇会儿再坐 你：好，走两圈
breathing rate.example: Friend: Why are you gasping after running? You: Breathing very fast. Friend: Is your breathing rate up? You: Yeah, must walk slowly. Friend: Rest before sitting. You: Good, walk two laps.

breathing room.context: 你说排得太满的日程让人喘不过气，每周得留出半天喘息的空间，不然要崩。
breathing room.translation: 朋友：你这日程太满了 你：我想留半天空 朋友：你是要留点喘息空间吗 你：对啊，不然要崩 朋友：那你推掉一些事 你：好，下周空半天
breathing room.example: Friend: Your schedule is too packed. You: Want to leave half a day empty. Friend: Do you need breathing room? You: Yeah, or I'll break. Friend: Then push some things away. You: Good, leave half a day next week.

breeding ground.context: 你说潮湿闷热的角落最容易长霉，说这种地方就是霉菌滋生的温床。
breeding ground.translation: 朋友：那墙角咋老发霉 你：又潮又闷 朋友：这是霉菌滋生地吗 你：对啊，越潮越长 朋友：咋处理 你：保持通风干燥
breeding ground.example: Friend: Why does that corner always mold? You: Damp and stuffy. Friend: Is this a breeding ground for mold? You: Yeah, damper, more mold. Friend: How to fix? You: Keep ventilated and dry.

breeding season.context: 你春天去看鸟，说这段时间正是鸟类的繁殖季，到处都能看到小鸟育雏。
breeding season.translation: 朋友：春天看鸟好看吗 你：正是它们繁殖的时候 朋友：这是繁殖季吗 你：对啊，到处有小鸟 朋友：你拍到没 你：拍了一堆
breeding season.example: Friend: Is bird-watching good in spring? You: It's their breeding season. Friend: Is this breeding season? You: Yeah, baby birds everywhere. Friend: Did you photograph? You: Took a pile.

brew strength.context: 你跟咖啡师说少放粉，说这次你想喝淡一点，不要那种太浓的口味。
brew strength.translation: 朋友：你咖啡要浓的淡的 你：淡一点，别太浓 朋友：你是在挑咖啡浓度吗 你：对啊，太浓喝不惯 朋友：那给你少放粉 你：好，谢了
brew strength.example: Friend: Do you want strong or mild coffee? You: Mild, not too strong. Friend: Are you choosing the brew strength? You: Yeah, too strong isn't my taste. Friend: Then less powder. You: Good, thanks.

brick-and-mortar office.context: 你公司这两年改居家办公了，说那个实体办公室干脆退掉，省下不少租金。
brick-and-mortar office.translation: 朋友：你们公司还租办公室吗 你：退了，全在家上班 朋友：那实体办公室不要了吗 你：对啊，省租金 朋友：那开会咋办 你：线上开
brick-and-mortar office.example: Friend: Does your company still rent an office? You: Terminated, all work from home. Friend: Don't you need a brick-and-mortar office? You: Yeah, save rent. Friend: Then how about meetings? You: Online.

bridal party.context: 你朋友结婚，你被拉去当伴郎，说那个伴郎伴娘团一出场，场面立马热闹起来。
bridal party.translation: 朋友：你结婚请你干啥 你：当伴郎 朋友：那伴郎伴娘团几个人 你：对啊，六个人 朋友：出场热闹不 你：对，特别热闹
bridal party.example: Friend: What are you doing at your friend's wedding? You: Being groomsman. Friend: How big is the bridal party? You: Yeah, six people. Friend: Is the entrance lively? You: Yes, very lively.

brighten one's day.context: 你雨天上班被人让了座，说这种小小的善意，一整天都让人心里暖暖的。
brighten one's day.translation: 朋友：你今天咋这么开心 你：有人给我让座了 朋友：这是让人开心的事吗 你：对啊，心里暖 朋友：那你说声谢谢没 你：说了，特别感谢
brighten one's day.example: Friend: Why are you so happy today? You: Someone gave me a seat. Friend: Did it brighten your day? You: Yeah, warm heart. Friend: Did you say thanks? You: Yes, very grateful.

brighten up.context: 你说下雨天家里点个蜡烛，整个屋子气氛一下就愉悦起来，说这种小布置最能点亮心情。
brighten up.translation: 朋友：你下雨天咋这么有情调 你：点了个蜡烛 朋友：这是在增添愉悦吗 你：对啊，气氛一下好 朋友：你挺会享受 你：对，小布置
brighten up.example: Friend: Why so cozy on a rainy day? You: Lit a candle. Friend: Are you brightening up the mood? You: Yeah, atmosphere lifts at once. Friend: You know how to enjoy. You: Yes, little setup.

bring along.context: 你约朋友去野餐，特意带上刚买的小蛋糕，说这就是来分享的好东西。
bring along.translation: 朋友：你野餐带了啥 你：刚买的小蛋糕 朋友：你是特意带来分享的吗 你：对啊，大家一起吃 朋友：还有别的没 你：带了水果和饮料
bring along.example: Friend: What did you bring for the picnic? You: Just-bought small cake. Friend: Did you bring it along to share? You: Yeah, everyone eats together. Friend: Anything else? You: Brought fruit and drinks.

bring forth.context: 你说那些老传统在今天能带来新启发，说时间虽然过了，智慧还能不断被拿出来。
bring forth.translation: 朋友：老书里有啥用 你：能带来新启发 朋友：是老智慧生出新东西吗 你：对啊，越品越有味 朋友：你常看吗 你：对，翻一翻
bring forth.example: Friend: What use are old books? You: Bring new inspiration. Friend: Do they bring forth new insights? You: Yeah, the more you savor, the more flavor. Friend: Do you read them often? You: Yes, flipping through.

bring into.context: 你说新来的制度把部门带进了一个新阶段，说这套规矩一上，大家效率都高了。
bring into.translation: 朋友：新制度好用吗 你：把我们带进新阶段 朋友：是使进入新状态吗 你：对啊，效率高了 朋友：大家适应不 你：慢慢适应
bring into.example: Friend: Is the new system good? You: Brought us into a new stage. Friend: Did it bring us into a new state? You: Yeah, efficiency up. Friend: Do people adapt? You: Slowly.

bring on.context: 你说连续加班容易把人拖进抑郁，说这种状态一上来，什么都提不起劲。
bring on.translation: 朋友：你最近咋情绪低 你：连续加班累的 朋友：是加班诱发情绪差吗 你：对啊，啥都不想干 朋友：那你休息几天 你：好，休一周
bring on.example: Friend: Why low mood lately? You: Continuous overtime exhausted me. Friend: Did overtime bring on depression? You: Yeah, don't want to do anything. Friend: Then rest a few days. You: Good, a week off.

bring to an end.context: 你说那个老项目跑了三年，终于该收尾了，说再拖下去也是浪费资源。
bring to an end.translation: 朋友：那老项目咋办 你：该收尾了 朋友：是让它结束吗 你：对啊，拖也没用 朋友：那谁来收 你：我牵头收
bring to an end.example: Friend: What about that old project? You: Time to bring it to an end. Friend: Should we bring it to an end? You: Yeah, dragging is useless. Friend: Then who closes it? You: I lead it.

bring to the table.context: 你说团队合作时，每个人都得拿出自己的本事，说谁多贡献，谁就更被看重。
bring to the table.translation: 朋友：团队合作靠啥 你：每人拿出本事 朋友：是各自提供贡献吗 你：对啊，多干多得 朋友：你能贡献啥 你：我会设计
bring to the table.example: Friend: What does teamwork rely on? You: Everyone brings their skills. Friend: Do they bring it to the table? You: Yeah, more work, more gain. Friend: What can you bring? You: I do design.

brisk walk.context: 你说每天饭后走三十分钟，得是那种快走，慢悠悠晃达不到锻炼效果。
brisk walk.translation: 朋友：你饭后走多久 你：半小时快走 朋友：是快步走吗 你：对啊，慢晃没用 朋友：你出汗不 你：微微出汗
brisk walk.example: Friend: How long do you walk after meals? You: Half hour brisk walk. Friend: Is it a brisk walk? You: Yeah, slow stroll is useless. Friend: Do you sweat? You: A little.

broad wag.context: 你家狗一看见你回家，整条尾巴连屁股一起摇，说这种大幅度摇尾说明它特别开心。
broad wag.translation: 朋友：你家狗见你啥反应 你：连屁股一起摇 朋友：这是大幅度摇尾吗 你：对啊，摇得欢 朋友：它是高兴吗 你：对，想让你摸
broad wag.example: Friend: How does your dog react when you come home? You: Wags with the whole butt. Friend: Is it a broad wag? You: Yeah, wagging hard. Friend: Is it happy? You: Yes, wants a pat.

broaden the mind.context: 你说旅行最能开阔眼界，说走遍不同地方，人才会知道世界有多大。
broaden the mind.translation: 朋友：旅行有啥用 你：能开阔眼界 朋友：是让人长见识吗 你：对啊，世界很大 朋友：你去过多少地方 你：十来个
broaden the mind.example: Friend: What's the use of traveling? You: It broadens the mind. Friend: Does it broaden the mind? You: Yeah, the world is big. Friend: How many places have you been? You: A dozen.

brown rice.context: 你说现在减肥都改吃糙米了，说这种没抛光的米更健康，就是口感粗点。
brown rice.translation: 朋友：你米饭咋换了 你：换成糙米了 朋友：这是没抛光的米吗 你：对啊，更健康 朋友：好吃不 你：粗点，但习惯
brown rice.example: Friend: Why did you change your rice? You: Switched to brown rice. Friend: Is it unpolished rice? You: Yeah, healthier. Friend: Is it tasty? You: Coarser, but used to it.

browsing history.context: 你说手机里那堆浏览记录能看出一个人最近在忙啥，说删都删不干净。
browsing history.translation: 朋友：你手机咋老弹广告 你：浏览记录被记了 朋友：是被上网记录盯上了吗 你：对啊，删不干净 朋友：那你清理一下 你：好，清一下
browsing history.example: Friend: Why does your phone keep popping ads? You: My browsing history got tracked. Friend: Are they using your browsing history? You: Yeah, can't fully delete. Friend: Then clean it. You: Good, clear it.

bubble away.context: 你说锅里那锅汤一直小火咕嘟着，说这种冒泡的状态最香，再炖半小时就好。
bubble away.translation: 朋友：你锅里啥在响 你：汤在小火咕嘟 朋友：是在冒泡吗 你：对啊，越炖越香 朋友：还要多久 你：半小时
bubble away.example: Friend: What's that sound in your pot? You: Soup simmering gently. Friend: Is it bubbling away? You: Yeah, the longer the tastier. Friend: How much longer? You: Half an hour.

bubbling away.context: 你站在灶前看那锅鸡汤，说汤面一直咕嘟咕嘟冒小泡，这种慢炖最出味。
bubbling away.translation: 朋友：你站那看啥 你：看鸡汤冒泡 朋友：是在咕嘟冒泡吗 你：对啊，慢炖出味 朋友：你守着它干啥 你：怕扑出来
bubbling away.example: Friend: What are you watching there? You: The chicken soup bubbling. Friend: Is it bubbling away? You: Yeah, slow stew tastes best. Friend: Why guard it? You: Afraid it boils over.

bucket list.context: 你说人这一辈子总得有个愿望清单，说趁年轻得把想做的事一件件划掉。
bucket list.translation: 朋友：你有啥人生目标 你：列了张愿望清单 朋友：这是死前必做清单吗 你：对啊，一件件划掉 朋友：你划掉几件了 你：五件
bucket list.example: Friend: What are your life goals? You: Made a bucket list. Friend: Is this a bucket list? You: Yeah, crossing off one by one. Friend: How many have you crossed? You: Five.

budget airline.context: 你说出差订票专挑那种廉价航空，说机票省下来的钱能多吃两顿好的。
budget airline.translation: 朋友：你出差机票买啥 你：挑廉价航空 朋友：是那种便宜航司吗 你：对啊，省下来吃好的 朋友：行李另收钱不 你：收，得注意
budget airline.example: Friend: What airline do you book for business trips? You: Pick a budget airline. Friend: Is it a budget airline? You: Yeah, savings for better food. Friend: Do they charge for baggage? You: Yes, watch out.

budget meal.context: 你说中午没钱下馆子，就找那种十几块的平价简餐，说吃饱就行，别讲究。
budget meal.translation: 朋友：你中午去哪吃 你：找个便宜简餐 朋友：是那种平价简餐吗 你：对啊，十几块 朋友：吃得好吗 你：吃饱就行
budget meal.example: Friend: Where do you eat lunch? You: Find a cheap budget meal. Friend: Is it a budget meal? You: Yeah, ten-plus yuan. Friend: Is it good? You: Fill up is enough.

budget planning.context: 你说每到月底就做一次预算规划，说把钱分好类，才知道钱都花哪了。
budget planning.translation: 朋友：你咋老记账 你：月底做预算规划 朋友：是在做预算吗 你：对啊，钱分好类 朋友：管得住吗 你：对，不乱花
budget planning.example: Friend: Why do you always keep accounts? You: Budget planning at month end. Friend: Are you doing budget planning? You: Yeah, split the money. Friend: Can you control it? You: Yes, no waste.

budget squeeze.context: 你说这两年工资没涨，物价却飞涨，手头的预算紧得厉害，说这种紧缩真让人难受。
budget squeeze.translation: 朋友：你最近咋这么省 你：钱紧得厉害 朋友：是预算紧缩吗 你：对啊，工资没涨 朋友：那咋办 你：少出去聚餐
budget squeeze.example: Friend: Why so frugal lately? You: Money very tight. Friend: Is there a budget squeeze? You: Yeah, wages didn't rise. Friend: Then what to do? You: Less dining out.

budget traveller.context: 你说那种专找青旅、坐夜班火车的旅客，就是典型的经济型旅客，省钱第一。
budget traveller.translation: 朋友：你出去住啥 你：住青旅 朋友：是那种省钱旅客吗 你：对啊，省钱第一 朋友：你玩得咋样 你：便宜，看得多
budget traveller.example: Friend: Where do you stay when traveling? You: Hostels. Friend: Are you a budget traveller? You: Yeah, saving first. Friend: How was the trip? You: Cheap, saw more.

build confidence.context: 你说第一次上台演讲腿都抖，多上去几次之后，慢慢就把信心建立起来了。
build confidence.translation: 朋友：你演讲还紧张吗 你：第一次腿抖 朋友：你后来建立信心了吗 你：对啊，多练几次 朋友：现在稳了没 你：对，自然多了
build confidence.example: Friend: Are you still nervous giving speeches? You: Legs shook the first time. Friend: Did you build confidence later? You: Yeah, practice more. Friend: Are you steady now? You: Yes, much more natural.

build over.context: 你说那片空地这几年全盖满了楼，说以前的农田早就被建筑覆盖了。
build over.translation: 朋友：那片地以前是啥 你：以前是农田 朋友：现在是被建筑盖满了吗 你：对啊，全是楼 朋友：变化真大 你：对，几年不见
build over.example: Friend: What was that land before? You: Farmland before. Friend: Is it now built over with buildings? You: Yeah, all buildings. Friend: Big change. You: Yes, gone in a few years.

building manager.context: 你说楼里那物业师傅随叫随到，说水管坏了喊一声，半小时就上门修。
building manager.translation: 朋友：你家水管坏了咋办 你：喊物业师傅 朋友：是物业来修吗 你：对啊，半小时到 朋友：收费贵不 你：不贵，挺负责
building manager.example: Friend: What if your pipe breaks? You: Call the building manager. Friend: Does the building manager come? You: Yeah, half hour to door. Friend: Is the fee expensive? You: Not expensive, responsible.

bulk buy.context: 你说家里那箱纸巾趁打折一次买够，说批量囤货比零买划算多了。
bulk buy.translation: 朋友：你咋买这么多纸巾 你：趁打折囤的 朋友：是大批量采购吗 你：对啊，比零买便宜 朋友：放得下吗 你：对，塞柜子里
bulk buy.example: Friend: Why buy so much tissue? You: Stocked up on sale. Friend: Is this a bulk buy? You: Yeah, cheaper than retail. Friend: Does it fit? You: Yes, in the cabinet.

bulk out.context: 你说做饭时加点土豆、青菜，能把一锅菜的分量撑起来，够两三个人吃。
bulk out.translation: 朋友：你这菜咋这么多 你：加了土豆青菜 朋友：是把分量加大了吗 你：对啊，够两三个人 朋友：这样省钱不 你：对，肉少菜多
bulk out.example: Friend: Why is this dish so big? You: Added potato and greens. Friend: Did you bulk out the meal? You: Yeah, feeds two or three. Friend: Does this save money? You: Yes, less meat, more veg.

bump in the road.context: 你说计划赶不上变化，这点小颠簸不碍事，绕过去继续走就行。
bump in the road.translation: 朋友：计划又变了咋办 你：这点小问题不算啥 朋友：是路上的小颠簸吗 你：对啊，绕过去就行 朋友：你心态真好 你：对，小事
bump in the road.example: Friend: What if the plan changes again? You: This small problem is nothing. Friend: Is it a bump in the road? You: Yeah, just go around. Friend: You have a great mindset. You: Yes, small thing.

bump up against.context: 你说项目推进到一半，老是跟预算和时间撞上，说这种冲突让人头疼。
bump up against.translation: 朋友：项目进行得顺吗 你：老跟预算撞 朋友：是产生冲突了吗 你：对啊，钱不够 朋友：那咋办 你：砍点非必要项
bump up against.example: Friend: Is the project going smoothly? You: Keeps bumping into the budget. Friend: Are you bumping up against limits? You: Yeah, not enough money. Friend: Then what? You: Cut non-essential items.

buried in.context: 你说最近天天加班，整个人都埋在文件堆里，连吃饭都顾不上。
buried in.translation: 朋友：你最近咋不见人 你：埋在文件堆里 朋友：是埋头于工作吗 你：对啊，连饭都顾不上 朋友：你悠着点 你：好，忙完这阵
buried in.example: Friend: Why haven't I seen you lately? You: Buried in paperwork. Friend: Are you buried in work? You: Yeah, even skip meals. Friend: Take it easy. You: Good, after this rush.

burn a hole in your pocket.context: 你说那顿大餐吃了小两千，说这钱花得像烧了个洞，钱包一下就瘪了。
burn a hole in your pocket.translation: 朋友：那顿饭花多少 你：小两千 朋友：是花钱如流水吗 你：对啊，钱包一下空 朋友：值不值啊 你：请客，值
burn a hole in your pocket.example: Friend: How much was that meal? You: Nearly two thousand. Friend: Did it burn a hole in your pocket? You: Yeah, wallet emptied at once. Friend: Is it worth it? You: Treating, worth.

burn calories.context: 你说走路半小时就能消耗不少热量，说不用玩命跑，慢慢走也管用。
burn calories.translation: 朋友：你咋不跑步 你：走路也能烧热量 朋友：是在消耗热量吗 你：对啊，半小时 朋友：这样能瘦吗 你：对，坚持就好
burn calories.example: Friend: Why not run? You: Walking also burns calories. Friend: Are you burning calories? You: Yeah, half an hour. Friend: Can you slim this way? You: Yes, persistence works.

burn fat.context: 你说想瘦肚子，得靠持续有氧才能燃脂，光做仰卧起坐没用。
burn fat.translation: 朋友：你咋老跑步 你：想燃脂 朋友：是在燃脂吗 你：对啊，光练肚子没用 朋友：多久见效 你：两三个月
burn fat.example: Friend: Why do you always run? You: Want to burn fat. Friend: Are you burning fat? You: Yeah, abs alone won't work. Friend: How long to see effect? You: Two or three months.

burn off calories.context: 你说吃完那顿火锅有点罪恶，赶紧下楼快走两圈，说这样能把多余热量消耗掉。
burn off calories.translation: 朋友：你吃了火锅咋还下楼 你：出去走走消耗热量 朋友：是把热量消耗掉吗 你：对啊，快走两圈 朋友：这样管用不 你：心理安慰也好
burn off calories.example: Friend: Why go downstairs after hotpot? You: Walk to burn off calories. Friend: Are you burning off calories? You: Yeah, two brisk laps. Friend: Does it work? You: Placebo counts too.

burn one's bridges.context: 你说离开那家公司时把话说死了，现在想想真是断了退路，说做人不能太绝。
burn one's bridges.translation: 朋友：你咋不回老东家 你：当初话说太死 朋友：是把退路断了吗 你：对啊，没法回头 朋友：后悔不 你：有点后悔
burn one's bridges.example: Friend: Why don't you go back to the old firm? You: Spoke too sharply when leaving. Friend: Did you burn your bridges? You: Yeah, no way back. Friend: Do you regret it? You: A little.

burning off.context: 你说那部烂剧最后被电视台一次放完，说这种烧剧的做法就是不想再播了。
burning off.translation: 朋友：那剧咋一下放完 你：电视台不想播了 朋友：是在烧剧吗 你：对啊，一次放完 朋友：这样剧迷不骂吗 你：对，骂声一片
burning off.example: Friend: Why did that show finish at once? You: The station didn't want to air it. Friend: Are they burning off the episodes? You: Yeah, aired in one go. Friend: Don't fans complain? You: Yes, lots of complaints.

burning out.context: 你说连续忙了一年，终于累得精疲力竭，说这种职业倦怠再不调整就要出问题。
burning out.translation: 朋友：你最近状态咋这么差 你：忙了一年累垮了 朋友：是职业过劳了吗 你：对啊，干啥都没劲 朋友：那你得休息 你：对，休个长假
burning out.example: Friend: Why is your state so poor lately? You: Busy a year, burned out. Friend: Are you burning out? You: Yeah, no energy for anything. Friend: Then you must rest. You: Yes, take a long leave.

burning question.context: 你说会上大家争论最凶的，就是那个最迫切要解答的问题，绕了半天绕不开。
burning question.translation: 朋友：你们会上吵啥 你：那个最急的问题 朋友：是那个迫切问题吗 你：对啊，绕不开 朋友：定下来没 你：对，必须解决
burning question.example: Friend: What were you arguing about at the meeting? You: The most urgent question. Friend: Is that the burning question? You: Yeah, can't avoid it. Friend: Did you settle it? You: Yes, must solve.

burnout prevention.context: 你说公司这两年开始重视过劳预防，给大家定了加班上限，说这种保护来得正是时候。
burnout prevention.translation: 朋友：你们公司这两年咋样 你：开始防过劳 朋友：是在做过劳预防吗 你：对啊，加班有限额 朋友：这政策好吗 你：对，来得及时
burnout prevention.example: Friend: How's your company these two years? You: Started burnout prevention. Friend: Is this burnout prevention? You: Yeah, overtime has a cap. Friend: Is this policy good? You: Yes, timely.

burst of anger.context: 你说那同事一句话就把你点着，说你那阵火上来得特别突然，事后又后悔。
burst of anger.translation: 朋友：你刚才咋发火了 你：被他一句话点着 朋友：是一阵暴怒吗 你：对啊，上来得突然 朋友：事后后悔不 你：对，后悔
burst of anger.example: Friend: Why did you flare up just now? You: His word set me off. Friend: Was that a burst of anger? You: Yeah, sudden burst. Friend: Do you regret it after? You: Yes, regret.

bury in.context: 你说一到周末就把自己埋在书里，说这种沉浸最能让人静下心来。
bury in.translation: 朋友：你周末在家干啥 你：埋在书里 朋友：是埋头读书吗 你：对啊，一坐一下午 朋友：你不嫌闷 你：不，最静心
bury in.example: Friend: What do you do at home on weekends? You: Bury myself in books. Friend: Are you burying yourself in reading? You: Yeah, an afternoon sitting. Friend: Don't you find it dull? You: No, most calming.

business acumen.context: 你说他这人天生就有商业头脑，摆个地摊都能比别人多赚一倍，说这就是敏锐。
business acumen.translation: 朋友：他咋赚钱这么快 你：天生有商业头脑 朋友：是有商业敏锐度吗 你：对啊，摆地摊都多赚 朋友：你学得来不 你：学不来，天生的
business acumen.example: Friend: Why does he make money so fast? You: Born with business acumen. Friend: Is this business acumen? You: Yeah, even a stall earns double. Friend: Can you learn it? You: No, born with it.

business brain.context: 你说他这人天生有商业头脑，刚毕业就摆地摊赚了第一桶金，说这就是天赋。
business brain.translation: 朋友：他咋刚毕业就赚到钱 你：天生有商业头脑 朋友：是有生意头脑吗 你：对啊，摆地摊都行 朋友：你学得来不 你：学不来
business brain.example: Friend: Why did he make money right after graduation? You: Born with a business brain. Friend: Is this a business brain? You: Yeah, even a stall works. Friend: Can you learn it? You: No.

business model.context: 你说这家店靠卖咖啡挣钱，说它的商业模式就是薄利多销，靠客流量撑着。
business model.translation: 朋友：那家小店咋赚钱 你：靠薄利多销 朋友：是它的商业模式吗 你：对啊，靠客流 朋友：这模式稳吗 你：对，人一多就赚
business model.example: Friend: How does that little shop make money? You: Low margin, high volume. Friend: Is this its business model? You: Yeah, relies on foot traffic. Friend: Is this model stable? You: Yes, crowds bring profit.

business rate.context: 你说英国开店还得交一种商铺物业税，说这跟国内的房产税还不太一样。
business rate.translation: 朋友：你在英国开店交啥税 你：一种商铺物业税 朋友：是那种商业地产税吗 你：对啊，按月交 朋友：贵不贵 你：不便宜
business rate.example: Friend: What tax do you pay opening a shop in the UK? You: A commercial property tax. Friend: Is that the business rate? You: Yeah, monthly. Friend: Is it expensive? You: Not cheap.

but rather.context: 你说问题不是出在产品上，而是出在销售方式上，说别把账算错了地方。
but rather.translation: 朋友：问题出在哪 你：不是产品，是销售 朋友：是说而是销售问题吗 你：对啊，方向错了 朋友：那咋改 你：换销售策略
but rather.example: Friend: Where is the problem? You: Not the product, but the sales. Friend: Do you mean it's rather the sales? You: Yeah, wrong direction. Friend: Then how to fix? You: Change the sales strategy.

butchery demos.context: 你说那家肉铺周末搞现场切肉演示，说看师傅一刀一刀切，买肉的人一下就多了。
butchery demos.translation: 朋友：那肉铺周末咋这么多人 你：在搞切肉演示 朋友：是现场切肉展示吗 你：对啊，师傅表演 朋友：这样肉好卖吗 你：对，看着新鲜
butchery demos.example: Friend: Why is that butcher busy on weekends? You: They're doing butchery demos. Friend: Are those butchery demos? You: Yeah, the butcher performs. Friend: Does this sell meat well? You: Yes, looks fresh.

butter up.context: 你说他想求领导办事，天天端茶倒水拍马屁，说这种讨好的样子让人看不下去。
butter up.translation: 朋友：他最近咋老围着领导转 你：想求领导办事 朋友：是在讨好领导吗 你：对啊，端茶倒水 朋友：这样有用吗 你：看领导吃不吃这套
butter up.example: Friend: Why does he hover around the boss lately? You: Wants a favor. Friend: Is he buttering the boss up? You: Yeah, bringing tea and water. Friend: Does this work? You: Depends if the boss falls for it.

button bashing.context: 你说玩那种街机格斗游戏，根本不靠技术，全靠疯狂按按键，乱拳打死老师傅。
button bashing.translation: 朋友：那格斗游戏咋玩 你：一顿乱按就行 朋友：是在狂按按键吗 你：对啊，技术不重要 朋友：这样能赢吗 你：对，对手都被按懵
button bashing.example: Friend: How to play that fighting game? You: Just mash buttons. Friend: Is this button bashing? You: Yeah, skill doesn't matter. Friend: Can you win this way? You: Yes, opponent gets dazed.

buy into.context: 你说团队里有些人根本不信这套改革，说他们不认同新理念，再好的制度也白搭。
buy into.translation: 朋友：大家支持改革吗 你：有人根本不信 朋友：是不认同新理念吗 你：对啊，怎么推都不动 朋友：那咋办 你：先说服核心的人
buy into.example: Friend: Does everyone support the reform? You: Some simply don't believe it. Friend: Do they not buy into it? You: Yeah, no matter how you push. Friend: Then what? You: Convince the core first.

buy one get one free.context: 你说那家超市在搞买一送一，说这种不买白不买，赶紧拎两袋回来。
buy one get one free.translation: 朋友：你咋拎两袋回来 你：超市在买一送一 朋友：是那种买一送一吗 你：对啊，不买白不买 朋友：啥东西这么划算 你：洗衣液
buy one get one free.example: Friend: Why did you carry two bags back? You: The supermarket is buy one get one free. Friend: Is it buy one get one free? You: Yeah, free stuff can't miss. Friend: What's such a deal? You: Laundry liquid.

buy up.context: 你说那家开发商把周围的地全买下来了，说这样整片区域都归它开发。
buy up.translation: 朋友：那片地归谁了 你：被一家开发商全买了 朋友：是被全部收购了吗 你：对啊，整片归它 朋友：以后干啥用 你：建商场和住宅
buy up.example: Friend: Who owns that area? You: Bought up by one developer. Friend: Did they buy it all up? You: Yeah, the whole area is theirs. Friend: Then what for? You: Mall and housing.

buzz around.context: 你说这一上午接了十个电话，整个人忙得团团转，连口水都顾不上喝。
buzz around.translation: 朋友：你这一上午跑哪了 你：接了十个电话 朋友：是忙得团团转吗 你：对啊，水都没喝 朋友：你歇歇吧 你：好，喝口水
buzz around.example: Friend: Where have you been all morning? You: Took ten calls. Friend: Are you buzzing around? You: Yeah, haven't even drunk water. Friend: Take a break. You: Good, have a sip.

by all mean.context: 你说朋友搬家你一定得去帮忙，说这种大事务必到场，不然不够意思。
by all mean.translation: 朋友：我周末搬家你来不 你：一定来帮忙 朋友：是务必到场吗 你：对啊，这种大事 朋友：那我等你来 你：好，早上去
by all mean.example: Friend: Will you come when I move this weekend? You: Definitely come help. Friend: Must you by all means come? You: Yeah, this is a big deal. Friend: Then I'll wait for you. You: Good, morning.

by and large.context: 你说总体来看这一年虽然忙，但收获也不少，说总体上还是值得的。
by and large.translation: 朋友：这一年过得咋样 你：总体还不错 朋友：是大体上还行吗 你：对啊，忙但有收获 朋友：你满意不 你：对，满意
by and large.example: Friend: How was this year? You: By and large not bad. Friend: Is it by and large okay? You: Yeah, busy but gained. Friend: Are you satisfied? You: Yes, satisfied.

by any stretch.context: 你说他再怎么说也不可能是冠军，说无论如何都差得远，想都别想。
by any stretch.translation: 朋友：他能拿冠军不 你：怎么说也不可能 朋友：是无论如何不行吗 你：对啊，差得远 朋友：他还挺自信 你：自信过头了
by any stretch.example: Friend: Can he win the championship? You: Impossible by any stretch. Friend: Is it by any stretch no? You: Yeah, far off. Friend: He's quite confident. You: Overconfident.

by contrast.context: 你说别人家孩子放假都在玩，相比之下你家那位却天天上补习班，真是辛苦。
by contrast.translation: 朋友：你家孩子放假干啥 你：天天上补习班 朋友：是相比之下更累吗 你：对啊，别家都在玩 朋友：孩子愿意吗 你：不太愿意
by contrast.example: Friend: What does your kid do on holiday? You: Tutoring every day. Friend: Is it by contrast more tiring? You: Yeah, others are playing. Friend: Is the kid willing? You: Not really.

by default.context: 你说电脑重启之后，那些设置就回到了默认状态，说这跟没改过一样。
by default.translation: 朋友：你改的设置咋没了 你：重启回到默认了 朋友：是默认设置吗 你：对啊，跟没改一样 朋友：那你得重改 你：好，再调一遍
by default.example: Friend: Why are your settings gone? You: Reset to default after reboot. Friend: Is it by default? You: Yeah, as if unchanged. Friend: Then you must redo it. You: Good, adjust again.

by leaps and bounds.context: 你说这两年电商发展飞速，说跟几年前比，简直是一步登天，变化大得吓人。
by leaps and bounds.translation: 朋友：这两年电商变化大不 你：发展得飞快 朋友：是飞速发展吗 你：对啊，几年一个样 朋友：你跟上节奏没 你：对，慢慢学
by leaps and bounds.example: Friend: Has e-commerce changed a lot these two years? You: Growing by leaps and bounds. Friend: Is it growing by leaps and bounds? You: Yeah, different every few years. Friend: Are you keeping up? You: Yes, learning slowly.

by no mean.context: 你说他绝不是那种会食言的人，说他答应的事，就一定会办到。
by no mean.translation: 朋友：他说话算数吗 你：绝对算数 朋友：是绝不食言吗 你：对啊，答应就办到 朋友：你这么信他 你：对，十年朋友
by no mean.example: Friend: Does he keep his word? You: Definitely. Friend: Is he by no means someone who breaks promises? You: Yeah, a promise is kept. Friend: You trust him so much? You: Yes, ten years of friendship.

by one's sides.context: 你说紧张的时候，有个好朋友站在身旁，心里立马就踏实多了。
by one's sides.translation: 朋友：你紧张时咋调节 你：让朋友站我旁边 朋友：是在身旁陪着吗 你：对啊，心里就踏实 朋友：你朋友真靠谱 你：对，一直陪着
by one's sides.example: Friend: How do you calm down when nervous? You: Let a friend stand by my side. Friend: Are they by your side? You: Yeah, heart settles. Friend: Your friend is reliable. You: Yes, always there.

cabin pressure.context: 你说飞机升到高空，耳朵会发胀，说这是机舱气压变化造成的，咽咽口水就好。
cabin pressure.translation: 朋友：你坐飞机耳朵咋老响 你：气压变化 朋友：是机舱气压变了吗 你：对啊，耳朵发胀 朋友：咋缓解 你：咽口水
cabin pressure.example: Friend: Why do your ears ring on planes? You: Pressure changes. Friend: Is it cabin pressure? You: Yeah, ears feel stuffed. Friend: How to relieve? You: Swallow.

caffeine hit.context: 你说早上不来一杯黑咖啡，整个人都提不起神，说这口咖啡因一到，脑子才开机。
caffeine hit.translation: 朋友：你早上必喝咖啡啊 你：不来一杯没精神 朋友：是靠咖啡因提神吗 你：对啊，喝了才清醒 朋友：你一天几杯 你：两杯
caffeine hit.example: Friend: Must you have coffee in the morning? You: No cup, no energy. Friend: Is it a caffeine hit? You: Yeah, awake only after. Friend: How many cups a day? You: Two.

call into question.context: 你说那份报告的数据对不上，大家都开始质疑它的可信度，说结果得重新核实。
call into question.translation: 朋友：那报告咋了 你：数据对不上 朋友：大家是在质疑它吗 你：对啊，可信度存疑 朋友：那咋办 你：重新核实
call into question.example: Friend: What's wrong with that report? You: Data doesn't match. Friend: Are people calling it into question? You: Yeah, credibility doubtful. Friend: Then what? You: Recheck.

call it a day.context: 你说跟那个人处了半年，实在合不来，说干脆到此为止，好聚好散。
call it a day.translation: 朋友：你俩咋分了 你：实在合不来 朋友：是结束这段关系吗 你：对啊，好聚好散 朋友：你难受不 你：刚开始，现在好了
call it a day.example: Friend: Why did you two split? You: Really incompatible. Friend: Did you call it a day? You: Yeah, part in peace. Friend: Are you hurt? You: At first, now fine.

call of nature.context: 你说开车跑长途，半路忽然内急，说这是大自然在召唤，得赶紧找服务区。
call of nature.translation: 朋友：你咋急着找地方 你：路上内急了 朋友：是要上厕所吗 你：对啊，憋不住 朋友：前面有服务区 你：好，加速开
call of nature.example: Friend: Why are you rushing to find a place? You: Got the call of nature on the road. Friend: Is it the call of nature? You: Yeah, can't hold. Friend: There's a service area ahead. You: Good, speed up.

call out.context: 你说看到有人在网上造谣，就公开站出来指责他，说这种事不能装没看见。
call out.translation: 朋友：你咋跟人吵起来了 你：他在网上造谣 朋友：是你公开指责他吗 你：对啊，不能装没看见 朋友：这样不招事吗 你：对，但该说
call out.example: Friend: Why did you argue with him? You: He was spreading rumors online. Friend: Did you call him out? You: Yeah, can't pretend not to see. Friend: Doesn't this cause trouble? You: Yes, but must say.

call upon.context: 你说遇到拿不准的事，就去请教那些老法师，说他们经验多，值得登门拜访。
call upon.translation: 朋友：你拿不定主意咋办 你：去请教老前辈 朋友：是去拜访他们吗 你：对啊，经验多 朋友：人家愿意见你吗 你：对，聊得挺好
call upon.example: Friend: What do you do when unsure? You: Consult the veterans. Friend: Do you call upon them? You: Yeah, they have more experience. Friend: Are they willing to see you? You: Yes, chat well.

caloric value.context: 你说减肥时得看食物包装上的热量值，说这数字一高，就知道这东西不能多吃。
caloric value.translation: 朋友：你买东西先看啥 你：看热量值 朋友：是看热量多少吗 你：对啊，高了就不买 朋友：你这习惯好 你：对，管得住嘴
caloric value.example: Friend: What do you check first when buying? You: The caloric value. Friend: Do you look at the caloric value? You: Yeah, high and won't buy. Friend: Good habit. You: Yes, control the mouth.

calorie burn.context: 你说跑步半小时的热量消耗，比你吃一块蛋糕还少，说这点运动量根本不够。
calorie burn.translation: 朋友：你跑半小时能烧多少 你：比一块蛋糕还少 朋友：是热量消耗少吗 你：对啊，不够 朋友：那你得跑久点 你：好，加到一小时
calorie burn.example: Friend: How much do you burn running half an hour? You: Less than one cake. Friend: Is the calorie burn low? You: Yeah, not enough. Friend: Then run longer. You: Good, add an hour.

calorie count.context: 你说减脂期每天都得算着卡路里吃，说这数字高的东西，再好也只能咽口水。
calorie count.translation: 朋友：你减脂期吃啥 你：算着热量吃 朋友：是看卡路里含量吗 你：对啊，高了不碰 朋友：你饿不饿 你：习惯了
calorie count.example: Friend: What do you eat on a fat loss diet? You: Eat by the calorie count. Friend: Do you watch the calorie count? You: Yeah, high and won't touch. Friend: Are you hungry? You: Used to it.

calorie overload.context: 你说一顿火锅加奶茶再加甜点，热量一下就爆表，说这种吃法不上胖才怪。
calorie overload.translation: 朋友：你今晚吃了啥 你：火锅奶茶加甜点 朋友：是热量超载了吗 你：对啊，一下爆表 朋友：你不内疚吗 你：明天再减
calorie overload.example: Friend: What did you eat tonight? You: Hotpot, milk tea, dessert. Friend: Is it calorie overload? You: Yeah, blew up at once. Friend: Don't you feel guilty? You: Diet tomorrow.

calories served.context: 你说那套餐盘上标着每份多少大卡，说吃之前先看一眼，心里有数。
calories served.translation: 朋友：那餐盘上写的啥 你：每份的热量 朋友：是提供的卡路里吗 你：对啊，多少大卡 朋友：你看了有用吗 你：对，控制食量
calories served.example: Friend: What's written on that plate? You: The calories per serving. Friend: Is it the calories served? You: Yeah, how many kcal. Friend: Is it useful to see? You: Yes, control portions.

came into force.context: 你说那个新法规从今年一月起正式生效，说现在再这么干就是违法了。
came into force.translation: 朋友：那个新规咋样了 你：今年一月起生效 朋友：是开始施行吗 你：对啊，再干就违法 朋友：大家都知道吗 你：对，得通知
came into force.example: Friend: What about that new rule? You: Came into force this January. Friend: Did it come into force? You: Yeah, doing it again is illegal. Friend: Does everyone know? You: Yes, must notify.

camera obscura.context: 你说最早的照相机其实就是个暗箱，说光线通过小孔进去，在里面成像。
camera obscura.translation: 朋友：最早的相机啥样 你：就是个暗箱 朋友：是那种暗箱吗 你：对啊，小孔成像 朋友：你见过没 你：对，博物馆里有
camera obscura.example: Friend: What was the earliest camera like? You: Just a camera obscura. Friend: Is it the camera obscura? You: Yeah, pinhole imaging. Friend: Have you seen one? You: Yes, in the museum.

camera roll.context: 你说手机相册里存了几千张照片，说翻都翻不过来，得定期清理一下。
camera roll.translation: 朋友：你手机咋这么卡 你：相册存了几千张 朋友：是相机胶卷满了吗 你：对啊，翻不过来 朋友：那你清一清 你：好，删一批
camera roll.example: Friend: Why is your phone so laggy? You: Thousands of photos in the album. Friend: Is your camera roll full? You: Yeah, can't scroll. Friend: Then clean it. You: Good, delete a batch.

camp out.context: 你说为了抢演唱会门票，有人通宵在门口搭帐篷排队，说这种熬夜等票的事，年轻人真拼。
camp out.translation: 朋友：那演唱会票难抢不 你：有人通宵排队 朋友：是在门口熬夜等吗 你：对啊，搭帐篷 朋友：你干过没 你：没有，太拼
camp out.example: Friend: Are those concert tickets hard to get? You: Some queue overnight. Friend: Are they camping out? You: Yeah, pitching tents. Friend: Have you done this? You: No, too hardcore.

camping expedition.context: 你说国庆跟朋友开车去山里露营，说这种短途露营旅行，比在城里宅着有意思多了。
camping expedition.translation: 朋友：国庆你去哪玩 你：开车去山里露营 朋友：是露营短途旅行吗 你：对啊，比城里有意思 朋友：你带啥了 你：帐篷睡袋
camping expedition.example: Friend: Where did you go on National Day? You: Drove to the mountains to camp. Friend: Is it a camping expedition? You: Yeah, more fun than the city. Friend: What did you bring? You: Tent and sleeping bag.

camping gear.context: 你说一到露营，就得把帐篷、睡袋、炉子这些装备全备齐，说少一样都不方便。
camping gear.translation: 朋友：你露营带啥 你：帐篷睡袋炉子 朋友：是一整套露营装备吗 你：对啊，少一样不行 朋友：你这一套贵不 你：对，攒了几年
camping gear.example: Friend: What do you bring for camping? You: Tent, sleeping bag, stove. Friend: Is it a full set of camping gear? You: Yeah, missing one is bad. Friend: Is this set expensive? You: Yes, gathered over years.

camping site.context: 你说去郊外找了个有草地、有水源的地方扎营，说这种露营地最舒服，还便宜。
camping site.translation: 朋友：你露营选在哪 你：有草地有水源的地方 朋友：是那种露营区吗 你：对啊，舒服又便宜 朋友：收门票不 你：对，收一点
camping site.example: Friend: Where did you pick to camp? You: A place with grass and water. Friend: Is it a camping site? You: Yeah, comfy and cheap. Friend: Do they charge entry? You: Yes, a little.

campus life.context: 你说大学那几年，上课、社团、食堂来回跑，说这种校园生活现在想起来特别怀念。
campus life.translation: 朋友：你大学咋过的 你：上课社团食堂 朋友：是校园生活吗 你：对啊，天天跑 朋友：你怀念不 你：对，特别怀念
campus life.example: Friend: How did you spend college? You: Classes, clubs, cafeteria. Friend: Is it campus life? You: Yeah, running every day. Friend: Do you miss it? You: Yes, really miss it.

cancel out.context: 你说加班多拿的钱，全被看病吃药抵消了，说这种买卖真是得不偿失。
cancel out.translation: 朋友：你加班赚的钱咋又花了 你：全看病吃药了 朋友：是被抵消了吗 你：对啊，白忙 朋友：你后悔不 你：对，身体要紧
cancel out.example: Friend: Why did the overtime pay get spent again? You: All on doctor and medicine. Friend: Did it cancel out? You: Yeah, worked for nothing. Friend: Do you regret it? You: Yes, health matters.

candidate profile.context: 你说 HR 筛简历，先看那个求职者画像，说不符合的直接就pass，根本不面试。
candidate profile.translation: 朋友：你们咋筛人 你：先看求职者画像 朋友：是看简历吗 你：对啊，不符合直接pass 朋友：看重啥 你：经验和学历
candidate profile.example: Friend: How do you screen candidates? You: First look at the candidate profile. Friend: Do you look at the candidate profile? You: Yeah, no fit and pass. Friend: What do you value? You: Experience and degree.

candidate reaction.context: 你说面试时不光看你答得对不对，更看你遇到突发情况时的临场反应，说这才是真本事。
candidate reaction.translation: 朋友：面试考啥 你：不光看答案 朋友：还看临场反应吗 你：对啊，突发情况 朋友：你紧张不 你：紧张，但硬撑
candidate reaction.example: Friend: What does the interview test? You: Not just the answer. Friend: Also candidate reaction? You: Yeah, unexpected situations. Friend: Are you nervous? You: Yes, but hold on.

cap visitor numbers.context: 你说那个公园人太多，周末只好限流，说把入园人数卡住，不然太挤了。
cap visitor numbers.translation: 朋友：那周末公园人多不 你：多到开始限流 朋友：是限制入园人数吗 你：对啊，不然太挤 朋友：你能进去吗 你：对，早上去
cap visitor numbers.example: Friend: Is the park crowded on weekends? You: So crowded they cap visitors. Friend: Do they cap visitor numbers? You: Yeah, or too packed. Friend: Can you get in? You: Yes, go in the morning.

capable of.context: 你说他这人完全有能力独自扛下这个项目，说交给他，不用太担心。
capable of.translation: 朋友：这项目交给谁 你：交给他就行 朋友：他有能力做吗 你：对啊，能扛下来 朋友：你放心不 你：对，放心
capable of.example: Friend: Who do we give this project to? You: Just give it to him. Friend: Is he capable of it? You: Yeah, can handle it. Friend: Are you reassured? You: Yes, reassured.

capital city.context: 你说去一个国家旅游，总得先去它的首都看看，说那里最能代表这个国家。
capital city.translation: 朋友：去国外先看啥 你：先逛首都 朋友：是那个首都吗 你：对啊，最有代表性 朋友：你去过几个首都 你：五六个
capital city.example: Friend: What do you see first abroad? You: Visit the capital city first. Friend: Is it the capital city? You: Yeah, most representative. Friend: How many capitals have you been to? You: Five or six.

capsule wardrobe.context: 你说现在流行那种精简衣橱，说衣服不用多，几件经典款搭来搭去就够穿。
capsule wardrobe.translation: 朋友：你衣服咋这么少 你：在搞精简衣橱 朋友：是那种胶囊衣橱吗 你：对啊，经典款百搭 朋友：你不嫌少吗 你：对，省得选
capsule wardrobe.example: Friend: Why do you have so few clothes? You: Doing a capsule wardrobe. Friend: Is it a capsule wardrobe? You: Yeah, classic pieces go with anything. Friend: Don't you feel it's few? You: Yes, saves choosing.

captive breeding.context: 你说有些珍稀动物在野外快灭绝了，只能靠人工繁育来保命，说这是无奈之举。
captive breeding.translation: 朋友：那些珍稀动物咋保命 你：靠人工繁育 朋友：是那种人工繁育吗 你：对啊，野外快没了 朋友：这样管用吗 你：对，先保住
captive breeding.example: Friend: How do rare animals survive? You: Through captive breeding. Friend: Is it captive breeding? You: Yeah, almost gone in the wild. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, preserve first.

capture the imagination of.context: 你说那个童话故事一下抓住了孩子们的想象力，说他们听完都想着自己也能飞。
capture the imagination of.translation: 朋友：那孩子咋老幻想 你：被一个童话迷住了 朋友：是吸引了他们想象吗 你：对啊，老想着飞 朋友：这故事好吗 你：对，特别有想象力
capture the imagination of.example: Friend: Why does that child keep fantasizing? You: Captivated by a fairy tale. Friend: Did it capture the imagination of kids? You: Yeah, always wanting to fly. Friend: Is the story good? You: Yes, very imaginative.

carbon dioxide emission.context: 你说工厂那些大烟囱，每天都在往外排二氧化碳，说这种排放是全球变暖的主因之一。
carbon dioxide emission.translation: 朋友：那些大烟囱排啥 你：排二氧化碳 朋友：是二氧化碳排放吗 你：对啊，天天排 朋友：这对天气影响大不 你：对，全球变暖
carbon dioxide emission.example: Friend: What do those big chimneys emit? You: Carbon dioxide. Friend: Is it carbon dioxide emission? You: Yeah, daily. Friend: Does it affect the weather a lot? You: Yes, global warming.

carbon emission.context: 你说现在出门开车都讲究低碳，说少排一点碳，就是给地球帮一点忙。
carbon emission.translation: 朋友：你咋改骑车了 你：少排点碳 朋友：是在减碳排放吗 你：对啊，能少就少 朋友：这样管用吗 你：对，积少成多
carbon emission.example: Friend: Why switch to cycling? You: Cut carbon emission a bit. Friend: Are you cutting carbon emission? You: Yeah, less if possible. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, small amounts add up.

carbon footprint.context: 你说人每天开车、坐飞机、用电，加起来就是自己的碳足迹，说这数字越大，对地球负担越重。
carbon footprint.translation: 朋友：啥叫碳足迹 你：你日常排的碳 朋友：是你的碳足迹吗 你：对啊，排多负担重 朋友：你咋减 你：少开车多走路
carbon footprint.example: Friend: What's a carbon footprint? You: The carbon you emit daily. Friend: Is it your carbon footprint? You: Yeah, more emission, heavier burden. Friend: How do you reduce it? You: Less driving, more walking.

carbon neutral.context: 你说那家公司宣布要在十年内实现碳中和，说排多少碳，就种多少树把它补回来。
carbon neutral.translation: 朋友：那公司说要干啥 你：十年内碳中和 朋友：是实现碳中和吗 你：对啊，排多少补多少 朋友：这目标大不 你：对，挺有魄力
carbon neutral.example: Friend: What did that company announce? You: Carbon neutral in ten years. Friend: Will it become carbon neutral? You: Yeah, offset what it emits. Friend: Is the goal big? You: Yes, ambitious.

carbon offset.context: 你说坐飞机没法不排碳，那就花钱买碳抵消，说捐给种树项目，就算把账平了。
carbon offset.translation: 朋友：你坐飞机咋补碳 你：花钱买碳抵消 朋友：是买碳抵消吗 你：对啊，捐给种树 朋友：这样心安不 你：对，算是平衡
carbon offset.example: Friend: How do you offset carbon when flying? You: Pay for carbon offset. Friend: Do you buy carbon offsets? You: Yeah, donate to tree planting. Friend: Does this ease the mind? You: Yes, sort of balanced.

carbon sink.context: 你说森林就是天然的碳汇，说大树一长，就能把空气中的碳吸进去存起来。
carbon sink.translation: 朋友：森林有啥用 你：能吸碳存碳 朋友：是那种碳汇吗 你：对啊，大树吸碳 朋友：那多种树 你：对，最实在
carbon sink.example: Friend: What use are forests? You: Absorb and store carbon. Friend: Is it a carbon sink? You: Yeah, big trees absorb carbon. Friend: Then plant more trees. You: Yes, most practical.

carboniferous period.context: 你说远古有个石炭纪，说那时候的植物埋在地下，亿万年之后就变成了煤。
carboniferous period.translation: 朋友：煤是咋来的 你：远古植物变的 朋友：是那个石炭纪吗 你：对啊，埋了亿万年 朋友：你咋知道 你：看纪录片
carboniferous period.example: Friend: Where does coal come from? You: Ancient plants turned into it. Friend: Is it the carboniferous period? You: Yeah, buried for eons. Friend: How do you know? You: Watched a documentary.

cardiac arrest.context: 你说那人跑步时忽然倒地，说这是心脏骤停，得马上做心肺复苏，一秒都不能等。
cardiac arrest.translation: 朋友：那人咋突然倒地 你：是心脏骤停 朋友：是心脏骤停吗 你：对啊，得马上救 朋友：你会救不 你：对，学过急救
cardiac arrest.example: Friend: Why did that person suddenly collapse? You: It's cardiac arrest. Friend: Is it cardiac arrest? You: Yeah, must save at once. Friend: Can you save them? You: Yes, learned first aid.

cardio exercise.context: 你说想瘦得靠有氧运动，说那种跑跑跳跳三十分钟以上，才真正开始燃脂。
cardio exercise.translation: 朋友：你想咋瘦 你：靠有氧 朋友：是有氧运动吗 你：对啊，跑跳半小时 朋友：累不累 你：对，累但有效
cardio exercise.example: Friend: How do you want to slim? You: Through cardio exercise. Friend: Is it cardio exercise? You: Yeah, run and jump half hour. Friend: Is it tiring? You: Yes, tiring but effective.

cardio exercises.context: 你说每周固定做三次有氧，说跑步、跳绳、骑车换着来，这样不枯燥。
cardio exercises.translation: 朋友：你每周练啥 你：三次有氧 朋友：是有氧运动吗 你：对啊，换着来 朋友：你坚持多久了 你：小半年
cardio exercises.example: Friend: What do you train weekly? You: Three sessions of cardio. Friend: Are these cardio exercises? You: Yeah, switch them up. Friend: How long have you kept it? You: Half a year.

cardiovascular disease.context: 你说上了年纪最怕心血管疾病，说这种病一旦发作，后果往往很严重。
cardiovascular disease.translation: 朋友：老人最怕啥病 你：心血管方面的 朋友：是心血管疾病吗 你：对啊，发作很危险 朋友：咋预防 你：少油多运动
cardiovascular disease.example: Friend: What disease do old people fear most? You: Cardiovascular ones. Friend: Is it cardiovascular disease? You: Yeah, dangerous if it hits. Friend: How to prevent? You: Less oil, more exercise.

cardiovascular diseases.context: 你说现在心血管疾病越来越年轻化，说三十出头的人也开始得，全是熬夜吃出来的。
cardiovascular diseases.translation: 朋友：现在心血管病咋年轻了 你：三十出头就有 朋友：是那些心血管疾病吗 你：对啊，熬夜吃出来的 朋友：那得注意 你：对，早点养
cardiovascular diseases.example: Friend: Why are cardiovascular diseases getting younger? You: Thirties already have them. Friend: Are they cardiovascular diseases? You: Yeah, from late nights and diet. Friend: Then must watch out. You: Yes, maintain early.

cardiovascular exercise.context: 你说想护心就得靠有氧运动，说那种让心跳加快的运动，每周三次最见效。
cardiovascular exercise.translation: 朋友：你咋老跑步 你：想护心 朋友：是在做有氧运动吗 你：对啊，每周三次 朋友：这样心脏好吗 你：对，医生建议的
cardiovascular exercise.example: Friend: Why do you always run? You: Want to protect my heart. Friend: Is it cardiovascular exercise? You: Yeah, three times a week. Friend: Is this good for the heart? You: Yes, doctor recommended.

cardiovascular fitness.context: 你说体测时医生夸你心血管好，说这都是常年跑步跑出来的结果。
cardiovascular fitness.translation: 朋友：你体测结果咋样 你：医生说我心血管好 朋友：是心血管健康吗 你：对啊，常年跑的 朋友：你坚持多久了 你：五六年
cardiovascular fitness.example: Friend: How was your fitness test? You: Doctor says my heart and vessels are good. Friend: Is it cardiovascular fitness? You: Yeah, from years of running. Friend: How long have you kept it? You: Five or six years.

cardiovascular health.context: 你说上了年纪，得定期查心血管健康，说这种事防胜于治。
cardiovascular health.translation: 朋友：你爸妈身体咋样 你：定期查心血管 朋友：是查心血管健康吗 你：对啊，防胜于治 朋友：查出问题没 你：对，都还好
cardiovascular health.example: Friend: How are your parents? You: Regularly check cardiovascular health. Friend: Is it cardiovascular health? You: Yeah, prevention over cure. Friend: Any problems found? You: Yes, all fine.

cardiovascular problems.context: 你说他这两年老觉得胸闷、头晕，医生说这是心血管出了问题，得好好查。
cardiovascular problems.translation: 朋友：他最近身体咋了 你：老胸闷头晕 朋友：是心血管问题吗 你：对啊，得好好查 朋友：严重不 你：对，得住院
cardiovascular problems.example: Friend: What's wrong with him lately? You: Always chest tight and dizzy. Friend: Are these cardiovascular problems? You: Yeah, must check well. Friend: Is it serious? You: Yes, must stay in hospital.

care home.context: 你说爷爷奶奶年纪大了行动不便，子女又没空照顾，只好送去养老院，说那里有人照看。
care home.translation: 朋友：你爷爷谁照顾 你：送去养老院了 朋友：是那种养老院吗 你：对啊，有人照看 朋友：你常去看不 你：对，周末去
care home.example: Friend: Who takes care of your grandfather? You: Sent to a care home. Friend: Is it a care home? You: Yeah, staffed care. Friend: Do you visit often? You: Yes, weekends.

career aspiration.context: 你说你当年的职业理想是当一名老师，说现在虽然没当成，但教英语也算是绕回来了。
career aspiration.translation: 朋友：你当年想干啥 你：想当老师 朋友：是职业理想吗 你：对啊，现在教英语 朋友：你满意不 你：对，也算圆了
career aspiration.example: Friend: What did you want to do back then? You: Be a teacher. Friend: Is it your career aspiration? You: Yeah, now teaching English. Friend: Are you satisfied? You: Yes, sort of fulfilled.

career counsellor.context: 你说毕业前不知道干啥，就去找了职业规划师，说他帮你把方向理清了。
career counsellor.translation: 朋友：你毕业咋选的方向 你：找了职业规划师 朋友：是职业规划师吗 你：对啊，帮我理方向 朋友：他说得准不 你：对，挺准
career counsellor.example: Friend: How did you pick your direction after graduation? You: Saw a career counsellor. Friend: Is it a career counsellor? You: Yeah, helped sort the direction. Friend: Was he accurate? You: Yes, quite accurate.

career event.context: 你说学校开招聘会那天，你跑了一圈递了二十份简历，说这种机会不抓住就没了。
career event.translation: 朋友：你上周忙啥 你：去了招聘会 朋友：是那种招聘会吗 你：对啊，递了二十份简历 朋友：有回音没 你：对，两个面试
career event.example: Friend: What were you busy with last week? You: Went to a career event. Friend: Is it a career event? You: Yeah, handed out twenty resumes. Friend: Any response? You: Yes, two interviews.

career ladder.context: 你说想在公司里往上爬，就得一步步沿着晋升阶梯走，说急不得，先把活干好。
career ladder.translation: 朋友：你想升职不 你：想，一步步爬 朋友：是沿着晋升阶梯吗 你：对啊，急不得 朋友：你现在到哪一级了 你：对，刚升一级
career ladder.example: Friend: Do you want a promotion? You: Yes, climb step by step. Friend: Is it up the career ladder? You: Yeah, can't rush. Friend: What level are you at now? You: Yes, just got one.

career move.context: 你说从大公司跳到小创业公司，是一次职业上的大变动，说赌对了就是海阔天空。
career move.translation: 朋友：你咋从大公司跳了 你：去小创业公司 朋友：是职业上的大变动吗 你：对啊，赌一把 朋友：你怕不怕 你：对，有点，但想试
career move.example: Friend: Why did you leave the big company? You: Went to a small startup. Friend: Is it a big career move? You: Yeah, taking a gamble. Friend: Aren't you afraid? You: Yes, a bit, but want to try.

career option.context: 你说刚毕业时面前摆着好几种职业选择，说选哪条路，决定了后来十年的方向。
career option.translation: 朋友：你毕业时咋选的 你：面前几条路 朋友：是职业选择吗 你：对啊，定了十年方向 朋友：你选对了吗 你：对，还行
career option.example: Friend: How did you choose at graduation? You: Several paths ahead. Friend: Is it a career option? You: Yeah, set ten years of direction. Friend: Did you choose right? You: Yes, okay.

career path.context: 你说自己的职业道路走得不算顺，说换了三行才找到现在这行，说弯路也是路。
career path.translation: 朋友：你工作咋换这么多 你：走了点弯路 朋友：是职业道路吗 你：对啊，换了三行 朋友：现在定下来没 你：对，这行定了
career path.example: Friend: Why did you change jobs so much? You: Took some detours. Friend: Is it your career path? You: Yeah, switched three fields. Friend: Have you settled now? You: Yes, settled in this field.

career priorities.context: 你说现在换工作，最看重的不是钱多钱少，而是能不能顾家，说这是你的职业优先事项。
career priorities.translation: 朋友：你换工作最看重啥 你：能不能顾家 朋友：是职业优先事项吗 你：对啊，钱其次 朋友：你这样老板要不 你：对，遇到了
career priorities.example: Friend: What do you value most when changing jobs? You: Whether it lets you care for family. Friend: Are these career priorities? You: Yeah, money second. Friend: Do bosses accept this? You: Yes, found one.

career prospects.context: 你说他选的这一行，未来的职业前景特别好，说人才缺口大，不愁找不到工作。
career prospects.translation: 朋友：他选的这行咋样 你：前景特别好 朋友：是职业前景好吗 你：对啊，缺人 朋友：他毕业好找工作不 你：对，抢着要
career prospects.example: Friend: How's the field he picked? You: Career prospects very good. Friend: Are career prospects good? You: Yeah, talent shortage. Friend: Will he find a job after graduation? You: Yes, fought over.

career success.context: 你说他靠一股劲从基层干到总监，说这种职业成功不是靠运气，是熬出来的。
career success.translation: 朋友：他咋升到总监的 你：熬出来的 朋友：是职业成功吗 你：对啊，从基层干 朋友：你羡慕不 你：对，佩服
career success.example: Friend: How did he rise to director? You: Earned through hard work. Friend: Is this career success? You: Yeah, from the bottom. Friend: Do you envy him? You: Yes, admire.

career suicide.context: 你说他在关键时候辞了那份稳定工作，说这种举动在别人眼里简直是自毁前程。
career suicide.translation: 朋友：他咋把稳工作辞了 你：别人都骂他傻 朋友：是自毁前程吗 你：对啊，别人不理解 朋友：他后悔不 你：对，不后悔
career suicide.example: Friend: Why did he quit the stable job? You: Everyone calls him stupid. Friend: Is it career suicide? You: Yeah, others don't understand. Friend: Does he regret it? You: Yes, no regret.

careers events.context: 你说今年学校连着办了好几场招聘会，说不同行业都来，机会比往年多。
careers events.translation: 朋友：今年学校招聘会多不 你：连着办了好几场 朋友：是那种招聘会吗 你：对啊，行业都来 朋友：你投了没 你：对，投了几家
careers events.example: Friend: Are there many career fairs at school this year? You: Several in a row. Friend: Are they careers events? You: Yeah, industries all come. Friend: Did you apply? You: Yes, to a few.

careful thought.context: 你说那个决定你得好好想想，说这种事不能拍脑袋，得经过深思熟虑再开口。
careful thought.translation: 朋友：你想好咋回了没 你：还得仔细想想 朋友：是得深思熟虑吗 你：对啊，不能拍脑袋 朋友：你想几天了 你：对，三天
careful thought.example: Friend: Have you decided how to reply? You: Still need careful thought. Friend: Is it a careful thought? You: Yeah, can't decide on impulse. Friend: How many days have you thought? You: Yes, three.

careful with.context: 你说那个瓷器易碎，拿的时候小心点，说这种东西得轻拿轻放，别毛手毛脚。
careful with.translation: 朋友：这盘子咋拿 你：小心点，易碎 朋友：是要小心吗 你：对啊，轻拿轻放 朋友：我知道了 你：对，别摔了
careful with.example: Friend: How do I carry this plate? You: Careful, fragile. Friend: Are you being careful with it? You: Yeah, handle gently. Friend: Got it. You: Yes, don't drop it.

cargo bike.context: 你说现在欧洲流行那种带大货斗的自行车，说拉孩子、拉菜都靠它，比开车方便。
cargo bike.translation: 朋友：你骑那车咋带大箱子 你：是货运自行车 朋友：是那种货运自行车吗 你：对啊，拉啥都行 朋友：比开车方便吗 你：对，停车不犯愁
cargo bike.example: Friend: How do you carry big boxes on that bike? You: It's a cargo bike. Friend: Is it a cargo bike? You: Yeah, haul anything. Friend: More convenient than driving? You: Yes, parking is easy.

carried out.context: 你说那个项目按计划执行完了，说每个环节都照当初定的做，一点没走样。
carried out.translation: 朋友：那项目做完没 你：按计划执行完了 朋友：是按计划做的吗 你：对啊，没走样 朋友：领导满意不 你：对，挺满意
carried out.example: Friend: Is that project done? You: Carried out as planned. Friend: Was it carried out as planned? You: Yeah, no deviation. Friend: Is the boss satisfied? You: Yes, quite satisfied.

carried over.context: 你说这个约定不能今年就算完，得延续到明年，说大家都希望它接着办下去。
carried over.translation: 朋友：这活动今年办完就算了？ 你：得延续到明年 朋友：是延续下去吗 你：对啊，大家盼着 朋友：你牵头不 你：对，继续办
carried over.example: Friend: Is this activity over after this year? You: Must carry over to next year. Friend: Is it carried over? You: Yeah, people look forward to it. Friend: Will you lead it? You: Yes, keep it going.

carried over into.context: 你说上一次的好习惯，一直延续到今天，说有些事一旦养成，就影响到往后的日子。
carried over into.translation: 朋友：你这习惯咋保持这么久 你：从读书时养成 朋友：是延续到现在吗 你：对啊，影响到今天 朋友：你都有啥好习惯 你：对，早起和运动
