carried over into.example: Friend: How have you kept this habit so long? You: Formed back in school. Friend: Has it carried over into today? You: Yeah, affects today. Friend: What good habits do you have? You: Yes, early rise and exercise.

carrier of disease.context: 你说那只蚊子叮过谁，又叮你，说这种虫就是病菌携带者，被叮多了容易生病。
carrier of disease.translation: 朋友：蚊子咋老叮你 你：它是病菌携带者 朋友：是那种病菌携带者吗 你：对啊，叮过病人 朋友：那你得防 你：对，喷花露水
carrier of disease.example: Friend: Why do mosquitoes always bite you? You: They're carriers of disease. Friend: Are they carriers of disease? You: Yeah, bitten sick people. Friend: Then you must protect. You: Yes, spray repellent.

carry around.context: 你说你天天背着这个包，里面装着电脑和水壶，说走哪带哪，习惯了。
carry around.translation: 朋友：你包里老装啥 你：电脑和水壶 朋友：是随身携带吗 你：对啊，走哪带哪 朋友：沉不沉 你：对，习惯了
carry around.example: Friend: What do you always have in your bag? You: Laptop and water bottle. Friend: Do you carry it around? You: Yeah, take it everywhere. Friend: Is it heavy? You: Yes, used to it.

carry through.context: 你说这件事既然开了头，就得坚持到底，说半途而废最可惜，咬咬牙就过去了。
carry through.translation: 朋友：这项目咱还继续吗 你：既然开始就坚持 朋友：是贯彻到底吗 你：对啊，别半途而废 朋友：你撑得住吗 你：对，咬牙上
carry through.example: Friend: Do we keep going with this project? You: Since started, carry through. Friend: Will you carry through? You: Yeah, don't give up halfway. Friend: Can you hold on? You: Yes, grit teeth.

carry with.context: 你说每一份成功背后，都伴随着一堆辛苦，说天下没有白来的好事。
carry with.translation: 朋友：他成功得轻松吗 你：背后伴着辛苦 朋友：是伴随着付出吗 你：对啊，没有白来 朋友：你佩服他不 你：对，佩服
carry with.example: Friend: Was his success easy? You: Accompanied by hard work. Friend: Does it carry with hard work? You: Yeah, nothing comes free. Friend: Do you admire him? You: Yes, admire.

carve out.context: 你说再忙也得挤出点时间陪家人，说时间就像海绵里的水，挤挤总有的。
carve out.translation: 朋友：你咋抽时间陪家人 你：挤一挤就有 朋友：是挤出时间吗 你：对啊，再忙也得有 朋友：你咋做到的 你：对，少刷手机
carve out.example: Friend: How do you make time for family? You: Squeeze it out. Friend: Do you carve out time? You: Yeah, busy or not, must. Friend: How do you do it? You: Yes, less phone scrolling.

carving out.context: 你说他靠自己一步步开创出一番事业，说这不是谁给的，是他一刀一刀刻出来的。
carving out.translation: 朋友：他这事业咋来的 你：自己一步步开创 朋友：是靠自己开拓吗 你：对啊，没人给 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，真本事
carving out.example: Friend: How did he build this business? You: Carved it out step by step. Friend: Is he carving out his own path? You: Yeah, nobody gave it. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, real skill.

cash buffer.context: 你说家里总得留点应急的钱，说这笔现金缓冲，万一遇上急事才不至于抓瞎。
cash buffer.translation: 朋友：你存钱干啥 你：留应急的 朋友：是现金缓冲吗 你：对啊，万一有事 朋友：你留了多少 你：对，三个月工资
cash buffer.example: Friend: What are you saving for? You: An emergency buffer. Friend: Is it a cash buffer? You: Yeah, just in case. Friend: How much have you set aside? You: Yes, three months' salary.

cash flow.context: 你说小店生意再小，也得管好现金流，说钱进出顺畅，店才开得下去。
cash flow.translation: 朋友：你开店最难的是啥 你：管好现金流 朋友：是资金流动吗 你：对啊，钱得转得开 朋友：你管得咋样 你：对，慢慢学
cash flow.example: Friend: What's hardest about running a shop? You: Managing cash flow. Friend: Is it cash flow? You: Yeah, money must turn. Friend: How well do you manage? You: Yes, learning slowly.

cash in.context: 你说那套老房子涨了价，干脆卖掉兑现，说这笔钱正好拿来开新店。
cash in.translation: 朋友：你那老房咋处理 你：涨价了，卖了 朋友：是兑现吗 你：对啊，拿钱开店 朋友：你舍得不 你：对，旧的不去新的不来
cash in.example: Friend: What did you do with that old flat? You: It went up, sold it. Friend: Did you cash it in? You: Yeah, use the money for a new shop. Friend: Aren't you attached? You: Yes, out with the old, in with the new.

cash in hand.context: 你说做生意收账，最希望对方手头有现金，说一手交钱一手交货，最踏实。
cash in hand.translation: 朋友：你收账最盼啥 你：对方手头有现钱 朋友：是手头现金吗 你：对啊，一手交钱 朋友：比赊账踏实吧 你：对，踏实多了
cash in hand.example: Friend: What do you hope for when collecting payment? You: The other side has cash on hand. Friend: Is it cash in hand? You: Yeah, pay on the spot. Friend: More reassuring than credit? You: Yes, much more.

cash in on.context: 你说那商家趁着热点大搞促销，说这种借机赚钱的做法，大家都看在眼里。
cash in on.translation: 朋友：那商家咋这时候打折 你：趁着热点赚钱 朋友：是借机获利吗 你：对啊，借势一把 朋友：这样好吗 你：对，生意人的本事
cash in on.example: Friend: Why is that shop discounting now? You: Making money on the hype. Friend: Are they cashing in on it? You: Yeah, riding the trend. Friend: Is this good? You: Yes, a businessman's skill.

cash up.context: 你说每天关门后都得盘一遍账，说这种结算不能马虎，差一块钱都得对出来。
cash up.translation: 朋友：你每天下班干啥 你：盘账结算 朋友：是结算吗 你：对啊，差一块也得对 朋友：这麻烦不 你：对，习惯了
cash up.example: Friend: What do you do after closing daily? You: Cash up the books. Friend: Do you cash up? You: Yeah, even one yuan off must find. Friend: Is this troublesome? You: Yes, used to it.

cash was king.context: 你说前几年生意场上，大家都认现金，说那时候现金为王，谁手里有现钞谁说话硬。
cash was king.translation: 朋友：前几年生意啥规矩 你：都认现金 朋友：是现金为王吗 你：对啊，有现钞就硬 朋友：现在还这样吗 你：对，不一样了
cash was king.example: Friend: What were the business rules years ago? You: Everyone trusted cash. Friend: Was cash king? You: Yeah, cash on hand means clout. Friend: Is it still like this? You: Yes, different now.

cashless society.context: 你说现在出门买东西，一部手机全搞定，说这种无现金生活，越来越是大势所趋。
cashless society.translation: 朋友：你出门带钱不 你：不带，手机就行 朋友：是无现金社会吗 你：对啊，一部手机走天下 朋友：你习惯不 你：对，方便
cashless society.example: Friend: Do you carry cash when going out? You: No, phone is enough. Friend: Is it a cashless society? You: Yeah, one phone covers all. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, convenient.

cassette tape.context: 你说抽屉里还存着几盘老磁带，说那是学生时代听的歌，现在拿出来还能唱。
cassette tape.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里那是啥 你：几盘老磁带 朋友：是盒式磁带吗 你：对啊，学生时代的 朋友：还能放不 你：对，还能唱
cassette tape.example: Friend: What's that in your drawer? You: A few old cassette tapes. Friend: Are they cassette tapes? You: Yeah, from school days. Friend: Do they still play? You: Yes, still sing.

casual hook-up.context: 你说他最近谈的对象，俩人都没打算认真，说这种随意的短暂关系，谁也别当真。
casual hook-up.translation: 朋友：他新谈的对象咋样 你：俩人都不认真 朋友：是那种短暂约会吗 你：对啊，别当真 朋友：你劝他没 你：对，劝过
casual hook-up.example: Friend: How is his new partner? You: Neither takes it seriously. Friend: Is it a casual hook-up? You: Yeah, don't take it seriously. Friend: Did you advise him? You: Yes, did.

casual player.context: 你说自己玩游戏就是图个乐，说这种休闲玩家，打打输输都不往心里去。
casual player.translation: 朋友：你游戏打得咋样 你：瞎玩，图个乐 朋友：是那种休闲玩家吗 你：对啊，输赢无所谓 朋友：你不较真吗 你：对，玩嘛
casual player.example: Friend: How good are you at games? You: Just play for fun. Friend: Are you a casual player? You: Yeah, win or lose doesn't matter. Friend: Don't you take it seriously? You: Yes, it's just play.

casual wear.context: 你说上班穿西装领带太累，周末出门就换上一身休闲打扮，说舒服最重要。
casual wear.translation: 朋友：你周末穿啥出门 你：一身休闲 朋友：是休闲穿搭吗 你：对啊，舒服最重要 朋友：你不讲究点 你：对，周末放松
casual wear.example: Friend: What do you wear out on weekends? You: A casual outfit. Friend: Is it casual wear? You: Yeah, comfort matters most. Friend: Don't you dress up a bit? You: Yes, weekends to relax.

casual work.context: 你说没找着全职之前，先干点零工，说这种临时工作，好歹能挣点饭钱。
casual work.translation: 朋友：你现在干啥 你：先干点零工 朋友：是临时工作吗 你：对啊，挣点饭钱 朋友：你甘心吗 你：对，先过渡
casual work.example: Friend: What do you do now? You: Do some casual work first. Friend: Is it casual work? You: Yeah, earn some food money. Friend: Are you content? You: Yes, a transition.

catastrophic thinking.context: 你说他一遇到小事就往最坏处想，说这种灾难化思维，把自己吓得不轻。
catastrophic thinking.translation: 朋友：他咋老睡不着 你：一点事就往坏处想 朋友：是灾难化思维吗 你：对啊，把自己吓着 朋友：他得改改不 你：对，得想开
catastrophic thinking.example: Friend: Why can't he sleep? You: Thinks the worst from every little thing. Friend: Is it catastrophic thinking? You: Yeah, scares himself. Friend: Must he change it? You: Yes, must look on the bright side.

catch forty winks.context: 你说中午饭后困得不行，靠在椅子上眯了一小觉，说这十几分钟的小睡，下午就精神了。
catch forty winks.translation: 朋友：你中午咋趴在桌上 你：眯一会儿 朋友：是小睡片刻吗 你：对啊，十几分钟 朋友：下午精神不 你：对，好多了
catch forty winks.example: Friend: Why do you rest your head on the desk at noon? You: Catch forty winks. Friend: Are you catching forty winks? You: Yeah, ten minutes. Friend: Are you alert in the afternoon? You: Yes, much better.

catch in.context: 你说那场暴雨把大家困在半路，进退不得，说这种被困住的滋味真难受。
catch in.translation: 朋友：你昨晚咋回不来 你：被暴雨困住了 朋友：是被暴雨困住吗 你：对啊，进退不得 朋友：你咋办的 你：对，找地方躲了一夜
catch in.example: Friend: Why couldn't you come back last night? You: Caught in the rainstorm. Friend: Were you caught in it? You: Yeah, stuck, can't move. Friend: What did you do? You: Yes, sheltered overnight.

catchy song.context: 你说那首歌听一遍就忘不掉，说这种洗脑的口水歌，走到哪都在放。
catchy song.translation: 朋友：那歌咋老在你脑子里 你：听一遍就忘不掉 朋友：是那种洗脑神曲吗 你：对啊，走到哪都放 朋友：你烦不烦 你：对，有点
catchy song.example: Friend: Why is that song stuck in your head? You: Once heard, can't forget. Friend: Is it a catchy song? You: Yeah, everywhere it plays. Friend: Isn't it annoying? You: Yes, a bit.

catchy title.context: 你说文章想让人点开，就得有个抓眼球的标题，说这种标题起得好，内容再差也有人看。
catchy title.translation: 朋友：你文章咋没人看 你：标题没起好 朋友：是标题不够吸引人吗 你：对啊，得抓眼球 朋友：你改改试试 你：对，改个好标题
catchy title.example: Friend: Why does nobody read your article? You: The title isn't catchy. Friend: Is the title not catchy? You: Yeah, must grab attention. Friend: Try changing it. You: Yes, change to a good title.

catchy tune.context: 你说那首曲子一响，你就跟着哼，说这种朗朗上口的调子，最容易记在心里。
catchy tune.translation: 朋友：你咋老哼那曲子 你：调子太好记了 朋友：是那种抓耳旋律吗 你：对啊，一响就跟着 朋友：你哼几天了 你：对，三天
catchy tune.example: Friend: Why do you keep humming that tune? You: The melody is so memorable. Friend: Is it a catchy tune? You: Yeah, hum along as soon as it plays. Friend: How many days have you hummed it? You: Yes, three.

catered reception.context: 你说那对新人在酒店办酒席，说这种包办的婚宴，省了自己张罗的麻烦。
catered reception.translation: 朋友：他们婚礼咋办的 你：在酒店办酒席 朋友：是婚宴酒席吗 你：对啊，包给酒店 朋友：这样省事不 你：对，省心得多
catered reception.example: Friend: How did they hold the wedding? You: A catered reception at a hotel. Friend: Is it a catered reception? You: Yeah, outsourced to the hotel. Friend: Is this hassle-free? You: Yes, much easier.

caught napping.context: 你说球队这次输得猝不及防，说本来以为稳赢，结果被人打了个措手不及。
caught napping.translation: 朋友：你们队咋输了 你：被打了个措手不及 朋友：是猝不及防吗 你：对啊，以为稳赢 朋友：下次咋改进 你：对，别轻敌
caught napping.example: Friend: Why did your team lose? You: Caught napping. Friend: Were you caught napping? You: Yeah, thought it was a sure win. Friend: How to improve next time? You: Yes, don't underestimate.

caution against.context: 你说医生反复劝你少喝酒，说这种告诫你得听，不然身体迟早出问题。
caution against.translation: 朋友：医生跟你说啥 你：让我少喝酒 朋友：是告诫你不要喝吗 你：对啊，不听不行 朋友：你戒了没 你：对，戒了
caution against.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you? You: To drink less. Friend: Did he caution against drinking? You: Yeah, can't ignore. Friend: Have you quit? You: Yes, quit.

cautions against.context: 你说那篇文章警告大家别信谣言，说这种告诫是为了让大家别被带偏。
cautions against.translation: 朋友：那文章讲啥 你：让大家别信谣言 朋友：是告诫别轻信吗 你：对啊，怕被带偏 朋友：你看了啥感想 你：对，得多核实
cautions against.example: Friend: What is that article about? You: Telling people not to trust rumors. Friend: Does it caution against believing blindly? You: Yeah, fear of being misled. Friend: What do you think after reading? You: Yes, must verify more.

cave in.context: 你说那面老墙年久失修，雨天一淋就塌了一块，说这种坍塌真吓人。
cave in.translation: 朋友：那墙咋塌了一块 你：年久失修 朋友：是坍塌了吗 你：对啊，被雨淋的 朋友：人没事吧 你：对，没人在旁边
cave in.example: Friend: Why did that wall cave in? You: Long unrepaired. Friend: Did it cave in? You: Yeah, from the rain. Friend: Is anyone hurt? You: Yes, nobody nearby.

celebrate uniqueness.context: 你说现在的年轻人不随大流，说欣赏自己的独特，比勉强合群更重要。
celebrate uniqueness.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人咋不随大流 你：他们欣赏自己独特 朋友：是欣赏自身独特吗 你：对啊，不合群也行 朋友：你觉得这样好吗 你：对，挺好
celebrate uniqueness.example: Friend: Why don't young people follow the crowd now? You: They celebrate their uniqueness. Friend: Do they celebrate uniqueness? You: Yeah, it's okay to be different. Friend: Do you think this is good? You: Yes, good.

celebrity chef.context: 你说那家餐厅请到一位明星主厨，说他一来，店里天天排队，名气就是招牌。
celebrity chef.translation: 朋友：那餐厅咋这么火 你：请了位明星厨师 朋友：是明星厨师吗 你：对啊，名气就是招牌 朋友：你吃过没 你：对，吃过
celebrity chef.example: Friend: Why is that restaurant so popular? You: Hired a celebrity chef. Friend: Is it a celebrity chef? You: Yeah, fame is the招牌. Friend: Have you eaten there? You: Yes, have.

celebrity culture.context: 你说现在满屏都是明星八卦，说这种名人文化，把普通人的注意力全吸走了。
celebrity culture.translation: 朋友：网上咋全是明星事 你：名人文化盛行 朋友：是那种名人文化吗 你：对啊，八卦满天飞 朋友：你爱看吗 你：对，偶尔看
celebrity culture.example: Friend: Why is the internet full of celebrity stuff? You: Celebrity culture is everywhere. Friend: Is it celebrity culture? You: Yeah, gossip everywhere. Friend: Do you love reading it? You: Yes, occasionally.

celebrity endorsements.context: 你说那牌子请来明星拍广告，说这种名人代言一上，销量立马就涨。
celebrity endorsements.translation: 朋友：那牌子广告咋请人了 你：找了明星代言 朋友：是名人代言吗 你：对啊，一来就卖 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，粉丝买账
celebrity endorsements.example: Friend: Why does that brand hire people in ads? You: Got celebrity endorsements. Friend: Are they celebrity endorsements? You: Yeah, sells as soon as it's on. Friend: Does this work? You: Yes, fans buy.

celestial body.context: 你说晚上抬头看天，那些月亮、星星都是天体，说这种天文知识特别浪漫。
celestial body.translation: 朋友：晚上你看啥呢 你：看天上那些星星 朋友：是天体吗 你：对啊，月亮星星都是 朋友：你懂这些吗 你：对，略懂
celestial body.example: Friend: What are you looking at at night? You: Those stars in the sky. Friend: Are they celestial bodies? You: Yeah, moon and stars all are. Friend: Do you know about these? You: Yes, a little.

center on.context: 你说这场讨论别扯太远，说大家的话题得集中在一个核心问题上，不然越说越散。
center on.translation: 朋友：咱今天谈啥 你：集中在一个问题上 朋友：是集中于核心吗 你：对啊，别扯远 朋友：你主持得住吗 你：对，拉回来
center on.example: Friend: What do we talk about today? You: Center on one issue. Friend: Does it center on the core? You: Yeah, don't wander. Friend: Can you keep it focused? You: Yes, pull back.

central heating.context: 你说北方冬天屋里暖和，说那种集中供暖一送暖，家家都热得穿短袖。
central heating.translation: 朋友：北方冬天屋里冷不 你：有集中供暖 朋友：是那种集中供暖吗 你：对啊，屋里穿短袖 朋友：你羡慕不 你：对，羡慕
central heating.example: Friend: Is it cold indoors in northern winters? You: There's central heating. Friend: Is it central heating? You: Yeah, short sleeves inside. Friend: Do you envy it? You: Yes, envy.

centre around.context: 你说那场讨论会围着一个核心话题转，说大家的意见都围绕着它展开。
centre around.translation: 朋友：那会都聊啥 你：围着一个话题转 朋友：是围绕核心吗 你：对啊，别的没谈 朋友：聊出结果没 你：对，定下来了
centre around.example: Friend: What did that meeting discuss? You: Centered around one topic. Friend: Is it centered around the core? You: Yeah, nothing else. Friend: Did it reach a result? You: Yes, settled.

centre on.context: 你说这篇文章主要集中在一个问题上，说写来写去都是围绕它打转。
centre on.translation: 朋友：那文章讲啥 你：集中在一个问题上 朋友：是集中于核心吗 你：对啊，写来写去 朋友：你读了啥感想 你：对，讲得透
centre on.example: Friend: What is that article about? You: Centered on one issue. Friend: Is it centered on the core? You: Yeah, written around it. Friend: What do you think after reading? You: Yes, thorough.

centres around.context: 你说他这几年的生活，围绕着孩子转，说一切都以孩子为中心。
centres around.translation: 朋友：他这几年忙啥 你：围着孩子转 朋友：是围绕孩子吗 你：对啊，啥都以孩子为先 朋友：他不累吗 你：对，累但乐
centres around.example: Friend: What has he been busy with these years? You: Centres around the child. Friend: Does it centre around the child? You: Yeah, child first. Friend: Isn't he tired? You: Yes, but happy.

chain store.context: 你说那条街上开了好多家连锁门店，说不管走到哪，都是同一个牌子同一种味道。
chain store.translation: 朋友：那条街咋这么多同牌子 你：都是连锁门店 朋友：是那种连锁店吗 你：对啊，味道都一样 朋友：你常去哪家 你：对，就近的
chain store.example: Friend: Why so many same brands on that street? You: They're all chain stores. Friend: Are they chain stores? You: Yeah, same taste. Friend: Which one do you usually go to? You: Yes, the nearest.

championed by.context: 你说这项政策是由市长亲自支持推动的，说有他撑腰，推行起来才这么顺。
championed by.translation: 朋友：那政策咋推得这么顺 你：市长亲自支持 朋友：是由市长支持吗 你：对啊，有他撑腰 朋友：底下人买账不 你：对，买账
championed by.example: Friend: Why did that policy go so smoothly? You: Championed by the mayor. Friend: Is it championed by him? You: Yeah, backed by him. Friend: Do people below buy it? You: Yes, they do.

change the face of.context: 你说互联网彻底改变了人们的生活面貌，说现在出门带个手机就够了，跟十年前完全两回事。
change the face of.translation: 朋友：这些年最大的变化是啥 你：互联网改变了生活 朋友：是改变了面貌吗 你：对啊，手机走天下 朋友：你适应得了吗 你：对，习惯了
change the face of.example: Friend: What's the biggest change these years? You: The internet changed the face of life. Friend: Did it change the face of life? You: Yeah, phone covers all. Friend: Can you adapt? You: Yes, used to it.

channel their energies.context: 你说年轻人把那股劲头疏导到正地方，说引导好了，精力用对了就是本事。
channel their energies.translation: 朋友：那年轻人浑身是劲 你：得把劲疏导好 朋友：是疏导精力吗 你：对啊，用对地方 朋友：咋疏导 你：对，引导到正事上
channel their energies.example: Friend: That young person is full of energy. You: Need to channel it well. Friend: Do they channel their energies? You: Yeah, use it in the right place. Friend: How to channel? You: Yes, guide to real work.

character trait.context: 你说他这人最明显的性格特征就是犟，说认准的事十头牛都拉不回来。
character trait.translation: 朋友：他这人啥性格 你：最明显就是犟 朋友：是个性特征吗 你：对啊，认准就不改 朋友：你跟他能合作吗 你：对，慢慢磨
character trait.example: Friend: What's his personality? You: The most obvious trait is stubbornness. Friend: Is it a character trait? You: Yeah, won't change once decided. Friend: Can you work with him? You: Yes, slowly work it out.

charge point.context: 你说开电动车最怕半路没电，说现在商场地下车库都装了充电点，方便多了。
charge point.translation: 朋友：你开电动车咋补电 你：找商场地下的充电点 朋友：是那种充电点吗 你：对啊，逛个街就充 朋友：方便不 你：对，比以前方便
charge point.example: Friend: How do you recharge your EV? You: Find a charge point in the mall basement. Friend: Is it a charge point? You: Yeah, charge while shopping. Friend: Is it convenient? You: Yes, more convenient than before.

charging point.context: 你说小区门口新装了一排充电桩，说以后开电车的邻居再也不用拎着线板下楼了。
charging point.translation: 朋友：小区门口装了啥 你：一排充电桩 朋友：是那种充电桩吗 你：对啊，电车直接充 朋友：收费贵不 你：对，还行
charging point.example: Friend: What was installed at the community gate? You: A row of charging points. Friend: Are they charging points? You: Yeah, EVs charge directly. Friend: Is the fee expensive? You: Yes, okay.

charging points.context: 你说现在路上的充电点越来越多，说开长途再也不用担心半路趴窝。
charging points.translation: 朋友：现在开电车方便不 你：充电点到处都是 朋友：是那种充电点多吗 你：对啊，长途也不怕 朋友：你跑过长途没 你：对，跑过
charging points.example: Friend: Is it convenient to drive an EV now? You: Charging points everywhere. Friend: Are there more charging points? You: Yeah, no fear on long trips. Friend: Have you done a long trip? You: Yes, have.

charismatic personality.context: 你说他一上台就能把全场镇住，说这种魅力人格，是天生的领袖料。
charismatic personality.translation: 朋友：他一上台咋就有人气 你：天生有魅力 朋友：是魅力人格吗 你：对啊，能镇住场 朋友：你学得来不 你：对，学不来
charismatic personality.example: Friend: Why is he so popular on stage? You: Born with charisma. Friend: Is it a charismatic personality? You: Yeah, holds the room. Friend: Can you learn it? You: Yes, can't.

charity revenue.context: 你说那家慈善机构主要靠捐款和企业拨款过日子，说这种慈善收入，全靠大家愿意帮。
charity revenue.translation: 朋友：那机构靠啥活 你：靠捐款和拨款 朋友：是慈善收入吗 你：对啊，全靠好心 朋友：它运营得好吗 你：对，公开透明
charity revenue.example: Friend: How does that organization survive? You: On donations and grants. Friend: Is it charity revenue? You: Yeah, all from kind hearts. Friend: Does it run well? You: Yes, transparent.

charity work.context: 你说他周末总去敬老院做义工，说这种慈善工作，比在家刷手机有意义多了。
charity work.translation: 朋友：你周末咋老往外跑 你：去敬老院做义工 朋友：是慈善工作吗 你：对啊，比刷手机强 朋友：你坚持多久了 你：对，两年
charity work.example: Friend: Why do you always go out on weekends? You: Volunteer at a care home. Friend: Is it charity work? You: Yeah, better than scrolling. Friend: How long have you kept it? You: Yes, two years.

charm pricing.context: 你说那东西标价99元而不是100，说这种魅力定价，就是为了让你觉得便宜一块钱。
charm pricing.translation: 朋友：那东西咋卖99 你：不是100 朋友：是那种心理定价吗 你：对啊，让你觉得便宜 朋友：你吃这套不 你：对，有时候
charm pricing.example: Friend: Why is that sold at 99? You: Not 100. Friend: Is it charm pricing? You: Yeah, makes you feel cheap. Friend: Do you fall for this? You: Yes, sometimes.

charter flight.context: 你说为了赶那个急活，公司专门包了一架飞机，说这种包机，花钱但省时间。
charter flight.translation: 朋友：你们出差咋去的 你：包了架飞机 朋友：是那种包机吗 你：对啊，省时间 朋友：花钱多不 你：对，但值得
charter flight.example: Friend: How did you go on that business trip? You: Chartered a flight. Friend: Is it a charter flight? You: Yeah, saves time. Friend: Is it expensive? You: Yes, but worth it.

chatting away.context: 你说俩老朋友一见面就聊个不停，说这种畅快的闲聊，越聊越起劲。
chatting away.translation: 朋友：你俩咋聊这么久 你：老朋友见了面 朋友：是在畅聊吗 你：对啊，越聊越起劲 朋友：都聊些啥 你：对，东家长西家短
chatting away.example: Friend: Why have you two chatted so long? You: Old friends meeting. Friend: Are you chatting away? You: Yeah, the more the merrier. Friend: What do you talk about? You: Yes, everything.

cheaper cuts of meat.context: 你说炖牛肉不用买最嫩的那块，说这种平价肉块，慢炖几小时反而更香。
cheaper cuts of meat.translation: 朋友：你炖牛肉买哪块 你：买便宜那块 朋友：是那种平价肉吗 你：对啊，慢炖更香 朋友：你这做法省不省钱 你：对，省钱又好吃
cheaper cuts of meat.example: Friend: Which cut do you buy for stewed beef? You: The cheaper cut. Friend: Is it a cheaper cut of meat? You: Yeah, slow stew tastier. Friend: Does this save money? You: Yes, cheap and tasty.

cheaply made.context: 你说那个便宜玩具用两天就坏了，说这种粗制滥造的东西，看着漂亮不耐用。
cheaply made.translation: 朋友：那玩具咋坏这么快 你：便宜货 朋友：是粗制滥造吗 你：对啊，两天就坏 朋友：你后悔不 你：对，后悔买
cheaply made.example: Friend: Why did that toy break so fast? You: Cheap stuff. Friend: Is it cheaply made? You: Yeah, broke in two days. Friend: Do you regret it? You: Yes, regret buying.

check with.context: 你说这事不能你拍板，得先跟领导确认一下，说问清楚了再办，免得白跑。
check with.translation: 朋友：这事咱能定吗 你：得先问领导 朋友：是向领导确认吗 你：对啊，问清楚再办 朋友：你问了没 你：对，还没
check with.example: Friend: Can we decide this? You: Must check with the boss first. Friend: Do you check with him? You: Yeah, confirm before doing. Friend: Did you ask? You: Yes, not yet.

chemical dye.context: 你说那种衣服颜色特别艳，是用化学染料染的，说这种染料排到水里，污染特别大。
chemical dye.translation: 朋友：那衣服颜色咋这么艳 你：是化学染料染的 朋友：是那种化学染料吗 你：对啊，污染大 朋友：那对身体有害不 你：对，洗的时候注意
chemical dye.example: Friend: Why is that clothing color so vivid? You: Dyed with chemical dye. Friend: Is it a chemical dye? You: Yeah, big pollution. Friend: Is it harmful to health? You: Yes, be careful washing.

chemical fertiliser.context: 你说种庄稼不能光靠化肥，说这种化肥用多了，地会板结，还不如农家肥养地。
chemical fertiliser.translation: 朋友：你种地用啥肥 你：化肥和农家肥都用 朋友：是那种化肥吗 你：对啊，用多了地不好 朋友：你咋平衡 你：对，交替用
chemical fertiliser.example: Friend: What fertiliser do you use for crops? You: Both chemical and farm manure. Friend: Is it chemical fertiliser? You: Yeah, too much ruins soil. Friend: How do you balance? You: Yes, alternate.

chemical footprint.context: 你说那种化工厂排的废水，是它的化工污染足迹，说这种东西，躲得越远越好。
chemical footprint.translation: 朋友：那化工厂挨着住好吗 你：废水里全是化工残留 朋友：是化工污染足迹吗 你：对啊，躲远点 朋友：那附近的人咋办 你：对，盼着它搬走
chemical footprint.example: Friend: Is it good to live next to that chemical plant? You: The wastewater is full of chemical residue. Friend: Is it its chemical footprint? You: Yeah, stay far. Friend: Then what do nearby people do? You: Yes, hope it moves.

chew gum.context: 你说上课嚼口香糖会分散注意力，说老师规定教室里不许嚼，有规矩才有纪律。
chew gum.translation: 朋友：你上课咋不嚼糖了 你：老师不让 朋友：是不让嚼口香糖吗 你：对啊，教室不能嚼 朋友：你习惯吗 你：对，习惯了
chew gum.example: Friend: Why don't you chew gum in class anymore? You: Teacher doesn't allow. Friend: Is chewing gum not allowed? You: Yeah, not in class. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

chew on.context: 你说这个决定别着急，先放那儿自己琢磨两天，说多想几遍，心里就有数了。
chew on.translation: 朋友：这事咱定不 你：先放着想想 朋友：是仔细考虑吗 你：对啊，多琢磨 朋友：你琢磨几天了 你：对，两天
chew on.example: Friend: Should we decide this? You: Chew on it first. Friend: Will you chew on it? You: Yeah, think more. Friend: How many days have you chewed? You: Yes, two.

chew the fat.context: 你说几个老友周末找个咖啡馆，边喝边唠，说这种闲扯，最能让人放松。
chew the fat.translation: 朋友：你周末跟朋友干啥 你：找个咖啡馆唠嗑 朋友：是那种闲聊吗 你：对啊，边喝边扯 朋友：聊正事不 你：对，就闲扯
chew the fat.example: Friend: What do you do with friends on weekends? You: Find a café to chat. Friend: Are you chewing the fat? You: Yeah, chat over drinks. Friend: Do you talk business? You: Yes, just chat.

chewing sound.context: 你说旁边那人吃东西嘎嘣嘎嘣响，说这种咀嚼声，在安静的办公室里特别显眼。
chewing sound.translation: 朋友：你旁边那人咋老响 你：吃东西嘎嘣响 朋友：是那种咀嚼声吗 你：对啊，安静里特别明显 朋友：你烦不烦 你：对，有点
chewing sound.example: Friend: Why does the person next to you keep making noise? You: Crunching while eating. Friend: Is it a chewing sound? You: Yeah, obvious in silence. Friend: Aren't you annoyed? You: Yes, a bit.

chia seed.context: 你说现在流行在酸奶里撒一把奇亚籽，说这种小籽泡水就膨胀，饱腹感特别强。
chia seed.translation: 朋友：你酸奶里撒的啥 你：奇亚籽 朋友：是那种奇亚籽吗 你：对啊，泡了就胀 朋友：吃了管饱不 你：对，管饱
chia seed.example: Friend: What do you sprinkle in your yogurt? You: Chia seeds. Friend: Are they chia seeds? You: Yeah, swell in water. Friend: Do they fill you up? You: Yes.

child's pose.context: 你说瑜伽课最后老师让大家趴下来，做那个婴儿式，说这是用来放松和休息的姿势。
child's pose.translation: 朋友：瑜伽最后干啥 你：趴下来做婴儿式 朋友：是那种婴儿式吗 你：对啊，用来放松 朋友：你习惯这个姿势不 你：对，舒服
child's pose.example: Friend: What do you do at the end of yoga? You: Get down into child's pose. Friend: Is it child's pose? You: Yeah, for relaxation. Friend: Are you used to this pose? You: Yes, comfy.

childhood amnesia.context: 你说人长到三岁以前的事，几乎都记不起来，说这种童年失忆，是普遍现象。
childhood amnesia.translation: 朋友：你记得三岁前的事吗 你：几乎都忘光了 朋友：是童年失忆吗 你：对啊，大家都这样 朋友：你为啥忘 你：对，脑子还没长好
childhood amnesia.example: Friend: Do you remember things before age three? You: Almost all forgotten. Friend: Is it childhood amnesia? You: Yeah, everyone is like this. Friend: Why do you forget? You: Yes, brain not fully grown.

childhood development.context: 你说孩子小时候吃好睡好、多玩多跑，对他们的儿童发育最有好处，说底子打好了将来不发愁。
childhood development.translation: 朋友：小孩咋长得好 你：吃好睡好多玩 朋友：是儿童发育吗 你：对啊，底子打好 朋友：你家孩子长得咋样 你：对，挺好
childhood development.example: Friend: How do kids grow well? You: Eat well, sleep well, play more. Friend: Is it childhood development? You: Yeah, lay a good foundation. Friend: How is your kid growing? You: Yes, fine.

childhood memory.context: 你说翻到老照片，一下想起好多童年回忆，说那种夏天躲在奶奶家吃西瓜的日子，最难忘。
childhood memory.translation: 朋友：你看老照片想啥 你：想起小时候 朋友：是童年回忆吗 你：对啊，奶奶家的夏天 朋友：你怀念不 你：对，特别怀念
childhood memory.example: Friend: What do you think of when you see old photos? You: Think of childhood. Friend: Are they childhood memories? You: Yeah, summers at grandma's. Friend: Do you miss them? You: Yes, really miss.

childhood toy.context: 你说抽屉里还留着小时候那辆玩具小汽车，说这种童年玩具，现在看都发黄了。
childhood toy.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里那小车是啥 你：小时候的玩具 朋友：是童年玩具吗 你：对啊，都发黄了 朋友：你还留着它干啥 你：对，留念想
childhood toy.example: Friend: What is that little car in your drawer? You: A childhood toy. Friend: Is it a childhood toy? You: Yeah, yellowed now. Friend: Why do you still keep it? You: Yes, for nostalgia.

childlike adults.context: 你说他三十多了还爱打游戏、看动画，说这种童心未泯的大人，活得比谁都快乐。
childlike adults.translation: 朋友：他三十多了咋还看动画 你：心里住着小孩 朋友：是那种童心大人吗 你：对啊，活得快乐 朋友：你羡慕不 你：对，羡慕
childlike adults.example: Friend: Why does he still watch cartoons in his thirties? You: A kid inside. Friend: Is he a childlike adult? You: Yeah, lives happily. Friend: Do you envy him? You: Yes, envy.

chill out.context: 你说周末别老想着工作，说瘫在沙发上听听歌，这种放松，最能把一周的累卸下来。
chill out.translation: 朋友：你周末咋安排 你：瘫沙发上听歌 朋友：是在放松吗 你：对啊，卸卸累 朋友：你不觉得浪费时间吗 你：对，放松也是正事
chill out.example: Friend: How do you plan your weekend? You: Crash on the sofa listening to music. Friend: Are you chilling out? You: Yeah, unload the tiredness. Friend: Don't you feel it's a waste? You: Yes, relaxation is real work too.

chock-full of.context: 你说那一锅汤里塞满了各种料，说这种满到边的粥，喝一碗就撑。
chock-full of.translation: 朋友：你这锅里装啥了 你：塞满了料 朋友：是塞满的吗 你：对啊，满到边 朋友：你喝一碗够吗 你：对，撑
chock-full of.example: Friend: What is in that pot? You: Chock-full of ingredients. Friend: Is it chock-full of them? You: Yeah, full to the brim. Friend: Is one bowl enough? You: Yes, stuffed.

choke out.context: 你说她哭得上气不接下气，好半天才挤出一句话，说这种哽咽，谁看着都心疼。
choke out.translation: 朋友：她咋半天说不出话 你：哭得太厉害 朋友：是哽咽着说吗 你：对啊，挤出一句 朋友：你劝得住吗 你：对，先让她哭
choke out.example: Friend: Why can't she speak for so long? You: Cried too hard. Friend: Is she choking out her words? You: Yeah, squeezes out one. Friend: Can you calm her? You: Yes, let her cry first.

chomp on.context: 你说他拿起那根胡萝卜，嘎嘣嘎嘣地啃，说这种大口嚼，听着都香。
chomp on.translation: 朋友：他咋啃得这么响 你：拿着胡萝卜嚼 朋友：是在大口啃吗 你：对啊，嘎嘣嘎嘣 朋友：你也想吃不 你：对，有点
chomp on.example: Friend: Why is he munching so loudly? You: Chomping on a carrot. Friend: Is he chomping on it? You: Yeah, crunch crunch. Friend: Do you want some too? You: Yes, a bit.

chop up.context: 你说炒菜前先把肉和菜都切成小块，说这种切碎，炒起来才入味又均匀。
chop up.translation: 朋友：你炒菜前忙啥 你：把肉菜切碎 朋友：是切碎吗 你：对啊，小块好炒 朋友：你切得快不快 你：对，练出来的
chop up.example: Friend: What are you doing before stir-frying? You: Chop up the meat and veg. Friend: Do you chop them up? You: Yeah, small pieces cook evenly. Friend: Do you chop fast? You: Yes, practiced.

choral singing.context: 你说他们合唱团一上台，那种多声部的合唱，比一个人独唱有气势多了。
choral singing.translation: 朋友：那合唱好听不 你：多声部，有气势 朋友：是那种合唱吗 你：对啊，比独唱强 朋友：你想去不 你：对，想去听
choral singing.example: Friend: Is that choral singing good? You: Multi-part, powerful. Friend: Is it choral singing? You: Yeah, stronger than solo. Friend: Do you want to go? You: Yes, want to hear.

chord progression.context: 你说那首歌好听，主要是它的和弦走向顺，说这种和声一变，整个味道都不一样。
chord progression.translation: 朋友：那歌好听在哪 你：和弦走向顺 朋友：是那种和弦走向吗 你：对啊，一变就好听 朋友：你会弹吗 你：对，不会
chord progression.example: Friend: What makes that song good? You: Its chord progression is smooth. Friend: Is it the chord progression? You: Yeah, a change makes it good. Friend: Can you play it? You: Yes, can't.

chore payment.context: 你说国外小孩做家务能换零花钱，说这种做家务换酬劳的做法，让孩子更有动力。
chore payment.translation: 朋友：外国小孩咋挣零花 你：做家务换钱 朋友：是那种做家务酬劳吗 你：对啊，更有动力 朋友：你觉得这办法好吗 你：对，挺好
chore payment.example: Friend: How do foreign kids earn pocket money? You: Chore payment. Friend: Is it chore payment? You: Yeah, more motivated. Friend: Do you think this method is good? You: Yes, good.

chow down.context: 你说比赛一结束，几个人冲进馆子就大吃大喝，说这种放开吃，比啥都解乏。
chow down.translation: 朋友：比赛完你们干啥 你：冲进馆子大吃 朋友：是在大吃大喝吗 你：对啊，放开了吃 朋友：你们花得多不 你：对，AA
chow down.example: Friend: What do you do after the game? You: Rush into a restaurant to chow down. Friend: Are you chowing down? You: Yeah, eat freely. Friend: Do you spend a lot? You: Yes, go Dutch.

chow down on.context: 你说他一个人把那一大盘披萨全吃了，说这种狼吞虎咽，看着都觉得饱。
chow down on.translation: 朋友：他咋一个人吃完整张 你：狼吞虎咽 朋友：是在大吃吗 你：对啊，一下吃光 朋友：他平时就这么能吃吗 你：对，胃口好
chow down on.example: Friend: Why did he finish the whole pizza alone? You: Chow down on it. Friend: Is he chowing down on it? You: Yeah, ate it all at once. Friend: Is he usually this hungry? You: Yes, big appetite.

christmas past.context: 你说翻到老照片，就想起那些过去的圣诞节，说一家人围在树下拆礼物的日子，再回不去了。
christmas past.translation: 朋友：你看照片想啥 你：想起以前的圣诞 朋友：是过去的圣诞节吗 你：对啊，一家人围树 朋友：你怀念不 你：对，回不去了
christmas past.example: Friend: What do you think of when you see the photo? You: Think of past Christmases. Friend: Are they Christmas past? You: Yeah, family around the tree. Friend: Do you miss them? You: Yes, gone forever.

chronic disease.context: 你说糖尿病、高血压这些都是慢性病，说得长期吃药控制，不是吃几副药就能好的。
chronic disease.translation: 朋友：他这病能去根吗 你：慢性病，去不了 朋友：是慢性病吗 你：对啊，长期吃药 朋友：能治好吗 你：对，控制就好
chronic disease.example: Friend: Can his disease be cured? You: Chronic disease, can't root it out. Friend: Is it a chronic disease? You: Yeah, long-term meds. Friend: Can it be cured? You: Yes, control it well.

chronic illness.context: 你说他那老胃病好多年了，说这种慢性病，得慢慢养，急不得。
chronic illness.translation: 朋友：他那胃病咋样了 你：好多年了 朋友：是慢性病吗 你：对啊，慢慢养 朋友：他忌口不 你：对，忌得很严
chronic illness.example: Friend: How is his stomach problem? You: For many years. Friend: Is it a chronic illness? You: Yeah, slow recovery. Friend: Does he avoid certain food? You: Yes, strictly.

chronic irritation.context: 你说同桌老爱抖腿，说这种长期烦躁的小动作，吵得周围人都没法专心。
chronic irritation.translation: 朋友：你同桌咋老抖腿 你：停不下来 朋友：是长期烦躁吗 你：对啊，影响别人 朋友：你说过他没 你：对，说过
chronic irritation.example: Friend: Why does your deskmate always shake a leg? You: Can't stop. Friend: Is it chronic irritation? You: Yeah, affects others. Friend: Have you told him? You: Yes, have.

chronic lateness.context: 你说他迟到是出了名的，说这种习惯性迟到，大家都拿他没办法。
chronic lateness.translation: 朋友：他又迟到了 你：老毛病了 朋友：是习惯性迟到吗 你：对啊，谁也说不动 朋友：你们会扣他分吗 你：对，扣过
chronic lateness.example: Friend: He's late again. You: An old habit. Friend: Is it chronic lateness? You: Yeah, nobody can move him. Friend: Do you dock his points? You: Yes, have.

chronic low mood.context: 你说他这两年一直高兴不起来，说这种长期情绪低落，得去看看医生，不能硬扛。
chronic low mood.translation: 朋友：他这两年咋总不开心 你：情绪一直低 朋友：是长期情绪低落吗 你：对啊，得看医生 朋友：你劝他没 你：对，劝过
chronic low mood.example: Friend: Why has he been unhappy these two years? You: Low mood all the time. Friend: Is it chronic low mood? You: Yeah, must see a doctor. Friend: Did you advise him? You: Yes, have.

chronic pain.context: 你说他腰上的老毛病一到变天就疼，说这种慢性疼痛，治不断根，只能靠理疗缓解。
chronic pain.translation: 朋友：他那腰咋老疼 你：一变天就疼 朋友：是慢性疼痛吗 你：对啊，治不断根 朋友：他咋缓解 你：对，理疗
chronic pain.example: Friend: Why does his back always hurt? You: Hurts when the weather changes. Friend: Is it chronic pain? You: Yeah, can't root it out. Friend: How does he relieve it? You: Yes, physiotherapy.

chronic stress.context: 你说他这几年被工作压得喘不过气，说这种长期慢性压力，迟早把人压垮。
chronic stress.translation: 朋友：他最近状态咋这么差 你：压力一直很大 朋友：是长期慢性压力吗 你：对啊，迟早垮 朋友：你劝他休息没 你：对，劝过
chronic stress.example: Friend: Why is his state so poor lately? You: Stress has been huge. Friend: Is it chronic stress? You: Yeah, will break sooner or later. Friend: Did you tell him to rest? You: Yes, have.

chuck away.context: 你说那些旧书看完就扔了吧，说这种没用的东西，别老留着占地方。
chuck away.translation: 朋友：这旧书咋处理 你：看完就扔 朋友：是丢掉吗 你：对啊，占地方 朋友：你舍不得不 你：对，舍不得
chuck away.example: Friend: What to do with this old book? You: Chuck it away after reading. Friend: Will you chuck it away? You: Yeah, takes space. Friend: Aren't you attached? You: Yes, a little.

chuck it down.context: 你说外面忽然下起了倾盆大雨，说这种雨，简直是从天上往下泼水。
chuck it down.translation: 朋友：外面雨大不 你：跟泼水一样 朋友：是下大雨吗 你：对啊，出不去 朋友：你带伞没 你：对，没带
chuck it down.example: Friend: Is it raining hard outside? You: Like pouring water. Friend: Is it chucking it down? You: Yeah, can't go out. Friend: Did you bring an umbrella? You: Yes, no.

churn out.context: 你说那家旧工厂天天往外冒黑烟，说这种大量排放，把整条街都熏黑了。
churn out.translation: 朋友：那烟囱咋老冒烟 你：工厂排的 朋友：是大量排放烟尘吗 你：对啊，整条街都黑 朋友：环保没人管吗 你：对，在查
churn out.example: Friend: Why does that chimney always smoke? You: From the factory. Friend: Is it churning out smoke? You: Yeah, the whole street is black. Friend: Doesn't environmental care check it? You: Yes, investigating.

cigarette smoke.context: 你说在公共场合抽烟，那股香烟烟雾飘得满处都是，说二手烟最招人烦。
cigarette smoke.translation: 朋友：那人在公共场合抽烟 你：烟雾飘得到处都是 朋友：是香烟烟雾吗 你：对啊，二手烟最烦 朋友：你躲得开吗 你：对，走开点
cigarette smoke.example: Friend: That person is smoking in public. You: Cigarette smoke drifting everywhere. Friend: Is it cigarette smoke? You: Yeah, secondhand smoke is the worst. Friend: Can you avoid it? You: Yes, move away.

cinematic storytelling.context: 你说那种片子不靠炫技，靠一层层讲故事，说这种电影式叙事，最能抓住人心。
cinematic storytelling.translation: 朋友：那片子好看在哪 你：靠讲故事 朋友：是电影式叙事吗 你：对啊，一层层抓人 朋友：你看进去没 你：对，看进去了
cinematic storytelling.example: Friend: What makes that film good? You: Storytelling. Friend: Is it cinematic storytelling? You: Yeah, hooks layer by layer. Friend: Did you get into it? You: Yes, got into it.

circadian rhythm.context: 你说倒时差最难熬的，就是那套昼夜节律被打乱，说白天困、夜里精神，得好几天才能倒回来。
circadian rhythm.translation: 朋友：你倒时差咋这么难受 你：生物钟乱了 朋友：是昼夜节律被打乱吗 你：对啊，白天困夜里醒 朋友：几天能缓过来 你：对，三四天
circadian rhythm.example: Friend: Why is jet lag so hard for you? You: Body clock is messed up. Friend: Is your circadian rhythm off? You: Yeah, sleepy day, awake night. Friend: How many days to recover? You: Yes, three or four.

circle around.context: 你说几只小鸟在空中绕着圈飞，说这种盘旋，是它们在找地方落脚。
circle around.translation: 朋友：天上那几只鸟在干啥 你：在空中绕圈 朋友：是在盘旋吗 你：对啊，找地方停 朋友：它们要去哪 你：对，树上
circle around.example: Friend: What are those birds in the sky doing? You: Circling around. Friend: Are they circling around? You: Yeah, looking for a place to land. Friend: Where do they go? You: Yes, the tree.

circular economy.context: 你说现在讲究把用过的东西再回收利用，说这种循环经济，能少浪费很多资源。
circular economy.translation: 朋友：现在新提法是啥 你：把旧东西再利用 朋友：是循环经济吗 你：对啊，少浪费 朋友：这想法好吗 你：对，挺好
circular economy.example: Friend: What's the new idea now? You: Reuse old things. Friend: Is it a circular economy? You: Yeah, less waste. Friend: Is this idea good? You: Yes, good.

circular fashion.context: 你说现在衣服穿一次就扔太浪费，说那种把旧衣回收重纺的循环时尚，才是长久之道。
circular fashion.translation: 朋友：旧衣服咋处理 你：回收重纺 朋友：是循环时尚吗 你：对啊，别扔 朋友：这样环保不 你：对，省资源
circular fashion.example: Friend: What to do with old clothes? You: Recycle and respin. Friend: Is it circular fashion? You: Yeah, don't throw. Friend: Is this eco-friendly? You: Yes, saves resources.

circular movement.context: 你说刷牙得让牙刷在牙面上打圈，说这种画圈刷，比横着使劲刷干净多了。
circular movement.translation: 朋友：你刷牙咋这么慢 你：在牙面上打圈 朋友：是那种画圈刷吗 你：对啊，比横刷干净 朋友：你这习惯好 你：对，牙医教的
circular movement.example: Friend: Why do you brush so slowly? You: Making circles on the teeth. Friend: Is it a circular movement? You: Yeah, cleaner than scrubbing. Friend: Good habit. You: Yes, taught by the dentist.

city dweller.context: 你说在城里住久了，出门就是地铁和商场，说这种城市居民的生活，便利但吵。
city dweller.translation: 朋友：你在城里住惯了吗 你：出门就是地铁商场 朋友：是城市居民的生活吗 你：对啊，便利但吵 朋友：你想搬出去不 你：对，偶尔想
city dweller.example: Friend: Are you used to living in the city? You: Out the door is the subway and malls. Friend: Is it a city dweller's life? You: Yeah, convenient but noisy. Friend: Do you want to move out? You: Yes, occasionally.

clamp down on.context: 你说最近交警在严管违停，说这种加强打击，路边乱停车一下就少了。
clamp down on.translation: 朋友：最近路边车咋少了 你：交警在严管 朋友：是在打击违停吗 你：对啊，贴罚单 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
clamp down on.example: Friend: Why are fewer cars on the roadside lately? You: Traffic police are clamping down. Friend: Are they clamping down on illegal parking? You: Yeah, issuing tickets. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

clampdown on.context: 你说那波严打之后，街上那种乱摆摊的全消失了，说这种整顿，效果立竿见影。
clampdown on.translation: 朋友：那摆摊的咋没了 你：被严打了 朋友：是那种严打吗 你：对啊，一下消失 朋友：这样好吗 你：对，路通了
clampdown on.example: Friend: Why did those street vendors disappear? You: A clampdown hit them. Friend: Was it a clampdown? You: Yeah, gone at once. Friend: Is this good? You: Yes, roads clear.

classic line.context: 你说那部老电影里有句台词，大家到现在还挂在嘴边，说这种经典台词，真的能记一辈子。
classic line.translation: 朋友：那老电影哪句最有名 你：有句话大家老说 朋友：是经典台词吗 你：对啊，记一辈子 朋友：你会背吗 你：对，会
classic line.example: Friend: Which line in that old film is most famous? You: One people keep quoting. Friend: Is it a classic line? You: Yeah, remembered for life. Friend: Can you recite it? You: Yes, can.

classic literature.context: 你说学生时代该多读点经典名著，说这些书再过一百年，还是值得拿出来读。
classic literature.translation: 朋友：学生该读啥书 你：多读经典名著 朋友：是经典名著吗 你：对啊，过百年还值得 朋友：你最爱哪本 你：对，红楼梦
classic literature.example: Friend: What books should students read? You: Read more classic literature. Friend: Is it classic literature? You: Yeah, worth it in a hundred years. Friend: Which is your favorite? You: Yes, Dream of the Red Chamber.

classified.context: 你说那份文件上盖着机密章，说这种保密的东西，外人看了是要出事的。
classified.translation: 朋友：那文件你能看吗 你：盖着机密章 朋友：是机密的吗 你：对啊，外人不能看 朋友：你咋知道 你：对，领导说的
classified.example: Friend: Can you see that document? You: It's stamped confidential. Friend: Is it classified? You: Yeah, outsiders can't see. Friend: How do you know? You: Yes, the boss said.

classified as.context: 你说那种植物被归类为有毒品种，说这种分类一旦定了，大家就得离它远点。
classified as.translation: 朋友：那植物能摸吗 你：它被归为有毒 朋友：是被归类为有毒吗 你：对啊，离远点 朋友：它在哪呢 你：对，园里贴着牌子
classified as.example: Friend: Can you touch that plant? You: It's classified as toxic. Friend: Is it classified as toxic? You: Yeah, stay away. Friend: Where is it? You: Yes, signs in the garden.

clean beauty.context: 你说现在买护肤品都挑那种成分干净的，说这种纯净美妆的理念，就是不往脸上抹乱七八糟的东西。
clean beauty.translation: 朋友：你挑护肤品看啥 你：看成分干不干净 朋友：是纯净美妆吗 你：对啊，不抹乱七八糟 朋友：你信这一套不 你：对，信
clean beauty.example: Friend: What do you look for in skincare? You: Clean ingredients. Friend: Is it clean beauty? You: Yeah, no junk on the face. Friend: Do you believe in this? You: Yes, believe.

clean slate.context: 你说过去的事就让它过去，说现在一切从头开始，就当自己手里是一块空白的石板。
clean slate.translation: 朋友：你以前那些事咋放得下 你：从头开始 朋友：是重新开始吗 你：对啊，当空白石板 朋友：你能放下吗 你：对，慢慢放
clean slate.example: Friend: How do you let go of the past? You: Start from scratch. Friend: Is it a clean slate? You: Yeah, like a blank slate. Friend: Can you let go? You: Yes, slowly.

clear cut.context: 你说这事的标准很明确，说哪样行、哪样不行，一目了然，没什么好争的。
clear cut.translation: 朋友：这事咋算过 你：标准很明确 朋友：是一目了然吗 你：对啊，没什么好争 朋友：你按标准来没 你：对，按标准
clear cut.example: Friend: How is this counted as passing? You: The criteria are clear cut. Friend: Is it clear cut? You: Yeah, nothing to argue. Friend: Did you follow the criteria? You: Yes, follow them.

clear one's head.context: 你说心里乱的时候，就出去走两圈，说吹吹风，脑子里那团乱麻就理清了。
clear one's head.translation: 朋友：你咋老出去走 你：心里乱，走走 朋友：是理清思绪吗 你：对啊，吹吹风就清 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
clear one's head.example: Friend: Why do you always go out for walks? You: Mind messy, walking. Friend: Are you clearing your head? You: Yeah, wind clears it. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

clear out.context: 你说周末把抽屉彻底清了一遍，说那些没用的旧东西，全清空了心里才痛快。
clear out.translation: 朋友：你周末忙啥 你：清抽屉 朋友：是清理吗 你：对啊，旧东西全扔 朋友：你舍不得不 你：对，舍不得但清了
clear out.example: Friend: What were you busy with weekend? You: Clearing out the drawers. Friend: Are you clearing them out? You: Yeah, throw old things. Friend: Aren't you attached? You: Yes, but cleared.

clear terms.context: 你说签合同前，双方得把条款写得明明白白，说这种明确条款，日后才不会扯皮。
clear terms.translation: 朋友：签合同要注意啥 你：把条款写清楚 朋友：是明确条款吗 你：对啊，日后不扯皮 朋友：你都看了没 你：对，一条一条看
clear terms.example: Friend: What to watch when signing a contract? You: Write the terms clearly. Friend: Are they clear terms? You: Yeah, no disputes later. Friend: Did you read them? You: Yes, line by line.

click with.context: 你说俩人才见第一面，就聊得特别投缘，说这种一拍即合的感觉，挺难得。
click with.translation: 朋友：你俩咋这么快就熟 你：一见就投缘 朋友：是一拍即合吗 你：对啊，聊得来 朋友：你咋认识的 你：对，朋友介绍
click with.example: Friend: Why did you two get close so fast? You: Clicked at first meeting. Friend: Did you click? You: Yeah, hit it off. Friend: How did you meet? You: Yes, friend introduced.

climate catastrophe.context: 你说那些极端天气越来越频繁，说这种气候灾难，再不行动真的要来不及了。
climate catastrophe.translation: 朋友：这两年天气咋这么怪 你：极端天气多了 朋友：是气候灾难吗 你：对啊，再不行动就晚 朋友：咱能做点啥 你：对，少排放
climate catastrophe.example: Friend: Why is the weather so weird these two years? You: More extreme weather. Friend: Is it a climate catastrophe? You: Yeah, too late if we don't act. Friend: What can we do? You: Yes, emit less.

climate crisis.context: 你说现在全球都在谈气候危机，说这不是遥远的事，是每个人都躲不开的问题。
climate crisis.translation: 朋友：最近大家都在谈啥 你：气候危机 朋友：是气候危机吗 你：对啊，躲不开 朋友：你觉得严重不 你：对，严重
climate crisis.example: Friend: What is everyone talking about lately? You: The climate crisis. Friend: Is it the climate crisis? You: Yeah, can't avoid. Friend: Do you think it's serious? You: Yes, serious.

climate impact.context: 你说那些极端天气，都是气候变化带来的影响，说这种气候影响，连小地方都躲不掉。
climate impact.translation: 朋友：这洪水咋这么大 你：气候带来的影响 朋友：是气候影响吗 你：对啊，哪都躲不掉 朋友：咱咋办 你：对，提前防备
climate impact.example: Friend: Why is this flood so big? You: A climate impact. Friend: Is it a climate impact? You: Yeah, nowhere escapes. Friend: What do we do? You: Yes, prepare early.

climate model.context: 你说科学家靠计算机算出未来天气，说这种气候模型，能大致预判后面几十年会怎样。
climate model.translation: 朋友：科学家咋预测未来 你：用气候模型 朋友：是气候模型吗 你：对啊，算几十年 朋友：算得准吗 你：对，大致准
climate model.example: Friend: How do scientists predict the future? You: Use climate models. Friend: Is it a climate model? You: Yeah, calculate decades. Friend: Is it accurate? You: Yes, roughly.

climate pattern.context: 你说这几年雨下得越来越没规律，说这种气候规律一旦打乱，农民种地都难。
climate pattern.translation: 朋友：这两年雨咋这么乱 你：气候规律变了 朋友：是气候规律被打乱吗 你：对啊，种地都难 朋友：农民咋办 你：对，得适应
climate pattern.example: Friend: Why is the rain so erratic these two years? You: The climate pattern changed. Friend: Is the climate pattern off? You: Yeah, farming is hard. Friend: What do farmers do? You: Yes, adapt.

climate target.context: 你说那家公司立下了十年减碳的目标，说这种气候目标，得全公司一起拼才达得到。
climate target.translation: 朋友：那公司说要干啥 你：十年减碳 朋友：是气候目标吗 你：对啊，得一起拼 朋友：能达到吗 你：对，看行动
climate target.example: Friend: What did that company say it would do? You: Cut carbon in ten years. Friend: Is it a climate target? You: Yeah, all must work. Friend: Can it reach it? You: Yes, depends on action.

climb around.context: 你说那小孩刚学会走路，满屋到处乱爬，说这种爬来爬去，大人得紧跟在后头。
climb around.translation: 朋友：那小孩咋老乱跑 你：刚会走，满屋爬 朋友：是到处乱爬吗 你：对啊，得紧跟 朋友：你累不累 你：对，累但开心
climb around.example: Friend: Why does that child always run around? You: Just learned to walk, climbing around the house. Friend: Is he climbing around? You: Yeah, must follow close. Friend: Are you tired? You: Yes, tired but happy.

clinical diagnosis.context: 你说医生看了片子、问了症状，才给出一个明确的诊断，说这种临床诊断，不是靠猜的。
clinical diagnosis.translation: 朋友：医生咋说你这病 你：给了个明确诊断 朋友：是临床诊断吗 你：对啊，不靠猜 朋友：你放心不 你：对，放心
clinical diagnosis.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about your illness? You: Gave a clear diagnosis. Friend: Is it a clinical diagnosis? You: Yeah, not guesswork. Friend: Are you reassured? You: Yes, reassured.

clinical psychologist.context: 你说他压力大到失眠，就去找了个临床心理学家，说这种专业的人，最懂怎么疏导情绪。
clinical psychologist.translation: 朋友：他失眠咋看的 你：找了临床心理学家 朋友：是那种心理医生吗 你：对啊，最懂疏导 朋友：有用吗 你：对，有用
clinical psychologist.example: Friend: How did he see about his insomnia? You: Saw a clinical psychologist. Friend: Is it a clinical psychologist? You: Yeah, best at guidance. Friend: Is it useful? You: Yes, useful.

clinical trial.context: 你说那种新药上市前，得先在人身上做临床试验，说这种试验过了，才能放心给病人用。
clinical trial.translation: 朋友：那新药靠谱吗 你：先做临床试验 朋友：是临床试验吗 你：对啊，过了才放心 朋友：你敢试不 你：对，不敢
clinical trial.example: Friend: Is that new drug reliable? You: Clinical trial first. Friend: Is it a clinical trial? You: Yeah, pass then reassured. Friend: Dare you try it? You: Yes, don't dare.

clock off.context: 你说一到下班时间，立马打卡走人，说这种到点就走，是对自己辛苦一天的尊重。
clock off.translation: 朋友：你下班走得真快 你：到点就打卡 朋友：是打卡下班吗 你：对啊，不多待 朋友：领导不说你吗 你：对，不加班
clock off.example: Friend: You leave work so fast. You: Clock off on time. Friend: Do you clock off? You: Yeah, no extra stay. Friend: Doesn't the boss say anything? You: Yes, no overtime.

clog up.context: 你说那下水道堵了，脏水全溢到路面上，说这种堵塞，得赶紧找人来通。
clog up.translation: 朋友：那路上咋全是水 你：下水道堵了 朋友：是堵塞了吗 你：对啊，脏水冒出来 朋友：有人来修没 你：对，叫了
clog up.example: Friend: Why is the road all water? You: The drain is clogged up. Friend: Is it clogged up? You: Yeah, dirty water spills. Friend: Did someone come fix it? You: Yes, called.

clog with.context: 你说那条路一到早高峰，就被车塞得死死的，说这种堵，谁都别走了。
clog with.translation: 朋友：早上那条路咋走不动 你：被车塞满了 朋友：是被车堵塞吗 你：对啊，谁都走不了 朋友：你咋上班 你：对，改骑车
clog with.example: Friend: Why can't you move on that road in the morning? You: Clogged with cars. Friend: Is it clogged with cars? You: Yeah, nobody moves. Friend: How do you get to work? You: Yes, switched to cycling.

close off.context: 你说那段路因为施工被拦起来，说这种封锁，行人得绕另一条道。
close off.translation: 朋友：这条路咋走不过去 你：被拦起来了 朋友：是封锁了吗 你：对啊，得绕路 朋友：你绕多远 你：对，十分钟
close off.example: Friend: Why can't you cross this road? You: It's closed off. Friend: Is it closed off? You: Yeah, must detour. Friend: How far do you detour? You: Yes, ten minutes.

close out.context: 你说那家店撑不下去了，干脆清仓甩卖，说这种结束，把库存全低价出掉。
close out.translation: 朋友：那店咋全打折 你：撑不下去了 朋友：是清仓结束吗 你：对啊，低价甩 朋友：你去抢了没 你：对，去了
close out.example: Friend: Why is that shop all discounted? You: Can't hold on. Friend: Is it closing out? You: Yeah, sell cheap. Friend: Did you grab some? You: Yes, went.

close season.context: 你说到了春天，山里的打猎就暂停了，说这种禁猎期，是让鸟儿安心孵蛋的。
close season.translation: 朋友：山里春天能打猎吗 你：不能，停了 朋友：是禁猎期吗 你：对啊，让鸟孵蛋 朋友：啥时候能打 你：对，秋天
close season.example: Friend: Can you hunt in the mountains in spring? You: No, stopped. Friend: Is it the close season? You: Yeah, let birds hatch. Friend: When can you hunt? You: Yes, autumn.

close up.context: 你说拍照时得给脸来个大特写，说这种特写镜头，能把眼神里的情绪全拍出来。
close up.translation: 朋友：你这照片咋这么近 你：给脸来个特写 朋友：是特写镜头吗 你：对啊，拍出眼神 朋友：这样好看不 你：对，有情绪
close up.example: Friend: Why is this photo so close? You: A close-up on the face. Friend: Is it a close-up? You: Yeah, catch the eyes. Friend: Is it good-looking? You: Yes, emotional.

close-range reading.context: 你说眼睛累的时候，别凑太近看书，说这种近距离看，最伤视力。
close-range reading.translation: 朋友：你看书离这么近干嘛 你：凑得近才看得清 朋友：是近距离看书吗 你：对啊，伤眼睛 朋友：你得坐直了看 你：对，改
close-range reading.example: Friend: Why do you read so close? You: Only clear up close. Friend: Is it close-range reading? You: Yeah, hurts eyes. Friend: You must sit up straight. You: Yes, change.

clothing rental.context: 你说现在参加派对不想买新衣服，就租一件，说这种服装租赁，穿一次还回去就行。
clothing rental.translation: 朋友：你那礼服咋不买了 你：租一件 朋友：是服装租赁吗 你：对啊，穿完还 朋友：这样省钱不 你：对，省
clothing rental.example: Friend: Why don't you buy that gown? You: Rent one. Friend: Is it clothing rental? You: Yeah, return after wearing. Friend: Does this save money? You: Yes, saves.

cloud seeding.context: 你说天旱的时候，会往云里打炮催雨，说这种人工播云，是为了让庄稼别旱死。
cloud seeding.translation: 朋友：天上咋打炮 你：催雨 朋友：是人工播云吗 你：对啊，让庄稼别旱 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，有时候
cloud seeding.example: Friend: Why shoot cannons into the sky? You: To induce rain. Friend: Is it cloud seeding? You: Yeah, keep crops from drying. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, sometimes.

clued up.context: 你说他对这一带的馆子门儿清，说这种熟悉的人，最知道哪家好吃、哪家坑人。
clued up.translation: 朋友：你咋知道哪家好吃 你：他对这一片门儿清 朋友：是熟悉情况吗 你：对啊，哪家坑都知道 朋友：你跟他熟吗 你：对，熟
clued up.example: Friend: How do you know which is good? You: He's clued up about this area. Friend: Is he clued up? You: Yeah, knows which is a rip-off. Friend: Are you close to him? You: Yes, close.

clumps of hair.context: 你说他一梳头，梳子上就缠下一撮撮头发，说这种掉发，真是让人看着心慌。
clumps of hair.translation: 朋友：你梳子上咋这么多头发 你：一梳就掉一撮 朋友：是一撮撮头发吗 你：对啊，看着心慌 朋友：你去看医生没 你：对，去了
clumps of hair.example: Friend: Why so much hair on your comb? You: A tuft every time I comb. Friend: Are they clumps of hair? You: Yeah, scary to see. Friend: Did you see a doctor? You: Yes, did.

cluster algorithm.context: 你说做数据分析时，用那种聚类算法把相似的客户归成一类，说这样一看就能分群。
cluster algorithm.translation: 朋友：你咋把客户分的类 你：用聚类算法 朋友：是聚类算法吗 你：对啊，相似归一类 朋友：这算法好用不 你：对，好用
cluster algorithm.example: Friend: How did you group customers? You: Use a cluster algorithm. Friend: Is it a cluster algorithm? You: Yeah, similar grouped. Friend: Is this algorithm good? You: Yes, good.

coastal habitat.context: 你说那种在海边筑窝的水鸟，依赖的海岸居所一旦被破坏，它们就没地方住了。
coastal habitat.translation: 朋友：那水鸟住哪 你：靠海边那地方 朋友：是海岸居所吗 你：对啊，破坏了就没 朋友：现在保护得好吗 你：对，好
coastal habitat.example: Friend: Where does that water bird live? You: On the coastal habitat. Friend: Is it a coastal habitat? You: Yeah, no home if destroyed. Friend: Is it well protected now? You: Yes, well.

coastal metropolis.context: 你说像上海、深圳这种沿海大都市，一到晚上灯火通明，说这种城市，机会多但节奏也快。
coastal metropolis.translation: 朋友：你最想去哪个城市 你：上海那种沿海大都市 朋友：是沿海大都市吗 你：对啊，机会多 朋友：你觉得累不累 你：对，节奏快
coastal metropolis.example: Friend: Which city do you most want to go to? You: A coastal metropolis like Shanghai. Friend: Is it a coastal metropolis? You: Yeah, lots of opportunities. Friend: Do you think it's tiring? You: Yes, fast pace.

coastal water.context: 你说近海水域里的鱼越来越少，说这种过度捕捞，把海都掏空了。
coastal water.translation: 朋友：近海现在鱼多吗 你：越来越少 朋友：是近海水域吗 你：对啊，被捞空了 朋友：以后咋办 你：对，得休渔
coastal water.example: Friend: Are there many fish in coastal waters now? You: Fewer and fewer. Friend: Is it coastal water? You: Yeah, fished out. Friend: What then? You: Yes, must close fishing seasons.

cocoa bean.context: 你说巧克力是从那种小豆子磨出来的，说这种可可豆，发酵烘炒之后才香。
cocoa bean.translation: 朋友：巧克力咋做的 你：用那种小豆子磨 朋友：是可可豆吗 你：对啊，烘炒了才香 朋友：你爱吃巧克力不 你：对，爱吃
cocoa bean.example: Friend: How is chocolate made? You: Ground from those little beans. Friend: Are they cocoa beans? You: Yeah, roasted then fragrant. Friend: Do you love chocolate? You: Yes, love.

cocoa butter.context: 你说那种抹在皮肤上软软的油脂，就是可可脂，说它化了就是巧克力那种顺滑的口感。
cocoa butter.translation: 朋友：那软软的油是啥 你：是可可脂 朋友：是可可脂吗 你：对啊，化了就顺滑 朋友：它有啥用 你：对，做巧克力
cocoa butter.example: Friend: What is that soft fat? You: It's cocoa butter. Friend: Is it cocoa butter? You: Yeah, melts smooth. Friend: What is it used for? You: Yes, making chocolate.

coconut milk.context: 你说煮咖喱的时候倒一点椰奶，说这种椰奶一放，整锅就又香又浓。
coconut milk.translation: 朋友：你咖喱里加啥 你：倒点椰奶 朋友：是椰奶吗 你：对啊，又香又浓 朋友：这样好吃不 你：对，好吃
coconut milk.example: Friend: What do you put in your curry? You: Pour some coconut milk. Friend: Is it coconut milk? You: Yeah, fragrant and rich. Friend: Is this tasty? You: Yes, tasty.

coffee cultivar.context: 你说同样是咖啡豆，不同品种味道差很多，说这种咖啡品种的区别，内行一喝就尝得出来。
coffee cultivar.translation: 朋友：这咖啡喝着咋不一样 你：品种不同 朋友：是咖啡品种吗 你：对啊，内行一喝就知道 朋友：你分得出来吗 你：对，慢慢学
coffee cultivar.example: Friend: Why does this coffee taste different? You: Different cultivar. Friend: Is it a coffee cultivar? You: Yeah, experts taste it. Friend: Can you tell? You: Yes, learning.

cognitive ability.context: 你说老人最该练的就是认知能力，说脑子越用越灵，不用就会钝。
cognitive ability.translation: 朋友：老人该练啥 你：练认知能力 朋友：是认知能力吗 你：对啊，越用越灵 朋友：咋练 你：对，读书做题
cognitive ability.example: Friend: What should old people train? You: Cognitive ability. Friend: Is it cognitive ability? You: Yeah, use it or lose it. Friend: How to train? You: Yes, read and solve.

cognitive behaviour.context: 你说人要是老往坏处想，行为也跟着拧巴，说这种认知行为上的偏差，得一点点扭过来。
cognitive behaviour.translation: 朋友：他这毛病咋改 你：老往坏处想 朋友：是认知行为偏差吗 你：对啊，得扭过来 朋友：你能帮他不 你：对，慢慢帮
cognitive behaviour.example: Friend: How to change his problem? You: Always thinks the worst. Friend: Is it cognitive behaviour bias? You: Yeah, must turn it. Friend: Can you help him? You: Yes, slowly help.

cognitive behavioural therapy.context: 你说他焦虑到看了心理医生，医生用那种认知行为疗法，说几轮下来整个人轻松多了。
cognitive behavioural therapy.translation: 朋友：他焦虑看的啥 你：认知行为疗法 朋友：是那种疗法吗 你：对啊，几轮就轻松 朋友：这疗法管用不 你：对，管用
cognitive behavioural therapy.example: Friend: What did he see for anxiety? You: Cognitive behavioural therapy. Friend: Is it that therapy? You: Yeah, few sessions, lighter. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

cognitive benefit.context: 你说每天散步半小时，不光强身，还能让脑子更清楚，说这种健脑益处，是医生都推荐的。
cognitive benefit.translation: 朋友：散步有啥用 你：不光强身 朋友：是有健脑益处吗 你：对啊，脑子更清 朋友：医生推荐不 你：对，推荐
cognitive benefit.example: Friend: What use is walking? You: Not just fitness. Friend: Is there a cognitive benefit? You: Yeah, mind clearer. Friend: Do doctors recommend it? You: Yes, recommend.

cognitive bias.context: 你说人做决定时，常常被直觉带偏，说这种认知偏见，自己往往察觉不到。
cognitive bias.translation: 朋友：他咋老选错 你：被直觉带偏 朋友：是认知偏见吗 你：对啊，自己察觉不到 朋友：能改不 你：对，多反省
cognitive bias.example: Friend: Why does he always choose wrong? You: Led astray by intuition. Friend: Is it a cognitive bias? You: Yeah, can't notice. Friend: Can it change? You: Yes, reflect more.

cognitive boost.context: 你说一杯咖啡下肚，脑子立马清醒，说这种提升认知的效果，比什么都直接。
cognitive boost.translation: 朋友：你下午咋老喝咖啡 你：提提神 朋友：是提升认知吗 你：对啊，立马清醒 朋友：这样对身体好不 你：对，适量就好
cognitive boost.example: Friend: Why do you always drink coffee in the afternoon? You: Perk up. Friend: Is it a cognitive boost? You: Yeah, clear at once. Friend: Is this good for health? You: Yes, in moderation.

cognitive development.context: 你说小孩三岁前，大脑发育最快，说这时候多陪多逗，对他们的认知发育特别关键。
cognitive development.translation: 朋友：小孩多大最关键 你：三岁前大脑发育快 朋友：是认知发育吗 你：对啊，多陪多逗 朋友：你家孩子咋样 你：对，挺好
cognitive development.example: Friend: When are children most critical? You: Brain develops fastest before three. Friend: Is it cognitive development? You: Yeah, play and talk more. Friend: How is your child? You: Yes, fine.

cognitive exercise.context: 你说老人天天玩数独、背单词，说这种认知训练，能让脑子一直不生锈。
cognitive exercise.translation: 朋友：你爸妈咋老玩数独 你：在做认知训练 朋友：是认知训练吗 你：对啊，防生锈 朋友：管用不 你：对，管用
cognitive exercise.example: Friend: Why do your parents always do sudoku? You: Doing cognitive exercise. Friend: Is it cognitive exercise? You: Yeah, prevent rust. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

cognitive flexibility.context: 你说聪明的人能在不同任务之间来回切换，说这种认知灵活性，是可以练出来的。
cognitive flexibility.translation: 朋友：聪明人厉害在哪 你：能来回切换 朋友：是认知灵活性吗 你：对啊，能练 朋友：你咋练 你：对，多任务
cognitive flexibility.example: Friend: Where are smart people sharp? You: Switch between tasks. Friend: Is it cognitive flexibility? You: Yeah, can train. Friend: How do you train? You: Yes, multitask.

cognitive function.context: 你说上了年纪，记忆力、反应力这些认知功能都会慢慢退，说得多动脑才能保住。
cognitive function.translation: 朋友：老人最怕啥 你：记性反应变差 朋友：是认知功能下降吗 你：对啊，得多动脑 朋友：咋动脑 你：对，多社交
cognitive function.example: Friend: What do old people fear most? You: Memory and reactions declining. Friend: Is it cognitive function decline? You: Yeah, must use brain. Friend: How to use it? You: Yes, socialize more.

cognitive gain.context: 你说坚持学新东西几年，脑子明显比以前好使，说这种认知提升，是时间熬出来的。
cognitive gain.translation: 朋友：你这几年脑子咋这么快 你：一直学新东西 朋友：是认知提升吗 你：对啊，时间熬的 朋友：你学啥了 你：对，学语言
cognitive gain.example: Friend: Why is your mind so fast these years? You: Kept learning new things. Friend: Is it a cognitive gain? You: Yeah, earned by time. Friend: What did you learn? You: Yes, a language.

cognitive impairment.context: 你说有些老人记性越来越差，连家人都认不出，说这种认知障碍，得赶紧去查。
cognitive impairment.translation: 朋友：他咋连人都不认了 你：记性越来越差 朋友：是认知障碍吗 你：对啊，得赶紧查 朋友：严重不 你：对，得重视
cognitive impairment.example: Friend: Why can't he even recognize people? You: Memory getting worse. Friend: Is it cognitive impairment? You: Yeah, must check fast. Friend: Is it serious? You: Yes, must take seriously.

cognitive limitation.context: 你说人的脑子一次能装的东西有限，说这种认知局限性，谁也逃不掉。
cognitive limitation.translation: 朋友：你咋一次只记一件事 你：脑子装不下太多 朋友：是认知局限性吗 你：对啊，谁也逃不掉 朋友：那咋办 你：对，写下来
cognitive limitation.example: Friend: Why do you only remember one thing at a time? You: The brain can't hold much. Friend: Is it cognitive limitation? You: Yeah, nobody escapes. Friend: Then what? You: Yes, write it down.

cognitive load.context: 你说一边开会一边回消息，脑子转不过来，说这种认知负荷太大，最容易出错。
cognitive load.translation: 朋友：你今天咋老出错 你：一边开会一边回消息 朋友：是认知负荷太大吗 你：对啊，容易错 朋友：那你专心点 你：对，一件一件来
cognitive load.example: Friend: Why do you keep making mistakes today? You: Meeting while replying messages. Friend: Is the cognitive load too high? You: Yeah, easy to err. Friend: Then focus more. You: Yes, one thing at a time.

cognitive performance.context: 你说睡够了觉，第二天脑子转得快，说这种认知能力的状态，跟睡眠好坏直接挂钩。
cognitive performance.translation: 朋友：你今天咋反应这么快 你：昨晚睡够了 朋友：是认知状态好吗 你：对啊，跟睡觉有关 朋友：你昨晚几点睡 你：对，十点
cognitive performance.example: Friend: Why are you so sharp today? You: Slept enough last night. Friend: Is it good cognitive performance? You: Yeah, tied to sleep. Friend: What time did you sleep last night? You: Yes, ten.

cold dip.context: 你说天冷有人专门往冰水里跳，说这种冷水浴，说是能让人瞬间精神，但你看着都冷。
cold dip.translation: 朋友：他咋往冰水里跳 你：说是冷水浴 朋友：是冷水浴吗 你：对啊，跳完精神 朋友：你敢试不 你：对，不敢
cold dip.example: Friend: Why does he jump into icy water? You: Says it's a cold dip. Friend: Is it a cold dip? You: Yeah, energizing after. Friend: Dare you try it? You: Yes, don't dare.

cold hard cash.context: 你说做小买卖，最希望对方当场就给现钱，说这种冷硬现金，比赊账踏实多了。
cold hard cash.translation: 朋友：你做生意最爱啥 你：当场给现金 朋友：是冷硬现金吗 你：对啊，比赊账踏实 朋友：现在还有人给现金吗 你：对，有
cold hard cash.example: Friend: What do you love most in business? You: Cash on the spot. Friend: Is it cold hard cash? You: Yeah, more reassuring than credit. Friend: Do people still give cash now? You: Yes, do.

cold shock.context: 你说冬天一下扎进冷水，身子猛地一缩，说这种冷应激反应，是身体本能的自保。
cold shock.translation: 朋友：你一下水咋哆嗦 你：被冰得一缩 朋友：是冷应激反应吗 你：对啊，身体本能 朋友：你缓过来没 你：对，缓过来了
cold shock.example: Friend: Why do you shiver when you hit the water? You: Winced from the cold. Friend: Is it a cold shock? You: Yeah, body's instinct. Friend: Did you recover? You: Yes, recovered.

cold storage facility.context: 你说那种雪糕、冻肉都得存进专门的冷库，说这种冷库一断电，里面东西全得坏。
cold storage facility.translation: 朋友：雪糕都存哪 你：存进冷库 朋友：是冷库吗 你：对啊，断电就坏 朋友：你去过没 你：对，去过
cold storage facility.example: Friend: Where are the ice creams stored? You: In a cold storage facility. Friend: Is it a cold storage facility? You: Yeah, power cut and they spoil. Friend: Have you been? You: Yes, have.

cold temperature.context: 你说深海里那种低温环境，鱼都长得特别慢，说这种低温，是它们为了保命熬出来的。
cold temperature.translation: 朋友：深海鱼咋长这么慢 你：水太冷了 朋友：是低温环境吗 你：对啊，长得慢 朋友：这种鱼好吃不 你：对，鲜
cold temperature.example: Friend: Why do deep-sea fish grow so slowly? You: Water too cold. Friend: Is it a cold temperature? You: Yeah, grow slowly. Friend: Is this fish tasty? You: Yes, fresh.

cold weather.context: 你说一到冬天，这种严寒天气，出门不裹严实，鼻子都能冻掉。
cold weather.translation: 朋友：这几天咋这么冷 你：严寒天气来了 朋友：是严寒天气吗 你：对啊，不裹严冻鼻子 朋友：你咋穿的 你：对，裹成球
cold weather.example: Friend: Why is it so cold these days? You: Cold weather has come. Friend: Is it cold weather? You: Yeah, unprotected nose freezes. Friend: How are you dressed? You: Yes, bundled up.

cold-water swimming.context: 你说现在流行那种冬泳，说大冷天往湖里跳的人，说是越游越精神。
cold-water swimming.translation: 朋友：那湖里咋还有人游泳 你：在冬泳 朋友：是冷水游泳吗 你：对啊，越游越精神 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
cold-water swimming.example: Friend: Why are people still swimming in that lake? You: Cold-water swimming. Friend: Is it cold-water swimming? You: Yeah, more spirited. Friend: Do you admire them? You: Yes, admire.

collectible appeal.context: 你说那种老邮票，越存越值钱，说这种收藏价值，是它最吸引人的地方。
collectible appeal.translation: 朋友：那老邮票值钱不 你：越存越贵 朋友：是收藏价值吗 你：对啊，最吸引人 朋友：你有收藏没 你：对，集过
collectible appeal.example: Friend: Is that old stamp valuable? You: More valuable the longer kept. Friend: Is it collectible appeal? You: Yeah, most attractive. Friend: Do you collect? You: Yes, did.

collective bargaining.context: 你说工人要涨工资，不是一个个去谈，而是由工会代表大家集体谈判，说这种方式更有底气。
collective bargaining.translation: 朋友：工人涨工资咋谈 你：工会代表大家 朋友：是集体谈判吗 你：对啊，更有底气 朋友：谈成了吗 你：对，谈成了
collective bargaining.example: Friend: How do workers negotiate pay rises? You: The union represents everyone. Friend: Is it collective bargaining? You: Yeah, more clout. Friend: Did they get it? You: Yes, they did.

collective effort.context: 你说这个项目能成，靠的是一群人齐心协力，说这种集体努力，一个人再厉害也干不成。
collective effort.translation: 朋友：这项目咋成的 你：靠大家一起干 朋友：是集体努力吗 你：对啊，一个人干不成 朋友：你出了多少力 你：对，出了一份
collective effort.example: Friend: How did this project succeed? You: Everyone worked together. Friend: Is it collective effort? You: Yeah, one person can't. Friend: How much did you contribute? You: Yes, my share.

colour blindness.context: 你说他分不清红和绿，说这种色盲，开车的时候最危险。
colour blindness.translation: 朋友：他分不清红啥 你：红绿分不清 朋友：是色盲吗 你：对啊，开车危险 朋友：他有驾照不 你：对，有
colour blindness.example: Friend: What can't he tell apart, red and what? You: Can't tell red from green. Friend: Is it colour blindness? You: Yeah, dangerous driving. Friend: Does he have a license? You: Yes, does.

colouring book.context: 你说现在成年人也流行那种涂色本，说拿着彩笔慢慢涂，涂完心里特别静。
colouring book.translation: 朋友：你买那本子干啥 你：涂色玩 朋友：是涂色本吗 你：对啊，涂完心静 朋友：你多大了还玩 你：对，减压
colouring book.example: Friend: What is that book you bought for? You: Colouring in. Friend: Is it a colouring book? You: Yeah, calm after colouring. Friend: How old are you to still play? You: Yes, de-stress.

combat loneliness.context: 你说独居老人最怕孤单，说这种时候，多出去跟人聊聊天，才排得开那份冷清。
combat loneliness.translation: 朋友：独居老人最愁啥 你：孤单 朋友：是排解孤单吗 你：对啊，多出去聊 朋友：你爸妈出去不 你：对，天天出去
combat loneliness.example: Friend: What do seniors living alone fear most? You: Loneliness. Friend: Is it combating loneliness? You: Yeah, go out and chat. Friend: Do your parents go out? You: Yes, daily.

combat prejudice.context: 你说那种拿身材说事的偏见，就得有人站出来反对，说这种对抗，才能慢慢改变风气。
combat prejudice.translation: 朋友：那些偏见咋破 你：有人站出来反对 朋友：是对抗偏见吗 你：对啊，改变风气 朋友：你敢站出来不 你：对，敢
combat prejudice.example: Friend: How to break those prejudices? You: Someone stands against. Friend: Is it combating prejudice? You: Yeah, change the trend. Friend: Dare you stand out? You: Yes, dare.

combat stress.context: 你说工作压力一大，就得多出去走走，说这种缓解，是给自己松松弦。
combat stress.translation: 朋友：你压力大咋调节 你：出去走走 朋友：是缓解压力吗 你：对啊，松松弦 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
combat stress.example: Friend: How do you cope with big stress? You: Go out for walks. Friend: Is it combating stress? You: Yeah, loosen the string. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

combined approach.context: 你说光靠跑步不行，还得配上控制饮食，说这种综合方案，减得才稳。
combined approach.translation: 朋友：你减肥用啥法 你：跑步加控制吃 朋友：是综合方案吗 你：对啊，减得稳 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
combined approach.example: Friend: What method do you use to lose weight? You: Running plus diet control. Friend: Is it a combined approach? You: Yeah, steady loss. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

combined with.context: 你说这个成绩，是他天分加上努力换来的，说这种结合，才让他走到今天。
combined with.translation: 朋友：他咋这么厉害 你：天分加努力 朋友：是结合在一起吗 你：对啊，走到今天 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
combined with.example: Friend: Why is he so good? You: Talent combined with effort. Friend: Is it combined with? You: Yeah, got here. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

come a long way.context: 你说他这几年变化真大，从一个毛头小子变成了稳重的人，说这种进步，真是走了很远。
come a long way.translation: 朋友：他这几年咋变这么大 你：从毛头小子变稳了 朋友：是进步很大吗 你：对啊，走了很远 朋友：你咋看出来的 你：对，看他做事
come a long way.example: Friend: Why has he changed so much these years? You: From a boy to steady. Friend: Has he come a long way? You: Yeah, far. Friend: How can you tell? You: Yes, watch what he does.

come alive.context: 你说那本书一翻开，那些人物就像活了一样，说这种鲜活的描写，最能把人拉进故事里。
come alive.translation: 朋友：那书好看在哪 你：人物像活了 朋友：是故事鲜活吗 你：对啊，被拉进故事 朋友：你读完没 你：对，读完了
come alive.example: Friend: What makes that book good? You: Characters seem alive. Friend: Does the story come alive? You: Yeah, pulled into the story. Friend: Did you finish it? You: Yes, did.

come all the way.context: 你说朋友从几百公里外专门跑来看你，说这种远道而来的心意，比什么都珍贵。
come all the way.translation: 朋友：他咋大老远跑来了 你：专程来看我 朋友：是远道而来吗 你：对啊，心意珍贵 朋友：你请他吃饭没 你：对，请了
come all the way.example: Friend: Why did he come from so far? You: On purpose to see me. Friend: Did he come all the way? You: Yeah, his heart is precious. Friend: Did you treat him to a meal? You: Yes, did.

come and go.context: 你说那些流行玩意儿，总是来了又走，说这种转瞬即逝的潮流，追也追不完。
come and go.translation: 朋友：那些流行咋老变 你：来了又走 朋友：是转瞬即逝吗 你：对啊，追不完 朋友：你追不追 你：对，不追
come and go.example: Friend: Why do those trends always change? You: Come and go. Friend: Do they come and go? You: Yeah, endless chase. Friend: Do you chase them? You: Yes, don't.

come apart at the seams.context: 你说他连轴转了一个月，整个人快撑不住，说这种濒临崩溃的状态，谁看了都心疼。
come apart at the seams.translation: 朋友：他最近状态咋这么差 你：连轴转了一个月 朋友：是快崩溃了吗 你：对啊，撑不住 朋友：你劝他休息没 你：对，劝过
come apart at the seams.example: Friend: Why is his state so poor lately? You: Non-stop for a month. Friend: Is he coming apart at the seams? You: Yeah, can't hold on. Friend: Did you tell him to rest? You: Yes, have.

come around.context: 你说他昏了好一会儿才醒过来，说这种慢慢缓过来的过程，让人捏了一把汗。
come around.translation: 朋友：他刚才咋晕了 你：过会儿才醒 朋友：是慢慢苏醒吗 你：对啊，让人捏汗 朋友：他现在好点没 你：对，好点了
come around.example: Friend: Why did he faint just now? You: Came around after a while. Friend: Did he come around? You: Yeah, made one sweat. Friend: Is he better now? You: Yes, better.

come as a surprise.context: 你说他突然宣布要辞职，说这种出人意料的决定，把大家都惊到了。
come as a surprise.translation: 朋友：他辞职大家啥反应 你：全惊呆了 朋友：是出人意料吗 你：对啊，谁也没想到 朋友：你问他为啥没 你：对，问了
come as a surprise.example: Friend: How did everyone react to his resignation? You: All stunned. Friend: Did it come as a surprise? You: Yeah, nobody thought. Friend: Did you ask why? You: Yes, did.

come at a cost.context: 你说这份成功是拿健康换的，说这种代价，再风光也补不回来。
come at a cost.translation: 朋友：他这成功咋来的 你：拿健康换的 朋友：是有代价吗 你：对啊，补不回来 朋友：他后悔不 你：对，后悔
come at a cost.example: Friend: How did his success come? You: Traded health for it. Friend: Does it come at a cost? You: Yeah, can't make up. Friend: Does he regret it? You: Yes, regrets.

come at a price.context: 你说天上不会掉馅饼，说这种好事，背后一定标着一个价，得想想才拿。
come at a price.translation: 朋友：这便宜能占吗 你：背后有价 朋友：是有代价吗 你：对啊，得想才拿 朋友：你拿不拿 你：对，不拿
come at a price.example: Friend: Can I take this bargain? You: There's a price behind. Friend: Does it come at a price? You: Yeah, think before taking. Friend: Will you take it? You: Yes, won't.

come back with.context: 你说问他咋想的，他半天回了一句，说这种回应，让人摸不着头脑。
come back with.translation: 朋友：他咋回你的 你：半天回了一句 朋友：是这样回应吗 你：对啊，摸不着头脑 朋友：你追着问没 你：对，问了
come back with.example: Friend: How did he reply? You: Replied one line after a while. Friend: Did he come back with that? You: Yeah, puzzling. Friend: Did you press him? You: Yes, did.

come down to.context: 你说大家争来争去，最后其实就一句话，说归根结底，还是钱的事。
come down to.translation: 朋友：你们争半天争啥 你：还是钱 朋友：是归根结底吗 你：对啊，钱的事 朋友：那咋解决 你：对，谈钱
come down to.example: Friend: What were you arguing about for so long? You: Still money. Friend: Does it all come down to? You: Yeah, money. Friend: How to solve it? You: Yes, talk money.

come in many forms.context: 你说孤独这种事，有好多种样子，说一个人待着是孤独，在人群里也可能孤独。
come in many forms.translation: 朋友：孤独是啥样 你：有好多种 朋友：是有多种形式吗 你：对啊，一个人或在人群里 朋友：你体会过吗 你：对，体会过
come in many forms.example: Friend: What is loneliness like? You: It comes in many forms. Friend: Does it come in many forms? You: Yeah, alone or in a crowd. Friend: Have you felt it? You: Yes, have.

come in useful.context: 你说你带的那把伞，今天下大雨派上了用场，说这种时候，备着点东西总没错。
come in useful.translation: 朋友：你今天咋没淋着 你：带了伞 朋友：是派上用场了吗 你：对啊，下大雨 朋友：你咋想到带伞 你：对，看了天气预报
come in useful.example: Friend: Why didn't you get wet today? You: Brought an umbrella. Friend: Did it come in useful? You: Yeah, heavy rain. Friend: Why did you think to bring it? You: Yes, checked the forecast.

come into.context: 你说他一毕业就继承了一笔家产，说这种好运气，是别人求都求不来的。
come into.translation: 朋友：他咋刚毕业就有钱 你：继承了家产 朋友：是得到家产吗 你：对啊，求不来的运气 朋友：你羡慕不 你：对，羡慕
come into.example: Friend: Why is he rich right after graduation? You: Inherited a family fortune. Friend: Did he come into it? You: Yeah, luck you can't ask for. Friend: Do you envy him? You: Yes, envy.

come into the picture.context: 你说这事本来跟你没关系，可后来你也被牵了进去，说这种被牵涉进来，想躲都躲不掉。
come into the picture.translation: 朋友：这事跟你有关吗 你：本来无关 朋友：后来是被牵涉了吗 你：对啊，躲不掉 朋友：你后悔不 你：对，有点
come into the picture.example: Friend: Is this related to you? You: Not originally. Friend: Did you come into the picture? You: Yeah, can't avoid. Friend: Do you regret it? You: Yes, a bit.

come out of one's shell.context: 你说他以前不爱说话，这两年慢慢开朗了，说这种走出封闭的变化，让人看着高兴。
come out of one's shell.translation: 朋友：他咋变开朗了 你：慢慢走出来 朋友：是变得开朗了吗 你：对啊，让人高兴 朋友：你帮过他没 你：对，陪他聊
come out of one's shell.example: Friend: Why has he become more outgoing? You: Slowly came out. Friend: Did he come out of his shell? You: Yeah, makes people happy. Friend: Did you help him? You: Yes, chatted with him.

come out with.context: 你说那家店忽然推出一款新品，说这种说出来就卖的打法，让老顾客都眼前一亮。
come out with.translation: 朋友：那店最近有啥新 你：推了款新品 朋友：是推出新品吗 你：对啊，让人眼前一亮 朋友：你尝了没 你：对，尝了
come out with.example: Friend: What's new at that shop lately? You: Came out with a new item. Friend: Did they come out with it? You: Yeah, eyes light up. Friend: Did you try it? You: Yes, did.

come to life.context: 你说一到晚上，那条老街就热闹起来，说这种充满活力的样子，最有烟火气。
come to life.translation: 朋友：那老街晚上咋样 你：一下就热闹 朋友：是充满活力吗 你：对啊，有烟火气 朋友：你爱去不 你：对，爱去
come to life.example: Friend: How is that old street at night? You: Comes alive at once. Friend: Does it come to life? You: Yeah, full of everyday life. Friend: Do you love going? You: Yes, love.

come to light.context: 你说那桩旧案过了好多年，真相才慢慢露出来，说这种大白于天下，来得晚但总来了。
come to light.translation: 朋友：那旧案咋翻出来了 你：真相露出来了 朋友：是真相大白吗 你：对啊，晚但来了 朋友：你咋看 你：对，该来的来
come to light.example: Friend: Why did that old case resurface? You: The truth came to light. Friend: Did it come to light? You: Yeah, late but came. Friend: How do you see it? You: Yes, what should come.

come to one's rescue.context: 你说你正愁得没办法，朋友突然过来帮你一把，说这种解围，真是雪中送炭。
come to one's rescue.translation: 朋友：你那天咋解决的 你：朋友来帮的 朋友：是来解围吗 你：对啊，雪中送炭 朋友：你谢人家没 你：对，请吃饭
come to one's rescue.example: Friend: How did you solve it that day? You: A friend came to help. Friend: Did they come to your rescue? You: Yeah, timely help. Friend: Did you thank them? You: Yes, treated to a meal.

come under fire.context: 你说那家产品出了问题，被网友一通骂，说这种受到批评，商家得赶紧回应。
come under fire.translation: 朋友：那商家最近咋了 你：被网友骂 朋友：是受到批评吗 你：对啊，得回应 朋友：它回应了没 你：对，回应了
come under fire.example: Friend: What happened to that shop lately? You: Criticized by netizens. Friend: Did it come under fire? You: Yeah, must respond. Friend: Did it respond? You: Yes, did.

comedic effect.context: 你说那种喜剧片，靠一句包袱把人逗得直乐，说这种喜剧效果，是它最值钱的地方。
comedic effect.translation: 朋友：那喜剧片好看在哪 你：包袱多 朋友：是喜剧效果吗 你：对啊，最值钱 朋友：你笑了没 你：对，笑了
comedic effect.example: Friend: What makes that comedy good? You: Lots of punchlines. Friend: Is it comedic effect? You: Yeah, most valuable. Friend: Did you laugh? You: Yes, did.

comes as a result of.context: 你说他现在身体差，全是当年熬出来的，说这种结果，是长期攒下来的。
comes as a result of.translation: 朋友：他身体咋这么差 你：当年熬出来的 朋友：是由熬夜引起的吗 你：对啊，长期攒的 朋友：他后悔不 你：对，后悔
comes as a result of.example: Friend: Why is his health so poor? You: Earned through those late nights. Friend: Does it come as a result of? You: Yeah, long-term buildup. Friend: Does he regret it? You: Yes, regrets.

comes through.context: 你说那场大灾，他硬是挺了过来，说这种安然度过的经历，让他整个人都变了。
comes through.translation: 朋友：他咋熬过来的 你：硬是挺过来 朋友：是挺过来了吗 你：对啊，人变了 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
comes through.example: Friend: How did he get through that disaster? You: Came through it. Friend: Did he come through? You: Yeah, changed. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

comfort animal.context: 你说有焦虑的人养一只温顺的猫，说这种陪伴的动物，能让人心里踏实不少。
comfort animal.translation: 朋友：他养那猫干啥 你：陪着他 朋友：是陪伴动物吗 你：对啊，让人踏实 朋友：猫管用不 你：对，管用
comfort animal.example: Friend: Why does he keep that cat? You: To keep him company. Friend: Is it a comfort animal? You: Yeah, makes people steady. Friend: Does the cat work? You: Yes, works.

comfort blanket.context: 你说小孩走到哪都要抱着那条旧毯子，说这种安抚物，是他心里最踏实的寄托。
comfort blanket.translation: 朋友：那孩子咋老抱个毯子 你：是他的安抚物 朋友：是心灵慰藉物吗 你：对啊，抱着踏实 朋友：毯子旧了咋办 你：对，洗了接着抱
comfort blanket.example: Friend: Why does that child always hold a blanket? You: It's his comfort blanket. Friend: Is it a comfort blanket? You: Yeah, feels safe holding it. Friend: What when the blanket gets old? You: Yes, wash and keep holding.

comfort eat.context: 你说她一不开心就狂吃甜品，说这种情绪化进食，越吃越胖，还解不了愁。
comfort eat.translation: 朋友：她一难受就吃啥 你：狂吃甜品 朋友：是情绪化进食吗 你：对啊，越吃越胖 朋友：你劝她没 你：对，劝过
comfort eat.example: Friend: What does she eat when upset? You: Binge sweets. Friend: Is it comfort eating? You: Yeah, fatter the more. Friend: Did you advise her? You: Yes, have.

comfort food.context: 你说一到冬天，就想念妈妈做的那碗热汤面，说这种慰藉美食，吃的不只是味道，是回忆。
comfort food.translation: 朋友：你冬天最爱吃啥 你：妈妈做的汤面 朋友：是慰藉美食吗 你：对啊，吃的是回忆 朋友：你自己做得出不 你：对，做不出
comfort food.example: Friend: What do you love most in winter? You: Mom's hot noodle soup. Friend: Is it comfort food? You: Yeah, eating memory. Friend: Can you make it yourself? You: Yes, can't.

coming apart at the seams.context: 你说那个团队人心涣散，眼看就要散架，说这种分崩离析的局面，谁也救不回来。
coming apart at the seams.translation: 朋友：那团队咋了 你：人心散了 朋友：是分崩离析吗 你：对啊，救不回 朋友：你咋看 你：对，可惜
coming apart at the seams.example: Friend: What happened to that team? You: Morale fell apart. Friend: Is it coming apart at the seams? You: Yeah, can't save. Friend: How do you see it? You: Yes, pity.

coming out of.context: 你说他那些好主意，都是从一段苦日子里熬出来的，说这种经历过后，人就不一样了。
coming out of.translation: 朋友：他那主意咋来的 你：从苦日子里熬的 朋友：是从经历中出来的吗 你：对啊，人不一样 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
coming out of.example: Friend: Where did his good ideas come from? You: Emerging from hard times. Friend: Are they coming out of? You: Yeah, people change. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

commercial gain.context: 你说他做这一行，主要是为了那份商业收益，说情怀再好，也得先赚钱。
commercial gain.translation: 朋友：他干这行图啥 你：图商业收益 朋友：是商业收益吗 你：对啊，得先赚钱 朋友：你理解他不 你：对，理解
commercial gain.example: Friend: What does he get out of this line? You: Commercial gain. Friend: Is it commercial gain? You: Yeah, money first. Friend: Do you understand him? You: Yes, understand.

commercial production.context: 你说那种手工做的杯子，一个卖好几百，说一旦量产出货，价格立马就下来。
commercial production.translation: 朋友：那杯子咋不贵了 你：量产了 朋友：是量产吗 你：对啊，一下便宜 朋友：质量一样吗 你：对，差不多
commercial production.example: Friend: Why did that cup get cheap? You: It went into commercial production. Friend: Is it commercial production? You: Yeah, suddenly cheap. Friend: Is the quality the same? You: Yes, about.

commercial rent.context: 你说那家店位置好，可商业租金也高，说这种房租，把利润都吃掉一大半。
commercial rent.translation: 朋友：那店位置好吗 你：好，但房租贵 朋友：是商业租金吗 你：对啊，吃掉利润 朋友：老板赚不赚 你：对，勉强
commercial rent.example: Friend: Is that shop in a good location? You: Yes, but rent high. Friend: Is it commercial rent? You: Yeah, eats profit. Friend: Does the owner make money? You: Yes, barely.

commercial success.context: 你说那部电影不光叫好，还卖座，说这种商业上的成功，是每个导演都盼的。
commercial success.translation: 朋友：那电影咋样 你：又叫好又叫座 朋友：是商业成功吗 你：对啊，导演都盼 朋友：你看了没 你：对，看了
commercial success.example: Friend: How is that movie? You: Praised and box office hit. Friend: Is it commercial success? You: Yeah, every director wants. Friend: Did you see it? You: Yes, did.

commercially minded.context: 你说他满脑子都是怎么赚钱，说这种有商业思维的人，走到哪都能发现商机。
commercially minded.translation: 朋友：他咋老想着赚钱 你：有商业头脑 朋友：是有商业思维吗 你：对啊，到处发现商机 朋友：你学得来不 你：对，学不来
commercially minded.example: Friend: Why does he always think about making money? You: Commercially minded. Friend: Is he commercially minded? You: Yeah, finds opportunities everywhere. Friend: Can you learn it? You: Yes, can't.

commiserate with.context: 你说朋友失业那段时间，你天天陪他聊天，说这种同情感，比给钱还管用。
commiserate with.translation: 朋友：他失业你咋陪的 你：天天陪他聊 朋友：是同情他吗 你：对啊，比给钱管用 朋友：他缓过来没 你：对，缓过来了
commiserate with.example: Friend: How did you keep him company when unemployed? You: Chatted daily. Friend: Did you commiserate with him? You: Yeah, more useful than money. Friend: Did he recover? You: Yes, did.

common condition.context: 你说嗓子干、咳嗽，是换季时最常见的小毛病，说这种常见状况，多喝热水就好。
common condition.translation: 朋友：你嗓子咋了 你：换季嗓子干 朋友：是常见状况吗 你：对啊，多喝热水 朋友：你喝了没 你：对，喝了
common condition.example: Friend: What's wrong with your throat? You: Dry throat in season change. Friend: Is it a common condition? You: Yeah, drink more hot water. Friend: Did you drink? You: Yes, did.

common issue.context: 你说电脑死机、软件卡顿，是上班族天天碰到的常见问题，说这种毛病，重启多半能好。
common issue.translation: 朋友：你电脑又咋了 你：卡死了 朋友：是常见问题吗 你：对啊，重启就好 朋友：你习惯没 你：对，习惯了
common issue.example: Friend: What's wrong with your computer again? You: Froze. Friend: Is it a common issue? You: Yeah, restart fixes. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

commonly held belief.context: 你说大家都以为这事很简单，说这种普遍看法，往往跟真实情况差得远。
commonly held belief.translation: 朋友：大家都咋想这事 你：以为很简单 朋友：是普遍看法吗 你：对啊，差得远 朋友：真实情况是啥 你：对，难得很
commonly held belief.example: Friend: What does everyone think about this? You: Think it's simple. Friend: Is it a commonly held belief? You: Yeah, far from truth. Friend: What's the truth? You: Yes, very hard.

communal living.context: 你说年轻人现在流行几个人合租一栋大房子，说这种公共生活，既省钱又热闹。
communal living.translation: 朋友：你现在咋住的 你：跟人合租大房子 朋友：是公共生活吗 你：对啊，省钱又热闹 朋友：你住得惯吗 你：对，习惯了
communal living.example: Friend: How do you live now? You: Sharing a big house with others. Friend: Is it communal living? You: Yeah, cheap and lively. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

commune with nature.context: 你说周末就想去山里走走，说那种跟山水待在一起的感觉，最能让心静下来。
commune with nature.translation: 朋友：你周末咋安排 你：去山里走走 朋友：是亲近自然吗 你：对啊，心静 朋友：你一人去还是结伴 你：对，一人
commune with nature.example: Friend: How do you plan your weekend? You: Walk in the mountains. Friend: Are you communing with nature? You: Yeah, mind calms. Friend: Alone or with others? You: Yes, alone.

communicative ability.context: 你说他这人不会说话，明明是好意，一开口就得罪人，说这种表达能力，是得好好练。
communicative ability.translation: 朋友：他咋老得罪人 你：不会说话 朋友：是表达能力差吗 你：对啊，一开口就错 朋友：他能练出来不 你：对，慢慢练
communicative ability.example: Friend: Why does he always offend people? You: Can't speak. Friend: Is his communicative ability poor? You: Yeah, wrong as soon as he opens. Friend: Can he train it? You: Yes, slowly.

community bonds.context: 你说一个住了几十年的老小区，街坊邻居互相认识，说这种社区纽带，是新小区比不了的。
community bonds.translation: 朋友：你那小区咋样 你：邻居都熟 朋友：是社区纽带吗 你：对啊，新小区比不了 朋友：你住得惯吗 你：对，惯了
community bonds.example: Friend: How is your community? You: Neighbors all know each other. Friend: Is it community bonds? You: Yeah, new ones can't match. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

community care.context: 你说老人不一定非要住养老院，说那种在社区里就地养老的照护，更让人安心。
community care.translation: 朋友：你爸妈咋养老 你：在社区里 朋友：是社区养老吗 你：对啊，更安心 朋友：他们习惯不 你：对，习惯了
community care.example: Friend: How do your parents age? You: In the community. Friend: Is it community care? You: Yeah, more reassuring. Friend: Are they used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

community hub.context: 你说那条街上开了个书吧，说这种社区枢纽，是附近老人小孩最爱去的地方。
community hub.translation: 朋友：那书吧开得咋样 你：老人小孩都爱去 朋友：是社区枢纽吗 你：对啊，聚人的地方 朋友：你去过没 你：对，去过
community hub.example: Friend: How is that book bar doing? You: Old and young all love it. Friend: Is it a community hub? You: Yeah, a gathering spot. Friend: Have you been? You: Yes, have.

community spirit.context: 你说小区一有啥事，大家都搭把手，说这种互助精神，让住在这里的人心里暖。
community spirit.translation: 朋友：你们小区人咋样 你：都爱帮忙 朋友：是互助精神吗 你：对啊，心里暖 朋友：你帮过别人没 你：对，帮过
community spirit.example: Friend: How are the people in your community? You: All love to help. Friend: Is it community spirit? You: Yeah, warm heart. Friend: Have you helped others? You: Yes, have.

commute by public transport.context: 你说他每天坐地铁上下班，说这种公交通勤，比开车省心还省钱。
commute by public transport.translation: 朋友：他咋上班 你：坐地铁 朋友：是坐公交通勤吗 你：对啊，省心省钱 朋友：他抱怨过没 你：对，抱怨过人多
commute by public transport.example: Friend: How does he go to work? You: By subway. Friend: Does he commute by public transport? You: Yeah, easy and cheap. Friend: Has he complained? You: Yes, about crowds.

commute cost.context: 你说住得远，每天上下班的成本算下来，一年也是一大笔钱，说这种通勤成本，真不低。
commute cost.translation: 朋友：你住远了咋办 你：每天上下班花钱 朋友：是通勤成本吗 你：对啊，一年一大笔 朋友：你算过没 你：对，算过
commute cost.example: Friend: What if you live far? You: Spend daily on the commute. Friend: Is it commute cost? You: Yeah, a big sum a year. Friend: Have you calculated? You: Yes, have.

commute expense.context: 你说天天打车上下班，这种通勤开销，比工资涨得还快，说再这样下去吃不消。
commute expense.translation: 朋友：你天天打车咋受的了 你：开销比工资涨得快 朋友：是通勤开销吗 你：对啊，吃不消 朋友：你改坐地铁没 你：对，改了
commute expense.example: Friend: How can you afford daily taxis? You: The expense rises faster than pay. Friend: Is it commute expense? You: Yeah, can't take it. Friend: Did you switch to the subway? You: Yes, did.

commuting nightmares.context: 你说早高峰挤地铁，人贴人连个扶手都抓不着，说这种通勤噩梦，谁经历谁知道。
commuting nightmares.translation: 朋友：早高峰地铁啥样 你：人贴人 朋友：是通勤噩梦吗 你：对啊，抓不着扶手 朋友：你咋熬过来 你：对，习惯了
commuting nightmares.example: Friend: What's the subway like in rush hour? You: Body to body. Friend: Are they commuting nightmares? You: Yeah, can't grab a rail. Friend: How do you survive? You: Yes, used to it.

compact camera.context: 你说现在出门就带个小卡片机，说这种便携相机，比大单反轻便多了。
compact camera.translation: 朋友：你现在用啥相机 你：带个小卡片机 朋友：是便携相机吗 你：对啊，轻便 朋友：它拍得清不 你：对，够用
