compact camera.example: Friend: What camera do you use now? You: A compact camera. Friend: Is it a compact camera? You: Yeah, lightweight. Friend: Does it take clear shots? You: Yes, enough.

compact disc.context: 你说抽屉里还存着一摞老CD，说这种光盘，现在年轻人都没见过。
compact disc.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里那是啥 你：一摞老CD 朋友：是CD光盘吗 你：对啊，年轻人没见过 朋友：还能放不 你：对，能放
compact disc.example: Friend: What is that in your drawer? You: A stack of old CDs. Friend: Are they compact discs? You: Yeah, young people haven't seen. Friend: Do they still play? You: Yes, do.

company bandwidth.context: 你说公司今年人手不够，说这种带宽不足，什么活都堆着干不完。
company bandwidth.translation: 朋友：你们今年咋这么忙 你：人手不够 朋友：是公司带宽不够吗 你：对啊，活堆着干不完 朋友：招人没 你：对，在招
company bandwidth.example: Friend: Why are you so busy this year? You: Not enough staff. Friend: Is company bandwidth lacking? You: Yeah, work piles up. Friend: Are you hiring? You: Yes, hiring.

company culture.context: 你说找工作不光看工资，还得看跟公司文化合不合，说这种文化适配，干久了才舒服。
company culture.translation: 朋友：你换工作看啥 你：看文化合不合 朋友：是企业文化适配吗 你：对啊，干久了舒服 朋友：你遇到合的没 你：对，遇到了
company culture.example: Friend: What do you look for when changing jobs? You: Whether the culture fits. Friend: Is it company culture fit? You: Yeah, comfortable long term. Friend: Have you found a fit? You: Yes, have.

comparative developmental psychology.context: 你说他研究小孩是怎么长大的，还拿不同年龄段来对比，说这门学科，就是比较发展心理学。
comparative developmental psychology.translation: 朋友：他研究啥的 你：小孩咋长大 朋友：是比较发展心理学吗 你：对啊，拿年龄对比 朋友：这学科有意思不 你：对，有意思
comparative developmental psychology.example: Friend: What does he research? You: How children grow. Friend: Is it comparative developmental psychology? You: Yeah, compare by age. Friend: Is this subject interesting? You: Yes, interesting.

compare prices.context: 你说买大件之前，总得在几个平台上比比价，说这种货比三家，才不花冤枉钱。
compare prices.translation: 朋友：你买那电器咋买的 你：比了好几个价 朋友：是比价吗 你：对啊，不花冤枉钱 朋友：你省了多少 你：对，省了几百
compare prices.example: Friend: How did you buy that appliance? You: Compared prices on several. Friend: Did you compare prices? You: Yeah, no wasted money. Friend: How much did you save? You: Yes, saved hundreds.

compete for.context: 你说十几个候选人争一个名额，说这种激烈角逐，真得拿出真本事才行。
compete for.translation: 朋友：那岗位难进吗 你：十几个人争一个 朋友：是角逐名额吗 你：对啊，得有真本事 朋友：你争上没 你：对，没争上
compete for.example: Friend: Is that job hard to get? You: Ten-plus people fight for one spot. Friend: Do they compete for it? You: Yeah, need real skill. Friend: Did you get it? You: Yes, didn't.

competitive gaming.context: 你说现在年轻人打游戏不光图乐，还能打职业比赛，说这种竞技网游，打得好真能当饭吃。
competitive gaming.translation: 朋友：他打游戏能当饭吃吗 你：能打职业赛 朋友：是竞技网游吗 你：对啊，打得好就行 朋友：你觉得靠谱不 你：对，少数行
competitive gaming.example: Friend: Can he make a living playing games? You: Can play pro matches. Friend: Is it competitive gaming? You: Yeah, good play pays. Friend: Do you think it's reliable? You: Yes, few make it.

competitive mindset.context: 你说他一上场就想着赢，说这种求胜的竞争思维，是他打比赛最关键的东西。
competitive mindset.translation: 朋友：他打比赛咋这么拼 你：一上场就想赢 朋友：是竞争思维吗 你：对啊，拼劲足 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
competitive mindset.example: Friend: Why does he play so hard? You: Wants to win the moment he steps on. Friend: Is it a competitive mindset? You: Yeah, full of drive. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

complete with.context: 你说那间新房子，家具、家电全配齐，说这种带全家伙计的房子，拎包就能住。
complete with.translation: 朋友：那房子能直接住吗 你：家具家电都齐 朋友：是配有吗 你：对啊，拎包就住 朋友：这样方便不 你：对，方便
complete with.example: Friend: Can you live in that flat right away? You: Furnished and appliances all in. Friend: Is it complete with? You: Yeah, move in with bags. Friend: Is this convenient? You: Yes, convenient.

compress into.context: 你说那一大摞文件，被他压缩成一个小U盘，说这种压缩，省了一大半地方。
compress into.translation: 朋友：那堆文件咋带的 你：压成一个U盘 朋友：是压缩成吗 你：对啊，省地方 朋友：打开麻烦不 你：对，不麻烦
compress into.example: Friend: How did you carry that pile of files? You: Compressed into a USB. Friend: Is it compressed into? You: Yeah, saves space. Friend: Is opening it troublesome? You: Yes, not.

comprise of.context: 你说这个小组，是由五个不同专业的人组成的，说这种组合，正好啥活都能干。
comprise of.translation: 朋友：你们小组几个人 你：五个不同专业 朋友：是由组成吗 你：对啊，啥都能干 朋友：配合得好吗 你：对，挺好
comprise of.example: Friend: How many in your group? You: Five different majors. Friend: Is it comprised of? You: Yeah, can do anything. Friend: Do you cooperate well? You: Yes, fine.

compulsory break.context: 你说连续开了三小时会，公司规定每小时必须休息一次，说这种强制休息，其实是帮大家缓一缓。
compulsory break.translation: 朋友：你们会咋老打断 你：规定一小时休息 朋友：是强制休息吗 你：对啊，缓一缓 朋友：这规定好吗 你：对，好
compulsory break.example: Friend: Why is your meeting always interrupted? You: Mandatory break every hour. Friend: Is it a compulsory break? You: Yeah, a breather. Friend: Is this rule good? You: Yes, good.

compulsory education.context: 你说小孩到了六岁就得上学，说这种义务教育，是每个孩子都躲不开的。
compulsory education.translation: 朋友：小孩几岁上学 你：六岁 朋友：是义务教育吗 你：对啊，躲不开 朋友：家里能不让上吗 你：对，不能
compulsory education.example: Friend: At what age do kids start school? You: Six. Friend: Is it compulsory education? You: Yeah, can't avoid. Friend: Can families keep them home? You: Yes, can't.

concerned with.context: 你说他这人做事，最关心的是别人开不开心，说他老忙着顾及旁人的感受。
concerned with.translation: 朋友：他最在意啥 你：别人开不开心 朋友：是关心别人吗 你：对啊，老顾及旁人 朋友：你觉得这样累不 你：对，有点累
concerned with.example: Friend: What does he care about most? You: Whether others are happy. Friend: Is he concerned with others? You: Yeah, always mindful. Friend: Do you think it's tiring? You: Yes, a bit.

concession stand.context: 你说球场边上那种卖热狗饮料的小摊，说这种小吃摊，看球时来一根最过瘾。
concession stand.translation: 朋友：球场边那小摊卖啥 你：热狗饮料 朋友：是小吃摊吗 你：对啊，看球来一根 朋友：贵不贵 你：对，贵但爽
concession stand.example: Friend: What does that stall by the stadium sell? You: Hot dogs and drinks. Friend: Is it a concession stand? You: Yeah, one during the game. Friend: Is it expensive? You: Yes, pricey but great.

conduct a survey.context: 你说为了搞清楚大家喜欢啥，公司专门发了一轮问卷，说这种调研，得找一百个人问。
conduct a survey.translation: 朋友：公司最近在忙啥 你：发问卷 朋友：是开展调研吗 你：对啊，问一百人 朋友：结果咋样 你：对，还在收
conduct a survey.example: Friend: What is the company busy with lately? You: Issuing questionnaires. Friend: Are they conducting a survey? You: Yeah, ask a hundred. Friend: How are the results? You: Yes, still collecting.

confine to.context: 你说上课得把手机收进包里，说这种收起来，是为了让大家专心听讲。
confine to.translation: 朋友：上课手机咋放 你：收进包里 朋友：是收进吗 你：对啊，专心听讲 朋友：你乐意不 你：对，一开始不乐意
confine to.example: Friend: Where do phones go in class? You: Confined to the bag. Friend: Are they confined to the bag? You: Yeah, focus on the lecture. Friend: Are you willing? You: Yes, not at first.

confined space.context: 你说电梯里那种小空间，待久了让人发闷，说这种密闭地方，最让人不舒服。
confined space.translation: 朋友：你最烦啥地方 你：电梯里 朋友：是密闭空间吗 你：对啊，待久了闷 朋友：你咋克服 你：对，快进快出
confined space.example: Friend: What place do you hate most? You: The elevator. Friend: Is it a confined space? You: Yeah, stuffy after a while. Friend: How do you cope? You: Yes, in and out fast.

confiscate from.context: 你说老师把学生上课玩的手机没收了，说这种从学生手里拿走的东西，放学才还。
confiscate from.translation: 朋友：那学生手机咋没了 你：被老师收了 朋友：是被没收吗 你：对啊，放学才还 朋友：他后悔不 你：对，后悔
confiscate from.example: Friend: Why does that student's phone disappear? You: Confiscated by the teacher. Friend: Was it confiscated from him? You: Yeah, returned after school. Friend: Does he regret it? You: Yes, regrets.

conforms to.context: 你说产品出厂前，都得照着那个国家标准来，说这种照着规矩来的，才合格。
conforms to.translation: 朋友：产品咋算合格 你：照标准来 朋友：是遵守标准吗 你：对啊，照着做 朋友：这标准严不严 你：对，严
conforms to.example: Friend: How is a product counted as qualified? You: Follow the standard. Friend: Does it conform to the standard? You: Yeah, follow it. Friend: Is this standard strict? You: Yes, strict.

confuse with.context: 你说这俩名字长得像，老有人把它们弄混，说这种混淆，一不留神就出错。
confuse with.translation: 朋友：这俩名字咋老搞混 你：长得太像 朋友：是混淆吗 你：对啊，一不留神错 朋友：你咋分清楚 你：对，多看两眼
confuse with.example: Friend: Why are these two names always mixed up? You: Look too alike. Friend: Are they confused with each other? You: Yeah, slip up and err. Friend: How do you tell them apart? You: Yes, look twice.

conjure up.context: 你说一听到那首老歌，就想起小时候的暑假，说这种让往事浮上心头的感觉，最打动人。
conjure up.translation: 朋友：那歌让你想起啥 你：小时候的暑假 朋友：是让往事浮现吗 你：对啊，浮上心头 朋友：你怀念不 你：对，怀念
conjure up.example: Friend: What does that song remind you of? You: Childhood summers. Friend: Does it conjure up memories? You: Yeah, rise to mind. Friend: Do you miss it? You: Yes, miss.

connect to.context: 你说电脑一连上那个WiFi，就自动开始下载，说这种一接上就连通的感觉，真方便。
connect to.translation: 朋友：你电脑咋自动下东西 你：一连WiFi就下 朋友：是连接到网络吗 你：对啊，一接就通 朋友：这样方便不 你：对，方便
connect to.example: Friend: Why does your computer download automatically? You: It connects to the WiFi. Friend: Does it connect to it? You: Yeah, as soon as it links. Friend: Is this convenient? You: Yes, convenient.

connection strength.context: 你说这种WiFi隔两堵墙就弱得不行，说这种连接强度，最是闹心。
connection strength.translation: 朋友：你家里网咋这么差 你：隔两堵墙就弱 朋友：是连接强度不够吗 你：对啊，闹心 朋友：你咋解决 你：对，加个路由器
connection strength.example: Friend: Why is your home wifi so poor? You: Two walls and it weakens. Friend: Is the connection strength poor? You: Yeah, annoying. Friend: How do you fix it? You: Yes, add a router.

conscious of.context: 你说走在冰面上，得时时脚下留神，说这种察觉到危险的状态，能保人不摔。
conscious of.translation: 朋友：你走冰上咋这么小心 你：得脚下留神 朋友：是意识到危险吗 你：对啊，保人不摔 朋友：你滑倒过没 你：对，滑过
conscious of.example: Friend: Why are you so careful on the ice? You: Must watch every step. Friend: Are you conscious of the danger? You: Yeah, keeps you from falling. Friend: Have you slipped? You: Yes, have.

conservation efforts.context: 你说那些熊猫、朱鹮能活下来，全靠这些年的保护，说这种努力，晚一步就没了。
conservation efforts.translation: 朋友：那些珍稀动物咋保住的 你：全靠这些年保护 朋友：是保护努力吗 你：对啊，晚一步就没 朋友：你觉得值不值 你：对，值
conservation efforts.example: Friend: How were those rare animals saved? You: All those years of conservation efforts. Friend: Are they conservation efforts? You: Yeah, one step late and gone. Friend: Do you think it's worth it? You: Yes, worth.

conserve energy.context: 你说没人时把灯都关了，说这种节约用电的做法，每月电费能省不少。
conserve energy.translation: 朋友：你出门咋老关灯 你：节能 朋友：是节约能源吗 你：对啊，省电费 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
conserve energy.example: Friend: Why do you always switch off lights when leaving? You: To conserve energy. Friend: Is it conserving energy? You: Yeah, save on bills. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

conserve heat.context: 你说冬天窗户缝都得贴上密封条，说这种锁住温度的做法，屋里能暖和好几度。
conserve heat.translation: 朋友：你冬天窗户咋贴胶带 你：把缝堵上 朋友：是锁温吗 你：对啊，暖和好几度 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
conserve heat.example: Friend: Why do you tape your windows in winter? You: Seal the gaps. Friend: Is it conserving heat? You: Yeah, several degrees warmer. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

console release.context: 你说那台新游戏机发售那天，官网一下挤爆了，说这种首发，熬夜抢的人真多。
console release.translation: 朋友：那新游戏机咋样 你：发售那天挤爆 朋友：是游戏机发售吗 你：对啊，熬夜抢 朋友：你抢到没 你：对，抢到了
console release.example: Friend: How is that new console? You: The site crashed on release day. Friend: Is it a console release? You: Yeah, stay up to grab. Friend: Did you get one? You: Yes, did.

consolidate memories.context: 你说人睡觉的时候，大脑会把白天学的东西存牢，说这种巩固记忆的过程，是睡好的好处之一。
consolidate memories.translation: 朋友：为啥睡好了记性好 你：大脑在存东西 朋友：是巩固记忆吗 你：对啊，睡好就牢 朋友：你熬夜背过书没 你：对，背了也忘
consolidate memories.example: Friend: Why is memory better after good sleep? You: The brain stores things. Friend: Is it consolidating memories? You: Yeah, good sleep locks it. Friend: Have you pulled an all-nighter to study? You: Yes, forgot even if you did.

conspicuous consumption.context: 你说有人买名牌不是为了用，是为了让别人看，说这种炫耀性消费，图的就是面子。
conspicuous consumption.translation: 朋友：那人买名牌图啥 你：给别人看 朋友：是炫耀性消费吗 你：对啊，图面子 朋友：你理解这种人不 你：对，理解
conspicuous consumption.example: Friend: What does that person get from buying luxury brands? You: For others to see. Friend: Is it conspicuous consumption? You: Yeah, face. Friend: Do you understand such people? You: Yes, understand.

constructive feedback.context: 你说领导给你提的意见，不是骂你，是帮你改，说这种建设性反馈，听进去才进步。
constructive feedback.translation: 朋友：领导给你提意见了 你：不是骂，是帮我改 朋友：是建设性意见吗 你：对啊，听进去才进步 朋友：你改了没 你：对，改了
constructive feedback.example: Friend: Did the boss give you feedback? You: Not scolding, helping me improve. Friend: Is it constructive feedback? You: Yeah, listen in and grow. Friend: Did you change? You: Yes, did.

constructive thinking.context: 你说遇到麻烦别老抱怨，得想想怎么解决，说这种建设性思考，才是成年人该有的样子。
constructive thinking.translation: 朋友：遇到麻烦你咋想 你：别光抱怨，想办法 朋友：是建设性思考吗 你：对啊，成年人该有 朋友：你做到没 你：对，慢慢做
constructive thinking.example: Friend: How do you think when trouble hits? You: Stop complaining, find a way. Friend: Is it constructive thinking? You: Yeah, what adults should have. Friend: Do you manage it? You: Yes, slowly.

consultant psychiatrist.context: 你说他那种严重的焦虑，得找个资深的精神科医生看，说这种顾问级的医生，最懂怎么治。
consultant psychiatrist.translation: 朋友：他焦虑看的啥医生 你：资深精神科医生 朋友：是顾问精神科医生吗 你：对啊，最懂怎么治 朋友：他好点没 你：对，好点了
consultant psychiatrist.example: Friend: What kind of doctor does he see for anxiety? You: A senior psychiatrist. Friend: Is it a consultant psychiatrist? You: Yeah, best at treating. Friend: Is he better? You: Yes, better.

consumer brand.context: 你说那种天天能在超市见到的牌子，就是消费品牌，说它不靠广告，靠的是回头客。
consumer brand.translation: 朋友：那牌子你常买吗 你：超市天天见 朋友：是消费品牌吗 你：对啊，靠回头客 朋友：你认它不 你：对，认
consumer brand.example: Friend: Do you often buy that brand? You: See it in the supermarket daily. Friend: Is it a consumer brand? You: Yeah, on repeat customers. Friend: Do you recognize it? You: Yes, do.

consumer demand.context: 你说大家现在都想要又便宜又好用的东西，说这种消费者需求，最让商家挠头。
consumer demand.translation: 朋友：现在顾客想要啥 你：又便宜又好用 朋友：是消费者需求吗 你：对啊，商家挠头 朋友：你咋想 你：对，正常
consumer demand.example: Friend: What do customers want now? You: Cheap and useful. Friend: Is it consumer demand? You: Yeah, headaches for shops. Friend: What do you think? You: Yes, normal.

consumer habit.context: 你说你买牙膏只挑那一个牌子，说这种消费习惯，用久了就懒得换。
consumer habit.translation: 朋友：你牙膏咋老用那牌子 你：用久了懒得换 朋友：是消费习惯吗 你：对啊，懒得选 朋友：你试过别的没 你：对，试过
consumer habit.example: Friend: Why do you always use that toothpaste brand? You: Used long, lazy to switch. Friend: Is it a consumer habit? You: Yeah, lazy to choose. Friend: Have you tried others? You: Yes, have.

consumer product.context: 你说那种超市里卖的洗发水、肥皂，都是消费品，说这种东西，用完就得再买。
consumer product.translation: 朋友：超市里那些是啥 你：洗发水肥皂 朋友：是消费品吗 你：对啊，用完再买 朋友：你常买哪样 你：对，洗发水
consumer product.example: Friend: What are those things in the supermarket? You: Shampoo and soap. Friend: Are they consumer products? You: Yeah, buy again after use. Friend: Which do you often buy? You: Yes, shampoo.

contactless payment.context: 你说现在买东西不用掏现金，手机一贴就付了，说这种非接触式支付，越来越方便。
contactless payment.translation: 朋友：你现在咋付钱 你：手机一贴就付 朋友：是非接触式支付吗 你：对啊，越来越方便 朋友：你习惯不 你：对，习惯了
contactless payment.example: Friend: How do you pay now? You: Tap the phone and pay. Friend: Is it contactless payment? You: Yeah, more convenient. Friend: Are you used to it? You: Yes, used to it.

container home.context: 你说郊外那些用旧集装箱改成的小房子，说这种集装箱房屋，又便宜又有特色。
container home.translation: 朋友：郊外那些小房子是啥 你：集装箱改的 朋友：是集装箱房屋吗 你：对啊，便宜有特色 朋友：你想住不 你：对，想
container home.example: Friend: What are those little houses in the suburbs? You: Converted containers. Friend: Are they container homes? You: Yeah, cheap and distinctive. Friend: Do you want to live there? You: Yes, want.

content creator.context: 你说他天天在网上拍视频、写文章，说这种内容创作者，靠让大家爱看吃饭。
content creator.translation: 朋友：他靠啥吃饭 你：拍视频写文章 朋友：是内容创作者吗 你：对啊，靠大家爱看 朋友：你做得来不 你：对，做不来
content creator.example: Friend: How does he make a living? You: Films videos, writes articles. Friend: Is he a content creator? You: Yeah, on people loving it. Friend: Can you do it? You: Yes, can't.

content with.context: 你说他这人容易知足，说能有一份安稳工作，他就挺满足，不再贪多。
content with.translation: 朋友：他这人好伺候吗 你：容易知足 朋友：是满足于现状吗 你：对啊，安稳就够 朋友：你这样吗 你：对，我也这样
content with.example: Friend: Is that person easy to please? You: Easy to content. Friend: Is he content with? You: Yeah, stability is enough. Friend: Are you like that? You: Yes, I am.

context clue.context: 你说读英文时遇到生词，别急着查，先看前后那几句，说这种上下文线索，常常能猜出意思。
context clue.translation: 朋友：你读英文遇生词咋办 你：先看前后句 朋友：是上下文线索吗 你：对啊，常能猜出 朋友：这办法好用不 你：对，好用
context clue.example: Friend: What do you do when new words hit in English reading? You: First look at the surrounding sentences. Friend: Are they context clues? You: Yeah, often guess. Friend: Is this method good? You: Yes, good.

contractual obligation.context: 你说签了合同就得按上面办，说这种合同义务，不照做就得赔钱。
contractual obligation.translation: 朋友：签了合同就得照办吗 你：对啊 朋友：是合同义务吗 你：对啊，不做赔钱 朋友：你看过条款没 你：对，看过
contractual obligation.example: Friend: Once a contract is signed, must you follow it? You: Yeah. Friend: Is it a contractual obligation? You: Yeah, breach and pay. Friend: Did you read the terms? You: Yes, did.

convenience factor.context: 你说那家店离你近，东西也全，说这种方便的因素，是你老爱去它的原因。
convenience factor.translation: 朋友：你咋老去那家店 你：离得近，东西全 朋友：是方便的因素吗 你：对啊，图省事 朋友：你不觉得远吗 你：对，五分钟
convenience factor.example: Friend: Why do you always go to that shop? You: Near and fully stocked. Friend: Is it the convenience factor? You: Yeah, saves effort. Friend: Don't you find it far? You: Yes, five minutes.

convenience food.context: 你说忙得没空做饭，就从冰箱拿份速食，微波炉一转，说这种方便食品，最适合懒人。
convenience food.translation: 朋友：你忙时吃啥 你：拿份速食热一下 朋友：是速食吗 你：对啊，适合懒人 朋友：你常吃吗 你：对，常吃
convenience food.example: Friend: What do you eat when busy? You: Grab a ready meal and heat it. Friend: Is it convenience food? You: Yeah, for lazy people. Friend: Do you eat it often? You: Yes, often.

convenience outlet.context: 你说家楼下那个卖日用品的小店，说这种便民小店，半夜想买个灯泡都能买到。
convenience outlet.translation: 朋友：半夜想买灯泡咋办 你：楼下有小店 朋友：是便民小店吗 你：对啊，半夜能买 朋友：这样方便不 你：对，方便
convenience outlet.example: Friend: What if you want a bulb at midnight? You: There's a shop downstairs. Friend: Is it a convenience outlet? You: Yeah, buy at midnight. Friend: Is this convenient? You: Yes, convenient.

conversation designers.context: 你说那种聊天机器人说的话，全是背后有人一句句写好的，说这些对话设计师，最懂人爱听啥。
conversation designers.translation: 朋友：那机器人的话谁写的 你：有人一句句写 朋友：是对话设计师吗 你：对啊，懂人爱听啥 朋友：这活有意思不 你：对，有意思
conversation designers.example: Friend: Who writes what that chatbot says? You: Someone writes line by line. Friend: Are they conversation designers? You: Yeah, know what people love. Friend: Is this job interesting? You: Yes, interesting.

conversational partner.context: 你说练口语最得有个能一直聊的搭子，说这种对话伙伴，比自己闷头练强多了。
conversational partner.translation: 朋友：你口语咋练的 你：找了个搭子 朋友：是对话伙伴吗 你：对啊，比闷头练强 朋友：那搭子好找不 你：对，不好找
conversational partner.example: Friend: How do you practice speaking? You: Found a buddy. Friend: Is it a conversational partner? You: Yeah, better than alone. Friend: Is that buddy easy to find? You: Yes, not easy.

converse with.context: 你说你就爱跟那种有见识的人聊天，说跟他们一聊，自己也能长不少见识。
converse with.translation: 朋友：你爱跟谁聊天 你：有见识的人 朋友：是跟人交谈吗 你：对啊，长见识 朋友：你常这样吗 你：对，常
converse with.example: Friend: Who do you love chatting with? You: Knowledgeable people. Friend: Do you converse with them? You: Yeah, gain insight. Friend: Do you often? You: Yes, often.

converted flat.context: 你说那间老厂房被改成了公寓，说这种改造公寓，看着旧，里面却挺新。
converted flat.translation: 朋友：你租那房子咋样 你：老厂房改的 朋友：是改造公寓吗 你：对啊，里面挺新 朋友：这种房好住不 你：对，好住
converted flat.example: Friend: How is that flat you rent? You: Converted from an old factory. Friend: Is it a converted flat? You: Yeah, inside quite new. Friend: Is such a flat good to live in? You: Yes, good.

cook from scratch.context: 你说周末不买现成菜，从洗菜切菜一步步做起，说这种从头做饭，吃着才香。
cook from scratch.translation: 朋友：你周末咋吃饭 你：自己从头做 朋友：是从头做饭吗 你：对啊，切菜开始 朋友：这样麻烦不 你：对，麻烦但香
cook from scratch.example: Friend: What do you eat on weekends? You: Cook from scratch. Friend: Is it cooking from scratch? You: Yeah, start from chopping. Friend: Is it troublesome? You: Yes, troublesome but tasty.

cookery skills.context: 你说他那一手做菜的本事，全是跟奶奶学的，说这种烹饪技巧，没个十年八年练不出来。
cookery skills.translation: 朋友：他做菜咋这么好吃 你：跟奶奶学的 朋友：是烹饪技巧吗 你：对啊，练了好多年 朋友：你学得来不 你：对，学不来
cookery skills.example: Friend: Why does he cook so well? You: Learned from grandma. Friend: Is it cookery skills? You: Yeah, years of practice. Friend: Can you learn it? You: Yes, can't.

cool cat.context: 你说天塌下来他都不慌，说这种淡定从容的人，是大伙儿最愿意一起共事的。
cool cat.translation: 朋友：出事了他咋不慌 你：他是个淡定的人 朋友：是那种淡定的人吗 你：对啊，遇事不慌 朋友：你学得来不 你：对，学不来
cool cat.example: Friend: Why isn't he panicked when things go wrong? You: He's a cool cat. Friend: Is he a cool cat? You: Yeah, calm in trouble. Friend: Can you learn it? You: Yes, can't.

coordinate with.context: 你说团队做事得跟大家的节奏配合好，说这种步调一致，才能把事情推得动。
coordinate with.translation: 朋友：你们团队咋配合的 你：跟着大家的节奏 朋友：是配合步调吗 你：对啊，一致才推得动 朋友：你们配合得好吗 你：对，挺好
coordinate with.example: Friend: How does your team coordinate? You: Follow everyone's rhythm. Friend: Do you coordinate with? You: Yeah, unified to push forward. Friend: Do you coordinate well? You: Yes, fine.

cope with hardship.context: 你说他从山里出来读书，全靠咬牙顶住困难，说这种应对困境的韧劲儿，是他成的关键。
cope with hardship.translation: 朋友：他咋从山里读出来的 你：咬牙顶住困难 朋友：是应对困境吗 你：对啊，靠韧劲儿 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
cope with hardship.example: Friend: How did he get out of the mountains to study? You: Gritted through hardship. Friend: Is it coping with hardship? You: Yeah, on grit. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

cope with stress.context: 你说工作压力一大，就靠跑步来扛，说这种应对压力的法子，比闷在心里强。
cope with stress.translation: 朋友：你压力大咋扛 你：靠跑步 朋友：是应对压力吗 你：对啊，比闷着强 朋友：这样管用不 你：对，管用
cope with stress.example: Friend: How do you cope with big stress? You: Through running. Friend: Is it coping with stress? You: Yeah, better than bottling up. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

coping mechanism.context: 你说每个人解压的法子不一样，说这种应对方式，是慢慢摸索出来的。
coping mechanism.translation: 朋友：你解压靠啥 你：靠写作 朋友：是应对方式吗 你：对啊，自己摸索的 朋友：你这法子管用不 你：对，管用
coping mechanism.example: Friend: What do you use to de-stress? You: Through writing. Friend: Is it a coping mechanism? You: Yeah, figured it out myself. Friend: Does this method work? You: Yes, works.

coping skill.context: 你说他焦虑时就深呼吸、数数，说这种应对技巧，是心理老师教他的。
coping skill.translation: 朋友：他焦虑时咋调节 你：深呼吸数数 朋友：是应对技巧吗 你：对啊，老师教的 朋友：这招管用不 你：对，管用
coping skill.example: Friend: How does he regulate when anxious? You: Deep breath, count. Friend: Is it a coping skill? You: Yeah, taught by the teacher. Friend: Does this trick work? You: Yes, works.

coping strategy.context: 你说遇事先深呼吸再开口，说这种应对方法，能让你少说错话。
coping strategy.translation: 朋友：你发火前咋控制 你：先深呼吸 朋友：是应对方法吗 你：对啊，少说错话 朋友：你这招学的谁的 你：对，学的书
coping strategy.example: Friend: How do you control before losing temper? You: Deep breath first. Friend: Is it a coping strategy? You: Yeah, say fewer wrong things. Friend: Whose trick did you learn? You: Yes, from a book.

copy behaviour.context: 你说小孩最爱学大人的样子，说这种模仿行为，是他们学东西最快的法子。
copy behaviour.translation: 朋友：那小孩咋学大人 你：模仿大人 朋友：是模仿行为吗 你：对啊，学东西快 朋友：你家孩子学你啥了 你：对，学我喝茶
copy behaviour.example: Friend: Why does that child mimic adults? You: Copy behavior. Friend: Is it copy behavior? You: Yeah, learns fast. Friend: What did your kid copy from you? You: Yes, copied me drinking tea.

coral bleaching.context: 你说海水一升温，珊瑚就变白死掉，说这种珊瑚白化，是海洋里最让人揪心的事。
coral bleaching.translation: 朋友：海里那珊瑚咋变白了 你：水太热了 朋友：是珊瑚白化吗 你：对啊，变白就死 朋友：这咋解决 你：对，降温
coral bleaching.example: Friend: Why did the coral in the sea turn white? You: Water got too hot. Friend: Is it coral bleaching? You: Yeah, white means dead. Friend: How to solve it? You: Yes, cool the water.

coral reef.context: 你说潜到海底，那一大片彩色的珊瑚礁，是鱼和虾最爱的家，说这种地方，真该好好保护。
coral reef.translation: 朋友：海底那彩色的是啥 你：珊瑚礁 朋友：是珊瑚礁吗 你：对啊，鱼虾的家 朋友：你下去看过没 你：对，没看过
coral reef.example: Friend: What is that colorful thing at the bottom of the sea? You: A coral reef. Friend: Is it a coral reef? You: Yeah, home to fish and shrimp. Friend: Have you dived down to see? You: Yes, haven't.

core ideal.context: 你说那家店做了这么多年，靠的就是一个核心理念，说东西真、价格实，别的都不重要。
core ideal.translation: 朋友：那店靠啥活下来 你：东西真价格实 朋友：是核心理念吗 你：对啊，别的不重要 朋友：你信这理念不 你：对，信
core ideal.example: Friend: What does that shop rely on to survive? You: Real goods, honest price. Friend: Is it a core ideal? You: Yeah, rest doesn't matter. Friend: Do you believe in this ideal? You: Yes, believe.

core needs.context: 你说人这一辈子，吃饭、睡觉、有人爱，就这几样核心需求，别的都是锦上添花。
core needs.translation: 朋友：人最该要啥 你：吃饭睡觉有人爱 朋友：是核心需求吗 你：对啊，别的是锦上添花 朋友：你想明白没 你：对，想明白了
core needs.example: Friend: What do people most need? You: Food, sleep, someone to love. Friend: Are they core needs? You: Yeah, rest is icing on the cake. Friend: Have you figured it out? You: Yes, have.

core piece.context: 你说衣橱里那件白衬衫，配啥都好看，说这种基础单品，是最经得住穿的。
core piece.translation: 朋友：你衣橱里最爱穿啥 你：那件白衬衫 朋友：是基础单品吗 你：对啊，配啥都好看 朋友：这衣服贵不 你：对，不贵
core piece.example: Friend: What do you love most in your wardrobe? You: That white shirt. Friend: Is it a core piece? You: Yeah, goes with anything. Friend: Is this shirt expensive? You: Yes, not.

coronary heart disease.context: 你说他常年吃油吃肉，年纪不大就查出冠心病，说这种病，跟吃太油脱不了干系。
coronary heart disease.translation: 朋友：他咋得这病的 你：常年吃油吃肉 朋友：是冠心病吗 你：对啊，吃太油 朋友：他现在咋样 你：对，吃药控制
coronary heart disease.example: Friend: How did he get this disease? You: Years of greasy, meaty diet. Friend: Is it coronary heart disease? You: Yeah, from too much oil. Friend: How is he now? You: Yes, on meds.

corporate culture.context: 你说进一家新公司，先得看看它的企业文化，说大家天天加不加班、和不和睦，比工资还重要。
corporate culture.translation: 朋友：你换工作先看啥 你：看企业文化 朋友：是企业文化吗 你：对啊，比工资重要 朋友：你遇到好的没 你：对，遇到了
corporate culture.example: Friend: What do you look for first when changing jobs? You: The corporate culture. Friend: Is it corporate culture? You: Yeah, more important than pay. Friend: Have you found a good one? You: Yes, have.

corrective lens.context: 你说眼睛近视就得戴那种矫正镜片，说这种镜片一戴，远处的字立马就看清了。
corrective lens.translation: 朋友：你近视咋矫正 你：戴矫正镜片 朋友：是矫正镜片吗 你：对啊，远处就清了 朋友：这镜片贵不 你：对，不便宜
corrective lens.example: Friend: How do you correct your nearsightedness? You: Wear corrective lenses. Friend: Are they corrective lenses? You: Yeah, distance gets clear. Friend: Are these lenses expensive? You: Yes, not cheap.

correlates with.context: 你说睡得少跟记性差是连着的，说这两件事常常一起出现，不是巧合。
correlates with.translation: 朋友：你俩咋老一起出问题 你：睡少和记性差 朋友：是相关吗 你：对啊，不是巧合 朋友：你咋发现的 你：对，看数据
correlates with.example: Friend: Why do those two problems always appear together? You: Little sleep and poor memory. Friend: Does it correlate with? You: Yeah, not a coincidence. Friend: How did you find out? You: Yes, from data.

correspond with.context: 你说这事得跟当时的情况对得上，说前后一致，大家才信你说的话。
correspond with.translation: 朋友：他说的话可信不 你：跟情况对得上 朋友：是符合一致吗 你：对啊，前后一致 朋友：你咋查的 你：对，问了旁人
correspond with.example: Friend: Is what he says credible? You: It corresponds with the situation. Friend: Does it correspond with? You: Yeah, consistent. Friend: How did you check? You: Yes, asked others.

corresponds with.context: 你说这份报告里的数字，跟当初说好的完全对不上，说这种不一致，得让人重写。
corresponds with.translation: 朋友：那报告咋样 你：数字对不上 朋友：是与不符吗 你：对啊，让人重写 朋友：错在哪 你：对，总数错了
corresponds with.example: Friend: How is that report? You: The numbers don't match. Friend: Does it correspond with? You: Yeah, have them rewrite. Friend: Where is the error? You: Yes, the total is wrong.

cortisol drop.context: 你说一觉睡到大天亮，测出来那个压力激素就降下来，说这种皮质醇下降，是身体最舒服的状态。
cortisol drop.translation: 朋友：你睡好了身体啥感觉 你：压力激素降了 朋友：是皮质醇下降吗 你：对啊，最舒服 朋友：你咋知道的 你：对，测的
cortisol drop.example: Friend: How does your body feel after a good sleep? You: The stress hormone drops. Friend: Is it a cortisol drop? You: Yeah, most comfortable. Friend: How do you know? You: Yes, measured.

cosmetic regulation.context: 你说那种往脸上抹的东西，国家都管得很严，说这种美妆法规，是为了别让乱七八糟的东西上脸。
cosmetic regulation.translation: 朋友：那些护肤品安全不 你：国家管得严 朋友：是美妆法规吗 你：对啊，别乱上脸 朋友：这法规好吗 你：对，好
cosmetic regulation.example: Friend: Are those skincare products safe? You: The state regulates strictly. Friend: Is it cosmetic regulation? You: Yeah, no junk on the face. Friend: Is this regulation good? You: Yes, good.

cosmetic surgery.context: 你说有人为了变美，专门去动那种整容手术，说这种事，得自己想清楚再上手术台。
cosmetic surgery.translation: 朋友：她咋变了这么多 你：做了整容手术 朋友：是整容手术吗 你：对啊，得想清楚 朋友：你敢做不 你：对，不敢
cosmetic surgery.example: Friend: Why has she changed so much? You: Had cosmetic surgery. Friend: Is it cosmetic surgery? You: Yeah, think it through. Friend: Dare you do it? You: Yes, don't dare.

cosmic radiation.context: 你说宇航员在太空待久了，会被那种来自宇宙的射线照着，说这种宇宙辐射，比地面上强多了。
cosmic radiation.translation: 朋友：宇航员在太空怕啥 你：怕那种宇宙射线 朋友：是宇宙辐射吗 你：对啊，比地面强 朋友：他们咋防护 你：对，穿防护服
cosmic radiation.example: Friend: What are astronauts afraid of in space? You: Cosmic radiation. Friend: Is it cosmic radiation? You: Yeah, stronger than on the ground. Friend: How do they protect? You: Yes, suits.

cosmic rays.context: 你说那些从宇宙深处飞来的高能射线，一刻不停地扫过地球，说这种宇宙射线，你看不见但一直存在。
cosmic rays.translation: 朋友：天上那些看不见的是啥 你：宇宙射线 朋友：是宇宙射线吗 你：对啊，看不见但一直有 朋友：它对人有害吗 你：对，有防护就没事
cosmic rays.example: Friend: What are those invisible things in the sky? You: Cosmic rays. Friend: Are they cosmic rays? You: Yeah, invisible but always there. Friend: Is it harmful to people? You: Yes, fine with protection.

cost a fortune.context: 你说那辆老跑车看着一般，可修一次就得花好几万，说这玩意儿真是贵得离谱。
cost a fortune.translation: 朋友：那跑车修一次多少 你：好几万 朋友：是花很多钱吗 你：对啊，贵得离谱 朋友：你买得起不 你：对，买不起
cost a fortune.example: Friend: How much to repair that old sports car once? You: Tens of thousands. Friend: Does it cost a fortune? You: Yeah, shockingly expensive. Friend: Can you afford it? You: Yes, can't.

cost effective.context: 你说那种东西不贵，又耐用，说这种性价比高的东西，最值得买回来。
cost effective.translation: 朋友：这东西值得买不 你：不贵又耐用 朋友：是性价比高吗 你：对啊，值得买 朋友：你买了几样 你：对，买了三样
cost effective.example: Friend: Is this thing worth buying? You: Cheap and durable. Friend: Is it cost effective? You: Yeah, worth buying. Friend: How many did you buy? You: Yes, three.

cost of living.context: 你说这两年物价涨得厉害，说这种生活开销一涨，每个月攒下的钱就少了。
cost of living.translation: 朋友：这两年钱够花吗 你：物价涨得厉害 朋友：是生活开销涨了吗 你：对啊，攒的钱少了 朋友：你咋省 你：对，少出去吃
cost of living.example: Friend: Is money enough these two years? You: Prices rose sharply. Friend: Is the cost of living rising? You: Yeah, savings shrink. Friend: How do you save? You: Yes, eat out less.

cost of renting.context: 你说在大城市住，光是租房这一项，就吃掉一半工资，说这种租房成本，真压得人喘不过气。
cost of renting.translation: 朋友：你工资一大半干啥了 你：交房租 朋友：是租房成本吗 你：对啊，压得慌 朋友：你打算咋办 你：对，合租
cost of renting.example: Friend: Where does most of your wage go? You: Rent. Friend: Is it the cost of renting? You: Yeah, suffocating. Friend: What do you plan? You: Yes, share a flat.

cost the earth.context: 你说把那片青山全推了盖楼，赚的是眼前钱，可给环境的代价，是几辈子都还不清的。
cost the earth.translation: 朋友：那片山咋全平了 你：盖楼赚钱 朋友：是让环境付大代价吗 你：对啊，几辈子还不清 朋友：你觉得值吗 你：对，不值
cost the earth.example: Friend: Why was that hill flattened? You: Build towers for money. Friend: Does it cost the earth? You: Yeah, generations can't repay. Friend: Do you think it's worth it? You: Yes, not.

cottage industry.context: 你说那种几个人在家做手工、做衣裳的小作坊，说这种家庭小作坊，钱不多但自由。
cottage industry.translation: 朋友：那几个人在家干啥 你：做手工做衣裳 朋友：是家庭小作坊吗 你：对啊，钱不多但自由 朋友：你羡慕不 你：对，有点
cottage industry.example: Friend: What are those few people doing at home? You: Handcrafts and sewing. Friend: Is it a cottage industry? You: Yeah, little money but free. Friend: Do you envy it? You: Yes, a bit.

cotton farming.context: 你说那一带整片田都种棉花，说这种棉花种植，是当地人家一年的指望。
cotton farming.translation: 朋友：那片田种的啥 你：棉花 朋友：是棉花种植吗 你：对啊，一年的指望 朋友：你见过种棉花没 你：对，见过
cotton farming.example: Friend: What is grown in that field? You: Cotton. Friend: Is it cotton farming? You: Yeah, a year's hope. Friend: Have you seen cotton farming? You: Yes, have.

couch potato.context: 你说他一下班就瘫在沙发上看电视，说这种久坐懒人，一动都不想动。
couch potato.translation: 朋友：他下班咋不动 你：瘫沙发上看电视 朋友：是久坐懒人吗 你：对啊，一动不想动 朋友：你劝他运动没 你：对，劝过
couch potato.example: Friend: Why doesn't he move after work? You: Slumps on the couch watching TV. Friend: Is he a couch potato? You: Yeah, doesn't want to move. Friend: Did you urge him to exercise? You: Yes, have.

counselling service.context: 你说压力大到自己扛不住时，可以去那种心理咨询聊聊，说专业的人一听，就帮你理清了。
counselling service.translation: 朋友：你压力大找谁聊 你：心理咨询 朋友：是心理咨询吗 你：对啊，帮你理清 朋友：这管用不 你：对，管用
counselling service.example: Friend: Who do you talk to when stress is too big? You: A counselling service. Friend: Is it a counselling service? You: Yeah, helps you sort it out. Friend: Does it work? You: Yes, works.

count one's blessings.context: 你说日子再难，也得想想自己拥有的那些好东西，说这种常怀感恩的心态，能让人知足。
count one's blessings.translation: 朋友：你日子难咋过的 你：想想拥有的好东西 朋友：是常怀感恩吗 你：对啊，知足 朋友：你最感恩啥 你：对，家人
count one's blessings.example: Friend: How do you get through hard days? You: Think of the good things you have. Friend: Do you count your blessings? You: Yeah, content. Friend: What are you most grateful for? You: Yes, family.

count sheep.context: 你说睡不着的时候，闭上眼睛一遍遍数羊，说这种老办法，偶尔还真管用。
count sheep.translation: 朋友：你睡不着咋办 你：数羊 朋友：是数羊助眠吗 你：对啊，老办法 朋友：这招灵不 你：对，偶尔灵
count sheep.example: Friend: What do you do when you can't sleep? You: Count sheep. Friend: Do you count sheep? You: Yeah, an old trick. Friend: Does this trick work? You: Yes, occasionally.

count towards.context: 你说这门课修下来的学分，能算进毕业要求里，说这种计入指标的成绩，得好好考。
count towards.translation: 朋友：这门课重要吗 你：能算进毕业要求 朋友：是计入指标吗 你：对啊，得好好考 朋友：你认真学没 你：对，认真学了
count towards.example: Friend: Is this course important? You: It counts toward graduation. Friend: Does it count towards? You: Yeah, must study hard. Friend: Did you study seriously? You: Yes, did.

country park.context: 你说周末想躲进有树有草的地方，说那种乡村公园，跑两圈比城里舒服多了。
country park.translation: 朋友：周末你想去哪 你：有树有草的公园 朋友：是乡村公园吗 你：对啊，比城里舒服 朋友：你常去不 你：对，常去
country park.example: Friend: Where do you want to go this weekend? You: A park with trees and grass. Friend: Is it a country park? You: Yeah, more comfortable than the city. Friend: Do you go often? You: Yes, often.

country retreat.context: 你说工作累了，就找个乡下小院子住两天，说这种远离城市的度假，最能让人回血。
country retreat.translation: 朋友：你累了咋放松 你：去乡下小院住两天 朋友：是乡村度假吗 你：对啊，回血 朋友：你去过没 你：对，去过
country retreat.example: Friend: How do you relax when tired? You: Stay two days at a country cottage. Friend: Is it a country retreat? You: Yeah, recharge. Friend: Have you been? You: Yes, have.

countryside dweller.context: 你说那种守着几亩田、养几只鸡的乡下人，说这种乡村居民的日子，看着慢但踏实。
countryside dweller.translation: 朋友：那地方住的是啥人 你：守田养鸡的乡下人 朋友：是乡村居民吗 你：对啊，慢但踏实 朋友：你想过这种日子不 你：对，想
countryside dweller.example: Friend: What kind of people live there? You: Countryside dwellers with fields and chickens. Friend: Are they countryside dwellers? You: Yeah, slow but steady. Friend: Do you want this life? You: Yes, want.

coupled with.context: 你说他天分好，再加上肯下苦功，说这种两样加起来，想不成就都难。
coupled with.translation: 朋友：他咋这么厉害 你：天分好又肯练 朋友：是加上吗 你：对啊，想不成都难 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
coupled with.example: Friend: Why is he so good? You: Talent plus hard practice. Friend: Is it coupled with? You: Yeah, hard not to succeed. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

course module.context: 你说这门课分成好几个小单元，说这种课程模块，学一块算一块，压力小多了。
course module.translation: 朋友：这课咋学的 你：分成几个小单元 朋友：是课程模块吗 你：对啊，一块一块学 朋友：这样轻松不 你：对，轻松
course module.example: Friend: How is this course studied? You: Split into several modules. Friend: Is it a course module? You: Yeah, learn piece by piece. Friend: Is this easy? You: Yes, easy.

course of action.context: 你说遇到这事，大家先一起商量出个做法，说这种行动方案定下来，才好分头去干。
course of action.translation: 朋友：这事你们咋定的 你：先商量出个做法 朋友：是行动方案吗 你：对啊，定了分头干 朋友：你们定得快不 你：对，挺快
course of action.example: Friend: How did you settle this? You: First agreed on a course of action. Friend: Is it a course of action? You: Yeah, then split up. Friend: Did you settle fast? You: Yes, quite fast.

course of true love.context: 你说俩人在一起，吵过又和好、和好又吵，说这种真爱之路，从来都不是一帆风顺的。
course of true love.translation: 朋友：他俩咋老吵 你：吵了又和好 朋友：是真爱之路吗 你：对啊，不顺 朋友：你羡慕这种感情不 你：对，又爱又累
course of true love.example: Friend: Why do those two always argue? You: Argue then make up. Friend: Is it the course of true love? You: Yeah, not smooth. Friend: Do you envy this relationship? You: Yes, love and tiring.

courtship ritual.context: 你说鸟儿到了春天，雄的就开屏、跳舞给雌的看，说这种求偶仪式，是为了找个好伴儿。
courtship ritual.translation: 朋友：那鸟儿春天干啥 你：开屏跳舞 朋友：是求偶仪式吗 你：对啊，找伴儿 朋友：你看过这场面没 你：对，看过
courtship ritual.example: Friend: What do those birds do in spring? You: Fan tails and dance. Friend: Is it a courtship ritual? You: Yeah, find a mate. Friend: Have you seen this scene? You: Yes, have.

cover against.context: 你说出门旅游，先给行李保个险，说这种为意外投保的做法，花钱买个踏实。
cover against.translation: 朋友：你旅游买保险不 你：给行李保个险 朋友：是为意外投保吗 你：对啊，买踏实 朋友：这钱花得值不 你：对，值
cover against.example: Friend: Do you buy insurance when traveling? You: Insure the luggage. Friend: Do you cover against? You: Yeah, peace of mind. Friend: Is this money well spent? You: Yes, worth.

cover up.context: 你说他明明做错了事，还想遮遮掩掩，说这种掩饰，早晚要被人拆穿。
cover up.translation: 朋友：他做错事了没 你：错了还想遮 朋友：是在掩饰吗 你：对啊，早晚拆穿 朋友：你咋知道的 你：对，看出来了
cover up.example: Friend: Did he do something wrong? You: Yes, but tries to cover it. Friend: Is he covering up? You: Yeah, exposed sooner or later. Friend: How do you know? You: Yes, can tell.

coworking space.context: 你说现在一人创业，租不起整层办公室，就去那种共享办公空间，说大家各干各的，还便宜。
coworking space.translation: 朋友：你一人在哪办公 你：那种共享空间 朋友：是共享办公空间吗 你：对啊，各干各的还便宜 朋友：这样方便不 你：对，方便
coworking space.example: Friend: Where do you work alone? You: A coworking space. Friend: Is it a coworking space? You: Yeah, separate desks, cheap. Friend: Is this convenient? You: Yes, convenient.

crack of dawn.context: 你说为了赶头班火车，天还没亮就爬起来，说这种破晓时分出门的滋味，冷是冷了点，但值。
crack of dawn.translation: 朋友：你今早咋这么早 你：赶头班火车 朋友：是破晓就出门吗 你：对啊，天没亮 朋友：你困不 你：对，困但值
crack of dawn.example: Friend: Why are you out so early this morning? You: Catch the first train. Friend: Did you leave at the crack of dawn? You: Yeah, before sunrise. Friend: Are you sleepy? You: Yes, sleepy but worth.

crack the code.context: 你说那道难题大家琢磨了好久，终于被他想通了，说这种破解难题的成就感，最是让人高兴。
crack the code.translation: 朋友：那题谁解出来的 你：被他想通了 朋友：是破解难题吗 你：对啊，最有成就感 朋友：你佩服不 你：对，佩服
crack the code.example: Friend: Who solved that puzzle? You: He figured it out. Friend: Did he crack the code? You: Yeah, most rewarding. Friend: Do you admire it? You: Yes, admire.

craft kit.context: 你说给小孩买那种带各种小工具的手工包，说这种手工材料包，一个人在家就能玩一下午。
craft kit.translation: 朋友：你给小孩买的啥 你：手工材料包 朋友：是手工材料包吗 你：对啊，在家玩一下午 朋友：这包贵不贵 你：对，不贵
craft kit.example: Friend: What did you buy for the kid? You: A craft kit. Friend: Is it a craft kit? You: Yeah, plays at home all afternoon. Friend: Is this kit expensive? You: Yes, not.

craft market.context: 你说周末那种摆满手作小玩意的集市，说这种工艺品市场，逛一圈能淘到不少好东西。
craft market.translation: 朋友：周末那集市咋样 你：摆满手作小玩意 朋友：是工艺品市场吗 你：对啊，能淘到东西 朋友：你淘到啥没 你：对，淘到个陶杯
craft market.example: Friend: How is that market on weekends? You: Full of handmade trinkets. Friend: Is it a craft market? You: Yeah, can hunt for things. Friend: Did you find anything? You: Yes, found a clay cup.

crave admiration.context: 你说他做啥事都想被人夸，说这种渴求赞美的心思，让他特别在意别人怎么看。
crave admiration.translation: 朋友：他咋老想被人夸 你：就爱听好话 朋友：是渴求赞美吗 你：对啊，特别在意别人看法 朋友：你理解他不 你：对，理解
crave admiration.example: Friend: Why does he always want to be praised? You: Loves kind words. Friend: Is it craving admiration? You: Yeah, cares a lot about others' views. Friend: Do you understand him? You: Yes, understand.

crave for.context: 你说天热的时候，就特别想来一口冰的，说这种对冷饮的渴望，自己都管不住。
crave for.translation: 朋友：天热你最想吃啥 你：一口冰的 朋友：是渴望吗 你：对啊，管不住 朋友：你吃了啥冰的 你：对，冰淇淋
crave for.example: Friend: What do you most want when it's hot? You: An ice cold bite. Friend: Is it craving for? You: Yeah, can't control. Friend: What ice thing did you eat? You: Yes, ice cream.

cream tea.context: 你说去英国玩，总得尝一回那种配着司康和奶油的茶点，说这种英式奶油茶，甜是甜，但地道。
cream tea.translation: 朋友：你去英国吃啥了 你：那种配司康的茶点 朋友：是奶油茶点吗 你：对啊，甜但地道 朋友：你爱吃甜的吗 你：对，一般
cream tea.example: Friend: What did you eat in the UK? You: That tea with scones. Friend: Is it cream tea? You: Yeah, sweet but authentic. Friend: Do you love sweet things? You: Yes, average.

creative outlet.context: 你说平时压力大，就靠画画来疏解，说这种抒发创意的途径，是给自己开的一扇小窗。
creative outlet.translation: 朋友：你压力大咋疏解 你：靠画画 朋友：是抒发创意的途径吗 你：对啊，开了扇小窗 朋友：你画得好吗 你：对，瞎画
creative outlet.example: Friend: How do you release stress? You: Through drawing. Friend: Is it a creative outlet? You: Yeah, opened a little window. Friend: Do you draw well? You: Yes, just doodle.

creative task.context: 你说老师布置的那种动手又动脑的活，最有意思，说这种创造性活动，比死记硬背强。
creative task.translation: 朋友：老师布置的啥活有意思 你：动手动脑的 朋友：是创造性活动吗 你：对啊，比死记硬背强 朋友：你爱做这种活不 你：对，爱做
creative task.example: Friend: What kind of task from the teacher is fun? You: Hands-on, brainy ones. Friend: Is it a creative task? You: Yeah, better than rote learning. Friend: Do you love this kind of task? You: Yes, love.

creative thinking.context: 你说别老按老一套想问题，得换个角度，说这种创造性思维，才能想出新点子。
creative thinking.translation: 朋友：你咋老有新点子 你：换个角度想 朋友：是创造性思维吗 你：对啊，老一套不行 朋友：你咋练的 你：对，多想
creative thinking.example: Friend: Why do you always have new ideas? You: Think from another angle. Friend: Is it creative thinking? You: Yeah, old ways don't work. Friend: How do you practice? You: Yes, think more.

creature comforts.context: 你说出门在外，最惦记的还是家里那几样舒服玩意儿，说这种物质上的小享受，最能让人想家。
creature comforts.translation: 朋友：你出门最惦记啥 你：家里那几样舒服玩意儿 朋友：是物质享受吗 你：对啊，最想家 朋友：你都惦记啥 你：对，床和热饭
creature comforts.example: Friend: What do you miss most when away? You: Those little comforts at home. Friend: Are they creature comforts? You: Yeah, most homesick. Friend: What do you miss? You: Yes, bed and hot food.

credit with.context: 你说大家都说他脾气好，说这种被人认为有好脾气，是他最让人喜欢的地方。
credit with.translation: 朋友：大家咋评价他 你：说他脾气好 朋友：是被认为有好脾气吗 你：对啊，最招人喜欢 朋友：你也这样觉得吗 你：对，这样
credit with.example: Friend: How does everyone see him? You: Say he has a good temper. Friend: Is he credited with a good temper? You: Yeah, most likable. Friend: Do you think so too? You: Yes, do.

creep in.context: 你说拖延这毛病，是一点点慢慢养成的，说这种悄悄滋长的坏习惯，想改也难。
creep in.translation: 朋友：你拖延咋来的 你：一点点养成 朋友：是悄悄滋生吗 你：对啊，想改也难 朋友：你改了没 你：对，慢慢改
creep in.example: Friend: How did procrastination start? You: Grew little by little. Friend: Did it creep in? You: Yeah, hard to change. Friend: Have you changed it? You: Yes, slowly.

creep up on.context: 你说年纪这个东西，是不知不觉就来的，说这种悄然袭来的变化，让人回头才惊觉。
creep up on.translation: 朋友：你咋突然开始养生了 你：年纪悄悄就来了 朋友：是悄然袭来吗 你：对啊，回头才惊觉 朋友：你今年多大了 你：对，四十
creep up on.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly start health care? You: Age crept up on me. Friend: Did it creep up on you? You: Yeah, look back and startle. Friend: How old are you this year? You: Yes, forty.

creepy crawly.context: 你说小孩一见着地上爬的小虫子就喊害怕，说这种小爬虫，是小孩最讨厌的东西。
creepy crawly.translation: 朋友：那小孩怕啥 你：地上爬的小虫子 朋友：是小爬虫吗 你：对啊，最讨厌 朋友：你小时候怕吗 你：对，也怕
creepy crawly.example: Friend: What is that child afraid of? You: Little crawling bugs on the ground. Friend: Are they creepy crawlies? You: Yeah, most hated. Friend: Were you afraid as a kid? You: Yes, were.

cricket ground.context: 你说那种大片绿油油的场地上，一群人追着球跑，说这就是英国人最爱的板球场。
cricket ground.translation: 朋友：那片绿场上跑的是啥 你：打板球的人 朋友：是板球场吗 你：对啊，英国人最爱 朋友：你看过比赛没 你：对，看过
cricket ground.example: Friend: Who is running on that green field? You: Cricket players. Friend: Is it a cricket ground? You: Yeah, Brits love it most. Friend: Have you watched a match? You: Yes, have.

crime investigation.context: 你说那种警察查案子、追真凶的剧最好看，说这种犯罪调查的剧情，一集接一集停不下来。
crime investigation.translation: 朋友：你最爱看啥剧 你：警察查案的 朋友：是犯罪调查吗 你：对啊，停不下来 朋友：你最近追哪部 你：对，一部悬疑剧
crime investigation.example: Friend: What shows do you love most? You: Police solving cases. Friend: Is it crime investigation? You: Yeah, can't stop. Friend: Which one are you following lately? You: Yes, a mystery show.

crime scene.context: 你说警察一到现场，就把那块地方围起来，说这种案发现场，多一眼都不能多看。
crime scene.translation: 朋友：那地方为啥围起来 你：警察在查案 朋友：是案发现场吗 你：对啊，不能多看 朋友：你靠近过没 你：对，没靠近
crime scene.example: Friend: Why is that area cordoned off? You: Police are investigating. Friend: Is it a crime scene? You: Yeah, can't look close. Friend: Have you been near it? You: Yes, haven't.

critical infrastructure.context: 你说电、水、路这些东西一旦停了，全城都得乱，说这种关键基础设施，平时看不见，缺了才知道重要。
critical infrastructure.translation: 朋友：停电那天啥感觉 你：全城都乱了 朋友：是关键基础设施吗 你：对啊，缺了才知道 朋友：你咋办的 你：对，等来电
critical infrastructure.example: Friend: What did the blackout feel like? You: The whole city fell apart. Friend: Is it critical infrastructure? You: Yeah, only know its importance when gone. Friend: What did you do? You: Yes, wait for power.

critical mark.context: 你说那条河的污染指标一到那个临界值，就不能再往里面排东西了，说再排就要出大事。
critical mark.translation: 朋友：那河能再排东西不 你：到临界值了 朋友：是临界值吗 你：对啊，再排出大事 朋友：现在咋补救 你：对，先治污
critical mark.example: Friend: Can we still dump into that river? You: Hit the critical mark. Friend: Is it the critical mark? You: Yeah, more dumping brings disaster. Friend: How to fix now? You: Yes, clean the pollution first.

crop cultivation.context: 你说那一片田一年四季轮着种不同的庄稼，说这种作物种植，是农民一年到头最忙的事。
crop cultivation.translation: 朋友：那片田一年忙啥 你：轮着种庄稼 朋友：是作物种植吗 你：对啊，一年到头忙 朋友：你种过地没 你：对，没种过
crop cultivation.example: Friend: What is that field busy with all year? You: Rotating crops. Friend: Is it crop cultivation? You: Yeah, busy all year. Friend: Have you farmed? You: Yes, haven't.

crop pollination.context: 你说那些蜜蜂在花上飞来飞去，是在帮庄稼授粉，说这种授粉做得好，秋天才能多打粮。
crop pollination.translation: 朋友：那蜜蜂在花上干啥 你：帮庄稼授粉 朋友：是作物授粉吗 你：对啊，秋天多打粮 朋友：蜜蜂少了会咋样 你：对，粮减产
crop pollination.example: Friend: What are those bees doing on the flowers? You: Pollinating crops. Friend: Is it crop pollination? You: Yeah, more grain in autumn. Friend: What if bees decline? You: Yes, grain drops.

cross.context: 你说过马路得先看左右，别跟车抢道，说这种横穿马路的事，最危险。
cross.translation: 朋友：过马路你咋看的 你：先看左右 朋友：是横穿吗 你：对啊，别跟车抢 朋友：你被车吓过没 你：对，吓过
cross.example: Friend: How do you cross the road? You: Look left and right first. Friend: Do you cross? You: Yeah, don't fight cars. Friend: Have you been scared by a car? You: Yes, have.

cross my heart.context: 你说这事我真没干，说这种我发誓的话，是让你一定要信我。
cross my heart.translation: 朋友：这事是你干的吗 你：真不是，我发誓 朋友：是我发誓吗 你：对啊，你得信我 朋友：我凭啥信你 你：对，拿人格保证
cross my heart.example: Friend: Did you do this? You: Really not, I swear. Friend: Do you cross your heart? You: Yeah, you must believe me. Friend: Why should I believe you? You: Yes, on my honor.

cross the finishing line.context: 你说他跑最后冲刺，第一个冲过终点线，说这种赢的瞬间，全场都为他叫好。
cross the finishing line.translation: 朋友：那比赛谁第一个到的 你：他第一个冲线 朋友：是冲过终点线吗 你：对啊，全场叫好 朋友：你为他高兴不 你：对，高兴
cross the finishing line.example: Friend: Who was first in that race? You: He crossed the line first. Friend: Did he cross the finishing line? You: Yeah, the crowd cheered. Friend: Are you happy for him? You: Yes, happy.

cross your mind.context: 你说走在街上，忽然想起白天忘了给朋友回消息，说这种念头一闪过，自己都吓一跳。
cross your mind.translation: 朋友：你咋突然掏手机 你：想起忘回消息了 朋友：是突然想到吗 你：对啊，吓一跳 朋友：你回了没 你：对，马上回
cross your mind.example: Friend: Why do you suddenly take out your phone? You: Reminded I forgot to reply. Friend: Did it cross your mind? You: Yeah, startled. Friend: Did you reply? You: Yes, right away.

crow's feet.context: 你说爱笑的人，眼角慢慢长出一道道细纹，说这种鱼尾纹，是她笑了好多年的记号。
crow's feet.translation: 朋友：她眼角那是啥 你：笑出来的细纹 朋友：是鱼尾纹吗 你：对啊，笑了好多年 朋友：你觉得这好看吗 你：对，好看
crow's feet.example: Friend: What is that at the corner of her eyes? You: Fine lines from smiling. Friend: Are they crow's feet? You: Yeah, from years of smiling. Friend: Do you think it's pretty? You: Yes, pretty.

crown of the head.context: 你说被人从头顶轻轻拍一下，都能感觉到，说这种头顶的地方，最敏感。
crown of the head.translation: 朋友：你头被拍一下啥感觉 你：特别敏感 朋友：是头顶吗 你：对啊，轻轻拍都有感觉 朋友：你喜欢被拍头吗 你：对，不喜欢
crown of the head.example: Friend: How does it feel when your head is patted? You: Very sensitive. Friend: Is it the crown of the head? You: Yeah, a light pat is felt. Friend: Do you like having your head patted? You: Yes, don't.

crucial link.context: 你说吃多少和得什么病，这中间连着一条关键的线，说这就是大家常说的吃什么决定你成为什么。
crucial link.translation: 朋友：吃跟得病有啥关系 你：中间有一条关键的线 朋友：是关键关联吗 你：对啊，吃啥决定啥 朋友：你信这个不 你：对，信
crucial link.example: Friend: What's the link between diet and disease? You: There's a crucial link. Friend: Is it a crucial link? You: Yeah, you are what you eat. Friend: Do you believe this? You: Yes, believe.

cruise ship.context: 你和朋友计划长假出游，在讨论坐哪种交通工具度假时，聊到大游轮。
cruise ship.translation: 朋友：这个长假我们出去玩吧 你：我们坐游轮去海上度假怎么样 朋友：好啊 还能在船上看日出 你：听说那艘游轮特别大 上面还有游泳池
cruise ship.example: Friend: Let's go somewhere this long holiday. You: How about taking a cruise ship to vacation on the sea? Friend: Great, we can watch sunrise on board. You: I heard that cruise ship is huge and even has a swimming pool.

cry like a baby.context: 你陪朋友看了一部特别感人的电影，散场后他还坐在座位上抹眼泪，你忍不住调侃他。
cry like a baby.translation: 朋友：这部电影也太好哭了吧 你：你怎么哭成这样了 朋友：我也控制不住 看到最后那段直接崩溃了 你：你都这么大了还像小孩一样嚎啕大哭
cry like a baby.example: Friend: This movie is such a tearjerker. You: Why are you crying like that? Friend: I couldn't help it; the ending totally broke me. You: You're all grown up and still cry like a baby.

crying shame.context: 朋友准备了半年的比赛临时取消，你约他吃饭时替他觉得十分惋惜。
crying shame.translation: 朋友：我准备了半年的比赛今天取消了 你：太可惜了 你练了那么久 朋友：是啊 白忙活了这么久 你：真是件憾事 不过下次还有机会
crying shame.example: Friend: The competition I trained for half a year was called off today. You: That's a crying shame after all your practice. Friend: Yeah, all that effort went to waste. You: It really is a crying shame, but there's always next time.

crystal clear.context: 老师反复讲了几遍的数学题你还是不懂，最后他换了种方式一讲，你一下子就通了。
crystal clear.translation: 朋友：这道题你弄懂了吗 你：老师讲得太快 我还是一头雾水 朋友：那我换个思路给你讲一遍 你：现在我彻底明白了 简直一清二楚
crystal clear.example: Friend: Did you figure out this problem? You: The teacher went too fast and I'm still lost. Friend: Let me explain it again in a different way. You: Now it's crystal clear to me.

culinary creativity.context: 你在家做饭总爱把两种不相干的食材凑一起，朋友来吃饭时夸你很有做菜灵感。
culinary creativity.translation: 朋友：今天这道菜搭配得也太妙了 你：我就是随便把冰箱里的食材凑一起 朋友：你在做饭上还真有想法 你：主要是喜欢折腾点美食创意
culinary creativity.example: Friend: The flavor pairing in this dish is brilliant. You: I just threw together whatever was in the fridge. Friend: You really have a flair in the kitchen. You: I just love experimenting with culinary creativity.

culinary desire.context: 深夜路过餐厅闻到一阵香味，你突然特别想吃顿好的，打电话跟朋友抱怨。
culinary desire.translation: 朋友：大晚上的你打电话干嘛 你：我路过火锅店 突然食欲大开 朋友：那你赶紧去吃啊 你：可是怕吃夜宵长胖 这饮食欲望真折磨人
culinary desire.example: Friend: Why are you calling me so late? You: I passed a hotpot place and suddenly had a huge craving. Friend: Then just go eat. You: But I'm afraid of gaining weight; this culinary desire is torture.

culinary skill.context: 你最近跟着美食视频天天练菜，朋友尝过你的手艺后，夸你进步飞快。
culinary skill.translation: 朋友：你这菜做得比餐厅还好吃 你：我最近天天跟着视频学做菜 朋友：怪不得 刀工和火候都很到位 你：都是慢慢练出来的烹饪技巧
culinary skill.example: Friend: This tastes better than restaurant food. You: I've been following cooking videos every day. Friend: No wonder; your knife work and timing are spot on. You: It's cooking skill built up slowly.

culinary tips.context: 妈妈打电话来教你做鱼，分享了几个她多年总结的厨房小窍门，你转述给朋友听。
culinary tips.translation: 朋友：你做的鱼怎么一点腥味都没有 你：我妈在电话里教了我几招 朋友：快说说是什么秘诀 你：她说煎鱼前用料酒腌一下 这都是实用的烹饪窍门
culinary tips.example: Friend: How come your fish has no fishy smell? You: My mom taught me a few tricks over the phone. Friend: Tell me the secret. You: She said marinate it in cooking wine first; that's a handy culinary tip.

culinary tradition.context: 你带外国朋友回老家过年，他对年夜饭一定要吃饺子这件事特别好奇。
culinary tradition.translation: 朋友：为什么过年你们一定要吃饺子 你：这是我们老辈传下来的饮食传统 朋友：每道菜背后都有故事吗 你：当然了 这就是中国的烹饪传统
culinary tradition.example: Friend: Why do you always eat dumplings during the New Year? You: It's a food tradition passed down from our elders. Friend: Does every dish have a story? You: Of course; that's our culinary tradition.

cultural export.context: 你们在咖啡馆聊起一部国产剧在海外爆红的现象，讨论这算不算一种对外输出。
cultural export.translation: 朋友：最近这部国产剧在国外特别火 你：对啊 好多外国人都在追 朋友：这算是一种文化输出吧 你：没错 好的文化就该走出去
cultural export.example: Friend: This homegrown drama is huge overseas lately. You: Yeah, so many foreigners are hooked on it. Friend: That counts as a cultural export, right? You: Exactly; good culture should go global.

cultural heritage.context: 你们去古城旅游，站在一座几百年的老建筑前，聊起文物保护的话题。
cultural heritage.translation: 朋友：这老房子都几百年了还这么结实 你：它是全国重点保护的文化遗产 朋友：能保存到现在真不容易 你：是啊 我们这代人得好好守护它
cultural heritage.example: Friend: This old house has stood for hundreds of years. You: It's a cultural heritage site under national protection. Friend: It's remarkable it survived this long. You: Yeah, our generation must protect it well.

cultural idea.context: 你和外国室友聊到为什么年轻人总要回老家发展，发现背后是不同的固有想法。
cultural idea.translation: 朋友：你们为什么毕业后一定要回老家 你：这是我们从小接受的文化观念 朋友：我们那边人更愿意去大城市闯荡 你：每代人的固有想法确实不一样
cultural idea.example: Friend: Why do you have to go back to your hometown after graduation? You: It's a cultural idea we grow up with. Friend: People where I'm from prefer big cities. You: Each generation's cultural idea is really different.

cultural immersion.context: 你准备去国外短期游学，朋友问跟团旅游和住在当地人家到底有什么差别。
cultural immersion.translation: 朋友：去国外玩跟住在当地人家一样吗 你：完全不同 住进去才能真正融入 朋友：就是那种沉浸式体验对吧 你：对 这才是真正的文化沉浸
cultural immersion.example: Friend: Is sightseeing abroad the same as living with locals? You: Totally different; only by staying can you truly fit in. Friend: That immersive experience, right? You: Exactly, that's real cultural immersion.

cultural melting pot.context: 你们聊到移民城市为什么包容性强，自然联想到纽约那样的地方。
cultural melting pot.translation: 朋友：为什么纽约能容纳那么多人 你：它就像一个文化大熔炉 各种人都能聚在一起 朋友：那不同文化不会冲突吗 你：反而互相融合 越来越丰富
cultural melting pot.example: Friend: Why can New York hold so many people? You: It's like a cultural melting pot where everyone gathers. Friend: Don't cultures clash? You: Instead they blend and become richer.

cultural movement.context: 上艺术史课讲到文艺复兴，老师在课上介绍这是一场影响深远的思想解放运动。
cultural movement.translation: 朋友：文艺复兴到底是怎么兴起的 你：它其实是一场伟大的文化运动 朋友：都影响了哪些方面 你：绘画、建筑和文学全都被改变了
cultural movement.example: Friend: How did the Renaissance actually begin? You: It was a great cultural movement. Friend: What did it influence? You: It transformed painting, architecture, and literature.

cultural norm.context: 你刚到国外上学，学长提醒你当地有些社交习惯和国内很不一样，别失礼。
cultural norm.translation: 朋友：去了那边记得先了解一下当地规矩 你：比如有什么要注意的吗 朋友：见面打招呼的方式就不同 你：看来入乡随俗 尊重当地社会习俗很重要
cultural norm.example: Friend: Learn the local rules before you go there. You: Anything specific I should watch for? Friend: Even the way people greet each other differs. You: So respecting local cultural norms really matters.

cultural site.context: 你们周末计划去郊外踏青，在网上查附近有什么值得一看的古迹遗址。
cultural site.translation: 朋友：周末我们去哪儿玩比较好 你：郊外有处很有名的文化遗址 朋友：那里现在还能看到古迹吗 你：当然 还有保存完好的古代城墙呢
cultural site.example: Friend: Where should we go this weekend? You: There's a famous cultural site in the suburbs. Friend: Can we still see the relics there? You: Sure, some ancient walls are still well preserved.

culturally diverse.context: 你在国际学校读书，班里同学来自世界各地，朋友听了特别羡慕你的环境。
culturally diverse.translation: 朋友：你们班里同学都是哪里人啊 你：来自二十多个国家 特别多元 朋友：那一定很有意思 你：对 我们学校是出了名的多元文化
culturally diverse.example: Friend: Where do your classmates come from? You: Over twenty countries; it's very diverse. Friend: That must be fascinating. You: Yeah, our school is famously culturally diverse.

cumulus cloud.context: 周末爬山时天空飘着大片棉花糖一样的云，你和朋友停下来仰头拍照。
cumulus cloud.translation: 朋友：你看天上那朵云多像棉花糖 你：这是典型的积云 晴天才会有 朋友：难怪今天天气这么好 你：这种云通常预示着好天气
cumulus cloud.example: Friend: Look, that cloud looks like cotton candy. You: That's a typical cumulus cloud; it only appears on clear days. Friend: No wonder the weather is so nice. You: These clouds usually mean good weather ahead.

cup of tea.context: 朋友约你去玩蹦极，你其实不太敢碰刺激项目，委婉地表示这不合你的胃口。
cup of tea.translation: 朋友：周末我们去蹦极吧 特别刺激 你：我胆子小 这种项目不太适合我 朋友：那你平时喜欢玩什么 你：安静点的才是我喜欢的类型
cup of tea.example: Friend: Let's go bungee jumping this weekend, it's thrilling. You: I'm not brave; that's not really my cup of tea. Friend: What do you usually enjoy? You: Something calm is more my cup of tea.

cupboard staple.context: 你教刚一个人住的朋友怎么买菜不浪费，告诉他哪些东西建议一直囤在橱柜里。
cupboard staple.translation: 朋友：一个人住买菜总是浪费 你：你可以先囤些常备食材 朋友：比如哪些呢 你：大米、面条和罐头 这些都是橱柜里的必备品
cupboard staple.example: Friend: Living alone, I always waste groceries. You: You can stock up on cupboard staples first. Friend: Like what? You: Rice, noodles, and canned food are real cupboard staples.

curb consumption.context: 新闻里说要提倡节约用电，你和朋友在晚饭时聊起自己平时能做什么。
curb consumption.translation: 朋友：今天新闻说要节约用电了 你：是啊 大家都得控制用电 朋友：那我们平时要注意什么 你：出门随手关灯 减少不必要的消耗
curb consumption.example: Friend: The news says we should save electricity today. You: Yeah, everyone must curb their power consumption. Friend: What should we watch in daily life? You: Turn off lights when out and curb unnecessary consumption.

curb usage.context: 医生说你最近用眼过度，让你少看手机，你跟朋友吐槽戒手机好难。
curb usage.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不怎么刷手机了 你：医生让我控制手机使用时间 朋友：每天只能玩多久啊 你：说最多一小时 不然眼睛受不了
curb usage.example: Friend: Why aren't you on your phone much lately? You: The doctor told me to curb my screen usage. Friend: How long a day can you use it? You: At most an hour, or my eyes can't take it.

curl up.context: 下雨天你哪儿也不想去，窝在沙发角落盖着毯子看小说，朋友视频来看你。
curl up.translation: 朋友：今天下这么大雨 你打算干嘛 你：我就蜷缩在沙发上看小说 朋友：盖着毯子一定很舒服吧 你：对 配上热茶 简直太惬意了
curl up.example: Friend: It's raining so hard today; what are you up to? You: I'll just curl up on the sofa with a novel. Friend: That must be cozy under a blanket. You: Yeah, with hot tea, it's pure bliss.

current account.context: 你准备办人生第一张银行卡，大堂经理耐心地向你解释两种账户的区别。
current account.translation: 朋友：办银行卡选哪种账户好呢 你：经理说日常用办活期账户就行 朋友：那这个账户有什么用 你：平时存取钱都用它 很方便
current account.example: Friend: Which bank account should I choose? You: The manager said a current account is enough for daily use. Friend: What is it for? You: You deposit and withdraw money from it; it's very convenient.

cursive writing.context: 你翻到外婆年轻时的笔记本，发现她当年的字写得特别流畅连笔，拿来给朋友看。
cursive writing.translation: 朋友：你看我外婆年轻时写的字 你：她写的是连笔字 真漂亮 朋友：现在还有人这么写字吗 你：很少了 大家都习惯打字了
cursive writing.example: Friend: Look at the handwriting from my grandma's youth. You: It's cursive writing; it's really beautiful. Friend: Does anyone still write like that? You: Rarely; everyone is used to typing now.

custom itinerary.context: 你们厌倦了跟团赶景点，决定找旅行社按自己的喜好重新安排路线。
custom itinerary.translation: 朋友：跟团游太累了 天天赶景点 你：那我们做个定制行程吧 朋友：这样能按自己的节奏玩吗 你：当然 想去哪就去哪
custom itinerary.example: Friend: Package tours are exhausting, always rushing. You: Then let's make a custom itinerary. Friend: Can we go at our own pace? You: Of course; we go wherever we want.

customary tip.context: 你第一次去国外餐厅吃饭，结账时不知道该给多少，朋友悄悄提醒你规矩。
customary tip.translation: 朋友：吃完饭服务员问你吃得怎么样 你：吃得挺好 不过我该给多少小费 朋友：一般给账单的百分之十五 这是当地的惯例 你：明白了 下次就按这个给
customary tip.example: Friend: The waiter asked how you liked the meal. You: Great, but how much should I tip? Friend: Usually fifteen percent of the bill; that's the customary tip. You: Got it, I'll tip that way next time.

customer base.context: 朋友刚开了家小咖啡馆，生意不温不火，你们在讨论怎么把客人留住。
customer base.translation: 朋友：我这店开了半年 客人还是不多 你：先把现有的客户群维护好 朋友：要怎么做呢 你：加个微信群 逢年过节送点小优惠
customer base.example: Friend: My shop has been open half a year and still has few customers. You: First maintain your existing customer base well. Friend: How? You: Start a WeChat group and offer little discounts on holidays.

customer loyalty.context: 你们在排队买咖啡，聊到那家店为什么回头客特别多、大家都认准它。
customer loyalty.translation: 朋友：那家咖啡店为什么天天都满座 你：它家积分卡做得好 顾客愿意一直来 朋友：这就是培养了忠诚度吧 你：对 靠的就是顾客忠诚度
customer loyalty.example: Friend: Why is that coffee shop always packed? You: Their loyalty card works; customers keep coming back. Friend: That's building customer loyalty, right? You: Yeah, it all comes down to customer loyalty.

cut back.context: 体检报告说你血糖偏高，医生嘱咐你少吃甜食，你约朋友吃饭时说起。
cut back.translation: 朋友：医生怎么说你的血糖 你：让我少吃糖和甜饮料 朋友：那奶茶还能喝吗 你：得减量了 尽量改喝白开水
cut back.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about your blood sugar? You: Told me to cut back on sugar and sweet drinks. Friend: Can I still have milk tea? You: You need to cut back; switch to plain water.

cut back on.context: 这个月你们俩都花超了，周末坐在一起对着账单商量怎么节约开支。
cut back on.translation: 朋友：这个月工资又花光了 你：我们得开始减少不必要的开销 朋友：从哪里省起呢 你：先少点几次外卖 省下不少
cut back on.example: Friend: My salary is gone again this month. You: We need to cut back on unnecessary spending. Friend: Where do we start saving? You: Order takeout less; that saves a lot.

cut consumption.context: 公司今年下了节能指标，会议室门口贴了随手关灯提示，你和同事聊起。
cut consumption.translation: 朋友：公司最近怎么这么省电 你：听说今年要降低能耗指标 朋友：那我们平时要注意什么 你：下班关电脑 减少不必要的消耗
cut consumption.example: Friend: Why is the company saving power so much lately? You: They need to cut this year's energy use. Friend: What should we watch? You: Shut down computers after work and cut wasteful consumption.

cut costs.context: 公司效益不好，开会要求各部门压缩开支，你和同事在茶水间私下聊。
cut costs.translation: 朋友：听说公司要开始省钱了 你：是啊 各部门都在削减开支 朋友：那我们的报销会受影响吗 你：不好说 先把成本砍下来要紧
cut costs.example: Friend: I heard the company is about to tighten its belt. You: Yeah, every department is cutting costs. Friend: Will our reimbursements be affected? You: Hard to say; cutting costs comes first.

cut down purchases.context: 你衣柜已经塞不下了，下定决心这季度少买新衣服，朋友表示支持。
cut down purchases.translation: 朋友：你最近都不逛街买衣服了 你：衣柜都塞爆了 得减少购物 朋友：那看到打折也忍住不买吗 你：对 非必要的都先不买
cut down purchases.example: Friend: You haven't gone shopping for clothes lately. You: My wardrobe is overflowing; I must cut down purchases. Friend: Even when there's a sale? You: Yeah, skip buying anything nonessential.

cut emissions.context: 新闻说本市要大力发展公共交通，你和朋友讨论这跟环保有什么关系。
cut emissions.translation: 朋友：最近怎么到处都在修地铁 你：为了鼓励大家绿色出行 朋友：这样做有什么好处 你：能减少汽车尾气 帮助减排
cut emissions.example: Friend: Why are they building subway lines everywhere? You: To encourage green travel for everyone. Friend: What's the benefit? You: It reduces tailpipe emissions and helps cut emissions overall.

cut food waste.context: 你发现自己每次做饭都做多、倒掉可惜，朋友教你按顿买菜别贪多。
cut food waste.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天倒剩饭剩菜 你：每次买菜都买多了 朋友：你可以按顿数买 少做一点 你：好办法 这样还能减少厨余浪费
cut food waste.example: Friend: Why do you throw away leftovers every day? You: I always buy too much groceries. Friend: Buy by the number of meals and cook less. You: Good idea; that helps cut food waste too.

cut funding.context: 学校突然削减了实验室经费，学长学姐们在走廊里议论接下来怎么办。
cut funding.translation: 朋友：听说学校要砍掉咱们实验室的经费了 你：是啊 新项目可能做不了了 朋友：那今年的实验怎么办 你：只能压缩开支 先保住要紧的
cut funding.example: Friend: I heard the school decided to cut funding for our lab. You: Yeah, the new project may not happen. Friend: What about this year's experiments? You: We'll trim budgets and keep only what's essential.

cut one's teeth.context: 朋友刚毕业在小公司天天打杂，觉得没前途，你安慰他新人都是这么过来的。
cut one's teeth.translation: 朋友：我天天在公司复印跑腿 感觉没前途 你：别着急 新人都是从基层练起的 朋友：这样真能学到东西吗 你：当然 先在小事上历练出来再说
cut one's teeth.example: Friend: I just copy and run errands at the office; it feels pointless. You: Don't worry; newcomers cut their teeth on small stuff first. Friend: Can I really learn that way? You: Of course; you cut your teeth before moving up.

cut short.context: 你周末本来计划出去玩，结果临时通知要加班，只好把行程一压再压。
cut short.translation: 朋友：周末不是说好去爬山吗 你：临时要加班 只能把行程缩短了 朋友：那还能去成吗 你：勉强去半天 也算放松一下
cut short.example: Friend: Weren't we supposed to hike this weekend? You: I have to work overtime, so I'll cut it short. Friend: Can we still go? You: Just for half a day; at least we relax a bit.

cut tedious work.context: 公司上线新系统后，报销、填表这些杂活儿自动流转了，你和同事在茶水间松了口气。
cut tedious work.translation: 朋友：最近公司是不是轻松多了 你：是啊 新系统把那些繁琐的活儿都自动化了 朋友：以前填报销单要多久 你：现在系统自动搞定 省了好多重复劳动
cut tedious work.example: Friend: Isn't work much easier lately? You: Yeah, the new system cuts tedious work automatically. Friend: How long did filling expense reports take before? You: Now the system handles it, cutting tedious work and saving us hours.

cut the risk of.context: 冬天流感高发，医生建议打疫苗，你跟朋友解释打疫苗到底有什么用。
cut the risk of.translation: 朋友：冬天流感这么厉害 我们要怎么预防 你：去打个疫苗能降低得病风险 朋友：除了打疫苗还要注意什么 你：勤洗手、戴口罩 都能减少被传染的可能
cut the risk of.example: Friend: Flu is raging in winter; how do we protect ourselves? You: Getting a vaccine can cut the risk of catching it. Friend: Anything else? You: Wash hands often and wear masks; that also cuts the risk of infection.

cut tobacco consumption.context: 新闻里说公共场所全面禁烟后，街上抽烟的人明显少了，你和朋友散步时聊起。
cut tobacco consumption.translation: 朋友：最近路上抽烟的人好像少了 你：因为公共场所都开始禁烟了 朋友：这办法真有效啊 你：对 政策一推行 烟草消耗确实降下来了
cut tobacco consumption.example: Friend: Fewer people seem to smoke on the street lately. You: Because smoking is banned in public places. Friend: That really works. You: Yeah, once the policy kicks in, they cut tobacco consumption.

cut up.context: 你坐朋友的车下班，旁边一辆车突然从非机动车道别过来，朋友气得直按喇叭。
cut up.translation: 朋友：刚才那辆车怎么回事 硬往前面插 你：他从非机动车道直接切过来 太危险了 朋友：这种加塞的人真没素质 你：就是 随便别车最讨厌了
cut up.example: Friend: What was that car doing, cutting right in front? You: He cut us up from the bike lane; it was dangerous. Friend: Drivers who cut people up have no manners. You: Exactly; cutting people up on the road is the worst.

cut working hours.context: 公司试行四天工作制，你和同事午休时兴奋地讨论这会带来什么改变。
cut working hours.translation: 朋友：听说公司要试行四天工作制了 你：真的吗 那我们的工时能缩短多少 朋友：好像每周少上一天班 你：太好了 这样能多陪陪家人
cut working hours.example: Friend: I heard the company is trying a four-day week. You: Really? How much will they cut working hours? Friend: Apparently one day off a week. You: Great, that gives me more time with family.

cutting out.context: 朋友体检发现身上长了个小东西，医生建议做个小手术拿掉，他拿报告来问你。
cutting out.translation: 朋友：医生说我身上长了个小东西 你：严重吗 要怎么处理 朋友：建议做个小手术把它切除 你：那赶紧约时间 早做早放心
cutting out.example: Friend: The doctor found a small thing growing on me. You: Is it serious? How do they treat it? Friend: They suggest a minor surgery for cutting it out. You: Then book it soon; better done early.

cutting-edge technology.context: 你们去逛科技展会，被一台能自己炒菜、还会端盘的机器人吸引住了。
cutting-edge technology.translation: 朋友：你看这台机器居然能自己炒菜 你：现在的技术真是越来越先进了 朋友：这就是最新的前沿科技吧 你：对 展会到处都是这类尖端技术
cutting-edge technology.example: Friend: Look, this machine can stir-fry by itself. You: Technology is really advanced these days. Friend: That's cutting-edge technology, right? You: Yeah, the whole show is full of cutting-edge technology.

cyber thief.context: 同事的账号被盗、钱被骗子转走，公司在群里发安全提醒，大家议论纷纷。
cyber thief.translation: 朋友：听说小王的账号昨天被盗了 你：啊 钱也被转走了吗 朋友：对 骗子伪装成客服骗了他 你：现在网络窃贼手段太多了 大家都得小心
cyber thief.example: Friend: I heard Xiao Wang's account was hacked yesterday. You: Really? Was his money stolen too? Friend: Yeah, the scammer pretended to be customer service. You: Cyber thieves have so many tricks; everyone must stay alert.

cycle lane.context: 你每天骑车上班，发现路边新画了一条专用车道，骑起来安心多了。
cycle lane.translation: 朋友：你骑车上班路上安全吗 你：最近路边新修了自行车道 安全多了 朋友：有专用道就不怕汽车抢了 你：对 骑车走在专用道上特别安心
cycle lane.example: Friend: Is it safe cycling to work? You: They just painted a cycle lane on the road; much safer. Friend: Then cars won't cut you off. You: Yeah, riding in the cycle lane feels really safe.

dad dancing.context: 家庭聚会上你爸被亲戚拉起来跳舞，动作又土又认真，全家都笑弯了腰。
dad dancing.translation: 朋友：你爸刚才那舞跳得太搞笑了 你：他还觉得自己跳得特别好 朋友：那动作简直是老爸专属舞步 你：对 一本正经地乱扭 特别可爱
dad dancing.example: Friend: The way your dad danced was hilarious. You: He actually thinks he's a great dancer. Friend: That's classic dad dancing right there. You: Yeah, he dances dead seriously; it's so cute.

daily commute.context: 你每天上下班要坐一小时地铁，跟约饭的朋友吐槽路上耗掉的时间。
daily commute.translation: 朋友：你上班路上要花多久啊 你：单程一个小时 天天如此 朋友：那通勤挺辛苦的 你：是啊 每天上下班路上就要耗两小时
daily commute.example: Friend: How long is your daily commute? You: An hour each way, every single day. Friend: That's a tough daily commute. You: Yeah, my daily commute eats up two hours a day.

daily grind.context: 周五晚上你瘫在椅子上，跟刚下班的朋友感叹这一周上班真的太累了。
daily grind.translation: 朋友：终于到周末了 你：可不是嘛 这周上班快把我累垮了 朋友：天天早起挤地铁确实辛苦 你：这就是上班族的日常奔波啊
daily grind.example: Friend: The weekend is finally here. You: Tell me about it; work wore me out this week. Friend: Waking early and taking the subway is tough. You: That's just the daily grind of office life.

daily hardship.context: 你看了部讲山区孩子上学的纪录片，跟朋友感慨那些孩子过得真不容易。
daily hardship.translation: 朋友：纪录片里那些孩子真可怜 你：他们每天天不亮就要走山路上学 朋友：这日子也太苦了 你：是啊 这些日常的磨难我们很难想象
daily hardship.example: Friend: Those kids in the documentary are so pitiful. You: They hike mountain trails before dawn every day. Friend: That's such a hard life. You: Yeah, we can hardly imagine these daily hardships.

daily life.context: 你刚从国外交换回来，朋友约你叙旧，让你讲讲那边的日子跟国内有什么不同。
daily life.translation: 朋友：交换那一年过得怎么样 你：那边的生活节奏比国内慢很多 朋友：平时一天都怎么安排呢 你：其实就是很普通的日常生活 上学、做饭、散步
daily life.example: Friend: How was your exchange year? You: Life there moved much slower than at home. Friend: What did a typical day look like? You: Just ordinary daily life; studying, cooking, walking.

daily lives.context: 你和各国朋友聊天，发现虽然文化不同，但大家一天的日子过得都差不多。
daily lives.translation: 朋友：你跟外国室友都聊些什么 你：聊各自国家的日子是怎么过的 朋友：差别大吗 你：其实大家的日常生活都差不多 上班吃饭睡觉
daily lives.example: Friend: What do you chat about with your foreign roommates? You: About how daily life goes in our countries. Friend: Is it very different? You: Actually our daily lives are much the same; work, eat, sleep.

daily requirement.context: 你在健身增肌，看营养标签算每天该吃多少蛋白质，朋友凑过来看你在算什么。
daily requirement.translation: 朋友：你天天盯着营养表算什么呢 你：算我每天该摄入多少蛋白质 朋友：一天大概要吃多少 你：按体重算 得达到每日需求量才行
daily requirement.example: Friend: Why do you stare at nutrition labels all day? You: Calculating how much protein I need daily. Friend: How much per day? You: Based on my weight, I must meet the daily requirement.

daily ritual.context: 你有个坚持多年的小习惯，每天早起先喝一杯温水，朋友听了觉得很特别。
daily ritual.translation: 朋友：你每天起床第一件事是干嘛 你：先空腹喝一杯温白开 朋友：你怎么坚持这么多年的 你：这已经成了我的日常小仪式了
daily ritual.example: Friend: What's the first thing you do every morning? You: Drink a glass of warm water on an empty stomach. Friend: How have you kept it for years? You: It's become my little daily ritual.

daily routine.context: 放假在家你作息全乱了，朋友约午饭发现你大中午才迷迷糊糊起床。
daily routine.translation: 朋友：你假期怎么天天中午才起 你：一放假作息就全乱套了 朋友：以前你不是挺规律的吗 你：是啊 还是得把日常作息调回来
daily routine.example: Friend: Why do you wake at noon every holiday? You: My routine completely falls apart on vacation. Friend: Weren't you pretty regular before? You: Yeah, I need to get my daily routine back.

daily staples.context: 你帮刚出国的朋友列超市采购清单，告诉他几样天天都要吃的东西。
daily staples.translation: 朋友：刚到这边 超市都该买些什么 你：先把大米、面条这些主食买齐 朋友：调料之类的也要买吗 你：对 这些都是日常离不开的主食
daily staples.example: Friend: I just got here; what should I buy at the supermarket? You: Stock up on rice and noodles first. Friend: What about seasonings? You: Yes, those daily staples are things you can't live without.

daily tasks.context: 你刚当上班委，老师列了一堆每天要盯的小事，你拿给同是班委的朋友看。
daily tasks.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天忙忙碌碌的 你：老师让我负责每天的班级小事 朋友：都要做些什么呢 你：点名、发作业、盯卫生 这些日常任务
daily tasks.example: Friend: Why are you so busy these days? You: The teacher put me in charge of small daily class duties. Friend: Like what? You: Taking attendance, handing out homework, checking tidiness; these daily tasks.

dairy allergy.context: 你和朋友去蛋糕店买甜点，对方坚决不拿奶油款，你问了才知道原因。
dairy allergy.translation: 朋友：这块奶油蛋糕看起来很好吃啊 你：我不能吃 我对乳制品过敏 朋友：那奶茶那些也不能喝吗 你：对 含奶的东西我都碰不得
dairy allergy.example: Friend: That cream cake looks delicious. You: I can't eat it; I have a dairy allergy. Friend: So no milk tea either? You: Right; anything with dairy is off-limits for me.

dairy milk.context: 你最近胃不好改喝燕麦奶，朋友看到你购物车里的东西问起缘由。
dairy milk.translation: 朋友：你怎么改成喝燕麦奶了 你：我对普通牛乳有点不耐受 朋友：那喝着味道一样吗 你：差不多 习惯了也挺好喝
dairy milk.example: Friend: Why did you switch to oat milk? You: Regular dairy milk doesn't agree with me. Friend: Does it taste the same? You: Pretty similar; once you get used to it, it's fine.

dairy product.context: 你们在超市采购，朋友指着冷藏柜问哪些东西算同一类食品。
dairy product.translation: 朋友：冷藏柜里哪些东西是乳制品啊 你：牛奶、酸奶、奶酪都算 朋友：那黄油也算吗 你：对 这些都是常见的乳制品
dairy product.example: Friend: Which items in the fridge section are dairy products? You: Milk, yogurt, and cheese all count. Friend: Is butter included? You: Yes; these are all common dairy products.

danger zone.context: 妈妈学了食品安全知识，打电话提醒你肉在室温下放太久就不能吃了。
danger zone.translation: 朋友：这块肉在外面放了一上午还能吃吗 你：放这么久可不能吃了 朋友：为什么呀 你：室温是细菌繁殖的危险区 肉很容易变质
danger zone.example: Friend: Is this meat still okay after sitting out all morning? You: It can't be eaten after that long. Friend: Why? You: Room temperature is the danger zone where bacteria grow fast.

dangerous driving.context: 新闻里播了一起超速肇事事故，你和朋友边吃晚饭边聊起开车安全。
dangerous driving.translation: 朋友：今天新闻又播了一起车祸 你：司机超速还酒驾 太不像话了 朋友：这种行为是不是犯法的 你：当然 危险驾驶是要负法律责任的
dangerous driving.example: Friend: The news showed another car crash today. You: The driver was speeding and drunk; it's outrageous. Friend: Is that even illegal? You: Of course; dangerous driving has legal consequences.

daredevil pursuit.context: 朋友迷上了攀岩蹦极这类刺激运动，你虽然不敢玩但挺佩服他的胆子。
daredevil pursuit.translation: 朋友：周末我们去玩高空跳伞吧 你：我胆子小 这种冒险活动你自己去吧 朋友：你真该试试 特别解压 你：还是算了 这种冒险消遣不适合我
daredevil pursuit.example: Friend: Let's go skydiving this weekend. You: I'm not brave; you go do that daredevil pursuit yourself. Friend: You should try it; it's a great stress reliever. You: No thanks; that daredevil pursuit isn't for me.

dark chocolate.context: 你在控制甜食，店员推荐低糖零食，你纠结货架上买哪种巧克力。
dark chocolate.translation: 朋友：你不是在戒糖吗 怎么还买巧克力 你：我买的是黑巧克力 含糖少 朋友：那不是特别苦吗 你：习惯了还挺香的 对身体也没那么大负担
dark chocolate.example: Friend: Aren't you cutting sugar? Why buy chocolate? You: I'm getting dark chocolate; it has less sugar. Friend: Isn't it really bitter? You: You get used to it; dark chocolate is easier on the body.

dark fantasy.context: 你最近迷上一类氛围阴郁的小说，兴冲冲地给朋友安利书单。
dark fantasy.translation: 朋友：你最近看的什么小说啊 你：是那种氛围很阴郁的奇幻小说 朋友：听起来怪压抑的 你：不会啊 这种暗黑幻想特别上头 一看就停不下来
dark fantasy.example: Friend: What novel have you been reading lately? You: A fantasy novel with a really gloomy atmosphere. Friend: Sounds depressing. You: Not at all; this dark fantasy is addictive and hard to put down.

dark time.context: 朋友创业失败心情低落，你陪他吃夜宵，聊到他那段最难熬的日子。
dark time.translation: 朋友：去年公司倒闭那会儿 真是我最难的时候 你：那段日子你是怎么熬过来的 朋友：全靠朋友陪着慢慢走出来 你：最难的时期总算过去了
dark time.example: Friend: When my company collapsed last year was the darkest time. You: How did you get through that dark time? Friend: Friends stayed with me and helped me out slowly. You: That dark time is finally over.

darwinian natural selection.context: 上生物课讲进化论，老师用长颈鹿的长脖子举例，解释一个经典概念。
darwinian natural selection.translation: 朋友：长颈鹿的脖子为什么这么长 你：这就是自然选择的结果 朋友：那具体是怎么回事呢 你：脖子长的更容易活下来 一代代传下来的
darwinian natural selection.example: Friend: Why are giraffes' necks so long? You: That's the result of Darwinian natural selection. Friend: How does it work exactly? You: Longer necks helped them survive, so the trait got passed down.

data analytics.context: 你刚转行做数据分析，朋友好奇这份新工作每天到底在忙什么。
data analytics.translation: 朋友：你新工作每天都忙些什么呀 你：主要是看数据 找里面的规律 朋友：听起来挺无聊的 你：其实很有意思 从数字里看出趋势
data analytics.example: Friend: What do you do at your new job every day? You: Mostly look at data and find patterns in it. Friend: Sounds boring. You: Actually data analytics is interesting; you spot trends in the numbers.

data collection.context: 你们小组做课程调研，在群里分工谁发问卷、谁负责收集结果。
data collection.translation: 朋友：咱们这个调研项目谁负责发问卷 你：我来做数据采集那部分吧 朋友：那要收集多少份才够 你：至少两百份 不然样本不够
data collection.example: Friend: Who's sending out the survey for our project? You: I'll handle the data collection part. Friend: How many responses do we need? You: At least two hundred; otherwise the sample is too small.

dating app.context: 朋友单身很久了，你推荐他试试手机上的交友软件，他半信半疑。
dating app.translation: 朋友：我单身好久了 也没机会认识新人 你：你可以试试约会软件啊 朋友：靠谱吗 上面都是什么人 你：说不定能遇到合适的呢
dating app.example: Friend: I've been single forever and can't meet new people. You: You could try a dating app. Friend: Is it reliable? Who's on there? You: Maybe you'll meet someone nice on a dating app.

dating apps.context: 你们聊天聊到现在年轻人都怎么找对象，发现身边好多人靠手机软件。
dating apps.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人都是怎么找对象的 你：好多人都在手机上用交友软件 朋友：你自己用过吗 你：用过几个 不过也没遇到合适的
dating apps.example: Friend: How do young people find partners these days? You: Many people use dating apps on their phones. Friend: Have you used them? You: I tried a few dating apps, but didn't meet the right person.

day job.context: 你下班后还写文章做自媒体，朋友约你打球时好奇你怎么安排时间。
day job.translation: 朋友：你下班还写文章 不累吗 你：白天上班是为了生活 写东西是爱好 朋友：那哪个算正职呢 你：上班是本职工作 写东西算副业
day job.example: Friend: You write articles after work; aren't you tired? You: My day job pays the bills; writing is my hobby. Friend: Which one is your real job? You: My day job is my profession; writing's just a side thing.

day out.context: 周末天气特别好，你们临时决定坐高铁去邻市玩一天，晚上再回来。
day out.translation: 朋友：今天天气这么好 别浪费了 你：那我们坐高铁去邻市玩一天吧 朋友：当天来回来得及吗 你：来得及 正好出去透透气
day out.example: Friend: The weather is so nice today; don't waste it. You: Let's take the high-speed rail for a day out in the next city. Friend: Can we make it back the same day? You: Sure; a day out like this is just what we need.

day-to-day activities.context: 奶奶年纪大了记性变差，医生让你留意她每天都在做些什么，你跟朋友说起。
day-to-day activities.translation: 朋友：医生让我观察奶奶的状态 你：都要记录些什么呢 朋友：她每天的活动 比如吃饭、散步 你：这样能看出她有没有退步
day-to-day activities.example: Friend: The doctor asked me to watch Grandma's condition. You: What should you record? Friend: Her day-to-day activities, like eating and walking. You: That shows whether her condition is declining.

daylight exposure.context: 医生说你睡得不好跟晒太阳太少有关，建议你白天多出门走走。
daylight exposure.translation: 朋友：我最近老失眠 是怎么回事 你：医生说你可能晒太少太阳了 朋友：晒太阳跟睡觉还有关系吗 你：当然 白天日照够了晚上才睡得香
daylight exposure.example: Friend: I've had insomnia lately; why is that? You: The doctor said you may not get enough daylight. Friend: Does daylight affect sleep? You: Sure; enough daylight exposure in the day helps you sleep at night.

dead end.context: 你第一次去老小区找朋友，开车绕来绕去结果一头扎进了一条走不通的路。
dead end.translation: 朋友：你到哪了 怎么还没上来 你：我开进一条死胡同里了 正掉头呢 朋友：那个小区路特别绕 你：我都绕迷路了 这条路根本不通
dead end.example: Friend: Where are you? Why aren't you up yet? You: I drove into a dead end and am turning around. Friend: The roads in that neighborhood are really confusing. You: I'm lost; this is a complete dead end.

dead ringer.context: 你路上看到一个陌生人，侧脸跟你大学同学简直一模一样，赶紧拍下来发给朋友。
dead ringer.translation: 朋友：我刚才路上看到一个人 超像咱们同学 你：真的假的 发来看看 朋友：你看这侧脸 简直一模一样 你：天呐 跟他长得简直是一个模子刻出来的
dead ringer.example: Friend: I saw someone on the street who looks exactly like our classmate. You: Really? Send me a photo. Friend: Look at the side profile; it's uncanny. You: Wow, he's a dead ringer for him.

dead skin cell.context: 你去做脸，美容师一边给你去角质，一边解释脸上起皮是怎么回事。
dead skin cell.translation: 朋友：你脸最近怎么起皮了 你：可能是换季了 脸上总掉皮屑 朋友：那去做个深层清洁吧 你：美容师说这些都是脱落的死皮细胞
dead skin cell.example: Friend: Why is your skin flaking lately? You: Maybe it's the season; my face keeps peeling. Friend: Then get a deep cleansing. You: The esthetician said these are just dead skin cells.

dead zone.context: 你和朋友去山里徒步，走到山谷深处手机突然一格信号都没有了。
dead zone.translation: 朋友：你手机有信号吗 发个定位试试 你：完全没有 这里是个无信号区 朋友：那待会儿怎么约碰面啊 你：只能先记个路标 等出了山谷再说
dead zone.example: Friend: Do you have signal? Try sending a location. You: None at all; this is a dead zone. Friend: Then how do we meet up later? You: Just mark a landmark and talk once we leave the valley.

deaf mute.context: 你在图书馆遇到一位既听不到也说不出话的读者，朋友小声跟你解释怎么交流。
deaf mute.translation: 朋友：那边有位读者好像听不到也说不出话 你：那我们怎么跟他沟通呢 朋友：可以用手写下来给他看 你：好 我们说话小声点 别打扰他
deaf mute.example: Friend: That reader over there seems deaf and unable to speak. You: How do we communicate with him? Friend: We can write it down for him. You: Okay, let's keep our voices low so we don't disturb him.

death row.context: 你看了部讲冤案的美剧，朋友问你那个关押死刑犯的地方叫什么。
death row.translation: 朋友：剧里那个被判死刑的犯人关在哪儿 你：关在专门的死囚牢房区 朋友：那地方听着就很压抑 你：是啊 里面的人都等着最终结果
death row.example: Friend: Where do they keep the death-row inmate in the show? You: In the special death row area. Friend: That place sounds depressing. You: Yeah, people on death row wait there for the final verdict.

debate with.context: 课堂上老师组织辩论赛，你被分到和另一个小组辩论一个环保话题。
debate with.translation: 朋友：明天的辩论赛你准备得怎么样了 你：我们组要跟对方小组辩论环保话题 朋友：你们观点站得住吗 你：资料都查好了 就等着上场了
debate with.example: Friend: How's your prep for tomorrow's debate? You: Our group will debate the environmental topic against theirs. Friend: Is your argument solid? You: We've gathered the sources; ready to take the stage.

debit card.context: 你结账时刷错了卡，店员提醒你储蓄卡和信用卡的用法其实不一样。
debit card.translation: 朋友：结账用微信不行吗 你：店里只收银行卡或者现金 朋友：我这张储蓄卡能刷吗 你：可以 借记卡直接从账户里扣钱
debit card.example: Friend: Can't I just pay by WeChat? You: The shop only takes bank cards or cash. Friend: Does my debit card work? You: Yes, a debit card pays straight from your account.

deciding on.context: 你和朋友周末聚餐，对着菜单翻来翻去半小时，谁都拿不定主意。
deciding on.translation: 朋友：我们到底点什么菜啊 都看了半小时了 你：我还在纠结选鱼还是选鸡 朋友：快点决定吧 我都饿了 你：那就烤鱼吧 就这么定了
deciding on.example: Friend: What on earth are we ordering? It's been half an hour. You: I'm still deciding on fish versus chicken. Friend: Hurry up deciding; I'm starving. You: Then the grilled fish; we've decided on that.

decision maker.context: 公司要换办公软件，你和同事提了方案，但最后拍板的是大老板。
decision maker.translation: 朋友：咱们提的换软件的建议能成吗 你：不好说 最后拍板的是老板 朋友：他才是真正做决定的人 你：对 大领导才是关键的决策者
decision maker.example: Friend: Do you think our software-switch proposal will pass? You: Hard to say; the boss has the final say. Friend: He's the real decision maker. You: Yeah, the big boss is the actual decision maker.

decision making.context: 你们聊到现在年轻人做决定总爱先查攻略，跟长辈拍脑袋做事很不一样。
decision making.translation: 朋友：你买房都要查三个月攻略吗 你：对啊 现在做决定都讲究理性 朋友：我们爸妈那辈看上就买 你：现在决策都靠数据 不冲动消费了
decision making.example: Friend: You research house-buying for three months? You: Yeah, people decide rationally these days. Friend: Our parents bought on a whim. You: Modern decision making relies on data; no more impulse buys.

decorative item.context: 你搬新家，朋友送了你一个陶瓷花瓶当礼物，摆在玄关正好合适。
decorative item.translation: 朋友：你新家玄关是不是缺个摆设 你：我正想买个花瓶放花呢 朋友：那这个陶瓷摆件送你 正好当装饰 你：太合适了 摆在那儿真好看
decorative item.example: Friend: Doesn't your entryway need a decorative item? You: I was looking for a vase for flowers. Friend: Then take this ceramic decorative item. You: Perfect; it looks great there.

dedicated to.context: 朋友在社区办了个免费自习室专门给附近学生写作业，你去参观。
dedicated to.translation: 朋友：你这个自习室是免费的吗 你：对啊 专门留给附近学生写作业 朋友：你真的为孩子花了好多心思 你：就想专心做一件有意义的事
dedicated to.example: Friend: Is this study room free? You: Yeah, it's dedicated to local students doing homework. Friend: You really dedicate so much to the kids. You: I just want to dedicate myself to something meaningful.

deep breathing.context: 你上台发言前紧张得手抖，朋友拉住你，教你上台前先做几次深呼吸。
