deep breathing.translation: 朋友：你脸色怎么这么白 不就是个发言吗 你：我紧张得手都在抖 朋友：来 先做几次深呼吸放松一下 你：吸——呼——好像真的没那么慌了
deep breathing.example: Friend: Why are you so pale? It's just a speech. You: I'm so nervous my hands are shaking. Friend: Come on, take some deep breathing to calm down. You: In... out... the deep breathing really helps.

deep conversation.context: 你和大学室友多年没见，深夜关了灯，聊起各自这几年的经历。
deep conversation.translation: 朋友：上一次这么聊天还是毕业那会儿 你：今晚我们聊聊心里话吧 朋友：好多事平时都没空细想 你：对 这种深夜深聊最难得
deep conversation.example: Friend: Last time we talked like this was at graduation. You: Let's have a heart-to-heart tonight. Friend: So many things we never get to think through. You: Yeah, a deep conversation late at night is rare.

deep down.context: 朋友嘴上说早就放下了那段感情，你却看得出他心里其实很难受。
deep down.translation: 朋友：他表面上装得跟没事人一样 你：他其实心里还是很放不下吧 朋友：你怎么知道的 你：因为他嘴上说没事 内心深处其实很在意
deep down.example: Friend: He acts as if nothing happened. You: Deep down he still hasn't let go, right? Friend: How can you tell? You: He says he's fine, but deep down he really cares.

deep sleep.context: 你最近老是半夜醒来，睡眠手环显示你的深睡时间特别短。
deep sleep.translation: 朋友：你最近休息得好吗 你：半夜总醒 睡不沉 朋友：手环数据怎么说 你：说我深度睡眠时间太短了 难怪白天没精神
deep sleep.example: Friend: Have you been resting well? You: I wake at night and never sleep deeply. Friend: What does your band show? You: My deep sleep is too short; no wonder I'm tired by day.

deep-sea creature.context: 你们去海洋馆特别展区，看到那些长得奇形怪状的鱼都是深海来的。
deep-sea creature.translation: 朋友：这条鱼长得也太奇怪了 你：它是从很深的海里捞上来的 朋友：深海里怎么会长成这样 你：水压大、又没光 深海生物都长得特别怪异
deep-sea creature.example: Friend: This fish looks so strange. You: It was brought up from the deep sea. Friend: Why do deep-sea creatures look like that? You: High pressure and no light make deep-sea creatures look bizarre.

default on debt.context: 新闻里说有家公司还不上贷款倒闭了，你和朋友聊起欠钱不还的后果。
default on debt.translation: 朋友：那家公司怎么突然就没了 你：它还不上银行贷款 直接违约了 朋友：欠钱不还后果很严重吧 你：对 还不上债会上征信的
default on debt.example: Friend: How did that company suddenly disappear? You: It couldn't repay its loan and defaulted on its debt. Friend: Is defaulting on debt really serious? You: Yeah, defaulting on a debt ruins your credit record.

define as.context: 上课讨论什么是成功，老师让每个人先用一句话给它下个定义。
define as.translation: 朋友：你觉得什么才算成功啊 你：我把它定义为过上自己想要的生活 朋友：那赚钱多就算成功吗 你：不一定 成功因人而异
define as.example: Friend: What counts as success to you? You: I define it as living the life you want. Friend: Does earning a lot mean success? You: Not necessarily; we define success differently.

delay ageing.context: 你妈妈坚持天天跑步防晒，朋友夸她看着比实际年龄年轻好多。
delay ageing.translation: 朋友：你妈妈怎么保养的 看着真年轻 你：她天天运动 还特别注意防晒 朋友：难怪 看着比同龄人年轻好多 你：她说坚持锻炼能延缓衰老
delay ageing.example: Friend: How does your mom stay so young-looking? You: She exercises daily and protects her skin from the sun. Friend: No wonder she looks younger than her age. You: She says it helps delay ageing.

delayed gratification.context: 你为了攒钱买相机，连续三个月忍住不喝奶茶，朋友说你太有定力了。
delayed gratification.translation: 朋友：你三个月没喝奶茶 就为了攒钱买相机 你：对啊 想要的东西得先忍一忍 朋友：这也太能忍了吧 你：这叫延迟满足 先苦后甜嘛
delayed gratification.example: Friend: You cut out milk tea for three months just to save for a camera? You: Yeah, I have to wait for what I want. Friend: That's so much self-control. You: It's delayed gratification; sweet after the wait.

delayed growth.context: 邻居家孩子比同龄人矮一截，爸妈带他去医院检查是不是发育偏慢。
delayed growth.translation: 朋友：邻居家孩子是不是比同龄人矮 你：他爸妈带他去医院查了 朋友：医生怎么说 你：说是发育有点迟缓 要多补充营养
delayed growth.example: Friend: Isn't the neighbor's kid shorter than others? You: His parents took him to the hospital. Friend: What did the doctor say? You: Said he has delayed growth and needs more nutrition.

delayed homebuying.context: 你们这代年轻人普遍不着急买房，爸妈天天催，你们却想再缓两年。
delayed homebuying.translation: 朋友：你爸妈又催你买房了吧 你：是啊 但我想再缓两年 朋友：他们不着急抱孙吗 你：现在年轻人都延后买房 不被房贷绑住
delayed homebuying.example: Friend: Did your parents push you to buy a home again? You: Yeah, but I want to wait a couple more years. Friend: Aren't they in a hurry? You: Young people now delay homebuying to avoid mortgage debt.

deliberately.context: 同事打翻了你的水杯却一声不吭，你觉得他根本是故意的，跟朋友吐槽。
deliberately.translation: 朋友：我桌上的水杯被人碰翻了 你：是不小心还是故意的 朋友：他明明看到了还绕开 你：那就是故意打翻的 也太没礼貌了
deliberately.example: Friend: Someone knocked over my water cup. You: Was it an accident or done deliberately? Friend: He saw it and walked around on purpose. You: Then he deliberately knocked it; how rude.

delivery drone.context: 你刷到新闻说偏远山区开始用无人机送药，朋友觉得特别新奇。
delivery drone.translation: 朋友：你看这条新闻了吗 山里用飞机送药 你：那是配送无人机 山里开车要好久 朋友：十分钟就能送到山顶 你：对 这玩意儿以后会越来越普及
delivery drone.example: Friend: Did you see the news? They're delivering medicine by air in the mountains. You: That's a delivery drone; driving up takes forever. Friend: It reaches the summit in ten minutes. You: Yeah, the delivery drone will become common.

delve deeper into.context: 你写论文卡在一个问题上，导师让你别停在表面，再往深挖一层。
delve deeper into.translation: 朋友：论文那部分你写得怎么样了 你：我只查到了表面资料 导师让我再深入挖一挖 朋友：那你接下来打算怎么找资料 你：去数据库里翻原始论文 深入探究这个理论
delve deeper into.example: Friend: How's that part of your thesis going? You: I only found surface info; my advisor said to delve deeper. Friend: How will you dig further? You: I'll look up original papers to delve deeper into the theory.

delve into.context: 你对一桩历史谜案特别感兴趣，周末泡在图书馆里翻史料，跟朋友分享。
delve into.translation: 朋友：周末你又泡图书馆干嘛去 你：我在研究一桩历史谜案 特别有意思 朋友：你查了多少资料了 你：一头扎进去好几天了 越查越上瘾
delve into.example: Friend: Why are you spending the weekend in the library again? You: I'm delving into a historical mystery; it's fascinating. Friend: How much have you dug up? You: I've been delving into it for days; the deeper I go, the more hooked I am.

delving deeper into.context: 你做市场调研发现一个反常数据，决定顺着这个方向继续往下查。
delving deeper into.translation: 朋友：那个反常的数据你搞清楚了吗 你：还没有 我正顺着这条线往下查 朋友：要不要我帮你一起整理 你：好啊 我们一起深入探究一下原因
delving deeper into.example: Friend: Did you figure out that odd data point? You: Not yet; I'm delving deeper along that thread. Friend: Want help organizing it? You: Sure; let's keep delving deeper into the cause together.

demographic make-up.context: 老师布置小调查，让大家查自己小区里老年人多还是年轻人多。
demographic make-up.translation: 朋友：咱们小区都是些什么人住啊 你：我查了一下 老人特别多 朋友：这就是人口构成吧 你：对 看一个地方的人口构成很重要
demographic make-up.example: Friend: What kind of people live in our neighborhood? You: I checked; there are a lot of seniors. Friend: That's the demographic make-up. You: Yeah, the demographic make-up of an area matters a lot.

demographic makeup.context: 奶茶店选址前要先看看周边是上班族还是学生，再决定卖什么价位。
demographic makeup.translation: 朋友：新店开在哪儿比较好 你：先看看周边都是什么人 朋友：学生多就卖便宜点的奶茶 你：对 先摸清当地的人口构成再定价
demographic makeup.example: Friend: Where should we open the new shop? You: First see what people live around there. Friend: More students means cheaper drinks. You: Right; first study the local demographic makeup.

demographic shift.context: 新闻说这几年老人越来越多、孩子越来越少，你和朋友聊起这种变化。
demographic shift.translation: 朋友：最近怎么到处都在建养老院 你：因为老人越来越多了 朋友：这就是人口结构在变化吧 你：对 这种人口结构变迁影响特别大
demographic shift.example: Friend: Why are they building nursing homes everywhere? You: Because seniors are growing in number. Friend: That's a demographic shift, right? You: Yeah, this demographic shift has huge effects.

dental health.context: 你最近牙龈老出血，医生让你好好刷牙定期洗牙，你跟朋友说起。
dental health.translation: 朋友：你最近是不是老捂着脸 你：我牙龈老出血 医生说我牙齿要好好保护 朋友：那你现在怎么护牙 你：早晚认真刷 半年洗一次牙
dental health.example: Friend: Why are you always holding your cheek lately? You: My gums bleed; the doctor said to protect my dental health. Friend: How do you care for your teeth now? You: Brush twice daily and clean them every six months.

dental routine.context: 你发现朋友牙齿特别白，取经问他每天刷牙都是怎么做的。
dental routine.translation: 朋友：你牙齿怎么这么白 有什么秘诀吗 你：就是每天认真刷够两分钟 朋友：还要用牙线和漱口水吗 你：对 这就是我的日常护牙流程
dental routine.example: Friend: Why are your teeth so white? Any secret? You: Just brush two minutes every day. Friend: Do floss and mouthwash too? You: Yeah, that's my daily dental routine.

department store.context: 你们想买双鞋，朋友建议去市中心那栋什么都卖的大商场逛逛。
department store.translation: 朋友：买鞋去哪儿比较好啊 你：去市中心那家大百货商场吧 朋友：那里是几层都卖东西吗 你：对 从衣服到化妆品一层一层都有
department store.example: Friend: Where's good to buy shoes? You: Let's go to the big department store downtown. Friend: Does it sell everything on different floors? You: Yeah, from clothes to cosmetics, a department store has it all.

dependence on.context: 你发现自己离开手机就浑身不自在，朋友说你这是对手机太依赖了。
dependence on.translation: 朋友：你现在五分钟不看手机就难受吧 你：是啊 走哪儿都得带着它 朋友：你这是对手机太依赖了 你：我也知道不好 但就是戒不掉
dependence on.example: Friend: You feel uneasy if you don't check your phone for five minutes. You: Yeah, I carry it everywhere. Friend: That's too much dependence on your phone. You: I know it's bad, but I can't quit.

dependency on.context: 你们聊到有些国家能源全靠进口，一旦断供整个国家就会出大问题。
dependency on.translation: 朋友：那个国家为什么老被卡脖子 你：它的能源全靠进口 朋友：这种依赖太危险了吧 你：对 过度依赖别人是要付出代价的
dependency on.example: Friend: Why is that country always held hostage? You: Its energy all depends on imports. Friend: That dependency is dangerous. You: Yeah, too much dependency on others comes at a price.

dependency ratio.context: 上社会课讲到老龄化，老师说以后一对年轻人要养的老人越来越多。
dependency ratio.translation: 朋友：以后我们年轻人压力会不会很大 你：是啊 一对夫妻要养四个老人 朋友：这就是说的什么赡养率吗 你：对 老人多孩子少 赡养比越来越高
dependency ratio.example: Friend: Will young people face huge pressure later? You: Yeah, a couple may support four elders. Friend: Is that the dependency ratio? You: Yeah, with more elders and fewer kids, the dependency ratio rises.

dependent on.context: 你表弟上了大学还每个月要家里打钱，朋友说他经济上还没独立。
dependent on.translation: 朋友：你表弟上大学还找家里要钱啊 你：对 他花钱大手大脚 朋友：那他经济上还没独立 你：是啊 还完全靠家里
dependent on.example: Friend: Your cousin still asks his parents for money in college? You: Yeah, he spends recklessly. Friend: So he's still financially dependent on them. You: Right; he's totally dependent on his family.

depends upon.context: 你们商量周末去哪玩，朋友说天气好就爬山、下雨就改成看电影。
depends upon.translation: 朋友：周末我们怎么安排呢 你：看天气吧 晴天就去爬山 朋友：下雨了怎么办 你：那就看情况 一切都看天气而定
depends upon.example: Friend: What's our plan for the weekend? You: Depends on the weather; hike if it's sunny. Friend: What if it rains? You: Then we'll see; everything depends upon the weather.

depicted as.context: 你们聊到电影里反派总被塑造成凶神恶煞的样子，其实真人未必如此。
depicted as.translation: 朋友：电影里的坏人都长得一脸凶相 你：那是导演故意这么拍的 朋友：坏人都被描绘成那个样子 你：其实现实里坏人未必长得凶
depicted as.example: Friend: Villains in movies always look menacing. You: That's how directors deliberately portray them. Friend: They're depicted as so wicked on screen. You: In real life, bad people aren't always depicted as scary.

depressive symptom.context: 你朋友最近总失眠、没胃口，你建议他别硬扛，早点去看看医生。
depressive symptom.translation: 朋友：我最近老失眠 还什么都不想吃 你：这样多久了 别是情绪上出了问题 朋友：我也担心 要不要去看看医生 你：早去早安心 这些都是抑郁的症状
depressive symptom.example: Friend: I've had insomnia and lost my appetite lately. You: How long? It might be emotional. Friend: Should I see a doctor? You: Better early; these are classic depressive symptoms.

deprived areas.context: 你们看公益纪录片，讲志愿者去缺教室、缺老师的偏远山区支教。
deprived areas.translation: 朋友：那些孩子连像样的教室都没有 你：是啊 很多贫困地区连老师都留不住 朋友：我们能为他们做点什么呢 你：可以捐点书本和文具过去
deprived areas.example: Friend: Those kids don't even have a proper classroom. You: Yeah, in deprived areas they can't even keep teachers. Friend: What can we do for them? You: We can donate books and stationery to those deprived areas.

derive from.context: 上英语课讲到很多英文单词其实都来自拉丁语，老师举了好几个例子。
derive from.translation: 朋友：英语单词怎么这么难记 你：其实很多词都是从别的语言来的 朋友：比如从哪儿来的呢 你：不少英文词都源自拉丁语
derive from.example: Friend: Why are English words so hard to remember? You: Many actually come from other languages. Friend: Like where from? You: Plenty of English words derive from Latin.

derives from.context: 你跟外国朋友解释火锅这个词，聊到中文里好多说法的由来。
derives from.translation: 朋友：火锅这个词字面是什么意思 你：就是锅子里煮着东西 朋友：那它这个叫法怎么来的 你：这个说法就源自大家围炉吃饭的习惯
derives from.example: Friend: What does hotpot literally mean? You: Just cooking things in a pot. Friend: Where does the name come from? You: The name derives from the habit of eating around the stove.

descend from.context: 朋友姓一个很罕见的姓，你们好奇这个家族最早是从哪里迁来的。
descend from.translation: 朋友：我这个姓特别少见 你：听说你们家祖上是从中原迁过来的 朋友：你怎么知道的 你：家谱上写着 你们这一支是从中原传下来的
descend from.example: Friend: My surname is really rare. You: I heard your ancestors migrated from the central plains. Friend: How do you know? You: The family tree says your line descends from the central plains.

descend upon.context: 黄金周一到，热门景点瞬间挤满各地游客，你们在朋友圈里看着都怕。
descend upon.translation: 朋友：国庆那景点还能去吗 你：别去了 全国的人都涌过去了 朋友：朋友圈里全是人挤人 你：一到假期 游客就一下子涌进各个景点
descend upon.example: Friend: Can we still visit that spot on National Day? You: Don't; people descend on it from everywhere. Friend: My feed is all crowds. You: Once the holiday hits, tourists descend upon every scenic spot.

described as.context: 你在读一本新书，封底把它吹得天花乱坠，朋友问你到底写得怎样。
described as.translation: 朋友：那本书写得好看吗 你：书皮上把它说得天花乱坠的 朋友：真有那么神吗 你：读着还行 没被形容的那么夸张
described as.example: Friend: Is that book any good? You: The cover describes it as absolutely amazing. Friend: Is it really that good? You: It's okay; not as great as it's described as.

designed to.context: 你买了把人体工学椅，朋友问你这把椅子跟普通办公椅有什么不一样。
designed to.translation: 朋友：你这椅子看着跟普通的没区别啊 你：它是专门设计来护腰的 朋友：坐起来真的舒服很多吗 你：对 这把椅子就是为久坐的人设计的
designed to.example: Friend: This chair looks like any other. You: It's designed to support your lower back. Friend: Is it really more comfortable? You: Yeah, this chair is designed for people who sit long hours.

designer brands.context: 你逛街时朋友拎着个很贵的包，你问她是不是又买了大牌的东西。
designer brands.translation: 朋友：你这个包在哪买的 看着不便宜 你：是个设计师品牌的 打折时入的 朋友：大牌就是好看 但也真贵 你：对啊 设计师品牌动辄上万
designer brands.example: Friend: Where'd you get that bag? It looks pricey. You: It's a designer brand; I got it on sale. Friend: Designer brands look great but cost a fortune. You: Yeah, designer brands easily cost over ten thousand.

designer clothes.context: 同事穿了一身剪裁特别讲究的衣服来上班，你一眼就看出不便宜。
designer clothes.translation: 朋友：你今天这身衣服在哪儿买的 真有气质 你：朋友从国外带回来的 是名牌 朋友：大牌衣服就是不一样 版型特别好 你：对 设计师服装穿在身上就是显档次
designer clothes.example: Friend: Where did you get today's outfit? It looks classy. You: A friend brought it back from abroad; it's a brand. Friend: Designer clothes fit so well. You: Yeah, designer clothes really stand out.

designer gear.context: 你看朋友从头到脚都是名牌，调侃他简直是行走的广告牌。
designer gear.translation: 朋友：你这一身行头可不便宜啊 你：都是些喜欢的潮牌而已 朋友：帽子、鞋、包全是大牌 你：嘿嘿 我就爱攒这些设计师单品
designer gear.example: Friend: That whole outfit of yours didn't come cheap. You: Just some streetwear brands I like. Friend: Hat, shoes, bag, all designer gear. You: Heh, I love collecting designer gear.

designer jeans.context: 朋友穿了条版型特别好的牛仔裤，你好奇怎么比普通的贵那么多。
designer jeans.translation: 朋友：你这条牛仔裤版型真好 你：这是设计师款的 所以贵 朋友：不就是条牛仔裤吗 你：剪裁和料子确实不一样 穿着特别显腿型
designer jeans.example: Friend: Your jeans fit really well. You: They're designer jeans, so they cost more. Friend: Aren't they just jeans? You: The cut and fabric differ; designer jeans flatter your legs.

desk job.context: 你以前是干跑腿的，现在坐办公室，朋友问你这半年适不适应。
desk job.translation: 朋友：你现在天天坐办公室 习惯了吗 你：刚开始腰老疼 坐不住 朋友：那还是体力活舒服 你：不一样 伏案工作也有它的辛苦
desk job.example: Friend: Are you used to sitting in an office all day? You: At first my back ached; I couldn't sit still. Friend: Physical work was easier then. You: Different; a desk job has its own hardships.

destine to.context: 你们聊到一个从小就爱画画的同学，现在真的成了小有名气的画家。
destine to.translation: 朋友：你还记得那个天天画画的同学吗 你：记得啊 他现在真成画家了 朋友：他从小就像是吃这碗饭的料 你：对 好像天生就注定要当画家
destine to.example: Friend: Remember that classmate who drew all the time? You: Yeah, he really became a painter. Friend: He seemed born for it. You: Right; he looked destined to be a painter.

destined for.context: 朋友被保送进了名牌大学，全班同学都说他前途一片光明。
destined for.translation: 朋友：你听说了吗 他被保送清华了 你：真的吗 太厉害了 朋友：他一直都是年级第一 你：这种人天生就是要去名校的
destined for.example: Friend: Did you hear? He got guaranteed into Tsinghua. You: Really? That's amazing. Friend: He's been top of the grade. You: People like him seem destined for a top university.

destructive impact.context: 新闻说那次海上漏油对附近海域的生态造成了长期伤害，你们聊起。
destructive impact.translation: 朋友：那次海上漏油后来怎么样了 你：对附近海域伤害特别大 朋友：海里的鱼和鸟都受影响了吗 你：对 这种污染的破坏性影响很多年都消不掉
destructive impact.example: Friend: What happened after that oil spill? You: It hit the nearby sea really hard. Friend: Did the fish and birds suffer? You: Yeah, the destructive impact of such pollution lasts for years.

determin factor.context: 你们聊到高考那几分就能甩开上千人，其实录取时好多因素都在起作用。
determin factor.translation: 朋友：高考差一分就差出几千名 你：所以分数特别关键 朋友：那是不是分数高就一定能上 你：也不是 分数只是其中一个决定性因素
determin factor.example: Friend: One point at Gaokao separates thousands. You: So scores really matter. Friend: Does a high score guarantee admission? You: Not necessarily; it's just one determining factor.

developed country.context: 你们聊到为什么有些国家看病几乎不花钱，朋友给你科普原因。
developed country.translation: 朋友：为什么那边看病几乎不花钱 你：因为人家是发达国家 福利做得好 朋友：那我们什么时候能赶上 你：还得再发展好些年
developed country.example: Friend: Why is healthcare almost free there? You: Because it's a developed country with good welfare. Friend: When will we catch up? You: It'll take many more years.

developed society.context: 老师在课上讨论什么样的社会才算真正发达，说不能只看有钱没钱。
developed society.translation: 朋友：是不是有钱就算发达社会了 你：不一定 还要看教育和福利 朋友：那什么样才算发达呢 你：一个真正发达的社会人人都有保障
developed society.example: Friend: Does being rich mean a developed society? You: Not necessarily; education and welfare matter too. Friend: What makes it developed then? You: A truly developed society guarantees everyone security.

developmental phase.context: 朋友家孩子刚上小学，老师说这个阶段打基础特别重要，朋友来问你。
developmental phase.translation: 朋友：我家孩子刚上一年级 该注意什么 你：老师说这是打基础的关键阶段 朋友：那要不要多报几个兴趣班 你：先看孩子状态 每个阶段重点不一样
developmental phase.example: Friend: My kid just started first grade; what should I watch? You: The teacher says this is a key developmental phase. Friend: Should I sign him up for many classes? You: Watch him first; each developmental phase has its focus.

developmental psychology.context: 你表妹选大学专业，在纠结心理学里到底选哪个方向，来问你的意见。
developmental psychology.translation: 朋友：你表妹想学心理学 选了哪个方向 你：她选了研究人怎么成长的那个 朋友：是发展心理学吗 你：对 她想研究小孩怎么一步步长大
developmental psychology.example: Friend: Your cousin wants to study psychology; which branch? You: The one about how people grow. Friend: Developmental psychology? You: Yeah, she wants to study how children develop.

developmental stage.context: 你看育儿书了解到孩子不同年龄有不同特点，跟刚当妈的朋友分享。
developmental stage.translation: 朋友：为什么三岁孩子什么都要自己来 你：书上说这是他们成长的一个阶段 朋友：过了这个阶段就好了吗 你：对 每个成长阶段都有特点
developmental stage.example: Friend: Why do three-year-olds want to do everything themselves? You: The book says it's a developmental stage. Friend: Will it pass? You: Yeah; each developmental stage has its traits.

devoid of.context: 你看了部特别无聊的电影，整场下来一点让人眼前一亮的地方都没有。
devoid of.translation: 朋友：昨晚那部新片好看吗 你：特别无聊 一点新意都没有 朋友：演员不是挺有名的吗 你：剧本太烂 整场毫无惊喜可言
devoid of.example: Friend: Was that new movie good last night? You: So boring; zero originality. Friend: Aren't the actors famous? You: The script is bad; it's devoid of any surprise.

diagnosed with.context: 朋友去年体检查出甲状腺有个小结节，医生说良性、定期复查就行。
diagnosed with.translation: 朋友：你去年体检不是查出甲状腺结节吗 你：对啊 医生说良性的 没事 朋友：那要吃药吗 你：不用 定期复查就好 幸亏发现得早
diagnosed with.example: Friend: Didn't your checkup find a thyroid nodule last year? You: Yeah, the doctor said it's benign. Friend: Do you need medicine? You: No, just regular checks; good thing it was diagnosed early.

diaphragmatic breathing.context: 瑜伽课上老师让大家把手放在肚子上，用肚子而不是胸口呼吸。
diaphragmatic breathing.translation: 朋友：老师让我们把手放肚子上干嘛 你：试试用肚子呼吸 而不是胸口 朋友：这样呼吸有什么好处呢 你：这叫腹式呼吸 能让人更平静
diaphragmatic breathing.example: Friend: Why does the teacher want our hands on our bellies? You: Try breathing with your belly, not your chest. Friend: What's the benefit? You: That's diaphragmatic breathing; it calms you down.

die down.context: 半夜突然刮大风下暴雨，你睡不着，等到后半夜风才慢慢小下来。
die down.translation: 朋友：昨晚那风刮得我都没睡着 你：是啊 后半夜才慢慢停下来 朋友：今天早上又天晴了 你：对 这场风渐渐就过去了
die down.example: Friend: That wind kept me awake last night. You: Yeah, it only died down toward dawn. Friend: It's sunny again this morning. You: Right; the storm finally died down.

die of boredom.context: 周末爸妈出门，留你一个人在家没人陪，你无聊得直打哈欠。
die of boredom.translation: 朋友：你周末一个人在家干嘛呢 你：爸妈都出去了 没人陪我 朋友：那你怎么打发时间 你：我都快无聊死了 电视也不好看
die of boredom.example: Friend: What are you doing home alone this weekend? You: My parents went out; I have no company. Friend: How do you kill time? You: I'm practically dying of boredom; even TV is dull.

die off.context: 你们聊到因为环境变化，河边以前随处可见的鸟现在一年比一年少。
die off.translation: 朋友：以前河边好多鸟 现在怎么没了 你：环境变了 它们找不到吃的 朋友：是不是都一只只死掉了 你：对 数量一年比一年少 快绝迹了
die off.example: Friend: There were so many birds by the river before; where did they go? You: The environment changed and they can't find food. Friend: Are they dying off one by one? You: Yeah, their numbers drop each year; they're dying off.

diesel vehicle.context: 新闻说大城市开始限制柴油车上路，你和朋友散步时聊起为什么。
diesel vehicle.translation: 朋友：路上是不是见不到那种冒黑烟的车了 你：因为柴油车都被限行 朋友：为什么要限制它 你：柴油车尾气污染大 所以慢慢不让跑了
diesel vehicle.example: Friend: Do you see fewer smoky vehicles on the road? You: Because diesel vehicles are restricted. Friend: Why restrict them? You: Diesel vehicles emit more pollution, so they're gradually banned.

diet culture.context: 你看朋友圈人人都在减肥算热量，朋友说这种风气其实挺不健康的。
diet culture.translation: 朋友：现在怎么人人都在算卡路里 你：对 好像吃多一口就有罪 朋友：这种风气真的好吗 你：不好 这种节食焦虑反而让人更焦虑
diet culture.example: Friend: Why is everyone counting calories now? You: Yeah, as if eating a bite is a sin. Friend: Is that trend healthy? You: No; diet culture just makes people more anxious.

diet-derived fluid.context: 医生说人每天摄入的水有一部分其实来自食物，不只靠直接喝。
diet-derived fluid.translation: 朋友：我每天真的要喝八杯水吗 你：其实吃的蔬菜水果里也有水分 朋友：那喝的水可以少一点吗 你：可以 一部分水分是从食物里来的
diet-derived fluid.example: Friend: Do I really need eight glasses of water a day? You: Fruits and veggies contain water too. Friend: Can I drink less then? You: Yeah; some diet-derived fluid comes from the food you eat.

dietary choice.context: 你最近开始吃素，朋友聚餐点菜时特意照顾你的饮食习惯。
dietary choice.translation: 朋友：你现在是吃素了对吧 你：对 这半年开始不吃肉了 朋友：那点菜我们给你单独点素的 你：谢谢 每个人饮食选择不一样嘛
dietary choice.example: Friend: You're vegetarian now, right? You: Yeah, I stopped eating meat half a year ago. Friend: Then we'll order veggie dishes for you. You: Thanks; everyone's dietary choice is different.

dietary fibre.context: 你最近老便秘，医生让你多吃蔬菜粗粮，说里面有东西帮肠道蠕动。
dietary fibre.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老往厕所跑 你：医生让我多吃蔬菜和粗粮 朋友：为什么呀 你：里面的膳食纤维能帮肠道动起来
dietary fibre.example: Friend: Why are you always rushing to the bathroom? You: The doctor told me to eat more veggies and whole grains. Friend: Why? You: The dietary fibre in them helps your gut move.

dietary guidelines.context: 你照着网上的健康吃法吃饭，朋友告诉你那些建议其实是官方发布的。
dietary guidelines.translation: 朋友：你天天查的饮食建议是哪来的 你：说是国家推荐的健康吃法 朋友：那个是不是定期更新的 你：对 就是官方发布的膳食指南
dietary guidelines.example: Friend: Where do those diet tips you follow come from? You: The country's recommended way to eat. Friend: Is it updated regularly? You: Yeah, it's the official dietary guidelines.

differ from.context: 你发现南方同学买豆腐脑吃甜的，跟你从小吃咸的完全不一样。
differ from.translation: 朋友：你们那边豆腐脑是甜的还是咸的 你：我们这边都吃咸的 放酱油 朋友：我们那边居然放糖 你：原来南北差别这么大
differ from.example: Friend: Is tofu pudding sweet or salty where you're from? You: We eat it salty with soy sauce. Friend: Ours is sweet with sugar. You: So it really differs from place to place.

different countries across the world.context: 你刷到一个旅行博主的视频，他去过的地方遍布全球各地。
different countries across the world.translation: 朋友：这个博主也太能跑了吧 你：他已经去过几十个国家了 朋友：都有哪些地方啊 你：世界各地他几乎都跑遍了
different countries across the world.example: Friend: That travel blogger is always on the move. You: He's been to dozens of countries. Friend: Where has he been? You: He's visited different countries across the world.

differs from person to person.context: 你们聊到有些人喝茶提神、有些人喝茶反而犯困，效果特别奇怪。
differs from person to person.translation: 朋友：你喝咖啡是提神还是犯困 你：我喝了反而更困 朋友：我同事喝了特别精神 你：看来咖啡的效果因人而异
differs from person to person.example: Friend: Does coffee wake you up or make you sleepy? You: It makes me sleepier. Friend: My coworker gets a huge boost. You: So the effect differs from person to person.

difficult moment.context: 朋友考研失败躲在家里，你约他出来吃饭，陪他熬过最难熬的时候。
difficult moment.translation: 朋友：考研没考上 我这阵子真的很低落 你：没事 谁都有难的时候 朋友：感觉努力全白费了 你：熬过这段艰难时期就好了
difficult moment.example: Friend: I failed the exam and I've been so low lately. You: It's okay; everyone has hard times. Friend: Feels like all my effort was wasted. You: Get through this difficult moment and things will improve.

dig up.context: 你搬家收拾旧箱子，翻出好多小时候的照片和玩具，特别怀念。
dig up.translation: 朋友：你这一上午翻箱倒柜找什么呢 你：我在找小时候的旧照片 朋友：翻出来了吗 你：找到了 还翻出好多当年的小玩意儿
dig up.example: Friend: What are you digging through boxes for? You: Looking for my old childhood photos. Friend: Found them? You: Yeah, I dug up loads of old little things from back then.

digestive upset.context: 你昨晚吃了太辣的火锅，今天早上起来肚子一直不舒服。
digestive upset.translation: 朋友：你今天脸色不太好 怎么了 你：昨晚那火锅太辣 我肚子到现在还难受 朋友：是不是吃坏肚子了 你：对 肠胃一直不舒服
digestive upset.example: Friend: You don't look well today; what's wrong? You: Last night's hotpot was too spicy; my stomach still hurts. Friend: Did your stomach get upset? You: Yeah, I've had a digestive upset all morning.

digital age.context: 奶奶不会用智能手机连健康码都亮不出来，你感叹现在什么都得靠手机。
digital age.translation: 朋友：奶奶昨天出门连健康码都弄不出来 你：现在出门干啥都得用手机 朋友：老人确实跟不上这个时代 你：对啊 这就是数码时代的无奈
digital age.example: Friend: Grandma couldn't even pull up the health code yesterday. You: Everything today needs a phone. Friend: The elderly can't keep up. You: Yeah, that's life in the digital age.

digital camera.context: 你翻出家里一台老相机，朋友现在拍照都用手机，早就没人用相机了。
digital camera.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里这台老机器是什么 你：是我以前买的数码相机 朋友：现在谁还用相机啊 不都用手机拍吗 你：对啊 这相机早就闲置吃灰了
digital camera.example: Friend: What's this old gadget in your drawer? You: It's my old digital camera. Friend: Who uses a camera now? Everyone uses a phone. You: Yeah, this digital camera has been gathering dust.

digital dependency.context: 你发现自己手机一没电就心慌，朋友说这是典型的对数码产品上瘾。
digital dependency.translation: 朋友：你手机没电半小时 就跟丢了魂一样 你：是啊 没手机我坐立难安 朋友：你这就是对数码产品太依赖了 你：我也知道 但就是离不开
digital dependency.example: Friend: You look lost when your phone's dead for half an hour. You: Yeah, I can't sit still without it. Friend: That's real digital dependency. You: I know, but I just can't let go.

digital detox.context: 你打算周末把手机扔一边、不碰电脑，好好让自己歇一天。
digital detox.translation: 朋友：周末你怎么不回消息了 你：我打算来个数字戒断 彻底不看手机 朋友：一天不看手机你受得了吗 你：试试呗 让眼睛和脑子都歇歇
digital detox.example: Friend: Why aren't you replying this weekend? You: I'm going on a digital detox, no phone at all. Friend: Can you last a day without it? You: Let's try; let my eyes and brain rest.

digital device.context: 老师上课前让大家把手机平板都收进书包，不许摊在桌上。
digital device.translation: 朋友：老师怎么让我们把手机都收走 你：说上课不许用任何电子设备 朋友：那查资料怎么办 你：下课再查 上课专心听讲
digital device.example: Friend: Why did the teacher make us put our phones away? You: Said no digital devices in class. Friend: What if we need to look things up? You: Do it after class; focus during the lesson.

digital era.context: 你爷爷学着用智能手机发视频，你感叹老一辈也在努力跟上时代。
digital era.translation: 朋友：爷爷现在都会给你发视频了 你：是啊 他还学会了网购 朋友：老人学这个真不容易 你：对啊 在这个数字时代 谁都不想被落下
digital era.example: Friend: Grandpa even sends you videos now. You: Yeah, he's learned online shopping too. Friend: It's hard for the elderly to learn. You: Right; in this digital era, no one wants to be left behind.

digital footprint.context: 老师在信息课上讲，你在网上发的每条东西都会留下痕迹、很难删掉。
digital footprint.translation: 朋友：我发的那条朋友圈删了就没事了吧 你：别天真 网上的东西都有痕迹 朋友：删干净不就行了吗 你：难 你在网上留下的痕迹一辈子都在
digital footprint.example: Friend: Deleting that post should be fine, right? You: Don't be naive; everything online leaves traces. Friend: If I delete it cleanly? You: Hard; your digital footprint stays forever.

digital gadget.context: 你生日朋友送你一个新出的智能手表，你拆开礼物开心坏了。
digital gadget.translation: 朋友：你最近又买了什么新玩意儿 你：朋友送了我块智能手表 朋友：现在这些小电器真高级 你：对啊 好玩的数码产品越来越多了
digital gadget.example: Friend: What new gadget did you buy lately? You: A friend gave me a smartwatch. Friend: These little digital gadgets are so advanced. You: Yeah, there are more and more fun digital gadgets.

digital information.context: 你们找旧资料发现现在什么都存在电脑里，翻老纸档特别费劲。
digital information.translation: 朋友：以前的老档案怎么都翻不到 你：那时候还没数字化呢 朋友：现在找资料是不是方便多了 你：对 都变成电子信息了 一搜就有
digital information.example: Friend: Why can't we find those old records? You: They weren't digitized back then. Friend: Is finding things easier now? You: Yeah; now it's all digital information you can search.

digital literacy.context: 你奶奶不会扫码也不会网约车，你觉得老人也该学点基本操作。
digital literacy.translation: 朋友：奶奶出门连打车都不会 你：对啊 她连智能手机都用不利索 朋友：年轻人是不是该教一教老人 你：对 基本的数字素养还是要有
digital literacy.example: Friend: Grandma can't even get a taxi on her own. You: Yeah, she can't use a smartphone well. Friend: Should young people teach the elderly? You: Yeah, some digital literacy is essential.

digital native.context: 你家小孩刚会走路就会划手机，朋友笑称这代人生下来就懂数码。
digital native.translation: 朋友：你家娃才两岁就会划手机了 你：对啊 比我玩得还溜 朋友：现在的小孩真是天生就懂数码 你：对 他们是数字时代的原住民
digital native.example: Friend: Your two-year-old already swipes the phone. You: Yeah, he's better at it than I am. Friend: Kids these days are digital natives. You: Right; they're digital natives from birth.

digital nomad.context: 你朋友辞了职，带着电脑一边旅行一边远程办公，满世界旅居。
digital nomad.translation: 朋友：你朋友现在在哪呢 不在公司上班了吗 你：他辞职了 边旅游边远程干活 朋友：这日子也太潇洒了 你：对 他就是大家说的数字游民
digital nomad.example: Friend: Where's your friend now? Doesn't he work at the office? You: He quit; he travels and works remotely. Friend: That life sounds amazing. You: Yeah, he's what you call a digital nomad.

digital payment.context: 你出门忘带钱包，结果发现到处都能扫码付钱，现金根本用不上。
digital payment.translation: 朋友：你今天带现金了吗 我忘带钱包了 你：没事 现在都扫码支付 朋友：小摊小贩也能扫吗 你：能啊 到处都是电子支付
digital payment.example: Friend: Did you bring cash? I forgot my wallet. You: No worries; everyone pays by QR code. Friend: Even street vendors? You: Yeah; digital payment is everywhere now.

digital perk.context: 公司给员工发购物卡和远程办公设备，你跟朋友介绍自家福利。
digital perk.translation: 朋友：你们公司福利怎么样啊 你：除了工资 还发电脑和补贴 朋友：这些都算员工福利吗 你：对 公司还配远程办公的设备
digital perk.example: Friend: How are the benefits at your company? You: Besides salary, they give a laptop and allowances. Friend: Do those count as perks? You: Yeah; they even supply digital perks for remote work.

digital photography.context: 你最近迷上拍照，朋友问你买相机是玩胶卷还是玩数码。
digital photography.translation: 朋友：你最近老出去拍照 是学胶卷吗 你：不是 我玩的是数码摄影 朋友：那不是跟手机差不多吗 你：差远了 画质和效果都不一样
digital photography.example: Friend: You're always out taking photos; film? You: No, it's digital photography. Friend: Isn't that like a phone? You: Way different; the quality and effects differ.

digital platform.context: 你做自媒体，朋友问你发视频主要放在哪个网站上。
digital platform.translation: 朋友：你做视频都发在哪个网站啊 你：主要发在一个视频平台上 朋友：那个平台流量大吗 你：挺大的 现在人都爱看短视频
digital platform.example: Friend: Where do you post your videos? You: Mainly on one video platform. Friend: Does that platform get much traffic? You: A lot; people love short videos on the digital platform.

digital revolution.context: 老师上课讲这二十年手机和网络改变了所有人的生活，是一场大变革。
digital revolution.translation: 朋友：这二十年变化也太大了 你：对啊 谁能想到出门都不用带钱了 朋友：这就是老师说的技术变革吧 你：对 这场数字革命改变了一切
digital revolution.example: Friend: Things have changed so much in twenty years. You: Yeah, who thought we'd leave home without cash? Friend: That's the tech revolution, right? You: Yeah, the digital revolution changed everything.

digital screen.context: 医生说你看手机太久、盯屏幕太多，让你每小时歇一会儿眼睛。
digital screen.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老揉眼睛 你：看电脑手机太多 眼睛干得很 朋友：医生怎么说 你：让我少盯电子屏幕 每小时歇一会儿
digital screen.example: Friend: Why are you always rubbing your eyes? You: Too much screen time; my eyes are dry. Friend: What did the doctor say? You: Cut the screen time and rest my eyes hourly.

digital skills.context: 公司招新人要求会用各种办公软件，朋友说现在不会电脑根本不行。
digital skills.translation: 朋友：现在找工作都要求会电脑吗 你：对啊 基本办公软件都得会 朋友：这就是所谓的数字技能吧 你：对 现在没这个技能寸步难行
digital skills.example: Friend: Do jobs require computer skills now? You: Yeah, basic office software is a must. Friend: That's digital skills, right? You: Yeah; without digital skills you can't get by.

digital substitute.context: 你以前爱买书，现在都用平板看电子书，觉得纸质书没必要了。
digital substitute.translation: 朋友：你现在怎么不买书了 你：都用平板看电子书了 朋友：那能代替纸书吗 你：基本可以 电子书就是纸书的数码替代品
digital substitute.example: Friend: Why don't you buy books anymore? You: I read e-books on a tablet. Friend: Can that replace real books? You: Pretty much; an e-book is the digital substitute for paper.

digital tool.context: 你同事教你用一个新软件整理表格，说比手动填快多了。
digital tool.translation: 朋友：你整理表格也太慢了吧 你：我都是一个个手动填的 朋友：你试试这个软件 能自动生成 你：这么高级 有了这数字化工具效率翻倍
digital tool.example: Friend: You're so slow at organizing spreadsheets. You: I fill them in by hand. Friend: Try this app; it generates them automatically. You: So advanced; this digital tool doubles my efficiency.

digital transaction.context: 你在网上买东西，朋友问你线上转账付款到底安不安全。
digital transaction.translation: 朋友：你在网上买东西 不怕钱被骗吗 你：都是正规平台付款 有保障 朋友：这种网上转账安全吗 你：对 正规的数字交易都有记录可查
digital transaction.example: Friend: Aren't you afraid of being scammed buying online? You: I pay on official platforms; it's protected. Friend: Is that kind of online payment safe? You: Yeah; every digital transaction is recorded.

digital twin.context: 你听工程师说工厂给每台机器都做了个一模一样的电脑模型，特别神奇。
digital twin.translation: 朋友：你们工厂电脑里那个模型是干嘛的 你：它跟真机器一模一样 实时对应 朋友：这有什么用呢 你：能提前预测机器会不会出故障
digital twin.example: Friend: What's that model on your factory computers for? You: It mirrors the real machine in real time. Friend: What's the use? You: It predicts failures; that's a digital twin.

digital wallet.context: 你把银行卡绑在手机上，出门刷一下手机就能付钱，朋友觉得新鲜。
digital wallet.translation: 朋友：你刚才刷手机就付完钱了 怎么弄的 你：我把银行卡绑进了手机钱包 朋友：这就是电子钱包吧 你：对 出门连卡都不用带了
digital wallet.example: Friend: You just paid by tapping your phone? How? You: I linked my card to my phone's wallet. Friend: That's a digital wallet, right? You: Yeah; I don't even carry cards now.

digital world.context: 你妹妹整天泡在网上打游戏，跟现实生活都快脱节了。
digital world.translation: 朋友：你妹妹怎么天天窝在房间打游戏 你：她觉得网上比现实有意思 朋友：这样跟真人都不交流了 你：对 她整个人活在数字世界里
digital world.example: Friend: Why does your sister hole up gaming all day? You: She finds the online world more fun. Friend: Then she barely talks to real people. You: Yeah; she lives in a digital world.

dine on.context: 朋友请你去一家高级餐厅，问你今晚想吃点什么招牌菜。
dine on.translation: 朋友：今晚这家餐厅你想点什么 你：听说他们的牛排特别有名 朋友：那就来一份招牌牛排吧 你：好啊 今晚就好好吃一顿
dine on.example: Friend: What do you want at this restaurant tonight? You: Their steak is supposed to be famous. Friend: Then let's have the signature steak. You: Great; let's dine on steak tonight.

dine with.context: 你导师约你周六晚上去他家吃饭，你紧张地准备见面礼物。
dine with.translation: 朋友：导师约你周六去他家吃饭啊 你：是啊 我还不知道要聊什么 朋友：那你准备带点礼物吗 你：准备了点水果 能跟老师一起吃饭挺荣幸的
dine with.example: Friend: Your advisor invited you to his place Saturday? You: Yeah, I don't know what we'll talk about. Friend: Should you bring a gift? You: I got some fruit; it's an honor to dine with him.

direct result.context: 你连着熬了一周夜，结果今天直接在课堂上睡着了，老师都看在眼里。
direct result.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么在课上睡着了 你：连着熬了一周 身体扛不住了 朋友：这就是熬夜的后果啊 你：对 今天犯困就是缺觉的直接结果
direct result.example: Friend: Why did you fall asleep in class today? You: I pulled all-nighters for a week; my body gave out. Friend: That's the consequence. You: Yeah; today's drowsiness is a direct result.

disabled people.context: 你坐地铁发现车厢里有专门给轮椅预留的位置，朋友说现在贴心多了。
disabled people.translation: 朋友：地铁里那片空位是留着干嘛的 你：是给坐轮椅的乘客留的 朋友：现在对残障人士挺照顾的 你：对 公共设施都为他们考虑了
disabled people.example: Friend: What's that empty space on the subway for? You: It's reserved for wheelchair users. Friend: It's considerate toward disabled people now. You: Yeah; public facilities think about disabled people.

disagree with.context: 你吃了朋友推荐的网红甜品，结果胃里一直翻江倒海不舒服。
disagree with.translation: 朋友：那家网红甜品你吃着怎么样 你：吃完胃里一直难受 朋友：不会吧 很多人排队买啊 你：可能这东西不合我胃口 我胃受不了
disagree with.example: Friend: How was that trendy dessert? You: My stomach's been off since I ate it. Friend: Really? So many people queue for it. You: It must disagree with my stomach; it really disagrees with me.

discarded equipment.context: 公司换了一批新电脑，旧的那批拉去专门回收，不能随便扔。
discarded equipment.translation: 朋友：仓库里那堆旧电脑怎么处理 你：公司说要专门回收 不能乱扔 朋友：为什么不能直接丢了 你：里面有电池 废弃设备得专业处理
discarded equipment.example: Friend: What about those old computers in storage? You: The company says recycle them properly. Friend: Why not just dump them? You: They have batteries; discarded equipment needs special handling.

disconnect from.context: 你周末打算把工作群消息屏蔽，彻底从工作里抽身出来休息。
disconnect from.translation: 朋友：周末你还老看工作群干嘛 你：我也不想看 但是老忍不住 朋友：不如直接把工作软件退了 你：好 周末就彻底跟工作断联
disconnect from.example: Friend: Why are you still checking the work group on weekends? You: I can't help it. Friend: Why not disconnect from work apps? You: Good idea; I'll disconnect from work on weekends.

discourage.context: 你想辞职去开咖啡店，爸妈劝你别冲动，说风险太大。
discourage.translation: 朋友：你爸妈支持你辞职开店吗 你：他们一个劲劝我别冲动 朋友：为什么呀 你：他们怕我赔钱 一直泼冷水打消我的念头
discourage.example: Friend: Do your parents support quitting to open a cafe? You: They keep discouraging me from rushing. Friend: Why? You: They fear I'll lose money and keep discouraging the idea.

discretionary spending.context: 你这个月发了工资，还完房租贷款，剩下的钱才敢拿来玩乐。
discretionary spending.translation: 朋友：你这月发工资了 打算怎么花 你：先把房租贷款还了 朋友：剩下的能随便花了吧 你：对 那部分才是我能自由支配的钱
discretionary spending.example: Friend: Payday; how will you spend it? You: Pay rent and loans first. Friend: Then the rest is free to spend? You: Yeah; that's my discretionary spending.

discriminate against.context: 新闻里说有些公司招人只要男生，你和朋友觉得特别不公平。
discriminate against.translation: 朋友：你看到那条招聘新闻了吗 只招男生 你：这也太不公平了吧 朋友：这就是明目张胆的性别歧视 你：对 企业不能因为性别就歧视人
discriminate against.example: Friend: Did you see that job posting? Only hiring men. You: That's so unfair. Friend: That's outright gender discrimination. You: Yeah; companies shouldn't discriminate against people by gender.

dispense with.context: 你们聚餐决定这次不搞复杂的点菜流程，直接上套餐省事。
dispense with.translation: 朋友：今天点菜还是一个个点吗 你：太麻烦了 直接上套餐吧 朋友：这样会不会不够灵活 你：无所谓 今天就省掉这些讲究
dispense with.example: Friend: Order dishes one by one again today? You: Too much hassle; just get the set meal. Friend: Won't that be less flexible? You: Doesn't matter; let's dispense with the fuss today.

disperse cloud.context: 你们本来看天气预报担心下雨，结果一阵大风把云全吹散了。
disperse cloud.translation: 朋友：今天会不会下雨啊 看预报挺悬的 你：刚才那阵大风把云都吹散了 朋友：那太阳出来了没 你：出来了 风把云层都吹散了
disperse cloud.example: Friend: Will it rain today? The forecast is shaky. You: That gust just dispersed the clouds. Friend: Is the sun out now? You: Yeah; the wind dispersed the clouds.

disposable clothing.context: 你看朋友买了一堆穿两次就扔的便宜衣服，觉得这样特别不环保。
disposable clothing.translation: 朋友：你这一堆新衣服怎么都吊牌还在 你：打折买的 穿两次就不想要了 朋友：这样也太浪费了 你：对 这种穿两次就丢的衣服特别不环保
disposable clothing.example: Friend: Why are so many of these clothes still tagged? You: Bought them on sale; they're worn twice then tossed. Friend: That's so wasteful. You: Yeah; disposable clothing is really bad for the planet.

disposable culture.context: 你们聊到现在什么都用一次性的，外卖盒、塑料袋到处都是。
disposable culture.translation: 朋友：现在外卖盒是不是太多了 你：对 到处都是一次性的东西 朋友：这种风气真的好吗 你：不好 一次性消费太污染环境了
disposable culture.example: Friend: Aren't there too many takeout boxes now? You: Yeah, everything is disposable. Friend: Is that trend healthy? You: No; this disposable culture pollutes the environment.

disposable income.context: 你算了笔账，发现交完房租税后，能自由花的钱其实没多少。
disposable income.translation: 朋友：你一个月到手能攒下多少 你：扣完税和房租 其实没剩多少 朋友：能随便花的钱不多啊 你：对 可支配收入就那么点
disposable income.example: Friend: How much can you save a month? You: After tax and rent, not much left. Friend: So little you can freely spend. You: Yeah; my disposable income is pretty small.

dispose of.context: 你搬新家收拾出一堆旧杂物，不知道该扔到哪里去才合规。
dispose of.translation: 朋友：你这堆旧东西都不要了吗 你：对 用不上了 想丢掉 朋友：大件垃圾要分类扔 你：我查查该怎么处理这些旧物
dispose of.example: Friend: You don't want all this old stuff? You: No, it's useless; I want to throw it away. Friend: Big waste needs sorting. You: Let me check how to properly dispose of it.

disrupt harmony.context: 你爸妈因为一点小事拌嘴，家里气氛一下子僵住，你在中间打圆场。
disrupt harmony.translation: 朋友：你家今天怎么静悄悄的 你：我爸妈刚才因为点小事吵了两句 朋友：那现在和好了吗 你：我劝了劝 可别为这点事伤了和气
disrupt harmony.example: Friend: Why is your house so quiet today? You: My parents bickered over something small. Friend: Have they made up? You: I talked to them; don't let it disrupt family harmony.

distant social connection.context: 你在同学聚会上认识了几个点头之交，加了微信却几乎不怎么联系。
distant social connection.translation: 朋友：上周聚会认识的那些人你还联系吗 你：不怎么联系 就加了个微信 朋友：那也算朋友吗 你：不算 就是些疏远的关系
distant social connection.example: Friend: Do you still talk to those people from the party? You: Barely; we just added each other. Friend: Are they even friends? You: No; they're just distant social connections.

distract from.context: 你在图书馆备考，旁边老有人刷短视频外放，你根本静不下心。
distract from.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么没去图书馆学习 你：旁边老有人放短视频 太分心了 朋友：那戴个耳塞呢 你：戴了也没用 就是静不下心看书
distract from.example: Friend: Why didn't you study at the library today? You: Someone played short videos out loud; it distracted me. Friend: Wear earplugs then. You: Didn't help; it distracted me from focusing.

distract from trouble.context: 你失恋后心情很差，朋友拉你去打球看电影，帮你把注意力转移开。
distract from trouble.translation: 朋友：你这几天一直闷闷不乐的 你：心里那点事老放不下 朋友：要不出去打打球 转移一下注意 你：好啊 让脑子别老想那些烦心事
distract from trouble.example: Friend: You've been glum for days. You: I can't let go of that trouble. Friend: Let's play ball to distract you from it. You: Good; let my mind get distracted from the trouble.

distracted by.context: 你上课老忍不住刷手机，结果这次考试退步了，老师找你谈话。
distracted by.translation: 朋友：你这次考试怎么退步这么多 你：上课老被手机分心 听不进去 朋友：那上课把手机收起来啊 你：知道了 下次不分心了
distracted by.example: Friend: Why did your grades drop so much? You: I got distracted by my phone in class. Friend: Then put it away in class. You: I know; I won't get distracted by it next time.

distracting noise.context: 你在咖啡馆想赶稿，结果旁边客人聊天声音特别大，根本写不下去。
distracting noise.translation: 朋友：你不是说要去咖啡馆写稿吗 你：那边人太多 太吵了 朋友：那安静吗 你：根本不安静 全是聊天的噪音 没法专心
distracting noise.example: Friend: Weren't you going to the cafe to write? You: Too many people; it's loud. Friend: Is it quiet? You: Not at all; it's all distracting noise, can't focus.

ditch dye.context: 你染了两年头发最近发质变差，决定再也不染了，让它自己长回来。
ditch dye.translation: 朋友：你头发怎么黑了 不染了吗 你：不染了 头发都染坏了 朋友：那等它慢慢长回来 你：对 干脆放弃染发 让头发自己恢复
ditch dye.example: Friend: Your hair's dark; you stopped dyeing? You: Yeah, dyeing ruined my hair. Friend: Let it grow out then? You: Right; I'll ditch the dye and let it recover.

diverse body shape.context: 你看时装秀发现模特不再清一色瘦，各种身材都有，觉得这是好事。
diverse body shape.translation: 朋友：现在模特怎么什么身材都有 你：对啊 不再是以前那种瘦条条了 朋友：这样看着舒服多了 你：对 各种体型都该被接受
diverse body shape.example: Friend: Why are models all shapes now? You: Yeah, not just the old skinny type. Friend: That's more comfortable to watch. You: Yeah; diverse body shapes should all be accepted.

divert tourists.context: 热门景点节假日人满为患，景区引导游客分流到周边小景点错峰。
divert tourists.translation: 朋友：国庆那景点不挤爆了吗 你：景区把人分流到周边小点了 朋友：这办法能管用吗 你：能 引导游客错峰 主景点就不那么挤了
divert tourists.example: Friend: Won't that spot be packed on National Day? You: They divert tourists to smaller nearby spots. Friend: Does that work? You: Yeah; diverting tourists eases the main site.

divine consequences.context: 你奶奶讲老话，说做了亏心事会遭报应，你听了半信半疑。
divine consequences.translation: 朋友：奶奶老说做坏事会遭天谴 你：是啊 她信这个 朋友：你觉得真有报应吗 你：我也说不清 老一辈都这么讲
divine consequences.example: Friend: Grandma says bad deeds bring divine consequences. You: Yeah, she believes that. Friend: Do you think there's really retribution? You: Not sure; that's how elders talk about divine consequences.

divvied up.context: 小组项目结束后，你们把拿到的奖金按每个人的贡献平分。
divvied up.translation: 朋友：咱们这次项目奖金怎么分 你：按每个人干活的多少分吧 朋友：那最后分下来每人多少 你：大家一平分 拿到手里还不错
divvied up.example: Friend: How do we split this project bonus? You: By how much each of us worked. Friend: How much does each get? You: Once it's divvied up, each gets a fair share.

divvy up.context: 你和朋友合买了一个超大披萨，两个人一人一半分着吃。
divvy up.translation: 朋友：这个披萨太大 咱们俩吃不完 你：那一人一半分着吃吧 朋友：你多吃点 我不太饿 你：别客气 咱们平分就好
divvy up.example: Friend: This pizza is too big for both of us. You: Then let's divvy it up half and half. Friend: You eat more; I'm not that hungry. You: Don't be polite; let's divvy it up fairly.

dna test.context: 你朋友怀疑孩子长得不像自己，纠结要不要偷偷去做个鉴定。
dna test.translation: 朋友：我最近老怀疑孩子长得不像我 你：那你打算怎么办 朋友：要不要偷偷做个检测 你：这种事还是想清楚 别乱猜
dna test.example: Friend: I keep wondering if the kid looks like me. You: What will you do? Friend: Should I secretly get a DNA test? You: Think it through; don't just guess.

do enough.context: 你复习了一晚上心里还是没底，朋友安慰你该做的都已经做了。
do enough.translation: 朋友：明天就要考试了 我好慌 你：你这阵子不是天天在复习吗 朋友：可是我还是怕考不好 你：别担心 你已经做得够多了
do enough.example: Friend: The exam's tomorrow; I'm panicking. You: Haven't you studied every day lately? Friend: But I'm still afraid. You: Don't worry; you've done enough.

do the job.context: 你找不到专门的螺丝刀，朋友说用硬币顶着拧一下也能凑合。
do the job.translation: 朋友：你这柜子螺丝松了 有螺丝刀吗 你：没找到 用硬币顶着拧行不行 朋友：凑合一下 能拧紧就行 你：好 硬币也能顶上去
do the job.example: Friend: The cabinet screw is loose; do you have a screwdriver? You: Not found; can a coin work? Friend: It'll do the job if it tightens it. You: Okay, a coin can do the job.

do the math.context: 你们合租算房租水电，掏出手机加加减减看每人该摊多少钱。
do the math.translation: 朋友：这个月水电一共三百六 三个人怎么分 你：你算算每人多少 朋友：三百六除以三 一人一百二 你：对 算完一人一百二
do the math.example: Friend: Utilities are 360 this month; split three ways? You: Do the math on your phone. Friend: 360 divided by 3 is 120 each. You: Right; once you do the math, it's 120 a head.

do the same.context: 你朋友坚持早起跑步后身体好很多，你也想照着做一遍。
do the same.translation: 朋友：我坚持早起跑步 身体好多了 你：那我也跟你一样天天早起跑 朋友：你能起得来吗 你：试试看 跟你做一样的事
do the same.example: Friend: I run early every day and feel much better. You: Then I'll do the same and run early. Friend: Can you actually wake up? You: Let's try; I'll do the same as you.

do wonder.context: 你失眠很久，朋友推荐你睡前喝杯热牛奶，说特别管用。
do wonder.translation: 朋友：我最近又睡不着了 你：试试睡前喝杯热牛奶 朋友：真的有用吗 你：特别管用 好多人都说它奇效
do wonder.example: Friend: I can't sleep again lately. You: Try warm milk before bed. Friend: Does it really work? You: It does wonders; many people say so.

do wonder for.context: 你换季皮肤干得起皮，朋友送了你一瓶保湿霜，说效果特别好。
do wonder for.translation: 朋友：你脸怎么这么干 你：换季就起皮 难受 朋友：你试试这瓶保湿霜 特别润 你：真的吗 听说它对干皮奇效
do wonder for.example: Friend: Why is your skin so dry? You: It flakes every season change. Friend: Try this moisturizer; it's really rich. You: Really? I heard it does wonders for dry skin.

dog ownership.context: 你在纠结要不要养条狗，朋友说养狗看着好玩其实特别费神。
dog ownership.translation: 朋友：你真打算养只狗啊 你：对啊 我挺喜欢狗的 朋友：你知道养狗多花时间吗 你：知道 每天得遛还得喂
dog ownership.example: Friend: Are you really getting a dog? You: Yeah, I love dogs. Friend: Do you know how much work dog ownership is? You: I know; walking and feeding every day.

dog theft.context: 新闻里说有人专门偷狗卖钱，附近养狗的邻居都紧张起来。
dog theft.translation: 朋友：最近新闻说有人专门偷狗 你：是啊 我邻居家狗前几天差点被偷 朋友：现在遛狗都得看紧 你：对 不然被偷狗贼盯上就麻烦了
dog theft.example: Friend: The news says people are stealing dogs lately. You: Yeah, my neighbor's dog was almost taken. Friend: So watch your dog closely on walks. You: Yeah; dog theft is a real risk now.

domestic arrangement.context: 你和新室友商量谁住主卧谁住次卧，以及房租具体怎么分。
domestic arrangement.translation: 朋友：咱们这房子怎么住 你：我住小间 你住大间吧 朋友：那房租怎么摊 你：大间多摊一点 咱们把住的安排谈清楚
domestic arrangement.example: Friend: How do we split the rooms? You: I'll take the small one; you take the big. Friend: How about the rent? You: The big room pays a bit more; let's settle our living arrangement.

domestic dog.context: 你们在乡下路边看到一条流浪狗，朋友问这跟家里养的狗有啥区别。
domestic dog.translation: 朋友：路边这条狗是流浪的吧 你：对 不是家养的 朋友：它跟家里养的狗长得一样啊 你：样子差不多 但家犬是被人养大的
domestic dog.example: Friend: That dog by the road is a stray, right? You: Yeah, not a domestic dog. Friend: It looks the same as a pet. You: Looks similar, but a domestic dog is raised by people.

domestic flight.context: 你假期去海南玩，朋友问你订的机票是国内航班还是要转机。
domestic flight.translation: 朋友：你去海南订机票了吗 你：订了 直飞的国内航班 朋友：飞过去要多久啊 你：两个半小时 挺快的
domestic flight.example: Friend: Did you book tickets to Hainan? You: Yes, a direct domestic flight. Friend: How long is the flight? You: Two and a half hours; pretty fast.

domestic skills.context: 你第一次一个人住，连做饭洗衣服都不太行，朋友笑你生活能力差。
domestic skills.translation: 朋友：你一个人住 饭怎么办 你：外卖凑合 或者煮个面条 朋友：你这生活技能也太差了 你：是啊 连基本家务都不会
domestic skills.example: Friend: Living alone; how do you manage meals? You: Takeout or just noodles. Friend: Your domestic skills are pretty weak. You: Yeah; I don't even know basic chores.

dominated by.context: 你们聊到这个行业几乎被几家大公司垄断，小公司很难生存。
dominated by.translation: 朋友：这行现在是不是就那几家大厂说了算 你：对啊 市场被它们占了 朋友：小公司怎么活啊 你：难 整个行业都被这几家主导
dominated by.example: Friend: Do a few giants rule this industry now? You: Yeah, they dominate the market. Friend: How do small firms survive? You: Hard; the industry is dominated by those few.

don't cost the earth.context: 你想请朋友吃顿好的又怕太贵，朋友说那家店其实人均很便宜。
don't cost the earth.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅会不会特别贵啊 你：不会 人均才几十块 朋友：真的吗 那太好了 你：对 又好吃又不贵
don't cost the earth.example: Friend: Won't that restaurant be expensive? You: No, only a few dozen per person. Friend: Really? Great. You: Yeah; good food that doesn't cost the earth.

don't judge a book by its cover.context: 你看那个穿得很朴素的人居然是公司大老板，朋友提醒你别小看人。
don't judge a book by its cover.translation: 朋友：那个人穿得普普通通的 你：别小看人 他其实是老板 朋友：真没看出来 你：就是嘛 不能光看外表
don't judge a book by its cover.example: Friend: That guy dresses so plainly. You: Don't underestimate him; he's the boss. Friend: I'd never have guessed. You: Right; don't judge a book by its cover.

donut hole.context: 你去甜品店买点心，店员推荐那种一口一个的小圆球甜点。
donut hole.translation: 朋友：你想买点什么甜点 你：那个圆球状的小点心看着不错 朋友：那是甜甜圈球 一口一个 你：来一份尝尝
donut hole.example: Friend: What dessert do you want? You: Those round little treats look good. Friend: Those are donut holes; one bite each. You: Let me get a portion of donut holes.

doom scrolling.context: 你睡前躺着刷负面新闻，越刷越焦虑，朋友劝你别再看了。
doom scrolling.translation: 朋友：你大半夜还在刷手机看什么 你：全是负面新闻 越看越烦 朋友：别刷了 越刷越焦虑 你：停不下来啊 越刷越想看
doom scrolling.example: Friend: Why are you scrolling your phone late at night? You: All bad news; it's upsetting. Friend: Stop doom scrolling; it worsens anxiety. You: I can't; doom scrolling is addictive.

dos and don'ts.context: 你刚到新公司，同事给你列了一份办公室里该做不该做的小事。
dos and don'ts.translation: 朋友：第一天上班有什么要注意的吗 你：我整理了一份办公室守则 朋友：都写了些什么 你：哪些能做哪些不能做 都列清楚了
dos and don'ts.example: Friend: Anything to watch on my first day? You: I made a list of office dos and don'ts. Friend: What's on it? You: All the dos and don'ts written out clearly.

double whammy.context: 你这个月房租涨了，奖金又没发下来，真是祸不单行赶一块儿。
double whammy.translation: 朋友：你这个月怎么愁眉苦脸的 你：房租涨了 奖金还没发 朋友：这也太倒霉了吧 你：对 真是双重打击 赶一块儿了
double whammy.example: Friend: Why the long face this month? You: Rent went up and my bonus is gone. Friend: That's rotten luck. You: Yeah; it's a double whammy, both at once.

down.context: 你朋友今天情绪特别低落，问他怎么了他也不说，你约他出来散心。
down.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么一直闷闷不乐的 你：也没什么大事 就是心情有点低落 朋友：出来走走吧 别一个人闷着 你：好 陪我聊聊天就好
down.example: Friend: Why have you been so down today? You: Nothing major; just feeling a bit down. Friend: Come out for a walk; don't mope alone. You: Okay; just chat with me.

down by.context: 你看这个月销售数据比上个月少了两成，跟同事在群里汇报。
down by.translation: 朋友：这个月销量怎么样 你：比上个月下降了百分之二十 朋友：怎么掉这么多 你：可能是淡季 数据确实不好看
down by.example: Friend: How are sales this month? You: They're down by twenty percent from last month. Friend: Why so low? You: Maybe off-season; the numbers are down by a lot.

down in the dumps.context: 朋友养的小猫走了，这两天他一直躲在家里不肯出门。
down in the dumps.translation: 朋友：你这两天怎么都不出门 你：我家猫昨天走了 心里特别难受 朋友：难怪你一直闷闷不乐 你：我还没缓过来 心情低落到极点
down in the dumps.example: Friend: Why haven't you gone out these days? You: My cat passed yesterday; I'm heartbroken. Friend: No wonder you're down in the dumps. You: I haven't recovered; I'm really down in the dumps.

down the line.context: 你跟朋友约在街角那家咖啡馆，说就在这条街一直往前走到底。
down the line.translation: 朋友：那家咖啡馆在哪儿啊 我没看到 你：就在这条街一直往前走 朋友：是靠近十字路口那家吗 你：对 沿街走到底就到了
down the line.example: Friend: Where's that cafe? I don't see it. You: Just keep walking down the street. Friend: The one near the crossroads? You: Yeah; go down the line and you're there.

down to.context: 你这次考试进步很大，老师问你是怎么做到的，你说全靠每天坚持。
down to.translation: 朋友：你这次怎么进步这么多 你：都是天天刷题刷出来的 朋友：真的是靠自己努力吗 你：对 成绩提高全靠我每天坚持
down to.example: Friend: How'd you improve so much this time? You: From drilling problems every day. Friend: All your own effort? You: Yeah; the improvement is down to daily practice.

down to personal judgement.context: 选电影还是选书这个问题没有标准答案，朋友说全看个人喜好。
down to personal judgement.translation: 朋友：你觉得看电影好还是看书好 你：这没个标准答案吧 朋友：那到底选哪个呢 你：看个人喜欢 全凭个人判断
down to personal judgement.example: Friend: Is watching a movie better or reading? You: There's no standard answer. Friend: Then which do you pick? You: It's down to personal judgement; whatever you like.

down tools.context: 傍晚六点一到，工地的工人们纷纷放下工具准备下班回家。
down tools.translation: 朋友：工地这会儿怎么安静下来了 你：到点了 工人们都收工了 朋友：他们每天准时下班吗 你：对 六点一到就停工回家
down tools.example: Friend: Why's the construction site quiet now? You: It's quitting time; workers down tools. Friend: Do they leave on time daily? You: Yeah; at six they down tools and go home.

download apps to a tablet.context: 你刚给孩子买了个平板，帮他把几个学习软件一个个装上去。
download apps to a tablet.translation: 朋友：你这平板新买的 装了什么软件 你：我帮孩子装了几个学习软件 朋友：都是从应用商店下的吗 你：对 把学习应用下载到平板上
download apps to a tablet.example: Friend: New tablet; what apps did you install? You: I put a few study apps on for my kid. Friend: All from the app store? You: Yeah; I downloaded the apps to the tablet.

downplay others.context: 你同事老在领导面前把自己说得很厉害，把别人的功劳讲得一文不值。
downplay others.translation: 朋友：那个同事怎么老在领导面前吹牛 你：他总把自己说得特别厉害 朋友：那别人的活呢 你：他就故意贬低别人的贡献
downplay others.example: Friend: Why does that coworker always brag to the boss? You: He makes himself sound amazing. Friend: What about others' work? You: He deliberately downplays others' contributions.

doze off.context: 你下午开例会特别困，坐在会议室里头一点一点地打起了瞌睡。
doze off.translation: 朋友：你下午开会是不是睡着了 你：太困了 听着听着就眯过去了 朋友：领导看到没 你：应该没有 我打了个盹就醒了
doze off.example: Friend: Did you fall asleep in that afternoon meeting? You: I was so tired; I dozed off while listening. Friend: Did the boss notice? You: Probably not; I dozed off for a bit then woke up.

drag away from.context: 朋友在博物馆展品前挪不动脚，你俩赶时间，只好硬拉着他走。
drag away from.translation: 朋友：再让我看一眼这个展品嘛 你：来不及了 下一个馆要关门了 朋友：就看一小会儿 你：不行 我把你从这儿拉走了
drag away from.example: Friend: Let me look at this exhibit one more second. You: We're out of time; the next hall is closing. Friend: Just a moment. You: No; I have to drag you away from it.

drag on.context: 那场部门会开了三个小时还没完，你和同事在下面都坐不住了。
drag on.translation: 朋友：这个会到底什么时候开完 你：都三个小时了 还在扯 朋友：能不能快点结束 你：这帮人一开起会就没完没了
drag on.example: Friend: When will this meeting finally end? You: Three hours already, still going. Friend: Can't they speed it up? You: These meetings just drag on and on.

drain away.context: 你最近特别累，感觉精力像水一样一点点流走，朋友约你出门都提不起劲。
drain away.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老没精神 你：感觉精力都快被工作耗干了 朋友：周末好好休息一下 你：对 不然精力都流走了
drain away.example: Friend: Why are you so low on energy lately? You: Work's draining it all away. Friend: Rest well this weekend. You: Yeah, or my energy will keep draining away.

drain on.context: 你养了两只猫，觉得它们每个月吃掉你不少钱和精力。
drain on.translation: 朋友：养猫一个月得花多少钱啊 你：吃的看病加起来 真是不小的开销 朋友：那还养得起吗 你：养是养得起 就是挺耗钱的
drain on.example: Friend: How much does a cat cost a month? You: Food and vet bills are a real drain. Friend: Can you still afford it? You: Barely; cats are a real drain on my budget.

drastic change.context: 你毕业这两年生活发生了很大变化，朋友再见到你都快认不出了。
drastic change.translation: 朋友：你这两年变化也太大了吧 你：换了工作搬了家 整个人都不一样了 朋友：什么时候开始的 你：就从毕业那年 一切都变了
drastic change.example: Friend: You've changed so much these two years. You: New job and new city; I'm a different person. Friend: When did it start? You: Since graduation; a drastic change happened.

draw attention to.context: 老师在课上敲黑板，提醒大家注意这道特别容易错的题。
draw attention to.translation: 朋友：刚才老师敲黑板是要说什么 你：他想让我们注意这个易错点 朋友：这个点考试常考吗 你：对 老师特意提醒大家别忽略
draw attention to.example: Friend: Why did the teacher tap the board? You: He wanted to draw attention to this trap. Friend: Does it often appear on exams? You: Yeah; he drew attention to it on purpose.

draw conclusion.context: 你们看完一篇研究报告，讨论能不能根据现有数据直接下定论。
draw conclusion.translation: 朋友：这份报告能说明问题吗 你：数据还不够 先别急着下结论 朋友：那还需要什么 你：再等等更多证据 才能下结论
draw conclusion.example: Friend: Does this report prove the point? You: Not enough data; don't draw conclusions yet. Friend: What else is needed? You: Wait for more evidence before drawing a conclusion.

draw from.context: 你写作文没灵感，老师建议你多从自己的生活经历里找素材。
draw from.translation: 朋友：这篇作文你写得怎么样了 你：脑子空空 不知道写什么 朋友：可以从你自己的经历写起 你：对 从生活里取材就好办了
draw from.example: Friend: How's that essay going? You: My mind's blank; I don't know what to write. Friend: Draw from your own experience. You: Right; drawing from life makes it easier.

draw on.context: 你做演讲没思路，朋友建议你参考以前看过的那些成功案例。
draw on.translation: 朋友：明天演讲你准备好了吗 你：还没 不知道怎么开头 朋友：你可以用以前的案例作参考 你：好 借鉴一下别人的经验
draw on.example: Friend: Ready for tomorrow's speech? You: Not yet; I don't know how to start. Friend: Draw on the cases you've seen. You: Good; I'll draw on others' experience.

draws back.context: 你看到一只没拴绳的大狗冲过来，吓得本能地往后退了一步。
draws back.translation: 朋友：那狗冲过来了 你：我吓得赶紧往后退了一步 朋友：它有没有拴绳啊 你：没有 我本能地往后一缩
draws back.example: Friend: That dog's charging over. You: I drew back a step in fright. Friend: Is it on a leash? You: No; I instinctively drew back.

dream job.context: 你跟朋友聊以后想干什么，说最想做一份跟摄影有关的工作。
dream job.translation: 朋友：你以后最想做什么工作啊 你：我最想当摄影师 到处拍拍照 朋友：那现在的工作不是白干了 你：慢慢往理想工作靠呗
dream job.example: Friend: What's the job you most want? You: I'd love to be a photographer, traveling and shooting. Friend: Isn't your current job wasted then? You: I'll work toward my dream job.

dream partner.context: 你跟朋友聊找对象的标准，描述自己心里那个理想的人是什么样。
dream partner.translation: 朋友：你理想中的另一半是什么样 你：希望能聊得来 脾气好 朋友：就这些吗 你：对 聊得来最重要 这就是我心中理想的人
dream partner.example: Friend: What's your dream partner like? You: Someone easy to talk to and kind. Friend: That's it? You: Yeah; good conversation matters most, that's my dream partner.

dress code.context: 你下周要参加面试，朋友提醒你公司对着装有要求，别穿太随便。
dress code.translation: 朋友：面试那天你打算穿什么 你：我穿休闲装去行吗 朋友：最好正式点 公司对着装有要求 你：那我穿衬衫西裤吧
dress code.example: Friend: What will you wear to the interview? You: Is casual okay? Friend: Better dress up; the office has a dress code. You: Then I'll wear a shirt and trousers.

dress hire.context: 朋友要参加婚礼当伴娘，纠结礼服是买一件还是租一件穿一次。
dress hire.translation: 朋友：下周当伴娘 礼服买还是租 你：租一件就行 就穿一次 朋友：租礼服贵不贵 你：不贵 比买划算多了
dress hire.example: Friend: Bridesmaid next week; buy or rent the dress? You: Rent it; you only wear it once. Friend: Is dress hire expensive? You: No; dress hire is way cheaper than buying.

drift apart.context: 你和最好的朋友上大学去了不同城市，慢慢地联系就越来越少。
drift apart.translation: 朋友：你跟以前那个好朋友还联系吗 你：去了不同城市 慢慢就疏远了 朋友：怎么会这样 你：都忙各自的生活 就淡了
drift apart.example: Friend: Do you still talk to your old best friend? You: Different cities; we drifted apart slowly. Friend: How did that happen? You: Busy with our own lives; we just drifted apart.

drift through.context: 你毕业后有段时间没目标，天天在家混日子，朋友都看不过去了。
drift through.translation: 朋友：你毕业后这半年都干嘛呢 你：也没干嘛 就是晃晃悠悠 朋友：这样下去不行啊 你：我知道 不能再这么混日子了
drift through.example: Friend: What have you done since graduating? You: Nothing much; just drifting through the days. Friend: You can't keep drifting. You: I know; I can't keep drifting through life.

drifts through.context: 朋友辞职后旅行了一整年，没有明确计划，走到哪算哪。
drifts through.translation: 朋友：他这一年都在干嘛 你：辞了职 到处晃 没个目的 朋友：不上班不心慌吗 你：他就想这样漫无目的地过一段日子
drifts through.example: Friend: What's he been up to this year? You: Quit his job, drifting around with no plan. Friend: Doesn't he worry? You: He just wants to drift through life for a while.

drinking water.context: 你去户外爬山，朋友带的水喝完了，问能不能直接接山泉水喝。
drinking water.translation: 朋友：我带的水喝完了 山里水能直接喝吗 你：不行 没烧开的水不能喝 朋友：那怎么办 你：前面有小卖部 去买瓶饮用水
drinking water.example: Friend: My water's gone; can I drink from the spring? You: No, unboiled water isn't safe. Friend: Then what? You: There's a shop ahead; buy some drinking water.

drive away.context: 你家楼下老有流浪猫翻垃圾桶，你妈一出门就把它们赶走。
drive away.translation: 朋友：楼下那几只流浪猫还在吗 你：我妈一出门就把它们撵走 朋友：为什么要赶走它们 你：它们老翻垃圾桶 把垃圾弄一地
drive away.example: Friend: Are those stray cats still downstairs? You: My mom drives them off whenever she goes out. Friend: Why drive them away? You: They tip over the bins and scatter trash.

drive by.context: 你朋友说现在点外卖，骑手骑车到楼下打电话让你自己下去拿。
drive by.translation: 朋友：现在外卖都怎么送上来 你：骑手骑车到楼下 打个电话让你下去拿 朋友：他不送上门了吗 你：对 就骑车经过楼下放下
drive by.example: Friend: How is delivery brought up now? You: The rider cycles down and calls you down. Friend: Doesn't he bring it up? You: No; he just drops it off in a drive-by.

drive down.context: 新闻说竞争激烈后手机价格一直在往下降，你和朋友散步时聊起。
drive down.translation: 朋友：现在手机是不是越来越便宜了 你：对啊 价格一直在降 朋友：为什么会降呢 你：厂家打价格战 把价格压下来
drive down.example: Friend: Aren't phones getting cheaper now? You: Yeah, prices keep going down. Friend: Why? You: Makers compete to drive prices down.

drive the growth.context: 你们聊到电商怎么带动了整个行业发展，朋友给你分析背后逻辑。
drive the growth.translation: 朋友：这几年什么行业发展最快 你：电商吧 带动了好多相关产业 朋友：它是怎么带动的呢 你：网购火了 整个产业链都跟着涨
drive the growth.example: Friend: Which industry grew fastest lately? You: E-commerce; it drove many related industries. Friend: How? You: Online shopping drove the growth of the whole chain.

driver's seat.context: 新项目让你当负责人，你终于从执行者变成了拿主意的人。
driver's seat.translation: 朋友：这项目以后谁牵头啊 你：公司让我来带这个项目 朋友：那你就是说了算的人了 你：对 这次我终于坐到了驾驶座上
driver's seat.example: Friend: Who's leading this project? You: The company put me in charge. Friend: So you're the one calling the shots? You: Yeah; this time I'm in the driver's seat.

driving licence.context: 你满了十八岁，约朋友一起去报名学开车、考驾照。
driving licence.translation: 朋友：你考驾照了吗 我正想去报个名 你：我去年就拿到了 朋友：难不难考 你：多练练就行 有了驾照去哪都方便
driving licence.example: Friend: Have you got your driving licence? I want to sign up. You: I got mine last year. Friend: Is it hard to pass? You: Practice more; a driving licence makes travel easy.

drop down.context: 你在高楼窗边看楼下的雨滴顺着玻璃一点点往下滑。
drop down.translation: 朋友：你看这雨下得多大 你：雨珠顺着窗户往下滑 朋友：今天估计一时半会儿停不了 你：对 雨一直往下掉
drop down.example: Friend: Look how hard it's raining. You: Drops of rain drop down the window. Friend: It won't stop anytime soon. You: Yeah, the rain just keeps dropping down.

drop off.context: 你周末窝在沙发上看电视，看着看着就迷迷糊糊睡着了。
drop off.translation: 朋友：你昨天晚上干嘛去了 你：在沙发上看电视 看着看着就睡着了 朋友：那你没洗澡就睡了 你：对 困得直接就睡过去了
drop off.example: Friend: What did you do last night? You: Watched TV on the sofa and dropped off. Friend: You slept without showering? You: Yeah; I was so tired I dropped off right there.

drove up.context: 你约朋友在学校门口见，他打了个车很快就到了。
drove up.translation: 朋友：你到哪儿了 我们在门口等你 你：我打的 马上就到 朋友：快点啊 都等你半天了 你：来了来了 车已经开过来了
drove up.example: Friend: Where are you? We're waiting at the gate. You: I took a cab; almost there. Friend: Hurry up; we've waited ages. You: Coming; the cab just drove up.

drown out.context: 演出时台上音乐太响，把台下朋友说话的声音全盖住了。
drown out.translation: 朋友：你说什么 我听不见 你：音乐太响 把说话声都盖过去了 朋友：那我们待会儿再聊 你：好 这音乐声太大了
drown out.example: Friend: What did you say? I can't hear. You: The music drowns out our voices. Friend: Let's talk later. You: Okay; the music drowns everything out.

dry brush.context: 秋天你去郊外徒步，路边全是枯黄干枯的灌木丛。
dry brush.translation: 朋友：这路边的草怎么都黄了 你：秋天到了 灌木都干枯了 朋友：看着干巴巴的 你：对 这些都是枯灌木
dry brush.example: Friend: Why is the grass yellow by the road? You: Autumn's here; the brush has dried out. Friend: It looks all withered. You: Yeah; it's all dry brush.

dry january.context: 朋友新年立志这个月一滴酒都不喝，看自己能不能坚持下来。
dry january.translation: 朋友：你最近聚餐都不喝啤酒了 你：我这个月在戒酒 看看能不能坚持 朋友：为什么突然戒了 你：新年想清清肠胃 试一个月
dry january.example: Friend: You're skipping beer at dinners lately? You: I'm doing dry January; trying to stick to it. Friend: Why quit suddenly? You: Want to reset my body; dry January for a month.

duchenne smile.context: 你翻照片发现有的笑是假的、有的笑得眼睛都弯了，特别好认。
duchenne smile.translation: 朋友：你看这两张照片 哪个是真笑 你：第二张 眼睛都弯了 朋友：这种笑是不是装不出来 你：对 眼睛跟着笑才是真的笑
duchenne smile.example: Friend: Which of these two photos is a real smile? You: The second; her eyes crinkle. Friend: Can that be faked? You: No; a Duchenne smile reaches the eyes.

during pregnancy.context: 你表姐怀了宝宝，医生提醒她这期间饮食和用药都要特别小心。
during pregnancy.translation: 朋友：你表姐怀孕了 要注意什么 你：医生说这期间用药得特别小心 朋友：咖啡奶茶还能喝吗 你：最好别 怀孕期间得忌口
during pregnancy.example: Friend: Your cousin's pregnant; what to watch? You: The doctor said medicines need care during pregnancy. Friend: Can she still have coffee? You: Better not; during pregnancy she must watch her diet.

dust mite.context: 你最近老打喷嚏，医生说床上那些小虫子可能是元凶。
dust mite.translation: 朋友：你怎么老打喷嚏 你：可能是床上有小虫子 医生说要多晒被子 朋友：那是什么虫子啊 你：叫尘螨 晒被子能杀掉一些
dust mite.example: Friend: Why are you always sneezing? You: Maybe tiny bugs in the bed; the doctor says sun the sheets. Friend: What bugs? You: Dust mites; sunning the bed kills some dust mites.

dutch courage.context: 朋友要上台表白紧张得要死，先灌了两杯酒给自己壮胆。
dutch courage.translation: 朋友：我紧张得说不出话 怎么办 你：要不先喝两口壮壮胆 朋友：喝酒有用吗 你：对 很多人靠酒后壮胆才敢开口
dutch courage.example: Friend: I'm too nervous to speak; what do I do? You: Have a drink to steady your nerves. Friend: Does drinking help? You: Yeah; many need some Dutch courage to speak up.

duvet day.context: 你今天没生病但特别不想上班，跟公司请了个在家瘫着的假。
duvet day.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么没来上班 你：没生病 就是不想动 在家瘫了一天 朋友：公司允许这样吗 你：现在流行请这种在家躺平假
duvet day.example: Friend: Why weren't you at work today? You: Not sick; just didn't want to move, stayed in bed. Friend: Does the company allow that? You: Yeah; a duvet day is popular now.

dwell on.context: 你考试没考好一直闷闷不乐，朋友劝你别老揪着这件事不放。
dwell on.translation: 朋友：你都烦好几天了 还在想那事啊 你：唉 老忍不住去想 朋友：别揪着不放了 过去就过去了 你：也是 不能老纠结在失败上
dwell on.example: Friend: You've been down for days; still thinking about it? You: I can't help dwelling on it. Friend: Stop dwelling on it; it's over. You: Right; I shouldn't dwell on the failure.

dwell on negatives.context: 你失恋后天天回想吵架的细节，朋友劝你别老往坏处钻。
dwell on negatives.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天翻旧账 想那些不开心的 你：忍不住啊 满脑子都是那些事 朋友：老想这些对身体不好 你：也是 别老纠结糟心事了
dwell on negatives.example: Friend: Why do you keep rehashing the unhappy parts? You: Can't help it; it's all in my head. Friend: Dwelling on negatives is bad for you. You: Right; I shouldn't dwell on negatives.

dying out.context: 你们聊到有些方言年轻人都不会说了，再过几代可能就消失了。
dying out.translation: 朋友：你还会说老家的方言吗 你：会一点 现在小孩都不说了 朋友：那方言以后会不会消失 你：有可能 再不保护就快没了
dying out.example: Friend: Can you still speak your hometown dialect? You: A little; kids don't speak it now. Friend: Will dialects die out? You: Maybe; without protection they're dying out.

dynamic stretch.context: 你去健身房，教练让大家跑步前先做几组活动手脚的热身动作。
dynamic stretch.translation: 朋友：跑步前还要先活动吗 你：对 先做几组动态拉伸热身 朋友：不活动直接跑不行吗 你：容易拉伤 还是先拉伸一下
dynamic stretch.example: Friend: Do we warm up before running? You: Yeah, do some dynamic stretching first. Friend: Can't we just run? You: You might pull a muscle; warm up with dynamic stretches.

early age.context: 你朋友三岁就开始学钢琴，现在弹得特别好，童子功很扎实。
early age.translation: 朋友：你这琴弹得也太好了 学了多久了 你：我三岁就开始学琴了 朋友：这么小就开始 真早 你：对 从小练起 基本功才扎实
early age.example: Friend: You play so well; how long have you studied? You: I started the piano at an early age. Friend: So young? That's early. You: Yeah; starting at an early age builds solid basics.

early bird.context: 朋友每天早上六点就起床去公园，你周末十点还起不来，特别羡慕。
early bird.translation: 朋友：你怎么每天六点就起了 你：我习惯了 早起还能去公园转转 朋友：我周末十点都起不来 你：你得向早起的人学习
early bird.example: Friend: Why are you up at six every day? You: I'm used to it; early birds get a park walk. Friend: I can't wake before ten on weekends. You: You should learn from early birds.

early childhood.context: 老师在课上讲一个人小时候的经历对性格影响很大，拿小朋友举例。
early childhood.translation: 朋友：为什么有的人性格特别好 你：老师说小时候的经历影响很大 朋友：具体是哪个阶段呢 你：幼儿时期对人一生影响最深
early childhood.example: Friend: Why are some people so easygoing? You: The teacher says early experiences matter a lot. Friend: Which stage? You: Early childhood shapes a person the most.

early days.context: 你刚用一个新护肤品一周，朋友问你效果怎么样，你说还看不出来。
early days.translation: 朋友：你新换的护肤品好用吗 你：才用了一周 还看不出效果 朋友：不会没效果吧 你：别急 现在下结论还早
early days.example: Friend: Is your new skincare working? You: Only a week in; can't tell yet. Friend: Maybe it doesn't work? You: Don't rush; it's still early days.

early morning pick-me-up.context: 你每天到公司第一件事就是冲一杯咖啡，不然整个上午都没精神。
early morning pick-me-up.translation: 朋友：你每天到公司先干嘛 你：先冲一杯咖啡提提神 朋友：不喝咖啡就上不了班吗 你：对 早上不来一杯真不行
early morning pick-me-up.example: Friend: What's the first thing at the office? You: Brew a coffee to wake up. Friend: Can't work without it? You: Yeah; I need my early morning pick-me-up.

early mortality.context: 医生说长期熬夜抽烟会影响寿命，你听了之后开始重视身体。
early mortality.translation: 朋友：医生说老熬夜对身体特别不好 你：是啊 长期透支会影响寿命 朋友：有这么严重吗 你：对 早亡风险都高了
early mortality.example: Friend: The doctor says staying up is really bad for you. You: Yeah, long-term overwork shortens life. Friend: That serious? You: Yeah; it raises the risk of early mortality.

early night.context: 你连着熬了几天夜，今晚决定早点上床睡觉，把精神补回来。
early night.translation: 朋友：今晚不一起出去吃了吗 你：不去了 我今晚想早点睡 朋友：太阳从西边出来了 你：熬了好几天 今晚要早点休息
early night.example: Friend: Not coming out for dinner tonight? You: No; I want an early night. Friend: Whoa, that's rare. You: I've stayed up for days; I need an early night.

early on.context: 你回忆起刚上大学那会儿，其实很多好习惯当时就已经养成了。
early on.translation: 朋友：你这个好习惯是怎么养成的 你：其实大一一入学就定了 朋友：这么早吗 你：对 早期养成的习惯最长久
early on.example: Friend: How did you build this good habit? You: I set it early on, back in freshman year. Friend: That early? You: Yeah; habits formed early on last the longest.

earn pocket money.context: 你周末帮邻居遛狗，赚点零花买自己想要的小玩意儿。
earn pocket money.translation: 朋友：你周末去干嘛 又赚外快啊 你：帮邻居遛狗 赚点零花 朋友：一个月能赚多少 你：不多 够我自己花就行
earn pocket money.example: Friend: What are you up to this weekend? More side cash? You: Walking the neighbor's dog to earn pocket money. Friend: How much a month? You: Not much; enough for my own spending.

earth bank.context: 你们在郊外河边散步，看到一道长长的土坡护着河岸。
earth bank.translation: 朋友：这河边一道长长的坡是什么 你：那是一道土堤 护着河岸 朋友：它有什么用呢 你：涨水的时候挡水用
earth bank.example: Friend: What's that long slope by the river? You: It's an earth bank holding the river. Friend: What's it for? You: The earth bank holds back flood water.

ease off.context: 你连续加班一周，周末终于能歇口气，整个人都松下来了。
ease off.translation: 朋友：这周末终于能歇了吧 你：是啊 加班一周 弦绷太久了 朋友：好好放松一下 你：对 让自己缓一缓
ease off.example: Friend: You can finally rest this weekend. You: Yeah, a week of overtime; too tense. Friend: Just ease off and relax. You: Right; let myself ease off.

easier said than done.context: 你朋友说要减肥，喊了半年一斤没瘦，你调侃他光说不练。
easier said than done.translation: 朋友：我下个月一定开始减肥 你：你这话都说了半年了 朋友：这次是真的 你：每次都这么说 做起来可没那么容易
easier said than done.example: Friend: I'll really start dieting next month. You: You've said that for half a year. Friend: This time I mean it. You: It's always easier said than done.

easier to swallow.context: 你跟老板提加薪，把话说得委婉点，对方更容易听得进去。
easier to swallow.translation: 朋友：怎么跟老板提加薪比较好 你：话说得客气点 他更容易接受 朋友：直说不行吗 你：太直接容易尴尬 委婉点更好接受
easier to swallow.example: Friend: How do I ask the boss for a raise? You: Put it politely; it's easier to swallow. Friend: Can't I just ask straight? You: Too blunt gets awkward; softer is easier to swallow.

eat away at.context: 你撒了个谎后一直良心不安，那件事天天在心里折磨你。
eat away at.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么心神不宁的 你：我上次撒了个谎 一直过意不去 朋友：那去说清楚不就行了 你：这事天天在心里折磨我
eat away at.example: Friend: Why so on edge lately? You: I told a lie last time and feel guilty. Friend: Then just come clean. You: It keeps eating away at me.

eat into.context: 你每个月还房贷加上吃饭，工资刚到手就被花掉一大半。
eat into.translation: 朋友：你一个月能攒下多少钱 你：还完房贷和吃饭 剩不下多少 朋友：这开销也太大了 你：对 房租天天在吞我的工资
eat into.example: Friend: How much can you save a month? You: After mortgage and food, little's left. Friend: That's a big drain. You: Yeah; rent eats into my salary fast.

eat out.context: 你最近加班懒得做饭，顿顿都在外面吃，钱包快扛不住了。
eat out.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老点外卖 你：加班太累 不想做饭 朋友：天天在外面吃多贵啊 你：是啊 老下馆子可吃不消
eat out.example: Friend: Why the takeout every day? You: Too tired from overtime to cook. Friend: Eating out daily is pricey. You: Yeah; eating out all the time hurts the wallet.

eating habits.context: 你最近肠胃不好，医生让你反思一下自己平时吃饭的毛病。
eating habits.translation: 朋友：你胃怎么又不舒服了 你：可能是我吃饭太快 还老点辣的 朋友：这习惯确实不好 你：对 得改改我的饮食习惯
eating habits.example: Friend: Why is your stomach upset again? You: Maybe I eat too fast and always order spicy. Friend: Those habits are bad. You: Yeah; I need to fix my eating habits.

ecological recession.context: 你们看纪录片讲过度开采后土地变成荒漠，生态一年不如一年。
ecological recession.translation: 朋友：这片地方以前不是森林吗 你：被过度开采 现在都荒了 朋友：怎么变成这样的 你：生态一年年在恶化
ecological recession.example: Friend: Wasn't this area once a forest? You: Over-mining turned it barren. Friend: How did it come to this? You: There's been an ecological recession here.

ecological roulette.context: 科学家警告人类瞎折腾环境就像在赌运气，不知道哪天会出事。
ecological roulette.translation: 朋友：科学家为什么说现在很危险 你：我们对环境乱来 跟赌运气一样 朋友：这是什么意思呢 你：就是拿地球当轮盘赌 指不定哪天出事
ecological roulette.example: Friend: Why do scientists say we're at risk? You: We gamble with the environment. Friend: What does that mean? You: It's ecological roulette; we never know when disaster hits.

economic disparity.context: 你们聊到有的地方特别富、有的地方还很落后，差距特别明显。
economic disparity.translation: 朋友：为什么有的地方那么富 有的还那么穷 你：地区之间经济差距很大 朋友：那能缩小吗 你：得靠发展慢慢缩小差距
economic disparity.example: Friend: Why are some areas rich and others poor? You: There's a big economic disparity. Friend: Can it be narrowed? You: Development slowly narrows the economic disparity.

economic impact.context: 疫情那几年好多小店关门，你和朋友聊这件事带来的后果。
economic impact.translation: 朋友：那几年你那家小店后来怎么样了 你：撑不住 关门了 朋友：这对你们家影响大吗 你：特别大 那段日子损失不小
economic impact.example: Friend: What happened to your shop back then? You: Couldn't hold on; it closed. Friend: Did it hit your family hard? You: Yeah; the economic impact was huge.

economic loss.context: 那场台风把朋友家的窗户都吹破了，修了不少钱。
economic loss.translation: 朋友：上次台风你家损失大吗 你：窗户被吹破 修了好几千 朋友：这钱花得冤 你：对 白白损失了一笔
economic loss.example: Friend: Were you hit hard by that typhoon? You: Window broke; cost thousands to fix. Friend: That's such a waste. You: Yeah; it was a real economic loss.

economic powerhouse.context: 你们聊到沿海那几个城市工厂多发展快，是全国的经济支柱。
economic powerhouse.translation: 朋友：哪几个城市最发达啊 你：沿海那几个 工厂多 发展快 朋友：它们在全国算什么地位 你：是国家的经济重镇
economic powerhouse.example: Friend: Which cities are most developed? You: The coastal ones; lots of factories. Friend: What's their role nationally? You: They're the country's economic powerhouse.

economic situation.context: 你朋友找工作找了好久，说现在大环境不好，工作特别难找。
economic situation.translation: 朋友：你最近工作找得怎么样了 你：不好找 现在大环境不行 朋友：公司都不招人了吗 你：对 形势不太好 慢慢来吧
economic situation.example: Friend: How's your job hunt going? You: Tough; the economy's not great now. Friend: Are companies not hiring? You: Yeah; the economic situation's poor; just take it slow.

economy of scale.context: 厂家买原材料买得多就便宜，朋友解释为什么大公司成本更低。
economy of scale.translation: 朋友：为什么大公司的东西更便宜 你：因为它买得多 成本就低 朋友：这是什么道理呢 你：就是做得越大越省 规模效应
economy of scale.example: Friend: Why are big companies' products cheaper? You: They buy in bulk, so cost is low. Friend: How does that work? You: The bigger you get, the cheaper; economy of scale.

edible comforter.context: 你心情不好的时候就爱点甜品，朋友说甜食就是你的安慰剂。
edible comforter.translation: 朋友：你一难过就狂吃甜的 你：是啊 吃点甜的心情就好 朋友：蛋糕奶茶就是你的安慰吧 你：对 美食就是我的慰藉
edible comforter.example: Friend: You binge sweets whenever you're down. You: Yeah, something sweet cheers me up. Friend: Cakes and milk tea are your comfort food. You: Right; food's my edible comforter.

educational establishment.context: 你给孩子报课外班，朋友问你报的是学校还是外面的培训机构。
educational establishment.translation: 朋友：你家孩子报的那个班 是学校开的吗 你：是外面的一家培训机构 朋友：正规吗 你：正规 是一家老牌教育机构
educational establishment.example: Friend: Is that class your kid attends run by school? You: It's an outside training center. Friend: Is it legit? You: Yeah; it's a well-established educational establishment.

educational read.context: 你睡前不爱看小说，喜欢看点能长知识的书，朋友问你看什么。
educational read.translation: 朋友：你睡前都看什么书啊 你：不看小说 看点能长知识的 朋友：这种书看着不困吗 你：困 但能学到东西 很值
educational read.example: Friend: What do you read before bed? You: Not novels; something educational. Friend: Isn't that dull? You: It is, but an educational read teaches you a lot.

either good or bad.context: 朋友刚换新工作，你说新工作可能很好也可能很糟，得看实际。
either good or bad.translation: 朋友：我下周就换新工作了 好紧张 你：新工作嘛 可能好也可能坏 朋友：你觉得会顺利吗 你：不好说 好坏都有可能
either good or bad.example: Friend: I start the new job next week; so nervous. You: A new job could be good or bad. Friend: Do you think it'll go well? You: Hard to say; it's either good or bad.

elderly care.context: 你们聊到以后养老院会越来越多，因为老人多了需要专门照顾。
elderly care.translation: 朋友：最近怎么到处都在建养老院 你：老人越来越多 得有人照顾 朋友：以后谁来照顾老人呢 你：需要专业的养老服务
elderly care.example: Friend: Why are nursing homes everywhere lately? You: More seniors need care. Friend: Who'll care for them later? You: Professional elderly care is needed.

electric light.context: 你小时候停电点蜡烛，朋友问那时候没有电灯是怎么照明的。
electric light.translation: 朋友：小时候停电是怎么过来的 你：点蜡烛 黑黑的 朋友：那没有电灯真不方便 你：对 还是电灯方便
electric light.example: Friend: How did you manage blackouts as a kid? You: Lit candles; it was dark. Friend: Life's hard without electric light. You: Yeah; electric light is so convenient.

electric scooter.context: 你在地铁站看到很多人骑那种小滑板车代步，觉得特别方便。
electric scooter.translation: 朋友：路边那些小滑板车是什么 你：电动滑板车 短途代步用的 朋友：骑着安全吗 你：慢点骑还行 现在挺常见的
electric scooter.example: Friend: What are those little scooters on the sidewalk? You: Electric scooters for short trips. Friend: Are they safe? You: At a slow speed, okay; electric scooters are common now.

electric vehicle.context: 你朋友买了辆新能源汽车，你问他跟以前的油车有什么不一样。
electric vehicle.translation: 朋友：你新买那辆是电车吧 你：对 充电的那种 朋友：跟油车比哪个划算 你：电车开着省钱 就是充电麻烦点
electric vehicle.example: Friend: Your new car is electric, right? You: Yeah, it charges up. Friend: Better than gas cars? You: EVs cost less to run, though charging's a hassle.

electric vehicle (ev.context: 你刷新闻发现马路上绿牌车越来越多，新能源车已经普及了。
electric vehicle (ev.translation: 朋友：路上绿牌子的车是不是越来越多 你：对啊 都是新能源电动车 朋友：为什么大家都换电车 你：政策支持 还省油钱
electric vehicle (ev.example: Friend: Aren't there more green-plated cars on the road? You: Yeah, all electric vehicles. Friend: Why switch to EVs? You: Government support and savings on fuel.

electrical appliance.context: 你搬家清点东西，数了数家里大大小小的电器一共有多少件。
electrical appliance.translation: 朋友：你家买了多少件电器啊 你：冰箱、洗衣机、空调 一堆 朋友：哪个最贵啊 你：空调最贵 这些家电都不便宜
electrical appliance.example: Friend: How many appliances do you own? You: Fridge, washer, AC, a bunch. Friend: Which cost the most? You: The AC; electrical appliances aren't cheap.

electrical stimulation.context: 你腰肌劳损做康复，医生用贴在身上的小仪器帮你恢复。
electrical stimulation.translation: 朋友：你腰不好去医院怎么治 你：医生贴了个小仪器在我腰上 朋友：那是什么治疗啊 你：说是电刺激 帮助肌肉恢复
electrical stimulation.example: Friend: How does the hospital treat your back? You: The doctor puts a small device on my waist. Friend: What treatment is that? You: It's electrical stimulation to help the muscle recover.

electrical wire.context: 你看到墙上一根裸露的线，赶紧告诉物业说这里不安全。
electrical wire.translation: 朋友：墙上那根露出来的是什么 你：是一根电线 没包好 朋友：那多危险啊 你：对 赶紧叫物业来处理
electrical wire.example: Friend: What's that exposed thing on the wall? You: It's an electrical wire, poorly covered. Friend: That's dangerous. You: Yeah; call the property team about the electrical wire.

electronic devices.context: 飞机起飞前空姐提醒大家把手机电脑都调到飞行模式。
electronic devices.translation: 朋友：空姐刚才说什么来着 你：让我们把电子设备调飞行模式 朋友：平板也算吗 你：对 所有电子设备都要关Wi-Fi
electronic devices.example: Friend: What did the flight attendant say? You: Switch electronic devices to airplane mode. Friend: Does the tablet count? You: Yeah; all electronic devices must turn off Wi-Fi.

electronic document.context: 你找工作全靠把简历存在电脑里，随时发邮件给招聘公司。
electronic document.translation: 朋友：你找工作简历怎么投啊 你：存在电脑里 直接发邮件 朋友：还得打印出来吗 你：不用 电子文档就行
electronic document.example: Friend: How do you send your resume? You: Keep it on the computer and email it. Friend: Do you need to print it? You: No; an electronic document works.

electronic equipment.context: 你坐飞机过安检，工作人员提醒包里的电子设备要单独拿出来过机。
electronic equipment.translation: 朋友：安检让我们把什么东西拿出来 你：包里的电子设备都要单独过 朋友：耳机充电宝也算吗 你：对 这些都得单独拿出来
electronic equipment.example: Friend: What did security ask us to take out? You: All the electronic equipment in the bag goes separately. Friend: Earphones and power bank too? You: Yeah; these electronic devices go through alone.

electronic gadgets.context: 你抽屉里塞满了各种小数码产品，耳机、手环、充电器，朋友来你家翻出来看。
electronic gadgets.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里怎么这么多小电器 你：都是些耳机、手环之类的 朋友：你买这么多干嘛 你：喜欢嘛 这些小玩意儿特别有意思
electronic gadgets.example: Friend: Why so many gadgets in your drawer? You: Earphones, bands, things like that. Friend: Why buy so many? You: I love them; these little electronic gadgets are fun.

elephant herd.context: 你们在非洲草原看野生动物纪录片，看到一大群大象排队走过。
elephant herd.translation: 朋友：你看 那边一大群大象走过来了 你：那是象群 有老有小一起走 朋友：它们是一家子吗 你：对 象群一般都是一个大家族
elephant herd.example: Friend: Look, a big group of elephants is coming. You: That's an elephant herd, adults and young. Friend: Are they a family? You: Yeah; an elephant herd is usually one big family.

elevator pitch.context: 你创业想找投资，在电梯里偶遇投资人，得用三十秒把项目讲清楚。
elevator pitch.translation: 朋友：你昨天在电梯碰到那个投资人了吗 你：碰到了 我三十秒就把项目讲完了 朋友：他感兴趣吗 你：应该吧 这种简短介绍特别关键
elevator pitch.example: Friend: Did you meet that investor in the elevator yesterday? You: Yeah, I pitched my project in thirty seconds. Friend: Was he interested? You: Maybe; an elevator pitch like that matters.

eleventh hour.context: 项目明天就要交了，团队熬夜赶工，在最后一刻才把方案交上去。
eleventh hour.translation: 朋友：方案终于交上去了 吓死我了 你：我们可是踩着点交的 朋友：再晚一点就来不及了 你：对 真是最后关头才赶完
