eleventh hour.example: Friend: We finally turned in the proposal; so scary. You: We handed it in at the last minute. Friend: Any later and we'd miss it. You: Yeah; we finished at the eleventh hour.

embark on.context: 你毕业工作几年攒了点钱，终于下定决心去国外读研究生，重新出发。
embark on.translation: 朋友：你真要辞职去读书啊 你：对啊 想再挑战一下自己 朋友：什么时候走 你：下个月 正式开启新的一段学习
embark on.example: Friend: You're really quitting to study? You: Yeah, I want to challenge myself again. Friend: When do you leave? You: Next month; I'm embarking on a new study journey.

embrace one's body.context: 你总嫌自己不够瘦，朋友劝你别苛责自己，要学会接受现在的身材。
embrace one's body.translation: 朋友：你怎么又说自己胖 想减肥 你：总觉得不够好看 朋友：别这样 你要学会接纳自己的身体 你：也是 健康开心最重要
embrace one's body.example: Friend: Why call yourself fat again and want to diet? You: I never think I look good. Friend: Stop; you should embrace your body. You: Right; health and happiness matter most.

emerge from.context: 大雾天早上，太阳从云层后面慢慢露出来，你和朋友在公园看日出。
emerge from.translation: 朋友：雾这么大 今天还能看到日出吗 你：等等看 太阳马上要出来了 朋友：出来了 从云后面露出来了 你：对 太阳慢慢从雾里钻出来
emerge from.example: Friend: With this fog, will we even see sunrise? You: Wait; the sun's about to appear. Friend: There it is, emerging from the clouds. You: Yeah; the sun emerges from the fog.

emerged as.context: 你朋友本来只是个普通员工，几年时间慢慢成了公司最离不开的人。
emerged as.translation: 朋友：他这几年怎么升得这么快 你：一步一步干上来的 朋友：现在他在公司算什么角色 你：已经成了最核心的人
emerged as.example: Friend: How'd he rise so fast these years? You: Step by step. Friend: What's his role now? You: He has emerged as the key person in the company.

emergency fund.context: 理财博主建议你每个月强制存一笔钱，留着应急用，别全花光。
emergency fund.translation: 朋友：你怎么每个月都要存一笔钱 你：留着应急用 万一突然要用钱 朋友：这就是应急储备金吧 你：对 手里有钱心里不慌
emergency fund.example: Friend: Why do you save a sum every month? You: For emergencies, in case money's suddenly needed. Friend: That's an emergency fund. You: Yeah; cash on hand eases the mind.

emerging technologies.context: 展会上满眼都是人工智能、机器人这些新鲜玩意儿，跟以前完全不一样。
emerging technologies.translation: 朋友：这展会怎么全是机器人啊 你：都是最近冒出来的新技术 朋友：发展也太快了吧 你：对 各种新兴技术一年一个样
emerging technologies.example: Friend: Why are there robots all over the show? You: These are newly emerged technologies. Friend: It's advancing so fast. You: Yeah; emerging technologies change every year.

emerging technology.context: 你在课上听老师讲人工智能这种刚冒头的技术，以后可能改变生活。
emerging technology.translation: 朋友：老师上课都讲些什么新东西 你：在讲人工智能这种新技术 朋友：它以后会火吗 你：肯定 新兴技术潜力特别大
emerging technology.example: Friend: What new things does the teacher cover? You: Cutting-edge tech like AI. Friend: Will it take off? You: Definitely; an emerging technology has huge potential.

emerging trend.context: 你发现这两年身边露营的人越来越多，是一种新流行起来的趋势。
emerging trend.translation: 朋友：最近怎么人人都去露营 你：对啊 朋友圈全是帐篷 朋友：这是一种新潮流吧 你：对 露营成了新的休闲趋势
emerging trend.example: Friend: Why is everyone camping lately? You: Yeah, my feed is all tents. Friend: That's a new trend. You: Yeah; camping is an emerging trend now.

emerita professor.context: 那位头发花白的老师早就退休了，学校还专门请她回来做讲座。
emerita professor.translation: 朋友：那位老太太是我们学校以前的老师吧 你：对 她退休好多年了 朋友：怎么又请她回来讲课 你：她是荣誉退休教授 大家都敬重她
emerita professor.example: Friend: Is that lady a former teacher at our school? You: Yeah, retired years ago. Friend: Why invite her back to lecture? You: She's an emerita professor everyone respects.

emotion regulation.context: 你情绪一上来就控制不住，朋友建议你学学怎么调节自己的心情。
emotion regulation.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么突然就发火了 你：我也不想 但一下没忍住 朋友：你得学着调节情绪 你：好 以后慢慢来
emotion regulation.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly lose your temper? You: I didn't mean to, but I snapped. Friend: You need emotion regulation. You: Okay; I'll work on it slowly.

emotion-understanding ability.context: 你朋友特别会察言观色，你一不开心他马上就能看出来。
emotion-understanding ability.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道我今天心情不好 你：看你说话语气就知道了 朋友：你也太会读心了 你：没啦 就是比较会体察别人情绪
emotion-understanding ability.example: Friend: How do you know I'm in a bad mood? You: I hear it in your tone. Friend: You can really read people. You: Not really; just good emotion-understanding ability.

emotional barrier.context: 你失恋后总觉得跟谁都聊不深，朋友说你心里像隔了一堵墙。
emotional barrier.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老一个人待着 你：不太想跟人说话 朋友：是不是心里关上了一扇门 你：可能吧 心里有道坎过不去
emotional barrier.example: Friend: Why do you keep to yourself lately? You: I don't feel like talking to people. Friend: Have you put up an emotional barrier? You: Maybe; there's a wall I can't cross.

emotional control.context: 你在服务窗口上班，遇到再难缠的客户也得保持微笑，不能发火。
emotional control.translation: 朋友：你今天遇到那个客户够难缠的吧 你：是啊 还不能跟他吵 朋友：真够练脾气的 你：对 干这行必须会控制情绪
emotional control.example: Friend: That client was really tough today, right? You: Yeah, but I couldn't argue back. Friend: It really tests your temper. You: Yeah; this job demands emotional control.

emotional cue.context: 你看电影时，主角一个眼神你就知道他接下来要干嘛，朋友说你读得准。
emotional cue.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道他要做什么 你：看他那个眼神就猜到了 朋友：这也太准了吧 你：导演就靠这些小动作暗示剧情
emotional cue.example: Friend: How did you know what he'd do? You: I read it from his look. Friend: That's so accurate. You: The director gives emotional cues through small gestures.

emotional damage.context: 你小时候被当众骂过，长大以后特别不自信，朋友说那是留下的阴影。
emotional damage.translation: 朋友：你为什么这么怕在人前说话 你：小时候被当众凶过 一直有阴影 朋友：那真的伤你很深吧 你：对 那种伤害到现在还有
emotional damage.example: Friend: Why are you so scared of speaking in public? You: I was scolded in public as a kid; it left a mark. Friend: That hurt you deeply. You: Yeah; that emotional damage lingers.

emotional exhaustion.context: 你连轴转了好几个月，不光身体累，心里也觉得特别空、提不起劲。
emotional exhaustion.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么连笑都懒得笑了 你：太忙了 心里累得很 朋友：那就是情绪透支了 你：对 感觉心都被掏空了
emotional exhaustion.example: Friend: Why don't you even smile lately? You: Too busy; emotionally drained. Friend: That's emotional exhaustion. You: Yeah; I feel emptied out.

emotional healing.context: 你失恋后花了大半年才慢慢走出来，朋友陪你一点点恢复。
emotional healing.translation: 朋友：你现在状态好多了啊 你：是啊 花了好一阵子才缓过来 朋友：是怎么慢慢好起来的 你：时间和朋友陪伴 治愈了我
emotional healing.example: Friend: You look so much better now. You: Yeah, it took a long while to recover. Friend: How did you heal? You: Time and friends brought emotional healing.

emotional intelligence.context: 你同事特别会来事，跟谁都能聊两句，朋友说这就是情商高。
emotional intelligence.translation: 朋友：你同事跟谁都聊得来 真厉害 你：对啊 他特别会察言观色 朋友：这就是情商高吧 你：对 上班情商高特别吃香
emotional intelligence.example: Friend: Your coworker gets along with everyone; impressive. You: Yeah, he reads people well. Friend: That's high emotional intelligence. You: Yeah; EQ really helps at work.

emotional intelligence (eq.context: 招聘时除了看成绩，公司也看一个人会不会跟人打交道、处理情绪。
emotional intelligence (eq.translation: 朋友：现在招人都看什么呢 你：不光看成绩 还看会不会待人接物 朋友：这就是说的情商吧 你：对 情商在工作里很重要
emotional intelligence (eq.example: Friend: What do companies look for when hiring? You: Not just grades; how you handle people. Friend: That's EQ. You: Yeah; emotional intelligence matters at work.

emotional investment.context: 你养了五年的猫走了，你难过了好久，朋友说你对它投入太多感情。
emotional investment.translation: 朋友：你为那只猫难过这么久啊 你：毕竟养了五年 感情特别深 朋友：你真是把感情都投进去了 你：对 养久了就像家人一样
emotional investment.example: Friend: You've grieved that cat so long. You: Five years; I was really attached. Friend: You put so much into it. You: Yeah; that emotional investment felt like family.

emotional outburst.context: 你压力大到忍不住在办公室哭了出来，同事都愣住了。
emotional outburst.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么突然就哭了 你：压力一下子全涌上来 没忍住 朋友：没事吧 先冷静一下 你：刚才真是情绪一下子没绷住
emotional outburst.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly cry today? You: All the pressure welled up; I couldn't hold it. Friend: Are you okay? Calm down. You: I just had an emotional outburst.

emotional outlet.context: 你压力大的时候就去跑步、写日记，把心里的不舒服发泄出来。
emotional outlet.translation: 朋友：你压力大的时候都怎么办 你：去跑几圈 或者写写日记 朋友：这样有用吗 你：有用 得有个发泄情绪的出口
emotional outlet.example: Friend: What do you do when stressed? You: Go running or write in a journal. Friend: Does that help? You: Yeah; I need an emotional outlet.

emotional regulation.context: 你学了几招深呼吸的办法，生气的时候先停三秒，慢慢就平静了。
emotional regulation.translation: 朋友：你现在脾气怎么变好了 你：我学会了调节自己的情绪 朋友：怎么做到的 你：生气时先深呼吸几下
emotional regulation.example: Friend: Why have you become calmer? You: I learned emotional regulation. Friend: How? You: Take a few deep breaths when angry.

emotional release.context: 你受了委屈回家大哭一场，哭完整个人都轻松了，朋友说你释放出来就好。
emotional release.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么肿了 哭过了吗 你：受了委屈 回家哭了一顿 朋友：哭出来也好 憋在心里难受 你：对 哭完反而轻松了
emotional release.example: Friend: Why are your eyes puffy? Did you cry? You: I was wronged; cried it out at home. Friend: Letting it out is good. You: Yeah; the emotional release felt lighter.

emotional residue.context: 你下班回到家，工作上的烦心事还残留在脑子里，久久散不去。
emotional residue.translation: 朋友：你怎么到家了还皱着眉 你：白天那些事还在脑子里转 朋友：别把工作情绪带回家 你：对 残留的情绪老散不掉
emotional residue.example: Friend: Why are you still frowning at home? You: The day's stuff is still on my mind. Friend: Don't bring work mood home. You: Yeah; the emotional residue lingers.

emotional rollercoaster.context: 你面试那家公司，从紧张到惊喜再到失落，心情跟坐过山车一样。
emotional rollercoaster.translation: 朋友：今天面试怎么样啊 你：心情像坐过山车 一会紧张一会开心 朋友：最后结果呢 你：还在等通知 真是跌宕起伏
emotional rollercoaster.example: Friend: How was the interview? You: It was an emotional rollercoaster, up and down. Friend: What's the result? You: Still waiting; what an emotional rollercoaster.

emotional shift.context: 你刚才还阴着脸，听到好消息后一下子就笑了，情绪转变得特别快。
emotional shift.translation: 朋友：你刚才还不开心 怎么一下就笑了 你：刚收到个好消息 心情一下子就好了 朋友：你这情绪变得也太快了 你：好事一来立马就变了
emotional shift.example: Friend: You were down; why smiling now? You: Got good news; my mood just flipped. Friend: What an emotional shift. You: Good news makes the emotional shift instantly.

emotional slump.context: 期末考结束后你整个人松懈下来，连着好几天提不起劲，朋友来约你。
emotional slump.translation: 朋友：你这几天怎么都不出门 你：考完了 反而没什么劲 朋友：是不是考完后的低落期 你：对 就是考完那阵子的低谷
emotional slump.example: Friend: Why haven't you gone out lately? You: Exams are done; I feel flat. Friend: Is that the post-exam slump? You: Yeah; it's an emotional slump after exams.

emotional state.context: 你今天要去面试，出门前反复调整心情，让自己保持最好的状态。
emotional state.translation: 朋友：你今天面试 紧张吗 你：有点 我得先把心情调整好 朋友：现在状态怎么样 你：调整好了 可以上了
emotional state.example: Friend: Nervous about today's interview? You: A little; I need to set my mood. Friend: How do you feel now? You: My emotional state is set; I'm ready.

emotional strength.context: 你一个人扛过了那段最难的日子，朋友说你比想象中坚强多了。
emotional strength.translation: 朋友：那段日子你一个人怎么过来的 你：咬咬牙就挺过来了 朋友：你真比别人坚强 你：也是被逼出来的 慢慢就有韧性了
emotional strength.example: Friend: How did you get through that tough time alone? You: Bit my lip and hung on. Friend: You're stronger than you think. You: Forced to be; I built up emotional strength.

emotional stress.context: 你最近又要加班又要照顾家里，两头压力大，整个人都绷紧了。
emotional stress.translation: 朋友：你最近脸色好差 怎么了 你：工作家里两头忙 压力特别大 朋友：别硬撑 该歇歇 你：心里压得慌 压力真不小
emotional stress.example: Friend: You look worn; what's wrong? You: Work and family both piling up; real pressure. Friend: Don't push yourself. You: I'm tense; this emotional stress is heavy.

emotional support.context: 你最难受的时候，朋友什么都没说就陪着你，给了你很大安慰。
emotional support.translation: 朋友：你那阵子是怎么走出来的 你：全靠朋友一直陪着我 朋友：有人陪着确实好 你：对 朋友的陪伴比什么都管用
emotional support.example: Friend: How did you pull through that time? You: Friends stayed by me the whole way. Friend: Company helps a lot. You: Yeah; emotional support from friends means everything.

emotional surge.context: 你收到录取通知那一刻，心跳突然加速，激动得说不出话。
emotional surge.translation: 朋友：收到通知那一刻你什么反应 你：心跳一下就快了 特别激动 朋友：是不是都快哭了 你：对 那阵激动的情绪一下涌上来
emotional surge.example: Friend: How did you react to the offer? You: My heart raced; I was so moved. Friend: Almost cried? You: Yeah; a big emotional surge hit me.

emotional turmoil.context: 你最近又是考试又是找工作，心里乱成一团，朋友看你坐立不安。
emotional turmoil.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么坐立不安的 你：考试找工作挤一块儿 心里乱得很 朋友：别太着急 一件一件来 你：我这心里乱成一锅粥了
emotional turmoil.example: Friend: Why are you so restless lately? You: Exams and job hunting at once; my mind's in chaos. Friend: Take it one thing at a time. You: I'm in real emotional turmoil.

emotional wellbeing.context: 医生说除了身体健康，心情愉快同样重要，你开始学着放松自己。
emotional wellbeing.translation: 朋友：医生都跟你说什么了 你：不光身体 心情也要好 朋友：那你最近开心吗 你：还行 挺注意调节心情的
emotional wellbeing.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you? You: Not just body; your mood matters too. Friend: Are you happier now? You: Pretty much; I care about my emotional wellbeing.

emotions run high.context: 球赛打到最后一秒两队还平着，看台上观众都激动得站起来喊。
emotions run high.translation: 朋友：最后这球太紧张了 你：全场都站起来喊了 朋友：你看那观众多激动 你：对 关键时候大家情绪都上来了
emotions run high.example: Friend: That last play is so tense. You: The whole crowd's on its feet. Friend: Look how fired up they are. You: Yeah; emotions run high at the end.

empathetic concern.context: 朋友考试没考好难过，你没笑话他，而是认真听他说、安慰他。
empathetic concern.translation: 朋友：这次没考好 我真的很难过 你：没事 尽力了就好 朋友：你不笑话我吗 你：当然不 我特别理解你的心情
empathetic concern.example: Friend: I failed and feel so bad. You: It's okay; you did your best. Friend: You're not laughing at me? You: Of course not; I feel empathetic concern for you.

empathise with.context: 你也有过考研失利的经历，朋友跟你吐槽时你特别能感同身受。
empathise with.translation: 朋友：考研没上岸 我这阵子特别难受 你：我也经历过 特别能理解你 朋友：那你当时怎么走出来的 你：慢慢来 我完全能体会你
empathise with.example: Friend: I didn't pass the grad exam; I've been so low. You: I've been there; I really empathise with you. Friend: How did you recover? You: Take it slow; I empathise with how you feel.

employability skills.context: 你快毕业了，学校开讲座教大家写简历、面试这些找工作的本事。
employability skills.translation: 朋友：学校最近老开讲座 讲什么啊 你：教我们写简历、面试这些找工作本事 朋友：这些在学校能学到吗 你：对 就是帮我们提升就业技能
employability skills.example: Friend: Why does school keep holding talks? You: Teaching resumes and interviews, job skills. Friend: Can you learn these at school? You: Yeah; it builds employability skills.

employee benefit.context: 你找工作除了看工资，还问清楚公司有没有年假、五险一金这些福利。
employee benefit.translation: 朋友：你面试都问公司什么问题啊 你：除了工资 我还问有没有年假 朋友：这些就是员工福利吧 你：对 福利好的公司更留人
employee benefit.example: Friend: What do you ask employers in interviews? You: Besides salary, I ask about annual leave. Friend: Those are employee benefits. You: Yeah; good employee benefits keep people.

employee demand.context: 公司最近加班多，大家联合起来向老板反映，想争取早点下班。
employee demand.translation: 朋友：最近大家都在群里抱怨加班 你：是啊 都想早点回家 朋友：公司听到了吗 你：大家把诉求提上去 看领导怎么回应
employee demand.example: Friend: Everyone's complaining about overtime in the group. You: Yeah, we want to leave early. Friend: Does the boss hear? You: We raise our demands; let's see how he responds.

employee wellbeing.context: 公司新修了健身房和休息区，让大家上班别太累、有空放松一下。
employee wellbeing.translation: 朋友：公司怎么新盖了个健身房 你：让大家有空去锻炼放松 朋友：这是为员工考虑吧 你：对 公司开始重视员工身心健康了
employee wellbeing.example: Friend: Why did the company build a gym? You: For us to work out and relax. Friend: That's caring about staff. You: Yeah; they now value employee wellbeing.

employment contract.context: 你入职第一天，人事让你签一份合同，上面写清工资和试用期。
employment contract.translation: 朋友：入职第一天要办什么手续 你：先签一份劳动合同 朋友：上面都写些什么 你：工资、试用期这些都白纸黑字写清楚
employment contract.example: Friend: What's the first day paperwork? You: First sign the employment contract. Friend: What's on it? You: Salary and trial period, all written in the employment contract.

employment rate.context: 新闻说这几年大学生找工作变难了，你和朋友聊起现在的就业形势。
employment rate.translation: 朋友：现在大学生好找工作吗 你：不容易 找工作的人特别多 朋友：听说就业率在下降 你：对 大环境是这样
employment rate.example: Friend: Is it easy for grads to find jobs now? You: Not easy; so many job hunters. Friend: I hear the employment rate is falling. You: Yeah; that's the environment.

empty calories.context: 你爱喝可乐吃薯片，朋友说这些东西热量高但没什么营养。
empty calories.translation: 朋友：你怎么老点可乐喝 你：就是爱这口甜的 朋友：这些甜饮料热量高又没营养 你：对 全是空热量 该少喝点
empty calories.example: Friend: Why do you always order cola? You: I just love the sweet taste. Friend: Sugary drinks are high-cal, low-nutrition. You: Yeah; they're empty calories; I should cut back.

empty space.context: 你设计海报时画面别堆太满，留些空地方看着反而更舒服。
empty space.translation: 朋友：你这海报元素是不是太多了 你：有点挤 看着不舒服 朋友：少放点 留点空白 你：对 留白反而更好看
empty space.example: Friend: Isn't this poster too cluttered? You: A bit crowded; uncomfortable. Friend: Add some empty space. You: Right; empty space makes it look better.

empty storefront.context: 你以前常逛的那条街，最近好多店都关门了，卷帘门拉着。
empty storefront.translation: 朋友：以前那条街怎么好多店都关了 你：是啊 好多门面都空着 朋友：以前不是挺热闹的吗 你：现在萧条了 都是空门面
empty storefront.example: Friend: Why are so many shops closed on that street? You: Yeah, lots of storefronts stand empty. Friend: It used to be busy. You: Now it's declined; all empty storefronts.

en route.context: 你们开车去郊外玩，半路上朋友说肚子饿了想找地方吃饭。
en route.translation: 朋友：我们现在开到哪儿了 你：还在路上呢 大概一半路程 朋友：我饿了 找个地方吃饭吧 你：好 路上找家馆子
en route.example: Friend: Where are we on the drive? You: Still en route, about halfway. Friend: I'm hungry; let's eat. You: Okay; grab a place en route.

end result.context: 你们折腾了半天做蛋糕，最后出来的样子歪歪扭扭但味道不错。
end result.translation: 朋友：你这蛋糕做得也太歪了 你：过程手忙脚乱的 朋友：那最后做成什么样了 你：虽然丑 但味道还可以
end result.example: Friend: Your cake came out so lopsided. You: The process was chaos. Friend: What was the end result? You: Ugly, but the end result tasted fine.

end with.context: 你们聚餐最后点了一份水果拼盘收尾，大家吃得很满足。
end with.translation: 朋友：这顿饭吃得真饱 你：最后再来份水果吧 朋友：以甜点收尾最舒服了 你：对 这顿饭完美收尾
end with.example: Friend: That meal was so filling. You: Let's end with a fruit platter. Friend: Ending with dessert is the best. You: Yeah; we'll end with something sweet.

ends up.context: 你本来只想逛半小时街，结果一不小心逛了三小时还拎着大包。
ends up.translation: 朋友：你不是说就逛半小时吗 你：忍不住 看到喜欢的就买 朋友：最后花了多少钱 你：逛了三小时 拎了一堆东西回家
ends up.example: Friend: Weren't you only shopping half an hour? You: Couldn't stop buying. Friend: How'd it end up? You: I ended up shopping three hours with bags.

energy bill.context: 夏天天天开空调，这个月电费账单一出来吓你一跳。
energy bill.translation: 朋友：这个月电费怎么这么高 你：天天开空调 能不高吗 朋友：账单出来多少 你：好几百 看着心疼
energy bill.example: Friend: Why's the electric bill so high? You: AC every day; of course it's high. Friend: How much was the energy bill? You: Hundreds; it hurts.

energy efficiency.context: 你换了台新空调说比旧的省电，朋友问你怎么知道它更节能。
energy efficiency.translation: 朋友：你新空调很省电吗 你：对 比旧的那台省好多电 朋友：怎么做到的 你：设计上更节能 利用率高
energy efficiency.example: Friend: Is your new AC really efficient? You: Yeah, saves a lot more than the old one. Friend: How? You: It's designed for energy efficiency.

energy expenditure.context: 你在减肥，朋友告诉你运动消耗的卡路里其实没你想的那么多。
energy expenditure.translation: 朋友：我跑半小时能消耗多少 你：其实没你想象的多 朋友：那不是白跑了 你：不会 多少都算能量消耗
energy expenditure.example: Friend: How many calories do I burn in half an hour? You: Less than you think. Friend: Then it's pointless? You: No; every bit counts as energy expenditure.

energy levels.context: 你下午三四点就犯困，朋友说这是人体精力自然下滑的时候。
energy levels.translation: 朋友：你下午怎么老犯困 你：一到三四点就没精神 朋友：大家这时候都累 你：对 这时候精力最低落
energy levels.example: Friend: Why do you get sleepy in the afternoon? You: Around three or four I lose steam. Friend: Everyone does then. You: Yeah; our energy levels dip then.

engage in different activities.context: 你周末不爱待在家，喜欢约朋友打球看展聚餐，安排得满满当当。
engage in different activities.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么安排那么满 你：爱打球 看展 还约饭 朋友：一天能忙得过来吗 你：就喜欢多参加各种活动
engage in different activities.example: Friend: Why's your weekend so packed? You: Ball, exhibitions, dinners. Friend: Can you fit it all? You: I love to engage in different activities.

engage with.context: 你上英语口语课不爱开口，老师鼓励你多跟同学互动、积极参与。
engage with.translation: 朋友：你上课怎么老不说话 你：怕说错 不好意思开口 朋友：别怕 多跟同学交流 你：好 以后积极参与课堂
engage with.example: Friend: Why don't you speak in class? You: Afraid of mistakes, shy. Friend: Don't be; engage with classmates more. You: Okay; I'll engage more in class.

engineering skills.context: 你朋友是工程师，拆装修理样样在行，家里东西坏了都找他。
engineering skills.translation: 朋友：我家这个桌子松了 你朋友会修吗 你：他是工程师 手特别巧 朋友：那让他来看看 你：对 这些修理活他最在行
engineering skills.example: Friend: My table's loose; can your friend fix it? You: He's an engineer, really handy. Friend: Ask him over. You: Yeah; his engineering skills cover repairs.

engrossed in.context: 你看一本小说太入迷，朋友喊你吃饭喊了三遍你都没听见。
engrossed in.translation: 朋友：吃饭了 喊你好几遍了 你：啊 我看书太入迷了 朋友：什么书这么好看 你：完全看进去了 根本没听见
engrossed in.example: Friend: Dinner; I called you several times. You: Oh? I was engrossed in the book. Friend: What's so good? You: I was engrossed in it; I didn't hear.

enjoy adrenaline rush.context: 朋友特别爱坐过山车，越刺激越兴奋，你不敢玩只能在旁边看着。
enjoy adrenaline rush.translation: 朋友：过山车你真不敢坐吗 你：不敢 我怕高 朋友：多刺激啊 坐完特别爽 你：你就喜欢这种心跳加速的感觉
enjoy adrenaline rush.example: Friend: You really won't ride the coaster? You: No; I'm scared of heights. Friend: It's thrilling, such a rush. You: You just enjoy the adrenaline rush.

enough said.context: 你跟朋友讲了个尴尬事，他一听就明白了，笑着说不用再解释。
enough said.translation: 朋友：昨天那件事我真是尴尬死了 你：懂的 不用说了 朋友：你都不问具体怎么回事 你：不用 一听就明白了
enough said.example: Friend: That thing yesterday was so awkward. You: I get it; enough said. Friend: Won't you ask details? You: No need; enough said.

enroll in.context: 新学期开始，你在网上给自己报了一个篮球班。
enroll in.translation: 朋友：这学期你又报什么班了 你：我报了个篮球课 想动动 朋友：什么时候开始上课 你：下周就开始 已经选好课了
enroll in.example: Friend: What class did you sign up for this term? You: I enrolled in a basketball course. Friend: When does it start? You: Next week; I've enrolled in it.

enter for.context: 公司要办羽毛球比赛，你同事报名参加还拉着你一起组队。
enter for.translation: 朋友：公司要办羽毛球赛 你报名吗 你：报啊 咱们组个队 朋友：你水平行不行啊 你：凑合 反正重在参与
enter for.example: Friend: Company's holding a badminton contest; in? You: Yeah, let's team up. Friend: Are you any good? You: Meh; just enter for the fun of it.

entered into.context: 你朋友毕业后跟人合伙开了家咖啡店，正式签了合作协议。
entered into.translation: 朋友：他最近在忙什么呢 你：跟人合伙开了家咖啡店 朋友：谈成了吗 你：成了 正式签了合作协议
entered into.example: Friend: What's he busy with lately? You: Partnering to open a cafe. Friend: Did it work out? You: Yeah; they entered into a partnership.

entrance product.context: 你预算有限，让店员推荐个便宜好用的入门款相机先练手。
entrance product.translation: 朋友：你预算多少买相机 你：就几千块 要个便宜好用的 朋友：那这台入门款正合适 你：好 先买台入门机练手
entrance product.example: Friend: What's your camera budget? You: Just a few thousand, cheap and usable. Friend: Then this entry-level model is perfect. You: Good; I'll start with an entrance product.

entry fee.context: 你们去公园玩，到门口才知道要收门票，朋友问多少钱。
entry fee.translation: 朋友：这公园进去要花钱吗 你：门口写着门票三十块 朋友：这么贵啊 你：还好 就当买门票了
entry fee.example: Friend: Is the park free to enter? You: The gate says a 30-yuan entry fee. Friend: That's pricey. You: It's fine; just the entry fee.

entry quota.context: 那个热门博物馆限流，每天只放一定人数进去，得提前预约。
entry quota.translation: 朋友：那个博物馆能直接进吗 你：不行 每天限人数 得提前约 朋友：一天放多少人进去 你：有入园配额 约满就没了
entry quota.example: Friend: Can we just walk into that museum? You: No, limited daily entry; book ahead. Friend: How many a day? You: There's an entry quota; once full, no entry.

environmental concern.context: 你们聊到现在年轻人点外卖都不要一次性餐具，开始注意环保。
environmental concern.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人点外卖都不要餐具了 你：对 大家越来越关注环境 朋友：这是好事啊 你：对 环保意识越来越强了
environmental concern.example: Friend: Young people skip disposable cutlery now. You: Yeah, people care more about the environment. Friend: That's good. You: Yeah; environmental concern is growing.

environmental cost.context: 你们聊到经济快速发展的同时，其实也付出了环境上的代价。
environmental cost.translation: 朋友：这几年发展是快了 你：但也付出了环境代价 朋友：怎么说 你：工厂多了 空气没以前好了
environmental cost.example: Friend: Development's been fast these years. You: But there's an environmental cost. Friend: How so? You: More factories; the air isn't what it was.

environmental damage.context: 新闻里说那片海域因为漏油，生态被破坏得很严重。
environmental damage.translation: 朋友：上次漏油后来怎么样了 你：那片海域生态被破坏了 朋友：动物们都怎么样了 你：伤害很大 环境恢复要好多年
environmental damage.example: Friend: What happened after that oil spill? You: The sea's ecosystem was damaged. Friend: What about the wildlife? You: Badly hurt; repairing the environmental damage takes years.

environmental footprint.context: 你开始算自己一天产生多少垃圾用多少电，看看对地球影响多大。
environmental footprint.translation: 朋友：你最近老算自己用多少水电 你：想看看自己对环境影响多大 朋友：这就是说的什么足迹吧 你：对 每个人都有环境足迹
environmental footprint.example: Friend: Why do you track your water and power use? You: To see my impact on the planet. Friend: That's your footprint. You: Yeah; everyone leaves an environmental footprint.

environmental hazard.context: 你家附近工地乱堆废料，朋友提醒你那可能会影响周边环境。
environmental hazard.translation: 朋友：工地那堆废料乱堆在那儿 你：是啊 看着就不卫生 朋友：会不会污染周边 你：有可能 这是个环境隐患
environmental hazard.example: Friend: That waste pile at the site is messy. You: Yeah, looks unhygienic. Friend: Could it pollute the area? You: Maybe; it's an environmental hazard.

environmental impact.context: 你们新小区要砍掉一片树，居民们都在担心对周围环境的影响。
environmental impact.translation: 朋友：小区要砍掉那片树你知道吗 你：知道 大家都在担心 朋友：砍树会有什么影响 你：对周围环境影响挺大的
environmental impact.example: Friend: Did you know they'll cut down that grove? You: Yeah, everyone's worried. Friend: What's the impact? You: The environmental impact on the area is big.

environmental limits.context: 老师讲地球能承受的人口和污染是有限的，不能无限度开发。
environmental limits.translation: 朋友：地球能一直这样开发下去吗 你：不行 环境是有承受上限的 朋友：超过了会怎么样 你：那就糟了 地球有它的极限
environmental limits.example: Friend: Can we keep developing forever? You: No; the environment has its limits. Friend: What if we exceed them? You: Then trouble; there are environmental limits.

environmental psychologist.context: 你们聊到有科学家专门研究为什么住在大自然里让人更开心。
environmental psychologist.translation: 朋友：为什么住在山里心情特别好 你：有专家专门研究这个 朋友：那是什么专家啊 你：研究环境怎么影响人的学者
environmental psychologist.example: Friend: Why does living in nature feel so good? You: Some experts study exactly that. Friend: What kind of experts? You: Environmental psychologists.

environmental risk.context: 新闻里说河边那个旧仓库漏化学品，是附近居民的健康隐患。
environmental risk.translation: 朋友：河边那个旧仓库还在用吗 你：听说漏了化学品 大家都在担心 朋友：那不是很危险吗 你：对 这是个环境隐患 得赶紧处理
environmental risk.example: Friend: Is that old riverside warehouse still used? You: It leaked chemicals; people are worried. Friend: Isn't that dangerous? You: Yeah; it's an environmental risk that must be fixed.

environmental trigger.context: 你一到春天就打喷嚏，医生说可能是花粉这种环境因素诱发的过敏。
environmental trigger.translation: 朋友：你怎么一到春天就打喷嚏 你：医生说是花粉引起的过敏 朋友：那出门戴个口罩吧 你：对 花粉就是我的环境诱因
environmental trigger.example: Friend: Why do you sneeze every spring? You: The doctor says it's a pollen allergy. Friend: Then wear a mask out. You: Yeah; pollen is my environmental trigger.

environmentally conscious.context: 你朋友买菜自带布袋子、吃饭不用一次性筷子，特别注意环保。
environmentally conscious.translation: 朋友：你怎么买菜还自己带袋子 你：少用塑料袋 保护环境嘛 朋友：你也太环保了 你：对 我是有环保意识的人
environmentally conscious.example: Friend: Why bring your own bag shopping? You: Less plastic, better for the planet. Friend: You're so green. You: Yeah; I'm environmentally conscious.

environmentally damaging.context: 专家说那种一次性发泡餐盒埋在地里几百年都烂不掉，特别毁环境。
environmentally damaging.translation: 朋友：那种白色餐盒能降解吗 你：烂不掉 埋土里几百年都还在 朋友：那不是特别污染吗 你：对 这种东西对环境有害
environmentally damaging.example: Friend: Does that white foam box decompose? You: No; it stays for centuries underground. Friend: Isn't that polluting? You: Yeah; it's environmentally damaging.

environmentally friendly.context: 你买东西专挑包装能回收、能耗低的产品，觉得这样对地球好。
environmentally friendly.translation: 朋友：你买东西怎么老看包装 你：我尽量买环保一点的 朋友：什么样的算环保呢 你：包装能回收的那种
environmentally friendly.example: Friend: Why do you always check the packaging? You: I try to buy eco-friendly ones. Friend: What counts as eco-friendly? You: Ones with recyclable packaging.

environmentally friendly materials.context: 你给家里挑家具，专选用竹子、再生木这种对环境友好的材料。
environmentally friendly materials.translation: 朋友：你新家柜子挑的什么材料 你：竹子和再生木材 比较环保 朋友：这种材料贵不贵 你：稍微贵点 但用的是环保材料
environmentally friendly materials.example: Friend: What material for your new cabinets? You: Bamboo and reclaimed wood; greener. Friend: Is that pricey? You: A bit, but they're environmentally friendly materials.

epidemic levels.context: 新闻说那种流感现在传播得特别快，已经达到了高发的程度。
epidemic levels.translation: 朋友：最近感冒的人是不是特别多 你：对啊 班里一大半都病倒了 朋友：这传播速度也太快了 你：对 疫情已经到了高发程度
epidemic levels.example: Friend: Aren't so many people getting a cold lately? You: Yeah, half the class is down. Friend: It spreads so fast. You: Yeah; it's reached epidemic levels.

epidemiological research.context: 教授做研究调查某种病在人群里的分布规律，收集了几千份数据。
epidemiological research.translation: 朋友：教授那个课题是研究什么的 你：在查某种病的发病规律 朋友：要收集多少数据 你：几千份 这是正规的调研
epidemiological research.example: Friend: What's the professor's project about? You: How a certain disease spreads in people. Friend: How much data? You: Thousands; it's proper epidemiological research.

epidemiological study.context: 你们读了一篇论文，讲科学家追踪了上万人二十年来看某种病的诱因。
epidemiological study.translation: 朋友：这篇论文研究方法靠谱吗 你：追踪了上万人二十年 很严谨 朋友：这是什么研究啊 你：是正规的医学研究
epidemiological study.example: Friend: Is that paper's method sound? You: Tracked tens of thousands for twenty years. Friend: What kind of study? You: It's a solid epidemiological study.

equal and fair access.context: 老师说不该因为家庭出身就把孩子分三六九等，人人都该有同等机会。
equal and fair access.translation: 朋友：为什么穷人家孩子难出头 你：资源和机会本来就不均 朋友：理想的社会不该这样吧 你：对 人人都该有公平的机会
equal and fair access.example: Friend: Why do poor kids struggle to get ahead? You: Resources and opportunities aren't equal. Friend: Society shouldn't be like that. You: Right; all deserve equal and fair access.

equal to.context: 老板把一个很重要的项目交给你，说他相信你完全能扛得住。
equal to.translation: 朋友：老板把那个大项目交给你了 你：对啊 说相信我能行 朋友：你有信心做好吗 你：应该没问题 我能胜任
equal to.example: Friend: The boss gave you that big project? You: Yeah, he trusts me to handle it. Friend: Confident you can? You: Should be; I'm equal to the task.

equality act.context: 老师在课上介绍英国那个禁止就业歧视的法律，说它保护少数群体。
equality act.translation: 朋友：老师说的那部保护少数群体的法律叫什么 你：是一部关于平等的法案 朋友：它管什么用呢 你：禁止单位因为身份歧视人
equality act.example: Friend: What's that law protecting minorities called? You: It's an equality act. Friend: What does it do? You: It bans workplace discrimination.

equates to.context: 你一个月房租五千，朋友说这差不多相当于半个月工资了。
equates to.translation: 朋友：你一个月房租多少 你：五千块 朋友：那差不多是你工资的一半吧 你：对 房租占了一半工资
equates to.example: Friend: How much rent a month? You: Five thousand. Friend: That's about half your salary. You: Yeah; the rent equates to half my pay.

equip with.context: 你新买的那台相机自带一个特别好的镜头，不用额外再买。
equip with.translation: 朋友：你新相机还要另外配镜头吗 你：不用 它自带一个好镜头 朋友：那挺方便的 你：对 出厂就配好了
equip with.example: Friend: Does your new camera need an extra lens? You: No, it comes with a good one. Friend: Convenient. You: Yeah; it's equipped with a great lens.

equivalent of.context: 你说一个苹果手机的钱，差不多能买三个普通安卓手机。
equivalent of.translation: 朋友：一个苹果手机多少钱 你：大几千 朋友：那够买几个普通手机了 你：对 一部苹果能顶三个安卓
equivalent of.example: Friend: How much is one iPhone? You: Several thousand. Friend: That buys how many budget phones? You: Yeah; one iPhone is the equivalent of three Android phones.

equivalent to.context: 你说这份工作虽然名头好听，但干的活跟打杂其实差不多。
equivalent to.translation: 朋友：你那新工作听着挺光鲜的 你：其实干的活跟杂务差不多 朋友：不就是换个说法吗 你：对 实际等同于打杂
equivalent to.example: Friend: Your new job sounds fancy. You: Actually the work is like odd jobs. Friend: Isn't it just a fancy name? You: Yeah; it's equivalent to doing chores.

erode family time.context: 你天天加班，回家连跟家人说句话的时间都没了，朋友说你这样不行。
erode family time.translation: 朋友：你多久没跟家里人一起吃饭了 你：天天加班 到家都该睡了 朋友：再这样家人都疏远了 你：是啊 工作在占掉我的家庭时间
erode family time.example: Friend: When did you last eat with your family? You: Overtime; home at bedtime. Friend: Your family will drift away. You: Yeah; work erodes my family time.

errand paralysis.context: 你周末面对一堆小差事，这个也想做那个也想做，结果一件都没动。
errand paralysis.translation: 朋友：你周末不是说要收拾房间吗 你：一堆小事堆着 越想越不想动 朋友：结果一件都没干吧 你：对 小事堆多了反而动不了
errand paralysis.example: Friend: Weren't you going to tidy up this weekend? You: So many small errands; the more I think, the less I do. Friend: Did none of them get done? You: Yeah; errand paralysis set in.

erupting star.context: 你看天文纪录片讲某颗恒星突然大爆发，喷发出巨大的耀斑。
erupting star.translation: 朋友：天上那颗特别亮的星怎么了 你：它突然爆发了一下 朋友：怎么这么突然 你：对 是恒星爆发 喷了一大团物质
erupting star.example: Friend: What's up with that bright star? You: It suddenly erupted. Friend: How sudden? You: Yeah; it's an erupting star bursting with flares.

escape from reality.context: 你工作太累，周末躲在家里看剧打游戏，想暂时把现实抛到一边。
escape from reality.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么又窝在家里 你：太累了 就想躲在剧里 朋友：天天这样也不是办法 你：就想暂时逃离一下现实
escape from reality.example: Friend: Holed up at home again this weekend? You: So tired; I want to hide in shows. Friend: It's not a long-term fix. You: I just want to escape from reality for a bit.

esports career.context: 你朋友打游戏打出了成绩，想把当职业选手当成正经工作来做。
esports career.translation: 朋友：你朋友打游戏打出名了 想干嘛 你：他想当职业选手 走这条路 朋友：家里人支持吗 你：在商量 这是他想走的职业路
esports career.example: Friend: Your friend got famous gaming; what does he want? You: He wants an esports career. Friend: Do his family support it? You: Discussing; it's the career he wants.

essential for.context: 老师说学好外语对以后找工作特别重要，是必不可少的本事。
essential for.translation: 朋友：你说我现在学外语晚不晚 你：不晚 以后找工作都用得上 朋友：真有那么重要吗 你：对 这技能对求职必不可少
essential for.example: Friend: Is it too late to learn a language now? You: No; it helps in job hunting. Friend: Is it really that important? You: Yeah; it's essential for getting hired.

essential item.context: 你出门旅行前收拾行李，朋友告诉你哪几样东西一定要带。
essential item.translation: 朋友：出门旅行要带些什么 你：身份证、充电器这些必须带 朋友：就这几样吗 你：对 这几样是必备的东西
essential item.example: Friend: What to pack for a trip? You: ID, charger, the must-haves. Friend: Just those? You: Yeah; those are the essential items.

essential nutrient.context: 医生说人身体需要几种自己造不出来的营养，得靠吃饭补。
essential nutrient.translation: 朋友：医生说我要多吃点什么 你：几种身体自己造不出来的营养 朋友：那要多吃什么补 你：肉蛋奶 补充必需营养
essential nutrient.example: Friend: What does the doctor say I should eat more? You: Nutrients your body can't make itself. Friend: What to eat? You: Meat, eggs, milk; get essential nutrients.

essential oil.context: 你睡前在枕头旁滴两滴香香的精油，说这样特别好入睡。
essential oil.translation: 朋友：你睡前枕头那香香的是什么 你：是精油 助眠用的 朋友：闻着确实挺好睡 你：对 滴两滴精油就放松了
essential oil.example: Friend: What's that nice smell by your pillow? You: It's essential oil to help sleep. Friend: It does smell relaxing. You: Yeah; a few drops of essential oil calm me down.

essential thing.context: 你出差收拾行李，朋友提醒你哪几样东西出门一定要带齐。
essential thing.translation: 朋友：出差行李就一个小包够吗 你：身份证、手机、充电器就行 朋友：其他的呢 你：这些是出门必备的东西
essential thing.example: Friend: Is one small bag enough for a business trip? You: ID, phone, charger are enough. Friend: What else? You: Those are the essential things to bring.

essential things in life.context: 你说钱买不来快乐，但健康、家人这些才是生活里真正重要的东西。
essential things in life.translation: 朋友：你觉得人生最重要的是什么 你：不是钱 是健康和家人 朋友：钱不重要吗 你：够用就行 健康陪伴才是必需
essential things in life.example: Friend: What do you think matters most in life? You: Not money, but health and family. Friend: Doesn't money matter? You: Enough is fine; those are essential things in life.

essential to.context: 老师说语言环境对学一门外语特别关键，天天听才学得会。
essential to.translation: 朋友：我学了好几年外语还是张不开嘴 你：你缺少天天用的环境 朋友：那怎么办 你：多跟人聊 环境对学语言必不可少
essential to.example: Friend: Years of study and still can't speak. You: You lack a daily environment. Friend: What to do? You: Talk more; environment is essential to learning a language.

ethical dilemma.context: 你朋友捡到一个装满钱的钱包，纠结是自己留下还是还给失主。
ethical dilemma.translation: 朋友：我捡到一个钱包 里面好多钱 你：这还用想 还给失主啊 朋友：可是没人看见 我也动心了 你：别贪昧心钱 这是个道德难题
ethical dilemma.example: Friend: I found a wallet with lots of cash. You: Return it, obviously. Friend: But no one saw; I'm tempted. You: Don't take ill-gotten money; it's an ethical dilemma.

ethical eating.context: 你朋友只买蔬菜不吃肉，说不光为了减肥，也是对动物友好。
ethical eating.translation: 朋友：你怎么突然开始吃素了 你：不光减肥 也为了动物 朋友：这是出于健康考虑吗 你：也有 我在讲究吃得有良心
ethical eating.example: Friend: Why suddenly go vegetarian? You: Not just weight; it's for animals. Friend: For health reasons? You: Partly; I care about ethical eating.

ethical reasons.context: 你不买皮草，朋友问你是因为贵还是另有原因。
ethical reasons.translation: 朋友：你为什么从来不买皮草 你：不想伤害动物 朋友：是出于什么考虑呢 你：对 是出于道德上的原因
ethical reasons.example: Friend: Why never buy fur? You: Don't want to hurt animals. Friend: For what reason? You: Yeah; for ethical reasons.

ethical shopper.context: 你买东西先看是不是公平交易、来源正不正当，朋友笑你太较真。
ethical shopper.translation: 朋友：你买个东西怎么还要查来源 你：我想确认它来源正不正规 朋友：你也太讲究了 你：对 我就想做个负责任的消费者
ethical shopper.example: Friend: Why check where things come from? You: I want to be sure it's sourced fairly. Friend: You're too fussy. You: Yeah; I want to be an ethical shopper.

ethical shopping.context: 你逛街不冲动下单，先想想要不要、需不需要，朋友说你变理性了。
ethical shopping.translation: 朋友：你现在逛街都不买东西了 你：先想想要不要 不盲买 朋友：这是好事 你：对 现在购物都很理性
ethical shopping.example: Friend: You don't buy things shopping anymore? You: Think first; no blind buying. Friend: That's good. You: Yeah; my ethical shopping has grown.

ethically sourced.context: 你买咖啡时专挑那种标明咖啡豆来源、对农民公平的牌子。
ethically sourced.translation: 朋友：你怎么只买这一种咖啡 你：它标明豆子来源 对农民公平 朋友：你连这个都讲究 你：对 我选来源正规的
ethically sourced.example: Friend: Why only buy this coffee? You: It states the beans' source, fair to farmers. Friend: You care about that too. You: Yeah; I buy ethically sourced coffee.

ethnic background.context: 你们班里同学来自不同国家，老师让大家介绍自己家里是哪里人。
ethnic background.translation: 朋友：你爸妈都是哪里人啊 你：我家南方北方都有亲戚 朋友：那你的籍贯算哪儿的 你：这就是介绍一个人的籍贯
ethnic background.example: Friend: Where are your parents from? You: Relatives all over the country. Friend: So what's your family root? You: That's your ethnic background.

ethnic minority.context: 你们聊到学校里少数族裔的同学特别少，活动上很难看到他们。
ethnic minority.translation: 朋友：咱们学校外国同学多吗 你：不多 很少见 朋友：那他们能适应吗 你：少数族裔同学需要更多照顾
ethnic minority.example: Friend: Are there many foreign students at our school? You: Not many; rarely seen. Friend: Do they fit in? You: Students from ethnic minorities need more support.

eucalyptus leaf.context: 你在动物园看到考拉抱着叶子嚼，讲解员说它们只吃那一种叶子。
eucalyptus leaf.translation: 朋友：那只考拉抱着叶子在干嘛 你：在吃饭 它只吃桉树叶 朋友：别的叶子不吃吗 你：对 考拉几乎只吃桉树叶
eucalyptus leaf.example: Friend: What's that koala doing with leaves? You: Eating; it only eats eucalyptus leaves. Friend: Nothing else? You: Yeah; koalas live on eucalyptus leaves.

european union.context: 你朋友要去欧洲旅行，你帮他查那边通用的签证和货币情况。
european union.translation: 朋友：去欧洲好几个国家 是不是每个国家都要签证 你：不用 有那个联盟的签证就行 朋友：货币也通用吗 你：大部分国家用同一种钱
european union.example: Friend: Visiting several European countries, need a visa for each? You: No; one Schengen visa works. Friend: Same currency? You: Most share one, in the union.

even after.context: 你帮了朋友那么多次，可轮到你有事，他却连句谢谢都没有。
even after.translation: 朋友：你帮他那么多 他还这样对你 你：我都帮他无数次了 朋友：他也太不懂事了 你：就是 我都帮了这么多次他还这样
even after.example: Friend: You helped him so much, yet he treats you like this. You: I've helped him countless times. Friend: He's so ungrateful. You: Yeah; even after all that, he's like this.

even as.context: 你一边赶着 deadline，一边还得接家里电话，两头忙得不可开交。
even as.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么这么忙 你：赶项目的同时 家里还老打电话来 朋友：忙得过来吗 你：就是忙成一团
even as.example: Friend: Why so busy lately? You: Even as I cram the project, family keeps calling. Friend: Can you cope? You: I'm juggling it all at once.

every now and then.context: 你跟老朋友不常见面，但每隔一段时间总会约出来吃顿饭。
every now and then.translation: 朋友：咱俩多久没聚了 你：也就一两个月吧 朋友：有空出来吃个饭 你：好 我偶尔也想约你
every now and then.example: Friend: How long since we met? You: Maybe a month or two. Friend: Let's grab a meal. You: Sure; I meet you every now and then.

everyday items.context: 你搬家去超市采购，朋友帮你列了牙刷毛巾这些天天用得上的东西。
everyday items.translation: 朋友：刚搬家 超市先买什么 你：牙刷、毛巾这些天天用的 朋友：还缺什么 你：先把日常用品备齐
everyday items.example: Friend: Just moved; what to buy first? You: Toothbrush, towel, daily basics. Friend: Anything else? You: Stock up on everyday items first.

everyday life.context: 你搬到新城市住了半年，慢慢适应了那边买菜上班的节奏。
everyday life.translation: 朋友：搬去那边住习惯了吗 你：差不多了 买菜上班都熟了 朋友：跟以前差别大吗 你：习惯就好 这就是日常生活
everyday life.example: Friend: Used to living there after six months? You: Pretty much; shopping and commuting are familiar. Friend: Much different? You: You get used to it; it's just everyday life.

everyday noise.context: 你住在大马路边，天天被车流声吵得午睡都不踏实。
everyday noise.translation: 朋友：你家住马路边吵不吵 你：吵 车来车往根本睡不好 朋友：那你怎么住的 你：习惯了这些噪音
everyday noise.example: Friend: Is your place by the road noisy? You: Yeah; traffic ruins my naps. Friend: How do you live with it? You: I've gotten used to the everyday noise.

everyday vocabulary.context: 你背单词老背那些生僻词，朋友说先把天天用得到的词掌握好。
everyday vocabulary.translation: 朋友：我背单词怎么进步这么慢 你：你老背难词 先背常用的 朋友：常用词有哪些 你：就是平时说话天天用的那些
everyday vocabulary.example: Friend: Why am I so slow memorizing words? You: You study rare ones; start with common ones. Friend: Which are common? You: The everyday vocabulary you use all the time.

evoke emotion.context: 你看电影时那段配乐特别打动人，朋友说音乐就是为了调动情绪。
evoke emotion.translation: 朋友：那段配乐听着好感动 你：是吧 音乐最能打动人 朋友：导演为什么要配这段 你：就是为了唤起观众的情绪
evoke emotion.example: Friend: That soundtrack is so moving. You: Right; music really stirs people. Friend: Why did the director add it? You: To evoke emotion in the audience.

evolutionary psychology.context: 你选课时好奇那门讲人为什么会有某种行为的课到底学什么。
evolutionary psychology.translation: 朋友：你选的那门课是研究什么的 你：讲人为什么会这样那样行为 朋友：那是什么学科啊 你：就是用进化的角度看人
evolutionary psychology.example: Friend: What does that course you picked study? You: Why people behave the way they do. Friend: What field? You: It's evolutionary psychology.

evolutionary purpose.context: 你们聊到人为什么会笑，朋友说这背后可能有什么进化上的道理。
evolutionary purpose.translation: 朋友：你说人为什么会笑呢 你：专家说笑是从祖先那里传下来的 朋友：那有什么用 你：是为了团结大家
evolutionary purpose.example: Friend: Why do humans laugh? You: Experts say laughter goes back to our ancestors. Friend: What's it for? You: It has an evolutionary purpose, bonding the group.

evolve from.context: 老师讲人是从远古的猿类一点点演变来的，举了化石证据。
evolve from.translation: 朋友：人真的是猴子变的吗 你：不是猴子 是从更古老的动物演变来的 朋友：那我们最早什么样 你：是由很早的祖先演变来的
evolve from.example: Friend: Did humans really come from monkeys? You: Not monkeys, but from older ancestors. Friend: What did we look like? You: We evolved from very early ancestors.

evolved from.context: 你翻到家里一张老照片，发现爷爷年轻时候跟你长得特别像。
evolved from.translation: 朋友：这照片里年轻人长得好像你 你：那是我爷爷年轻时 朋友：你们俩真像 你：对啊 我长得就像他
evolved from.example: Friend: That young man in the photo looks like you. You: That's my grandpa when young. Friend: You two really resemble. You: Yeah; I've evolved from his looks.

exam pressure.context: 临近期末，你天天熬夜复习，朋友说你被考试压得都瘦了。
exam pressure.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老熬到半夜 你：期末快到了 天天背书 朋友：看着都瘦了 你：考试压力太大了
exam pressure.example: Friend: Why stay up till midnight lately? You: Finals near; cramming every day. Friend: You've lost weight. You: The exam pressure is too much.

exam season.context: 十二月一到，图书馆里全是埋头复习的人，大家都进入考试季了。
exam season.translation: 朋友：图书馆今天怎么这么多人 你：一到考试季 大家都来复习 朋友：连座位都抢不到了 你：对 这就是考试季
exam season.example: Friend: Why so crowded in the library today? You: Exam season hits; everyone comes to study. Friend: Can't even get a seat. You: Yeah; it's exam season.

except that.context: 你说这家餐厅各方面都好，就是位置太偏、不好找。
except that.translation: 朋友：这家餐厅味道怎么样 你：味道环境都好 就是位置偏 朋友：那去一趟多麻烦 你：除了位置不好 别的都好
except that.example: Friend: How's that restaurant? You: Food and ambiance are great, just the location. Friend: A hassle to reach then. You: Except that, it's all good.

exception to the rule.context: 你们公司一般六点下班，唯独你们部门经常加班到很晚，是个例外。
exception to the rule.translation: 朋友：你们部门天天加班啊 你：对 别的部门都准点走 朋友：那你们真是特殊 你：对 我们就是规则的例外
exception to the rule.example: Friend: Does your department work overtime daily? You: Yeah; others leave on time. Friend: You're really special. You: Yeah; we're the exception to the rule.

excess consumption.context: 你最近零食吃太多，体重涨了，朋友劝你别老这么吃。
excess consumption.translation: 朋友：你怎么又买了一堆薯片 你：嘴馋嘛 忍不住 朋友：吃太多对身体不好 你：对 这样吃太多了
excess consumption.example: Friend: Why buy another pile of chips? You: Just can't resist. Friend: Eating like this is bad. You: Yeah; this excess consumption of snacks.

excess intake.context: 医生说你维生素补过头了，有些东西吃多了反而有害。
excess intake.translation: 朋友：医生怎么说我身体 你：什么都不缺 就是补多了 朋友：那还要继续吃补剂吗 你：别了 过量反而不好
excess intake.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about me? You: Nothing lacking, just overdoing supplements. Friend: Keep taking them? You: No; excess intake is harmful.

excessive buying.context: 你双十一买了一堆没用的东西，衣柜都塞爆了，朋友说你该少买点。
excessive buying.translation: 朋友：你双十一又剁手了吧 你：买了一堆 好多都没用 朋友：你这买得也太多了 你：对 得控制一下购物
excessive buying.example: Friend: Did you splurge on Double Eleven again? You: Bought a pile, most useless. Friend: That's way too much buying. You: Yeah; I need to curb excessive buying.

excessive drinking.context: 你朋友聚会老喝大酒，你劝他少喝点，说喝多了伤肝。
excessive drinking.translation: 朋友：上次聚会你喝了多少 你：就一点点 我劝他少喝 朋友：他还跟人拼酒 你：对 这样喝太伤身体了
excessive drinking.example: Friend: How much did you drink at the party? You: Just a little; I told him to cut down. Friend: He was still drinking to match others. You: Yeah; such excessive drinking harms health.

excessive heat.context: 今年夏天热得离谱，出门走两步就一身汗，你和朋友都受不了。
excessive heat.translation: 朋友：今天这温度也太高了 你：三十八九度 出门就冒汗 朋友：这天气怎么活 你：对 太热了
excessive heat.example: Friend: Is the temperature insane today? You: Nearly forty; sweat just walking out. Friend: How do people live in this? You: Yeah; it's extreme heat.

excluded from.context: 你报名比赛因为太晚，名额满了，被排在了外面。
excluded from.translation: 朋友：你报名那个比赛成功了吗 你：没赶上 名额满了 朋友：那怎么办 你：只能等下一届
excluded from.example: Friend: Did you get into that contest? You: No; missed it, slots full. Friend: Then what? You: Wait for next time; I was excluded from this one.

exclusive lane.context: 你在马路上看到一条只让公交车走的车道，别的车不能进。
exclusive lane.translation: 朋友：那条车道别的车能走吗 你：不能 那是公交车专用道 朋友：私家车进去会被罚 你：对 那是专用车道
exclusive lane.example: Friend: Can other cars use that lane? You: No; it's the bus lane. Friend: Will private cars get fined? You: Yeah; it's an exclusive lane.

exclusive release.context: 你等了好久的那部电影终于在某个视频网站独播了，别的地方看不着。
exclusive release.translation: 朋友：你等的那部电影哪能看 你：只在那个视频网站上放 朋友：别的地方没有吗 你：没有 它是独家上线的
exclusive release.example: Friend: Where can I watch that movie you waited for? You: Only on that one video site. Friend: Not elsewhere? You: No; it's an exclusive release there.

executive producer.context: 你看电影片尾字幕，发现那个大明星除了主演还挂了别的头衔。
executive producer.translation: 朋友：片尾那个制片人是谁啊 你：就是主演那个大明星 朋友：他还管制作吗 你：对 他是执行制片人
executive producer.example: Friend: Who's that producer in the credits? You: The lead star himself. Friend: Does he also produce? You: Yeah; he's the executive producer.

exempt from.context: 你说自己运气好，怎么吃都不胖，朋友羡慕得不行。
exempt from.translation: 朋友：你怎么吃那么多还不胖 你：我天生就吃不胖 朋友：太气人了 你：对 我算是免于发胖
exempt from.example: Friend: How do you eat so much and not gain weight? You: I'm just built that way. Friend: So unfair. You: Yeah; I'm exempt from gaining weight.

exercise regimen.context: 你给朋友看你新做的锻炼计划，一周去三次健身房。
exercise regimen.translation: 朋友：你最近健身挺有规律啊 你：对 每周练三次 朋友：这计划坚持多久了 你：刚定的健身方案
exercise regimen.example: Friend: You've kept to a neat workout routine. You: Yeah, training three times a week. Friend: How long's that plan? You: It's my new exercise regimen.

exercise routine.context: 你给自己定了一套每周跑步三次的锻炼计划，坚持了一个月。
exercise routine.translation: 朋友：你最近气色好很多啊 你：我每周跑步三次 坚持一个月了 朋友：这计划你定的 你：对 一套固定的锻炼安排
exercise routine.example: Friend: You look so much better lately. You: I run three times a week, a month now. Friend: You set this routine? You: Yeah, a fixed exercise routine.

exercising regularly.context: 医生说只要你坚持定期锻炼，身体状态会慢慢好起来。
exercising regularly.translation: 朋友：我这身子骨怎么总这么虚 你：医生说你得规律运动 朋友：一周练几次合适 你：坚持锻炼 身体会结实起来
exercising regularly.example: Friend: Why do I feel so weak? You: The doctor says you need regular exercise. Friend: How often? You: Keep exercising regularly and you'll toughen up.

exert control.context: 你家小孩一闹脾气就在地上打滚，朋友问你平时怎么管他。
exert control.translation: 朋友：你家小孩不听话你怎么管 你：得立好规矩 不能由着他来 朋友：他闹脾气你怎么办 你：必须管得住 立好规矩
exert control.example: Friend: How do you handle your kid's tantrums? You: Set rules, can't let him rule. Friend: What when he throws a fit? You: You must exert control firmly.

exert dominance.context: 你们部门新主管一来就开会立威，凡事都要按他说的来。
exert dominance.translation: 朋友：新来的主管是不是特别强势 你：对啊 什么都得听他的 朋友：他一上任就想镇住大家 你：对 特别爱摆架子
exert dominance.example: Friend: Is the new manager really pushy? You: Yeah, everything goes his way. Friend: He wants to assert himself right away. You: Yeah; he loves to exert dominance.

exert influence on.context: 老师说好的老师对学生一辈子影响很深，能改变他们的方向。
exert influence on.translation: 朋友：你有没有特别感激的老师 你：有一位 影响了我很多 朋友：他怎么影响你的 你：他鼓励我 改变了我的方向
exert influence on.example: Friend: Any teacher you're really grateful for? You: One influenced me deeply. Friend: How? You: He encouraged me; he exerted influence on my direction.

existential crises.context: 你最近老想人活着到底为了什么，半夜睡不着，跟朋友聊起这种迷茫。
existential crises.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老发呆想事情 你：老想人活着到底图什么 朋友：想这些干嘛 你：唉 就是突然的迷茫
existential crises.example: Friend: Why do you zone out thinking lately? You: Keep wondering what life's for. Friend: Why dwell on that? You: Sigh; it's these existential crises.

existential crisis.context: 你毕业两年还没稳定下来，突然对未来一片迷茫，跟朋友倾诉。
existential crisis.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么一直闷闷不乐 你：工作也不顺 前途也迷茫 朋友：别想太多 走一步看一步 你：就是突然的迷茫期
existential crisis.example: Friend: Why so down lately? You: Work's rough, future feels unclear. Friend: Don't overthink; take it step by step. You: I'm in an existential crisis.

exotic flavour.context: 你在国外超市看到一种从没吃过的奇怪零食，买来尝尝鲜。
exotic flavour.translation: 朋友：你手里那包零食是什么 没见过 你：本地特色 味道挺怪的 朋友：好吃吗 你：挺新奇的一种口味
exotic flavour.example: Friend: What's that snack in your hand? Never seen it. You: Local specialty, tastes odd. Friend: Is it good? You: It's an exotic flavour worth trying.

expand menu.context: 那家素食餐厅客人越来越多，老板决定多加几道菜丰富菜单。
expand menu.translation: 朋友：那家素菜馆生意挺好啊 你：对 老板要多加几个菜 朋友：为什么扩菜单 你：客人多了 得丰富一下菜单
expand menu.example: Friend: That veggie restaurant does well. You: Yeah, the owner's adding more dishes. Friend: Why expand? You: More customers, so they expand the menu.

experiential gift.context: 你朋友生日，你不送实物，送他一次跳伞体验，让他玩个痛快。
experiential gift.translation: 朋友：他生日你送什么好呢 你：送他一次跳伞体验 比实物有意思 朋友：他肯定惊喜 你：对 送体验特别走心
experiential gift.example: Friend: What should we get him for his birthday? You: A skydiving experience, more fun than stuff. Friend: He'll be thrilled. You: Yeah; an experiential gift beats things.

experiential retail.context: 你发现现在的实体店不光卖东西，还让顾客在里面玩、喝东西。
experiential retail.translation: 朋友：现在那些店怎么都能坐着喝东西 你：对啊 不光卖货 还能体验 朋友：跟以前的商店不一样了 你：对 都是体验型的店
experiential retail.example: Friend: Why can you sit and drink in those stores now? You: Yeah, not just selling, you experience. Friend: Different from old shops. You: Yeah; it's experiential retail.

experiment with.context: 你做饭爱瞎琢磨，今天加这个料明天加那个，朋友说你是在试新菜。
experiment with.translation: 朋友：你今天做的菜怎么味道怪 你：我瞎加了点料试试 朋友：能好吃吗 你：试出来的 我就爱乱试
experiment with.example: Friend: Why's today's dish taste odd? You: I tossed in something new to try. Friend: Will it taste good? You: Experimenting; I love to experiment with recipes.

experimental learning.context: 老师说与其死记硬背，不如让学生动手做一做，学得更牢。
experimental learning.translation: 朋友：为什么这节课让我们自己动手做 你：老师说这样学得快 朋友：比光听讲强吗 你：对 这种动手学记得牢
experimental learning.example: Friend: Why do we build things in this class? You: The teacher says we learn faster. Friend: Better than just listening? You: Yeah; it's hands-on, experiential learning.

experimental psychology.context: 你选心理学课时发现有个方向专门做实验，用数据研究人的心理。
experimental psychology.translation: 朋友：心理学里你选哪个方向 你：做实验那个 用数据说话 朋友：那是什么方向啊 你：就是做实验那个分支
experimental psychology.example: Friend: Which psychology branch did you pick? You: The experimental one, data-driven. Friend: What's that called? You: It's experimental psychology.

expert at.context: 你朋友特别擅长修电脑，一有毛病大家都找他。
expert at.translation: 朋友：我电脑又蓝屏了 你找谁修 你：找他啊 他特会修电脑 朋友：他是工程师吗 你：不是 就是自己练出来的能手
expert at.example: Friend: My PC crashed again; who fixes it? You: Him; he's an expert at computers. Friend: Is he an engineer? You: No; just self-taught and an expert at it.

explode with.context: 你听到喜讯开心得不行，激动得又蹦又跳，朋友都被你逗乐了。
explode with.translation: 朋友：你中了什么奖 这么开心 你：拿到了那个梦寐以求的 offer 朋友：看你激动的 你：我高兴坏了
explode with.example: Friend: What did you win, so happy? You: Got that dream offer. Friend: Look how thrilled you are. You: I'm exploding with joy.

exploit others.context: 你那个朋友总爱占别人便宜，让同事帮他干活却从不回报。
exploit others.translation: 朋友：他怎么老让你帮他做事 你：他总使唤别人 自己不干活 朋友：这种人不值得交 你：对 就爱利用别人
exploit others.example: Friend: Why does he always make you work for him? You: He uses people, never does his own. Friend: Not worth being friends. You: Yeah; he just exploits others.

exploitative wage.context: 新闻里说有些工厂一天干十几个小时，工资却低得可怜。
exploitative wage.translation: 朋友：那种工厂工人一个月挣多少 你：特别少 一天干好久 朋友：那也太不公平了 你：对 工资低得可怜
exploitative wage.example: Friend: How much do those factory workers earn? You: Very little, working long days. Friend: That's so unfair. You: Yeah; it's an exploitative wage.

explore surroundings.context: 你到了新城市第一天，放下行李就出门到处走走摸摸路。
explore surroundings.translation: 朋友：你到新地方先干嘛 你：放下东西就出门转转 朋友：去认识一下周围 你：对 先摸摸这一带
explore surroundings.example: Friend: What do you do first in a new city? You: Drop bags and head out for a walk. Friend: To get to know the area? You: Yeah; explore the surroundings.

extend working life.context: 新闻说因为年轻人不够，以后可能要大家干到更大年纪才能退休。
extend working life.translation: 朋友：以后是不是要推迟退休了 你：对啊 干的年纪可能要延长 朋友：那得干到多少岁 你：政策上要延后退休
extend working life.example: Friend: Will retirement be delayed later? You: Yeah; people may work longer. Friend: Until what age? You: They plan to extend working life.

extensive reading.context: 你学英语不只背课本，还大量读小说新闻，朋友问你怎么进步这么快。
extensive reading.translation: 朋友：你英语怎么进步这么快 你：我天天读小说和新闻 朋友：就课本够吗 你：不够 得多读
extensive reading.example: Friend: How'd your English improve so fast? You: I read novels and news daily. Friend: Is the textbook enough? You: No; extensive reading matters.

extensive transport network.context: 你这个城市地铁公交特别方便，去哪都能到，跟朋友夸这里交通。
extensive transport network.translation: 朋友：你这城市出行方便吗 你：地铁公交到处都有 去哪都快 朋友：交通挺发达的 你：对 路网特别全
extensive transport network.example: Friend: Is getting around your city easy? You: Subway and buses everywhere. Friend: Good transport. You: Yeah; an extensive transport network.

extra income.context: 你下班之后接了点私活，每个月多挣一点零花钱。
extra income.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老熬夜 你：接点私活 赚点外快 朋友：挺能干啊 你：就是想多赚点
extra income.example: Friend: Why stay up late lately? You: Taking side gigs for extra cash. Friend: You're hardworking. You: Just want some extra income.

extraterrestrial life.context: 你和朋友夜观星星，聊到宇宙那么大，真的可能有外星人吗。
extraterrestrial life.translation: 朋友：你说宇宙里有外星人吗 你：那么多星球 说不定真有 朋友：谁知道呢 你：对 有没有外星生命谁也说不准
extraterrestrial life.example: Friend: Do you think there are aliens out there? You: So many planets, maybe yes. Friend: Who knows? You: Yeah; whether extraterrestrial life exists is unknown.

extreme day trip.context: 你们周末想一日往返爬一座高山，当天去当天回，行程拉得很满。
extreme day trip.translation: 朋友：周末想爬那座高山 你：一天来回特别赶 朋友：那来得及吗 你：早出晚归 一日来回
extreme day trip.example: Friend: Want to climb that tall mountain this weekend? You: A day trip back and forth is tight. Friend: Is it doable? You: Early out, late back; an extreme day trip.

extreme living.context: 你看博主在极寒无人区生活，条件艰苦得让你咋舌。
extreme living.translation: 朋友：那个博主在零下几十度地方住 你：对 就一个人在野外 朋友：怎么受得了 你：对 这种极限生活真不是一般人
extreme living.example: Friend: That blogger lives in minus-tens weather. You: Yeah, alone out there. Friend: How can they stand it? You: Yeah; extreme living like that isn't for everyone.

extreme pressure.context: 你坐深潜器下到海底，朋友说越深水压越大，人根本受不了。
extreme pressure.translation: 朋友：海底越深是不是越可怕 你：对 压力大得惊人 朋友：那怎么下去 你：得靠特制的耐压设备
extreme pressure.example: Friend: Isn't the deep sea scary? You: Yeah, the pressure is extreme. Friend: How do they go down? You: With special pressure-proof equipment.

extreme privilege.context: 你们聊到有些人含着金汤匙出生，什么好资源都有，跟普通人天差地别。
extreme privilege.translation: 朋友：有些人天生什么都不缺啊 你：对 从小要什么有什么 朋友：这命也太好了 你：对 这种特权普通人比不了
extreme privilege.example: Friend: Some people have everything from birth. You: Yeah, whatever they want. Friend: What a life. You: Yeah; such extreme privilege is beyond ordinary folks.

extreme situation.context: 你朋友遇到家里着火这种极端情况，慌得不知道怎么办才好。
extreme situation.translation: 朋友：昨天家里突然着火 吓死我了 你：那你当时怎么办的 朋友：都懵了 你：遇到这种极端情况是会慌
extreme situation.example: Friend: Fire broke out at my home yesterday; I was terrified. You: What did you do then? Friend: I froze. You: In such an extreme situation, anyone panics.

extreme sport.context: 朋友特别爱蹦极攀岩，你不敢玩那种特别刺激的项目。
extreme sport.translation: 朋友：周末一起去蹦极吗 你：不敢 太刺激了 朋友：你就怕这种运动 你：对 我不玩极限运动
extreme sport.example: Friend: Bungee jumping this weekend? You: No, too thrilling. Friend: You just fear those sports. You: Yeah; I don't do extreme sports.

extreme weather.context: 新闻里说今年夏天暴雨暴雪特别反常，天气越来越怪了。
extreme weather.translation: 朋友：今年天气怎么这么怪 你：对 该热的时候冷 该下雨的时候旱 朋友：这是怎么了 你：都是极端天气闹的
extreme weather.example: Friend: Why's the weather so weird this year? You: Yeah, cold when hot, dry when rainy. Friend: What's going on? You: It's all that extreme weather.

extreme weather event.context: 新闻连续报道高温、洪水，说这类反常的天灾这几年越来越多。
extreme weather event.translation: 朋友：今年怎么天灾这么多 你：高温、洪水一样接一样 朋友：这正常吗 你：不正常 都是极端天气
extreme weather event.example: Friend: Why so many disasters this year? You: Heat and floods one after another. Friend: Is this normal? You: No; these extreme weather events keep coming.

extrinsic motivation.context: 你说小孩要是光为了拿奖励才学习，那不是真的喜欢学。
extrinsic motivation.translation: 朋友：你给孩子奖钱让他写作业 你：对 写完给一百块 朋友：这招管用吗 你：管用 但靠的是奖励
extrinsic motivation.example: Friend: You reward your kid money for homework? You: Yeah, a hundred bucks when done. Friend: Does it work? You: It works, but it's extrinsic motivation.

extrinsic reward.context: 你说干一件事如果只是为了钱，一旦没钱就没动力了。
extrinsic reward.translation: 朋友：你怎么突然不做那件事了 你：没奖金了 就不想干了 朋友：那你动力也太实在了 你：对 全靠外部奖励
extrinsic reward.example: Friend: Why'd you stop doing that thing? You: No bonus, so no drive. Friend: That's a very material motive. You: Yeah; it's all extrinsic rewards.

extroverted manner.context: 你朋友见谁都聊得来，第一次见面就跟人称兄道弟，性格特别外向。
extroverted manner.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么跟谁都能聊 你：他天生外向 不认生 朋友：跟谁都自来熟 你：对 性格特别外向
extroverted manner.example: Friend: Why can your friend talk to anyone? You: He's born outgoing, not shy. Friend: Instantly friendly with everyone. You: Yeah; such an extroverted manner.

exuberant personality.context: 你朋友天天乐呵呵，走到哪都有笑声，是个特别有活力的人。
exuberant personality.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么天天那么开心 你：他天生就热情 精力旺盛 朋友：跟他待着真开心 你：对 他特别有活力
exuberant personality.example: Friend: Why is your friend so cheerful every day? You: He's born warm and high-energy. Friend: Nice to be around him. You: Yeah; he has an exuberant personality.

eye contact.context: 你面试时不敢跟考官对视，朋友提醒你说话要看着对方眼睛。
eye contact.translation: 朋友：面试别老低头 看着考官眼睛 你：我紧张 不敢对视 朋友：看着对方更有礼貌 你：好 我练着眼神交流
eye contact.example: Friend: Don't look down in the interview; meet the eyes. You: I'm nervous, scared to look. Friend: Eye contact is more polite. You: Okay; I'll practice eye contact.

eye fatigue.context: 你天天对着电脑，到下午眼睛又干又酸，朋友说你这是看屏幕太多。
eye fatigue.translation: 朋友：你怎么老揉眼睛 你：盯了一天电脑 眼睛干 朋友：该歇一歇了 你：对 眼睛太累了
eye fatigue.example: Friend: Why do you keep rubbing your eyes? You: Stared at the screen all day; dry. Friend: Time to rest. You: Yeah; this eye fatigue.

eye strain.context: 你熬夜看手机看到半夜，第二天眼睛又酸又胀，朋友说你这是用眼过度。
eye strain.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么红红的 你：昨晚躺着刷手机到半夜 朋友：看多了就会酸 你：对 眼睛太累了
eye strain.example: Friend: Why are your eyes bloodshot? You: Lay on the phone till midnight. Friend: Too much screen strains them. You: Yeah; I've got eye strain.

eyelid surgery.context: 你朋友嫌自己眼睛小，跑去咨询割双眼皮的手术。
eyelid surgery.translation: 朋友：你最近老打听整容医院干嘛 你：想把眼睛弄大一点 朋友：是做眼皮手术吗 你：对 我想去咨询一下
eyelid surgery.example: Friend: Why are you asking about plastic surgery? You: Want to make my eyes bigger. Friend: Eyelid surgery then? You: Yeah; I want to consult about it.

face mask.context: 去人多的地方你都会戴个口罩，朋友问你是不是还怕生病。
face mask.translation: 朋友：你出门怎么还戴口罩啊 你：人多的地方戴一个放心 朋友：现在不戴的人多了 你：我习惯了 戴着安心
face mask.example: Friend: Why still wear a mask out? You: In crowded places, wearing one reassures me. Friend: Most people stopped now. You: I'm used to it; the mask makes me feel safe.

face-to-face interaction.context: 你说网上聊得再好，也不如坐下来面对面聊一次来得实在。
face-to-face interaction.translation: 朋友：你们俩聊这么久 见面了吗 你：还没 都是线上聊 朋友：不如约出来当面聊聊 你：对 面对面交流更真实
face-to-face interaction.example: Friend: You've chatted so long; met up? You: Not yet, all online. Friend: Meet in person then. You: Yeah; face-to-face interaction feels real.

facial expression.context: 你朋友嘴上说着没事，表情却藏不住难过，你一眼就看出来了。
facial expression.translation: 朋友：他说没事 可你怎么看出来他难过 你：他脸上的表情骗不了人 朋友：你从哪儿看出来的 你：对 他那表情藏不住
facial expression.example: Friend: He says he's fine; how do you know he's sad? You: His facial expression gives him away. Friend: How? You: Yeah; his facial expression can't hide it.

facial features.context: 你翻老照片发现你外甥跟你小时候长得一模一样，五官特别像。
facial features.translation: 朋友：你外甥跟你小时候真像 你：是吧 那鼻子眼睛跟我一个样 朋友：哪最像 你：对 五官特别像
facial features.example: Friend: Your nephew looks just like you as a kid. You: Right? Same nose and eyes. Friend: Where most alike? You: Yeah; his facial features mirror mine.

facial movements.context: 你朋友一说话就眉飞色舞，脸上表情特别丰富，跟他聊天很有意思。
facial movements.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么那么爱做鬼脸 你：他一激动脸上表情就特别多 朋友：跟他聊天有意思吗 你：对 他面部表情可生动了
facial movements.example: Friend: Why does your friend make so many faces? You: When excited, his face moves a lot. Friend: Is chatting with him fun? You: Yeah; his facial movements are so lively.

facial recognition.context: 你现在进小区刷一下脸门就开了，朋友觉得这种刷脸进门特别方便。
facial recognition.translation: 朋友：你们小区进门还要刷门禁卡吗 你：不用 刷脸就开 朋友：这就是人脸识别吧 你：对 刷一下脸就行
facial recognition.example: Friend: Does your building need a key card? You: No, face scan opens it. Friend: That's facial recognition. You: Yeah; just scan your face.

facial resemblance.context: 你弟弟跟你爸爸年轻时简直一个模子刻出来的，长得太像了。
facial resemblance.translation: 朋友：你弟弟怎么跟你爸那么像 你：别人都说他俩一个样 朋友：真有那么像吗 你：对 长得特别像
facial resemblance.example: Friend: Why does your brother look like your dad? You: Everyone says they're identical. Friend: Really that alike? You: Yeah; a striking facial resemblance.

factor in.context: 你出去旅行做预算时，朋友提醒你把机票酒店之外，吃饭门票都算进去。
factor in.translation: 朋友：做预算光算机票酒店够吗 你：那还要算什么 朋友：吃饭门票都得算进去 你：对 把零碎花销都算上
factor in.example: Friend: Is the budget just flights and hotel enough? You: What else? Friend: Meals and tickets too. You: Right; factor in all the little costs.

fad diet.context: 你朋友跟风喝一种网红减肥茶，半个月就不喝了，朋友说那都是一时流行。
fad diet.translation: 朋友：你最近喝的减肥茶有用吗 你：就火了一阵 现在都没人提了 朋友：这种流行法能信吗 你：对 都是一阵风
fad diet.example: Friend: Does that diet tea work? You: Faded after a while; nobody talks of it. Friend: Can you trust such fads? You: Yeah; it's just a fad diet.

fad toy.context: 你说去年满大街卖的那种解压玩具，今年连影子都没了。
fad toy.translation: 朋友：去年那个捏捏乐怎么不见卖了 你：就火了一个暑假 现在都没人玩了 朋友：这种流行去得也快 你：对 都是一阵风的玩具
fad toy.example: Friend: Where did that pop-it from last year go? You: Just a summer craze; nobody plays now. Friend: Such fads fade fast. You: Yeah; it was a fad toy.

fade away.context: 你跟小学同学多年不联系，那些当年特别好的回忆也慢慢淡了。
fade away.translation: 朋友：你还记得小学那批好朋友吗 你：记得一点 但好多事都模糊了 朋友：时间真能冲淡一切 你：对 回忆都慢慢淡了
fade away.example: Friend: Remember those primary school friends? You: A little, but details blur. Friend: Time fades everything. You: Yeah; the memories fade away.

fade into.context: 你在人群里戴着帽子低着头，慢慢混进人群看不见了。
fade into.translation: 朋友：刚才那个人呢 怎么不见了 你：他低着头 混进人群里了 朋友：一眨眼就没影了 你：对 消失在人群里
fade into.example: Friend: Where'd that person go? Gone? You: Head down, blended into the crowd. Friend: Vanished in a blink. You: Yeah; he faded into the crowd.

fading away.context: 你说以前家里那台老收音机早就不听了，这种东西都快被淘汰了。
fading away.translation: 朋友：你家那台老收音机还在吗 你：在角落落灰 没人听了 朋友：这种东西现在过时了 你：对 都快被淘汰了
fading away.example: Friend: Is that old radio of yours still around? You: Gathering dust; nobody listens. Friend: Such things are outdated. You: Yeah; it's fading away.

fair pay.context: 你朋友在工地干一天活，老板给的钱却少得可怜，觉得不公平。
fair pay.translation: 朋友：你一天干那么久 挣多少啊 你：少得可怜 朋友：这也太少了吧 你：对 干这么久该多给点
fair pay.example: Friend: Working so long a day, how much do you earn? You: Far too little. Friend: That's so low. You: Yeah; they deserve fair pay.

fake memory.context: 你说小时候那件事你记得特别清楚，朋友却说根本没这回事。
fake memory.translation: 朋友：我记得那年我们去过海边 你：哪有 咱们没去过 朋友：我记得清清楚楚啊 你：你这记忆是假的
fake memory.example: Friend: I remember we went to the beach that year. You: We didn't; never went. Friend: I clearly remember it. You: You have a fake memory.

fall by the wayside.context: 你说大学时一起创业的那几个朋友，后来一个个都放弃了。
fall by the wayside.translation: 朋友：当年一起创业那几个人呢 你：没撑下去 一个个都退出了 朋友：好可惜啊 你：对 当初的计划都半途而废了
fall by the wayside.example: Friend: What happened to those startup buddies? You: Couldn't last; quit one by one. Friend: Such a shame. You: Yeah; the plans fell by the wayside.

fall from grace.context: 那个曾经很红的明星因为做错事，一下子从神坛上掉了下来。
fall from grace.translation: 朋友：那个明星怎么最近没消息了 你：他出了事 形象全毁了 朋友：以前多风光啊 你：对 一下子形象崩塌了
fall from grace.example: Friend: Why is that star off the radar? You: He got caught; his image's ruined. Friend: He was so famous. You: Yeah; he fell from grace.

fall in step.context: 你刚进公司时跟着老员工学，人家怎么做你就跟着怎么做。
fall in step.translation: 朋友：你刚入职那会怎么学的 你：跟着老员工后面学 朋友：就是照着做呗 你：对 跟着他们的步调
fall in step.example: Friend: How did you learn when you joined? You: Followed the old hands around. Friend: Just copied them? You: Yeah; I fell in step with them.

fall into debt.context: 你说现在年轻人刷信用卡、借网贷，一不小心就背上债。
fall into debt.translation: 朋友：他怎么年纪轻轻就欠了一屁股债 你：借网贷借的 利滚利 朋友：这可怎么还 你：对 一不小心就负债了
fall into debt.example: Friend: How is he in debt at such a young age? You: Online loans, interest piling up. Friend: How will he repay? You: Yeah; it's easy to fall into debt.

fall madly in love.context: 你朋友谈了个恋爱，俩人天天黏在一起，好得跟一个人似的。
fall madly in love.translation: 朋友：你朋友最近怎么天天不见人 你：谈恋爱了 正热恋呢 朋友：好成什么样了 你：对 甜得不行
fall madly in love.example: Friend: Why is your friend MIA lately? You: In love, totally smitten. Friend: How smitten? You: Yeah; they fell madly in love.

fall out.context: 你说你跟那个好朋友因为一件小事闹翻，现在谁也不理谁。
fall out.translation: 朋友：你跟那个好朋友还联系吗 你：不联系了 闹翻了 朋友：因为什么呀 你：一点小事 闹绝交了
fall out.example: Friend: Still talking to that good friend? You: No, we had a falling out. Friend: Over what? You: A little thing; we fell out.

fall out of love.context: 你说两个人在一起久了，感情会慢慢变淡，不像一开始那么甜。
fall out of love.translation: 朋友：他俩以前那么好 现在呢 你：淡了 不像刚在一起那样 朋友：怎么会这样 你：对 感情慢慢变淡了
fall out of love.example: Friend: They were so good together; now? You: Faded; not like the start. Friend: How so? You: Yeah; they fell out of love.

fall out of touch with.context: 你毕业后跟中学同学渐渐没了联系，见面都认不出来了。
fall out of touch with.translation: 朋友：你中学那批同学还联系吗 你：都不联系了 慢慢断了 朋友：一个都没留吗 你：对 都失去联系了
fall out of touch with.example: Friend: Still in touch with your middle school crew? You: No, drifted apart. Friend: Nobody left? You: Yeah; I fell out of touch with them.

falling fertility.context: 新闻说这几年生孩子的人越来越少，年轻人都不爱生了。
falling fertility.translation: 朋友：你发现现在生娃的少了吗 你：对 大家都不爱生了 朋友：为什么呢 你：压力大 生育率一直在降
falling fertility.example: Friend: Notice fewer people having kids? You: Yeah, people don't want to. Friend: Why? You: Pressure; fertility keeps falling.

falling in line with.context: 你说这做法跟公司一直以来的规矩是一致的，没有特别之处。
falling in line with.translation: 朋友：新这规矩会不会跟以前冲突 你：不会 跟原来一致 朋友：那就好 你：对 跟老规矩是一致的
falling in line with.example: Friend: Won't the new rule clash with the old? You: No, it lines up with it. Friend: Good. You: Yeah; it's falling in line with the old one.

falling off the wagon once or twice.context: 你说他戒了半年烟，上周朋友一递烟没忍住，又抽上了。
falling off the wagon once or twice.translation: 朋友：他不是戒烟了吗 你：戒了半年 上周又破戒了 朋友：怎么又抽上了 你：对 没忍住 又复发了
falling off the wagon once or twice.example: Friend: Didn't he quit smoking? You: Six months quit, then slipped last week. Friend: Back to it? You: Yeah; he fell off the wagon.

falling victim to.context: 你说现在老年人特别容易被卖保健品的骗子骗走养老钱。
falling victim to.translation: 朋友：我奶奶又被骗买保健品了 你：老人最容易上这种当 朋友：怎么就信了呢 你：对 老人家最容易被骗子骗
falling victim to.example: Friend: My grandma was scammed into supplements again. You: Elderly are easiest to fool. Friend: Why do they believe it? You: Yeah; they fall victim to scammers.

familiar to.context: 你说这首歌听着特别耳熟，好像在哪儿听过。
familiar to.translation: 朋友：这首歌你以前听过吗 你：耳熟 好像在哪儿听过 朋友：在哪呢 你：对 就是想不起来 似曾相识
familiar to.example: Friend: Heard this song before? You: Sounds familiar; I think I have. Friend: Where? You: Yeah; it's familiar to me.

familiar with.context: 你说这条地铁线你天天坐，闭着眼都知道哪站下。
familiar with.translation: 朋友：这条线你熟不熟 你：太熟了 天天坐 朋友：哪站换车知道吗 你：对 我熟得很
familiar with.example: Friend: Do you know this subway line well? You: So well, ride it daily. Friend: Know where to transfer? You: Yeah; I'm familiar with it.

family get together.context: 过年一大家子人聚在一起吃顿饭，特别热闹。
family get together.translation: 朋友：春节你们家怎么过 你：全家十几口人聚一桌吃饭 朋友：热闹吧 你：对 一大家人聚一起
family get together.example: Friend: How does your family spend the New Year? You: A dozen of us gather for a meal. Friend: Lively? You: Yeah; a big family get together.

family get-together.context: 你说这周要找个时间把家里人聚起来吃顿饭，好久没见了。
family get-together.translation: 朋友：这周家里有什么安排 你：约全家吃顿饭 好久没聚了 朋友：都能到齐吗 你：对 一家人聚聚
family get-together.example: Friend: Any plans for the family this week? You: Gather everyone for a meal; long time. Friend: Can everyone make it? You: Yeah; a family get-together.

family members.context: 你说你家里人不多，就爸妈和你三个人。
family members.translation: 朋友：你家几口人啊 你：就我和爸妈三个 朋友：兄弟姐妹呢 你：没有 就我们三个
family members.example: Friend: How many in your family? You: Just me and my parents, three. Friend: Siblings? You: No; just the three family members.

family origins.context: 你说爷爷那一辈是从外地迁过来的，老家其实不在这儿。
family origins.translation: 朋友：你老家是这儿的吗 你：不是 爷爷那辈搬来的 朋友：那你老家在哪儿 你：对 祖上是别处迁来的
family origins.example: Friend: Is your hometown here? You: No; grandpa moved here. Friend: Where's your root? You: Yeah; family origins are elsewhere.

family situation.context: 你说找对象人家会问家里什么情况，其实就是问家境。
family situation.translation: 朋友：相亲都问你什么呀 你：工作、家里什么情况 朋友：这是问家境吧 你：对 就是问家庭状况
family situation.example: Friend: What do they ask at blind dates? You: Job, and your family situation. Friend: That's your family background. You: Yeah; they ask about your family situation.

family tree.context: 你说爷爷家里挂着一张画了好多代人的图，一查才知道祖宗是谁。
family tree.translation: 朋友：你家墙上那张大图是什么 你：家谱 画了好多代人 朋友：能看出祖上是谁吗 你：对 家谱上写得清清楚楚
family tree.example: Friend: What's that big chart on your wall? You: The family tree, many generations. Friend: Can you trace your ancestors? You: Yeah; the family tree shows it.

famous for.context: 你说那座小城因为一道名菜而出名，全国人都知道。
famous for.translation: 朋友：那座城市有什么特别的 你：就因为一道菜出名 朋友：哪道菜啊 你：对 那城市以吃闻名
famous for.example: Friend: What's special about that city? You: It's famous for one dish. Friend: Which one? You: Yeah; it's famous for its food.

fan wildfire.context: 你说天干物燥，一点点火星都可能把整片林子点着。
fan wildfire.translation: 朋友：这么久不下雨 山里安全吗 你：不安全 一点火星都能烧起来 朋友：那可得小心 你：对 风大还会助长火势
fan wildfire.example: Friend: So dry, are the hills safe? You: No; a spark could set them alight. Friend: Be careful then. You: Yeah; wind would fan the wildfire.

fantasy sports.context: 你朋友爱打球，每周在网上组个虚拟队跟别人比赛，特别投入。
fantasy sports.translation: 朋友：你朋友周末干嘛老对着电脑 你：他在网上组球队比赛 朋友：这也算打球吗 你：对 就是那种梦幻联赛
fantasy sports.example: Friend: Why is your friend glued to the PC on weekends? You: He drafts a team online. Friend: Is that really sports? You: Yeah; it's fantasy sports.

far more.context: 你说这家店比那家贵多了，但东西确实也好不少。
far more.translation: 朋友：这家比那家贵多少啊 你：贵多了 差不多两倍 朋友：东西值这个价吗 你：对 好不少
far more.example: Friend: How much pricier is this one? You: Far more, almost double. Friend: Worth it? You: Yeah; far more worth it.

far more likely.context: 你说不睡觉的人比好好睡觉的人，更容易生病。
far more likely.translation: 朋友：熬夜真的对身体不好吗 你：对 熬夜的人更容易生病 朋友：有多容易 你：对 风险高很多
far more likely.example: Friend: Is staying up really bad for you? You: Yeah; night owls get sick more. Friend: How much more? You: Yeah; far more likely to fall ill.

far removed from.context: 你说现在的手机跟十年前比，几乎是完全不一样的东西了。
far removed from.translation: 朋友：这手机跟你以前那个比 你：差多少啊 你：完全不是一回事了 朋友：进步真大 你：对 跟以前截然不同
far removed from.example: Friend: How does this phone compare to your old one? You: It's a world of difference. Friend: What a leap. You: Yeah; far removed from what it used to be.

far too.context: 你说今天外面太冷了，出门得裹上最厚的那件外套。
far too.translation: 朋友：今天出去穿什么 你：太冷了 得穿最厚的 朋友：有多冷 你：对 冷得不行
far too.example: Friend: What to wear out today? You: Freezing, wear the thickest coat. Friend: How cold? You: Yeah; far too cold.

far-flung communities.context: 你说送书到那些山里的村子特别难，路远得很。
far-flung communities.translation: 朋友：那些偏远村子怎么送物资 你：山路绕好久才能到 朋友：真不方便 你：对 都是特别偏远的地方
far-flung communities.example: Friend: How do supplies reach those mountain villages? You: Long windy mountain roads. Friend: So inconvenient. You: Yeah; such far-flung communities.

farming practices.context: 你回老家看爷爷种地，发现他们的种法跟书上写的不太一样。
farming practices.translation: 朋友：你爷爷怎么种地的 你：就靠老法子 一年年这么种 朋友：跟书上一样吗 你：对 都是老辈传下的种法
farming practices.example: Friend: How does your grandfather farm? You: Old ways, year after year. Friend: Like the books? You: Yeah; traditional farming practices.

fascinating failure.context: 你说那家公司第一次创业虽然失败了，但积累的经验特别值钱。
fascinating failure.translation: 朋友：他那次创业不是黄了吗 你：黄了 但他说收获特别大 朋友：失败也有收获吗 你：对 虽然输了 但学到很多
fascinating failure.example: Friend: Didn't that startup of his fail? You: Yes, but he says he gained a lot. Friend: Value in failure? You: Yeah; a fascinating failure with lessons.

fashion footprint.context: 你说买一件衣服看着便宜，从做出来到扔掉其实对环境影响很大。
fashion footprint.translation: 朋友：你老说买衣服不好 为什么 你：做衣服本身就特别耗资源 朋友：这就是说的什么足迹吧 你：对 衣服也有环境足迹
fashion footprint.example: Friend: Why do you say buying clothes is bad? You: Making clothes is so resource-heavy. Friend: That footprint thing? You: Yeah; the fashion footprint.

fashion industry.context: 你说那些大牌总部都挤在那几个城市，带动了一整条街的生意。
fashion industry.translation: 朋友：那几个城市凭什么那么时髦 你：大牌都扎堆在那儿 朋友：什么行业这么火 你：对 就是时尚行业
fashion industry.example: Friend: Why are those cities so fashionable? You: Big brands all cluster there. Friend: What industry? You: Yeah; the fashion industry.

fashion innocent.context: 你说朋友刚工作不久，穿搭特别朴素，完全不讲究。
fashion innocent.translation: 朋友：你朋友平时怎么穿啊 你：随便穿 根本不懂搭配 朋友：他完全不懂时尚吗 你：对 就是个时尚小白
fashion innocent.example: Friend: How does your friend usually dress? You: Random, no styling at all. Friend: Totally clueless about fashion? You: Yeah; a real fashion innocent.

fashion rule.context: 你朋友特别讲究穿搭，说什么场合就该穿什么衣服，不能乱穿。
fashion rule.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么穿什么都那么讲究 你：他说不同场合有不同规矩 朋友：连这个都有讲究 你：对 有讲究穿搭的规矩
fashion rule.example: Friend: Why is your friend so precise in dressing? You: He says each occasion has rules. Friend: Even that? You: Yeah; there are fashion rules.

fashion style.context: 你朋友穿搭特别有自己一套，走在街上一眼就能认出是他。
fashion style.translation: 朋友：你朋友穿衣风格挺特别啊 你：对 就他那一套 别人学不来 朋友：一眼能认出他 你：对 风格特别鲜明
fashion style.example: Friend: Your friend has a unique style. You: Yeah, his own thing, hard to copy. Friend: You'd spot him instantly. You: Yeah; a distinct fashion style.

fashion victim.context: 你说他为了赶时髦，硬穿不适合自己的衣服，看着特别别扭。
fashion victim.translation: 朋友：他今天这身穿着不搭啊 你：硬跟潮流穿的 不适合他 朋友：看着怪别扭的 你：对 就是赶时髦赶过头了
fashion victim.example: Friend: His outfit today doesn't suit him. You: He forced the trend, doesn't fit. Friend: Looks awkward. You: Yeah; a total fashion victim.

fast fashion.context: 你说现在衣服便宜得很，穿两次就扔，大家买得特别快。
fast fashion.translation: 朋友：你怎么衣服穿两次就不要了 你：便宜嘛 不喜欢就换 朋友：这样买得也太快了 你：对 都是快时尚
fast fashion.example: Friend: Why ditch clothes after wearing twice? You: Cheap; switch when bored. Friend: You buy so fast. You: Yeah; it's fast fashion.

fast fashion waste.context: 你说快时尚穿两次就扔，堆出的旧衣服山特别吓人。
fast fashion waste.translation: 朋友：那些穿旧的衣服都扔哪了 你：堆成山了 没人要 朋友：这也太浪费了 你：对 旧衣服堆成山
fast fashion waste.example: Friend: Where do all those worn-out clothes go? You: Piled up, unwanted. Friend: Such waste. You: Yeah; fast fashion waste piles up.

fast food.context: 你说忙起来没时间做饭，一日三顿全靠汉堡薯条对付。
fast food.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天点汉堡 你：太忙了 没空做饭 朋友：老吃这个对身体不好 你：对 都是快餐
fast food.example: Friend: Why burgers every day lately? You: Too busy to cook. Friend: Bad for you. You: Yeah; all fast food.

fast forward.context: 你说看录像的时候，遇到前面无聊部分就直接往前跳。
fast forward.translation: 朋友：这录像前面好长一段没意思 你：直接往后跳呗 朋友：怎么跳那么快 你：对 快进过去
fast forward.example: Friend: The first part of the video is boring. You: Just skip ahead. Friend: How'd you jump so far? You: Yeah; fast forward through it.

fast rule.context: 你说公司有条死规矩，迟到一次就扣钱，谁都不能例外。
fast rule.translation: 朋友：迟到一次扣多少钱啊 你：公司规定的 迟到就扣 朋友：商量一下行不行 你：对 这是死规矩
fast rule.example: Friend: How much for being late? You: Company rule, fines you. Friend: Can we talk around it? You: Yeah; it's a hard and fast rule.

fast-fashion textile.context: 你说那些便宜衣服大多是化纤做的，扔了很难降解。
fast-fashion textile.translation: 朋友：你这衣服料子摸着怪怪的 你：化纤的 便宜嘛 朋友：这种料子环保吗 你：对 不好降解
fast-fashion textile.example: Friend: Your fabric feels odd. You: Synthetic, it's cheap. Friend: Is it eco-friendly? You: Yeah; it's cheap fast-fashion textile.

fast-paced world.context: 你说现在上班节奏快得很，一整天下来根本停不下来。
fast-paced world.translation: 朋友：你这日子过得也太快了 你：早上一睁眼就忙 一直到下班 朋友：连喘口气的空都没有 你：对 都是快节奏
fast-paced world.example: Friend: Your life is so fast-paced. You: Up at dawn, busy till off work. Friend: No time to breathe. You: Yeah; it's a fast-paced world.

fatal accident.context: 新闻里说高速上出了严重车祸，人没救过来，你听了特别难受。
fatal accident.translation: 朋友：新闻里那起车祸你看了吗 你：看了 人没了 太可怜了 朋友：怎么会这么严重 你：对 出了人命的大事故
fatal accident.example: Friend: Did you see that crash on the news? You: Yeah, someone died; so sad. Friend: How so serious? You: Yeah; a fatal accident.

faulty equipment.context: 你说那台老打印机老是卡纸，公司决定换一台新的。
faulty equipment.translation: 朋友：这打印机怎么又坏了 你：老出毛病 该换了 朋友：修不好吗 你：对 机器本身就有问题
faulty equipment.example: Friend: Why is the printer broken again? You: Always faulty; time to replace. Friend: Can't fix? You: Yeah; it's faulty equipment.

faux meat.context: 你说现在素食店有一种做出来跟肉一个味的假肉，特别神奇。
faux meat.translation: 朋友：你盘子里这块是肉吗 你：不是 是素的 做的跟肉一样 朋友：吃起来真一样吗 你：对 味道跟肉几乎一样
faux meat.example: Friend: Is that meat on your plate? You: No, plant-based, tastes like meat. Friend: Really the same? You: Yeah; it's faux meat.

fawn over.context: 你说新领导一来，大家都抢着表现，围着他转。
fawn over.translation: 朋友：新领导来了大家怎么都那么热情 你：都抢着讨好他呗 朋友：至于吗 你：对 都围着他转
fawn over.example: Friend: Why is everyone so warm to the new boss? You: All fawning over him. Friend: Really? You: Yeah; they fawn over him.

fear not.context: 你朋友第一次上台演讲紧张得发抖，你在台下小声给他打气：别怕。
fear not.translation: 朋友：他在台上抖什么呢 你：第一次演讲 紧张 朋友：你给他加油 你：别怕 你能行
fear not.example: Friend: Why is he shaking on stage? You: First speech, nervous. Friend: Cheer him on. You: Fear not; you can do it.

fear of heights.context: 你朋友坐摩天轮到最高处吓得不敢动，说自己天生怕高。
fear of heights.translation: 朋友：你在摩天轮顶上怎么僵住了 你：太高了 我腿软 朋友：你有恐高症啊 你：对 我就是怕高
fear of heights.example: Friend: Why freeze at the top of the Ferris wheel? You: Too high; my legs are weak. Friend: You're afraid of heights. You: Yeah; I have a fear of heights.

fear of missing out.context: 你说一到周末不刷手机就怕错过朋友的消息，越刷越停不下来。
fear of missing out.translation: 朋友：你怎么老刷手机看群消息 你：怕错过大家聊什么 朋友：这病叫什么来着 你：对 就是怕错过
fear of missing out.example: Friend: Why keep checking group chats? You: Afraid to miss what folks say. Friend: What's that called? You: Yeah; it's the fear of missing out.

feast on.context: 朋友来你家乡玩，你带他把当地特色菜点了个遍，大吃一顿。
feast on.translation: 朋友：今天这顿太丰盛了 你：带你来尝尝我们这儿的特色 朋友：每样都好吃 你：对 敞开吃一顿
feast on.example: Friend: Today's feast is lavish. You: Tried our local specialties. Friend: Every dish is great. You: Yeah; let's feast on them.

feed into.context: 你说每个月攒下的那点钱，慢慢变成了一笔不小的存款。
feed into.translation: 朋友：你攒的钱怎么越攒越多 你：每个月存一点 慢慢就多了 朋友：这些钱都去哪了 你：对 一点点攒起来
feed into.example: Friend: How did your savings grow? You: A little each month builds up. Friend: Where does it all go? You: Yeah; it feeds into my savings.

feeding ground.context: 你说河边那片草地一到傍晚，就聚来好多小鸟找吃的。
feeding ground.translation: 朋友：河边那么多鸟在干嘛 你：找吃的呢 朋友：怎么都聚在那儿 你：对 那是它们找食的地方
feeding ground.example: Friend: What are all those birds by the river doing? You: Looking for food. Friend: Why gather there? You: Yeah; it's their feeding ground.

feel at ease.context: 你说在朋友家待着特别放松，像在自己家一样自在。
feel at ease.translation: 朋友：来我家别客气 随便坐 你：在你这儿真的特别舒服 朋友：那就多来玩 你：对 自在得很
feel at ease.example: Friend: Make yourself at home. You: I really feel at ease here. Friend: Come often then. You: Yeah; I feel so at ease.

feel compelled to.context: 你说看到别人都报名了，自己也忍不住想跟着报。
feel compelled to.translation: 朋友：大家都报那个班了 你：是吧 我也想跟着报一个 朋友：你是真想去还是跟风 你：对 看别人都去我也想去
feel compelled to.example: Friend: Everyone signed up for that class. You: Yeah, I feel like joining too. Friend: Genuinely or just following? You: Yeah; I feel compelled to.

feel down.context: 你说朋友这几天话特别少，看着情绪不太高。
feel down.translation: 朋友：你这两天怎么话这么少 你：也没什么 就是心情不太好 朋友：怎么了 你：对 就是情绪有点低落
feel down.example: Friend: So quiet these two days? You: Nothing, just low mood. Friend: What's up? You: Yeah; I feel down.

feel obliged to.context: 你说朋友帮过你大忙，这次他生日你觉得必须回请一顿。
feel obliged to.translation: 朋友：他上次帮了你那么多 你：所以这生日我得好好请他 朋友：是该表示表示 你：对 觉得有这个义务
feel obliged to.example: Friend: He helped you so much last time. You: So I must treat his birthday. Friend: You should show gratitude. You: Yeah; I feel obliged to.

feel the pinch.context: 你说这个月花超了，最近手头紧，连奶茶都舍不得喝。
feel the pinch.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不喝奶茶了 你：这个月花超了 手头紧 朋友：那省着点花 你：对 最近真的很紧
feel the pinch.example: Friend: Why no milk tea lately? You: Overspent this month; feeling the pinch. Friend: Spend less then. You: Yeah; really pinched right now.

feel the urge to.context: 你说一到晚上就特别想吃点甜的，不吃总觉得少点什么。
feel the urge to.translation: 朋友：你怎么大半夜又翻零食 你：一到晚上就馋甜的 朋友：这是想吃东西了 你：对 特别有冲动
feel the urge to.example: Friend: Why dig for snacks again at midnight? You: Crave something sweet at night. Friend: That's a craving. You: Yeah; I feel the urge to snack.

feel valued.context: 你说在现在这家公司干得特别有劲，因为领导常常夸你、认可你。
feel valued.translation: 朋友：你最近上班怎么这么开心 你：领导常夸我 觉得自己被重视 朋友：这种感觉好 你：对 被重视真的很重要
