feel valued.example: Friend: Why so happy at work lately? You: Boss praises me; I feel valued. Friend: That feeling matters. You: Yeah; feeling valued is key.

feel-good factor.context: 你说周末跟朋友出去玩一天，整个人心情都特别好。
feel-good factor.translation: 朋友：你这周末玩得怎么样 你：特别开心 心情一下就好了 朋友：出去玩就是解压 你：对 整个人都放松了
feel-good factor.example: Friend: How was your weekend outing? You: So joyful; mood lifted. Friend: Outings really lift you. You: Yeah; a real feel-good factor.

feel-good treat.context: 你说不开心的时候，一块蛋糕就能把自己哄好。
feel-good treat.translation: 朋友：你一难过就吃蛋糕吗 你：对 一块甜的就舒服了 朋友：蛋糕这么管用 你：对 就是我的治愈美食
feel-good treat.example: Friend: Do you eat cake when sad? You: Yeah, something sweet cheers me. Friend: Cake works that well? You: Yeah; it's my feel-good treat.

feeling of belonging.context: 你说来到新城市交了几个好朋友后，终于有了归属感。
feeling of belonging.translation: 朋友：你来这边多久了 还习惯吗 你：现在交了朋友 踏实多了 朋友：找到家的感觉了 你：对 有归属感了
feeling of belonging.example: Friend: How long since you moved; settled in? You: Made friends now, much steadier. Friend: Feel at home? You: Yeah; I have a feeling of belonging.

feeling under the weather.context: 你说今天起来头有点晕、嗓子也不舒服，估计是要感冒了。
feeling under the weather.translation: 朋友：你今天脸色不太好 你：头有点晕 嗓子也难受 朋友：是不是着凉了 你：对 感觉不太对劲
feeling under the weather.example: Friend: You don't look well today. You: Head dizzy, throat sore. Friend: Caught a cold? You: Yeah; I'm feeling under the weather.

fell into.context: 你说不小心把刚买的手机掉地上了，屏幕摔了一道缝。
fell into.translation: 朋友：你手机屏怎么裂了 你：早上不小心掉地上了 朋友：心疼坏了吧 你：对 一松手就掉地上了
fell into.example: Friend: Why's your screen cracked? You: Accidentally dropped it this morning. Friend: Must hurt. You: Yeah; it fell onto the floor.

fellow being.context: 你说养宠物就像家里多了个小伙伴，都是活生生的生命，得好好待它。
fellow being.translation: 朋友：你把那条狗当家人啊 你：当然 它也是一条命 朋友：对动物这么上心 你：对 都该好好对待
fellow being.example: Friend: You treat that dog like family? You: Of course, it's a living being. Friend: So caring to animals. You: Yeah; fellow beings deserve care.

fence off.context: 你说那片施工地用一排栅栏圈起来，不让人随便进去。
fence off.translation: 朋友：那边怎么围起来了 你：施工地 怕人进去危险 朋友：用什么围的 你：对 拉了一排栅栏隔开
fence off.example: Friend: Why is that area fenced off? You: A site, risky to enter. Friend: With what? You: Yeah; they fenced it off.

feng shui.context: 你说装修时老人坚持把床摆在南边，说这样住得舒服。
feng shui.translation: 朋友：你家床怎么都朝南摆 你：我妈说这样摆风水好 朋友：她还信这个啊 你：对 老一辈讲究风水
feng shui.example: Friend: Why is your bed facing south? You: Mom says that brings good feng shui. Friend: She still believes that? You: Yeah; elders care about feng shui.

fermented food.context: 你说韩国人餐餐都泡菜，那种发酵过的小菜吃着特别爽。
fermented food.translation: 朋友：你吃的那个酸酸的小菜是什么 你：泡菜 发酵过的 朋友：天天吃不会腻吗 你：对 特别下饭
fermented food.example: Friend: What's that tangy side dish? You: Kimchi, fermented food. Friend: Not sick of it daily? You: Yeah; it's fermented food.

fictional fear.context: 你说看恐怖片吓得心跳加速，但你知道那都是假的。
fictional fear.translation: 朋友：你看恐怖片怕不怕 你：怕啊 心跳飞快 朋友：知道是假的还怕 你：对 那种害怕是假的
fictional fear.example: Friend: Scared watching horror flicks? You: Yeah, heart racing. Friend: Even knowing it's fake? You: Yeah; it's just fictional fear.

fictional monster.context: 你说电影里那种青面獠牙的怪物，都是编剧编出来吓唬人的。
fictional monster.translation: 朋友：电影里那个鬼长得真吓人 你：都是编出来的 现实里没有 朋友：那编剧想象力真丰富 你：对 全是虚构的怪兽
fictional monster.example: Friend: That monster in the movie is scary. You: Made up, not real. Friend: Wild imagination. You: Yeah; it's a fictional monster.

fiddle with.context: 你说朋友开会时老转笔、揪头发，坐不住。
fiddle with.translation: 朋友：他开会怎么老转笔 你：手闲不下来 老爱摆弄东西 朋友：紧张吧 你：对 就是爱摆弄
fiddle with.example: Friend: Why does he spin his pen in meetings? You: Hands can't rest; always fiddling. Friend: Nervous? You: Yeah; he just fiddles with things.

fidget off.context: 你说人一焦虑就爱抖腿，其实是身体在自己释放压力。
fidget off.translation: 朋友：你怎么老抖腿 你：一紧张就停不下来 朋友：这样好受点吗 你：对 抖一抖能缓解压力
fidget off.example: Friend: Why do you keep shaking your leg? You: Can't stop when nervous. Friend: Does it help? You: Yeah; fidgeting off the tension.

field of vision.context: 你说你坐的位置正对着黑板，看得特别清楚。
field of vision.translation: 朋友：你坐哪一排看得清吗 你：第一排 正对黑板 朋友：那看得清楚了 你：对 一眼全能看到
field of vision.example: Friend: Can you see well from your row? You: Front row, facing the board. Friend: That's clear. You: Yeah; right in my field of vision.

field trip.context: 你说学校组织去博物馆参观，一整个年级都去，还能学东西。
field trip.translation: 朋友：明天学校组织什么活动 你：去博物馆参观 实地看看 朋友：比上课有意思吧 你：对 就是一次实地考察
field trip.example: Friend: What's tomorrow's school trip? You: Visit a museum, see it real. Friend: Better than class? You: Yeah; a field trip.

fight or flight.context: 你说一遇到危险，人心里第一反应就是要么冲上去要么跑。
fight or flight.translation: 朋友：刚才那条狗冲过来你怎么愣了 你：一瞬间脑子一片空白 朋友：身体本能反应嘛 你：对 就是要么打要么逃
fight or flight.example: Friend: Why did you freeze when the dog charged? You: Mind went blank in a second. Friend: That's instinct. You: Yeah; fight or flight kicks in.

figure.context: 你说这个月花的钱比上个月多了不少，得翻翻账单看看。
figure.translation: 朋友：这个月开销大不大 你：比上个月多了好多 朋友：多了多少啊 你：对 具体数字得算算
figure.example: Friend: How's spending this month? You: Way up on last month. Friend: By how much? You: Yeah; need to check the figure.

file a patent.context: 你说自己捣鼓的那个小发明，公司决定去申请专利保护。
file a patent.translation: 朋友：你那个小发明打算怎么办 你：去申请个专利 保护起来 朋友：怕别人抄走啊 你：对 先申请专利
file a patent.example: Friend: What'll you do with your invention? You: File a patent to protect it. Friend: Afraid of copying? You: Yeah; file a patent first.

fill a position.context: 你说那个岗位空了好久，公司终于招到合适的人补上了。
fill a position.translation: 朋友：你们部门那个空缺补上了吗 你：招到人了 下周入职 朋友：挺快啊 你：对 那个岗位终于补上了
fill a position.example: Friend: Did your department fill that vacancy? You: Hired someone, starts next week. Friend: Fast. You: Yeah; the position is filled.

fill in the blanks.context: 你说考试时有一道填空题没答上来，其他都写满了。
fill in the blanks.translation: 朋友：考试那道填空你写出来了吗 你：没答出来 想不起来 朋友：可惜了 你：对 空了一格
fill in the blanks.example: Friend: Did you solve that fill-in question? You: Couldn't recall. Friend: Shame. You: Yeah; I left a blank.

fill in the blanks of.context: 你说读这段历史，正好能补上你之前不知道的那部分。
fill in the blanks of.translation: 朋友：这本书能帮你补上什么 你：正好填上我不懂的那一段 朋友：读完就全了 你：对 把空白都补上了
fill in the blanks of.example: Friend: What does this book fill in for you? You: Exactly the part I didn't know. Friend: Now it's complete. You: Yeah; it fills in the blanks.

fill in the gap.context: 你说工作后觉得大学时缺的那门课，现在自学补上了。
fill in the gap.translation: 朋友：你工作后还在学什么 你：补上学时没学的那门课 朋友：怎么突然补这个 你：对 把那个缺口填上
fill in the gap.example: Friend: What are you learning after work? You: Catching up on a missed course. Friend: Why now? You: Yeah; to fill in the gap.

fill up.context: 你说车快没油了，路过加油站赶紧加满。
fill up.translation: 朋友：你车油还够吗 你：快没了 去加点 朋友：加满吗 你：对 一次加满
fill up.example: Friend: Is your car low on gas? You: Almost empty, go fill up. Friend: Fill it full? You: Yeah; fill up the tank.

filling in.context: 你说体检时护士让你填表，一项一项填过去。
filling in.translation: 朋友：体检第一步干嘛 你：先填个表 基本信息 朋友：都填什么呀 你：对 一项项填过去
filling in.example: Friend: First step at the checkup? You: Fill in a form, basic info. Friend: What's on it? You: Yeah; filling in each part.

film buff.context: 你说朋友特别爱看电影，新片出来第一时间就去电影院看。
film buff.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么什么电影都知道 你：他是个电影迷 新片必看 朋友：这么爱电影 你：对 就是个影迷
film buff.example: Friend: How does your friend know every movie? You: He's a film buff, sees every new one. Friend: Loves films. You: Yeah; a real film buff.

film camera.context: 你说现在都用手机拍照了，可你朋友还爱用那种装胶卷的老相机。
film camera.translation: 朋友：你拿的那是什么相机啊 你：胶卷相机 特别有味道 朋友：手机不就够了吗 你：对 就是喜欢那种复古感
film camera.example: Friend: What's that camera you hold? You: A film camera, has character. Friend: Isn't the phone enough? You: Yeah; I love the film camera feel.

filter applicant.context: 你说公司招人的时候，先看简历，把不合适的先筛掉。
filter applicant.translation: 朋友：投了那么多简历有回音吗 你：不知道 HR 怎么筛的 朋友：第一步看什么 你：对 先把不合适的筛掉
filter applicant.example: Friend: Heard back after so many applications? You: Not sure how HR filters. Friend: First step? You: Yeah; they filter applicants first.

final straw.context: 你说加班加了一周，昨晚又被通知周末也得来，这就忍无可忍了。
final straw.translation: 朋友：你怎么突然发火了 你：连着加一周 周末还要来 朋友：这也太过分了 你：对 这是最后一根稻草
final straw.example: Friend: Why blow up suddenly? You: Overtime a week, now weekends too. Friend: That's too much. You: Yeah; that was the final straw.

financial burden.context: 你说一个人在外面租房子，房租就是最大的开销负担。
financial burden.translation: 朋友：一个人在外面住压力大吗 你：房租就占了一大半工资 朋友：这负担也太重了 你：对 经济压力特别大
financial burden.example: Friend: Hard living on your own? You: Rent takes most of my salary. Friend: That's a heavy load. You: Yeah; a big financial burden.

financial crisis.context: 你说新闻里讲以前那次大危机，好多人一夜之间就失业了。
financial crisis.translation: 朋友：新闻里说的那次大危机是怎么回事 你：就是经济大萧条 好多人失业 朋友：后来好起来了吗 你：对 就是那次大危机
financial crisis.example: Friend: What's that big crisis on the news? You: A financial crisis, many lost jobs. Friend: Did it recover? You: Yeah; it was the financial crisis.

financial discipline.context: 你说朋友花钱特别有计划，该花的花、不该花的绝不乱买。
financial discipline.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么月月能攒下钱 你：他花钱特别有谱 朋友：是怎么做到的 你：对 就是有自制力
financial discipline.example: Friend: How does your friend save every month? You: He spends so wisely. Friend: How? You: Yeah; he's got real financial discipline.

financial dispute.context: 你说亲戚之间因为一笔遗产闹上了法院，亲情都没了。
financial dispute.translation: 朋友：你家亲戚怎么闹上法院了 你：为了一笔钱 吵起来了 朋友：至于闹成这样吗 你：对 就是钱的纠纷
financial dispute.example: Friend: Why did your relatives go to court? You: Over a sum of money. Friend: Worth it? You: Yeah; it was a financial dispute.

financial incentive.context: 你说公司干得多就拿得多奖金，大家都特别有干劲。
financial incentive.translation: 朋友：你们公司怎么激励大家 你：干得好有额外奖金 朋友：这样大家更有动力吧 你：对 就是靠钱来激励
financial incentive.example: Friend: How does your company motivate you? You: Good work gets bonuses. Friend: That drives people. You: Yeah; a financial incentive.

financial literacy.context: 你说现在年轻人信用卡乱刷，就是因为从小没学过怎么管钱。
financial literacy.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么欠了一屁股卡债 你：不懂怎么管钱 乱刷 朋友：这方面学校不教吗 你：对 就是缺理财常识
financial literacy.example: Friend: Why is your friend in card debt? You: Doesn't manage money, swipes freely. Friend: Don't schools teach it? You: Yeah; he lacks financial literacy.

financial reward.context: 你说项目成了之后，公司给大家发了一笔厚厚的奖金作为奖励。
financial reward.translation: 朋友：项目成了有什么好处 你：发了一笔奖金 朋友：这奖励实在啊 你：对 就是物质奖励
financial reward.example: Friend: What do you get when the project lands? You: A bonus payout. Friend: Real reward. You: Yeah; a solid financial reward.

financial risk.context: 你说把积蓄全压进一个生意里，万一赔了就什么都没了。
financial risk.translation: 朋友：你敢把钱全投进去吗 你：不敢 万一赔了就完了 朋友：风险多大啊 你：对 经济风险太大
financial risk.example: Friend: Dare to put all savings in? You: No, lose it all if it fails. Friend: Huge risk. You: Yeah; big financial risk.

financial transaction.context: 你说现在出门买东西全用手机扫一下，钱就转过去了，特别方便。
financial transaction.translation: 朋友：现在怎么付钱啊 你：扫一下码 钱就过去了 朋友：连现金都不用了 你：对 都是线上交易
financial transaction.example: Friend: How do people pay now? You: Scan a code, money transfers. Friend: No cash even. You: Yeah; all digital financial transactions.

financially savvy.context: 你说朋友特别会理财，几年下来工资没多高却攒了一笔钱。
financially savvy.translation: 朋友：你朋友工资不高怎么攒下钱的 你：他特别会管钱 朋友：怎么做到的 你：对 就是理财精明
financially savvy.example: Friend: How did your friend save on a modest salary? You: He manages money so well. Friend: How? You: Yeah; he's financially savvy.

find fault with.context: 你说那个领导特别爱挑毛病，下属做什么他都能挑出错来。
find fault with.translation: 朋友：你们领导好相处吗 你：特别爱挑刺 怎么做都不满意 朋友：那也太难伺候了 你：对 老挑毛病
find fault with.example: Friend: Is your boss easy to work with? You: Always nitpicking, never satisfied. Friend: Tough to please. You: Yeah; he finds fault with everything.

fine feathers do not make fine birds.context: 你说别看他穿得普通，其实特别有本事，真是不能光看外表。
fine feathers do not make fine birds.translation: 朋友：那个人穿得普普通通的 你：别小看他 其实特别厉害 朋友：真看不出来 你：对 人不可貌相
fine feathers do not make fine birds.example: Friend: That guy dresses so plainly. You: Don't judge, he's really capable. Friend: Can't tell. You: Yeah; fine feathers don't make fine birds.

fine motor.context: 你说小孩小时候学用筷子、扣扣子，练的就是手上的精细动作。
fine motor.translation: 朋友：小孩学用筷子那么难吗 你：对啊 手上动作得慢慢练 朋友：这是练什么 你：对 就是练精细动作
fine motor.example: Friend: Is learning chopsticks hard for kids? You: Yeah; hand control takes practice. Friend: What's that training? You: Yeah; building fine motor skills.

fine motor skill.context: 你说小孩子到了一定年龄，扣扣子、画画这些小动作就熟练了。
fine motor skill.translation: 朋友：你家孩子会自己扣扣子了吗 你：会了 最近练出来的 朋友：动作越来越灵活了 你：对 精细动作练出来了
fine motor skill.example: Friend: Can your kid button his own shirt? You: Yes, just picked it up. Friend: Hands getting nimble. You: Yeah; a fine motor skill developed.

finish off.context: 你说这点活儿半小时就能干完，赶紧弄完得了。
finish off.translation: 朋友：这点活还要干多久 你：快了 一会儿就搞定 朋友：加油 弄完就休息 你：对 赶紧干完
finish off.example: Friend: How much longer on this? You: Almost done, finishing up. Friend: Finish and rest. You: Yeah; let's finish off.

finite verb.context: 你说英语句子里那个有时态变化的动词，才是真正的谓语核心。
finite verb.translation: 朋友：一个句子里哪个词是核心啊 你：那个有时态变化的动词 朋友：为什么 你：对 它才是句子的关键
finite verb.example: Friend: Which word is the core of a sentence? You: The verb that changes tense. Friend: Why? You: Yeah; it's the finite verb.

firm grasp.context: 你说朋友对那门学问掌握得特别扎实，问什么都难不倒他。
firm grasp.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么什么都懂 你：他对那方面研究得特别透 朋友：是真本事啊 你：对 掌握得特别牢
firm grasp.example: Friend: Why does your friend know everything? You: He masters that field deeply. Friend: Real skill. You: Yeah; a firm grasp of it.

first aid.context: 你说家里药箱里得备点创可贴消毒水，万一有人小伤能马上处理。
first aid.translation: 朋友：你家药箱里都放什么 你：创可贴、消毒水 朋友：备这些干嘛 你：对 万一受伤能先处理
first aid.example: Friend: What's in your first-aid kit? You: Bandages, antiseptic. Friend: Why keep them? You: Yeah; for first aid when someone's hurt.

first ever.context: 你说这是你长这么大第一次一个人出远门，心里又紧张又兴奋。
first ever.translation: 朋友：你紧张什么呀 你：这是我头一回一个人出远门 朋友：别害怕 试试嘛 你：对 还是头一回呢
first ever.example: Friend: Why so nervous? You: It's my first ever solo trip. Friend: Don't be, give it a go. You: Yeah; it's my first ever.

first impression.context: 你说面试时头几分钟的表现特别关键，第一印象定了后面就难改。
first impression.translation: 朋友：面试穿什么重要吗 你：重要 头几分钟就定了印象 朋友：那得收拾得体点 你：对 第一印象很重要
first impression.example: Friend: Does interview dress matter? You: Yeah; the first minutes set the impression. Friend: Dress well then. You: Yeah; the first impression counts.

first off.context: 你说要办这件事，第一步先得把材料备齐，别的往后再说。
first off.translation: 朋友：办这件事第一步干嘛 你：先把材料备齐 朋友：然后呢 你：对 先把最要紧的办了
first off.example: Friend: What's the first step for this? You: First off, gather the papers. Friend: Then? You: Yeah; first off, get the essentials.

first reaction.context: 你说看到朋友突然出现在门口，第一反应就是吓一跳。
first reaction.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么叫出声了 你：他突然冒出来 吓我一跳 朋友：那是本能反应 你：对 第一反应就是吓一跳
first reaction.example: Friend: Why did you yelp? You: He popped out of nowhere, startled me. Friend: That's instinct. You: Yeah; my first reaction was a jump.

first thing.context: 你说早上起来第一件事就是喝水，别的都往后放。
first thing.translation: 朋友：你起床先干嘛 你：先喝一大杯水 朋友：为什么先喝水 你：对 这是每天第一件事
first thing.example: Friend: What do you do first on waking? You: Drink a big glass of water. Friend: Why first? You: Yeah; it's the first thing.

first-class degree.context: 你说朋友特别厉害，大学四年门门高分，最后拿了最高的学位。
first-class degree.translation: 朋友：你朋友学习那么好最后拿了什么学位 你：最高那档 门门都优秀 朋友：太牛了 你：对 一等学位
first-class degree.example: Friend: What degree did your brilliant friend get? You: The top grade, straight honors. Friend: Amazing. You: Yeah; a first-class degree.

fit around.context: 你说你上班时间灵活，朋友约你可以挑你不忙的时候见。
fit around.translation: 朋友：你什么时候方便出来聚 你：我时间灵活 挑我不忙的时候 朋友：那约哪天都行 你：对 迁就你时间
fit around.example: Friend: When are you free to meet? You: My hours are flexible; pick a slow day. Friend: Any day then. You: Yeah; I can fit around your schedule.

fit for purpose.context: 你说买个工具不能光看便宜，关键是好不好用、派不派得上用场。
fit for purpose.translation: 朋友：这个便宜买哪个 你：便宜不管用 也不能买 朋友：那要看什么 你：对 得看好不好用
fit for purpose.example: Friend: Which cheap one to buy? You: Cheap but useless is no good. Friend: Then what matters? You: Yeah; it must fit for purpose.

fit in.context: 你说刚进新班时谁都不认识，过了半学期才慢慢熟起来。
fit in.translation: 朋友：你到新班适应了吗 你：刚去谁都不熟 现在好多了 朋友：慢慢就熟了 你：对 终于融入进去了
fit in.example: Friend: Settled in the new class? You: At first, no one to know; better now. Friend: Takes time. You: Yeah; I fit in at last.

fit in with.context: 你说新同事性格随和，跟大家很快就处到一块儿了。
fit in with.translation: 朋友：新来的同事好相处吗 你：特别随和 跟谁都聊得来 朋友：融入得真快 你：对 跟大家处得来
fit in with.example: Friend: Is the new colleague easy to get along with? You: So easy, chats with everyone. Friend: Blended in fast. You: Yeah; she fits in with the team.

fit into.context: 你说这个箱子大小正好能塞进行李架，出门带着特别方便。
fit into.translation: 朋友：你这箱子能塞得上飞机吗 你：正好 大小刚合适 朋友：那带着方便 你：对 正好塞进去
fit into.example: Friend: Will this bag fit the plane rack? You: Exactly, just the right size. Friend: Handy then. You: Yeah; it fits into the rack.

fit sb in.context: 你说医生这周号满了，但听说你急着看，帮你加塞了一个。
fit sb in.translation: 朋友：你这病能看上医生吗 你：约满了 医生给加了个号 朋友：真幸运 你：对 挤进去了一个号
fit sb in.example: Friend: Can you see the doctor for this? You: Booked up, but squeezed me in. Friend: Lucky. You: Yeah; he fit me in.

fit the bill.context: 你说这个岗位要能写又能说，那个新来的同事正好两样都行。
fit the bill.translation: 朋友：那个新同事能胜任吗 你：正好能写又能说 朋友：太合适了 你：对 正合要求
fit the bill.example: Friend: Can the new hire handle it? You: Writes and speaks, both solid. Friend: Perfect fit. You: Yeah; she fits the bill.

fit through.context: 你说这家具拆成零件后，才塞得进那扇窄门。
fit through.translation: 朋友：这个大家具怎么搬进去 你：拆了再塞进去 朋友：门太窄了 你：对 拆了才能过
fit through.example: Friend: How move this big furniture in? You: Take it apart to fit through. Friend: Door's too narrow. You: Yeah; it can only fit through when apart.

fit together.context: 你说这几个零件咔哒一拼，就装成了一个小玩具。
fit together.translation: 朋友：这个小玩具怎么装起来 你：几个零件拼一块就行 朋友：严丝合缝吗 你：对 一拼就装上了
fit together.example: Friend: How do you assemble this toy? You: Snap the pieces together. You: Snug fit? You: Yeah; the pieces fit together.

fit with.context: 你说这辆新车自带倒车影像，后面有障碍就报警。
fit with.translation: 朋友：你新车有倒车影像吗 你：有 后面有东西就响 朋友：这个配置挺实用 你：对 自带这个功能
fit with.example: Friend: Does your new car have a rear camera? You: Yes, beeps if something's behind. Friend: Practical feature. You: Yeah; it's fitted with one.

fit you in.context: 你说牙医这两天排满了，但愿意帮你插一个空档。
fit you in.translation: 朋友：你能约上那个牙医吗 你：排满了 他愿意给我加个空档 朋友：那就好 你：对 挤出个空档
fit you in.example: Friend: Could you book the dentist? You: Full, but he'll fit me in. Friend: Good. You: Yeah; he'll fit you in at a gap.

fitness junkie.context: 你说朋友一天不进健身房就浑身难受，简直是个健身迷。
fitness junkie.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么天天泡健身房 你：一天不去就难受 朋友：这也太拼了 你：对 就是个健身狂
fitness junkie.example: Friend: Why is your friend at the gym daily? You: Feels off skipping a day. Friend: So intense. You: Yeah; a real fitness junkie.

fitness lover.context: 你说朋友周末不去逛街，就爱去健身房练一身汗。
fitness lover.translation: 朋友：你朋友周末都干嘛 你：就爱泡健身房 朋友：这么爱锻炼 你：对 就是个健身迷
fitness lover.example: Friend: What does your friend do on weekends? You: Just loves the gym. Friend: So into exercise. You: Yeah; a keen fitness lover.

fitness regime.context: 你说朋友给自己定了一套系统的锻炼计划，连吃什么都安排好。
fitness regime.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么练得那么壮 你：他有一套完整的计划 朋友：吃得也讲究 你：对 一套健身方案
fitness regime.example: Friend: How's your friend so muscular? You: He follows a full plan. Friend: Diet too. You: Yeah; a real fitness regime.

fitness tracker.context: 你说朋友手腕上戴了个小东西，能记步数、测心跳。
fitness tracker.translation: 朋友：你手上戴的那是什么 你：记步数 测心跳的 朋友：这是什么东西 你：对 就是个健身手环
fitness tracker.example: Friend: What's that on your wrist? You: Tracks steps and heart rate. Friend: What's it called? You: Yeah; a fitness tracker.

fits into.context: 你说新同事性格随和，很快就跟整个团队处到了一起。
fits into.translation: 朋友：新来的跟大家合得来吗 你：特别随和 跟谁都行 朋友：这么快就融入了 你：对 很快就融入了
fits into.example: Friend: Does the new one click with everyone? You: Easygoing, fine with all. Friend: Blended so fast. You: Yeah; he fits into the team well.

fits the bill.context: 你说要招一个会拍照又会写文案的人，她正好两样都在行。
fits the bill.translation: 朋友：她能胜任这岗位吗 你：会拍又会写 正合适 朋友：太对口了 你：对 正好符合要求
fits the bill.example: Friend: Is she right for the role? You: Shoots and writes, just right. Friend: Perfect match. You: Yeah; she fits the bill.

fits with.context: 你说他的性格跟这工作特别配，干起来得心应手。
fits with.translation: 朋友：他干这份工作顺手吗 你：性格就适合这个 干起来特顺 朋友：人岗特别匹配 你：对 正好相配
fits with.example: Friend: Is he suited to this job? You: His personality fits it; he's smooth. Friend: Great match. You: Yeah; he fits with the role.

five-a-day diet.context: 你说医生让你每天吃够五种蔬菜水果，对身体特别好。
five-a-day diet.translation: 朋友：医生让你怎么吃 你：每天五种蔬果 朋友：这么多吗 你：对 就是每日五果蔬
five-a-day diet.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you to eat? You: Five fruits and veggies a day. Friend: That much? You: Yeah; a five-a-day diet.

five-star hotel.context: 你说这次生日想奢侈一把，住一晚那种带泳池的高级酒店。
five-star hotel.translation: 朋友：这次生日想怎么过 你：住一晚那种带泳池的酒店 朋友：档次挺高啊 你：对 就是五星酒店
five-star hotel.example: Friend: How to spend this birthday? You: Stay one night at a pool hotel. Friend: Fancy. You: Yeah; a five-star hotel.

fixed costs.context: 你说开店哪怕一天没客人，房租水电这些钱也照付，省不掉。
fixed costs.translation: 朋友：开店一天没生意也亏钱吗 你：对 房租水电照付 朋友：这些是跑不掉的开销 你：对 就是固定成本
fixed costs.example: Friend: Losing money even on an empty day? You: Yeah, rent and utilities still due. Friend: Those unavoidable costs. You: Yeah; fixed costs.

fixed expense.context: 你说每个月房租是雷打不动的一笔钱，得先留出来。
fixed expense.translation: 朋友：你每个月必花的钱有哪些 你：房租是大头 一分不少 朋友：这就是雷打不动的开销 你：对 固定支出
fixed expense.example: Friend: What do you must spend monthly? You: Rent is the big chunk, fixed. Friend: That steady expense. You: Yeah; a fixed expense.

fixed mindset.context: 你说朋友老觉得自己天生笨、学不会新东西，不敢尝试。
fixed mindset.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么不学点新技能 你：他觉得自己天生学不会 朋友：这想法不对啊 你：对 就是固化思维
fixed mindset.example: Friend: Why doesn't your friend learn new skills? You: He thinks he's born unable. Friend: Wrong mindset. You: Yeah; a fixed mindset.

fixed-penalty notice.context: 你说你上次违章停车，交警直接给了你一张罚单让你去交钱。
fixed-penalty notice.translation: 朋友：你停车没在车位上被罚了 你：对 交警给了张罚单 朋友：罚了多少 你：对 就是张罚款单
fixed-penalty notice.example: Friend: Got fined for parking off the spot? You: Yeah; the cop gave me a ticket. Friend: How much? You: Yeah; a fixed-penalty notice.

fizzle out.context: 你说当初兴致勃勃开的那家小店，撑了半年就悄无声息地关了。
fizzle out.translation: 朋友：你那店后来怎么样了 你：开了半年 慢慢就不做了 朋友：怎么就没下文了 你：对 虎头蛇尾地结束了
fizzle out.example: Friend: How's that shop of yours? You: Ran half a year, quietly faded. Friend: Just fizzled. You: Yeah; it fizzled out.

fizzy drink.context: 你说大热天最想喝一瓶冰镇的带气泡的饮料，特别解渴。
fizzy drink.translation: 朋友：大夏天你最想喝什么 你：冰镇带气泡的那种 朋友：喝着爽吧 你：对 就是汽水
fizzy drink.example: Friend: What do you crave in the heat? You: An icy bubbly drink. Friend: Refreshing. You: Yeah; a fizzy drink.

flagging down.context: 你说在路边举着手拦了半天，才终于有一辆出租车停下来。
flagging down.translation: 朋友：你怎么去的车站 你：在路边拦了半天车 朋友：好打吗 你：对 好不容易拦下来一辆
flagging down.example: Friend: How did you get to the station? You: Hailed a cab on the road. Friend: Easy? You: Yeah; flagging down a taxi.

flake on.context: 你说约好的事他临时不来了，让你白等了一场。
flake on.translation: 朋友：你们约好吃饭他怎么没来 你：临时说不来了 放我鸽子 朋友：这人怎么这样 你：对 就爱爽约
flake on.example: Friend: Why didn't he show for the meal? You: Bailed last minute on me. Friend: How rude. You: Yeah; he flaked on me.

flake out on sb.context: 你说跟那个朋友约好一起旅游，结果他临时不去了，机票都白买。
flake out on sb.translation: 朋友：你们旅行去成了吗 你：他临时不去了 就我一人去的 朋友：白瞎了一张票 你：对 放我鸽子
flake out on sb.example: Friend: Did your trip happen? You: He bailed last minute; I went alone. Friend: Wasted a ticket. You: Yeah; he flaked out on me.

flash card.context: 你说背单词就把生词写在小卡片上，一面写英文一面写中文。
flash card.translation: 朋友：你怎么背单词这么快 你：我把生词写在小卡片上 朋友：怎么用这卡片 你：对 一面写一面背
flash card.example: Friend: How do you memorize words so fast? You: I put new words on small cards. Friend: How? You: Yeah; using flash cards.

flash flood.context: 新闻里说山里突降暴雨，大水一下子从山上冲下来，特别吓人。
flash flood.translation: 朋友：新闻里那场山洪怎么来的 你：突然下暴雨 水一下子冲下来 朋友：太突然了 你：对 就是山洪
flash flood.example: Friend: How did that flash flood happen? You: Sudden rain, water rushed down. Friend: So sudden. You: Yeah; a flash flood.

flash flooding.context: 你说那天下暴雨，街上一下就积了齐膝的水，车都开不过去。
flash flooding.translation: 朋友：那天下雨街上怎么样 你：水一下子积到膝盖 车都动不了 朋友：太吓人了 你：对 就是突发的大水
flash flooding.example: Friend: What were the streets like in that rain? You: Water rose to the knees; cars stuck. Friend: Terrifying. You: Yeah; sudden flash flooding.

flash of light.context: 你说拍照时突然一道强光闪过，眼前白了一下。
flash of light.translation: 朋友：你刚怎么眯了下眼 你：刚才有道强光闪了一下 朋友：是拍照的闪光灯吧 你：对 就是一道光闪过
flash of light.example: Friend: Why did you squint just now? You: A bright light flashed. Friend: The camera flash? You: Yeah; a flash of light.

flat organisation.context: 你说那家创业公司没有层层级别，大家直接找负责人说事，办事特别快。
flat organisation.translation: 朋友：你们公司是不是层级特别多 你：不多 扁平化 大家直接沟通 朋友：这样效率高吧 你：对 没那么多头衔
flat organisation.example: Friend: Is your company heavy on hierarchy? You: No, flat, people talk direct. Friend: More efficient. You: Yeah; a flat organisation.

flat share.context: 你说房租太贵，找了两个朋友一起合租一套，每人一间卧室。
flat share.translation: 朋友：你房租一个人扛得住吗 你：扛不住 找人合租 朋友：怎么分的 你：对 一人一间卧室
flat share.example: Friend: Can you cover the rent alone? You: No; I share the flat. Friend: How? You: Yeah; a flat share, one room each.

flat-screen tv.context: 你说家里那台老电视换成了薄薄的大屏，挂在墙上特别省地方。
flat-screen tv.translation: 朋友：你家新电视薄不薄 你：薄得很 挂墙上 不占地 朋友：跟以前那个大背投比 你：对 就是平板电视
flat-screen tv.example: Friend: Is your new TV thin? You: Really thin, mounted on the wall. Friend: Compared to that old box? You: Yeah; a flat-screen TV.

flavour of the month.context: 你说去年流行的那个网红饮品，今年没人提了，火得快去得也快。
flavour of the month.translation: 朋友：去年那个网红饮料怎么不见卖了 你：就火了一阵 现在早过气了 朋友：都是一阵风 你：对 就是一时爆款
flavour of the month.example: Friend: Where's that viral drink from last year? You: Just a craze, long gone. Friend: Fads fade fast. You: Yeah; the flavour of the month.

flavour profile.context: 你说这家店的咖啡喝起来带点坚果味，老板说这是豆子本身的特点。
flavour profile.translation: 朋友：这咖啡喝着什么味啊 你：带点坚果香 朋友：这是豆子本身的味道吧 你：对 就是它的风味特点
flavour profile.example: Friend: How does this coffee taste? You: A hint of nuts. Friend: That's the bean's character. You: Yeah; its flavour profile.

flew over to.context: 你说这次出差直接坐飞机飞过去，三个小时就到了。
flew over to.translation: 朋友：你这次怎么去那么远 你：飞过去 三个小时就到 朋友：比坐火车快多了 你：对 直接飞过去
flew over to.example: Friend: How're you going that far? You: Fly over, three hours. Friend: Faster than the train. You: Yeah; flew over to there.

flexible schedule.context: 你说你上班时间自己安排，上午不去下午来也行，特别自由。
flexible schedule.translation: 朋友：你们上班几点打卡 你：不用打卡 时间自己定 朋友：这么自由 你：对 弹性工时
flexible schedule.example: Friend: What time do you clock in? You: No clock-in, hours flexible. Friend: So free. You: Yeah; a flexible schedule.

flexible software.context: 你说公司那套软件特别灵活，想怎么调就怎么调，不像以前死死板。
flexible software.translation: 朋友：你们那办公软件好用吗 你：特别灵活 想怎么改怎么改 朋友：比以前那个强吧 你：对 就是弹性的工具
flexible software.example: Friend: Is your office software good? You: So flexible, tweak it as you like. Friend: Better than the old one. You: Yeah; flexible software.

flexible thinking.context: 你说他脑子转得快，一条路走不通马上换个思路，不死钻牛角尖。
flexible thinking.translation: 朋友：他遇到难题怎么办 你：换个思路 不钻牛角尖 朋友：脑子真活 你：对 就是思维灵活
flexible thinking.example: Friend: How does he handle hard problems? You: Switch angles, not stubborn. Friend: Nimble mind. You: Yeah; flexible thinking.

flexible working.context: 你说现在很多公司允许在家上班，一周去公司两三天就行。
flexible working.translation: 朋友：你们公司能在家上班吗 你：能 一周去两三天 朋友：这么好 你：对 就是弹性办公
flexible working.example: Friend: Can you work from home? You: Yes, in two or three days. Friend: So good. You: Yeah; flexible working.

flexitarian diet.context: 你说朋友吃素但不是全素，偶尔也吃点鱼，属于那种弹性素食。
flexitarian diet.translation: 朋友：你朋友是纯素吗 你：不是 主要吃素 偶尔吃鱼 朋友：那是什么吃法 你：对 就是弹性素食
flexitarian diet.example: Friend: Is your friend a strict vegetarian? You: No, mostly plants, fish now and then. Friend: What's that called? You: Yeah; a flexitarian diet.

flight path.context: 你说抬头看飞机划过天空，那条线就是它从起飞到降落的路线。
flight path.translation: 朋友：天上那条白线是什么 你：飞机飞过留下的轨迹 朋友：那就是它的飞行线吧 你：对 就是飞行路线
flight path.example: Friend: What's that white line in the sky? You: A plane's trail. Friend: That's its flight route. You: Yeah; its flight path.

float in space.context: 你说宇航员在空间站里整个人是飘着的，喝水都结成小球。
float in space.translation: 朋友：宇航员在太空怎么待着 你：整个人飘着 脚不沾地 朋友：喝水怎么办 你：对 就是在太空飘着
float in space.example: Friend: How do astronauts float in space? You: Whole body drifts, feet off the ground. Friend: And water? You: Yeah; they float in space.

flood risk.context: 你说住在河边地势低，一下大雨家里就可能进水，有点担心。
flood risk.translation: 朋友：你家这边下雨安全吗 你：地势低 怕淹 朋友：那可得当心 你：对 有被淹的风险
flood risk.example: Friend: Is your place safe in rain? You: Low ground, might flood. Friend: Then be careful. You: Yeah; there's a flood risk.

flooding back.context: 你说路过母校，那些上学时的画面一下子全涌回了脑子里。
flooding back.translation: 朋友：你路过学校怎么站着发呆 你：好多上学的事一下子涌上来 朋友：想当年了吧 你：对 回忆全涌上来了
flooding back.example: Friend: Why zone out by the school? You: Old school memories flooded back. Friend: Nostalgic. You: Yeah; memories came flooding back.

floor tile.context: 你说家里客厅铺了那种一块块拼起来的大方砖，好打理。
floor tile.translation: 朋友：你家客厅铺的什么砖 你：大方砖 一块块拼的 朋友：好打扫吗 你：对 就是地砖
floor tile.example: Friend: What tiles are in your living room? You: Big square floor tiles. Friend: Easy to clean? You: Yeah; they're floor tiles.

fluid intake.context: 你说天热的时候一天得喝够八杯水，别等渴了才喝。
fluid intake.translation: 朋友：天热你一天喝多少水 你：至少八杯 朋友：喝够了才不上火 你：对 得保证水分摄入
fluid intake.example: Friend: How much water do you drink in heat? You: At least eight cups. Friend: Enough keeps you well. You: Yeah; watch your fluid intake.

fluid shift.context: 你说剧烈出汗后，身体里的水分和盐分一下子跑到皮肤表层去了。
fluid shift.translation: 朋友：跑完步怎么脸一下红了 你：汗出多了 血都跑到体表 朋友：这就是身体在调节 你：对 就是体液在重新分布
fluid shift.example: Friend: Why did your face flush after running? You: Sweated a lot, blood moved to the skin. Friend: Body adjusting. You: Yeah; a fluid shift.

fluorine-carbon bond.context: 老师讲化学时说那种特别牢固的化学键，很难被打断。
fluorine-carbon bond.translation: 朋友：老师说哪种键最结实 你：一种含氟的键 特别牢 朋友：为什么牢 你：对 就是那种化学键
fluorine-carbon bond.example: Friend: Which bond did the teacher say is strongest? You: A fluorine one, really tough. Friend: Why tough? You: Yeah; it's the fluorine-carbon bond.

flush out.context: 你说警察躲在门外，等嫌疑人一出来就冲上去把他逼出来。
flush out.translation: 朋友：警察怎么抓到那个人的 你：守在门口 等他一出来就上 朋友：是把他逼出来的 你：对 把他逼了出来
flush out.example: Friend: How did the cops catch him? You: Waited outside and moved in. Friend: Flushed him out. You: Yeah; they flushed him out.

flushes out.context: 你说多喝水能把身体里的废物都冲出去，对肾好。
flushes out.translation: 朋友：为什么要多喝水 你：把身体里的废物冲出去 朋友：对肾好是吧 你：对 水把脏东西冲出来
flushes out.example: Friend: Why drink lots of water? You: It flushes the waste out. Friend: Good for kidneys. You: Yeah; it flushes out toxins.

fly into a rage.context: 你说他一听手下把事搞砸了，一下子气得脸都红了，大吼起来。
fly into a rage.translation: 朋友：他刚才怎么发那么大火 你：听说事搞砸了 一下就炸了 朋友：至于气成那样吗 你：对 就是勃然大怒
fly into a rage.example: Friend: Why was he so furious? You: Heard it all went wrong, blew up. Friend: That angry? You: Yeah; he flew into a rage.

fly off the handle.context: 你说那个老板一点就着，下属犯个小错他就跳起来骂人。
fly off the handle.translation: 朋友：你们老板脾气怎么样 你：一点就炸 骂起人来难听 朋友：谁受得了 你：对 动不动就大发雷霆
fly off the handle.example: Friend: How's your boss's temper? You: Explodes at the slightest slip. Friend: Hard to take. You: Yeah; he flies off the handle.

fly off the shelves.context: 你说那款新手机一上市就被抢光，店里货架都空了。
fly off the shelves.translation: 朋友：那款新手机好买吗 你：一上架就被抢光了 朋友：这么火 你：对 卖得跟飞一样
fly off the shelves.example: Friend: Is that new phone easy to get? You: Flew off the shelves at launch. Friend: So hot. You: Yeah; it flew off the shelves.

fly the nest.context: 你说孩子大了总要离开家自己出去闯，当爸妈的虽然舍不得也得放手。
fly the nest.translation: 朋友：你家孩子要去外地工作了 你：是啊 长大了 该自己飞了 朋友：你舍得吗 你：对 就是离巢了
fly the nest.example: Friend: Your kid's leaving for work out of town? You: Yeah, grown up, off on his own. You: Can you let go? You: Yeah; time to fly the nest.

flying off the shelves.context: 你说那本小说一出版就卖疯了，书店里天天补货都补不及。
flying off the shelves.translation: 朋友：那本小说卖得怎么样 你：卖疯了 天天补都补不及 朋友：这么畅销 你：对 卖得飞快
flying off the shelves.example: Friend: How's that novel selling? You: Flying off the shelves, restocking daily. Friend: A hit. You: Yeah; flying off the shelves.

fob off.context: 你说问他到底去不去，他老是说再看看，就是不正面回答。
fob off.translation: 朋友：他到底去不去啊 你：老说再看看 不给准话 朋友：这是在敷衍你吧 你：对 就爱搪塞
fob off.example: Friend: Is he going or not? You: Keeps saying maybe, no clear answer. Friend: He's fobbing you off. You: Yeah; he fobs me off.

focussed on.context: 你说朋友最近一门心思备考，吃饭睡觉都在想那点事。
focussed on.translation: 朋友：你朋友最近怎么不出来玩 你：在备考 一门心思看书 朋友：够专注的 你：对 全神贯注
focussed on.example: Friend: Why won't your friend hang out? You: Studying, fully focused. Friend: So dedicated. You: Yeah; he's focussed on it.

folk wisdom.context: 你说老人常说春捂秋冻，其实是一代代传下来的生活经验。
folk wisdom.translation: 朋友：老人说春捂秋冻有道理吗 你：都是老一辈传下来的说法 朋友：准不准 你：对 就是民间说法
folk wisdom.example: Friend: Is that old saying about dressing right? You: Folk wisdom passed down. Friend: Reliable? You: Yeah; it's folk wisdom.

follow fixtures.context: 你说你朋友不看直播，就爱盯着赛程表，看哪天有比赛。
follow fixtures.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么老翻赛程表 你：他就爱看哪天有比赛 朋友：他不看直播吗 你：对 就关注赛程
follow fixtures.example: Friend: Why does your friend keep checking fixtures? You: He just tracks who plays when. Friend: Doesn't watch live? You: Yeah; he follows fixtures.

follow through.context: 你说做事情不能三分钟热度，得坚持到最后才算数。
follow through.translation: 朋友：你那计划坚持得怎么样了 你：还在做 没半途而废 朋友：坚持到底就赢了 你：对 得做到底
follow through.example: Friend: How's your plan holding up? You: Still at it, not quit. Friend: See it through. You: Yeah; follow through to the end.

follow up.context: 你说面试完之后，公司还会打电话再问问情况，看你合不合适。
follow up.translation: 朋友：面试完就完事了吗 你：还会再打电话跟进 朋友：问什么呀 你：对 就是再跟进一下
follow up.example: Friend: Is the interview the end? You: They'll call to follow up. Friend: About what? You: Yeah; to follow up on you.

follow up with.context: 你说先发个邮件问一下，过两天再打个电话接着问，别断了联系。
follow up with.translation: 朋友：这事怎么跟进啊 你：先发邮件 过两天再打电话 朋友：这样人家就记得你了 你：对 接着跟进
follow up with.example: Friend: How do I follow up on this? You: Email first, then call in two days. Friend: Keeps you on their mind. You: Yeah; follow up with a call.

followed by.context: 你说先吃点开胃菜，接着才上主菜，一道一道来。
followed by.translation: 朋友：这顿饭先上什么 你：先开胃菜 再上主菜 朋友：一道一道来是吧 你：对 接着是主菜
followed by.example: Friend: What's first at this meal? You: Starters first, then the main. Friend: Course by course. You: Yeah, starters followed by the main.

fond memory.context: 你说翻到旧照片，想起小时候暑假在外婆家的那些开心日子。
fond memory.translation: 朋友：你看照片怎么笑了 你：想起小时候在外婆家的日子 朋友：那时候真开心 你：对 都是美好的回忆
fond memory.example: Friend: Why smile at the photo? You: Remembering childhood summers at grandma's. Friend: So happy then. You: Yeah; a fond memory.

food allergy.context: 你说朋友一吃海鲜就起疹子，医生说他是对某种食物过敏。
food allergy.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么一吃虾就起包 你：他对海鲜过敏 朋友：那可得忌口 你：对 就是食物过敏
food allergy.example: Friend: Why does your friend break out after shrimp? You: He's allergic to seafood. Friend: Avoid it then. You: Yeah; a food allergy.

food chain.context: 你说小草被兔子吃，兔子又被狐狸吃，一环扣一环。
food chain.translation: 朋友：动物之间谁吃谁啊 你：兔子吃草 狐狸吃兔子 朋友：一环扣一环 你：对 就是食物链
food chain.example: Friend: Who eats whom among animals? You: Rabbits eat grass, foxes eat rabbits. Friend: Linked in a chain. You: Yeah; the food chain.

food delivery apps.context: 你说现在懒得做饭，掏出手机点几下，饭就送到家门口。
food delivery apps.translation: 朋友：你今天午饭怎么解决 你：手机上点一下 送到门口 朋友：真方便 你：对 就是外卖软件
food delivery apps.example: Friend: How's lunch today? You: Tap the phone, it's at the door. Friend: So easy. You: Yeah; food delivery apps.

food envy.context: 你说朋友点了一大桌菜，自己那份看着就馋，特别羡慕。
food envy.translation: 朋友：你怎么老盯着我这盘菜 你：你点的这个看着太香了 朋友：你也点一份呗 你：对 我羡慕你的菜
food envy.example: Friend: Why keep eyeing my dish? You: Yours looks so delicious. Friend: Order one then. You: Yeah; I've got food envy.

food for thought.context: 你说老师今天讲的那句话特别有道理，回家路上还一直在琢磨。
food for thought.translation: 朋友：老师今天说什么了 你：有句话特别值得琢磨 朋友：哪句啊 你：对 发人深省
food for thought.example: Friend: What did the teacher say today? You: One line really got me thinking. Friend: Which? You: Yeah; real food for thought.

food labels.context: 你说买包装食品前，一定要翻过来看背面写的配料和保质期。
food labels.translation: 朋友：你买零食怎么老翻背面看 你：看看配料和保质期 朋友：这是看标签吧 你：对 就是食品标签
food labels.example: Friend: Why flip snacks to read the back? You: Check ingredients and expiry. Friend: That's the label. You: Yeah; the food labels.

food miles.context: 你说现在超市里的菜从外地运来，跑了几千公里才到你手里。
food miles.translation: 朋友：这菜本地不就有吗 你：这是外地运来的 跑了很远 朋友：这么远运过来 你：对 运输里程特别长
food miles.example: Friend: Isn't this local produce? You: It's shipped from far, miles away. Friend: So far. You: Yeah; long food miles.

food packaging.context: 你说现在食品外面包着一层又一层塑料，吃完扔一大堆。
food packaging.translation: 朋友：这零食外面包了几层啊 你：一层又一层 吃完全是塑料 朋友：这包装太浪费了 你：对 就是食品包装
food packaging.example: Friend: How many wrappers on this snack? You: Layer after layer, plastic trash. Friend: Such waste. You: Yeah; food packaging.

food parcel.context: 你说社区给困难家庭发米发油，一包包送到家门口。
food parcel.translation: 朋友：社区给你家送的那包是什么 你：米和油 救济用的 朋友：是给困难家庭的吧 你：对 就是救济粮包
food parcel.example: Friend: What's that pack the community dropped off? You: Rice and oil, relief. Friend: For needy families. You: Yeah; a food parcel.

food processor.context: 你说做酱的时候用那个能搅碎东西的机器，几秒钟就弄好了。
food processor.translation: 朋友：你做酱怎么这么快 你：用那个搅碎机几秒钟就好 朋友：那是什么机器 你：对 就是料理机
food processor.example: Friend: How'd you make the sauce so fast? You: That blender chops it in seconds. Friend: What machine? You: Yeah; a food processor.

food production.context: 你说中国用很少的地养了好多人，这粮食生产特别了不起。
food production.translation: 朋友：我们国家这么多人吃得饱吗 你：吃得饱 粮食生产厉害 朋友：怎么做到的 你：对 就是粮食生产
food production.example: Friend: Can we feed so many people? You: Yes, food production is strong. Friend: How? You: Yeah; our food production.

food security.context: 你说有些国家天旱地荒，老百姓连饭都吃不上，这是大问题。
food security.translation: 朋友：新闻里那些地方的人怎么饿肚子 你：地里长不出东西 朋友：这就是吃饭的问题吧 你：对 就是粮食安全
food security.example: Friend: Why are people hungry in those places? You: Crops won't grow. Friend: That's a food issue. You: Yeah; food security.

food trend.context: 你说这两年风特别大的那种燕麦奶，以前谁都没听说过。
food trend.translation: 朋友：你最近喝的燕麦奶挺新鲜 你：就这两年火起来的 朋友：这是新的饮食潮流吧 你：对 就是一种新潮流
food trend.example: Friend: That oat milk you're drinking is new. You: Just became trendy lately. Friend: A food trend. You: Yeah; the latest food trend.

food truck.context: 你说公司楼下停着一辆卖汉堡的小车，中午排队的人特别多。
food truck.translation: 朋友：中午你下楼吃的什么 你：楼下那辆卖汉堡的小车 朋友：就那辆餐车啊 你：对 就是流动餐车
food truck.example: Friend: What did you have downstairs at noon? You: That burger truck by the office. Friend: The food truck. You: Yeah; the food truck.

foot and ankle specialist.context: 你说最近脚踝老疼，朋友让你去找专门看脚的医生。
foot and ankle specialist.translation: 朋友：你脚踝疼该看什么医生 你：朋友说找专门看脚的 朋友：那是什么科 你：对 就是足踝专科
foot and ankle specialist.example: Friend: What doctor for your ankle pain? You: My friend said see a foot specialist. Friend: That's what kind? You: Yeah; a foot and ankle specialist.

footprint reduction.context: 你说少买衣服、少开车，都是在一点点减少自己对环境的影响。
footprint reduction.translation: 朋友：你老说少买东西是为了啥 你：减少对环境的影响 朋友：就是那个什么足迹吧 你：对 减少碳足迹
footprint reduction.example: Friend: Why do you keep saying buy less? You: To cut my impact on the planet. Friend: That footprint thing. You: Yeah; footprint reduction.

for a good cause.context: 你说朋友报名跑半马，是为了给慈善机构筹款，自己也锻炼了。
for a good cause.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么去跑半马了 你：为了给慈善筹款 朋友：跑个步还做善事 你：对 就是为公益
for a good cause.example: Friend: Why's your friend running a half marathon? You: To raise for charity. Friend: Running for a cause. You: Yeah; running for a good cause.

for a short time.context: 你说朋友出差就去两三天，行李带得特别少。
for a short time.translation: 朋友：你出差去多久 你：就两三天 很快回来 朋友：那行李不用带多 你：对 就去一小段时间
for a short time.example: Friend: How long's your trip? You: Just two or three days, quick. Friend: Pack light then. You: Yeah; just for a short time.

for a start.context: 你说要说这件事不好，首先钱就花得太多了，其他还在其次。
for a start.translation: 朋友：这事你怎么看 你：先说钱吧 花得太多了 朋友：这是头一个问题 你：对 首先就是钱
for a start.example: Friend: What do you think of this? You: For a start, it costs too much. Friend: The first issue. You: Yeah; for a start, the cost.

for ages.context: 你说跟小学那个好朋友好久没见了，算下来都五六年了。
for ages.translation: 朋友：你跟小学那个好朋友还有联系吗 你：好久没见了 五六年了 朋友：这么久啊 你：对 好长时间了
for ages.example: Friend: Still in touch with your primary school friend? You: Ages since we met, five or six years. Friend: That long. You: Yeah; for ages.

for any reason.context: 你说不管因为什么原因，答应别人的事就一定要做到。
for any reason.translation: 朋友：他临时有事能不算数吗 你：不行 答应了就得做到 朋友：有事也不行吗 你：对 什么原因都不行
for any reason.example: Friend: Can he break his promise if something's up? You: No; a promise is kept. Friend: Even with a reason? You: Yeah; for any reason, keep it.

for better or worse.context: 你说结了婚就是两个人一起过日子，不管以后顺不顺都一起扛。
for better or worse.translation: 朋友：你们俩打算就这么过下去吗 你：对 好赖都一起过 朋友：想好坏都说定了 你：对 无论好坏
for better or worse.example: Friend: You two plan to stay together? You: Yeah, through thick and thin. Friend: In joy and sorrow. You: Yeah; for better or worse.

for centuries.context: 你说那座老教堂盖了几百年，一辈辈人都在里面做礼拜。
for centuries.translation: 朋友：那座教堂多久了 你：盖了好几个世纪 朋友：真老啊 你：对 几个世纪了
for centuries.example: Friend: How old is that church? You: Built centuries ago. Friend: So old. You: Yeah; for centuries.

for certain.context: 你说这事我敢打包票，他肯定不会忘。
for certain.translation: 朋友：他真的会来吗 你：我敢肯定 他不会忘 朋友：你怎么这么有把握 你：对 我确定
for certain.example: Friend: Will he really come? You: For certain, he won't forget. Friend: So sure. You: Yeah; I know for certain.

for decades.context: 你说这条街上的老馆子开了几十年，从小吃到大。
for decades.translation: 朋友：这家馆子开多久了 你：几十年了 我从小吃到大 朋友：是老店啊 你：对 开了几十年
for decades.example: Friend: How long's this place been open? You: For decades, since I was a kid. Friend: An old-timer. You: Yeah; for decades.

for generations to come.context: 你说现在多保护点环境，是为了让以后的孩子也能看到蓝天。
for generations to come.translation: 朋友：现在环保这么较真干嘛 你：为了以后的孩子也能好 朋友：想得真远 你：对 为了子孙后代
for generations to come.example: Friend: Why push environmental protection so hard? You: So future kids thrive too. Friend: Thinking long. You: Yeah; for generations to come.

for hundreds of years.context: 你说那座古城已经立在那儿几百年了，看尽了朝代更替。
for hundreds of years.translation: 朋友：那座城楼多久了 你：几百年了 多少朝代都见过 朋友：真历史悠久 你：对 几百年了
for hundreds of years.example: Friend: How old is that gate tower? You: Hundreds of years, seen dynasties. Friend: So historic. You: Yeah; for hundreds of years.

for one reason or another.context: 你说那几次聚会他都没来，一会儿说忙一会儿说有事，原因说不上来。
for one reason or another.translation: 朋友：他怎么老不来聚会 你：一会儿忙一会儿有事 朋友：到底为啥 你：对 说不上什么原因
for one reason or another.example: Friend: Why does he skip every gathering? You: Busy here, busy there. Friend: What's the real reason? You: Yeah; for one reason or another.

for peanuts.context: 你说他刚工作时给人打工，一个月那点钱少得可怜。
for peanuts.translation: 朋友：他刚工作时挣多少 你：特别少 可怜巴巴 朋友：那么点怎么活 你：对 就为一点点钱
for peanuts.example: Friend: How much did he earn at first? You: Hardly anything. Friend: How did he live? You: Yeah; he worked for peanuts.

for pleasure.context: 你说他学画画不是为了当大师，就是自己喜欢、画着开心。
for pleasure.translation: 朋友：你学画画想当画家吗 你：不是 就是自己喜欢 朋友：不为了出名啊 你：对 就是图个开心
for pleasure.example: Friend: Do you paint to become a pro? You: No, just love it. Friend: Not for fame. You: Yeah; just for pleasure.

for short.context: 你说大家都叫他小李，其实小李是李什么的简称。
for short.translation: 朋友：他为什么叫小李啊 你：就是名字的简称 朋友：原名叫啥 你：对 简称小李
for short.example: Friend: Why is he called Xiao Li? You: It's short for his full name. Friend: What's the full name? You: Yeah; short for it.

for so long.context: 你说等了他好久，从中午等到下午，他才来。
for so long.translation: 朋友：你等了他多久 你：好久了 从中午等到现在 朋友：他可真能让你等 你：对 等了这么久
for so long.example: Friend: How long did you wait? You: So long, from noon till now. Friend: He really kept you waiting. You: Yeah; waited for so long.

for some time to come.context: 你说这情况接下来好一段时间都不会变，大家先适应适应。
for some time to come.translation: 朋友：这状态什么时候能好转 你：一时半会儿好不了 朋友：那得熬一阵 你：对 未来一段时间都这样
for some time to come.example: Friend: When will this improve? You: Not for a while yet. Friend: Then we wait. You: Yeah; for some time to come.

for that matter.context: 你说他自己都不去，更别说让他带朋友去了。
for that matter.translation: 朋友：他会带朋友一起去吗 你：他自己都不去 朋友：那朋友更不会去了 你：对 他自己都不去 更别说别人了
for that matter.example: Friend: Will he bring friends along? You: He won't even go himself. Friend: Then friends won't either. You: Yeah; he won't go, and for that matter, no one else.

for the better.context: 你说换了新领导之后，部门的风气一下就好了起来。
for the better.translation: 朋友：你们部门最近怎么样 你：换了领导后 好多了 朋友：人一换就不一样 你：对 往好了变
for the better.example: Friend: How's your department lately? You: Much better after the new boss. Friend: Change helps. You: Yeah; changed for the better.

for the first time ever.context: 你说这是你长这么大第一次出国，激动得一晚上没睡着。
for the first time ever.translation: 朋友：你怎么这么兴奋 你：我第一次出国啊 朋友：以前没出过国吗 你：对 头一回
for the first time ever.example: Friend: Why so excited? You: My first time ever going abroad. Friend: Never before? You: Yeah; for the first time ever.

for the most part.context: 你说这座城市大部分时候天气都不错，就是冬天偶尔冷几天。
for the most part.translation: 朋友：这城市天气怎么样 你：多数时候挺好 就是冬天冷 朋友：算宜居吧 你：对 总体来说不错
for the most part.example: Friend: How's the weather here? You: Mostly fine, cold in winter. Friend: Livable. You: Yeah; for the most part, fine.

for the rest of.context: 你说接下来这一整个暑假，你都打算在家看书。
for the rest of.translation: 朋友：你暑假有什么打算 你：整个假期都在家看书 朋友：不出去转转吗 你：对 接下来一整个假期
for the rest of.example: Friend: Plans for the summer? You: Read at home the whole break. Friend: Not going out? You: Yeah; for the rest of the holiday.

for the time being.context: 你说眼下先这样办，以后有变化再说。
for the time being.translation: 朋友：这事现在怎么办 你：先这么办 以后再说 朋友：临时先将就 你：对 就先这样
for the time being.example: Friend: How to handle this now? You: Do it this way for now. Friend: Temporarily. You: Yeah; for the time being.

for the very first time.context: 你说今天是你头一回自己做饭，虽然卖相差但吃着挺香。
for the very first time.translation: 朋友：这菜你自己做的 你：对 我第一次做饭 朋友：头一回就敢上手 你：对 就是第一次
for the very first time.example: Friend: You cooked this? You: Yeah; my first time cooking. Friend: First time going for it. You: Yeah; for the very first time.

for year.context: 你说你学这个学了好几年了，早就入门了。
for year.translation: 朋友：你这门道学多久了 你：好几年了 朋友：那不早熟了 你：对 学好几年了
for year.example: Friend: How long have you studied this? You: Several years. Friend: Long mastered then. You: Yeah; for years.

forage for.context: 你说松鼠在树林里东找西找，到处藏松果。
forage for.translation: 朋友：那只松鼠在忙什么呢 你：到处找松果藏起来 朋友：在找吃的吧 你：对 就是四处觅食
forage for.example: Friend: What's that squirrel up to? You: Scouting around for pinecones. Friend: Foraging for food. You: Yeah; foraging for nuts.

forest bathing.context: 你说周末别老待在家里，去山里走走，呼吸一下新鲜空气。
forest bathing.translation: 朋友：周末干嘛老待在家里 你：去山里走走 呼吸新鲜空气 朋友：这就像日本人说的森林浴吧 你：对 就是森林浴
forest bathing.example: Friend: Why stay home on weekends? You: Walk in the woods, breathe fresh air. Friend: That forest bathing thing. You: Yeah; forest bathing.

forever chemical.context: 你说那种工业用的化学物质特别难分解，在环境里能留一辈子。
forever chemical.translation: 朋友：这种化学东西有什么不好 你：几百年都不分解 留在环境里 朋友：太可怕了 你：对 就是永久化学品
forever chemical.example: Friend: What's wrong with that chemical? You: It won't break down for centuries. Friend: Scary. You: Yeah; a forever chemical.

forget about.context: 你说不开心的事就别老想着了，过去就过去了。
forget about.translation: 朋友：你怎么还在为那件事懊恼 你：我也想忘掉 朋友：别老惦记了 你：对 把它忘了吧
forget about.example: Friend: Why still dwell on that? You: I want to forget it. Friend: Stop fixating. You: Yeah; forget about it.

fork out for.context: 你说为了那台心仪的电脑，一下子花掉了两个月工资，肉疼得很。
fork out for.translation: 朋友：你那台电脑多少钱买的 你：贵得很 两个月工资没了 朋友：花这么多 你：对 大出血了
fork out for.example: Friend: How much was that laptop? You: Cost a bomb, two months' pay. Friend: That much. You: Yeah; forked out for it.

formal document.context: 你说公司要签的那份东西得盖章签字，是正式的文件，不能随便。
formal document.translation: 朋友：这份合同随便签签就行 你：不行 这是正式文件 得盖章 朋友：这么严肃 你：对 是正式文书
formal document.example: Friend: Just sign this contract casually? You: No, it's a formal document, needs a stamp. Friend: So serious. You: Yeah; a formal document.

formal outfit.context: 你说朋友婚礼要求穿正式点，你翻出了压箱底的那套西装。
formal outfit.translation: 朋友：朋友婚礼穿什么去 你：穿正式点 翻出了西装 朋友：这正装挺精神 你：对 就是正式打扮
formal outfit.example: Friend: What to wear to the wedding? You: Dress up, pulled out the suit. Friend: Sharp formal outfit. You: Yeah; a formal outfit.

formal writing.context: 你说写作文跟发微信不一样，得用正式的书面语，不能太随便。
formal writing.translation: 朋友：写作文能口语化吗 你：不能 得用正式的写法 朋友：跟发微信不一样 你：对 要正式书面
formal writing.example: Friend: Can I write the essay casually? You: No, use formal writing. Friend: Unlike texting. You: Yeah; it's formal writing.

forty winks.context: 你说午饭后困得不行，趴在桌上眯了一小觉，立马就精神了。
forty winks.translation: 朋友：你下午怎么突然精神了 你：中午眯了一小觉 朋友：打个盹管用吗 你：对 就是打个盹
forty winks.example: Friend: Why perked up this afternoon? You: Napped a little at noon. Friend: Does a quick nap help? You: Yeah; forty winks.

forward thinking.context: 你说那个老板眼光长远，早早布局，几年后生意一下就起来了。
forward thinking.translation: 朋友：他怎么生意越做越大 你：他想得远 早早就布局了 朋友：有远见啊 你：对 就是有远见
forward thinking.example: Friend: How did his business grow so much? You: He thought ahead, planned early. Friend: Foresight. You: Yeah; forward thinking.

fossil fuel.context: 你说现在发电大多还靠烧煤烧油，这些都是埋在地下的老能源。
fossil fuel.translation: 朋友：我们发的电是哪来的 你：大多烧煤烧油 朋友：这些是老能源吧 你：对 就是化石燃料
fossil fuel.example: Friend: Where does our power come from? You: Mostly burning coal and oil. Friend: Those old fuels. You: Yeah; fossil fuels.

found.context: 你说他和几个朋友凑钱开了家小公司，刚成立两年。
found.translation: 朋友：这家公司开多久了 你：刚成立两年 朋友：谁办起来的 你：对 他跟朋友一起办的
found.example: Friend: How old is this company? You: Founded just two years ago. Friend: Who started it? You: Yeah; he founded it with friends.

fountain pen.context: 你说老师改作业用的不是圆珠笔，是那种灌墨水的老式钢笔。
fountain pen.translation: 朋友：老师改作业用什么笔 你：灌墨水那种钢笔 朋友：现在少见了 你：对 就是钢笔
fountain pen.example: Friend: What pen does the teacher use? You: One you fill with ink. Friend: Rare these days. You: Yeah; a fountain pen.

four-day week.context: 你说新闻里有些国家试行了一周只上四天班，大家高兴坏了。
four-day week.translation: 朋友：新闻里那个上四天班是真的吗 你：在试行了 一周休三天 朋友：太幸福了 你：对 就是四天工作制
four-day week.example: Friend: Is that four-day work week on the news real? You: They're trying it, three days off. Friend: So lucky. You: Yeah; a four-day week.

fragile heritage.context: 你说那些老城墙老庙特别脆弱，游客一多、风雨一打就容易坏。
fragile heritage.translation: 朋友：那些老古迹怎么老修 你：年代久了 特别怕碰怕淋 朋友：得好好保护 你：对 就是脆弱古迹
fragile heritage.example: Friend: Why are those old relics always under repair? You: Fragile, worn by time. Friend: Must protect them. You: Yeah; fragile heritage.

fragile self-esteem.context: 你说那个朋友特别敏感，别人随口一句他就想半天，自尊心特别脆。
fragile self-esteem.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么老玻璃心 你：一句玩笑他都想半天 朋友：也太敏感了 你：对 自尊心特别脆
fragile self-esteem.example: Friend: Why is your friend so sensitive? You: Jokes bug him for days. Friend: Too thin-skinned. You: Yeah; fragile self-esteem.

frame of mind.context: 你说今天心情好，看什么都顺眼；心情差的时候，一点小事也烦。
frame of mind.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么好说话 你：心情好呗 朋友：心情好坏差这么多 你：对 就是心态问题
frame of mind.example: Friend: Why are you so easy today? You: Good mood. Friend: Mood matters so much. You: Yeah; it's the frame of mind.

fraudulent return.context: 你说有人买了东西穿两次就退货，专坑商家，这种行为特别不地道。
fraudulent return.translation: 朋友：他怎么老退货 你：穿两次就退 坑商家 朋友：这也太不地道了 你：对 就是恶意退货
fraudulent return.example: Friend: Why does he return things so often? You: Wears them twice, then returns. Friend: Exploiting the shop. You: Yeah; a fraudulent return.

free from.context: 你说搬到山脚下住后，终于远离了城市的喧嚣，特别清净。
free from.translation: 朋友：你搬过去住感觉怎么样 你：清净多了 没了噪音 朋友：远离闹市了 你：对 就是远离了烦恼
free from.example: Friend: How's living after the move? You: Quiet, no more noise. Friend: Away from the bustle. You: Yeah; free from the noise.

free of.context: 你说这块牌子上写着，这个房间里不许抽烟，也不许拍照。
free of.translation: 朋友：这牌子上写的什么 你：禁止抽烟 禁止拍照 朋友：管得挺严 你：对 这里不能抽烟
free of.example: Friend: What's that sign say? You: No smoking, no photos. Friend: Strict. You: Yeah; it's free of smoking.

free parking.context: 你说这家商场买东西停车不要钱，逛多久都不收费。
free parking.translation: 朋友：这商场停车要钱吗 你：不要 随便停多久 朋友：这福利不错 你：对 就是免费停车
free parking.example: Friend: Is parking at this mall free? You: Yes, park as long as you like. Friend: Nice perk. You: Yeah; free parking.

free solo climbing.context: 你说那个登山爱好者不系绳子就爬悬崖，看得你手心直冒汗。
free solo climbing.translation: 朋友：那个人怎么光着手爬悬崖 你：不系绳子 太敢了 朋友：不要命了 你：对 就是徒手攀岩
free solo climbing.example: Friend: Why's he climbing the cliff bare-handed? You: No ropes, so daring. Friend: Risking his life. You: Yeah; free solo climbing.

free trial.context: 你说那个软件先免费用七天，觉得好再交钱，先试试。
free trial.translation: 朋友：这个软件要花钱吗 你：先免费试七天 朋友：不好就不买 你：对 就是免费试用
free trial.example: Friend: Does this software cost money? You: Free trial for seven days. Friend: Quit if not good. You: Yeah; a free trial.

free up.context: 你说把那些杂事交给别人，自己就能腾出时间来做正事。
free up.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不忙那些杂活了 你：交给别人了 腾出时间 朋友：这样你就能专心了 你：对 腾出时间
free up.example: Friend: Why aren't you busy with those chores? You: Handed them off to free up time. Friend: Now you can focus. You: Yeah; freed up my time.

free will.context: 你说又没人逼你，去不去全看你自己愿不愿意。
free will.translation: 朋友：你想让我去我就去？ 你：随你 没人逼你 朋友：那我自己定 你：对 全凭你自己意愿
free will.example: Friend: Should I just go because you ask? You: Up to you, no one's forcing. Friend: My own call. You: Yeah; your own free will.

freed from.context: 你说考完试那天，整个人一下子从紧张里解脱出来，轻松极了。
freed from.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么放松 你：考完试了 解脱了 朋友：终于不用熬了 你：对 从紧张里解放了
freed from.example: Friend: Why so relaxed today? You: Exam's over, freed from stress. Friend: No more grind. You: Yeah; freed from the pressure.

freed up.context: 你说机器把人手从重复劳动里解放出来，效率高多了。
freed up.translation: 朋友：这机器真那么好用 你：把人从重复活儿里解放出来 朋友：效率高多了 你：对 人手被解放了
freed up.example: Friend: Is that machine really that good? You: Freed people from repetitive tasks. Friend: Much more efficient. You: Yeah; people got freed up.

freezing cold.context: 你说今天外面风一吹，冷得像刀割，出门得裹上最厚的。
freezing cold.translation: 朋友：今天出门穿什么 你：冷风刺骨 多穿点 朋友：冷成这样 你：对 就是冰冷
freezing cold.example: Friend: What to wear out today? You: Biting wind, bundle up. Friend: That cold. You: Yeah; freezing cold.

freezing point.context: 你说水在零度的时候会结冰，这个温度就叫冰点。
freezing point.translation: 朋友：水多少度结冰啊 你：零度 就是结冰点 朋友：再冷就冻上了 你：对 就是冰点
freezing point.example: Friend: At what temp does water freeze? You: Zero, the freezing point. Friend: Colder and it freezes. You: Yeah; the freezing point.

freezing temperature.context: 你说北方冬天零下二十多度，呵口气都成雾，冷得不行。
freezing temperature.translation: 朋友：北方冬天多冷 你：零下二十多度 朋友：怎么出门啊 你：对 就是严寒
freezing temperature.example: Friend: How cold is a northern winter? You: Twenty below zero. Friend: How do you go out? You: Yeah; freezing temperatures.

fresh from farm.context: 你说这家店的菜都是当地地里刚摘的，新鲜得很。
fresh from farm.translation: 朋友：你这菜怎么这么新鲜 你：当地地里刚摘的 朋友：就是现摘的吧 你：对 就是农场直供
fresh from farm.example: Friend: Why is this produce so fresh? You: Just picked from local fields. Friend: Farm-direct then. You: Yeah; fresh from the farm.

fresh produce.context: 你说菜市场那堆青菜、番茄、鸡蛋都是刚到的鲜货，水灵得很。
fresh produce.translation: 朋友：菜市场今天什么最新鲜 你：那堆青菜番茄 早上刚到 朋友：看着就水灵 你：对 就是生鲜
fresh produce.example: Friend: What's freshest at the market? You: Greens and tomatoes, just in. Friend: So crisp. You: Yeah; fresh produce.

fresh start.context: 你说换了个城市工作，就当一切重新开始，把过去都翻篇。
fresh start.translation: 朋友：你去新城市想好了吗 你：就当重新开始 翻篇 朋友：从头再来也挺好 你：对 就是新的开始
fresh start.example: Friend: Set on the new city? You: Treat it as a fresh start. Friend: A clean slate. You: Yeah; a fresh start.

fresh woodland air.context: 你说周末钻进树林里，吸的全是树叶泥土的清香，比城里舒服多了。
fresh woodland air.translation: 朋友：你周末去山里感觉怎么样 你：全是树叶泥土的清香 朋友：比城里强吧 你：对 就是林间新鲜空气
fresh woodland air.example: Friend: How was your weekend in the woods? You: Air of leaves and soil. Friend: Better than the city. You: Yeah; fresh woodland air.

freshen up.context: 你说出门前洗把脸、换身干净衣服，整个人一下就精神了。
freshen up.translation: 朋友：你出门前收拾什么呢 你：洗把脸 换身干净衣服 朋友：这样就精神了 你：对 焕然一新
freshen up.example: Friend: What are you tidying up before going out? You: Wash my face, change clothes. Friend: Feeling refreshed. You: Yeah; freshen up.

freshers' week.context: 你说大学刚开学那一周，全是迎新活动，到处是新来的同学。
freshers' week.translation: 朋友：开学第一周忙什么 你：全是迎新活动 到处是新同学 朋友：就是新生周吧 你：对 就是新生周
freshers' week.example: Friend: What's the first week of school like? You: All orientation, new students everywhere. Friend: Freshers' week. You: Yeah; freshers' week.

freshly ground.context: 你说这家咖啡店的豆子是当场磨的，闻着特别香。
freshly ground.translation: 朋友：这咖啡怎么这么香 你：豆子是现磨的 朋友：现磨的就是香 你：对 就是现磨
freshly ground.example: Friend: Why's this coffee so aromatic? You: Beans are ground fresh. Friend: Freshly ground smells great. You: Yeah; freshly ground.

friendship circle.context: 你说工作后认识的人多了，朋友圈比上学时大了一圈。
friendship circle.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么越来越多 你：工作后认识的人多了 朋友：圈子变大了 你：对 就是朋友圈
friendship circle.example: Friend: Why do you have more friends now? You: Met more people at work. Friend: Wider circle. You: Yeah; my friendship circle grew.

friendships of convenience.context: 你说职场上那些朋友，多半是一起做事才处着，真有事未必帮忙。
friendships of convenience.translation: 朋友：你跟公司同事处得好吗 你：表面挺好 真有事未必帮 朋友：这就是同事关系吧 你：对 就是利益之交
friendships of convenience.example: Friend: Do you get along with colleagues? You: Fine on the surface, not really. Friend: That workplace bond. You: Yeah; friendships of convenience.

from.context: 你说你是从老家坐了一夜火车才到这儿的。
from.translation: 朋友：你从哪儿来的呀 你：从老家坐了一夜火车 朋友：一路辛苦了 你：对 从老远来
from.example: Friend: Where are you from? You: From my hometown, an overnight train. Friend: Long ride. You: Yeah; from far away.

from above.context: 你说飞机从天上往下看，整座城市小得像积木。
from above.translation: 朋友：坐飞机往下看什么感觉 你：城市小得像积木 朋友：从上面看就是不一样 你：对 就是从上面
from above.example: Friend: What's it like looking down from a plane? You: The city's like blocks. Friend: Seen from above. You: Yeah; from above.

from abroad.context: 你说这包零食是朋友托人从国外带回来的，国内买不着。
from abroad.translation: 朋友：这零食国内有卖的吗 你：没有 是国外带回来的 朋友：远道而来 你：对 就是从国外来的
from abroad.example: Friend: Is this snack sold here? You: No, brought back from abroad. Friend: Traveled far. You: Yeah; from abroad.

from all over the world.context: 你说那所大学里有从世界各地来的学生，什么国家的都有。
from all over the world.translation: 朋友：那学校学生都哪来的 你：世界各地都有 朋友：真国际化 你：对 来自全球
from all over the world.example: Friend: Where do that school's students come from? You: All over the world. Friend: So international. You: Yeah; from all over the world.

from all walks of life.context: 你说参加那个讲座的人什么职业都有，学生、医生、老板都来了。
from all walks of life.translation: 朋友：那个讲座都是什么人去 你：各行各业都有 朋友：真热闹 你：对 来自各行各业
from all walks of life.example: Friend: Who goes to that talk? You: All sorts of people. Friend: A real mix. You: Yeah; from all walks of life.

from an early age.context: 你说朋友弹钢琴弹得特别好，是因为从小就开始学了。
from an early age.translation: 朋友：你钢琴怎么弹得这么好 你：我从小就开始学了 朋友：这么有底子 你：对 就是从小练的
from an early age.example: Friend: How do you play the piano so well? You: I started from an early age. Friend: Such a base. You: Yeah; from an early age.

from around the world.context: 你说那个音乐节请来的乐队来自世界各地，风格五花八门。
from around the world.translation: 朋友：那个音乐节都有谁来 你：乐队来自世界各地 朋友：真国际化 你：对 来自全球
from around the world.example: Friend: Who's at that music festival? You: Bands from around the world. Friend: So global. You: Yeah; from around the world.

from generation to generation.context: 你说这门手艺爷爷传给爸爸，爸爸又传给你，一辈辈这么传下来。
from generation to generation.translation: 朋友：你这手艺跟谁学的 你：爷爷传爸爸 爸爸再传给我 朋友：一辈辈传下来 你：对 就是代代相传
from generation to generation.example: Friend: Who taught you this craft? You: Grandpa to dad, dad to me. Friend: Passed down. You: Yeah; from generation to generation.

from now.context: 你说从今天起，你决定每天早睡半小时，不再熬夜。
from now.translation: 朋友：你以后打算怎么改 你：从今天起 每天早睡半小时 朋友：能坚持吗 你：对 从现在开始
from now.example: Friend: How will you change from now? You: From now, sleep half an hour earlier. Friend: Will you keep it? You: Yeah; from now on.

from place to place.context: 你说做销售的人老得出差，这个城市跑那个城市，到处跑。
from place to place.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老见不到人 你：跑销售 到处跑 朋友：真辛苦 你：对 一个地方一个地方跑
from place to place.example: Friend: Why are you never around lately? You: Sales job, moving around. Friend: So busy. You: Yeah; moving from place to place.

from scratch.context: 你说这顿饭是你自己从和面开始做的，没用任何半成品。
from scratch.translation: 朋友：这蛋糕买的还是做的 你：自己做的 从零开始 朋友：太厉害了 你：对 就是从头做
from scratch.example: Friend: Is this cake bought or homemade? You: Homemade, from scratch. Friend: Impressive. You: Yeah; made from scratch.

from top to bottom.context: 你说大扫除那天，你把家里从天花板到地板彻底收拾了一遍。
from top to bottom.translation: 朋友：你家今天怎么这么干净 你：彻底收拾了一遍 从上到下 朋友：真彻底 你：对 里里外外都打扫了
from top to bottom.example: Friend: Why is your place so spotless today? You: Cleaned it thoroughly, top to bottom. Friend: So thorough. You: Yeah; from top to bottom.

front line.context: 你说医生护士这些冲在最前面治病救人的人，是真正的前线。
front line.translation: 朋友：你说谁最辛苦啊 你：那些冲在最前面的医生 朋友：就是前线吧 你：对 最危险的第一线
front line.example: Friend: Who works the hardest? You: The doctors at the very front. Friend: On the front line. You: Yeah; on the front line.

front-loaded wage.context: 你说那份工作刚入职工资就定得高，不靠小费，旱涝保收。
front-loaded wage.translation: 朋友：那份工作收入怎么样 你：一上来工资就高 不靠小费 朋友：挺稳当 你：对 就是固定高薪
front-loaded wage.example: Friend: How's the pay at that job? You: High from the start, no tips needed. Friend: Steady. You: Yeah; a front-loaded wage.

frown upon.context: 你说老一辈特别不赞成年轻人光谈恋爱不结婚，觉得不像话。
frown upon.translation: 朋友：我妈怎么老催我结婚 你：老一辈不赞成只谈恋爱 朋友：真唠叨 你：对 他们看不惯
frown upon.example: Friend: Why does my mom keep pushing marriage? You: Elders frown on just dating. Friend: So nagging. You: Yeah; they frown upon it.

frozen dessert.context: 你说夏天从冰柜里拿出那种冷冻的甜品，冰冰凉凉特别解暑。
frozen dessert.translation: 朋友：天热你想吃点什么 你：那种冰的甜品 凉凉的 朋友：跟冰淇淋不一样吧 你：对 就是冷冻甜品
frozen dessert.example: Friend: What do you crave in the heat? You: That frozen dessert, icy and cool. Friend: Different from ice cream? You: Yeah; a frozen dessert.

frozen food.context: 你说冰箱里冻着那种买好的备菜，没空做饭时热一热就能吃。
frozen food.translation: 朋友：你冰箱里都存了些什么 你：冻着的菜 没空做饭时热一下 朋友：真方便 你：对 就是冷冻食材
frozen food.example: Friend: What's in your freezer? You: Frozen meals, heat up when busy. Friend: So handy. You: Yeah; frozen food.

frozen in time.context: 你说那张老照片里的场景，好像一下子被定格在那年，再没变过。
frozen in time.translation: 朋友：这照片看着特别有年代感 你：像是一下子停在那年了 朋友：时光凝固了 你：对 就像定格在那年
frozen in time.example: Friend: That photo feels so dated. You: As if frozen in that year. Friend: Time stood still. You: Yeah; frozen in time.

frozen yoghurt.context: 你说夏天最爱吃那种冰冰的酸奶，比冰淇淋清爽。
frozen yoghurt.translation: 朋友：夏天你最爱吃什么冰的 你：那种冻酸奶 比冰淇淋清爽 朋友：真开胃 你：对 就是冻酸奶
frozen yoghurt.example: Friend: What frozen treat do you love in summer? You: Frozen yogurt, lighter than ice cream. Friend: Refreshing. You: Yeah; frozen yoghurt.

fruit and veg.context: 你说医生让你多吃蔬菜水果，每天一斤菜半斤果。
fruit and veg.translation: 朋友：医生让你多吃什么 你：蔬菜水果 一天一斤菜 朋友：健康饮食 你：对 就是果蔬
fruit and veg.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you to eat more? You: Fruit and veg, a pound a day. Friend: Healthy. You: Yeah; fruit and veg.

fuel consumption.context: 你说你这车特别费油，跑一公里油钱都不少。
fuel consumption.translation: 朋友：你这车费油吗 你：特别费 跑一点就一箱油 朋友：养车挺贵 你：对 油耗特别高
fuel consumption.example: Friend: Is your car gas-hungry? You: Yes, burns through a tank fast. Friend: Expensive to run. You: Yeah; high fuel consumption.

fuel cost.context: 你说油价一涨，你每月开车上下班的钱就跟着涨。
fuel cost.translation: 朋友：你这月开车花多少 你：油价涨了 花多了 朋友：油钱真不便宜 你：对 油费又涨了
fuel cost.example: Friend: How much driving this month? You: Gas prices up, paying more. Friend: Fuel costs add up. You: Yeah; fuel cost rose.

fuel load.context: 你说天干物燥，满山的枯草落叶特别容易着火，一点就着。
fuel load.translation: 朋友：这么久不下雨 山里危险吗 你：满山枯草 特别容易着火 朋友：一点火星都危险 你：对 全是易燃物
fuel load.example: Friend: With no rain, are the hills risky? You: Dry brush everywhere, easy to ignite. Friend: A spark is dangerous. You: Yeah; a heavy fuel load.

fuel one's creative soul.context: 你说旅行时看到的好风景，总能给你写东西带来灵感。
fuel one's creative soul.translation: 朋友：你怎么老往外跑 你：出去看看 才有灵感写东西 朋友：旅行激发创作吧 你：对 就是激发创作欲
fuel one's creative soul.example: Friend: Why do you keep traveling? You: Seeing places fuels my writing. Friend: Fuels your creativity. You: Yeah; it fuels my creative soul.

full moon.context: 你说今晚月亮特别圆特别亮，挂在天上像个大盘子。
full moon.translation: 朋友：今晚月亮真亮啊 你：特别圆 像个大盘子 朋友：就是满月吧 你：对 就是满月
full moon.example: Friend: The moon is so bright tonight. You: So round, like a big plate. Friend: That's the full moon. You: Yeah; a full moon.

full picture.context: 你说别看新闻热闹，一件事得看全了才能下结论，别只听一面。
full picture.translation: 朋友：这事到底谁对谁错 你：你只看到一面 得看全貌 朋友：我也想了解全啊 你：对 得看整个情况
full picture.example: Friend: Who's right in this? You: You only see one side; get the full picture. Friend: I want to know it all. You: Yeah; the full picture.

full-body workout.context: 你说这一套动作练下来，浑身肌肉都动到了，比单练一处强。
full-body workout.translation: 朋友：你今天练的什么 你：一套动作 全身都练到 朋友：比只练一处好 你：对 就是全身锻炼
full-body workout.example: Friend: What did you train today? You: A routine working the whole body. Friend: Better than one area. You: Yeah; a full-body workout.

full-time parenthood.context: 你说朋友有了孩子后就不上班了，在家专门带娃，一当就是好几年。
full-time parenthood.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么不去上班了 你：在家带孩子 全职带娃 朋友：也是份工作 你：对 就是全职育儿
full-time parenthood.example: Friend: Why did your friend stop working? You: Stays home raising the kid. Friend: A job in itself. You: Yeah; full-time parenthood.

funding pressure.context: 你说学校新盖楼差一大笔钱，校长天天为钱的事发愁。
funding pressure.translation: 朋友：你们学校最近在忙什么 你：盖新楼 差一大笔钱 朋友：校长压力大吧 你：对 就是资金压力
funding pressure.example: Friend: What's your school busy with? You: Building, short on funds. Friend: Pressure on the principal. You: Yeah; funding pressure.

fungal network.context: 你说树林底下那些菌丝连成一张大网，树和树之间靠它互相送养分。
fungal network.translation: 朋友：地下那些白丝是什么 你：菌丝 树之间靠它传养分 朋友：像一张网一样 你：对 就是真菌网络
fungal network.example: Friend: What are those white threads underground? You: Fungi, trees share nutrients through them. Friend: Like a web. You: Yeah; a fungal network.

further education.context: 你说工作后还想再读个书，去学校接着学个新本事。
further education.translation: 朋友：你上班了怎么还去上课 你：想再学点新东西 朋友：就是继续教育吧 你：对 就是工作后再学习
further education.example: Friend: Why take classes after work? You: Want to learn something new. Friend: Further education. You: Yeah; further education.

fusion cuisine.context: 你说那家餐厅把川菜和法餐的做法混在一起，味道特别新奇。
fusion cuisine.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅菜有什么特别 你：把中餐西餐混着做 朋友：什么风味 你：对 就是融合菜
fusion cuisine.example: Friend: What's special about that restaurant? You: Mixes Chinese and Western ways. Friend: What style? You: Yeah; fusion cuisine.

fusion food.context: 你说现在流行那种把两种不搭的菜凑一块儿做的新吃法。
fusion food.translation: 朋友：你今天点的这菜怎么怪怪的 你：两种不搭的凑一块儿了 朋友：什么新吃法 你：对 就是融合菜
fusion food.example: Friend: Why does today's dish taste odd? You: Two unlikely cuisines combined. Friend: What style? You: Yeah; fusion food.

fuss with.context: 你说朋友出门前老对着镜子拨弄头发、整理衣领，折腾半天。
fuss with.translation: 朋友：你朋友出门前在镜子前干嘛呢 你：老拨弄头发 整理衣领 朋友：至于折腾这么久吗 你：对 就是瞎摆弄
fuss with.example: Friend: What's your friend doing at the mirror? You: Fussing with hair and collar. Friend: So long. You: Yeah; just fussing with it.

fussy eater.context: 你说朋友吃饭这也不吃那也不吃，青菜嫌苦、肉嫌柴，特别挑。
fussy eater.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么点啥都不满意 你：这也不吃那也不吃 朋友：太挑食了 你：对 就是个挑食的人
fussy eater.example: Friend: Why is your friend unhappy with everything? You: Picky, eats hardly anything. Friend: So fussy. You: Yeah; a real fussy eater.

future generations.context: 你说现在多节约点水，是为了让以后的人也有干净水用。
future generations.translation: 朋友：你老节约用水干嘛 你：留给以后的人用 朋友：想得真远 你：对 为了下一代
future generations.example: Friend: Why save water so much? You: So future generations have clean water. Friend: Thinking long. You: Yeah; for future generations.

gagging clause.context: 你说那家公司跟员工签的协议里有条规矩，离职后不能乱说话。
gagging clause.translation: 朋友：他离职后怎么不聊公司的事 你：协议里有条规矩 不让说 朋友：就是封口吧 你：对 就是封口条款
gagging clause.example: Friend: Why won't he talk about the company after leaving? You: A clause bans him from speaking. Friend: Gag clause. You: Yeah; a gagging clause.

gain access to.context: 你说要进那个资料室，得先找管理员开个权限才能进。
gain access to.translation: 朋友：那间资料室能进吗 你：得先申请权限 朋友：找谁申请 你：对 先拿到权限
gain access to.example: Friend: Can we enter that archive? You: Need to get access first. Friend: From whom? You: Yeah; gain access to it.

gain experience.context: 你说刚毕业别老盯着工资，先找个能学东西、攒经验的活儿。
gain experience.translation: 朋友：刚毕业找工作看什么 你：先看能不能攒经验 朋友：钱少点也行 你：对 先攒经验
gain experience.example: Friend: What to look for in a first job? You: Where you gain experience. Friend: Even for less pay. You: Yeah; gain experience first.

gain from.context: 你说多读书看着费时间，其实以后能用上的地方特别多。
gain from.translation: 朋友：读那么多闲书有用吗 你：有用 慢慢就能受益 朋友：怎么个受益法 你：对 就是从中获益
gain from.example: Friend: Is reading all those books useful? You: Yes, you benefit over time. Friend: How? You: Yeah; you gain from them.

gain popularity.context: 你说那部前几年没人看的剧，这两年突然火了，大家都在追。
gain popularity.translation: 朋友：那部剧怎么最近火了 你：这两年慢慢被人喜欢上 朋友：越来越多人看了 你：对 就是越来越流行
gain popularity.example: Friend: Why is that show hot now? You: It's been gaining popularity lately. Friend: More viewers. You: Yeah; gaining popularity.

gaining traction.context: 你说那个新牌子一开始没人理，这两年口碑起来了，越卖越好。
gaining traction.translation: 朋友：那个新牌子你听说过吗 你：一开始没人理 这两年慢慢火了 朋友：开始被认可了 你：对 就是越来越有势头
gaining traction.example: Friend: Heard of that new brand? You: Ignored at first, now catching on. Friend: Gaining traction. You: Yeah; gaining traction.

game experience.context: 你说这游戏画面再好，玩着卡顿掉帧，体验也不会好。
game experience.translation: 朋友：这游戏玩着怎么样 你：画面好看 但老卡 朋友：那体验就差了 你：对 就是游戏体验
game experience.example: Friend: How's that game to play? You: Pretty graphics, but laggy. Friend: Then the experience suffers. You: Yeah; the game experience.

game over.context: 你说比赛输到这个份上，比分差太多，再怎么追也没戏了。
game over.translation: 朋友：咱们队还有戏吗 你：差太多了 追不回来了 朋友：那就没戏了 你：对 大势已去
game over.example: Friend: Is our team still in it? You: Too far behind, can't catch up. Friend: Then it's over. You: Yeah; game over.

gameplay mechanic.context: 你说这游戏玩起来有好多小规矩，比如怎么躲、怎么跳，得慢慢摸。
gameplay mechanic.translation: 朋友：这游戏怎么玩啊 你：里头有好多小机制 得慢慢学 朋友：什么机制啊 你：对 就是游戏里的规则
gameplay mechanic.example: Friend: How do you play this game? You: It has many little mechanics to learn. Friend: What mechanics? You: Yeah; the gameplay mechanics.

gaming developer.context: 你说朋友不是光玩游戏，他是做游戏的，自己设计关卡。
gaming developer.translation: 朋友：你朋友是打游戏很厉害吗 你：不是 他是做游戏的 朋友：那就是游戏开发者吧 你：对 就是做游戏的人
gaming developer.example: Friend: Is your friend great at playing games? You: No, he makes them. Friend: A game developer. You: Yeah; a gaming developer.

gaming disorder.context: 你说新闻里医生提醒，有些孩子一玩游戏就停不下来，影响了正常生活。
gaming disorder.translation: 朋友：现在小孩怎么一玩游戏就不停 你：医生说这是种病 影响生活 朋友：这么严重 你：对 就是游戏成瘾
gaming disorder.example: Friend: Why can't kids stop gaming? You: Doctors call it a disorder, affects life. Friend: That serious. You: Yeah; gaming disorder.

gaming portfolio.context: 你说朋友找工作时把自己做过的游戏整理成一份作品，给公司看。
gaming portfolio.translation: 朋友：他找游戏工作带什么去 你：整理了一份自己做过的游戏 朋友：这就是他的作品吧 你：对 就是游戏履历
gaming portfolio.example: Friend: What does he bring to game interviews? You: A portfolio of games he made. Friend: That's his work. You: Yeah; his gaming portfolio.

gap in the market.context: 你说你发现大家想买的一种东西市面上还没人卖，这就是个机会。
gap in the market.translation: 朋友：你怎么想到开这家店的 你：发现大家想要的没人卖 朋友：这就是个机会 你：对 就是市场空白
gap in the market.example: Friend: Why open this shop? You: I saw something people want but no one sells. Friend: A gap in the market. You: Yeah; a gap in the market.

gap year.context: 你说有的学生毕业后不急着上班，先出去旅游一年再回来工作。
gap year.translation: 朋友：你朋友毕业怎么不上班 你：先出去玩一年 再回来工作 朋友：这就是间隔年吧 你：对 就是空档年
gap year.example: Friend: Why isn't your friend working after graduation? You: Travels a year first. Friend: A gap year. You: Yeah; a gap year.

garden shed.context: 你说你家院子角落有个小棚子，专门放铁锹、扫把这些园艺工具。
garden shed.translation: 朋友：你家院子角落那个小棚干嘛的 你：放园艺工具的 朋友：就是个储物棚吧 你：对 就是花园工具棚
garden shed.example: Friend: What's that shed in your yard? You: Stores garden tools. Friend: A storage shed. You: Yeah; a garden shed.

garment worker.context: 你说新闻里那些做衣服的工人，一天站十几个小时，挣得却很少。
garment worker.translation: 朋友：新闻里那些做衣服的工人怎么样 你：站一天 挣得很少 朋友：太辛苦了 你：对 就是制衣工人
garment worker.example: Friend: How are those garment workers on the news? You: Standing all day, paid little. Friend: So hard. You: Yeah; garment workers.

gastrointestinal illness.context: 你说吃坏肚子后上吐下泻，医生说是肠胃方面的毛病。
gastrointestinal illness.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么老跑厕所 你：吃坏肚子 上吐下泻 朋友：是肠胃不舒服吧 你：对 就是肠胃病
gastrointestinal illness.example: Friend: Why are you running to the toilet? You: Bad food, vomiting and diarrhea. Friend: A stomach bug. You: Yeah; a gastrointestinal illness.

gastrointestinal tract.context: 你说吃进去的东西从嘴到胃到肠子，走的这一条路就是消化道。
gastrointestinal tract.translation: 朋友：吃的东西在身体里怎么走的 你：从嘴到胃到肠子一条路 朋友：这就是消化道吧 你：对 就是胃肠道
gastrointestinal tract.example: Friend: How does food travel in the body? You: Mouth, stomach, intestines, one path. Friend: The digestive tract. You: Yeah; the gastrointestinal tract.

gather dust.context: 你说你那架买了好几年的相机，早不用了，现在搁柜子里落灰。
gather dust.translation: 朋友：你那相机怎么不用了 你：早不用了 搁柜子里落灰 朋友：可惜了 你：对 就是积灰
gather dust.example: Friend: Why don't you use that camera? You: Not for years, gathering dust. Friend: Shame. You: Yeah; gathering dust.

gather momentum.context: 你说那个项目一开始没什么动静，这半年慢慢就做起来了，越做越顺。
gather momentum.translation: 朋友：那项目现在怎么样了 你：一开始没动静 这半年做起来了 朋友：越来越有势头 你：对 就是越做越有劲
gather momentum.example: Friend: How's that project going? You: Quiet at first, building up this half year. Friend: Gaining speed. You: Yeah; gathering momentum.

gather round.context: 你说老师一宣布明天春游，全班同学呼啦一下都围过来看通知。
gather round.translation: 朋友：老师说什么了 你们都围过去 你：说明天春游 大家都凑过来看 朋友：真热闹 你：对 都聚过来
gather round.example: Friend: What did the teacher say that drew you over? You: Tomorrow's trip, everyone gathered round. Friend: Lively. You: Yeah; we gathered round.

gauge talent.context: 你说面试时出一堆题，就是为了看看求职者到底有几斤几两。
gauge talent.translation: 朋友：面试怎么出那么多题 你：就是看看求职者的本事 朋友：考的是真本事吧 你：对 就是考察能力
gauge talent.example: Friend: Why so many interview questions? You: To gauge what the candidate can do. Friend: Testing real skill. You: Yeah; to gauge talent.

gen z.context: 你说现在那些十几岁的小孩都是网上泡大的，跟你们小时候完全不一样。
gen z.translation: 朋友：现在的小孩怎么都爱玩手机 你：他们是网上长大的一代 朋友：跟你们那代不一样 你：对 就是Z世代
gen z.example: Friend: Why do kids love phones so much? You: They grew up online. Friend: Different from your generation. You: Yeah; Gen Z.

gender bias.context: 你说有些公司招人时默认男生更能扛事，其实这就是偏见。
gender bias.translation: 朋友：那家公司怎么不爱招女生 你：觉得男生更能扛事 朋友：这就是偏见吧 你：对 就是性别偏见
gender bias.example: Friend: Why doesn't that firm hire women? You: They assume men handle more. Friend: That's bias. You: Yeah; gender bias.

gender pay gap.context: 你说干同样的活，男女拿的工资却不一样，这不合理。
gender pay gap.translation: 朋友：你们公司男女工资一样吗 你：不一样 差着一截呢 朋友：这不公平 你：对 就是性别工资差
gender pay gap.example: Friend: Is pay equal for men and women at your firm? You: No, there's a gap. Friend: Unfair. You: Yeah; a gender pay gap.

gender relation.context: 你说男生女生相处时，因为想法不一样常常会闹点小别扭。
gender relation.translation: 朋友：你说男生女生为什么老闹别扭 你：想法不一样 很正常 朋友：怎么才能处好 你：对 就是两性相处
gender relation.example: Friend: Why do men and women clash? You: Different ways of thinking. Friend: How to get along? You: Yeah; gender relations.

genealogy butler.context: 你说现在有新职业专门帮人查家谱、找祖宗，特别新潮。
genealogy butler.translation: 朋友：你听说有人专门帮人找祖宗吗 你：听说了 是个新职业 朋友：这是干嘛的 你：对 就是帮人寻根
genealogy butler.example: Friend: Heard of people paid to trace ancestors? You: Yeah, it's a new job. Friend: What do they do? You: Yeah; a genealogy butler.

general fitness.context: 你说他不专门练哪一块，就是跑步游泳骑车都来一点，整体身体好。
general fitness.translation: 朋友：你平时怎么锻炼的 你：跑步游泳都来点 朋友：就为整体健康吧 你：对 就是全面健身
general fitness.example: Friend: How do you usually work out? You: Running, swimming, a bit of all. Friend: For overall fitness. You: Yeah; general fitness.

general public.context: 你说这件事不光你们关心，普通老百姓也都在关注。
general public.translation: 朋友：这事就你们圈里关心吧 你：不是 老百姓也都在看 朋友：大家都知道了 你：对 就是普通大众
general public.example: Friend: Is this just your circle that cares? You: No, the public is watching too. Friend: Everyone knows. You: Yeah; the general public.

generation gap.context: 你说爸妈那个年代觉得稳定最重要，你却想出去闯，两代人想法差很多。
generation gap.translation: 朋友：你爸妈怎么老让你考公务员 你：他们那代就求稳定 朋友：跟你们想法不一样 你：对 就是代沟
generation gap.example: Friend: Why do your parents push the civil service? You: Their generation wanted stability. Friend: Different from you. You: Yeah; a generation gap.

genetic factor.context: 你说他个子高不高，一半看基因，一半看后天吃什么。
genetic factor.translation: 朋友：他怎么长那么高 你：一半是天生的 一半看营养 朋友：天生占多大 你：对 就是基因因素
genetic factor.example: Friend: How's he so tall? You: Part genetics, part nutrition. Friend: How big a role? You: Yeah; a genetic factor.

genetic make-up.context: 你说每个人的长相身材，都是由身上那套基因决定的。
genetic make-up.translation: 朋友：为什么一家人长得像 你：身上那套基因决定的 朋友：这就是天生的吧 你：对 就是基因构成
genetic make-up.example: Friend: Why do family members look alike? You: Their genetic make-up decides it. Friend: Inborn. You: Yeah; the genetic make-up.

genetic potential.context: 你说运动员再怎么练，也有个极限，超过天生的上限就很难了。
genetic potential.translation: 朋友：是不是苦练就能成冠军 你：也有个极限 到顶了就难 朋友：什么极限 你：对 就是天生的上限
genetic potential.example: Friend: Can hard work make anyone a champion? You: There's a ceiling, hard to break. Friend: What ceiling? You: Yeah; one's genetic potential.

genetic recombination.context: 老师说孩子的基因是爸妈两人重新组合来的，所以既像爸又像妈。
genetic recombination.translation: 朋友：孩子为什么既像爸又像妈 你：基因是两人重新配的 朋友：怎么配的 你：对 就是基因重新组合
genetic recombination.example: Friend: Why does the kid resemble both parents? You: Genes reshuffle from both. Friend: How? You: Yeah; genetic recombination.

genetic reshuffling.context: 你说孩子的基因从爸妈那里重新洗了一遍牌，所以兄弟姐妹各不一样。
genetic reshuffling.translation: 朋友：兄弟姐妹怎么长得不一样 你：基因像洗了牌重新发 朋友：真形象 你：对 就是基因重组
genetic reshuffling.example: Friend: Why do siblings look so different? You: Genes reshuffled like cards. Friend: Nice image. You: Yeah; genetic reshuffling.

genetic sample.context: 你说医院做检查时抽了一点血，拿去化验基因。
genetic sample.translation: 朋友：医院抽那点血干嘛 你：拿去化验基因 朋友：这是查什么 你：对 就是基因样本
genetic sample.example: Friend: What's that blood drawn at the hospital for? You: To test the genes. Friend: Checking what? You: Yeah; a genetic sample.

gentle background hum.context: 你说咖啡馆里一直有轻轻的音乐声，听着让人特别放松。
gentle background hum.translation: 朋友：你怎么老爱待在那家咖啡馆 你：里头有轻轻的背景声 特别舒服 朋友：像白噪音吧 你：对 就是轻柔背景声
gentle background hum.example: Friend: Why do you love that café? You: There's a soft hum, so relaxing. Friend: Like white noise. You: Yeah; a gentle background hum.

genuine recommendation.context: 你说这个地方不是广告吹出来的，是朋友真去过觉得好才推荐给你。
genuine recommendation.translation: 朋友：这家店值得去吗 你：朋友真去过 说确实好 朋友：不是打广告吧 你：对 就是真心推荐
genuine recommendation.example: Friend: Is this place worth going? You: A friend really went and liked it. Friend: Not an ad. You: Yeah; a genuine recommendation.

geographical centre.context: 你说那个公园正好在这座城市的正中心，从哪边走都一样远。
geographical centre.translation: 朋友：这个公园位置怎么样 你：就在城市正中间 朋友：市中心吧 你：对 就是地理中心
geographical centre.example: Friend: Where's that park located? You: Right in the city's middle. Friend: The city center. You: Yeah; the geographical centre.

georgian architecture.context: 你说那片老房子又高又规整，窗户一排一排特别对称，是那种老式风格。
georgian architecture.translation: 朋友：那片老房子什么风格 你：窗户一排排 特别对称规整 朋友：真好看 你：对 就是那种老式建筑
georgian architecture.example: Friend: What style are those old houses? You: Tall, symmetrical, rows of windows. Friend: Beautiful. You: Yeah; Georgian architecture.

geriatric care.context: 你说老了以后看病难，专门有一类医院是给老人看病的。
geriatric care.translation: 朋友：老人看病有专门的医院吗 你：有 专门看老年病的 朋友：叫什么科 你：对 就是老年医疗
geriatric care.example: Friend: Is there special care for the elderly? You: Yes, clinics for old people. Friend: What's it called? You: Yeah; geriatric care.

german folklore.context: 你说那些格林童话里的故事，都是很久很久以前德国民间传下来的。
german folklore.translation: 朋友：格林童话是哪儿来的 你：德国民间老故事 一辈辈传下来 朋友：真有味道 你：对 就是德国传说
german folklore.example: Friend: Where do Grimm's tales come from? You: Old German folk tales, passed down. Friend: Charming. You: Yeah; German folklore.

german shepherd.context: 你说朋友家养了一只大狼狗，背黑黑的、耳朵竖着，看着特别精神。
german shepherd.translation: 朋友：你朋友家养的什么狗 你：那种大狼狗 立着耳朵 朋友：真威风 你：对 就是德国牧羊犬
german shepherd.example: Friend: What dog does your friend keep? You: That big black-backed one, ears up. Friend: Majestic. You: Yeah; a German shepherd.

get.context: 你说你昨天收到了朋友寄来的一个包裹，拆开一看特别惊喜。
get.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么开心 你：收到朋友寄的包裹了 朋友：寄的什么呀 你：对 就是收到礼物
get.example: Friend: Why so happy today? You: Got a package from a friend. Friend: What's inside? You: Yeah; I got a surprise.

get a feel for.context: 你说刚学开车那会儿，多摸几回车就慢慢找到感觉了。
get a feel for.translation: 朋友：你刚学车的时候上手快吗 你：多开几次就有感觉了 朋友：什么感觉 你：对 就是慢慢找到手感
get a feel for.example: Friend: Did you pick up driving fast? You: After a few tries, you get a feel. Friend: What feel? You: Yeah; get a feel for it.

get a grip.context: 你说工作一乱就容易慌，得先稳住自己，一件一件理清楚。
get a grip.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么忙乱成这样 你：活儿堆一起 先稳住再说 朋友：理清楚就好了 你：对 先稳住阵脚
get a grip.example: Friend: Why so swamped today? You: Piled up; pull myself together first. Friend: Sort it out. You: Yeah; get a grip.

get a grip on.context: 你说新工作一团乱，你得先花一周把情况彻底摸清楚才能上手。
get a grip on.translation: 朋友：新工作你适应得怎么样 你：在慢慢摸情况 朋友：得先弄明白吧 你：对 就是彻底搞清楚
get a grip on.example: Friend: How's the new role going? You: Getting a grip on things. Friend: Need to understand it. You: Yeah; get a grip on it.

get a handle on.context: 你说这事儿现在乱成一团，你得先把它控制住，别让它再恶化。
get a handle on.translation: 朋友：这事现在怎么这么乱 你：得先控制住 别更糟 朋友：慢慢来 你：对 就是把它控制住
get a handle on.example: Friend: Why is this such a mess? You: Must get a handle on it, stop it worsening. Friend: Take it slow. You: Yeah; get a handle on it.

get a life.context: 你说朋友天天就知道窝在家里打游戏，劝他出去找点正经事做。
get a life.translation: 朋友：你朋友周末干嘛呢 你：窝家里打游戏 朋友：该出去找点事做 你：对 就是过得充实点
get a life.example: Friend: What does your friend do on weekends? You: Holes up gaming. Friend: He should get a life. You: Yeah; get a life.
