hectic revision.example: Friend: Why is the library so hard to get a seat in lately? You: Finals are near; everyone's in hectic revision. Friend: How's your revision going? You: I still have two chapters left; I'll have to grind a bit more tonight.

height of fashion.context: 朋友穿了一身刚发布的流行款来聚会，大家笑说她简直是潮流的最前沿。
height of fashion.translation: 朋友：你这身衣服是今年的新款吧 你：是啊 刚上两周就被我买到了 朋友：你现在真是站在height of fashion 你：被你这么一说 我都不好意思了
height of fashion.example: Friend: That outfit of yours is this year's new release, isn't it? You: Yeah, I got it just two weeks after it dropped. Friend: You're really at the height of fashion right now. You: You're making me shy saying that.

help out with.context: 邻居搬东西忙不过来，你主动过去搭把手，帮着把箱子抬上电梯。
help out with.translation: 朋友：新邻居在搬家具 我们要不要去帮忙 你：走 我去help out with搬箱子 朋友：人家还没开口叫人呢 你：举手之劳嘛 邻里之间互相照应很正常
help out with.example: Friend: The new neighbor is moving furniture; should we help? You: Let's go, I'll help out with the boxes. Friend: They haven't even asked anyone yet. You: It's the least I can do; neighbors should look out for each other.

helping hand.context: 朋友最近一个人带孩子忙得团团转，你周末过去搭了把手，她特别感激。
helping hand.translation: 朋友：这周我一个人带娃快崩溃了 你：周末我过去给你搭个helping hand吧 朋友：那可真是救我于水火 你：小事一桩 你也该好好歇一天了
helping hand.example: Friend: I'm about to break down doing childcare alone this week. You: Let me lend a helping hand this weekend. Friend: That would really save me. You: It's nothing; you deserve a proper day off too.

herbal remedy.context: 你感冒总不好，朋友推荐说她妈妈常用洋甘菊泡茶，说是管用的草本偏方。
herbal remedy.translation: 朋友：你感冒这么久还没好 你：吃药也不见怎么见效 朋友：我妈有个herbal remedy 用蜂蜜泡柠檬很管用 你：那我今晚就试试 希望明天能舒服点
herbal remedy.example: Friend: Your cold still isn't gone after this long. You: The medicine isn't doing much. Friend: My mom has a herbal remedy, lemon tea with honey that works well. You: I'll try it tonight; hopefully I'll feel better tomorrow.

herbal tea.context: 晚上你不想喝咖啡怕睡不着，于是泡了一杯不含咖啡因的花草茶。
herbal tea.translation: 朋友：这么晚了还喝茶 你不怕睡不着吗 你：这是herbal tea 里面不含咖啡因的 朋友：喝着还有点甜甜的味道 你：是洋甘菊的 喝完整个人都放松下来
herbal tea.example: Friend: Drinking tea this late, aren't you afraid you can't sleep? You: It's herbal tea; there's no caffeine in it. Friend: It tastes a bit sweet. You: It's chamomile; after drinking it you feel all relaxed.

here and now.context: 朋友总在担心未来又懊悔过去，你劝她别想那么多，好好活在当下这一刻。
here and now.translation: 朋友：我总在想要是当初选了另一条路就好了 你：别再纠结过去了 好好把握here and now吧 朋友：可未来的事也让人焦虑 你：一步一步走 把眼前的日子过好最重要
here and now.example: Friend: I keep thinking what if I'd chosen the other path. You: Stop dwelling on the past; live in the here and now. Friend: But the future makes me anxious too. You: Take it step by step; living the present well matters most.

here to stay.context: 疫情后远程办公成了常态，你和朋友聊起，说这种工作方式已经长期存在了。
here to stay.translation: 朋友：现在公司还允许在家办公吗 你：早就成常态了 这种工作方式看来是here to stay 朋友：那通勤时间省下来真好 你：是啊 就是少了点面对面的交流
here to stay.example: Friend: Does the company still allow working from home? You: It's normal now; this way of working is here to stay. Friend: Then saving the commute time is great. You: Yeah, though you miss the face-to-face interaction a bit.

hidden cost.context: 网上买东西看到标价便宜，结账时却冒出运费和手续费，你感叹隐形花销真多。
hidden cost.translation: 朋友：这件东西看着真便宜啊 你：先别高兴 结账时往往还有hidden cost 朋友：真的吗 会加些什么钱 你：运费包装费一大堆 最后总价可能贵不少
hidden cost.example: Friend: This item looks really cheap. You: Don't celebrate yet; there are usually hidden costs at checkout. Friend: Really, what gets added? You: Shipping, packaging, all sorts; the total can end up much higher.

hide away.context: 周末下大雨，你和朋友都不想出门，窝在家里躲着，享受难得的清闲。
hide away.translation: 朋友：这雨下得根本没法出门 你：正好 我们就hide away在家看电影吧 朋友：那我点个外卖陪你 你：太好了 这样窝着一整天都不无聊
hide away.example: Friend: This rain makes going out impossible. You: Perfect, let's just hide away at home and watch movies. Friend: Then I'll order delivery to keep you company. You: Great, we won't be bored tucked in all day.

hide out.context: 猫主子一听见要洗澡，就钻到沙发底下躲起来，怎么哄都不出来。
hide out.translation: 朋友：猫又不见了 你：一提到洗澡 它准是hide out在沙发底下了 朋友：你试试拿逗猫棒引它出来 你：没用的 它今天打定主意要躲到底了
hide out.example: Friend: The cat's gone again. You: Whenever bath time is mentioned, it hides out under the sofa. Friend: Try luring it out with the teaser wand. You: No use; it's set on hiding today.

hierarchy of needs.context: 心理学课上老师讲到马斯洛，说人的需求是从底层往上层层递进的。
hierarchy of needs.translation: 朋友：这个需求层次图到底怎么看 你：它讲的就是hierarchy of needs 从温饱一直到自我实现 朋友：最底下那层是吃饭睡觉吗 你：对 基本需求满足了才会追求更高的
hierarchy of needs.example: Friend: How do you read this hierarchy of needs diagram? You: It lays out the hierarchy of needs, from basic food and shelter up to self-actualization. Friend: The bottom layer is eating and sleeping? You: Right, you pursue higher needs once the basics are met.

high blood pressure.context: 爷爷体检时测出血压偏高，医生反复叮嘱他少盐少油、按时服药控制。
high blood pressure.translation: 朋友：爷爷这次体检结果怎么样 你：别的都挺好 就是查出来high blood pressure 朋友：那他以后饮食得清淡点了 你：医生也这么说 还要每天定点量血压
high blood pressure.example: Friend: How was your grandfather's checkup result? You: Everything else is fine, except he has high blood pressure. Friend: Then his diet has to be lighter from now on. You: The doctor agreed; he should also measure his blood pressure daily.

high in salt.context: 你看食品包装配料表，发现某款泡面钠含量特别高，朋友提醒它属于高盐食品。
high in salt.translation: 朋友：这泡面吃着是挺咸的 你：你看它配料表 钠排得特别靠前 朋友：那它确实high in salt 不能经常吃 你：偶尔解个馋还行 天天吃身体可受不了
high in salt.example: Friend: This instant noodles is quite salty. You: Look at the ingredients; sodium is way up the list. Friend: Then it's really high in salt; you can't eat it often. You: Once in a while for a craving is fine, but daily would wreck your body.

high street.context: 周末你和朋友约在市中心逛街，一路逛着主街上的各类小店和连锁品牌。
high street.translation: 朋友：今天去哪个区域逛街比较好 你：就去市中心的high street吧 店特别集中 朋友：那边停车方便吗 你：不太好停 我们坐地铁去最省心
high street.example: Friend: Which area is best for shopping today? You: Let's go to the high street downtown; the shops are all concentrated there. Friend: Is parking easy over there? You: Not really; taking the metro is the least hassle.

high sugar content.context: 你给孩子买果汁前看了看标签，发现这款饮料糖分很高，于是换了低糖的。
high sugar content.translation: 朋友：你怎么把这瓶果汁放回去了 你：你看它sugar特别多 属于high sugar content 朋友：小孩就爱喝甜的 你：正是这样才得控制 我换这款低糖的给他
high sugar content.example: Friend: Why did you put that juice bottle back? You: Look how much sugar it has; it's high in sugar content. Friend: Kids just love sweet drinks. You: Exactly why we control it; I'll get this low-sugar one for him.

high up.context: 你站在观景台往远处看，朋友指着塔顶问你那上面站着的人在干什么。
high up.translation: 朋友：你快看那座塔尖上有人在干活 你：他们high up在上面 真是看着都腿软 朋友：工人胆子也太大了 你：人家那是专业训练过的 安全措施做得很足
high up.example: Friend: Look, there are workers way up on that spire. You: Way up high like that, just watching makes my legs weak. Friend: Those workers are so brave. You: They're professionally trained; the safety measures are solid.

high-achiev student.context: 班里同学讨论谁能拿奖学金，大家一致认为那个常年第一的学霸最有希望。
high-achiev student.translation: 朋友：今年奖学金你觉得会给谁 你：肯定是那个学霸啊 他是典型的high-achieving student 朋友：人家不仅成绩好 还参加各种竞赛 你：这样的同学不当代表都难
high-achiev student.example: Friend: Who do you think will get the scholarship this year? You: Definitely that top student; he's a classic high-achieving student. Friend: He's not only top in grades but joins all kinds of contests. You: It's hard not to make someone like that the rep.

high-definition tv screen.context: 朋友新家买了台超大电视，你去做客时感叹屏幕清晰，像在电影院一样。
high-definition tv screen.translation: 朋友：我家刚换了台七十五寸的电视 你：哇 这块high-definition tv screen 看着真过瘾 朋友：看球赛简直像坐现场 你：那以后周末看球就来你家集合吧
high-definition tv screen.example: Friend: I just got a seventy-five-inch TV at home. You: Wow, this high-definition TV screen is a real treat to watch. Friend: Watching a match on it feels like being at the stadium. You: Then let's gather at your place for weekend games.

high-quality fabric.context: 你摸了摸朋友刚买的外套，手感很厚实，她介绍说这是用优质面料做的。
high-quality fabric.translation: 朋友：你摸摸我这件大衣 质感是不是特别好 你：确实手感很细腻 一看就是high-quality fabric 朋友：贵是贵了点 但版型确实挺括 你：穿个几年不过时 也算值了
high-quality fabric.example: Friend: Feel this coat of mine; isn't the texture great? You: It really feels smooth; clearly a high-quality fabric. Friend: It's pricey, but the cut holds its shape. You: If it stays stylish for years, it's worth it.

high-visibility clothing.context: 傍晚你在工地旁看到工人都穿着黄马甲，朋友解释那是为了安全的反光服。
high-visibility clothing.translation: 朋友：天黑了 工人们还在干活啊 你：你看他们都穿着high-visibility clothing 司机老远就能看见 朋友：这样确实安全多了 你：是啊 夜间作业防护一定要做到位
high-visibility clothing.example: Friend: Workers are still on the job after dark. You: Look, they all wear high-visibility clothing so drivers can spot them from far away. Friend: That really makes it much safer. You: Right, protection on night shifts has to be thorough.

higher authority.context: 你和领导对某个决定有分歧，领导说这事他做不了主，得请示更上面的权威。
higher authority.translation: 朋友：这个方案你们领导批了吗 你：他说自己权限不够 得请示higher authority 朋友：那还要等多久啊 你：估计得开个会研究 我们先把材料准备齐
higher authority.example: Friend: Did your leader approve the plan? You: He said his authority isn't enough; we have to ask a higher authority. Friend: Then how long will that take? You: Probably a meeting to review; let's get the materials ready first.

highlight reel.context: 朋友婚礼上拍了一大堆照片，他挑出最精彩的片段剪成一段集锦视频。
highlight reel.translation: 朋友：我婚礼的照片终于修完了 你：快看看挑出来的highlights 朋友：我把最好笑和最感人的片段 剪了个highlight reel 你：放出来大家一起看 肯定又哭又笑
highlight reel.example: Friend: I finally finished editing my wedding photos. You: Let's see the highlights. Friend: I took the funniest and most moving bits and made a highlight reel. You: Play it for everyone; we'll laugh and cry.

historic hub.context: 你到一座古城旅游，导游介绍说这里自古以来就是商贸往来的历史枢纽。
historic hub.translation: 朋友：这座古城以前是干什么的 你：它历来就是个historic hub 南来北往的商人都在这落脚 朋友：难怪遗迹保存得这么完整 你：走 我们去老茶馆坐一坐
historic hub.example: Friend: What was this old city for in the past? You: It's long been a historic hub; merchants from north and south stopped here. Friend: No wonder the relics are so well preserved. You: Let's go sit in the old teahouse.

historic site.context: 周末你约朋友去博物馆，说城里那座老城楼是个很值得一看的历史遗迹。
historic site.translation: 朋友：周末去哪儿逛逛好呢 你：我带你去城中心那座historic site 老城楼有六百年历史了 朋友：门票贵不贵呀 你：学生半价 讲解器租一个就更有意思
historic site.example: Friend: Where should we wander this weekend? You: I'll take you to that historic site downtown; the old gate tower is six hundred years old. Friend: Is the ticket expensive? You: Half price for students; renting an audio guide makes it more fun.

historical relic.context: 博物馆玻璃柜里摆着出土的古代器物，你轻声给朋友介绍这些珍贵的历史文物。
historical relic.translation: 朋友：展柜里这把古剑真有上千年吗 你：是真的 这些historical relic都是考古挖出来的 朋友：能保存成这样太不容易了 你：是啊 每一件背后都有故事
historical relic.example: Friend: Is that ancient sword in the case really a thousand years old? You: It is; these historical relics were all dug up by archaeologists. Friend: Amazing they survived in such shape. You: Right, every one has a story behind it.

hit our shelves.context: 你期待已久的新款护肤品终于上市了，朋友一早通知你说可以去店里买了。
hit our shelves.translation: 朋友：你等的那个新款上市了吗 你：今天刚hit our shelves 我正准备下班就去抢 朋友：有现货吗 别又白跑一趟 你：店员说今早刚补的货 应该没问题
hit our shelves.example: Friend: Did that new release you've been waiting for hit the shelves yet? You: It just hit our shelves today; I'm heading straight there after work. Friend: Do they have stock, or will it be a wasted trip? You: The shop said they restocked this morning; should be fine.

hit sb in the pocket.context: 油价又涨了，朋友抱怨说每次涨价都像是从大家口袋里往外掏钱。
hit sb in the pocket.translation: 朋友：这油价怎么又涨了一毛 你：每次加油都觉得被hit in the pocket 朋友：一个月下来得多花好几百 你：以后能坐地铁就不开车了
hit sb in the pocket.example: Friend: Gas prices went up another ten cents. You: Every time I fill up I feel like I'm being hit in the pocket. Friend: That adds up to hundreds more a month. You: From now on I'll take the metro whenever I can.

hit the 'off' button.context: 你熬夜看剧实在太困了，说完晚安就起身，啪地按下电脑的关机键去睡觉。
hit the 'off' button.translation: 朋友：这集还有半小时才结束呢 你：我实在撑不住了 先hit the off button去睡了 朋友：那我自己看完剩下的 你：晚安 明天再聊后续剧情
hit the 'off' button.example: Friend: There's still half an hour left in this episode. You: I really can't stay up; I'll hit the off button and go to bed. Friend: Then I'll finish the rest by myself. You: Goodnight, let's talk about the plot tomorrow.

hit the books.context: 考试临近，朋友们都约着出去玩，你却决定留在图书馆埋头苦读复习。
hit the books.translation: 朋友：周末大家约着去唱K 你：我就不去了 下周要考试 得回去hit the books 朋友：别把自己绷太紧呀 你：这周拼一拼 考完再好好放松
hit the books.example: Friend: Everyone's going karaoke this weekend. You: I'll skip it; there's an exam next week and I need to hit the books. Friend: Don't wear yourself out. You: Grind this week, then I'll relax after the test.

hit the gym.context: 你办了张健身卡却一直没去，朋友笑话你，说这周一定拉你去健身房打卡。
hit the gym.translation: 朋友：你那健身卡办了一个月了吧 你：是啊 一次都还没去过 朋友：那可不行 这周末必须一起hit the gym 你：行吧 你陪我去我就不犯怵了
hit the gym.example: Friend: It's been a month since you got that gym membership, right? You: Yeah, and I haven't gone once. Friend: That won't do; we must hit the gym together this weekend. You: Alright, if you come with me I won't dread it.

hit the roof.context: 你不小心把妈妈刚买的花瓶打碎了，她回家看到一地碎片顿时大发雷霆。
hit the roof.translation: 朋友：你妈刚才怎么发那么大火 你：我把她心爱的花瓶打碎了 她直接hit the roof 朋友：那你赶紧道歉收拾一下吧 你：我已经认错了 等她气消点再说话
hit the roof.example: Friend: Why did your mom blow up so just now? You: I broke her favorite vase and she really hit the roof. Friend: Then apologize and clean it up quickly. You: I already admitted it; I'll wait till she cools down to talk.

hit the sack.context: 你连续加了两天班，回到家连外套都没脱，倒头就想上床睡觉。
hit the sack.translation: 朋友：你今晚怎么这么早就困了 你：连续熬了两天 我现在只想马上hit the sack 朋友：那你赶紧去洗漱休息吧 你：好 明天终于能睡个自然醒了
hit the sack.example: Friend: Why are you sleepy so early tonight? You: I've pulled two all-nighters; I just want to hit the sack right now. Friend: Then go wash up and get some rest. You: Okay, tomorrow I can finally sleep in.

hitch a ride.context: 你在路边等不到公交，正好朋友开车经过，你便顺路搭他的车回了家。
hitch a ride.translation: 朋友：公交怎么等了半小时还不来 你：要不我hitch a ride 你看那不是小李开车过来了 朋友：那你问问他顺不顺路 你：他刚好回我们小区 这下省事了
hitch a ride.example: Friend: The bus hasn't come even after half an hour. You: Maybe I'll hitch a ride; isn't that Xiao Li driving by? Friend: Then ask if he's heading our way. You: He's going right back to our complex; this saves me a lot.

hitting the books.context: 期末季路过图书馆，看到朋友天天占座苦读，你感叹他最近真的在用功。
hitting the books.translation: 朋友：这两天怎么都约不出来你 你：我hitting the books呢 论文下周就得交 朋友：你也太拼了 注意休息 你：赶完这波我请你吃饭赔罪
hitting the books.example: Friend: Why can't I get hold of you these days? You: I'm hitting the books; the paper's due next week. Friend: You're grinding too hard; take care. You: I'll treat you to dinner once I'm through this.

hog the middle lane.context: 高速上前方车慢腾腾占着中间道，朋友超不过去，气得吐槽那司机占着道不走。
hog the middle lane.translation: 朋友：前面那车怎么开这么慢 还一直占着中间道 你：他这是在hog the middle lane 后面压了一串车 朋友：我找机会从右边超了他 你：注意安全 别跟这种人较劲
hog the middle lane.example: Friend: Why is that car ahead going so slow and staying in the middle lane? You: He's hogging the middle lane; there's a whole line of cars stuck behind. Friend: I'll overtake on the right when I can. You: Stay safe; don't tangle with him.

hold back on.context: 你看中一款新相机但价钱不菲，朋友劝你先别急着掏钱，再观望一阵再说。
hold back on.translation: 朋友：那款相机你下单了吗 你：还在犹豫 朋友：你先hold back on买 说不定下个月就降价 你：有道理 我再等等看测评
hold back on.example: Friend: Did you order that camera yet? You: I'm still hesitating. Friend: You should hold back on buying; maybe it'll drop next month. You: Good point; I'll wait for the reviews first.

hold in.context: 被朋友误会后你心里委屈，却不想当场发作，硬生生把情绪压了下去。
hold in.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么不替自己辩解一下 你：当着那么多人 我只好把火hold in 朋友：可憋在心里多难受啊 你：等散场了我们再慢慢说清楚
hold in.example: Friend: Why didn't you defend yourself just now? You: In front of so many people, I had to hold in my anger. Friend: But bottling it up feels awful. You: We'll talk it through after everyone leaves.

hold off.context: 外面突然下起大雨，原本计划的野餐只好往后推迟，等天气好转再说。
hold off.translation: 朋友：野餐的东西我都准备好了 你：你看这雨下的 我们最好hold off until天气放晴 朋友：那改到下周六行吗 你：可以 到时候提前看天气预报
hold off.example: Friend: I've got all the picnic things ready. You: Looking at this rain, we'd better hold off until the weather clears. Friend: How about next Saturday instead? You: Fine; we'll check the forecast ahead of time.

hold on a second.context: 你正急着出门找钥匙，朋友在身后喊你等一下，说有东西忘了拿。
hold on a second.translation: 朋友：等等 你别走那么快 你：怎么啦 我快赶不上地铁了 朋友：hold on a second 你把伞落桌上了 你：哎哟谢谢 差点淋雨回家
hold on a second.example: Friend: Wait, don't walk so fast. You: What is it? I'm about to miss the metro. Friend: Hold on a second, you left your umbrella on the table. You: Thanks, I almost would've gotten soaked on the way home.

hold onto the past.context: 朋友早已从一段旧情里走出来，你却还反复提起，他劝你别再沉湎于过去了。
hold onto the past.translation: 朋友：我昨天又在街上碰见前任了 你：都过去这么久了 你别再hold onto the past了 朋友：就是偶尔想起来有点感慨 你：往前看 前面有更好的在等你
hold onto the past.example: Friend: I ran into my ex on the street again yesterday. You: It's been so long; stop holding onto the past. Friend: I just feel a bit nostalgic sometimes. You: Look ahead; something better is waiting for you.

hold out for.context: 你卖二手电器时买家一直压价，你却不肯降价，坚持等一个愿意出合理价的人。
hold out for.translation: 朋友：那个买家出的价你接受了吗 你：太低了 我打算hold out for a fair price 朋友：万一一直卖不掉呢 你：宁可多挂几天 也不想贱卖了它
hold out for.example: Friend: Did you accept that buyer's offer? You: Too low; I'm going to hold out for a fair price. Friend: What if it doesn't sell at all? You: I'd rather keep it listed a few more days than sell it cheap.

hold the door.context: 你和朋友进旋转门时，身后还有位老人推着婴儿车，你伸手帮她扶住门。
hold the door.translation: 朋友：快进来呀 门要关上了 你：你先等一下 我帮那位阿姨hold the door 朋友：你人真好 她一个人推孩子确实不方便 你：顺手的事 我们快进去吧
hold the door.example: Friend: Hurry in, the door's closing. You: Wait a second; I'll hold the door for that lady. Friend: You're so kind; it's inconvenient pushing a baby alone. You: It's no trouble; let's get inside now.

hold the key to.context: 老师说掌握学习方法，才是提高成绩的关键，光靠死记硬背用处不大。
hold the key to.translation: 朋友：我天天刷题 成绩还是上不去 你：因为方法不对 好的方法才hold the key to进步 朋友：那我该怎么调整 你：先把错题弄懂 比盲目刷新题有用
hold the key to.example: Friend: I do endless exercises, yet my grades still won't go up. You: Because your method's off; a good method holds the key to progress. Friend: Then how should I adjust? You: Master the wrong questions first; it beats blindly doing new ones.

hold with.context: 朋友提议周末去爬山，你却更想待在家，坦白说自己不太赞同这个安排。
hold with.translation: 朋友：周末我们去爬山怎么样 你：说实话 我不太hold with这种高强度的安排 朋友：那你想干嘛 你：找个咖啡馆坐坐聊聊天就行
hold with.example: Friend: How about hiking this weekend? You: Honestly, I don't hold with such intense plans. Friend: Then what do you feel like? You: Just finding a café to sit and chat is enough.

hold your hors.context: 朋友急着要拆刚到的快递，你拦住他说别急，先把刀准备好再拆也不迟。
hold your hors.translation: 朋友：我要赶紧把这个箱子拆开看看 你：hold your horses 先找把剪刀 别把里面的东西划坏了 朋友：你说得对 我太着急了 你：慢慢来 又没人跟你抢
hold your hors.example: Friend: I've got to open this box and see what's inside. You: Hold your horses; find some scissors first, or you'll cut what's inside. Friend: You're right, I'm too impatient. You: Take your time; no one's racing you.

holding up.context: 早上高架上车祸堵了一路，朋友问你迟到多久，你说事故还在处理中。
holding up.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么迟到了这么久 你：前面出了车祸 整条路都被holding up 朋友：那你后来是怎么绕出来的 你：跟着导航换了条小路 总算赶过来了
holding up.example: Friend: Why are you so late today? You: There was an accident ahead; the whole road was held up. Friend: Then how did you get around it? You: I followed the maps onto a side road and finally made it.

holiday snap.context: 聚会时朋友翻出去年旅行拍的照片，一张张给大家讲当时的趣事。
holiday snap.translation: 朋友：看看我去年在海边拍的照片 你：这张抓拍得真好 朋友：都是随手拍的holiday snap 你：那边风景也太美了吧 下次我们也去那个岛
holiday snap.example: Friend: Look at the photos I took at the beach last year. You: This candid shot turned out great. Friend: They're just random holiday snaps. You: The scenery there is stunning; let's visit that island next time too.

home away from home.context: 你出差住到朋友推荐的短租公寓，地方虽小却温馨，让你有宾至如归的感觉。
home away from home.translation: 朋友：你出差住的地方还习惯吗 你：特别好 简直是a home away from home 朋友：那我就放心了 你：床很软 厨房还能自己做点简餐
home away from home.example: Friend: Are you comfortable where you're staying on the trip? You: It's wonderful; it's a real home away from home. Friend: Then I can stop worrying. You: The bed's soft, and I can even cook simple meals in the kitchen.

home base.context: 周末你们一群人把你家当成集合点，聚会、开会、打牌都聚在你这里。
home base.translation: 朋友：今天的局定在哪里呀 你：还定在我家吧 这里就是我们的home base 朋友：那我带点零食过去 你：好 我把地方收拾一下 你们随便来
home base.example: Friend: Where are we gathering today? You: Still at my place; it's our home base. Friend: Then I'll bring some snacks. You: Great, I'll tidy up; just come over.

home bird.context: 朋友一到周末就只想窝在家里，从不参加聚会，大家笑称他是个标准宅男。
home bird.translation: 朋友：周末聚餐你到底来不来呀 你：你们去吧 我就不去了 朋友：你真是个home bird 一到周末就不见人影 你：在家追剧比出门自在多了
home bird.example: Friend: Are you coming to the weekend dinner after all? You: You guys go; I'll sit this one out. Friend: You're such a home bird; you vanish every weekend. You: Binge-watching at home is way comfier than going out.

home comfort.context: 你搬了新家，朋友来做客，你带她参观那些让居家生活更舒服的小物件。
home comfort.translation: 朋友：你家布置得真温馨 你：我特意添置了不少home comfort 比如这盏小暖灯 朋友：窝在这样的沙发上看剧太舒服了 你：是啊 宅家也能很幸福
home comfort.example: Friend: Your place is so cozy. You: I added a few home comforts, like this little warm lamp. Friend: Catching up on shows on a sofa like this is just lovely. You: Right; staying home can be pure happiness.

home cooking.context: 朋友来你家吃饭，尝了你妈妈做的红烧肉，连连称赞家常菜最是暖胃。
home cooking.translation: 朋友：今天这桌菜是外面饭店点的吗 你：哪能 都是我妈做的home cooking 朋友：这味道比馆子还香 你：家里的菜就是实在 吃着心里踏实
home cooking.example: Friend: Did you order today's spread from a restaurant? You: Of course not; it's all my mom's home cooking. Friend: This tastes better than any restaurant. You: Home cooking is just hearty; it fills you up inside.

home delivery.context: 你懒得下楼取快递，索性在超市上下单，让他们把菜直接送货上门。
home delivery.translation: 朋友：晚上想吃什么菜 你：我不想出门了 直接让超市home delivery吧 朋友：那我点个菜 你：行 半小时就送到楼下了
home delivery.example: Friend: What do you want for dinner? You: I don't want to go out; let's just get home delivery from the supermarket. Friend: Then I'll pick a few things. You: Good, it'll be downstairs in half an hour.

home exercise.context: 疫情后健身房常关门，你跟着视频在家练瑜伽，慢慢养成了居家锻炼的习惯。
home exercise.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么不去健身房了 你：我改成home exercise了 跟着视频做瑜伽 朋友：在家能练出效果吗 你：坚持下来一样塑形 还省了来回跑
home exercise.example: Friend: Why aren't you going to the gym lately? You: I switched to home exercise, following yoga videos. Friend: Can you get results at home? You: If you stick with it it works too, and saves the trip back and forth.

home exercising.context: 外面下雨没法出门跑步，你就在客厅跟着教程做力量训练，保持运动量。
home exercising.translation: 朋友：今天又下雨 你还跑步吗 你：跑不了了 那我在家home exercising 做几组力量训练 朋友：你这自律性真强 你：习惯了一天不动就浑身难受
home exercising.example: Friend: It's raining again today; are you still running? You: Can't, so I'll just do home exercising with some strength sets. Friend: You're so disciplined. You: Once it's a habit, you feel restless if you skip a day.

home life.context: 聊起工作和生活如何平衡，你说自己现在下班后的家庭生活简单又开心。
home life.translation: 朋友：你下班后一般都怎么安排 你：我home life挺简单的 做做饭看看书 朋友：这样安稳的日子也挺好 你：是啊 平平淡淡才是真
home life.example: Friend: How do you usually spend your evenings after work? You: My home life is pretty simple; I cook and read. Friend: Such a calm, steady life is nice too. You: Right; the plain and quiet is the real thing.

home robot.context: 朋友家新添置了一台扫地机器人，你去做客时看着它自己跑来跑去觉得新奇。
home robot.translation: 朋友：你家这台圆滚滚的是什么 你：是台home robot 每天自动扫地拖地 朋友：那你可省了不少家务事 你：是啊 解放双手太香了
home robot.example: Friend: What's that round thing at your place? You: It's a home robot that vacuums and mops on its own every day. Friend: That saves you a ton of housework. You: Exactly; having your hands freed is the best.

home town.context: 过年你要坐长途车回老家，朋友问起你家乡那边冬天冷不冷。
home town.translation: 朋友：你老家那边冬天一般多少度 你：我home town在北方 冬天能到零下十几度 朋友：那回去得穿得很厚吧 你：羽绒服围巾都备齐 暖气倒是很足
home town.example: Friend: How cold does it usually get in your hometown in winter? You: My home town is in the north; it can drop to minus ten. Friend: Then you must bundle up heavily to go back. You: Down coat and scarf all ready; the heating indoors is strong, though.

home truth.context: 朋友最近状态不对却嘴硬不承认，你忍不住说出几句戳破真相的大实话。
home truth.translation: 朋友：我没事 就是最近有点累 你：咱们认识这么多年了 我跟你说句home truth吧 你其实压力太大了 朋友：被你看穿了 我确实该好好歇一歇 你：这周末我陪你去郊外走走放松一下
home truth.example: Friend: I'm fine, just a bit tired lately. You: We've known each other years; let me give you a home truth—you're actually way too stressed. Friend: You saw right through me; I really should rest. You: This weekend I'll take you to the countryside to unwind.

home viewing.context: 新片影院下映后，你和朋友商量着买个会员，等上线了在家大屏上看。
home viewing.translation: 朋友：那部新电影你去电影院看了吗 你：没有 我打算等它home viewing的时候再看 朋友：在家大屏配爆米花也挺爽 你：对 还能随时暂停去接水
home viewing.example: Friend: Did you catch that new film in the cinema? You: No, I plan to wait for home viewing. Friend: Big screen at home with popcorn is pretty great too. You: Right, and you can pause anytime to get a drink.

homemade craft.context: 学校义卖会上，朋友摆了个小摊，卖她自己做的手工发卡和小摆件。
homemade craft.translation: 朋友：你摊位上这些小东西都哪儿来的 你：都是我自己做的homemade craft 朋友：这发卡做得真精致 多少钱一个 你：五块一个 所得都捐给公益
homemade craft.example: Friend: Where did all these little things on your stall come from? You: They're all my own homemade craft. Friend: This hair clip is so delicate; how much? You: Five yuan each; all proceeds go to charity.

honor with.context: 学校把优秀毕业生请回台上，授予他荣誉校友的称号，全场鼓掌。
honor with.translation: 朋友：台上那位学长好厉害啊 你：学校今天honor him with荣誉校友称号 朋友：他毕业才几年就这么有成就 你：是啊 我们也得好好努力了
honor with.example: Friend: That alumnus on stage is impressive. You: The school is honoring him with an honorary alumni title today. Friend: He's achieved so much just a few years after graduating. You: Right, we should work hard too.

hook up to.context: 你买了台新音箱，回家后照着说明书把它连上手机蓝牙，试了试音效。
hook up to.translation: 朋友：你这音箱怎么用啊 你：先把它hook up to手机蓝牙 然后就能播放了 朋友：连上了 你听听这低音效果 你：确实比我那旧音箱强太多
hook up to.example: Friend: How do you use this speaker? You: First hook it up to your phone's Bluetooth, then you can play. Friend: It's connected; listen to this bass. You: It's way better than my old speaker.

hooked on.context: 朋友最近一有空就打某款游戏，连吃饭都在聊攻略，你说他简直是迷上了。
hooked on.translation: 朋友：你怎么这几天天天抱着手机 你：我最近hooked on一款新游戏 根本停不下来 朋友：玩物丧志啊 你：就周末放松一下 下周肯定收心
hooked on.example: Friend: Why are you glued to your phone these days? You: I'm hooked on a new game; I just can't stop. Friend: That's a bad habit. You: It's just for weekend relaxation; I'll get back on track next week.

hop online.context: 你突然想查一个资料，招呼朋友坐到电脑前，说这就上网帮他搜一搜。
hop online.translation: 朋友：你知道那家书店的具体地址吗 你：我帮你hop online搜一下导航 朋友：搜到了吗 你：找到了 就在地铁站旁边 走过去十分钟
hop online.example: Friend: Do you know that bookstore's exact address? You: Let me hop online and search for directions. Friend: Did you find it? You: Found it; it's right by the metro station, a ten-minute walk.

hope for.context: 期末出成绩前你心里没底，跟朋友说自己只希望别挂科就知足了。
hope for.translation: 朋友：这次考试你觉得能考多少分 你：我也不敢多想 只hope for一个及格就行 朋友：你复习得那么认真 肯定比你想的好 你：借你吉言 出分了我第一时间告诉你
hope for.example: Friend: How many points do you think you'll get on this exam? You: I don't dare hope for much; I just hope for a pass. Friend: You studied so hard, it'll be better than you think. You: I'll take your word for it; I'll tell you the moment scores come out.

hopeless romantic.context: 朋友总记得各种纪念日，还喜欢看爱情电影，你笑说他就是个无可救药的浪漫派。
hopeless romantic.translation: 朋友：我又给女朋友准备了一份惊喜 你：你真是个hopeless romantic 连这种小日子都记着 朋友：感情不就得靠这些仪式感吗 你：说得对 她收到肯定特别感动
hopeless romantic.example: Friend: I've prepared another surprise for my girlfriend. You: You're such a hopeless romantic; you even remember little days like this. Friend: Relationships need these little rituals, right? You: True; she'll be so moved when she gets it.

horizontal brush stroke.context: 你请教牙医正确的刷牙方法，牙医示范说要顺着牙面横向轻轻刷动。
horizontal brush stroke.translation: 朋友：我刷牙总是刷不干净 你：医生说可以用horizontal brush stroke 顺着牙齿方向轻轻刷 朋友：要刷多久才够呢 你：至少两分钟 里面大牙要多刷几下
horizontal brush stroke.example: Friend: I never seem to brush my teeth clean. You: The dentist says you can use horizontal brush strokes, brushing gently along the teeth. Friend: How long should I brush? You: At least two minutes; spend extra on the back molars.

hormone cortisol.context: 健身课上教练讲到长期熬夜会让压力激素升高，影响训练效果。
hormone cortisol.translation: 朋友：为什么我最近练了也不长肌肉 你：可能和你熬夜有关 压力激素cortisol升高会妨碍恢复 朋友：那我以后得早点睡 你：对 睡够了 训练效果才出得来
hormone cortisol.example: Friend: Why aren't I gaining muscle even though I've been training? You: It might be the late nights; high cortisol gets in the way of recovery. Friend: Then I should sleep earlier. You: Right; only with enough sleep will the training pay off.

horror film.context: 周末朋友想约你一起看电影，问你敢不敢陪他看一部吓人的恐怖片。
horror film.translation: 朋友：今晚我们看个电影吧 你：你想看哪种类型的 朋友：我挑了部horror film 你敢不敢一起看 你：有你陪着我就不怕 不过关灯前要做好心理准备
horror film.example: Friend: Let's watch a movie tonight. You: What genre do you want? Friend: I picked a horror film; dare you watch it with me? You: With you beside me I won't be scared, but brace yourself before the lights go out.

hospitality businesses.context: 朋友开了家小民宿，你聊起疫情这几年，餐饮住宿行业受冲击特别大。
hospitality businesses.translation: 朋友：你那家民宿今年生意怎么样 你：这两年hospitality businesses都不好做 客流少了一大半 朋友：慢慢会恢复起来的 你：是啊 等旅游彻底回暖就好了
hospitality businesses.example: Friend: How's business at your B&B this year? You: Hospitality businesses have struggled these two years; footfall's down by more than half. Friend: It'll pick back up gradually. You: Right, once tourism fully recovers it'll be fine.

hospitality staff.context: 酒店招新，你和朋友聊起这里的服务员工资不高，却要三班倒很辛苦。
hospitality staff.translation: 朋友：你那个酒店工作累不累啊 你：挺辛苦的 当hospitality staff得站一整天还倒班 朋友：那你图什么呢 你：包吃包住 还能学点接待的经验
hospitality staff.example: Friend: Is that hotel job of yours tiring? You: Pretty tough; as hospitality staff you stand all day and work shifts. Friend: Then what do you get out of it? You: Meals and lodging are included, and I learn some service experience.

hostile environment.context: 野外考察时团队进了一片风沙很大的荒地，大家说这环境实在太恶劣了。
hostile environment.translation: 朋友：这地方风也太大了吧 你：是啊 对考察队来说是个hostile environment 朋友：我们得把帽子口罩都戴好 你：快走 翻过这个坡就能避风了
hostile environment.example: Friend: The wind here is so strong. You: Yeah, it's a hostile environment for the survey team. Friend: We'd better put on hats and masks. You: Hurry; once we get over this slope we'll be out of the wind.

hot air.context: 同事开会时讲了一堆漂亮话却没实际方案，你私下跟朋友说那都是空话。
hot air.translation: 朋友：刚才那位经理讲的你听明白了吗 你：全是hot air 一句实际方案都没有 朋友：那这事到底谁来推 你：还得我们自己拿主意
hot air.example: Friend: Did you understand what that manager said? You: It was all hot air; not one practical plan. Friend: Then who's actually going to push this? You: We'll have to figure it out ourselves.

hot air balloon.context: 旅游时你在郊外看到天空飘着一个大大的热气球，朋友兴奋地指给你看。
hot air balloon.translation: 朋友：你看天上那个彩色的是什么 你：是个hot air balloon 慢慢飘着呢 朋友：坐上去看风景一定特别棒 你：等我们下次来也体验一把
hot air balloon.example: Friend: What's that colorful thing in the sky? You: It's a hot air balloon, drifting along slowly. Friend: The view from up there must be amazing. You: Let's try it next time we come.

hot spell.context: 连着一周都是三十七八度的高温，你和朋友出门走几步就满头大汗。
hot spell.translation: 朋友：这天气什么时候是个头啊 你：气象台说这股hot spell还要持续好几天 朋友：那出门简直是受罪 你：多喝水 尽量别在正午外出
hot spell.example: Friend: When will this weather end? You: The forecast says this hot spell will last several more days. Friend: Then going out is pure torture. You: Drink plenty of water and avoid going out at midday.

hot topic.context: 吃饭时你们聊起最近全网都在讨论的一个社会新闻，越聊越起劲。
hot topic.translation: 朋友：你看最近那个热搜了吗 你：看了 这话题现在是个hot topic 大家都在讨论 朋友：你怎么看这件事 你：我觉得还是等官方调查结果再说
hot topic.example: Friend: Did you see that trending topic lately? You: I did; it's a real hot topic right now and everyone's debating it. Friend: What's your take on it? You: I think we should wait for the official findings.

hot under the collar.context: 你不小心把朋友刚买的限量球鞋弄脏了，他又急又气，脸都涨红了。
hot under the collar.translation: 朋友：你看你把我鞋弄成什么样了 你：我不是故意的 擦擦应该就干净了 朋友：那可是我排了好久才买到的 你：别hot under the collar了 我赔你送去清洗
hot under the collar.example: Friend: Look what you've done to my shoes. You: I didn't mean it; it should wipe clean. Friend: I waited ages to get these. You: Don't get so hot under the collar; I'll pay to get them cleaned.

hotel of mum and dad.context: 朋友三十好几还住在爸妈家不交房租，大家笑称他是住在父母旅馆里。
hotel of mum and dad.translation: 朋友：你那同事怎么三十多了还跟父母住 你：他是住在the hotel of mum and dad 房租水电全免 朋友：那他自己工资都攒下来了 你：是啊 就是缺点独立生活的经验
hotel of mum and dad.example: Friend: Why does your colleague still live with his parents in his thirties? You: He's living in the hotel of mum and dad, rent and bills all free. Friend: Then he saves his whole salary. You: Right, though he lacks a bit of independent living experience.

hour of need.context: 朋友最近遇到难处开口借钱，你二话不说就帮了他，说朋友难处时就该伸手。
hour of need.translation: 朋友：这次真不好意思开口 你：咱俩谁跟谁 你在your hour of need我当然帮你 朋友：等我发了工资就还你 你：不急 先把眼前的坎过去
hour of need.example: Friend: I really hate to ask this time. You: Come on, between us—when you're in your hour of need, of course I'll help. Friend: I'll pay you back once I get my salary. You: No rush; first get through this rough patch.

house of lords.context: 英国政治课上老师讲到议会结构，介绍说上议院议员是由任命和世袭产生的。
house of lords.translation: 朋友：英国议会不是分上下两院吗 你：对 那个house of lords 主要是任命和世袭的议员 朋友：那它和下议院哪个权力大 你：下议院由选举产生 实权更大一些
house of lords.example: Friend: Doesn't the British parliament have two houses? You: Right, the House of Lords is mostly appointed and hereditary members. Friend: Which has more power, it or the Commons? You: The elected Commons holds more real power.

house plant.context: 你在出租屋里摆了几盆绿植，朋友来玩时说这几盆室内植物让房间生动多了。
house plant.translation: 朋友：你这房间摆了几盆植物 一下就不一样了 你：我特别喜欢养house plant 看着它们慢慢长大很治愈 朋友：好养吗 我总把花养死 你：先从绿萝这种皮实的开始试
house plant.example: Friend: Putting a few plants in your room really changes it. You: I love keeping house plants; watching them grow is so healing. Friend: Are they easy to care for? I always kill mine. You: Start with something hardy like a pothos.

household appliance.context: 朋友搬新家正采购，你陪她逛电器城，讨论哪件家用电器最值得先买。
household appliance.translation: 朋友：新家第一件电器买什么好 你：我建议先买冰箱 这个household appliance天天都要用 朋友：洗衣机呢 你：可以排在第二 其他的慢慢再添
household appliance.example: Friend: What's the first appliance to buy for the new place? You: I'd suggest a fridge; it's a household appliance you use every day. Friend: What about a washing machine? You: Second priority; add the rest gradually.

household chore.context: 周末你和朋友分工，一个洗碗一个扫地，把家里的家务琐事分着做完。
household chore.translation: 朋友：这堆碗又堆起来了 你：我们分工吧 我来收拾厨房 你去拖地 朋友：这些household chores真是做不完 你：两个人分着干 半小时就搞定
household chore.example: Friend: The dishes are piling up again. You: Let's split it; I'll do the kitchen and you mop the floor. Friend: These household chores never end. You: Split two ways, we'll be done in half an hour.

household consumption.context: 电费账单寄来你吓了一跳，朋友帮你分析，说夏天空调拉高冷了家庭用电。
household consumption.translation: 朋友：这月电费怎么这么高 你：空调天天开 household consumption自然就上去了 朋友：那出门记得把空调关了 你：我以后随手关掉 能省一点是一点
household consumption.example: Friend: Why is this month's electricity bill so high? You: With the AC on every day, household consumption naturally goes up. Friend: Then remember to turn it off when you go out. You: I'll switch it off from now on; every bit helps.

household expense.context: 你和室友月底算账，把房租水电网费加起来，讨论每月固定的家庭开销。
household expense.translation: 朋友：我们这个月账对一下吧 你：房租加水电网 这几项household expense就不少 朋友：那伙食还能再省省吗 你：自己多做饭 比天天外卖划算
household expense.example: Friend: Let's balance our accounts this month. You: Rent plus utilities and internet, those household expenses alone add up a lot. Friend: Can we cut the food bill more? You: Cook more at home; it beats ordering takeout every day.

household item.context: 搬家打包时你发现抽屉里全是零碎的日用品，朋友说这些都得单独装箱。
household item.translation: 朋友：这一抽屉都是些什么啊 你：牙膏针线充电线 各种household item 朋友：我们找个小箱子专门装它们 你：好 贴个标签 搬家时才好找
household item.example: Friend: What even is this whole drawer? You: Toothpaste, thread, chargers—all kinds of household items. Friend: Let's find a small box just for these. You: Good, and label it so we can find things when moving.

housing affordability.context: 新闻里在讨论大城市房价太高，年轻人买房越来越吃力，聊到购房承受力问题。
housing affordability.translation: 朋友：现在的房价你觉得合理吗 你：确实太高了 年轻人的housing affordability越来越差 朋友：那大家怎么办 你：很多人先租房 等攒够了首付再说
housing affordability.example: Friend: Do you think today's home prices are reasonable? You: Honestly too high; young people's housing affordability keeps worsening. Friend: Then what do people do? You: Many rent first and wait till they've saved a down payment.

hover over.context: 你在做网页设计演示，把鼠标停在某个按钮上，旁边就弹出提示说明。
hover over.translation: 朋友：你把鼠标移到这个图标上看看 你：只要hover over它 就会弹出一句说明文字 朋友：这样用户一看就懂了 你：是啊 交互做得越直观越好
hover over.example: Friend: Hover your mouse over this icon and see. You: Whenever you hover over it, a little explanation pops up. Friend: Then users get it at a glance. You: Right; the more intuitive the interaction, the better.

how do you fancy.context: 周末你想约朋友出去，于是问他想不想一起去新开的那家咖啡馆坐坐。
how do you fancy.translation: 朋友：今天天气这么好 你：how do you fancy去河边那家新咖啡馆坐坐 朋友：好呀 我正好也想出去走走 你：那我们半小时后在路口碰头
how do you fancy.example: Friend: The weather's so nice today. You: How do you fancy sitting by that new riverside café? Friend: Sure, I wanted to get out for a walk too. You: Then let's meet at the corner in half an hour.

human activity.context: 环保纪录片里展示冰川融化，旁白说这些变化大多来自人类日常活动的累积。
human activity.translation: 朋友：冰川真的在一点点消失吗 你：是的 大部分和human activity的累积排放有关 朋友：那我们普通人能做什么 你：少开车多坐公共交通 从自己做起
human activity.example: Friend: Are glaciers really disappearing little by little? You: Yes, mostly tied to the cumulative emissions from human activity. Friend: Then what can ordinary people do? You: Drive less and take public transit; start with yourself.

human body.context: 解剖课上老师讲解骨骼结构，说人体是一套设计得非常精巧的系统。
human body.translation: 朋友：人的骨头一共有多少块来着 你：成人大概二百零六块 整个人体结构特别精妙 朋友：你背得真熟 你：考试要考的 我昨晚刚复习过
human body.example: Friend: How many bones are in the human body again? You: About two hundred and six in an adult; the whole human body is exquisitely designed. Friend: You really know it by heart. You: It's on the test; I just reviewed it last night.

human connection.context: 奶奶一个人住，周末你都尽量回去陪她，因为老人最需要的是人与人的情感陪伴。
human connection.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么总往奶奶家跑 你：她最缺的不是钱 是那种真实的human connection 朋友：那我陪你一起去看看她 你：太好了 她见人多可开心了
human connection.example: Friend: Why do you always head to your grandma's on weekends? You: What she misses most isn't money, but that real human connection. Friend: Then I'll come with you to visit her. You: Great; she's so happy when there are more people around.

human enhancement.context: 科技展上看到机械外骨骼，朋友问这类人体增强技术未来会不会普及。
human enhancement.translation: 朋友：这副外骨骼穿起来是什么感觉 你：它属于human enhancement 能帮你扛起更重的东西 朋友：以后是不是人人都能穿 你：先帮工人和康复人群用起来吧
human enhancement.example: Friend: What does this exoskeleton feel like to wear? You: It's human enhancement; it lets you carry much heavier loads. Friend: Will everyone be able to wear it one day? You: Probably for workers and rehab patients first.

human habitation.context: 徒步时你们走到一片荒无人烟的山谷，四周安静得听不见一点人声。
human habitation.translation: 朋友：这地方方圆几公里都没人吧 你：是啊 这里几乎没有任何human habitation 朋友：晚上会不会有野生动物 你：我们就在营地待着 把帐篷扎好
human habitation.example: Friend: There's probably no one for miles around here, right? You: Right, there's almost no human habitation here. Friend: Will there be wild animals at night? You: We'll just stay in camp and pitch the tent well.

human nature.context: 朋友在便利店捡到钱包却纠结要不要据为己有，你笑说这就是人性的考验。
human nature.translation: 朋友：我捡到个钱包 里面还有好几百块 你：交还给失主吧 这也是对human nature的考验 朋友：我本来也想还的 你：那就快去交给店员 失主肯定急坏了
human nature.example: Friend: I found a wallet with several hundred yuan in it. You: Give it back to the owner; it's a test of human nature. Friend: I meant to return it anyway. You: Then hurry and hand it to the shop assistant; the owner must be frantic.

human resources.context: 你在公司内部网站上找招聘信息，点进人力资源栏目看最新的岗位。
human resources.translation: 朋友：你们公司还招人吗 你：你上human resources那个板块看 岗位都挂在上面 朋友：需要内推吗 你：可以 你把简历发我 我帮你递进去
human resources.example: Friend: Is your company still hiring? You: Check the human resources section; all the openings are posted there. Friend: Do I need an internal referral? You: You do; send me your resume and I'll pass it on.

human resources department.context: 你入职第一天，前台让你先去人力资源部门办手续、录档案、领设备。
human resources department.translation: 朋友：今天第一天上班顺利吗 你：一早先去human resources department办了入职 领了电脑和门禁卡 朋友：接下来就去见部门同事了 你：希望一切都能慢慢上手
human resources department.example: Friend: How's your first day of work going? You: First I went to the human resources department for onboarding, got my laptop and access card. Friend: Next you'll meet your team. You: Hopefully I'll ease into everything gradually.

human sentiment.context: 读诗时朋友感慨好的作品总能唤起人内心共通的情感，跨越年代打动读者。
human sentiment.translation: 朋友：为什么几百年前的诗现在还能打动我们 你：因为它写出了共通的human sentiment 朋友：离别和思念是永恒的主题 你：是啊 这就是文字的力量
human sentiment.example: Friend: Why do poems from hundreds of years ago still move us today? You: Because they capture a shared human sentiment. Friend: Longing and parting are timeless themes. You: Right; that's the power of words.

human settlement.context: 考古纪录片里展示几千年前的村落遗迹，学者据此推断早期人类定居点的样貌。
human settlement.translation: 朋友：这些土堆下面真的住过人吗 你：考古学家认为这是一处ancient human settlement 有房子和墓葬 朋友：真难想象那时候的生活 你：是啊 每一层土都藏着故事
human settlement.example: Friend: Did people really live under these mounds? You: Archaeologists think this is an ancient human settlement, with houses and tombs. Friend: It's hard to imagine life back then. You: Right; every layer of soil holds a story.

human speech.context: 教鹦鹉说话时你发现，动物能模仿声音，却无法真正理解人类语言背后的意思。
human speech.translation: 朋友：你家鹦鹉居然会说你好 你：它只是模仿声音 并不懂human speech真正的含义 朋友：那它知道自己在说什么吗 你：应该不懂 就是学个腔调罢了
human speech.example: Friend: Your parrot can actually say hello. You: It just mimics sounds; it doesn't truly understand human speech. Friend: Does it know what it's saying? You: Probably not; it's just copying the tone.

humanoid robot.context: 科技展上一台外形和人差不多的机器人走出来打招呼，你和朋友都看呆了。
humanoid robot.translation: 朋友：那个走路的是机器人吗 你：对啊 是台humanoid robot 长得跟人几乎一样 朋友：它能跟我们对话吗 你：可以简单问答 但动作还有点生硬
humanoid robot.example: Friend: Is that thing walking a robot? You: Yeah, it's a humanoid robot, almost identical to a person. Friend: Can it talk with us? You: It can do simple Q and A, though its movements are still a bit stiff.

humming motors.context: 你半夜经过机房，听见一排排服务器运转发出低沉而持续的嗡嗡声。
humming motors.translation: 朋友：这屋里一直嗡嗡响 你：是那些服务器在转 满屋子都是humming motors 朋友：在这上班不吵得慌吗 你：习惯了就还好 戴副耳塞就行
humming motors.example: Friend: There's a constant hum in this room. You: It's the servers running; the whole place is full of humming motors. Friend: Isn't it noisy to work here? You: You get used to it; earplugs do the trick.

hunched over.context: 朋友在电脑前坐了一整天，你抬头看他弓着背缩着脖子，提醒他起来活动活动。
hunched over.translation: 朋友：我背怎么这么酸 你：你看你整天hunched over电脑 脖子都快缩成球了 朋友：那我该怎么坐 你：把屏幕垫高 每隔一小时起来走两步
hunched over.example: Friend: Why is my back so sore? You: Look at you, hunched over the computer all day, neck curled up tight. Friend: Then how should I sit? You: Raise the screen and get up to walk every hour.

hundreds of millions of.context: 刷手机看到一款手机月销量过亿，你跟朋友感叹这数字实在惊人。
hundreds of millions of.translation: 朋友：这款手机卖得到底有多火 你：全球已经卖了hundreds of millions of台 朋友：这也太夸张了吧 你：是呀 几乎人手一台的节奏
hundreds of millions of.example: Friend: How popular is this phone actually? You: It's already sold hundreds of millions of units worldwide. Friend: That's absurd. You: Right; it's almost one in every person.

hundreds of thousands of.context: 演唱会开票瞬间秒空，平台后台显示几十万粉丝同时在线抢购。
hundreds of thousands of.translation: 朋友：票怎么一秒就没了 你：hundreds of thousands of人在抢 我们手速哪比得过 朋友：那只能收黄牛票了 你：太贵了 我还是蹲直播吧
hundreds of thousands of.example: Friend: How did the tickets vanish in a second? You: Hundreds of thousands of people were grabbing them; we can't match that speed. Friend: Then we'll have to buy from scalpers. You: Too expensive; I'll just watch the livestream.

hung out with.context: 周末你约了几个老同学一起吃饭逛街，聊起这一年大家各自的变化。
hung out with.translation: 朋友：这周跟老朋友聚得怎么样 你：我hung out with几个大学同学 聊了一整个晚上 朋友：大家现在都在忙什么呢 你：有的上班有的读研 变化都挺大的
hung out with.example: Friend: How was hanging out with old friends this week? You: I hung out with a few college classmates and chatted all evening. Friend: What is everyone up to now? You: Some working, some studying for grad school; lots has changed.

hush up.context: 公司出了个小事故，领导要求内部封口，绝不能让消息泄露到外面。
hush up.translation: 朋友：上次那个事故最后怎么处理的 你：老板要求hush it up 不许对外透露一个字 朋友：那员工不都知道了吗 你：让大家签了保密协议 谁敢说谁负责
hush up.example: Friend: How was that incident handled in the end? You: The boss wanted to hush it up; not a word to the outside. Friend: But all the employees know. You: They signed NDAs; whoever talks owns the consequences.

hustle and bustle.context: 周末你俩扎进热闹的市中心，人来人往车水马龙，朋友却觉得这份喧嚣才是都市味道。
hustle and bustle.translation: 朋友：市中心也太挤了吧 你：这就是那种hustle and bustle 热闹得让人兴奋 朋友：我还是喜欢安静点的地方 你：那我们逛一会儿就去咖啡馆歇歇
hustle and bustle.example: Friend: The city center is so crowded. You: This is that hustle and bustle; the bustle itself feels exciting. Friend: I still prefer quieter places. You: Then we'll wander a bit and rest at a café.

hybrid engine.context: 朋友新买了辆混动车，你坐进去感受，他介绍说这种车油电结合特别省油。
hybrid engine.translation: 朋友：你这车比之前省多少油 你：因为它是hybrid engine 市区用电高速用油 朋友：那充电麻烦吗 你：有刹车回收 基本不用特意去充
hybrid engine.example: Friend: How much less fuel does your new car use? You: Because it has a hybrid engine, it runs on electric in town and petrol on highways. Friend: Is charging a hassle? You: It recovers energy through braking; rarely need to plug in.

hybrid working.context: 疫情后你们公司改成了一周到岗两天、其余居家，聊起这种新的上班方式。
hybrid working.translation: 朋友：你们现在还天天去公司吗 你：我们搞hybrid working 每周到岗两天就好 朋友：那岂不是很自由 你：也得看项目 忙的时候还是会天天去
hybrid working.example: Friend: Do you still go to the office every day? You: We do hybrid working; just two days in the office a week. Friend: Isn't that really flexible? You: Depends on the project; busy weeks you go every day anyway.

hydration station.context: 马拉松赛道边每隔一段就设一个补水点，跑者经过时拿杯水继续往前。
hydration station.translation: 朋友：跑半程顶得住吗 你：没事 沿路每隔两公里就有hydration station 朋友：那补给还挺到位的 你：对 跑完五公里我就去补点水
hydration station.example: Friend: Can you handle the half marathon? You: It's fine; there's a hydration station every two kilometers along the route. Friend: The support is pretty thorough. You: Right; I'll grab water after five kilometers.

hygiene lapse.context: 餐厅吃坏肚子被投诉，店长在复盘会上承认是后厨一次卫生上的疏忽。
hygiene lapse.translation: 朋友：那家店怎么突然关门整改了 你：被查出一次hygiene lapse 食材没冷藏好 朋友：难怪吃完我肚子不舒服 你：以后吃饭得更留心一点
hygiene lapse.example: Friend: Why did that restaurant suddenly close for rectification? You: They were caught in a hygiene lapse, storing ingredients improperly. Friend: No wonder my stomach felt off after eating there. You: We'll have to be more careful about where we eat.

hygienic hypothesis.context: 育儿课上老师讲，小时候适当接触细菌反而有助于免疫力，提到著名的卫生假说。
hygienic hypothesis.translation: 朋友：孩子是不是越干净越好 你：其实hygiene hypothesis说 太干净反而容易过敏 朋友：那也不能太脏吧 你：平衡就好 正常接触泥土细菌没问题
hygienic hypothesis.example: Friend: Is it better to keep a child as clean as possible? You: Actually the hygiene hypothesis says being too clean can lead to allergies. Friend: But it can't be too dirty either. You: Balance is key; normal contact with dirt and germs is fine.

ice cream innovation.context: 你在冷饮店看到新出的盐味冰淇淋，跟朋友聊起商家总在不断推出新奇口味。
ice cream innovation.translation: 朋友：这个新口味我从来没见过 你：商家一直在做ice cream innovation 什么奇怪的搭配都有 朋友：咸的冰淇淋好吃吗 你：尝一口还真挺上头的
ice cream innovation.example: Friend: I've never seen this new flavor before. You: Shops keep doing ice cream innovation, coming up with all sorts of odd combos. Friend: Does salty ice cream taste good? You: One bite and it's surprisingly addictive.

ice rink.context: 冬天你和朋友去商场里的真冰场滑冰，一开始摔得东倒西歪慢慢才找到感觉。
ice rink.translation: 朋友：你会滑冰吗 我不敢上 你：来吧 这个ice rink不陡 扶着栏杆慢慢走 朋友：我刚摔了一跤 你：正常 多摔几次就找到平衡了
ice rink.example: Friend: Can you skate? I'm too scared to get on. You: Come on, this ice rink isn't steep; just hold the rail and take it slow. Friend: I just fell. You: Normal; fall a few more times and you'll find your balance.

iceberg lettuce.context: 做沙拉时朋友问用哪种生菜脆，你推荐她买那种包得紧实、叫西生菜的品种。
iceberg lettuce.translation: 朋友：我做沙拉买哪种生菜好 你：你买iceberg lettuce 那种叶子脆生生的 朋友：它和普通生菜有啥区别 你：更爽口 拌三明治也很好吃
iceberg lettuce.example: Friend: Which lettuce should I buy for salad? You: Get iceberg lettuce; the leaves are nice and crunchy. Friend: How is it different from regular lettuce? You: Crunchier; great in sandwiches too.

iconic toy.context: 你翻出小时候玩的铁皮机器人，跟朋友说这可是一代人记忆里的经典玩具。
iconic toy.translation: 朋友：你怎么还留着这个老玩具 你：它可是那时候的iconic toy 全班都想要一个 朋友：现在的小孩还玩这个吗 你：少了 都被手机和平板取代了
iconic toy.example: Friend: Why have you kept this old toy? You: It was an iconic toy back then; everyone in class wanted one. Friend: Do kids play with these anymore? You: Rarely; phones and tablets have taken over.

icy grip.context: 寒潮来袭，你和朋友裹紧大衣走在路上，感觉整座城市都被严寒牢牢攥住。
icy grip.translation: 朋友：今天也太冷了吧 你：寒潮一来 整座城都被an icy grip攥住了 朋友：风刮得脸生疼 你：快躲进前面那家店暖和一下
icy grip.example: Friend: It's so cold today. You: Once the cold wave hits, the whole city is in an icy grip. Friend: The wind stings my face. You: Quick, duck into that shop ahead to warm up.

icy water.context: 夏天跑完步你满头大汗，朋友递来一瓶刚从冰箱拿出来的冰水，你一口灌下半瓶。
icy water.translation: 朋友：快喝点水吧 你：这冰水来得太及时了 我渴得不行 朋友：刚运动完别喝太急 你：就一口 舒服多了
icy water.example: Friend: Have some water. You: This icy water couldn't come at a better time; I'm so thirsty. Friend: Don't gulp it right after exercise. You: Just one sip; I already feel much better.

id card.context: 去酒店入住前台要登记证件，你翻包找了半天才掏出身份证递给对方。
id card.translation: 朋友：前台说要登记证件 你：我带了 这是我的id card 朋友：需不需要押金啊 你：要的 你记得也把身份证准备好
id card.example: Friend: The front desk wants to register an ID. You: I brought it; here's my ID card. Friend: Do they require a deposit too? You: They do; remember to get your ID card ready as well.

ideal customer profile.context: 创业团队开会讨论产品定位，市场部同事画出了最理想客户的画像。
ideal customer profile.translation: 朋友：我们这产品到底卖给谁呀 你：市场部已经做了ideal customer profile 主要是二十五到三十五岁女性 朋友：那宣传就得投她们常看的号 你：对 精准触达才不浪费预算
ideal customer profile.example: Friend: Who exactly are we selling this product to? You: Marketing has built an ideal customer profile, mainly women aged twenty-five to thirty-five. Friend: Then we should advertise on the accounts they follow. You: Right; precise reach doesn't waste the budget.

idealised self.context: 你总在社交网络上看到别人光鲜的生活，心理学家说那其实只是人们想呈现的理想自我。
idealised self.translation: 朋友：为什么刷朋友圈越刷越焦虑 你：大家展示的多是idealised self 不是真实日常 朋友：那看着别人更好就难受 你：别比啦 过好自己的日子就行
idealised self.example: Friend: Why does scrolling Moments make me more anxious? You: People mostly show their idealised self, not real daily life. Friend: Then it hurts seeing others seem better. You: Stop comparing; just live your own life well.

identical twin.context: 朋友生了对长得一模一样的双胞胎，你去看望时都快分不清谁是谁了。
identical twin.translation: 朋友：这俩孩子长得也太像了 你：他们是identical twin 几乎就是一个模子刻出来的 朋友：那爸妈怎么分得清 你：手上戴不同颜色的手环
identical twin.example: Friend: These two look so alike. You: They're identical twins, almost carved from the same mold. Friend: Then how do the parents tell them apart? You: They wear wristbands in different colors.

identity theft.context: 你收到短信说账户异常，警觉地告诉朋友这可能是身份盗用的诈骗。
identity theft.translation: 朋友：你短信说银行卡被盗刷了 你：别乱点链接 这很可能是identity theft诈骗 朋友：那我该怎么办 你：直接打银行官方电话核实
identity theft.example: Friend: The text says your card was used fraudulently. You: Don't click the link; it's probably identity theft fraud. Friend: Then what should I do? You: Call the bank's official number directly to check.

idle away.context: 退休后你外公每天在公园长椅上晒晒太阳下下棋，慢悠悠打发时光。
idle away.translation: 朋友：你外公退休后的日子过得怎么样 你：每天在公园idle away时光 下棋听戏 朋友：这样也挺惬意的 你：是啊 忙了一辈子该享清福了
idle away.example: Friend: How's your grandfather's retired life? You: He idles away his days in the park, playing chess and listening to opera. Friend: That sounds really leisurely. You: Right; after a busy life he deserves to enjoy peace.

if so.context: 同事问你周末要不要加班，你本不想去，反问他是不是必须到场。
if so.translation: 朋友：这周末可能要加个班 你：if so那我得提前推掉别的事 朋友：也不是一定 看项目进度 你：你确定了再告诉我吧
if so.example: Friend: We might have to work overtime this weekend. You: If so, I'll have to cancel my other plans. Friend: Not necessarily; it depends on the project progress. You: Then tell me once you're sure.

if that’s the case.context: 朋友说航班可能取消，你顺着话问，要是真那样我们今晚住哪儿。
if that’s the case.translation: 朋友：天气预报说今晚有大暴雨 你：if that's the case 航班搞不好会取消 朋友：那我们得住机场附近了 你：先把附近酒店订上比较稳妥
if that’s the case.example: Friend: The forecast says a heavy storm tonight. You: If that's the case, the flight might get canceled. Friend: Then we'd have to stay near the airport. You: Safer to book a nearby hotel now.

if the worst comes to the worst.context: 你准备了备用方案，告诉朋友万一计划全泡汤，我们也有兜底的办法。
if the worst comes to the worst.translation: 朋友：万一到时候下雨怎么办 你：if the worst comes to the worst 我们就改去室内展馆 朋友：那门票退起来麻烦吗 你：买的可退票 不怕临时改
if the worst comes to the worst.example: Friend: What if it rains when we get there? You: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll switch to the indoor exhibition hall. Friend: Is the ticket refund a hassle? You: I bought refundable ones; no fear of changing plans.

ignorance is bliss.context: 朋友总想查前任的近况，你劝他别自寻烦恼，不知道反而更快乐。
ignorance is bliss.translation: 朋友：我忍不住又去翻他的动态了 你：真的别再看了 ignorance is bliss 知道了反而难受 朋友：可是我控制不住自己 你：把账号取关 时间长了就好了
ignorance is bliss.example: Friend: I couldn't help checking his updates again. You: Really stop; ignorance is bliss, and knowing only hurts. Friend: But I can't control myself. You: Unfollow him; with time it gets easier.

illegal logging.context: 环保纪录片里展示成片被砍光的山林，旁白说这些是偷偷进行的非法砍伐。
illegal logging.translation: 朋友：这些山怎么树都被砍光了 你：多半是illegal logging 半夜偷偷砍完拉走 朋友：那为什么没人管 你：执法难度大 只能靠监督举报
illegal logging.example: Friend: Why are all the trees gone on these hills? You: Probably illegal logging, cut down and carted off at night. Friend: Then why does nobody stop it? You: Enforcement is hard; it relies on monitoring and reporting.

image quality.context: 你买了台新相机，拍出来的照片细节锐利，朋友夸这画质比手机强太多。
image quality.translation: 朋友：你这相机拍的夜景真清楚 你：传感器大 image quality自然就上去了 朋友：手机不是也能夜景模式吗 你：放大看就知道差别了 细节完全不一样
image quality.example: Friend: The night shots from your camera are really clear. You: With a bigger sensor, the image quality naturally goes up. Friend: Doesn't the phone have night mode too? You: Zoom in and you'll see the difference; the detail is on another level.

imaginary danger.context: 小孩怕黑不敢一个人睡，你安慰他房间里没有怪物，那些害怕都是想象出来的。
imaginary danger.translation: 朋友：我怕衣柜里藏着怪物 你：别怕 那只是你imaginary danger 现实里什么都没有 朋友：那你能不能陪我睡 你：我把小夜灯开着 你就不怕了
imaginary danger.example: Friend: I'm afraid there's a monster in the wardrobe. You: Don't worry, that's just an imaginary danger; there's nothing real. Friend: Then can you sleep with me? You: I'll leave the nightlight on; then you won't be scared.

imaginative play.context: 幼儿园里小朋友拿着玩偶假装做饭开派对，老师说这就是有益的想象游戏。
imaginative play.translation: 朋友：孩子们在玩过家家 你：这就是imaginative play 对大脑发育特别好 朋友：就瞎玩也有好处吗 你：有的 他们在练习角色扮演和表达
imaginative play.example: Friend: The kids are playing house. You: That's imaginative play; it's really good for brain development. Friend: Does just messing around help? You: Yes; they're practicing role play and expression.

immediate environment.context: 你到新公司上班，首先得观察周围同事的习惯和规矩，尽快熟悉这个小环境。
immediate environment.translation: 朋友：新环境上班第一天感觉怎么样 你：我先观察一下immediate environment 大家几点午休 怎么沟通 朋友：慢慢来 熟了就好 你：有不懂的我就主动问
immediate environment.example: Friend: How was your first day in the new environment? You: First I'll observe my immediate environment—when everyone takes lunch, how people communicate. Friend: Take it slow; it'll get familiar. You: I'll just ask whenever I'm unsure.

immediate family.context: 办签证要填家庭成员信息，你只填了爸妈和自己，朋友问爷爷奶奶算不算。
immediate family.translation: 朋友：申请表上家庭成员都写谁 你：一般指immediate family 就是父母和兄弟姐妹 朋友：那爷爷奶奶不算吗 你：要写的话另外有一栏 你先把直系亲属填了
immediate family.example: Friend: Whom do I list as family on the application? You: Usually immediate family means parents and siblings. Friend: Do grandparents not count? You: There's a separate section if needed; fill in the immediate family first.

immediate positive emotion.context: 心理学课上老师说，收到一句表扬能立刻带来积极情绪，让人一天都开心。
immediate positive emotion.translation: 朋友：为什么别人一句夸奖能高兴半天 你：因为它能带来immediate positive emotion 大脑立刻就爽了 朋友：那多夸人还真是好事 你：对 成本低 效果好
immediate positive emotion.example: Friend: Why can one compliment make you happy all day? You: Because it brings an immediate positive emotion; the brain feels good right away. Friend: So praising people more is genuinely good. You: Right; cheap and effective.

immense stress.context: 项目上线前一周你连轴转，朋友看你黑眼圈重，说你压力实在太大了。
immense stress.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么都不回消息 你：项目上线前 我正顶着immense stress 朋友：再熬下去身体要出问题 你：再坚持一周 上线了就好了
immense stress.example: Friend: Why haven't you replied lately? You: Before launch, I'm under immense stress. Friend: Keep grinding and your health will break. You: Just hold on a week; once it launches I'll be fine.

immerse in nature.context: 周末你特意跑到山里住两天，关掉手机，让自己彻底沉浸在自然里。
immerse in nature.translation: 朋友：你这周末又躲山里去 你：对 我想好好immerse in nature 把工作彻底忘掉 朋友：空气肯定特别好吧 你：是啊 听着鸟叫睡觉 压力全消了
immerse in nature.example: Friend: Off to the mountains again this weekend? You: Yeah, I want to really immerse in nature and forget work completely. Friend: The air must be amazing. You: Right; sleeping to birdsong, all the stress just melts away.

immersed in.context: 朋友看书特别投入，你喊他好几声都没反应，原来他完全沉浸在小说里了。
immersed in.translation: 朋友：你喊他干嘛呢 他根本听不见 你：他整个人都immersed in那本小说了 朋友：看个书至于这么入迷吗 你：你读进去就知道了 特别上头
immersed in.example: Friend: Why are you calling him? He can't hear a thing. You: He's totally immersed in that novel. Friend: Can reading really be that absorbing? You: Wait till you get into it; it's addictive.

immersive experience.context: 你们去体验 VR 展馆，戴上眼镜后仿佛置身另一个世界，朋友说这沉浸感太强了。
immersive experience.translation: 朋友：这也太真实了吧 你：戴上设备后就是一种immersive experience 跟真的一样 朋友：我差点伸手去碰那只恐龙 你：大家都这样 新鲜感特别足
immersive experience.example: Friend: This feels so real. You: Once you put on the headset it's an immersive experience, just like being there. Friend: I almost reached out to touch that dinosaur. You: Everyone does; the novelty is off the charts.

immersive reading.context: 出差路上你带了本小说，在飞机上一口气读了大半，享受这种沉浸式阅读。
immersive reading.translation: 朋友：你在飞机上都干嘛呀 你：看书 两小时不被打扰 是难得的immersive reading 朋友：我一上飞机就想睡觉 你：那是你没挑到对的书
immersive reading.example: Friend: What do you do on a flight? You: Read; two undisturbed hours is rare immersive reading. Friend: I just want to sleep as soon as I board. You: That's because you haven't picked the right book.

immersive travel.context: 你不爱去景点打卡，更喜欢住在当地人家中深入体验，聊起这种深度旅行方式。
immersive travel.translation: 朋友：你旅游怎么不去看那些名胜 你：我更喜欢immersive travel 住当地人家里学做家常菜 朋友：那样不是更麻烦吗 你：麻烦点 但看到的才是真生活
immersive travel.example: Friend: Why don't you see the famous sights when you travel? You: I prefer immersive travel, staying with locals and learning to cook their food. Friend: Isn't that more of a hassle? You: A bit, but you see the real life.

immune function.context: 医生让你规律作息多睡觉，说这能帮身体维持正常的免疫功能。
immune function.translation: 朋友：我最近老感冒 你：得注意提高immune function 多睡觉别熬夜 朋友：光睡觉就能不生病吗 你：免疫跟上了 自然就少生病了
immune function.example: Friend: I keep catching colds lately. You: You need to support your immune function—sleep more and stop staying up. Friend: Just sleeping really keeps illness away? You: Once your immunity is up, you get sick less.

immune health.context: 体检后医生建议你多吃蔬果、勤锻炼，这些都对免疫健康有好处。
immune health.translation: 朋友：提高免疫力到底吃啥好 你：其实照顾好immune health 主要靠均衡饮食加运动 朋友：保健品要不要吃 你：不如先把三餐和睡眠搞好
immune health.example: Friend: What should I eat to boost immunity? You: Honestly, taking care of immune health is mainly a balanced diet plus exercise. Friend: Should I take supplements? You: Better sort out meals and sleep first.

immune system.context: 科普视频里讲到打疫苗的原理，说疫苗是在训练身体的免疫系统识别敌人。
immune system.translation: 朋友：打疫苗到底为啥能防病 你：它先把弱病毒送进身体 训练immune system认识它 朋友：那真病毒来了就不怕了 你：对 免疫系统一下就能反应过来
immune system.example: Friend: Why do vaccines prevent disease? You: They send weakened virus in first, training the immune system to recognize it. Friend: Then you're safe when the real one comes. You: Right, the immune system reacts instantly.

impact on.context: 论文里讨论手机使用时长和成绩的关系，你和同学聊起屏幕时间对学习的影响。
impact on.translation: 朋友：这篇文章结论靠谱吗 你：它研究的是screen time对成绩的impact on 学生表现 朋友：那手机真会拖后腿吗 你：过度使用确实有负面影响
impact on.example: Friend: Is this paper's conclusion reliable? You: It studies the impact on students' performance from screen time. Friend: Does the phone really hold you back? You: Excessive use does have a negative effect.

impacts on.context: 新闻里在分析减排政策对空气质量的作用，提到它对市民健康的种种影响。
impacts on.translation: 朋友：这个政策真有用吗 你：它讨论了减排对城市空气的impacts on 大家的健康 朋友：具体体现在哪里 你：呼吸道病人少了 蓝天多了
impacts on.example: Friend: Is this policy actually useful? You: It examines the impacts on public health from cutting emissions. Friend: Where does that show? You: Fewer respiratory patients and more blue sky days.

imperial college london.context: 朋友立志要考去英国名校，你问他是不是瞄准了伦敦帝国理工那类学校。
imperial college london.translation: 朋友：我想去英国读硕士 你：是瞄准imperial college london那类学校吗 朋友：对 那里理工科特别强 你：那你得把绩点和雅思都刷上去
imperial college london.example: Friend: I want to do a master's in the UK. You: Are you aiming at Imperial College London and places like that? Friend: Yes, their STEM programs are really strong. You: Then you'll need to boost your GPA and IELTS.

impervious to.context: 朋友脾气特别好，别人怎么吐槽他都不为所动，你说他简直刀枪不入。
impervious to.translation: 朋友：刚才那同事话说得多难听啊 你：他好像完全impervious to criticism 一点都不生气 朋友：这心态也太好了 你：是啊 换我早急了
impervious to.example: Friend: How cutting was that colleague's words just now? You: He seems totally impervious to criticism, not annoyed at all. Friend: What a great mindset. You: Right; I'd have lost my cool already.

impinge on.context: 你抱怨楼里装修噪音太大，朋友提醒说别让这些杂事过多干扰到正常生活。
impinge on.translation: 朋友：最近装修吵得我没法集中 你：噪音确实会impinge on我们的生活质量 朋友：要不要戴耳塞 你：我买了副 下班回来就清静了
impinge on.example: Friend: The renovation noise makes it impossible to focus. You: Noise really can impinge on our quality of life. Friend: Should I wear earplugs? You: I bought a pair; it's peaceful once I'm back.

import produce.context: 你在超市看到进口水果柜台，聊起有些农产品本地不产只能靠进口。
import produce.translation: 朋友：这菠萝怎么这么贵 你：它是imported produce 长途运来的 运费都算里面了 朋友：那不如吃本地的应季水果 你：对 便宜还新鲜
import produce.example: Friend: Why is this pineapple so expensive? You: It's imported produce, shipped a long way, and the freight is in the price. Friend: Then better eat local in-season fruit. You: Right; cheaper and fresher.

import tax.context: 你海淘了一件外国商品，结账时发现加了一笔进口关税，价格一下贵了不少。
import tax.translation: 朋友：这海外直邮怎么比标价贵这么多 你：因为要交import tax 还有清关费 朋友：那以后还值不值得买 你：算上税 有时候国内买更划算
import tax.example: Friend: Why is this overseas order so much more than the price tag? You: Because there's import tax plus customs clearance. Friend: Then is it still worth buying abroad? You: Once tax is added, buying domestic is sometimes cheaper.

imported ingredient.context: 你在咖啡店喝到一款特别的糖浆，店员介绍说这是专门从国外进口的原料。
imported ingredient.translation: 朋友：这杯咖啡味道怎么这么特别 你：它用了一种imported ingredient 国内不常见 朋友：难怪比别家贵一点 你：物以稀为贵 偶尔喝一杯还行
imported ingredient.example: Friend: Why does this coffee taste so special? You: It uses an imported ingredient that's rare domestically. Friend: No wonder it's a bit pricier. You: Rarity has its price; a cup once in a while is fine.

impromptu think tank.context: 临时被拉去讨论公司难题，几个同事凑在一起七嘴八舌，像个临时智囊团。
impromptu think tank.translation: 朋友：开会聊了俩小时 有结论吗 你：我们几个临时组了个impromptu think tank 你一言我一语 朋友：那点子靠谱吗 你：还真冒出几个可行的方向
impromptu think tank.example: Friend: Two hours of meeting; any conclusion? You: We formed an impromptu think tank, tossing ideas back and forth. Friend: Are the ideas any good? You: We actually came up with a few workable directions.

improve blood flow.context: 医生建议久坐的人每小时站起来走几分钟，说这样能促进血液循环。
improve blood flow.translation: 朋友：我久坐老觉得腿脚发麻 你：多站起来走走 能improve blood flow 朋友：那上班怎么办 你：每小时接杯水 顺便活动两分钟
improve blood flow.example: Friend: Sitting long, my legs keep falling asleep. You: Stand up and walk; it improves blood flow. Friend: But I have to sit at work. You: Get water every hour and move around for two minutes.

improve incrementally.context: 你练口语不追求突飞猛进，而是每天进步一点点，朋友问这样效果如何。
improve incrementally.translation: 朋友：你英语怎么稳步变好的 你：我不求速成 只是每天improve incrementally 朋友：这样不会太慢吗 你：慢是慢 但基础扎实 忘不掉
improve incrementally.example: Friend: How is your English steadily getting better? You: I'm not chasing fast progress; I just improve incrementally each day. Friend: Isn't that too slow? You: Slow, but solid; it sticks.

improve mobility.context: 爷爷膝盖不好走路费劲，医生让他做康复训练，慢慢恢复腿部活动能力。
improve mobility.translation: 朋友：爷爷现在能自己下楼了吗 你：做了康复训练 腿的mobility比以前好多了 朋友：那他还能遛弯吗 你：可以 慢走半小时没问题
improve mobility.example: Friend: Can Grandpa get downstairs on his own now? You: After rehab, his mobility is much better than before. Friend: Then can he still take walks? You: Yes, a slow half-hour stroll is fine.

improve performance.context: 运动员教练分析比赛录像，说休息充分才能在下场比赛里发挥更好。
improve performance.translation: 朋友：我们队怎么总在最后掉链子 你：得训练加恢复结合 才能improve performance 朋友：那战术上要不要调整 你：体能跟上了 战术才执行得出来
improve performance.example: Friend: Why does our team always fade at the end? You: Training plus recovery together will improve performance. Friend: Should we adjust the tactics? You: Once fitness holds up, tactics can actually be executed.

improve posture.context: 你天天伏案写代码，肩膀越来越圆，朋友建议你练背来改善体态。
improve posture.translation: 朋友：你怎么越来越驼背了 你：坐办公室坐的 你说我该怎么improve posture 朋友：多练背 再把椅子调高点 你：我明天就买个靠垫
improve posture.example: Friend: Why are you getting more and more hunched? You: From sitting at the office; how do I improve my posture? Friend: Train your back and raise your chair. You: I'll buy a cushion tomorrow.

impulse buy.context: 你路过橱窗被一款打折零食吸引，当场就买了，回家才后悔又乱花钱。
impulse buy.translation: 朋友：你这袋零食哪儿来的 你：路过店门口没忍住 一时impulse buy买的 朋友：你这月都冲动消费几回了 你：是啊 下次真得捂紧钱包
impulse buy.example: Friend: Where did this bag of snacks come from? You: I couldn't resist passing the shop and made an impulse buy. Friend: That's your umpteenth impulse buy this month. You: Right, next time I really need to hold onto my wallet.

in a positive light.context: 朋友总盯着自己的缺点，你劝他换个角度，从积极面看待自己的经历。
in a positive light.translation: 朋友：我觉得自己这也不行那也不行 你：你得把事情看in a positive light 多看看优点 朋友：可我确实搞砸过很多事 你：失败也是经验 慢慢来
in a positive light.example: Friend: I feel I'm no good at anything. You: You need to see things in a positive light and focus on your strengths. Friend: But I've really messed up a lot. You: Failure is experience too; take it slow.

in a rush.context: 早上起晚了，你抓起包就往车站冲，一路上慌慌张张连早饭都没吃。
in a rush.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么跑着来的 你：起晚了 in a rush出门 连早餐都没吃 朋友：那先去买个面包垫垫 你：来不及了 先打卡再说
in a rush.example: Friend: Why did you come running today? You: I got up late and left in a rush, without even eating breakfast. Friend: Then grab a bun to fill up first. You: No time; let's clock in first.

in a split second.context: 球场上对手眼看要射门，守门员一个飞身，在电光火石间把球扑了出去。
in a split second.translation: 朋友：刚才那个扑救太神了 你：守门员in a split second就反应过来了 朋友：这就是顶级门将的直觉 你：换我早就愣在原地了
in a split second.example: Friend: That save was incredible. You: The goalkeeper reacted in a split second. Friend: That's the instinct of a top keeper. You: I'd have been frozen right there.

in an age of.context: 你跟朋友聊起，在这个人人离不开手机的时代，保持专注变得越来越难。
in an age of.translation: 朋友：为什么现在看书看十分钟就走神 你：in an age of endless notifications 专注成了稀缺品 朋友：那怎么找回状态 你：看书时把手机放另一个房间
in an age of.example: Friend: Why can I only read for ten minutes before drifting? You: In an age of endless notifications, focus is a rare thing. Friend: Then how do you get it back? You: Leave your phone in another room while reading.

in attendance.context: 公司年会上，老板在台上发言，全体员工都到场出席，气氛很正式。
in attendance.translation: 朋友：今天年会人怎么这么齐 你：全体员工都in attendance 老板在前面讲话呢 朋友：那我们等下要不要合影 你：散场前肯定会拍大合照
in attendance.example: Friend: Why is everyone at the annual dinner? You: All the staff are in attendance, with the boss speaking up front. Friend: Should we take a group photo later? You: There'll definitely be one before it ends.

in bulk.context: 你和室友发现纸巾洗衣液这类日用品囤着用特别划算，于是干脆整箱批发采购。
in bulk.translation: 朋友：这些日用品哪里买便宜 你：我们都in bulk买 一次囤够半年的量 朋友：那家里堆得下吗 你：省着点买 堆阳台也还行
in bulk.example: Friend: Where's the cheapest place for these daily supplies? You: We buy in bulk, stocking up half a year at once. Friend: Is there room at home? You: Buy sensibly; the balcony holds it.

in check.context: 你最近管住嘴迈开腿，体重慢慢回到正常，朋友问你是怎么控制住的。
in check.translation: 朋友：你这两个月瘦了不少啊 你：靠把饮食和运动都keep in check 一点一点调整 朋友：有没有偷懒的时候 你：偶尔也吃顿好的 别过量就行
in check.example: Friend: You've lost a lot these two months. You: By keeping my diet and exercise in check, adjusting little by little. Friend: Any times you slack off? You: Occasionally a treat, as long as it's not over the top.

in circulation.context: 你提到一枚老版硬币现在少见，朋友说还在流通中的其实已经很少了。
in circulation.translation: 朋友：这种一块钱的纸币还能用吗 你：还在in circulation 不过银行都不再印了 朋友：那留着会不会升值 你：全新品相以后可能有点收藏价值
in circulation.example: Friend: Can these one-yuan notes still be used? You: They're still in circulation, though banks no longer print them. Friend: Will they be worth something if kept? You: Mint-condition ones might have collector value later.

in combination with.context: 教练让你把有氧运动和力量训练结合起来练，说搭配起来效果最好。
in combination with.translation: 朋友：我只做跑步能减肥吗 你：最好把cardio in combination with力量训练 一起练 朋友：那样一周练几次呢 你：三次有氧两次力量 安排开
in combination with.example: Friend: Can I lose weight just by running? You: Better to do cardio in combination with strength training. Friend: Then how many times a week? You: Three cardio days and two strength days, spread out.

in common with.context: 你和新同事聊起家乡，发现你们俩居然都来自同一座小城，口味也一样。
in common with.translation: 朋友：你是哪里人呀 你：我是南方小城的 in common with你 咱们还真算半个老乡 朋友：难怪你也这么爱吃辣 你：那以后吃饭就找对人了
in common with.example: Friend: Where are you from? You: A small southern town; in common with you, we're practically half-provincials. Friend: No wonder you love spicy food too. You: Then I've found the right person for meals.

in comparison to.context: 你换了新工作，朋友问起新岗位和旧岗位比起来待遇差别大不大。
in comparison to.translation: 朋友：新工作工资怎么样 你：in comparison to以前 涨了差不多三成 朋友：那挺好啊 忙不忙 你：忙一点 但值得
in comparison to.example: Friend: How's the pay at the new job? You: In comparison to before, it's up about thirty percent. Friend: That's great; is it busy? You: A bit busier, but worth it.

in conjunction with.context: 项目是几个部门联合推进的，你跟朋友解释说这次活动是多部门协同办的。
in conjunction with.translation: 朋友：这次活动是你们部门自己搞的吗 你：不是 in conjunction with市场和财务一起办的 朋友：那协调起来挺麻烦吧 你：开了好几个会才对拢
in conjunction with.example: Friend: Did your department run this event on its own? You: No, in conjunction with marketing and finance. Friend: Then coordinating is a hassle? You: We had several meetings to align everything.

in consequence.context: 昨晚下了整夜暴雨，今早路面积水严重，交通因此受到很大影响。
in consequence.translation: 朋友：今早路上怎么堵成这样 你：夜里下了大雨 in consequence 好多路段都积水了 朋友：那你迟到了吗 你：提前出门半小时才勉强赶到
in consequence.example: Friend: Why is the road so jammed this morning? You: It rained all night, and in consequence many sections are flooded. Friend: Were you late? You: Leaving half an hour early, I barely made it.

in contrast with.context: 你对比两个城市的生活节奏，朋友说一个快一个慢，差别特别鲜明。
in contrast with.translation: 朋友：你更喜欢哪座城市 你：上海节奏快 in contrast with成都那种慢悠悠 朋友：那你现在定居在哪儿 你：我选了慢一点的 压力小
in contrast with.example: Friend: Which city do you prefer? You: Shanghai's fast; in contrast with Chengdu's slow pace. Friend: Then where do you live now? You: I picked the slower one; less pressure.

in control.context: 遇到突发状况大家都慌了，你却沉着冷静，一步步把局面稳住。
in control.translation: 朋友：刚才机器突然出故障 你：那时候最需要有人in control 我就先断电再排查 朋友：大家都慌成一团了 你：越乱越要冷静处理
in control.example: Friend: The machine suddenly broke just now. You: That's when you need someone in control; I cut power first then checked it. Friend: Everyone was panicking. You: The messier it gets, the calmer you must be.

in control of.context: 项目上你是负责人，大小决策都由你拍板，朋友开玩笑说你现在大权在握。
in control of.translation: 朋友：这个方案最后谁说了算 你：现在我in control of这个项目 我拍板就行 朋友：那压力不小啊 你：责任大 但成就感也强
in control of.example: Friend: Who has the final say on this plan? You: Right now I'm in control of the project, so I make the call. Friend: That's a lot of pressure. You: More responsibility, but more satisfaction too.

in crisis.context: 新闻里说那家公司资金链出了问题，正处在危机之中，大家都盯着后续。
in crisis.translation: 朋友：你买的那只股票最近怎么了 你：那家公司in crisis 现金流快断了 朋友：那我是不是该赶紧卖掉 你：先看它有没有救 别盲目操作
in crisis.example: Friend: What's up with that stock you bought? You: That company's in crisis, its cash flow is almost gone. Friend: Then should I sell right away? You: See if it can be saved first; don't act blindly.

in decades.context: 老同事聚会聊起变化，你说这家工厂几十年来头一回扩招，气氛都不一样了。
in decades.translation: 朋友：厂里现在效益怎么样 你：这是in decades头一回大规模扩招 大家干劲都足了 朋友：那你们年终奖能多拿点吧 你：应该比去年强不少
in decades.example: Friend: How's the factory doing now? You: For the first time in decades, it's hiring on a big scale; morale's up. Friend: Then your year-end bonus should be better? You: Should be noticeably up on last year.

in demand.context: 会做手冲咖啡的师傅特别抢手，你开的店人手不够，客人还特别多。
in demand.translation: 朋友：你这店生意这么好 你：好咖啡师傅现在特别in demand 我都快招不到人了 朋友：那工资开高点呗 你：已经加了 还是难抢
in demand.example: Friend: Your shop's doing so well. You: Skilled baristas are really in demand now; I can barely hire anyone. Friend: Then raise the pay. You: I already did; they're still hard to get.

in depth.context: 老师布置了阅读任务，要求大家不只是翻一遍，而是深入地读懂这本书。
in depth.translation: 朋友：这本书要读到什么程度 你：老师让我们in depth地读 还要写读书笔记 朋友：那得花不少时间 你：是 每周读一章慢慢啃
in depth.example: Friend: How deeply should we read this book? You: The teacher wants us to read it in depth and write notes. Friend: That'll take a lot of time. You: Yeah; one chapter a week, chewing through it slowly.

in exchange for.context: 你把多余的演唱会门票转给同学，不收钱，只换了他两张首映电影票。
in exchange for.translation: 朋友：你那张多余的演唱会票卖了吗 你：我送给同学了 in exchange for他两张电影票 朋友：这交换挺值啊 你：反正我也去不了 不如做个顺水人情
in exchange for.example: Friend: Did you sell that extra concert ticket? You: I gave it to a classmate in exchange for two movie premiere tickets. Friend: That's a fair swap. You: I couldn't go anyway; better to make a friend happy.

in extreme cases.context: 医生说这种药大多数人吃着没事，但在极少数情况下可能出现严重过敏。
in extreme cases.translation: 朋友：这药有什么副作用吗 你：一般没事 in extreme cases才会有人过敏休克 朋友：那我要注意什么 你：第一次吃先少量试试
in extreme cases.example: Friend: Any side effects from this medicine? You: Usually none; in extreme cases some people go into allergic shock. Friend: Then what should I watch for? You: Take a small amount the first time.

in fashion.context: 你翻出去年买的阔腿裤，朋友说现在这种裤型早就不流行了。
in fashion.translation: 朋友：这条裤子还挺好看 你：可这个款式现在还in fashion吗 朋友：阔腿裤早就过气了 你：那我留着在家穿也行
in fashion.example: Friend: These pants look nice. You: But is this cut still in fashion? Friend: Wide-leg pants went out of style long ago. You: Then I'll keep them just to wear at home.

in favour of.context: 部门开会投票是否远程办公，你举了手，表示自己更支持这种方式。
in favour of.translation: 朋友：你投票赞成还是反对 你：我in favour of远程办公 省了通勤 朋友：那老板会不会不同意 你：他说先试点两个月看看
in favour of.example: Friend: Did you vote for or against? You: I'm in favour of remote work; it saves the commute. Friend: Won't the boss disagree? You: He said let's trial it for two months first.

in focus.context: 你拍合照时一会儿虚一会儿实，摄影师提醒你坐稳别动，保持对焦清晰。
in focus.translation: 朋友：怎么每张都糊了 你：你刚才动了 没保持in focus 来 再拍一张 朋友：这次我稳住了 你：对 保持不动 咔嚓就好
in focus.example: Friend: Why is every photo blurry? You: You moved just now, out of focus. Come on, one more. Friend: I'm steady this time. You: Right, stay still, and click.

in force.context: 新的交规这个月起正式施行，朋友问你现在哪些规则开始生效了。
in force.translation: 朋友：新交规今天开始了吗 你：对 这条例已经in force了 朋友：那违章摄像头会更严吗 你：是 开车规矩点别侥幸
in force.example: Friend: Did the new traffic rules start today? You: Yes, the regulation is now in force. Friend: Will the cameras be stricter? You: Yes; drive by the book and don't gamble.

in front.context: 赛跑快到终点，你扭头一看，自己居然还领先着，心里一阵窃喜。
in front.translation: 朋友：最后一圈谁在前边 你：我还in front呢 再撑几十米就到了 朋友：别回头看 全力冲线 你：好 终点就在眼前
in front.example: Friend: Who's ahead on the last lap? You: I'm still in front; just hold on a few more meters. Friend: Stop looking back, sprint to the line. You: Okay, the finish is right there.

in full.context: 你买东西选了分期，朋友提醒说按时全额还款，不然会有利息。
in full.translation: 朋友：这个月账单怎么还 你：我打算in full还清 不想多付利息 朋友：那你得留点钱 你：工资一到账我就转过去
in full.example: Friend: How should I pay this month's bill? You: I plan to pay it in full; I don't want to pay interest. Friend: Then keep some money aside. You: I'll transfer it as soon as salary lands.

in future.context: 你这次考试粗心丢了分，老师提醒你以后读题要更仔细点。
in future.translation: 朋友：我这题怎么又看错了 你：in future读题多扫两遍 别再这么粗心 朋友：下次一定注意 你：审题清楚了 分数自然就上来了
in future.example: Friend: How did I misread this question again? You: In future, scan the question twice; don't be so careless. Friend: I'll be careful next time. You: Read it clearly and the score will go up.

in general term.context: 面试官问你对这个行业怎么看，你先笼统地概括了几句，再展开细节。
in general term.translation: 朋友：面试都问了些啥 你：我先in general term讲了讲行业趋势 再挑一两个细节展开 朋友：那气氛还好吗 你：挺顺畅的 等通知吧
in general term.example: Friend: What did the interview ask? You: First I spoke about industry trends in general terms, then expanded on a couple of details. Friend: How was the vibe? You: Pretty smooth; waiting for the result.

in good time.context: 朋友爱卡点出门，你提醒他早点动身，留出富余时间才不会误车。
in good time.translation: 朋友：我们几点出发赶火车 你：早点走吧 留点in good time 堵车也不慌 朋友：提前一小时够吗 你：够了 到了还能买杯咖啡
in good time.example: Friend: What time should we leave for the train? You: Go early; leave in good time so traffic doesn't panic us. Friend: An hour ahead enough? You: Enough; we can even grab a coffee on arrival.

in great number.context: 国庆假期景区人山人海，你和朋友被挤在中间，感叹游客真是太多了。
in great number.translation: 朋友：这景点人也太多了吧 你：游客in great number 我们走都走不动 朋友：早知道就不该凑这个热闹 你：是啊 下次错峰出行
in great number.example: Friend: There are so many people at this spot. You: Visitors are here in great number; we can barely move. Friend: I shouldn't have joined the rush. You: Right; next time go off-peak.

in harmony with.context: 你在乡下过周末，白天干农活晚上看星星，感觉人和自然相处得很和谐。
in harmony with.translation: 朋友：这几天住乡下感觉如何 你：节奏慢 人和自然in harmony with彼此相处 朋友：空气也特别好吧 你：晚上还能看到星星 城里可看不到
in harmony with.example: Friend: How's staying in the countryside these days? You: Slow pace, people living in harmony with nature. Friend: The air's amazing too? You: You can even see stars at night; never in the city.

in haste.context: 你早上起晚了，慌慌张张抓了包就出门，结果到了公司发现忘带工牌。
in haste.translation: 朋友：你怎么气喘吁吁的 你：出门太in haste 把工牌落桌上了 朋友：那还得回去拿 你：幸好同事顺路给我送了一趟
in haste.example: Friend: Why are you out of breath? You: I left in haste and forgot my badge on the desk. Friend: Then you'll have to go back. You: Luckily a colleague dropped it off for me.

in high demand.context: 降温后羽绒服卖得特别火，商场里几款热门颜色都快断货了。
in high demand.translation: 朋友：这件羽绒服还有M码吗 你：这两天天气骤降 外套in high demand 就剩最后两件了 朋友：那我赶紧拿下 你：别犹豫 犹豫就没了
in high demand.example: Friend: Is this down jacket still in size M? You: The temperature dropped suddenly; coats are in high demand, only two left. Friend: Then I'll grab it fast. You: Don't hesitate; hesitate and it's gone.

in hopes of.context: 你早起排队买网红店的面包，心里盼着开门时能抢到最后一个可颂。
in hopes of.translation: 朋友：你这么早来排队干嘛 你：我in hopes of抢到开门第一炉可颂 朋友：那估计要等好久 你：为了这口 值得
in hopes of.example: Friend: Why are you queuing so early? You: In hopes of grabbing the first batch of croissants when they open. Friend: That'll be a long wait. You: Worth it for this taste.

in isolation.context: 分析问题时你提醒大家别单看一个数据，要结合背景，不能孤立地下结论。
in isolation.translation: 朋友：就凭这一个数字就能判断吗 你：别把它viewed in isolation 得和其他数据放一起看 朋友：那还要对照什么 你：前几个月的走势 才能看出真假
in isolation.example: Friend: Can we judge from this one number alone? You: Don't take it in isolation; look it together with the other data. Friend: Then compare against what? You: The trend of past months, to tell real from noise.

in later life.context: 爷爷退休后坚持练字画画，你说这些爱好让他的晚年生活特别充实。
in later life.translation: 朋友：爷爷平时都怎么打发时间 你：他in later life爱上了书法 每天写两张大字 朋友：这习惯真好 你：是啊 脑子手都不闲着
in later life.example: Friend: How does your grandfather usually spend his time? You: In later life he took up calligraphy and writes a couple of sheets every day. Friend: Such a good habit. You: Right; keeps his mind and hands busy.

in length.context: 你买窗帘量错了尺寸，朋友问这扇窗户到底有多宽，好重新定尺寸。
in length.translation: 朋友：这窗帘还差一截 你：你再量一下 这个窗户in length有多少 朋友：大概两米三 你：那我重新做一块长点的
in length.example: Friend: The curtain's still a bit short. You: Measure again; how long is this window? Friend: About two meters thirty. You: Then I'll order a longer one.

in lieu of.context: 公司取消了年会聚餐，改成给每人发一笔过节费，你跟朋友说起这个变化。
in lieu of.translation: 朋友：今年公司还办年会吗 你：不办了 in lieu of聚餐 每人发了过节费 朋友：那不是更实在 你：是啊 拿钱比吃饭划算
in lieu of.example: Friend: Is the company still holding the annual party? You: No; in lieu of the dinner, everyone got a holiday allowance. Friend: Isn't that more practical? You: Right; cash beats a banquet.

in life.context: 朋友总说想要成功，你反问他，在生活里他到底最看重什么，金钱还是快乐。
in life.translation: 朋友：我到底该追求什么 你：先想明白 in life你最想要的是什么 朋友：我也挺迷茫的 你：慢慢找 别急着下决定
in life.example: Friend: What should I be chasing after all? You: First figure out what you want most in life. Friend: I'm pretty lost too. You: Take your time; don't rush the decision.

in light of.context: 考虑到最近天气反复，你们把户外活动改到了周末，看预报那天比较晴。
in light of.translation: 朋友：活动定在哪天 你：in light of这几天的天气 我们改到周六了 朋友：那天预报是晴天吗 你：对 温度也合适
