in light of.example: Friend: Which day is the event set for? You: In light of the weather lately, we moved it to Saturday. Friend: Is the forecast sunny that day? You: Yes, and the temperature is comfortable too.

in many cases.context: 老师讲题时说，这类题型在很多考试里都出现过，让大家务必掌握。
in many cases.translation: 朋友：这道题考的概率大吗 你：in many cases它都是必考知识点 你必须会 朋友：那我再做两道练练 你：做到不出错为止
in many cases.example: Friend: How likely is this problem to be tested? You: In many cases it's a must-know point; you've got to master it. Friend: Then I'll do two more for practice. You: Until you can't get it wrong.

in many parts of the world.context: 你在旅行博客上看到，这种传统小吃如今在世界很多地方都能吃到。
in many parts of the world.translation: 朋友：这道小吃国外也有吗 你：现在in many parts of the world都能找到中餐馆 朋友：那味道正宗吗 你：本地人也爱吃 改良过挺好吃的
in many parts of the world.example: Friend: Is this snack found abroad too? You: Nowadays you can find Chinese food in many parts of the world. Friend: Is it authentic? You: Locals love it; it's adapted and tastes good.

in mid-air.context: 你抛起一个球准备接球，朋友却伸手拍掉，球悬在半空两人都愣住了。
in mid-air.translation: 朋友：你扔那么高干嘛 你：球还in mid-air呢 我还没准备好接 朋友：我都伸手想帮你拍了 你：别闹 让我自己接住它
in mid-air.example: Friend: Why'd you throw it so high? You: The ball's still in mid-air; I haven't readied to catch it. Friend: I already reached out to bat it down. You: Stop it; let me catch it myself.

in mind.context: 朋友托你帮忙带东西，你嘴上答应，转身就差点忘了，只好反复提醒自己。
in mind.translation: 朋友：记得帮我带杯咖啡啊 你：我记in mind了 美式不加糖 朋友：别又忘了 你：放心 我手机上设了提醒
in mind.example: Friend: Remember to get me a coffee. You: I've got it in mind—an Americano, no sugar. Friend: Don't forget again. You: Relax; I've set a reminder on my phone.

in moderation.context: 医生说红酒不是完全不能喝，关键是要适量，每天一小杯就够。
in moderation.translation: 朋友：我就知道喝酒伤身 你：也不是完全不能喝 关键要in moderation 朋友：那喝多少合适 你：一天一小杯 别贪杯就行
in moderation.example: Friend: I always hear drinking is bad. You: It's not totally off-limits; the key is moderation. Friend: Then how much is okay? You: One small glass a day; just don't overdo it.

in most cases.context: 老师总结这道题的解法，说大部分情况下用这个套路都能做出来。
in most cases.translation: 朋友：这道题有简单办法吗 你：in most cases 用这个公式就能套出来 朋友：那特殊情况呢 你：少数例外单独记一下就行
in most cases.example: Friend: Is there an easy way for this problem? You: In most cases, this formula fits and solves it. Friend: What about special cases? You: Just memorize the few exceptions separately.

in need.context: 朋友创业遇到难处，你主动提出借钱帮他，说朋友有困难时就该拉一把。
in need.translation: 朋友：这次真的是走投无路了 你：我看你in need 这钱先拿去应急 朋友：我一定尽快还你 你：先把公司撑过去再说
in need.example: Friend: This time I'm really at the end of my rope. You: I see you're in need; take this money to cover the emergency first. Friend: I'll pay you back as soon as I can. You: Just keep the company afloat first.

in number.context: 你和同学对比两个班的人数，发现你们班在数量上比隔壁班多了快十人。
in number.translation: 朋友：你们班一共多少人 你：in number我们班有四十二个人 比你们多了快十个 朋友：那老师顾得过来吗 你：有点难 提问都轮不到我
in number.example: Friend: How many are in your class? You: In number, ours has forty-two, nearly ten more than yours. Friend: Can the teacher handle that? You: A bit tough; I barely ever get called on.

in office.context: 新闻里在聊新任市长上任后的新政，朋友问他这届班子已经执政多久了。
in office.translation: 朋友：这位新市长上来后有啥变化 你：他in office刚满一年 推了不少民生工程 朋友：那市民评价怎么样 你：整体还不错 挺务实的
in office.example: Friend: What changed since the new mayor took over? You: He's been in office just a year and pushed several public projects. Friend: How do residents rate him? You: Pretty good overall; quite practical.

in one go.context: 你熬了两个通宵，把堆积的周报一口气全部写完，终于长舒一口气。
in one go.translation: 朋友：那些周报你写完了吗 你：昨晚我in one go全写完了 手都写酸了 朋友：不用分几天吗 你：趁着有劲儿 一次搞定最爽
in one go.example: Friend: Did you finish those weekly reports? You: Last night I got them all done in one go; my hand aches. Friend: Couldn't you spread them over days? You: When I'm on a roll, knocking them all out is the best.

in one sense.context: 你说回老家这件事，在某种意义上既让人疲惫又让人期待，心情很复杂。
in one sense.translation: 朋友：你不是挺想回家的吗 你：in one sense我确实期待 可一想到催婚就头大 朋友：那你回去吗 你：回 该面对的躲不掉
in one sense.example: Friend: Don't you want to go home? You: In one sense I really look forward to it, but thinking about the wedding questions gives me a headache. Friend: Then are you going back? You: Yes; you can't avoid what's coming.

in one sitting.context: 你周末窝在沙发上，抱着一本小说一口气读完整本，连晚饭都差点忘了。
in one sitting.translation: 朋友：你一下午都没出门啊 你：这书太好看了 我in one sitting读完了整本 朋友：不累眼睛吗 你：太上头了 根本停不下来
in one sitting.example: Friend: You haven't left all afternoon? You: The book's so good I read the whole thing in one sitting. Friend: Doesn't it tire your eyes? You: It's addictive; I just couldn't stop.

in one's own right.context: 大家都说他是靠父亲出名，可朋友反驳说，他自己的作品本身就很有实力。
in one's own right.translation: 朋友：他是不是全靠他爸 你：不 他in his own right也很有才华 作品都拿过奖 朋友：那我之前误会他了 你：是啊 人家是真有本事
in one's own right.example: Friend: Is he just famous because of his dad? You: No; he's talented in his own right; his work has won awards. Friend: Then I had him wrong. You: Right; he really has the skill.

in one's tracks.context: 你正走着，突然听到身后有人喊你名字，整个人一下子僵在原地。
in one's tracks.translation: 朋友：刚才谁在叫你 你：我一听那声音 直接stopped in my tracks 你知道是谁吗 朋友：难道是你以为失联的老同学 你：对 太意外了
in one's tracks.example: Friend: Who was calling you just now? You: At that voice I stopped in my tracks; guess who it was? Friend: That old classmate you thought you'd lost? You: Exactly; such a surprise.

in operation.context: 工厂里机器二十四小时不停运转，你参观时师傅介绍说设备都在运行状态。
in operation.translation: 朋友：这么多机器声音好大 你：整条流水线都in operation 三班倒不停工 朋友：那工人怎么休息 你：轮班制 设备倒是从来不歇
in operation.example: Friend: All these machines are so loud. You: The whole line is in operation, running around the clock in shifts. Friend: Then how do workers rest? You: Rotating shifts; the equipment never stops, though.

in order.context: 搬家后你把书架、桌面都收拾得井井有条，朋友来玩时夸你家里真整洁。
in order.translation: 朋友：你家收拾得真干净 你：我刚把所有东西都put in order 分类摆好 朋友：那找东西方便多了 你：是 现在一目了然
in order.example: Friend: Your place is so tidy. You: I just put everything in order and arranged it by category. Friend: Then finding things is much easier. You: Right; now you can see it all at a glance.

in order for.context: 老师把 deadline 提前了一周，就是为了让大家有时间修改完善。
in order for.translation: 朋友：截止日期怎么突然提前了 你：in order for我们有时间改稿 老师特意调的 朋友：那这周得抓紧了 你：对 先把初稿赶出来
in order for.example: Friend: Why was the deadline suddenly moved up? You: So that we have time to revise, the teacher adjusted it on purpose. Friend: Then we have to hurry this week. You: Right; get the first draft out first.

in part.context: 你总结自己长胖的原因，一部分是吃得多，一部分是运动太少。
in part.translation: 朋友：你这阵子怎么胖了 你：in part是吃得多 in part是懒得动 朋友：那先从少吃点开始 你：再配合散步 双管齐下
in part.example: Friend: Why have you gained weight lately? You: In part it's eating more, in part it's being lazy about moving. Friend: Then start by eating a bit less. You: And add walking; tackle both.

in place.context: 活动开始前半小时，工作人员各就各位，设备和桌椅都摆放到位。
in place.translation: 朋友：准备好了吗 客人要来了 你：一切都in place了 就等他们进门 朋友：那我去门口迎宾 你：好 有问题随时招呼
in place.example: Friend: Are we ready? Guests are coming. You: Everything is in place; just waiting for them at the door. Friend: Then I'll welcome them at the entrance. You: Good; call me if anything comes up.

in practice.context: 理论上这个方法听起来完美，朋友却问你实际用起来效果到底如何。
in practice.translation: 朋友：这个方法听起来挺高级 你：理论上是好 in practice还得看落地 朋友：你试过了吗 你：试了两次 确实省事
in practice.example: Friend: This method sounds sophisticated. You: In theory it's great; in practice it depends on how it's implemented. Friend: Have you tried it? You: Twice; it really does save effort.

in proximity.context: 你选租的房子就在公司旁边，步行五分钟，朋友说你住得真够近的。
in proximity.translation: 朋友：你租房离公司多远 你：特别近 就在公司in proximity 走路五分钟 朋友：那通勤太幸福了 你：是啊 每天能多睡半小时
in proximity.example: Friend: How far is your rental from work? You: Really close, in proximity to the office, a five-minute walk. Friend: That commute is bliss. You: Right; I get an extra half hour of sleep.

in pursuit of.context: 朋友辞了稳定工作去环游世界，你说他这是勇敢地追求自己想要的生活。
in pursuit of.translation: 朋友：他真把工作辞了去旅行 你：他在in pursuit of自己真正想要的生活 挺勇敢的 朋友：钱够花吗 你：他边打工边走 也挺充实
in pursuit of.example: Friend: He really quit his job to travel? You: He's in pursuit of the life he truly wants; it's brave. Friend: Does he have enough money? You: He works along the way; it's quite fulfilling.

in real life.context: 游戏里再厉害的操作，你跟朋友说那都是虚拟的，现实里可没那么神。
in real life.translation: 朋友：他打游戏是不是特别牛 你：那是游戏里 in real life他就是个普通学生 朋友：反差这么大吗 你：是啊 网上现实两重天
in real life.example: Friend: Isn't he amazing at the game? You: That's in the game; in real life he's just an ordinary student. Friend: That big a contrast? You: Right; online and real life are two worlds.

in real time.context: 看球时你用手机刷着比分，朋友问你这数据是不是实时更新的。
in real time.translation: 朋友：这上面显示的比分准吗 你：是in real time刷新的 球一进就更新 朋友：比看电视直播还快 你：对 还省了广告时间
in real time.example: Friend: Is the score shown here accurate? You: It updates in real time; the moment a goal goes in it updates. Friend: Faster than the TV broadcast. You: Right, and no ad breaks.

in real-time.context: 疫情上网课时，老师开着屏幕共享，把白板上的演算实时同步给大家看。
in real-time.translation: 朋友：老师的板书怎么跟得上 你：他用屏幕共享 一切都是in real-time传过来的 朋友：那和在教室一样吗 你：差不多 就是互动差点
in real-time.example: Friend: How do you keep up with the teacher's writing? You: He shares his screen, everything's transmitted in real-time. Friend: Is it like being in class? You: Pretty close, just less interaction.

in recent times.context: 聊起这些年城市的变化，你说近来新开的书店和咖啡馆是越来越多了。
in recent times.translation: 朋友：这两年这边变化大吗 你：in recent times新开了好多咖啡馆 朋友：那逛街是不是更好玩了 你：是啊 周末有的逛了
in recent times.example: Friend: Has this area changed much these two years? You: In recent times, loads of cafés have opened. Friend: Then is wandering around more fun? You: Right; there's plenty to do on weekends.

in recognition of.context: 学校给坚持支教十年的老师颁发特别奖项，以表彰她多年的奉献。
in recognition of.translation: 朋友：校长刚才为什么给她颁奖 你：in recognition of她十年扎根山区支教 特别感动大家 朋友：她真是值得尊敬 你：是呀 我们都该向她学习
in recognition of.example: Friend: Why did the principal give her that award just now? You: In recognition of her ten years teaching in the mountains; it really moved everyone. Friend: She's truly admirable. You: Right; we should all learn from her.

in session.context: 你打老师电话一直没人接，朋友说这时候老师正在上课，会议进行中。
in session.translation: 朋友：老师怎么不接电话 你：这时候他in session呢 正在给学生上课 朋友：那晚点再打 你：好 等他下课了自然会回
in session.example: Friend: Why isn't the teacher answering? You: He's in session right now, teaching the students. Friend: Then call later. You: Okay; he'll reply once class is over.

in some cases.context: 医生解释这种药不是人人都需要，在某些特殊情况下才建议服用。
in some cases.translation: 朋友：这药大家都要吃吗 你：in some cases才需要 不是人人适用 朋友：那我怎么知道自己吃不吃 你：让医生根据你的情况判断
in some cases.example: Friend: Does everyone need this medicine? You: In some cases it's needed; not for everyone. Friend: Then how do I know if I should take it? You: Let the doctor judge based on your condition.

in some parts of.context: 你聊到这种方言在当地特别普遍，但在某些地区已经很少人会说了。
in some parts of.translation: 朋友：这种方言现在还有人讲吗 你：在本地还是常用的 in some parts of北方却快没人说了 朋友：那岂不是要失传 你：是啊 很可惜
in some parts of.example: Friend: Does anyone still speak this dialect? You: It's common locally, but in some parts of the north almost no one speaks it. Friend: Then won't it die out? You: Right; it's such a pity.

in some respect.context: 你评价新来的同事，说他在某些方面很出色，但在沟通上还需要锻炼。
in some respect.translation: 朋友：新同事能力怎么样 你：in some respect他技术很过硬 就是沟通还欠点火候 朋友：那慢慢磨合呗 你：是啊 多配合几次就好了
in some respect.example: Friend: How capable is the new colleague? You: In some respect his technical skills are solid, though his communication needs work. Friend: Then you'll just ease into it. You: Right; a few more collaborations and it'll smooth out.

in some way.context: 你说这次搬家虽然折腾，但在某种程度上也逼自己断舍离，扔掉了很多旧东西。
in some way.translation: 朋友：搬家累坏了吧 你：是累 in some way也算好事 我清掉了一堆杂物 朋友：那新房子住着更舒服了吧 你：空间一下就显出来了
in some way.example: Friend: Moving worn you out? You: Yeah, but in some way it's a good thing; I cleared out a pile of clutter. Friend: Then the new place feels comfier? You: The space opened right up.

in such cas.context: 朋友问你赶不赶时间，你说在这种情况下，我们干脆打车过去更稳妥。
in such cas.translation: 朋友：地铁过去来得及吗 你：in such case时间太紧 我们打车吧更稳 朋友：那费用贵点也值 你：对 别误了火车就好
in such cas.example: Friend: Will we make it on the metro? You: In such a case time's too tight; let's take a taxi to be safe. Friend: Then the extra cost is worth it. You: Right; just don't miss the train.

in sync.context: 跳舞时你们俩动作总是踩不到一个点上，朋友说看来俩人节奏没对上。
in sync.translation: 朋友：我们怎么老踩错拍 你：就是因为节奏没in sync 你快我慢 朋友：那先听鼓点再动 你：好 这次跟着音乐来
in sync.example: Friend: Why do we keep missing the beat? You: Because we're not in sync; you're fast and I'm slow. Friend: Then listen to the drum before moving. You: Okay, this time follow the music.

in sync with.context: 你练合唱时总跟不上伴奏，老师让你多听几遍，好让节奏和乐队对齐。
in sync with.translation: 朋友：我一唱就跑调 你：你先让自己in sync with伴奏 再开口 朋友：那要练多久 你：跟着哼几遍 找到感觉就好
in sync with.example: Friend: I go off-key whenever I sing. You: First get yourself in sync with the accompaniment, then start. Friend: How long to practice? You: Humming along a few times, and you'll find it.

in term.context: 老师讲完一个知识点，总结说从这个角度看，前后两章其实是连在一起的。
in term.translation: 朋友：这两章有什么关系吗 你：in term of逻辑 它们其实是一步步递进的 朋友：那我串起来复习 你：对 画个思维导图更清楚
in term.example: Friend: Is there a link between these two chapters? You: In terms of logic, they actually build step by step. Friend: Then I'll review them together. You: Right; a mind map makes it clearer.

in that.context: 朋友问你为什么喜欢这工作，你说主要是因为它能让你不断学到新东西。
in that.translation: 朋友：你为什么一直干这份工作 你：我喜欢它 in that每天都能接触新东西 朋友：工资也不是特别高啊 你：成长比那点工资重要
in that.example: Friend: Why have you stayed in this job? You: I like it in that I learn new things every day. Friend: The pay isn't that high, though. You: Growth matters more than that salary.

in the aftermath of.context: 大地震过后，灾区一片狼藉，新闻里人们在余波中互相帮助清理废墟。
in the aftermath of.translation: 朋友：那边的情况现在怎么样了 你：in the aftermath of地震 大家还在清理废墟 朋友：救援工作顺利吗 你：挺有序的 就是重建要很久
in the aftermath of.example: Friend: How are things over there now? You: In the aftermath of the quake, people are still clearing the rubble. Friend: Is the rescue going smoothly? You: Fairly orderly, though rebuilding will take long.

in the back of.context: 你嘴上说放下了，朋友却听出你心里其实还一直惦记着那件事。
in the back of.translation: 朋友：你真的把那件事忘了吗 你：表面上是 可在the back of我的心里 还一直挂着 朋友：那不如说开 你：算了 都过去了
in the back of.example: Friend: Have you really put that matter behind you? You: On the surface yes, but in the back of my mind it still lingers. Friend: Then maybe talk it out. You: Never mind; it's past.

in the back of my mind.context: 你出门后总在担心门锁没锁，朋友笑说这种隐忧一直藏在你脑子里。
in the back of my mind.translation: 朋友：你又回去检查门锁啊 你：in the back of my mind老觉得没锁好 朋友：这毛病挺常见的 你：是啊 不检查一遍不踏实
in the back of my mind.example: Friend: Checking the door lock again? You: In the back of my mind I keep feeling it's unlocked. Friend: That's a common quirk. You: Right; I don't feel at ease unless I check.

in the best of moods.context: 你今天拿到了期待已久的offer，走路都带风，朋友看你心情好得不得了。
in the best of moods.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么开心 你：我刚拿到offer 简直in the best of moods 朋友：那得庆祝一下 你：走 我请你喝奶茶
in the best of moods.example: Friend: Why are you in such a good mood today? You: I just got the offer; I'm in the best of moods. Friend: Then we should celebrate. You: Come, my treat for milk tea.

in the case of.context: 老师举例子说明规则，说一般情况这样处理，至于特殊情况要单独申请。
in the case of.translation: 朋友：这条规定我们也适用吗 你：一般情况是这样 in the case of特殊情况得单独报批 朋友：那我这种算特殊吗 你：你先提交看看
in the case of.example: Friend: Does this rule apply to us? You: Generally yes; in the case of special situations you apply separately. Friend: Then does mine count as special? You: Submit it and see.

in the centre of.context: 你们约在市中心广场见面，朋友问具体是在广场的哪个位置等。
in the centre of.translation: 朋友：我们在哪儿碰头啊 你：就在in the centre of那个大广场 喷泉旁边 朋友：人多好找吗 你：喷泉很显眼 一眼就能看到
in the centre of.example: Friend: Where do we meet? You: Right in the centre of the big square, by the fountain. Friend: Easy to find in the crowd? You: The fountain's very noticeable; you'll spot it at a glance.

in the corner of.context: 你找了半天眼镜，最后发现它就搁在房间角落的那张小桌子上。
in the corner of.translation: 朋友：你眼镜找到了吗 你：找到了 它就在in the corner of那个小房间里 朋友：你怎么把它放那么偏 你：昨晚看书随手搁那儿了
in the corner of.example: Friend: Did you find your glasses? You: Found them; they were in the corner of that small room. Friend: Why did you put them so out of the way? You: I set them down there reading last night.

in the depth of.context: 科考队深入冰层之下，朋友问他们在最深处都发现了什么古老样本。
in the depth of.translation: 朋友：他们钻到冰下面看到了什么 你：在the depth of冰层里 找到了几万年前的气泡 朋友：那能研究古气候吗 你：对 特别珍贵
in the depth of.example: Friend: What did they see under the ice? You: In the depth of the ice, they found air bubbles tens of thousands of years old. Friend: Can that reveal the ancient climate? You: Exactly; it's precious.

in the depths of winter.context: 你和朋友回忆大学时放寒假，说隆冬时节校园里安静又冷清。
in the depths of winter.translation: 朋友：你大学冬天怎么过的 你：in the depths of winter校园里人都走光了 朋友：那不是很冷清吗 你：但宿舍有暖气 窝着看书特舒服
in the depths of winter.example: Friend: How did you spend winters in college? You: In the depths of winter everyone left campus. Friend: Wasn't it lonely? You: But the dorms had heating; cozy with a book.

in the field of.context: 朋友考研选方向，你问他以后想在哪个领域深耕，他说对人工智能最感兴趣。
in the field of.translation: 朋友：你研究生想读什么方向 你：我想在the field of人工智能里做研究 朋友：那这个方向挺热门的 你：是 竞争也激烈 得好好准备
in the field of.example: Friend: What direction do you want for grad school? You: I want to research in the field of artificial intelligence. Friend: That's a hot field. You: Yes, competition is fierce; I have to prepare well.

in the form of.context: 公司给优秀员工发奖励，朋友问是以奖金形式还是放假形式发放。
in the form of.translation: 朋友：年终奖励怎么发呀 你：它会in the form of购物卡发到每个人手里 朋友：那比现金差点 你：也还行 正好可以买东西
in the form of.example: Friend: How is the year-end bonus given? You: It comes in the form of gift cards to everyone. Friend: That's a step down from cash. You: It's fine; perfect for shopping.

in the hope of.context: 你早到机场，在免税店里慢慢逛，盼着登机前能淘到便宜的香水。
in the hope of.translation: 朋友：你这么早来机场干嘛 你：我in the hope of逛免税店 看有没有打折香水 朋友：那你逛够了记得登机 你：放心 我定好闹钟了
in the hope of.example: Friend: Why are you at the airport so early? You: In the hope of browsing duty-free for discounted perfume. Friend: Don't forget boarding once you're done. You: Relax; I've set an alarm.

in the hope that.context: 你每天给朋友发鼓励消息，盼着他复习顺利、考试能超常发挥。
in the hope that.translation: 朋友：你天天给我加油 你：我in the hope that你这次能考出好成绩 朋友：被你这么一说我更有信心了 你：放轻松 你肯定没问题
in the hope that.example: Friend: You cheer me on every day. You: I do it in the hope that you'll do well on this exam. Friend: Hearing that makes me more confident. You: Relax; you'll be fine.

in the interim.context: 新电脑还没到货，朋友问你这几天临时用什么办公，你说先用旧笔记本顶着。
in the interim.translation: 朋友：新电脑什么时候到 你：还得一周 in the interim我先用旧本撑着 朋友：旧机子跑得动吗 你：凑合 别装太多东西就行
in the interim.example: Friend: When does the new computer arrive? You: Another week; in the interim I'm using the old laptop. Friend: Does the old one keep up? You: Barely; just don't install too much.

in the know.context: 公司要宣布一件大事，你是少数提前知道内情的人，却嘴严一个字不露。
in the know.translation: 朋友：听说公司要搞大动作 你：你别问我 in the know的人就那么几个 朋友：那到底是什么事 你：等官宣吧 现在不能说
in the know.example: Friend: I heard the company's about to make a big move. You: Don't ask me; only a few people are in the know. Friend: So what is it? You: Wait for the official announcement; I can't say now.

in the lead up to.context: 期末考前那几周图书馆特别挤，你和朋友都在埋头为考试做最后冲刺。
in the lead up to.translation: 朋友：最近图书馆怎么又满了 你：in the lead up to期末考试 大家都在抢座复习 朋友：你复习得怎么样了 你：还差一点点收尾
in the lead up to.example: Friend: Why is the library full again? You: In the lead up to finals, everyone's grabbing seats to study. Friend: How's your revision? You: Just a little left to finish.

in the limelight.context: 那位新人一上场就表现惊艳，一下子成了全场瞩目的焦点。
in the limelight.translation: 朋友：那个新人最近挺出风头啊 你：他一拿冠军 就立刻in the limelight了 朋友：采访都排着队吧 你：是啊 一夜成名
in the limelight.example: Friend: That newcomer's been getting a lot of attention. You: The moment he won, he was in the limelight. Friend: Interviews lined up for him? You: Right; he became famous overnight.

in the long term.context: 你现在多花点钱买质量好的东西，朋友问你是不是想着长远来看更划算。
in the long term.translation: 朋友：你怎么买这么贵的 你：我想in the long term它耐用 反而省钱 朋友：有道理 便宜货老坏更费钱 你：对 一步到位最好
in the long term.example: Friend: Why are you buying something so expensive? You: I figure in the long term it's durable and saves money. Friend: Makes sense; cheap stuff breaking costs more. You: Right; better to get it right the first time.

in the main.context: 你评价这家餐厅，说菜品总体不错，就是上菜速度偶尔有点慢。
in the main.translation: 朋友：这家店值得再来吗 你：in the main菜挺好吃 就是偶尔上得慢 朋友：那服务态度呢 你：态度挺好的 挺热情
in the main.example: Friend: Is this place worth coming back to? You: In the main the food's good, just occasionally slow to arrive. Friend: How's the service? You: Friendly and warm.

in the making.context: 朋友从小就显露出音乐天赋，老师说照这势头，他将来是个可塑之才。
in the making.translation: 朋友：这小孩弹琴真有灵气 你：老师说他是个a star in the making 朋友：以后肯定有出息 你：是啊 好好培养错不了
in the making.example: Friend: This kid really has a gift for playing. You: The teacher says he's a star in the making. Friend: He'll definitely go far. You: Right; nurture him well.

in the midst of.context: 你正忙着赶报告，朋友打电话来，你说自己这会儿正处在一堆事当中。
in the midst of.translation: 朋友：你现在方便聊几句吗 你：不好意思 我正in the midst of赶报告呢 朋友：那你先忙 晚点再说 你：好 忙完我打给你
in the midst of.example: Friend: Can you chat for a minute now? You: Sorry, I'm in the midst of rushing a report. Friend: Then get back to it; talk later. You: Okay, I'll call once I'm done.

in the mix.context: 公司要搞团建活动，你问朋友这次有没有他参加，想约着一起。
in the mix.translation: 朋友：这次团建你去不去 你：当然 我也想be in the mix 别落下我 朋友：那我们报一组 你：好 到时候别缺席
in the mix.example: Friend: Are you going to this team event? You: Of course, I want to be in the mix; don't leave me out. Friend: Then we'll sign up as a group. You: Good; don't flake on the day.

in the modern era.context: 聊起科技发展，你说在当今这个时代，手机几乎成了人人必备的工具。
in the modern era.translation: 朋友：现在出门不带手机行吗 你：in the modern era没手机简直寸步难行 朋友：付钱导航都靠它 你：是 已经离不开了
in the modern era.example: Friend: Can you go out without a phone nowadays? You: In the modern era, you can barely move without a phone. Friend: Payment and navigation both rely on it. You: Right; we can't live without it.

in the moment.context: 朋友总在焦虑未来，你劝他别想太多，好好活在当下这一刻就好。
in the moment.translation: 朋友：我老担心以后怎么办 你：别总活在明天里 试着focus in the moment 朋友：可未来也得规划呀 你：先把今天过好 未来自然来
in the moment.example: Friend: I keep worrying about the future. You: Stop living in tomorrow; try to be in the moment. Friend: But the future needs planning too. You: First live today well; the future will come.

in the money.context: 朋友买彩票居然中了奖，你开玩笑说这下他可算是有钱了。
in the money.translation: 朋友：我这张彩票中了五百块 你：哇 你这下in the money了 快请客 朋友：就五百 也不算多 你：聊胜于无 先去吃顿好的
in the money.example: Friend: This lottery ticket of mine won five hundred. You: Wow, you're in the money; treat us! Friend: Just five hundred; not much. You: Better than nothing; let's go eat well.

in the night.context: 你半夜被一阵雷声吵醒，朋友问是不是夜里经常下雨。
in the night.translation: 朋友：昨晚那雷雨大吗 你：半夜里the night突然炸雷 把我吓醒了 朋友：你还睡得着吗 你：关了窗 折腾半天才睡着
in the night.example: Friend: Was last night's thunderstorm big? You: In the night a sudden clap woke me up. Friend: Could you get back to sleep? You: Closed the window; it took ages to doze off.

in the number of.context: 统计两个班参赛的人数，你说在数量上今年报名的人比去年多了不少。
in the number of.translation: 朋友：今年报名的人多吗 你：in the number of报名者 今年比去年多了三成 朋友：那比赛更热闹了 你：是啊 奖品也丰富
in the number of.example: Friend: Are there more sign-ups this year? You: In the number of participants, it's up thirty percent on last year. Friend: Then the competition's livelier. You: Right, and the prizes are better.

in the pipeline.context: 你问公司下半年有没有什么新产品，同事说有几款正在筹备当中。
in the pipeline.translation: 朋友：你们下半年有新品吗 你：有几款还in the pipeline 估计年底发布 朋友：现在能剧透吗 你：保密 等官宣吧
in the pipeline.example: Friend: Do you have any new products for the second half? You: A few are still in the pipeline, probably launching by year-end. Friend: Any spoilers now? You: Under wraps; wait for the launch.

in the presence of.context: 面试时你被好几位考官围着提问，说当着这么多人的面回答特别紧张。
in the presence of.translation: 朋友：面试气氛紧张吗 你：在the presence of一排考官 我手心都出汗了 朋友：你肯定没问题 你：希望吧 等结果
in the presence of.example: Friend: Was the interview tense? You: In the presence of a row of interviewers, my palms sweated. Friend: You'll definitely be fine. You: I hope so; waiting for the result.

in the process.context: 你说自己一边收拾房间一边打电话，忙得不可开交，朋友在那头笑你。
in the process.translation: 朋友：你那边怎么咚咚的 你：我正in the process of打扫屋子呢 一手拿手机 朋友：那你先忙 晚点聊 你：好 收拾完找你
in the process.example: Friend: What's all that thumping on your end? You: I'm in the process of cleaning the room, holding the phone one-handed. Friend: Then get back to it; talk later. You: Okay, I'll hit you up once I'm done.

in the sense of.context: 你解释说这个词不是字面那个意思，从某种意义上讲它其实是个比喻。
in the sense of.translation: 朋友：这个短语到底怎么翻 你：从the sense of比喻来看 它不是真的指头发 朋友：那到底啥意思 你：就是让人放松点
in the sense of.example: Friend: How exactly do I translate this phrase? You: In the sense of a metaphor, it doesn't literally mean hair. Friend: Then what does it mean? You: It just means relax a bit.

in the short term.context: 这份工作虽然工资一般，但朋友说短期看可能一般，长远未必不好。
in the short term.translation: 朋友：这工作工资好像不高啊 你：in the short term确实一般 但能学到东西 朋友：那先干着呗 你：对 攒经验重要
in the short term.example: Friend: The pay at this job seems low. You: In the short term it's average, but you learn a lot. Friend: Then just work there for now. You: Right; building experience matters.

in the short-term.context: 你做的这个决定是为了解燃眉之急，朋友提醒你还得考虑更长远的影响。
in the short-term.translation: 朋友：你这么做能撑多久 你：in the short-term先应付过去 再说以后 朋友：那长期怎么办 你：走一步看一步吧
in the short-term.example: Friend: How long will this keep you going? You: In the short-term it gets us through; later we'll see. Friend: Then what about the long run? You: Take it one step at a time.

in the traditional sense.context: 现在很多家庭不办传统婚礼了，你说虽然不是传统意义上的仪式，但一样幸福。
in the traditional sense.translation: 朋友：他们连婚礼都不办啊 你：in the traditional sense没有 就领了证 朋友：那会不会遗憾 你：两人幸福就行 形式不重要
in the traditional sense.example: Friend: They aren't even having a wedding? You: Not in the traditional sense; they just got the certificate. Friend: Won't they regret it? You: As long as they're happy; the form doesn't matter.

in the use of.context: 老师提醒大家使用新软件时要注意的几个要点，你记在笔记本上。
in the use of.translation: 朋友：这个软件难用吗 你：刚接触时 in the use of它确实容易出错 朋友：那你教教我 你：我发你个教程 跟着点就行
in the use of.example: Friend: Is this software hard to use? You: When you first start, in the use of it you easily make mistakes. Friend: Then teach me. You: I'll send you a tutorial; just follow along.

in the vicinity of.context: 你在找一家据说开在公园附近的小书店，问朋友它到底在哪个方位。
in the vicinity of.translation: 朋友：那家小书店具体在哪儿 你：大概就在in the vicinity of那个公园 朋友：那我们走过去找 你：到了那边再问问路人
in the vicinity of.example: Friend: Where exactly is that little bookstore? You: It's somewhere in the vicinity of that park. Friend: Then let's walk over and look. You: We'll ask passersby once we get there.

in the wild.context: 动物园里的熊猫被养得肥肥胖胖，朋友却说你想看它们在野外的样子得去四川。
in the wild.translation: 朋友：熊猫真可爱 你：圈养的是胖 in the wild它们可灵活了 朋友：那有机会去四川看看 你：对 野外看到才难得
in the wild.example: Friend: Pandas are so cute. You: In captivity they're chubby; in the wild they're really agile. Friend: Then let's go to Sichuan someday. You: Right; seeing one in the wild is rare.

in the world.context: 你翻遍屋子找不到钥匙，朋友调侃说你到底把它丢哪儿去了。
in the world.translation: 朋友：你钥匙到底放哪儿了 你：我怎么也想不起来where in the world搁哪了 朋友：你今早出门用过吗 你：用过 估计落咖啡店了
in the world.example: Friend: Where on earth did you put your keys? You: I can't remember where in the world I left them. Friend: Did you use them when you left this morning? You: Yeah; probably left them at the café.

in the wrong time zone.context: 你刚从国外飞回，时差没倒过来，白天困晚上精神，朋友笑你像走错了时区。
in the wrong time zone.translation: 朋友：你怎么大半夜还在刷手机 你：刚倒完时差 整个人还in the wrong time zone 朋友：白天多出去晒晒太阳 你：好 争取一两天调回来
in the wrong time zone.example: Friend: Why are you still scrolling at midnight? You: Just got back from abroad, my body's still in the wrong time zone. Friend: Get some daylight during the day. You: Okay, trying to reset in a day or two.

in their own right.context: 大家提到她总说她是某某的女儿，朋友却强调，她凭自己本事也很成功。
in their own right.translation: 朋友：大家都只记得她爸是谁 你：可她in her own right也做出了成绩 朋友：那她挺不容易的 你：是 靠自己更值得佩服
in their own right.example: Friend: Everyone only remembers who her dad is. You: But she's achieved things in her own right. Friend: Then she's worked hard. You: Right; making it on your own is more admirable.

in this regard.context: 公司制度还有漏洞，你说在这一点上，我们还有很多工作要做。
in this regard.translation: 朋友：这次改革效果怎么样 你：in this regard比以前规范多了 但还有漏洞 朋友：那下一步改什么 你：先把审批流程理顺
in this regard.example: Friend: How did this round of reform work out? You: In this regard it's far more standardized, though there are still gaps. Friend: Then what's next? You: First streamline the approval process.

in this respect.context: 你评价两个方案，说它们在成本上差不多，但在效果上差别很大。
in this respect.translation: 朋友：这两个方案选哪个 你：成本差不多 in this respect效果差别挺大 朋友：哪个效果更好 你：第二个 虽然贵点但值得
in this respect.example: Friend: Which of these two plans to pick? You: The costs are similar; in this respect the effect differs a lot. Friend: Which one works better? You: The second, pricier but worth it.

in times gone by.context: 爷爷总说从前的日子慢，邻里间互相串门，不像现在各过各的。
in times gone by.translation: 朋友：爷爷又在讲古了 你：他说in times gone by大家都住大院里 晚上一起乘凉 朋友：现在住对门都不认识 你：是啊 时代不一样了
in times gone by.example: Friend: Grandpa's telling old stories again. You: He says in times gone by everyone lived in courtyards and cooled off together at night. Friend: Now we don't even know the people across the hall. You: Right; times have changed.

in truth.context: 朋友问你这道菜到底好不好吃，你不好意思直接夸，说实话味道真的一般。
in truth.translation: 朋友：这菜合你口味吗 你：in truth味道就那样 不算特别惊艳 朋友：那我就不点了 你：对 换个招牌菜试试
in truth.example: Friend: Does this dish suit your taste? You: In truth it's just okay, not particularly amazing. Friend: Then I won't order it. You: Right; let's try the signature instead.

in tune.context: 你唱歌时老跑调，朋友说你跟伴奏根本合不上拍，完全不在一个调上。
in tune.translation: 朋友：我唱得还行吧 你：你有点不在in tune 跟不上伴奏 朋友：那我怎么练 你：先跟着原唱哼熟了再开口
in tune.example: Friend: Was my singing okay? You: You're a bit out of tune, not keeping up with the backing. Friend: Then how do I practice? You: Hum along with the original until it's familiar.

in tune with.context: 新同事很会察言观色，总能摸准大家的情绪，朋友说他特别懂得体察氛围。
in tune with.translation: 朋友：他怎么一进来就知道谁不开心 你：他特别in tune with别人的情绪 很敏感 朋友：这是天赋吧 你：是 天生会读空气
in tune with.example: Friend: How does he know who's unhappy as soon as he walks in? You: He's really in tune with other people's feelings, very sensitive. Friend: Is that a gift? You: Yeah; born able to read the room.

in unison.context: 合唱演出时大家一起开口，声浪整齐，朋友说你们配合得简直天衣无缝。
in unison.translation: 朋友：刚才那首合得真好听 你：我们一起in unison开口 声音特别齐 朋友：排练了多久呀 你：练了一个月 才有这效果
in unison.example: Friend: That song just now blended so well. You: We started in unison, so the sound was tight. Friend: How long did you rehearse? You: A month, to get that result.

in years to come.context: 你相信现在养成的好习惯，在未来的日子里会慢慢给你回报。
in years to come.translation: 朋友：你天天早起图什么 你：现在打下的底子 in years to come会看到回报的 朋友：那我也想试试 你：先从早起十分钟开始
in years to come.example: Friend: What's the point of waking up early every day? You: The habits you build now will pay off in years to come. Friend: Then I want to try too. You: Start by getting up ten minutes earlier.

in-depth read.context: 备考时你不满足于泛读，而是把指定教材反复精读，逐章做笔记。
in-depth read.translation: 朋友：这本书你看几遍了 你：我做的是an in-depth read 逐章做笔记 朋友：那得多花时间 你：值得 考试就考这些细节
in-depth read.example: Friend: How many times have you read this book? You: I'm doing an in-depth read, taking notes chapter by chapter. Friend: That takes a lot of time. You: Worth it; the exam tests these details.

in-office collaboration.context: 公司改成远程办公后，同事们觉得少了那种线下当面协作的效率。
in-office collaboration.translation: 朋友：在家办公效率高吗 你：一个人干活还行 但少了那种in-office collaboration 灵感碰撞少了 朋友：那偶尔还是得回公司 你：对 一周聚两天最好
in-office collaboration.example: Friend: Is working from home efficient? You: Solo work is fine, but it misses that in-office collaboration and the spark of ideas. Friend: Then occasionally back to the office? You: Right; two days a week is best.

in-person meeting.context: 线上聊了很久，你和客户决定还是约一次线下会议，把关键问题谈清楚。
in-person meeting.translation: 朋友：这个项目电话里说不明白 你：那我们安排个in-person meeting当面聊 朋友：约在哪天方便 你：周四下午 去你们公司
in-person meeting.example: Friend: This project can't be sorted out over the phone. You: Then let's set an in-person meeting to talk face to face. Friend: What day suits? You: Thursday afternoon, at your office.

in-person meetup.context: 网友认识半年了，你们终于决定周末线下见一面，吃个饭认识真人。
in-person meetup.translation: 朋友：你们俩聊这么久 打算见一面吗 你：这周末约了个in-person meetup 朋友：会不会尴尬 你：聊得来就不怕尴尬
in-person meetup.example: Friend: You two have chatted so long; planning to meet? You: We've set an in-person meetup this weekend. Friend: Won't it be awkward? You: If we click, it won't be awkward.

inappropriate questions.context: 面试时有人问了很私人的问题，你事后跟朋友说那些问题问得很不得体。
inappropriate questions.translation: 朋友：面试都问你啥了 你：还问我打算什么时候结婚 这种inappropriate questions 朋友：这是越界了吧 你：是啊 跟工作没关系
inappropriate questions.example: Friend: What did they ask in the interview? You: They even asked when I plan to marry; such inappropriate questions. Friend: Isn't that crossing a line? You: Right; it has nothing to do with the job.

incandescent with rage.context: 老板看到报表上一连串错误，气得满脸通红，简直是怒不可遏。
incandescent with rage.translation: 朋友：老板今天脸色好吓人 你：他看到那堆错数据 简直incandescent with rage 朋友：谁做的报表啊 你：小张 这下要挨批了
incandescent with rage.example: Friend: The boss looks terrifying today. You: Seeing that pile of wrong figures, he was incandescent with rage. Friend: Who made the report? You: Xiao Zhang; now he's in for it.

inclin to.context: 朋友问你假期想宅家还是出门，你说自己更倾向于在家好好歇着。
inclin to.translation: 朋友：放假你想出去玩吗 你：我incline to在家躺平 累了一周了 朋友：那我自己出去逛 你：去吧 我睡觉养精神
inclin to.example: Friend: Do you want to go out for the holiday? You: I incline to just crashing at home; I've been worn out all week. Friend: Then I'll go wander by myself. You: Go on; I'll sleep and recharge.

inclusive beauty.context: 你看到美妆广告里各种身材肤色的模特，感叹现在的审美越来越包容了。
inclusive beauty.translation: 朋友：现在广告里模特真多样 你：这就是inclusive beauty 不再只挑一种脸型 朋友：看着舒服多了 你：对 美本来就很多元
inclusive beauty.example: Friend: The models in ads are so varied now. You: That's inclusive beauty; they no longer pick just one face type. Friend: It's much nicer to look at. You: Right; beauty is meant to be diverse.

incorporating into.context: 你把自己做的小功能整合进公司大产品里，朋友问你是怎么把它并进去的。
incorporating into.translation: 朋友：你那个小工具现在用上了 你：我把它incorporating into主产品里 作为一个模块 朋友：那调试顺利吗 你：还在磨合 快好了
incorporating into.example: Friend: Is that little tool of yours in use now? You: I'm incorporating it into the main product as a module. Friend: Is the integration going smoothly? You: Still ironing it out; almost there.

increasing in popularity.context: 你发现附近那家小咖啡馆人越来越多，朋友说它这两年是越来越火了。
increasing in popularity.translation: 朋友：那家小咖啡店最近人好多啊 你：是啊 它这几年increasing in popularity 朋友：味道也就那样 人咋越来越多 你：可能装修出片吧
increasing in popularity.example: Friend: That little café has gotten so crowded. You: Yeah, it's been increasing in popularity these years. Friend: The taste is just so-so; why more people? You: Probably the decor's photogenic.

incredible achievement.context: 队友带伤拿下冠军，教练说这对全队来说都是了不起的成就。
incredible achievement.translation: 朋友：他居然带伤赢了比赛 你：这真是个incredible achievement 太不容易了 朋友：全队都为他欢呼 你：是 当之无愧
incredible achievement.example: Friend: He actually won the match injured. You: It's an incredible achievement; so hard-won. Friend: The whole team cheered for him. You: Right; he deserves every bit of it.

incremental improvement.context: 你健身不追求速成，而是靠每周一点点的进步慢慢变壮。
incremental improvement.translation: 朋友：你健身多久了 怎么还没练出肌肉 你：我追求的是incremental improvement 每周进步一点点 朋友：那得坚持很久 你：对 急不来
incremental improvement.example: Friend: How long have you worked out? Why no muscles yet? You: I'm after incremental improvement, a little each week. Friend: Then you have to stick with it long. You: Right; you can't rush it.

incubation period.context: 得流感后你在家隔离，医生说这种病从感染到发病有一段潜伏期。
incubation period.translation: 朋友：我同桌昨天确诊了 我会不会被传染 你：这病有incubation period 你先观察几天 朋友：那我现在算安全吗 你：还不好说 这两天多量体温
incubation period.example: Friend: My deskmate was diagnosed yesterday; will I catch it? You: This illness has an incubation period; observe yourself for a few days. Friend: Am I safe now? You: Hard to say; check your temperature these two days.

independent creator.context: 朋友不签公司，自己在网上做内容做得风生水起，你说他就是个独立创作者。
independent creator.translation: 朋友：他怎么不找个正经班上 你：他是个independent creator 自己接广告做内容 朋友：那收入稳定吗 你：好的时候比上班强
independent creator.example: Friend: Why doesn't he get a proper job? You: He's an independent creator, doing his own content and ads. Friend: Is the income stable? You: In good times it beats a salary.

independent from.context: 孩子长大后搬出去住，朋友说他现在经济上已经完全独立于父母了。
independent from.translation: 朋友：他还跟家里要钱吗 你：不 他现在independent from父母 自己租房自己花 朋友：那真挺独立的 你：是啊 早早就独立了
independent from.example: Friend: Does he still ask his family for money? You: No; he's independent from his parents now, renting and spending on his own. Friend: Then he's really independent. You: Right; he started early.

independent living.context: 奶奶身体还硬朗，坚持一个人住，说能自己照顾自己就不想麻烦晚辈。
independent living.translation: 朋友：奶奶一个人住放心吗 你：她喜欢这种independent living 自己买菜做饭 朋友：那定期去看看她 你：对 周末我就回去
independent living.example: Friend: Is it safe for Grandma to live alone? You: She likes independent living; buying groceries and cooking for herself. Friend: Then visit her regularly. You: Right; I go back on weekends.

individual performer.context: 团队里那位同事不喜欢扎堆，更喜欢一个人接活独立完成。
individual performer.translation: 朋友：他怎么老一个人干活 你：他是个individual performer 喜欢独立解决问题 朋友：那协作怎么办 你：需要时再配合 平时他效率高
individual performer.example: Friend: Why does he always work alone? You: He's an individual performer who likes solving problems on his own. Friend: What about collaboration? You: He joins in when needed; on his own he's efficient.

indoor comfort.context: 你搬进一间向阳的大屋子，朋友来做客说这里采光通风都特别舒服。
indoor comfort.translation: 朋友：你这新房间住着舒服吗 你：特别好 窗大通风好 室内indoor comfort特别足 朋友：那住着心情都好 你：是啊 天天都不想出门
indoor comfort.example: Friend: Is your new room comfortable? You: Really; big windows and good airflow, the indoor comfort is great. Friend: Then your mood's good living there. You: Right; I barely want to go out.

indoor layout.context: 装修时你和朋友商量怎么隔出一个书房，讨论这个小户型的空间布局。
indoor layout.translation: 朋友：这小房子怎么隔个书房 你：我们得好好设计下indoor layout 把空间用足 朋友：能隔出来吗 你：做个榻榻米兼书房 一举两得
indoor layout.example: Friend: How do we carve out a study in this small place? You: We need to design the indoor layout well to use the space fully. Friend: Can we even fit one? You: A tatami room doubling as a study; two birds one stone.

indoor lighting.context: 你嫌家里灯太暗，想换个亮一点的，朋友问你是想暖光还是冷光。
indoor lighting.translation: 朋友：你换灯是为了看书吧 你：对 原来的indoor lighting太暗了 看书费眼 朋友：那换个暖白光 你：对 柔和又够亮
indoor lighting.example: Friend: You're changing the lamp for reading, right? You: Right; the original indoor lighting was too dim, straining my eyes. Friend: Then go for warm white. You: Right; soft but bright enough.

indulge in.context: 周末你啥也不干，就窝在沙发上看剧吃零食，好好犒劳一下自己。
indulge in.translation: 朋友：周末有什么安排 你：我就想indulge in沙发上躺一天 看剧吃零食 朋友：那也太惬意了 你：忙一周了 该放纵一下
indulge in.example: Friend: Any plans for the weekend? You: I just want to indulge in lying on the sofa all day, watching shows and snacking. Friend: That sounds lovely. You: Busy all week; time to treat myself.

indulged in.context: 朋友假期里天天熬夜打游戏，你提醒他这样放纵身体可受不了。
indulged in.translation: 朋友：我这假期天天打游戏到凌晨 你：你indulged in太久了 身体迟早抗议 朋友：就放纵这几天 你：开学了可别一下子调不过来
indulged in.example: Friend: This holiday I've gamed till dawn every day. You: You've indulged in it too long; your body will protest. Friend: Just these few days of indulgence. You: Don't struggle to reset once school starts.

indulgent food.context: 你一边减肥一边又忍不住点炸鸡奶茶，朋友说这些都是高热量的放纵食品。
indulgent food.translation: 朋友：你又点炸鸡了 你：嘴馋嘛 偶尔吃点这种indulgent food 朋友：那你的减肥计划怎么办 你：周末奖励自己一次 周一再减
indulgent food.example: Friend: You ordered fried chicken again? You: I was craving it; this indulgent food once in a while. Friend: Then what about your diet plan? You: Reward myself on weekends; start again Monday.

industrial pollution.context: 郊外那条河边上建了工厂，河水变了颜色，你说这都是工业污染闹的。
industrial pollution.translation: 朋友：这河水怎么这么浑 你：上游新建了厂子 industrial pollution排出来的 朋友：那里面鱼还能吃吗 你：别吃了 报给环保部门吧
industrial pollution.example: Friend: Why is the river so murky? You: A new plant upstream; it's industrial pollution. Friend: Are the fish in there still safe? You: Don't eat them; report it to the environment agency.

infest with.context: 租的老房子里一到夏天就有蚂蚁，朋友说墙角都被虫子爬满了。
infest with.translation: 朋友：这房子怎么那么多蚂蚁 你：估计墙角都infested with虫子了 朋友：那得喷药 你：我买了杀虫剂 今天就喷喷
infest with.example: Friend: Why are there so many ants in this place? You: Probably the corners are infested with bugs. Friend: Then we need to spray. You: I bought insecticide; I'll spray today.

inflatable mattress.context: 朋友来你家过夜，你没有多余的床，只好给她拿出一张充气床垫打地铺。
inflatable mattress.translation: 朋友：今晚我睡哪儿呀 你：客房没床了 给你铺个inflatable mattress打地铺 朋友：那软不软 你：充上气挺舒服的 再给你加床被子
inflatable mattress.example: Friend: Where do I sleep tonight? You: The spare room has no bed; I'll set up an inflatable mattress on the floor. Friend: Is it soft? You: Pretty comfy once inflated; I'll add a blanket.

inflated ego.context: 那个同事刚做出点成绩就到处吹牛，大家私下说他这人太自我膨胀了。
inflated ego.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么老吹自己 你：刚拿个奖就self ego膨胀得不行 朋友：大家都看不过去 你：让他飘着吧 早晚摔下来
inflated ego.example: Friend: Why is he bragging so much lately? You: Just one award and his ego's blown up way too big. Friend: Everyone's had enough of it. You: Let him float; he'll crash soon.

influencer marketing.context: 你们新产品想打开市场，朋友问要不要请网红带货做一波推广。
influencer marketing.translation: 朋友：这新品怎么让人知道 你：可以试试influencer marketing 找几个博主测评 朋友：那费用高不高 你：看量级 中小博主性价比高
influencer marketing.example: Friend: How do we get the word out about this new product? You: We could try influencer marketing, sending samples to a few bloggers. Friend: Is that expensive? You: Depends on the tier; mid-tier bloggers are good value.

informal loan.context: 朋友临时手头紧，你私下借给他一笔钱应急，说这只是朋友间的私下周转。
informal loan.translation: 朋友：能先借我两千周转一下吗 你：行 咱们之间就当一笔informal loan 朋友：我月底就还你 你：不急 先应急
informal loan.example: Friend: Can you lend me two thousand to cover this? You: Sure; between us it's just an informal loan. Friend: I'll pay you back by month end. You: No rush; cover the emergency first.

information overload.context: 你手机里装了一堆新闻 App，每天刷到信息看不完，感觉脑子都快炸了。
information overload.translation: 朋友：你怎么一刷手机就皱眉 你：信息太多了 我都suffer from information overload 朋友：取关几个号吧 你：是 我打算精简一下订阅
information overload.example: Friend: Why do you frown every time you scroll? You: Too much information; I'm suffering from information overload. Friend: Unfollow a few accounts. You: Right; I plan to trim my subscriptions.

ing.context: 飞机导航课上老师讲到那种不靠卫星也能定位的技术，朋友问它原理是什么。
ing.translation: 朋友：飞机在海上怎么定位自己 你：除了卫星 还有套叫惯性导航的系统 靠内部器件推算位置 朋友：那卫星坏了也不怕 你：对 多套系统互相备份
ing.example: Friend: How does a plane know its position over the sea? You: Besides satellites, there's inertial navigation, calculating position from internal sensors. Friend: Then you're safe if satellites fail? You: Right; multiple systems back each other up.

inherent pleasure.context: 你喜欢手工做陶艺，朋友问你图什么，你说做手工本身就有发自内心的快乐。
inherent pleasure.translation: 朋友：你怎么周末老去捏泥巴 你：做手工有那种inherent pleasure 过程就让人开心 朋友：图个什么呢 你：不图什么 享受过程就行
inherent pleasure.example: Friend: Why do you always do pottery on weekends? You: There's that inherent pleasure of crafting; the process itself makes me happy. Friend: What's the point? You: No point; just enjoying the process.

initial assessment.context: 老师给新来的学生做了一次摸底测验，好初步了解他的水平。
initial assessment.translation: 朋友：新同学考试考得怎么样 你：那只是个initial assessment 摸摸他的底子 朋友：水平如何 你：基础不错 可以进快班
initial assessment.example: Friend: How did the new student do on the test? You: It was just an initial assessment to gauge his level. Friend: How's his level? You: Decent foundation; he can join the advanced group.

inject with.context: 医生给你打疫苗，你紧张地问他这针是往胳膊哪里注射。
inject with.translation: 朋友：打针疼不疼啊 你：医生会inject it with疫苗 就在胳膊上 朋友：那要打几针 你：先打一针 过段时间再来加强
inject with.example: Friend: Does the shot hurt? You: The doctor will inject you with the vaccine, right in the arm. Friend: How many shots? You: One now, then a booster later.

inland capital.context: 你旅行时聊起，有些国家的首都不靠海，而是建在内陆地区。
inland capital.translation: 朋友：为什么有的首都不靠海呢 你：inland capital考虑的是国家安全 不靠海更稳 朋友：那有哪些例子 你：比如哈萨克斯坦的首都
inland capital.example: Friend: Why are some capitals not by the sea? You: An inland capital is about national security; away from the coast is safer. Friend: Which examples? You: Like Kazakhstan's capital.

innate curiosity.context: 小婴儿看到什么都想摸一摸，你说孩子这种好奇心是天生就有的。
innate curiosity.translation: 朋友：这宝宝怎么见啥都抓 你：那是一种innate curiosity 从小就有 朋友：是不是该保护好 你：对 别扼杀 让他多探索
innate curiosity.example: Friend: Why does the baby grab at everything? You: That's an innate curiosity, present from early on. Friend: Should we protect it? You: Right; don't stifle it, let him explore.

innate preference.context: 研究发现小婴儿天生更喜欢看人脸，朋友说这可能是与生俱来的偏好。
innate preference.translation: 朋友：为什么宝宝总盯着人脸看 你：那是一种innate preference 天生就对脸敏感 朋友：别的东西他也不爱看 你：对 这是进化来的本能
innate preference.example: Friend: Why do babies always stare at faces? You: That's an innate preference, wired to be sensitive to faces. Friend: He doesn't look at other things. You: Right; it's an evolutionary instinct.

inner circle.context: 你说真正遇事能商量的朋友其实不多，就那么几个最亲近的人。
inner circle.translation: 朋友：你朋友圈子那么大 你：其实真正算inner circle的就三五个人 朋友：那其他的算什么 你：普通朋友 逢年过节问个好
inner circle.example: Friend: You have such a big circle of friends. You: Actually my inner circle is just three or five people. Friend: Then what are the rest? You: Casual friends, just holiday greetings.

inner reflection.context: 朋友最近心情不好却不说，你建议他一个人静静，好好做些内心的反思。
inner reflection.translation: 朋友：我这两天心里乱糟糟的 你：一个人静一静 做点inner reflection 说不定想通了 朋友：去哪静一静好 你：去公园坐一坐 别刷手机
inner reflection.example: Friend: My mind's been a mess these two days. You: Be alone for a bit, do some inner reflection, maybe it'll sort itself out. Friend: Where's good for that? You: Sit in the park; put the phone away.

inner strength.context: 奶奶经历过那么多风浪，依然乐观，你说她身上有一股了不起的内在力量。
inner strength.translation: 朋友：奶奶怎么什么事都看得开 你：她身上有种inner strength 经历多了练出来的 朋友：我也想那样 你：多读书多经历 慢慢来
inner strength.example: Friend: How does Grandma take everything in stride? You: She has an inner strength, built up over all she's been through. Friend: I want to be like that too. You: Read and experience more; slowly.

inner world.context: 朋友话不多，但你说别看他安静，其实他的内心世界特别丰富。
inner world.translation: 朋友：他怎么整天不吭声 你：他只是安静 inner world可丰富了 朋友：你怎么知道 你：他写的日记里全是想法
inner world.example: Friend: Why doesn't he ever speak up? You: He's just quiet; his inner world is really rich. Friend: How do you know? You: His diary is full of thoughts.

insect repellent.context: 夏天去郊外露营，你喷好驱蚊水才出门，朋友问你带了什么防虫的东西。
insect repellent.translation: 朋友：这儿蚊子也太多了 你：我带了insect repellent 喷上就好多了 朋友：给我也喷点 你：行 喷完手腕脚踝都来一点
insect repellent.example: Friend: There are so many mosquitoes here. You: I brought insect repellent; once you spray it, it's much better. Friend: Spray some on me too. You: Okay, wrists and ankles too.

inspiring image.context: 你看到一张登山者立于山巅的照片，觉得特别鼓舞人心，决定拿来做手机壁纸。
inspiring image.translation: 朋友：你这壁纸换得挺有气势 你：这张inspiring image 看着就有劲儿 朋友：每次解锁都被激励一下 你：对 想偷懒时看看
inspiring image.example: Friend: Your new wallpaper looks powerful. You: This inspiring image gives me energy every time. Friend: You get motivated each time you unlock. You: Right; look at it when I want to slack off.

instant conclusion.context: 朋友刚看到一点苗头就急着下判断，你劝他别着急立刻下结论。
instant conclusion.translation: 朋友：我觉得他肯定是在针对我 你：别急着下instant conclusion 事情还没清楚呢 朋友：可我越想越气 你：先问问清楚再说
instant conclusion.example: Friend: I'm sure he's out to get me. You: Don't jump to an instant conclusion; things aren't clear yet. Friend: But the more I think, the angrier I get. You: Ask and clarify first.

instant gratification.context: 你说现在的人做事总想马上看到结果，这种即时满足的心态不太健康。
instant gratification.translation: 朋友：我怎么总静不下心看书 你：因为习惯了那种instant gratification 刷视频马上有乐子 朋友：那怎么改 你：从读长文开始 慢慢练耐心
instant gratification.example: Friend: Why can't I settle down to read? You: Because you're used to instant gratification; videos reward you instantly. Friend: Then how to change? You: Start with long reads, build patience slowly.

instant noodles.context: 加班到半夜，你懒得做饭，泡了碗方便面凑合，朋友说你也太将就了。
instant noodles.translation: 朋友：晚饭就吃这个啊 你：太晚了 泡碗instant noodles对付一口 朋友：那也太不健康了 你：偶尔一顿 明天好好吃
instant noodles.example: Friend: Just eating this for dinner? You: It's late; I'll make do with instant noodles. Friend: That's so unhealthy. You: Just for tonight; I'll eat well tomorrow.

instant photo.context: 聚会时你用拍立得给朋友拍了张照，照片慢慢显影，大家都凑过来看。
instant photo.translation: 朋友：这照片怎么得等一会儿 你：拍立得就是这样 等它慢慢instant photo显影 朋友：出来了 好清楚啊 你：这礼物送人挺有意义
instant photo.example: Friend: Why do we have to wait for this photo? You: That's how instant photos work; wait for it to develop. Friend: It's out; so clear! You: It makes a nice gift.

instant transfer.context: 你给朋友转钱，用的是秒到账的转账，对方立刻就收到了。
instant transfer.translation: 朋友：钱转过来了吗 我没收到提醒 你：我用的是instant transfer 应该秒到 朋友：真的到了 你：那行 这事就结了
instant transfer.example: Friend: Did the money come through? I got no alert. You: I used an instant transfer; it should be there in seconds. Friend: It really is. You: Then we're all set.

instruction manual.context: 新路由器不会装，你翻出说明书一步步照着连，朋友笑你没说明书就不会用。
instruction manual.translation: 朋友：网怎么弄好了 你：照着instruction manual一步步接的 朋友：你也不问问我 你：自己研究出来的 特有成就感
instruction manual.example: Friend: How did you set up the network? You: Following the instruction manual step by step. Friend: Why didn't you just ask me? You: Figuring it out myself feels rewarding.

insulate against.context: 冬天你在窗缝贴上密封条，说这样能挡住冷风，让屋里暖和些。
insulate against.translation: 朋友：屋里怎么暖和多了 你：我把窗缝insulate against冷风 贴上密封条了 朋友：这招真管用 你：对 一个冬天能省不少暖气
insulate against.example: Friend: Why is the room so much warmer? You: I insulated against the cold drafts by sealing the window gaps. Friend: That trick really works. You: Right; saves on heating all winter.

insulin sensitivity.context: 医生让你多运动，说这能提高身体对胰岛素的敏感度，对血糖好。
insulin sensitivity.translation: 朋友：我血糖有点偏高 你：医生说规律运动能improve insulin sensitivity 朋友：那做什么运动好 你：快走游泳都行 一周五次
insulin sensitivity.example: Friend: My blood sugar's a bit high. You: The doctor says regular exercise improves insulin sensitivity. Friend: What kind of exercise? You: Brisk walking or swimming, five times a week.

insurance cover.context: 你买保险时仔细看条款，朋友问这份保险到底保哪些风险。
insurance cover.translation: 朋友：这保险靠谱吗 你：它的insurance cover涵盖了意外和住院 朋友：那保费贵不贵 你：一年几百块 买个安心
insurance cover.example: Friend: Is this insurance any good? You: Its insurance cover includes accidents and hospitalization. Friend: Is the premium pricey? You: A few hundred a year, peace of mind.

integrate.context: 公司把几个小部门合并成一个大组，朋友问新领导怎么把大家整合起来。
integrate.translation: 朋友：部门合并后工作怎么开展 你：得把大家的流程integrate到一起 统一标准 朋友：那过渡期会乱吗 你：肯定会 慢慢理顺就好
integrate.example: Friend: How do we work after the merger? You: We have to integrate everyone's processes under one standard. Friend: Will it be chaotic in transition? You: Definitely; it'll smooth out gradually.

integrate circuit.context: 物理课上老师讲解手机里那颗指甲盖大小的芯片，说它其实是集成电路。
integrate circuit.translation: 朋友：手机里那个芯片有多小 你：就指甲盖大 里面是亿万个元件组成的integrated circuit 朋友：怎么塞进去的 你：纳米工艺 太神奇了
integrate circuit.example: Friend: How small is that chip in the phone? You: Nail-sized, holding billions of components on an integrated circuit. Friend: How do they fit them in? You: Nanometer process; amazing.

integrate into.context: 你刚到国外留学，花了好一阵子才融入当地的学习和生活节奏。
integrate into.translation: 朋友：出国还适应吗 你：正在努力integrate into当地生活 语言还是有点难 朋友：多交当地朋友就好了 你：是 我这周末去参加聚会
integrate into.example: Friend: Are you settling in abroad? You: Working hard to integrate into local life; the language is still a bit tough. Friend: Make local friends and it'll help. You: Right; I'm going to a gathering this weekend.

intellectual humility.context: 研讨会上老师说，真正聪明的人都敢于承认自己不懂，这就是智识上的谦逊。
intellectual humility.translation: 朋友：那个专家怎么老说不知道 你：那是一种intellectual humility 敢承认自己局限 朋友：这反而是真厉害 你：对 不懂装懂才可怕
intellectual humility.example: Friend: Why does that expert keep saying he doesn't know? You: That's intellectual humility, daring to admit your limits. Friend: That's actually real expertise. You: Right; pretending to know is what's scary.

intelligent control.context: 你家新装了智能开关，手机上就能关灯拉窗帘，朋友问这是什么系统。
intelligent control.translation: 朋友：你怎么躺床上用手机关灯 你：家装了intelligent control 手机上一键搞定 朋友：那出门忘关灯也能关 你：对 在外面也能操作
intelligent control.example: Friend: How do you turn off the light from bed on your phone? You: We installed intelligent control, one tap on the phone. Friend: Then you can turn it off even if you forgot when out? You: Right; works from anywhere.

intends to.context: 你问朋友毕业后打算做什么，他说自己计划先工作两年再读研。
intends to.translation: 朋友：你毕业后有什么打算 你：我intend to先工作两年 攒点钱再读研 朋友：那挺好 先体验一下职场 你：对 不然一直读书也闷
intends to.example: Friend: What are your plans after graduation? You: I intend to work for two years first, save money, then do a master's. Friend: That's good; experience the workplace. You: Right; studying nonstop is stifling.

intense irritation.context: 邻居装修一整天电钻响个不停，你烦躁得没法在家工作，抱怨这噪音。
intense irritation.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么没去上班 你：邻居装修钻个不停 那noise让我intense irritation 根本没法集中 朋友：那你去咖啡馆躲躲 你：行 安静地方效率高
intense irritation.example: Friend: Why aren't you at work today? You: The neighbor's drilling all day; it causes such intense irritation I can't focus. Friend: Then hole up in a café. You: Good; quiet places are efficient.

intensive agriculture.context: 新闻里讨论粮食产量，提到现代农业靠高投入高产出养活越来越多的人。
intensive agriculture.translation: 朋友：这么多人吃饭怎么够 你：现在靠intensive agriculture 一亩地能产出很多 朋友：那是不是用了很多化肥 你：是 也带来环境问题
intensive agriculture.example: Friend: How do we feed so many people? You: Now it's intensive agriculture, each mu yields a lot. Friend: Does that use lots of fertilizer? You: Yes, and it brings environmental problems.

intensive farming.context: 你在超市选鸡蛋时朋友说，市面上很多鸡蛋来自高密度的工业化养殖场。
intensive farming.translation: 朋友：这鸡蛋和那鸡蛋有啥区别 你：便宜的多半来自intensive farming 量大但鸡养得挤 朋友：那我买这种散养的 你：贵点 但吃得放心
intensive farming.example: Friend: What's the difference between these eggs? You: The cheap ones are mostly from intensive farming, high volume but crowded hens. Friend: Then I'll get these free-range. You: Pricier, but you eat at ease.

intentional living.context: 你辞掉忙碌工作后开始极简生活，每天有意识地安排时间做重要的事。
intentional living.translation: 朋友：你现在过得挺佛系 你：我在尝试intentional living 每天只做真正重要的事 朋友：那不无聊吗 你：反而更充实 少即是多
intentional living.example: Friend: You've become pretty laid-back now. You: I'm trying intentional living, only doing what really matters each day. Friend: Isn't that boring? You: Actually more fulfilling; less is more.

interactive element.context: 你做的这款学习 App 里有个小测验，朋友说这个互动环节让大家更爱用。
interactive element.translation: 朋友：你这 App 怎么让人坚持下来的 你：里面有个interactive element 学完来个小测验 朋友：这样确实更有参与感 你：对 用户留存高了不少
interactive element.example: Friend: What makes people stick with your app? You: There's an interactive element, a little quiz after each lesson. Friend: That really builds engagement. You: Right; retention went up a lot.

interior design.context: 朋友新家正在装修，你去参观时和她讨论客厅的墙面颜色和家具搭配。
interior design.translation: 朋友：我家客厅刷什么颜色好 你：做interior design得先定个风格 你喜欢哪种 朋友：我想要温馨点的 你：那就米白加木色 耐看
interior design.example: Friend: What color should I paint the living room? You: In interior design, pick a style first; which do you like? Friend: I want something warm. You: Then off-white with wood tones; it ages well.

intermittent fasting.context: 你最近改成不吃早饭、把进食集中在八小时内，朋友问你这是什么减肥法。
intermittent fasting.translation: 朋友：你怎么中午才吃饭 你：我在试intermittent fasting 把饭集中在八小时内吃 朋友：那饿不饿 你：刚开始饿 习惯了就好
intermittent fasting.example: Friend: Why do you only eat at noon? You: I'm trying intermittent fasting, fitting meals into an eight-hour window. Friend: Are you hungry? You: At first yes, but you get used to it.

internal temperature.context: 发烧时医生让你量体温，说发烧说明身体内部温度在升高，是在对抗感染。
internal temperature.translation: 朋友：我这体温算高烧吗 你：三十八度多 身体的internal temperature升高了 是在对抗病毒 朋友：那我要吃退烧药吗 你：先多喝水 持续不退再吃药
internal temperature.example: Friend: Is this a high fever? You: Over thirty-eight; your internal temperature is up, fighting the virus. Friend: Should I take fever medicine? You: Drink water first; take it if it won't break.

international acclaim.context: 那位导演的电影在国际电影节上拿了大奖，赢得了全球的赞誉。
international acclaim.translation: 朋友：他这部片子火到国外了 你：拿了国际大奖 获得了international acclaim 朋友：那票房肯定也高 你：是 这下他名气更大了
international acclaim.example: Friend: His film is a hit abroad. You: It won an international award, earning international acclaim. Friend: Then the box office must be high. You: Right; he's even more famous now.

internet memes.context: 你给朋友发了个搞笑表情包，说这是最近网上最火的梗图之一。
internet memes.translation: 朋友：这图什么意思啊 你：这是最近火的internet memes 配个文字就特别搞笑 朋友：那也太魔性了 你：我存了一堆 聊天专用
internet memes.example: Friend: What does this picture mean? You: It's one of those internet memes that went viral; add a caption and it's hilarious. Friend: It's so catchy. You: I've saved a bunch for chatting.

interplanetary travel.context: 你和朋友聊起未来的太空梦想，说希望有一天人类能实现跨行星旅行。
interplanetary travel.translation: 朋友：你想上天吗 你：我梦想有一天interplanetary travel成为可能 去火星看看 朋友：那得等多少年 你：说不定我们老了就能看到
interplanetary travel.example: Friend: Do you want to go to space? You: I dream of the day interplanetary travel is possible, to see Mars. Friend: How many years will that take? You: Maybe we'll see it in our old age.

interspace collision.context: 天文课上老师讲到卫星相撞的风险，说碎片在轨道上可能引发连锁碰撞。
interspace collision.translation: 朋友：太空里那么多卫星 不会撞吗 你：真有过interspace collision 碎片还会连锁反应 朋友：那我们的手机信号没事吧 你：近地卫星多 暂时还好
interspace collision.example: Friend: With so many satellites in space, don't they collide? You: There have been space collisions, and the debris triggers a chain reaction. Friend: Is our phone signal okay? You: Many low-orbit sats; for now we're fine.

interview format.context: 你做了个人物访谈节目，朋友问你更喜欢采访形式还是单人独白。
interview format.translation: 朋友：你这节目怎么是聊天形式 你：我选interview format 两个人聊比一个人讲自然 朋友：那嘉宾好找吗 你：找有趣的人 故事就好看
interview format.example: Friend: Why is your show in a chat format? You: I chose the interview format; two people chatting feels more natural than a monologue. Friend: Are guests easy to find? You: Find interesting people and the story's good.

intimate detail.context: 你在日记里记下很多和朋友相处的私密小事，这些细节别人都不知道。
intimate detail.translation: 朋友：你日记里都写些啥 你：一些很intimate detail 比如我们半夜聊天 朋友：那可别被别人看到 你：我加了密码锁
intimate detail.example: Friend: What do you write in your diary? You: Little intimate details, like our midnight chats. Friend: Then don't let anyone else see. You: It's password protected.

into.context: 你和朋友边吃火锅边聊，话题从工作聊到生活，越聊越投机。
into.translation: 朋友：这火锅越吃越热 你：我跟你聊到into兴头上了 再来瓶饮料 朋友：你慢点喝 别撑着 你：难得聊这么开心
into.example: Friend: The hot pot's getting spicier. You: I'm really into chatting with you; another drink. Friend: Slow down, don't overdo it. You: Rare to have such a good talk.

into consideration.context: 老师让大家写报告时，记得把实际情况和各种因素都纳入考虑范围。
into consideration.translation: 朋友：这报告怎么写才周全 你：把所有因素都take into consideration 再下结论 朋友：那要列哪些 你：成本时间风险 都得想到
into consideration.example: Friend: How do I write a thorough report? You: Take all the factors into consideration before concluding. Friend: Then what to list? You: Cost, time, risk; think of everything.

into practice.context: 你学了很久的理论，朋友问你什么时候把这些方法真正用到实际工作中。
into practice.translation: 朋友：这些方法学了有啥用 你：等工作中把它put into practice 就知道价值了 朋友：那现在能试试吗 你：下个项目就用起来
into practice.example: Friend: What's the use of learning these methods? You: Once you put them into practice at work, you'll see the value. Friend: Can we try now? You: We'll use them in the next project.

intrinsic motivation.context: 你说他坚持画画不是为了获奖，而是出于内心真正的热爱。
intrinsic motivation.translation: 朋友：他画这么辛苦图什么 你：靠的是intrinsic motivation 真的喜欢 不是为了奖状 朋友：这种动力才持久 你：对 外人催没用
intrinsic motivation.example: Friend: What drives him to paint so hard? You: It's intrinsic motivation; he truly loves it, not for awards. Friend: That kind of drive lasts. You: Right; outside pressure doesn't matter.

inundated with.context: 双十一过后你快递堆积如山，朋友笑说你被各种包裹淹没了。
inundated with.translation: 朋友：你这门口堆的什么 你：双十一买多了 我都inundated with快递 朋友：你这是买了多少 你：十几件 得慢慢拆
inundated with.example: Friend: What's all that piled at your door? You: Shopped too much on Singles' Day; I'm inundated with parcels. Friend: How much did you buy? You: Over ten; I'll unwrap them slowly.

invasive species.context: 公园里出现了不少外来植物，朋友说这些入侵物种抢了本地花草的地盘。
invasive species.translation: 朋友：这花以前没见过吧 你：多半是invasive species 抢了本地植物的养分 朋友：那要不要清理掉 你：园林会定期处理
invasive species.example: Friend: I haven't seen this flower before. You: Probably an invasive species, stealing nutrients from native plants. Friend: Should we remove it? You: The garden team handles it regularly.

invented language.context: 你学了一门全世界只有少数人会说的语言，朋友问它是怎么来的。
invented language.translation: 朋友：你学的这门语言哪儿来的 你：它是一门invented language 人为创造的 不是自然演变的 朋友：谁创造的呀 你：一个语言学家 为了沟通造的
invented language.example: Friend: Where does this language you're learning come from? You: It's an invented language, created on purpose rather than evolving naturally. Friend: Who invented it? You: A linguist, to enable communication.

involv in.context: 项目里出了问题，你被卷了进去，朋友问你到底牵涉到哪些环节。
involv in.translation: 朋友：这事儿怎么把你也扯进来了 你：我刚好involved in那个环节 就被牵连了 朋友：那你有责任吗 你：没有 只是协助调查
involv in.example: Friend: Why are you dragged into this? You: I happened to be involved in that part, so I got pulled in. Friend: Then are you at fault? You: No; just helping with the investigation.

irrational reaction.context: 朋友丢了手机就慌得不行，你觉得他这种反应有点过度、不太理性。
irrational reaction.translation: 朋友：我手机不见了 完了完了 你：别这么irrational reaction 先冷静想想落在哪 朋友：里面全是重要东西 你：打个电话看看在哪
irrational reaction.example: Friend: My phone's gone; I'm doomed. You: Don't have such an irrational reaction; calm down and think where you left it. Friend: It has all my important stuff. You: Call it and see where it rings.

irregular heartbeat.context: 爷爷最近总觉得心慌，医生检查说他有点心律不齐，得定期复查。
irregular heartbeat.translation: 朋友：爷爷最近身体怎么了 你：查出来有点irregular heartbeat 心跳不规律 朋友：那严重吗 你：医生说先观察 定期来复查
irregular heartbeat.example: Friend: What's wrong with Grandpa lately? You: They found an irregular heartbeat; his pulse is uneven. Friend: Is it serious? You: The doctor says observe first, come back for checkups.

isolate oneself.context: 朋友分手后就一个人待着，谁也不见，你说他这样把自己封闭起来可不行。
isolate oneself.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么都不回消息 你：分手后他把自己isolate了 谁也不想见 朋友：那我们得拉他出来 你：周末硬拽他出去走走
isolate oneself.example: Friend: Why isn't he replying lately? You: After the breakup he isolates himself and doesn't want to see anyone. Friend: Then we've got to pull him out. You: Drag him out for a walk this weekend.

it is often said that.context: 你和朋友聊起早起的好处，说人们常说早睡早起身体好。
it is often said that.translation: 朋友：你为啥非要早起 你：it is often said that早起使人健康又清醒 朋友：可我就是起不来 你：先从早起十分钟开始
it is often said that.example: Friend: Why do you insist on waking early? You: It is often said that early rising keeps you healthy and alert. Friend: But I just can't get up. You: Start by ten minutes earlier.

it takes all sorts to make a world.context: 路上看到各种奇奇怪怪的人，你笑着跟朋友说这世界真是形形色色。
it takes all sorts to make a world.translation: 朋友：今天地铁站那人打扮也太怪了 你：it takes all sorts to make a world 什么人都有 朋友：看得我都呆住了 你：习惯就好
it takes all sorts to make a world.example: Friend: The guy in the metro today was dressed so oddly. You: It takes all sorts to make a world; all kinds exist. Friend: I was stunned. You: You get used to it.

it turn out that.context: 你找了半天钥匙，最后发现它一直揣在自己兜里，朋友笑你说原来是这么回事。
it turn out that.translation: 朋友：找到钥匙了吗 你：it turned out that它一直在我裤兜里 白找半天 朋友：你这记性 真是没谁了 你：下次进门就放固定地方
it turn out that.example: Friend: Did you find the keys? You: It turned out that they'd been in my pocket all along; I looked for nothing. Friend: Your memory is something else. You: Next time I'll set them in a fixed spot.

it's no wonder.context: 朋友平时不复习还考了高分，你说难怪他考得好，原来他偷偷学了。
it's no wonder.translation: 朋友：他怎么考那么高 你：it's no wonder 人家晚上偷偷学到半夜 朋友：那我们被他骗了 你：是 表面玩其实努力
it's no wonder.example: Friend: How did he score so high? You: It's no wonder; he secretly studied till midnight. Friend: Then he fooled us. You: Right; playing on the surface, grinding in secret.

itinerary planning.context: 你和朋友计划假期出游，坐在一起翻地图、排日程，做行程规划。
itinerary planning.translation: 朋友：这趟旅行怎么安排 你：我们先做itinerary planning 每天去哪 住哪 朋友：要不要排太满 你：别太赶 留些自由时间
itinerary planning.example: Friend: How do we plan this trip? You: First do itinerary planning, deciding where to go and stay each day. Friend: Should we pack it tight? You: Not too rushed; leave free time.

jacket potato.context: 你在英式小餐馆点了个带皮烤土豆，朋友说这是英国很经典的主食。
jacket potato.translation: 朋友：这土豆连皮一起端上来 你：这叫jacket potato 英国很常见 里面还能加料 朋友：好吃吗 你：抹点黄油 特别香
jacket potato.example: Friend: This potato comes with the skin on. You: It's a jacket potato, very common in Britain, and you can add fillings. Friend: Does it taste good? You: With a bit of butter, it's delicious.

january blues.context: 元旦刚过，朋友们都觉得提不起劲，你说这大概就是常说的节后低落。
january blues.translation: 朋友：怎么放假回来更累了 你：这就是那种january blues 假期结束的失落感 朋友：什么时候能缓过来 你：忙两周进入状态就好
january blues.example: Friend: Why do I feel more tired after the holiday? You: That's the January blues, the letdown after the break. Friend: When will it fade? You: Once you're busy for two weeks and in the groove.

japanese wellness.context: 你喜欢上日本那种慢节奏养生方式，泡汤吃轻食，朋友问这是什么潮流。
japanese wellness.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么又吃素又泡汤 你：我在学那种japanese wellness 强调身心放松 朋友：那跟普通养生有啥区别 你：更讲究和自然相处
japanese wellness.example: Friend: Why are you eating light and soaking in hot springs lately? You: I'm into that Japanese wellness, emphasizing body-mind relaxation. Friend: How is it different from normal wellness? You: It focuses more on being in harmony with nature.

jet lag.context: 你刚从欧洲飞回来，白天犯困晚上精神，朋友说你这是典型的时差反应。
jet lag.translation: 朋友：你这两天怎么老打哈欠 你：跨了八个时区 还有点jet lag 朋友：倒时差难受吗 你：白天多晒太阳 两三天就好了
jet lag.example: Friend: Why do you keep yawning these two days? You: Crossed eight time zones; I still have some jet lag. Friend: Is it hard adjusting? You: Get daylight by day; it clears in two or three days.

jet off.context: 朋友突然订了张机票就飞去度假了，临走前才告诉你他临时出发的行程。
jet off.translation: 朋友：我明天就飞海南了 你：这么突然 说走就走啊 朋友：对啊 我jet off去放松几天 你：那你工作怎么办 朋友：请假了 赶紧享受阳光沙滩
jet off.example: Friend: I'm flying to Hainan tomorrow. You: So sudden; just off like that? Friend: Yeah, I'm jetting off to unwind for a few days. You: What about work? Friend: I took leave; time for sun and beach.

jet stream.context: 坐飞机时你问空姐为什么往西飞更快，她说是因为高空有股强风帮忙推。
jet stream.translation: 朋友：这回程怎么比去程快 你：因为顺着high-altitude jet stream 那股强风推着飞机 朋友：那往东就慢了 你：对 逆风就得多烧油
jet stream.example: Friend: Why is the return faster than the outgoing? You: Because it rides the high-altitude jet stream, a strong wind pushing the plane. Friend: Then eastbound is slower? You: Right; against the wind it burns more fuel.

jigsaw puzzle.context: 下雨天你和朋友窝在家里，对着一千块的拼图慢慢拼，一坐就是一下午。
jigsaw puzzle.translation: 朋友：这拼图有一千块 你：对啊 我们慢慢拼jigsaw puzzle 朋友：哪块是哪块 好难 你：先把边框拼出来 再分颜色
jigsaw puzzle.example: Friend: This puzzle has a thousand pieces. You: Right, let's slowly work on the jigsaw puzzle. Friend: Which piece is which; so hard. You: Do the edge first, then sort by color.

job application.context: 你毕业季投了一堆简历，朋友问你有没有哪家公司回复了你的求职申请。
job application.translation: 朋友：你投了那么多简历有回音吗 你：上周交的那个job application 刚收到面试通知 朋友：哪家公司呀 你：就是我最想去的那家
job application.example: Friend: Any replies to all those resumes? You: That job application I sent last week just got an interview notice. Friend: Which company? You: The one I wanted most.

job for life.context: 爷爷年轻时进了一家厂，一干就是一辈子，朋友说那时候一份工作能干到老。
job for life.translation: 朋友：爷爷在一个单位待多久了 你：他那个年代 一份job for life 干到退休 朋友：现在哪还有这种工作 你：是 大家都跳槽了
job for life.example: Friend: How long has Grandpa been at one workplace? You: In his time, a job for life, staying until retirement. Friend: There's no such job now. You: Right; everyone hops around.

job losses.context: 新闻里说那家大厂要裁员，朋友担心自己会不会受波及，讨论失业问题。
job losses.translation: 朋友：那大厂裁员裁多少 你：几千个job losses 不少人要重新找工作 朋友：那经济会不会受影响 你：短期内是有点压力
job losses.example: Friend: How many layoffs is that big company doing? You: Thousands of job losses, and many people will job-hunt again. Friend: Will the economy feel it? You: A bit of pressure in the short term.

job market.context: 你今年毕业找工作，朋友说现在就业市场竞争激烈，让你多投多试。
job market.translation: 朋友：今年找工作容易吗 你：job market挺紧张的 岗位少投的人多 朋友：那你急不急 你：急也没用 多投几家再说
job market.example: Friend: Is it easy finding work this year? You: The job market is tight, few openings and many applicants. Friend: Then are you anxious? You: Anxiety won't help; apply to more places.

job offer.context: 你终于收到了心仪公司的录用通知，激动地把消息告诉朋友。
job offer.translation: 朋友：结果出来了吗 你：出来了 我拿到job offer了！ 朋友：那太好了 工资满意吗 你：挺满意的 下周一入职
job offer.example: Friend: Is the result out? You: It is; I got the job offer! Friend: That's wonderful; is the pay okay? You: Pretty good; I start next Monday.

job recruiter.context: 你在招聘会上和一位 HR 聊天，朋友问你对面这位是招聘方还是求职者。
job recruiter.translation: 朋友：跟你聊天那位是做什么的 你：他是个job recruiter 专门来学校招人的 朋友：那他看中你了吗 你：他让我回去等面试
job recruiter.example: Friend: What does the person you're chatting with do? You: He's a job recruiter, here on campus to hire. Friend: Did he take to you? You: He told me to wait for an interview.

job satisfaction.context: 你换了几份工作后发现，比起工资，自己更在意每天干得开不开心。
job satisfaction.translation: 朋友：新工作干得顺心吗 你：钱不是最多 但job satisfaction挺高的 每天都有成就感 朋友：那这选择对了 你：是 开心最重要
job satisfaction.example: Friend: Are you happy at the new job? You: Not the highest pay, but job satisfaction is high; a sense of achievement daily. Friend: Then you chose right. You: Right; being happy matters most.

job security.context: 朋友在小公司干得不安心，总担心哪天公司倒闭，你说还是想找个稳定点的。
job security.translation: 朋友：你怎么老想跳槽 你：现在这公司没什么job security 说倒就倒 朋友：那考个编制稳当 你：我在看机会
job security.example: Friend: Why do you keep wanting to jump ship? You: There's no job security at this company; it could fold any time. Friend: Then a government job is steady. You: I'm looking into it.

job-hunting strategy.context: 你和学长讨教找工作的经验，他给你列了一套具体的求职打法。
job-hunting strategy.translation: 朋友：找工作有没有什么窍门 你：我学长给了套job-hunting strategy 先调研再投简历 朋友：听起来挺系统 你：对 别海投 精准投递
job-hunting strategy.example: Friend: Any tips for job hunting? You: My senior gave a job-hunting strategy: research first, then apply. Friend: Sounds systematic. You: Right; don't mass-apply, target carefully.

join force with.context: 你们两个部门项目撞车，决定干脆联手一起做，互相借力把事做成。
join force with.translation: 朋友：这个项目咱们自己做得过来吗 你：不如join forces with市场部 一起搞 朋友：那利润怎么分 你：先把事做成 分成好商量
join force with.example: Friend: Can our team handle this project alone? You: Better to join forces with the marketing team and do it together. Friend: Then how to split the profit? You: First get it done; the split is negotiable.

join society.context: 你刚进大学就报了摄影社团，朋友问你为什么想加入这个社团。
join society.translation: 朋友：你开学报了什么社团 你：我join了摄影社 每周还能出去拍照 朋友：那挺有意思 你：对 还能认识志同道合的人
join society.example: Friend: What club did you join at the start? You: I joined the photography society, going out shooting every week. Friend: That sounds fun. You: Right; and I meet like-minded people.

joint pain.context: 爬完山你膝盖酸了好几天，朋友说这是关节疼，让你别逞强再爬。
joint pain.translation: 朋友：你腿怎么一瘸一拐的 你：昨天爬太猛 现在joint pain厉害 朋友：那歇两天别剧烈运动了 你：好 贴个膏药缓缓
joint pain.example: Friend: Why are you limping? You: Pushed too hard climbing yesterday; now I have bad joint pain. Friend: Then rest two days, no intense exercise. You: Okay; I'll put on a pain-relief patch.

joke around.context: 你说那话朋友以为是认真的，你赶紧解释自己只是在开玩笑，别当真。
joke around.translation: 朋友：你刚才那话什么意思 你：我joking around呢 别当真 朋友：吓我一跳 你：开个玩笑放松下气氛
joke around.example: Friend: What did you mean just now? You: I was just joking around; don't take it seriously. Friend: You scared me. You: Just a joke to lighten the mood.

jot down.context: 朋友电话里报了串号码，你赶紧掏出纸笔随手记在便签上。
jot down.translation: 朋友：我把地址报给你 你：等一下 我jot down在手机备忘录里 朋友：记好了吗 你：好了 哪条路几号来着
jot down.example: Friend: I'll give you the address. You: Wait a second; let me jot it down in my phone notes. Friend: Got it? You: Got it; which road and number again?

juggle responsibilities.context: 你是职场妈妈，白天上班晚上带娃，朋友说你一个人扛这么多真不容易。
juggle responsibilities.translation: 朋友：你一天忙得过来吗 你：得juggle工作和带娃 时间排得满满的 朋友：那不累吗 你：习惯了 挤时间呗
juggle responsibilities.example: Friend: Can you handle a whole day? You: I have to juggle work and childcare, packed schedule. Friend: Isn't that tiring? You: Used to it; squeeze time in.

jumble sale.context: 学校周末办旧物义卖，你把闲置的书本玩具拿去摆卖，朋友也来淘便宜。
jumble sale.translation: 朋友：这周末学校有什么活动 你：有个jumble sale 大家把旧东西拿来卖 朋友：我去淘两本旧书 你：好东西不少 早点去
jumble sale.example: Friend: What's happening at school this weekend? You: There's a jumble sale, people selling their used things. Friend: I'll go hunt for some old books. You: Lots of good stuff; go early.

jump on the bandwagon.context: 最近露营特别火，你也跟风买了帐篷，朋友说你就是跟着大家凑热闹。
jump on the bandwagon.translation: 朋友：你怎么突然买起帐篷了 你：大家都去露营 我也jump on the bandwagon 朋友：你以前不是不爱户外吗 你：试一次嘛 好玩再说
jump on the bandwagon.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly buy a tent? You: Everyone's camping, so I'm jumping on the bandwagon. Friend: Didn't you hate the outdoors before? You: Give it a try; if it's fun, fine.

jump out of bed.context: 早上闹钟一响，你一下子从床上弹起来，因为今天要赶早班机。
jump out of bed.translation: 朋友：你今天起得真早啊 你：要赶飞机 闹钟一响就jump out of bed 朋友：早饭来得及吃吗 你：路上买个面包就行
jump out of bed.example: Friend: You're up so early today. You: Catching a flight; the alarm went off and I jumped out of bed. Friend: Time for breakfast? You: Grab a bun on the way.

jump scare.context: 你们在看恐怖片，屏幕上突然冒出来一个鬼脸，朋友吓得叫出声。
jump scare.translation: 朋友：刚才那一下吓我一跳 你：那个jump scare太突然了 镜头一直黑着 朋友：我都把爆米花扔了 你：哈哈 后面还有更吓人的
jump scare.example: Friend: That just now startled me. You: That jump scare was so sudden, the screen went dark. Friend: I dropped my popcorn. You: Haha, there's a scarier one later.

jump ship.context: 朋友在一家公司干了五年，最近却跳槽去了新东家，你问他为什么走。
jump ship.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然辞职了 你：他jump ship去了家给双倍工资的 朋友：那也难怪 你：是人都会动心
jump ship.example: Friend: Why did he suddenly quit? You: He jumped ship to a place offering double the pay. Friend: No wonder then. You: Anyone would be tempted.

jump straight into.context: 周末朋友一到你家，行李一放就直接拉你出门玩，一点不歇脚。
jump straight into.translation: 朋友：我来了 走 出去玩 你：你刚到就jump straight into玩 不歇会儿 朋友：时间宝贵 先逛起来 你：行吧 去哪
jump straight into.example: Friend: I'm here; let's go out. You: You jump straight into going out as soon as you arrive; no rest? Friend: Time's precious; let's start exploring. You: Alright, where to?

jump to conclusions.context: 朋友看到你回消息慢就以为你生气了，你说他别动不动就瞎猜下结论。
jump to conclusions.translation: 朋友：你是不是生我气了 半天不回消息 你：你别jump to conclusions 我刚在开会 朋友：哦 那我误会了 你：是 先问清楚嘛
jump to conclusions.example: Friend: Are you mad at me? You took ages replying. You: Don't jump to conclusions; I was just in a meeting. Friend: Oh, I misread it. You: Right; ask first.

jumping in.context: 朋友一听说哪里好玩就立刻报名参加，也不多做了解，你说他太冲动了。
jumping in.translation: 朋友：这活动我报上名了 你：你怎么想都没想就jumping in了 朋友：好玩就行呗 你：那别到时候后悔
jumping in.example: Friend: I signed up for this activity. You: You're jumping in without even thinking. Friend: As long as it's fun. You: Just don't regret it later.

jumping on the band wagon.context: 看别人都在抢着买新款，你也跟着凑热闹排起队，朋友说你就是在跟风。
jumping on the band wagon.translation: 朋友：这队排这么长干嘛呢 你：大家都在抢新款 我也jumping on the band wagon 朋友：你需要吗 你：其实不太需要 就是凑热闹
jumping on the band wagon.example: Friend: What's this long queue for? You: Everyone's grabbing the new release, so I'm jumping on the band wagon. Friend: Do you even need it? You: Not really; just joining the fun.

jumping red traffic lights.context: 你在路上看到一辆车闯了红灯嗖地过去，赶紧拉住朋友说太危险了。
jumping red traffic lights.translation: 朋友：那车怎么就冲过去了 你：他jumped red traffic lights 完全没减速 朋友：太不要命了 你：还好我们走得慢 没撞上
jumping red traffic lights.example: Friend: How did that car just shoot through? You: It jumped the red traffic light, not slowing at all. Friend: How reckless. You: Good thing we walked slowly; didn't get hit.

just yet.context: 你问朋友晚饭想吃什么，他说还没想好，暂时先不定。
just yet.translation: 朋友：晚饭订哪家 你：我还没决定just yet 等会儿再说 朋友：那五点前定下来 你：行 到时候我告诉你
just yet.example: Friend: Which place for dinner? You: I haven't decided just yet; let's talk later. Friend: Then settle it by five. You: Okay, I'll let you know then.

keen to.context: 公司要派人去外地培训，大家都抢着报名，你也很想去争取这个机会。
keen to.translation: 朋友：你想去那个外地培训吗 你：我特别keen to去 能学东西还能出差 朋友：那赶紧报名 你：我已经提交申请了
keen to.example: Friend: Do you want to go to that off-site training? You: I'm really keen to go; I'll learn and travel. Friend: Then sign up fast. You: I've already submitted my application.

keep.context: 下雨天出门你记得带伞，朋友问你怎么这么小心，你说就是习惯带伞。
keep.translation: 朋友：你怎么老随身带把伞 你：习惯了 keep it in包里 以防万一 朋友：今天也没下雨预报 你：备着总没错
keep.example: Friend: Why do you always carry an umbrella? You: It's a habit, keep it in the bag just in case. Friend: The forecast didn't say rain today. You: Better to have it just in case.

keep a clearer head.context: 遇到棘手的会议，你告诉自己别慌，保持头脑清醒才能把问题想明白。
keep a clearer head.translation: 朋友：等下大老板提问 好紧张 你：你得keep a clearer head 慢慢答 朋友：万一说错呢 你：想清楚再说 别抢话
keep a clearer head.example: Friend: The big boss will ask questions later; I'm so nervous. You: You need to keep a clearer head and answer slowly. Friend: What if I get it wrong? You: Think before speaking; don't jump in.

keep a lid on.context: 公司里出了个小差错，领导让大家先把这事捂住，别传出去闹大。
keep a lid on.translation: 朋友：刚才那事要不要告诉别人 你：老板让我们keep a lid on it 先内部处理 朋友：那客户问起怎么办 你：统一口径 别说漏嘴
keep a lid on.example: Friend: Should we tell anyone about that slip-up? You: The boss wants us to keep a lid on it, handling it internally first. Friend: What if the client asks? You: Keep one story; don't let it slip.

keep an eye out for.context: 你在火车站帮朋友找一个穿红衣服的人，让他多留意周围动静。
keep an eye out for.translation: 朋友：我该接的人长啥样 你：穿件红色外套 你帮我keep an eye out for他 朋友：我盯着出站口 你：看到了喊我
keep an eye out for.example: Friend: What does the person I'm picking up look like? You: In a red jacket; help me keep an eye out for him. Friend: I'll watch the exit. You: Shout if you spot him.

keep apart.context: 疫情期间你们公司让大家在家办公，彼此在网上保持距离不碰面。
keep apart.translation: 朋友：好久没见大家了 你：这阵子我们都keep apart 在家远程办公 朋友：那什么时候回公司 你：等通知吧 安全第一
keep apart.example: Friend: Long time no see everyone. You: Lately we all keep apart, working remotely at home. Friend: Then when do we go back? You: Wait for the notice; safety first.

keep at bay.context: 冬天你点蚊香在门口，说这样能把蚊子挡在外面，不让进屋。
keep at bay.translation: 朋友：这屋里蚊子也太多了 你：门口点盘蚊香 把蚊子keep at bay 朋友：那窗要不要关 你：纱窗关好 它们就进不来了
keep at bay.example: Friend: There are so many mosquitoes indoors. You: Light a coil at the door to keep mosquitoes at bay. Friend: Should I close the window? You: Keep the screen shut; they won't get in.

keep awake.context: 长途夜车上你困得眼皮打架，为了不坐过站，只能掐自己提神保持清醒。
keep awake.translation: 朋友：你怎么一直掐自己 你：太困了 得keep awake别坐过站 朋友：你眯会儿 到了我叫你 你：那行 你别也睡着了
keep awake.example: Friend: Why are you pinching yourself? You: I'm so sleepy; I have to keep awake so I don't miss my stop. Friend: Nod off; I'll wake you. You: Okay, but don't you fall asleep too.

keep clicking.context: 你刷短视频一刷就停不下来，手指机械地一直上滑，朋友说你就知道点屏幕。
keep clicking.translation: 朋友：你别一直刷手机了 你：根本停不下来 手一直keep clicking往上滑 朋友：再刷眼睛都坏了 你：最后一条 看完就放
keep clicking.example: Friend: Stop scrolling your phone. You: I can't stop; my hand keeps clicking upward automatically. Friend: Your eyes will go bad. You: Just one more, then I'll put it down.

keep down.context: 公司要控成本，经理让大家想办法把各项开支压下来。
keep down.translation: 朋友：这季度预算又紧了 你：经理让我们把各项成本keep down 别超支 朋友：那出差标准要降吗 你：对 能坐高铁就不坐飞机
keep down.example: Friend: The budget's tight again this quarter. You: The manager wants us to keep costs down and not go over budget. Friend: Then will travel standards drop? You: Right; take the high-speed rail, not flights.

keep grounded.context: 天气不好机场把航班都停飞了，朋友问你飞机为什么还不起飞。
keep grounded.translation: 朋友：我们的航班怎么还不动 你：大暴雨 所有飞机都keep grounded了 朋友：那要等多久 你：等雨小点 听广播通知
keep grounded.example: Friend: Why hasn't our flight moved? You: Heavy downpour; all planes are kept grounded. Friend: Then how long to wait? You: Until the rain eases; watch for announcements.

keep illness at bay.context: 医生让你秋冬多打疫苗、注意保暖，把生病的风险挡在外面。
keep illness at bay.translation: 朋友：我每年秋冬都要感冒 你：多穿点再打流感疫苗 把illness keep at bay 朋友：就这么有用吗 你：能挡掉不少小病
keep illness at bay.example: Friend: I catch a cold every autumn and winter. You: Bundle up and get the flu shot to keep illness at bay. Friend: Does it really help? You: It wards off quite a few minor illnesses.

keep in the dark.context: 公司偷偷给同事涨了薪，却故意不告诉你，你事后才发现自己被瞒着。
keep in the dark.translation: 朋友：他工资怎么比我高那么多 你：他们一直keep you in the dark 没告诉你 朋友：这不公平 我得去谈 你：对 先了解清楚行情
keep in the dark.example: Friend: Why is his salary so much higher than mine? You: They've been keeping you in the dark about it. Friend: That's unfair; I've got to negotiate. You: Right; first find out the market rate.

keep me updated.context: 你出差在外，让同事项目有进展随时跟你通气，别断了联系。
