keep me updated.translation: 朋友：那项目你不在场怎么跟进 你：你随时keep me updated 我远程也能帮上忙 朋友：有事我就发消息 你：好 重要节点一定告诉我
keep me updated.example: Friend: How will you follow the project while away? You: Keep me updated anytime; I can help remotely. Friend: I'll message if anything comes up. You: Good; tell me at key milestones.

keep off the weight.context: 你减了十斤后，朋友问你最近是怎么保持住、没反弹的。
keep off the weight.translation: 朋友：你瘦下来之后没反弹吧 你：我一直控制饮食 把weight keep off了 朋友：怎么做到不复发 你：每周量体重 多吃蔬菜
keep off the weight.example: Friend: You haven't regained the weight after losing it? You: I've kept my diet controlled to keep the weight off. Friend: How do you avoid relapse? You: Weigh weekly and eat more vegetables.

keep on top.context: 你做投资每天都看财经新闻，朋友问你怎么总能第一时间知道行情变化。
keep on top.translation: 朋友：你怎么消息这么灵通 你：我每天都看财经新闻 把行情keep on top 朋友：不累吗 你：习惯了 不看心里不踏实
keep on top.example: Friend: How are you so in the loop? You: I read financial news daily to keep on top of the market. Friend: Isn't it tiring? You: Habit; I feel uneasy without it.

keep one's feet on the ground.context: 朋友一出名就开始飘了，你劝他再风光也要脚踏实地，别忘本。
keep one's feet on the ground.translation: 朋友：他最近是不是有点飘 你：再红也得keep his feet on the ground 别忘本 朋友：身边人劝得住吗 你：点到为止吧
keep one's feet on the ground.example: Friend: Is he getting a bit arrogant lately? You: No matter how famous, he must keep his feet on the ground and stay humble. Friend: Can people around him keep him in check? You: Just a gentle word.

keep one's wits about.context: 走夜路时朋友叮嘱你留点神，遇到情况要随机应变保持警觉。
keep one's wits about.translation: 朋友：这条路晚上有点黑 你：你走路时keep your wits about你 别玩手机 朋友：知道了 我看着点路 你：对 安全第一
keep one's wits about.example: Friend: This road is dark at night. You: Keep your wits about you and don't use your phone. Friend: Got it; I'll watch the road. You: Right; safety first.

keep out of.context: 医生让你这种病人少吹空调，尽量别让冷风直接吹到身上。
keep out of.translation: 朋友：我这肩疼能吹空调吗 你：最好keep out of冷风直吹 容易加重 朋友：那夏天怎么过 你：对着墙吹 别直吹自己
keep out of.example: Friend: Can I use the AC with this shoulder pain? You: Better keep out of the direct cold draft; it'll worsen. Friend: Then how to get through summer? You: Point it at the wall, not yourself.

keep safe.context: 朋友要出远门，你在车站送别，叮嘱他路上千万注意安全。
keep safe.translation: 朋友：那我走啦 你：一路keep safe 到了给我报平安 朋友：好 你也保重 你：到了记得发消息
keep safe.example: Friend: Off I go then. You: Keep safe on the way; message me when you arrive. Friend: Okay, you take care too. You: Remember to text once you're there.

keep speeches brief.context: 老板在会上说时间有限，让每个人的发言都简短一点，别长篇大论。
keep speeches brief.translation: 朋友：轮到我发言了好紧张 你：老板说keep speeches brief 三分钟讲完重点 朋友：那我少铺垫 你：对 直接说结论
keep speeches brief.example: Friend: It's my turn to speak; I'm nervous. You: The boss says to keep speeches brief; cover the key points in three minutes. Friend: Then I'll skip the preamble. You: Right; lead with the conclusion.

keep sth in check.context: 你血糖偏高，医生让你把甜食控制住，别让它升得太快。
keep sth in check.translation: 朋友：我这血糖老降不下来 你：把甜食keep it in check 别一顿吃太多 朋友：那水果能吃吗 你：选低糖的 别榨汁喝
keep sth in check.example: Friend: My blood sugar won't come down. You: Keep sweets in check; don't eat too much at once. Friend: Then can I eat fruit? You: Pick low-sugar ones; don't juice them.

keep things in perspective.context: 朋友因为一次失利就情绪低落，你劝他把事情看开，别因为一件事否定自己。
keep things in perspective.translation: 朋友：这次没考好 我觉得自己好失败 你：你得keep things in perspective 一次考试说明不了全部 朋友：可我真的努力了 你：那下次再来 你比你想的强
keep things in perspective.example: Friend: I failed this exam; I feel like a loser. You: You need to keep things in perspective; one exam means nothing. Friend: But I really tried. You: Then next time; you're stronger than you think.

keep your cool.context: 高峰期打车被司机拒载，朋友气得想理论，你拉住他说别生气，冷静点。
keep your cool.translation: 朋友：那司机凭什么不拉我们 你：你keep your cool 别吵架 我们再叫一辆 朋友：太气人了 你：为这个生气不值
keep your cool.example: Friend: Why is that driver refusing us? You: Keep your cool; don't argue, let's just call another. Friend: So annoying. You: Not worth getting mad over.

keep your eyes peeled for.context: 你们在公园里找一只走丢的小狗，你让朋友睁大眼睛仔细搜寻周围。
keep your eyes peeled for.translation: 朋友：这小狗能藏哪儿呢 你：你keep your eyes peeled for黄色的小不点 朋友：那边草丛里有动静 你：快去看看是不是它
keep your eyes peeled for.example: Friend: Where could the puppy be hiding? You: Keep your eyes peeled for a little yellow one. Friend: There's movement in that bush. You: Quick, go see if it's him.

keep your hair on.context: 朋友因为一点小事就火冒三丈，你劝他别激动，消消气。
keep your hair on.translation: 朋友：他怎么能这么对我 太气了 你：你keep your hair on 为这事气坏身体不值 朋友：可我咽不下这口气 你：喝口水 慢慢说
keep your hair on.example: Friend: How could he do that to me; I'm furious. You: Keep your hair on; getting sick over this isn't worth it. Friend: But I can't swallow this. You: Have some water; talk it through.

keep...in check.context: 你负责管团队预算，每个月都把开销控制在合理范围里。
keep...in check.translation: 朋友：你们部门这个月超支了吗 你：没有 我每月都把开支keep it in check 朋友：怎么做到的 你：提前做预算 花一笔记一笔
keep...in check.example: Friend: Did your department go over budget this month? You: No; I keep spending in check every month. Friend: How? You: Budget ahead and log every expense.

keeping a healthy and positive approach.context: 经历挫折后你重新站起来，朋友说你一直对生活抱着健康积极的态度。
keeping a healthy and positive approach.translation: 朋友：你怎么总能这么乐观 你：我就keep a healthy and positive approach to生活 再难也往前看 朋友：这心态真难得 你：愁也一天 乐也一天
keeping a healthy and positive approach.example: Friend: How are you always so optimistic? You: I keep a healthy and positive approach to life; look forward even when it's hard. Friend: That mindset is rare. You: Worrying's a day, being happy's a day.

keeps things in perspective.context: 奶奶年纪大了却从不抱怨，朋友说她老人家总能把事情看得很开。
keeps things in perspective.translation: 朋友：奶奶怎么一点不焦虑 你：她一辈子经历多了 总能keep things in perspective 朋友：这智慧值得学 你：是 慢慢来比较快
keeps things in perspective.example: Friend: Why isn't Grandma anxious at all? You: She's been through a lifetime; she always keeps things in perspective. Friend: That wisdom is worth learning. You: Right; slow is smooth.

kerbside recycling.context: 你把垃圾分类后放在门口，朋友说这种定时收垃圾的方式很环保。
kerbside recycling.translation: 朋友：你这袋子分类分好啦 你：对 放门口等kerbside recycling来收 朋友：那电池放哪 你：单独放红色那个箱子
kerbside recycling.example: Friend: Did you sort the bags? You: Yes, set them out for the kerbside recycling pickup. Friend: Where do batteries go? You: The red box, separately.

key in.context: 你在自助机上买票，一步步把目的地和张数输入进去，朋友在旁边等。
key in.translation: 朋友：票买好了吗 你：我正key in目的地呢 再选张数 朋友：要不要我帮你看操作 你：快好了 投币就出票
key in.example: Friend: Did you buy the ticket? You: I'm keying in the destination now, then the number. Friend: Want me to help with the machine? You: Almost done; insert coins and it prints.

key step.context: 做实验时老师说，把数据准确记录下来是得出结论前最关键的一步。
key step.translation: 朋友：这步为什么这么重要 你：准确记录是key step 数据错了后面全白搭 朋友：那我多核对两遍 你：对 严谨点没坏处
key step.example: Friend: Why is this step so important? You: Accurate recording is a key step; if the data's wrong, everything after is wasted. Friend: Then I'll double-check twice. You: Right; rigor never hurts.

keyhole surgery.context: 医生说你这个手术切口很小，恢复快，朋友问是什么手术这么先进。
keyhole surgery.translation: 朋友：这手术要住院多久 你：是keyhole surgery 创口小 两三天就能出院 朋友：那真不遭罪 你：对 技术进步了
keyhole surgery.example: Friend: How long in hospital for this surgery? You: It's keyhole surgery, small cuts, out in two or three days. Friend: That's hardly any suffering. You: Right; technology has improved.

kick back.context: 周五晚上你啥也不干，就窝在沙发上喝着冰可乐看球赛，彻底放松下来。
kick back.translation: 朋友：周末有什么安排 你：就想kick back 沙发上躺着看球 朋友：那不出去聚聚 你：累了一周 先歇够了再说
kick back.example: Friend: Any plans for the weekend? You: Just kick back on the sofa watching the match. Friend: Not going out? You: Worn out all week; rest first.

kick in.context: 你喝下感冒药没过一会儿就犯困，朋友问药效是不是开始起作用了。
kick in.translation: 朋友：你怎么喝下药就打哈欠 你：那药劲开始kick in了 困得不行 朋友：那正好 吃完睡一觉 你：对 明天就精神了
kick in.example: Friend: Why are you yawning after the medicine? You: The dose is kicking in; I'm so sleepy. Friend: Perfect; sleep it off. You: Right; I'll feel better tomorrow.

kick the bucket.context: 爷爷开玩笑说自己年纪大了，哪天两腿一蹬就走了，大家赶紧让他别说这话。
kick the bucket.translation: 朋友：爷爷刚才说什么呢 你：他开玩笑说哪天就kick the bucket了 朋友：这玩笑可不好 你：是啊 我们赶紧让他说吉利话
kick the bucket.example: Friend: What was Grandpa saying just now? You: He joked that one day he'll kick the bucket. Friend: That's no joke. You: Right; we quickly got him to say something auspicious.

kick the habit.context: 你戒烟半年了，朋友问你当初是怎么把这个老烟瘾给戒掉的。
kick the habit.translation: 朋友：你真把烟戒了 怎么做到的 你：就是咬咬牙kick the habit 一开始特别难受 朋友：现在还想抽吗 你：偶尔想 忍忍就过去了
kick the habit.example: Friend: You really quit smoking? How? You: Just grit my teeth and kick the habit; it was rough at first. Friend: Still crave it now? You: Occasionally, but it passes.

kicks in.context: 新政策这个月起生效，朋友问什么时候能真正看到效果。
kicks in.translation: 朋友：这新政策多久见效 你：等它kicks in还得一阵子 朋友：那我们等等看 你：一个月后再来评估
kicks in.example: Friend: When will this new policy show results? You: It'll take a while once it kicks in. Friend: Then let's wait and see. You: Reassess in a month.

kill off.context: 外来的狼群把岛上的一种小鸟几乎捕杀殆尽，朋友说再不保护就灭绝了。
kill off.translation: 朋友：那岛上的鸟怎么少了那么多 你：被入侵的狼几乎kill off了 再不干预就绝种 朋友：那得赶紧保护 你：是 生态一旦破坏难恢复
kill off.example: Friend: Why have the birds on that island dropped so much? You: They've almost been killed off by invading wolves; without action they'll vanish. Friend: Then we must protect them fast. You: Right; ecosystems are hard to restore.

kilo sale.context: 你在古着市场按公斤挑衣服，朋友说这种论斤卖二手货的方式特别划算。
kilo sale.translation: 朋友：这店里衣服怎么按斤称 你：是那种kilo sale 论公斤卖古着 特别划算 朋友：那我挑几件 你：慢慢淘 能找到宝
kilo sale.example: Friend: How are clothes priced by weight in this shop? You: It's a kilo sale, secondhand vintage sold by the kilogram; great value. Friend: Then I'll pick a few. You: Dig slowly; you can find gems.

kindness campaign.context: 学校发起给山区孩子捐书的暖心活动，你和朋友整理了一堆旧书送去。
kindness campaign.translation: 朋友：这周末学校有什么公益活动 你：搞了个kindness campaign 给山区孩子捐书 朋友：那我们把旧书都翻出来 你：对 洗干净包好捐过去
kindness campaign.example: Friend: What charity event is the school doing this weekend? You: A kindness campaign, donating books to kids in the mountains. Friend: Then let's dig out our old books. You: Right; clean them and send them over.

knead dough.context: 你周末跟着教程学做面包，站在厨房里反复揉面，朋友在一旁看热闹。
knead dough.translation: 朋友：你这面团揉多久了 你：做面包得使劲knead dough 把面筋揉出来 朋友：揉成什么样才算好 你：不粘手能撑开薄膜就差不多了
knead dough.example: Friend: How long have you been kneading this dough? You: To make bread you have to knead the dough hard to develop the gluten. Friend: When's it ready? You: When it's not sticky and stretches into a thin film.

knock over.context: 你转身时没注意，把桌上一杯水碰翻了，朋友赶紧拿抹布来擦。
knock over.translation: 朋友：哎呀水洒了 你：我转身不小心knocked over那杯水 朋友：快拿纸擦擦 别弄湿电脑 你：还好电脑收起来了
knock over.example: Friend: Oh, the water spilled. You: I knocked over that cup turning around. Friend: Quick, get paper towels before it hits the laptop. You: Good thing the laptop was put away.

knocked off your bike.context: 朋友骑车被一辆拐弯的汽车别倒了，你赶去看他有没有摔伤。
knocked off your bike.translation: 朋友：你还好吗 摔哪儿了 你：被汽车别了一下 直接knocked off my bike 朋友：车摔坏了吗 你：人没事就好 车擦擦还能骑
knocked off your bike.example: Friend: Are you okay? Where'd you fall? You: A car cut me off and knocked me off my bike. Friend: Is the bike wrecked? You: Glad I'm fine; wipe the bike and it still rides.

knuckle down.context: 开学后你再不收心就赶不上了，朋友劝你赶紧沉下心来好好复习。
knuckle down.translation: 朋友：快考试了你怎么还在玩 你：是时候knuckle down 认真复习了 朋友：那我们一起自习 你：好 图书馆见
knuckle down.example: Friend: Why are you still playing before the exam? You: Time to knuckle down and study seriously. Friend: Then let's study together. You: Okay, see you at the library.

label as.context: 你不希望别人随便给一个复杂的人贴标签，朋友说别轻易下判断。
label as.translation: 朋友：他这人是不是太自私了 你：别随便label他 as坏人 人是多面的 朋友：可他确实做得不好 你：具体事具体看
label as.example: Friend: Isn't he just selfish? You: Don't label him as a bad person; people are multifaceted. Friend: But he really messed up. You: Judge the specific matter.

labour conditions.context: 朋友在工厂打工，聊起车间里的劳动条件，说夏天闷热冬天漏风。
labour conditions.translation: 朋友：你那工厂干活环境咋样 你：labour conditions一般 夏天特别闷 朋友：那有空调吗 你：就几台风扇 凑合着吧
labour conditions.example: Friend: What's the work environment like at your factory? You: The labour conditions are average; it's stuffy in summer. Friend: Is there AC? You: Just a few fans; making do.

labour exploitation.context: 新闻里曝光有些黑心工厂让工人超时劳动，朋友说这是对劳工的剥削。
labour exploitation.translation: 朋友：那些工人怎么一天干十二小时 你：那是典型的labour exploitation 老板压榨人 朋友：太过分了 你：希望监管能跟上
labour exploitation.example: Friend: Why do those workers toil twelve hours a day? You: That's typical labour exploitation, bosses squeezing people. Friend: That's outrageous. You: Hope regulation catches up.

labour shortage.context: 小区附近餐馆都在招工却招不到人，老板说现在劳动力特别紧缺。
labour shortage.translation: 朋友：怎么街边店都贴着招工 你：现在是labour shortage 年轻人不愿干餐饮 朋友：那工资开高点呗 你：涨了也难招
labour shortage.example: Friend: Why is every shop on the street hiring? You: There's a labour shortage now; young people won't do F&B. Friend: Then raise the wages. You: Even higher pay is hard to fill.

labrador retriever.context: 你朋友养了只金毛寻回犬，周末你们带它去公园扔飞盘，它跑得特别欢。
labrador retriever.translation: 朋友：你家这狗真温顺 你：它是labrador retriever 天生爱捡东西 朋友：带它遛弯累不累 你：我扔飞盘它去捡 可乖了
labrador retriever.example: Friend: Your dog is so gentle. You: It's a Labrador retriever, born to fetch. Friend: Is walking it tiring? You: I throw the frisbee and it retrieves; so well-behaved.

lace up.context: 出门前你发现鞋带松了，蹲在门口把鞋带给系紧，朋友在楼下等你。
lace up.translation: 朋友：你磨磨蹭蹭干嘛呢 你：我把鞋带lace up 不然走两步就散 朋友：快点 车来了 你：马上好
lace up.example: Friend: What are you dawdling at? You: I need to lace up my shoes, or they'll come undone walking. Friend: Hurry, the car's here. You: Almost ready.

lack connection.context: 你俩虽然住一起却各忙各的，一天说不上几句话，朋友说你们之间缺少交流。
lack connection.translation: 朋友：你俩最近怎么不怎么聊天 你：是有点lack connection 一回家就各自看手机 朋友：这样感情会淡的 你：那今晚一起做个饭吧
lack connection.example: Friend: Why don't you two talk much lately? You: We lack connection a bit; home and each on the phone. Friend: That makes the bond fade. You: Then let's cook dinner together tonight.

lack empathy.context: 同事被客户骂得掉眼泪，你主管却无动于衷，你觉得他太缺乏同理心了。
lack empathy.translation: 朋友：主管怎么一点反应都没有 你：他就是lack empathy 见不得别人难过 朋友：那跟着他好压抑 你：是啊 不近人情
lack empathy.example: Friend: Why does the boss show no reaction? You: He lacks empathy; he can't stand seeing others upset. Friend: Working under him is stifling. You: Right; cold.

lack of sunlight.context: 冬天你总觉得情绪低落，医生说这和日照不足、晒得太少有关系。
lack of sunlight.translation: 朋友：我一到冬天就提不起劲 你：可能是lack of sunlight 晒得少情绪会低 朋友：那怎么办 你：白天多出去走走 晒晒太阳
lack of sunlight.example: Friend: I feel low every winter. You: It might be lack of sunlight; less sun lowers your mood. Friend: Then what? You: Get out and soak up daylight by day.

lactose intolerance.context: 朋友一喝牛奶就拉肚子，你建议他去查查是不是乳糖不耐受。
lactose intolerance.translation: 朋友：我一喝牛奶就肚子不舒服 你：你可能有lactose intolerance 喝不了普通牛奶 朋友：那我喝什么补钙 你：换舒化奶或者喝豆浆
lactose intolerance.example: Friend: My stomach aches every time I drink milk. You: You might have lactose intolerance and can't handle regular milk. Friend: Then how do I get calcium? You: Switch to lactose-free milk or soy milk.

lag behind.context: 你数学没复习好，考试时发现别人都做完了你还在磨蹭，成绩落后了。
lag behind.translation: 朋友：这次数学你考得怎么样 你：又lag behind了 好几道大题没写完 朋友：那假期得补补 你：对 开学就跟不上了
lag behind.example: Friend: How did you do on math this time? You: I lagged behind again; didn't finish several big problems. Friend: Then catch up over the break. You: Right, or I'll fall behind once school starts.

land management.context: 村里搞新农村建设，朋友聊起怎么把这些耕地合理规划管理起来。
land management.translation: 朋友：村边上那片地以后用来干嘛 你：得做好land management 该种树种地 别乱盖房子 朋友：那我们去问问村干部 你：好 听听怎么规划
land management.example: Friend: What's that plot at the edge of the village for? You: We need good land management—plant and farm, don't build haphazardly. Friend: Then let's ask the village chief. You: Good; hear the plan.

land of nod.context: 你昨晚累得倒头就睡，朋友问你昨晚几点睡着的，你说沾枕头就进了梦乡。
land of nod.translation: 朋友：你昨晚几点睡的 你：倒头就进了the land of nod 一觉到天亮 朋友：那睡得真香 你：是 累狠了
land of nod.example: Friend: What time did you fall asleep last night? You: I dropped straight into the land of nod and slept till dawn. Friend: That's a deep sleep. You: Right; totally worn out.

land on.context: 记者会上市长被一群记者追问，朋友说大家的问题都冲着他去了。
land on.translation: 朋友：刚才记者会火药味挺足 你：一堆问题都landed on市长身上 他都答不过来 朋友：那他招架住了吗 你：还行 绕了几个弯
land on.example: Friend: That press conference was fiery. You: A bunch of questions landed on the mayor, he couldn't keep up. Friend: Did he hold up? You: Okay; dodged a few.

landfill site.context: 郊外那座大土山其实是垃圾填埋场，朋友路过问你那边为什么那么臭。
landfill site.translation: 朋友：这地方怎么这么味 你：那是个landfill site 垃圾都堆那儿 朋友：那住附近不遭罪吗 你：是 气味确实大
landfill site.example: Friend: Why does this area smell so bad? You: That's a landfill site; garbage is piled there. Friend: Don't people nearby suffer? You: Yeah, the stench is strong.

landfill textile.context: 环保讲座上讲，旧衣服如果不回收就会被当成废布料送去填埋。
landfill textile.translation: 朋友：捐不掉的旧衣服去哪了 你：多半成了landfill textile 埋进地里很难降解 朋友：那能怎么减少 你：少买新衣 旧物改造
landfill textile.example: Friend: Where do unworn donated clothes go? You: Mostly landfill textile, buried and hard to decompose. Friend: Then how to cut that? You: Buy less, upcycle old ones.

landscape architect.context: 小区请了位景观设计师来规划花园，朋友问他这工作具体做什么。
landscape architect.translation: 朋友：请来的那位是做什么的 你：是个landscape architect 专门设计绿化和步道 朋友：那花园会变好看吧 你：肯定 种上花就舒服了
landscape architect.example: Friend: What does the person they hired do? You: A landscape architect, who designs greenery and walkways. Friend: Then the garden will look better? You: Definitely; plant flowers and it's lovely.

language comprehension.context: 小孩子学语言特别快，老师说这阶段是语言理解能力发展的关键期。
language comprehension.translation: 朋友：为啥小孩学外语那么快 你：他们的language comprehension正在快速发展 朋友：那大人学就慢了 你：对 年纪越大越费劲
language comprehension.example: Friend: Why do kids pick up languages so fast? You: Their language comprehension is developing rapidly. Friend: Then adults learn slower? You: Right; the older you are, the harder.

lantern shark.context: 海洋纪录片里讲到深海有一种会发光的小鲨鱼，朋友说这名字真形象。
lantern shark.translation: 朋友：那深海鲨鱼怎么自己发光 你：它叫lantern shark 体内能发光 朋友：这么小还挺神奇 你：深海里为了找同伴和食物
lantern shark.example: Friend: How does that deep-sea shark glow? You: It's a lantern shark, its body can light up. Friend: So small yet amazing. You: In the deep sea, to find mates and food.

laptop stand.context: 你天天低头用电脑脖子酸，朋友推荐你买个支架把电脑垫高。
laptop stand.translation: 朋友：你颈椎是不是又不舒服 你：是 低头久了疼 朋友：你买个laptop stand把电脑架高 你：那样头就不用低着了 你：我这就去买一个
laptop stand.example: Friend: Is your neck bothering you again? You: Yeah, hurts after looking down. Friend: Get a laptop stand to raise the screen. You: Then I won't have to crane. You: I'll buy one now.

large numbers of.context: 新餐厅开业打折，店里一下来了很多顾客，忙得服务员都转不开。
large numbers of.translation: 朋友：这店怎么突然这么多人 你：打折吸引了large numbers of顾客 朋友：那我们改天再来吃 你：行 别在高峰期排队
large numbers of.example: Friend: Why is this place suddenly so crowded? You: The discount drew large numbers of customers. Friend: Then let's come another day. You: Good; avoid queuing at peak.

large quantity of.context: 公司搞促销一下进了一大批货，仓库都快堆不下了。
large quantity of.translation: 朋友：仓库怎么塞这么满 你：为了促销 我们备了a large quantity of货 朋友：那卖得掉吗 你：打折应该能清完
large quantity of.example: Friend: Why is the warehouse so packed? You: For the promo, we stocked a large quantity of goods. Friend: Will it sell? You: The discount should clear it.

laryngeal muscle.context: 声乐课上老师让你摸喉咙感受发声，说这就是喉部肌肉在振动。
laryngeal muscle.translation: 朋友：我唱歌总用不对地方 你：你摸这儿 这laryngeal muscle振动就是发声 朋友：那我怎么练 你：哼鸣练习 感受位置
laryngeal muscle.example: Friend: I always sing wrong. You: Feel here; this laryngeal muscle vibrating is how you make sound. Friend: How do I practice? You: Humming exercises, feel the spot.

lash out.context: 队友输了球后情绪失控，朝裁判发泄，朋友说他太冲动了。
lash out.translation: 朋友：他怎么冲裁判发脾气 你：输急了就lash out 控制不住 朋友：这样会吃牌的 你：是啊 冷静点就好了
lash out.example: Friend: Why is he snapping at the ref? You: Frustrated by losing, he lashes out and loses control. Friend: That'll earn him a card. You: Right; if only he'd calm down.

lash out at.context: 评论员在节目里猛烈抨击那种只顾赚钱不顾用户的做法。
lash out at.translation: 朋友：那节目怎么火药味那么足 你：评论员在lash out at那些只看钱的公司 朋友：说得挺解气 你：是 说到点上了
lash out at.example: Friend: Why was that show so fiery? You: The commentator is lashing out at companies that only care about money. Friend: Satisfying to hear. You: Right; he hit the nail.

last resort.context: 你试了好几种办法都修不好，朋友问实在不行还有没有最后的办法。
last resort.translation: 朋友：这电脑还能修吗 你：常规办法都试了 实在不行就as a last resort重装系统 朋友：那文件会丢吗 你：先备份再弄
last resort.example: Friend: Can this computer still be fixed? You: Tried the usual ways; as a last resort we reinstall the system. Friend: Will files be lost? You: Back up first, then do it.

lasting effects.context: 童年时那句鼓励改变了你很多，朋友说有些话的影响是长久深远的。
lasting effects.translation: 朋友：你怎么一直记着那句话 你：它给我带来的lasting effects 影响到现在 朋友：那真是遇对人了 你：是 一句话改变一生
lasting effects.example: Friend: Why do you still remember that phrase? You: Its lasting effects have stayed with me till now. Friend: Then you met the right person. You: Right; one phrase changed my life.

lateral thinking.context: 做咨询面试时遇到怪题，老师说别按常理想，要换个角度找突破口。
lateral thinking.translation: 朋友：这题我怎么一点思路没有 你：得用lateral thinking 别正面硬想 朋友：那怎么换角度 你：反着问 假如是最坏情况呢
lateral thinking.example: Friend: I have no clue on this problem. You: Use lateral thinking; don't attack it head on. Friend: Then how to switch angles? You: Flip it; what if it's the worst case?

latitude and longitude.context: 户外探险前朋友帮你在地图上标坐标，说看懂经纬度才不会迷路。
latitude and longitude.translation: 朋友：这地图上横竖线是啥 你：那是latitude and longitude 用来定位的 朋友：那我们照着走 你：对 别跑偏方向
latitude and longitude.example: Friend: What are those grid lines on the map? You: That's latitude and longitude, for locating. Friend: Then we follow them? You: Right; don't drift off course.

laugh off.context: 有人笑话你穿得土，你却不当回事，一笑而过继续做自己的事。
laugh off.translation: 朋友：他笑你穿得过时 你：我直接laugh it off 不往心里去 朋友：你心态真好 你：管他呢 舒服最重要
laugh off.example: Friend: He mocked your outdated outfit. You: I just laughed it off and didn't take it to heart. Friend: What a mindset. You: Whatever; comfort matters most.

lay down.context: 装修师傅在地上铺新地板，朋友问这层是怎么铺上去的。
lay down.translation: 朋友：这新地板看着真平整 你：师傅刚laid down一层 还得打磨上漆 朋友：那要晾几天 你：通风一周再进去住
lay down.example: Friend: This new floor looks smooth. You: The workers just laid down a layer; it still needs sanding and varnish. Friend: Then air it a few days? You: Ventilate a week before moving in.

lay your hands on.context: 你想要那本绝版书，问朋友能不能帮忙弄一本到手。
lay your hands on.translation: 朋友：那本绝版书你还找得到吗 你：我正想办法lay my hands on它 二手平台蹲一蹲 朋友：蹲到了告诉我 你：好 我也想看
lay your hands on.example: Friend: Can you still find that out-of-print book? You: I'm trying to lay my hands on it, watching the secondhand platforms. Friend: Tell me if you find one. You: Okay; I want to read it too.

layered decoration.context: 你家新做的背景墙有好几层立体效果，朋友问这是什么装修风格。
layered decoration.translation: 朋友：你这背景墙挺有层次 你：是那种layered decoration 一层一层叠出来的 朋友：造价高吗 你：不便宜 但效果值
layered decoration.example: Friend: Your accent wall has depth. You: It's that layered decoration, built up layer by layer. Friend: Is it pricey? You: Not cheap, but the look is worth it.

laze on.context: 周末你哪儿也不去，就瘫在沙发上晒太阳发呆，朋友笑你太会享受。
laze on.translation: 朋友：你周末就这么躺着啊 你：对啊 laze on沙发上晒晒太阳 多舒服 朋友：不无聊吗 你：这才叫放松
laze on.example: Friend: You're just lying around all weekend? You: Yeah, lazing on the sofa in the sun. Friend: Isn't it boring? You: That's what relaxing is.

ldl cholesterol.context: 体检报告里你胆固醇偏高，医生让你少吃肥肉，把坏胆固醇降下来。
ldl cholesterol.translation: 朋友：医生说我哪儿不好 你：你那个ldl cholesterol偏高 就是坏胆固醇 朋友：那要少吃什么 你：动物内脏和肥肉
ldl cholesterol.example: Friend: What did the doctor say's wrong? You: Your LDL cholesterol is high, the bad kind. Friend: Then what to cut? You: Organ meats and fatty pork.

lead a team.context: 你升职后第一次带团队，朋友问你当领导带一支队伍感觉如何。
lead a team.translation: 朋友：升了职感觉怎么样 你：现在得lead a team 责任大了不少 朋友：紧张吗 你：刚开始 慢慢摸索吧
lead a team.example: Friend: How does the promotion feel? You: Now I lead a team, way more responsibility. Friend: Nervous? You: At first; feeling my way.

lead the way.context: 你在熟悉的老城区里走在前面带路，朋友跟着你绕小路找那家老店。
lead the way.translation: 朋友：这地方你熟 你在前面带路吧 你：行 我lead the way 跟紧别走丢了 朋友：那小店真在这巷子里吗 你：对 拐个弯就到
lead the way.example: Friend: You know this area; lead the way. You: Okay, I'll lead the way, just follow and don't get lost. Friend: Is the shop really down this alley? You: Right; turn and it's there.

lean steak.context: 健身教练推荐你吃低脂高蛋白的瘦牛排，说减脂期特别适合。
lean steak.translation: 朋友：减脂期吃什么肉好 你：吃lean steak 瘦牛肉 蛋白高脂肪低 朋友：那怎么做比较好 你：煎一下配蔬菜
lean steak.example: Friend: What meat's good during a cut? You: Lean steak, lean beef; high protein, low fat. Friend: How to cook it? You: Pan-sear with veggies.

leap forward.context: 你看这几年手机技术突飞猛进，朋友说相比十年前简直是跨越式发展。
leap forward.translation: 朋友：这手机拍照也太强了 你：科技近年leap forward 跟十年前没法比 朋友：那以后会怎样 你：谁知道 越来越智能
leap forward.example: Friend: This phone's camera is incredible. You: Technology has leapt forward, nothing like ten years ago. Friend: Then what's next? You: Who knows; smarter and smarter.

leap year.context: 朋友生日是二月二十九号，你笑说他四年才过一次真正的生日。
leap year.translation: 朋友：你生日哪天呀 你：二月二十九 碰到leap year才能过一次真生日 朋友：那平时咋过 你：大家都帮我提前到二十八号过
leap year.example: Friend: When's your birthday? You: February twenty-ninth; only on a leap year is it a real birthday. Friend: Then how do you celebrate otherwise? You: Everyone celebrates it on the twenty-eighth instead.

learn from failure.context: 朋友创业失败很难过，你安慰他说别灰心，从失败里学到的东西最宝贵。
learn from failure.translation: 朋友：这次创业彻底失败了 你：别泄气 learn from failure 下次更有经验 朋友：可亏了不少钱 你：就当交学费 重头再来
learn from failure.example: Friend: This venture failed completely. You: Don't lose heart; learn from failure, next time you're more experienced. Friend: But I lost a lot. You: Tuition fee; start over.

learning benefit.context: 你边上学边打工，朋友说这样既能赚钱又能学到东西，挺有收获。
learning benefit.translation: 朋友：你打工图什么 你：除了工资 还有learning benefit 能练口语 朋友：那一举两得 你：对 时间也不浪费
learning benefit.example: Friend: What do you get from the job? You: Besides pay, there's the learning benefit of practicing English. Friend: Then it's two birds one stone. You: Right; no wasted time.

learning environment.context: 你转到一所新学校，发现这里同学爱问问题，学习氛围特别好。
learning environment.translation: 朋友：新学校感觉咋样 你：learning environment特别好 大家都爱讨论 朋友：那成绩会不会提高 你：氛围在这 想不进步都难
learning environment.example: Friend: How's the new school? You: The learning environment is great; everyone loves discussing. Friend: Then will grades improve? You: With that vibe, hard not to.

leave a bad taste in your mouth.context: 那家餐馆服务员态度极差，你说一次糟糕的体验让你对那地方印象特别差。
leave a bad taste in your mouth.translation: 朋友：你以后还去那家吗 你：不去了 那态度给我leave a bad taste in my mouth 朋友：真有那么差吗 你：服务员爱理不理 再也不去
leave a bad taste in your mouth.example: Friend: Will you go back to that place? You: No; that attitude left a bad taste in my mouth. Friend: Was it really that bad? You: The waiter ignored me; never again.

leave home.context: 你大学毕业搬到另一个城市，朋友问你第一次离家住习不习惯。
leave home.translation: 朋友：第一次一个人住感觉咋样 你：刚leave home那阵子特别想家 朋友：现在适应了吗 你：早就适应了 还挺自由
leave home.example: Friend: How does living alone feel, your first time? You: When I first left home, I really missed it. Friend: Settled in now? You: Long ago; it's actually freeing.

leave much to be desired.context: 你新买的这把椅子又硬又晃，朋友说这质量实在有待改进。
leave much to be desired.translation: 朋友：这把椅子坐着舒服吗 你：不太行 晃来晃去 quality真leave much to be desired 朋友：那退了吧 你：对 换个好的
leave much to be desired.example: Friend: Is this chair comfortable? You: Not really; it wobbles, the quality leaves much to be desired. Friend: Then return it. You: Right; get a better one.

led light.context: 你把家里旧灯泡全换成了 LED 的，朋友说这又亮又省电。
led light.translation: 朋友：你家灯换完看着真亮 你：全换成led light了 省电还不刺眼 朋友：贵不贵 你：贵点 但用得久
led light.example: Friend: Your lights are so bright now. You: Switched all to LED light; saves power and isn't harsh. Friend: Expensive? You: A bit, but they last long.

led lightbulb.context: 你买灯泡时特意选了带柔光的 LED 灯泡，朋友问你为啥挑这种。
led lightbulb.translation: 朋友：你这灯泡什么牌子 你：就是个led lightbulb 暖光的 朋友：比普通的好在哪 你：不频闪 看书舒服
led lightbulb.example: Friend: What brand is your bulb? You: Just an LED lightbulb, warm light. Friend: Better than normal ones? You: No flicker; easier on the eyes reading.

left luggage office.context: 你到站后不想拖着箱子逛，先去车站把大件行李存起来。
left luggage office.translation: 朋友：拖着箱子逛街好麻烦 你：先去left luggage office存起来 轻装逛 朋友：在哪呢 你：车站出口旁边 走两步就到
left luggage office.example: Friend: Dragging the suitcase around is such a hassle. You: First use the left luggage office, then stroll light. Friend: Where is it? You: By the station exit, two steps away.

left on read.context: 你给朋友发了长消息，他半天不回，却发了朋友圈，你说他这是已读不回。
left on read.translation: 朋友：我那消息他到底看没看 你：看了还发朋友圈 典型left on read 朋友：太气人了 你：别理他 等他来找你
left on read.example: Friend: Did he even read my message? You: He read it and posted a Moments update; classic left on read. Friend: So annoying. You: Ignore him; let him come to you.

left over.context: 聚餐后桌上还剩不少菜，你问朋友这些打包回去的剩菜怎么处理。
left over.translation: 朋友：这菜还剩好多 你：leftover的我们打包 晚上热一热还能吃 朋友：那别浪费了 你：对 打包回家
left over.example: Friend: There's still so much left. You: Let's pack up the leftover food; heat it tonight. Friend: Don't waste it then. You: Right; pack it home.

left to their own devices.context: 放假你把小孩一个人丢在家看电视，朋友说这样放任自流可不好。
left to their own devices.translation: 朋友：你一整天都不管孩子啊 你：我忙的时候就leave them to their own devices 朋友：那电视看太久了 你：是 我给他定个时间
left to their own devices.example: Friend: You're leaving the kids alone all day? You: When I'm busy I just leave them to their own devices. Friend: Then TV's on too long. You: Right; I'll set a limit.

leftover waste.context: 你把家里厨余和其他垃圾分开，说这些剩饭菜堆肥后能用来养花。
leftover waste.translation: 朋友：这菜叶骨头你留着干嘛 你：当leftover waste堆肥 正好养花 朋友：还挺环保 你：是 废物利用
leftover waste.example: Friend: Why keep those vegetable peels and bones? You: They're leftover waste for compost, good for the plants. Friend: Pretty eco. You: Right; use the waste.

legal requirement.context: 公司开业要办齐各种证照，朋友说这些都是法律规定必须满足的。
legal requirement.translation: 朋友：这手续怎么办这么多 你：都是legal requirement 一项都不能少 朋友：那得跑多少部门 你：先把营业执照办下来
legal requirement.example: Friend: Why are there so many formalities? You: They're all legal requirements, not one can be skipped. Friend: Then how many offices? You: Get the business license first.

legal tender.context: 你付款时收银员不收你手里那种旧版硬币，说它已经不算法定流通货币了。
legal tender.translation: 朋友：这硬币怎么不收 你：那种旧版已经不是legal tender了 朋友：那我怎么办 你：去银行换新的吧
legal tender.example: Friend: Why won't they take this coin? You: That old issue is no longer legal tender. Friend: Then what do I do? You: Exchange it at the bank.

legal term.context: 你看合同里好多词看不懂，朋友说这些都是行内常用的法律术语。
legal term.translation: 朋友：这合同怎么一句都看不懂 你：里面全是legal term 得查词典 朋友：要不要找个律师看看 你：对 签之前让专业的过一遍
legal term.example: Friend: Why is this contract unreadable? You: It's full of legal terms; you need a dictionary. Friend: Should we have a lawyer look? You: Right; get a pro to review before signing.

leisure activities.context: 退休后你妈一下子闲下来，朋友建议她多参加些社区里的休闲活动。
leisure activities.translation: 朋友：阿姨退休后天天在家待着 你：是 得多参加点leisure activities 不然闲出病 朋友：社区有太极班 你：给她报一个
leisure activities.example: Friend: Your mom just stays home after retiring. You: Right; she needs leisure activities, or she'll get restless. Friend: There's a tai chi class in the community. You: Sign her up.

leisure reading.context: 你睡前喜欢翻两页轻松的小说，说这种无目的的阅读特别解压。
leisure reading.translation: 朋友：你现在还看书呢 你：就做点leisure reading 不为考试 就是图个放松 朋友：那看什么类型 你：轻松的小说
leisure reading.example: Friend: You still read books? You: Just some leisure reading, not for exams, just to relax. Friend: What genre? You: Light novels.

lend casually.context: 你总借钱给不太熟的人，朋友提醒你别随便把钱借出去容易要不回来。
lend casually.translation: 朋友：你又借钱给那个同事 你：他人不错 朋友：你别lend money casually 上次那笔还没要回来呢 你：这倒是 我得留心
lend casually.example: Friend: You lent money to that colleague again? You: He seems nice. Friend: Don't lend money casually; the last one hasn't come back. You: True; I need to watch it.

lend money.context: 朋友家里有急事急用钱，你二话不说先借给他应急，说好发了工资还。
lend money.translation: 朋友：能借我五千吗 我家里急 你：行我lend you钱 你先用着 朋友：太感谢了 我发工资就还 你：不急 先把事办了
lend money.example: Friend: Can you lend me five thousand? It's an emergency at home. You: Sure, I'll lend you the money; use it first. Friend: Thanks so much; I'll pay back with my salary. You: No rush; handle the matter first.

lend support to.context: 你朋友参加比赛，你特意到现场给他加油说支持，朋友说有你打气更有信心。
lend support to.translation: 朋友：我明天比赛好紧张 你：我去现场lend you support 给你加油 朋友：有你在我就有底了 你：正常发挥就行
lend support to.example: Friend: I'm so nervous about tomorrow's match. You: I'll come lend you support and cheer you on. Friend: Having you there gives me confidence. You: Just play normally.

less is more.context: 你装修时坚持白墙不加多余装饰，说设计上少即是多，简单更耐看。
less is more.translation: 朋友：你家怎么全是白墙 你：我信奉less is more 简单大方耐看 朋友：那不会太单调吗 你：加点绿植就有生气
less is more.example: Friend: Why are all your walls white? You: I believe less is more; simple and timeless. Friend: Isn't it too plain? You: Add some plants and it's lively.

let go of.context: 朋友还在为过去的失败耿耿于怀，你劝他该放下就放下，别背着包袱。
let go of.translation: 朋友：我老想起那件丢人的事 你：你得let go of它 过去就过去了 朋友：可我就是放不下 你：做点新事 慢慢就淡了
let go of.example: Friend: I keep thinking back to that embarrassing moment. You: You've got to let go of it; it's over. Friend: But I just can't let it go. You: Do new things; it'll fade.

let loose.context: 演唱会现场你跟着音乐尽情舞动，把平时的拘束全都释放出来。
let loose.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么嗨 你：在livehouse我就let loose 放开了玩 朋友：那平时压抑太久了吧 你：对 偶尔疯一把
let loose.example: Friend: Why are you so hyped today? You: At the gig I just let loose and go wild. Friend: You've been bottled up too long? You: Right; go crazy once in a while.

let off steam.context: 朋友上班受了气，下班后约你去跑步，说要把这一肚子火发泄出来。
let off steam.translation: 朋友：今天被老板骂惨了 你：那去跑几圈let off steam 把气撒出去 朋友：跑完真舒服 你：出一身汗什么都忘了
let off steam.example: Friend: The boss tore into me today. You: Then run a few laps to let off steam and vent it out. Friend: Running feels so good. You: Sweat it out and you forget it all.

let one's hair down.context: 项目终于上线，你和同事周末聚在一起，喝酒说笑彻底放松下来。
let one's hair down.translation: 朋友：项目交了 终于能喘口气 你：今晚就let our hair down 好好放松 朋友：来 干杯 你：下周再拼
let one's hair down.example: Friend: The project shipped; finally a breather. You: Tonight let your hair down and really relax. Friend: Come, cheers. You: Grind again next week.

let their hair down.context: 公司年会老板让大家别拘束，尽情吃喝玩乐，把工作都抛在脑后。
let their hair down.translation: 朋友：年会上要正装吗 你：不用 大家都let their hair down 吃好喝好 朋友：那有表演吗 你：还有抽奖呢 玩开心点
let their hair down.example: Friend: Do we dress up for the annual party? You: No; everyone lets their hair down, eating and drinking. Friend: Any performances? You: There's a lucky draw; enjoy yourselves.

let your hair down.context: 你平时在公司总端着架子，周末和老朋友聚时才彻底卸下防备。
let your hair down.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么放得开 你：在老朋友面前就let my hair down了 朋友：上班绷太久了吧 你：是 出来玩就该痛快
let your hair down.example: Friend: Why are you so loose today? You: Around old friends I just let my hair down. Friend: You're tense at work too long? You: Right; when out to play, enjoy it.

let's start by looking at.context: 老师上课翻开课本，说这节课我们先从第一章的概念讲起。
let's start by looking at.translation: 朋友：今天讲什么呀 你：let's start by looking at第一章 把基础概念先搞懂 朋友：难不难 你：入门而已 别紧张
let's start by looking at.example: Friend: What's on today? You: Let's start by looking at chapter one, getting the basics clear. Friend: Is it hard? You: Just the intro; relax.

level against.context: 报告里同事把失误归咎于你，你气不过，说这些指责根本不公平。
level against.translation: 朋友：那报告怎么把锅甩给你 你：他把一堆责任leveled against我 明明不是我的错 朋友：那你得澄清 你：对 我找他说清楚
level against.example: Friend: Why does that report blame you? You: He leveled a bunch of charges against me, clearly not my fault. Friend: Then you should clarify. You: Right; I'll talk to him.

licensing rule.context: 你买了辆电动车去上牌，朋友问你这地方的上牌规定是怎样的。
licensing rule.translation: 朋友：你这车好上牌吗 你：得先看本地licensing rule 符合标准才能上 朋友：那要带什么材料 你：发票和身份证
licensing rule.example: Friend: Is your bike easy to register? You: First check the local licensing rule; only compliant ones can be plated. Friend: What papers needed? You: The invoice and ID.

lie ahead.context: 你快毕业了，朋友问你未来路上有哪些计划，工作还是继续读书。
lie ahead.translation: 朋友：毕业后有什么在前面等着你 你：未来还lie ahead很多选择 我还在想 朋友：别想太多 一步一步走 你：对 先把论文写完
lie ahead.example: Friend: What's lying ahead after graduation? You: Many choices lie ahead; I'm still thinking. Friend: Don't overthink; take it step by step. You: Right; finish the thesis first.

lie in.context: 周末你不设闹钟，早上睡到自然醒，朋友说你这是难得的懒觉。
lie in.translation: 朋友：你今天起得真晚 你：周末就想lie in一下 不被闹钟吵醒 朋友：那睡得香吗 你：特别沉 好久没睡这么足
lie in.example: Friend: You got up so late today. You: On weekends I just want to lie in, not woken by an alarm. Friend: Did you sleep well? You: Deeply; haven't slept that full in ages.

lie out.context: 你把新买的地毯平铺在客厅，朋友说这花色铺在地上还挺好看。
lie out.translation: 朋友：这地毯铺哪了 你：就lying out in客厅中间 朋友：踩着舒服吗 你：软乎乎的 光脚走特舒服
lie out.example: Friend: Where's this rug laid out? You: Just lying out in the middle of the living room. Friend: Does it feel nice underfoot? You: Plush; great barefoot.

lies behind.context: 你成绩一直不错，朋友问你背后到底有什么学习秘诀。
lies behind.translation: 朋友：你怎么考那么好 你：其实努力lies behind成绩背后 没什么捷径 朋友：你每天学多久 你：踏踏实实两小时
lies behind.example: Friend: How do you score so well? You: Actually, hard work lies behind the scores; no shortcut. Friend: How long do you study daily? You: A solid two hours.

lies with.context: 出了事故领导先不怪你，说这事到底是谁的责任还得查清楚。
lies with.translation: 朋友：这责任算谁的 你：具体是谁的责任still lies with调查结果 朋友：那我会被牵连吗 你：别担心 没做错就不怕
lies with.example: Friend: Whose fault is this? You: Exactly where the responsibility lies is still with the investigation. Friend: Then will I be implicated? You: Don't worry; if you did nothing wrong, no fear.

life challenge.context: 朋友一个人在外地打拼遇到困难，你说这都是人生中要面对的考验。
life challenge.translation: 朋友：一个人在外真难 你：这就是life challenge 熬过去就成长了 朋友：有时候真撑不住 你：不行就回家歇歇
life challenge.example: Friend: Being alone out here is so hard. You: This is a life challenge; get through it and you grow. Friend: Sometimes I can't hold on. You: If you can't, come home and rest.

life coach.context: 你对现状不满意，朋友建议你找个专门的人生教练聊聊，理理方向。
life coach.translation: 朋友：你最近老说迷茫 你：要不找个life coach聊聊 帮我理理目标 朋友：那有用吗 你：能换个角度看问题
life coach.example: Friend: You keep saying you're lost lately. You: Maybe talk to a life coach to sort out my goals. Friend: Does that help? You: It gives a fresh angle.

life cycle.context: 公司做产品经理，朋友问你一款产品从上市到退出市场要经历哪些阶段。
life cycle.translation: 朋友：这产品卖多久算合适 你：得看它的life cycle 从成长到成熟再到衰退 朋友：那衰退了怎么办 你：推出新品接档
life cycle.example: Friend: How long should a product sell? You: Look at its life cycle—growth, maturity, then decline. Friend: Then when it declines? You: Launch a new one to take over.

life essential.context: 你收拾行李出远门，只挑了几件真正的必需品带上，说轻装上阵。
life essential.translation: 朋友：你箱子怎么那么小 你：我只带life essential 衣服证件充电器 朋友：不多带点吗 你：轻装不累赘
life essential.example: Friend: Why is your suitcase so small? You: I only bring life essentials—clothes, ID, charger. Friend: Not bring more? You: Light packing, no clutter.

life events.context: 你这一年又是换工作又是搬家，朋友说你经历的人生大事可真不少。
life events.translation: 朋友：你这一年变化真大 你：工作搬家都是life events 赶上一块儿了 朋友：累不累 你：虽然忙 但都是好事
life events.example: Friend: You changed so much this year. You: Jobs and moving are life events, all at once. Friend: Tiring? You: Busy, but all good.

life expectancy.context: 新闻说随着医疗进步，现在人的预期寿命比几十年前高多了。
life expectancy.translation: 朋友：现在人是不是更长寿了 你：life expectancy比以前长了不少 朋友：那退休年龄也要推后吗 你：听说在讨论了
life expectancy.example: Friend: Do people live longer now? You: Life expectancy is much longer than before. Friend: Then will retirement age rise? You: I hear they're discussing it.

life hack.context: 你分享了一个挤番茄酱的小妙招，朋友说这种生活小技巧真省事。
life hack.translation: 朋友：你这番茄酱怎么倒得这么顺 你：告诉你个life hack 先晃两下再挤 朋友：还真不喷了 你：小技巧大用处
life hack.example: Friend: How do you squeeze the ketchup so smoothly? You: Here's a life hack: shake it first then squeeze. Friend: It really doesn't splatter. You: Small tricks, big help.

life is for living.context: 你总舍不得花钱旅行，朋友劝你说人生就是要去经历，别光攒钱。
life is for living.translation: 朋友：你攒那么钱干嘛 你：想留着以后用 朋友：life is for living 现在该花就花 你：也对 出去看看
life is for living.example: Friend: Why save so much? You: Want to keep it for later. Friend: Life is for living; spend when you should. You: True; go see the world.

life lesson.context: 你从那次失败里学到了道理，朋友说这种用教训换来的经验最深刻。
life lesson.translation: 朋友：那次倒霉事现在想想值吗 你：值 它给我上了宝贵的life lesson 朋友：学到啥了 你：做事要留后手
life lesson.example: Friend: Was that unlucky episode worth it in hindsight? You: Yes; it taught me a valuable life lesson. Friend: What did you learn? You: Always keep a backup.

life satisfaction.context: 你做了个生活满意度调查，问朋友打几分，朋友说最近过得挺知足。
life satisfaction.translation: 朋友：这问卷问你对生活满意吗 你：我打八分 life satisfaction还不错 朋友：那扣的两分呢 你：工作再轻松点就满分
life satisfaction.example: Friend: This survey asks how satisfied you are with life. You: I'd give it an eight; my life satisfaction is pretty good. Friend: What about the missing two? You: If work were easier, it'd be perfect.

life skill.context: 你觉得除了读书，会做饭、会修东西这些实用本领也很重要。
life skill.translation: 朋友：除了学习还要教孩子什么 你：得学点life skill 做饭算账都得会 朋友：学校不教这些 你：家里慢慢教
life skill.example: Friend: Besides studying, what should kids learn? You: Some life skills—cooking, handling money. Friend: School doesn't teach those. You: Teach them at home.

life stress.context: 你最近又忙工作又顾家，朋友说你肩上的生活压力可真不小。
life stress.translation: 朋友：你最近看着好累 你：工作家里两头顾 life stress挺大的 朋友：得给自己留时间 你：周末就出去走走
life stress.example: Friend: You look so tired lately. You: Juggling work and home, the life stress is a lot. Friend: You need time for yourself. You: I'll get out on weekends.

lifelong learning.context: 你退休后还在上网课学画画，朋友说你这就是活到老学到老。
lifelong learning.translation: 朋友：爷爷退休了还上什么网课 你：他坚持lifelong learning 想学画画 朋友：这么大岁数还学 你：是 脑子不闲着
lifelong learning.example: Friend: Why is Grandpa taking online classes after retiring? You: He keeps lifelong learning; wants to learn painting. Friend: Learning at that age? You: Right; keeps the mind busy.

lifestyle change.context: 你体检后开始早睡跑步，朋友说你这一整个人的生活方式都变了。
lifestyle change.translation: 朋友：你这两个月变化好大 你：做了个lifestyle change 早睡早起加运动 朋友：气色都不一样了 你：对 坚持下去
lifestyle change.example: Friend: You've changed so much these two months. You: I made a lifestyle change—early nights, early up, and exercise. Friend: Your glow is different. You: Right; stick with it.

lifestyle factor.context: 医生分析你失眠的原因，说很多都是生活方式上的因素造成的。
lifestyle factor.translation: 朋友：我为什么老失眠 你：医生说好多lifestyle factor 比如睡前刷手机 朋友：那怎么调 你：睡前一小时别碰手机
lifestyle factor.example: Friend: Why do I keep losing sleep? You: The doctor says many lifestyle factors, like scrolling before bed. Friend: Then how to fix it? You: No phone an hour before sleep.

lift a finger.context: 合租室友从不打扫卫生，你叫他帮忙他却一根手指都不肯动。
lift a finger.translation: 朋友：那室友怎么这么懒 你：让他帮忙他连a finger都不lift 朋友：地都快脏死了 你：真得跟他谈谈
lift a finger.example: Friend: Why is that roommate so lazy? You: When I ask for help, he won't lift a finger. Friend: The floor's filthy. You: Really need to talk to him.

lift mood.context: 你心情不好时爱听歌，朋友说轻快的音乐能把低落的情绪提起来。
lift mood.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么闷闷不乐 你：有点低落 朋友：听首开心的歌 lift your mood 你：真的 听完好多了
lift mood.example: Friend: Why are you so down today? You: A bit low. Friend: Play a happy song to lift your mood. You: Really; I feel better now.

lift one's mood.context: 朋友考试砸了很沮丧，你拉他去吃顿好的，说美食能让人心情好起来。
lift one's mood.translation: 朋友：考砸了 我好难受 你：走 去吃顿好的 lift your mood 朋友：吃完真的想开了 你：对 别想啦
lift one's mood.example: Friend: I failed the exam; I feel awful. You: Come, eat something good to lift your mood. Friend: I feel better after eating. You: Right; stop dwelling.

lift one's spirits.context: 团队项目失败大家都很沮丧，你讲了个笑话想给大伙提提气。
lift one's spirits.translation: 朋友：大家都没精打采的 你：我们得讲点开心的 lift our spirits 朋友：那就讲个段子 你：笑一笑 重新来
lift one's spirits.example: Friend: Everyone's so down. You: We need something fun to lift our spirits. Friend: Then tell a joke. You: A laugh, then start over.

lift spirits.context: 朋友刚失恋情绪低落，你拉他去公园晒太阳散步，帮他重新振作起来。
lift spirits.translation: 朋友：他这两天一直不出门 你：我们带他出去走走 lift his spirits 朋友：他会不会拒绝 你：硬拉也得去 晒晒太阳就好
lift spirits.example: Friend: He hasn't left home these two days. You: Let's take him out for a walk to lift his spirits. Friend: Will he refuse? You: Drag him out if needed; sunlight helps.

light box.context: 你在商场看到一张特别亮的广告灯箱，朋友说这种灯箱广告特别醒目。
light box.translation: 朋友：那商场门口亮的是什么 你：是个light box广告 晚上看着特别显眼 朋友：路过都想多看两眼 你：是 这设计成功
light box.example: Friend: What's that bright thing by the mall entrance? You: It's a light box ad; really eye-catching at night. Friend: You can't help looking. You: Right; the design works.

light read.context: 你出差路上带了本轻松的小散文集，说这种不费脑子的书最好读。
light read.translation: 朋友：你出差带什么书 你：就带本light read 翻翻不费脑 朋友：比专业书轻松多了 你：对 路上放松用
light read.example: Friend: What book did you pack for the trip? You: Just a light read, easy flipping. Friend: Way lighter than textbooks. You: Right; for relaxing on the way.

light wave.context: 物理课上老师讲到可见光是一种电磁波，朋友问它和电波有啥区别。
light wave.translation: 朋友：光到底是什么东西 你：它是一种light wave 也是电磁波的一种 朋友：那为什么能看见 你：特定波长眼睛就能接收
light wave.example: Friend: What actually is light? You: It's a light wave, a kind of electromagnetic wave. Friend: Then why can we see it? You: Our eyes detect certain wavelengths.

lighten mood.context: 开会气氛太僵，你插了句轻松的话，想缓和一下紧张的气氛。
lighten mood.translation: 朋友：这会开得好严肃 你：我讲个小段子 lighten the mood 朋友：大家真的笑了 你：气氛松快多了
lighten mood.example: Friend: This meeting is so tense. You: Let me crack a small joke to lighten the mood. Friend: Everyone actually laughed. You: The mood's much looser now.

lighter materials.context: 工程师说用新型材料做机身，手机能做得更薄更轻，朋友问是什么料。
lighter materials.translation: 朋友：这手机怎么这么轻 你：用了lighter materials 比旧款轻不少 朋友：那会不会不结实 你：硬度够的 放心
lighter materials.example: Friend: Why is this phone so light? You: It uses lighter materials, much lighter than the old one. Friend: Then is it sturdy? You: Hardness is fine; relax.

like no other.context: 你第一次吃到这家店的招牌甜品，朋友说这味道在别处可吃不到。
like no other.translation: 朋友：这甜品你尝过吗 你：头一回 味道真像no other 别处吃不到 朋友：那是 他家秘方 你：难怪这么多人排队
like no other.example: Friend: Have you tried this dessert? You: First time; the taste is like no other, nowhere else. Friend: Right; it's their secret recipe. You: No wonder the queue's so long.

limbic system.context: 心理学课上老师讲到大脑里负责情绪的那部分，朋友问它叫什么。
limbic system.translation: 朋友：人为什么会突然情绪上来 你：和大脑里limbic system有关 它管情绪 朋友：那能控制吗 你：了解它就能管理情绪
limbic system.example: Friend: Why do emotions suddenly surge? You: It's tied to the brain's limbic system, which handles emotion. Friend: Then can we control it? You: Understanding it helps manage emotions.

limit exposure.context: 医生让你少晒太阳，出门戴帽子，减少紫外线对皮肤的伤害。
limit exposure.translation: 朋友：我这晒斑怎么越来越多 你：你得limit exposure to太阳 出门戴帽子 朋友：那还能涂防晒吗 你：涂 双重防护
limit exposure.example: Friend: Why are my sunspots multiplying? You: You need to limit exposure to the sun; wear a hat out. Friend: Can I still use sunscreen? You: Yes, double protection.

limit to.context: 你预算有限，朋友问你这趟旅行最多能花多少，好帮你安排。
limit to.translation: 朋友：你这趟旅行预算多少 你：我limit to三千以内 朋友：那住宿得省着点 你：对 选便宜点的青旅
limit to.example: Friend: What's your travel budget? You: I'll limit it to within three thousand. Friend: Then save on lodging. You: Right; pick a cheap hostel.

limited edition.context: 你抢到了一款编号限量的球鞋，朋友说这种限量版以后还会升值。
limited edition.translation: 朋友：这鞋抢得真不容易 你：它是limited edition 全球就那么多 朋友：那舍不得穿吧 你：摆着收藏 偶尔拿出来看看
limited edition.example: Friend: This shoe was hard to grab. You: It's a limited edition, only so many made worldwide. Friend: Then you won't wear it? You: Keep it for collection; take a look sometimes.

limited stock.context: 你看中的那款包店员说只剩最后一个了，库存特别紧张。
limited stock.translation: 朋友：这包还有别的颜色吗 你：不好意思 stock已经limited了 就剩这一个 朋友：那我要了 你：赶紧结账 别被抢了
limited stock.example: Friend: Does this bag come in other colors? You: Sorry, stock is limited; only this one left. Friend: Then I'll take it. You: Check out fast before someone grabs it.

limited stocks.context: 大促时你想买的那款电器显示库存不多，赶紧下单怕被抢光。
limited stocks.translation: 朋友：这电器打折划算啊 你：提示limited stocks 就剩几件了 朋友：那赶紧下单 你：已经付款了 才安心
limited stocks.example: Friend: This appliance is a great deal on sale. You: It says limited stocks, only a few left. Friend: Then order fast. You: Already paid; now I can relax.

line judge.context: 网球比赛时你看有个裁判专门盯着边线，朋友问他是判什么的。
line judge.translation: 朋友：那个站边上的裁判是干嘛的 你：是line judge 专门看球出不出界 朋友：那主裁判什么 你：主裁盯全局 各有分工
line judge.example: Friend: What's that lineside umpire for? You: A line judge, who watches whether the ball is in or out. Friend: Then what does the main umpire do? You: The main ref watches the whole match; each has a role.

line of descent.context: 族谱课上老师讲，查家谱就是顺着祖先一代代往下找自己的世系血脉。
line of descent.translation: 朋友：我们家族谱真能追到几百年前 你：它记录的是line of descent 一代代传下来的 朋友：那我也想查查 你：去翻家里的旧本子
line of descent.example: Friend: Can our family tree really reach centuries back? You: It records the line of descent, passed down each generation. Friend: Then I want to look mine up too. You: Dig out the old family book.

line of dialogue.context: 两个部门之间沟通总是不通畅，你建议开个固定渠道让双方能说上话。
line of dialogue.translation: 朋友：两个部门怎么老互相误会 你：得开一条line of dialogue 让他们定期沟通 朋友：那谁牵头 你：拉个群 每周对一次
line of dialogue.example: Friend: Why do the two departments keep misunderstanding each other? You: Open a line of dialogue so they talk regularly. Friend: Then who leads? You: Make a group; sync weekly.

linger on.context: 散场后你和朋友舍不得走，在剧场门口又站了好久，回味刚才的演出。
linger on.translation: 朋友：散场了怎么还不回家 你：我想linger on一会儿 刚才那戏太好看了 朋友：那就门口再聊会儿 你：是 太上头了
linger on.example: Friend: Why aren't we heading home after the show? You: I want to linger on a bit; that play was amazing. Friend: Then chat by the door a while. You: Right; it's still in my head.

linguistic skills.context: 你在国外待了几年，朋友说你的外语能力进步特别大。
linguistic skills.translation: 朋友：你英语怎么这么流利了 你：天天用 linguistic skills练出来的 朋友：那现在看美剧不用字幕了 你：差不多 听新闻也行
linguistic skills.example: Friend: How is your English so fluent now? You: Living abroad built my linguistic skills daily. Friend: Then you watch shows without subtitles? You: Mostly; even the news.

link to.context: 论文里你把两个现象联系起来，说它们之间可能存在某种关系。
link to.translation: 朋友：这两个数据有关系吗 你：我觉得可以link them to看相关性 朋友：那能证明因果吗 你：还不能 先做相关分析
link to.example: Friend: Are these two data points related? You: I think we can link them to look at correlation. Friend: Does that prove causation? You: Not yet; first do a correlation analysis.

link with.context: 医生说这种生活习惯可能和慢性病有关联，朋友问具体怎么影响。
link with.translation: 朋友：熬夜真的会影响身体吗 你：研究熬夜link with很多慢性病 朋友：那我赶紧早睡 你：对 别不当回事
link with.example: Friend: Does staying up really affect health? You: Studies link it with many chronic conditions. Friend: Then I'll sleep early. You: Right; don't take it lightly.

links to.context: 你做网页时把每个按钮都链接到对应的页面，朋友问这些跳转都通了没。
links to.translation: 朋友：你这网站按钮都能点吗 你：我把每个都links to对应的页面了 朋友：那测试过没 你：点了一圈 都能跳对
links to.example: Friend: Do all the buttons on your site work? You: I've linked each to its corresponding page. Friend: Have you tested? You: Clicked around; all jump correctly.

listen actively.context: 和朋友聊天时你不抢话，而是认真听对方说，再给出回应。
listen actively.translation: 朋友：你聊天怎么这么有耐心 你：我会listen actively 等对方说完再回 朋友：这才是真朋友 你：互相尊重嘛
listen actively.example: Friend: Why are you so patient when chatting? You: I listen actively, waiting till they finish before replying. Friend: That's a true friend. You: Mutual respect.

listen attentively.context: 老师讲课你坐第一排认真听，笔记记得工工整整，朋友说你上课真专心。
listen attentively.translation: 朋友：你上课怎么总坐第一排 你：这样才能listen attentively不漏重点 朋友：难怪你笔记全 你：坐后面容易走神
listen attentively.example: Friend: Why do you always sit in the front row? You: That way I listen attentively and don't miss key points. Friend: No wonder your notes are complete. You: Sitting back gets distracting.

listen up.context: 老师要宣布一个重要通知，拍拍手让大家安静，说都听好了。
listen up.translation: 朋友：老师拍拍手干嘛呢 你：他让我们listen up 有重要事宣布 朋友：那安静点吧 你：听听他说什么
listen up.example: Friend: Why is the teacher clapping? You: He wants us to listen up, something important. Friend: Then be quiet. You: Let's hear what he says.

literary experience.context: 你读一本翻译精美的小说，朋友说这书带来的阅读享受比看剧还过瘾。
literary experience.translation: 朋友：你最近读什么书呢 你：一本好译本 那种rich literary experience 特别沉浸 朋友：比看剧还过瘾吗 你：想象空间更大
literary experience.example: Friend: What are you reading lately? You: A beautifully translated novel; the rich literary experience is so immersive. Friend: Better than watching shows? You: More room for imagination.

little bit.context: 你点奶茶时让店员少放糖，说自己只想加一点点甜味就够。
little bit.translation: 朋友：这奶茶要几分甜 你：就加a little bit糖 太甜腻 朋友：那半糖呢 你：再少点 微糖就行
little bit.example: Friend: How sweet do you want the milk tea? You: Just a little bit of sugar; too sweet is cloying. Friend: Half sugar then? You: Even less; just lightly sweet.

little more than.context: 你原以为这份工作很难，朋友说其实它不过就是个普通的活计。
little more than.translation: 朋友：这工作听着挺难吧 你：其实it's little more than填表打杂 朋友：那还挺轻松 你：是 没挑战
little more than.example: Friend: This job sounds hard? You: Actually it's little more than filling forms and odd jobs. Friend: Then it's pretty easy. You: Right; no challenge.

live apart.context: 你和对象因为工作原因分居两地，朋友问你们平时多久见一次。
live apart.translation: 朋友：你们俩现在住一起吗 你：没有 工作原因we live apart 同城都不常聚 朋友：那感情还好吗 你：周末就见面
live apart.example: Friend: Do you two live together now? You: No, work keeps us living apart; rarely meet even in the same city. Friend: Is the relationship okay? You: We meet on weekends.

live concert.context: 你买到了喜欢乐队的演唱会门票，朋友问你是去现场还是看转播。
live concert.translation: 朋友：那乐队演唱会你去吗 你：必须去live concert 现场氛围多棒 朋友：票难抢吧 你：我蹲到了 太激动了
live concert.example: Friend: Are you going to that band's concert? You: Definitely the live concert; the atmosphere's amazing. Friend: Were tickets hard to get? You: I scored some; so excited.

live event.context: 你买了票去现场看足球赛，说那种直播画面完全比不了现场的气氛。
live event.translation: 朋友：你在家看球不也一样 你：现场看live event的氛围完全不同 朋友：那票贵不贵 你：值 一起呐喊太爽
live event.example: Friend: Isn't watching at home the same? You: A live event's atmosphere is totally different. Friend: Is the ticket pricey? You: Worth it; roaring together is a blast.

live for today.context: 朋友总在为未来焦虑，你劝他别想那么多，好好活在当下这一刻。
live for today.translation: 朋友：我老担心以后怎么办 你：别想太多 live for today 把今天过好 朋友：可未来也得规划 你：先珍惜眼前
live for today.example: Friend: I keep worrying about the future. You: Don't overthink; live for today, live this day well. Friend: But the future needs planning. You: First cherish the present.

live in the now.context: 你练习冥想时老师让你把注意力放在当下，别回想过去也别担心未来。
live in the now.translation: 朋友：冥想到底在想什么 你：就是learn to live in the now 专注呼吸 朋友：脑子一乱怎么办 你：拉回来就好
live in the now.example: Friend: What do you actually think about in meditation? You: Just live in the now, focus on breathing. Friend: What if the mind wanders? You: Gently bring it back.

live music.context: 周末小酒吧里有乐队现场演出，你和朋友边喝东西边听现场音乐。
live music.translation: 朋友：今晚这酒吧挺热闹 你：有live music 乐队现场演奏 朋友：比录音棚版好听 你：对 现场有味道
live music.example: Friend: This bar's lively tonight. You: There's live music, a band playing. Friend: Better than the studio version. You: Right; live has a vibe.

live performance.context: 话剧开场前你有点紧张，朋友说这是你第一次登台现场表演，别紧张。
live performance.translation: 朋友：你今晚紧张吗 你：第一次live performance 手心都出汗了 朋友：你排练那么熟 怕啥 你：上去就好了
live performance.example: Friend: Are you nervous tonight? You: First live performance; my palms are sweating. Friend: You rehearsed so well, why worry? You: Once I'm on, it's fine.

live rent-free.context: 朋友毕业后搬去和父母住，不用交房租，你说他现在等于免费住家里。
live rent-free.translation: 朋友：他现在房租多少 你：他住爸妈家 基本live rent-free 朋友：那挺爽啊 你：就是还没独立
live rent-free.example: Friend: How much rent is he paying? You: Living at his parents', basically rent-free. Friend: That's nice. You: Just not independent yet.

live sporting events.context: 你不爱看电视，但特别喜欢去现场看球赛，朋友问你最爱哪个队的现场。
live sporting events.translation: 朋友：你怎么总往球场跑 你：我爱看live sporting events 现场助威太带劲 朋友：电视上不也能看 你：那气氛完全不一样
live sporting events.example: Friend: Why do you keep going to the stadium? You: I love live sporting events; cheering on site is electric. Friend: Isn't it on TV? You: The vibe is totally different.

live stream.context: 你不方便去现场，朋友说比赛会在网上直播，你直接手机看就行。
live stream.translation: 朋友：今晚比赛你去哪看 你：去不了现场 看live stream就行 朋友：手机上清楚吗 你：还行 别卡顿就好
live stream.example: Friend: Where are you watching tonight's match? You: Can't go on site; just watch the live stream. Friend: Is it clear on the phone? You: Fine, as long as it doesn't lag.

live streaming.context: 疫情时你上的都是网课，老师通过直播把课堂实时传到每个学生家里。
live streaming.translation: 朋友：你们那时候怎么上课 你：全靠live streaming 老师对着镜头讲 朋友：能互动吗 你：评论区举手
live streaming.example: Friend: How did you have class back then? You: All live streaming, the teacher talking to the camera. Friend: Could you interact? You: Raise hands in the comments.

lived experience.context: 老师说讲心理不能光看书，自己亲身经历过困难才更懂别人的感受。
lived experience.translation: 朋友：他怎么这么会开导人 你：他自己有lived experience 走过那段路 朋友：那确实更有说服力 你：是 过来人
lived experience.example: Friend: Why is he so good at comforting people? You: He has lived experience, walked that road himself. Friend: Then he's really persuasive. You: Right; he's been there.

liven up.context: 周末聚会气氛有点闷，你提议玩个游戏把大家情绪调动起来。
liven up.translation: 朋友：大家怎么都不说话 你：我们玩个桌游liven up the party 朋友：谁来组织 你：我来 保证热闹
liven up.example: Friend: Why is everyone quiet? You: Let's play a board game to liven up the party. Friend: Who organizes? You: I will; it'll be fun.

livestock farming.context: 乡下老家那边不少人家靠养猪养鸡为生，朋友问你这种养殖好不好做。
livestock farming.translation: 朋友：你老家那边都靠啥赚钱 你：很多人家搞livestock farming 养猪养鸡 朋友：那辛苦吗 你：起早贪黑 但也稳定
livestock farming.example: Friend: How do people in your hometown make a living? You: Many do livestock farming, raising pigs and chickens. Friend: Is it hard? You: Up before dawn, but steady.

living cost.context: 朋友刚毕业在大城市租房，感叹这里生活成本高得吓人。
living cost.translation: 朋友：这城市房租也太贵了 你：living cost高 工资一大半交了房租 朋友：那怎么存得下钱 你：省吃俭用呗
living cost.example: Friend: Rent in this city is so expensive. You: The living cost is high; most of the salary goes to rent. Friend: Then how do you save? You: Skrimp and save.

living creatures.context: 你带朋友去郊外小溪边玩，说这里水里石头下藏着各种各样的小生物。
living creatures.translation: 朋友：这小溪里有东西吗 你：翻石头看看 藏着好多living creatures 小虾小螺 朋友：真有意思 你：这就是大自然
living creatures.example: Friend: Is there anything in this stream? You: Flip a stone; lots of living creatures hide under it, shrimp and snails. Friend: How interesting. You: That's nature.

living organisms.context: 生物课上老师用显微镜给大家看水里的微生物，朋友凑过来好奇地看。
living organisms.translation: 朋友：这显微镜里黑乎乎的 你：调一下焦 你看那些动来动去的living organisms 朋友：水里原来这么多小生命 你：是 肉眼看不见而已
living organisms.example: Friend: What's all that dark stuff in the microscope? You: Adjust the focus; look at those moving living organisms. Friend: So many tiny lives in water. You: Right; just invisible to the eye.

living space.context: 你换了间大一点的房子，朋友来做客说这下你住得宽敞多了。
living space.translation: 朋友：你新家空间挺大啊 你：就是想要点living space 不用挤 朋友：那住得舒服吧 你：敞亮多了
living space.example: Friend: Your new place is spacious. You: I just wanted some living space, not cramped. Friend: Then it's comfortable? You: Much airier.

living spaces.context: 你陪朋友看新房楼盘，销售介绍说这里的户型客厅宽敞、卧室紧凑。
living spaces.translation: 朋友：这房子户型怎么样 你：living spaces设计得挺合理 客厅大卧室够用 朋友：总价高吗 你：有点 但住着舒服
living spaces.example: Friend: How's the layout? You: The living spaces are well designed, big living room and adequate bedrooms. Friend: Is the total price high? You: A bit, but comfortable.

living with.context: 你和室友合租一年了，朋友问你和人同住一起生活习惯磨合得怎么样。
living with.translation: 朋友：你们俩合租闹过矛盾吗 你：刚开始有点 现在living with彼此都习惯了 朋友：那分工做家务吗 你：轮着来
living with.example: Friend: Have you two had any conflicts sharing? You: A bit at first, now living with each other, we're used to it. Friend: Do you split chores? You: Take turns.

load with.context: 搬家时你把纸箱全装满书，朋友说你这箱子也太沉了搬不动。
load with.translation: 朋友：这箱子怎么这么沉 你：我把它loaded with书了 朋友：那得两个人抬 你：对 一个人搬不动
load with.example: Friend: Why is this box so heavy? You: I loaded it with books. Friend: Then two people have to lift it. You: Right; one can't.

local cuisine.context: 你到一座新城市旅游，朋友说来了就得尝尝当地最地道的美食。
local cuisine.translation: 朋友：来这儿吃什么好 你：先试试local cuisine 本地人都排队的那家 朋友：别去游客店 你：对 我做了攻略
local cuisine.example: Friend: What should we eat here? You: Try the local cuisine first, the place locals queue at. Friend: Avoid tourist traps. You: Right; I've done my research.

local grocer.context: 你家楼下那家小杂货铺开了几十年，老板都认识你了，朋友说这店真亲切。
local grocer.translation: 朋友：这小店东西全吗 你：楼下那个local grocer 酱油醋啥都有 朋友：比大超市方便 你：对 下楼就到
local grocer.example: Friend: Does this little shop have everything? You: The local grocer downstairs has soy sauce, vinegar, all of it. Friend: More convenient than a big supermarket. You: Right; just downstairs.

local independent shop.context: 你不爱去连锁大商场，更喜欢街角那种本地人开的独立小店，有个性。
local independent shop.translation: 朋友：你怎么老去那种小店 你：我喜欢local independent shop 有特色不千篇一律 朋友：东西贵不贵 你：差不多 但有意思
local independent shop.example: Friend: Why do you keep going to those small shops? You: I like the local independent shop, unique, not all the same. Friend: Is it pricey? You: About the same, but more interesting.

local ingredient.context: 这家餐馆主打用本地新鲜食材做菜，朋友说菜一吃就知道是当天采的。
local ingredient.translation: 朋友：这菜怎么这么鲜 你：他家全用local ingredient 当天采的 朋友：那价钱不便宜吧 你：值 新鲜看得见
local ingredient.example: Friend: Why is this dish so fresh? You: They use local ingredients, picked that day. Friend: Is it pricey? You: Worth it; the freshness shows.

local lingo.context: 你刚到南方小镇，当地人说的话你大半听不懂，朋友教你几句本地话。
local lingo.translation: 朋友：当地人说话你听得懂吗 你：一半靠猜 你教我两句local lingo呗 朋友：比如打招呼这么说 你：学会了 现学现卖
local lingo.example: Friend: Can you understand the locals? You: Half guessing; teach me some local lingo. Friend: Like, greet them this way. You: Got it; use it right away.

local resident.context: 你在小区住了三年，和楼下门卫大爷都熟了，朋友说你早成了街坊。
local resident.translation: 朋友：你在这儿住多久了 你：三年 也算个local resident了 邻居都认识我 朋友：那物业好打交道吗 你：熟了就好办事
local resident.example: Friend: How long have you lived here? You: Three years, practically a local resident; neighbors know me. Friend: Is the management easy to deal with? You: Once familiar, things go smoothly.

locally sourced food.context: 这家餐厅的菜都用周边农场当天送的菜，朋友说这种本地采购特别新鲜。
locally sourced food.translation: 朋友：这菜哪买的 你：他们用locally sourced food 周边农场直供 朋友：那真新鲜 你：是 还支持本地农民
locally sourced food.example: Friend: Where does the produce come from? You: They use locally sourced food, direct from nearby farms. Friend: That's really fresh. You: Right; and supports local farmers.

lock up.context: 晚上你下班停车后，习惯性地检查车窗车门锁好没，朋友催你快点上楼。
lock up.translation: 朋友：你锁个车怎么老半天 你：我得确认lock up好了 再上楼 朋友：这都成习惯了 你：对 安全点
lock up.example: Friend: Why do you take so long locking up? You: I have to confirm I locked up before going up. Friend: It's become a habit. You: Right; safer.

logging on.context: 你打开公司系统输密码登录，朋友在旁边等你进入系统。
logging on.translation: 朋友：你这密码输对了吗 你：正在logging on呢 马上进去 朋友：怎么这么慢 你：系统老 得等会儿
logging on.example: Friend: Did you get the password right? You: Just logging on now, almost in. Friend: Why so slow? You: The system's old; wait a bit.

logic puzzle.context: 你周末爱做那种烧脑的脑筋题，朋友说你这爱好真特别。
logic puzzle.translation: 朋友：你一个人对着草稿纸算啥呢 你：做个logic puzzle 挺烧脑的 朋友：好玩吗 你：解出来特有成就感
logic puzzle.example: Friend: What are you working out on scratch paper alone? You: A logic puzzle; really brainy. Friend: Is it fun? You: Solving it feels great.

logical reasoning.context: 面试时你做了几道逻辑题，朋友说这考的就是推理能力。
logical reasoning.translation: 朋友：面试还做题啊 你：几道logical reasoning题 看你怎么推导 朋友：难不难 你：要绕个弯 慢慢想
logical reasoning.example: Friend: They made you do a test in the interview? You: A few logical reasoning questions, seeing how you deduce. Friend: Hard? You: Takes a twist; think it through.

long after.context: 你和老同学多年后再相见，聊起毕业那天的事，仿佛是很久以前了。
long after.translation: 朋友：毕业那年我们好像还在昨天 你：其实long after那之后 都过去五六年了 朋友：时间真快 你：是 一晃就长大
long after.example: Friend: Graduation feels like yesterday. You: Actually, long after that, five or six years have passed. Friend: Time flies. You: Right; grown up in a blink.

long flowing locks.context: 广告里的模特一头乌黑长发随风飘动，朋友说那头发又顺又长真好看。
long flowing locks.translation: 朋友：那模特头发真漂亮 你：一头long flowing locks 风一吹特别飘逸 朋友：她怎么保养的 你：估计接的发
long flowing locks.example: Friend: That model's hair is beautiful. You: Long flowing locks, so graceful in the wind. Friend: How does she maintain it? You: Probably extensions.

long since.context: 你说起那部老剧，朋友说那剧他早就不记得结局了。
long since.translation: 朋友：那老剧你看过吗 你：早long since忘了剧情了 就记得挺好看 朋友：那还重温吗 你：有空再说吧
long since.example: Friend: Have you seen that old show? You: I've long since forgotten the plot, just remember it was good. Friend: Rewatch it then? You: Someday.

long-distance relationship.context: 你和对象在不同城市工作，一年见不了几次，朋友问你们异地恋怎么维持。
long-distance relationship.translation: 朋友：你们俩隔这么远 你：是long-distance relationship 全靠视频 朋友：会不会累 你：熬几年 就能在一起了
long-distance relationship.example: Friend: You two are so far apart. You: It's a long-distance relationship, all on video calls. Friend: Isn't it tiring? You: Hang in a few years and we'll be together.

long-duration flight.context: 你要飞十几个小时去欧洲，朋友提醒你这种长途飞行得在飞机上多活动。
long-duration flight.translation: 朋友：这一飞多久 你：十几个小时 这种long-duration flight 得注意别久坐 朋友：那我带个U型枕 你：对 多喝水多走动
long-duration flight.example: Friend: How long is the flight? You: Over ten hours; on a long-duration flight, don't just sit still. Friend: Then I'll bring a neck pillow. You: Right; drink water and walk around.

long-term interaction.context: 你和新同事共事大半年了，朋友问你们长期合作下来磨合得怎么样。
long-term interaction.translation: 朋友：你俩合作多久了 你：大半年 这种long-term interaction 磨合得差不多了 朋友：配合顺手吗 你：挺默契
long-term interaction.example: Friend: How long have you two worked together? You: Over half a year; after such long-term interaction, we're well synced. Friend: Is it smooth? You: Pretty in tune.

long-term medical condition.context: 你爷爷有高血压要长期吃药，朋友说这就是需要长期管理的慢性病。
long-term medical condition.translation: 朋友：爷爷这病要治多久 你：是种long-term medical condition 得一直吃药控制 朋友：那平时得注意啥 你：清淡饮食别累着
long-term medical condition.example: Friend: How long does Grandpa's condition need treatment? You: It's a long-term medical condition, on meds forever. Friend: Then what to watch? You: Light diet, don't overexert.

long-term memory.context: 你小时候住过的老街现在还能清楚记得，朋友说这都存进长期记忆里了。
long-term memory.translation: 朋友：你怎么还记得那么小的事 你：小时候住的街早就存在long-term memory里了 朋友：那真深刻 你：是啊 一辈子忘不掉
long-term memory.example: Friend: How do you still remember things from that young? You: The street I grew up on is stored in my long-term memory. Friend: That's really deep. You: Right; unforgettable for life.

long-term saving.context: 你每月工资一到账就强制存一笔，朋友问你这是在做什么理财。
long-term saving.translation: 朋友：你每月都存一笔钱啊 你：做点long-term saving 以防万一 朋友：存什么产品好 你：定期加指数基金
long-term saving.example: Friend: You set aside a sum every month? You: Doing some long-term saving for a rainy day. Friend: What products? You: Fixed deposits and index funds.

look.context: 你抬头看天发现乌云密布，朋友问你是不是快下雨了。
look.translation: 朋友：天上那云怎么黑压压的 你：你look 好像要下大雨 朋友：那带伞没 你：糟了 没带 快跑
look.example: Friend: Why are those clouds so dark? You: Look; it seems about to pour. Friend: Did you bring an umbrella? You: Oh no, I didn't; run.

look away.context: 拍照时你怕镜头，朋友说你别把脸扭开，看着镜头笑一下。
look away.translation: 朋友：你老躲镜头干嘛 你：我不自在 总忍不住look away 朋友：你看我 笑一个 你：那好吧
look away.example: Friend: Why do you keep dodging the camera? You: I feel awkward and can't help looking away. Friend: Look at me and smile. You: Alright then.

look back in time.context: 你站在博物馆里看老照片，仿佛一下穿越回去，重温几十年前的城市。
look back in time.translation: 朋友：这些老照片拍的哪儿 你：看着它们就像look back in time 回到几十年前 朋友：变化真大 你：是 城市全变样了
look back in time.example: Friend: Where were these old photos taken? You: Looking at them is like looking back in time, decades ago. Friend: How it's changed. You: Right; the city's totally different.

look back over.context: 年底你和朋友坐在一起，回顾这一年做过的大大小小的事情。
look back over.translation: 朋友：年底了 总结一下吧 你：我们look back over这一年 去了不少地方 朋友：这年过得值 你：对 收获满满
look back over.example: Friend: It's year-end; let's sum up. You: Let's look back over this year, we went to quite a few places. Friend: A worthwhile year. You: Right; full of gains.

look back through.context: 你翻着旧相册，一张张翻看和老朋友的合影，回忆起大学时光。
look back through.translation: 朋友：你翻什么呢这么入神 你：look back through大学相册 满满的回忆 朋友：那时候真年轻 你：是啊 一晃毕业多年
look back through.example: Friend: What are you so absorbed flipping through? You: Looking back through my college album, full of memories. Friend: So young back then. You: Right; graduated years ago in a blink.

look down at.context: 你坐缆车下山低头看脚下的小镇，朋友说从这儿看下去特别小。
look down at.translation: 朋友：这下面看着真小 你：从缆车look down at那小镇 跟玩具似的 朋友：风景真好 你：拍张照留念
look down at.example: Friend: Everything down there looks so small. You: Looking down at the town from the cable car, it's like toys. Friend: What a view. You: Take a photo.

look out on.context: 你租的房子窗外就是一片湖，朋友说从这屋里就能直接看到湖面，真舒服。
look out on.translation: 朋友：你这窗外是啥呀 你：窗户look out on一个小湖 天天看湖景 朋友：那也太幸福了 你：早上醒来就看水
look out on.example: Friend: What's outside your window? You: The window looks out on a little lake, lake view every day. Friend: That's bliss. You: Wake up to the water.

look over.context: 你交报告前又从头到尾检查了一遍，朋友问你还在看什么。
look over.translation: 朋友：报告不都交了吗 你：我再look over一遍 怕有错别字 朋友：你也太仔细了 你：交出去丢人就晚了
look over.example: Friend: Didn't you already submit the report? You: I'll look over it once more, afraid of typos. Friend: You're so careful. You: Embarrassment after submission is too late.

look to.context: 你创业遇到难题，朋友问你接下来打算指望谁帮忙，你说先靠自己。
look to.translation: 朋友：这难关你打算怎么办 你：先look to我自己想办法 不行再请教前辈 朋友：那有需要喊我 你：好 谢了
look to.example: Friend: How will you handle this rough patch? You: First I'll look to myself, then ask seniors if stuck. Friend: Shout if you need me. You: Okay, thanks.

look to the future.context: 毕业聚会上大家聊起以后的规划，你说不纠结过去，要多往前看。
look to the future.translation: 朋友：毕业以后你想干嘛 你：我就look to the future 往前看 朋友：不怀念大学时光吗 你：怀念但日子还得过
look to the future.example: Friend: What do you want to do after graduation? You: I just look to the future and move ahead. Friend: Won't you miss college? You: I will, but life goes on.

look to the past.context: 公司想改革却总有人翻老经验，你说不能一味往后看，得往前看。
look to the past.translation: 朋友：新方案老被说以前怎么怎么做 你：别老look to the past 时代变了 朋友：那老经验不管用了 你：是 得学新的
look to the past.example: Friend: The new plan keeps being met with 'we used to do it this way.' You: Stop always looking to the past; times have changed. Friend: Then old experience is useless? You: Right; learn new ways.

look up at.context: 你们走在山里抬头一看，头顶全是高大的古树，朋友惊叹树真高。
look up at.translation: 朋友：这树也太高了吧 你：你look up at那树冠 都快顶到天了 朋友：得几百年了 你：是 遮天蔽日
look up at.example: Friend: These trees are so tall. You: Look up at that canopy, almost touching the sky. Friend: Must be centuries old. You: Right; shades out the sun.

looks the same as.context: 你买的这款杯子和店里展示的样品一模一样，朋友说看着分不出差别。
looks the same as.translation: 朋友：你这杯子和样品一样吗 你：looks the same as那个样品 没差别 朋友：那质量好吗 你：摸着一样
looks the same as.example: Friend: Is your cup the same as the sample? You: It looks the same as that sample, no difference. Friend: Then is the quality good? You: Feels the same.

loom band.context: 你妹妹小时候特别喜欢编那种彩色橡皮筋手环，朋友问她戴的啥。
loom band.translation: 朋友：你手腕上这彩色圈啥玩意儿 你：小时候爱玩loom band 自己编的 朋友：现在还有人玩吗 你：怀旧嘛 留着纪念
loom band.example: Friend: What's that colorful band on your wrist? You: When little I loved loom bands, woven myself. Friend: Does anyone still play with them? You: For nostalgia; keepsake.

loose-leaf tea.context: 你不喝袋泡茶，更喜欢自己用茶叶泡，朋友说这散装茶更香。
loose-leaf tea.translation: 朋友：你怎么不用茶包 你：我更喜欢loose-leaf tea 现泡的香 朋友：那得过滤 你：买个小滤球就行
loose-leaf tea.example: Friend: Why not use tea bags? You: I prefer loose-leaf tea, freshly brewed tastes better. Friend: Then you need a filter. You: A little infuser ball does it.

looser clothing.context: 健身后你换上宽松的衣服回家，朋友说你这一身看着舒服多了。
looser clothing.translation: 朋友：你练完还穿这么紧 你：换了件looser clothing 松快多了 朋友：对 练完别勒着 你：是 透气舒服
looser clothing.example: Friend: You're still so tight-fitting after the gym. You: Changed into looser clothing; much more comfortable. Friend: Right, don't constrict after. You: Yeah; breathable.

lose sleep over.context: 你项目出了点小差错就睡不着觉，朋友劝你别为这种小事操心到失眠。
lose sleep over.translation: 朋友：你昨晚又没睡好 你：就为那点事一直lose sleep over 朋友：至于吗 多大点事 你：我就是爱瞎想
lose sleep over.example: Friend: Didn't you sleep well again last night? You: I keep losing sleep over that little thing. Friend: Is it worth it? It's nothing. You: I just overthink.

lose touch.context: 你和高中同学毕业后各忙各的，渐渐就断了联系，朋友问你还有来往吗。
lose touch.translation: 朋友：你那最好的高中朋友还联系吗 你：慢慢就lose touch了 各自太忙 朋友：那挺可惜 你：是 有空约约
lose touch.example: Friend: Are you still in touch with your best high school friend? You: We gradually lost touch, both too busy. Friend: That's a shame. You: Right; let's meet up when free.

lose yourself in.context: 你看书太投入，朋友喊你好几遍都没听见，完全沉浸在故事里了。
lose yourself in.translation: 朋友：你到底听没听我说话 你：不好意思 我刚才lose myself in那本小说了 朋友：看得这么入迷 你：是 太上头了
lose yourself in.example: Friend: Are you even listening? You: Sorry, I lost myself in that novel just now. Friend: That absorbed? You: Right; addictive.

loss of consciousness.context: 他突然倒下没了意识，大家吓坏了，赶紧拨打急救电话。
loss of consciousness.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然晕过去了 你：好像是loss of consciousness 快打120 朋友：救护车多久到 你：马上来 先让他平躺
loss of consciousness.example: Friend: Why did he suddenly collapse? You: Looks like loss of consciousness; call 120 now. Friend: How soon's the ambulance? You: Right away; lay him flat first.

loss of control.context: 你喝多了情绪失控，朋友说你那天完全是一时冲动失控了。
loss of control.translation: 朋友：你那天怎么哭着大喊 你：喝多了有点loss of control 现在想起来都尴尬 朋友：没事 大家都理解 你：下次不喝那么多了
loss of control.example: Friend: Why were you crying and shouting that day? You: Drank too much, a bit of loss of control; embarrassing now. Friend: It's okay, everyone understands. You: Won't drink that much next time.

loud bass.context: 隔壁车震音乐声特别大，低音震得你车窗都在抖，朋友抱怨太吵。
loud bass.translation: 朋友：那车低音也太响了 你：loud bass震得玻璃都动 朋友：这也太扰民 你：找警察吧
loud bass.example: Friend: That car's bass is so loud. You: The loud bass vibrates the windows. Friend: That's disturbing. You: Let's call the cops.

lounge around.context: 放假你哪儿也不去，就在家穿着睡衣东倒西歪地消磨一天。
lounge around.translation: 朋友：你假期有啥安排 你：就lounge around 穿睡衣瘫一天 朋友：不无聊吗 你：这才叫放松
lounge around.example: Friend: Any holiday plans? You: Just lounge around in my pajamas all day. Friend: Isn't it boring? You: That's relaxation.

lounging on.context: 周末阳光好，你和朋友懒洋洋地躺在阳台上晒太阳，什么也不干。
lounging on.translation: 朋友：你俩躺那儿干嘛呢 你：就在balcony上lounging on晒晒太阳 朋友：日子真惬意 你：什么也不想
lounging on.example: Friend: What are you two lying there doing? You: Just lounging on the balcony in the sun. Friend: Such a lazy life. You: Thinking about nothing.

low earth orbit.context: 航天课上老师讲卫星大多在离地面不高的轨道上运行，朋友问那是什么轨道。
low earth orbit.translation: 朋友：卫星离地面多远 你：大部分在low earth orbit 就几百公里高 朋友：那手机信号卫星在那儿吗 你：对 近地轨道
low earth orbit.example: Friend: How high are the satellites? You: Most are in low earth orbit, just a few hundred km up. Friend: Are the phone signal ones there? You: Right; low orbit.

low mood.context: 朋友最近总提不起劲，医生说他情绪有点低落，多出去走走会好。
low mood.translation: 朋友：我这阵子就是不开心 你：是有点low mood 多晒晒太阳 朋友：要看医生吗 你：先自己调 不行再说
low mood.example: Friend: I've just been unhappy lately. You: It's a bit of low mood; get more sun. Friend: Should I see a doctor? You: Try self-adjusting first; if not, then.

low self-esteem.context: 朋友总觉得自己这也不好那也不行，你说他其实是太自卑了，得自信点。
low self-esteem.translation: 朋友：我觉得自己什么都做不好 你：你就是太low self-esteem了 你其实挺优秀的 朋友：真的吗 你：对 相信自己
low self-esteem.example: Friend: I feel I can't do anything right. You: You just have too low self-esteem; you're actually quite good. Friend: Really? You: Right; believe in yourself.

low-cost airline.context: 你订机票特意选了便宜的航司，朋友说这就是那种价格低的廉航。
low-cost airline.translation: 朋友：你这机票怎么这么便宜 你：坐的是low-cost airline 没餐食没选座 朋友：便宜就行 你：对 能到就行
low-cost airline.example: Friend: Why is your flight so cheap? You: It's a low-cost airline, no meals or seat choice. Friend: Cheap is fine. You: Right; as long as we get there.

lower blood pressure.context: 医生让你多吃芹菜、少盐，说这些习惯能帮你把血压降下来。
lower blood pressure.translation: 朋友：我这老血压高怎么办 你：医生让我lower blood pressure 多吃芹菜少盐 朋友：那药还要吃吗 你：遵医嘱
lower blood pressure.example: Friend: My blood pressure's always high; what to do? You: The doctor says lower blood pressure, eat celery and less salt. Friend: Still on meds? You: Follow the doctor.

lower case.context: 你打字时不小心全用了大写，朋友说这些字母得改成小写才规范。
lower case.translation: 朋友：你这邮件怎么全是大写 你：忘了切回来 得用lower case 才对 朋友：改过来吧 你：对 重新打
lower case.example: Friend: Why is your email all caps? You: Forgot to switch back; should be lower case. Friend: Fix it. You: Right; retype.

lower stress.context: 医生让你每周散步三次，说规律运动能有效缓解压力。
lower stress.translation: 朋友：我这压力好大怎么减压 你：多运动 lower stress特别有效 朋友：做什么运动好 你：快走就行 别太累
lower stress.example: Friend: I'm so stressed; how to de-stress? You: Exercise more; it lowers stress really effectively. Friend: What exercise? You: Brisk walking, not too hard.

loyal customers.context: 你家楼下那家餐馆开了十几年，老顾客都成了回头客，朋友问你怎么做到的。
loyal customers.translation: 朋友：那家店生意怎么那么稳 你：靠一堆loyal customers 吃了十几年 朋友：那口味肯定好 你：对 老店有保障
loyal customers.example: Friend: Why is that restaurant's business so steady? You: It relies on loyal customers who've eaten there for ten-plus years. Friend: Then the taste must be good. You: Right; a trusted old place.

lucid dream.context: 朋友说他昨晚做梦还知道自己在做梦，你说这就是所谓的清醒梦。
lucid dream.translation: 朋友：我昨晚做梦还知道是在做梦 你：那叫lucid dream 挺难得的 朋友：能控制梦的内容吗 你：练久了可以
lucid dream.example: Friend: I dreamed last night and knew I was dreaming. You: That's a lucid dream, quite rare. Friend: Can you control the dream? You: With practice you can.

lunar cycle.context: 你聊起月亮的圆缺变化，说它大概每二十九天就循环一轮。
lunar cycle.translation: 朋友：月亮为啥会变圆变缺 你：跟着lunar cycle走 大概二十九天一轮 朋友：那满月是固定哪天 你：每月十五前后
lunar cycle.example: Friend: Why does the moon wax and wane? You: It follows the lunar cycle, about twenty-nine days per round. Friend: Is the full moon on a fixed day? You: Around the fifteenth each month.

lung cancer.context: 爷爷抽了一辈子烟，最近查出肺部有问题，朋友劝他赶紧戒烟。
lung cancer.translation: 朋友：爷爷这病严重吗 你：抽烟久了 得了lung cancer 朋友：那赶紧戒啊 你：是 现在戒还来得及
lung cancer.example: Friend: Is Grandpa's condition serious? You: A lifetime of smoking led to lung cancer. Friend: Then quit now. You: Right; still not too late.

lung capacity.context: 体测要吹肺活量，朋友深吸一口气使劲吹，数值比你高一大截。
lung capacity.translation: 朋友：你肺活量多少 你：四千多 他吹到六千 朋友：他lung capacity真好 你：人家天天游泳
lung capacity.example: Friend: What's your lung capacity? You: Over four thousand; he blew six thousand. Friend: His lung capacity is great. You: He swims daily.

lust for life.context: 你爷爷八十了还天天旅行拍照，朋友说他这把年纪还这么有活力真难得。
lust for life.translation: 朋友：爷爷八十大寿还精神这么好 你：他就是有股lust for life 到处玩 朋友：这状态真让人羡慕 你：是 热爱生活
lust for life.example: Friend: Grandpa's eighty and still so energetic. You: He has such a lust for life, always traveling. Friend: That state's enviable. You: Right; loves life.

luxury beauty.context: 你说现在的美妆牌子分高低端，专柜那种就是走高端路线的。
luxury beauty.translation: 朋友：这瓶面霜怎么这么贵 你：它走luxury beauty路线 专柜卖的 朋友：和平价差在哪 你：包装成分都讲究
luxury beauty.example: Friend: Why is this cream so expensive? You: It's luxury beauty, sold at department stores. Friend: Difference from drugstore? You: Packaging and ingredients.

luxury carriage.context: 你买了张软卧车票，朋友说你这是坐豪华车厢，睡得比硬卧舒服。
luxury carriage.translation: 朋友：你这卧铺怎么比我贵 你：我买的luxury carriage 包厢能关门 朋友：那真舒服 你：对 睡一觉就到
luxury carriage.example: Friend: Why is your sleeper pricier than mine? You: I got the luxury carriage, a private compartment with a door. Friend: That's comfy. You: Right; sleep and arrive.

luxury goods.context: 你逛街路过名牌店，朋友说那些包表都是卖给有钱人的奢侈品。
luxury goods.translation: 朋友：这店里东西咋这么贵 你：都是luxury goods 卖牌子 朋友：谁买呀 你：有钱人为个面子
luxury goods.example: Friend: Why is everything in this shop so expensive? You: It's all luxury goods, selling the brand. Friend: Who buys it? You: Rich people for status.

lying down.context: 你崴了脚，医生让你躺着别动，把脚抬高休息几天。
lying down.translation: 朋友：你这脚咋办 你：医生让我lying down别动 把脚垫高 朋友：那上班怎么办 你：请几天假养养
lying down.example: Friend: What's up with your ankle? You: The doctor says lie down, keep still, elevate it. Friend: Then work? You: Take a few days off to rest.

lyrical content.context: 你听歌不只听旋律，还特别注意歌词写得有没有意思，朋友说你听得细。
lyrical content.translation: 朋友：你听歌听啥呢 你：我更在意lyrical content 歌词讲的故事 朋友：旋律不重要吗 你：也重要 但歌词走心
lyrical content.example: Friend: What do you listen to in a song? You: I care more about the lyrical content, the story in the words. Friend: Doesn't the melody matter? You: It does, but lyrics that move me.

mac and cheese.context: 你在美式餐厅点了芝士通心粉，朋友说这是老外从小吃到大的comfort food。
mac and cheese.translation: 朋友：你点这是什么呀 你：mac and cheese 外国人都爱这口 朋友：好吃吗 你：芝士拉丝 特香
mac and cheese.example: Friend: What did you order? You: Mac and cheese; foreigners grow up on this. Friend: Does it taste good? You: Cheesy pull, so good.

machine learning.context: 朋友转行做算法，跟你聊起现在最火的机器学习到底是干什么的。
machine learning.translation: 朋友：你最近在学什么新技术 你：我在学machine learning 让电脑自己找规律 朋友：那难不难 你：要数学好 慢慢啃
machine learning.example: Friend: What new tech are you learning? You: Machine learning, teaching computers to find patterns. Friend: Is it hard? You: Needs good math; chew through it.

mad friday.context: 圣诞前最后一个工作日晚上，办公室同事们下班就约着出去狂欢。
mad friday.translation: 朋友：今晚大家怎么这么兴奋 你：今天是mad friday 圣诞前最后工作日 朋友：那下班去哪聚 你：酒吧见 狂欢去
