mad friday.example: Friend: Why is everyone so excited tonight? You: Today's Mad Friday, the last workday before Christmas. Friend: Then where after work? You: The bar; let's party.

made into.context: 你把旧牛仔布料改造成了一个帆布包，朋友说这是废物利用。
made into.translation: 朋友：你这包哪买的 你：旧牛仔裤made into的 我自己改的 朋友：手真巧 你：废物利用 不浪费
made into.example: Friend: Where did you buy this bag? You: Old jeans made into it; I upcycled it. Friend: So crafty. You: Waste not, reuse.

maiden name.context: 填表时你不知道已婚女性怎么写姓氏，朋友解释说婚前娘家姓才叫maiden name。
maiden name.translation: 朋友：她现在姓张 怎么资料里姓李 你：那是她maiden name 结婚前的姓 朋友：原来如此 你：对 婚后改了夫姓
maiden name.example: Friend: She's surnamed Zhang now; why is her record under Li? You: That's her maiden name, her surname before marriage. Friend: I see. You: Right; she took her husband's name.

main source of income.context: 朋友毕业后做兼职，你问他现在主要靠什么赚钱，收入来源是什么。
main source of income.translation: 朋友：你现在主要靠啥赚钱 你：做自媒体是我main source of income 朋友：那稳定吗 你：好的时候挺赚
main source of income.example: Friend: What do you mainly earn from now? You: Being a content creator is my main source of income. Friend: Is it stable? You: Pretty good when it goes well.

mainstream culture.context: 你看这部电影获奖又卖座，朋友说它已经从小众走进了大众主流文化。
mainstream culture.translation: 朋友：这电影为啥这么火 你：它从小众变成了mainstream culture 人人都看 朋友：那它艺术价值呢 你：也不差 难得
mainstream culture.example: Friend: Why is this movie so popular? You: It went from niche to mainstream culture, everyone watches it. Friend: Is the artistic value there? You: Also good; rare.

mainstream hit.context: 那个小众播客突然上了热搜，朋友说它这下成了破圈的热门节目。
mainstream hit.translation: 朋友：那播客以前没听说过啊 你：最近成了mainstream hit 一下破圈了 朋友：那还小众吗 你：火了就大众了
mainstream hit.example: Friend: Never heard of that podcast. You: It recently became a mainstream hit and broke out. Friend: Is it still niche? You: Once hot, it's mainstream.

mainstream music.context: 你听歌偏爱小众乐队，朋友说你怎么不爱听电台里那些主流音乐。
mainstream music.translation: 朋友：你怎么不听流行歌 你：我不太喜欢mainstream music 太套路 朋友：那你听啥 你：独立乐队更对味
mainstream music.example: Friend: Why don't you listen to pop? You: I don't care much for mainstream music; too formulaic. Friend: Then what do you listen to? You: Indie bands suit me.

maintain a positive outlook on life.context: 你经历低谷后重新振作，朋友说你一直对生活抱着积极的态度真难得。
maintain a positive outlook on life.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天乐呵呵 你：我尽量maintain a positive outlook on生活 朋友：遇到糟心事也这样吗 你：难过一会儿就翻篇
maintain a positive outlook on life.example: Friend: Why are you cheerful every day? You: I try to maintain a positive outlook on life. Friend: Even when things go wrong? You: Mope a while then move on.

maintain eye contact.context: 面试时你看着考官的眼睛回答，朋友说面试时眼神交流很重要。
maintain eye contact.translation: 朋友：面试紧张不敢看人 你：尽量maintain eye contact 显得自信 朋友：看哪好呢 你：看对方眉心 自然点
maintain eye contact.example: Friend: Too nervous to look people in the eye in the interview. You: Try to maintain eye contact; it shows confidence. Friend: Where to look? You: Between the brows, naturally.

maintain the status quo.context: 公司已经习惯了老一套，改革提议总被否决，大家说还是维持现状吧。
maintain the status quo.translation: 朋友：为啥新方案又被否了 你：领导想maintain the status quo 不想变 朋友：那啥时候能改 你：难 等上面推动
maintain the status quo.example: Friend: Why was the new plan rejected again? You: The bosses want to maintain the status quo, no change. Friend: Then when will it change? You: Hard; wait for a push from above.

major key.context: 你说这首曲子听着明亮欢快，朋友说这是因为它用了大调。
major key.translation: 朋友：这首曲子怎么这么开心 你：它是major key 大调一般都明快 朋友：那小调呢 你：小调就忧伤
major key.example: Friend: Why does this piece feel so cheerful? You: It's in a major key; major keys usually sound bright. Friend: And minor? You: Minor keys sound sad.

major tournament.context: 你喜欢的球队打进了决赛，朋友问你这次是不是要去看那场大赛事。
major tournament.translation: 朋友：咱们队进决赛了！ 你：这种major tournament 决赛必须去现场 朋友：票抢到了吗 你：蹲到一张 太激动了
major tournament.example: Friend: Our team made the final! You: At a major tournament, the final you have to watch live. Friend: Did you get a ticket? You: Scored one; so hyped.

make a big difference to.context: 你说养成早睡习惯后，整个人精神了好多，朋友问这对你影响大不大。
make a big difference to.translation: 朋友：早睡真有用吗 你：对我make a big difference 白天不困了 朋友：那你坚持多久了 你：一个月 状态好了
make a big difference to.example: Friend: Does sleeping early really help? You: It makes a big difference to me; I'm not sleepy by day. Friend: How long have you stuck with it? You: A month; feeling better.

make a career out of.context: 你本来只是业余拍照，后来越拍越好，干脆把这个做成了职业。
make a career out of.translation: 朋友：你现在靠拍照吃饭啊 你：我把摄影make a career out of了 朋友：那也太酷了 你：爱好变事业
make a career out of.example: Friend: You make a living from photography now? You: I made a career out of it. Friend: That's so cool. You: Hobby turned into work.

make a comeback.context: 那位过气明星又发新歌上热搜了，朋友说他这下重新火起来了。
make a comeback.translation: 朋友：他都消失好几年了 你：新歌一下make a comeback 又上热搜了 朋友：真不容易 你：是 粉丝回来了
make a comeback.example: Friend: He disappeared for years. You: His song just made a comeback and trended again. Friend: Really something. You: Right; the fans are back.

make a deposit.context: 你发了工资就去银行存一部分，朋友问你这是在办什么业务。
make a deposit.translation: 朋友：你去银行干嘛 你：存一笔钱 make a deposit 朋友：存活期还是定期 你：定期利息高点
make a deposit.example: Friend: What are you doing at the bank? You: Making a deposit. Friend: Current or fixed? You: Fixed, higher interest.

make a huge difference to.context: 你说换了个靠窗的工位后，上班心情都变好了，朋友问这影响有多大。
make a huge difference to.translation: 朋友：换工位后感觉咋样 你：对我心情make a huge difference 看着窗外舒服多了 朋友：那效率高了吧 你：是 不憋屈了
make a huge difference to.example: Friend: How's the new desk? You: It makes a huge difference to my mood; looking out the window is so much nicer. Friend: More productive? You: Right; less cramped.

make a name.context: 他从小地方出来打拼，如今在行业里有了名气，朋友说他总算出名了。
make a name.translation: 朋友：他现在可算出人头地了 你：从无人知晓到make a name 不容易 朋友：那他下一步呢 你：继续做大
make a name.example: Friend: He's really made it now. You: From nobody to making a name, not easy. Friend: Then what's next? You: Keep growing.

make a name for oneself.context: 你说他靠自己的作品在行业里闯出了名气，朋友问他是不是已经成名了。
make a name for oneself.translation: 朋友：他现在在圈内有名吗 你：靠自己的作品made a name for himself 朋友：没靠家里吧 你：没有 全是自己拼的
make a name for oneself.example: Friend: Is he known in the field now? You: He made a name for himself through his work. Friend: No family connections? You: None; all on his own.

make a note of.context: 朋友电话里报了个地址，你赶紧掏手机把它记下来，免得转头就忘。
make a note of.translation: 朋友：那地方在哪条路几号 你：等下 我make a note of一下 朋友：记好了吗 你：好了 我发给你
make a note of.example: Friend: Which road and number is the place? You: Wait, let me make a note of it. Friend: Got it? You: Got it; I'll send it to you.

make a profit.context: 你开的小店第一个月就开始赚钱了，朋友问你这生意到底赚不赚钱。
make a profit.translation: 朋友：你这小店能挣钱吗 你：第一个月就开始make a profit了 朋友：那挺顺利 你：刚够本 慢慢来
make a profit.example: Friend: Does your little shop make money? You: It started to make a profit in month one. Friend: Then it's smooth sailing. You: Just breaking even; slowly.

make all the difference.context: 你说面试时那句真诚的回答，一下就打动了考官，改变了整场面试。
make all the difference.translation: 朋友：你怎么被选中的 你：最后那句回答made all the difference 朋友：说啥了 你：真诚地讲了个故事
make all the difference.example: Friend: How did you get picked? You: That last answer made all the difference. Friend: What did you say? You: Told a story sincerely.

make all the difference to.context: 你说一个好搭档对团队影响特别大，朋友问你觉得什么样的队友最关键。
make all the difference to.translation: 朋友：你觉得团队里啥最重要 你：一个好队友makes all the difference to结果 朋友：咋个好法 你：靠谱不甩锅
make all the difference to.example: Friend: What do you think matters most in a team? You: A good teammate makes all the difference to the result. Friend: How so? You: Reliable, no dodging blame.

make allowances for.context: 你出门时特意多留了半小时缓冲，朋友说你这样就不怕堵车晚点了。
make allowances for.translation: 朋友：我们几点出发稳妥 你：早点走 make allowances for堵车 朋友：提前一小时够吗 你：够 留点富余
make allowances for.example: Friend: What time should we leave to be safe? You: Go early, make allowances for traffic. Friend: An hour ahead enough? You: Enough; leave slack.

make amends.context: 你上次说错话伤了朋友，一直想找机会当面道歉弥补。
make amends.translation: 朋友：你俩和好了吗 你：我想找机会make amends 给他道个歉 朋友：他还在生气吗 你：等他消消气
make amends.example: Friend: Have you two made up? You: I want a chance to make amends and apologize. Friend: Is he still mad? You: Wait till he cools off.

make amends for.context: 你弄坏了朋友的耳机，主动买个新的赔给他，说要弥补自己的过失。
make amends for.translation: 朋友：你那耳机修不好了 你：是我弄坏的 我得make amends for it 给你买个新的 朋友：不用那么客气 你：应该的
make amends for.example: Friend: Your earphones can't be fixed. You: I broke them; I have to make amends for it and buy you a new pair. Friend: No need to be so polite. You: It's on me.

make contact with.context: 你换了新号码，第一时间告诉老朋友，说以后常联系。
make contact with.translation: 朋友：你新号码多少 你：这就make contact with你 存一下 朋友：以后常约 你：好 周末吃饭
make contact with.example: Friend: What's your new number? You: Making contact with you right now; save it. Friend: Hang out often. You: Okay, dinner this weekend.

make conversation.context: 电梯里只有你和邻居，为了不尴尬，你主动搭话聊了几句天气。
make conversation.translation: 朋友：你跟邻居聊上啦 你：电梯里不说话太尴尬 就make conversation聊了两句 朋友：说啥了 你：今天天真好
make conversation.example: Friend: You started chatting with the neighbor? You: Silence in the lift is awkward, so we made conversation about the weather. Friend: What did you say? You: Nice weather today.

make do and mend.context: 你衣服破了舍不得扔，缝缝补补接着穿，朋友说你这是能省则省。
make do and mend.translation: 朋友：你这衣服都破了还穿 你：补补还能穿 make do and mend 朋友：太节省了吧 你：扔了可惜
make do and mend.example: Friend: You're still wearing that torn shirt? You: Mended it, make do and mend. Friend: Too frugal? You: Wasteful to throw it out.

make ends meet.context: 朋友刚毕业工资不高，除去房租吃饭刚好够花，朋友说勉强糊口。
make ends meet.translation: 朋友：你工资够花吗 你：刚毕业 能make ends meet就不错了 朋友：那存得下钱吗 你：先顾着生活
make ends meet.example: Friend: Does your salary cover it? You: Fresh out of school; just making ends meet is fine. Friend: Then can you save? You: Cover life first.

make every second count.context: 你说这周末就要毕业旅行了，让大家抓紧时间，每分每秒都别浪费。
make every second count.translation: 朋友：时间过得真快 你：毕业旅行make every second count 抓紧玩 朋友：那我们去哪 你：攻略都做好了
make every second count.example: Friend: Time flies. You: Make every second count on the graduation trip; enjoy it tight. Friend: Then where? You: The plan's all set.

make financial sense.context: 你买二手电动车而不是新车，朋友说这样算下来其实更划算。
make financial sense.translation: 朋友：你为啥买二手的 你：二手的make financial sense 省一大笔 朋友：会不会老坏 你：挑个靠谱的就行
make financial sense.example: Friend: Why buy secondhand? You: Secondhand makes financial sense, saves a lot. Friend: Won't it keep breaking? You: Pick a reliable one.

make for.context: 你说这地方安静又临海，特别适合写书，朋友说那可真是个写书的好地方。
make for.translation: 朋友：这海边小村适合干嘛 你：安静 特别make for一个写书的好地方 朋友：那你准备在这待多久 你：一个月
make for.example: Friend: What's this coastal village good for? You: Quiet; it really makes for a good place to write. Friend: Then how long will you stay? You: A month.

make it big.context: 那个草根歌手参加选秀一路走红，朋友说他这下真的成了大明星。
make it big.translation: 朋友：他现在可红了 你：从草根一路make it big 真不容易 朋友：那他以后还唱吗 你：当然 专辑都出了
make it big.example: Friend: He's so famous now. You: From nobody to making it big, really something. Friend: Will he keep singing? You: Of course; albums out already.

make more of.context: 你说现在的业余时间没利用好，朋友劝你多把精力放在更有价值的事上。
make more of.translation: 朋友：你下班都干嘛 你：瞎晃 没make more of时间 朋友：不如学点啥 你：是 报个班
make more of.example: Friend: What do you do after work? You: Wander around; not making more of my time. Friend: Why not learn something? You: Right; sign up for a class.

make more use of.context: 你公司有个闲置会议室老空着，朋友建议多利用它搞小型分享会。
make more use of.translation: 朋友：那会议室老空着多浪费 你：可以make more use of它 办分享会 朋友：那挺好 你：对 资源别闲着
make more use of.example: Friend: That meeting room sits idle, what a waste. You: We can make more use of it for talks. Friend: That'd be great. You: Right; don't leave resources idle.

make no sense.context: 你看一个规定怎么都想不通，朋友说这条逻辑就是说不通嘛。
make no sense.translation: 朋友：这规定为啥要这么定 你：我也觉得make no sense 朋友：那找谁问 你：问问行政
make no sense.example: Friend: Why is this rule made this way? You: I think it makes no sense either. Friend: Then who to ask? You: Ask admin.

make of.context: 你看朋友那辆车挺好看，问他这是什么牌子的车。
make of.translation: 朋友：你这车挺好看啊 你：你问what make of车 朋友：对 啥牌子 你：国产的 性价比高
make of.example: Friend: Your car looks nice. You: You're asking what make of car it is? Friend: Right, which brand? You: A domestic one, good value.

make one's eyes go funny.context: 朋友穿了身大红配大绿，你看一眼眼睛都被刺激到了，笑说这也太晃眼了。
make one's eyes go funny.translation: 朋友：我这身搭配咋样 你：我的眼睛都make my eyes go funny了 朋友：有那么夸张吗 你：红配绿 真的辣眼睛
make one's eyes go funny.example: Friend: How's this outfit of mine? You: It made my eyes go funny. Friend: Is it that bad? You: Red and green; really an eyesore.

make one's fortune.context: 他年轻时去南方闯荡，朋友说他就是靠那几年打拼发了家。
make one's fortune.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然有钱了 你：当年去深圳made his fortune 朋友：那也太励志 你：是 敢闯才有
make one's fortune.example: Friend: How did he suddenly get rich? You: He made his fortune back in Shenzhen. Friend: So inspiring. You: Right; dare to venture.

make or break.context: 明天的面试特别关键，朋友说这一场成败可能决定你能不能进这家公司。
make or break.translation: 朋友：明天面试重要不 你：特别make or break 过了就稳了 朋友：那今晚好好准备 你：对 不能搞砸
make or break.example: Friend: Is tomorrow's interview important? You: It's really make or break; pass it and you're in. Friend: Prepare well tonight then. You: Right; can't mess up.

make out.context: 电话那头信号差，你听不清对方说什么，让他再说一遍。
make out.translation: 朋友：你刚说啥我没听清 你：信号不好 I can't make out你说的话 朋友：我再说一遍 你：好 大点声
make out.example: Friend: I didn't catch what you said. You: Bad signal; I can't make out your words. Friend: Let me repeat. You: Okay, louder.

make sense of.context: 你对着一堆杂乱数据看了半天，朋友问你理清头绪没有。
make sense of.translation: 朋友：这报表你看明白没 你：我在make sense of这些数字 有点乱 朋友：要帮忙吗 你：对 一起捋
make sense of.example: Friend: Do you understand the report yet? You: Making sense of these numbers; it's messy. Friend: Want help? You: Right; sort it together.

make the most out of.context: 你说这假期短，得抓紧玩，别浪费了，朋友说咱们好好利用这几天。
make the most out of.translation: 朋友：就三天假 够玩吗 你：make the most out of它 排满点 朋友：那别太累 你：对 玩尽兴
make the most out of.example: Friend: Is three days enough? You: Make the most out of it, pack it tight. Friend: Then don't exhaust yourself. You: Right; enjoy it fully.

make themselves at home.context: 朋友第一次来你家，你让他别客气，想喝什么自己拿，像在自己家一样。
make themselves at home.translation: 朋友：我第一次来 有点拘谨 你：别客气 make yourselves at home 随便坐 朋友：那我不跟你见外了 你：对
make themselves at home.example: Friend: First time here, a bit awkward. You: Don't be shy; make yourselves at home, sit anywhere. Friend: Then I won't stand on ceremony. You: Right.

make time for.context: 你说再忙也要给朋友和家人留时间，朋友问你怎么挤出来的。
make time for.translation: 朋友：你天天加班 还聚会 你：再忙也得make time for朋友 挤挤就有 朋友：那不累吗 你：值得
make time for.example: Friend: You work overtime yet still meet up. You: No matter how busy, make time for friends; squeeze it out. Friend: Isn't it tiring? You: Worth it.

make up for lost time.context: 你落榜后埋头苦读一年，朋友说你这是在拼命补回之前浪费的时间。
make up for lost time.translation: 朋友：你这一年怎么这么拼 你：想make up for lost time 把去年耽误的补回来 朋友：那身体吃得消吗 你：拼这一年
make up for lost time.example: Friend: Why grind so hard this year? You: To make up for lost time, recover what I wasted last year. Friend: Can you handle it? You: Just push this year.

make up of.context: 你介绍公司团队组成，说一个项目组主要由设计、开发和测试组成。
make up of.translation: 朋友：你们团队都有啥人 你：一个项目组is made up of设计 开发测试 朋友：那人数多吗 你：十来个人
make up of.example: Friend: Who's on your team? You: A project group is made up of design, dev, and testing. Friend: Big? You: About ten people.

make...go further.context: 你精打细算地过日子，朋友问你怎么让每月那点钱能花得更久。
make...go further.translation: 朋友：你工资不高咋还能存下钱 你：会过日子 让钱go further 朋友：有啥妙招 你：自己做饭少点外卖
make...go further.example: Friend: You save despite low pay? You: Live smart, make the money go further. Friend: Any tips? You: Cook, less takeout.

makes a fuss about.context: 同事鞋带松了被你看见，他大惊小怪地说这说那，朋友笑他小题大做。
makes a fuss about.translation: 朋友：不就鞋带开了吗 你：他makes a fuss about这事 半天念叨 朋友：至于吗 你：就是爱小题大做
makes a fuss about.example: Friend: It's just an untied shoelace. You: He makes a fuss about it, going on and on. Friend: Is it worth it? You: He just loves making a fuss.

manage finances.context: 朋友刚工作不知道怎么管钱，你教他每月记账，学会理财。
manage finances.translation: 朋友：我老月光 你：得学会manage finances 记账 朋友：从哪开始 你：下个记账APP
manage finances.example: Friend: I always run out of money. You: Learn to manage finances, keep a budget. Friend: Where to start? You: Download a budget app.

manage footfall.context: 商场搞活动人特别多，你和同事商量怎么安排动线，把进店人流疏导开。
manage footfall.translation: 朋友：今天人太多 挤不动 你：得manage footfall 分时段进场 朋友：那加几个入口 你：对 分流
manage footfall.example: Friend: Too many people today, can't move. You: We need to manage footfall, stagger entry. Friend: Then add more entrances? You: Right; split the flow.

manage one's emotions.context: 你脾气急，朋友劝你遇事先深呼吸，学会管理自己的情绪。
manage one's emotions.translation: 朋友：你老一急就发火 你：得学会manage my emotions 先深呼吸 朋友：有用吗 你：练几次就稳了
manage one's emotions.example: Friend: You flare up whenever you rush. You: I need to manage my emotions, breathe first. Friend: Does it work? You: Practice a few times and it steadies.

management consultant.context: 朋友跳槽去做了给企业出主意的顾问，你问他这工作具体是干嘛的。
management consultant.translation: 朋友：他新工作是啥 你：做management consultant 给企业出主意 朋友：那经常出差吧 你：是 满世界飞
management consultant.example: Friend: What's his new job? You: A management consultant, advising companies. Friend: Lots of travel? You: Yeah; flying everywhere.

managerial job.context: 你升了主管，朋友说你现在终于做上了管理岗，不用再亲力亲为了。
managerial job.translation: 朋友：你升主管了 恭喜 你：算是个managerial job 带人做事 朋友：那压力大吧 你：是 责任也大
managerial job.example: Friend: You're a supervisor now, congrats. You: It's a managerial job, leading people. Friend: Big pressure? You: Right; big responsibility too.

manifest itself.context: 病慢慢显现出来时，医生说有些毛病早期不容易被察觉，得定期体检。
manifest itself.translation: 朋友：这病怎么才发现 你：它慢慢manifest itself 早期没感觉 朋友：那以后得常检查 你：对 早发现
manifest itself.example: Friend: Why was this illness only found now? You: It slowly manifests itself, no feeling early on. Friend: Then check often. You: Right; early detection.

manual labour.context: 爷爷年轻时在工地干体力活，朋友问他那时候是不是特别辛苦。
manual labour.translation: 朋友：爷爷以前干啥工作 你：在工地干manual labour 一天到晚使劲 朋友：那真累 你：是 挣辛苦钱
manual labour.example: Friend: What did Grandpa do? You: Manual labour at a construction site, hard work all day. Friend: That's really tiring. You: Right; earning hard money.

manual worker.context: 你路上看到送快递的小哥扛着大箱上楼，朋友说这些都是靠力气吃饭的人。
manual worker.translation: 朋友：那小哥真辛苦 你：就是manual worker 靠力气挣钱 朋友：天这么热还跑 你：是 不容易
manual worker.example: Friend: That delivery guy works hard. You: A manual worker, earning by his strength. Friend: Running in this heat. You: Right; not easy.

manufacturing process.context: 你参观工厂，师傅介绍说从原料到成品要经过好几道制造工序。
manufacturing process.translation: 朋友：这东西怎么做出来的 你：一整套manufacturing process 好几道工序 朋友：全是机器吗 你：机器加人工
manufacturing process.example: Friend: How is this made? You: A whole manufacturing process, several steps. Friend: All machines? You: Machines plus people.

many moons ago.context: 你说起小时候和邻居小孩一起抓鱼的事，朋友说那都是很久以前了。
many moons ago.translation: 朋友：你还记得那时候的事 你：many moons ago的事了 想起来还挺暖 朋友：现在那邻居还在吗 你：早搬了
many moons ago.example: Friend: You still remember back then? You: Many moons ago, but it warms me to think. Friend: Is that neighbor still around? You: Moved long ago.

map onto.context: 做设计时你要把每个功能对应到一个图标，朋友问你怎么映射的。
map onto.translation: 朋友：这图标和功能怎么对应 你：我把每个功能maps onto一个图标 朋友：那用户能看懂吗 你：设计成大家熟悉的样子
map onto.example: Friend: How do icons map to functions? You: I map each function onto an icon. Friend: Will users get it? You: Design them to look familiar.

march to the beat of their own drum.context: 朋友从不随大流，穿衣做事都按自己喜欢的来，你说他特立独行。
march to the beat of their own drum.translation: 朋友：他怎么老跟别人不一样 你：他就march to the beat of his own drum 不在乎别人眼光 朋友：这样也挺好 你：是 自在
march to the beat of their own drum.example: Friend: Why is he always different? You: He just marches to the beat of his own drum, not caring about others. Friend: That's nice too. You: Right; free.

marine biology.context: 你在水族馆做志愿，朋友说你是不是学海洋生物的。
marine biology.translation: 朋友：你天天去水族馆 你：我学marine biology 研究海里的生物 朋友：那有意思吗 你：特别 还能摸海龟
marine biology.example: Friend: You're at the aquarium every day. You: I study marine biology, researching sea life. Friend: Is it interesting? You: So interesting; even touch turtles.

marine ecosystem.context: 纪录片讲珊瑚礁在退化，朋友说破坏海洋生态系统影响很大。
marine ecosystem.translation: 朋友：珊瑚白化咋这么严重 你：它破坏整个marine ecosystem 鱼都没家了 朋友：那怎么救 你：减少污染
marine ecosystem.example: Friend: Why is coral bleaching so bad? You: It wrecks the whole marine ecosystem, fish lose their homes. Friend: Then how to save it? You: Cut pollution.

marine life.context: 你浮潜时看到一群彩色小鱼，朋友说这就是海里的生物世界。
marine life.translation: 朋友：水里那一堆彩色的是啥 你：各种marine life 鱼啊珊瑚啊 朋友：海底真美 你：是 像另一个世界
marine life.example: Friend: What's that colorful bunch underwater? You: All kinds of marine life—fish, coral. Friend: The seafloor is beautiful. You: Right; like another world.

marine organism.context: 显微镜下你看到一滴海水里游动的小东西，朋友问这是什么生物。
marine organism.translation: 朋友：这水滴里动的是啥 你：是种marine organism 肉眼看不见的小生命 朋友：海里到处都是吗 你：对 特别多
marine organism.example: Friend: What's moving in this drop? You: A marine organism, tiny life invisible to the eye. Friend: Are they everywhere in the sea? You: Right; loads.

marine species.context: 你和朋友聊起海里奇特的动物，朋友说深海里还有好多没发现的物种。
marine species.translation: 朋友：深海里都有啥 你：数不清的marine species 很多还没命名 朋友：那探险真有意思 你：是 未知太多
marine species.example: Friend: What's in the deep sea? You: Countless marine species, many unnamed. Friend: Exploration is fun. You: Right; so much unknown.

market demand.context: 公司开会讨论要不要上新产品，先看看市场上对这类东西的需求大不大。
market demand.translation: 朋友：这新品能卖出去吗 你：先看market demand 大家需不需要 朋友：调研做了吗 你：问卷发了不少
market demand.example: Friend: Will this new product sell? You: First look at market demand, whether people want it. Friend: Done research? You: Sent out plenty of surveys.

market hype.context: 那产品刚发布就被吹上天，朋友说都是营销炒作，别太当真。
market hype.translation: 朋友：这产品是不是真那么神 你：大多是market hype 别太当真 朋友：那实际好用吗 你：普通 宣传过头了
market hype.example: Friend: Is this product really that amazing? You: Mostly market hype; don't take it seriously. Friend: Then is it actually good? You: Average; overhyped.

market stall.context: 周末你去逛集市，一个卖手作饰品的小摊特别吸引人，你蹲下来挑。
market stall.translation: 朋友：这集市里你最想看哪个摊 你：那个market stall卖手工首饰的 我去挑挑 朋友：东西贵不贵 你：小玩意儿 买点纪念
market stall.example: Friend: Which stall at the market are you most looking at? You: That market stall selling handmade jewelry; let me browse. Friend: Is it pricey? You: Little trinkets; buy a keepsake.

market strategy.context: 公司开会讨论怎么把产品卖出去，朋友说这得先定个整体的市场打法。
market strategy.translation: 朋友：咱们这产品咋卖 你：先定个market strategy 走线上还是线下 朋友：那要投广告吗 你：看预算再说
market strategy.example: Friend: How do we sell this product? You: First set a market strategy, online or offline. Friend: Then advertise? You: See the budget first.

market trend.context: 你做投资总看数据，朋友说他是在判断接下来市场会往哪个方向走。
market trend.translation: 朋友：你天天研究这些图干嘛 你：看market trend 预测下一波风口 朋友：那你看准了吗 你：还在琢磨
market trend.example: Friend: Why study all those charts? You: Watching market trends, predicting the next trend. Friend: Have you got it? You: Still working it out.

marketing budget.context: 公司批钱做推广，你问老板今年准备拨多少营销预算。
marketing budget.translation: 朋友：今年推广有多少钱 你：老板批了marketing budget 五十万 朋友：那够投多少渠道 你：挑重点渠道投
marketing budget.example: Friend: How much for promotion this year? You: The boss approved a marketing budget of half a million. Friend: How many channels? You: Pick the key ones.

marketing strategy.context: 市场部讨论新品上市怎么打，朋友说一套好的营销策略特别重要。
marketing strategy.translation: 朋友：新品咋推 你：得有完整marketing strategy 定位定价推广 朋友：那先做啥 你：先找目标用户
marketing strategy.example: Friend: How to launch the new product? You: Need a complete marketing strategy—positioning, price, promotion. Friend: Then first? You: Find the target users.

marketing tactic.context: 你做了个抽奖活动拉新，朋友说这是常见的营销小手段。
marketing tactic.translation: 朋友：你那活动咋拉了那么多新人 你：搞了个抽奖的marketing tactic 朋友：效果不错吧 你：来的人多
marketing tactic.example: Friend: How did your event pull so many new users? You: Ran a giveaway, a marketing tactic. Friend: Worked well? You: Lots of people came.

mars rover.context: 新闻里播放火星车发回的照片，朋友说这台机器人真能干。
mars rover.translation: 朋友：那红色照片哪拍的 你：mars rover在火星上拍的 朋友：真高科技 你：是 跑那么远
mars rover.example: Friend: Where were those red photos taken? You: The Mars rover took them on Mars. Friend: So high-tech. You: Right; driving so far.

marvel at.context: 你站在大峡谷边上，被这大自然的壮丽惊得说不出话。
marvel at.translation: 朋友：这景色咋样 你：美得让我marvel at大自然的鬼斧神工 朋友：拍张照 你：必须的
marvel at.example: Friend: How's the view? You: So beautiful I marvel at nature's craftsmanship. Friend: Take a photo. You: Absolutely.

mass extinction.context: 老师讲恐龙为什么消失，朋友说那是一次生物大灭绝事件。
mass extinction.translation: 朋友：恐龙咋没的 你：一次mass extinction 小行星撞地球 朋友：那地球上生物死了好多 你：是 后来又慢慢恢复
mass extinction.example: Friend: Why did the dinosaurs disappear? You: A mass extinction, an asteroid hit. Friend: Then lots of life died. You: Right; slowly recovered later.

mass market.context: 你说这产品不做高端，就瞄准普通大众市场，走量为主。
mass market.translation: 朋友：咱产品定位高端吗 你：不 打mass market 走性价比 朋友：那利润薄吧 你：量大就行
mass market.example: Friend: Is our product premium? You: No; target the mass market, value for money. Friend: Then margins are thin? You: Volume makes up for it.

mass produce.context: 以前手工做一个，现在工厂一下能做上万个，朋友说现在能批量生产了。
mass produce.translation: 朋友：这东西以前贵吧 你：现在工厂能mass produce 成本一下降了 朋友：那质量一样吗 你：标准化了
mass produce.example: Friend: Was this expensive before? You: Now factories can mass produce, cost dropped. Friend: Is the quality the same? You: It's standardized.

mass production.context: 你对比手工和机器做的杯子，朋友说大批量生产后就便宜多了。
mass production.translation: 朋友：这杯子咋这么便宜 你：mass production做的 一个成本很低 朋友：那还有手作的味道吗 你：没有 走量的
mass production.example: Friend: Why is this mug so cheap? You: Mass production keeps each cost low. Friend: Still handmade feel? You: No; built for volume.

mass tourism.context: 假期你不想去人挤人的景点，朋友说那种大众旅游的地方太闹了。
mass tourism.translation: 朋友：国庆去哪玩 你：不去那些mass tourism景点 人挤人 朋友：那去哪 你：找个冷门小村
mass tourism.example: Friend: Where to go for the holiday? You: Skip those mass tourism spots, too crowded. Friend: Then where? You: A quiet little village.

material possession.context: 你说自己现在不再追求名牌包包，朋友说人越成熟越看淡物质财富。
material possession.translation: 朋友：你咋不买包了 你：我发现material possession没那么重要 朋友：那啥重要 你：开心健康
material possession.example: Friend: Why don't you buy bags anymore? You: I realized material possessions aren't that important. Friend: Then what is? You: Happiness and health.

maternity leave.context: 同事怀孕要休长假，朋友说她这产假能休好几个月。
maternity leave.translation: 朋友：她好久没来上班了 你：在休maternity leave 好几个月呢 朋友：那工作谁接 你：我们临时分了
maternity leave.example: Friend: She hasn't been to work for ages. You: She's on maternity leave, several months. Friend: Then who does her work? You: We split it temporarily.

mathematical certainty.context: 你说按现在这比分，主队赢球几乎是板上钉钉，朋友却觉得别高兴太早。
mathematical certainty.translation: 朋友：这比分稳了吧 你：再进一个就基本是mathematical certainty了 朋友：别奶 还有时间 你：希望别反转
mathematical certainty.example: Friend: Is the score safe now? You: One more goal and it's a mathematical certainty. Friend: Don't jinx it, there's still time. You: Hope it doesn't flip.

meal prep.context: 你周末一次把一周的菜做好分装，朋友说这就是提前备餐。
meal prep.translation: 朋友：你周末做一堆菜干嘛 你：meal prep 一次分装好 工作日热一下就行 朋友：那真省时间 你：对
meal prep.example: Friend: Why cook a bunch on the weekend? You: Meal prep, portion it out; heat up on workdays. Friend: That saves time. You: Right.

meaningful bond.context: 你和室友合租两年成了最好的朋友，朋友说你们之间有很深的情谊。
meaningful bond.translation: 朋友：你俩关系真好 你：住一起两年 有种meaningful bond 朋友：比大学时还铁 你：是 天天见
meaningful bond.example: Friend: You two are so close. You: Two years together, a meaningful bond. Friend: Closer than college days. You: Right; seeing each other daily.

measure up.context: 你新做的方案拿给老板看，朋友问你达到他的要求了没有。
measure up.translation: 朋友：老板满意你那方案吗 你：还不知道能不能measure up 朋友：你改了好几版了 你：希望这次过
measure up.example: Friend: Is the boss happy with your plan? You: Not sure yet if it will measure up. Friend: You've revised several versions. You: Hope this one passes.

measure up to.context: 你担心自己的能力达不到公司要求，朋友说你别太不自信。
measure up to.translation: 朋友：你怕过不了试用期啊 你：我怕自己measure up to expectations 朋友：你已经很努力了 你：希望能行
measure up to.example: Friend: Afraid you won't pass probation? You: I worry I won't measure up to expectations. Friend: You've worked so hard. You: Hope it's enough.

meat substitute.context: 你点了个植物肉汉堡，朋友问这是不是那种素的替代肉。
meat substitute.translation: 朋友：你这汉堡里夹的啥肉 你：是meat substitute 植物做的 朋友：吃起来像肉吗 你：挺像 不腻
meat substitute.example: Friend: What meat is in your burger? You: It's a meat substitute, plant-based. Friend: Does it taste like meat? You: Pretty close; not greasy.

media influence.context: 你说现在小姑娘都被广告里的完美身材影响，朋友问这会不会让人焦虑。
media influence.translation: 朋友：她怎么老嫌自己胖 你：受media influence 天天看完美身材 朋友：那怎么开导 你：告诉她美很多样
media influence.example: Friend: Why does she keep thinking she's fat? You: Media influence, seeing perfect bodies daily. Friend: Then how to comfort? You: Tell her beauty is diverse.

medial prefrontal cortex.context: 上课老师讲到大脑前额叶那块区域，朋友说这名字长得都记不住。
medial prefrontal cortex.translation: 朋友：刚才老师讲那脑区叫啥 你：medial prefrontal cortex 挺长 朋友：这部分管啥 你：管决策和情绪
medial prefrontal cortex.example: Friend: What was that brain region the teacher mentioned? You: The medial prefrontal cortex, quite a name. Friend: What does it do? You: Decision and emotion.

medical alert.context: 爷爷戴了个能一键呼救的手环，朋友说这就是老人用的医疗警报设备。
medical alert.translation: 朋友：爷爷手上戴的啥 你：是个medical alert 不舒服按一下就报警 朋友：那真实用 你：对 独居老人放心
medical alert.example: Friend: What's that on Grandpa's wrist? You: A medical alert; press it when unwell and it calls for help. Friend: Really practical. You: Right; peace of mind for someone living alone.

medical conditions.context: 入职体检要登记你以前得过什么病，朋友问你有没有慢性病。
medical conditions.translation: 朋友：体检表要填啥 你：把你的medical conditions写上 以前的病史 朋友：小毛病也算吗 你：如实填
medical conditions.example: Friend: What's on the health form? You: Fill in your medical conditions, past illnesses. Friend: Do minor issues count? You: Be honest.

medical cost.context: 你说现在看个病真贵，朋友聊起医保报销后自己要掏的钱。
medical cost.translation: 朋友：这病花了不少吧 你：medical cost挺高 报完还得自己出点 朋友：那医保真有用 你：是 不然更贵
medical cost.example: Friend: This illness cost a lot? You: The medical cost is high, even after insurance some out of pocket. Friend: Then insurance really helps. You: Right; else pricier.

medical vocabulary.context: 你是护士，朋友说你天天跟各种专业词打交道，医学词汇量真大。
medical vocabulary.translation: 朋友：你咋懂那么多病名 你：天天说 medical vocabulary背都背下来了 朋友：那我们听不懂你说啥 你：我给你翻译
medical vocabulary.example: Friend: How do you know so many disease names? You: Saying them daily, the medical vocabulary just sticks. Friend: Then we can't understand you. You: I'll translate.

mediterranean diet.context: 医生让你多吃橄榄油蔬果鱼，朋友说这就是有名的地中海饮食。
mediterranean diet.translation: 朋友：医生让我多吃啥 你：多吃蔬果鱼橄榄油 就是那个mediterranean diet 朋友：那好吃吗 你：健康 还不难吃
mediterranean diet.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell me to eat more of? You: Veg, fruit, fish, olive oil—that's the Mediterranean diet. Friend: Is it tasty? You: Healthy, and not bad.

meet one's expectations.context: 你第一次住这家民宿，朋友问老板这家店有没有达到你的预期。
meet one's expectations.translation: 朋友：这民宿住得咋样 你：它真的meet my expectations 干净舒服 朋友：那推荐吗 你：推荐
meet one's expectations.example: Friend: How's this B&B? You: It really meets my expectations, clean and comfy. Friend: Recommend it? You: Yes.

meet the eye.context: 你打开窗帘，窗外一片湖光山色，映入眼帘的全是好风景。
meet the eye.translation: 朋友：你家窗外看出去是啥 你：一眼望出去 全是风景just meet the eye 朋友：那也太爽了 你：每天看都不腻
meet the eye.example: Friend: What's the view out your window? You: At a glance, scenery that just meets the eye. Friend: That's the dream. You: Never tires of it.

meet up with.context: 你出差到朋友那座城市，约他下班后见面，朋友问在哪碰头。
meet up with.translation: 朋友：你到我们城市啦 你：下班后我meet up with你 一起吃饭 朋友：那就在你酒店附近 你：好
meet up with.example: Friend: You're in our city? You: I'll meet up with you after work for dinner. Friend: Then near your hotel. You: Okay.

meet with.context: 你说这次谈判很顺利，最后和对方达成了满意的结果。
meet with.translation: 朋友：谈判咋样 你：挺好 we met with他们的认可 合同签了 朋友：那祝贺 你：是 顺利
meet with.example: Friend: How'd the negotiation go? You: Great; we met with their approval and signed. Friend: Congrats. You: Right; smooth.

mega rich.context: 你说现在新闻里那些超级富豪，朋友问他们到底有多有钱。
mega rich.translation: 朋友：你看那新闻里的人 你：都是the mega rich 钱多得数不清 朋友：那普通人比不了 你：是 天壤之别
mega rich.example: Friend: Those people in the news? You: The mega rich, money beyond counting. Friend: Can't compare to ordinary folks. You: Right; worlds apart.

melt down.context: 你把巧克力放暖气旁边，回来一看都化了，朋友说这温度太高。
melt down.translation: 朋友：你这巧克力咋糊了 你：搁暖气边 melt down了 朋友：那还能吃吗 你：冻起来当酱吃
melt down.example: Friend: Why is your chocolate all gooey? You: Left it by the heater and it melted down. Friend: Still edible? You: Freeze it as a spread.

memorise piece.context: 你下周要演出，这几天一直在反复背那首曲子，朋友问练得咋样了。
memorise piece.translation: 朋友：你下周演出准备好没 你：在memorise the piece 练到不看谱了 朋友：那稳了 你：再顺几遍
memorise piece.example: Friend: Ready for next week's show? You: Memorising the piece; now no need for the score. Friend: Then you're set. You: Smooth it a few more times.

memory loss.context: 爷爷最近老忘事，医生说这是记忆力在减退，朋友问要不要紧。
memory loss.translation: 朋友：爷爷咋老忘事 你：有点memory loss 医生说要多动脑 朋友：那严重吗 你：先观察 多陪他聊天
memory loss.example: Friend: Why does Grandpa keep forgetting? You: Some memory loss; the doctor says keep the mind active. Friend: Is it serious? You: Observe first; chat with him more.

memory retention.context: 老师说边睡边复习记忆效果好，朋友问这是利用什么原理。
memory retention.translation: 朋友：睡前背书记得牢吗 你：研究说那能提高memory retention 朋友：真的假的 你：试试就知道
memory retention.example: Friend: Is memorizing before sleep effective? You: Studies say it boosts memory retention. Friend: Really? You: Try it and see.

mend a broken heart.context: 朋友刚失恋天天哭，你陪他吃饭聊天，说时间和朋友能治愈情伤。
mend a broken heart.translation: 朋友：我走不出来了 你：慢慢来 time heals 我们一起mend your broken heart 朋友：真的会好吗 你：会的 别一个人闷着
mend a broken heart.example: Friend: I can't get over it. You: Take it slow; time heals, let's mend your broken heart together. Friend: Will it really get better? You: Yes; don't mope alone.

mental arithmetic.context: 你买菜算账不用计算器，心算几下就出来了，朋友说你心算真快。
mental arithmetic.translation: 朋友：这账你咋不算计算器 你：简单的mental arithmetic就够了 朋友：你数学真好 你：练出来的
mental arithmetic.example: Friend: Why not use a calculator? You: Simple mental arithmetic is enough. Friend: Your math is good. You: Practiced.

mental clarity.context: 你早上喝杯咖啡再开工，说这样脑子特别清楚，效率高。
mental clarity.translation: 朋友：你为啥每天先喝咖啡 你：喝完脑子有那种mental clarity 干活快 朋友：那我也试试 你：别喝太晚
mental clarity.example: Friend: Why coffee first every day? You: It gives me that mental clarity, work faster. Friend: Then I'll try. You: Just not too late.

mental clutter.context: 你待办事项列了一大堆，脑子乱哄哄的，朋友说你得清空一下。
mental clutter.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老忘事 你：脑子里全是事 mental clutter太多 朋友：写下来就好 你：对 列个清单
mental clutter.example: Friend: Why do you keep forgetting lately? You: So many things on my mind, too much mental clutter. Friend: Write it down. You: Right; make a list.

mental disorder.context: 新闻里说要正视心理疾病，朋友说大家不该再歧视心理有问题的人。
mental disorder.translation: 朋友：那病是咋回事 你：是种mental disorder 跟感冒一样要看医生 朋友：那别歧视人家 你：对 正常对待
mental disorder.example: Friend: What's that illness? You: A mental disorder, like a cold, needs a doctor. Friend: Then don't stigmatize them. You: Right; treat normally.

mental fatigue.context: 你连续加班一周，朋友说你看着是精神上累，不是身体累。
mental fatigue.translation: 朋友：你咋这么累 你：是那种mental fatigue 脑子转不动了 朋友：那别硬撑 你：周末好好睡一觉
mental fatigue.example: Friend: Why are you so tired? You: It's mental fatigue, brain won't turn. Friend: Don't push through. You: Sleep well this weekend.

mental health.context: 公司现在很重视员工心理，朋友说大家心理健康比业绩还重要。
mental health.translation: 朋友：你们公司还搞心理咨询 你：现在很看重mental health 还配了咨询师 朋友：那挺人性化 你：是
mental health.example: Friend: Your company offers counseling? You: Now it values mental health, even has a counselor. Friend: That's humane. You: Right.

mental health benefit.context: 公司搞每周瑜伽课，朋友说这对员工心理状态有好处。
mental health benefit.translation: 朋友：公司为啥让我们做瑜伽 你：对mental health有benefit 放松减压 朋友：那挺好 你：是 不收费
mental health benefit.example: Friend: Why does the company make us do yoga? You: It has a mental health benefit, relaxing and de-stressing. Friend: That's nice. You: Right; free.

mental health condition.context: 你朋友长期焦虑，医生说这是需要认真对待的心理问题。
mental health condition.translation: 朋友：他这焦虑严重吗 你：是个mental health condition 得看医生 朋友：那别拖 你：对 早干预
mental health condition.example: Friend: Is his anxiety serious? You: It's a mental health condition, needs a doctor. Friend: Then don't delay. You: Right; early help.

mental health issues.context: 你说现在学生压力大，朋友聊起青少年心理问题越来越多。
mental health issues.translation: 朋友：现在小孩咋也不开心 你：mental health issues在学生里挺多 朋友：那学校该重视 你：是 多开心理课
mental health issues.example: Friend: Why are kids unhappy now? You: Mental health issues are common among students. Friend: Then schools should care. You: Right; more psychology classes.

mental health problems.context: 新闻说年轻人心理问题比例上升，朋友说大家都该多关心身边人。
mental health problems.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人压力真大 你：mental health problems比例越来越高 朋友：那多陪陪朋友 你：是 别让一个人扛
mental health problems.example: Friend: Young people are under so much pressure. You: Mental health problems are rising. Friend: Then spend time with friends. You: Right; don't let them carry it alone.

mental health support.context: 你说朋友情绪不好时，最需要的是有人陪在身边支持他。
mental health support.translation: 朋友：他不开心我能做啥 你：给点mental health support 陪着听他说 朋友：要劝他看医生吗 你：严重了就陪他去
mental health support.example: Friend: What can I do when he's down? You: Give some mental health support, just be there and listen. Friend: Should I urge him to see a doctor? You: If serious, go with him.

mental illness.context: 你说精神疾病和身体疾病一样，都不该被歧视，朋友说大家要多理解。
mental illness.translation: 朋友：那病会被人笑话吗 你：mental illness不该被歧视 跟发烧一样 朋友：那得普及 你：对
mental illness.example: Friend: Will people mock that illness? You: Mental illness shouldn't be stigmatized, just like a fever. Friend: Then we need awareness. You: Right.

mental image.context: 你闭上眼睛就能想出那幅画的样子，朋友说这就是脑子里的画面。
mental image.translation: 朋友：你咋不看图也能画出来 你：我脑子里有mental image 直接照着画 朋友：这能力真强 你：练久了就行
mental image.example: Friend: How can you draw without looking? You: I have a mental image, just draw it. Friend: Strong ability. You: Practice makes it.

mental imagery.context: 运动员比赛前在脑子里预演动作，朋友说这种心理演练很有用。
mental imagery.translation: 朋友：他闭眼站着干嘛 你：做mental imagery 在脑子里过一遍动作 朋友：这也管用 你：对 心理训练
mental imagery.example: Friend: Why's he standing with eyes closed? You: Doing mental imagery, running through the moves in his head. Friend: Does that work? You: Right; mental training.

mental outlook.context: 你说他虽然遇到很多挫折，但心态一直很积极，朋友说这很难得。
mental outlook.translation: 朋友：他咋天天乐呵呵 你：他mental outlook特别积极 朋友：那遇到难事也不垮 你：是 心态好
mental outlook.example: Friend: Why is he always cheerful? You: His mental outlook is really positive. Friend: Doesn't he break when things go wrong? You: Right; good mindset.

mental resilience.context: 你说她抗压能力特别强，朋友问她是怎么练出来的。
mental resilience.translation: 朋友：她咋这么扛事 你：mental resilience强 越挫越勇 朋友：咋练的 你：多经历就皮实了
mental resilience.example: Friend: How does she handle pressure so well? You: Strong mental resilience, bounces back. Friend: How to build it? You: More experience toughens you.

mental shield.context: 你说面对负面评价时，心里得有一层防护，别被轻易击垮。
mental shield.translation: 朋友：他被骂了就难受半天 你：得给自己加个mental shield 别太往心里去 朋友：咋加 你：分清对事对人
mental shield.example: Friend: He's upset for ages after criticism. You: Build a mental shield, don't take it too hard. Friend: How? You: Separate the issue from the person.

mental well-being.context: 你说工作再忙也要留点时间放松，朋友说这对心理状态好。
mental well-being.translation: 朋友：你周末都干啥放松 你：留点时间照顾mental well-being 散散步 朋友：那挺重要 你：是 别绷太紧
mental well-being.example: Friend: What do you do to relax on weekends? You: Set aside time for mental well-being, take walks. Friend: That's important. You: Right; don't be too tense.

mental wellbeing.context: 你说现在大家越来越重视心理状态，朋友说公司也开始关心这个了。
mental wellbeing.translation: 朋友：你最近状态咋这么好 你：开始注意mental wellbeing 早睡多运动 朋友：那确实有用 你：是
mental wellbeing.example: Friend: Why are you in such good shape lately? You: Started caring about mental wellbeing, sleep early and exercise. Friend: That really helps. You: Right.

mentally and physically stimulating.context: 你说爬山又累又要动脑认路，朋友说这是既锻炼身体又锻炼脑子。
mentally and physically stimulating.translation: 朋友：爬山有啥意思 你：它mentally and physically stimulating 身体累脑子也转 朋友：那真不错 你：是 下次一起
mentally and physically stimulating.example: Friend: What's fun about hiking? You: It's mentally and physically stimulating, body tired and brain working. Friend: That sounds good. You: Right; come along next time.

merchant bank.context: 朋友说他在那种专门做企业融资的银行上班，朋友问这是什么银行。
merchant bank.translation: 朋友：你那银行跟普通的一样吗 你：是merchant bank 专做企业业务 朋友：那个人能去存钱吗 你：不办个人业务
merchant bank.example: Friend: Is your bank like a normal one? You: A merchant bank, doing corporate business. Friend: Can individuals save there? You: No retail.

merit pay.context: 你说他们公司工资按绩效发，干得多拿得多，朋友问这是什么制度。
merit pay.translation: 朋友：你们工资咋算 你：merit pay 按表现发奖金 朋友：那多劳多得 你：是 有动力
merit pay.example: Friend: How is your pay calculated? You: Merit pay, bonuses by performance. Friend: Then more work more reward? You: Right; motivating.

mess with.context: 朋友老动你桌上的东西，你说别乱碰，弄坏了自己负责。
mess with.translation: 朋友：我看看你这新玩意儿 你：别mess with它 容易坏 朋友：就摸一下 你：那也别乱按
mess with.example: Friend: Let me see your new gadget. You: Don't mess with it, it breaks easily. Friend: Just a touch. You: Still don't press buttons.

metabolic disease.context: 医生说肥胖容易引发一类和代谢相关的病，朋友问这病严重不。
metabolic disease.translation: 朋友：这病跟胖有关啊 你：是种metabolic disease 得控制饮食 朋友：那能调好吗 你：管住嘴就行
metabolic disease.example: Friend: This illness is linked to weight? You: It's a metabolic disease, need to control diet. Friend: Can it be managed? You: Watch what you eat.

metabolic problems.context: 你体检报告里血糖血脂都有点高，医生说这是代谢上的小问题。
metabolic problems.translation: 朋友：你报告咋了 你：有些metabolic problems 血糖血脂偏高 朋友：那得忌口 你：是 少吃甜油
metabolic problems.example: Friend: What's on your report? You: Some metabolic problems, blood sugar and fat a bit high. Friend: Then watch your diet. You: Right; less sugar and grease.

metabolic rate.context: 你说年纪大了基础代谢变慢，朋友问这跟减肥有啥关系。
metabolic rate.translation: 朋友：为啥你现在容易胖 你：年纪大了metabolic rate降了 朋友：那咋办 你：多运动提上去
metabolic rate.example: Friend: Why do you gain weight easily now? You: With age the metabolic rate drops. Friend: Then what? You: Exercise to raise it.

metal plate.context: 你说那工地围挡是一块块铁板拼的，朋友问这是什么材料。
metal plate.translation: 朋友：这围挡啥做的 你：一块块metal plate 焊起来的 朋友：挺结实 你：是 挡风挡人
metal plate.example: Friend: What's that barrier made of? You: Metal plates, welded together. Friend: Pretty sturdy. You: Right; blocks wind and people.

metro system.context: 你到新城市旅游，朋友说这儿地铁特别方便，去哪都能坐。
metro system.translation: 朋友：这城市交通方便吗 你：metro system很发达 去哪都能坐地铁 朋友：那真省心 你：对 不堵车
metro system.example: Friend: Is transport convenient in this city? You: The metro system is great, go anywhere by subway. Friend: That's worry-free. You: Right; no traffic jams.

metropolitan area.context: 你说这座大城市连着周边好几个城，朋友问这一片到底有多大。
metropolitan area.translation: 朋友：这城市圈有多大 你：整个metropolitan area 连着周边好几个城 朋友：那人口得有几千万 你：是 超大
metropolitan area.example: Friend: How big is this metro area? You: The whole metropolitan area connects several cities around. Friend: Then tens of millions? You: Right; huge.

microplastic pollution.context: 你说现在连海水里都有塑料微粒，朋友问这是怎么进到海里的。
microplastic pollution.translation: 朋友：这海咋也脏了 你：microplastic pollution 洗衣服的微纤毛都进去了 朋友：那海鲜还能吃吗 你：少点塑料用品
microplastic pollution.example: Friend: Why is the sea dirty too? You: Microplastic pollution, microfibers from laundry. Friend: Then is seafood safe? You: Use less plastic.

mid-to-late 20s.context: 你朋友快三十了还单身，你说他现在正是二十五六往后那阵子，朋友说别着急。
mid-to-late 20s.translation: 朋友：他几岁了还不着急 你：也就mid-to-late 20s 正是打拼的时候 朋友：那婚姻呢 你：缘分没到
mid-to-late 20s.example: Friend: He's that age and in no hurry? You: Just mid-to-late 20s, building his career. Friend: Then marriage? You: Not yet.

middle age.context: 你说爸妈现在都到中年了，朋友问他们身体还好吧。
middle age.translation: 朋友：叔叔阿姨身体咋样 你：都到middle age了 多少有点小毛病 朋友：那多陪陪 你：是 常回家
middle age.example: Friend: How are your parents? You: They're in middle age now, a few minor issues. Friend: Then spend time with them. You: Right; go home often.

middle aged.context: 你说那位老师看着四十来岁，朋友说他正是中年，却还跟学生打成一片。
middle aged.translation: 朋友：那老师多大年纪 你：看着middle aged了 心态却特别年轻 朋友：难怪跟学生聊得来 你：是 没架子
middle aged.example: Friend: How old does that teacher look? You: He looks middle aged, but his mindset's young. Friend: No wonder he clicks with students. You: Right; no airs.

mild infection.context: 你嗓子有点不舒服，医生说是轻微的上呼吸道感染，吃点药就行。
mild infection.translation: 朋友：你这嗓子咋了 你：医生说有点mild infection 不严重 朋友：那吃药能好吗 你：多喝水 几天就好
mild infection.example: Friend: What's up with your throat? You: The doctor says a mild infection, not serious. Friend: Will medicine fix it? You: Drink water; a few days and fine.

milk chocolate.context: 你买了块黑巧克力，朋友说那不是他爱吃的牛奶巧克力，太苦了。
milk chocolate.translation: 朋友：你这巧克力咋这么苦 你：这是黑巧 不是milk chocolate 朋友：我就爱牛奶那种甜的 你：那你吃那个
milk chocolate.example: Friend: Why is your chocolate so bitter? You: This is dark, not milk chocolate. Friend: I like the sweet milky kind. You: Then eat that one.

milk teeth.context: 你家小孩掉了第一颗牙，朋友说这就是开始换乳牙了。
milk teeth.translation: 朋友：孩子咋说牙疼 你：开始换milk teeth了 恒牙要冒头 朋友：那正常吧 你：对 七岁换牙
milk teeth.example: Friend: Why is the kid's tooth aching? You: Starting to lose milk teeth, adult teeth coming. Friend: Is that normal? You: Right; at seven.

milk tooth.context: 你发现孩子摇摇晃晃有颗牙松了，朋友说这就是乳牙要掉了。
milk tooth.translation: 朋友：他嘴里那颗牙咋晃 你：是颗milk tooth 快掉了 朋友：那掉了别扔 你：对 留着纪念
milk tooth.example: Friend: Why is that tooth wiggling? You: It's a milk tooth, about to fall out. Friend: Then don't throw it away. You: Right; keep it.

millennial burnout.context: 你说现在年轻人加班多、压力大，朋友聊起这种普遍的倦怠现象。
millennial burnout.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人咋都喊累 你：那种millennial burnout 又卷又累 朋友：那怎么破 你：得学会松一松
millennial burnout.example: Friend: Why do young people always say they're tired? You: That millennial burnout, grinding and exhausted. Friend: Then how to fix it? You: Learn to loosen up.

mind wander.context: 开会时你脑子飘到晚饭吃啥了，朋友说你又走神了。
mind wander.translation: 朋友：老板刚说啥了 你：不好意思 I was letting my mind wander 朋友：认真听 要提问了 你：赶紧回来
mind wander.example: Friend: What did the boss just say? You: Sorry, my mind wandered. Friend: Pay attention, questions coming. You: Back now.

mindfulness practice.context: 你压力大时就坐着深呼吸几分钟，朋友说这是正念练习。
mindfulness practice.translation: 朋友：你每天坐那闭眼干嘛 你：做mindfulness practice 深呼吸 朋友：那有用不 你：心静多了
mindfulness practice.example: Friend: Why do you sit with eyes closed daily? You: A mindfulness practice, deep breathing. Friend: Does it help? You: Calms the mind.

minimal wardrobe.context: 你说自己衣服就十几件换着穿，朋友问这就是那种极简衣橱吧。
minimal wardrobe.translation: 朋友：你衣服咋这么少 你：minimal wardrobe 就十来件 好搭 朋友：那不会腻吗 你：都是经典款
minimal wardrobe.example: Friend: Why so few clothes? You: A minimal wardrobe, just ten-odd pieces, easy to match. Friend: Won't it get boring? You: All classics.

minimalist lifestyle.context: 你说自己现在东西越少越开心，朋友说这就是极简的生活方式。
minimalist lifestyle.translation: 朋友：你咋把家具都扔了 你：爱上minimalist lifestyle 东西少 心轻松 朋友：那不会太空吗 你：空才舒服
minimalist lifestyle.example: Friend: Why did you throw away the furniture? You: Fell for a minimalist lifestyle; less stuff, lighter mind. Friend: Won't it feel empty? You: Empty is comfortable.

minimise clutter.context: 你周末收拾屋子扔了一堆没用的，朋友说你这是在给生活做减法。
minimise clutter.translation: 朋友：你这两天收拾出啥了 你：把没用的minimise clutter 扔了一大袋 朋友：那屋子敞亮多了 你：是 断舍离
minimise clutter.example: Friend: What did you sort out these two days? You: Minimised the clutter, threw out a big bag. Friend: The room feels airier. You: Right; decluttering.

minimise impact.context: 公司搞活动选在工作日，朋友说这样能减少对大家周末的影响。
minimise impact.translation: 朋友：活动咋不周末搞 你：minimise impact on大家休息 选在工作日晚上 朋友：那也累 你：比占周末强
minimise impact.example: Friend: Why not hold the event on the weekend? You: To minimise impact on people's rest, hold it a weekday evening. Friend: Still tiring. You: Better than taking the weekend.

minimum wage.context: 你说兼职一小时才十几块，朋友问这是不是就是当地的最低工资。
minimum wage.translation: 朋友：你那兼职时薪多少 你：就比minimum wage高一点 朋友：那也太低 你：学生兼职嘛
minimum wage.example: Friend: What's your part-time hourly pay? You: Just a bit above minimum wage. Friend: That's low. You: Student job, you know.

minor key.context: 你说这首曲子调子低沉忧伤，朋友说这就是用小调写的。
minor key.translation: 朋友：这歌咋这么忧伤 你：它是minor key 小调就这感觉 朋友：那大调呢 你：大调就明亮
minor key.example: Friend: Why is this song so sad? You: It's a minor key; minor keys feel like this. Friend: And major? You: Major sounds bright.

miracle cure.context: 朋友病急乱投医想买特效神药，你劝他别信那些万能神药。
miracle cure.translation: 朋友：听说有个神药啥都治 你：别信那种miracle cure 哪有包治百病的 朋友：那正规治呗 你：对 看医生
miracle cure.example: Friend: Heard there's a wonder drug for everything. You: Don't believe that miracle cure; nothing cures all. Friend: Then proper treatment? You: Right; see a doctor.

miscellaneous cost.context: 你做报销单时有笔杂七杂八的费用，朋友问这该归到哪一栏。
miscellaneous cost.translation: 朋友：这几块钱的零头咋报 你：归到miscellaneous cost那栏 朋友：要发票吗 你：小票留着就行
miscellaneous cost.example: Friend: How to claim this few dollars of odd change? You: Put it under miscellaneous cost. Friend: Need a receipt? You: Keep the slip.

miss.context: 你说好久没见老同学了，挺想他的，朋友问要不要约着见一面。
miss.translation: 朋友：你最近咋样 你：我挺想你的 miss you好久了 朋友：那周末聚聚 你：好 吃饭
miss.example: Friend: How've you been? You: I've missed you for a long time. Friend: Then meet up this weekend. You: Okay, dinner.

miss out.context: 你说上次特价票没抢到真可惜，朋友说错过了一次好机会。
miss out.translation: 朋友：那特价票抢到没 你：没抢着 miss out了 朋友：那下次早点蹲 你：对 手慢无
miss out.example: Friend: Did you get the discounted ticket? You: No, I missed out. Friend: Then be quicker next time. You: Right; slow is gone.

miss out on.context: 你说因为加班没去成那次聚会，朋友问你错过了什么好玩的。
miss out on.translation: 朋友：昨晚聚会好玩不 你：我没去 因为加班missed out on好多 朋友：他们玩游戏来着 你：哎呀亏大了
miss out on.example: Friend: Was last night's party fun? You: I didn't go, missed out on so much because of overtime. Friend: They played games. You: Oh no, missed it.

miss out on body language.context: 你说视频开会看不到对方表情，朋友说这容易错过很多肢体语言信息。
miss out on body language.translation: 朋友：线上沟通总觉得差点意思 你：miss out on body language 看不到表情 朋友：那还是见面好 你：是
miss out on body language.example: Friend: Online meetings feel lacking somehow. You: You miss out on body language, can't see expressions. Friend: Then meeting face to face is better. You: Right.

miss the point.context: 你说他答了半天没答到点上，朋友问你他到底想说什么。
miss the point.translation: 朋友：他到底在说啥 你：完全missed the point 没抓到重点 朋友：那我们再问一遍 你：对 直接点
miss the point.example: Friend: What is he even saying? You: He completely missed the point, didn't get the gist. Friend: Then ask again. You: Right; be direct.

missing piece.context: 你说拼图还差最后一块就完整了，朋友问你那丢的一块在哪。
missing piece.translation: 朋友：这拼图拼完了吗 你：就差the missing piece 找不着了 朋友：是不是掉地上了 你：找找沙发底下
missing piece.example: Friend: Is the puzzle done? You: Just missing one piece, can't find it. Friend: Did it fall on the floor? You: Check under the sofa.

mission control.context: 火箭发射直播里有个大屏幕指挥团队在监控，朋友说这就是地面控制中心。
mission control.translation: 朋友：那屋里好多人盯着屏幕 你：是mission control 指挥发射的 朋友：真紧张 你：盯着呢
mission control.example: Friend: So many people staring at screens in that room. You: It's mission control, running the launch. Friend: So tense. You: All watching.

mistaken identity.context: 你在街上把陌生人当成了老朋友，朋友笑说你这是认错人了。
mistaken identity.translation: 朋友：你咋跟人打招呼 你：我把他认成老同学了 原来是mistaken identity 朋友：尴尬不 你：是 道歉就好
mistaken identity.example: Friend: Why did you greet that stranger? You: I mistook him for an old friend, just mistaken identity. Friend: Awkward? You: Right; just apologise.

mix and match.context: 你买衣服时说上衣下装可以随便搭，朋友说这就是混搭穿法。
mix and match.translation: 朋友：这俩能配一起吗 你：当然 随便mix and match 朋友：那真自由 你：对 穿出自己的风格
mix and match.example: Friend: Can these two go together? You: Sure, just mix and match. Friend: That's freeing. You: Right; wear your own style.

mix patterns.context: 你说她家沙发靠垫花色都不一样，朋友问她是不是故意混搭图案。
mix patterns.translation: 朋友：你这靠垫花纹都不一样 你：我故意mix patterns 看着热闹 朋友：挺有个性 你：是 不单调
mix patterns.example: Friend: Your cushion patterns are all different. You: I deliberately mix patterns, looks lively. Friend: Quite a character. You: Right; not dull.

mix up with.context: 你说班里有两个同名同学，老师点名老把他们俩搞混，朋友问怎么分。
mix up with.translation: 朋友：俩都叫张伟 咋分 你：老mix them up with each other 朋友：那喊学号吧 你：对
mix up with.example: Friend: Two Zhang Weis, how to tell them? You: Keeps mixing them up with each other. Friend: Then call by student number. You: Right.

mix with.context: 你说他在公司里跟谁都聊得来，朋友问他是不是特别会交朋友。
mix with.translation: 朋友：他咋跟谁都熟 你：特别会mix with各种人 朋友：那真社交达人 你：是
mix with.example: Friend: Why does he get along with everyone? You: He really mixes with all sorts of people. Friend: Such a social butterfly. You: Right.

mixed feelings.context: 你说搬到新城市既开心又舍不得老家，朋友问你心情是不是挺复杂。
mixed feelings.translation: 朋友：搬家高兴吗 你：mixed feelings 有点舍不得老家 朋友：那也有新机会呀 你：是 五味杂陈
mixed feelings.example: Friend: Happy about moving? You: Mixed feelings; a bit sad to leave home. Friend: But new opportunities too. You: Right; bittersweet.

mixed-use development.context: 你说这新楼楼下是商场楼上是住宅，朋友问这是什么开发模式。
mixed-use development.translation: 朋友：这楼下面咋是商店 你：是mixed-use development 商住一体 朋友：那买东西方便 你：是 下楼就到
mixed-use development.example: Friend: Why are shops downstairs? You: It's a mixed-use development, commercial and residential. Friend: Then shopping's convenient. You: Right; downstairs.

moan about.context: 朋友坐公交一路吐槽司机开得慢，你说他怎么老抱怨。
moan about.translation: 朋友：这司机开得也太慢 你：你别老moan about这个了 赶紧坐地铁吧 朋友：行吧 真烦 你：地铁十几分钟就到 比这强
moan about.example: Friend: This driver's so slow. You: Stop moaning about it; just take the metro. Friend: Fine. Annoying. You: The metro gets there in ten minutes, way better.

mobile consumption.context: 你说现在大家都用手机听东西，朋友问这是不是说移动收听成主流了。
mobile consumption.translation: 朋友：你都在哪听播客 你：手机上 现在mobile consumption是主流 朋友：那电脑没人看了 你：少了
mobile consumption.example: Friend: Where do you listen to podcasts? You: On the phone; mobile consumption is the mainstream now. Friend: Then nobody uses computers? You: Fewer.

mock-up facility.context: 宇航员训练时会用一比一的模拟舱，朋友说这就是个仿真设施。
mock-up facility.translation: 朋友：他们咋在地面练飞船操作 你：用个mock-up facility 一比一仿真 朋友：那跟真的一样吗 你：尽量像
mock-up facility.example: Friend: How do they train in spaceflight on the ground? You: A mock-up facility, a one-to-one replica. Friend: Like the real thing? You: As close as possible.

mode of transport.context: 你问朋友上班都用什么交通方式，朋友说他骑车二十分钟就到。
mode of transport.translation: 朋友：你上班咋去 你：骑车 我这个mode of transport最快 朋友：那不淋雨吗 你：天气好就骑
mode of transport.example: Friend: How do you get to work? You: Cycling; my mode of transport is fastest. Friend: Doesn't it rain on you? You: Ride when weather's nice.

modelled on.context: 你说这栋老建筑是照着国外一个名建筑仿建的，朋友问你是不是很像。
modelled on.translation: 朋友：这楼咋跟照片里的一样 你：它modelled on那个名建筑 朋友：那就是仿的呗 你：是 但挺好看
modelled on.example: Friend: Why does this building look just like the photo? You: It's modelled on that famous building. Friend: So it's a copy? You: Right; but looks good.

moderate consumption.context: 医生说酒不是完全不能喝，关键是要适量，朋友问那喝多少合适。
moderate consumption.translation: 朋友：酒能喝吗 你：moderate consumption就行 别贪杯 朋友：那多少算适量 你：一天一小杯
moderate consumption.example: Friend: Can I drink? You: Moderate consumption is fine, don't overdo it. Friend: How much is moderate? You: One small glass a day.

modern devices.context: 你说现在老人都用上智能手机平板了，朋友问这些现代设备难不难学。
modern devices.translation: 朋友：你妈咋也会用视频通话 你：现在modern devices都简单 教两遍就会 朋友：那真方便 你：是 随时能看见
modern devices.example: Friend: How does your mom do video calls? You: Modern devices are simple now; teach twice and she gets it. Friend: That's convenient. You: Right; see each other anytime.

modern life.context: 你说现代生活离不开手机电脑，朋友聊起这些便利也带来的烦恼。
modern life.translation: 朋友：你一天不玩手机行不 你：modern life根本离不开 朋友：那也累 你：是 但回不去了
modern life.example: Friend: Can you go a day without your phone? You: Modern life can't do without it. Friend: It's tiring too. You: Right; but can't go back.

modern world.context: 你说现在出门扫码付款，朋友说这个现代世界真是方便又高效。
modern world.translation: 朋友：现在出门带现金不 你：不用了 这modern world手机扫一下就行 朋友：那真省事 你：是 忘带手机才慌
modern world.example: Friend: Do you carry cash out now? You: No; in this modern world, just scan with the phone. Friend: So convenient. You: Right; only panic without the phone.

modest budget.context: 你预算不高还想出国玩，朋友说那就找便宜点的目的地。
modest budget.translation: 朋友：你这趟准备花多少 你：modest budget 就五千 朋友：那去近点的地方 你：对 东南亚就行
modest budget.example: Friend: How much are you budgeting for the trip? You: A modest budget, five thousand. Friend: Then go somewhere nearby. You: Right; Southeast Asia works.

monday blues.context: 周一早上你困得不想起床，朋友说这就是传说中的周一综合征。
monday blues.translation: 朋友：你咋又不想上班 你：周一嘛 有那种monday blues 朋友：熬过今天就好 你：是 周五最开心
monday blues.example: Friend: Why don't you want to work again? You: It's Monday, that Monday blues. Friend: Get through today. You: Right; Fridays are the best.

monetary cost.context: 你说帮忙不能光算钱，朋友问这件事的金钱成本到底有多少。
monetary cost.translation: 朋友：这事儿花了多少 你：monetary cost倒不高 主要费时间 朋友：那还行 你：是
monetary cost.example: Friend: How much did this cost? You: The monetary cost isn't high, it's the time. Friend: Then okay. You: Right.

monetary reward.context: 公司年会抽奖，朋友说除了荣誉，中奖还能拿到一笔实实在在的奖金。
monetary reward.translation: 朋友：一等奖是啥 你：有个monetary reward 五千块购物卡 朋友：那真不错 你：是 谁中谁开心
monetary reward.example: Friend: What's the first prize? You: A monetary reward, a five-thousand-yuan gift card. Friend: That's nice. You: Right; whoever wins is happy.

money pit.context: 你说那辆老修车钱比买车还贵，朋友说它就是个烧钱的无底洞。
money pit.translation: 朋友：你那车咋老坏 你：就是个money pit 修的钱都够买新的 朋友：那赶紧换 你：是 不想再填了
money pit.example: Friend: Why does your car keep breaking? You: It's a money pit; repairs cost more than a new one. Friend: Then replace it. You: Right; done filling it.

money-related conflict.context: 你说小两口老为钱吵架，朋友问他们这些矛盾主要因为什么。
money-related conflict.translation: 朋友：他俩老因为啥吵 你：都是money-related conflict 一个爱花一个爱攒 朋友：那得好好谈 你：对 钱最伤感情
money-related conflict.example: Friend: What do the couple keep fighting about? You: Money-related conflict, one loves spending one saves. Friend: Then they need to talk. You: Right; money hurts relationships most.

money-saving expert.context: 你说那同事特别会省钱，朋友问他是不是传说中的省钱达人。
money-saving expert.translation: 朋友：他咋天天中午带饭 你：人家是money-saving expert 各种优惠券 朋友：那一个月能省不少 你：是 真佩服
money-saving expert.example: Friend: Why does he bring lunch every day? You: He's a money-saving expert, all sorts of coupons. Friend: Then saves a lot a month. You: Right; really admire.

monitor workload.context: 你说老板盯紧大家工作量，朋友问公司是不是在防过劳。
monitor workload.translation: 朋友：老板咋老问忙不忙 你：在monitor workload 怕大家累倒 朋友：那还挺人性 你：是 别硬撑
monitor workload.example: Friend: Why does the boss keep asking if we're busy? You: Monitoring workload, afraid of burnout. Friend: That's humane. You: Right; don't push through.

monthly outgoings.context: 你说算一算每月房租吃饭网费，朋友问你一个月到底要花多少。
monthly outgoings.translation: 朋友：你一个月花多少钱 你：算上monthly outgoings 得四五千 朋友：那能存下吗 你：省着点能
monthly outgoings.example: Friend: How much do you spend a month? You: With the monthly outgoings, four to five thousand. Friend: Then can you save? You: Skrimp and you can.

monthly pay packet.context: 朋友刚发工资就请客，你说他这一个月工资到账还挺快。
monthly pay packet.translation: 朋友：今晚我请 发工资啦 你：你这monthly pay packet刚到账就花 朋友：犒劳一下自己 你：别月中就穷
monthly pay packet.example: Friend: My treat tonight, payday. You: You spend your monthly pay packet as soon as it lands. Friend: Reward myself. You: Don't be broke mid-month.

mood booster.context: 你说心情不好时吃块巧克力就好点，朋友说甜食真是提心情的好东西。
mood booster.translation: 朋友：你咋一难过就吃蛋糕 你：它是我的mood booster 吃完就开心 朋友：那别吃太多 你：偶尔没事
mood booster.example: Friend: Why do you eat cake when you're down? You: It's my mood booster, happy after. Friend: Don't eat too much. You: Once in a while, fine.

mood regulation.context: 你说生气时先冷静，朋友问这是不是一种情绪管理能力。
mood regulation.translation: 朋友：你咋不发火了 你：学着做mood regulation 先深呼吸 朋友：那真管用 你：是 不伤人伤己
mood regulation.example: Friend: Why don't you flare up? You: Learning mood regulation, breathe first. Friend: Does it really work? You: Right; no harm to anyone.

mood regulator.context: 你说散步听音乐能让人心情平稳，朋友说音乐真是个好东西。
mood regulator.translation: 朋友：你咋一焦虑就听歌 你：音乐是好的mood regulator 一听就静下来 朋友：那真方便 你：是 随身带
mood regulator.example: Friend: Why do you listen to music when anxious? You: Music's a good mood regulator; calms right down. Friend: That's convenient. You: Right; always on hand.

mood swing.context: 你说她一会儿开心一会儿难过，朋友问她是不是情绪起伏特别大。
mood swing.translation: 朋友：她咋一会儿哭一会儿笑 你：mood swing特别大 朋友：那得多关心 你：是 别刺激她
mood swing.example: Friend: Why does she cry then laugh? You: Big mood swings. Friend: Then care more. You: Right; don't trigger her.

moral maze.context: 你说朋友问了个两难问题，朋友说这真是让人纠结的道德难题。
moral maze.translation: 朋友：这事到底该帮谁 你：两难啊 是个moral maze 怎么选都有问题 朋友：那慢慢想 你：对 别急
moral maze.example: Friend: Whom should I help? You: It's a dilemma, a moral maze, any choice has issues. Friend: Then think slowly. You: Right; no rush.

more likely.context: 你说睡够了第二天更不容易出错，朋友问是不是这样。
more likely.translation: 朋友：早睡真的有用吗 你：睡够了more likely不犯错 朋友：那今晚早点睡 你：是 别熬夜
more likely.example: Friend: Does sleeping early really help? You: Well-rested, you're more likely to avoid mistakes. Friend: Then sleep early tonight. You: Right; no late nights.

more of.context: 你说这工作与其说是赚钱，不如说是图个开心，朋友问你怎么想的。
more of.translation: 朋友：你这工作工资不高 你：它more of一个爱好 不是为了钱 朋友：那真自在 你：是 开心最重要
more of.example: Friend: Your job doesn't pay well. You: It's more of a hobby, not for the money. Friend: That's free. You: Right; happiness first.

more of a say on.context: 你说新制度让一线员工更有发言权了，朋友问这有啥好处。
more of a say on.translation: 朋友：新制度改了啥 你：让员工have more of a say on怎么干活 朋友：那大家更积极 你：是
more of a say on.example: Friend: What changed in the new rule? You: Employees have more of a say on how to work. Friend: Then more motivated. You: Right.

more often.context: 你说自己现在比以前更常运动了，朋友问你多久锻炼一次。
more often.translation: 朋友：你最近锻炼挺勤 你：比以前more often 一周三次 朋友：那身体好吧 你：是 精神多了
more often.example: Friend: You exercise more often lately. You: More often than before, three times a week. Friend: Then healthier? You: Right; more energetic.

more than happy.context: 朋友找你帮忙，你说非常乐意，随时开口都行。
more than happy.translation: 朋友：能帮我搬个家吗 你：I'm more than happy to帮你 啥时候 朋友：周六上午 你：行 我准时到
more than happy.example: Friend: Can you help me move? You: I'm more than happy to, when? Friend: Saturday morning. You: Okay, I'll be there.

more than just.context: 你说这道菜不只是好吃，还让人想起外婆做的饭，朋友问这是啥菜。
more than just.translation: 朋友：这菜有啥特别 你：它is more than just好吃 还让人想家 朋友：那你外婆常做吗 你：对 怀念那个味
more than just.example: Friend: What's special about this dish? You: It's more than just tasty, it makes me miss home. Friend: Did your grandma often cook it? You: Right; miss that taste.

more to do with.context: 你说他失败不是因为笨，更多是因为没准备，朋友问你怎么看。
more to do with.translation: 朋友：他咋没考上 你：这more to do with没准备好 不是能力问题 朋友：那下次再来 你：对 这次好好准备
more to do with.example: Friend: Why didn't he pass? You: It has more to do with not preparing, not ability. Friend: Then next time. You: Right; prepare well.

morning person.context: 你说自己天不亮就醒，朋友问你是不是那种天生早起的人。
morning person.translation: 朋友：你咋七点就自然醒 你：我是个morning person 早起舒服 朋友：我可是夜猫子 你：哈哈 习惯不同
morning person.example: Friend: Why do you wake at seven naturally? You: I'm a morning person; waking early feels great. Friend: I'm a night owl. You: Haha, different habits.

most notably.context: 你说这节目有很多优点，最突出的是它特别真实，朋友问你最喜欢哪点。
most notably.translation: 朋友：这节目好看在哪 你：most notably它特别真实 不演 朋友：那确实难得 你：是
most notably.example: Friend: What makes this show good? You: Most notably, it's really authentic, not acting. Friend: That's rare. You: Right.

most often.context: 你说早上通勤最堵的时候是八点，朋友问你一般几点出门。
most often.translation: 朋友：几点最堵 你：most often八点那阵 朋友：那你几点走 你：提前一小时避开
most often.example: Friend: When is traffic worst? You: Most often around eight. Friend: Then when do you leave? You: An hour earlier to avoid it.

mother nature.context: 你说这场雨下得特别及时，朋友说这就是大自然的馈赠。
mother nature.translation: 朋友：这雨下得太及时了 你：mother nature知道庄稼旱了 朋友：那明天该出太阳了 你：是 雨后天晴
mother nature.example: Friend: This rain came just in time. You: Mother nature knew the crops were dry. Friend: Then sun tomorrow? You: Right; clear after rain.

mother tongue.context: 你说他在国外长大，母语其实是英语，朋友问他中文好不好。
mother tongue.translation: 朋友：他中文说得真好 你：他mother tongue是英语 朋友：那中文咋这么溜 你：家里也说
mother tongue.example: Friend: His Chinese is so good. You: His mother tongue is English. Friend: Then why such fluent Chinese? You: They speak it at home too.

motion sickness.context: 你一坐车就晕，朋友说你这就是晕车，得提前吃药。
motion sickness.translation: 朋友：你咋上车就难受 你：我有motion sickness 一坐长途就晕 朋友：那提前吃药 你：对 上车就睡
motion sickness.example: Friend: Why do you feel sick on the bus? You: I have motion sickness, long rides make me dizzy. Friend: Then take medicine in advance. You: Right; sleep on board.

motor function.context: 医生说爷爷中风后要复健，朋友问他现在手脚活动能力恢复得怎样。
motor function.translation: 朋友：爷爷现在能动了吗 你：在练motor function 慢慢恢复中 朋友：那能走路吗 你：扶着能走两步
motor function.example: Friend: Can Grandpa move now? You: Working on his motor function, recovering slowly. Friend: Then can he walk? You: A few steps with support.

motor skill.context: 你说小孩学骑车要练很久，朋友问这练的是哪种能力。
motor skill.translation: 朋友：他咋老学不会骑车 你：在练motor skill 协调性 朋友：那得多练 你：是 摔几次就会了
motor skill.example: Friend: Why can't he learn to bike? You: Practicing a motor skill, coordination. Friend: Then more practice. You: Right; a few falls and he gets it.

mountain biker.context: 朋友周末去山里骑车，你说他真是个资深的山地车手。
mountain biker.translation: 朋友：你周末又骑车去哪 你：去山里 我是个mountain biker 朋友：那挺刺激 你：是 注意安全
mountain biker.example: Friend: Where are you cycling again this weekend? You: The hills; I'm a mountain biker. Friend: That's exciting. You: Right; stay safe.

mountain range.context: 你站在山顶远眺，远处一排雪山连绵不绝，朋友说那是一整条大山脉。
mountain range.translation: 朋友：远处那一片白白的是啥 你：是一整道mountain range 全是雪山 朋友：那也太壮观 你：是 连绵不断
mountain range.example: Friend: What's that white stretch in the distance? You: A whole mountain range, all snow peaks. Friend: So magnificent. You: Right; goes on and on.

move apart.context: 你说老朋友毕业后各奔东西，朋友问他们俩现在还联系不。
move apart.translation: 朋友：他俩以前不是最好吗 你：毕业后就move apart了 各自忙 朋友：那挺可惜 你：是 渐行渐远
move apart.example: Friend: Weren't they best once? You: They moved apart after graduation, each busy. Friend: That's a shame. You: Right; drifting apart.

move around.context: 你说飞机上别老坐着，每隔一小时起来走一走，朋友问这是为啥。
move around.translation: 朋友：坐飞机老坐着腿酸 你：得时不时move around一下 促进循环 朋友：那起来走走 你：对 别一直坐
move around.example: Friend: My legs ache sitting on the plane. You: Move around now and then, boosts circulation. Friend: Then get up. You: Right; don't sit still.

move away from.context: 你说为了安静，朋友决定离开市中心，搬到郊区去住，朋友问他为啥。
move away from.translation: 朋友：你咋想搬郊区 你：move away from市中心 太吵太堵 朋友：那上班远吧 你：能接受
move away from.example: Friend: Why move to the suburbs? You: To move away from the city center, too noisy and jammed. Friend: Then commute is far. You: Worth it.

move forward.context: 你说项目卡住了别老停在这，得往前推进，朋友问下一步咋办。
move forward.translation: 朋友：这卡了三天了 你：别停 继续move forward 先做能做的 朋友：那剩下的咋办 你：边做边解
move forward.example: Friend: Stuck for three days. You: Don't stop, keep moving forward, do what we can first. Friend: Then the rest? You: Solve as we go.

move on to.context: 你说这题讲完了，咱们接着讲下一个知识点，朋友说那开始吧。
move on to.translation: 朋友：这题讲完啦 你：那move on to下一个知识点 朋友：今天讲多少 你：再讲两节
move on to.example: Friend: Done with this problem? You: Then move on to the next topic. Friend: How much today? You: Two more sections.

move out.context: 你说孩子大学毕业要搬出去单住，朋友问他找好房子没。
move out.translation: 朋友：你儿子要搬出去啊 你：长大了 move out自己住 朋友：那舍得吗 你：是 总要独立
move out.example: Friend: Your son's moving out? You: Grown up, moving out on his own. Friend: Can you bear it? You: Right; he needs independence.

move over.context: 地铁上人挤人，你请旁边的人往里让一让，朋友说借过一下。
move over.translation: 朋友：能让我过去吗 你：你往里move over一下 我要下车 朋友：不好意思 让让 你：谢谢
move over.example: Friend: Can I get through? You: Move over a bit, I need to get off. Friend: Sorry, pardon. You: Thanks.

move sb in mysterious ways.context: 你说有些机缘巧合，就像命运自有它的安排，朋友问你怎么突然感慨。
move sb in mysterious ways.translation: 朋友：你俩咋又碰上了 你：真巧 命运总work in mysterious ways 朋友：那也是缘分 你：是
move sb in mysterious ways.example: Friend: How did you two run into each other again? You: What a coincidence; fate moves in mysterious ways. Friend: It's destiny. You: Right.

movement signature.context: 警察看监控就能认出某人，朋友说每个人走路姿势都有特点。
movement signature.translation: 朋友：警察咋一眼认出他 你：每个人movement signature不同 走路姿势 朋友：这也太神了 你：是 认步不认错
movement signature.example: Friend: How did police recognize him at a glance? You: Each has a different movement signature, the way they walk. Friend: Amazing. You: Right; by the gait.

moves from.context: 你说这个地铁站从一号口换到三号口，朋友问这线路怎么走。
moves from.translation: 朋友：这号线咋换 你：它moves from这里 再走到那头 朋友：远不远 你：走五分钟
moves from.example: Friend: How do I change lines? You: It moves from here, then walk to the other end. Friend: Far? You: Five minutes.

movie theatre.context: 你说周末想去看新上映的电影，朋友问去哪家电影院。
movie theatre.translation: 朋友：周末看电影不 你：去那家movie theatre 屏幕大 朋友：几点场次 你：七点那场
movie theatre.example: Friend: Wanna see a movie this weekend? You: Go to that movie theatre, big screen. Friend: What time? You: The seven o'clock show.

moving away.context: 你说老邻居搬走去外地了，朋友问那房子现在空着没。
moving away.translation: 朋友：隔壁那家最近咋没声了 你：moving away搬去外地了 朋友：那可惜 挺熟的 你：是 有空打电话
moving away.example: Friend: Why is next door quiet lately? You: They're moving away to another city. Friend: That's a shame, we knew them. You: Right; call sometime.

moving back.context: 你说在大城市漂了几年后，朋友决定回老家发展，朋友问他为啥。
moving back.translation: 朋友：你咋不在大城市待了 你：moving back回老家 压力小 朋友：那工作呢 你：家里找好了
moving back.example: Friend: Why not stay in the big city? You: Moving back to my hometown, less pressure. Friend: Then work? You: Found one at home.

moving image.context: 你说比起照片，动态的影像更能记录生活，朋友问你是不是偏爱拍视频。
moving image.translation: 朋友：你咋老拍视频不拍照 你：moving image更真实 有声音有动作 朋友：那占内存 你：值得
moving image.example: Friend: Why do you shoot videos, not photos? You: Moving images are more real, with sound and motion. Friend: Then they take memory. You: Worth it.

much as.context: 你说虽然很想留下来，但明天还得早起，朋友说那你先回去吧。
much as.translation: 朋友：再坐会儿呗 你：much as我想多聊 明天还得早起 朋友：那行 改天再聚 你：好
much as.example: Friend: Stay a bit longer. You: Much as I'd love to chat more, I'm up early tomorrow. Friend: Okay, another time. You: Okay.

much less.context: 你说这题大人都不会，更别说小孩了，朋友问是不是太难了。
much less.translation: 朋友：这题孩子能做吗 你：大人都不会 much less小孩 朋友：那超纲了 你：是 太深了
much less.example: Friend: Can the kid do this? You: Adults can't, much less a child. Friend: Then it's beyond the syllabus. You: Right; too deep.

much like.context: 你说这只小狗的性格跟它妈妈一模一样，朋友说真是像极了。
much like.translation: 朋友：这小狗跟它妈一样皮 你：it's much like its mother 又活泼又馋 朋友：那真可爱 你：是
much like.example: Friend: This pup's as naughty as its mom. You: It's much like its mother, lively and greedy. Friend: So cute. You: Right.

mucous membrane.context: 医生说嗓子那层黏膜发炎了，朋友问这病是怎么引起的。
mucous membrane.translation: 朋友：医生说你哪发炎了 你：嗓子那层mucous membrane 说话太多 朋友：那少说话 你：对 多喝水
mucous membrane.example: Friend: Where did the doctor say is inflamed? You: The mucous membrane in my throat, from talking too much. Friend: Then talk less. You: Right; drink water.

multiplayer teamwork.context: 你说这个游戏特别讲究团队配合，朋友问大家怎么分工。
multiplayer teamwork.translation: 朋友：这游戏咋玩 你：靠multiplayer teamwork 有人输出有人奶 朋友：那得语音配合 你：是 不配合赢不了
multiplayer teamwork.example: Friend: How do you play this game? You: It's all about multiplayer teamwork, some deal damage some heal. Friend: Then need voice chat. You: Right; no teamwork, no win.

munch on.context: 你上班时爱边干活边嚼点零食，朋友说你咋老在吃东西。
munch on.translation: 朋友：你嘴里老嚼啥呢 你：munch on点瓜子 边干活边吃 朋友：那能专心吗 你：放松一下
munch on.example: Friend: What are you munching on? You: Munching on sunflower seeds while working. Friend: Can you focus? You: Just relaxing.

muscle atrophy.context: 医生说长期卧床不动会导致肌肉萎缩，朋友问怎么预防。
muscle atrophy.translation: 朋友：爷爷躺久了腿细了 你：有点muscle atrophy 得帮他活动 朋友：那咋练 你：被动抬腿
muscle atrophy.example: Friend: Grandpa's legs thinned lying in bed. You: Some muscle atrophy; need to move him. Friend: How? You: Passively lift his legs.

muscle cramp.context: 你游泳时小腿突然抽住了，朋友说这是抽筋，得赶紧上岸拉伸。
muscle cramp.translation: 朋友：你咋突然上岸了 你：小腿muscle cramp了 抽住了 朋友：快拉伸一下 你：对 揉一揉
muscle cramp.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly get out? You: A muscle cramp in my calf, seized up. Friend: Stretch it now. You: Right; rub it.

muscle development.context: 你说举铁要循序渐进，朋友问怎么练才能让肌肉长得匀称。
muscle development.translation: 朋友：咋练肌肉才好看 你：注意muscle development 别只练胸 朋友：那全身都练 你：对 均衡
muscle development.example: Friend: How to build nice muscles? You: Watch muscle development, don't just train chest. Friend: Then train whole body. You: Right; balanced.

muscle group.context: 你说练不同动作练的是不同肌肉群，朋友问今天练哪。
muscle group.translation: 朋友：今天练哪儿 你：练背这个muscle group 朋友：那明天呢 你：练腿
muscle group.example: Friend: What are we training today? You: This muscle group—back. Friend: And tomorrow? You: Legs.

muscle mass.context: 你说年纪大了肌肉会流失，朋友问怎么保持肌肉量。
muscle mass.translation: 朋友：你咋还坚持举铁 你：保住muscle mass 不然老了没劲 朋友：那真有用 你：是
muscle mass.example: Friend: Why keep lifting? You: To keep muscle mass, else weak when old. Friend: It really helps. You: Right.

muscle soreness.context: 你练完第二天浑身发酸，朋友说这是正常的肌肉酸痛。
muscle soreness.translation: 朋友：你咋走路都别扭 你：昨天练太狠 muscle soreness 朋友：拉伸就好 你：是 明天就不酸了
muscle soreness.example: Friend: Why are you walking funny? You: Trained too hard yesterday, muscle soreness. Friend: Stretch and it'll be fine. You: Right; sore's gone tomorrow.

muscle stiffness.context: 你早上起来脖子转不动，朋友说这是落枕，肌肉僵硬了。
muscle stiffness.translation: 朋友：你脖子咋僵了 你：落枕了 muscle stiffness 朋友：热敷一下 你：对 过两天就好
muscle stiffness.example: Friend: Why is your neck stiff? You: Slept wrong, muscle stiffness. Friend: Put a warm compress. You: Right; fine in a couple days.

muscle strain.context: 你搬箱子闪了腰，医生说是肌肉拉伤，得歇几天。
muscle strain.translation: 朋友：你腰咋了 你：搬东西闪了 muscle strain 朋友：那别再搬重的 你：对 养几天
muscle strain.example: Friend: What's wrong with your back? You: Strained it moving stuff, a muscle strain. Friend: Then don't lift heavy. You: Right; rest a few days.

muscle strength.context: 你说他坚持举铁半年，胳膊明显有劲了，朋友问是不是练出了肌肉。
muscle strength.translation: 朋友：他胳膊咋粗了 你：练出muscle strength了 朋友：那要多久 你：坚持半年
muscle strength.example: Friend: Why did his arms get bigger? You: Built up muscle strength. Friend: How long? You: Six months of sticking to it.

muscular strength.context: 你说搬重物要靠核心发力，朋友问怎么练才有这力气。
muscular strength.translation: 朋友：他咋搬那么轻松 你：muscular strength强 核心好 朋友：那我也练 你：从平板支撑开始
muscular strength.example: Friend: Why does he lift so easily? You: Strong muscular strength, good core. Friend: Then I'll train too. You: Start with planks.

music therapy.context: 医院里医生用音乐帮老人舒缓情绪，朋友说这就是音乐疗法。
music therapy.translation: 朋友：医院咋还放歌 你：是music therapy 帮病人放松 朋友：那真温馨 你：是 比药温柔
music therapy.example: Friend: Why is the hospital playing music? You: It's music therapy, soothing patients. Friend: So warm. You: Right; gentler than pills.

music to your ears.context: 你说考试过了，朋友说这对你来说真是天大的好消息。
music to your ears.translation: 朋友：我告诉你个好消息 你：啥呀 朋友：你考试过了 你：这真是music to my ears 太好了
music to your ears.example: Friend: I've got good news. You: What? Friend: You passed the exam. You: That's music to my ears, great.

musical ear.context: 你说他没学过乐理，一听就能听出哪个音跑了，朋友说他天生有音乐耳朵。
musical ear.translation: 朋友：他咋一耳就听出没调 你：有副musical ear 朋友：那真有天赋 你：是 羡慕
musical ear.example: Friend: How does he hear the off-key note instantly? You: He has a musical ear. Friend: Such talent. You: Right; jealous.

musical instrument.context: 你说孩子想学钢琴，朋友问家里要不要买个乐器。
musical instrument.translation: 朋友：孩子想学啥 你：想学个musical instrument 钢琴 朋友：那买架电钢琴先试试 你：对 别浪费
musical instrument.example: Friend: What does the kid want to learn? You: A musical instrument, the piano. Friend: Then get a digital piano to try. You: Right; don't waste.

musical notation.context: 你说学音乐得先认五线谱，朋友问那一串符号是什么。
musical notation.translation: 朋友：这纸上画的小蝌蚪是啥 你：musical notation 就是乐谱 朋友：那难学吗 你：练练就会
musical notation.example: Friend: What are those tadpoles on the paper? You: Musical notation, the sheet music. Friend: Is it hard to learn? You: Practice and you'll get it.

musical preference.context: 你说大家听歌口味差别很大，朋友问你最爱听什么类型。
musical preference.translation: 朋友：你最爱听啥歌 你：每个人musical preference不同 我爱听民谣 朋友：我就爱摇滚 你：各有所爱
musical preference.example: Friend: What do you love listening to? You: Musical preference differs; I love folk. Friend: I love rock. You: To each their own.

musical therapy.context: 你说医院用音乐帮病人放松，朋友问这是不是一种辅助疗法。
musical therapy.translation: 朋友：放歌能治病啊 你：算musical therapy 帮情绪舒缓 朋友：那真神奇 你：是 辅助治疗
musical therapy.example: Friend: Can music treat illness? You: It's musical therapy, soothing emotions. Friend: How magical. You: Right; a complement.

musical training.context: 你说学乐器的小孩脑子更灵活，朋友问这是为什么。
musical training.translation: 朋友：学琴真能让人变聪明 你：musical training锻炼大脑 朋友：那要从小吗 你：早点开始好
musical training.example: Friend: Does learning an instrument make kids smarter? You: Musical training works the brain. Friend: Then start young? You: Earlier is better.

must-have items.context: 你说出门旅行就那几样必带的，朋友问都有啥。
must-have items.translation: 朋友：你出差都带啥 你：护照充电器这几样must-have items 朋友：那药要带吗 你：常备药也带上
must-have items.example: Friend: What do you pack on a trip? You: Passport, charger, those must-have items. Friend: Then medicine? You: Bring common meds too.

must-see sights.context: 你说第一次到北京，那几个著名景点一个都不能错过，朋友问必去哪些。
must-see sights.translation: 朋友：来北京去哪 你：故宫长城这几个must-see sights 朋友：那得玩几天 你：三天差不多
must-see sights.example: Friend: Where to go in Beijing? You: The Forbidden City, the Wall, those must-see sights. Friend: How many days? You: About three.

mutual interest.context: 你说他俩能聊得来，是因为有共同的兴趣爱好，朋友问都喜欢啥。
mutual interest.translation: 朋友：他俩咋那么投缘 你：有mutual interest 都爱摄影 朋友：那真难得 你：是 有共同话题
mutual interest.example: Friend: Why do they click so well? You: A mutual interest, both love photography. Friend: That's rare. You: Right; common topics.

mutual trust.context: 你说合伙做生意最重要的是互相信任，朋友问怎么才能建立。
mutual trust.translation: 朋友：合伙生意最怕啥 你：没有mutual trust 互相猜忌 朋友：那怎么建 你：账上透明
mutual trust.example: Friend: What's the worst in a partnership? You: No mutual trust, suspicion. Friend: Then how to build it? You: Transparent accounts.

mutually beneficial relationship.context: 你说两家公司合作双赢，朋友问这种关系对双方有啥好处。
mutually beneficial relationship.translation: 朋友：他俩合作能长久吗 你：因为是mutually beneficial relationship 双赢 朋友：那挺好 你：是 都赚钱
mutually beneficial relationship.example: Friend: Will their partnership last? You: Because it's a mutually beneficial relationship, win-win. Friend: That's good. You: Right; both profit.

mystery box.context: 你说现在年轻人流行抽盲盒，朋友问这盒子里到底是啥。
mystery box.translation: 朋友：你排队买的啥 你：mystery box 盲盒 打开才知道 朋友：那刺激啊 你：是 抽到喜欢的就赚
mystery box.example: Friend: What are you queueing for? You: A mystery box, a blind box; open to know. Friend: That's thrilling. You: Right; win if you get the favorite.

nail bar.context: 周末你约朋友去做美甲，朋友说那家美甲店技术不错。
nail bar.translation: 朋友：周末一起做个指甲呗 你：去那家nail bar 手艺好 朋友：那约几点 你：下午两点
nail bar.example: Friend: Do nails together this weekend? You: Go to that nail bar, great skill. Friend: Then what time? You: Two p.m.

nap pod.context: 你说公司午休有个能躺平睡觉的舱，朋友说这待遇也太好了。
nap pod.translation: 朋友：你们公司还能午睡啊 你：有个nap pod 中午躺二十分钟 朋友：那真人性化 你：是 下午不困
nap pod.example: Friend: Your company lets you nap? You: There's a nap pod, lie down twenty minutes at noon. Friend: So humane. You: Right; not sleepy in the afternoon.

narcissistic personality disorder.context: 你说那种总觉得自己特别了不起、听不进别人话的人，医生说是种人格问题。
narcissistic personality disorder.translation: 朋友：他咋老觉得自己最牛 你：有点narcissistic personality disorder 朋友：那离远点 你：是 别刺激他
narcissistic personality disorder.example: Friend: Why does he always think he's the best? You: A bit of narcissistic personality disorder. Friend: Then stay away. You: Right; don't provoke him.

nasal sniff.context: 你感冒了不停抽鼻子，朋友递纸巾说你先擦擦。
nasal sniff.translation: 朋友：你咋老抽鼻子 你：感冒了 鼻子不通 朋友：拿纸巾擦擦 你：谢谢
nasal sniff.example: Friend: Why do you keep sniffing? You: Caught a cold, nose stuffed. Friend: Take a tissue. You: Thanks.

native language.context: 你说他在国外长大，但因为家里说中文，他母语其实是双语的，朋友问中文说得怎么样。
native language.translation: 朋友：他中文咋这么溜 你：native language有俩 中英都行 朋友：那真厉害 你：是 双语环境
native language.example: Friend: Why is his Chinese so fluent? You: He has two native languages, both Chinese and English. Friend: So impressive. You: Right; bilingual home.

natural antidepressant.context: 医生说运动能让人分泌快乐物质，是天然的抗抑郁方法，朋友问这靠谱不。
natural antidepressant.translation: 朋友：跑步真能让人开心 你：它是天然的natural antidepressant 朋友：那比吃药强 你：是 还健康
natural antidepressant.example: Friend: Can running really make you happy? You: It's a natural antidepressant. Friend: Then better than pills. You: Right; healthier.

natural beauty.context: 你说她不化妆也好看，朋友说这就是那种不经修饰的自然美。
natural beauty.translation: 朋友：她咋不化妆也那么好看 你：有种natural beauty 朋友：那真难得 你：是 清水出芙蓉
natural beauty.example: Friend: Why is she pretty without makeup? You: She has a natural beauty. Friend: That's rare. You: Right; pure and fresh.
