natural daylight.context: 你说办公室别老开台灯，多让阳光照进来对眼睛好，朋友问为啥。
natural daylight.translation: 朋友：你咋老拉窗帘 你：多晒natural daylight 比灯好 朋友：那眼睛舒服 你：是 还补钙
natural daylight.example: Friend: Why do you open the curtains? You: Let in more natural daylight, better than lamps. Friend: Then eyes feel better. You: Right; also vitamin D.

natural disasters.context: 新闻里又地震又洪水，朋友说这些都是让人无可奈何的自然灾害。
natural disasters.translation: 朋友：这世界咋老出事 你：各种natural disasters 没办法 朋友：那能预防吗 你：预警得做
natural disasters.example: Friend: Why does the world keep having disasters? You: All sorts of natural disasters, out of our hands. Friend: Then prevent? You: Early warning helps.

natural elements.context: 你说这公园设计得有山有水有石，把各种自然元素都搬进来了，朋友说像在城市里见山水。
natural elements.translation: 朋友：这公园设计得真讲究 你：融入了各种natural elements 山水石 朋友：那像在野外 你：是 闹中取静
natural elements.example: Friend: This park is designed so well. You: It blends natural elements—water, hills, rocks. Friend: Like being in the wild. You: Right; quiet in the bustle.

natural extract.context: 你说这瓶护肤品标着植物提取，朋友问那是不是纯天然的。
natural extract.translation: 朋友：这护肤品成分安全不 你：主打natural extract 植物提取 朋友：那敏感肌能用吗 你：应该可以
natural extract.example: Friend: Is this skincare safe? You: It features natural extract, plant-based. Friend: Then can sensitive skin use it? You: Should be okay.

natural fire prevention.context: 你说那片林区定期清理枯枝，朋友说这是在做天然的防火措施。
natural fire prevention.translation: 朋友：工人在林子里剪啥 你：清理枯枝 做natural fire prevention 朋友：那防山火 你：对
natural fire prevention.example: Friend: What are workers trimming in the woods? You: Clearing deadwood for natural fire prevention. Friend: Then preventing wildfire. You: Right.

natural food reserve.context: 你说松鼠秋天就藏坚果，朋友说这就是它天生的储粮本能。
natural food reserve.translation: 朋友：松鼠咋老藏果子 你：是它的natural food reserve本能 朋友：那冬天就不愁了 你：是
natural food reserve.example: Friend: Why do squirrels keep hiding nuts? You: Their natural food reserve instinct. Friend: Then they're set for winter. You: Right.

natural habitat.context: 你说把动物放回野外才是它真正该待的地方，朋友问那是什么地方。
natural habitat.translation: 朋友：这熊该放哪儿 你：放回它的natural habitat 朋友：那它就能活了 你：是
natural habitat.example: Friend: Where should this bear go? You: Back to its natural habitat. Friend: Then it can live. You: Right.

natural high.context: 你说跑完步那种浑身通透的感觉特别爽，朋友问这是不是就是天然的快感。
natural high.translation: 朋友：你咋那么爱跑步 你：跑完有那种natural high 特别爽 朋友：那比啥都强 你：是
natural high.example: Friend: Why do you love running so much? You: After a run there's that natural high, so good. Friend: Better than anything. You: Right.

natural instinct.context: 你说小猫天生就会抓老鼠，朋友说这是它的本能。
natural instinct.translation: 朋友：小猫没学过咋会抓虫 你：是它的natural instinct 朋友：那真天生 你：是
natural instinct.example: Friend: How does a kitten catch bugs without learning? You: Its natural instinct. Friend: Then it's born with it. You: Right.

natural leader.context: 你说他上学时大家就爱围着他转，朋友说他天生就是带头的料。
natural leader.translation: 朋友：他咋当领导那么顺 你：是个natural leader 朋友：那大家服他 你：是
natural leader.example: Friend: Why is he such a natural leader? You: He's a natural leader. Friend: Then people follow him. You: Right.

natural light.context: 你说拍照要找窗边，朋友说自然光打在脸上最好看。
natural light.translation: 朋友：这照片咋拍的 你：站窗边 用natural light拍的 朋友：那真柔和 你：是 别开闪光灯
natural light.example: Friend: How was this photo shot? You: By the window, with natural light. Friend: So soft. You: Right; no flash.

natural lighting.context: 你说新家装修把墙都开大窗，朋友说这样屋里采光特别好。
natural lighting.translation: 朋友：你家咋那么亮 你：全靠natural lighting 大落地窗 朋友：那真舒服 你：是 白天不用开灯
natural lighting.example: Friend: Why is your place so bright? You: All the natural lighting, floor-to-ceiling windows. Friend: So cozy. You: Right; no lights in the day.

natural look.context: 你说化妆要淡，朋友问那是不是走那种清透自然的风格。
natural look.translation: 朋友：你今天咋没怎么化妆 你：走natural look 清透 朋友：那真提气色 你：是
natural look.example: Friend: Why so little makeup today? You: Going for a natural look, sheer. Friend: It really lifts your skin. You: Right.

natural remedy.context: 你说感冒了多喝姜水，朋友说这就是老辈传下来的法子。
natural remedy.translation: 朋友：感冒了吃啥 你：煮点姜水喝 natural remedy 朋友：那管用吗 你：出出汗就好
natural remedy.example: Friend: What to do for a cold? You: Brew some ginger tea, a natural remedy. Friend: Does it work? You: Sweat it out.

natural resources.context: 你说水、空气、矿产都是大自然给的，朋友问这些宝贵的东西叫什么。
natural resources.translation: 朋友：这地底下挖的啥 你：都是natural resources 矿产水 朋友：那得省着用 你：对 别浪费
natural resources.example: Friend: What's dug out of the ground? You: All natural resources—minerals, water. Friend: Then use them sparingly. You: Right; don't waste.

natural rhythm.context: 你说人到点就困、到点就醒，朋友问这是不是就是身体自带的节律。
natural rhythm.translation: 朋友：你咋天天六点醒 你：跟着natural rhythm走 朋友：那真规律 你：是 身体自己的钟
natural rhythm.example: Friend: Why do you wake at six every day? You: Following the natural rhythm. Friend: So regular. You: Right; the body's own clock.

natural satellite.context: 你说月球是地球天然的卫星，朋友问那是怎么来的。
natural satellite.translation: 朋友：月亮是人造的吗 你：不是 是natural satellite 朋友：那绕地球转多久 你：一个月
natural satellite.example: Friend: Is the moon man-made? You: No, it's a natural satellite. Friend: Then how long to orbit Earth? You: A month.

natural scenery.context: 你说周末去郊外看山看水，朋友说这才叫真正的自然风光。
natural scenery.translation: 朋友：郊外好玩不 你：全是natural scenery 山清水秀 朋友：那真解压 你：是 比城里舒服
natural scenery.example: Friend: Is the countryside nice? You: All natural scenery, clear hills and water. Friend: So de-stressing. You: Right; better than the city.

natural selection.context: 你说长颈鹿脖子长是一代一代慢慢选出来的，朋友问这是什么道理。
natural selection.translation: 朋友：长颈鹿脖子咋那么长 你：是natural selection 一代代留下的 朋友：那真神奇 你：是 适者生存
natural selection.example: Friend: Why is the giraffe's neck so long? You: Natural selection, passed down through generations. Friend: So amazing. You: Right; survival of the fittest.

natural touch.context: 你说这床品摸起来像真丝一样顺滑，朋友问这是什么材质。
natural touch.translation: 朋友：这床单摸着真舒服 你：有那种natural touch 棉麻混纺的 朋友：那真亲肤 你：是
natural touch.example: Friend: This sheet feels so nice. You: It has that natural touch, cotton-linen blend. Friend: Really skin-friendly. You: Right.

natural urge.context: 你说看到可爱小猫就想逗一逗，朋友说这是人之常情的本能反应。
natural urge.translation: 朋友：你咋一见猫就走不动 你：看见可爱的就有natural urge想撸 朋友：哈哈 我也一样 你：是
natural urge.example: Friend: Why can't you walk past a cat? You: Seeing cute things gives a natural urge to pet them. Friend: Haha, me too. You: Right.

natural world.context: 你说周末去山里，朋友说这是去感受大自然的魅力。
natural world.translation: 朋友：周末去哪 你：去山里看看the natural world 朋友：那真放松 你：是 放空一下
natural world.example: Friend: Where this weekend? You: To the hills to see the natural world. Friend: So relaxing. You: Right; unwind.

nature lover.context: 你说他周末老往野外跑，朋友说他真是个热爱大自然的人。
nature lover.translation: 朋友：他周末又去山里了 你：他是个nature lover 闲不住 朋友：那真有活力 你：是
nature lover.example: Friend: He went to the hills again this weekend. You: He's a nature lover, can't stay put. Friend: So energetic. You: Right.

nature walk.context: 你说饭后去公园散步最舒服，朋友说这就是惬意的自然漫步。
nature walk.translation: 朋友：饭后走走不 你：去公园来个nature walk 消消食 朋友：那真舒服 你：是 吹风
nature walk.example: Friend: Walk after dinner? You: Take a nature walk in the park, digest. Friend: So nice. You: Right; feel the breeze.

navigation route.context: 你说开车跟着导航走，朋友问那条路线是怎么规划出来的。
navigation route.translation: 朋友：你咋不迷路 你：跟着navigation route走 朋友：那信号不好咋办 你：提前下好离线地图
navigation route.example: Friend: Why aren't you lost? You: Following the navigation route. Friend: Then if signal is bad? You: Download offline maps.

navigational system.context: 你说这车一上车就自动连导航，朋友说这系统挺方便。
navigational system.translation: 朋友：你这车真高级 你：navigational system一开就报路况 朋友：那真省心 你：是
navigational system.example: Friend: Your car is so high-tech. You: The navigational system reports traffic the moment it starts. Friend: So worry-free. You: Right.

need to.context: 你说学英语得天天练，朋友问那要花多少时间。
need to.translation: 朋友：学英语难吗 你：你need to天天坚持 朋友：那我每天半小时行不 你：行 坚持就行
need to.example: Friend: Is learning English hard? You: You need to stick with it daily. Friend: Then half an hour a day? You: Fine; consistency counts.

negative bias.context: 你说人容易先看到坏的一面，朋友问这是不是一种心理偏见。
negative bias.translation: 朋友：你咋老先往坏处想 你：是那种negative bias 天性 朋友：那得主动往好处看 你：对
negative bias.example: Friend: Why do you always expect the worst first? You: It's a negative bias, our nature. Friend: Then actively look on the bright side. You: Right.

negative effect.context: 你说熬夜对身体不好，朋友问具体有什么坏处。
negative effect.translation: 朋友：熬夜真的伤身体啊 你：有negative effect 免疫力下降 朋友：那早点睡 你：对
negative effect.example: Friend: Does staying up really harm you? You: It has a negative effect, lowers immunity. Friend: Then sleep early. You: Right.

negative emotion.context: 你说难过时别憋着，朋友说把负面情绪说出来会好受些。
negative emotion.translation: 朋友：你咋最近话少了 你：攒了好多negative emotion 朋友：说出来 我听着 你：好
negative emotion.example: Friend: Why so quiet lately? You: Loaded with negative emotions. Friend: Talk it out, I'm listening. You: Okay.

negative experience.context: 你说那次面试失败挺打击人，但也是次宝贵经历，朋友问你怎么走出来的。
negative experience.translation: 朋友：那次失败让你难受吧 你：是个negative experience 但学到不少 朋友：那值了 你：是
negative experience.example: Friend: That failure hit you hard. You: A negative experience, but I learned a lot. Friend: Then worth it. You: Right.

negative feeling.context: 你说被人误解时那种难受的感觉，朋友问你现在还记不记得。
negative feeling.translation: 朋友：被人误解啥感觉 你：那种negative feeling 堵得慌 朋友：那现在呢 你：想开了
negative feeling.example: Friend: What's it like to be misunderstood? You: That negative feeling, a lump. Friend: And now? You: Let it go.

negative impact.context: 你说交通噪音对睡眠影响大，朋友问住在路边是不是不好。
negative impact.translation: 朋友：你家住路边吵不吵 你：对睡眠有negative impact 朋友：那咋睡 你：装隔音窗
negative impact.example: Friend: Is it noisy living by the road? You: It has a negative impact on sleep. Friend: Then how do you sleep? You: Soundproof windows.

negative leap second.context: 老师讲钟表偶尔会多调一秒，朋友说这就是闰秒，问正负什么意思。
negative leap second.translation: 朋友：啥叫闰秒 你：钟慢了就加一秒 叫negative leap second 朋友：那真精密 你：是 对时间较真
negative leap second.example: Friend: What's a leap second? You: When the clock lags we add a second, a negative leap second. Friend: So precise. You: Right; obsessed with time.

negative mood.context: 你说她最近情绪不高，朋友问要不要约她出来散散心。
negative mood.translation: 朋友：她今天好像不开心 你：有点negative mood 朋友：那约她出来吃饭 你：对 让她开心点
negative mood.example: Friend: She seems unhappy today. You: In a negative mood. Friend: Then ask her out for dinner. You: Right; cheer her up.

negative response.context: 你说这个提案被老板一口否了，朋友问他是不是给了个反对的回应。
negative response.translation: 朋友：老板同意那方案没 你：给了个negative response 直接否了 朋友：那得改 你：是 再想想
negative response.example: Friend: Did the boss approve the plan? You: Gave a negative response, rejected it outright. Friend: Then revise. You: Right; rethink.

negative thought.context: 你说考试前别老担心自己考砸，朋友说这种消极想法要不得。
negative thought.translation: 朋友：我好怕考不过 你：别老有这种negative thought 朋友：那咋调整 你：多复习就有底
negative thought.example: Friend: I'm so afraid of failing. You: Stop having that negative thought. Friend: Then how to adjust? You: More revision gives confidence.

negativity bias.context: 你说人天生就爱记住坏事，朋友问这是不是叫什么负面偏见。
negativity bias.translation: 朋友：咋坏事记得比好事清 你：这叫negativity bias 大脑天生这样 朋友：那多记点开心的 你：对
negativity bias.example: Friend: Why do bad things stick better than good? You: That's the negativity bias, how the brain's wired. Friend: Then remember more happy things. You: Right.

negotiate pay.context: 你说跳槽前得先谈好工资，朋友问你怎么跟新老板开这个口。
negotiate pay.translation: 朋友：你新工作工资咋定 你：得主动negotiate pay 别不好意思 朋友：那咋谈 你：报个合理区间
negotiate pay.example: Friend: How's your new salary set? You: Negotiate pay proactively, don't be shy. Friend: Then how? You: Quote a reasonable range.

neighbours from hell.context: 你说楼上邻居天天半夜蹦迪，朋友说这简直是极品邻居。
neighbours from hell.translation: 朋友：你楼上咋那么吵 你：是neighbours from hell 半夜还蹦 朋友：那投诉 你：对 找物业
neighbours from hell.example: Friend: Why is upstairs so noisy? You: Neighbours from hell, partying at midnight. Friend: Then complain. You: Right; call the management.

nervous system.context: 医生说这种药是作用于全身神经系统的，朋友问那跟什么有关。
nervous system.translation: 朋友：这药治啥的 你：作用于nervous system 帮神经放松 朋友：那有副作用吗 你：会犯困
nervous system.example: Friend: What does this drug treat? You: It works on the nervous system, calming the nerves. Friend: Any side effects? You: Drowsy.

nervous tension.context: 你说马上要上台紧张得不行，朋友说这是神经绷太紧了。
nervous tension.translation: 朋友：你手咋在抖 你：上台前那种nervous tension 压不住 朋友：深呼吸 朋友：对 放松
nervous tension.example: Friend: Why are your hands shaking? You: Pre-stage nervous tension, can't control. Friend: Breathe. You: Right; relax.

net zero.context: 你说公司目标是零排放，朋友问这是什么意思。
net zero.translation: 朋友：你们说的净零是啥 你：就是net zero 排放全抵消 朋友：那怎么做到 你：多种树加节能
net zero.example: Friend: What's this net zero you talk about? You: Net zero, offset all emissions. Friend: Then how? You: Trees and energy saving.

net zero carbon.context: 你说这座大楼用太阳能供电，朋友说它基本实现了碳中和。
net zero carbon.translation: 朋友：这楼电费咋那么低 你：靠太阳能 基本net zero carbon 朋友：那真环保 你：是
net zero carbon.example: Friend: Why is this building's electricity bill so low? You: Solar-powered, basically net zero carbon. Friend: So green. You: Right.

networking opportunity.context: 你说行业会议能认识同行，朋友问这是不是个好机会。
networking opportunity.translation: 朋友：这会值得去吗 你：是个networking opportunity 能认识同行 朋友：那带上名片 你：对
networking opportunity.example: Friend: Is the conference worth going? You: A networking opportunity, meet peers. Friend: Then bring business cards. You: Right.

neural activity.context: 脑科学课上讲大脑活动能被仪器看到，朋友说这真神奇。
neural activity.translation: 朋友：那图上亮的是啥 你：大脑的neural activity 哪块亮就在工作 朋友：那真看得见 你：是
neural activity.example: Friend: What's lit up on that scan? You: Neural activity in the brain; lit means working. Friend: So visible. You: Right.

neural connection.context: 你说多学习能让大脑长出新连接，朋友问这是真的吗。
neural connection.translation: 朋友：学习真能改变大脑 你：形成新的neural connection 朋友：那活到老学到老 你：对
neural connection.example: Friend: Can learning really change the brain? You: It forges new neural connections. Friend: Then learn till old. You: Right.

neural implant.context: 你说科幻片里用脑机接口控制设备，朋友问这技术现在有了没。
neural implant.translation: 朋友：电影里那用脑子控制东西真的假的 你：有neural implant 在试了 朋友：那未来真科幻 你：是
neural implant.example: Friend: Is that mind-control thing in movies real? You: Neural implants are being tested. Friend: Then the future is sci-fi. You: Right.

neurological health.context: 你说老了脑子也要多练，朋友问这是为了什么。
neurological health.translation: 朋友：你咋还天天背单词 你：保护neurological health 防老糊涂 朋友：那真有用 你：是
neurological health.example: Friend: Why keep memorizing words? You: To protect neurological health, stay sharp. Friend: It really helps. You: Right.

never too late to learn.context: 你说阿姨五十岁才开始学画画，朋友说学习这事儿什么时候开始都不晚。
never too late to learn.translation: 朋友：阿姨这把年纪还学画画 你：never too late to learn 朋友：那真励志 你：是
never too late to learn.example: Friend: Your aunt learns painting at her age? You: Never too late to learn. Friend: So inspiring. You: Right.

new crazes.context: 你说最近流行玩那种解压玩具，朋友问这又是什么新风潮。
new crazes.translation: 朋友：最近大家咋都捏那个球 你：又是一波new crazes 解压玩具 朋友：那真减压 你：是
new crazes.example: Friend: Why is everyone squeezing that ball lately? You: Another set of new crazes, stress toys. Friend: So de-stressing. You: Right.

new kids on the block.context: 你说行业里来了家新公司，朋友问这个新来的对手什么来头。
new kids on the block.translation: 朋友：市场咋冒出个新牌子 你：是new kids on the block 刚进来 朋友：那能站稳吗 你：看本事
new kids on the block.example: Friend: Why did a new brand pop up? You: The new kids on the block, just entered. Friend: Then can they hold on? You: Depends on skill.

new lease of life.context: 你说爷爷退休后学摄影，整个人精神多了，朋友说他像是重获新生。
new lease of life.translation: 朋友：爷爷最近咋那么精神 你：学摄影后a new lease of life 朋友：那真不错 你：是
new lease of life.example: Friend: Why is Grandpa so perky lately? You: Photography gave him a new lease of life. Friend: That's great. You: Right.

new norm.context: 你说戴口罩出门已经成了大家习以为常的事，朋友问这是不是就是新常态。
new norm.translation: 朋友：出门还戴口罩啊 你：都成the new norm了 不戴反而奇怪 朋友：那啥时候能摘 你：看情况
new norm.example: Friend: Still wearing a mask out? You: It's become the new norm; not wearing feels odd. Friend: Then when can we drop it? You: See how it goes.

new normal.context: 你说现在大家习惯了线上办公，朋友说这就是疫情后带来的新常态。
new normal.translation: 朋友：你们还居家办公啊 你：算the new normal了 一周在家两天 朋友：那真舒服 你：是 通勤少了
new normal.example: Friend: You still work from home? You: It's the new normal now, two days a week at home. Friend: So nice. You: Right; less commute.

new round.context: 你说项目告一段落，接下来要开始新一轮冲刺了，朋友问目标是啥。
new round.translation: 朋友：这阶段干完啦 你：马上new round 又要冲刺 朋友：那目标定了吗 你：下个季度业绩
new round.example: Friend: This phase is done? You: Starting a new round soon, another sprint. Friend: Is the target set? You: Next quarter's numbers.

new year's resolutions.context: 新年刚过，你说自己立了个flag要减肥，朋友问你今年有啥打算。
new year's resolutions.translation: 朋友：新年有啥计划 你：立了new year's resolutions 要减肥读书 朋友：能坚持吗 你：争取
new year's resolutions.example: Friend: Any New Year plans? You: Made New Year's resolutions, to lose weight and read. Friend: Can you keep them? You: Trying.

newly independent.context: 你说那国刚独立不久，朋友问它现在局势稳不稳。
newly independent.translation: 朋友：那国建国多久 你：newly independent 才几年 朋友：那经济咋样 你：在发展
newly independent.example: Friend: How long has that country existed? You: Newly independent, only a few years. Friend: Then how's the economy? You: Developing.

news event.context: 你说今天热搜上那件大事，朋友问你看新闻了没。
news event.translation: 朋友：你看今天的热搜没 你：那个大news event 大家都在聊 朋友：那咋回事 你：一两句说不完
news event.example: Friend: Did you see today's trending? You: That big news event, everyone's talking. Friend: Then what happened? You: Can't sum up quickly.

niche audience.context: 你说这播客听众虽然不多，但都是铁杆，朋友问这是不是针对小众听众。
niche audience.translation: 朋友：你这播客收听量不高啊 你：面向niche audience 虽然小但死忠 朋友：那也好 你：是
niche audience.example: Friend: Your podcast's listen count isn't high. You: Targeting a niche audience, small but loyal. Friend: That's fine too. You: Right.

niche industry.context: 你说他做的那种手作蜡烛特别小众，朋友问这算什么行业。
niche industry.translation: 朋友：他做的那蜡烛有市场吗 你：算niche industry 量小但精 朋友：那赚钱吗 你：小众客户愿掏钱
niche industry.example: Friend: Is there a market for his candles? You: A niche industry, small but refined. Friend: Then does it pay? You: Niche customers pay up.

niche market.context: 你说这品牌不拼大众，就服务一小群高端客户，朋友问这是什么策略。
niche market.translation: 朋友：你这牌子咋不打广告 你：瞄准niche market 不拼量 朋友：那活得下去吗 你：高端客户够吃
niche market.example: Friend: Why doesn't your brand advertise? You: Targeting a niche market, no volume game. Friend: Then can you survive? You: High-end clients suffice.

niche museum.context: 你说城里那家专讲邮票的博物馆特别有意思，朋友问这算什么馆。
niche museum.translation: 朋友：你周末去啥博物馆 你：一个niche museum 专讲邮票的 朋友：那挺特别 你：是 长见识
niche museum.example: Friend: Which museum did you go to? You: A niche museum, all about stamps. Friend: That's special. You: Right; eye-opening.

night market.context: 你说晚上逛夜市吃小吃，朋友说夜市热闹又便宜。
night market.translation: 朋友：晚上去哪逛 你：去night market 边吃边逛 朋友：那真热闹 你：是 小吃多
night market.example: Friend: Where to wander at night? You: The night market, eat and stroll. Friend: So lively. You: Right; lots of snacks.

night owls.context: 你说他俩都是晚上精神，朋友说这俩夜猫子凑一块儿了。
night owls.translation: 朋友：你咋半夜还不睡 你：我和他都是night owls 晚上才有劲 朋友：那白天呢 你：困成狗
night owls.example: Friend: Why aren't you asleep at midnight? You: He and I are night owls, only energetic at night. Friend: Then daytime? You: Dead tired.

night-time routine.context: 你说睡前要洗澡刷牙看书，朋友问你那一套睡前流程是啥。
night-time routine.translation: 朋友：你晚上咋睡那么香 你：有固定night-time routine 洗澡看书 朋友：那真有助睡眠 你：是
night-time routine.example: Friend: Why do you sleep so well? You: A fixed night-time routine, shower and read. Friend: Really helps sleep. You: Right.

nighttime routine.context: 你说手机别带进卧室，朋友说睡前放下手机很重要，问你晚上都干啥。
nighttime routine.translation: 朋友：你睡前看手机不 你：不 我的nighttime routine是看书 朋友：那真养生 你：是
nighttime routine.example: Friend: Do you use your phone before bed? You: No; my nighttime routine is reading. Friend: So healthy. You: Right.

nitrogen oxide.context: 老师讲汽车尾气里那种有害气体，朋友问那是什么。
nitrogen oxide.translation: 朋友：汽车排的啥有毒 你：nitrogen oxide 那种氮氧化物 朋友：那对人咋样 你：伤肺
nitrogen oxide.example: Friend: What's toxic in car exhaust? You: Nitrogen oxide, those nitrogen oxides. Friend: Then how does it affect people? You: Harms the lungs.

no brainer.context: 你说这么划算的机票不买简直是傻子，朋友问你为啥。
no brainer.translation: 朋友：这机票值吗 你：这么便宜 简直是no brainer 朋友：那赶紧订 你：对 手慢无
no brainer.example: Friend: Is this flight worth it? You: So cheap, it's a no brainer. Friend: Then book fast. You: Right; slow is gone.

no chance.context: 朋友让你替他值夜班，你说想都别想，朋友笑你坚决。
no chance.translation: 朋友：你替我值个夜班呗 你：No chance 我也有安排 朋友：求你了 你：真不行
no chance.example: Friend: Cover my night shift? You: No chance, I have plans too. Friend: Please. You: Really can't.

no exception.context: 你说这个规定人人都要遵守，谁也不例外，朋友问老板也要吗。
no exception.translation: 朋友：这规定我也得守 你：当然 no exception 朋友：那老板呢 你：一样守
no exception.example: Friend: Do I have to follow this rule too? You: Of course, no exception. Friend: Then the boss? You: Same.

no laughing matter.context: 你说这事可不是闹着玩的，出了问题要担责任，朋友说你别太严肃。
no laughing matter.translation: 朋友：不就是个小错 你：这可不是no laughing matter 朋友：那咋办 你：赶紧补救
no laughing matter.example: Friend: It's just a small mistake. You: This is no laughing matter. Friend: Then what? You: Fix it fast.

no mention of.context: 你说他在报告里对那件事一个字都没提，朋友问是不是故意回避。
no mention of.translation: 朋友：他报告里提那事了吗 你：no mention of 一个字都没 朋友：那咋回事 你：估计想掩盖
no mention of.example: Friend: Did he mention that in the report? You: No mention of it, not a word. Friend: Then what's going on? You: Probably hiding it.

no pain no gain.context: 你练得浑身酸痛还坚持去健身房，朋友说没有付出就没有收获。
no pain no gain.translation: 朋友：你咋这么拼 你：no pain no gain 不练哪来的好身材 朋友：那真辛苦 你：是
no pain no gain.example: Friend: Why push so hard? You: No pain no gain; no workout, no great shape. Friend: So tough. You: Right.

no point.context: 你说跟他讲道理是白费口舌，朋友问为什么。
no point.translation: 朋友：你再劝劝他呗 你：no point 他听不进去 朋友：那算了 你：是
no point.example: Friend: Try to persuade him again. You: No point; he won't listen. Friend: Then forget it. You: Right.

no question.context: 你说他肯定能考上，朋友问你怎么这么有把握。
no question.translation: 朋友：他这次能上吗 你：那是no question 他准备得特别足 朋友：那祝贺 你：是
no question.example: Friend: Will he get in this time? You: No question; he prepared so well. Friend: Then congrats. You: Right.

no-tipping policy.context: 你说这家餐厅不收小费，朋友问那服务会打折扣吗。
no-tipping policy.translation: 朋友：这国外店咋不给小费 你：人家是no-tipping policy 朋友：那服务还一样好吗 你：是 工资里含了
no-tipping policy.example: Friend: Why no tipping at this place? You: They have a no-tipping policy. Friend: Then is service still good? You: Right; it's in the wages.

nod off.context: 你说开会时他困得直点头，朋友说他打盹儿了。
nod off.translation: 朋友：他咋老点头 你：困得nod off了 朋友：昨晚干啥了 你：追剧到半夜
nod off.example: Friend: Why is he nodding? You: He's nodding off. Friend: What was he doing last night? You: Binge-watching till midnight.

noise pollution.context: 你说住在大马路边天天被车吵，朋友问这算不算噪音污染。
noise pollution.translation: 朋友：你家住路边吵不吵 你：noise pollution天天来 朋友：那咋睡 你：耳塞
noise pollution.example: Friend: Is it noisy by the road? You: Noise pollution every day. Friend: Then how do you sleep? You: Earplugs.

noise-induced hearing loss.context: 你说戴耳机声音太大久了会伤听力，朋友问这是什么造成的。
noise-induced hearing loss.translation: 朋友：他咋听力下降了 你：长期大音量听耳机 noise-induced hearing loss 朋友：那得改习惯 你：是
noise-induced hearing loss.example: Friend: Why did his hearing drop? You: Loud earphones long-term, noise-induced hearing loss. Friend: Then change the habit. You: Right.

non-profit organisation.context: 你说他辞了大厂工作去做公益，朋友问那是什么样的组织。
non-profit organisation.translation: 朋友：他现在做啥工作 你：在个non-profit organisation 做环保 朋友：那工资高吗 你：不高 图意义
non-profit organisation.example: Friend: What does he do now? You: At a non-profit organisation, doing environmental work. Friend: Does it pay well? You: Not high; for meaning.

none at all.context: 你问他介意不介意，朋友说一点也不，完全没关系。
none at all.translation: 朋友：你介意我用一下吗 你：一点也不none at all 朋友：那真感谢 你：客气啥
none at all.example: Friend: Do you mind if I use it? You: None at all, not a bit. Friend: Thanks so much. You: Don't mention it.

none other than.context: 你说最后揭幕的大奖嘉宾竟然是他自己，朋友说这惊喜也太大了。
none other than.translation: 朋友：颁奖嘉宾是谁 你：揭幕一看 none other than他本人 朋友：那真想不到 你：是
none other than.example: Friend: Who's the presenter? You: Revealed, none other than himself. Friend: So unexpected. You: Right.

nose to the grindstone.context: 你说他这俩月天天加班埋头苦干，朋友问他在忙什么大项目。
nose to the grindstone.translation: 朋友：他咋连面都见不着 你：nose to the grindstone 赶大项目 朋友：那真拼 你：是
nose to the grindstone.example: Friend: Why can't we even see him? You: Nose to the grindstone, rushing a big project. Friend: So grinding. You: Right.

nostalgic tune.context: 你说商场放的那首歌一听就回到小时候，朋友问这是什么曲子。
nostalgic tune.translation: 朋友：这歌咋这么熟 你：那是首nostalgic tune 我们小时候的动画片 朋友：一下就回忆起来了 你：是
nostalgic tune.example: Friend: Why is this song so familiar? You: A nostalgic tune, our childhood cartoon. Friend: Memories flood back. You: Right.

not a chance.context: 朋友让你把刚买的新手机借给他玩，你说想都别想，朋友笑你抠。
not a chance.translation: 朋友：借你新手机玩两天 你：not a chance 刚买的 朋友：真抠 你：嘿嘿
not a chance.example: Friend: Lend me your new phone for two days. You: Not a chance, just bought it. Friend: So stingy. You: Hehe.

not give two hoots.context: 你说他被人骂了还乐呵呵，朋友说他是真的一点不在乎。
not give two hoots.translation: 朋友：他被骂了咋不生气 你：他not give two hoots 根本不在乎 朋友：那心态真好 你：是
not give two hoots.example: Friend: Why isn't he mad after being scolded? You: He doesn't give two hoots, doesn't care at all. Friend: Such a mindset. You: Right.

not long.context: 你说等不了多久就要放假了，朋友问那还有几天。
not long.translation: 朋友：离放假还有多久 你：not long了 就一周 朋友：那快了 你：是 倒计时
not long.example: Friend: How long till the holiday? You: Not long, just a week. Friend: Then soon. You: Right; counting down.

not long after.context: 你说他走了没多久，朋友就来了，朋友问这中间隔了多久。
not long after.translation: 朋友：他刚走吗 你：not long after他就来了 朋友：那真巧 你：是
not long after.example: Friend: Did he just leave? You: You came not long after he left. Friend: What a coincidence. You: Right.

not only that.context: 你说这菜好吃，而且还便宜，朋友问你是不是很划算。
not only that.translation: 朋友：这家菜咋样 你：好吃 not only that 还便宜 朋友：那真划算 你：是
not only that.example: Friend: How's the food here? You: Tasty; not only that, it's cheap. Friend: Then great value. You: Right.

not so much.context: 你说他这毛病与其说懒，不如说是拖延，朋友问你怎么看。
not so much.translation: 朋友：他是不是太懒 你：not so much懒 不如说是拖延 朋友：那咋改 你：分解任务
not so much.example: Friend: Is he just lazy? You: Not so much lazy, more like procrastinating. Friend: Then how to fix? You: Break tasks down.

not that.context: 你说不是说你不好，只是这件事换个做法更好，朋友问你是不是在怪他。
not that.translation: 朋友：你是说我做错了 你：not that 你不好 是方法可以换 朋友：那我懂了 你：好
not that.example: Friend: Are you saying I did wrong? You: Not that you're bad; the method could change. Friend: Then I get it. You: Good.

not to be sneezed at.context: 你说这奖金虽然不多，但也不容小觑，朋友问有多少。
not to be sneezed at.translation: 朋友：这奖金有多少 你：不算多 but not to be sneezed at 朋友：那也挺实在 你：是
not to be sneezed at.example: Friend: How much is the bonus? You: Not huge, but not to be sneezed at. Friend: Still solid. You: Right.

noth more than.context: 你说那不过是个普通工作，别看得太重，朋友问你为什么。
noth more than.translation: 朋友：这工作是不是特别牛 你：nothing more than一份工 别想太多 朋友：那你咋还干 你：糊口
noth more than.example: Friend: Is this job super great? You: Nothing more than a job, don't overthink. Friend: Then why keep doing it? You: To make a living.

noticeable surge.context: 你说这个月订单一下多了很多，朋友问是不是有大单子。
noticeable surge.translation: 朋友：这月业绩咋突然好 你：有个noticeable surge 新客户来了 朋友：那真不错 你：是
noticeable surge.example: Friend: Why did this month's sales suddenly pick up? You: A noticeable surge, new clients. Friend: That's great. You: Right.

now and again.context: 你说自己不是天天跑步，只是偶尔跑跑，朋友问你多久一次。
now and again.translation: 朋友：你跑步很勤啊 你：就now and again 一周一次 朋友：那挺好 你：是 动起来就行
now and again.example: Friend: You run quite often. You: Just now and again, once a week. Friend: That's fine. You: Right; just move.

nowhere near.context: 你说这工资离买房差得远呢，朋友问你攒了多少。
nowhere near.translation: 朋友：攒够首付了吗 你：nowhere near 差远了 朋友：那慢慢攒 你：是
nowhere near.example: Friend: Saved enough for the down payment? You: Nowhere near, far from it. Friend: Then save slowly. You: Right.

nurture positivity.context: 你说每天早上给自己打气，朋友问这是在培养积极心态吗。
nurture positivity.translation: 朋友：你咋天天对镜子笑 你：nurture positivity 给自己打气 朋友：那真有用 你：是
nurture positivity.example: Friend: Why smile at the mirror every day? You: To nurture positivity, pump myself up. Friend: It really helps. You: Right.

nut job.context: 你说那个当街乱喊的人可能是个疯子，朋友让你离他远点。
nut job.translation: 朋友：那人咋突然大喊 你：估计是个nut job 离他远点 朋友：真吓人 你：是
nut job.example: Friend: Why is that guy suddenly yelling? You: Probably a nut job; stay away. Friend: So scary. You: Right.

nutrient density.context: 你说菠菜这种菜吃一点点就顶饱，朋友问这是不是营养特别密集。
nutrient density.translation: 朋友：吃啥最顶饱 你：看nutrient density 菠菜这种 朋友：那真健康 你：是
nutrient density.example: Friend: What's most filling? You: Look at nutrient density; things like spinach. Friend: So healthy. You: Right.

nutritional content.context: 你说看包装上那栏数字，朋友问这是什么成分表。
nutritional content.translation: 朋友：这包装上一堆数字是啥 你：写着nutritional content 营养成分 朋友：那看得懂吗 你：看热量和糖
nutritional content.example: Friend: What are those numbers on the pack? You: The nutritional content, ingredients. Friend: Can you read it? You: Look at calories and sugar.

nutritional imbalance.context: 你说老吃泡面会营养不均衡，朋友问这会怎么样。
nutritional imbalance.translation: 朋友：我老吃泡面没事吧 你：容易nutritional imbalance 缺维生素 朋友：那多吃菜 你：对
nutritional imbalance.example: Friend: Is instant noodles okay? You: Easy to get a nutritional imbalance, lacking vitamins. Friend: Then eat more veg. You: Right.

nutritional profile.context: 你说这杯奶昔蛋白质高、糖也高，朋友问它整体营养结构怎么样。
nutritional profile.translation: 朋友：这奶昔健康不 你：nutritional profile里糖偏高 朋友：那别多喝 你：是
nutritional profile.example: Friend: Is this shake healthy? You: In its nutritional profile, sugar's high. Friend: Then don't drink much. You: Right.

nutritional therapist.context: 你说找了个营养师帮你配餐，朋友问那是什么医生。
nutritional therapist.translation: 朋友：你最近吃饭咋那么讲究 你：找了个nutritional therapist 帮配餐 朋友：那贵吗 你：比看病值
nutritional therapist.example: Friend: Why so careful with food lately? You: Saw a nutritional therapist to plan meals. Friend: Is it expensive? You: Worth it more than the doctor.

nutritional value.context: 你说这个燕麦比白米有营养，朋友问是看什么指标。
nutritional value.translation: 朋友：燕麦真比白米好 你：看nutritional value 纤维高 朋友：那以后换着吃 你：对
nutritional value.example: Friend: Is oats really better than white rice? You: Look at nutritional value, more fiber. Friend: Then switch. You: Right.

née.context: 你说那位女作家婚后改了夫姓，但作品还常用婚前的姓，朋友问这是什么。
née.translation: 朋友：她书名叫王静 咋同事叫她李太太 你：王静是她née 娘家姓 朋友：那作品用旧姓 你：是
née.example: Friend: Her book's under Wang Jing, but colleagues call her Mrs. Li? You: Wang Jing is her née, her maiden name. Friend: Then she uses the old name in books. You: Right.

oasis of calm.context: 你说这家咖啡馆藏在巷子里特别安静，朋友说这是闹市中的一方净土。
oasis of calm.translation: 朋友：这咖啡馆咋那么安静 你：闹市里的oasis of calm 朋友：那真适合看书 你：是
oasis of calm.example: Friend: Why is this café so quiet? You: An oasis of calm in the busy city. Friend: Perfect for reading. You: Right.

oat milk.context: 你说你喝不惯牛奶，点了杯燕麦拿铁，朋友问那是什么奶。
oat milk.translation: 朋友：你这拿铁用的啥奶 你：oat milk 燕麦做的 朋友：那好喝吗 你：有股麦香
oat milk.example: Friend: What milk's in your latte? You: Oat milk, made from oats. Friend: Does it taste good? You: A grainy aroma.

oath of loyalty.context: 你说新员工入职要宣誓效忠公司，朋友问这是什么仪式。
oath of loyalty.translation: 朋友：新人入职咋还举手 你：宣个oath of loyalty 表忠心 朋友：那真严肃 你：是
oath of loyalty.example: Friend: Why do new hires raise hands? You: Taking an oath of loyalty, pledging. Friend: So formal. You: Right.

obesity rate.context: 你说现在胖人越来越多，朋友问这是为什么。
obesity rate.translation: 朋友：这大街上咋胖子多了 你：obesity rate上升 吃多动少 朋友：那得注意 你：是
obesity rate.example: Friend: Why are there more overweight people? You: Obesity rate is rising, eating more moving less. Friend: Then watch out. You: Right.

oblivious to.context: 你说他沉浸在自己世界里，完全没注意到周围人在笑他，朋友问他知不知道。
oblivious to.translation: 朋友：他咋没发现大家在笑 你：oblivious to周围 完全没察觉 朋友：那真呆萌 你：是
oblivious to.example: Friend: Why didn't he notice people laughing? You: Oblivious to his surroundings, didn't notice at all. Friend: So endearing. You: Right.

obsessed with.context: 你说他满脑子都是游戏，朋友问这算不算走火入魔。
obsessed with.translation: 朋友：他咋一下班就打游戏 你：obsessed with游戏 啥都不管 朋友：那得拉他出来 你：是
obsessed with.example: Friend: Why does he game the moment he's off work? You: Obsessed with games, ignores everything. Friend: Then pull him out. You: Right.

obsession with.context: 你说她对买包有一种执念，朋友问这是不是太沉迷了。
obsession with.translation: 朋友：她咋老买包 你：an obsession with包 停不下来 朋友：那得管管 你：是
obsession with.example: Friend: Why does she keep buying bags? You: An obsession with bags, can't stop. Friend: Then rein her in. You: Right.

occupational therapy.context: 医生说中风病人要做康复，朋友问那是哪种治疗。
occupational therapy.translation: 朋友：爷爷康复做啥 你：occupational therapy 练日常生活动作 朋友：那真有用 你：是
occupational therapy.example: Friend: What's Grandpa's rehab? You: Occupational therapy, practicing daily living skills. Friend: It really helps. You: Right.

occupy one's mind.context: 你说失恋后满脑子都是那个人，朋友问这是不是走不出来。
occupy one's mind.translation: 朋友：你咋老发呆 你：满脑子occupy my mind都是他 朋友：那得找点事做 你：是
occupy one's mind.example: Friend: Why do you zone out? You: He occupies my mind all the time. Friend: Then find something to do. You: Right.

ocean exploration.context: 你说深海下面还有好多没去过的地方，朋友聊起探索海底的话题。
ocean exploration.translation: 朋友：海底啥样 你：ocean exploration还在进行 好多未知 朋友：那真神秘 你：是
ocean exploration.example: Friend: What's the seafloor like? You: Ocean exploration is ongoing, so much unknown. Friend: So mysterious. You: Right.

ocean floor.context: 你说海底其实不是平的，也有高山峡谷，朋友问这是什么地形。
ocean floor.translation: 朋友：海底是平的吗 你：ocean floor上也有山有谷 朋友：那跟陆地一样 你：是
ocean floor.example: Friend: Is the seafloor flat? You: The ocean floor has hills and valleys too. Friend: Like the land? You: Right.

ocean tides.context: 你说海边每天涨潮退潮，朋友问这是什么引起的。
ocean tides.translation: 朋友：这潮水咋天天变 你：是ocean tides 月亮引力拉的 朋友：那真神奇 你：是
ocean tides.example: Friend: Why does the tide change daily? You: Ocean tides, pulled by the moon's gravity. Friend: So amazing. You: Right.

oceanic resource.context: 你说海里有石油有矿产，朋友问这些算不算财富。
oceanic resource.translation: 朋友：海里都有啥宝贝 你：oceanic resource 石油矿 朋友：那得保护 你：是
oceanic resource.example: Friend: What treasures are in the sea? You: Oceanic resources, oil and minerals. Friend: Then protect them. You: Right.

odd jobs.context: 你说他放假不找全职，就做点零工赚点零花钱，朋友问这是什么工作。
odd jobs.translation: 朋友：他放假做啥 你：打点儿odd jobs 发发传单 朋友：那轻松 你：是
odd jobs.example: Friend: What does he do on holiday? You: Some odd jobs, handing out flyers. Friend: That's easy. You: Right.

odds and ends.context: 你搬家翻出一堆零碎，朋友说这些杂七杂八的东西该清就清。
odds and ends.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里咋那么乱 你：一堆odds and ends 没用的小玩意儿 朋友：该扔就扔 你：对
odds and ends.example: Friend: Why is your drawer so messy? You: A bunch of odds and ends, useless little trinkets. Friend: Throw out what you don't need. You: Right.

of all ages.context: 你说这公园老少都爱来，朋友问是不是各个年龄的人都在。
of all ages.translation: 朋友：这公园人真多 你：of all ages 老人小孩都有 朋友：那真热闹 你：是
of all ages.example: Friend: This park is so crowded. You: People of all ages, old and young. Friend: So lively. You: Right.

of all kinds.context: 你说这超市里什么都有，朋友问是不是品类特别全。
of all kinds.translation: 朋友：这超市真大 你：卖的东西of all kinds 啥都能买着 朋友：那真方便 你：是
of all kinds.example: Friend: This supermarket is huge. You: Sells goods of all kinds, everything's there. Friend: So convenient. You: Right.

of any kind.context: 你说这地方什么娱乐都没有，朋友问是不是连个小卖部都找不到。
of any kind.translation: 朋友：这村里有啥玩的 你：啥都没有 no entertainment of any kind 朋友：那真无聊 你：是
of any kind.example: Friend: What's there to do in this village? You: Nothing, no entertainment of any kind. Friend: So boring. You: Right.

off.context: 你说闹钟一响就出门，朋友问你几点走。
off.translation: 朋友：你几点出门 你：一到七点我就off 走了 朋友：那真准时 你：是
off.example: Friend: What time do you leave? You: At seven sharp I'm off. Friend: So punctual. You: Right.

off guard.context: 你说老板突然驾到，把大家打了个措手不及，朋友问你们在干嘛。
off guard.translation: 朋友：你俩咋慌慌张张 你：老板突然来 打了我们个off guard 朋友：那在摸鱼吧 你：嘘 别说
off guard.example: Friend: Why are you two panicking? You: The boss came suddenly, caught us off guard. Friend: Slacking off then? You: Shh, don't say.

off the beaten track.context: 你说这景点偏在山沟沟里，朋友问好不好找。
off the beaten track.translation: 朋友：这地方咋导航都搜不到 你：在off the beaten track 得开好久 朋友：那风景美不 你：人少景美
off the beaten track.example: Friend: Why can't I find this place on maps? You: It's off the beaten track, a long drive. Friend: Is the scenery nice? You: Few people, beautiful.

off work.context: 你说你今天不上班，朋友问那在家干嘛。
off work.translation: 朋友：你今天咋不去公司 你：today I'm off work 在家歇着 朋友：那真爽 你：是
off work.example: Friend: Why aren't you at the office today? You: I'm off work today, resting at home. Friend: So nice. You: Right.

offbeat question.context: 面试时被突然问了个奇怪问题，朋友说那问题真怪。
offbeat question.translation: 朋友：面试问啥了 你：问我如果动物能说话选哪个 一个offbeat question 朋友：那咋答 你：随便聊
offbeat question.example: Friend: What did they ask in the interview? You: If animals could talk, which to pick—an offbeat question. Friend: Then how to answer? You: Just chat.

offend nostrils.context: 你说那化粪池盖子一掀，味道直冲鼻子，朋友说快捂着点。
offend nostrils.translation: 朋友：啥味儿这么冲 你：那井盖一掀直offend nostrils 朋友：快捂鼻子 你：是 快走
offend nostrils.example: Friend: What's that stinging smell? You: Lifting that cover really offends the nostrils. Friend: Cover your nose. You: Right; walk on.

offer sb a carrot.context: 你说老板为了让大家多干活，先给点甜头，朋友问这是什么招。
offer sb a carrot.translation: 朋友：老板咋突然请客 你：offer us a carrot 画个饼 朋友：那真去干啊 你：先看看
offer sb a carrot.example: Friend: Why is the boss suddenly treating us? You: Offering us a carrot, dangling a treat. Friend: Then should we work? You: Wait and see.

official complaint.context: 你在酒店住店时房间空调坏了三次也没人来修，前台态度还很敷衍，于是你决定正式向总部投诉。
official complaint.translation: 朋友：你昨天住的那家酒店怎么样啊 你：房间空调坏了三次都没人来修 前台还一直敷衍我 朋友：那你怎么不直接投诉他们呢 你：我已经准备写一封正式投诉寄去总部了 朋友：早就该这样了 这种服务必须有人管管
official complaint.example: Friend: How was that hotel you stayed at yesterday? You: The air conditioning broke three times and nobody came to fix it, and the front desk just kept brushing me off. Friend: Then why didn't you just make an official complaint? You: I'm already drafting an official complaint to send to head office. Friend: It's about time; someone has to hold that kind of service accountable.

official record.context: 你去办出国手续，工作人员要求你出示一份由公安局盖章的官方记录来证明你的无犯罪背景。
official record.translation: 朋友：签证那边材料都交齐了吗 你：还差一份无犯罪证明没开出来 朋友：这个去哪里办比较靠谱呢 你：得去派出所开一份盖公章的官方记录 朋友：那你赶紧去办吧 别耽误了下周递签的时间
official record.example: Friend: Have you handed in all the visa documents yet? You: I'm still missing a clean criminal record certificate. Friend: Where do you go to get that sorted properly? You: I need to get an official record stamped at the local police station. Friend: Then go get it quickly, don't miss next week's application.

official statistic.context: 聊到城市发展时，你想引用最权威的数据来说话，而不是道听途说，于是提到了政府发布的官方统计。
official statistic.translation: 朋友：听说咱们城市人口又涨了不少啊 你：具体多少我也只是猜 朋友：那你有没有可靠的数字呢 你：还是看统计局公布的官方统计比较准 朋友：也是 网上那些传言多半都靠不住
official statistic.example: Friend: I heard our city's population has grown a lot again. You: I'm only guessing at the exact number myself. Friend: Do you have any reliable figures then? You: It's best to check the official statistics published by the bureau. Friend: True, most of the rumors online just aren't trustworthy.

offline activity.context: 周末你们原计划上网刷剧，后来朋友提议去市集逛逛、见见真人，你们就决定把假期留给线下活动。
offline activity.translation: 朋友：这周末打算怎么安排啊 你：本来想窝在家里上网刷剧来着 朋友：整天对着屏幕多没意思 不如出去走走 你：好主意 我们安排一点线下活动吧 朋友：那就去新开的市集逛逛 听说挺热闹的
offline activity.example: Friend: What are you planning for the weekend? You: I was going to laze at home and binge shows online. Friend: Staring at a screen all day is boring, let's go out instead. You: Good idea, let's organise some offline activity then. Friend: Then let's check out the new market, I heard it's lively.

oilse rape.context: 在英国乡间开车时，你看到大片开着黄花的田，朋友告诉你那不是野花，而是种来喂牲口和榨油的油菜。
oilse rape.translation: 朋友：路边这一片金黄的花田真漂亮啊 你：我还以为是谁家种来观赏的呢 朋友：这可不是观赏花 是农场种的油菜 你：原来这种植物还能做动物饲料和油啊 朋友：对 英国人特别喜欢种它
oilse rape.example: Friend: That whole golden field by the road is really beautiful. You: I thought someone had planted it just for show. Friend: It's not ornamental, it's oilseed rape grown on the farm. You: So this crop is used for animal feed and for oil as well? Friend: Yes, the British love growing it.

old adage.context: 朋友总抱怨现在的年轻人没耐心，你便搬出一句流传很久的老话来劝他，说好事多磨。
old adage.translation: 朋友：现在的孩子做什么都急着要结果 真让人着急 你：别急嘛 老话说欲速则不达 朋友：都什么年代了 还讲这种老道理 你：这句古老谚语能传到今天 自然有它的道理 朋友：唉 也许你说得有点道理
old adage.example: Friend: Kids these days rush for results in everything, it's so frustrating. You: Take it easy, as the old saying goes, more haste less speed. Friend: It's the modern age, why still preach those old lines? You: An old adage that has lasted this long must have some truth to it. Friend: Well, maybe you have a point.

old age.context: 你的爷爷马上要过八十大寿，全家商量送什么礼物能让他在晚年过得更舒心，于是聊起了老人的生活。
old age.translation: 朋友：爷爷八十大寿你打算送他什么呀 你：想送个按摩椅 让他晚年能舒服点 朋友：他那个年纪最需要的就是有人陪着 你：我也是这么想的 老年之后图个清静安康 朋友：那就陪他好好吃顿饭吧
old age.example: Friend: What are you getting your grandpa for his eightieth birthday? You: I'm thinking of a massage chair to make his old age more comfortable. Friend: At his age, what he needs most is company. You: I agree, in old age people just long for peace and health. Friend: Then let's just have a nice meal with him.

old and new.context: 整理衣柜时你翻出了大学时的旧T恤，旁边又摆着刚买的新款，两件放在一起让你感慨时代的变化。
old and new.translation: 朋友：你箱子里这件旧T恤都发黄了 还留着干嘛 你：这是我大学毕业那年买的 特别有纪念意义 朋友：旁边这件新款倒是很时髦 你：把新旧摆在一起看 变化真是太大了 朋友：哈哈 你这是在怀旧呢
old and new.example: Friend: Why are you keeping this yellowed old T-shirt in your box? You: I bought it the year I graduated, it means a lot to me. Friend: The new one next to it looks quite stylish though. You: Putting old and new side by side, the change is really striking. Friend: Haha, you're just being nostalgic.

old-fashioned cash.context: 你出门发现手机支付用不了，只能翻口袋找出几张皱巴巴的纸币，感叹还是这种传统纸币让人安心。
old-fashioned cash.translation: 朋友：你怎么站在收银台发呆呢 你：手机忽然没电了 支付一直刷不出来 朋友：那你身上带现金了吗 你：就剩几张这种旧版纸币 凑凑合合付了吧 朋友：这年头还能摸到现金 也挺难得的
old-fashioned cash.example: Friend: Why are you just standing there at the register? You: My phone suddenly died and the payment won't go through. Friend: Do you have any cash on you then? You: I've only got a few old-fashioned notes, I'll manage with those. Friend: It's rare these days to even handle cash.

olympic torch.context: 奥运开幕当天晚上，你们守在电视前看圣火点燃的瞬间，为这神圣的一刻激动得鼓起掌来。
olympic torch.translation: 朋友：开幕式你看了吗 太震撼了 你：我全程盯着屏幕 眼睛都没敢眨 朋友：最后火炬点燃那一下 我鸡皮疙瘩都起来了 你：那支奥运火炬传递了好多个国家呢 朋友：真希望有一天能去现场看看
olympic torch.example: Friend: Did you watch the opening ceremony? It was stunning. You: I stared at the screen the whole time without blinking. Friend: When the torch was finally lit, I got goosebumps. You: The Olympic torch was carried through so many countries. Friend: I really hope to see it live one day.

omega 3.context: 体检后医生建议你多吃深海鱼补充营养，说这种脂肪酸对大脑特别好，你便开始研究起保健品。
omega 3.translation: 朋友：医生最近让你多吃点什么补身体呢 你：他说我该多吃深海鱼 补补大脑 朋友：是补那种欧米伽三脂肪酸吗 你：对 就是omega 3 这种营养挺珍贵的 朋友：那我也跟着吃点 反正没坏处
omega 3.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you to eat more of lately? You: He said I should eat more deep-sea fish for my brain. Friend: Is that the omega 3 fatty acid supplement? You: Exactly, omega 3 is quite a precious nutrient. Friend: Then I'll take some too, it can't hurt.

omega-3 fatty acid.context: 你在超市货架前纠结买哪种油，营养顾问告诉你深海鱼里的那种脂肪酸对心血管最友好。
omega-3 fatty acid.translation: 朋友：你天天买鱼 是在减肥吗 你：不是 是为了补充一种好脂肪 朋友：是不是那种欧米伽三脂肪酸啊 你：对 它就藏在深海鱼里 对心脏很有好处 朋友：难怪你最近气色看着不错
omega-3 fatty acid.example: Friend: Are you losing weight, buying fish every day? You: No, I'm just getting a certain good fat. Friend: Is it that omega-3 fatty acid? You: Right, you find it in deep-sea fish and it's great for the heart. Friend: No wonder you've been looking well lately.

on.context: 下雨天你把伞靠在门边，出门时朋友提醒你别忘了伞，还叮嘱你把手机放好别淋着。
on.translation: 朋友：你出门记得带伞啊 外面下大雨呢 你：我知道 伞就放在门后面 朋友：手机也揣好 别又弄湿了 你：放心 我把它塞到外套口袋里 朋友：那路上小心 雨大慢点开
on.example: Friend: Remember to take an umbrella, it's pouring outside. You: I know, the umbrella is right behind the door. Friend: Keep your phone safe too, don't get it wet again. You: Relax, I'll slip it into my jacket pocket. Friend: Then drive slowly, the rain is heavy.

on a budget.context: 你和朋友打算吃顿大餐庆祝，但这个月手头紧，于是你们商量着找一家性价比高的小店。
on a budget.translation: 朋友：今晚咱们去吃那家新开的牛排吧 你：我这个月预算有点紧 得精打细算 朋友：那我们找个实惠点的小馆子 你：好 只要吃得开心 不用去贵的地方 朋友：行 我知道一家味道不错又便宜的
on a budget.example: Friend: Let's try that new steak place tonight. You: I'm on a budget this month, I have to watch my spending. Friend: Then let's find a cheap, cosy little place instead. You: Fine, as long as it's fun, we don't need somewhere pricey. Friend: Okay, I know one that tastes great and is cheap.

on a diet.context: 夏天快到了，你想趁现在减几斤，朋友推荐你先从控制饮食开始，说光靠运动不够。
on a diet.translation: 朋友：你最近是不是在减肥呀 你：是啊 我正打算开始节食一阵子 朋友：节食可别饿坏了身体 营养得跟上 你：我就是想瘦一点 夏天穿衣服好看 朋友：那也得健康地减 别太拼了
on a diet.example: Friend: Are you on a diet lately? You: Yeah, I'm planning to go on a diet for a while. Friend: Don't starve yourself on a diet, you still need nutrition. You: I just want to slim down a bit for summer clothes. Friend: Then do it healthily, don't push too hard.

on a par with.context: 公司来了个新同事，履历普通却拿了和你一样的薪水，你暗自觉得这待遇算是和你相当了。
on a par with.translation: 朋友：新来的那个同事工资居然跟你一样高 你：我也挺意外的 他经验并不算多 朋友：那你心里是不是不太平衡啊 你：算了 既然他薪水和我相当 就当公平竞争吧 朋友：你这心态倒是挺好
on a par with.example: Friend: The new colleague gets paid the same as you, believe it or not. You: I was surprised too, he doesn't have that much experience. Friend: Doesn't that make you feel a bit sore? You: Forget it, if he's on a par with my pay, let's just compete fairly. Friend: You've got a really good attitude.

on a regular basis.context: 你问朋友多久去一次健身房，他说自己不是偶尔突击，而是几乎每隔一天就去，已经坚持两年了。
on a regular basis.translation: 朋友：你去健身房是心血来潮那种吗 你：不是 我差不多每隔一天就去一次 朋友：这么有规律 坚持多久了 你：两年多了 我一直坚持定期锻炼 朋友：难怪你身材保持得这么好
on a regular basis.example: Friend: Do you only hit the gym on a whim? You: No, I go just about every other day. Friend: That's so regular, how long have you kept it up? You: Over two years, I exercise on a regular basis. Friend: No wonder you stay in such good shape.

on alert.context: 台风预警发布后，整个城市进入戒备状态，超市货架被扫空，大家都绷紧了神经。
on alert.translation: 朋友：台风要来了 你那边囤货了吗 你：超市都快被抢空了 大家紧张得很 朋友：听说全城已经进入警戒状态了 你：是啊 所有人都高度戒备 门窗都检查过了 朋友：那你今晚千万别出门
on alert.example: Friend: The typhoon's coming, did you stock up? You: The supermarket's almost cleared out, everyone's on edge. Friend: I heard the whole city is on alert already. You: Right, everyone's on alert and has checked their doors and windows. Friend: Then whatever you do, don't go out tonight.

on an empty stomach.context: 教练提醒你早上跑步前别先吃东西，说空腹运动燃烧脂肪更快，你便决定早起先去跑。
on an empty stomach.translation: 朋友：你晨跑前会先吃早餐吗 你：教练说最好不要 要我空腹跑 朋友：饿肚子运动不难受吗 你：他说空腹锻炼燃脂效率更高 朋友：那你跑完可得好好补一顿
on an empty stomach.example: Friend: Do you eat breakfast before your morning run? You: The coach says not to, I should run on an empty stomach. Friend: Isn't exercising on an empty stomach uncomfortable? You: He says working out on an empty stomach burns fat faster. Friend: Then make sure you eat well after the run.

on campus.context: 开学前你在纠结住校外还是宿舍，朋友说住校内最省心，上课吃饭走路都方便。
on campus.translation: 朋友：你这学期决定住哪里了吗 你：还在纠结是租房子还是住校 朋友：住宿舍多好啊 走路就能上课 你：你是说住校内比较方便是吗 朋友：对 住在学校里 吃饭洗澡都省事
on campus.example: Friend: Have you decided where to live this term? You: I'm still torn between renting and living in halls. Friend: Living on campus is great, you can walk to class. You: So you think living on campus is more convenient? Friend: Yes, on campus, eating and showering are all easy.

on display.context: 商场中庭摆了一组新款机器人在公开展出，路过的大人小孩都围上去拍照，场面很热闹。
on display.translation: 朋友：商场中庭围了一大群人 在看什么呢 你：好像在展出一款新机器人 朋友：让我也凑过去看看 它是公开展出的吗 你：对 直接放在大厅里展览 谁都能看 朋友：做得还真像真人啊
on display.example: Friend: Why is a big crowd gathered in the mall atrium? You: It seems a new robot is on display. Friend: Let me squeeze over, is it on display to the public? You: Yeah, it's on display right in the hall for everyone. Friend: It really looks just like a real person.

on edge.context: 明天就要大考了，你昨晚紧张得没睡好，今天坐立不安，总觉得哪里没复习到位。
on edge.translation: 朋友：你今天脸色怎么这么差啊 你：明天考试 我紧张得一晚上没睡着 朋友：别绷太紧 放轻松点 你：可我现在就是坐立不安 心里发慌 朋友：你这是太焦虑了 深呼吸试试
on edge.example: Friend: Why do you look so terrible today? You: I have an exam tomorrow and I was too nervous to sleep all night. Friend: Don't wind yourself up so tight, just relax. You: But I feel on edge now, my nerves are all jittery. Friend: You're just on edge, try taking a deep breath.

on hold.context: 你打电话给客服咨询账单问题，音乐响了半天也没人接，就这样一直让你在电话那头等着。
on hold.translation: 朋友：你问题解决了吗 电话打完没 你：别提了 一直让我在电话里干等着 朋友：都等了多久了 你：快二十分钟了 这事儿算暂时搁置了 朋友：这种客服效率真让人崩溃
on hold.example: Friend: Did you sort out your problem, have you finished the call? You: Don't ask, they just kept me on hold on the phone. Friend: How long have you been waiting? You: Almost twenty minutes, so this is on hold for now. Friend: This kind of customer service is honestly maddening.

on its way.context: 天气预报说一股冷空气正在南下，明早起来你就能明显感到降温了，冬天的脚步越来越近。
on its way.translation: 朋友：明天是不是要降温了 你：是啊 一股冷空气正在路上 朋友：那我得把厚外套找出来了 你：冬天眼看就要来了 注意别感冒 朋友：我这就去收拾换季的衣服
on its way.example: Friend: Is it going to cool down tomorrow? You: Yeah, a cold front is on its way. Friend: Then I need to dig out my thick coat. You: Winter is on its way soon, take care not to catch a cold. Friend: I'll go sort out my seasonal clothes right now.

on offer.context: 你在奥莱看中一双鞋，标价牌上写着折扣，店员说这是本店正在促销的款，特别划算。
on offer.translation: 朋友：你脚上这双鞋打几折买的呀 你：半价呢 刚好赶上店里在做活动 朋友：真划算 是一直都打折吗 你：不是 这批货现在正在打折出售 过几天就恢复原价了 朋友：那我也赶紧去抢一双
on offer.example: Friend: What discount did you get on those shoes? You: Half price, I caught the store's promotion. Friend: That's a bargain, are they always on offer? You: No, this line is on offer right now and goes back to full price soon. Friend: Then I'd better rush in and grab a pair too.

on one's own.context: 朋友想约你周末一起搬家，但你已经和搬家公司约好了，不想再麻烦别人，打算自己一个人搞定。
on one's own.translation: 朋友：周末搬家需要我来帮忙吗 你：不用啦 我打算自己一个人搞定 朋友：那么多箱子 你一个人行吗 你：我已经请好搬家公司了 自己弄更自在 朋友：那你有事随时叫我
on one's own.example: Friend: Do you need my help moving this weekend? You: No thanks, I plan to manage it on my own. Friend: With all those boxes, can you manage on your own? You: I've booked the movers, doing it on my own feels freer. Friend: Then just call me if you need anything.

on paper.context: 虽然方案听起来很美，但老板说现在只是写在纸面上的设想，真正落地还得看实际执行。
on paper.translation: 朋友：这个新项目听起来很美好啊 你：可是它现在还停留在理论阶段 朋友：意思是还没真正做出来吗 你：对 目前只是纸面上的计划 还没落地验证 朋友：那可得小心别画大饼
on paper.example: Friend: This new project sounds wonderful. You: But for now it only exists on paper. Friend: You mean it hasn't actually been built yet? You: Right, on paper it's just a plan, not yet proven in practice. Friend: Then careful not to just sell a dream.

on pause.context: 视频会议进行到一半突然卡住，老板的画面定在原地不动，大家只好在群里等着它恢复。
on pause.translation: 朋友：刚才开会怎么忽然断线了 你：老板的画面卡在那 一直不动 朋友：那会议是先暂停了吗 你：对 系统自动暂停了 大家都在等恢复 朋友：这网络真是太不给力了
on pause.example: Friend: Why did the meeting suddenly cut out just now? You: The boss's screen froze and stayed still. Friend: So the meeting went on pause? You: Yeah, it's on pause and everyone is waiting for it to resume. Friend: This internet really lets us down.

on record.context: 新闻里说今年夏天可能是有记录以来最热的一年，老人们都感叹没经历过这样的酷暑。
on record.translation: 朋友：今年夏天也太热了吧 你：气象部门说这可能是有记录以来最热的 朋友：我活了几十年 真没见过这种热法 你：确实 这是有史以来最高的气温了 朋友：再这样下去可怎么好
on record.example: Friend: This summer is unbelievably hot. You: The weather office says it may be the hottest on record. Friend: I've lived decades and never seen heat like this. You: Right, this is the hottest temperature on record. Friend: What are we going to do if it keeps going?

on repeat.context: 你健身时总爱把同一首歌放进播放列表反复听，朋友笑你一首歌听到腻，你却觉得有节奏才带劲。
on repeat.translation: 朋友：你手机里怎么老放同一首歌啊 你：这首歌特别带劲 我跑步时一直循环播放 朋友：循环播放不会听腻吗 你：不会 跟着节奏跑反而更有劲 朋友：你这听歌方式也太专一了
on repeat.example: Friend: Why do you always play the same song on your phone? You: This track is so pumping, I play it on repeat when I run. Friend: Doesn't playing it on repeated loop get boring? You: No, running to the beat actually pushes me harder. Friend: You're really devoted to this one song.

on sb's behalf.context: 你临时要去外地出差，赶不上公司会议，只好拜托同事代表你在会上发言表态。
on sb's behalf.translation: 朋友：下午的项目会你还参加吗 你：我赶不回来了 得拜托你代表我去 朋友：你是让我代表你发言吗 你：对 麻烦你替我在会上表个态 朋友：行 那你放心去吧 这边交给我
on sb's behalf.example: Friend: Are you still joining this afternoon's project meeting? You: I can't make it back, I'll have to ask you to go on my behalf. Friend: You mean I should speak on your behalf? You: Yes, please voice my position at the meeting on my behalf. Friend: Fine, go ahead, leave it to me.

on screen.context: 你吐槽追剧时真人比屏幕上瘦多了，朋友笑着说镜头其实会把人拍得显胖，本人反而更好看。
on screen.translation: 朋友：这个演员真人比电视上瘦好多啊 你：我也发现了 镜头真的会骗人 朋友：他在屏幕上看着就挺正常的 你：可一上镜人就显胖 现实中反而更清秀 朋友：看来荧幕形象真不能当真
on screen.example: Friend: This actor is much thinner in person than on TV. You: I noticed too, the camera really does lie. Friend: He looks perfectly normal on screen though. You: But on screen you look bigger, in person he's actually slimmer. Friend: So on-screen image really can't be trusted.

on site.context: 网络断了，工程师直接赶到机房现场排查，说很多问题必须到现场才能看出症结。
on site.translation: 朋友：网修好没有 你们IT怎么说 你：工程师已经赶到机房现场了 朋友：远程不能解决吗 还要跑一趟 你：很多故障必须到现场才能查清楚 朋友：那这次估计要折腾一阵子了
on site.example: Friend: Is the internet fixed, what did IT say? You: The engineer is already on site at the server room. Friend: Can't it be fixed remotely, why go there? You: A lot of faults can only be diagnosed properly on site. Friend: Then this is going to take a while.

on stage.context: 第一次上台演讲前你紧张得手心冒汗，老师鼓励你站到台上就当台下没人，自然发挥就好。
on stage.translation: 朋友：第一次上台演讲 你紧张不紧张 你：紧张啊 手心全是汗 朋友：站到台上别往下看 盯着远处就行 你：我怕一站上舞台就大脑空白 朋友：放松点 你准备得很充分了
on stage.example: Friend: Are you nervous about speaking on stage for the first time? You: I am, my palms are all sweaty. Friend: Once you're on stage, don't look down, just gaze into the distance. You: I'm afraid I'll go blank once I'm on stage. Friend: Relax, you've prepared really well.

on standby.context: 医院急诊人手紧张，部分医生今天处于待命状态，一有需要就得立刻顶上。
on standby.translation: 朋友：你们科室今天忙得过来吗 你：人手挺紧的 好多医生都在待命 朋友：待命是说随时要上班吗 你：对 大家随时准备着 一有急诊就顶上 朋友：那你们这工作强度也太大了
on standby.example: Friend: Is your department coping today? You: We're short-handed, many doctors are on standby. Friend: Does on standby mean on call any moment? You: Right, everyone is on standby and jumps in the second there's an emergency. Friend: Your workload is just enormous.

on the condition that.context: 妈妈答应给你买新自行车，但前提条件是这学期成绩不能掉出前五，你只好暗自努力。
on the condition that.translation: 朋友：你妈真答应给你买新车啦 你：嗯 不过有个前提条件 朋友：什么条件啊 你：她说只有我期末考进前五才买 朋友：那你可得加把劲了
on the condition that.example: Friend: Did your mum really promise to buy you a new bike? You: Yeah, but there's a condition. Friend: What condition? You: She said she will, on the condition I make the top five this term. Friend: Then you'd really better put in the work.

on the dole.context: 闲聊时聊到英国福利制度，朋友说有些年轻人嫌工作累，干脆靠着领救济金过日子。
on the dole.translation: 朋友：英国年轻人现在都靠什么生活啊 你：不少人没工作 就靠失业救济金过活 朋友：一直领救济金 那不就废了吗 你：大家管这叫领失业救济 听着都让人着急 朋友：这种生活方式真不行
on the dole.example: Friend: How do young people in Britain make a living these days? You: Many are out of work and just living on the dole. Friend: Living on the dole like that, won't they just waste away? You: People call it being on the dole, it's worrying to watch. Friend: That way of living really doesn't work.

on the dot.context: 和朋友约好八点在咖啡馆见，你七点五十九就到了，推门进去发现对方已经坐在那等你。
on the dot.translation: 朋友：我们约的八点 你怎么这么早 你：我掐着点来的 八点整准到 朋友：你倒是真准时 一分不差 你：说好了八点 我当然得准点到啊 朋友：行 那我下次也不迟到了
on the dot.example: Friend: We said eight, why are you so early? You: I timed it, I'll arrive right at eight on the dot. Friend: You're really punctual, not a second off. You: We agreed on eight, so of course I'll be there on the dot. Friend: Fine, I won't be late next time either.

on the edge of.context: 公司财报出来前，整个部门都悬着心，感觉马上就要站在裁员的边缘上，气氛压抑。
on the edge of.translation: 朋友：你们公司最近气氛怎么样啊 你：挺压抑的 大家都在等财报消息 朋友：是不是快撑不住了 你：感觉公司已经濒临裁员的边缘了 朋友：那你要不要偷偷看看新机会
on the edge of.example: Friend: How's the atmosphere at your company lately? You: Pretty tense, everyone's waiting for the earnings report. Friend: Are they about to go under? You: It feels like the firm is on the edge of layoffs. Friend: Then shouldn't you quietly look for new opportunities?

on the flip side.context: 朋友只看到这件事花钱多，你却提醒他换个角度看，省下的时间其实更值钱。
on the flip side.translation: 朋友：花这么多钱请人打扫 太奢侈了吧 你：可是换个角度看 我们省下了时间啊 朋友：还能这么算账 朋友说 朋友：反过来看 时间拿去加班不也能赚回来吗 你：你这么一说 好像也有点道理
on the flip side.example: Friend: Spending this much on a cleaner is such a luxury. You: But on the flip side, we save so much time. Friend: You can count it that way? Friend: On the flip side, isn't that time earned back working overtime? You: Put that way, you might have a point.

on the go.context: 你连续跑了一天展会，从早到晚没停过，晚上瘫在沙发上感叹自己这一整天真是连轴转。
on the go.translation: 朋友：你今天跑展会跑得怎么样 你：累瘫了 从早忙到晚没歇过 朋友：你这一天到晚也太拼了 你：可不是嘛 我整天都在连轴转 朋友：赶紧泡个澡好好歇歇吧
on the go.example: Friend: How did your trade fair day go? You: I'm wiped out, busy from dawn till dusk without a break. Friend: You've really been on the go all day. You: Exactly, I've been on the go nonstop the whole day. Friend: Go soak in a bath and rest properly.

on the ground.context: 新闻说救援物资已经空投，但记者强调地面情况和新闻里看到的完全是两码事。
on the ground.translation: 朋友：灾区那边救援不是已经到位了吗 你：新闻看着挺好 可实际情况完全不同 朋友：差别很大吗 你：到了现场才知道 地面上困难重重 朋友：看来报道总归是隔了一层
on the ground.example: Friend: Hasn't relief already reached the disaster area? You: It looks fine on the news, but the reality is totally different. Friend: Is the gap that big? You: Only on the ground do you realise how hard things really are. Friend: So reports always are one step removed.

on the job.context: 新员工问你能不能边上班边摸鱼刷手机，你笑着说上班时间就该专注做事，别想偷懒。
on the job.translation: 朋友：上班的时候偷偷刷会儿手机 应该没事吧 你：最好别 工作时间就该专心 朋友：偶尔放松一下嘛 你：在岗位上就好好干活 别老想着偷懒 朋友：行吧 我还是认真干活吧
on the job.example: Friend: Is it okay to sneak in some phone time at work? You: Better not, you should focus while on the job. Friend: Just a little break now and then. You: While you're on the job, just work hard and stop slacking. Friend: Fine, I'll get my work done then.

on the nose.context: 朋友问你这场比赛比分猜得准不准，你说你猜的结果和最后比分几乎一模一样，简直精准到点。
on the nose.translation: 朋友：你赛前猜的比分是多少来着 你：我猜的二比一 结果真就是二比一 朋友：哇 你也猜得太准了吧 你：可不是嘛 简直准到不能再准 朋友：下次赌球你可得带带我
on the nose.example: Friend: What score did you predict before the match? You: I said two-one, and it really ended two-one. Friend: Wow, you nailed it exactly. You: Right, it was dead on the nose. Friend: Next time betting, you have to take me along.

on the rise.context: 夏天一到，医院里肠胃门诊的病人就越来越多，医生说这类季节性小毛病正在逐年增多。
on the rise.translation: 朋友：最近你怎么老去医院啊 你：肠胃不太好 夏天肠胃病人特别多 朋友：是不是天热吃东西不干净闹的 你：可能吧 这类小毛病好像越来越多了 朋友：那你冰的东西可得少吃
on the rise.example: Friend: Why have you been going to hospital so much lately? You: My stomach's off, there are so many gut patients in summer. Friend: Is it from eating unclean food in the heat? You: Maybe, these little ailments seem to be on the rise. Friend: Then you should cut down on cold drinks.

on the road.context: 你辞了职，打算花几个月开车环岛旅行，朋友打电话问你近况，你说自己目前正在路上。
on the road.translation: 朋友：你辞职之后都在忙些什么呀 你：我开车出来旅行 一路向南走 朋友：这日子也太自在了 你：我现在就是在路上 想去哪就去哪 朋友：注意安全 玩够了记得回来
on the road.example: Friend: What have you been up to since you quit? You: I'm on a road trip, driving south along the coast. Friend: That life sounds totally free. You: Right now I'm on the road, going wherever I feel like. Friend: Stay safe, and come back when you've had enough.

on the scene.context: 火灾现场浓烟滚滚，消防员赶到后第一时间冲进楼里救人，目击者拍下了他们到场的画面。
on the scene.translation: 朋友：新闻里那栋楼着火你看了吗 你：看了 消防几分钟就赶到了现场 朋友：他们一到场就冲进去了吗 你：对 消防员第一时间出现在现场救人 朋友：真是太勇敢了
on the scene.example: Friend: Did you see the news about that building on fire? You: Yeah, firefighters were on the scene within minutes. Friend: Did they rush in the moment they were on the scene? You: Right, the crew were on the scene immediately to rescue people. Friend: They're truly brave.

on the top.context: 你爬山时口渴，想把水放在背包最上面好随手拿，结果一翻包发现东西堆得盖住了壶。
on the top.translation: 朋友：你水放哪了 我找半天找不到 你：我记得就放在背包上面啊 朋友：上面全是衣服 根本看不到壶 你：我把东西挪开 水壶其实在最上面一层 朋友：你这包塞得也太满了
on the top.example: Friend: Where did you put the water? I've looked forever. You: I thought I put it on the top of the bag. Friend: The top's all clothes, I can't see the bottle. You: Let me move things, the bottle's actually on the very top. Friend: You've crammed this bag way too full.

on the up.context: 朋友的小公司这半年订单越来越多，势头很好，他笑着说生意最近真是节节高升。
on the up.translation: 朋友：你那家小公司最近生意怎么样 你：挺不错的 订单一个接一个 朋友：看来你这事业是走上坡路了 你：是啊 我感觉生意正在节节攀升 朋友：照这势头 明年能扩团队了
on the up.example: Friend: How's business at your small company lately? You: Pretty good, orders are coming in one after another. Friend: So your business is really on the up then. You: Yeah, I feel the business is on the up. Friend: At this rate, you can expand the team next year.

on their own.context: 孩子想去夏令营又不放心家里，你鼓励他大胆去，说很多事他自己一个人也能做得很好。
on their own.translation: 朋友：儿子第一次去夏令营 舍不得吧 你：有点 可他总要学会独立 朋友：他担心自己一个人应付不来 你：告诉他 很多事他凭自己也能行 朋友：是该让孩子独自锻炼锻炼
on their own.example: Friend: Your son's first summer camp, hard to let go? You: A little, but he has to learn to be independent. Friend: He's worried he can't manage on his own. You: Tell him he can manage many things on his own. Friend: Kids should build independence on their own.

on top.context: 比赛最后一分钟你方还落后两分，这时队友投进一个三分球，一下反超占了上风。
on top.translation: 朋友：最后那球进得太关键了吧 你：可不是 一投进我们立刻就领先了 朋友：你方这是直接占了上风啊 你：对 最后一分钟我们反超占据了优势 朋友：这球看得人心脏都快跳出来了
on top.example: Friend: That last basket was so crucial. You: Exactly, the moment it went in we took the lead. Friend: Your side is on top now. You: Right, we were on top after the last-minute turnaround. Friend: That shot made my heart race.

on top of.context: 你上班已经很累了，结果回家还要做饭、遛狗、辅导孩子作业，一堆事全凑到了一起。
on top of.translation: 朋友：你今天下班怎么一脸憔悴 你：上班已经够累了 回家还一堆事 朋友：都忙些什么啊 你：做饭遛狗辅导作业 再加上孩子发烧 朋友：你这一天也太难了
on top of.example: Friend: Why do you look worn out after work today? You: Work's exhausting enough, and at home there's a pile on. Friend: What's keeping you so busy? You: Cooking, walking the dog, homework, and on top of that the kid has a fever. Friend: Your day has been way too much.

on top of that.context: 你早上起晚了赶地铁，结果到了公司发现忘带电脑，偏偏电梯又坏了，真是祸不单行。
on top of that.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么一路跑着来的 你：起晚了赶地铁 已经够惨了 朋友：还有更糟的吗 你：更糟的是我把电脑落家里了 朋友：你今天也太倒霉了吧
on top of that.example: Friend: Why did you come sprinting in today? You: I woke up late and rushed the subway, that was bad enough. Friend: Could it get any worse? You: On top of that, I left my laptop at home. Friend: Today is just piling it on for you.

on top of this.context: 公司这个月利润刚好转，结果原材料又涨价，紧接着客户还压价，真是屋漏偏逢连夜雨。
on top of this.translation: 朋友：公司这个月终于赚了点钱吧 你：刚缓过来一点 原材料就涨价了 朋友：真是没完没了啊 你：更惨的是客户还一个劲压价 朋友：这行现在是真难做
on top of this.example: Friend: The company finally made a bit this month? You: We just turned a corner when the raw materials went up. Friend: It just never ends. You: On top of this, customers keep pressing us on price. Friend: This industry is really hard now.

on track.context: 项目进度比预期慢了一周，老板把大家叫去开会，问怎样才能让一切重回正轨。
on track.translation: 朋友：这周项目进度有点滞后啊 你：是 比原计划慢了大概一周 朋友：那咱们得赶紧把它拉回正轨 你：对 要尽快让一切回到计划轨道上来 朋友：今天加班把落后的补上吧
on track.example: Friend: The project is slipping this week. You: Yeah, it's about a week behind plan. Friend: Then we need to get it back on track fast. You: Right, we must get everything on track as soon as possible. Friend: Let's work overtime today to catch up.

on-demand film.context: 周末不想出门去影院，你便窝在沙发上打开电视，挑一部点播影片躺着看。
on-demand film.translation: 朋友：周末晚上怎么安排呀 你：不想出门了 在家挑部片子看 朋友：是去影院还是在电视上点啊 你：我打算在电视上点播一部影片 躺着多舒服 朋友：那我也去你家一起看
on-demand film.example: Friend: What's the plan for Saturday night? You: I don't want to go out, I'll pick a film at home. Friend: Cinema or on demand on the TV? You: I'll pick an on-demand film on the telly, so comfy lying down. Friend: Then I'll come over and watch with you.

on-demand listening.context: 你开车通勤时不爱听直播电台，更喜欢随时点开自己喜欢的播客，想停就停想跳就跳。
on-demand listening.translation: 朋友：你开车路上都听什么节目啊 你：我不爱听直播电台 更爱听播客 朋友：听直播不也挺好吗 你：我喜欢这种点播收听 想暂停就暂停 朋友：确实 自己掌控节奏最舒服
on-demand listening.example: Friend: What do you listen to on your commute? You: I don't like live radio, I prefer podcasts. Friend: Isn't live radio nice too? You: I prefer on-demand listening, I can pause whenever I want. Friend: True, controlling the pace yourself is best.

onboard catering.context: 坐长途火车时你嫌自带饭麻烦，便问乘务员车上都提供哪些餐食，结果选择还挺多。
onboard catering.translation: 朋友：坐这趟长途车要好几个小时 吃饭咋办 你：我问了乘务员 车上有餐车 朋友：那车上都提供什么吃的啊 你：盒饭点心饮料都有 这种车上餐食还挺全 朋友：那我就放心了 不用自带干粮
onboard catering.example: Friend: This long train ride takes hours, how do we eat? You: I asked the attendant, there's a dining car. Friend: What on-board catering do they offer? You: Boxed meals, snacks and drinks, the on-board catering is quite complete. Friend: Then I'm relieved, no need to bring my own.

once in a blue moon.context: 朋友约你周末去爬山，你说自己平日忙得很，大概一年也就爬这么一回，机会难得。
once in a blue moon.translation: 朋友：这周末去爬山 你去不去啊 你：我最近太忙了 平时真抽不出空 朋友：那好不容易约一次 就当放松了 你：行吧 我这种机会真是千载难逢 朋友：那就说定了 周六早上见
once in a blue moon.example: Friend: Hiking this weekend, coming? You: I've been so busy lately, I rarely find time. Friend: Then since we rarely meet up, just treat it as a break. You: Alright, this chance for me comes once in a blue moon. Friend: It's a deal then, see you Saturday morning.

once more.context: 你唱歌时高音破了音，朋友笑着让你再来一遍，说这次肯定能唱上去。
once more.translation: 朋友：刚那高音没上去啊 你：我紧张了一下 没发挥好 朋友：没关系 你再唱一遍试试 你：那我重新唱一次 朋友：这次状态好多了
once more.example: Friend: You didn't hit that high note just now. You: I tensed up a bit, it didn't go well. Friend: No worries, try once more. You: Then I'll sing it once more. Friend: Much better this time.

one size fits all.context: 公司发福利不区分新老员工，人人都拿一样的购物卡，你觉得这种一刀切的做法有点不公平。
one size fits all.translation: 朋友：今年公司福利发的购物卡挺厚啊 你：可新老员工都发一样的 不太合理吧 朋友：你是说这是一刀切 没考虑差别 你：对 这种一刀切的做法 干多干少都一样 朋友：确实应该按贡献来发
one size fits all.example: Friend: This year's welfare shopping cards are pretty generous. You: But new and old staff all get the same, isn't that odd? Friend: You mean it's one size fits all, ignoring differences? You: Right, this one-size-fits-all way rewards everyone the same. Friend: It really should be based on contribution.

one's cup of tea.context: 朋友约你去看画展，你对抽象画实在提不起兴趣，直说那种艺术不太合你的口味。
one's cup of tea.translation: 朋友：周末那个抽象画展 一起去看吗 你：我对那种画真没什么感觉 朋友：就当陶冶情操嘛 你：说实话 这类艺术不太合我的口味 朋友：行吧 那我们去看电影
one's cup of tea.example: Friend: Want to go to that abstract art show this weekend? You: I really don't feel much for that kind of painting. Friend: Just go to broaden your mind. You: Honestly, that art isn't really my cup of tea. Friend: Fine, let's go see a film instead.

ones to watch.context: 公司新招进来几个实习生，其中一个特别有灵气，老板说这几个年轻人值得大家重点关注。
ones to watch.translation: 朋友：新来的实习生你留意过吗 你：有个小伙子特别机灵 一看就是好苗子 朋友：他是这届里最有潜力的吗 你：对 他们几个都是值得关注的新人 朋友：好好培养 将来能挑大梁
ones to watch.example: Friend: Have you noticed the new interns? You: One young man is really sharp, clearly a rising talent. Friend: Is he the most promising of the batch? You: Yeah, they're all ones to watch. Friend: Nurture them well, they'll lead one day.

online course.context: 你打算利用下班后的时间充充电，朋友推荐你报一门网课，说在家就能学还省钱。
online course.translation: 朋友：你最近不是想提升一下自己吗 你：是啊 想报点课学学新东西 朋友：那报个网课呗 在家就能上课 你：网课时间灵活 挺适合我这种上班族 朋友：那你赶紧选一门报上
online course.example: Friend: Weren't you wanting to improve yourself lately? You: Yeah, I want to take some courses and learn new things. Friend: Then take an online course, you can study at home. You: An online course is flexible, perfect for a working person like me. Friend: Then pick one and sign up soon.

online dating.context: 你一直单身，朋友说现在年轻人都爱在交友软件上认识异性，劝你也试试线上约会。
online dating.translation: 朋友：你都单身两年了 怎么还不找对象 你：圈子太小 认识不了新朋友 朋友：现在大家都用软件线上交友啊 你：线上交友靠谱吗 我有点没底 朋友：可以试试看 反正不亏
online dating.example: Friend: You've been single two years, why not date? You: My social circle's too small to meet anyone new. Friend: Everyone does online dating on apps these days. You: Is online dating reliable? I'm not so sure. Friend: Just give it a try, no harm done.

online learning platform.context: 表妹想自学编程，你建议她先找个靠谱的线上学习平台，跟着系统课程一步步入门。
online learning platform.translation: 朋友：我想学编程 该从哪里开始啊 你：先找个靠谱的线上学习平台 朋友：上面的课讲得明白吗 你：找个好的线上学习平台 跟着视频系统学就行 朋友：那我今晚就去注册一个
online learning platform.example: Friend: I want to learn coding, where do I start? You: First find a reliable online learning platform. Friend: Are the courses on it clear? You: Get a good online learning platform and follow the videos systematically. Friend: Then I'll sign up tonight.

online lecture.context: 疫情期间学校停课，老师改成在网上直播讲课，同学们守着电脑听这场线上讲座。
online lecture.translation: 朋友：这周学校又停课了吗 你：是啊 老师改成在网上直播讲课 朋友：这种线上讲座效果怎么样 你：比想象中好 还能回放看重播 朋友：科技发达了 停课也不耽误学习
online lecture.example: Friend: Is school closed again this week? You: Yeah, teachers switched to online lectures. Friend: How do those online lectures work out? You: Better than expected, and you can replay them. Friend: Technology lets learning continue even when closed.

online platform.context: 你想找个能同时买菜、订餐、缴费的一站式服务，朋友说现在一个手机应用就能全搞定。
online platform.translation: 朋友：你平时都用什么软件点外卖啊 你：我用那个综合应用 啥都能办 朋友：是那种一站式在线平台吗 你：对 买菜订餐缴费都在这个在线平台上 朋友：确实省事 一个顶好几个
online platform.example: Friend: What app do you usually use to order food? You: I use that all-in-one app for everything. Friend: Is it that one online platform? You: Right, groceries, delivery and bills, all on one online platform. Friend: So handy, one app does the work of several.

online retail.context: 开实体店的阿姨抱怨生意一年不如一年，说大家现在都习惯网购，线上零售抢走了客流。
online retail.translation: 朋友：阿姨这店今年生意怎么样啊 你：唉 一年比一年难做了 朋友：是被网购抢走了生意吗 你：可不是嘛 现在线上零售太火了 朋友：要不您也试试开个网店
online retail.example: Friend: How's business at your aunt's shop this year? You: Sigh, it gets harder every year. Friend: Is online shopping taking your customers? You: Exactly, online retail is booming these days. Friend: Why not try opening an online store yourself?

online retailer.context: 你在网上买了件衣服，担心尺码不合适，朋友说这家在线零售商支持七天无理由退货，很方便。
online retailer.translation: 朋友：你网上买衣服 不怕尺码不合适吗 你：我看这家在线零售商支持退换 朋友：退换方便吗 运费谁出 你：这家在线零售商七天内随便退 挺省心的 朋友：那我也敢在网上下单了
online retailer.example: Friend: Buying clothes online, aren't you worried about the size? You: I saw this online retailer accepts returns. Friend: Is returning easy, who pays shipping? You: This online retailer lets you return within seven days, hassle-free. Friend: Then I dare order online too.

online shopping.context: 周末你懒得跑商场，干脆窝在沙发上点手机下单，朋友笑你现在出门都少了，全靠网购。
online shopping.translation: 朋友：周末陪我去商场逛逛呗 你：不想动了 我在家手机上买就行 朋友：你现在真是网购达人啊 你：网购多省事 送货上门 朋友：也对 我也躺着下单吧
online shopping.example: Friend: Come to the mall with me this weekend. You: Can't be bothered, I'll just order on my phone at home. Friend: You're such an online shopping addict now. You: Online shopping is so easy, it delivers right to the door. Friend: True, I'll just order from the couch too.

online sites.context: 你想查一家店靠不靠谱，朋友建议你先去点评网站看看评价，别光看商家自己的宣传。
online sites.translation: 朋友：那家新开的餐厅靠谱吗 你：我也不知道 没去过 朋友：你可以上网查查点评网站啊 你：对 我先去那些在线网站上看看评价 朋友：差评多的话咱就换一家
online sites.example: Friend: Is that new restaurant any good? You: I don't know, I've never been. Friend: You can check review sites online. You: Right, I'll look it up on those online sites for reviews first. Friend: If the reviews are bad, let's pick another place.

only if.context: 老板说这个项目只有在团队全力以赴的前提下才能提前交付，否则宁可顺延一周。
only if.translation: 朋友：项目能提前一周交吗 你：老板说只有大家全力投入才行 朋友：意思是条件很严格 你：对 只有满足这个条件 我们才能提前交 朋友：那这周都得加班了
only if.example: Friend: Can we deliver the project a week early? You: The boss says only if the team goes all out. Friend: So the condition is pretty strict? You: Right, only under that condition can we deliver early. Friend: Then we're all working overtime this week.

only just.context: 你搬新家刚收拾完，朋友来访时你说自己才刚住进来没几天，好多东西还没归置好。
only just.translation: 朋友：你新家收拾得怎么样了 你：我才刚搬进来没几天 朋友：住得还习惯吧 家具都到位了吗 你：刚刚才把床支起来 其他还乱着呢 朋友：不着急 慢慢弄
only just.example: Friend: How's your new place coming along? You: I only just moved in a few days ago. Friend: Are you settling in, is the furniture all there? You: I've only just put the bed up, the rest is still a mess. Friend: No rush, take your time.

only then.context: 老师说你必须先把基础打扎实，到那时才能谈提高难度，一步都不能急。
only then.translation: 朋友：我想直接练最难的曲子 行不行 你：老师说得先把基本功练扎实 朋友：那要练到什么时候才行啊 你：只有那时 你才能开始弹难曲子 朋友：行吧 那我从头慢慢练
only then.example: Friend: Can I start practising the hardest piece directly? You: The teacher says you must nail the basics first. Friend: When will that be? You: Only then can you begin the difficult pieces. Friend: Alright, I'll start from the bottom slowly.

only to.context: 你兴冲冲跑到机场想给女友惊喜，结果到了才发现她坐的航班早就飞走了，白跑一趟。
only to.translation: 朋友：你今天去机场接到女朋友了吗 你：我兴冲冲跑过去 结果航班早就走了 朋友：你不是看错时间了吧 你：我赶了过去 结果却发现早过了登机时间 朋友：真是空欢喜一场
only to.example: Friend: Did you pick up your girlfriend at the airport today? You: I rushed over excitedly, only to find her flight had already left. Friend: You didn't read the time wrong, did you? You: I hurried there, only to find boarding had long passed. Friend: What an empty thrill.

only to find.context: 你翻山越岭去看传说中的绝美瀑布，到了眼前才发现水已经干了，只剩一块光秃秃的石头。
only to find.translation: 朋友：那个网红瀑布你去看了吗 你：我爬了半天山 结果大失所望 朋友：怎么了 不好看吗 你：我好不容易赶到 结果却发现瀑布早就干了 朋友：网上的照片果然不能信
only to find.example: Friend: Did you see that famous waterfall? You: I hiked for ages, only to be really let down. Friend: What happened, wasn't it pretty? You: I made it all the way, only to find the waterfall had dried up. Friend: Online photos really can't be trusted.

open dialogue.context: 夫妻之间有点矛盾很正常，关键是别憋着，坐下来坦诚沟通才能把问题说开。
open dialogue.translation: 朋友：你们俩昨天是不是吵架了 你：有点小别扭 不过今晚打算好好聊聊 朋友：别冷战 有话摊开说 你：对 我们需要一次坦诚的交谈 把误会解开 朋友：说开了就好了
open dialogue.example: Friend: Did you two have a row yesterday? You: A little tiff, but we plan to talk it out tonight. Friend: Don't give the silent treatment, just speak openly. You: Right, we need an open dialogue to clear up the misunderstanding. Friend: It's fine once it's out in the open.

open doors to.context: 学好一门外语不光能出国旅游，还能为你打开通往更大世界的大门，机会多得多。
open doors to.translation: 朋友：你说我现在学外语还来得及吗 你：当然 多一门语言就多一条路 朋友：真有那么大差别吗 你：学好外语能为你打开很多新机会 朋友：那我今晚就开始背单词
open doors to.example: Friend: Is it too late for me to learn a language now? You: Of course not, one more language is one more path. Friend: Does it really make that big a difference? You: Mastering a language can open doors to many new opportunities. Friend: Then I'll start memorising words tonight.

open for business.context: 装修队通知你新店已经装修好，今天正式开门营业，邀请你第一天去捧场试吃。
open for business.translation: 朋友：你那家新店装修好了吗 你：差不多了 今天正式开始营业 朋友：那我可得第一天去捧个场 你：欢迎你来 今天我们开门做生意 全场八折 朋友：那我下班就过去
open for business.example: Friend: Is your new shop renovated yet? You: Almost, we open for business today. Friend: Then I must show up on day one. You: You're welcome, today we're open for business with twenty percent off. Friend: Then I'll head over after work.

open letter.context: 毕业十周年班长发起一封联名信，把大家对母校的祝福和建议都写进去，打算交给校长。
open letter.translation: 朋友：毕业这么多年 大家想给母校留点什么 你：要不联名写一封公开信吧 朋友：公开信里都写些什么呢 你：把大家的祝福和建议都放进这封公开信 朋友：这主意好 既真诚又有分量
open letter.example: Friend: Ten years on, what should we leave for our alma mater? You: How about signing an open letter together? Friend: What would we put in the open letter? You: Put everyone's wishes and suggestions in this open letter. Friend: Great idea, heartfelt and weighty.

open up.context: 辞职后你去了大理住了半年，那段自由的日子一下子为你打开了全新的生活方式。
open up.translation: 朋友：你在大理那半年都做了什么呀 你：就是发呆看云 想清楚了很多事 朋友：那趟旅行改变你了吗 你：它真的为我打开了一扇看世界的新窗 朋友：看来你这步走对了
open up.example: Friend: What did you do those six months in Dali? You: Just watched the clouds and thought through a lot of things. Friend: Did that trip change you? You: It really opened up a whole new way of living for me. Friend: Looks like you made the right move.

opens doors to.context: 这份新工作不但薪水高，还为你打开了通往海外市场的大门，发展空间一下子大了很多。
opens doors to.translation: 朋友：你接了那个新 offer 吗 你：接了 待遇比现在好不少 朋友：还有别的吸引你的地方吗 你：它还为我打开了海外发展的机会 朋友：那这步棋下得太值了
opens doors to.example: Friend: Did you take that new offer? You: Yes, the pay's a lot better than now. Friend: Anything else drawing you to it? You: It also opens doors to overseas opportunities for me. Friend: Then this move is totally worth it.

opens up.context: 孩子终于肯自己拧开瓶盖了，那只小手一下一下使劲，瓶盖慢慢张开，他高兴得直拍手。
opens up.translation: 朋友：宝宝今天会自己开瓶盖了 你：是啊 他小手使劲拧 终于把盖子弄开了 朋友：他是不是特别有成就感 你：对 盖子一打开 他高兴得直拍手 朋友：小家伙进步真快
opens up.example: Friend: The baby can open the bottle cap by himself today. You: Yeah, his little hand twisted hard and finally it opened up. Friend: Is he so proud of himself? You: Right, the moment it opened up he clapped his hands. Friend: The little one is progressing fast.

operational cost.context: 开店最头疼的就是房租水电这些固定开销，老板说每个月光是运营成本就压得人喘不过气。
operational cost.translation: 朋友：你这店每个月能赚多少啊 你：扣掉房租水电 其实剩不了多少 朋友：主要开销是哪一块呢 你：光是每个月的运营成本就占了一大半 朋友：实体店真是不容易
operational cost.example: Friend: How much do you make a month at this shop? You: After rent and utilities, not much is left. Friend: Where's the main cost? You: The monthly operational cost alone takes up more than half. Friend: Running a physical shop is really tough.

ophthalmic surgeon.context: 你近视度数又涨了，妈妈带你去大医院找专门做眼睛手术的医生检查，说这方面得找专家。
ophthalmic surgeon.translation: 朋友：你眼睛又不舒服了 想去哪家医院啊 你：我妈让我挂个眼科专家号看看 朋友：是那种专门做眼睛手术的大夫吗 你：对 就找那位眼科外科医生 朋友：让专家看看 心里也踏实
ophthalmic surgeon.example: Friend: Your eyes are bothering again, which hospital? You: My mum wants me to book an eye specialist. Friend: Is that a surgeon who operates on eyes? You: Right, we'll see that ophthalmic surgeon. Friend: Seeing a specialist puts your mind at ease.

opinion is divided.context: 要不要给老人装电梯，楼里的邻居们吵成一团，有人赞成有人反对，谁也说服不了谁。
opinion is divided.translation: 朋友：咱们楼加装电梯那事 定下来了吗 你：还没呢 邻居们意见根本统一不了 朋友：有人支持 有人反对是吧 你：对 大家意见分歧 谁也说服不了谁 朋友：这事急不得 慢慢谈吧
opinion is divided.example: Friend: Has the elevator thing in our building been settled? You: Not yet, the neighbours just can't agree. Friend: Some support, some oppose, right? You: Right, opinion is divided and no one can convince anyone. Friend: It can't be rushed, let's talk slowly.

opportunities for promotion.context: 你在公司干了三年还是原地踏步，同事悄悄告诉你这家店晋升机会不多，劝你骑驴找马。
opportunities for promotion.translation: 朋友：你来公司三年了 升过职吗 你：没有 一直还是原来的岗位 朋友：是不是这家公司晋升机会太少了 你：对 这里的晋升机会特别有限 朋友：那你该看看外面的机会了
opportunities for promotion.example: Friend: You've been here three years, have you been promoted? You: No, still the same post. Friend: Are the opportunities for promotion here just too few? You: Right, the opportunities for promotion are really limited. Friend: Then you should look at opportunities outside.

opt for.context: 毕业季面临两个offer，一个稳定一个高薪，纠结半天后你最终选择了更有发展空间的那家。
opt for.translation: 朋友：两个offer 你最后选了哪一个啊 你：纠结了好久 还是选了发展空间大的 朋友：你是怎么做出这个选择的 你：我最终决定选那家更能成长的 朋友：年轻就该选有挑战的
opt for.example: Friend: Of the two offers, which did you pick in the end? You: After ages of hesitation, I chose the one with more growth. Friend: How did you make that choice? You: I finally opted for the one that offers more growth. Friend: Young people should pick a challenge.

opt for outdoors.context: 周末天气特别好，朋友约你去爬山，你却更想待在阳台晒太阳，于是你们选了各自喜欢的放松方式。
opt for outdoors.translation: 朋友：这么好的天 咱们去爬山吧 你：我今天不太想动 就想待着 朋友：那你打算干嘛 你：我更想宅家晒太阳 你选户外活动也行 朋友：行 咱们各玩各的
opt for outdoors.example: Friend: Such a nice day, let's go hiking. You: I don't feel like moving today, I just want to laze. Friend: What do you plan to do then? You: I'd rather stay home in the sun, you can opt for outdoors. Friend: Fine, let's each do our own thing.

opt out.context: 公司推出一个可选的付费会员服务，你本来不打算开通，最后还是选择退订这项附加收费。
opt out.translation: 朋友：公司新出的那个会员服务 你开通了吗 你：我试了一个月 觉得用不上 朋友：那你打算怎么处理啊 你：我决定不续了 干脆退订这项附加服务 朋友：确实 用不上就别花那冤枉钱
opt out.example: Friend: Did you sign up for the company's new membership? You: I tried a month, but I don't really use it. Friend: So what will you do with it? You: I won't renew, I'll opt out of that extra service. Friend: Right, don't waste money on what you don't use.

optimised for.context: 这款手机专门针对拍照做了优化，夜景模式特别强，朋友说它就是为摄影爱好者量身打造的。
optimised for.translation: 朋友：你新换的这手机 拍照清楚吗 你：特别清楚 夜景拍出来都很亮 朋友：它是不是专门为拍照做了优化啊 你：对 这款手机就是为拍照优化过的 朋友：难怪你天天拿它拍风景
optimised for.example: Friend: Is your new phone good at taking photos? You: Really clear, even night shots come out bright. Friend: Is it optimised for photography then? You: Right, this phone is optimised for taking photos. Friend: No wonder you shoot scenery with it every day.

optimistic mindset.context: 面试时被问到遇到挫折怎么办，你说自己始终保持乐观，相信办法总比困难多。
optimistic mindset.translation: 朋友：面试最后那个问题你答得怎么样 你：我讲了自己怎么面对失败 朋友：面试官都喜欢正能量的回答吧 你：我说自己一直抱着乐观的心态 不轻言放弃 朋友：这个回答肯定加分
optimistic mindset.example: Friend: How did you answer that last interview question? You: I talked about how I deal with failure. Friend: Interviewers love positive answers, right? You: I said I keep an optimistic mindset and never give up easily. Friend: That answer definitely got you points.

optimistic outlook.context: 医生建议慢性病老人多看开些，保持积极心态对身体恢复比吃药还有帮助。
optimistic outlook.translation: 朋友：爷爷这病养得怎么样了 你：医生说心态好 恢复就快 朋友：老人家现在想得开吗 你：他现在很乐观 总往好处想 朋友：保持这样的心态 对身体最有好处
optimistic outlook.example: Friend: How's your grandpa recovering from his illness? You: The doctor says a good mind speeds recovery. Friend: Is the old man keeping a positive outlook?
