You: He's very optimistic now, always looking on the bright side. Friend: Such an optimistic outlook is best for his health.

opting to.context: 毕业之后你没有急着找工作，而是选择先环游世界一年，边打工边看风景。
opting to.translation: 朋友：毕业之后你怎么不先找工作啊 你：我想先出去看看 给自己放个假 朋友：那你打算怎么安排这一年呢 你：我打算先周游世界 边打工边旅行 朋友：年轻真好 想干嘛干嘛
opting to.example: Friend: Why aren't you looking for a job after graduation? You: I want to go out and see the world, give myself a break. Friend: So how will you spend this year? You: I'm opting to travel around the world, working as I go. Friend: Youth is great, you can do whatever you want.

or else.context: 妈妈催你赶紧把作业写完，不然今晚就不许看电视，你只好磨磨蹭蹭地坐回书桌前。
or else.translation: 朋友：你怎么不出去玩啊 还在写作业呢 你：我妈说不写完就不许看电视 朋友：那你快点写呗 朋友：你赶紧把作业搞定 不然今晚真没得看 你：知道了 我这就写
or else.example: Friend: Why aren't you out playing, still doing homework? You: My mum says no TV until I finish it. Friend: Then just hurry up and write. Friend: Or else you'll really get no TV tonight. You: I know, I'm writing now.

or so the saying goes.context: 奶奶常说人比人气死人，你笑着说正如俗话讲的，知足才能常乐。
or so the saying goes.translation: 朋友：我总羡慕别人赚得比我多 心里不平衡 你：奶奶不是常说 人比人气死人嘛 朋友：老人家的话还有点道理 你：正如俗话所说 知足才能常乐 朋友：也是 别跟人比 过好自己就行
or so the saying goes.example: Friend: I'm always jealous of people earning more, it's frustrating. You: Doesn't grandma always say comparing with others kills you? Friend: The old folks have a point. You: As the saying goes, contentment brings constant joy. Friend: Right, don't compare, just live your own life.

orbital debris.context: 航天课上老师说太空中飘着很多报废卫星和碎片，这些轨道垃圾对航天器威胁很大。
orbital debris.translation: 朋友：宇航员出舱会不会撞上太空垃圾啊 你：有可能 太空中碎片特别多 朋友：那些飘着的垃圾是哪来的 你：都是报废卫星变成的轨道碎片 特别危险 朋友：那宇航员工作可真够惊险的
orbital debris.example: Friend: Could astronauts hit space junk on a spacewalk? You: Possibly, there's loads of debris up there. Friend: Where does all that floating junk come from? You: It's orbital debris from dead satellites, really dangerous. Friend: Then astronauts' work is genuinely risky.

orbital pollution.context: 环保组织警告说废弃的卫星越来越多，这种轨道污染如果不治理，未来太空出行会很危险。
orbital pollution.translation: 朋友：你说卫星都挤在天上 会不会撞一起啊 你：很可能 现在太空垃圾越来越多 朋友：这种问题有个专门说法吗 你：叫轨道污染 再不治理就麻烦了 朋友：科技发展也带来新问题啊
orbital pollution.example: Friend: With satellites crowding the sky, could they collide? You: Quite likely, there's more and more space junk. Friend: Is there a term for this problem? You: It's called orbital pollution, and it'll be trouble if unmanaged. Friend: Technology brings new problems too.

ordinary patterns.context: 新来的软件还是沿用老一套操作逻辑，你用惯了之后觉得它和以前的版本没什么区别。
ordinary patterns.translation: 朋友：这新版软件用着顺手吗 你：界面变漂亮了 可操作还是老一套 朋友：跟旧版本差别大不大 你：其实和普通模式差不多 该点哪还点哪 朋友：那升级不升级都一样了
ordinary patterns.example: Friend: Is the new software version easy to use? You: The interface looks nicer, but the actions are the same. Friend: Is it very different from the old version? You: Actually it follows the ordinary patterns, still click the same spots. Friend: Then upgrading makes no difference.

organ dysfunction.context: 长期熬夜酗酒会伤肝，医生说严重时会导致某个器官无法正常工作，必须及时治疗。
organ dysfunction.translation: 朋友：他年纪轻轻怎么就住院了呢 你：长期喝酒把身体喝坏了 朋友：医生怎么说严重程度 你：说他已经出现了器官功能障碍 得赶紧治 朋友：这教训也太惨痛了
organ dysfunction.example: Friend: Why is he in hospital at such a young age? You: Years of drinking wrecked his body. Friend: How serious does the doctor say? You: He's already showing organ dysfunction, needs urgent treatment. Friend: That's such a harsh lesson.

organic content.context: 做自媒体你纠结要不要花钱推广，朋友说先做好自然流量内容，比硬广更能留住粉丝。
organic content.translation: 朋友：你这视频要不要投点广告推广一下 你：我想先把内容做好再说 朋友：不花钱推 怎么涨粉啊 你：我先发点自然生长的内容 慢慢积累粉丝 朋友：也行 内容硬了自然有人看
organic content.example: Friend: Should we spend on ads to push this video? You: I want to get the content right first. Friend: How do you grow followers without paid promotion? You: I'll post some organic content first and build followers slowly. Friend: Fine, solid content draws people naturally.

organic cotton.context: 你皮肤敏感，买内衣时专挑那种不打农药种出来的棉料，说贴身穿还是天然的放心。
organic cotton.translation: 朋友：你买衣服怎么专挑这种贵的啊 你：我皮肤敏感 得穿舒服的料子 朋友：这种棉和普通棉有什么区别 你：这是有机棉 不打农药 贴身穿更安心 朋友：难怪你只买这一种
organic cotton.example: Friend: Why do you only pick this expensive kind of clothing? You: My skin's sensitive, I need comfortable fabric. Friend: What's different about this cotton? You: It's organic cotton, no pesticides, safer against the skin. Friend: No wonder you only buy this kind.

organic produce.context: 你每周都去农贸市场挑那些没打蜡、没催熟的新鲜菜，说吃这种农产品身体才健康。
organic produce.translation: 朋友：你天天往菜市场跑 不嫌麻烦吗 你：我就爱买那种刚摘的新鲜菜 朋友：超市菜不也一样新鲜吗 你：不一样 我专挑有机农产品 吃着放心 朋友：你这是吃得讲究
organic produce.example: Friend: Don't you find it a hassle going to the market daily? You: I love buying freshly picked vegetables. Friend: Aren't supermarket greens just as fresh? You: Not the same, I only choose organic produce, it's reassuring. Friend: You really eat with care.

organically grown produce.context: 医生推荐你多吃那种不施化肥自然长出来的蔬果，说长期吃对肠胃负担小。
organically grown produce.translation: 朋友：医生让你多吃点什么啊 你：他说让我多吃点新鲜果蔬 朋友：普通蔬菜水果不行吗 你：最好选那种有机种植的农产品 没农药残留 朋友：那得多花不少钱吧
organically grown produce.example: Friend: What did the doctor tell you to eat more of? You: He said to eat more fresh fruit and veg. Friend: Aren't ordinary fruit and vegetables fine? You: Better choose organically grown produce, no pesticide residue. Friend: That must cost quite a bit more.

original recipe.context: 奶奶做的红烧肉特别香，你问她秘诀，她神秘地说全靠那本祖传下来的原始菜谱。
original recipe.translation: 朋友：你奶奶做的红烧肉也太好吃了吧 你：那是 她有一手绝活 朋友：能教教我怎么做吗 你：她说全靠那本老菜谱 配料比例都是固定的 朋友：这菜谱估计传了好几代了
original recipe.example: Friend: Your grandma's braised pork is so delicious. You: Yeah, she's got a secret touch. Friend: Can she teach me how to make it? You: She says it's all down to the original recipe, fixed proportions. Friend: That recipe must have passed down generations.

originate from.context: 你好奇这家奶茶店为什么这么火，朋友说它的配方其实源自台湾，后来才传到内地。
originate from.translation: 朋友：这家奶茶怎么突然就火遍全国了 你：我也好奇 它到底哪来的 朋友：你查过它的来历吗 你：据说它的口味源自台湾 后来才火起来 朋友：难怪喝着有点台式味道
originate from.example: Friend: How did this milk tea chain suddenly go nationwide? You: I'm curious where it actually came from. Friend: Have you looked into its origins? You: They say the taste originates from Taiwan, then spread here. Friend: No wonder it tastes a bit Taiwanese.

originate in.context: 聊到喝茶的历史，朋友说中国人种茶饮茶的习惯最早起源于西南地区，后来才传遍全国。
originate in.translation: 朋友：咱们国家喝茶的习惯是从哪开始的啊 你：这个我知道 最早起源于西南 朋友：是从云南四川那一带吗 你：对 饮茶的风俗最早起源在那里 朋友：茶文化真是源远流长
originate in.example: Friend: Where did our tea-drinking habit begin? You: I know this, it first originated in the southwest. Friend: Around Yunnan and Sichuan then? You: Right, the tea custom originated there. Friend: Tea culture really goes back centuries.

originates from.context: 你问朋友这道菜的辣味来自哪里，他说那种特殊的香辛味其实源自当地一种野生辣椒。
originates from.translation: 朋友：这道菜里那股特别的香味是啥啊 你：我也说不太清 得问问厨师 朋友：你知道这味道的来历吗 你：据说它源自当地一种野生香料 朋友：难怪吃着这么有地方特色
originates from.example: Friend: What's that special aroma in this dish? You: I'm not sure, we'd have to ask the chef. Friend: Do you know where the flavour comes from? You: They say it originates from a local wild spice. Friend: No wonder it tastes so regional.

orthorexia nervosa.context: 心理咨询师说现在有些人过度追求干净健康，到了病态的程度，把这叫健康饮食强迫症。
orthorexia nervosa.translation: 朋友：她吃饭怎么这么挑剔 连油都不吃 你：她不是挑剔 是有点心理问题 朋友：吃饭还能吃出病来啊 你：医生说这叫健康饮食强迫症 对食物过于讲究 朋友：这也太极端了
orthorexia nervosa.example: Friend: Why is she so fussy about food, won't even use oil? You: It's not fussiness, it's a bit of a mental issue. Friend: Can you get ill from eating? You: The doctor calls it orthorexia nervosa, being obsessed with clean food. Friend: That's extreme.

other than.context: 除了每天通勤坐地铁，你平时几乎不出门，周末就宅在家里看书，生活简单得很。
other than.translation: 朋友：你周末一般都出去哪玩啊 你：我基本哪都不去 就待在家 朋友：天天宅着不闷吗 你：除了上班坐地铁 我真很少出门 朋友：那你社交也太少了吧
other than.example: Friend: Where do you usually go at weekends? You: I basically go nowhere, just stay home. Friend: Isn't that boring, staying in all the time? You: Other than commuting by subway, I really hardly go out. Friend: Then your social life is too thin.

out.context: 感冒发烧请假在家躺了一周，今天感觉好多了，你打算下楼去买点东西，顺便活动活动。
out.translation: 朋友：你病好了吗 今天能出门了吗 你：好多了 想下去走走透透气 朋友：别刚退烧就累着啊 你：我就出门买点东西 顺便活动一下 朋友：那慢点走 别着急
out.example: Friend: Are you better, can you go out today? You: Much better, I want to go down for some air. Friend: Don't overdo it just after a fever. You: I'll just pop out to buy some things and get out and about. Friend: Then take it slow, don't rush.

out and about.context: 今天聚会喝了点酒，回家倒头就呼呼大睡，连闹钟都没听见，朋友笑你睡得像块木头。
out and about.translation: 朋友：昨晚聚会你怎么先走了 你：喝了点酒 一沾枕头就睡死过去 朋友：那你今早闹钟响了吗 你：我睡得特别沉 完全没听见 朋友：你这是倒头就睡啊 睡得真香
out and about.example: Friend: Why did you leave early at last night's party? You: I had some wine and was out like a light the moment my head hit the pillow. Friend: Did you hear the alarm this morning? You: I slept so deeply I didn't hear it at all. Friend: You were out like a light, what a deep sleep.

out like a light.context: 博物馆里那块古化石被绳子围了起来，工作人员说这个区域对普通参观者是禁止进入的。
out like a light.translation: 朋友：那个展厅怎么围起来了 我能进去看吗 你：不行 那块区域游客不能进 朋友：为什么不让靠近啊 你：那是重点保护区 对游客是禁止入内的 朋友：那就在外面隔着玻璃看看吧
out like a light.example: Friend: Why is that gallery roped off, can I go in? You: No, visitors can't enter that area. Friend: Why isn't it open? You: It's a protected zone, out of bounds to visitors. Friend: Then we'll just look through the glass from outside.

out of bounds.context: 朋友拉你去吃人均五百的自助，你说这价位远超自己这个月的预算，实在舍不得。
out of bounds.translation: 朋友：那家五百一位的自助 去不去吃 你：太贵了 超出我这个月的预算了 朋友：偶尔奢侈一回嘛 你：不行 这价格真的超预算了 朋友：那咱们换个便宜点的
out of bounds.example: Friend: That five-hundred-yuan buffet, want to go? You: Too pricey, it's over my budget this month. Friend: Treat yourself once in a while. You: No, this price is really out of budget. Friend: Then let's pick somewhere cheaper.

out of budget.context: 路口那家开了二十年的小饭馆昨天关门了，老板说实在撑不下去，彻底停业了。
out of budget.translation: 朋友：巷口那家老饭馆怎么关门了 你：老板说房租涨太多 撑不下去了 朋友：那以后是不是就彻底不开了 你：对 这店已经倒闭了 真可惜 朋友：好端端一家店 说没就没
out of budget.example: Friend: Why did the old eatery at the alley close? You: The boss says rent rose too much to survive. Friend: So it's closed for good now? You: Right, the shop has gone out of business, such a pity. Friend: A good shop, gone just like that.

out of business.context: 妈妈翻出你十年前的牛仔裤，你一试发现早就扣不上了，款式也明显过时了。
out of business.translation: 朋友：你柜子里这条旧牛仔裤还留着啊 你：那是我大学时候穿的 挺有感情 朋友：现在还能穿得上吗 你：早过时了 款式也不时髦了 朋友：那不如捐了腾地方
out of business.example: Friend: You still keep these old jeans in your closet? You: I wore them in college, they mean a lot. Friend: Can you still fit into them now? You: They're long out of fashion, the style's dated too. Friend: Then donate them to free up space.

out of fashion.context: 你翻出一件妈妈年轻时的风衣，款式早就不流行了，但料子特别好，你又舍不得扔。
out of fashion.translation: 朋友：这件风衣款式好老啊 谁的呀 你：是我妈年轻时穿的 料子特别好 朋友：这款式现在早就不时髦了吧 你：确实早过时了 可我舍不得扔 朋友：改一改说不定还能穿
out of fashion.example: Friend: This trench coat is so old-fashioned, whose is it? You: It's my mum's from when she was young, the fabric's great. Friend: This style went out of style ages ago, right? You: It's out of style now, but I can't bear to throw it out. Friend: Alter it and you might still wear it.

out of pocket.context: 公司报销流程特别慢，你这次看病自己先垫了钱，要等一个月才能报销回来。
out of pocket.translation: 朋友：上次体检那笔钱 报销下来了吗 你：还没呢 我得自己先垫着 朋友：这算你自己掏腰包吗 你：对 这部分钱暂时得我先自费 朋友：报销太慢了 真烦人
out of pocket.example: Friend: Has that medical reimbursement come through yet? You: Not yet, I have to cover it myself first. Friend: So that's out of your own pocket? You: Right, I'm out of pocket for this part for now. Friend: Reimbursement is too slow, so annoying.

out of proportion.context: 一点小事你就紧张得不行，朋友劝你别把问题看得太严重，事情其实没你想的那么糟。
out of proportion.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么又愁眉苦脸的 你：就因为昨天那点小失误 我一直放心不下 朋友：你就是把小事看得太重了 你：我是不是把问题放大了 朋友：对 别让小事占了上风 放松点
out of proportion.example: Friend: Why are you looking glum again today? You: I can't stop worrying about that small slip yesterday. Friend: You're blowing a small thing out of proportion. You: Am I making a mountain out of it? Friend: Right, don't let it get out of proportion, relax.

out of style.context: 弟弟买了件今年流行的亮色外套，你说这颜色过两年就不时髦了，潮流变得太快。
out of style.translation: 朋友：我新买的这件外套颜色很时髦吧 你：亮是挺亮的 就是怕过时快 朋友：今年大街上都流行这个色 你：潮流变得快 过两年就不时尚了 朋友：那就趁今年多穿穿
out of style.example: Friend: The colour of my new coat is trendy, right? You: Bright, but I'm afraid it dates fast. Friend: Everyone's wearing this colour this year. You: Fashions change fast, in two years it'll be out of style. Friend: Then I'll wear it a lot this year.

out of sync.context: 开会时你和同事同时开口又同时停，节奏总是错开，大家忍不住笑了起来。
out of sync.translation: 朋友：刚才开会咱俩怎么老抢话 你：就是啊 我们说话节奏总对不上 朋友：特别尴尬 你刚说我就接 你：咱俩的节奏总是不同步 朋友：下次你先说 我等你讲完
out of sync.example: Friend: Why did we keep talking over each other in the meeting? You: Exactly, our rhythms are always out of sync. Friend: So awkward, you start just as I jump in. You: We're always out of sync. Friend: Next time you speak first, I'll wait until you finish.

out of the way.context: 你和朋友想去个安静没人打扰的地方度假，于是挑了一个藏在山谷里、很偏僻的小村子。
out of the way.translation: 朋友：这趟旅行想去人多热闹的地方吗 你：不想 我就想找个清净地方 朋友：那咱们找个偏僻点的小村子住几天 你：好 越偏僻越好 最好远离喧嚣 朋友：那我去订个山脚下的民宿
out of the way.example: Friend: Do you want somewhere busy and lively for the trip? You: No, I just want a quiet place. Friend: Then let's find a remote little village to stay a few days. You: Good, the more out of the way the better, away from the noise. Friend: I'll book a B&B at the foot of the hills.

out of this world.context: 朋友带你去吃一家私房菜，第一口下去你就惊呆了，连连说这味道简直好吃到升天。
out of this world.translation: 朋友：这家私房菜你头一回吃吧 你：天呐 也太好吃了吧 朋友：我没骗你吧 味道绝不绝 你：简直好吃到不像人间的味道 朋友：这可是我藏了好久的宝藏店
out of this world.example: Friend: First time trying this private kitchen? You: Oh my god, it's so delicious. Friend: I didn't lie, is it amazing? You: The taste is out of this world. Friend: This has been my hidden gem for ages.

out of tune.context: KTV里朋友唱歌跑调跑得离谱，大家笑成一团，他自己却浑然不觉，还唱得特别投入。
out of tune.translation: 朋友：你刚才那首高音也太飘了 你：有吗 我自我感觉良好啊 朋友：你完全跑调了 大家都笑翻了 你：我怎么一点都没觉得 朋友：你这是唱歌完全不在调上
out of tune.example: Friend: That high note you just sang was all over the place. You: Really? I thought I sounded great. Friend: You were completely out of tune, everyone cracked up. You: How did I not notice? Friend: You were totally out of tune.

out on.context: 周末你不在家待着，朋友约你出去看新上映的电影，你爽快地答应了。
out on.translation: 朋友：周末你在家吗 要不要一起出去 你：我正好没事 出去透透气也好 朋友：那去看那部新上映的电影吧 你：行啊 我跟你们一起出去看 朋友：那就约周六下午
out on.example: Friend: Are you home this weekend, want to go out? You: I happen to be free, getting some air sounds nice. Friend: Then let's see that newly released film. You: Sure, I'll come out with you. Friend: Let's make it Saturday afternoon.

out-of-town retail.context: 你开车带朋友去城郊新开的大型购物区，那里有大片停车场，比市中心好停多了。
out-of-town retail.translation: 朋友：这家商场停车方便吗 市中心太难停了 你：这是城郊那家 停车特别方便 朋友：是不是那种带大停车场的购物区啊 你：对 这种城郊商场停车不发愁 朋友：那就开车去 不挤地铁了
out-of-town retail.example: Friend: Is parking easy at this mall? The city centre's impossible. You: This is the out-of-town one, parking's a breeze. Friend: Is it that out-of-town retail park with a big lot? You: Right, this out-of-town retail place has no parking hassle. Friend: Then we'll drive, skip the subway.

outdoor activity.context: 周末你不想待在家里，约朋友去郊外骑车爬山，说多做点户外活动对身体好。
outdoor activity.translation: 朋友：这周末别老窝在家了 出去动一动 你：好啊 咱们去郊外骑车爬山 朋友：多做点户外活动 整个人都精神 你：是啊 户外活动比在家躺平板强多了 朋友：那就周六早上出发
outdoor activity.example: Friend: Stop lazing at home this weekend, let's move. You: Good, let's cycle and hike in the suburbs. Friend: More outdoor activity lifts your spirits. You: Right, outdoor activity beats lying on the sofa. Friend: Then set off Saturday morning.

outdoor dip.context: 夏天太热，你和朋友一大早就跳进湖水里游了一小圈，上来之后浑身通透特别舒服。
outdoor dip.translation: 朋友：这么早去湖边干嘛呀 你：太热了 想去水里泡一会儿 朋友：你是要下去游一圈吗 这水凉不凉 你：就想在湖里快速游一小会儿 特别解暑 朋友：那你注意安全 别游太远
outdoor dip.example: Friend: Why are you at the lake so early? You: It's so hot, I want to dip in the water. Friend: You're going for an outdoor dip, isn't the water cold? You: I just want a quick outdoor dip in the lake, it's so cooling. Friend: Then be safe, don't swim too far.

outdoor enthusiast.context: 公司要组织团建，负责的同事问你平时喜欢爬山露营吗，说想找个户外爱好者带队。
outdoor enthusiast.translation: 朋友：团建想找个会带队的人 你有经验吗 你：我周末常去爬山露营 算半个爱好者 朋友：那你正好是个户外爱好者 能帮忙组织吗 你：行 我来安排路线和装备 朋友：那就拜托你了
outdoor enthusiast.example: Friend: For the team build we need someone who can lead, any experience? You: I hike and camp on weekends, sort of an enthusiast. Friend: Then you're an outdoor enthusiast, can you help organise? You: Sure, I'll plan the route and gear. Friend: Then it's on you.

outdoor retreat.context: 你工作压力大，每到周末就躲进山中小木屋住两天，找个能彻底放松的地方静一静。
outdoor retreat.translation: 朋友：你周末老去山里 到底图什么啊 你：就是想找个安静地方放空自己 朋友：是那种专门用来放松的度假村吗 你：对 我喜欢这种户外静修 特别治愈 朋友：你也该好好歇歇了
outdoor retreat.example: Friend: Why do you keep going to the mountains on weekends? You: I just want a quiet place to empty my head. Friend: Is it that kind of outdoor retreat to relax? You: Right, I love this outdoor retreat, it's so healing. Friend: You really do need a proper rest.

outdoor venue.context: 办户外婚礼要挑个能摆下五十桌的开阔场地，你和朋友跑了好几个庄园才看中一处。
outdoor venue.translation: 朋友：户外婚礼场地你们看中哪了 你：跑了好几天 终于相中一个庄园 朋友：那个场地能摆下多少桌啊 你：那是个很开阔的户外场地 能摆五十桌 朋友：那地方风景应该不错吧
outdoor venue.example: Friend: Which outdoor wedding venue did you like? You: After days of looking, we finally found a manor. Friend: How many tables does that venue fit? You: It's a spacious outdoor venue that fits fifty tables. Friend: That place must have a nice view.

outdoor walk.context: 医生劝你别总坐着，每天晚饭后出去走上半小时，说这种饭后散步对降压很有帮助。
outdoor walk.translation: 朋友：医生让你平时多做点什么运动啊 你：没让我去健身房 就让我多走路 朋友：走路也算锻炼吗 你：他说每天饭后户外走一走就挺好 朋友：那我陪你每天晚上散步
outdoor walk.example: Friend: What exercise did the doctor tell you to do? You: Not the gym, just more walking. Friend: Does walking even count as exercise? You: He says an outdoor walk after meals is quite good. Friend: Then I'll join you on the evening walks.

outer space.context: 小时候你总抬头问妈妈星星上面有什么，妈妈说那遥远的外层空间藏着好多未知的秘密。
outer space.translation: 朋友：你小时候最喜欢看什么动画片啊 你：我最爱看宇宙探险的 总想飞到天上 朋友：你那时候对外太空很好奇是吗 你：对 我总好奇太空里都有什么 朋友：每个孩子都做过飞天梦吧
outer space.example: Friend: What was your favourite cartoon as a kid? You: I loved space adventures, always wanting to fly up. Friend: You were curious about outer space back then? You: Right, I always wondered what's out in outer space. Friend: Every kid has dreamed of flying.

outlook on life.context: 经历了那场大病之后，你整个人想开了很多，觉得保持积极乐观的人生态度比什么都重要。
outlook on life.translation: 朋友：你这两年好像变开朗了不少 你：生了场大病 很多事都看开了 朋友：是不是对生活有了新的看法 你：对 我现在抱着积极的人生态度 珍惜每一天 朋友：这心态转变真挺好的
outlook on life.example: Friend: You seem much more cheerful these two years. You: After that serious illness, I let go of a lot. Friend: So you have a new outlook on life? You: Right, I keep a positive outlook on life and treasure each day. Friend: That mindset change is really good.

outlying region.context: 地图显示市中心地铁四通八达，而你住的地方远在郊区，出门一趟要倒好几趟车。
outlying region.translation: 朋友：你住的地方交通方便吗 出门要多久 你：不太方便 离市中心特别远 朋友：是那种偏僻的远郊吗 你：对 我住在边远区域 进城要一个小时 朋友：那你每天通勤太辛苦
outlying region.example: Friend: Is transport where you live convenient, how long to get out? You: Not really, it's really far from the centre. Friend: Is it that kind of remote outer region? You: Right, I live in an outlying region, an hour into town. Friend: Your daily commute is so tough.

outpace inflation.context: 老板说今年公司效益好，给大家涨的工资终于跑赢了物价，钱终于经花了一些。
outpace inflation.translation: 朋友：今年涨工资了吗 涨了多少啊 你：涨了百分之五 总算没白干 朋友：涨的这点钱 赶得上物价涨吗 你：还行 这次涨幅总算跑赢了通胀 朋友：那日子能松快点了
outpace inflation.example: Friend: Did you get a raise this year, how much? You: Five percent, not for nothing. Friend: Does that keep up with rising prices? You: It's okay, this raise finally outpaces inflation. Friend: Then things can loosen up a bit.

output hypothesis.context: 你是学外语的，跟朋友聊到怎么才能真正学会一门语言，提到了Swain提出的输出假说。
output hypothesis.translation: 朋友：我学了多年英语 还是张不开嘴 你：光背没用 得真开口说 朋友：有什么语言学上的依据吗 你：有个输出假说 说多说才能真正学会 朋友：难怪哑巴英语这么多
output hypothesis.example: Friend: I've studied English years but still can't speak. You: Just memorising won't work, you have to really speak. Friend: Is there any linguistic theory behind that? You: There's the output hypothesis, that producing language is how you really learn. Friend: No wonder so many learn dumb English.

outward appearance.context: 刚认识的同事看起来冷冷淡淡，你相处久了才发现她心地特别善良，不能光看外表。
outward appearance.translation: 朋友：新来的那个同事是不是不太好相处啊 你：一开始我也这么觉得 朋友：看着她挺冷淡的 是吧 你：其实不能只凭外在样貌 判断一个人 朋友：那得多相处才知道
outward appearance.example: Friend: Is the new colleague hard to get along with? You: At first I thought so too. Friend: She looks pretty cold, right? You: Actually you can't judge someone by their outward appearance alone. Friend: Then you need to spend time to know them.

ovarian cancer.context: 阿姨例行体检查出妇科方面的问题，医生说要进一步检查，可能是卵巢方面的疾病。
ovarian cancer.translation: 朋友：阿姨体检结果出来了吗 严重不 你：医生说要进一步检查 有点担心 朋友：是哪方面的问题啊 你：好像是卵巢方面的 医生建议再查一次 朋友：别太担心 早发现早治疗
ovarian cancer.example: Friend: Has Auntie's check-up result come out, is it serious? You: The doctor wants more tests, I'm a bit worried. Friend: Which part is the issue? You: It seems to be ovarian, the doctor suggests rechecking. Friend: Don't worry too much, early detection helps.

over the course of a year.context: 朋友问你学这辆车花了多长时间，你说自己不是速成，而是在整整一年里慢慢练出来的。
over the course of a year.translation: 朋友：你这车技练了多久才这么溜啊 你：不是一朝一夕 练了好久 朋友：大概练了多长时间呢 你：是在一年的时间里 断断续续练出来的 朋友：熟能生巧嘛 正常
over the course of a year.example: Friend: How long did it take you to drive so smoothly? You: Not overnight, I practised a long time. Friend: Roughly how long? You: Over the course of a year, on and off. Friend: Practice makes perfect, that's normal.

over the last decade or so.context: 聊到手机行业的变化，你说差不多这十年间，智能手机从稀罕物变成了人人必备的东西。
over the last decade or so.translation: 朋友：你还记得十年前大家都用什么手机吗 你：那会儿还是按键机呢 真快 朋友：这十年变化也太大了吧 你：是 过去这十年左右 手机完全变了样 朋友：科技发展真是日新月异
over the last decade or so.example: Friend: Do you remember what phones people used ten years ago? You: It was still keypad phones, time flies. Friend: The change over ten years is huge. You: Right, over the last decade or so phones have totally transformed. Friend: Technology really moves fast.

over the next decade.context: 老板在大会上给大家打气，说公司定下目标，要在未来十年内做到行业前三名。
over the next decade.translation: 朋友：老板今天开会都讲了些什么啊 你：他给我们画了个挺大的饼 朋友：具体是怎么规划的 你：说要在未来十年内做到行业前三 朋友：这目标野心不小啊
over the next decade.example: Friend: What did the boss say at today's meeting? You: He painted us quite a big vision. Friend: What's the具体 plan? You: He says within the next decade we'll be top three in the industry. Friend: That's an ambitious goal.

over the odds.context: 朋友买二手车买贵了，比市场价多花了两万，他懊恼地说自己真是被坑了，买高了。
over the odds.translation: 朋友：你那辆二手车花了多少钱买的 你：八万 后来才发现买贵了 朋友：市场价不是才六万吗 你：可不是 我多花了两万 买得太贵了 朋友：下次买车一定得多比几家
over the odds.example: Friend: How much did you pay for that used car? You: Eighty thousand, only later did I find I overpaid. Friend: Isn't the market price around sixty thousand? You: Right, I paid over the odds by twenty thousand. Friend: Next time, definitely compare dealers.

over the top.context: 朋友为了生日派对又是包场地又是请乐队，你觉得排场太大了，有点过度铺张。
over the top.translation: 朋友：我生日想包个场地 再请个乐队 你：会不会太铺张了 就吃个饭呗 朋友：难得过一次生日 想热闹点 你：我觉得你这安排有点太夸张了 朋友：没事 难得奢侈一回
over the top.example: Friend: For my birthday I want to book a venue and a band. You: Isn't that over the top? We could just eat. Friend: It's my birthday once, I want a party. You: I think your plan is a bit over the top. Friend: It's fine, splurge once in a while.

over the years.context: 翻到老照片，你和朋友感慨这些年大家都变了好多，一晃这么多年就过去了。
over the years.translation: 朋友：这张老照片里咱们多年轻啊 你：可不是嘛 一晃都十年了 朋友：时间过得真快啊 你：这么多年过去了 大家变化都挺大 朋友：有空再聚聚吧 别疏远了
over the years.example: Friend: Look how young we were in this old photo. You: Right, ten years have flown by. Friend: Time really flies. You: Over the years, we've all changed a lot. Friend: Let's meet up again soon, don't drift apart.

over time.context: 你刚学做饭时总把菜炒糊，练得多了，厨艺不知不觉越来越好，真的是熟能生巧。
over time.translation: 朋友：你现在做饭怎么这么好吃了 你：一开始可惨了 老炒糊 朋友：是怎么练出来的 你：时间久了 手艺自然就进步了 朋友：果然凡事都得慢慢来
over time.example: Friend: How did you get so good at cooking? You: At first it was awful, I kept burning everything. Friend: How did you get there? You: Over time, my cooking naturally improved. Friend: Everything really takes time.

over-reliance on digital devices.context: 医生提醒说现在孩子整天抱着手机平板，这种对电子产品的过度依赖对眼睛特别不好。
over-reliance on digital devices.translation: 朋友：孩子最近老揉眼睛 是怎么回事啊 你：是不是看屏幕时间太长了 朋友：他一回家就抱着平板不放 你：这种对电子设备的过度依赖真得管管 朋友：那我得限制他每天的屏幕时间
over-reliance on digital devices.example: Friend: The kid keeps rubbing his eyes lately, what's wrong? You: Is it too much screen time? Friend: He clutches the tablet the moment he's home. You: This over-reliance on digital devices really needs controlling. Friend: Then I'll limit his daily screen time.

overcome hardship.context: 创业者说起那段最难的日子，说正是咬牙挺过了种种困境，才有了今天的小公司。
overcome hardship.translation: 朋友：你这公司开起来 最难得是哪段日子 你：刚开始那年 差点撑不下去 朋友：后来是怎么熬过来的 你：就是硬着头皮 一步步克服了困境 朋友：能坚持下来真不容易
overcome hardship.example: Friend: The hardest part of starting your company was when? You: The first year, I almost gave up. Friend: How did you get through it later? You: I just gritted my teeth and overcame the hardship step by step. Friend: Sticking it out was really hard.

overcome setbacks.context: 跑马拉松中途你腿疼得想放弃，但还是咬着牙坚持下来，说人就是要不断战胜挫折。
overcome setbacks.translation: 朋友：跑马中途想放弃的时候多吗 你：特别多 腿都快抬不动了 朋友：那你最后怎么坚持下来的 你：就是靠着一股劲 一次次克服了挫折 朋友：你这意志力真让人佩服
overcome setbacks.example: Friend: How often did you want to quit mid-marathon? You: Loads of times, I could barely lift my legs. Friend: Then how did you finish? You: Just on sheer will, overcoming setbacks again and again. Friend: Your willpower is admirable.

overflow with.context: 毕业典礼上，同学们眼里闪着泪光，心里满是对母校的不舍和对未来的期待。
overflow with.translation: 朋友：毕业典礼那天你哭了吗 你：哭了 特别舍不得 朋友：大家情绪都很激动吧 你：对 每个人心里都充满了不舍和期待 朋友：这段青春真让人怀念
overflow with.example: Friend: Did you cry at the graduation ceremony? You: I did, so reluctant to leave. Friend: Was everyone very emotional? You: Right, everyone's heart overflowed with sadness and hope. Friend: This youth is really something to miss.

overhead cost.context: 开店除了房租，还有水电人工这些固定开销，老板说每个月光是杂七杂八的运营成本就压得慌。
overhead cost.translation: 朋友：你这店一个月杂七杂八要花多少钱 你：房租水电人工加起来 不少呢 朋友：主要是哪些固定开销啊 你：光是日常运营成本就占了大头 朋友：做生意真是处处要钱
overhead cost.example: Friend: How much do those misc costs add up to monthly? You: Rent, utilities, staff, it adds up. Friend: What are the main fixed costs? You: Just the overhead cost takes up the biggest chunk. Friend: Running a business costs money everywhere.

overlooked inventor.context: 博物馆里展出一位生前穷困潦倒、死后才被认可的发明家，他的很多发明当时都被埋没了。
overlooked inventor.translation: 朋友：这个展里介绍的发明家你听说过吗 你：没有 听着挺陌生的 朋友：他活着的时候 根本没人看重他 你：他就是那种被埋没的发明家 去世后才出名 朋友：天才总是生不逢时
overlooked inventor.example: Friend: Have you heard of the inventor in this exhibit? You: No, he sounds unfamiliar. Friend: When he was alive, nobody valued him. You: He was an overlooked inventor who only got famous after death. Friend: Geniuses always outlive their time.

overnight rail.context: 你要去远方城市出差，时间紧赶不上白天的车，朋友建议你坐过夜列车，睡一觉就到。
overnight rail.translation: 朋友：你明天出差怎么去啊 坐高铁吗 你：时间不合适 白天的车赶不上 朋友：那就坐夜车 睡一觉就到了 你：对 我订了张过夜列车的卧铺票 朋友：那正好 路上还能睡个好觉
overnight rail.example: Friend: How are you travelling on your business trip, high-speed rail? You: The times don't work, I can't make the daytime train. Friend: Then take the overnight train, sleep and you're there. You: Right, I booked a sleeper on the overnight rail. Friend: Perfect, you can sleep well on the way.

overnight stay.context: 你临时要在另一个城市过夜，酒店又订满了，朋友说可以安排你在他家凑合一晚。
overnight stay.translation: 朋友：你今晚还能赶回来吗 天都黑了 你：怕是回不去了 得在外面住一晚 朋友：那用我帮你安排个住宿吗 你：能凑合一晚的地方就行 朋友：那你住我家吧 别花钱住酒店
overnight stay.example: Friend: Can you still get back tonight, it's dark. You: I'm afraid not, I'll have to stay out overnight. Friend: Shall I arrange an overnight stay for you? You: Anywhere for an overnight stay will do. Friend: Then stay at my place, don't pay for a hotel.

overwhelming majority.context: 投票结果出来后，候选人拿下了九成选票，媒体说这是压倒性的胜利，对手毫无还手之力。
overwhelming majority.translation: 朋友：这次投票结果你看了吗 差距大不大 你：大得吓人 九成都是他 朋友：这也太悬殊了吧 你：对 他以压倒性优势赢了选举 朋友：对手这回输得没脾气
overwhelming majority.example: Friend: Did you see the vote result, was the gap big? You: Scary big, ninety percent went to him. Friend: That's a huge margin. You: Right, he won by an overwhelming majority. Friend: His opponent had nothing to say about that.

overwhelming stress.context: 临考试前你突然发着高烧还要背书，整个人被巨大的压力压得快喘不过气。
overwhelming stress.translation: 朋友：你脸色这么差 是不是压力太大了 你：考试加生病 我快撑不住了 朋友：别把自己逼太紧啊 你：这股巨大的压力压得我好难受 朋友：先睡一觉 别硬扛
overwhelming stress.example: Friend: You look awful, are you under too much pressure? You: Exams plus illness, I can barely cope. Friend: Don't push yourself too hard. You: This overwhelming stress is crushing me. Friend: Sleep first, don't force it.

own brand.context: 你在超市货架上看到贴着超市自有商标的饼干，比大牌便宜一半，朋友说这其实是同一家厂做的。
own brand.translation: 朋友：你怎么买这种牌子的饼干 没听过啊 你：这是超市自己的牌子 便宜一半呢 朋友：这种自有品牌的东西质量靠谱吗 你：其实和大牌是一个厂出的 朋友：那还挺划算的
own brand.example: Friend: Why buy this biscuit brand? Never heard of it. You: It's the store's own brand, half the price. Friend: Is an own-brand product any good? You: It's actually made by the same factory as the big brands. Friend: That's quite a bargain.

own up to.context: 打碎了朋友心爱的杯子，你心里过意不去，犹豫半天还是主动承认了错误，请求原谅。
own up to.translation: 朋友：你怎么把我杯子打碎了 对不起啊 你：是我不小心碰掉的 跟你说实话 朋友：那杯子我挺喜欢的 你：是我不对 我得为自己的错误负责 朋友：算了 你肯承认就好
own up to.example: Friend: Why did you break my cup? Sorry about that. You: I knocked it over by accident, I'm telling you honestly. Friend: I quite liked that cup. You: It's my fault, I must own up to my mistake. Friend: Forget it, at least you owned up.

owns up to.context: 儿子打碎了妈妈心爱的花瓶，犹豫了半天，最后还是红着脸向妈妈承认了错误。
owns up to.translation: 朋友：你妈那花瓶碎了 她知道是你弄的吗 你：我一开始没敢说 心里特别慌 朋友：那后来呢 你：最后我还是鼓起勇气 向她承认了错误 朋友：你敢承认 她就不会太生气
owns up to.example: Friend: Your mum's vase is broken, does she know you did it? You: At first I didn't dare say, I was so anxious. Friend: And then? You: In the end I plucked up courage and owned up to her. Friend: If you own up, she won't be too angry.

oxidative damage.context: 老师说阳光中的紫外线会损伤皮肤细胞，长期暴晒会造成细胞层面的氧化伤害，出门要防晒。
oxidative damage.translation: 朋友：大夏天你怎么还穿长袖打伞啊 你：防晒啊 紫外线特别伤皮肤 朋友：晒一晒能有多大伤害 你：紫外线会造成细胞的氧化损伤 长期晒容易老 朋友：那我也得涂点防晒霜
oxidative damage.example: Friend: Why wear long sleeves and a parasol in summer? You: To block the sun, UV rays really damage skin. Friend: How harmful can a bit of sun be? You: UV causes oxidative damage to cells, and ages you long-term. Friend: Then I should put on sunscreen too.

oxygen intake.context: 医生说高原反应是因为人到了高处吸进的氧气变少，身体一时适应不过来造成的。
oxygen intake.translation: 朋友：我上高原怎么老觉得胸闷气短 你：那是因为空气稀薄 朋友：缺氧具体是什么原因啊 你：是你吸入的氧气量下降 身体一时不适应 朋友：那我该怎么缓解呢
oxygen intake.example: Friend: Why do I feel short of breath up on the plateau? You: Because the air is thin. Friend: What exactly causes the lack of oxygen? You: It's your oxygen intake dropping, your body can't adapt at once. Friend: Then how do I relieve it?

oxygen level.context: 护士给爷爷量完血氧，说这个数值有点偏低，需要观察一下，必要时吸氧。
oxygen level.translation: 朋友：爷爷吸氧那个机器 数值正常吗 你：护士刚看了说有点低 朋友：低到多少 危险吗 你：他血液里的含氧量不太够 得多留意 朋友：那就听医生的 该吸氧就吸
oxygen level.example: Friend: Is the reading on Grandpa's oxygen machine normal? You: The nurse just said it's a bit low. Friend: How low, is it dangerous? You: His oxygen level isn't enough, we need to watch it. Friend: Then follow the doctor, use oxygen if needed.

pace of life.context: 从大城市搬到小县城后，你最大的感受就是这里日子过得慢多了，生活节奏一下子舒缓下来。
pace of life.translation: 朋友：你搬去小县城住 感觉怎么样 你：特别舒服 就是日子慢了好多 朋友：那边的生活节奏跟大城市差很多吧 你：对 生活节奏一下子慢下来 整个人都放松了 朋友：这才叫过日子嘛
pace of life.example: Friend: How do you find moving to a small county town? You: Really nice, life's just much slower. Friend: Is the pace of life very different from the big city? You: Right, the pace of life slowed right down and I've relaxed. Friend: That's what living is about.

paced breathing.context: 面试紧张时教练教你一种呼吸方法，慢慢吸气再缓缓呼出，说这种节律呼吸能让人冷静下来。
paced breathing.translation: 朋友：一面试我就紧张到手抖 怎么办啊 你：我教你个方法 慢慢调整呼吸 朋友：具体怎么呼吸才管用呢 你：用这种节律呼吸 吸气呼气都放慢 心就静了 朋友：那我面试前试试
paced breathing.example: Friend: My hands shake with nerves at interviews, what do I do? You: I'll teach you a way, adjust your breathing slowly. Friend: How exactly should I breathe? You: Use paced breathing, slow the in-breath and out-breath, and your mind calms. Friend: Then I'll try it before the interview.

pack into.context: 搬家那天大家把大大小小的纸箱全塞进一辆小车里，塞得满满当当，关车门都费劲。
pack into.translation: 朋友：你这么多东西 一辆小车装得下吗 你：能 咱们硬塞 挤一挤 朋友：都快堆到车顶了 你小心点 你：我把零碎都往车后座塞 塞得满满当当 朋友：这下关车门都难了吧
pack into.example: Friend: Can one small car fit all your stuff? You: It can, we'll force it in, squeeze it. Friend: It's almost piled to the roof, be careful. You: I'm packing all the bits into the back seat, packing it full. Friend: Now closing the door is hard, right?

pack light.context: 周末去短途旅行，你特意只背一个小背包，朋友问你怎么不带箱子，你说轻装出门最自在。
pack light.translation: 朋友：出门玩两天 你怎么就背个小包啊 你：轻装出门多自在 不用拖箱子 朋友：换洗衣服都够装吗 你：够了 我习惯轻装旅行 朋友：那倒是 少带点东西省事
pack light.example: Friend: For a two-day trip, why just a small bag? You: Packing light is freeing, no dragging a case. Friend: Is there room for a change of clothes? You: Enough, I'm used to packing light. Friend: True, travelling light is easier.

pack up.context: 旅行回来你累瘫在沙发上，朋友问你什么时候收拾行李，你说明天再弄，今天只想躺着。
pack up.translation: 朋友：旅行回来了 行李收拾了吗 你：没有 我累得只想躺着 朋友：那些脏衣服不得赶紧洗啊 你：明天再收拾行李吧 今天实在动不了 朋友：那你先好好睡一觉
pack up.example: Friend: You're back, have you packed up? You: Not yet, I'm too tired to move. Friend: Don't the dirty clothes need washing soon? You: I'll pack up tomorrow, I really can't move today. Friend: Then just sleep well first.

pack with.context: 周末的商场里人山人海，每层都挤满了逛街的人，连电梯口都排起了长队。
pack with.translation: 朋友：周末商场人多不多啊 你：别提了 人挤人 挪都挪不动 朋友：每个楼层都这么挤吗 你：对 每层都挤满了逛街的人 朋友：那咱别逛了 赶紧回家
pack with.example: Friend: Is the mall crowded on weekends? You: Don't ask, packed shoulder to shoulder. Friend: Is every floor this packed? You: Right, every floor is packed with shoppers. Friend: Then let's skip it and go home.

package holiday.context: 你第一次出国不想做攻略，朋友推荐你报那种机酒全包的旅行团，说省心又划算。
package holiday.translation: 朋友：你第一次出国旅游 攻略做了吗 你：还没 头大 不想做 朋友：那报个打包旅游团吧 机酒全包 你：对 这种全包旅游团最省心 朋友：那我帮你看看有哪些团
package holiday.example: Friend: For your first trip abroad, done the itinerary? You: Not yet, it's a headache, I don't want to. Friend: Then book a package holiday, flights and hotel all in. You: Right, a package holiday is the least hassle. Friend: Then I'll check what tours are on offer.

packaged food.context: 加班太晚你不想做饭，就从超市拎回几盒现成的速食，朋友笑你天天吃包装食品不健康。
packaged food.translation: 朋友：今晚又吃速食啊 你：加班太晚 懒得做 就买了点现成的 朋友：这种包装食品添加剂多 你得少吃 你：偶尔吃点包装食品 也没办法 朋友：周末你还是自己做点新鲜的吧
packaged food.example: Friend: Instant food again tonight? You: Home late from work, too lazy to cook, just bought ready meals. Friend: Packaged food has lots of additives, you should eat less. You: Packaged food now and then, I have no choice. Friend: Cook something fresh on the weekend.

packed in like sardines.context: 早高峰的地铁里人贴人挤得水泄不通，朋友无奈地说这哪是坐车，简直是被塞成了沙丁鱼。
packed in like sardines.translation: 朋友：早高峰坐地铁 人多不多啊 你：别提了 人贴人 动都动不了 朋友：挤成什么样了 你：大家挤得像罐头里的沙丁鱼 朋友：这通勤也太受罪了
packed in like sardines.example: Friend: Is the subway crowded at rush hour? You: Don't ask, pressed chest to back, can't move. Friend: How packed is it? You: We're packed in like sardines. Friend: This commute is pure suffering.

packed lunch.context: 为了省钱也健康，你每天早上在家做好便当带到公司，中午微波炉一热就能吃。
packed lunch.translation: 朋友：你中午怎么又带饭了 不出去吃吗 你：自己带饭 省钱又健康 朋友：每天早上现做来得及吗 你：对 我每天在家做好自带午餐带来 朋友：你也太会过日子了
packed lunch.example: Friend: Bringing lunch again, not eating out? You: Bringing my own lunch saves money and is healthy. Friend: Is there time to cook it every morning? You: Right, I make a packed lunch at home every morning. Friend: You're so good at budgeting.

packed lunches.context: 孩子们开学都自己背着饭盒上学，老师说带饭比学校食堂干净，家长们也放心。
packed lunches.translation: 朋友：孩子中午在学校吃饭怎么办啊 你：我给他装了个便当盒带着 朋友：学校不是有食堂吗 你：自带盒饭比食堂干净 我们家都让他带 朋友：那你每天早上得早起准备
packed lunches.example: Friend: How does your child eat lunch at school? You: I pack a lunch box for him. Friend: Doesn't the school have a canteen? You: Packed lunches are cleaner than the canteen, we send him with one. Friend: Then you have to get up early daily.

paid promotion.context: 新品牌刚上市没钱打广告，只能靠出钱请博主发推广帖，朋友说这就是付费推广。
paid promotion.translation: 朋友：你那新品牌怎么让大家知道啊 你：没钱打大广告 只能找博主 朋友：是花钱请人帮你发帖宣传吗 你：对 这就是付费推广 先把名声打出去 朋友：烧钱换流量 得算好账
paid promotion.example: Friend: How are you getting word out about your new brand? You: No budget for big ads, so I'll use bloggers. Friend: Paying people to post promotions? You: Right, that's paid promotion, build the name first. Friend: Spending for traffic, watch the budget.

painful loss.context: 球队主力赛季报销，教练说失去这样一位核心对全队是个沉重打击，大家都很难过。
painful loss.translation: 朋友：你们队那个主力怎么不上场啊 你：受伤了 这个赛季都报销了 朋友：没了他 球队影响大吗 你：失去他真是个沉痛的损失 大家都挺难过 朋友：希望他早日伤愈归来
painful loss.example: Friend: Why isn't your team's star playing? You: He's injured, out for the whole season. Friend: Is the team affected without him? You: Losing him is a painful loss, everyone's quite sad. Friend: Hope he recovers and returns soon.

pair with.context: 挑红酒时店员告诉你，这款干红最适合搭配牛排，说红肉配红酒是经典组合。
pair with.translation: 朋友：我不懂红酒 你帮我挑一瓶呗 你：你打算配什么菜吃呢 朋友：今晚煎牛排 朋友：那选这款干红 它特别适合搭配红肉 你：对 牛排就该配这种红酒 朋友：听你的 就拿这瓶
pair with.example: Friend: I don't know wine, help me pick a bottle. You: What are you planning to eat with it? Friend: Pan-fried steak tonight. Friend: Then get this dry red, it pairs well with red meat. You: Right, steak should be paired with this kind of red. Friend: I'll take your advice and get this one.

palm oil.context: 环保课上老师说很多零食里都用棕榈油加工，这种油的生产正在毁掉大片热带雨林。
palm oil.translation: 朋友：你买零食怎么还看配料表啊 你：我在找有没有棕榈油 朋友：这种油怎么了 不能吃吗 你：它生产时砍掉太多雨林 特别不环保 朋友：那我以后也少买这种零食
palm oil.example: Friend: Why are you reading the ingredient list on snacks? You: I'm looking for palm oil. Friend: What's wrong with that, can't you eat it? You: Making it cuts down too much rainforest, really bad for the environment. Friend: Then I'll avoid those snacks too.

panic about.context: 明天要上台演讲，你今晚翻来覆去睡不着，总担心自己会忘词，越想越紧张。
panic about.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么坐立不安的 有心事 你：明天演讲 我越想越慌 朋友：别自己吓自己啊 你：我就是对这次演讲特别紧张 怕出丑 朋友：深呼吸 你准备得很充分了
panic about.example: Friend: Why are you on edge today, something on your mind? You: Tomorrow's speech, the more I think the more nervous. Friend: Don't psych yourself out. You: I really panic about this speech, afraid of messing up. Friend: Deep breaths, you're well prepared.

panic attack.context: 第一次独自坐飞机你紧张得不行，起飞那一刻心跳加速，朋友笑着说这是典型的紧张反应。
panic attack.translation: 朋友：第一次坐飞机 感觉怎么样 你：太刺激了 心跳一直很快 朋友：起飞那会儿是不是特别紧张 你：对 我当时紧张得胸口发闷 朋友：适应一下就好了 别怕
panic attack.example: Friend: First time flying, how does it feel? You: Thrilling, my heart's been racing. Friend: Were you really nervous at takeoff? You: Right, I had a panic attack and my chest felt tight. Friend: It passes once you adjust, don't be afraid.

panic shopping.context: 听说要刮台风，超市里的米面油一下被抢购一空，大家都在疯狂囤货，生怕物资短缺。
panic shopping.translation: 朋友：台风要来 你去超市囤货了吗 你：去了 货架都快被抢空了 朋友：大家都在疯狂抢购呢 你：可不是 一有风声大家就开始囤物资 朋友：其实真没必要抢这么多
panic shopping.example: Friend: Typhoon's coming, did you stock up at the supermarket? You: I did, shelves are nearly cleared. Friend: Everyone's panic buying. You: Right, the moment there's news people start panic shopping. Friend: Really no need to buy this much.

panoramic view.context: 登上山顶观景台，整座城市尽收眼底，朋友感叹从这高处俯瞰下去，景色真是一览无余。
panoramic view.translation: 朋友：爬到山顶累不累啊 你：累是累 可风景值了 朋友：站在上面能看多远 你：整个城市都看得清清楚楚 这种全景视野特别震撼 朋友：这趟爬山没白来
panoramic view.example: Friend: Was climbing to the top tiring? You: Tiring, but the view's worth it. Friend: How far can you see from up there? You: The whole city's laid out clearly, the panoramic view is stunning. Friend: The climb was worth it.

paradigm shift.context: 公司从做功能手机转型到智能手机，这一转变彻底改变了整个行业，被称为一场范式革命。
paradigm shift.translation: 朋友：这家公司这几年变化怎么这么大 你：他们彻底换了个赛道 朋友：是说整个商业模式都变了吗 你：对 这是一次巨大的范式转变 整个行业都跟着变了 朋友：不转型就淘汰 真现实
paradigm shift.example: Friend: Why has this company changed so much lately? You: They completely switched tracks. Friend: So the whole business model changed? You: Right, it's a huge paradigm shift that changed the whole industry. Friend: Adapt or die, so realistic.

parallel to.context: 你沿着河边那条平行于马路的绿道骑车，一路吹着风，特别舒服。
parallel to.translation: 朋友：你平时都在哪条道上骑车锻炼啊 你：就河边那条 挨着马路 朋友：是和马路平行的那条绿道吗 你：对 那条和公路平行的自行车道特别舒服 朋友：那我明天也去骑骑
parallel to.example: Friend: Which path do you usually cycle on? You: The one by the river, next to the road. Friend: Is it the green path parallel to the road? You: Right, the cycle lane parallel to the road is really pleasant. Friend: Then I'll ride it tomorrow too.

parasympathetic nervous system.context: 上生物课时老师讲到，人紧张时身体会自动调节，而负责放松和休息的是副交感神经系统。
parasympathetic nervous system.translation: 朋友：为什么人一紧张心跳就加快啊 你：那是身体自动调节的结果 朋友：那负责让人放松的是哪部分啊 你：是副交感神经系统 它帮你平静下来 朋友：人体真是设计精巧
parasympathetic nervous system.example: Friend: Why does your heart race when you're nervous? You: It's the body's automatic regulation. Friend: Then which part helps you relax? You: It's the parasympathetic nervous system, it calms you down. Friend: The human body is so ingeniously designed.

parent tree.context: 林业员指着一片大树说，整片森林里的树苗最初都是从眼前这棵母树繁衍出来的。
parent tree.translation: 朋友：这片林子长得这么茂盛 都是野生的吗 你：最早都是从那棵大树长出来的 朋友：就是那棵特别高的老树吗 你：对 它是这一片的母树 别的都是它的后代 朋友：那它可有年头了
parent tree.example: Friend: Is this lush forest all wild? You: It all originally grew from that big tree. Friend: That really tall old tree? You: Right, it's the parent tree of the whole area, the rest are its offspring. Friend: Then it must be very old.

parental leave.context: 公司新政策允许员工生娃后带薪休假一段日子，管这叫育儿假，男女都能申请。
parental leave.translation: 朋友：你们公司对生孩子这事 有什么福利吗 你：有 可以申请带薪休假照顾孩子 朋友：这就叫育儿假是吗 你：对 男女员工都能休育儿假 朋友：这政策挺人性化的
parental leave.example: Friend: Does your company offer any benefits for having kids? You: Yes, you can take paid leave to care for the baby. Friend: Is that called parental leave? You: Right, both parents can take parental leave. Friend: That's a considerate policy.

parental stipend.context: 刚工作的年轻人手头紧，父母每个月固定给他打一笔生活费，帮他渡过最初几年。
parental stipend.translation: 朋友：你刚工作那几年 经济上紧不紧 你：紧啊 全靠爸妈接济 朋友：是每个月固定给一笔钱吗 你：对 我爸妈每月给我一笔津贴 帮我过渡 朋友：等你站稳脚跟就好了
parental stipend.example: Friend: Were you short on money those first working years? You: Yeah, totally relied on my parents. Friend: Do they give a fixed sum each month? You: Right, my parents give me a monthly stipend to tide me over. Friend: It gets better once you're settled.

parental supervision.context: 孩子放学就抱着手机玩，老师建议家长多盯着点，不能放任孩子没日没夜地刷视频。
parental supervision.translation: 朋友：孩子放学就玩手机 说不听怎么办 你：家长得上点心 不能全由着他 朋友：具体该怎么管呢 你：家长得好好监管他 规定好玩手机的时间 朋友：那我今晚就跟他约法三章
parental supervision.example: Friend: The kid just phones after school, won't listen, what to do? You: Parents must pay attention, can't just let him be. Friend: How exactly should I manage it? You: You need good parental supervision and set phone time. Friend: Then I'll lay down rules tonight.

parental support.context: 刚上大学那几年家里条件不好，全靠父母经济上的支持，你才顺利读完了书。
parental support.translation: 朋友：你上大学那几年 学费都哪来的啊 你：全靠我爸妈在背后支持 朋友：他们经济上帮衬得多吗 你：对 多亏了父母的经济帮扶 我才念完书 朋友：以后好好孝顺他们
parental support.example: Friend: Where did your university tuition come from? You: Entirely my parents' support. Friend: Did they help you a lot financially? You: Right, thanks to my parents' support I finished my studies. Friend: Then look after them well.

park lot.context: 商场地下停车场车位满了，你绕了好几圈都没找到空位，朋友建议你停到路边试试。
park lot.translation: 朋友：商场地下停车场有车位吗 你：满了 绕了好几圈都没找到 朋友：那怎么办 停哪啊 你：这停车场一位难求 我先去外面转转 朋友：要不停远一点 走两步
park lot.example: Friend: Are there spots in the mall's underground lot? You: Full, I've circled several times with none. Friend: So what now, where to park? You: The park lot is packed, let me try outside. Friend: Or park farther and walk a bit.

part with.context: 旧手机放了好几年，你一直舍不得卖掉，朋友说留着没用，劝你干脆忍痛割爱出掉。
part with.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里那台旧手机还留着干嘛 你：舍不得扔 挺有纪念意义 朋友：放着也用不了 不如卖了换钱 你：唉 我就是舍不得把它出手 朋友：留着占地方 出了吧
part with.example: Friend: Why keep that old phone in your drawer? You: Can't bear to throw it out, it's sentimental. Friend: You can't use it anyway, sell it for cash. You: Sigh, I just can't part with it. Friend: It takes up space, just let it go.

part-time course.context: 你想利用周末学点新技能，朋友推荐你报一门业余时间上的课程，不耽误白天上班。
part-time course.translation: 朋友：你不是想学点新东西吗 怎么安排时间 你：我白天要上班 只能业余时间学 朋友：那就报个业余时间上的课程 你：对 我找了门兼职读的课程 周末上课 朋友：这样工作学习两不耽误
part-time course.example: Friend: You wanted to learn something new, how'll you fit it in? You: I work days, so I can only study in my spare time. Friend: Then take a part-time course. You: Right, I found a part-time course on weekends. Friend: That balances work and study.

part-time job.context: 大学生活费不够花，你便在课余找了份兼职，周末去咖啡店打工补贴开销。
part-time job.translation: 朋友：你这个月又喊缺钱了 要不要做个兼职 你：我正想找份周末兼职呢 朋友：你有时间做吗 课业忙不忙 你：我在咖啡店找了份兼职 周末去打工 朋友：这样能自己挣零花钱了
part-time job.example: Friend: Short of money again this month, want a part-time job? You: I was just looking for a weekend part-time job. Friend: Do you have time, are studies busy? You: I found a part-time job at a café, working weekends. Friend: Then you can earn your own pocket money.

part-time work.context: 宝妈想重返社会又怕顾不上孩子，朋友建议她先找点时间灵活的兼职工作过渡一下。
part-time work.translation: 朋友：你打算什么时候重新出去工作啊 你：孩子还小 我想先做点灵活的 朋友：那找点时间自由的兼职做 你：对 我先做点兼职工作过渡 朋友：等孩子大点再找全职的
part-time work.example: Friend: When do you plan to go back to work? You: The kid's small, I want something flexible first. Friend: Then find some flexible part-time work. You: Right, I'll do some part-time work to transition. Friend: Find full-time once the kid is bigger.

partial to.context: 吃饭时朋友问你爱喝啤酒还是红酒，你说自己平时更偏爱来杯茶，酒倒是无所谓。
partial to.translation: 朋友：吃饭你爱配啤酒还是红酒啊 你：其实我更爱喝茶 朋友：茶有什么好喝的 不解腻 你：我就是偏爱茶 喝酒反倒一般 朋友：那下次聚餐给你点壶茶
partial to.example: Friend: Do you prefer beer or wine with a meal? You: Actually I'm partial to tea. Friend: Tea doesn't cut through grease. You: I'm partial to tea, drinking is just so-so for me. Friend: Then I'll order a pot of tea next time.

partly to do with.context: 最近你工作特别不顺，朋友安慰你说 partly 是因为大环境不好，不全是你的问题。
partly to do with.translation: 朋友：最近怎么总唉声叹气的 工作不顺吗 你：事事都不顺 我都怀疑自己了 朋友：别全怪自己 大环境也有影响 你：也许我不顺 部分原因在于大环境吧 朋友：想开点 会好起来的
partly to do with.example: Friend: Why the long faces lately, work not going well? You: Everything's going wrong, I'm doubting myself. Friend: Don't blame it all on yourself, the environment matters. You: Maybe my troubles are partly to do with the wider environment. Friend: Cheer up, it'll get better.

partner with.context: 小公司单打独斗太难，你决定和另一家资源互补的公司合作，一起拿下大项目。
partner with.translation: 朋友：这个大项目 咱们一家公司吃得下吗 你：吃不下 得找家伙伴联手 朋友：你打算和哪家公司合作啊 你：我准备和那家资源互补的公司合作 朋友：强强联手 胜算更大
partner with.example: Friend: Can our company handle this big project alone? You: Not alone, we need a partner. Friend: Which company will you partner with? You: I'll partner with that company with complementary resources. Friend: Joined strength stands a better chance.

parts per trillion.context: 环境课上老师说有些污染物在水里浓度极低，得用万亿分之一这样的单位才能量出来。
parts per trillion.translation: 朋友：那种特别微量的污染物 怎么测啊 你：得用特别小的浓度单位 朋友：具体是多小的单位呢 你：得用万亿分之一这种量级来表示 朋友：科学真是精密
parts per trillion.example: Friend: How do you measure trace pollutants? You: You need a really tiny concentration unit. Friend: How small exactly? You: You have to use parts per trillion as the unit. Friend: Science is so precise.

paso doble.context: 晚会上大家跳起热情奔放的西班牙舞，你跟着节奏扭起来，朋友告诉你这叫斗牛舞。
paso doble.translation: 朋友：晚会上大家跳得好热烈 这是什么舞啊 你：看着挺有激情的 我也想试试 朋友：这叫斗牛舞 节奏特别带劲 你：对 就是那种热烈的斗牛舞 朋友：那我也跟着跳一段
paso doble.example: Friend: Everyone's dancing so passionately at the party, what dance is it? You: It looks fiery, I want to try too. Friend: It's the paso doble, the beat is pumping. You: Right, it's that fiery paso doble. Friend: Then I'll dance a bit too.

pass down.context: 奶奶的拿手菜传到了你这一代，你说这是家里代代传下来的味道，一定要好好保留。
pass down.translation: 朋友：你这道菜做得跟奶奶一个味啊 你：她手把手教我的 传下来的 朋友：这手艺是一辈辈传下来的吧 你：对 这是奶奶传给我的 得好好传下去 朋友：等你有孩子也教给他
pass down.example: Friend: This dish tastes just like your grandma's. You: She taught me hand in hand, it's been passed down. Friend: This skill's been handed down generations, right? You: Right, my grandma passed it down to me, I must keep it. Friend: Teach it to your kids too.

pass on.context: 你感冒还没好，朋友约你吃饭，你说自己刚好，怕传染给别人，就不聚餐了。
pass on.translation: 朋友：今晚聚餐你来不来啊 你：我感冒刚好 怕传给你们 朋友：没事 大家抵抗力都好 你：还是不去了 免得把病传染给大家 朋友：那你在家好好养着
pass on.example: Friend: Coming to tonight's dinner? You: My cold just cleared, I'm afraid I'll pass it on. Friend: It's fine, we're all hardy. You: Better not go, lest I pass the bug to everyone. Friend: Then rest up at home.

pass on to.context: 老主任退休前把手头的客户资源都交给了你，说希望你能把这些关系好好接下去。
pass on to.translation: 朋友：老主任退休 交接工作顺利吗 你：他把手头客户都交给我了 朋友：这些关系以后就归你维护了 你：对 他把客户都托付给我了 我得好好接 朋友：好好干 别辜负老主任
pass on to.example: Friend: Did the handover go well for the retiring director? You: He handed all his clients over to me. Friend: Those relationships are yours to keep now. You: Right, he passed the clients on to me, I must carry it on. Friend: Do well, don't let him down.

pass over.context: 升职时名单上跳过了你，直接提了资历更浅的同事，你心里很不是滋味却又不好说。
pass over.translation: 朋友：这次升职名单上怎么没你啊 你：别提了 把我给漏了 朋友：怎么会这样 不是你最该升吗 你：名单上直接跳过了我 提了别人 朋友：这也太不公平了
pass over.example: Friend: Why aren't you on the promotion list? You: Don't ask, they left me out. Friend: How, weren't you the one? You: The list just passed me over and promoted someone else. Friend: That's so unfair.

pass through.context: 火车要穿过一条很长的隧道，车厢一下子暗下来，朋友问这是开到哪里了。
pass through.translation: 朋友：车厢怎么突然变黑了 你：咱们进隧道了 朋友：这隧道得多长啊 灯一直不亮 你：火车要穿过整座山 得开好一会儿 朋友：出了隧道是不是就快到了
pass through.example: Friend: Why did the carriage suddenly go dark? You: We've entered a tunnel. Friend: How long is this tunnel, lights still not on? You: The train passes right through the mountain, takes a while. Friend: Do we arrive after the tunnel?

passed down from.context: 你做的这道老菜是外婆年轻时传下来的，朋友尝了一口说特别有家的味道。
passed down from.translation: 朋友：这道菜味道真特别 有什么来头吗 你：是我外婆年轻时传下来的 朋友：这方子传了好几代了吧 你：对 是外婆从她那代传下来的 朋友：这味道里都是故事
passed down from.example: Friend: This dish tastes special, what's its story? You: It was handed down from when my grandma was young. Friend: Has this recipe passed generations? You: Right, it was passed down from my grandma's time. Friend: There's a story in this taste.

passes through.context: 阳光透过树叶洒在地上，你和朋友散步时聊起这种光线穿过缝隙照进来的景象特别美。
passes through.translation: 朋友：你看这阳光透过树叶 多好看 你：光斑一晃一晃的 像在跳舞 朋友：光线穿过树叶缝隙照下来真美 你：对 阳光穿过枝叶洒下来 特别温柔 朋友：这种午后真惬意
passes through.example: Friend: Look at the sunlight through the leaves, so pretty. You: The spots flicker like dancing. Friend: Light passing through the leaves is lovely. You: Right, sunlight passing through the branches is so gentle. Friend: Such an afternoon is bliss.

passionate about.context: 聊到梦想时，你说自己从小就热爱画画，一直对绘画充满热情，想当个插画师。
passionate about.translation: 朋友：你小时候的梦想是什么啊 你：我一直特别喜欢画画 朋友：是那种打心底里热爱的吗 你：对 我对画画充满热情 想当插画师 朋友：那就坚持你的热爱
passionate about.example: Friend: What was your childhood dream? You: I've always loved drawing. Friend: The kind you're truly passionate about? You: Right, I'm passionate about drawing and want to be an illustrator. Friend: Then stick to your passion.

passive smoking.context: 咖啡馆里有人抽烟，旁边不吸烟的女士只好默默吸着二手烟，难受得直咳嗽。
passive smoking.translation: 朋友：咖啡馆里怎么还有人抽烟啊 你：就是 旁边的人跟着受害 朋友：不抽烟也跟着吸进去 是吧 你：对 大家被动吸着二手烟 特别难受 朋友：真该在公共场合全面禁烟
passive smoking.example: Friend: Why is someone smoking in the café? You: Exactly, people nearby suffer too. Friend: Non-smokers breathe it in too, right? You: Right, everyone suffers passive smoking, it's awful. Friend: Public places really should be smoke-free.

past one's sell-by date.context: 冰箱里那罐果酱放了大半年，你一看标签早过了保质期，妈妈笑着说它早就过期不能吃了。
past one's sell-by date.translation: 朋友：冰箱里那罐果酱还能吃吗 你：我看看标签 好像过期了 朋友：都过期多久了 扔了吧 你：是 它早过了保质期 不能吃了 朋友：这种东西可别舍不得扔
past one's sell-by date.example: Friend: Is that jar of jam in the fridge still okay? You: Let me check the label, seems expired. Friend: How long, just throw it out. You: Right, it's past its sell-by date, can't eat it. Friend: Don't cling to that kind of thing.

pastoral care.context: 寄宿学校老师说他们不光管学习，还负责照顾学生的情绪和生活，这叫人文关怀。
pastoral care.translation: 朋友：这所寄宿学校管得严不严啊 你：挺贴心的 老师很照顾学生 朋友：除了学习 生活上也管吗 你：对 学校特别注重对学生的人文关怀 朋友：把孩子送这儿我放心
pastoral care.example: Friend: Is this boarding school strict? You: Quite caring, teachers look after students. Friend: Beyond study, do they care for daily life? You: Right, the school focuses a lot on pastoral care. Friend: I'm reassured sending my kid here.

patch up.context: 你和朋友为点小事冷战了好几天，后来你主动请他喝杯咖啡，俩人和好如初。
patch up.translation: 朋友：你俩不是闹别扭了吗 怎么和好了 你：我主动找他聊了聊 就解开了 朋友：是你先低的头啊 你：对 我主动找他把矛盾说开 和好如初了 朋友：朋友之间没必要较真
patch up.example: Friend: Weren't you two falling out, how're you friends again? You: I reached out and talked it through, we cleared it. Friend: You were the first to bend? You: Right, I patched things up with him and we're good again. Friend: No need to be stubborn between friends.

paternity leave.context: 同事家宝宝刚出生，他说这个月开始休陪产假，在家帮忙带孩子照顾老婆。
paternity leave.translation: 朋友：你这阵子怎么不来上班了 去哪了 你：我家宝宝刚出生 在家陪老婆 朋友：是休那个陪产假吗 你：对 我休了陪产假 在家帮忙带孩子 朋友：好好享受这段时光
paternity leave.example: Friend: Why aren't you at work these days, where are you? You: My baby was just born, I'm home with my wife. Friend: Is that paternity leave? You: Right, I'm on paternity leave, helping with the baby. Friend: Enjoy this time.

patrol vessel.context: 海边巡逻艇来回巡视，防止非法船只靠近，远远就能看到那艘白色的执法船。
patrol vessel.translation: 朋友：海面上那艘大船是干嘛的啊 你：那是巡逻用的执法船 朋友：它在海上来回转 是巡逻吗 你：对 那是艘海上巡逻船 负责安保 朋友：有它在 海上就安全多了
patrol vessel.example: Friend: What's that big ship on the sea for? You: It's a law-enforcement patrol boat. Friend: Crisscrossing the sea, is it patrolling? You: Right, that's a patrol vessel on maritime security. Friend: Safer with it around.

pave the way for.context: 改革开放为后来的经济腾飞铺平了道路，让无数普通人有了创业致富的机会。
pave the way for.translation: 朋友：你说这几十年 为什么发展这么快啊 你：靠的是早早打开了局面 朋友：是说当年的政策打下了基础吗 你：对 那个决定为后来的发展铺了路 朋友：一步先 步步先
pave the way for.example: Friend: Why has development been so fast these decades? You: Because the door opened early. Friend: So the old policy laid the foundation? You: Right, that decision paved the way for later growth. Friend: First step leads all the way.

paved the way.context: 当年他的坚持为后来团队的成功铺平了道路，大家都说没有他就没有今天。
paved the way.translation: 朋友：你说咱们团队今天的成绩 靠的是谁 你：最早全靠他一个人硬扛 朋友：是他当年打下了好底子吗 你：对 是他为今天的成功铺了路 朋友：真该好好谢谢他
paved the way.example: Friend: Who does today's team success rest on? You: At first it was all him carrying it alone. Friend: Did he lay the solid foundation back then? You: Right, he paved the way for today's success. Friend: We really should thank him.

pavement cafes.context: 夏天傍晚，街边露天咖啡馆坐满了人，大家喝着冰咖啡聊着天，特别惬意。
pavement cafes.translation: 朋友：夏天晚上去哪坐坐比较舒服啊 你：街边那种露天咖啡馆就挺好 朋友：是坐在人行道边上的那种吗 你：对 这种露天咖啡馆吹风聊天特别惬意 朋友：那今晚去坐一坐
pavement cafes.example: Friend: Where's nice to sit on a summer evening? You: Those pavement cafés by the street are great. Friend: The kind sitting on the pavement? You: Right, pavement cafés are lovely for chatting in the breeze. Friend: Then let's sit there tonight.

pavement queue.context: 演唱会场外排起了长队，大家顶着太阳有序地等入场，队伍绕了广场一圈。
pavement queue.translation: 朋友：演唱会入口怎么这么多人在排队 你：大家都在等开门进场 朋友：这队伍绕了一大圈 得排多久啊 你：是啊 站台前排了好长一条队 朋友：那咱们早点来就好了
pavement queue.example: Friend: Why is a long queue at the concert entrance? You: Everyone's waiting for the gates to open. Friend: The line loops the square, how long a wait? You: Right, the pavement queue is really long. Friend: We should have come earlier.

pay close attention to.context: 带爷爷奶奶去看病，你反复叮嘱大夫一定要仔细检查，说老人的病耽误不得。
pay close attention to.translation: 朋友：带老人看病 你都跟医生说啥了 你：我让他一定要仔细检查 朋友：是希望医生多上心吗 你：对 我请医生密切关注老人的身体 朋友：检查细致点才放心
pay close attention to.example: Friend: What did you tell the doctor taking your grandparents? You: I asked him to examine them really carefully. Friend: Wanting the doctor to take extra care? You: Right, I asked the doctor to pay close attention to them. Friend: Thorough checks are reassuring.

pay freeze.context: 经济不景气，公司今年不涨工资还冻结了薪资，员工们怨声载道却又没办法。
pay freeze.translation: 朋友：今年公司还涨工资吗 你：别想了 今年都不涨了 朋友：是把工资给冻结了吗 你：对 公司今年冻结了薪资 大家都有意见 朋友：这行情 能保住饭碗就不错
pay freeze.example: Friend: Is there a raise this year? You: Forget it, no raises this year. Friend: Has pay been frozen? You: Right, the company imposed a pay freeze, everyone's unhappy. Friend: In this climate, keeping your job is enough.

pay gap.context: 同岗不同酬，男员工工资普遍比女员工高，公司内部这个工资差距一直被人诟病。
pay gap.translation: 朋友：你们公司男女待遇公平吗 你：不太公平 差得还不少 朋友：是说同岗位工资有差距吗 你：对 大家一直诟病这种工资差距 朋友：这问题早就该改改了
pay gap.example: Friend: Is pay fair between men and women at your company? You: Not very, the gap's quite big. Friend: So there's a pay gap for the same job? You: Right, everyone criticises this pay gap. Friend: This issue should be fixed long ago.

pay grade.context: 同事问你能不能决定给客户打折，你苦笑着说这种事超出你的职权范围，得请示领导。
pay grade.translation: 朋友：这单能给客户打点折吗 你定就行 你：打折这事我可做不了主 朋友：怎么 你还没这个权限吗 你：对 这超出我的职权范围了 得问领导 朋友：那我等你消息
pay grade.example: Friend: Can we discount this order, just decide? You: I can't decide on discounts. Friend: You don't have that authority? You: Right, it's above my pay grade, I have to ask the boss. Friend: Then I'll wait for your word.

pay heed.context: 朋友开车分心看手机，你提醒他开车务必集中注意力，说安全比什么都重要。
pay heed.translation: 朋友：你开车怎么老提醒我看路啊 你：开车千万别分心 安全第一 朋友：我就瞟一眼手机而已 你：开车可得集中注意力 别拿安全开玩笑 朋友：行 我专心开
pay heed.example: Friend: Why do you keep telling me to watch the road? You: Never get distracted driving, safety first. Friend: I'm just glancing at my phone. You: Pay heed to the road when driving, don't risk safety. Friend: Okay, I'll focus.

pay increase.context: 辛苦干了一年，你盼着年底能涨点工资，好改善一下拮据的生活，结果老板只字未提。
pay increase.translation: 朋友：你今年盼着涨工资吗 你：当然盼着 都辛苦了一年了 朋友：老板提过加薪的事吗 你：半字没提 我还等着涨工资呢 朋友：要不你主动去问问
pay increase.example: Friend: Are you hoping for a raise this year? You: Of course, I've worked hard all year. Friend: Has the boss mentioned a pay increase? You: Not a word, I'm still waiting for a pay increase. Friend: Why not ask him yourself?

pay it forward.context: 你帮了陌生人一个忙，对方要谢你，你却说不用，把这份善意接着传给下一个需要的人就好。
pay it forward.translation: 朋友：你帮那个老人提东西 他怎么谢你的 你：我没要他谢 就让他去帮别人 朋友：你这叫什么 做好事不留名吗 你：对 我跟他说把这份善意继续传递下去 朋友：你这心态真好
pay it forward.example: Friend: You helped the old man carry things, how did he thank you? You: I didn't take his thanks, just told him to help someone else. Friend: What's that called, doing good without credit? You: Right, I told him to pay it forward to the next person. Friend: You have such a great attitude.

pay off.context: 坚持学了两年英语后，你终于能流利地和外国客户聊天，感叹这番努力总算有了回报。
pay off.translation: 朋友：你这两年坚持学英语 值不值啊 你：值 现在能跟老外聊了 朋友：努力真的见到效果了吗 你：对 这两年的付出终于有了回报 朋友：看来坚持就是胜利
pay off.example: Friend: Was it worth studying English these two years? You: Worth it, I can chat with foreigners now. Friend: Did the effort finally pay off? You: Right, two years of effort finally paid off. Friend: Looks like persistence wins.

pay rise.context: 在小公司干了三年，你终于等到了涨工资的通知，虽然不多，但心里还是美滋滋的。
pay rise.translation: 朋友：你今年涨工资了吗 你：涨了一点 总算等到了 朋友：你们那边是叫涨工资吗 你：对 我终于盼到了这次涨工资 朋友：涨了多少 请客吃饭吧
pay rise.example: Friend: Did you get a raise this year? You: A little, I finally got it. Friend: Do you call it a pay rise over there? You: Right, I finally got this pay rise. Friend: How much, treat us to a meal.

pay secrecy.context: 公司规定同事之间不许打听工资，谁透露就开除，大家都很好奇却又不敢问。
pay secrecy.translation: 朋友：你们同事工资都互相知道吗 你：不知道 公司不让打听 朋友：工资是保密的吗 你：对 公司一直实行工资保密制度 大家谁也不问谁 朋友：这样反而更好奇了
pay secrecy.example: Friend: Do colleagues at your place know each other's pay? You: No, the company forbids asking. Friend: Is pay kept secret? You: Right, the company keeps pay secrecy, nobody asks anyone. Friend: That only makes you more curious.

pay transparency.context: 这家创业公司反其道而行，把所有人的工资都公开出来，说透明才能服众。
pay transparency.translation: 朋友：你们公司工资都互相知道吗 你：都知道 全是公开的 朋友：这么大方 不怕人有意见吗 你：我们主打工资透明 觉得这样最公平 朋友：这做法还挺新潮
pay transparency.example: Friend: Do people know each other's pay at your company? You: Yes, it's all public. Friend: That open, no complaints? You: We emphasise pay transparency, thinking it's fairest. Friend: That's quite a novel way.

pea protein.context: 健身餐里你不爱喝牛奶，就用那种植物蛋白冲调，说纯素饮食也能补足蛋白质。
pea protein.translation: 朋友：你健身喝蛋白粉吗 我怎么没见你喝 你：我喝的是那种植物蛋白 朋友：是豌豆做的那种素蛋白粉吗 你：对 我用豌豆蛋白补营养 纯素也够 朋友：现在选择真多
pea protein.example: Friend: Don't you drink protein powder for gym? You: I drink the plant-based kind. Friend: Is that the pea protein vegan powder? You: Right, I use pea protein for nutrition, vegan is enough. Friend: So many choices now.

peace of mind.context: 给孩子配了定位手表后，你随时知道他在哪，心里那块石头终于落地，安心多了。
peace of mind.translation: 朋友：孩子一个人上学 你放心得下吗 你：有点悬 所以给他戴了手表 朋友：现在能随时知道他位置了 你：对 我终于能放下心 安心多了 朋友：有个牵挂的物件就是踏实
peace of mind.example: Friend: Are you at ease letting the child go to school alone? You: A bit nervous, so I put a watch on him. Friend: Now you know where he is anytime? You: Right, I finally have peace of mind. Friend: A tracking device gives peace of mind.

peak season.context: 你想节假日去热门景点玩，朋友提醒说那时候是旅游旺季，人多价高最好避开。
peak season.translation: 朋友：国庆你想去那个热门景点玩吗 你：想啊 正好放假有时间 朋友：那可是旅游旺季 人挤人 朋友：对 旺季去哪都是人挤人 你：那我错峰出行吧
peak season.example: Friend: Do you want to visit that popular spot over National Day? You: Yes, I'm off and have time. Friend: It's peak season then, packed. Friend: Right, in peak season everywhere is crowded. You: Then I'll travel off-peak.

peanut allergy.context: 同学聚餐点了带花生的菜，你赶紧拦住，说自己对花生严重过敏，碰一点都危险。
peanut allergy.translation: 朋友：这道花生炒菜看着不错 点不点 你：千万别点 我对花生过敏 朋友：很严重吗 就一点而已 你：我花生过敏很严重 一点都碰不得 朋友：那换道菜 安全第一
peanut allergy.example: Friend: This stir-fry with peanuts looks good, order it? You: Please don't, I'm allergic to peanuts. Friend: That serious? It's just a bit. You: My peanut allergy is severe, I can't touch any. Friend: Then order another dish, safety first.

pecking order.context: 部门里谁说话最算数大家心里都清楚，新来的小年轻不懂规矩，冲撞了那个地位最高的人。
pecking order.translation: 朋友：部门里谁说了算 你心里有数吗 你：当然 大家都有自己的位置 朋友：新来的不懂规矩 得罪人了吧 你：他冲撞了那个地位最高的老员工 朋友：职场这等级可别乱闯
pecking order.example: Friend: Who calls the shots in the department, do you know? You: Of course, everyone knows their place. Friend: The new kid doesn't know the ropes, offended someone? You: He bumped into the person at the top of the pecking order. Friend: Don't mess with workplace ranks.

pedestrian etiquette.context: 在国外地铁里你靠右站留出通道，朋友说这是基本的走路规矩，不然挡着赶路的人。
pedestrian etiquette.translation: 朋友：在地铁扶梯上 大家怎么都站一边啊 你：这是规矩 留出左边给人快走 朋友：不守着点会被人说吧 你：对 这就是基本的步行礼仪 别挡路 朋友：入乡随俗 我也靠右边站
pedestrian etiquette.example: Friend: Why does everyone stand on one side on the escalator? You: It's the etiquette, leaving the left for people in a rush. Friend: Will people judge you if you don't? You: Right, that's basic pedestrian etiquette, don't block the way. Friend: When in Rome, I'll stand right too.

peer friend.context: 你在外地读书，遇到难处时最想的不是家人，而是和你同一年纪、无话不谈的那个朋友。
peer friend.translation: 朋友：你在外地 遇到烦心事找谁聊啊 你：就找那个跟我同龄的死党 朋友：是你们班那个最好的朋友吗 你：对 就是那个同龄好友 跟我特别投缘 朋友：有个懂你的朋友真好
peer friend.example: Friend: Far from home, who do you talk to when upset? You: Just that same-age best buddy. Friend: That closest friend in your class? You: Right, that peer friend, we really click. Friend: It's great to have a friend who gets you.

peer group.context: 孩子上初中后特别爱跟班里同学比穿比吃，你说他受周围同伴的影响太大了。
peer group.translation: 朋友：孩子最近怎么老追着买名牌鞋啊 你：都是跟班里同学学的 朋友：是受他那个圈子影响吧 你：对 他整天跟同龄圈的孩子比 朋友：得引导他别攀比
peer group.example: Friend: Why is the kid always chasing brand shoes lately? You: He learned it from his classmates. Friend: Influenced by his peer group? You: Right, he's always comparing with his peer group. Friend: Guide him not to keep up.

peer influence.context: 你发现妹妹最近开始学抽烟，一问才知道是被她那些朋友带的，你说这是典型的同伴影响。
peer influence.translation: 朋友：你妹妹最近怎么老躲着抽烟啊 你：我一问 是被她朋友带的 朋友：是不是跟那帮学坏了 你：对 明显是受同伴影响学的坏毛病 朋友：得赶紧管管 别越学越坏
peer influence.example: Friend: Why is your sister always hiding to smoke lately? You: I asked, it's her friends who got her into it. Friend: Gone bad with that crowd? You: Right, it's clearly peer influence that picked up the habit. Friend: Stop it fast, or it worsens.

peer pressure.context: 本来说好不喝酒的朋友聚会，结果大家都劝，你碍于面子还是端起了杯，这就是同辈的压力。
peer pressure.translation: 朋友：咱们今天不是说好了不喝酒吗 你：是啊 可大家都在劝 朋友：你是被大家逼着喝的吧 你：对 都是碍于同辈压力 不好拒绝 朋友：真不想喝就直接说
peer pressure.example: Friend: Didn't we agree not to drink today? You: Yeah, but everyone's persuading. Friend: You were pressured into it by everyone? You: Right, it's peer pressure, hard to refuse. Friend: Just say no if you really don't want.

peer recommendation.context: 找工作时你最看重内推，朋友说有同行的人推荐，比自己投简历胜算大得多。
peer recommendation.translation: 朋友：你找工作都怎么投简历啊 你：我最想找熟人内推 朋友：内推真的比自己投有用吗 你：对 有同行的人推荐 机会大很多 朋友：那你赶紧问问认识的人
peer recommendation.example: Friend: How do you apply for jobs? You: I most want an internal referral. Friend: Is a peer recommendation really better than applying yourself? You: Right, a peer recommendation boosts your chances a lot. Friend: Then ask people you know fast.

peer spending habit.context: 刚工作的年轻人爱攀比消费，你说这种受同伴影响的消费习惯，很容易让人超前透支。
peer spending habit.translation: 朋友：他刚工作就买名牌包 钱哪来的啊 你：都是跟同事学的 攀比嘛 朋友：是受同伴花钱习惯的影响吧 你：对 这种同龄人消费习惯 最容易让人乱花钱 朋友：得理性消费
peer spending habit.example: Friend: He buys designer bags just starting out, where's the money? You: Learned from colleagues, keeping up. Friend: Influenced by peers' spending habits? You: Right, that peer spending habit easily makes you overspend. Friend: Spend rationally.

peer support.context: 刚化疗那阵你情绪最低落，多亏了一群同样患病的朋友互相打气，才慢慢挺了过来。
peer support.translation: 朋友：你生病那段日子 是怎么熬过来的 你：多亏了一群病友互相鼓励 朋友：是那种同病相怜的伙伴吗 你：对 他们的陪伴帮了我大忙 朋友：有个同路人真的温暖
peer support.example: Friend: How did you get through being ill? You: Thanks to a group of patients encouraging each other. Friend: That kindred peer support? You: Right, their peer support helped me enormously. Friend: A fellow traveller is so warm.

pen pal.context: 初中时你交了个外国笔友，俩人靠写信聊各自的生活，虽然没见过面却成了好朋友。
pen pal.translation: 朋友：你以前真跟外国人通过信吗 你：是啊 初中认识一个笔友 朋友：你们一直靠写信联系吗 你：对 我那个笔友 我们靠书信往来多年 朋友：现在还联系吗
pen pal.example: Friend: Did you really correspond with a foreigner back then? You: Yeah, I met a pen pal in middle school. Friend: Did you keep in touch only by letters? You: Right, my pen pal and I wrote for years. Friend: Are you still in touch?

pension gap.context: 退休后你发现自己的养老金比男同事少一大截，说是因为过去产假影响了缴费年限。
pension gap.translation: 朋友：你退休后养老金够花吗 你：不太够 比男同事少不少 朋友：差在哪呢 是有养老金差距吗 你：对 就是那种因为育儿造成的养老金差距 朋友：这对女性太不公平
pension gap.example: Friend: Is your pension enough after retiring? You: Not really, much less than male colleagues. Friend: Where's the gap, a pension gap? You: Right, it's that pension gap caused by career breaks. Friend: That's so unfair to women.

per capita.context: 聊到哪个国家最富，朋友拿人均收入来比，说光看总量没用，得看人均水平。
per capita.translation: 朋友：咱们国家经济总量排第几啊 你：挺靠前的 可人一多就摊薄了 朋友：那得按人均来比才公平吧 你：对 看人均收入才能比出真差距 朋友：总量和人均两回事
per capita.example: Friend: Where does our economy rank in total? You: Pretty high, but population dilutes it. Friend: Then comparing per capita is fairer? You: Right, per capita income shows the real gap. Friend: Total and per capita are different things.

perceive as.context: 同事把你随口一句玩笑当成了认真的承诺，你赶紧解释说他误会了自己的意思。
perceive as.translation: 朋友：你不是说要请大家吃饭吗 什么时候 你：我那是客气话 你当真啦 朋友：我可是把你的话当承诺了 你：你别把我那句玩笑话当成承诺啊 朋友：嗨 那我白高兴了
perceive as.example: Friend: Didn't you say you'd treat us, when? You: That was just politeness, you took it literally? Friend: I perceived your words as a promise. You: Don't perceive my joke as a promise. Friend: Ah, I got excited for nothing.

perceived as.context: 他只是个普通员工，却常被客户错当成老板，你说这气场和打扮太有老板范儿了。
perceived as.translation: 朋友：那位客户把你同事当成老板了 你：哈哈 他穿得是挺像老板 朋友：大家都把他当成公司负责人吗 你：对 他被人当成老板了 其实就是个普通员工 朋友：这气势真像那么回事
perceived as.example: Friend: That client mistook your colleague for the boss. You: Haha, he dresses like one. Friend: Do people perceive him as the person in charge? You: Right, he's perceived as the boss, though he's just staff. Friend: He really looks the part.

perceived corruption.context: 民意调查显示，老百姓觉得现在办事比以前规范多了，那种暗箱操作的事少了很多。
perceived corruption.translation: 朋友：你觉得现在办事还容易碰到贪污吗 你：少多了 规矩了很多 朋友：是老百姓普遍这么觉得吗 你：对 大家感觉上的腐败现象少了 朋友：风气确实在变好
perceived corruption.example: Friend: Do you still easily run into corruption? You: Much less, it's more regulated. Friend: Is that how people generally feel? You: Right, the perceived corruption is lower now. Friend: The climate really is improving.

perfect catch.context: 朋友给你介绍对象，说对方又高又帅工作还好，你笑着说那简直是打着灯笼都难找的理想伴侣。
perfect catch.translation: 朋友：我给你介绍个对象 条件特别好 你：真的吗 快说说看 朋友：他又高又帅 工作也好 你：那简直是个理想伴侣啊 上哪找去 朋友：那你周末见见呗
perfect catch.example: Friend: I'll set you up, this person is really great. You: Really, tell me more. Friend: Tall, handsome, great job. You: That's a perfect catch, where do you find them? Friend: Then meet them this weekend.

period drama.context: 周末你窝在沙发上看那种讲民国故事的老电视剧，朋友说这类年代剧特别有怀旧味道。
period drama.translation: 朋友：你周末都在家看什么剧啊 你：在看一部讲老上海的电视剧 朋友：是那种讲过去年代故事的剧吗 你：对 这种年代剧看着特别有味道 朋友：比那些现代剧耐看
period drama.example: Friend: What shows do you watch at home on weekends? You: Watching one about old Shanghai. Friend: Is it that period drama set in bygone days? You: Right, this period drama has such a nostalgic feel. Friend: More enduring than modern dramas.

period property.context: 你看房时专挑那种有年代感的老洋房，朋友说这种老房子虽然旧但特别有味道。
period property.translation: 朋友：你买房怎么不买新小区啊 你：我就喜欢那种老式老房子 朋友：是那种有年代感的老建筑吗 你：对 我特别喜欢这种老式老房子 有味道 朋友：就是修起来费钱吧
period property.example: Friend: Why not buy a new development? You: I love those old period houses. Friend: That kind of characterful old property? You: Right, I really love this period property, it has charm. Friend: But renovating costs a lot.

perk up.context: 下午开会你困得直点头，一杯冰咖啡下肚后，整个人立刻精神起来，朋友笑你见效真快。
perk up.translation: 朋友：你刚才还困得打盹呢 现在怎么精神了 你：喝了杯咖啡 立马就醒了 朋友：这一杯就把你提振起来了吗 你：对 喝完咖啡人一下就有精神了 朋友：咖啡因还真管用
perk up.example: Friend: You were nodding off a moment ago, why alert now? You: Had a coffee, woke right up. Friend: That one drink perked you up? You: Right, after coffee I perked up at once. Friend: Caffeine really works.

permanent tenant.context: 你租的房子签了五年长约，房东说只打算租给长期稳定的住户，不喜欢三天两头换租客。
permanent tenant.translation: 朋友：你这房子租期签了多久啊 你：五年 房东想找稳定租客 朋友：他是不喜欢经常换租客吧 你：对 他就想找个长期租客 省心 朋友：这样你也踏实
permanent tenant.example: Friend: How long is your lease? You: Five years, the landlord wants a stable tenant. Friend: He doesn't like changing tenants often? You: Right, he wants a permanent tenant, less hassle. Friend: Then you're settled too.

personal advice.context: 刚入职你很多流程都不懂，老员工主动找你聊，给了你好多实用的个人建议。
personal advice.translation: 朋友：你刚进公司 有人带你吗 你：有个老同事特别热心 朋友：他都教你些什么呀 你：他给我提了好多实用的个人建议 帮我入门 朋友：遇到好同事是福气
personal advice.example: Friend: On joining, is there someone to guide you? You: A senior colleague's been really helpful. Friend: What does he teach you? You: He's given me a lot of personal advice to get started. Friend: A good colleague is a blessing.

personal best.context: 运动会上你打破了自己去年的最好成绩，虽然没拿冠军，但刷新了个人纪录还是很开心。
personal best.translation: 朋友：运动会你跑了第几名啊 你：没拿冠军 不过破了自己纪录 朋友：你是说刷新了自己的最好成绩吗 你：对 我跑出了个人最好成绩 特别高兴 朋友：超越自己也很棒
personal best.example: Friend: Where did you place at the sports day? You: Not on the podium, but beat my own record. Friend: You mean a new personal best? You: Right, I hit a personal best, so happy. Friend: Beating yourself is great too.

personal care product.context: 出差住酒店，你发现洗漱台上的小瓶洗护用品都是那种一次性个人护理产品，用着挺方便。
personal care product.translation: 朋友：酒店房间里都提供什么洗漱用品啊 你：小瓶洗发水沐浴露 都有 朋友：是那种个人护理套装吗 你：对 都是现成的个人护理用品 用着方便 朋友：出门住酒店就是省事
personal care product.example: Friend: What toiletries does the hotel provide? You: Small bottles of shampoo and body wash. Friend: That personal care product set? You: Right, they provide personal care products, so convenient. Friend: Staying in hotels is hassle-free.

personal choice.context: 要不要回老家发展，朋友劝你别被别人的意见绑架，说这终究是你自己的人生选择。
personal choice.translation: 朋友：大家都劝你回老家 你怎么想 你：我也在纠结 拿不定主意 朋友：别人说再多 路还得自己走 你：对 回不回去是我的个人选择 朋友：想清楚再决定 别勉强自己
personal choice.example: Friend: Everyone urges you to go home, what do you think? You: I'm torn, can't decide. Friend: Whatever others say, you walk your own road. You: Right, going back or not is my personal choice. Friend: Decide carefully, don't force yourself.

personal detail.context: 刚认识的同事聊天总爱打听你家住哪、工资多少，这些个人私事让你很不舒服。
personal detail.translation: 朋友：新同事人怎么样啊 好相处吗 你：别的还行 就是爱打听私事 朋友：她都问你些什么呀 你：净问些家住哪工资多少 这种个人琐事 朋友：这种查户口式聊天真烦人
personal detail.example: Friend: How's the new colleague, easy to get along with? You: Otherwise fine, but loves prying into private stuff. Friend: What does she ask? You: All those personal details like where you live and your pay. Friend: That interrogation-style chat is annoying.

personal experience.context: 面试时老板问你为什么转行，你便讲了几段自己亲身经历的故事，来说明转行的心路历程。
personal experience.translation: 朋友：面试老板都问你些什么了 你：他问我为什么想转行 朋友：你是怎么回答的 你：我讲了几段自己亲身经历的事 来说明原因 朋友：用亲身经历回答 最打动人
personal experience.example: Friend: What did the interviewer ask you? You: He asked why I want to switch careers. Friend: How did you answer? You: I told him some of my personal experiences to explain. Friend: Answering with personal experience is most moving.

personal finance.context: 你最近开始学着理财，朋友推荐你先看看个人财务方面的书，学会量入为出。
personal finance.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总在看理财的书啊 你：想学学怎么管好自己的钱 朋友：是那种讲个人财务的书吗 你：对 我在看个人财务方面的书 学着规划 朋友：学会理财 日子就宽松了
personal finance.example: Friend: Why are you reading finance books lately? You: Want to learn to manage my money. Friend: Those personal finance books? You: Right, I'm reading about personal finance to plan better. Friend: Once you budget, life gets easier.

personal hygiene.context: 医生提醒老人要勤洗手、勤换衣，说良好的个人卫生能减少很多疾病。
personal hygiene.translation: 朋友：医生都嘱咐你些什么注意事项啊 你：让我多注意个人卫生 勤洗手 朋友：他是不是特别强调卫生习惯 你：对 说良好的个人卫生能防病 朋友：那我每天好好洗手
personal hygiene.example: Friend: What precautions did the doctor tell you? You: To mind personal hygiene, wash hands often. Friend: Did he stress hygiene habits? You: Right, he said good personal hygiene prevents illness. Friend: Then I'll wash my hands well daily.

personal life.context: 同事们都很好奇你周末都干嘛，你却不爱聊自己的私事，总想把工作和生活分开。
personal life.translation: 朋友：你周末都怎么安排啊 跟大家说说呗 你：我不太爱聊这些私事 朋友：你是不是把工作和生活分得很开 你：对 我想保留一点自己的私人生活 朋友：有点神秘感挺好
personal life.example: Friend: How do you spend weekends, tell us? You: I don't like talking about that private stuff. Friend: Do you keep work and personal life very separate? You: Right, I want to keep some private life to myself. Friend: A bit of mystery is nice.

personal lives.context: 名人上节目时从不提自己的家庭，记者说他把公众形象和私人生活分得清清楚楚。
personal lives.translation: 朋友：那个明星怎么从来不聊家里的事 你：他把隐私保护得很好 朋友：他是不是特别看重私生活 你：对 他刻意和自己的私人生活保持距离 朋友：这样才能不被打扰
personal lives.example: Friend: Why does that celebrity never talk about family? You: He guards his privacy well. Friend: Does he really value his private life? You: Right, he keeps his personal lives carefully separate. Friend: That's how you stay undisturbed.

personal preference.context: 请客点菜时朋友问你忌口什么，你说自己不吃香菜，这纯属个人口味，别见怪。
personal preference.translation: 朋友：点菜你有没有什么忌口啊 你：别的都行 就是不吃香菜 朋友：这是你个人的口味偏好吗 你：对 我个人不爱吃香菜 习惯了 朋友：那我点菜不放香菜
personal preference.example: Friend: Any dietary restrictions for ordering? You: Everything's fine, just no coriander. Friend: Is that your personal preference? You: Right, it's my personal preference, I'm used to it. Friend: Then I'll order without coriander.

personal space.context: 地铁上有人离你特别近，你下意识往旁边挪了挪，觉得每个人都该有自己的私人空间。
personal space.translation: 朋友：地铁上那人贴着你站 你不难受吗 你：特别难受 我不喜欢靠太近 朋友：你是不是很需要私人空间 你：对 我很看重自己的私人空间 朋友：人多的时候真没办法
personal space.example: Friend: That person pressed against you on the subway, not uncomfortable? You: Very, I don't like standing too close. Friend: Do you value your personal space a lot? You: Right, I really value my personal space. Friend: Hard to avoid in a crowd.

personal stereo.context: 你翻出爸爸年轻时用的随身听，放一盘旧磁带进去，那种怀旧的声音一下把你拉回从前。
personal stereo.translation: 朋友：你手里那个老机器是什么 看着挺旧 你：这是我爸年轻时用的随身听 朋友：放磁带的那种老音响吗 你：对 就是那种老式随身音响 特别怀旧 朋友：现在都见不到了
personal stereo.example: Friend: What's that old device in your hand, looks vintage. You: It's the personal stereo my dad used when young. Friend: That old cassette player? You: Right, that old personal stereo, so nostalgic. Friend: You rarely see them now.

personal stylist.context: 公司年会你想穿得体面些，朋友推荐你请个专门的形象顾问，帮你从头到脚搭配一番。
personal stylist.translation: 朋友：年会你打算穿什么啊 想好了吗 你：没头绪 怕穿得不对 朋友：那找个私人造型师帮你搭搭 你：对 请个私人造型师从头到脚弄一下 朋友：保证你惊艳全场
personal stylist.example: Friend: What will you wear to the annual party, decided? You: No clue, afraid of getting it wrong. Friend: Then get a personal stylist to dress you. You: Right, hire a personal stylist to style me head to toe. Friend: You'll stun everyone.

personal touch.context: 奶奶做的菜里总放一小碟自己腌的小菜，那点小心思让每顿饭都有了家的味道。
personal touch.translation: 朋友：奶奶做的饭为什么这么有家的感觉 你：她总加点自己的小心思 朋友：是那种与众不同的细节吗 你：对 她总爱添点个性化的小点缀 朋友：这就是家的味道
personal touch.example: Friend: Why does Grandma's cooking feel so homely? You: She always adds her own little touch. Friend: That special personal detail? You: Right, she adds a personal touch to every meal. Friend: That's the taste of home.

personalised benefit.context: 公司发福利不再人人一样，而是让员工自己选最需要的东西，这种个性化福利大家都很满意。
personalised benefit.translation: 朋友：今年公司福利发的什么啊 你：这次不一样 让自己挑 朋友：是那种可以自己选的福利吗 你：对 这种个性化福利比统一发贴心多了 朋友：公司越来越懂员工了
personalised benefit.example: Friend: What did the company give as benefits this year? You: Different this time, we choose. Friend: Those benefits you pick yourself? You: Right, this personalised benefit beats the one-size-fits-all. Friend: The company understands staff better.

personalised setting.context: 你手机里的字体大小、亮度都按自己的习惯调好了，朋友借去用却怎么都不顺手。
personalised setting.translation: 朋友：借你手机用一下 怎么字这么大啊 你：我自己调的 用着顺手 朋友：你是把它设成自己习惯的样子了吗 你：对 我都调成个性化设置了 朋友：怪不得我用不惯
personalised setting.example: Friend: Lend me your phone, why is the font so big? You: I set it myself, it suits me. Friend: You've set it to your personal preference? You: Right, I adjusted all the personalised settings. Friend: No wonder I'm not used to it.

personality characteristics.context: 面试时面试官问你觉得自己是个什么样的人，你便列举了自己性格上的几个鲜明特点来回答。
personality characteristics.translation: 朋友：面试的时候 都问你什么问题了 你：他让我说说自己性格上的特点 朋友：那你是怎么介绍自己的 你：我说了自己几个比较明显的个性特征 朋友：能清楚说出自己的特点 挺好的
personality characteristics.example: Friend: What did they ask in the interview? You: He asked me to describe my personality. Friend: How did you introduce yourself? You: I listed a few of my personality characteristics. Friend: Being able to state your traits clearly is good.

personality trait.context: 老师说了解一个孩子的性格特点，比看他成绩更重要，因为这些特质会影响他一生。
personality trait.translation: 朋友：你觉得了解孩子 什么最重要啊 你：我觉得性格比成绩还重要 朋友：是说要看他天生的那些特质吗 你：对 了解孩子的性格特质 才能因材施教 朋友：你这教育观念挺新的
personality trait.example: Friend: What do you think matters most about knowing a child? You: I think character matters more than grades. Friend: You mean seeing their inborn traits? You: Right, knowing the child's personality trait helps teach them right. Friend: Your views on education are quite modern.

personality type.context: 朋友做了性格测试，测出是外向型，你笑说难怪他那么爱社交，走到哪都能聊起来。
personality type.translation: 朋友：你做的那个人格测试 结果是什么啊 你：说我是外向型人格 特别爱社交 朋友：你是哪种人格类型来着 你：我这种人格类型 就是天生爱热闹的那种 朋友：难怪你朋友那么多
personality type.example: Friend: What did that personality test give you? You: It said I'm an extrovert, super social. Friend: Which personality type are you again? You: My personality type is the outgoing kind. Friend: No wonder you have so many friends.

pessimistic outlook.context: 比赛输了之后，队友们都很沮丧，你劝大家别老往坏处想，免得悲观情绪影响士气。
pessimistic outlook.translation: 朋友：输了球 大家情绪都很低落 你：是啊 我看谁都高兴不起来 朋友：你别也跟着一起泄气啊 你：我就是有点悲观 总觉得没戏了 朋友：往好处想想 下次再赢回来
pessimistic outlook.example: Friend: Everyone's so down after losing. You: Yeah, nobody seems able to cheer up. Friend: Don't you get discouraged too? You: I have such a pessimistic outlook, feeling it's hopeless. Friend: Look on the bright side, win it back next time.

petri dish.context: 生物课上老师拿出一个圆玻璃碟子，说这是用来培养细菌的培养皿，让大家小心别打碎。
petri dish.translation: 朋友：实验桌上那个圆玻璃碟是干嘛用的 你：那是用来培养细菌的碟子 朋友：这种装菌种的盘子 有专门名字吗 你：对 它叫培养皿 实验必备 朋友：名字还挺形象的
petri dish.example: Friend: What's that round glass dish on the lab table for? You: It's for growing bacteria. Friend: Does this culture dish have a special name? You: Right, it's called a petri dish, essential for labs. Friend: The name is quite descriptive.

petrol vehicle.context: 你在考虑买新车，纠结买电动还是加油的，朋友说汽油车现在加油方便但油耗越来越贵。
petrol vehicle.translation: 朋友：你买车 想买电动还是加油的啊 你：还在纠结 各有利弊 朋友：加油的那种车 现在划算吗 你：汽油车加油是方便 可油费不便宜 朋友：那你再权衡权衡
petrol vehicle.example: Friend: For a car, electric or petrol? You: Still torn, each has pros and cons. Friend: Are petrol vehicles good value now? You: A petrol vehicle is easy to refuel, but petrol's pricey. Friend: Then weigh it up more.

petting session.context: 周末你去宠物咖啡馆撸猫，那里专门设了一个和小猫玩耍的时段，你边摸边笑特别治愈。
petting session.translation: 朋友：周末去那个猫咖 好玩吗 你：特别治愈 一屋子小猫随便摸 朋友：是那种可以和猫互动的时段吗 你：对 大家坐在一起撸猫 特别放松 朋友：那我也想去放松一下
petting session.example: Friend: Was that cat cafe fun this weekend? You: So healing, a room of cats to pet. Friend: That session where you interact with the cats? You: Right, the petting session together is so relaxing. Friend: Then I want to unwind there too.

phasing out.context: 政府宣布要逐步淘汰老旧的燃油公交车，换成新能源的，几年内全部换完。
