separate from.example: Friend: Why think about work off hours? You: Can't separate them. Friend: Separate from life? You: Right, separate work from life. Friend: Switch off after work.

separation anxiety.context: 你说孩子第一次离开家住校，朋友说他心里直发慌，这就是分离焦虑。
separation anxiety.translation: 朋友：孩子第一次住校 哭着不肯走 你：他舍不得家 朋友：是说舍不得离开的焦虑吗 你：对 是分离焦虑 朋友：慢慢适应
separation anxiety.example: Friend: Kid cried leaving home for school. You: He misses home. Friend: That separation anxiety? You: Right, it's separation anxiety. Friend: He'll adjust.

serial returner.context: 你说他网购退来退去，朋友说这种买了又退的人就是剁手党。
serial returner.translation: 朋友：他那快递咋天天退 买了又退 你：买了不合适就退 朋友：是说那种老退东西的人吗 你：对 他就是个退货达人 朋友：商家都怕他
serial returner.example: Friend: Why does he return parcels daily? You: Buys, then sends back. Friend: That serial returner? You: Right, he's a serial returner. Friend: Shops dread him.

serve as.context: 你说那张旧桌子现在当书架用，朋友说一物两用特别划算。
serve as.translation: 朋友：这桌子现在干啥使啊 你：拿来当书架用 朋友：是说它派什么用场吗 你：对 它现在当书架用 朋友：一物两用
serve as.example: Friend: What's this table used for? You: As a bookshelf. Friend: Serving as? You: Right, it serves as a bookshelf. Friend: Two uses in one.

serve up.context: 你说朋友来家吃饭，你端上拿手菜招待，朋友说真香。
serve up.translation: 朋友：你请客都给客人做啥吃 你：做几道拿手菜 朋友：是说端上菜招待吗 你：对 我端上拿手菜 朋友：有口福了
serve up.example: Friend: What do you cook for guests? You: My specialities. Friend: Serving up a meal? You: Right, I serve up my specialities. Friend: Lucky me.

serves as.context: 你说这张沙发平时当床用，朋友说来客人时派上大用场。
serves as.translation: 朋友：这沙发 客人来了咋用啊 你：展开就是一张床 朋友：是说它当什么用吗 你：对 它当床用 朋友：太实用了
serves as.example: Friend: How is this sofa used for guests? You: Opens into a bed. Friend: It serves as? You: Right, it serves as a bed. Friend: So practical.

service charge.context: 你说下馆子结账时还要另付一笔服务费，朋友说这是规矩。
service charge.translation: 朋友：这顿饭咋比菜单上贵 你：还要加一笔服务费 朋友：是说那笔额外的费用吗 你：对 是那笔服务费 朋友：难怪贵
service charge.example: Friend: Why is the bill above the menu? You: Plus a service charge. Friend: That service charge? You: Right, it's the service charge. Friend: No wonder pricey.

serving utensil.context: 你说吃饭得用公筷，朋友说别用手直接抓菜。
serving utensil.translation: 朋友：夹菜用啥干净啊 你：用公筷 朋友：是说那个夹菜的工具吗 你：对 用公筷夹菜 朋友：卫生
serving utensil.example: Friend: What to serve food with? You: Serving chopsticks. Friend: That serving utensil? You: Right, use a serving utensil. Friend: Hygienic.

set apart.context: 你说他跟别人不一样的地方，就是做事特别认真，朋友说这点让他脱颖而出。
set apart.translation: 朋友：他跟别人比 强在哪 你：做事特别认真 朋友：是说他与众不同吗 你：对 他这点特别突出 朋友：脱颖而出
set apart.example: Friend: How is he different from others? You: So diligent. Friend: Setting him apart? You: Right, it sets him apart. Friend: Standing out.

set aside for.context: 你说这笔钱是专门留着交学费的，朋友说别挪作他用。
set aside for.translation: 朋友：这钱你存着干啥啊 别动它 你：专门留着交学费的 朋友：是说为某事留出来吗 你：对 这笔钱留着交学费 朋友：专款专用
set aside for.example: Friend: What's this money earmarked for? Don't touch. You: For tuition. Friend: Set aside for it? You: Right, set aside for tuition. Friend: Earmarked.

set deadline.context: 你说做项目得先定个最后期限，朋友说不然大家都拖着不做。
set deadline.translation: 朋友：这项目啥时候交啊 没个准数 你：得先定个截止日期 朋友：是说定个截止时间吗 你：对 先定个截止日期 朋友：大家才有动力
set deadline.example: Friend: When's the project due? No clear date. You: Set a deadline first. Friend: Set a deadline? You: Right, set a deadline first. Friend: Then people move.

set fire to.context: 你说他一时冲动把仓库点着了，朋友说这火闯大祸了。
set fire to.translation: 朋友：那仓库咋着火了 你：有人故意放的火 朋友：是说有人放火吗 你：对 有人故意纵火 朋友：太危险了
set fire to.example: Friend: How did the warehouse catch fire? You: Someone set it alight. Friend: Set fire to it? You: Right, someone set fire to it. Friend: So dangerous.

set foot in.context: 你说长这么大第一次出国，朋友说踏出第一步特别兴奋。
set foot in.translation: 朋友：你头一回去国外 啥感觉 你：又紧张又兴奋 朋友：是说第一次踏上吗 你：对 第一次踏上异国土地 朋友：好好玩
set foot in.example: Friend: How's your first trip abroad? You: Nervous and excited. Friend: Setting foot in? You: Right, first time setting foot abroad. Friend: Enjoy it.

set foot on.context: 你说他从小就没离开过老家那个村子，朋友说他都没踏出过远门。
set foot on.translation: 朋友：你出过远门吗 去过大城市没 你：没 一直待在村里 朋友：是说他没踏出过吗 你：对 他从没离开过村子 朋友：该出去看看
set foot on.example: Friend: Been far, to a big city? You: No, always in the village. Friend: Set foot outside? You: Right, he never set foot outside. Friend: Go see the world.

set in.context: 你说坏习惯久了就改不掉了，朋友说一旦养成特别难改。
set in.translation: 朋友：他熬夜的毛病 咋老改不了 你：坏习惯早就养成了 朋友：是说坏习惯形成了吗 你：对 熬夜的毛病根深蒂固 朋友：慢慢来
set in.example: Friend: Why can't he break the late nights? You: The habit set in. Friend: Set in? You: Right, it's set in. Friend: Take it slow.

set in motion.context: 你说一个好主意一传开，大家跟着干，朋友说事情就这么动起来了。
set in motion.translation: 朋友：这项目咋一下就跑起来了 你：好主意一传开就动起来了 朋友：是说让事情开始运转吗 你：对 让它运转起来 朋友：大家干劲足
set in motion.example: Friend: Why did the project suddenly take off? You: A good idea set it moving. Friend: Set in motion? You: Right, it's set in motion. Friend: Everyone's fired up.

set limits.context: 你说对孩子不能啥都顺着，朋友说立点规矩孩子才知道边界。
set limits.translation: 朋友：孩子太任性 咋管啊 你：给他立点规矩 朋友：是说给他设点界限吗 你：对 给他设点规矩 朋友：惯子如杀子
set limits.example: Friend: Kid's spoiled, how to handle? You: Set some limits. Friend: Set limits? You: Right, set some limits. Friend: Spoiling harms them.

set of muscles.context: 你说举哑铃练的是手臂那一块肌肉，朋友说坚持练胳膊就有力了。
set of muscles.translation: 朋友：举哑铃 练的是哪儿啊 你：练手臂那块肌肉 朋友：是说那一组肌肉吗 你：对 练那组肌肉 朋友：胳膊越来越有劲
set of muscles.example: Friend: What do dumbbells train? You: The arm muscles. Friend: That set of muscles? You: Right, that set of muscles. Friend: Arms get stronger.

set off for.context: 你说天没亮就出发赶早班机，朋友说得早起赶路。
set off for.translation: 朋友：你明天几点出发去机场 你：天没亮就走 朋友：是说动身出发吗 你：对 一早就动身去机场 朋友：别误了飞机
set off for.example: Friend: When leave for the airport tomorrow? You: Before dawn. Friend: Setting off for? You: Right, set off for the airport early. Friend: Don't miss the flight.

set out.context: 你说出发前他把计划写在纸上，朋友说一步一步照着走。
set out.translation: 朋友：他这趟旅行 都咋安排的 你：他把计划都列好了 朋友：是说把计划列出来吗 你：对 他把计划列出来了 朋友：有条有理
set out.example: Friend: How's he planned the trip? You: Wrote out the plan. Friend: Setting out a plan? You: Right, he set out the plan. Friend: So organised.

set sb up for.context: 你说他夸你几句你就干劲十足，朋友说别被人捧两句就飘了。
set sb up for.translation: 朋友：他咋一说你好 你就特有劲 你：被人一夸就来劲 朋友：是说被人捧得飘起来吗 你：对 别被捧得太高 朋友：踏实点
set sb up for.example: Friend: Why so fired up when praised? You: Compliments energise me. Friend: Setting you up for a fall? You: Right, don't let it set you up for a fall. Friend: Stay grounded.

set target.context: 你说这个季度得定个销售目标，朋友说有目标才有动力。
set target.translation: 朋友：这季度业绩咋定啊 你：先定个销售目标 朋友：是说定个目标吗 你：对 定个销售目标 朋友：大家才有方向
set target.example: Friend: How to set this quarter's sales? You: Set a sales target. Friend: Set a target? You: Right, set a target. Friend: Then there's direction.

set the course for.context: 你说领导给团队指了个方向，朋友说大家朝着目标往前走。
set the course for.translation: 朋友：领导这次指了条啥路 你：给咱们指了个方向 朋友：是说定下前进方向吗 你：对 定好前进方向 朋友：跟着走就行
set the course for.example: Friend: What direction did the boss set? You: Pointed us a way. Friend: Setting the course? You: Right, set the course ahead. Friend: Just follow.

set time.context: 你说每天固定几点锻炼，朋友说定时定点坚持才有效。
set time.translation: 朋友：你每天几点锻炼啊 你：固定晚饭后练 朋友：是说固定的时间吗 你：对 定个固定时间 朋友：坚持就有效
set time.example: Friend: When do you exercise daily? You: Fixed after dinner. Friend: A set time? You: Right, pick a set time. Friend: Stick with it.

set to.context: 你说这事儿准备好就随时能干，朋友说一到时机就动手。
set to.translation: 朋友：这活儿咱啥时候开始干 你：准备好就随时干 朋友：是说准备好就动手吗 你：对 准备好就动手 朋友：等信号
set to.example: Friend: When do we start the job? You: Whenever ready. Friend: Set to go? You: Right, we're set to go. Friend: Wait for the word.

set you back.context: 你说那部手机花了你两个月工资，朋友说买个这玩意儿真不便宜。
set you back.translation: 朋友：你那新手机 花了不少钱吧 你：花了我两个月工资 朋友：是说花了你多少钱吗 你：对 它花了我好多钱 朋友：奢侈
set you back.example: Friend: Did your new phone cost a lot? You: Two months' pay. Friend: Setting you back? You: Right, it set me back a lot. Friend: Luxurious.

set you back a small fortune.context: 你说办场婚礼花了不少钱，朋友说结个婚真是一笔大开销。
set you back a small fortune.translation: 朋友：办婚礼花了多少钱啊 你：花了一大笔 朋友：是说花了一大笔钱吗 你：对 花了一大笔钱 朋友：心疼吧
set you back a small fortune.example: Friend: How much was the wedding? You: A small fortune. Friend: Setting you back a small fortune? You: Right, it set me back a small fortune. Friend: Must hurt.

settle for.context: 你说买不到最满意的，朋友说差不多就行了，别太挑。
settle for.translation: 朋友：这衣服我咋挑都不满意 你：差不多就行了 朋友：是说将就一下吗 你：对 差不多就将就吧 朋友：别太挑剔
settle for.example: Friend: Can't find clothes I love. You: Good enough will do. Friend: Settle for it? You: Right, settle for it. Friend: Don't be too picky.

settle on.context: 你说挑来挑去最后选了蓝色那款，朋友说你就定它了。
settle on.translation: 朋友：最后你选哪款颜色啊 你：就选蓝色那款吧 朋友：是说最后选定了吗 你：对 我就选蓝色那款 朋友：定了就别后悔
settle on.example: Friend: Which colour in the end? You: The blue one. Friend: Settling on it? You: Right, I settled on the blue. Friend: No regrets once chosen.

settling for.context: 你说他老是将就着用便宜货，朋友说凑合久了也不是办法。
settling for.translation: 朋友：他为啥老买便宜的凑合用 你：他习惯将就了 朋友：是说他总将就吗 你：对 他老将就着用便宜货 朋友：该买好的了
settling for.example: Friend: Why always settling for cheap? You: He's used to settling. Friend: Settling for it? You: Right, he keeps settling for cheap. Friend: Time for better.

sewerage system.context: 你说城里的地下管道又老又乱，朋友说那排水系统该修了。
sewerage system.translation: 朋友：一下大雨 街道就积水 你：地下管道太老了 朋友：是说那套排水系统吗 你：对 是那套排水系统 朋友：早该修了
sewerage system.example: Friend: Why does the street flood when it rains? You: Old underground pipes. Friend: That sewerage system? You: Right, it's the sewerage system. Friend: Long overdue.

sex cell.context: 你说生物课上讲人是怎么传宗接代的，朋友说那就是繁殖用的细胞。
sex cell.translation: 朋友：生物课讲的那个 是啥细胞啊 你：就是繁殖用的那种 朋友：是说那个生殖细胞吗 你：对 是生殖细胞 朋友：生命真奇妙
sex cell.example: Friend: What cell did bio class cover? You: The reproductive kind. Friend: That sex cell? You: Right, it's a sex cell. Friend: Life is amazing.

sexual selection.context: 老师说动物为了抢配偶各显神通，朋友说这就是自然界的择偶竞争。
sexual selection.translation: 朋友：雄鸟为啥老开屏啊 你：为了吸引雌鸟 朋友：是说那种择偶的竞争吗 你：对 是自然的性选择 朋友：大自然真精彩
sexual selection.example: Friend: Why do male peacocks fan their tails? You: To attract females. Friend: That sexual selection? You: Right, it's sexual selection. Friend: Nature is fascinating.

shake in one's boots.context: 你说第一次上台演讲腿都发软，朋友说紧张得直发抖。
shake in one's boots.translation: 朋友：你头回上台 啥感觉啊 你：腿都吓软了 朋友：是说吓得发抖吗 你：对 我吓得直发抖 朋友：多上几次就好了
shake in one's boots.example: Friend: How was your first stage? You: Legs went weak. Friend: Shaking in your boots? You: Right, I shook in my boots. Friend: More times, easier.

shake one's booty.context: 朋友约你去跳舞，说音乐一响你就该扭起来，朋友说别害羞大胆扭。
shake one's booty.translation: 朋友：聚会跳舞 你咋老坐着 你：我不会跳 朋友：是说跟着音乐扭起来吗 你：对 大胆扭起来 朋友：放开点
shake one's booty.example: Friend: Why sit out the party dance? You: I can't dance. Friend: Shake your booty? You: Right, shake your booty. Friend: Let loose.

shallow breath.context: 你说做噩梦醒来，朋友说你当时呼吸又浅又急。
shallow breath.translation: 朋友：你做噩梦醒来 啥样啊 你：呼吸都变浅了 朋友：是说那种浅浅的呼吸吗 你：对 就是浅浅的呼吸 朋友：缓一缓就好
shallow breath.example: Friend: How were you after the nightmare? You: Shallow breathing. Friend: That shallow breath? You: Right, it was a shallow breath. Friend: Ease off.

shape into.context: 你说把黏土捏成各种小动物，朋友说捏得有模有样。
shape into.translation: 朋友：你拿这团泥 干啥呢 你：把它捏成小动物 朋友：是说把它捏成型吗 你：对 把它捏成小玩意儿 朋友：手真巧
shape into.example: Friend: What are you doing with the clay? You: Shaping it into animals. Friend: Shaping it into? You: Right, shape it into little animals. Friend: So skilful.

shared amusement.context: 你说和朋友一起看搞笑视频笑作一团，朋友说那种一起乐的感觉特别好。
shared amusement.translation: 朋友：你俩看啥呢 笑成这样 你：看搞笑视频 朋友：是说一起乐吗 你：对 大家一起乐 朋友：快乐加倍
shared amusement.example: Friend: What are you two laughing at? You: A funny video. Friend: Shared amusement? You: Right, it's shared amusement. Friend: Double the fun.

shared experience.context: 你说一起经历过难事，朋友说这种共同的经历让人特别铁。
shared experience.translation: 朋友：你俩关系咋这么铁 你：一块儿共过患难 朋友：是说一起经历过吗 你：对 有过共同经历 朋友：患难见真情
shared experience.example: Friend: Why are you two so close? You: Went through hard times together. Friend: A shared experience? You: Right, a shared experience. Friend: A friend in need.

shared experiences.context: 你说战友们一起扛过枪，朋友说那些共同的回忆特别珍贵。
shared experiences.translation: 朋友：战友聚会 咋那么激动 你：一起吃过苦 朋友：是说那些共同经历吗 你：对 都是共同的回忆 朋友：一辈子的兄弟
shared experiences.example: Friend: Why so moved at the reunion? You: Suffered together. Friend: Those shared experiences? You: Right, those shared experiences. Friend: Brothers for life.

shared identity.context: 你说一个地方的人有共同的口音，朋友说这就是他们共同的身份。
shared identity.translation: 朋友：同乡见面咋那么亲 你：都一个地方的 朋友：是说那种共同的身份吗 你：对 有共同的身份 朋友：老乡见老乡
shared identity.example: Friend: Why are fellow townsfolk so close? You: Same place. Friend: That shared identity? You: Right, a shared identity. Friend: Fellow townsfolk.

shared responsibility.context: 你说带孩子是夫妻俩的事，朋友说该一起担着，别一个人扛。
shared responsibility.translation: 朋友：带娃咋全是你一个人 你：该两个人一起担 朋友：是说共同承担责任吗 你：对 共同承担责任 朋友：别一个人扛
shared responsibility.example: Friend: Why is childcare all on you? You: Should share it. Friend: Shared responsibility? You: Right, it's shared responsibility. Friend: Don't carry it alone.

shared transport.context: 你说上班拼车既省钱又环保，朋友说这种一起坐车的方式挺好。
shared transport.translation: 朋友：你现在咋上班啊 还坐地铁吗 你：跟同事拼车去 朋友：是说一起搭车吗 你：对 是拼车出行 朋友：省钱又环保
shared transport.example: Friend: How do you commute now? Still subway? You: Carpool with colleagues. Friend: Shared transport? You: Right, it's shared transport. Friend: Cheap and green.

shared values.context: 你说一家人坐一起吃饭聊天，朋友说这种共享的感觉特别温暖。
shared values.translation: 朋友：你们一家人周末都干啥 你：一起吃饭聊天 朋友：是说那种共享的时光吗 你：对 共享一顿饭 朋友：家的味道
shared values.example: Friend: What does your family do weekends? You: Eat and chat together. Friend: Shared values? You: Right, we share a meal. Friend: Home flavour.

sharing economy.context: 你说现在出门打车、借东西都能共享，朋友说这种共享的模式特别方便。
sharing economy.translation: 朋友：现在借东西咋这么方便 你：都能共享着用 朋友：是说那种共享的模式吗 你：对 是共享经济 朋友：省了不少钱
sharing economy.example: Friend: Why is borrowing so easy now? You: Shared use. Friend: That sharing economy? You: Right, it's the sharing economy. Friend: Saves money.

sharp shock.context: 你说他突然被通知裁员，朋友说这打击来得太突然。
sharp shock.translation: 朋友：他昨天还好好的 今天咋就失业了 你：裁员通知太突然 朋友：是说那一下的打击吗 你：对 是个沉重打击 朋友：太突然了
sharp shock.example: Friend: Fine yesterday, why jobless today? You: Sudden layoff notice. Friend: That sharp shock? You: Right, it was a sharp shock. Friend: So sudden.

shave off.context: 你说理发师咔嚓几剪刀，朋友说一下就剪掉了一大截头发。
shave off.translation: 朋友：你这头发咋短了这么多 你：理发师一剪刀剪短了 朋友：是说剪掉一截吗 你：对 剪掉了一截头发 朋友：清爽多了
shave off.example: Friend: Why is your hair so short? You: The barber cut it. Friend: Shaved off? You: Right, shaved off a length. Friend: Much fresher.

shed light on.context: 你说这个新发现让大家搞懂了以前的谜团，朋友说这研究揭开了谜底。
shed light on.translation: 朋友：这个新发现 说明啥问题啊 你：把以前的谜团解开了 朋友：是说把谜团讲清楚吗 你：对 这研究揭开了谜底 朋友：长知识了
shed light on.example: Friend: What does this new discovery show? You: Solved an old mystery. Friend: Shedding light on it? You: Right, it sheds light on the mystery. Friend: Learned a lot.

shed tears.context: 你说听到那个坏消息，朋友说她当场就掉眼泪了。
shed tears.translation: 朋友：她听到那消息 啥反应啊 你：当场就哭了 朋友：是说她掉眼泪了吗 你：对 她当场落泪 朋友：太心疼了
shed tears.example: Friend: How did she react to the news? You: Cried on the spot. Friend: Shedding tears? You: Right, she shed tears. Friend: So sad.

shed weight.context: 你说坚持跑步三个月，朋友说你整整瘦了一圈。
shed weight.translation: 朋友：你最近咋瘦了这么多 你：坚持跑步三个月 朋友：是说减掉了体重吗 你：对 我瘦了一圈 朋友：真有毅力
shed weight.example: Friend: Why so much slimmer lately? You: Ran for three months. Friend: Shedding weight? You: Right, I shed weight. Friend: So disciplined.

shelf life.context: 你说牛奶放冰箱也有保质期，朋友说过了期就别喝了。
shelf life.translation: 朋友：这牛奶放多久就不能喝了 你：看包装上的保质期 朋友：是说它能放多久吗 你：对 看它的保质期 朋友：过期就扔
shelf life.example: Friend: How long is milk good for? You: Check the shelf life. Friend: That shelf life? You: Right, check the shelf life. Friend: Toss it expired.

shell out.context: 你说买个包花了好几千，朋友说为这玩意儿花这么多钱真舍得。
shell out.translation: 朋友：你这包多少钱买的 你：花了好几千 朋友：是说花一大笔钱吗 你：对 我花了一大笔钱 朋友：真舍得
shell out.example: Friend: How much was this bag? You: Several thousand. Friend: Shelling out? You: Right, I shelled out a lot. Friend: So lavish.

shift away.context: 你说大家渐渐不用现金了，朋友说付钱方式在慢慢改变。
shift away.translation: 朋友：现在咋没人用现金了 你：都用手机付了 朋友：是说慢慢转变方式吗 你：对 支付方式在转变 朋友：越来越方便
shift away.example: Friend: Why does nobody use cash now? You: Everyone pays by phone. Friend: Shifting away? You: Right, shifting away from cash. Friend: More convenient.

shift from.context: 你说他的兴趣从打球转到看书了，朋友说人长大了爱好会变。
shift from.translation: 朋友：你以前爱打球 现在咋爱看书了 你：兴趣慢慢变了 朋友：是说从打球转到看书吗 你：对 我兴趣转移了 朋友：人各阶段不同
shift from.example: Friend: Used to love ball games, why reading now? You: Interests shifted. Friend: Shifting from it? You: Right, I shifted from ball games. Friend: Stages of life.

shift one's attention.context: 你说开会时别老盯着手机，朋友说把注意力放回到发言的人身上。
shift one's attention.translation: 朋友：开会你咋老看手机 不认真听 你：我把注意力收回来 朋友：是说把注意力转回来吗 你：对 把注意力放回来 朋友：认真听
shift one's attention.example: Friend: Why check your phone in the meeting? You: I'll refocus. Friend: Shifting attention back? You: Right, shift attention back. Friend: Listen up.

shift pattern.context: 你说厂里工人三班倒，朋友说这种轮班制没个准点休息。
shift pattern.translation: 朋友：你上班 一天都干啥啊 倒班吗 你：三班倒 轮着来 朋友：是说那种轮班安排吗 你：对 是轮班制 朋友：休息不规律
shift pattern.example: Friend: What's your shift like? You: Three shifts, rotating. Friend: That shift pattern? You: Right, it's the shift pattern. Friend: Irregular rest.

shift shopping habits.context: 你说现在年轻人爱网购不爱逛街，朋友说购物习惯变了。
shift shopping habits.translation: 朋友：现在咋没人爱逛商场了 你：都改网上买了 朋友：是说购物方式变了吗 你：对 购物习惯变了 朋友：实体店难了
shift shopping habits.example: Friend: Why does nobody shop at malls? You: Switched to online. Friend: Shifting shopping habits? You: Right, shopping habits shifted. Friend: Malls struggle.

shine through.context: 你说他虽然话不多，但眼神里透着真诚，朋友说那份善良藏不住。
shine through.translation: 朋友：他话不多 人真的好吗 你：他的真诚藏不住 朋友：是说他的好品质露出来吗 你：对 他的善良自然流露 朋友：日久见人心
shine through.example: Friend: Quiet, is he really good? You: His sincerity shows. Friend: Shining through? You: Right, it shines through. Friend: Time tells.

shipping container.context: 你说海边堆满了那种大铁箱子，朋友说那是装货用的集装箱。
shipping container.translation: 朋友：海边那些大铁箱子 干啥用的 你：装货用的集装箱 朋友：就是那个运货的箱子吗 你：对 是集装箱 朋友：货运靠它
shipping container.example: Friend: What are those big metal boxes? You: Cargo containers. Friend: That shipping container? You: Right, it's a shipping container. Friend: Carried by ships.

shipping industry.context: 你说中国出口货物靠海运，朋友说那就是庞大的航运业。
shipping industry.translation: 朋友：咱们的货 都咋运出国啊 你：靠海运 量大 朋友：是说那个海运的行业吗 你：对 是航运业 朋友：运量大
shipping industry.example: Friend: How are our goods shipped abroad? You: By sea, in bulk. Friend: That shipping industry? You: Right, it's the shipping industry. Friend: Huge volume.

shock value.context: 你说有些广告故意做得很夸张，朋友说就为博人眼球，不管好不好看。
shock value.translation: 朋友：那广告咋这么奇怪 故意吓人 你：就为博人注意 朋友：是说故意制造话题吗 你：对 就是为了博眼球 朋友：噱头而已
shock value.example: Friend: Why is that ad so weird, shocking? You: To grab attention. Friend: That shock value? You: Right, it's for shock value. Friend: Just a gimmick.

shoestring budget.context: 你说刚毕业钱少，朋友说靠着一点点预算也能把日子过好。
shoestring budget.translation: 朋友：你刚上班 钱够花吗 你：靠一点点预算 凑合过 朋友：是说那点有限的钱吗 你：对 靠一点点预算 朋友：慢慢会好
shoestring budget.example: Friend: Can you live on a starting salary? You: On a shoestring. Friend: That shoestring budget? You: Right, on a shoestring budget. Friend: It'll improve.

shoot off.context: 你说饭局没吃完他就先走了，朋友说他急着赶下一场。
shoot off.translation: 朋友：他咋饭没吃完就走了 你：急着赶下一场 朋友：是说他匆匆走了吗 你：对 他匆匆走了 朋友：忙人
shoot off.example: Friend: Why did he leave before the meal? You: Rushed off. Friend: Shopping off? You: Right, he shot off. Friend: A busy man.

shoot up.context: 你说这两年房价涨得飞快，朋友说一下就蹿上去了。
shoot up.translation: 朋友：这房价咋涨这么猛 你：一下就蹿上去了 朋友：是说价格猛涨吗 你：对 房价一下涨上去 朋友：买不起了
shoot up.example: Friend: Why did house prices surge? You: Shot up. Friend: Shooting up? You: Right, prices shot up. Friend: Can't afford.

shop around.context: 你说买保险得多比几家，朋友说这样才能买到划算的。
shop around.translation: 朋友：你买保险 咋选的啊 你：多对比几家再说 朋友：是说多逛几家比较吗 你：对 多逛几家对比 朋友：不吃亏
shop around.example: Friend: How did you pick the insurance? You: Compared a few. Friend: Shopping around? You: Right, I shopped around. Friend: No loss.

shop floor.context: 你说工厂里工人都在车间忙，朋友说那就是干活的地方。
shop floor.translation: 朋友：工人都在哪儿干活啊 你：都在车间里 朋友：是说那个干活的车间吗 你：对 在车间干活 朋友：辛苦
shop floor.example: Friend: Where do the workers work? You: On the shop floor. Friend: That shop floor? You: Right, on the shop floor. Friend: Hard work.

shop list.context: 你说出门前对着单子买东西，朋友说照着清单买就不会漏。
shop list.translation: 朋友：你超市买东西 咋不漏这漏那 你：我列了个购物单 朋友：是说那张购物单子吗 你：对 我有购物清单 朋友：照着买就行
shop list.example: Friend: Why don't you forget things shopping? You: I made a list. Friend: That shopping list? You: Right, a shopping list. Friend: Just follow it.

shopping impulse.context: 你说逛着逛着就多买了没用的，朋友说那是一时冲动下的单。
shopping impulse.translation: 朋友：你这买的一堆 啥时候想要的 你：逛着逛着一时兴起 朋友：是说一时冲动买的吗 你：对 是一时冲动买的 朋友：别乱花钱
shopping impulse.example: Friend: When did you want all this? You: On impulse while browsing. Friend: That shopping impulse? You: Right, it was a shopping impulse. Friend: Don't splurge.

shopping lists.context: 你说一家人各列各的单子，朋友说凑一起照着买就行。
shopping lists.translation: 朋友：周末采购 都买些啥啊 你：每人列张单子 朋友：是说那些购物清单吗 你：对 照着购物清单买 朋友：不会买重
shopping lists.example: Friend: What to buy this weekend? You: Everyone makes a list. Friend: Those shopping lists? You: Right, use the shopping lists. Friend: No duplicates.

shopping malls.context: 你说周末最爱跟朋友去大商场逛，朋友说那种地方啥都有。
shopping malls.translation: 朋友：周末你都去哪儿逛啊 你：去那些大商场 朋友：就是那种大购物中心吗 你：对 逛大商场 朋友：吃喝玩乐都齐
shopping malls.example: Friend: Where do you shop weekends? You: The big malls. Friend: Those shopping malls? You: Right, the shopping malls. Friend: Food and fun all there.

short attention span.context: 你说他看书翻两页就走神，朋友说那是注意力集中不了多久。
short attention span.translation: 朋友：他咋看书看两页就玩 你：他注意力老跑 朋友：是说注意力集中时间短吗 你：对 他注意力时间短 朋友：坐不住
short attention span.example: Friend: Why does he read two pages then play? You: His mind wanders. Friend: That short attention span? You: Right, a short attention span. Friend: Can't sit still.

short term memory.context: 你说他刚说过的话转头就忘，朋友说那就是记性不好。
short term memory.translation: 朋友：他咋老忘事 刚说的就不记得 你：他记性不好 朋友：是说那种短期记忆差吗 你：对 他短期记忆差 朋友：得拿笔记
short term memory.example: Friend: Why forget things just said? You: His memory's bad. Friend: That short term memory? You: Right, poor short term memory. Friend: Take notes.

short-form content.context: 你说现在大家都爱刷十几秒的短视频，朋友说那种短短小视频特别上头。
short-form content.translation: 朋友：你咋一刷手机就刷半天 你：看那种短短小视频 朋友：就是那种很短的视频吗 你：对 是短视频 朋友：越刷越停不下来
short-form content.example: Friend: Why scroll for hours? You: Watching short videos. Friend: That short-form content? You: Right, it's short-form content. Friend: Can't stop.

short-haul trip.context: 你说周末就去周边玩两天，朋友说别跑远，短途游最轻松。
short-haul trip.translation: 朋友：周末想出去玩 去哪儿好 你：去周边 一两天就行 朋友：是说那种短途旅行吗 你：对 来个短途游 朋友：不累
short-haul trip.example: Friend: Want a trip this weekend, where? You: Nearby, a day or two. Friend: That short-haul trip? You: Right, a short-haul trip. Friend: No exhaustion.

short-term memory.context: 你说他年纪轻轻就老忘事，朋友说那是短期记忆出了问题。
short-term memory.translation: 朋友：他咋刚放的东西就找不到 你：他短期记忆不好 朋友：是说那种短期记忆吗 你：对 他短期记忆差 朋友：该去看看
short-term memory.example: Friend: Why can't he find things he just put? You: His short-term memory's bad. Friend: That short-term memory? You: Right, poor short-term memory. Friend: Get checked.

shortage of.context: 你说灾区最缺的就是干净的水和食物，朋友说物资紧缺。
shortage of.translation: 朋友：灾区现在最缺啥啊 你：干净的水和吃的 朋友：是说物资不够吗 你：对 物资紧缺 朋友：赶紧支援
shortage of.example: Friend: What's most needed in the disaster zone? You: Clean water and food. Friend: A shortage of it? You: Right, a shortage of supplies. Friend: Send aid.

shorten daytime.context: 你说冬天天黑得早，朋友说白天一下就变短了。
shorten daytime.translation: 朋友：冬天咋下午四点就黑了 你：白天变短了 朋友：是说白天时间变短吗 你：对 白天变短了 朋友：注意保暖
shorten daytime.example: Friend: Why dark at four in winter? You: Short days. Friend: Shortening daytime? You: Right, shortening daytime. Friend: Keep warm.

shortly after.context: 你说他刚走没几分钟，朋友说你这时候打电话他肯定不在。
shortly after.translation: 朋友：他刚走 我现在找他行吗 你：他走没一会儿 朋友：是说刚过没多久吗 你：对 他刚走没一会儿 朋友：等会儿再打
shortly after.example: Friend: He just left, can I call now? You: He left moments ago. Friend: Shortly after? You: Right, shortly after he left. Friend: Call later.

shoulder to cry on.context: 你说受委屈时就想找个能说说心里话的人，朋友说那种可以依靠的肩膀最难得。
shoulder to cry on.translation: 朋友：你难过的时候都找谁啊 你：找能说心里话的人 朋友：是说可以依靠的人吗 你：对 找个可以倾诉的人 朋友：有个依靠真好
shoulder to cry on.example: Friend: Who do you turn to when sad? You: Someone to talk to. Friend: A shoulder to cry on? You: Right, a shoulder to cry on. Friend: Nice to have support.

shoulders to cry on.context: 你说难过得时候朋友都在身边陪你，朋友说这种时候有人陪最暖。
shoulders to cry on.translation: 朋友：你难过那阵 谁在你身边啊 你：朋友们都陪着我 朋友：是说有依靠的人吗 你：对 有人可以依靠 朋友：太暖了
shoulders to cry on.example: Friend: Who was there when you were down? You: Friends all around. Friend: Shoulders to cry on? You: Right, shoulders to cry on. Friend: So warm.

shout out.context: 你说演讲完当众夸了一个人，朋友说大方表扬让人舒服。
shout out.translation: 朋友：你在台上 特意提了谁啊 你：夸了那个努力的同事 朋友：是说当众点名表扬吗 你：对 我当众表扬了他 朋友：他肯定开心
shout out.example: Friend: Who did you mention on stage? You: Praised the hardworking colleague. Friend: Shouting out? You: Right, I shouted him out. Friend: He must be happy.

show off talents.context: 你说晚会上他大方露了一手才艺，朋友说有本事就该展示出来。
show off talents.translation: 朋友：晚会上他表演的那手 真绝 你：他有本事就爱展示 朋友：是说展示他的才艺吗 你：对 他大方展示才艺 朋友：深藏不露
show off talents.example: Friend: His party act was amazing. You: He loves showing his talent. Friend: Showing off talents? You: Right, he shows off his talents. Friend: Hidden talent.

showcase talent.context: 你说公司年会给新人一个展示的舞台，朋友说有才华就该露出来。
showcase talent.translation: 朋友：年会上新人都表演啥啊 你：有才华的都上台秀 朋友：是说展示才华吗 你：对 给他们舞台展示才华 朋友：藏龙卧虎
showcase talent.example: Friend: What do newcomers do at the gala? You: Talented ones perform. Friend: Showcasing talent? You: Right, showcasing talent. Friend: Hidden gems.

shrinking violet.context: 你说他开会从来不发言，朋友说他害羞得像躲在角落的小花。
shrinking violet.translation: 朋友：他咋开会老不说话 缩在角落 你：他特别害羞 朋友：是说他很害羞不敢出头吗 你：对 他太害羞了 朋友：多鼓励
shrinking violet.example: Friend: Why so quiet in meetings, cornered? You: He's shy. Friend: A shrinking violet? You: Right, he's a shrinking violet. Friend: Encourage him.

shrinking violets.context: 你说那些害羞的姑娘们不敢举手，朋友说胆小得像躲起来的小花。
shrinking violets.translation: 朋友：那几个姑娘 咋不敢举手发言 你：她们都挺害羞的 朋友：是说她们很害羞吗 你：对 她们都很害羞 朋友：别紧张
shrinking violets.example: Friend: Why won't those girls raise hands? You: They're shy. Friend: Shrinking violets? You: Right, they're shrinking violets. Friend: Don't be nervous.

shrub land.context: 你说郊外那片长满矮树的荒地，朋友说那是灌木丛生的地方。
shrub land.translation: 朋友：郊外那片荒地 长的啥啊 你：全是矮树野草 朋友：是说那片灌木地吗 你：对 是片灌木丛 朋友：野趣十足
shrub land.example: Friend: What grows on that wild land? You: Bushes and weeds. Friend: That shrub land? You: Right, it's shrub land. Friend: So wild.

shut down.context: 你说工厂因为事故暂时停产了，朋友说得查清原因再开。
shut down.translation: 朋友：那工厂咋突然停了 你：出事故 暂时关了 朋友：是说停工关门吗 你：对 工厂暂时关了 朋友：等修好再开
shut down.example: Friend: Why did the plant suddenly stop? You: An accident, shut down. Friend: Shut down? You: Right, it's shut down. Friend: Reopen once fixed.

shut up.context: 你说吵架时他让你闭嘴别吵，朋友说这种话太伤人了。
shut up.translation: 朋友：吵架时他说啥了 你：他让我闭嘴别吵 朋友：是叫人别说话吗 你：对 他让我闭嘴 朋友：话太重了
shut up.example: Friend: What did he say in the fight? You: He told me to shut up. Friend: Telling you to shut up? You: Right, he told me to shut up. Friend: Too harsh.

shy away from.context: 你说他不敢在公开场合发言，朋友说他就是怕丢脸不敢尝试。
shy away from.translation: 朋友：他咋老不敢当众说话 你：他怕出丑 不敢试 朋友：是说他不敢做吗 你：对 他不敢当众说话 朋友：多练练就好
shy away from.example: Friend: Why won't he speak publicly? You: He's scared, won't try. Friend: Shying away from it? You: Right, he shies away from it. Friend: Practise more.

side effect.context: 你说吃这药犯困，朋友说那是它的副作用，过几天就适应了。
side effect.translation: 朋友：吃这药 咋老犯困啊 你：是药的副作用 朋友：是说药的不良反应吗 你：对 是药物副作用 朋友：过几天就好
side effect.example: Friend: Why sleepy on this medicine? You: It's a side effect. Friend: That side effect? You: Right, it's a side effect. Friend: Settles in days.

side hustle.context: 你说下班还接私活干，朋友说搞点副业多挣点钱挺好。
side hustle.translation: 朋友：你下班还忙啥呢 不歇着 你：接点私活 多挣点 朋友：是说那额外的活儿吗 你：对 我搞点副业 朋友：真能干
side hustle.example: Friend: Why busy after work? You: Taking side jobs. Friend: That side hustle? You: Right, a side hustle. Friend: So capable.

side walk.context: 你说走路别玩手机，朋友说走人行道最安全。
side walk.translation: 朋友：走路咋玩手机 小心车 你：我走人行道上 朋友：是说走那个人行道吗 你：对 走人行道 朋友：别分心
side walk.example: Friend: Why phone while walking, watch cars? You: I'm on the sidewalk. Friend: That sidewalk? You: Right, on the sidewalk. Friend: Don't get distracted.

sift through.context: 你说翻了半天资料才找到要的，朋友说一大堆里慢慢筛。
sift through.translation: 朋友：你找那资料 找着没 你：翻了半天才找到 朋友：是说从一大堆里筛吗 你：对 我从里面筛半天 朋友：慢慢找
sift through.example: Friend: Found that document? You: Dug ages. Friend: Sifting through it? You: Right, I sifted through it. Friend: Search slowly.

sightsee and experience.context: 你说出去玩不光看风景，朋友说还得亲身感受当地的生活。
sightsee and experience.translation: 朋友：旅游你都咋玩啊 就看景吗 你：不光看景 还体验生活 朋友：是说去体验吗 你：对 边逛边体验 朋友：这样才尽兴
sightsee and experience.example: Friend: How do you travel, just sights? You: More than sights, experience life. Friend: To sightsee and experience? You: Right, sightsee and experience. Friend: Then it's full.

sightseeing excursion.context: 你说报个一日游团，朋友说跟着团逛景点省心。
sightseeing excursion.translation: 朋友：到了新城市 咋逛景点啊 你：报个一日游的团 朋友：是说那种短途游览吗 你：对 报个游览团 朋友：省心
sightseeing excursion.example: Friend: How to tour a new city? You: A day tour. Friend: That sightseeing excursion? You: Right, a sightseeing excursion. Friend: Carefree.

sightseeing experience.context: 你说这趟出门玩得特别开心，朋友说那种见闻满满的感觉最难忘。
sightseeing experience.translation: 朋友：你这趟旅行 玩得咋样 你：特别开心 见识了不少 朋友：是说那种旅行的经历吗 你：对 是段难忘的旅行经历 朋友：值了
sightseeing experience.example: Friend: How was the trip? You: Great, saw a lot. Friend: That sightseeing experience? You: Right, a sightseeing experience. Friend: Worth it.

sightseeing spot.context: 你说这个地方游客最爱打卡，朋友说那是个有名的景点。
sightseeing spot.translation: 朋友：这附近有啥必去的地方吗 你：有个有名的景点 朋友：就是那个有名的景点吗 你：对 是个打卡景点 朋友：去看看
sightseeing spot.example: Friend: Any must-see nearby? You: A famous spot. Friend: That sightseeing spot? You: Right, it's a sightseeing spot. Friend: Go see.

sightseeing tour.context: 你说来北京就报个游览团，朋友说跟着导游逛最省心。
sightseeing tour.translation: 朋友：来北京咋逛景点好啊 你：报个游览团跟着走 朋友：是说那种跟团游览吗 你：对 报个游览团 朋友：省得自己查
sightseeing tour.example: Friend: How to see Beijing's sights? You: On a guided tour. Friend: That sightseeing tour? You: Right, a sightseeing tour. Friend: No need to plan.

sign up.context: 你说想上那个网课，朋友说先在网上报名就行。
sign up.translation: 朋友：那门网课 咋报啊 你：网上注册一下就行 朋友：是说在网上报名吗 你：对 网上报名注册 朋友：挺方便
sign up.example: Friend: How to sign up for that course? You: Register online. Friend: Sign up? You: Right, sign up online. Friend: Convenient.

significant heating.context: 你说这天气晒着暖烘烘的，朋友说一晒身上就明显发热。
significant heating.translation: 朋友：今天太阳晒着真舒服 你：身上都晒热了 朋友：是说身上明显发热吗 你：对 晒得明显发热 朋友：暖洋洋
significant heating.example: Friend: The sun feels lovely today. You: Body's warming up. Friend: Significant heating? You: Right, there's significant heating. Friend: Toasty.

significant other.context: 你说过年带对象回家见父母，朋友说那就是你的另一半了。
significant other.translation: 朋友：你过年带谁回家啊 你：带我对象见见爸妈 朋友：是说你的另一半吗 你：对 是我的另一半 朋友：好事将近
significant other.example: Friend: Who are you bringing home? You: My partner to meet parents. Friend: That significant other? You: Right, my significant other. Friend: Wedding bells.

silent peace.context: 你说两人静静坐在一起不说话，朋友说那种安宁特别难得。
silent peace.translation: 朋友：你俩坐那儿不说话 不尴尬吗 你：安静待着 特别舒服 朋友：是说那种安静吗 你：对 是那份安宁 朋友：岁月静好
silent peace.example: Friend: Not talking, isn't it awkward? You: Quiet time is comfy. Friend: That silent peace? You: Right, a silent peace. Friend: Peaceful.

silicon valley.context: 你说好多大公司都在那边，朋友说那就是有名的科技谷。
silicon valley.translation: 朋友：那边咋那么多科技公司 你：都扎堆在科技谷 朋友：就是那个有名的硅谷吗 你：对 是硅谷 朋友：高科技人才多
silicon valley.example: Friend: Why so many tech firms there? You: They cluster in the valley. Friend: That silicon valley? You: Right, it's silicon valley. Friend: Lots of talent.

silver fox.context: 你说那位头发花白的大叔特别有魅力，朋友说那种成熟的帅最迷人。
silver fox.translation: 朋友：那位大叔 咋那么有气质 你：头发花白 特有魅力 朋友：是说那种成熟的帅大叔吗 你：对 是个魅力大叔 朋友：越老越有味道
silver fox.example: Friend: Why does that man have such charm? You: Grey hair, charismatic. Friend: That silver fox? You: Right, he's a silver fox. Friend: More charm with age.

simply put.context: 你说这事儿说白了就一句话，朋友说简单讲就是这么个理。
simply put.translation: 朋友：这事儿我还是没绕明白 你：说白了 就很简单 朋友：是说简单讲吗 你：对 简单讲就是这样 朋友：听懂了
simply put.example: Friend: Still don't get this. You: Simply put, it's easy. Friend: Simply put? You: Right, simply put, it's like this. Friend: Got it.

since the turn of the millennium.context: 你说从新千年开始，手机一下就普及了，朋友说那以后变化特别快。
since the turn of the millennium.translation: 朋友：手机啥时候开始普及的 你：新千年那会儿 朋友：是说新千年以来吗 你：对 从新千年开始 朋友：时代变化真快
since the turn of the millennium.example: Friend: When did phones take off? You: Around the millennium. Friend: Since the millennium? You: Right, since the turn of the millennium. Friend: Times change fast.

sincere praise.context: 你说他真心夸你做得好，朋友说那种真诚的表扬最让人开心。
sincere praise.translation: 朋友：他咋夸你的啊 你：说我做得真好 朋友：是说那种真诚的夸奖吗 你：对 是真诚的表扬 朋友：听着就舒服
sincere praise.example: Friend: How did he praise you? You: Said I did great. Friend: That sincere praise? You: Right, sincere praise. Friend: Heartwarming.

sing along.context: 你说演唱会大家都跟着一起哼，朋友说全场一起唱真带劲。
sing along.translation: 朋友：演唱会上 大家都干啥啊 你：跟着歌手一起唱 朋友：是说跟着一起唱吗 你：对 大家一起跟着唱 朋友：气氛好
sing along.example: Friend: What does everyone do at the concert? You: Sing along. Friend: Sing along? You: Right, everyone sings along. Friend: Great vibe.

sing along to.context: 你说洗澡时你爱跟着歌哼，朋友说大声唱出来更爽。
sing along to.translation: 朋友：你洗澡时都哼啥歌啊 你：跟着流行歌一起唱 朋友：是说跟着歌一起唱吗 你：对 跟着歌一起唱 朋友：开心就好
sing along to.example: Friend: What do you sing in the shower? You: Along to pop songs. Friend: Sing along to them? You: Right, sing along to the songs. Friend: Happy is best.

sing the praises of.context: 你说大家都夸那个餐厅味道好，朋友说人人都夸它就出名了。
sing the praises of.translation: 朋友：那家餐厅 大家评价咋样 你：人人都夸它好吃 朋友：是说大家都夸它吗 你：对 大家都夸它 朋友：口碑好
sing the praises of.example: Friend: What do people say about that restaurant? You: Everyone raves. Friend: Singing the praises of it? You: Right, singing the praises of it. Friend: Great reviews.

singing the praises of.context: 你说全城人都夸那部电影好看，朋友说大家都在夸它。
singing the praises of.translation: 朋友：那部电影 真那么好看吗 你：全城人都夸它 朋友：是说大家都在夸它吗 你：对 大家都在夸那部电影 朋友：我也去看
singing the praises of.example: Friend: Is that film really that good? You: The city raves about it. Friend: Singing the praises of it? You: Right, singing the praises of it. Friend: I'll watch it too.

single out.context: 你说老师单独表扬了一个学生，朋友说那孩子这下可骄傲了。
single out.translation: 朋友：老师咋单独点了一个人的名 你：夸他作业写得好 朋友：是说单独挑出一个人吗 你：对 老师单独表扬了他 朋友：该奖励
single out.example: Friend: Why did the teacher single one out? You: Praised his homework. Friend: Singling him out? You: Right, singled him out. Friend: Reward him.

single-use plastic.context: 你说现在饭店都用一次性塑料饭盒，朋友说这种用一次就扔的不环保。
single-use plastic.translation: 朋友：外卖咋都用那种塑料盒 你：用一次就扔 不环保 朋友：是说那种一次性的塑料吗 你：对 是一次性塑料 朋友：该少用
single-use plastic.example: Friend: Why do takeaways use plastic boxes? You: Used once, wasteful. Friend: That single-use plastic? You: Right, it's single-use plastic. Friend: Should cut down.

single-use wrapping.context: 你说现在奶茶都用一层薄塑料袋包着，朋友说这种一次性包装太浪费。
single-use wrapping.translation: 朋友：奶茶外面那层薄皮 干啥用的 你：包一下 拿着手不烫 朋友：是说那种一次性的包装吗 你：对 是一次性包装 朋友：浪费材料
single-use wrapping.example: Friend: What's that thin wrap on the milk tea? You: To stop burns. Friend: That single-use wrapping? You: Right, it's single-use wrapping. Friend: Wasteful.

sink into.context: 你说累了一天往沙发里一瘫，朋友说整个人陷进去特别放松。
sink into.translation: 朋友：下班你咋往沙发上一躺 不动了 你：累坏了 瘫进去 朋友：是说陷进去放松吗 你：对 我瘫进沙发里 朋友：好好歇歇
sink into.example: Friend: Why flop on the sofa after work? You: Exhausted, sink in. Friend: Sinking into it? You: Right, I sink into the sofa. Friend: Rest well.

sinking feeling.context: 你说等电梯时心里突然一沉，朋友说有种不祥的预感。
sinking feeling.translation: 朋友：你刚才站那儿 脸色咋变了 你：心里突然一沉 朋友：是说那种不祥的感觉吗 你：对 有种不祥的预感 朋友：别多想
sinking feeling.example: Friend: Why did your face change? You: A sinking feeling. Friend: That sinking feeling? You: Right, a sinking feeling. Friend: Don't overthink.

sit at.context: 你说大家围坐在长桌旁吃饭，朋友说一排人坐得满满的。
sit at.translation: 朋友：聚餐 都坐哪儿啊 你：围坐在长桌旁 朋友：是说围坐在桌边吗 你：对 围坐在桌边 朋友：热闹
sit at.example: Friend: Where do you sit for the meal? You: Around the long table. Friend: Sitting at? You: Right, sitting at the table. Friend: Lively.

sit out.context: 你说那天下雨球赛只好不参加，朋友说改天再踢。
sit out.translation: 朋友：今天下雨 球赛还踢不踢 你：只好不踢了 改天 朋友：是说这次就不参加了吗 你：对 这次就先不踢 朋友：等天晴
sit out.example: Friend: With the rain, play the match? You: Sit it out, another day. Friend: Sitting it out? You: Right, sit it out. Friend: Wait for sun.

sit up.context: 你说熬夜工作后第二天早上得喝杯咖啡，朋友说靠它提神才能坐直。
sit up.translation: 朋友：你今早咋喝两杯咖啡 你：熬夜了 得提神 朋友：是说坐起来提神吗 你：对 喝杯咖啡提提神 朋友：别老熬夜
sit up.example: Friend: Why two coffees this morning? You: Stayed up, need a pick-me-up. Friend: Sitting up alert? You: Right, sit up with coffee. Friend: Don't stay up late.

site degradation.context: 你说游客乱扔垃圾把古迹都弄脏了，朋友说这种破坏得赶紧治理。
site degradation.translation: 朋友：那古迹咋看着脏兮兮的 你：游客乱扔垃圾 弄脏的 朋友：是说古迹被破坏吗 你：对 是古迹退化 朋友：得保护
site degradation.example: Friend: Why is the site so dirty? You: Littering by tourists. Friend: That site degradation? You: Right, it's site degradation. Friend: Protect it.

size up.context: 你说进店里先打量一下东西贵不贵，朋友说摸个底再决定买不买。
size up.translation: 朋友：你进店先干啥啊 转一圈 你：先看看东西咋样 朋友：是说先掂量一下吗 你：对 先掂量一下 朋友：心里有个数
size up.example: Friend: First thing in a shop, look around? You: Check the goods. Friend: Sizing it up? You: Right, size it up first. Friend: Know what you're after.

skill at.context: 你说他特别擅长跟人打交道，朋友说这种本事不是谁都有。
skill at.translation: 朋友：他谈业务 咋这么厉害 你：他特别会沟通 朋友：是说他擅长这个吗 你：对 他擅长沟通 朋友：天生的
skill at.example: Friend: Why's he so good at deals? You: Great communicator. Friend: Skill at it? You: Right, he has a skill at it. Friend: Natural.

skilled labour.context: 你说工厂缺会技术的工人，朋友说这种有手艺的工人特别抢手。
skilled labour.translation: 朋友：工厂现在最缺啥人啊 你：缺会技术的工人 朋友：是说那种有手艺的工人吗 你：对 缺熟练技工 朋友：工资高
skilled labour.example: Friend: What does the factory lack? You: Skilled workers. Friend: That skilled labour? You: Right, it's skilled labour. Friend: Well paid.

skills shortage.context: 你说现在好多岗位没人干，朋友说缺人的问题特别严重。
skills shortage.translation: 朋友：公司招人 咋这么难啊 你：缺人 招不到 朋友：是说人手不够吗 你：对 是人手短缺 朋友：加薪招人
skills shortage.example: Friend: Why is hiring so hard? You: Short of people. Friend: That skills shortage? You: Right, it's a skills shortage. Friend: Raise pay to recruit.

skin infection.context: 你说胳膊上破了块皮老不好，朋友说怕是皮肤感染了，赶紧看看。
skin infection.translation: 朋友：我胳膊破了块皮 老不好 你：可能感染了 朋友：是说皮肤感染了吗 你：对 怕是皮肤感染 朋友：赶紧去看看
skin infection.example: Friend: My arm wound won't heal. You: Might be infected. Friend: A skin infection? You: Right, it's a skin infection. Friend: Go see a doctor.

skin temperature.context: 你说测体温时别只测外面，朋友说皮肤温度和体内不一样。
skin temperature.translation: 朋友：发烧了 咋测体温准啊 你：别只测皮肤表面 朋友：是说皮肤的温度吗 你：对 皮肤温度不准 朋友：量口腔更准
skin temperature.example: Friend: How to take a fever accurately? You: Don't just measure skin. Friend: That skin temperature? You: Right, skin temperature. Friend: Oral is better.

skincare routine.context: 你说每天早晚认真洗脸涂护肤霜，朋友说坚持下来皮肤就好。
skincare routine.translation: 朋友：你皮肤咋这么好 咋保养的 你：每天早晚认真护肤 朋友：是说那套护肤步骤吗 你：对 坚持护肤流程 朋友：真自律
skincare routine.example: Friend: Why is your skin so good? You: Skincare every morning and night. Friend: That skincare routine? You: Right, a skincare routine. Friend: So disciplined.

skip a beat.context: 你说听到好消息那一刻心跳都停了一下，朋友说惊喜得没反应过来。
skip a beat.translation: 朋友：你听到那消息 啥反应 你：愣了一下 心跳都停了 朋友：是说心跳漏一拍吗 你：对 心跳都漏了一拍 朋友：太惊喜了
skip a beat.example: Friend: How did you react to the news? You: Freezed, heart skipped. Friend: Skipped a beat? You: Right, my heart skipped a beat. Friend: So thrilled.

skip over.context: 你说讲课时别在那个细节上多纠缠，朋友说跳过它讲重点。
skip over.translation: 朋友：这部分知识点 讲细点不 你：别在这儿磨蹭 跳过 朋友：是说略过不讲吗 你：对 这部分略过去 朋友：讲重点
skip over.example: Friend: Explain this part in detail? You: Don't dwell, skip it. Friend: Skipping over it? You: Right, skip over it. Friend: Focus on key points.

skip shopping.context: 你说这周太忙，朋友说那就干脆别去逛超市了，改天再说。
skip shopping.translation: 朋友：这周末还去大采购不 你：太忙 这次就别去了 朋友：是说这次不去购物了吗 你：对 这次先不购物 朋友：下周再说
skip shopping.example: Friend: Big shopping this weekend? You: Too busy, skip it. Friend: Skipping shopping? You: Right, skip shopping. Friend: Next week.

skive off.context: 你说他今天没上班跑去玩，朋友说这种旷工偷懒的行为可不好。
skive off.translation: 朋友：他今天没来上班 干啥去了 你：偷偷出去玩了 朋友：是说他偷偷旷工吗 你：对 他偷偷旷工了 朋友：被发现要挨批
skive off.example: Friend: Why is he absent today? You: Sneaked off to play. Friend: Skiving off? You: Right, he's skiving off. Friend: In trouble if caught.

slack off.context: 你说周末别老躺着不动，朋友说懒懒散散一天就过去了。
slack off.translation: 朋友：你周末咋老躺着 不动弹 你：就想歇着 朋友：是说偷懒不动吗 你：对 别偷懒 朋友：起来动动
slack off.example: Friend: Why laze around weekends? You: Just want to rest. Friend: Slacking off? You: Right, don't slack off. Friend: Get up and move.

slap on the face.context: 你说他当众被拒，朋友说那一下简直是当众打脸，太没面子了。
slap on the face.translation: 朋友：他当众表白被拒 啥反应 你：脸都挂不住了 朋友：是说当众下不来台吗 你：对 简直是当众打脸 朋友：太尴尬了
slap on the face.example: Friend: Rejected publicly, how did he take it? You: Lost face. Friend: A slap on the face? You: Right, it was a slap on the face. Friend: So awkward.

slash overhead.context: 你说公司要省钱，朋友说先把日常开销砍一砍，别花冤枉钱。
slash overhead.translation: 朋友：今年预算紧 咋省钱啊 你：先砍一砍日常开销 朋友：是说削减日常开销吗 你：对 先削减日常开销 朋友：能省则省
slash overhead.example: Friend: Budget's tight, how to save? You: Cut overhead first. Friend: Slash overhead? You: Right, slash overhead first. Friend: Save wherever.

sleep apnoea.context: 医生说他睡觉老喘气停停，朋友说那是一种睡眠呼吸的毛病。
sleep apnoea.translation: 朋友：他睡觉咋老憋气 断断续续 你：可能是呼吸的毛病 朋友：就是那个呼吸暂停吗 你：对 是睡眠呼吸暂停 朋友：去查查
sleep apnoea.example: Friend: Why does he gasp in his sleep? You: Maybe a breathing issue. Friend: That sleep apnoea? You: Right, it's sleep apnoea. Friend: Get it checked.

sleep cycle.context: 你说早睡早起身体好，朋友说跟着身体的睡眠节奏走最养人。
sleep cycle.translation: 朋友：我几点睡几点起最好啊 你：跟着身体节奏来 朋友：是说那个睡眠周期吗 你：对 顺着睡眠周期睡 朋友：别打乱它
sleep cycle.example: Friend: When to sleep and wake? You: Follow your body. Friend: That sleep cycle? You: Right, follow the sleep cycle. Friend: Don't disrupt it.

sleep deficiency.context: 你说天天熬夜上班没精神，朋友说这是睡眠不够闹的。
sleep deficiency.translation: 朋友：我天天犯困 没精神 你：你睡太少了 朋友：是说睡眠不足吗 你：对 是睡眠不足 朋友：早点睡
sleep deficiency.example: Friend: Always drowsy, low on energy? You: You're sleep-starved. Friend: That sleep deficiency? You: Right, it's sleep deficiency. Friend: Sleep early.

sleep deprivation.context: 你说考试前连熬几夜，朋友说长期缺觉脑子都不转了。
sleep deprivation.translation: 朋友：备考那阵 我老走神 记不住 你：你睡得太少了 朋友：是说缺觉吗 你：对 是长期缺觉 朋友：先补个觉
sleep deprivation.example: Friend: Distracted, forgetful during exams? You: You're sleep-starved. Friend: That sleep deprivation? You: Right, it's sleep deprivation. Friend: Catch up on sleep.

sleep disorder.context: 你说他常年睡不着觉，朋友说那是种睡眠上的毛病，得治。
sleep disorder.translation: 朋友：他咋天天半夜还醒着 你：他睡眠一直不好 朋友：是说睡眠有毛病吗 你：对 是睡眠障碍 朋友：看看医生吧
sleep disorder.example: Friend: Why is he awake at night? You: His sleep's always poor. Friend: That sleep disorder? You: Right, it's a sleep disorder. Friend: See a doctor.

sleep disruption.context: 你说换了时差后几天都睡不踏实，朋友说作息一下被打乱了。
sleep disruption.translation: 朋友：出差回来 我咋老睡不好 你：时差把你作息打乱了 朋友：是说睡眠被打乱吗 你：对 睡眠被打乱了 朋友：几天就调整过来
sleep disruption.example: Friend: Why can't I sleep after the trip? You: Jet lag disrupted you. Friend: That sleep disruption? You: Right, it's sleep disruption. Friend: Adjusts in days.

sleep disturbances.context: 你说他这阵子老做噩梦睡不好，朋友说那是睡眠出了问题。
sleep disturbances.translation: 朋友：他最近咋老说睡不好 还做噩梦 你：是睡眠出问题了 朋友：是说睡眠那些毛病吗 你：对 是睡眠紊乱 朋友：别太累
sleep disturbances.example: Friend: Why does he sleep poorly, nightmares? You: A sleep problem. Friend: Those sleep disturbances? You: Right, they're sleep disturbances. Friend: Don't overwork.

sleep habits.context: 你说想睡好就得养成固定的睡觉习惯，朋友说每天定点睡定点起。
sleep habits.translation: 朋友：我老睡不好 咋调整啊 你：养成固定的睡觉习惯 朋友：是说那些睡觉的习惯吗 你：对 养成好的睡眠习惯 朋友：坚持就见效
sleep habits.example: Friend: Can't sleep well, how to fix? You: Build regular sleep habits. Friend: Those sleep habits? You: Right, good sleep habits. Friend: Stick with it.

sleep hygiene.context: 医生说睡前别刷手机别喝浓茶，朋友说讲究点睡眠卫生才睡得香。
sleep hygiene.translation: 朋友：想睡好 睡前都该注意啥 你：别刷手机 别喝茶 朋友：是说睡前的讲究吗 你：对 注意睡眠卫生 朋友：睡得香
sleep hygiene.example: Friend: What to watch before bed? You: No phone, no tea. Friend: That sleep hygiene? You: Right, mind sleep hygiene. Friend: Sleeps soundly.

sleep in.context: 你说周末没闹钟就睡到中午，朋友说难得睡个懒觉真舒服。
sleep in.translation: 朋友：周末你几点起啊 没人叫 你：没闹钟 就睡到自然醒 朋友：是说睡个懒觉吗 你：对 我周末爱睡懒觉 朋友：放松一下
sleep in.example: Friend: When do you wake weekends, no alarm? You: No alarm, sleep in. Friend: Sleeping in? You: Right, I sleep in weekends. Friend: Relax a bit.

sleep on it.context: 你说拿不准要不要辞职，朋友说别马上决定，先放一晚明天再想。
sleep on it.translation: 朋友：这工作你到底辞不辞啊 纠结啥 你：拿不定主意 先放一晚 朋友：是说先想一晚再决定吗 你：对 我再想一晚 朋友：别冲动
sleep on it.example: Friend: Quit or not, why torn? You: Undecided, sleep on it. Friend: Sleeping on it? You: Right, I'll sleep on it. Friend: Don't rush.

sleep pattern.context: 你说他每天凌晨三点才睡，朋友说这种颠倒的作息时间得改。
sleep pattern.translation: 朋友：他咋天天半夜三点才睡 你：作息时间都乱了 朋友：是说他的睡眠节奏吗 你：对 他睡眠节律乱了 朋友：慢慢调整
sleep pattern.example: Friend: Why does he sleep at three? You: His rhythm's messed up. Friend: That sleep pattern? You: Right, it's his sleep pattern. Friend: Adjust slowly.

sleep pod.context: 赶早班飞机在机场转机，你又累又困需要眯一会儿，这时发现航站楼里摆着一排可以躺进去的休息胶囊舱，就会用到 sleep pod 这个说法。
sleep pod.translation: 朋友：你这趟转机要等五个小时 你：我快困死了 好想找个地方躺一会儿 朋友：那边有一排 sleep pod 投币就能进去睡一小时 你：太好了 我正好进去补个觉 免得下一趟航班犯困
sleep pod.example: Friend: You have a five-hour layover on this trip. You: I am so exhausted, I really want to lie down somewhere. Friend: There is a sleep pod over there, you can pay to sleep inside for an hour. You: Perfect, I will go catch up on sleep so I do not drift off on the next flight.

sleep quality.context: 体检时医生问你最近睡得怎么样，你抱怨夜里总醒、白天没精神，这时就会聊到 sleep quality（睡眠质量）这个话题。
sleep quality.translation: 朋友：你最近脸色怎么这么差 你：我夜里总是醒 睡眠质量特别差 朋友：是不是睡前玩手机刷太久了 你：有可能 我打算今晚九点就把手机放下 好好提升一下睡眠质量
sleep quality.example: Friend: Why do you look so worn out lately? You: I keep waking up at night and my sleep quality is really poor. Friend: Are you on your phone too long before bed? You: Maybe, I will put the phone down at nine tonight to improve my sleep quality.

sleeper train.context: 你计划跨城过夜旅行，不想浪费白天住酒店，朋友建议你坐晚上出发、清晨到达的卧铺火车，这时就会聊到 sleeper train。
sleeper train.translation: 朋友：我们去外地玩要坐十四个小时火车 你：白天坐过去太浪费时间了 朋友：那我们可以订 sleeper train 晚上睡一觉就到 你：这个主意好 还能省一晚住宿钱
sleeper train.example: Friend: Our trip out of town takes a fourteen-hour train. You: It would waste daylight to ride there during the day. Friend: Then we can book a sleeper train and sleep all the way there. You: Great idea, that also saves us a night of hotel money.

sleeping bag.context: 周末和朋友约好去山里露营，收拾行李时你纠结要不要带睡袋，朋友提醒你山里夜里很冷，这时就会聊到 sleeping bag。
sleeping bag.translation: 朋友：周末去露营你都收拾好什么了 你：帐篷和手电筒都装好了 朋友：你那个厚 sleeping bag 别忘了 山上半夜会结冰 你：放心 我已经塞到背包最下面了
sleeping bag.example: Friend: What have you packed for the camping trip this weekend? You: The tent and flashlight are ready. Friend: Do not forget your thick sleeping bag, it freezes at night on the mountain. You: Relax, I already stuffed it at the bottom of my backpack.

slip into.context: 你发现自己最近一回家就瘫在沙发上刷手机，越来越不想运动，朋友提醒你这是不知不觉染上了坏习惯，这时就会用到 slip into。
slip into.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么都不去健身房了 你：工作太累 回家就只想躺着刷手机 朋友：你再这样会 slip into bad habits 的 身体都要生锈了 你：你说得对 我今晚就下楼跑两圈
slip into.example: Friend: Why have you stopped going to the gym lately? You: Work is so tiring, I just want to lie on the couch scrolling. Friend: You will slip into bad habits if you keep this up, your body will rust. You: You are right, I will jog downstairs tonight.

slip up.context: 你在公司负责整理一份重要报表，结果提交后被老板发现填错了一个数字，你懊悔自己怎么疏忽了，这时就会用到 slip up。
slip up.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么垂头丧气的 你：我昨天交的报表里金额写错了一个零 朋友：哎呀 你在哪儿 slip up 了 下次交叉检查一遍 你：我本来核对过两遍 还是出了错 太不应该了
slip up.example: Friend: Why do you look so down today? You: I put an extra zero in the amount on the report I turned in. Friend: Oh no, where did you slip up? Double check it next time. You: I did check it twice, yet I still messed up, that is really on me.

slow fashion.context: 你逛商场时看到新款衣服很想买，但想起衣柜里一大堆只穿过两次的衣服，于是决定改走少买精买的路线，这时就会聊到 slow fashion。
slow fashion.translation: 朋友：这家店新上的风衣好好看 要不要买 你：我最近在关注 slow fashion 不想再冲动消费了 朋友：就是买耐穿、能穿很久的那种对吧 你：对 每件都要值得反复穿才下手
slow fashion.example: Friend: This shop just got new trench coats, should we get one? You: I have been into slow fashion lately, I do not want impulse buys anymore. Friend: You mean buying durable pieces you will wear for years? You: Exactly, I only buy something if I will wear it again and again.

slow gait.context: 在小区散步时你注意到邻居老爷爷走路越来越慢、步伐迟缓，你跟朋友聊起人老了步态变化，这时就会用到 slow gait。
slow gait.translation: 朋友：楼下张爷爷最近走路怎么那么慢 你：他膝盖不好 走起路来 slow gait 特别明显 朋友：年纪大了步态变慢也是衰老的信号 你：是啊 我们有空多陪他慢慢走走
slow gait.example: Friend: Why is Grandpa Zhang downstairs walking so slowly these days? You: His knees are bad, and his slow gait is really noticeable now. Friend: A slow gait in old age is also a sign of aging. You: True, let us walk with him slowly when we have time.

slow lane.context: 周末你不想赶时间去热门景点人挤人，宁愿骑车在小街上慢慢逛，朋友问你怎么不去网红打卡点，你说自己想走慢车道，这时就会用到 slow lane。
slow lane.translation: 朋友：周末我们去那个网红景点打卡吧 你：我不想赶时间挤来挤去 朋友：那你想怎么安排 你：我就想走 slow lane 慢慢骑车逛小巷子 不赶任何行程
slow lane.example: Friend: Let us go check out that viral scenic spot this weekend. You: I do not want to rush and squeeze through crowds. Friend: So how do you want to spend the day? You: I want to stay in the slow lane, biking around the back streets with no schedule.

slow progression.context: 带孩子去验光，医生说近视度数涨得不算快，建议多户外活动来延缓度数加深，这时就会聊到 slow progression。
slow progression.translation: 朋友：孩子上次验光度数涨了多少 你：医生说 slow progression 不算太快 朋友：那平时是不是要多在户外活动 你：对 每天户外两小时能延缓近视加深
slow progression.example: Friend: How much did your kid's prescription go up at the last eye exam? You: The doctor said it is slow progression, not too fast. Friend: So outdoor time really helps, right? You: Yes, two hours outside a day slows down myopia progression.

slows down.context: 你开车经过学校路段，看到操场上孩子们在跑，教练吹哨让大家减速，你也跟着松油门放慢车速，这时就会用到 slows down。
slows down.translation: 朋友：前面学校路段你怎么减速了 你：操场上体育课 孩子们在跑道上跑 朋友：那确实要 slows down 小心点 你：对 经过学校门口都得踩轻刹车
slows down.example: Friend: Why did you slow down near the school ahead? You: The kids are having PE on the track out there. Friend: Then you really should slow down and be careful. You: Right, you have to ease off the gas by any school gate.

slum it.context: 你和朋友去旅行订不起星级酒店，只好住进青年旅社的四人间，朋友吐槽太简陋，你开玩笑说咱们这是在体验生活，这时就会用到 slum it。
slum it.translation: 朋友：这青旅四人间也太挤了吧 你：出来玩预算有限 只能 slum it 几天了 朋友：上下铺还能听到隔壁打呼噜 你：就当体验生活 反正睡一觉第二天又精神了
slum it.example: Friend: This hostel four-bed room is way too cramped. You: Our budget is tight, so we just have to slum it for a few days. Friend: I can hear the people next bunk snoring. You: Just see it as an adventure, one night's sleep and we are fresh again.

slurred speech.context: 聚会上有个同学喝多了，说话含糊不清、舌头像打了结，你扶他坐下，朋友问他怎么了，这时就会用到 slurred speech。
slurred speech.translation: 朋友：他怎么话都说不清楚了 你：他今晚喝太多了 明显 slurred speech 朋友：赶紧给他倒杯温水醒醒酒 你：行 我扶他到沙发上靠一会儿
slurred speech.example: Friend: Why can he not even speak clearly? You: He drank way too much tonight, his speech is clearly slurred now. Friend: Quick, pour him some warm water to sober up. You: Okay, I will help him over to the couch to rest.

small change.context: 你在便利店想买瓶水，结账时发现钱包没带够整钱，只剩一把硬币，这时就会聊到 small change。
small change.translation: 朋友：你这瓶水多少钱 你：八块 我身上只有 small change 了 朋友：我这儿有整钱 先帮你垫上吧 你：太谢谢了 回头我微信转你
small change.example: Friend: How much is that bottle of water? You: Eight yuan, and I only have small change on me now. Friend: I have bills on me, let me cover it for you. You: Thanks a lot, I will pay you back on WeChat.

small favour.context: 你搬了新家想请同事帮忙搬个箱子，又怕太麻烦人家，朋友说这不费力气，就是举手之劳，这时就会用到 small favour。
small favour.translation: 朋友：你叫我过来干嘛呀 你：想请你帮个 small favour 搬一下这个柜子 朋友：就这小事 一句话的事 你：太感谢了 搬完请你喝奶茶
small favour.example: Friend: Why did you ask me to come over? You: I need a small favour, can you help move this cabinet? Friend: That is tiny, just say the word. You: Thanks so much, I will treat you to milk tea after.

small talk.context: 参加一个行业酒会，周围全是陌生人，你端着酒杯不知道说什么，朋友教你先聊聊天气和假期破冰，这时就会用到 small talk。
small talk.translation: 朋友：你怎么一个人站在角落 你：我不认识大家 不知道怎么开口 朋友：先做 small talk 聊聊天气和最近的假期就行 你：好 我去跟旁边那位女士搭个话
small talk.example: Friend: Why are you standing in the corner alone? You: I do not know anyone here, I have no idea how to start. Friend: Just make small talk about the weather and recent holidays. You: Okay, I will go chat with the woman next to me.

smart devices.context: 你刚搬新家，想让手机、灯、窗帘都能语音控制，朋友带你去逛家电卖场，跟你介绍各种能联网的设备，这时就会用到 smart devices。
smart devices.translation: 朋友：你新家装修打算弄成什么样 你：我想装一堆 smart devices 手机就能全控制 朋友：灯、空调、门锁都能连同一个 App 你：对 这样回家一句话就能全开
smart devices.example: Friend: How do you want to set up your new place? You: I want lots of smart devices I can control from my phone. Friend: The lights, AC and locks can all connect to one app. You: Exactly, then one voice command turns everything on.

smart glasses.context: 你开车时想看导航又不想低头看手机，朋友推荐你装一副能把路线投射到眼前的智能眼镜，这时就会用到 smart glasses。
smart glasses.translation: 朋友：你开车看导航总低头太危险 你：是啊 看一眼路都得转回去 朋友：你可以试试 smart glasses 路线直接显示在眼前 你：那真方便 我也去配一副
smart glasses.example: Friend: It is dangerous to keep looking down at the navigation while driving. You: Yeah, I have to glance away from the road. Friend: You could try smart glasses, the route shows right in front of you. You: That sounds handy, I will get a pair too.

smart home.context: 朋友来你家做客，发现你说句话灯就亮、空调自己调温度，特别惊讶，问你家是不是装了系统，这时就会用到 smart home。
smart home.translation: 朋友：你家灯怎么自己亮了 你：我装了 smart home 系统 一句话就能控制家电 朋友：那窗帘和门锁也能语音控制吗 你：当然 喊一声就全搞定
smart home.example: Friend: How did the light turn on by itself at your place? You: I set up a smart home system, voice controls all the appliances. Friend: So the curtains and locks respond to voice too? You: Of course, one command handles everything.

smart lighting.context: 你想晚上起夜不刺眼、看电影时灯光自动调暗，朋友推荐你装一套能跟着场景变化的智能照明，这时就会用到 smart lighting。
smart lighting.translation: 朋友：你家晚上看电视灯太亮晃眼 你：是啊 想调光还得起身找开关 朋友：装个 smart lighting 看电影自动调暗 你：那挺舒服 起夜还能亮小夜灯
smart lighting.example: Friend: The lights are way too bright when you watch TV at night. You: Yeah, and I have to get up to dim them. Friend: Get smart lighting that dims itself during a movie. You: That would be nice, plus a soft night light when I get up.

smart speaker.context: 你在家想听音乐、问天气、定闹钟，不想每次都掏手机，朋友建议你买个放在桌上的音箱，说句话它就回应，这时就会用到 smart speaker。
smart speaker.translation: 朋友：你每天早上怎么定闹钟 你：还得摸出手机划半天 朋友：买个 smart speaker 放桌上 说句话就设好 你：那我也来一个 还能顺便播报天气
smart speaker.example: Friend: How do you set your alarm every morning? You: I still dig out my phone and tap around. Friend: Put a smart speaker on your desk, just tell it the time. You: I will get one too, it can also read the weather out loud.

smart thermostat.context: 你家空调冬天总是太冷夏天太热，手动调不准，朋友推荐你装一个能自己学习室温的温控器，这时就会用到 smart thermostat。
smart thermostat.translation: 朋友：你家空调温度怎么忽冷忽热 你：手动调老是拿不准 朋友：装个 smart thermostat 它会自己学你习惯 你：那正好 不用每天来回拧了
smart thermostat.example: Friend: Why does your room swing between too cold and too hot? You: I can never get the manual setting right. Friend: Install a smart thermostat, it learns your habits on its own. You: Perfect, no more twisting the dial every day.

smarter processing.context: 你用修图软件处理照片时发现一键能把皮肤磨得更自然、细节更清楚，朋友说这是算法更精细的处理效果，这时就会用到 smarter processing。
smarter processing.translation: 朋友：你这张照片修得好自然啊 你：用了新版软件 算法做了 smarter processing 朋友：难怪皮肤看着不假 细节也清楚 你：对 比旧版自然多了
smarter processing.example: Friend: You retouched this photo so naturally. You: I used the new app, it has smarter processing now. Friend: No wonder the skin looks real and the details are sharp. You: Right, it looks way more natural than the old version.

smartphone addiction.context: 你发现自己吃饭、走路都在刷手机，一刷就是两小时，朋友担心你刷得太多，聊到手机成瘾这个话题，这时就会用到 smartphone addiction。
smartphone addiction.translation: 朋友：你怎么吃饭都盯着手机 你：不知不觉就刷了两小时短视频 朋友：你这有点 smartphone addiction 了 得控制一下 你：是 我今晚开始把手机放另一个房间
smartphone addiction.example: Friend: Why are you staring at your phone even during meals? You: Without noticing I have scrolled short videos for two hours. Friend: You are getting smartphone addiction, you need to cut back. You: True, I will leave the phone in another room tonight.

smell the flowers.context: 你每天忙工作忙到连周末都在赶进度，朋友拉你去公园散步，说你该停下来闻闻花香享受生活，这时就会用到 smell the flowers。
smell the flowers.translation: 朋友：你多久没好好休息了 你：天天加班 周末也在赶报告 朋友：你得抽空 smell the flowers 别把自己绷太紧 你：走吧 现在就去公园走走
smell the flowers.example: Friend: How long has it been since you truly rested? You: I work overtime every day, even weekends on reports. Friend: You need to stop and smell the flowers, do not keep yourself wound tight. You: Let us go, we will take a walk in the park right now.

smoke-free zone.context: 你带家人去餐厅吃饭，进门看到墙上贴着无烟区域的标志，朋友问能不能在这儿抽烟，你指给他看，这时就会用到 smoke-free zone。
smoke-free zone.translation: 朋友：我们找个位置坐吧 我先抽根烟 你：别抽了 这是 smoke-free zone 墙上有标志 朋友：哦 那我吃完饭去外面走廊抽 你：行 饭后出去抽一根再进来
smoke-free zone.example: Friend: Let us find a seat, I will smoke a cigarette first. You: Do not, this is a smoke-free zone, there is a sign on the wall. Friend: Oh, I will go out to the hallway after the meal. You: Fine, smoke one outside and come back in.

smoking ban.context: 你住的城市最近在公共场所全面禁烟，车站和餐厅都不能抽了，朋友吐槽烟不好抽了，这时就会用到 smoking ban。
smoking ban.translation: 朋友：现在车站怎么都不能抽烟了 你：市里刚出了 smoking ban 所有室内公共场合都禁 朋友：那以后只能在指定室外点抽 你：对 这样空气也清爽不少
smoking ban.example: Friend: Why can we not smoke at the station anymore? You: The city just passed a smoking ban, all indoor public places are off limits. Friend: Then we can only smoke in the designated outdoor spots. You: Right, the air feels cleaner now too.

smoking prevalence.context: 在医院做健康宣讲，医生提到现在抽烟的人比十年前少了，聊到人群中吸烟比例的下降，这时就会用到 smoking prevalence。
smoking prevalence.translation: 朋友：现在抽烟的人好像比以前少了 你：对 报告里 smoking prevalence 这十年一直在降 朋友：主要是宣传和烟税起了作用 你：是啊 年轻人抽烟的比例最低
smoking prevalence.example: Friend: It seems fewer people smoke than before. You: Right, the report says smoking prevalence has dropped steadily over ten years. Friend: Public campaigns and tobacco tax did the job. You: Exactly, the rate is lowest among young people now.

smooth over.context: 你和同事因为排班闹了点别扭，领导知道后把你们叫到一起聊了聊，把分歧化解掉了，这时就会用到 smooth over。
smooth over.translation: 朋友：你和小李昨天是不是吵起来了 你：为排班的事有点不愉快 朋友：领导已经帮你们 smooth over 了 别往心里去 你：嗯 其实我俩也都不是真心计较
smooth over.example: Friend: Did you and Xiao Li have a fight yesterday? You: We were a bit upset over the shift schedule. Friend: The manager already helped smooth things over, do not take it to heart. You: Yeah, neither of us really meant to hold a grudge.

snack on.context: 你看电影时嘴巴闲不住，边看边往嘴里塞坚果和薯片，朋友笑你不停嘴，这时就会用到 snack on。
snack on.translation: 朋友：你看电影怎么一直在吃东西 你：我习惯边看边 snack on 点坚果 朋友：那你别把薯片渣掉座椅上 你：放心 我垫着纸巾吃
snack on.example: Friend: Why are you eating nonstop during the movie? You: I usually snack on some nuts while watching. Friend: Just do not drop chip crumbs on the seat. You: Relax, I am eating over a tissue.

snail mail.context: 你给国外的朋友寄一张手写明信片，朋友笑说现在谁还寄信，等寄到都一周后了，你说这种慢慢的信才有意思，这时就会用到 snail mail。
snail mail.translation: 朋友：你现在还寄明信片啊 你：对啊 寄一张 snail mail 过去特别有仪式感 朋友：等它到你朋友手里都过一周了 你：就是要这种慢慢的期待感嘛
snail mail.example: Friend: You are still mailing postcards these days? You: Yeah, sending snail mail feels like a ritual. Friend: It will take a week to reach your friend. You: That slow sense of anticipation is the whole point.

snap judgement.context: 相亲第一次见面，对方刚坐下你就觉得这人不太对，但又不想太草率下结论，朋友劝你别凭第一印象就否定人家，这时就会用到 snap judgement。
snap judgement.translation: 朋友：第一次见面感觉怎么样 你：说不上来 但第一印象不太好 朋友：别做 snap judgement 多聊两次再看 你：也是 我再约他喝杯咖啡聊聊
snap judgement.example: Friend: How was the first date? You: Hard to say, but my first impression was not great. Friend: Do not make a snap judgement, meet them twice more first. You: True, I will ask them out for coffee again.

snap out of.context: 你考试失利后整天闷闷不乐，饭也不吃，朋友着急地拍你肩膀说别沉浸在坏情绪里了，赶紧振作起来，这时就会用到 snap out of。
snap out of.translation: 朋友：你这两天怎么都不说话 你：考试没考好 心里堵得慌 朋友：赶紧 snap out of it 难过一晚就够了 你：好吧 我出去跑一圈透透气
snap out of.example: Friend: Why have you not said a word for two days? You: I bombed the exam and feel really down. Friend: Snap out of it now, one night of feeling bad is enough. You: Okay, I will go out for a run to clear my head.

sneak up.context: 你在小区里遛狗，猫突然从灌木后头悄悄靠近，你还没发现，这时就会用到 sneak up。
sneak up.translation: 朋友：你看那边有只猫 你：在哪儿呢 我怎么没看见 朋友：它正 sneak up on 那只麻雀呢 轻点别惊动它 你：嘘 我们站这儿看它想干嘛
sneak up.example: Friend: Look, there is a cat over there. You: Where? I do not see it. Friend: It is sneaking up on that sparrow, stay quiet so we do not scare it. You: Shh, let us stand here and watch what it does.

sneeze at.context: 朋友请你去一家很贵的餐厅，你尝了一口觉得味道一般，但又不好意思直说，心想这种价位自己才不稀罕，这时就会用到 sneeze at 的否定用法。
sneeze at.translation: 朋友：这家米其林餐厅味道不错吧 你：说实话 我真不觉得有多惊艳 朋友：你这嘴也太挑了 多少人排队都吃不上 你：这种价位我可一点都不 sneeze at
sneeze at.example: Friend: Is this Michelin restaurant not amazing? You: Honestly, I am not that impressed. Friend: You are so picky, people queue up hours for this. You: I would not sneeze at a cheaper bowl of noodles myself.

sneezed at.context: 同事升职了你心里有点不是滋味，但嘴上说自己才不稀罕那个位置，朋友听出你口是心非，这时就会用到 sneezed at。
sneezed at.translation: 朋友：小李升主管了你不羡慕吗 你：那位置累死个人 我才不 sneeze at 朋友：你嘴上说不稀罕 其实心里挺在意吧 你：唉 多少有点吧
sneezed at.example: Friend: Xiao Li got promoted, are you not jealous? You: That position is a grind, I would not sneeze at it anyway. Friend: You say you do not care, but deep down you mind, right? You: Well, a little bit, I guess.

sniffer dog.context: 你在机场过安检，看到一只大狗蹲在行李箱旁，工作人员说这是搜爆犬，鼻子特别灵，这时就会用到 sniffer dog。
sniffer dog.translation: 朋友：那只大狗站行李箱旁边干嘛 你：它是 sniffer dog 专门闻有没有违禁品 朋友：它鼻子真有那么灵吗 你：当然 几克毒品都能闻出来
sniffer dog.example: Friend: What is that big dog doing by the luggage? You: It is a sniffer dog, trained to sniff out illegal items. Friend: Is its nose really that sensitive? You: Absolutely, it can smell even a few grams of drugs.

snooze button.context: 早上闹钟响了你困得睁不开眼，伸手一按那个贪睡键想再赖五分钟，结果一赖就睡过了头，这时就会用到 snooze button。
snooze button.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么迟到了半小时 你：闹钟响了我按了 snooze button 想再睡五分钟 朋友：一按贪睡键就等于睡过头 你：是啊 醒来已经九点半了
snooze button.example: Friend: Why are you half an hour late today? You: When the alarm went off I hit the snooze button for five more minutes. Friend: Hitting that snooze button always means oversleeping. You: Tell me about it, I woke up at nine thirty.

snuff it.context: 几个老朋友聊起老一辈，其中一位半开玩笑地说当年那只老猫要是还在，现在都快成精了，另一位逗趣说它怕是早就咽气了，这时就会用到 snuff it 的委婉俚语。
snuff it.translation: 朋友：咱们以前养的那只橘猫现在多大了 你：它三年前就 snuff it 了 我难过了好一阵 朋友：时间真快 它也算寿终正寝了 你：是啊 活到十五岁很不错了
snuff it.example: Friend: How old would our old orange cat be now? You: It snuffed it three years ago, I was sad for ages. Friend: Time flies, it lived out a full life. You: Yeah, making it to fifteen was pretty good.

snuggle up.context: 冬夜外面下着雨，你和朋友窝在沙发上盖着同一条毯子看老电影，暖得不想动，这时就会用到 snuggle up。
snuggle up.translation: 朋友：今天外面好冷还下雨 你：我们 snuggle up 在沙发上盖毯子看电影吧 朋友：把那条厚毛毯也拿过来 你：给你 我们俩挤一块儿就暖和了
snuggle up.example: Friend: It is so cold and rainy outside today. You: Let us snuggle up on the couch under a blanket and watch a movie. Friend: Bring that thick throw over too. You: Here, the two of us huddled together will stay warm.

snuggled up.context: 你读完一本小说，窝在被窝里把台灯调到最暗，回想故事结尾，整个人放松又慵懒，这时就会用到 snuggled up。
snuggled up.translation: 朋友：你这会儿在干嘛呢 你：我 snuggled up 在被窝里 刚读完一本小说 朋友：灯这么暗对眼睛不好 你：就剩最后一章了 看完这页我就关灯睡
snuggled up.example: Friend: What are you up to right now? You: I am all snuggled up under the covers, just finished a novel. Friend: The light is too dim for your eyes. You: Only one chapter left, I will turn it off after this page.

so.context: 周末你本来约朋友吃饭，结果临时被通知要加班，你叹了口气说那就下次吧，朋友问你怎么了，这时就会用到 so 引出新话题的口语用法。
so.translation: 朋友：周末你不是说要去吃火锅吗 你：so 我刚接到通知 得留下来加班 朋友：那火锅只能改下周了 你：行吧 等我忙完这阵再约
so.example: Friend: Did you not plan hot pot this weekend? You: So, I just got told I have to stay late at work. Friend: Then the hot pot has to move to next week. You: Fine, let us reschedule once this rush is over.

so called.context: 朋友吹嘘自己是圈内大神，结果你一看他做的方案全是漏洞，你半讽刺地说这位所谓的专家也不过如此，这时就会用到 so called。
so called.translation: 朋友：那位专家做的方案你看了吗 你：他那位所谓的 so called 专家 方案里全是漏洞 朋友：名气大不一定真有水平 你：是啊 徒有虚名罢了
so called.example: Friend: Did you see the plan that expert put together? You: His so-called expertise is all holes in the plan. Friend: A big name does not always mean real skill. You: Exactly, it is all reputation with no substance.

so much more.context: 朋友带你去他家做客，你发现他家不只是装修好看，连书架、灯光、小摆件都特别用心，你感叹这远不止好看那么简单，这时就会用到 so much more。
so much more.translation: 朋友：我家刚装修好 你来看看 你：不只是好看啊 每个角落都 so much more 心思 朋友：我花了半年慢慢布置的 你：真的 这已经是能住人的样板间了
so much more.example: Friend: I just finished renovating, come over and see. You: It is not just nice, there is so much more thought in every corner. Friend: I spent half a year slowly putting it together. You: Really, this is like a livable show flat.

so much so that.context: 你为了备考每天学到凌晨一两点，累到喝咖啡都不管用，朋友见你眼圈发黑，说你已经拼到伤身体的地步了，这时就会用到 so much so that。
so much so that.translation: 朋友：你最近每天学到几点 你：凌晨一两点 困到喝咖啡都没用 朋友：你拼到 so much so that 眼睛都黑了 这样不行 你：我再坚持这两周就考试了
so much so that.example: Friend: How late have you been studying every day? You: Until one or two in the morning, coffee does not even wake me up. Friend: You push it so much so that your eyes are all dark, that is bad. You: Only two more weeks until the exam.

soak up.context: 你刚到国外读书，上课像海绵吸水一样拼命吸收新单词和新知识点，朋友说你这阵子学得真快，这时就会用到 soak up。
soak up.translation: 朋友：你来国外半年英语进步真大 你：我天天泡在英语环境里 拼命 soak up 新词 朋友：这种沉浸式学语言最快了 你：对 走路吃饭都在听都在记
soak up.example: Friend: Your English improved so much in just half a year abroad. You: I live in an English environment and soak up new words every day. Friend: Immersion is the fastest way to learn a language. You: Right, I listen and memorize even while walking and eating.

soapy scrub.context: 夏天运动完一身汗，你想冲个舒服的澡，朋友建议你用香皂仔细搓洗一遍比随便冲一下解乏，这时就会用到 soapy scrub。
soapy scrub.translation: 朋友：跑了五公里一身汗 快冲一下吧 你：我想好好洗个 soapy scrub 解解乏 朋友：别随便冲两下就出来 用香皂仔细搓 你：行 今晚我多泡一会儿
soapy scrub.example: Friend: You ran five kilometres and are soaked in sweat, go rinse off. You: I want a proper soapy scrub to unwind. Friend: Do not just splash water quickly, scrub well with soap. You: Okay, I will linger in the shower tonight.

soaring rent.context: 你毕业留在大城市工作，发现每年房租都在涨，涨得比工资快，跟朋友吐槽房租压力，这时就会用到 soaring rent。
soaring rent.translation: 朋友：你今年房租又涨了多少 你：一年涨了八百 这 soaring rent 真扛不住 朋友：工资涨得还没房租快 你：是啊 想换个便宜点的房子都难
soaring rent.example: Friend: How much has your rent gone up this year? You: Eight hundred a year, this soaring rent is really killing me. Friend: The pay rises slower than the rent. You: Tell me about it, even finding a cheaper flat is hard.

sociable activity.context: 周末你不想在家待着，朋友约你去参加一个读书分享会，说这种社交活动能认识同好，这时就会用到 sociable activity。
sociable activity.translation: 朋友：周末别老宅家了 你：那去哪儿呢 朋友：有个读书分享会 是种很好的 sociable activity 你：行 我去认识几个爱看书的朋友
sociable activity.example: Friend: Stop staying home all weekend. You: So where should I go? Friend: There is a book-sharing meetup, a really sociable activity. You: Fine, I will go and meet some book lovers.

social activities.context: 你刚到新公司，午休时一个人吃饭很孤单，同事拉你一起去食堂，说多参加社交活动才能融入，这时就会用到 social activities。
social activities.translation: 朋友：你中午怎么一个人吃饭 你：刚来还不认识大家 有点不好意思 朋友：多参加 social activities 很快就熟了 你：好啊 明天一起去食堂吧
social activities.example: Friend: Why are you eating lunch alone? You: I just started here and do not know anyone yet, it feels awkward. Friend: Join more social activities and you will fit in fast. You: Okay, let us go to the canteen together tomorrow.

social anxiety disorder.context: 你发现自己一到人多的聚会就紧张得说不出话，手心冒汗，朋友建议你去找心理咨询，说这可能是社交焦虑症，这时就会用到 social anxiety disorder。
social anxiety disorder.translation: 朋友：你一开会发言就脸红手抖 你：人多场合我就特别紧张 声音都发颤 朋友：你这可能是 social anxiety disorder 得找人聊聊 你：我打算下周去学校心理中心看看
social anxiety disorder.example: Friend: You blush and shake every time you speak in meetings. You: In crowds I get so nervous my voice shakes. Friend: That might be social anxiety disorder, you should talk to someone. You: I plan to visit the campus counselling centre next week.

social arrangement.context: 你和朋友好久没见，想约个时间聚聚，翻了半天日历发现大家都忙，最后定在周六下午茶馆，这时就会用到 social arrangement。
social arrangement.translation: 朋友：我们好久没见面了吧 你：是啊 得做个 social arrangement 聚一下 朋友：你周几方便 我订个茶位 你：周六下午吧 找个安静的茶馆坐坐
social arrangement.example: Friend: It has been ages since we last met. You: Yeah, we need to make a social arrangement to catch up. Friend: What day works for you, I will book a table. You: Saturday afternoon, let us find a quiet teahouse.

social barriers.context: 你是外地来的毕业生，在新城市找工作时发现有些岗位更倾向本地人，你跟朋友聊起这种隐性门槛，这时就会用到 social barriers。
social barriers.translation: 朋友：你投简历回得怎么样 你：好多岗位好像更倾向招本地人 朋友：这就是 social barriers 外人很难跨过去 你：是啊 语言和圈子都得重新建
social barriers.example: Friend: How are the replies to your applications going? You: A lot of jobs seem to prefer locals. Friend: That is the social barriers, outsiders have a hard time crossing them. You: True, I have to rebuild both language and social circles.

social behaviour.context: 在公司培训课上，老师讲职场中怎么和客户打招呼、怎么送礼得体，聊到职场中的社交行为规范，这时就会用到 social behaviour。
social behaviour.translation: 朋友：今天培训都学了什么 你：讲职场 social behaviour 跟客户交往的分寸 朋友：比如见面怎么寒暄送礼吗 你：对 细节特别多 说错话都不礼貌
social behaviour.example: Friend: What did you learn in today's training? You: We covered workplace social behaviour and the right way to deal with clients. Friend: Like how to greet and give gifts? You: Exactly, there are so many details, one wrong word feels rude.

social being.context: 你在公园看到一群老人凑在一起下棋聊天，笑声不断，朋友感慨人是需要群体的动物，这时就会用到 social being。
social being.translation: 朋友：那帮大爷天天在公园下棋 你：是啊 人是 social being 待在家里会憋坏 朋友：所以他们天天凑一起热闹 你：对 老年人尤其需要有人说话
social being.example: Friend: Those old men play chess in the park every day. You: Yeah, humans are social beings, staying home alone drives you crazy. Friend: That is why they gather for the fun. You: Right, older people especially need people to talk to.

social benefits.context: 你看到新闻里政府给低收入家庭发补贴、建免费社区医院，聊到社会提供给普通人的福利，这时就会用到 social benefits。
social benefits.translation: 朋友：新闻里说给低收入家庭发钱了 你：这就是 social benefits 帮困难的人过日子 朋友：有了这些福利看病才看得起 你：是啊 社会就该照顾最弱势的人
social benefits.example: Friend: The news says they are giving money to low-income families. You: That is the social benefits to help struggling people get by. Friend: With those benefits people can afford medical care. You: Exactly, society should look after the most vulnerable.

social bond.context: 团队一起做完一个大项目，大家在庆功饭上碰杯，朋友说这种一起熬夜奋战的经历特别能拉近关系，这时就会用到 social bond。
social bond.translation: 朋友：项目上线那一刻大家都哭了 你：一起熬了三个月 这种 social bond 特别深 朋友：以后这帮人就是过命的交情了 你：对 比普通同事亲近多了
social bond.example: Friend: Everyone cried the moment the project went live. You: We pulled three all-nighter months, this social bond is really strong. Friend: This crew is bonded for life now. You: Right, much closer than ordinary coworkers.

social bonding.context: 公司组织新人一起做户外拓展，通过游戏让大家互相熟悉，教练说这是在增进团队的社交联结，这时就会用到 social bonding。
social bonding.translation: 朋友：今天拓展活动好累啊 你：又是搭人桥又是信任背摔 朋友：教练说这是 social bonding 让大家更快熟 你：确实 一天下来跟大家都不生分了
social bonding.example: Friend: Today's team-building was so exhausting. You: We did the human bridge and the trust fall too. Friend: The coach said it is social bonding to make us close fast. You: True, after one day I feel relaxed with everyone.

social circle.context: 你换了新城市工作，发现自己认识的人一只手数得过来，周末都没人约，跟朋友抱怨社交圈太小，这时就会用到 social circle。
social circle.translation: 朋友：你来新城市半年了 周末都跟谁玩 你：social circle 特别小 除了同事没别人 朋友：多参加点活动认识新朋友 你：我这周末去个读书会看看
social circle.example: Friend: You have been in the new city half a year, who do you hang out with on weekends? You: My social circle is tiny, nobody except coworkers. Friend: Join some activities to meet new people. You: I will go to a book club this weekend.

social code.context: 你第一次去英国人家吃饭，不知道该带什么礼物、几点到合适，朋友提醒你入乡随俗，聊到当地不成文的社交规矩，这时就会用到 social code。
social code.translation: 朋友：第一次去英国人家做客要注意啥 你：我也不知道 怕说错话 朋友：你得懂那边的 social code 比如带点小礼物 你：好 我买点葡萄酒和花带过去
social code.example: Friend: What should I watch for at my first British dinner invitation? You: I am not sure either, afraid of saying the wrong thing. Friend: You need the local social code, like bringing a small gift. You: Okay, I will bring some wine and flowers.

social commitment.context: 你在公司年会上主动报名参加公益捐书活动，聊到企业和个人对社会应尽的责任，这时就会用到 social commitment。
social commitment.translation: 朋友：年会上你报了什么项目 你：捐书助学 也算尽点 social commitment 朋友：这活动挺有意义 还能认识同事 你：对 捐书不多但心意到了
social commitment.example: Friend: Which project did you sign up for at the annual party? You: Book donation for kids, doing my bit of social commitment. Friend: That is meaningful, and you meet coworkers too. You: Right, the books are few but the thought counts.

social connection.context: 你毕业多年还跟大学室友保持联系，逢年过节互相问候，朋友说这种长久的关系特别珍贵，这时就会用到 social connection。
social connection.translation: 朋友：你跟大学室友还有联系吗 你：当然 逢年过节都互相问候 朋友：这种 social connection 特别珍贵 别丢了 你：是啊 已经是一辈子的朋友了
social connection.example: Friend: Do you still keep in touch with your college roommates? You: Of course, we greet each other every holiday. Friend: That kind of social connection is precious, do not lose it. You: Right, they are friends for life now.

social contact.context: 你刚做完手术在家休养，一个人待着有点闷，朋友说你得保持跟外界的接触，哪怕打打电话也行，这时就会用到 social contact。
social contact.translation: 朋友：你术后恢复得怎么样 你：在家躺了两周 有点闷 朋友：你得保持 social contact 哪怕打打电话 你：行 我明天约朋友视频聊聊
social contact.example: Friend: How is your recovery after surgery? You: I have been lying at home for two weeks, feeling bored. Friend: You need to keep social contact, even just phone calls. You: Okay, I will video call a friend tomorrow.

social conversations.context: 你在电梯里跟邻居碰面，不知道说什么好，朋友教你几句轻松的开场白，比如天气和周末计划，这时就会用到 social conversations。
social conversations.translation: 朋友：你在电梯里碰到邻居都聊啥 你：就尴尬地点个头 不知道说啥 朋友：来几句 social conversations 问问天气就行 你：行 下次我主动聊聊天气
social conversations.example: Friend: What do you talk about when you bump into a neighbour in the lift? You: Just an awkward nod, I have no idea what to say. Friend: Start some social conversations, just ask about the weather. You: Okay, next time I will bring up the weather.

social drain.context: 你连续参加了三天聚会，回到家一句话都不想说，觉得比上班还累，朋友说你这是社交耗损过度，这时就会用到 social drain。
social drain.translation: 朋友：你这周末连赶三场聚会 你：回到家一句话都不想说 比上班还累 朋友：这是 social drain 太频繁会透支 你：下周我得在家静静待一天
social drain.example: Friend: You hit three parties in a row this weekend. You: I came home and cannot say a word, more tired than at work. Friend: That is social drain, too much of it burns you out. You: I need a quiet day at home next week.

social events.context: 同事邀请你参加公司的年会和庆功晚宴，你犹豫要不要去，朋友说这种社交活动能认识不同部门的人，这时就会用到 social events。
social events.translation: 朋友：公司年会你去不去 你：我还在犹豫 怕尴尬 朋友：这种 social events 多参加能认识别的部门的人 你：也是 那我报名参加吧
social events.example: Friend: Are you going to the company annual party? You: I am still deciding, afraid it will be awkward. Friend: These social events let you meet people from other departments. You: True, I will sign up then.

social gathering.context: 生日那天你约了几个好友来家里吃火锅，大家围坐一起聊到深夜，朋友说这种小聚会最舒服，这时就会用到 social gathering。
social gathering.translation: 朋友：你生日怎么过的 你：就叫了几个好友在家吃火锅 朋友：这种小 social gathering 比去酒吧舒服 你：对 大家聊到半夜都不想走
social gathering.example: Friend: How did you spend your birthday? You: I just had a few close friends over for hot pot. Friend: A small social gathering like that is nicer than a bar. You: Right, we talked till midnight and nobody wanted to leave.

social good.context: 你在小区发起旧衣物回收箱，邻居们把不穿的衣服捐给需要的人，聊到大家一起做对社会有益的事，这时就会用到 social good。
social good.translation: 朋友：你在小区设的回收箱是干嘛的 你：收旧衣服捐给山区 也算做点 social good 朋友：这想法不错 我家也有一堆旧衣服 你：对 明天拿下来一起捐
social good.example: Friend: What is that donation box you put in the neighbourhood for? You: Collecting old clothes for mountain areas, doing some social good. Friend: Nice idea, I have a pile of old clothes at home. You: Right, bring them down tomorrow and donate them too.

social harmony.context: 你在国外观察到这里邻里之间客气友善、公共场所排队有序，朋友说这就是社会和谐的日常体现，这时就会用到 social harmony。
social harmony.translation: 朋友：你在国外感觉怎么样 你：大家排队都不挤 邻里也客气 朋友：这种 social harmony 看着就舒服 你：是啊 公共场所很少有人吵架
social harmony.example: Friend: How do you like living abroad? You: People queue without shoving, and neighbours are polite. Friend: That social harmony just feels nice. You: Right, you rarely see people arguing in public.

social influencer.context: 你刷到一个博主推荐的护肤品特别好用，评论里一堆人跟着买，朋友说这种网上有影响力的人带货能力很强，这时就会用到 social influencer。
social influencer.translation: 朋友：你买的那个面霜真好用吗 你：是一个 social influencer 推荐的 评论好多人跟买 朋友：她粉丝多 带货能力确实强 你：对 一条帖子能带爆一个单品
social influencer.example: Friend: Is that face cream you bought actually good? You: A social influencer recommended it, and tons of people bought it. Friend: She has so many followers, her selling power is strong. You: Right, one post can make a product sell out.

social interaction.context: 新生入学时，老师组织大家做破冰游戏，通过互动让彼此熟悉，聊到人与人之间双向的交流，这时就会用到 social interaction。
social interaction.translation: 朋友：开学第一周都干嘛了 你：天天做破冰游戏 互相认识 朋友：这种 social interaction 能帮你快速交朋友 你：对 一周下来全班都能叫出名字了
social interaction.example: Friend: What did you do the first week of term? You: Icebreaker games every day to get to know each other. Friend: That social interaction helps you make friends fast. You: Right, after a week I can name the whole class.

social isolation.context: 你刚到新城市没朋友，周末一个人逛街看电影，时间长了觉得心里空落落的，朋友劝你别把自己封闭起来，这时就会用到 social isolation。
social isolation.translation: 朋友：你来这边三个月了 周末都怎么过 你：一个人看电影逛街 有点 social isolation 朋友：这样久了会抑郁 出去认识点人 你：我这周末去个兴趣班试试
social isolation.example: Friend: You have been here three months, what do you do on weekends? You: Watch movies and shop alone, I feel some social isolation. Friend: That leads to depression, go meet people. You: I will try a hobby class this weekend.

social jet lag.context: 你周一到周五早睡早起，周末却熬夜到凌晨、中午才起，结果周一更累，医生说这叫社交时差，这时就会用到 social jet lag。
social jet lag.translation: 朋友：你周一早上怎么那么困 你：周末熬到两点才睡 中午才起 朋友：你这是 social jet lag 作息差太多了 你：是啊 比出差倒时差还难受
social jet lag.example: Friend: Why are you so sleepy on Monday morning? You: I stayed up till two on the weekend and slept till noon. Friend: That is social jet lag, your schedule flipped too much. You: Yeah, worse than jet lag from a trip.

social jetlag.context: 你周末熬夜追剧，周日中午才起，周一早上闹钟响时整个人昏昏沉沉，朋友说这就是作息颠倒造成的周末时差，这时就会用到 social jetlag。
social jetlag.translation: 朋友：你周一早上怎么起不来 你：周末熬夜追剧 中午才起床 朋友：这种 social jetlag 周一最难受 你：对 周日晚上躺床上根本睡不着
social jetlag.example: Friend: Why can you not get up on Monday? You: I binged shows till late on the weekend and got up at noon. Friend: This social jetlag makes Monday the worst day. You: Tell me about it, I cannot fall asleep Sunday night.

social life.context: 你周末不是聚会就是约饭，工作日却天天吃外卖，朋友说你这社交生活也太丰富了，这时就会用到 social life。
social life.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么排这么满 你：又是聚会又是约饭 朋友：你这 social life 也太丰富了吧 你：哈哈 工作日都宅 周末集中社交呗
social life.example: Friend: Why is your weekend so packed? You: Parties and dinners back to back. Friend: Your social life is incredibly full. You: Haha, I stay in all week and pack the social stuff into weekends.

social lives.context: 你和同事们下班后各自有约，有人健身有人聚会，朋友说大家下班后的生活都挺多彩，这时就会用到 social lives。
social lives.translation: 朋友：你们同事下班都干嘛 你：有的健身 有的聚会 都挺充实 朋友：大家的 social lives 真丰富 你：对 不像我以前下班就回家躺
social lives.example: Friend: What do your coworkers do after work? You: Some work out, some party, all quite full. Friend: Their social lives are really rich. You: Right, not like me before, I went straight home to lie down.

social media.context: 你每天醒来第一件事就是刷短视频，吃饭也刷，睡前还刷，朋友劝你少看点社交媒体，这时就会用到 social media。
social media.translation: 朋友：你怎么吃饭都在刷手机 你：习惯了 一睁眼就刷 social media 朋友：你刷得太久了 伤眼睛也浪费时间 你：是 我得控制每天刷手机的时间
social media.example: Friend: Why are you scrolling your phone even during meals? You: Out of habit, the first thing I do is check social media. Friend: You use it way too much, it hurts your eyes and wastes time. You: True, I should limit my daily scrolling.

social media accounts.context: 你注册了好几个社交平台账号，微信、小红书、微博都有，朋友问你怎么管理这么多账号，这时就会用到 social media accounts。
social media accounts.translation: 朋友：你手机里装了几个社交软件 你：微信 小红书 微博 好几个 social media accounts 朋友：你切换过来不累吗 你：习惯了 每个平台发不一样的内容
social media accounts.example: Friend: How many social apps do you have on your phone? You: WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, several social media accounts. Friend: Is switching between them not tiring? You: I am used to it, I post different content on each.

social media addict.context: 你发现自己一天不刷手机就焦虑，总怕错过什么，朋友说你这是社交媒体成瘾了，劝你戒一戒，这时就会用到 social media addict。
social media addict.translation: 朋友：你每隔十分钟就看一次手机 你：总怕错过朋友的消息 朋友：你都快成 social media addict 了 得戒一戒 你：是 我今晚开始把通知全关掉
social media addict.example: Friend: You check your phone every ten minutes. You: I am afraid of missing messages from friends. Friend: You are turning into a social media addict, you need a break. You: True, I will turn off all notifications tonight.

social media feeds.context: 你早上一睁眼就刷朋友圈和短视频，刷着刷着半小时过去了，朋友笑你天天被动态牵着走，这时就会用到 social media feeds。
