social media feeds.translation: 朋友：你早上几点醒的 怎么一直在刷手机 你：一睁眼就刷 social media feeds 半小时过去了 朋友：你每天被动态牵着走 该出门了 你：好 我马上起来洗漱
social media feeds.example: Friend: When did you wake up, why are you still scrolling? You: The moment I woke up I scrolled my social media feeds, half an hour gone. Friend: You are ruled by feeds all day, time to get up. You: Okay, I will go wash up now.

social media influencer.context: 你关注的一个博主粉丝几百万，发一条广告就有无数人购买，朋友说这种人在网上影响力特别大，这时就会用到 social media influencer。
social media influencer.translation: 朋友：你关注的那个博主真能带货 你：她一条帖子发出去 评论全是求链接 朋友：这就是 social media influencer 的威力 你：对 她推荐什么我都忍不住下单
social media influencer.example: Friend: That blogger you follow really moves products. You: The moment she posts, the comments beg for links. Friend: That is the power of a social media influencer. You: Right, I cannot resist buying whatever she recommends.

social media platform.context: 你想和国外朋友联系，纠结用微信还是用别的软件，朋友说不同国家用的平台不一样，这时就会用到 social media platform。
social media platform.translation: 朋友：你跟国外朋友用什么聊天 你：他在英国 用什么 social media platform 呢 朋友：他们大多用 Instagram 和 WhatsApp 你：好 我也注册一个账号
social media platform.example: Friend: How do you chat with your friend abroad? You: He is in the UK, which social media platform should I use? Friend: They mostly use Instagram and WhatsApp. You: Okay, I will sign up for an account too.

social mobility.context: 你看到新闻里说农村孩子通过读书考上好大学、进大城市工作，朋友说这是阶层之间的流动，这时就会用到 social mobility。
social mobility.translation: 朋友：那个村子今年考了好几个大学生 你：靠读书走出大山 朋友：这就是 social mobility 知识改变命运 你：是啊 一代人努力全家翻身
social mobility.example: Friend: That village sent several kids to good university this year. You: They walked out of the mountains through studying. Friend: That is social mobility, education changes fate. You: Right, one generation's effort lifts the whole family.

social network.context: 你刚到一个新班级，一个人都不认识，朋友说别怕，慢慢就会建立起自己的人际关系网，这时就会用到 social network。
social network.translation: 朋友：新班级你都认识谁了 你：一个都不认识 有点慌 朋友：别急 慢慢会建起自己的 social network 你：希望这周能交到一个同桌朋友
social network.example: Friend: Who do you know in the new class? You: Nobody yet, I am a bit nervous. Friend: Do not worry, you will slowly build your own social network. You: I hope I make a desk-mate friend this week.

social norms.context: 你在公共场合大声打电话，旁边人都皱眉看你，朋友小声提醒你注意素质，聊到社会上默认的行为规范，这时就会用到 social norms。
social norms.translation: 朋友：你打电话声音小点 旁边人都看呢 你：哦不好意思 没注意 朋友：在公共场合小声说话是 social norms 你：好 我出去走廊打
social norms.example: Friend: Keep your voice down on the phone, people are staring. You: Oh sorry, I did not notice. Friend: Speaking softly in public is one of the social norms. You: Okay, I will go out to the hallway to talk.

social obligations.context: 年底你被各种聚餐、拜年、随礼忙得团团转，朋友吐槽现代人的社交负担真重，这时就会用到 social obligations。
social obligations.translation: 朋友：年底你怎么天天往外跑 你：又要聚餐又要随礼 各种 social obligations 朋友：光红包都得准备好几个 你：是啊 这个月钱包特别瘪
social obligations.example: Friend: Why are you out every day at year end? You: Dinners and gift money, all kinds of social obligations. Friend: You have to prepare several red envelopes alone. You: Right, my wallet is really thin this month.

social occasion.context: 你被邀请参加朋友的婚礼，纠结穿什么衣服才得体，朋友说这种正式聚会场合有专门的着装要求，这时就会用到 social occasion。
social occasion.translation: 朋友：下周六朋友婚礼你穿什么去 你：我还在想 这种 social occasion 不能太随意 朋友：穿件衬衫西裤就挺得体 你：行 我去买件新衬衫
social occasion.example: Friend: What will you wear to the friend's wedding next Saturday? You: I am still thinking, on a social occasion like this I cannot dress too casually. Friend: A shirt and trousers would be just right. You: Okay, I will buy a new shirt.

social overload.context: 你周末被安排了四个局，连轴转下来感觉脑子嗡嗡的，朋友说你这是社交太多超负荷了，这时就会用到 social overload。
social overload.translation: 朋友：你这周末排了几个局 你：早中晚四个 连轴转 朋友：这是 social overload 得歇一天 你：周一我得在家躺到中午补回来
social overload.example: Friend: How many meetups do you have this weekend? You: Four, morning noon and night, back to back. Friend: That is social overload, you need a rest day. You: On Monday I will stay in bed till noon to recover.

social perception.context: 面试时老板说他特别看重员工读人眼色、察言观色的能力，聊到这种对他人情绪的判断力，这时就会用到 social perception。
social perception.translation: 朋友：今天面试都问了啥 你：老板说他看重 social perception 会察言观色 朋友：这种能力比硬技能还重要 你：是啊 做客户工作特别需要
social perception.example: Friend: What did they ask in today's interview? You: The boss said he values social perception, reading people's moods. Friend: That matters even more than hard skills. You: Right, client work needs it a lot.

social skill.context: 你家孩子刚上幼儿园很怕生，不爱跟小朋友玩，老师建议多带他参加集体活动培养社交能力，这时就会用到 social skill。
social skill.translation: 朋友：你家孩子上幼儿园适应得怎样 你：他不太敢跟别的小朋友玩 朋友：多陪他练 social skill 慢慢就放开了 你：我周末带他去游乐场跟孩子多玩
social skill.example: Friend: How is your kid settling into kindergarten? You: He is too shy to play with the other children. Friend: Practise his social skill more, he will open up slowly. You: I will take him to the playground to play with other kids this weekend.

social support.context: 你一个人在外地生病住院，爸妈打钱过来还天天视频关心你，朋友说有人惦记就是最大的支持，这时就会用到 social support。
social support.translation: 朋友：你生病住院有人照顾吗 你：我一个人在外地 但爸妈天天视频陪我 朋友：这种 social support 比什么都强 你：是啊 有家人惦记就不害怕
social support.example: Friend: Is there someone taking care of you in hospital? You: I am alone in this city, but my parents video call me every day. Friend: That social support means more than anything. You: Right, with family caring I do not feel scared.

social tie.context: 你在新公司有一个关系特别铁的同事，午饭一起吃、加班一起扛，朋友说这种牢靠的关系特别难得，这时就会用到 social tie。
social tie.translation: 朋友：你在新公司交到好朋友了吗 你：有个同事跟我特别铁 午饭一起吃 朋友：这种 social tie 在工作里很珍贵 你：对 我俩加班都互相带饭
social tie.example: Friend: Have you made any good friends at the new job? You: There is one coworker I am really close to, we have lunch together. Friend: A social tie like that is precious at work. You: Right, we even bring each other food when we work late.

social time.context: 你发现自己一周到晚都在忙工作，完全没留时间跟朋友见面，朋友说你得专门留出社交时间，这时就会用到 social time。
social time.translation: 朋友：你这两周怎么都不约我了 你：工作太忙 一点 social time 都没留 朋友：再忙也得挤时间见朋友啊 你：行 这周五晚上我们吃个饭
social time.example: Friend: Why have you not asked me out these two weeks? You: Work is so busy I have not set aside any social time. Friend: No matter how busy you must squeeze time for friends. You: Okay, let us have dinner this Friday night.

social welfare.context: 你看到新闻里说政府建了更多平价养老院、给老人发补贴，聊到社会提供给弱势群体的保障，这时就会用到 social welfare。
social welfare.translation: 朋友：新闻里说新建了好多养老院 你：这就是 social welfare 让老人有地方去 朋友：有了这些老人晚年才安稳 你：是啊 社会福利越来越完善了
social welfare.example: Friend: The news says they built lots of new nursing homes. You: That is social welfare, giving the elderly a place to go. Friend: With that, old people have a secure later life. You: Right, the welfare system keeps improving.

socially attractive.context: 你在班里特别受欢迎，谁有困难都愿意找你帮忙，同学说你人缘真好，这时就会用到 socially attractive。
socially attractive.translation: 朋友：你怎么全班都跟你合得来 你：可能我比较会听人说话吧 朋友：你就是 socially attractive 大家都喜欢靠近你 你：哈哈 互相帮忙嘛
socially attractive.example: Friend: Why does everyone in class get along with you? You: Maybe because I am a good listener. Friend: You are just socially attractive, everyone wants to be near you. You: Haha, we just help each other out.

socially conscious.context: 你买东西时会特意选环保包装的产品，看到浪费食物的新闻会难过，朋友说你是个有社会责任感的人，这时就会用到 socially conscious。
socially conscious.translation: 朋友：你买东西怎么都看包装环不环保 你：我不想浪费 能选环保的就选 朋友：你是真的 socially conscious 朋友都该学学 你：举手之劳嘛 能少污染一点是一点
socially conscious.example: Friend: Why do you check whether the packaging is eco-friendly when shopping? You: I do not want to waste, I pick the green option when I can. Friend: You are truly socially conscious, others should learn. You: It is a small effort, less pollution is better.

societal pressure.context: 你发现身边年轻人为了买房掏空六个钱包，社会普遍焦虑，朋友聊到这种无形的社会压力，这时就会用到 societal pressure。
societal pressure.translation: 朋友：现在年轻人买房压力真大 你：掏空家里六个钱包还得还贷 朋友：这就是 societal pressure 不买房好像失败 你：是啊 大家都被推着往前跑
societal pressure.example: Friend: The pressure on young people to buy a flat is huge now. You: They drain six family wallets and still pay a mortgage. Friend: That is societal pressure, not buying feels like failing. You: Right, everyone is being pushed forward.

socioeconomic group.context: 做问卷调查时把受访者按收入和职业分成几类统计，老师说这是在按社会经济阶层分析数据，这时就会用到 socioeconomic group。
socioeconomic group.translation: 朋友：你问卷结果怎么分类统计 你：按收入和职业分成不同 socioeconomic group 朋友：这样能看出不同群体的差异 你：对 白领和学生答案差别很大
socioeconomic group.example: Friend: How are you grouping your survey results? You: By income and job into different socioeconomic groups. Friend: That shows the differences across groups. You: Right, white-collar workers and students answer very differently.

soft drink.context: 朋友聚餐时点饮料，有人点啤酒有人点果汁，你问服务员有没有不含酒精的饮品，这时就会用到 soft drink。
soft drink.translation: 朋友：大家想喝点什么 你：我不喝酒 给我来杯 soft drink 吧 朋友：那你点橙汁还是可乐 你：要杯鲜橙汁 解腻又健康
soft drink.example: Friend: What does everyone want to drink? You: I do not drink alcohol, get me a soft drink please. Friend: Orange juice or cola? You: Fresh orange juice, refreshing and healthy.

soft skill.context: 找工作时你发现除了专业技能，公司还看重沟通、协作这些软能力，朋友提醒你简历里也要写上，这时就会用到 soft skill。
soft skill.translation: 朋友：你简历除了写软件操作 还写了啥 你：就写了技术相关的证书 朋友：你得补点 soft skill 比如团队沟通 你：对 我加上跨部门协作这一项
soft skill.example: Friend: Besides software skills, what else is on your CV? You: Just the technical certificates. Friend: You need to add some soft skill, like team communication. You: Right, I will add cross-department collaboration.

soften the blow.context: 你被公司裁员心里很难受，领导在通知你时语气特别温和、还给你写了推荐信，朋友说他这是在尽量减轻坏消息对你的打击，这时就会用到 soften the blow。
soften the blow.translation: 朋友：今天公司找你谈什么了 你：说这个项目要裁员 轮到我了 朋友：领导怎么说的 你：他语气特别温和 还帮我写推荐信 尽量 soften the blow 朋友：他人不错 你也别太难过
soften the blow.example: Friend: What did the company talk to you about today? You: They said the project is cutting staff, and I am on the list. Friend: How did the manager put it? You: His tone was really gentle, and he even wrote me a reference, trying to soften the blow. Friend: He is a decent guy, do not take it too hard.

solar flare.context: 你刷新闻看到说太阳爆发了一次强烈耀斑，可能影响手机信号和电网，朋友跟你聊起这个天文现象，这时就会用到 solar flare。
solar flare.translation: 朋友：今天手机信号怎么时有时无 你：新闻说太阳爆发了一次 solar flare 朋友：耀斑还能影响手机信号吗 你：对 它会干扰电网和卫星 这两天先别坐太靠窗户
solar flare.example: Friend: Why does the phone signal keep cutting out today? You: The news says the sun erupted with a solar flare. Friend: Can a solar flare really affect phone signals? You: Yes, it disturbs the grid and satellites, stay away from windows for two days.

solar panel.context: 你家屋顶装了几块太阳能板，夏天发的电自己用还能卖给电网，朋友来参观问起，这时就会用到 solar panel。
solar panel.translation: 朋友：你家电费怎么这个月才二十块 你：我屋顶装了 solar panel 自己发电自己用 朋友：那夏天是不是还能多发电卖回去 你：对 有余电就卖给电网 挺划算
solar panel.example: Friend: Why is your electricity bill only twenty yuan this month? You: I put solar panels on the roof, I generate my own power. Friend: So in summer you can sell the extra back to the grid? You: Right, any surplus goes back, it pays off.

solar power.context: 你家乡建了一片风力和太阳能发电站，不再靠烧煤，朋友带你去看，聊到清洁能源，这时就会用到 solar power。
solar power.translation: 朋友：你家那边的天空怎么这么蓝 你：我们建了 solar power 和风力发电 不再烧煤 朋友：那空气好太多了 电费也便宜吧 你：对 清洁能源既干净又划算
solar power.example: Friend: Why is the sky so blue where you live? You: We built solar power and wind stations, no more burning coal. Friend: Then the air is much cleaner, and electricity is cheaper too? You: Right, clean energy is both green and affordable.

solar system.context: 晚上你带孩子在楼顶用望远镜看星星，孩子问天上有几大行星，你给他讲太阳和绕它转的行星组成的系统，这时就会用到 solar system。
solar system.translation: 朋友：你昨晚带孩子干嘛去了 你：在楼顶用望远镜看星星 朋友：他看得懂吗 你：我给他讲了 solar system 有几大行星 他特别入迷
solar system.example: Friend: What did you and the kid do last night? You: We watched the stars on the roof with a telescope. Friend: Can he understand? You: I explained the solar system and how many planets there are, he was hooked.

sold on.context: 你听朋友说新开的咖啡店氛围特别好，试了一次觉得确实不错，你跟朋友说你完全认同他的推荐，这时就会用到 sold on。
sold on.translation: 朋友：上次我推荐的那家咖啡店你去了吗 你：去了 真的很好喝 我彻底 sold on 他家豆子 朋友：我就说吧 他家手冲特别香 你：对 我这周末还想去再喝一杯
sold on.example: Friend: Did you try that coffee shop I recommended? You: I did, it tastes great, I am totally sold on their beans. Friend: I told you, their pour-over smells amazing. You: Right, I want to go back again this weekend.

soldier on.context: 你生病发烧到三十九度还坚持去上班，同事劝你回家休息，你说手头的活不能丢，硬撑着把活干完，这时就会用到 soldier on。
soldier on.translation: 朋友：你都烧到三十九度了 还去上班 你：手头项目今天必须交 我得 soldier on 把它干完 朋友：你不要命了 干完赶紧回家睡觉 你：行 交完这版我立刻走
soldier on.example: Friend: You have a 39-degree fever and still go to work? You: The project is due today, I have to soldier on and finish it. Friend: You are crazy, go home to sleep the moment you submit. You: Okay, I will leave right after this version.

solid basics.context: 你帮妈妈收拾衣柜，发现她衣橱里全是白T、牛仔裤这种百搭基础款，朋友说这种实用款最容易穿，这时就会用到 solid basics。
solid basics.translation: 朋友：你妈妈的衣服怎么全是白T和牛仔裤 你：她不爱赶时髦 只买 solid basics 朋友：这种基础款确实好搭配 怎么穿都不出错 你：对 她一件白T能穿五年
solid basics.example: Friend: Why are your mom's clothes all white tees and jeans? You: She does not chase trends, she only buys solid basics. Friend: Those basics are so easy to pair, you cannot go wrong. You: Right, one white tee lasts her five years.

solid state battery.context: 你看新闻说某车企发布了新一代电池，充电更快还更安全，老师讲这是和传统液态电池不同的新技术，这时就会用到 solid state battery。
solid state battery.translation: 朋友：你看新闻没 这车电池真能十分钟充满 你：它用的是 solid state battery 跟以前的不一样 朋友：那是不是更安全不起火 你：对 技术上进步很大
solid state battery.example: Friend: Did you see the news, the car battery charges in ten minutes? You: It uses a solid state battery, totally different from before. Friend: So it is safer and does not catch fire? You: Right, big leap in the tech.

solo play.context: 学校新年晚会上，有个同学上台弹了一首钢琴曲独奏，全场鼓掌，朋友说这是他第一次单独表演，这时就会用到 solo play。
solo play.translation: 朋友：晚会上那个弹钢琴的是谁 你：是我们班同学 他那段 solo play 特别惊艳 朋友：一个人弹整场不紧张吗 你：他练了半年 弹得特别稳
solo play.example: Friend: Who was that piano player at the New Year party? You: A classmate, his solo play was really stunning. Friend: Is he not nervous playing alone on stage? You: He practised for half a year, he played so steadily.

solo traveller.context: 你一个人订机票去云南玩，朋友担心你一个人不安全，你说你就喜欢独自旅行的自在，这时就会用到 solo traveller。
solo traveller.translation: 朋友：你一个人去云南玩不害怕吗 你：我当 solo traveller 好多年了 一个人特别自由 朋友：那路上吃饭住宿怎么办 你：走到哪儿算哪儿 想停就停
solo traveller.example: Friend: Are you not scared travelling to Yunnan alone? You: I have been a solo traveller for years, being alone is so free. Friend: How do you handle food and lodging? You: Just go with the flow, stop whenever I like.

some kind of.context: 你在国外餐厅点菜，看不懂菜单，随便指了一个听起来像鸡肉的菜，朋友问你点的什么，你说也不知道，就某种鸡肉菜，这时就会用到 some kind of。
some kind of.translation: 朋友：你点的这道菜叫什么 你：我也看不懂菜单 随便点了 some kind of 鸡肉 朋友：味道怎么样 你：还行 就是不知道里面放了啥
some kind of.example: Friend: What is the dish you ordered called? You: I cannot read the menu, I just ordered some kind of chicken. Friend: How does it taste? You: Okay, I just have no idea what is in it.

some sort of.context: 你半夜听到楼下有奇怪的声响，叫醒朋友说好像有什么动静，朋友披衣起来看，发现是猫打翻了东西，这时就会用到 some sort of。
some sort of.translation: 朋友：大半夜你叫我干嘛 你：楼下好像有 some sort of 响声 怪吓人的 朋友：我去看看 你：小心点 别摔着
some sort of.example: Friend: Why did you wake me up in the middle of the night? You: There was some sort of noise downstairs, it sounded scary. Friend: I will go check. You: Be careful, do not fall.

some time ago.context: 你跟朋友聊起小时候常去的那家老冰棍店，朋友说那店早就关门了，你回忆说那都是很久以前的事了，这时就会用到 some time ago。
some time ago.translation: 朋友：你还记得小学门口那家老冰棍店吗 你：记得啊 不过那是 some time ago 的事了 朋友：听说那店三年前就关门了 你：是啊 现在想吃都找不到了
some time ago.example: Friend: Do you remember that old popsicle shop by your primary school? You: Of course, but that was some time ago. Friend: I heard it closed three years ago. You: Right, now I cannot even find one.

some way off.context: 你问朋友地铁站还有多远，朋友说看路牌显示还有一公里，估计还要走十分钟，这时就会用到 some way off。
some way off.translation: 朋友：地铁站快到了吧 你：路牌显示还有一公里 还 some way off 呢 朋友：那我们加快脚步 别赶不上末班车 你：行 我拉着你跑两步
some way off.example: Friend: Is the metro station almost there? You: The sign says one kilometre to go, it is still some way off. Friend: Then let us hurry, or we miss the last train. You: Okay, I will jog with you a bit.

sooner rather than later.context: 你体检发现血脂偏高，医生劝你赶紧开始控制饮食，别拖到出问题才行动，朋友也劝你早点开始，这时就会用到 sooner rather than later。
sooner rather than later.translation: 朋友：医生怎么说你血脂的事 你：让我赶紧控制饮食 别拖 朋友：确实 这种事越早开始越好 你：你说得对 我就 sooner rather than later 从明天开始清淡吃饭 朋友：行 我陪你一起少油少盐
sooner rather than later.example: Friend: What did the doctor say about your cholesterol? You: He told me to start watching my diet right away, do not wait. Friend: Right, the earlier the better. You: You are right, I will do it sooner rather than later and eat light starting tomorrow. Friend: Good, I will join you in cutting oil and salt.

soothing effect.context: 你跑完步喝了杯热牛奶，朋友说温牛奶能让人放松、帮助入睡，聊到它的舒缓效果，这时就会用到 soothing effect。
soothing effect.translation: 朋友：你跑完步怎么不喝运动饮料 你：我喝了杯热牛奶 有 soothing effect 能放松 朋友：那睡前喝是不是更好 你：对 晚上喝一杯特别好睡
soothing effect.example: Friend: Why not a sports drink after your run? You: I had warm milk, it has a soothing effect and relaxes me. Friend: Is it even better before bed? You: Right, a cup at night helps me sleep really well.

sore throat.context: 你感冒了嗓子疼得说不出话，朋友约你去唱歌，你摆手说嗓子不行，朋友让你多喝温水，这时就会用到 sore throat。
sore throat.translation: 朋友：周末去唱歌吧 你：去不了 我感冒了 嗓子疼得厉害 朋友：sore throat 那你多喝温水 少说话 你：行 等我好了再约
sore throat.example: Friend: Let us go karaoke this weekend. You: Cannot, I have a cold and a really bad sore throat. Friend: A sore throat, then drink warm water and rest your voice. You: Okay, let us reschedule when I am better.

sore thumb.context: 你穿了一身亮黄色外套走进全是黑西装的会场，朋友笑着说你在人群里特别显眼，这时就会用到 sore thumb。
sore thumb.translation: 朋友：你今天穿这件黄外套太扎眼了 你：怎么了 不好看吗 朋友：一屋子黑西装 你跟个 sore thumb 一样 大家都看你 你：哈哈 我就是想显眼一点
sore thumb.example: Friend: That bright yellow jacket is really eye-catching today. You: Why, does it not look good? Friend: In a room of black suits you stand out like a sore thumb, everyone stares. You: Haha, I wanted to be noticed.

sort of.context: 你被问周末想干嘛，犹豫了一下说好像想去看个电影，朋友说那就去吧，这时就会用到 sort of。
sort of.translation: 朋友：周末你想干嘛 看电影还是逛街 你：我 sort of 想看个新上的电影 朋友：那就去看呗 几点那场 你：下午三点那场吧
sort of.example: Friend: What do you want this weekend, a movie or shopping? You: I sort of want to see that new film. Friend: Then let us go, which showing? You: The three o'clock afternoon one.

sort through.context: 你周末在家整理抽屉，把一堆旧票据和小物件分类扔掉，朋友问你在干嘛，你说在收拾东西，这时就会用到 sort through。
sort through.translation: 朋友：你周末蹲地上翻什么呢 你：sort through 抽屉里的旧票据 该扔的扔 朋友：收拾完客厅一下子清爽了吧 你：对 扔了三大袋垃圾
sort through.example: Friend: What are you doing squatting on the floor this weekend? You: Sorting through the old receipts in the drawer, throwing out what I do not need. Friend: The living room looks so much cleaner now. You: Right, I tossed three bags of junk.

sound awareness.context: 幼儿园老师做活动，训练小朋友分辨声音、听声音认动物，聊到对声音的敏感度，这时就会用到 sound awareness。
sound awareness.translation: 朋友：今天幼儿园都做什么游戏了 你：老师教小朋友听声音辨动物 练 sound awareness 朋友：这种训练对孩子听力有好处 你：是啊 孩子们玩得特别开心
sound awareness.example: Friend: What games did the kindergarten do today? You: The teacher trained the kids to identify animals by sound, building sound awareness. Friend: That kind of training helps their hearing. You: Right, the kids had so much fun.

sound barrier.context: 你看纪录片说飞机飞得足够快就能突破音障，发出一声巨响，朋友问什么是音障，这时就会用到 sound barrier。
sound barrier.translation: 朋友：刚才那声巨响是飞机吗 你：对 飞机突破 sound barrier 时会产生音爆 朋友：音障是什么意思 你：就是飞机速度超过声音时那道坎
sound barrier.example: Friend: Was that loud boom from a plane? You: Yes, the plane broke the sound barrier and made a sonic boom. Friend: What does the sound barrier mean? You: It is the threshold when a plane outruns the speed of sound.

sound sensitivity.context: 你发现自己对办公室的嗡嗡声特别敏感，别人没事你却烦躁得不行，医生说这是对声音过度敏感，这时就会用到 sound sensitivity。
sound sensitivity.translation: 朋友：你怎么一进办公室就皱眉头 你：那空调的嗡嗡声让我特别烦躁 朋友：你这是 sound sensitivity 太敏感了 得戴耳塞试试 你：行 我买副隔音耳塞
sound sensitivity.example: Friend: Why do you frown the moment you walk into the office? You: That hum of the AC makes me really irritable. Friend: That is sound sensitivity, you are too sensitive, try earplugs. You: Okay, I will buy a pair of noise-cancelling ones.

sound system.context: 朋友来你家看球，你把客厅的音响开到最大，朋友说你家这套设备效果跟电影院一样，这时就会用到 sound system。
sound system.translation: 朋友：你家看球声音怎么这么震撼 你：我装了一套 sound system 跟电影院似的 朋友：那周末在你家看球赛太爽了 你：对 我还买了大投影幕布
sound system.example: Friend: Why is watching the match at your place so immersive? You: I set up a sound system just like a cinema. Friend: Then watching games at your place on weekends is perfect. You: Right, I also bought a big projection screen.

sounds like.context: 朋友学了几句中文发语音给你，你听了觉得发音特别标准，问他是不是在国外长大的中国人，这时就会用到 sounds like。
sounds like.translation: 朋友：我刚学了几句中文 你听听 你：发音好标准啊 sounds like 你是母语者 朋友：哈哈 我就跟着语音软件反复练 你：难怪 真听不出口音
sounds like.example: Friend: I just learned a few lines of Chinese, listen. You: Your pronunciation is so standard, you sound like a native. Friend: Haha, I just practised with the app on repeat. You: No wonder, I cannot hear any accent.

sovereign state.context: 上政治课老师讲，一个国家要有自己独立的政府和领土才算主权国家，朋友问什么是主权国家，这时就会用到 sovereign state。
sovereign state.translation: 朋友：政治课今天讲什么了 你：讲什么才算一个 sovereign state 主权国家 朋友：得有自己的领土和政府吗 你：对 国际上承认才算数
sovereign state.example: Friend: What did politics class cover today? You: What makes a sovereign state. Friend: So it needs its own territory and government? You: Right, and international recognition to count.

soya milk.context: 你早上买早餐，想点豆浆，店员问要牛奶还是豆奶，你说你乳糖不耐，要豆奶，这时就会用到 soya milk。
soya milk.translation: 朋友：早餐你要喝什么 豆浆还是咖啡 你：我乳糖不耐 给我来杯 soya milk 朋友：那配个包子吧 你：行 再来个青菜包
soya milk.example: Friend: What do you want for breakfast, soy milk or coffee? You: I am lactose intolerant, give me a cup of soya milk. Friend: Then have a steamed bun with it. You: Okay, one veggie bun too.

space debris removal.context: 你看新闻说科学家在研究怎么清理太空里飘着的废弃卫星和火箭残骸，聊到太空垃圾清理，这时就会用到 space debris removal。
space debris removal.translation: 朋友：新闻说天上飘着好多废弃卫星 你：对 科学家在研究 space debris removal 怎么清 朋友：这些碎片撞坏正常卫星就麻烦了 你：是啊 太空垃圾越来越多
space debris removal.example: Friend: The news says there are loads of dead satellites drifting up there. You: Right, scientists are researching space debris removal. Friend: It is trouble if the fragments hit working satellites. You: Yeah, space junk keeps piling up.

space expedition.context: 孩子学校布置了一篇关于太空的作文，问你人能不能去别的星球旅行，你跟他聊起星际探险的梦想，这时就会用到 space expedition。
space expedition.translation: 朋友：你家孩子今天作文写什么 你：写了一次 space expedition 去火星旅行 朋友：现在孩子想象力真丰富 你：对啊 他说长大要当宇航员
space expedition.example: Friend: What did your kid write for today's essay? You: He wrote about a space expedition travelling to Mars. Friend: Kids these days have such rich imaginations. You: Right, he says he wants to be an astronaut when he grows up.

space exploration.context: 你看纪录片讲人类发射探测器去火星，聊到人类探索宇宙的努力，这时就会用到 space exploration。
space exploration.translation: 朋友：你最近看什么纪录片呢 你：讲人类 space exploration 从第一颗卫星到火星车 朋友：几十年前谁能想到能上火星 你：是啊 科技发展太快了
space exploration.example: Friend: What documentary are you watching these days? You: It covers human space exploration, from the first satellite to the Mars rover. Friend: Decades ago nobody imagined we could reach Mars. You: Right, tech is moving so fast.

space junk.context: 你看科普视频说地球轨道上飘着几千块废弃零件和旧电池，老师说这就是太空垃圾，这时就会用到 space junk。
space junk.translation: 朋友：你看那个科普视频了吗 天上飘着好多废零件 你：那就是 space junk 旧卫星和火箭残骸 朋友：这么多垃圾以后发射飞船都危险 你：是啊 得想办法清一清
space junk.example: Friend: Did you see that science video, loads of dead parts drifting in orbit? You: That is space junk, old satellites and rocket bits. Friend: With that much junk, future launches get risky. You: Right, we have to find a way to clean it up.

space mission.context: 新闻说某国又发射了一个探测器去月球背面，聊到这次任务要做什么，这时就会用到 space mission。
space mission.translation: 朋友：今天新闻说又有个飞船上天了 你：是去月球背面的一次 space mission 朋友：这次要做什么特别的事吗 你：要在那边放一个观测站
space mission.example: Friend: The news says another spacecraft launched today. You: It is a space mission to the far side of the moon. Friend: Is it doing anything special there? You: It will set up an observation station over there.

space race.context: 历史课讲上世纪两个超级大国比着发卫星、送宇航员，朋友问那段时间叫什么，这时就会用到 space race。
space race.translation: 朋友：历史课讲美苏那段比着上天的事 你：对 那就是 space race 太空竞赛 朋友：结果美国人先登上了月球 你：是啊 那段时间技术突飞猛进
space race.example: Friend: History class covered that USA vs USSR space race. You: Right, that was the space race. Friend: The Americans got to the moon first. You: Yeah, tech leapt forward back then.

space sickness.context: 你坐飞船模拟机时刚起飞就头晕恶心，朋友说这是宇航员刚上太空会有的太空眩晕，这时就会用到 space sickness。
space sickness.translation: 朋友：你刚才坐模拟机怎么脸色发白 你：刚一起飞就头晕恶心 朋友：那就是 space sickness 宇航员刚开始都这样 你：我连地球模拟器都受不了 还当什么宇航员
space sickness.example: Friend: Why did you go pale in the simulator just now? You: I felt dizzy and sick the moment it took off. Friend: That is space sickness, astronauts feel that at first. You: I cannot even handle a simulator, forget being an astronaut.

space vehicle.context: 你看科幻片里各种飞船和探测器，朋友问这些飞行器在专业上叫什么，这时就会用到 space vehicle。
space vehicle.translation: 朋友：电影里那些能飞的探测器真帅 你：专业上叫 space vehicle 航天器 朋友：跟普通飞机有啥区别 你：它是冲出大气层在外层空间飞的
space vehicle.example: Friend: Those probes in the movie look so cool. You: Officially they are a space vehicle. Friend: How are they different from planes? You: They leave the atmosphere and fly in outer space.

spacecraft wreckage.context: 新闻说失联的卫星残骸掉在了大海里，救援队在海上搜寻残骸碎片，这时就会用到 spacecraft wreckage。
spacecraft wreckage.translation: 朋友：今天海上怎么那么多救援船 你：在找一颗失控卫星的 spacecraft wreckage 朋友：那些碎片掉海里危险吗 你：只要不掉到居民区就没事
spacecraft wreckage.example: Friend: Why are there so many rescue boats out at sea today? You: They are searching for the spacecraft wreckage of a lost satellite. Friend: Are those fragments dangerous at sea? You: As long as they do not fall on a town.

spaced learning.context: 你背单词总忘，朋友教你别一次背太多，隔几天复习一次，老师说这叫间隔式学习，记得更牢，这时就会用到 spaced learning。
spaced learning.translation: 朋友：你怎么背单词今天背明天忘 你：我一次性背两百个 当然忘 朋友：你试试 spaced learning 每天复习一点 你：行 我每天复习二十个旧词
spaced learning.example: Friend: Why do you forget the words you memorize by the next day? You: I cram two hundred at once, of course I forget. Friend: Try spaced learning, review a bit every day. You: Okay, I will review twenty old words daily.

spaceflight components.context: 你看航天展，展品里有火箭发动机零件和各种精密仪器，讲解员说这些都是飞船上用的配件，这时就会用到 spaceflight components。
spaceflight components.translation: 朋友：展览里这些精密零件都是干嘛的 你：都是 spaceflight components 飞船上用的配件 朋友：看着比手机零件还复杂 你：那当然 要扛得住太空环境
spaceflight components.example: Friend: What are all these precision parts at the exhibition for? You: They are spaceflight components, the parts used on spacecraft. Friend: They look more complex than phone parts. You: Of course, they must survive space conditions.

spade-toothed whale.context: 你看海洋纪录片，解说员说有一种极为罕见的鲸鱼叫铲齿鲸，人类几乎没见过活体，这时就会用到 spade-toothed whale。
spade-toothed whale.translation: 朋友：纪录片里那种长奇怪牙齿的鲸是什么 你：是 spade-toothed whale 铲齿鲸 极其罕见 朋友：人类见过活的吗 你：几乎没有 只找到过骨骼标本
spade-toothed whale.example: Friend: What is that weird-toothed whale in the documentary? You: It is the spade-toothed whale, extremely rare. Friend: Have humans ever seen one alive? You: Hardly, we only have skeleton specimens.

spar with.context: 你和朋友在辩论会上各持观点互相质询，老师说这种你来我往的争论也是一种切磋，这时就会用到 spar with。
spar with.translation: 朋友：今天辩论会你跟谁一组 你：我跟小李正面对辩 互相 spar with 好几回合 朋友：你们俩争得可真激烈 你：就当切磋嘛 谁也不真生气
spar with.example: Friend: Who were you teamed with in today's debate? You: I debated head-on with Xiao Li, we sparred with each other for rounds. Friend: You two argued really fiercely. You: Just sparring, nobody is actually upset.

spare a thought for.context: 冬天看到外卖小哥在寒风里骑车送餐，你跟朋友说真该体谅一下这些辛苦工作的人，这时就会用到 spare a thought for。
spare a thought for.translation: 朋友：今天外卖怎么送了一个小时 你：外面刮大风 小哥骑车不容易 朋友：是啊 你就 spare a thought for 他们 别催单了 你：对 我给了他个好评
spare a thought for.example: Friend: Why did the delivery take an hour today? You: It is windy out there, the rider has a hard time on his bike. Friend: Right, spare a thought for them, do not rush the order. You: True, I gave him a good review.

spare cash.context: 你看到朋友想买个新键盘又舍不得，你说你手头有点闲钱，可以先借给他，这时就会用到 spare cash。
spare cash.translation: 朋友：我想买个机械键盘 但这个月钱花超了 你：我这儿有 spare cash 先借你 朋友：那多不好意思 你：没事 发了工资再还我就行
spare cash.example: Friend: I want a mechanical keyboard, but I overspent this month. You: I have some spare cash, I can lend you. Friend: That feels bad. You: No worries, pay me back when you get paid.

spare downtime.context: 你电脑突然死机了，重要文件还没存，朋友说系统维护的时候机器会停一阵，这时就会用到 spare downtime。
spare downtime.translation: 朋友：你电脑怎么突然蓝屏了 你：正写文件呢 直接死了 朋友：系统维护的时候就会有这种 spare downtime 你：我白写了半小时 太惨了
spare downtime.example: Friend: Why did your computer suddenly blue-screen? You: I was writing a file and it died. Friend: There is this spare downtime during system maintenance. You: I lost half an hour of work, that is awful.

spare parts.context: 你家空调坏了，师傅说型号太老，找不到替换零件了，让你考虑换新机，这时就会用到 spare parts。
spare parts.translation: 朋友：你家空调怎么不制冷了 你：师傅说型号太老 没 spare parts 配了 朋友：那只能换台新的了 你：是啊 旧的修不好了
spare parts.example: Friend: Why is your AC not cooling? You: The repairman said the model is too old, no spare parts left. Friend: Then you have to buy a new one. You: Right, the old one cannot be fixed.

spare space.context: 你整理衣柜发现空出一大块地方，朋友问你能不能借放点箱子，你说刚好有空位，这时就会用到 spare space。
spare space.translation: 朋友：你家阳台有空地方吗 我想放点箱子 你：有啊 刚腾出来一块 spare space 朋友：那我周末搬过去 你：行 我给你留着门
spare space.example: Friend: Is there any room on your balcony, I want to store some boxes? You: Sure, I just cleared some spare space. Friend: Then I will move them over this weekend. You: Okay, I will leave the door open for you.

spark joy.context: 你帮妈妈整理衣柜，每拿起一件东西就问她留着开不开心，朋友说这是近藤麻理惠整理法里问自己的关键问题，这时就会用到 spark joy。
spark joy.translation: 朋友：你扔东西怎么每件都拿起来看半天 你：我在问自己 这东西 spark joy 吗 不留就扔 朋友：这种整理法真能断舍离 你：对 一晚上清出两袋旧衣服
spark joy.example: Friend: Why do you hold up every item and stare before throwing? You: I am asking myself if it spark joy, out it goes if not. Friend: That method really helps you declutter. You: Right, I cleared two bags of old clothes in one night.

speak volume.context: 你看到朋友默默把你落在餐厅的手机送了回来，没留名就走了，你跟朋友说这件小事特别暖，特别能说明他为人，这时就会用到 speak volumes。
speak volume.translation: 朋友：谁把我手机送回来的 你：是隔壁桌那个小伙子 没留名就走了 朋友：这人品真不错 你：是啊 他做的这件事 speaks volumes 他人特别好
speak volume.example: Friend: Who brought my phone back? You: That guy at the next table, he left without leaving a name. Friend: What a decent person. You: Right, that act speaks volumes about his character.

special occasions.context: 朋友结婚你在挑礼物，纠结买实用的还是好看的，朋友说这种喜庆场合送包装精致的就对了，这时就会用到 special occasions。
special occasions.translation: 朋友：下周五朋友婚礼我送什么礼物好 你：这种 special occasions 送包装精致的礼盒就行 朋友：送红包会不会更实在 你：都行 看新人需要什么
special occasions.example: Friend: What gift should I get for the friend's wedding next Friday? You: On special occasions like this, a nicely wrapped box works. Friend: Would a red envelope be more practical? You: Either, depends on what the couple needs.

special someone.context: 你生日快到了，朋友问你今年想要什么礼物，你说希望和心里那个人一起吃顿饭，朋友会心一笑，这时就会用到 special someone。
special someone.translation: 朋友：你今年生日想要什么礼物 你：我就想和那个 special someone 吃顿饭 朋友：哟 有情况啊 谁呀 你：保密 等以后告诉你
special someone.example: Friend: What gift do you want for your birthday this year? You: I just want to have dinner with that special someone. Friend: Oho, something going on, who is it? You: It is a secret, I will tell you later.

specialise in.context: 你问朋友那家餐厅主做什么菜系，朋友说他们专做云南菜，食材都是空运来的，这时就会用到 specialise in。
specialise in.translation: 朋友：那家新餐厅主打什么菜 你：他们 specialise in 云南菜 菌子都是空运来的 朋友：那我可得去尝尝 你：对 他家汽锅鸡特别鲜
specialise in.example: Friend: What does that new restaurant specialise in? You: They specialise in Yunnan food, the mushrooms are flown in. Friend: Then I have to try it. You: Right, their steam-pot chicken is really fresh.

specialised equipment.context: 你去牙科诊所，医生说洗牙需要用到专门的设备，让你躺到治疗椅上，聊到这些专用仪器，这时就会用到 specialised equipment。
specialised equipment.translation: 朋友：洗个牙怎么要躺那么久 你：医生在用 specialised equipment 一点点清理 朋友：这些设备是不是特别贵 你：对 诊所一台机器就好几万
specialised equipment.example: Friend: Why does teeth cleaning take so long? You: The dentist is using specialised equipment to clean bit by bit. Friend: Is that gear really expensive? You: Right, one machine costs tens of thousands.

specialist camera.context: 你想买台好相机去拍鸟，店员说你这种拍远景的需求得用专业相机配长焦镜头，这时就会用到 specialist camera。
specialist camera.translation: 朋友：你买这台相机干嘛用 你：想去公园拍鸟 得用 specialist camera 配长焦 朋友：那镜头比机身还贵吧 你：对 一套下来小两万
specialist camera.example: Friend: What are you buying this camera for? You: I want to photograph birds in the park, I need a specialist camera with a telephoto lens. Friend: The lens costs more than the body, right? You: Right, the whole set is nearly twenty thousand.

specialist therapy session.context: 你最近压力大睡不好，朋友建议你去做几次心理咨询，说跟专业咨询师聊比自己扛着强，这时就会用到 specialist therapy session。
specialist therapy session.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总失眠 你：工作压力大 心里堵得慌 朋友：你去做几次 specialist therapy session 会好很多 你：行 我预约一个下周看看
specialist therapy session.example: Friend: Why have you been losing sleep lately? You: Work pressure is huge, I feel weighed down. Friend: Go to a few specialist therapy sessions, it will help. You: Okay, I will book one for next week.

spectator sport.context: 朋友约你去看足球比赛，说现场几万人一起呐喊特别有氛围，你问这是啥比赛这么吸引人，这时就会用到 spectator sport。
spectator sport.translation: 朋友：周末去看球赛吧 现场气氛特别好 你：足球是不是最受欢迎的 spectator sport 朋友：对 几十万人在看台上一起喊 你：行 买张票去感受一下
spectator sport.example: Friend: Let us go watch a football match this weekend, the atmosphere is amazing. You: Is football the most popular spectator sport? Friend: Right, tens of thousands shouting together in the stands. You: Okay, I will buy a ticket to feel it.

speed limit.context: 你开车上高速，朋友提醒你这段路限速一百二，别开太快被拍，这时就会用到 speed limit。
speed limit.translation: 朋友：这段高速你开多少 你：一百一 朋友：注意 speed limit 这段是一百二 别超了 你：放心 我没超速 前面有摄像头
speed limit.example: Friend: How fast are you going on this highway? You: A hundred and ten. Friend: Mind the speed limit, it is a hundred and twenty here, do not exceed. You: Relax, I am not speeding, there is a camera ahead.

speeds up.context: 你赶飞机快迟到了，让司机开快点，朋友说这段路限速，再快就要吃罚单了，这时就会用到 speeds up。
speeds up.translation: 朋友：再快点 我们赶不上飞机了 你：这段路限速 不能再快了 朋友：你看那车一下就 speeds up 超过我们 你：那是人家赶时间 咱们安全第一
speeds up.example: Friend: Hurry up, we will miss the flight. You: The road has a speed limit, I cannot go faster. Friend: Look at that car speeding up past us. You: They are in a rush, we play it safe.

spell out.context: 老师讲题时发现你没听懂，停下来一步一步把公式怎么来的讲清楚，朋友说他讲得真细，这时就会用到 spell out。
spell out.translation: 朋友：这道题老师讲了啥 我没听懂 你：他停下来 spell out 每一步怎么算的 朋友：那你现在会了吗 你：会了 他讲得特别清楚
spell out.example: Friend: What did the teacher explain on that problem, I did not get it. You: He stopped to spell out every step of the calculation. Friend: Do you get it now? You: Yes, he explained it really clearly.

spell the end of.context: 你看到新闻说某大商场关门后这条街的小店也跟着倒了，评论说这个大店的离开宣告了整条街商业的终结，这时就会用到 spell the end of。
spell the end of.translation: 朋友：这家大商场怎么突然关门了 你：它一倒 旁边小店也跟着倒 朋友：这是不是 spell the end of 这条街的商业 你：是啊 整条街以后冷清了
spell the end of.example: Friend: Why did that big mall suddenly close? You: Once it went down, the little shops nearby closed too. Friend: Does that spell the end of business on this street? You: Right, the whole street will be quiet now.

spend a penny.context: 你跟朋友逛街逛到一半想上厕所，不好意思直说，委婉地说想花点小钱去趟洗手间，朋友秒懂，这时就会用到 spend a penny。
spend a penny.translation: 朋友：我们再逛两家店吧 你：等一下 我想先 spend a penny 洗手间在哪儿 朋友：就在前面拐角 我等你 你：好 我马上回来
spend a penny.example: Friend: Let us browse two more shops. You: Wait, I need to spend a penny first, where is the restroom? Friend: Just around the corner, I will wait. You: Okay, I will be right back.

spend lavishly on.context: 朋友生日你买了个很贵的蛋糕还订了餐厅，朋友说你也太大手大脚了，你说生日就该好好花一次，这时就会用到 spend lavishly on。
spend lavishly on.translation: 朋友：你这生日蛋糕多少钱啊 看着就不便宜 你：生日嘛 我 spend lavishly on 她 开心就好 朋友：你也太大方了 平时可别这么花 你：知道 一年就这一次
spend lavishly on.example: Friend: How much was that birthday cake, it looks expensive. You: It is her birthday, I spend lavishly on her, as long as she is happy. Friend: You are so generous, do not spend like this normally. You: I know, it is only once a year.

spend time on gadgets.context: 你周末在家除了刷手机就是打游戏，朋友说你别老在电子设备上耗时间，出去走走，这时就会用到 spend time on gadgets。
spend time on gadgets.translation: 朋友：你周末都干嘛了 你：在家打游戏刷手机 朋友：你 spend time on gadgets 太多了 出去运动运动 你：行 我下午约朋友打球去
spend time on gadgets.example: Friend: What did you do all weekend? You: Stayed home playing games and on my phone. Friend: You spend too much time on gadgets, go outside and exercise. You: Okay, I will play ball with friends this afternoon.

spending spree.context: 朋友发了第一笔工资，拉着你去商场，从鞋买到包一下花掉小半个月工资，你说你这是疯狂购物，这时就会用到 spending spree。
spending spree.translation: 朋友：我发工资了 今天必须去血拼 你：你这是要 go on a spending spree 吗 朋友：对啊 看到喜欢的全买 你：悠着点 别月底吃土
spending spree.example: Friend: I got paid, I have to go on a shopping spree today. You: You are going on a spending spree? Friend: Exactly, I will buy everything I like. You: Easy on it, do not eat dirt at month end.

spending time with.context: 你周末没有安排工作，专门留出来陪爸妈吃饭散步，朋友说你这周安排得挺松，你说就是想多陪陪家人，这时就会用到 spending time with。
spending time with.translation: 朋友：你这周末怎么不加班了 你：我想 spending time with 爸妈 好久没陪他们吃饭了 朋友：是该多陪陪家人 你：对 工作永远做不完
spending time with.example: Friend: Why are you not working overtime this weekend? You: I want spending time with my parents, it has been ages since we ate together. Friend: You really should spend more time with family. You: Right, work never ends.

spending urges.context: 朋友为了减肥天天催自己节食运动，结果越减越焦虑，你劝她别太逼自己，朋友说她就是忍不住督促自己，这时就会用到 spending urges。
spending urges.translation: 朋友：你减肥怎么搞得这么焦虑 你：我天天 spending urges 自己必须瘦 朋友：别逼太紧 身体重要 你：也是 我今天先吃顿好的
spending urges.example: Friend: Why has your dieting made you so anxious? You: I spend all my urges pushing myself to be thin. Friend: Do not push so hard, your health matters. You: True, I will have a nice meal today.

spick and span.context: 周末你把家里打扫得窗明几净、一尘不染，朋友来做客一进门就夸你家干净得像样板间，这时就会用到 spick and span。
spick and span.translation: 朋友：你家怎么这么干净 跟样板间似的 你：我周末大扫除了一天 收拾得 spick and span 朋友：地板都反光了 你：那是 我拖了三遍
spick and span.example: Friend: Why is your place so clean, like a show flat? You: I spent the whole weekend deep cleaning, it is spick and span. Friend: The floor is practically shining. You: Yep, I mopped it three times.

spin in one's grave.context: 你看到年轻人把老祖宗留下的传统手艺改成花哨网红款，朋友感慨老辈人要是看到肯定在地下都不得安宁，这时就会用到 spin in one's grave。
spin in one's grave.translation: 朋友：现在这菜改成甜味的了 真难吃 你：老祖宗要是知道 估计都 spin in their grave 朋友：好好的传统味道全改没了 你：是啊 瞎改什么呀
spin in one's grave.example: Friend: This dish is sweetened now, it tastes awful. You: The ancestors would spin in their graves if they knew. Friend: The traditional taste is all gone. You: Right, why mess with it.

spin plates.context: 工作同时推进好几个项目，每天忙得连轴转，朋友说你一个人同时转好几个盘子，别把哪个摔了，这时就会用到 spin plates。
spin plates.translation: 朋友：你一个人同时接几个项目 忙得过来吗 你：没办法 手头同时 spin plates 好几个 朋友：小心别把哪个盘子摔了 你：是啊 每天都得盯紧
spin plates.example: Friend: You are juggling several projects alone, can you handle it? You: No choice, I am spinning several plates at once. Friend: Careful not to drop one. You: Right, I have to watch them all day.

spinal curvature.context: 你久坐办公腰酸背痛，医生说这是坐姿不好导致脊柱曲度出了问题，让你多起来活动，这时就会用到 spinal curvature。
spinal curvature.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总揉腰 你：久坐办公室 腰特别疼 朋友：医生说这是 spinal curvature 出了问题 你：让我每小时起来活动两分钟
spinal curvature.example: Friend: Why are you rubbing your back lately? You: Sitting at the desk too long, my lower back aches. Friend: The doctor says it is a spinal curvature problem. You: He told me to stand up and move every hour for two minutes.

spinal twist.context: 上瑜伽课老师带你做扭转动作，让你慢慢把脊柱拧开，朋友问这动作有什么用，这时就会用到 spinal twist。
spinal twist.translation: 朋友：瑜伽课上那个拧腰动作有用吗 你：是 spinal twist 能放松背部僵硬 朋友：我扭的时候腰咔咔响 你：那是正常的 慢慢做别用力过猛
spinal twist.example: Friend: Does that twisting move in yoga class help? You: It is a spinal twist, it relaxes your stiff back. Friend: My back cracks when I twist. You: That is normal, go slow and do not force it.

splash out.context: 你发了奖金就拉朋友去吃顿好的，朋友说你难得大方一次，你说犒劳自己一下，这时就会用到 splash out。
splash out.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么请我吃这么贵的餐厅 你：发奖金了 得 splash out 犒劳一下自己 朋友：难得大方一次 那我多点两个菜 你：随便点 今天我请客
splash out.example: Friend: Why are you treating me to such an expensive place today? You: I got my bonus, time to splash out and treat myself. Friend: A rare splurge, then I will order two more dishes. You: Order whatever, it is on me today.

splash out on.context: 你双十一咬牙买了个心仪很久的名牌包，朋友说你这次真下血本了，你说就奖励自己一年的辛苦，这时就会用到 splash out on。
splash out on.translation: 朋友：你这包真好看 得不少钱吧 你：双十一我 splash out on 它 咬咬牙买的 朋友：你平时那么节俭 这次真舍得 你：就犒劳一下自己
splash out on.example: Friend: That bag looks great, it must have cost a lot. You: I splashed out on it during Double Eleven, bought it on impulse. Friend: You are usually so frugal, you really went for it this time. You: Just rewarding myself.

splash the cash.context: 朋友中了小彩票，立刻拉大家去酒吧喝酒庆祝，朋友说他这回挥金如土了，这时就会用到 splash the cash。
splash the cash.translation: 朋友：你中彩票了 今晚怎么请客 你：中了五十块 今晚我 splash the cash 大家随便点 朋友：哈哈 五十块你就敢这么说 你：来来来 一人一杯啤酒
splash the cash.example: Friend: You won the lottery, why are you treating us tonight? You: Won fifty bucks, tonight I splash the cash, order whatever. Friend: Haha, you talk big for fifty bucks. You: Come on, one beer each.

splash the cash on.context: 朋友升职后立刻换了个最新款手机，还买了块表，同事说他拿到钱就大手笔花，这时就会用到 splash the cash on。
splash the cash on.translation: 朋友：小李升职后怎么换了个新手机 你：他 splash the cash on 最新款还买了表 朋友：工资还没到手就花光了 你：是啊 他就是及时行乐型
splash the cash on.example: Friend: Why did Xiao Li get a new phone after the promotion? You: He splashed the cash on the latest model and a watch. Friend: He spent it before the pay rise even arrives. You: Right, he lives for the moment.

splatter film.context: 电影院新上了一部满是血腥镜头的片子，朋友拉你去看，你说你不爱看这种暴力片，这时就会用到 splatter film。
splatter film.translation: 朋友：周末新上的那个恐怖片去看不 你：那种 splatter film 全是血浆 我不爱看 朋友：就是图个刺激嘛 你：我算了 我去看个轻松点的喜剧
splatter film.example: Friend: Wanna see that new horror out this weekend? You: That splatter film is all blood and gore, I do not like it. Friend: It is just for the thrill. You: Count me out, I will watch a light comedy.

split from.context: 公司一个老部门独立出去成了新公司，老员工们各自分了股权，聊到拆分独立，这时就会用到 split from。
split from.translation: 朋友：你们部门怎么单独搬出去了 你：我们 split from 总公司 独立成新公司了 朋友：那股权是不是也分了 你：对 老员工都拿了一部分
split from.example: Friend: Why did your department move out on its own? You: We split from the parent company and became independent. Friend: So the shares got divided too? You: Right, the long-term staff each got a stake.

split into.context: 全班四十个人要分成几个小组做项目，老师让大家自己组队，朋友问你想跟谁一组，这时就会用到 split into。
split into.translation: 朋友：老师让我们分组做项目 你：我们班四十人 split into 八个小组吧 朋友：那我们几个凑一组 你：行 加上隔壁那两个同学
split into.example: Friend: The teacher wants us to form groups for the project. You: Our class of forty will split into eight groups. Friend: Then let us team up together. You: Okay, add those two students next door too.

split opinion.context: 新电影上映后观众评价两极分化，有人爱有人骂，朋友问你觉得怎么样，你说这片子评论就是分裂的，这时就会用到 split opinion。
split opinion.translation: 朋友：新上那个电影你看了吗 评价怎么样 你：特别 split opinion 有人哭有人骂 朋友：那到底好不好看 你：你自己去看就知道了
split opinion.example: Friend: Did you see the new film, what are the reviews? You: It really splits opinion, some cry, some rant. Friend: So is it actually good? You: You will have to see for yourself.

split second.context: 红灯变绿的一刹那，你脚还没抬起，旁边车就一下冲了出去，朋友说就那么一瞬间，这时就会用到 split second。
split second.translation: 朋友：刚才那车怎么一下就窜出去了 你：绿灯亮的 split second 他就冲了 朋友：你反应慢点都容易被蹭 你：是啊 过马路真得小心
split second.example: Friend: How did that car shoot off just now? You: The split second the light turned green he was off. Friend: If you are a second slow you get sideswiped. You: Right, you have to be careful crossing.

split up with.context: 你听说大学室友和谈了五年的女朋友分手了，约他出来喝酒安慰他，这时就会用到 split up with。
split up with.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么一个人喝酒 你：我跟女朋友 split up with 了 谈了五年 朋友：为什么啊 出什么事了 你：性格不合 慢慢就淡了
split up with.example: Friend: Why are you drinking alone lately? You: I split up with my girlfriend, five years together. Friend: Why, what happened? You: We were not compatible, it just faded.

spoil sport.context: 大家正玩得开心，有人提议去爬山结果外面下大雨，你扫兴地说今天玩不成了，朋友怪你真扫兴，这时就会用到 spoil sport。
spoil sport.translation: 朋友：大家玩得正嗨 你：外面下大雨了 今天去不了公园了 朋友：你也太 spoil sport 了 真扫兴 你：那我们改去室内桌游嘛
spoil sport.example: Friend: We are all having fun. You: It is pouring outside, we cannot go to the park today. Friend: You are such a spoil sport. You: Then let us switch to board games indoors.

spoilt for choice.context: 商场里有二十种口味的冰淇淋，你站在柜台前看了半天不知道选哪个，朋友说你都挑花眼了，这时就会用到 spoilt for choice。
spoilt for choice.translation: 朋友：你想吃什么口味的冰淇淋 你：二十多种口味 我都 spoilt for choice 了 朋友：那就来个经典香草吧 你：不行 我要纠结到关门
spoilt for choice.example: Friend: What flavour ice cream do you want? You: Twenty flavours, I am spoilt for choice. Friend: Just go with classic vanilla. You: No, I will stand here debating till closing.

sponge city.context: 你看到城市新建了好多能吸水的公园和道路，下雨也不积水了，朋友说这是海绵城市的设计，这时就会用到 sponge city。
sponge city.translation: 朋友：下这么大雨怎么路上没积水 你：我们这儿建了 sponge city 绿地和路面都能吸水 朋友：这种设计真先进 你：对 下雨天终于不怕趟水了
sponge city.example: Friend: Why is there no flooding on the road in this heavy rain? You: We built a sponge city, the green spaces and roads absorb water. Friend: That design is really advanced. You: Right, no more wading through floods on rainy days.

sponsor spot.context: 你听播客听到一半，主播念了一段广告，说今天节目是由某品牌赞助的，朋友问你刚才那段是什么，这时就会用到 sponsor spot。
sponsor spot.translation: 朋友：你刚才听什么呢 听到一半笑了 你：播客中间有一段 sponsor spot 念广告 朋友：现在播客都靠赞助赚钱了 你：对 念一段口播拿一笔钱
sponsor spot.example: Friend: What were you listening to, why did you laugh halfway? You: There was a sponsor spot in the podcast reading an ad. Friend: Podcasts make money from sponsorships now. You: Right, they get paid for each ad read.

sponsored content.context: 你刷到博主发的一条笔记特别像广告，点进去一看末尾标了合作，朋友说这种就是品牌付费推广内容，这时就会用到 sponsored content。
sponsored content.translation: 朋友：你看博主这条推荐 像不像广告 你：末尾标了合作 这就是 sponsored content 朋友：那我得自己判断 不能全信 你：对 推广内容要多看评论
sponsored content.example: Friend: Does that blogger's recommendation look like an ad? You: It says partnership at the end, this is sponsored content. Friend: Then I have to judge for myself, not trust it blindly. You: Right, read the comments on sponsored posts.

spontaneous joke.context: 迎新会上大家都很拘束，新来的学长突然讲了个笑话，把大家逗笑，气氛一下子放松下来，这时就会用到 spontaneous joke。
spontaneous joke.translation: 朋友：迎新会刚开始大家都挺尴尬 你：后来学长突然讲了个 spontaneous joke 朋友：一下子就把冷场打破了 你：对 大家笑完就熟了
spontaneous joke.example: Friend: The welcome party was awkward at first. You: Then a senior cracked a spontaneous joke. Friend: It instantly broke the ice. You: Right, after the laugh we all loosened up.

sport craze.context: 你发现身边人突然都开始飞盘和桨板，朋友说最近这股户外热真流行，这时就会用到 sport craze。
sport craze.translation: 朋友：怎么现在人人都玩飞盘了 你：这股 sport craze 半年内就火遍全城 朋友：上周我去草坪 一半人在扔飞盘 你：对 大家都想出门动一动
sport craze.example: Friend: Why is everyone playing frisbee now? You: This sport craze swept the whole city in half a year. Friend: Last week half the people on the lawn were throwing frisbees. You: Right, everyone wants to get outside and move.

sporting calendar.context: 你想订球赛的票，问朋友下赛季都有哪些重要比赛，朋友拿出一张全年的赛事表给你看，这时就会用到 sporting calendar。
sporting calendar.translation: 朋友：下赛季本地队都有哪些比赛 你：我这儿有一整年的 sporting calendar 朋友：那欧冠比赛在几月 你：十一月开始踢
sporting calendar.example: Friend: What games does the local team play next season? You: I have the whole year's sporting calendar here. Friend: Which month does the Champions League start? You: It kicks off in November.

sporting fixture.context: 你和朋友约好这周六去看一场足球赛，朋友提醒你记得提前买票，这时就会用到 sporting fixture。
sporting fixture.translation: 朋友：这周六咱们那场球赛别忘了 你：我记着呢 这个 sporting fixture 我盼了一周了 朋友：票买好了吗 别现场没座 你：早就买好了 两张连座
sporting fixture.example: Friend: Do not forget our football match this Saturday. You: I remember, I have been looking forward to this sporting fixture all week. Friend: Did you buy the tickets, do not end up standing. You: Bought them long ago, two seats together.

sporting fixtures.context: 你翻了翻手机日历，发现这周末、下周末都有比赛安排，朋友说这赛季赛程排得真密，这时就会用到 sporting fixtures。
sporting fixtures.translation: 朋友：你这两个月怎么周末都不在家 你：赛事一个接一个 全是 sporting fixtures 朋友：你不累吗 场场都去 你：不累 看球多开心
sporting fixtures.example: Friend: Why are you out every weekend these two months? You: The games come one after another, all sporting fixtures. Friend: Are you not tired going to every one? You: Not tired, watching football is joy.

sporting venues.context: 你想办个公司篮球赛，问朋友去哪儿租场地合适，朋友说体育馆和大学操场都行，这时就会用到 sporting venues。
sporting venues.translation: 朋友：公司想办个篮球赛 去哪儿租场地 你：大学体育馆和室外球场都是 sporting venues 朋友：哪个便宜点 你：室外操场便宜 还通风
sporting venues.example: Friend: The company wants to hold a basketball match, where do we rent a court? You: The university gym and outdoor courts are sporting venues. Friend: Which is cheaper? You: The outdoor court is cheaper and breezy.

sports analytics.context: 你看体育频道解说分析球队胜率和球员数据，朋友说现在解说都靠数据说话，聊到赛事数据分析，这时就会用到 sports analytics。
sports analytics.translation: 朋友：解说怎么老说什么预期进球率 你：现在都靠 sports analytics 分析比赛 朋友：光看数据能预测胜负吗 你：能参考 但场上变化也多
sports analytics.example: Friend: Why do the commentators keep mentioning expected goals? You: They rely on sports analytics to break down the game. Friend: Can data predict who wins? You: It helps, but a lot can change on the pitch.

sports events.context: 你城市最近要办马拉松，整条街都在封路准备，朋友问为什么这么热闹，你说有大型体育赛事，这时就会用到 sports events。
sports events.translation: 朋友：今天路边怎么都封路了 你：市里在办马拉松 各种 sports events 连着来 朋友：那我出门得绕路 你：对 上午别走那条街
sports events.example: Friend: Why are the roads closed today? You: The city is holding a marathon, lots of sports events back to back. Friend: Then I have to take a detour. You: Right, avoid that street in the morning.

sports venue.context: 你想带朋友去看演唱会，查附近哪个场馆能坐几万人，聊到演出场地，这时就会用到 sports venue。
sports venue.translation: 朋友：周末演唱会在哪儿办 你：在市体育中心 那个 sports venue 能坐五万人 朋友：那得提前去 不然堵在路上 你：对 我们提前两小时出门
sports venue.example: Friend: Where is the weekend concert held? You: At the city sports centre, that sports venue holds fifty thousand. Friend: Then leave early or we get stuck in traffic. You: Right, set out two hours ahead.

spot potential.context: 你在公司新人里注意到一个小伙子特别努力，朋友说他将来肯定有前途，你说你已经看出他的潜力了，这时就会用到 spot potential。
spot potential.translation: 朋友：你怎么总夸那个新来的 你：我 spot potential 他将来能扛大旗 朋友：他确实是块料 朋友都看出来了 你：再培养两年就能独当一面
spot potential.example: Friend: Why do you always praise the new guy? You: I spot potential in him, he can lead teams one day. Friend: He is really promising, everyone sees it. You: Give him two more years and he will run things alone.

spr up.context: 春天一过，小区草坪里一下子冒出好多野花，朋友说这些花什么时候开的，你说春天一到就纷纷冒出来了，这时就会用到 spr up。
spr up.translation: 朋友：楼下草坪怎么突然开满小花 你：春天一到就 spr up 一大片 朋友：上周还光秃秃的呢 你：是啊 春天一夜之间就绿了
spr up.example: Friend: Why did the lawn downstairs suddenly bloom with little flowers? You: They sprang up all at once when spring came. Friend: It was bare just last week. You: Right, spring turns everything green overnight.

sprawling suburb.context: 你从市中心开车出来，开了半小时还是密密麻麻的住宅区，朋友说这城市郊区铺得真开，这时就会用到 sprawling suburb。
sprawling suburb.translation: 朋友：开了半小时怎么还在楼群里 你：这城市的 sprawling suburb 铺得特别开 朋友：住这儿每天通勤得多久 你：单程就一个小时
sprawling suburb.example: Friend: Why are we still in apartment blocks after half an hour's drive? You: The city's sprawling suburb stretches forever. Friend: How long is the commute living out here? You: An hour one way.

spread across.context: 你从飞机上往下看，一座大城市灯火连成一片，绵延几十公里，朋友说这城市真大，横跨那么远，这时就会用到 spread across。
spread across.translation: 朋友：从飞机上看下面那城真大 你：灯火 spread across 几十公里 一眼望不到头 朋友：住这样的大城市也挺累 你：是啊 哪儿都得开车半小时
spread across.example: Friend: That city below from the plane is huge. You: The lights spread across dozens of kilometres, you cannot see the end. Friend: Living in such a big city must be tiring. You: Right, everywhere takes half an hour by car.

spread across the globe.context: 你看到某款中国电动车卖遍了全世界，从欧洲到南美都能看到，朋友说它这是卖到全球了，这时就会用到 spread across the globe。
spread across the globe.translation: 朋友：你在国外街头怎么也看到咱们那款电动车 你：它 spread across the globe 卖遍了全世界 朋友：现在国货真的牛 你：是啊 哪儿都能见到
spread across the globe.example: Friend: Why do I see our Chinese electric car on foreign streets too? You: It has spread across the globe, sold everywhere. Friend: Chinese brands are really something now. You: Right, you see them everywhere.

spread across the world.context: 你看新闻说一种新病毒在好几国蔓延开了，专家担心它会扩散到更多国家，这时就会用到 spread across the world。
spread across the world.translation: 朋友：新闻说那种新病毒传到好几个国家了 你：它 spread across the world 越来越快 朋友：那出门得戴口罩 你：对 公共交通上别摘
spread across the world.example: Friend: The news says that new virus has reached several countries. You: It is spreading across the world faster and faster. Friend: Then we should wear masks outside. You: Right, keep them on in public transport.

spreads across.context: 你看到一种新奶茶店一下开遍全城，从东到西都能看到招牌，朋友说这牌子扩张得真快，这时就会用到 spreads across。
spreads across.translation: 朋友：怎么到处都能看到那家奶茶店 你：它这半年 spreads across 整个城市 朋友：一条街上就有两家 你：对 扩张得比什么都快
spreads across.example: Friend: Why do I see that bubble tea shop everywhere? You: It has spread across the whole city in half a year. Friend: There are two on one street. You: Right, it is expanding faster than anything.

spring chickens.context: 公司年会大家笑你一把年纪还在学新软件，你不服老说自己又不是小孩，朋友逗你说可别逞强，这时就会用到 spring chickens。
spring chickens.translation: 朋友：你这个岁数还学编程 能学会吗 你：我又不是 spring chickens 学个新软件怎么了 朋友：行行行 您宝刀未老 你：那是 学东西不分年龄
spring chickens.example: Friend: At your age, can you really learn coding? You: I am no spring chicken, why not learn a new app? Friend: Alright, you are still sharp. You: Exactly, learning knows no age.

spring cleaning.context: 春节一过你看着家里乱七八糟，决定周末来个大扫除，把冬天积的灰都清掉，朋友问你忙什么，这时就会用到 spring cleaning。
spring cleaning.translation: 朋友：你这周末怎么又擦玻璃又洗窗帘 你：每年春天都来个 spring cleaning 把家彻底清一遍 朋友：收拾完是不是特别有成就感 你：对 看着亮堂多了
spring cleaning.example: Friend: Why are you washing windows and curtains this weekend? You: Every spring I do a spring cleaning to deep-clean the whole place. Friend: Does it feel rewarding afterwards? You: Right, it looks so much brighter.

spring to mind.context: 老师在课上问大家听到环保会想到什么，第一个冒出来的念头是什么，朋友说他脑子里立刻蹦出塑料袋，这时就会用到 spring to mind。
spring to mind.translation: 朋友：老师问听到环保你想到什么 你：我脑子里立刻 spring to mind 两个字 塑料袋 朋友：哈哈 我也是 你：看来大家都被白色污染害过
spring to mind.example: Friend: What came to mind when the teacher asked about the environment? You: Two words immediately sprang to mind, plastic bags. Friend: Haha, me too. You: Seems we have all suffered plastic pollution.

sprinkle on.context: 你做蛋糕时在表面撒一层糖粉装饰，朋友问你撒的是什么，你说就是撒点糖在上面提味，这时就会用到 sprinkle on。
sprinkle on.translation: 朋友：蛋糕表面那层白白的是什么 你：我在上面 sprinkle on 一层糖粉 装饰用 朋友：看着就好吃 甜而不腻 你：对 还好看
sprinkle on.example: Friend: What is that white layer on top of the cake? You: I sprinkled on some powdered sugar as decoration. Friend: It looks delicious, sweet but not heavy. You: Right, and it looks pretty.

spur on.context: 你比赛落后时队友一句加油让你重新打起精神，最后反超，朋友说就是那一下激励了你，这时就会用到 spur on。
spur on.translation: 朋友：你最后怎么突然提速的 你：队友在场边喊 spur me on 我就拼了 朋友：那句话一下让你满血复活 你：对 被人推着跑真的有劲
spur on.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly speed up at the end? You: My teammate yelled to spur me on from the side, and I dug in. Friend: That shout refilled your energy. You: Right, being pushed on gives you real drive.

squeeze into.context: 地铁里人挤人，你好不容易才挤进一节车厢，朋友说你这是硬挤进来的，这时就会用到 squeeze into。
squeeze into.translation: 朋友：这节车厢也太挤了 你：我好不容易才 squeeze into 来 朋友：门一关你都不用抓扶手了 你：对 挤得严严实实的
squeeze into.example: Friend: This carriage is so packed. You: I barely managed to squeeze into it. Friend: With the doors closed you do not even need to hold the rail. You: Right, packed tight as a can.

squeeze out.context: 你在便利店想挤点果酱在面包上，结果瓶子太用力挤多了，朋友笑你挤太多了，这时就会用到 squeeze out。
squeeze out.translation: 朋友：你面包上怎么涂了那么多果酱 你：手一滑 squeeze out 一大坨 朋友：这一口下去全是糖 你：没事 我喜欢吃甜的
squeeze out.example: Friend: Why is there so much jam on your bread? You: My hand slipped and I squeezed out a huge blob. Friend: One bite is all sugar. You: No worries, I love sweet stuff.

squeeze out of.context: 你想报的选修课名额满了，被挤到了候补名单上，朋友说你没抢到，这时就会用到 squeeze out of。
squeeze out of.translation: 朋友：你选上那个摄影课了吗 你：没有 我被 squeeze out of 了 名额一下就满了 朋友：那你只能等有人退课 你：是啊 候补排第三个
squeeze out of.example: Friend: Did you get into that photography class? You: No, I got squeezed out of it, the spots filled up in seconds. Friend: Then you have to wait for someone to drop. You: Right, I am third on the wait list.

squeezed out of.context: 你用毛巾把刚洗好的衣服里的水拧出来，朋友说你力气真大，一下就把水拧干了，这时就会用到 squeezed out of。
squeezed out of.translation: 朋友：你这衣服拧得真干 你：我把 squeezed out of 的水拧干净了 朋友：那晾一晚上就干了 你：对 明天就能穿
squeezed out of.example: Friend: You wrung that cloth really dry. You: I squeezed out of it all the water I could. Friend: Then one night of hanging will dry it. You: Right, I can wear it tomorrow.

squeezing out.context: 你挤柠檬想给菜加点酸味，朋友看你使劲捏柠檬片，说你在使劲把汁挤出来，这时就会用到 squeezing out。
squeezing out.translation: 朋友：你在厨房里捏柠檬干嘛 你：squeezing out 柠檬汁 想拌个沙拉 朋友：那你得选黄柠檬才够酸 你：行 我再切半个
squeezing out.example: Friend: What are you doing squeezing lemons in the kitchen? You: Squeezing out lemon juice to make a salad. Friend: Then use yellow lemons, they are sour enough. You: Okay, I will cut another half.

stacking shelves.context: 朋友找了份超市兼职，周末去理货，把商品一排排摆上货架，你问他工作难不难，他说就是摆东西，这时就会用到 stacking shelves。
stacking shelves.translation: 朋友：你周末兼职做什么 你：在超市 stacking shelves 把货摆整齐 朋友：站一天累不累 你：习惯就好 还能偷偷试吃
stacking shelves.example: Friend: What is your weekend part-time job? You: Stacking shelves at the supermarket, tidying up the goods. Friend: Is standing all day tiring? You: You get used to it, and I can sneak samples.

staff engagement.context: 公司最近搞团建发福利，大家积极性高了不少，老板在会上说这是为了提升员工的参与感，这时就会用到 staff engagement。
staff engagement.translation: 朋友：公司最近怎么又是下午茶又是团建 你：老板想提升 staff engagement 大家干活更有劲 朋友：这招确实有用 你：对 大家都开心多了
staff engagement.example: Friend: Why is the company doing afternoon tea and team building lately? You: The boss wants to lift staff engagement so we work with more drive. Friend: That really works. You: Right, everyone is much happier.

staff retention.context: 你们部门老员工纷纷跳槽去了别家，新老板开会说要想办法留住人，聊到员工留存，这时就会用到 staff retention。
staff retention.translation: 朋友：你们部门怎么走了好几个老人 你：待遇一般 大家都往外跳 老板愁 staff retention 朋友：再不涨工资 人走更多 你：是啊 加薪才是硬道理
staff retention.example: Friend: Why did several long-timers leave your department? You: The pay is average, everyone jumps ship. The boss worries about staff retention. Friend: Raise wages or more will leave. You: Right, better pay is the key.

staff satisfaction.context: HR在群里发了个匿名问卷，让大家给公司打分，聊到想了解员工满不满意，这时就会用到 staff satisfaction。
staff satisfaction.translation: 朋友：HR发的问卷你填了吗 你：填了 就问对工资和环境满意不 朋友：他们在测 staff satisfaction 看大家满意度 你：我给食堂打了个低分
staff satisfaction.example: Friend: Did you fill out that survey HR sent? You: Yes, it asked about pay and the workplace. Friend: They are measuring staff satisfaction. You: I gave the canteen a low score.

stage confidence.context: 孩子第一次上台演讲腿发抖，老师说多上台几次就有舞台自信了，朋友问怎么练，这时就会用到 stage confidence。
stage confidence.translation: 朋友：你家孩子上次上台紧张吗 你：紧张得声音都抖 朋友：多上台几次 stage confidence 就练出来了 你：是 我给他报了个演讲班
stage confidence.example: Friend: Was your kid nervous on stage last time? You: His voice was shaking. Friend: Stage confidence builds up after a few more times. You: Right, I signed him up for a speech class.

stagnant water.context: 你小区楼下一下雨就积一滩水，两天都不干，夏天还招蚊子，朋友说这死水太容易滋生蚊子，这时就会用到 stagnant water。
stagnant water.translation: 朋友：楼下怎么又积水了 还臭烘烘的 你：那滩 stagnant water 两天都不干 招蚊子 朋友：得跟物业反映清一清 你：对 不然夏天全是蚊子
stagnant water.example: Friend: Why is there standing water downstairs again, it smells. You: That stagnant water has not drained in two days and breeds mosquitoes. Friend: We should tell the property to clear it. You: Right, or mosquitoes everywhere in summer.

stained glass door.context: 你去老教堂参观，看到门上彩色玻璃拼着圣经故事，朋友说这门真漂亮，这时就会用到 stained glass door。
stained glass door.translation: 朋友：这教堂的门怎么花花绿绿的 你：是 stained glass door 彩玻拼的圣经故事 朋友：阳光一照特别好看 你：对 站在门口像进了画里
stained glass door.example: Friend: Why is that church door so colourful? You: It is a stained glass door with Bible scenes. Friend: It looks stunning in the sunlight. You: Right, standing by it feels like stepping into a painting.

stake out.context: 警察在嫌疑人住处外面蹲守了好几天，观察他什么时候出门，朋友问他们在那儿干嘛，这时就会用到 stake out。
stake out.translation: 朋友：那辆面包车怎么老停在楼下 你：警察在 stake out 监视嫌疑人 朋友：他们要蹲到什么时候 你：等嫌疑人一出门就行动
stake out.example: Friend: Why is that van always parked downstairs? You: The police are staking out the suspect. Friend: How long will they stake out? You: They move the moment he steps out.

stand head and shoulders above.context: 你儿子成绩在班里排第一，老师说他比同龄孩子高出一大截，将来肯定有出息，这时就会用到 stand head and shoulders above。
stand head and shoulders above.translation: 朋友：你儿子期末考了多少 你：年级第一 比第二名高出三十分 朋友：他真是 stand head and shoulders above 同龄人 你：是啊 这孩子读书是块料
stand head and shoulders above.example: Friend: How did your son do on the finals? You: Top of the grade, thirty points above second place. Friend: He stands head and shoulders above his peers. You: Right, the kid is a natural at studying.

stand no chance.context: 你队跟冠军队比赛，朋友问你觉得有希望赢吗，你说跟他们打根本没戏，这时就会用到 stand no chance。
stand no chance.translation: 朋友：咱们队明天跟冠军队踢 你：咱们跟他们打 stand no chance 朋友：别这么丧气 踢踢看嘛 你：行 就当去学习经验
stand no chance.example: Friend: Our team plays the champions tomorrow. You: We stand no chance against them. Friend: Do not be so down, just play. You: Fine, treat it as a learning experience.

stand the test.context: 你和好朋友认识十年了，每年都见，你说真正的友情经得起时间考验，朋友说你们这关系真铁，这时就会用到 stand the test。
stand the test.translation: 朋友：你俩认识多少年了 你：十年了 每年都还见面 朋友：这种友情真能 stand the test 你：是啊 吵不散的才是真朋友
stand the test.example: Friend: How long have you two known each other? You: Ten years, we still meet every year. Friend: That friendship really stands the test. You: Right, real friends do not fall apart over fights.

stand the test of time.context: 爷爷用了四十年的老手表还在走，你说这表质量真好，朋友说老物件就是经得住时间考验，这时就会用到 stand the test of time。
stand the test of time.translation: 朋友：你爷爷这块表真老 还在走吗 你：用了四十年 还准时 朋友：好东西真能 stand the test of time 你：是啊 比现在的电子表结实多了
stand the test of time.example: Friend: That watch of your grandpa's is really old, does it still run? You: Forty years old and still on time. Friend: A quality item stands the test of time. You: Right, sturdier than today's digital watches.

stand to reason.context: 同事说下雨就别出门了，你说既然雨下得不大，那照常去也合理，朋友点头说确实说得通，这时就会用到 stand to reason。
stand to reason.translation: 朋友：下这么小雨 还要去公园吗 你：雨不大 照常去也 stand to reason 朋友：那我们带伞出门吧 你：行 小雨正好凉快
stand to reason.example: Friend: With this light rain, should we still go to the park? You: The rain is small, it stands to reason we go as planned. Friend: Then let us take umbrellas. You: Okay, light rain is actually cool.

standby mode.context: 你下班忘了关电脑，同事提醒你屏幕黑着但没关机，还在待机，这时就会用到 standby mode。
standby mode.translation: 朋友：你电脑屏幕怎么黑了 你：我没关机 就是 standby mode 待机了 朋友：待机也费电 走的时候关一下 你：行 我明天记得关
standby mode.example: Friend: Why is your computer screen black? You: I did not shut it down, it is just in standby mode. Friend: Standby still uses power, shut it off when you leave. You: Okay, I will remember tomorrow.

standing order.context: 你每月固定把房租自动转给房东，不用每个月手动操作，朋友问你怎么交租这么省心，你说设了自动转账指令，这时就会用到 standing order。
standing order.translation: 朋友：你每个月房租怎么交的 从来不用催 你：我设了 standing order 自动转账 朋友：这种自动付款真省心 你：对 不用每月记着转
standing order.example: Friend: How do you pay the rent, you never get reminded? You: I set up a standing order for automatic transfer. Friend: That automatic payment is so worry-free. You: Right, no need to remember each month.

stands for.context: 孩子问你学校的校服缩写YLLC是哪几个词，你说是学校名字的首字母缩写，这时就会用到 stands for。
stands for.translation: 朋友：校服上那个缩写 YLLC 啥意思 你：stands for 学校名字的首字母 朋友：我还以为是什么暗号呢 你：哈哈 就是校名而已
stands for.example: Friend: What does the abbreviation YLLC on the uniform mean? You: It stands for the school name's initials. Friend: I thought it was some secret code. You: Haha, it is just the school name.

staple food.context: 你在国外餐厅不知道点什么，服务员说米饭是这儿的主食，推荐你试试，这时就会用到 staple food。
staple food.translation: 朋友：这餐厅有什么必点的 你：米饭是这儿的 staple food 配什么菜都行 朋友：那我点个咖喱饭 你：行 再来份汤
staple food.example: Friend: What must we order at this restaurant? You: Rice is the staple food here, it goes with any dish. Friend: Then I will have curry rice. You: Okay, add a soup too.

star in.context: 朋友追的那部新剧里男主角特别帅，你问是谁演的，朋友说他最近主演了好几部热门电影，这时就会用到 star in。
star in.translation: 朋友：你追的那剧男主是谁演的 你：他最近 star in 了好几部热门电影 朋友：难怪看着眼熟 你：对 他去年还拿了最佳新人奖
star in.example: Friend: Who plays the lead in that show you follow? You: He has starred in several hit films lately. Friend: No wonder he looks familiar. You: Right, he won best newcomer last year.

star of the show.context: 晚会上大家都在等一个节目，结果是一只经过训练的小狗上台表演算术，全场最热闹，朋友说这狗成了全场主角，这时就会用到 star of the show。
star of the show.translation: 朋友：晚会上哪个节目最火 你：那只小狗算算术 它才是 star of the show 朋友：观众都围着它拍照 你：对 比人表演还受欢迎
star of the show.example: Friend: Which act was the hit of the party? You: The dog doing arithmetic, it was the star of the show. Friend: Everyone crowded around to photograph it. You: Right, more popular than the human acts.

star sign.context: 朋友新认识了个对象，问对方是什么星座，你说你是天秤座，讲究公平，这时就会用到 star sign。
star sign.translation: 朋友：你生日是几月 什么星座 你：十月的 我是天秤座 star sign 朋友：天秤座是不是特别纠结 你：哈哈 选个餐厅能纠结半小时
star sign.example: Friend: What month is your birthday, what is your star sign? You: October, my star sign is Libra. Friend: Are Libras really indecisive? You: Haha, I spend half an hour picking a restaurant.

staring at.context: 你在美术馆盯着一幅画看了好久，朋友问你在看什么，你说被画里的细节吸引住了，这时就会用到 staring at。
staring at.translation: 朋友：你站那幅画前看什么呢 你：我一直 staring at 画里那只小鸟 朋友：它画得特别传神吧 你：对 跟真的一样
staring at.example: Friend: What are you staring at in front of that painting? You: I keep staring at the little bird in the painting. Friend: It is painted so lifelike, right? You: Right, looks just like a real bird.

stark contrast.context: 你把现在的生活和十年前比，发现变化特别大，从出租屋搬了新家、换了工作，朋友说这对比太鲜明了，这时就会用到 stark contrast。
stark contrast.translation: 朋友：你现在和十年前照片一比 变化真大 你：十年前住隔板间 现在有自己的房子 朋友：这真是 stark contrast 天差地别 你：是啊 一步步熬出来的
stark contrast.example: Friend: Comparing your photos now to ten years ago, the change is huge. You: Ten years ago I lived in a partitioned room, now I own a flat. Friend: That is a stark contrast, worlds apart. You: Right, I earned it step by step.

start by.context: 老师教写作文说开头别绕圈子，先从最重要的观点开始，朋友问怎么写开头，老师说先点主题，这时就会用到 start by。
start by.translation: 朋友：作文开头怎么写才好 你：老师说 start by 先讲最重要的观点 别绕弯 朋友：那我开头第一句就点题 你：对 阅卷老师一眼就明白
start by.example: Friend: How should I start my essay? You: The teacher says start by giving the main point, do not beat around the bush. Friend: Then my first sentence states the topic. You: Right, the grader gets it at a glance.

start off with.context: 你周末的安排是先从打扫厨房开始，然后再写报告，朋友问你先做哪个，你说先收拾厨房，这时就会用到 start off with。
start off with.translation: 朋友：你周末先干嘛 先写报告吗 你：我想 start off with 把厨房收拾了 朋友：然后再写报告 你：对 环境清爽了才写得进去
start off with.example: Friend: What will you do first this weekend, write the report? You: I want to start off with tidying the kitchen. Friend: Then the report. You: Right, I focus better in a clean space.

start on.context: 你吃完饭打算开始收拾脏衣服，朋友约你出去散步，你说等我把这堆衣服洗完再出门，这时就会用到 start on。
start on.translation: 朋友：吃完饭我们出去散步吧 你：等我先 start on 这堆脏衣服 洗完再走 朋友：那我等你 你：行 半小时就洗完
start on.example: Friend: Let us go for a walk after dinner. You: Let me start on this pile of laundry first, then we go. Friend: I will wait for you. You: Okay, it will be done in half an hour.

start out.context: 你刚毕业进公司从最基础的岗位做起，朋友问你工作感觉如何，你说一切才刚开始，这时就会用到 start out。
start out.translation: 朋友：新工作感觉怎么样 你：刚 start out 从最基础的活干起 朋友：慢慢来 什么都得学 你：对 先把流程摸熟
start out.example: Friend: How is the new job? You: I am just starting out, doing the most basic tasks. Friend: Take it slow, you have everything to learn. You: Right, first get the process down.

start out with.context: 你学烘焙一开始只用最简单的原料，从最基础的配方做起，朋友问你怎么入门的，这时就会用到 start out with。
start out with.translation: 朋友：你怎么学做蛋糕的 你：一开始 start out with 最简单的配方 朋友：失败过吗 你：当然 烤糊了好几个才成功
start out with.example: Friend: How did you learn to bake cakes? You: At first I started out with the simplest recipes. Friend: Did you fail? You: Of course, I burned several before it worked.

starting point.context: 你做旅行计划时先定第一站要去哪儿，朋友说这就是规划的起点，你说对，先把首站定了再排后面，这时就会用到 starting point。
starting point.translation: 朋友：你这趟旅行计划得怎样了 你：刚定了 starting point 第一站飞成都 朋友：然后呢 你：再从成都一路往南玩
starting point.example: Friend: How is your travel plan coming along? You: I just set the starting point, first stop flying to Chengdu. Friend: Then what? You: Then head south all the way from Chengdu.

stash away.context: 你把舍不得扔的旧照片和信都收到一个铁盒子里藏起来，朋友问你在干嘛，你说把这些宝贝收好，以后慢慢看，这时就会用到 stash away。
stash away.translation: 朋友：你在柜子里翻什么呢 你：把旧照片和信 stash away 到铁盒里 朋友：这些都是老回忆啊 你：对 收好了 以后翻出来看特别有意思
stash away.example: Friend: What are you digging through in the cabinet? You: I am stashing away old photos and letters in a metal box. Friend: Those are all old memories. You: Right, I will keep them safe and look back later.

static stretch.context: 上健身课老师让你站着保持一个拉伸姿势不动三十秒，朋友问这跟以前弹来弹去的拉伸有啥不一样，这时就会用到 static stretch。
static stretch.translation: 朋友：你这节课怎么站着不动 你：老师让做 static stretch 保持姿势不动 朋友：跟以前那种弹来弹去有啥区别 你：这种拉得更深 不伤韧带
static stretch.example: Friend: Why are you standing still in this class? You: The teacher has us do a static stretch, holding the pose. Friend: How is it different from the bouncing kind? You: This stretches deeper and does not hurt the ligaments.

status signifier.context: 你看到有人戴块大金表，朋友说这表就是给别人看地位的标志，不是为了看时间，这时就会用到 status signifier。
status signifier.translation: 朋友：他那块大金表真贵吧 你：其实根本不看时间 就是个 status signifier 朋友：戴出来给别人看的 你：对 表就是身份的广告牌
status signifier.example: Friend: That gold watch on his wrist must be expensive. You: He barely checks the time on it, it is just a status signifier. Friend: Worn for other people to see. You: Right, the watch is a billboard of status.

status symbol.context: 朋友买了辆豪华车，车标一露出来大家都知道他条件不错，朋友说这种车就是身份象征，这时就会用到 status symbol。
status symbol.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然换了辆好车 你：车就是个 status symbol 开出去有面子 朋友：其实性能也没多强 你：对 买的就是个标
status symbol.example: Friend: Why did he suddenly switch to a luxury car? You: A car is a status symbol, it gives him face out there. Friend: It is not even that much better to drive. You: Right, he buys the badge.

stay at.context: 你周末不想出门，就待在家里看书，朋友约你吃饭，你说我就在家待着了，叫外卖吧，这时就会用到 stay at。
stay at.translation: 朋友：周末出来聚餐吧 你：我就 stay at 家了 不想动 朋友：那我给你叫个外卖送过去 你：行 一份黄焖鸡
stay at.example: Friend: Come out for a meal this weekend. You: I will just stay at home, do not want to move. Friend: Then I will order delivery to your place. You: Okay, one braised chicken.

stay awake.context: 你昨晚熬夜看球，今早得开车去办事，朋友提醒你别困，一定要保持清醒，这时就会用到 stay awake。
stay awake.translation: 朋友：你昨晚看球看到几点 你：看到两点 今早开车得 stay awake 朋友：困了就开窗吹吹风 你：行 我喝杯咖啡提提神
stay awake.example: Friend: How late did you watch the game last night? You: Till two, and I have to stay awake driving today. Friend: If you get sleepy, open the window. You: Okay, I will have a coffee to perk up.

stay fit.context: 你每周固定去游泳三次，两年没感冒过，朋友问你身材怎么保持这么好，你说就是坚持锻炼，这时就会用到 stay fit。
stay fit.translation: 朋友：你怎么两年都没感冒过 你：我每周游泳三次 就为了 stay fit 朋友：这习惯真不错 你：对 身体是自己的
stay fit.example: Friend: How come you have not caught a cold in two years? You: I swim three times a week to stay fit. Friend: That habit is great. You: Right, your health is your own.

stay fit and healthy.context: 你每天早起跑步还吃蔬菜，朋友问你有什么保养秘诀，你说就是坚持运动加健康饮食，这时就会用到 stay fit and healthy。
stay fit and healthy.translation: 朋友：你看着比实际年龄年轻十岁 你：我天天早起跑步 吃蔬菜 朋友：就是靠运动和饮食 stay fit and healthy 你：对 别熬夜比啥都强
stay fit and healthy.example: Friend: You look ten years younger than your age. You: I jog early every morning and eat vegetables. Friend: So you stay fit and healthy through exercise and diet. You: Right, not staying up late beats everything.

stay focused.context: 你考试复习时把手机放到另一个房间，朋友问你怎么这么自律，你说学习时就得保持专注，这时就会用到 stay focused。
stay focused.translation: 朋友：你怎么学习时把手机放别的屋 你：为了 stay focused 不被消息打断 朋友：这办法真管用 你：对 一拿手机就浪费一小时
stay focused.example: Friend: Why do you put your phone in another room when studying? You: To stay focused, no message interruptions. Friend: That method really works. You: Right, one glance at the phone wastes an hour.

stay in.context: 外面下大雨刮大风，你跟朋友说今天哪儿也不去了，就待在家里看电影，这时就会用到 stay in。
stay in.translation: 朋友：今天外面刮大风 还出门吗 你：算了 stay in 在家看电影吧 朋友：那我点个外卖过去陪你 你：行 再来桶爆米花
stay in.example: Friend: It is windy out today, still going out? You: Forget it, I will stay in and watch a movie. Friend: Then I will order delivery and come over. You: Okay, bring a bucket of popcorn too.

stay in sync.context: 你和异地恋的对象平时作息不一样，周末特意约着同时起床同时睡，朋友说你们这是在找同步，这时就会用到 stay in sync。
stay in sync.translation: 朋友：你俩异地怎么还能每天同时睡 你：特意调作息 stay in sync 这样聊天时间才凑得上 朋友：挺不容易的 你：对 距离远就得靠默契
stay in sync.example: Friend: How do you and your long-distance partner sleep at the same time? You: We adjusted our schedules to stay in sync, so we can chat. Friend: That is not easy. You: Right, distance takes mutual effort.

stay in the zone.context: 你在电脑前做设计时整个人进入状态，两小时都没看手机，朋友喊你吃饭你都没听见，这时就会用到 stay in the zone。
stay in the zone.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么喊你都不应 你：我做图做 stay in the zone 了 完全没听见 朋友：这种专注状态真难得 你：对 思路一断就接不上了
stay in the zone.example: Friend: Why did you not answer when I called just now? You: I stayed in the zone designing and did not hear you. Friend: That focus is rare. You: Right, once the thread breaks it is hard to pick up.

stay mobile.context: 你陪奶奶每天散步做手指操，医生说老人多活动能保持肢体灵活，这时就会用到 stay mobile。
stay mobile.translation: 朋友：你奶奶快九十了还能自己走路 你：每天陪她散步做手指操 朋友：老人就得这样 stay mobile 才不退化 你：对 越不动越僵硬
stay mobile.example: Friend: Your grandma is nearly ninety and still walks on her own? You: I walk with her and do finger exercises daily. Friend: Older people must stay mobile to slow decline. You: Right, the less you move, the stiffer you get.

stay motivated.context: 你备考时一开始天天学，过两周就想放弃，朋友说你得找到动力，别半途而废，这时就会用到 stay motivated。
stay motivated.translation: 朋友：你怎么学了两周就不想学了 你：太累了 没劲了 朋友：你得 stay motivated 想想考上以后 你：对 我贴个目标在桌前激励自己
stay motivated.example: Friend: Why do you not want to study after two weeks? You: It is too tiring, I have no drive. Friend: You need to stay motivated, think of the reward. You: Right, I will stick a goal note on my desk.

stay on top of.context: 你做新媒体运营，每天要看热点、刷数据，朋友问你怎么跟得上变化这么快的行业，你说得时刻盯紧，这时就会用到 stay on top of。
stay on top of.translation: 朋友：你们这行变化这么快 怎么跟得上 你：每天都得 stay on top of 热点和数据 朋友：稍微一停就落后 你：对 这行不进则退
stay on top of.example: Friend: Your industry changes so fast, how do you keep up? You: Every day I have to stay on top of trends and data. Friend: Stop for a second and you fall behind. You: Right, it is sink or swim.

stay on track with.context: 你在准备雅思考试，每天按计划刷题，朋友问你进度怎么样，你说我得按计划走不能跑偏，这时就会用到 stay on track with。
stay on track with.translation: 朋友：你雅思复习进度怎么样 你：每天按计划做题 stay on track with 目标 朋友：别被别的事打乱节奏 你：对 这周开始口语也要练了
stay on track with.example: Friend: How is your IELTS prep going? You: I do exercises on schedule to stay on track with the goal. Friend: Do not let other things break your rhythm. You: Right, I start practising speaking this week too.

stay sharp.context: 你年纪大了还坚持每天读报纸玩数独，医生说多动脑筋能让脑子保持敏锐，这时就会用到 stay sharp。
stay sharp.translation: 朋友：你爷爷八十多了反应还挺快 你：他天天看报玩数独 朋友：就是靠这些小任务 stay sharp 你：对 脑子越用越灵
stay sharp.example: Friend: Your grandfather is eighty-something and still quick-witted. You: He reads the paper and does Sudoku every day. Friend: That keeps him staying sharp. You: Right, the brain gets sharper with use.

stay with.context: 你学骑车时摔了好几次，朋友扶着车让你别放弃，坚持练就能学会，这时就会用到 stay with。
stay with.translation: 朋友：摔了三次了 还学吗 你：我再 stay with 它练几次 肯定能学会 朋友：慢慢来 平衡感一下就来了 你：行 我再试两圈
stay with.example: Friend: You have fallen three times, still want to learn? You: I will stay with it a few more tries, I will get it. Friend: Go slow, balance clicks suddenly. You: Okay, two more laps.

stay-at-home dad.context: 你邻居夫妻俩都上班，爸爸在家带孩子做饭，朋友说这是新趋势，全职奶爸也不少了，这时就会用到 stay-at-home dad。
stay-at-home dad.translation: 朋友：你邻居家怎么是爸爸接孩子 你：他是 stay-at-home dad 在家带娃做饭 朋友：现在这样的爸爸真不少 你：对 谁工资低谁在家带
stay-at-home dad.example: Friend: Why is the dad picking up the kid at your neighbour's? You: He is a stay-at-home dad, raising the kid and cooking. Friend: There are plenty of dads like that now. You: Right, whoever earns less stays home.

stayed out.context: 你周末在外面玩到半夜才回家，朋友问你今晚又去哪儿疯了，这时就会用到 stayed out。
stayed out.translation: 朋友：你昨晚几点回来的 你：跟朋友聚餐 stayed out 到半夜十二点 朋友：一玩就忘了时间 你：对 聊嗨了就没注意几点
stayed out.example: Friend: What time did you get back last night? You: I stayed out till midnight at a dinner with friends. Friend: You lose track of time once you have fun. You: Right, we got talking and did not notice.

stays the same.context: 你问朋友这城市跟五年比有变化吗，朋友说除了多了几栋楼，其他都没怎么变，这时就会用到 stays the same。
stays the same.translation: 朋友：五年没回这城市 变化大吗 你：除了多了几栋楼 其他 stays the same 朋友：那老馆子还在吗 你：都在 味道也没变
stays the same.example: Friend: It has been five years since I left, is the city much changed? You: Besides a few new buildings, it stays the same. Friend: Is that old restaurant still there? You: Still there, tastes the same too.

steam on.context: 项目遇到困难大家有点泄气，老板开会说我们不能停，得继续加紧推进，这时就会用到 steam on。
steam on.translation: 朋友：项目遇到坎了 大家都有点丧 你：老板说别停 继续 steam on 往前推 朋友：他倒是有信心 你：对 越是难越不能松劲
steam on.example: Friend: The project hit a wall, everyone feels down. You: The boss said do not stop, keep steaming on forward. Friend: He sure has faith. You: Right, the harder it gets the harder we push.

steeping time.context: 你泡茶时把茶叶放进去，朋友问要泡多久，你说泡个三四分钟味道最好，这时就会用到 steeping time。
steeping time.translation: 朋友：这茶要泡多久才好喝 你：steeping time 三四分钟 太久会苦 朋友：那我定个闹钟 你：行 时间到了叫我
steeping time.example: Friend: How long should this tea steep? You: The steeping time is three to four minutes, too long turns bitter. Friend: Then I will set a timer. You: Okay, tell me when it rings.

steer clear of.context: 医生让你少喝冰的少吃辣的，朋友聚餐总约火锅，你说我得远离那些刺激肠胃的食物，这时就会用到 steer clear of。
steer clear of.translation: 朋友：周末又去吃火锅吧 你：医生让我 steer clear of 辣的冰的 朋友：那你吃点清淡的锅 你：行 我点个番茄锅
steer clear of.example: Friend: Hot pot again this weekend? You: The doctor told me to steer clear of spicy and iced food. Friend: Then you have the mild broth. You: Okay, I will get the tomato one.

stems from.context: 你脾气急，朋友说你每次跟人吵架都因为沉不住气，其实问题根源是你太想赢，这时就会用到 stems from。
stems from.translation: 朋友：你每次吵架都那么激动 你：我也不知道 就是控制不住 朋友：其实 stems from 你太想赢过别人 你：唉 被你说中了 是该改改
stems from.example: Friend: Why do you get so heated every fight? You: I do not know, I just cannot help it. Friend: It stems from you wanting to win every argument. You: Ugh, you nailed it, I should change.

step foot in.context: 朋友邀请你去一个特别高端的私人会所，你说那种地方我从来没踏进去过，朋友笑你土，这时就会用到 step foot in。
step foot in.translation: 朋友：周末带你去个高级会所玩玩 你：那种地方我从来没 step foot in 过 朋友：怕什么 我带你见世面 你：行 但我可不会说那边的客套话
step foot in.example: Friend: Let me take you to a fancy private club this weekend. You: I have never stepped foot in a place like that. Friend: What are you afraid of, I will show you the world. You: Okay, but I do not know their fancy manners.

step in the right direction.context: 你之前一直想学游泳但没行动，今天终于报了个班，朋友说你这是往对的方向迈出了一步，这时就会用到 step in the right direction。
step in the right direction.translation: 朋友：你今天终于报游泳班了 你：想了两年 今天才迈出第一步 朋友：这就是 step in the right direction 你：对 先下水再说
step in the right direction.example: Friend: You finally signed up for swimming today? You: Thought about it for two years, today I made the first move. Friend: That is a step in the right direction. You: Right, just get in the water.

step into.context: 老领导退休了，新接手的同事临时被推上负责整个项目，朋友问他准备好了吗，这时就会用到 step into。
step into.translation: 朋友：老领导突然退休 谁接他的活 你：小李临时 step into 那个位置 朋友：他压力肯定很大 你：对 整个项目一下子压他身上
step into.example: Friend: The old manager suddenly retired, who takes over? You: Xiao Li suddenly stepped into that role. Friend: He must be under huge pressure. You: Right, the whole project landed on him at once.

step out of.context: 你在一家公司待了五年，朋友说你该跳出舒适区去试试新岗位，别老待在熟悉的地方，这时就会用到 step out of。
step out of.translation: 朋友：你在这公司五年了 没想过换换 你：待着太舒服了 不想动 朋友：你该 step out of 舒适区 试试挑战 你：也是 我看看外面机会
step out of.example: Friend: Five years at the same company, never thought of a change? You: It is too comfortable, I do not want to move. Friend: You should step out of your comfort zone and try a challenge. You: True, I will look at outside options.

step out onto.context: 你早上推开门走到阳台上，发现外面下了大雪，白茫茫一片，朋友惊讶说一晚上就积雪了，这时就会用到 step out onto。
step out onto.translation: 朋友：你昨晚听到风声没 你：我今早 step out onto 阳台 一看全是雪 朋友：一夜之间就积了这么厚 你：对 出门都得穿靴子
step out onto.example: Friend: Did you hear the wind last night? You: I stepped out onto the balcony this morning and saw it was all snow. Friend: That much snow piled up overnight. You: Right, I have to wear boots to go out.

step up to the plate.context: 团队里没人愿意接这个烂摊子项目，你主动举手说我来扛，同事们都看着你，老板也松了口气，这时就会用到 step up to the plate。
step up to the plate.translation: 朋友：这个烂摊子项目没人愿意接 你：那我 step up to the plate 我来扛 朋友：你真行 这活可不好干 你：总得有人接吧
step up to the plate.example: Friend: Nobody wants to take on this messy project. You: Then I will step up to the plate and take it on. Friend: You are brave, this job is tough. You: Someone has to do it.

stepping stone.context: 你先在小公司干两年攒经验，再跳去大公司，朋友说小公司就是个跳板，能让你走到更大的平台，这时就会用到 stepping stone。
stepping stone.translation: 朋友：你怎么先去小公司 不直接去大厂 你：小公司是个 stepping stone 攒经验再跳 朋友：这样履历更好看 你：对 先练本事再谈平台
