stepping stone.example: Friend: Why start at a small company instead of a big firm? You: A small company is a stepping stone to build experience. Friend: Then your résumé looks better. You: Right, build skills first, then aim higher.

stepping stones.context: 公园里有一条小溪，要踩着水里一块块石头才能过去，朋友问你敢不敢走，这时就会用到 stepping stones。
stepping stones.translation: 朋友：前面这条小溪怎么过去 你：踩着那些 stepping stones 一块块过去 朋友：别掉水里了 你：小心点走 抓稳石头
stepping stones.example: Friend: How do we cross that little stream ahead? You: Step across those stepping stones one by one. Friend: Do not fall in. You: Step carefully and hold the stones steady.

stick around.context: 电影散场后朋友说别急着走，等人群散一散再出去，免得挤，于是你们在座位上又坐了一会儿，这时就会用到 stick around。
stick around.translation: 朋友：电影结束了 走吧 你：再 stick around 一会儿 等人散了再出去 朋友：行 那我们多坐两分钟 你：对 挤在门口也难受
stick around.example: Friend: The movie is over, let us go. You: Stick around a bit longer, wait for the crowd to thin. Friend: Okay, we will sit another two minutes. You: Right, squeezing by the door is no fun.

stick out.context: 你在人群里一眼就看到那个穿亮红外套的朋友，他太显眼了，老远就看见，这时就会用到 stick out。
stick out.translation: 朋友：你怎么一下就看到我了 你：你那件红外套在人群里 stick out 老远 朋友：哈哈 我就知道穿红色好找 你：对 以后聚会你就穿这件
stick out.example: Friend: How did you spot me so fast? You: That red jacket sticks out in the crowd, I saw you from far. Friend: Haha, I knew red would be easy to find. You: Right, wear this at every gathering.

stick to resolutions.context: 新年你给自己定了每天跑步半小时的计划，结果过了三天就放弃了，朋友说你得坚持住，别又是三分钟热度，这时就会用到 stick to resolutions。
stick to resolutions.translation: 朋友：你新年不是说要天天跑步吗 你：跑了三天就没跑了 朋友：你得 stick to resolutions 别又放弃 你：是 我今天开始重新跑
stick to resolutions.example: Friend: Did you not resolve to run every day for the New Year? You: I quit after three days. Friend: You have to stick to resolutions, do not give up again. You: Right, I start running again today.

stick to their guns.context: 开会时大家都劝你改方案，你坚持自己的想法不改，朋友说你立场真坚定，这时就会用到 stick to their guns。
stick to their guns.translation: 朋友：大家都让你改方案 你怎么想 你：我觉得这个方向对 就 stick to my guns 不改 朋友：你真坚定 不怕得罪人 你：对的事就得坚持
stick to their guns.example: Friend: Everyone wants you to change the plan, what do you think? You: I think this direction is right, I will stick to my guns. Friend: You are really firm, not afraid to upset people. You: I stand by what is right.

stick with it.context: 你学吉他一开始按弦手疼想放弃，老师说别放弃，坚持练就能弹曲子，朋友也鼓励你再坚持，这时就会用到 stick with it。
stick with it.translation: 朋友：按弦手太疼了 我不想学了 你：老师说 stick with it 熬过这阵就好了 朋友：那你再练一个月 你：行 我坚持下去
stick with it.example: Friend: My fingers hurt pressing the strings, I want to quit. You: The teacher says stick with it, you will get past this stage. Friend: Then practise another month. You: Okay, I will stick with it.

stiff penalty.context: 你闯红灯被交警拦下，朋友说这种违章罚得很重，聊到严厉的处罚，这时就会用到 stiff penalty。
stiff penalty.translation: 朋友：你怎么闯红灯了 你：没注意灯就过去了 朋友：这种违章 stiff penalty 扣六分还罚款 你：唉 下次再也不敢了
stiff penalty.example: Friend: Why did you run the red light? You: I did not notice the light and went through. Friend: That offence carries a stiff penalty, six points and a fine. You: Sigh, I will never do that again.

stifle curiosity.context: 妈妈总说孩子问东问西太烦，让他别问了，朋友说这样会掐灭孩子的好奇心，这时就会用到 stifle curiosity。
stifle curiosity.translation: 朋友：你家孩子怎么天天追着问为什么 你：我嫌烦 让他别问了 朋友：别 stifle curiosity 多好的事 你：也是 我以后耐心点答
stifle curiosity.example: Friend: Why does your kid chase you with so many questions? You: I get annoyed and tell him to stop. Friend: Do not stifle his curiosity, it is a good thing. You: True, I will be more patient answering.

still a long way off.context: 你问朋友博士还要读几年才能毕业，朋友笑着说还早呢，离毕业还有好长一段路，这时就会用到 still a long way off。
still a long way off.translation: 朋友：你博士快毕业了吧 你：才第二年 毕业还 still a long way off 呢 朋友：那还得熬个三四年 你：是啊 慢慢来呗
still a long way off.example: Friend: Are you nearly done with your PhD? You: Only my second year, graduation is still a long way off. Friend: Then another three or four years to grind. You: Right, take it slow.

stimulate creativity.context: 老师说教学方法要灵活，别照本宣科，要多用游戏和讨论激发学生的创造力，这时就会用到 stimulate creativity。
stimulate creativity.translation: 朋友：老师上课天天念PPT 好无聊 你：老师说要 stimulate creativity 得让学生多动手 朋友：那多上点实验课多好 你：对 光听课没动力
stimulate creativity.example: Friend: The teacher just reads the slides every class, so boring. You: The teacher says to stimulate creativity we need more hands-on work. Friend: More lab classes would be better. You: Right, just listening gives no drive.

stir up.context: 你一提前任朋友就叹气，说你总翻旧账勾起大家的情绪，聊到这种勾起往事的做法，这时就会用到 stir up。
stir up.translation: 朋友：你怎么又提以前那事 你：我就是随口一说 朋友：你这是 stir up 大家的不愉快 别提了 你：好 我不说了 吃饭吃饭
stir up.example: Friend: Why bring up that old thing again? You: I just mentioned it offhand. Friend: You are stirring up bad feelings again, drop it. You: Okay, I will stop, let us eat.

stock up on.context: 台风要来之前，小区群里大家开始囤水囤零食，朋友说这种天气就得提前备足物资，这时就会用到 stock up on。
stock up on.translation: 朋友：台风要来了 你去超市吗 你：去 stock up on 水和吃的 朋友：我也去 再买几包方便面 你：行 咱们一起去
stock up on.example: Friend: The typhoon is coming, are you going to the supermarket? You: Yes, stock up on water and food. Friend: I will go too, get a few packs of instant noodles. You: Okay, let us go together.

stoop over.context: 你低头写东西太久，脖子酸得不行，朋友让你别一直俯身趴在桌上，起来活动活动，这时就会用到 stoop over。
stoop over.translation: 朋友：你怎么一直在揉脖子 你：我 stoop over 桌子写了一下午报告 朋友：别老弯腰趴着 起来走走 你：行 我去倒杯水活动下
stoop over.example: Friend: Why are you rubbing your neck? You: I have been stooping over the desk writing reports all afternoon. Friend: Do not hunch over all day, stand up and walk. You: Okay, I will get some water and stretch.

stop by.context: 你下班路上顺道去邻居家还个书，没提前约就敲了门，朋友说你这是顺便过去看看，这时就会用到 stop by。
stop by.translation: 朋友：你下班怎么这么晚才到家 你：stop by 邻居家还了本书 聊了两句 朋友：你们关系真不错 你：对 都是老邻居了
stop by.example: Friend: Why are you home so late from work? You: I stopped by the neighbour's to return a book and chatted a bit. Friend: You two get along well. You: Right, we are old neighbours.

stop off.context: 你开车去外地，路上在一家小镇加油站停了十分钟吃个热狗，朋友说你这是中途短暂停一下，这时就会用到 stop off。
stop off.translation: 朋友：我们开了三小时了 休息一下吧 你：前面有个加油站 stop off 一下 买点吃的 朋友：行 我正好上个厕所 你：十分钟就回来
stop off.example: Friend: We have driven three hours, let us rest. You: There is a gas station ahead, let us stop off and get food. Friend: Good, I need the restroom. You: Back in ten minutes.

stop-go traffic.context: 你周末开车进城，路上车子一辆接一辆堵得一动不动，朋友叹口气说这一路真是走走停停，这时就会用到 stop-go traffic。
stop-go traffic.translation: 朋友：今天进城怎么这么慢 你：路上全是 stop-go traffic 一步一挪 朋友：早知道坐地铁来了 你：是啊 周末进城别开车
stop-go traffic.example: Friend: Why is it so slow getting into town today? You: The road is all stop-go traffic, inching along. Friend: We should have taken the metro. You: Right, never drive into town on weekends.

store memory.context: 你背单词时把它们放进不同场景里记，老师说这样知识能更好地储存在大脑里，这时就会用到 store memory。
store memory.translation: 朋友：你怎么记单词记得那么牢 你：我把它们放进故事里 store memory 朋友：这种方法比死记硬背强 你：对 有画面就忘不掉
store memory.example: Friend: How do you memorize words so well? You: I put them in stories to store memory better. Friend: That beats rote memorizing. You: Right, a picture makes it unforgettable.

storm drain.context: 夏天暴雨过后，路边排水井往外冒水，朋友问那是啥管道，你说那是雨水排水管，这时就会用到 storm drain。
storm drain.translation: 朋友：大雨过后那井盖怎么往外冒水 你：那是 storm drain 排水井 雨太大来不及排 朋友：小心别踩 水挺深 你：对 绕着走
storm drain.example: Friend: Why is that well cover gushing after the heavy rain? You: That is the storm drain, the rain is too much to drain quickly. Friend: Careful not to step in, the water is deep. You: Right, walk around it.

storm suppression.context: 新闻说科学家在试验怎么给台风削弱风力，让它登陆时别那么猛，朋友说这是在人工控制风暴，这时就会用到 storm suppression。
storm suppression.translation: 朋友：新闻说台风要登陆了 你：科学家在试 storm suppression 想削弱它 朋友：真能把风搞小吗 你：能稍微减弱一点 减少破坏
storm suppression.example: Friend: The news says the typhoon is making landfall. You: Scientists are trying storm suppression to weaken it. Friend: Can they really soften the wind? You: A little, to reduce damage.

straight after.context: 你开完会马上就去见客户，朋友问你怎么不喘口气，你说事情一件接一件，开完会立刻就得走，这时就会用到 straight after。
straight after.translation: 朋友：你会开完了 歇会儿再去客户那儿 你：不了 straight after 就走 客户在等 朋友：你也太连轴转了 你：没办法 时间排满了
straight after.example: Friend: The meeting is done, rest a bit before the client visit. You: No, I leave straight after, the client is waiting. Friend: You are going nonstop. You: No choice, the schedule is packed.

straight away.context: 朋友给你打电话说有急事，你一听就放下手头的事立刻出门，朋友说你来得真快，这时就会用到 straight away。
straight away.translation: 朋友：你在家吗 出急事了 你：我 straight away 就过来了 你在哪儿 朋友：我在地铁站口 你：我五分钟到
straight away.example: Friend: Are you home, something urgent came up. You: I am coming straight away, where are you? Friend: I am at the metro exit. You: I will be there in five minutes.

straight to the point.context: 朋友说话绕了半天还没说到重点，你打断他说你直接说结论吧，别绕圈子，这时就会用到 straight to the point。
straight to the point.translation: 朋友：我跟你说今天那事 就是那个 朋友你：你能不能 straight to the point 直接说结果 朋友：就是我被领导表扬了 你：早说嘛 恭喜恭喜
straight to the point.example: Friend: Let me tell you about today's thing, you know that... Friend: Can you get straight to the point and say the result? Friend: I got praised by the boss. You: Tell me sooner, congratulations.

straight up in the air.context: 你拍跳高视频时镜头里那人身子绷得笔直往上跳，朋友说他整个人直挺挺往上窜，这时就会用到 straight up in the air。
straight up in the air.translation: 朋友：他跳起来那姿势真好看 你：整个人 straight up in the air 特别直 朋友：像根弹起来的弹簧 你：对 他弹力特别好
straight up in the air.example: Friend: That form when he jumps looks great. You: His body is straight up in the air, so upright. Friend: Like a bouncing spring. You: Right, his rebound is excellent.

strain friendship.context: 你和好朋友因为借钱的事闹得不愉快，两年都没说话，朋友说钱这东西太伤感情了，这时就会用到 strain friendship。
strain friendship.translation: 朋友：你俩怎么两年没联系了 你：上次借钱的事 strain 了 friendship 朋友：钱真的最伤感情 你：是啊 现在都不好意思找他
strain friendship.example: Friend: Why have you two not spoken for two years? You: That money thing strained our friendship. Friend: Money really damages friendships. You: Right, I am too awkward to reach out now.

strap on.context: 你玩跳伞前教练把安全带绑在你身上，说设备都固定好了，让你别担心，这时就会用到 strap on。
strap on.translation: 朋友：你今天跳伞 紧张吗 你：教练把装备 strap on 好了 说很安全 朋友：那你到时候别害怕 你：行 我跳
strap on.example: Friend: You are skydiving today, nervous? You: The instructor strapped on all my gear, he says it is safe. Friend: Do not panic up there. You: Okay, I will jump.

strapped for cash.context: 你这个月花超了，房租都快交不起，朋友问你怎么不出去玩了，你说最近手头紧，这时就会用到 strapped for cash。
strapped for cash.translation: 朋友：周末出去玩吧 你：不去了 最近 strapped for cash 朋友：你也太省了 钱呢 你：这个月买太多东西了
strapped for cash.example: Friend: Let us go out this weekend. You: Skip it, I am strapped for cash lately. Friend: You are being too frugal, where did the money go? You: I bought too much this month.

strategic thinking.context: 老板在会上说做管理不能只看眼前，要有长远的战略眼光，朋友问这是什么意思，你说就是想远一点，这时就会用到 strategic thinking。
strategic thinking.translation: 朋友：老板今天讲什么战略 我没听懂 你：就是 strategic thinking 别只顾眼前 朋友：那我们小员工想那么远干嘛 你：对 想长远点没坏处
strategic thinking.example: Friend: What was that strategy the boss talked about today, I did not get it. You: It is strategic thinking, do not only focus on the near term. Friend: Why should we small staff think that far? You: Right, it does not hurt to plan ahead.

stream down.context: 你看电影里主角难过时眼泪顺着脸颊往下流，朋友说她哭得真伤心，这时就会用到 stream down。
stream down.translation: 朋友：她怎么哭成这样 你：眼泪一直 stream down 脸颊 看着都心疼 朋友：这戏演得真投入 你：对 把人都看哭了
stream down.example: Friend: Why is she crying so hard? You: Tears are streaming down her cheeks, it is heart-wrenching. Friend: She really threw herself into the role. You: Right, it makes us cry too.

stream platform.context: 你周末在家用Netflix看剧，朋友问你用什么平台看的，你说就是视频网站，想看什么搜一下就行，这时就会用到 stream platform。
stream platform.translation: 朋友：你昨晚看的那部剧哪儿看的 你：就在 stream platform 上 搜剧名就行 朋友：那得开会员吧 你：对 一个月十几块
stream platform.example: Friend: Where did you watch that show last night? You: On a stream platform, just search the title. Friend: So you need a membership? You: Right, about ten yuan a month.

streaming service.context: 你周末在家用Netflix追剧，朋友问你怎么不买会员还能看剧，你说网上这种视频订阅平台很多，聊到流媒体服务，这时就会用到 streaming service。
streaming service.translation: 朋友：你最近追的剧在哪儿看的 你：就用那个 streaming service 会员一充随便看 朋友：那一个月多少钱 你：十几块 比买盘划算
streaming service.example: Friend: Where are you watching that show these days? You: On that streaming service, one membership and I watch anything. Friend: How much a month? You: About ten yuan, cheaper than buying discs.

streaming services.context: 你手机里装了好几个视频App，朋友问你为什么装这么多，你说不同平台有不同的剧，都得订，这时就会用到 streaming services。
streaming services.translation: 朋友：你手机怎么装了五六个视频App 你：不同 streaming services 有不同的剧 朋友：那会员费得好几百吧 你：轮流开 看完一个再开另一个
streaming services.example: Friend: Why do you have five or six video apps on your phone? You: Different streaming services carry different shows. Friend: Then the membership fees add up to hundreds. You: I rotate them, finish one then open another.

street fashion.context: 你逛潮流街区看到年轻人都穿着滑板鞋、印花卫衣，朋友说这就是现在流行的街头风格，这时就会用到 street fashion。
street fashion.translation: 朋友：这条街怎么年轻人穿得都这么潮 你：这就是 street fashion 街头风格 朋友：跟上班穿的完全不一样 你：对 舒服又有个性
street fashion.example: Friend: Why do young people on this street dress so trendily? You: That is street fashion, the streetwear style. Friend: Totally different from office wear. You: Right, comfy and individual.

strength training.context: 你去健身房，教练让你举铁练肌肉，别光做跑步机有氧，朋友说增肌得做力量训练，这时就会用到 strength training。
strength training.translation: 朋友：你去健身房都干嘛 就跑步吗 你：现在主要做 strength training 举铁 朋友：举铁能长肌肉 不粗吗 你：练对了线条好看 不会变壮
strength training.example: Friend: What do you do at the gym, just run? You: Now I mainly do strength training, lifting weights. Friend: Lifting builds muscle, will it get bulky? You: Done right, it gives shape, not bulk.

stress and anxiety.context: 你最近赶项目连续加班，又焦虑又睡不好，朋友看你脸色差，说你压力太大了，聊到紧张和焦虑，这时就会用到 stress and anxiety。
stress and anxiety.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老叹气 你：赶项目天天加班 整个人 stress and anxiety 朋友：得找点时间放松放松 你：等这阵忙完吧
stress and anxiety.example: Friend: Why do you keep sighing lately? You: Crunching on a project, working overtime, all this stress and anxiety. Friend: You need some time to relax. You: Once this rush is over.

stress fracture.context: 你跑步太久膝盖疼，去医院检查，医生说骨头没断但有小裂纹，是运动量太大造成的应力性骨折，这时就会用到 stress fracture。
stress fracture.translation: 朋友：你膝盖怎么肿了 你：跑太多 医生说是 stress fracture 应力性骨折 朋友：那得休息多久 你：至少六周不能跑
stress fracture.example: Friend: Why is your knee swollen? You: I ran too much, the doctor says it is a stress fracture. Friend: How long do you have to rest? You: At least six weeks of no running.

stress hormone.context: 医生抽血检查，说你压力大的时候身体会分泌一种让你紧张的激素，聊到压力激素，这时就会用到 stress hormone。
stress hormone.translation: 朋友：医生抽血都查什么呀 你：看压力激素水平 最近太累了 朋友：这种 stress hormone 高了会怎样 你：会失眠还掉头发
stress hormone.example: Friend: What does the blood test check? You: The stress hormone level, I have been too tired lately. Friend: What happens when that stress hormone is high? You: It causes insomnia and hair loss.

stress hormone cortisol.context: 医生给你解释说人在紧张时肾上腺会分泌一种叫皮质醇的东西，聊到这种压力激素，这时就会用到 stress hormone cortisol。
stress hormone cortisol.translation: 朋友：医生说我压力大 到底啥意思 你：就是 stress hormone cortisol 分泌太多了 朋友：那这玩意儿高了会怎样 你：会胖还会睡不着
stress hormone cortisol.example: Friend: What does the doctor mean by high stress? You: It means the stress hormone cortisol is overproduced. Friend: What happens when it is high? You: It makes you gain weight and lose sleep.

stress level.context: 你最近天天加班，朋友看你暴躁易怒，说你压力水平太高了，得减减压，这时就会用到 stress level。
stress level.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么一点小事就发火 你：加班太多 stress level 特别高 朋友：你得去按个摩放松下 你：行 周末我去泡个温泉
stress level.example: Friend: Why do you snap at the smallest things lately? You: Too much overtime, my stress level is through the roof. Friend: You need a massage to relax. You: Okay, I will soak in a hot spring this weekend.

stress management.context: 你看养生文章说现代人压力大，得学会管理情绪，朋友问怎么管理，文章说要有专门的减压技巧，这时就会用到 stress management。
stress management.translation: 朋友：你最近看什么书呢 你：在看 stress management 怎么减压 朋友：里面都教了啥 你：深呼吸 运动 别硬扛
stress management.example: Friend: What are you reading lately? You: A book on stress management, how to ease pressure. Friend: What does it teach? You: Deep breathing, exercise, do not tough it out.

stress relief.context: 你周末去爬山出了一身汗，朋友说这一身汗出完整个人都轻松了，聊到这种放松效果，这时就会用到 stress relief。
stress relief.translation: 朋友：周末爬山累不累 你：累是累 但出汗特别解压 朋友：运动真是最好的 stress relief 你：对 出一身汗烦恼全没了
stress relief.example: Friend: Was hiking tiring this weekend? You: Tiring, but sweating is so releasing. Friend: Exercise is the best stress relief. You: Right, one good sweat washes the worries away.

stress response.context: 你快考试了心跳加速手心出汗，老师说这是身体面对压力时的本能反应，这时就会用到 stress response。
stress response.translation: 朋友：你怎么一到考试就手心出汗 你：一紧张就心跳快 朋友：这是身体的 stress response 正常反应 你：那怎么才能不那么紧张 朋友：多考几次就习惯了
stress response.example: Friend: Why do your palms sweat every exam? You: The moment I get nervous my heart races. Friend: That is the body's stress response, totally normal. You: How do I stop being so nervous? Friend: After a few exams you get used to it.

stressed out.context: 你连续一个月天天加班到十点，今天对着电脑突然想哭，朋友说你这是压力爆棚了，得休息，这时就会用到 stressed out。
stressed out.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么眼睛红红的 你：连续加班一个月 整个人 stressed out 朋友：你今晚必须早点睡 别硬撑 你：行 我九点就上床
stressed out.example: Friend: Why are your eyes red today? You: A month of overtime, I am totally stressed out. Friend: You have to sleep early tonight, do not push on. You: Okay, I will go to bed at nine.

stressed out lives.context: 新闻说现代人天天加班赶进度，压力大得睡不着，聊到这种高压的生活状态，这时就会用到 stressed out lives。
stressed out lives.translation: 朋友：新闻说现在年轻人都睡不好 你：天天赶进度 过着 stressed out lives 朋友：这么拼值得吗 你：也是 身体最重要
stressed out lives.example: Friend: The news says young people these days cannot sleep. You: Always chasing deadlines, living stressed out lives. Friend: Is all that grind worth it? You: Right, health matters most.

stressful event.context: 你上周搬家又加班又感冒，一堆事挤在一起，朋友说你最近烦心事真多，这时就会用到 stressful event。
stressful event.translation: 朋友：你这两周怎么瘦了一圈 你：又搬家又加班还感冒 一堆 stressful event 朋友：你这阵子确实太折腾 你：等忙完这阵就好了
stressful event.example: Friend: Why have you lost weight in two weeks? You: Moving house, overtime and a cold, a string of stressful events. Friend: You have really been through it. You: Once this rush is over.

stressful scenario.context: 公司做心理测试，故意把志愿者放在高压场景里看他们怎么反应，朋友问这是在干嘛，你说这是压力测试，这时就会用到 stressful scenario。
stressful scenario.translation: 朋友：你们公司做什么测试呢 你：故意给个 stressful scenario 看大家反应 朋友：这是测抗压能力吗 你：对 看谁情绪最稳
stressful scenario.example: Friend: What test is your company running? You: They give people a stressful scenario and watch the response. Friend: Is that testing stress tolerance? You: Right, to see who stays calmest.

stressful situation.context: 你一个人在陌生城市找工作，每天跑面试，钱包越来越瘪，朋友说你这段时间真难，这时就会用到 stressful situation。
stressful situation.translation: 朋友：你最近一个人在那边还好吗 你：天天跑面试 压力特别大 朋友：你这 stressful situation 确实不容易 你：没事 总会找到工作的
stressful situation.example: Friend: Are you doing okay alone in that city? You: Running interviews every day, the pressure is huge. Friend: Your stressful situation is really tough. You: It is okay, I will land a job eventually.

stretch back.context: 你跟朋友聊起奶奶做的红烧肉那股香味，说这味道从童年一直记到现在，朋友说这记忆真久远，这时就会用到 stretch back。
stretch back.translation: 朋友：你怎么对红烧肉那么熟悉 你：这份记忆 stretch back 到我小时候 奶奶常做 朋友：几十年了 味道还记得 你：对 一想起来就流口水
stretch back.example: Friend: Why are you so familiar with braised pork? You: That memory stretches back to my childhood, grandma made it often. Friend: You still remember the taste after decades. You: Right, I salivate just thinking about it.

stretch budget.context: 你这个月花钱大手大脚，月底一算超预算了，朋友说你把钱花得太松了，下个月得省着点，这时就会用到 stretch budget。
stretch budget.translation: 朋友：你这月怎么超支了 你：买了太多东西 stretch 了 budget 朋友：下个月得勒紧点 你：对 这个月后半段吃泡面
stretch budget.example: Friend: Why did you go over budget this month? You: I bought too much and stretched the budget too far. Friend: Next month you have to tighten up. You: Right, instant noodles for the rest of this month.

stretch one's brain.context: 你怕自己变笨，每天做数独和逻辑题，朋友问你干嘛天天做题，你说就是锻炼大脑，这时就会用到 stretch one's brain。
stretch one's brain.translation: 朋友：你天天做数独干嘛 你：就是 stretch my brain 防止老年痴呆 朋友：你才多大就担心这个 你：哈哈 提前练着嘛
stretch one's brain.example: Friend: Why do you do Sudoku every day? You: Just to stretch my brain and avoid dementia. Friend: You are too young to worry about that. You: Haha, training early.

stretch the truth.context: 你朋友说他这次考试考了满分，你听他吹得太夸张，怀疑他是不是把成绩说大了，聊到夸大其词，这时就会用到 stretch the truth。
stretch the truth.translation: 朋友：他说他这次考了满分 你：我看是 stretch the truth 吧 顶多九十 朋友：他就爱吹牛 你：对 说什么都得打个折
stretch the truth.example: Friend: He says he got full marks on this exam. You: I think he is stretching the truth, maybe ninety. Friend: He loves to brag. You: Right, discount everything he says.

stretches from.context: 你看地图上那条山脉从西边一直绵延到东边，朋友说这山真长，横贯整个国家，这时就会用到 stretches from。
stretches from.translation: 朋友：地图上那座山有多长 你：它 stretches from 西边一直到东边 朋友：跨了好几个省吧 你：对 开车穿过都得一天
stretches from.example: Friend: How long is that mountain range on the map? You: It stretches from the west all the way to the east. Friend: It crosses several provinces, right? You: Right, driving across takes a day.

strike back.context: 你被同事抢了功劳，朋友劝你别忍，该反击就反击，别让人白欺负，这时就会用到 strike back。
strike back.translation: 朋友：你那份方案被他抢去邀功了 你：我知道 但我没说话 朋友：你得 strike back 凭什么让他白拿 你：对 下次我在会上说明
strike back.example: Friend: He took credit for your proposal. You: I know, but I stayed quiet. Friend: You have to strike back, why let him take it for free? You: Right, next meeting I will set the record straight.

strike up a conversation.context: 在电梯里你和一个陌生人对视，你笑着先开口聊今天天气，朋友说你真会主动搭话，这时就会用到 strike up a conversation。
strike up a conversation.translation: 朋友：你怎么跟电梯里陌生人聊起来了 你：我先 strike up a conversation 聊了句天气 朋友：你真自来熟 换我可不好意思 你：就一句话的事
strike up a conversation.example: Friend: How did you start chatting with the stranger in the lift? You: I struck up a conversation by talking about the weather. Friend: You are so at ease, I would be too shy. You: It is just one sentence.

strip off.context: 你夏天回家热得不行，一进门就把外套脱了扔沙发上，朋友说你这脱衣服也太急了，这时就会用到 strip off。
strip off.translation: 朋友：你一进门就脱外套干嘛 你：外面太热 赶紧 strip off 凉快凉快 朋友：把衣服挂好别乱扔 你：行 我挂起来
strip off.example: Friend: Why strip off your coat the moment you walk in? You: It is too hot outside, I strip off to cool down. Friend: Hang the coat up, do not throw it around. You: Okay, I will hang it up.

strives to.context: 你为了这次比赛准备了半年，每天训练四小时，朋友说你真拼，你说就是想尽全力做到最好，这时就会用到 strives to。
strives to.translation: 朋友：你每天训练多久啊 你：四小时 我 strives to 做到最好 朋友：半年后比赛 你肯定能行 你：希望吧 不拼一下后悔
strives to.example: Friend: How long do you train every day? You: Four hours, I strive to do my best. Friend: In half a year at the meet, you will nail it. You: Hope so, I will regret it if I do not give it my all.

stroke of.context: 你跟朋友约好八点见面，结果朋友八点整准时到，朋友说他准得像钟表，这时就会用到 stroke of。
stroke of.translation: 朋友：你怎么每次都八点整到 你：我习惯准点 八 on the stroke 就出现 朋友：比闹钟还准 你：约好几点就几点嘛
stroke of.example: Friend: Why are you always there exactly at eight? You: I am used to being on time, arriving on the stroke of eight. Friend: More punctual than an alarm clock. You: If we agree on a time, I keep it.

stroll along.context: 你周末没目的，沿着海边小路慢慢走，看渔船和海鸥，朋友说你这是在海边闲逛，这时就会用到 stroll along。
stroll along.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪儿玩了 你：在海边 stroll along 吹海风 朋友：吹海风散步真舒服 你：对 走了一下午也不累
stroll along.example: Friend: Where did you go this weekend? You: Strolled along the seaside, breathing the sea breeze. Friend: Walking by the sea sounds lovely. You: Right, I walked the whole afternoon without tiring.

stroll through.context: 你在老城区漫无目的地穿小巷，看老房子和花店，朋友说你这是在老街里闲逛，这时就会用到 stroll through。
stroll through.translation: 朋友：你下午一个人去哪了 你：在老街里 stroll through 看老房子 朋友：那种小巷特别有味道 你：对 走走停停很舒服
stroll through.example: Friend: Where did you go alone this afternoon? You: I strolled through the old town, looking at old houses. Friend: Those little lanes have so much character. You: Right, stopping and walking at your own pace is nice.

strong point.context: 朋友问你英语哪方面最拿手，你说口语是自己的强项，写作就一般了，这时就会用到 strong point。
strong point.translation: 朋友：你英语考试哪部分最厉害 你：听力是我 strong point 写作就不行 朋友：那你多练练写作 你：对 我这周末开始写日记
strong point.example: Friend: Which part of the English exam are you best at? You: Listening is my strong point, writing is weak. Friend: Then practise writing more. You: Right, I will keep a diary this weekend.

struggle to.context: 你第一次学做饭，切菜切到手，朋友说别灰心，一开始做都这样，慢慢来，这时就会用到 struggle to。
struggle to.translation: 朋友：你怎么把手切了 你：第一次切菜 struggle to 控制刀 朋友：慢慢来 练多了就好了 你：行 我这周再练两次
struggle to.example: Friend: Why did you cut your hand? You: It is my first time chopping, I struggle to control the knife. Friend: Take it slow, practice makes perfect. You: Okay, I will practise twice more this week.

struggled with.context: 你最近几个月一直被失眠困扰，每天躺床上两小时都睡不着，朋友说你这状态太差了，得看看医生，这时就会用到 struggled with。
struggled with.translation: 朋友：你最近黑眼圈怎么这么重 你：这两个月 struggled with 失眠 睡不好 朋友：那你赶紧去看看医生 你：我已经约了下周一
struggled with.example: Friend: Why are your dark circles so bad lately? You: I have struggled with insomnia these two months. Friend: Then go see a doctor soon. You: I already booked one for next Monday.

struggling to.context: 你刚进新公司，对着一堆新系统不会用，每天都在努力搞懂流程，朋友问你适应得怎样，你说还在使劲学，这时就会用到 struggling to。
struggling to.translation: 朋友：新公司上手了吗 你：还在 struggling to 搞懂这些系统 朋友：过两周就熟了 你：希望吧 每天都在问同事
struggling to.example: Friend: Have you picked up the new company yet? You: I am still struggling to figure out these systems. Friend: You will be used to it in two weeks. You: Hope so, I ask coworkers every day.

struggling with.context: 你朋友这两个月学新系统一直不顺，总卡壳，朋友说他还在跟困难较劲，聊到挣扎应对，这时就会用到 struggling with。
struggling with.translation: 朋友：你新工作上手了吗 你：还在 struggling with 这些系统 老出错 朋友：过两周就熟了 你：对
struggling with.example: Friend: Have you gotten up to speed on the new job? You: Still struggling with these systems, keep making errors. Friend: In two weeks you will know them. You: Right.

strut their stuff.context: 你在健身房刚练出点肌肉，对着镜子摆姿势秀给朋友看，朋友笑你终于敢展示了，这时就会用到 strut their stuff。
strut their stuff.translation: 朋友：你最近练得怎么样 你：练了俩月 敢对着镜子 strut my stuff 了 朋友：哈哈 这是秀肌肉啊 你：对 总算没白练
strut their stuff.example: Friend: How has your training been? You: Two months in, I dare strut my stuff in front of the mirror. Friend: Haha, showing off the muscles. You: Right, the effort paid off.

stuck at home.context: 周末下大暴雨，你本来约好出去玩，结果被堵在家里哪儿也去不了，朋友说你今天被困在家里了，这时就会用到 stuck at home。
stuck at home.translation: 朋友：周末出来玩吧 你：外面下大暴雨 我 stuck at home 出不去 朋友：那咱们在家打游戏吧 你：行 我开个房间
stuck at home.example: Friend: Come out this weekend. You: It is pouring, I am stuck at home and cannot get out. Friend: Then let us play games at your place. You: Okay, I will open a room.

stuck in.context: 你早上开车出门结果路上出事故，整条路封了，你被堵在半路进退不得，朋友问你到哪儿了，你说堵在路上了，这时就会用到 stuck in。
stuck in.translation: 朋友：你到哪儿了 我们都等你吃饭 你：路上出事故 我 stuck in 半路 动不了 朋友：那我们先吃 你：行 我到了再说
stuck in.example: Friend: Where are you, we are waiting for you for dinner. You: There was an accident, I am stuck halfway and cannot move. Friend: Then we will start eating. You: Okay, let me know when I arrive.

stuck in a rut.context: 你每天上班下班回家，三点一线干了五年，觉得日子特别单调没意思，朋友说你这是陷入 routine 了，这时就会用到 stuck in a rut。
stuck in a rut.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么总说无聊 你：每天三点一线 干了五年 朋友：你这是 stuck in a rut 得找点新事做 你：对 我周末去学个陶艺
stuck in a rut.example: Friend: Why do you keep saying you are bored? You: Same three-point routine, five years running. Friend: You are stuck in a rut, you need something new. You: Right, I will take a pottery class this weekend.

student body.context: 学校要选学生代表上台发言，老师问大家意见，聊到全体同学的想法，这时就会用到 student body。
student body.translation: 朋友：老师选谁上台发言了 你：问了整个 student body 的意见 朋友：最后选了谁 你：选了成绩最好那个班长
student body.example: Friend: Who did the teacher pick to speak on stage? You: They asked the whole student body for opinions. Friend: Who did they pick in the end? You: The top student, the class monitor.

student budget.context: 你是学生，每个月生活费就那么多，买个好耳机得攒好久，朋友说你这预算真有限，这时就会用到 student budget。
student budget.translation: 朋友：你买这么贵的耳机干嘛 你：我 student budget 有限 攒了俩月才买 朋友：学生就是得省着花 你：对 少吃两顿外卖攒的
student budget.example: Friend: Why such an expensive headset? You: My student budget is tight, I saved for two months. Friend: Students have to spend carefully. You: Right, I skipped takeout for a while.

student dorm.context: 你上大学第一次住集体宿舍，六个人一间，晚上聊天聊到半夜，朋友问你宿舍住得习惯吗，这时就会用到 student dorm。
student dorm.translation: 朋友：你大学住几人间 你：住 student dorm 六个人一间 朋友：晚上睡得着吗 你：聊嗨了能聊到半夜
student dorm.example: Friend: How many in your university room? You: I live in a student dorm, six people to a room. Friend: Can you sleep at night? You: When we get chatting it goes till midnight.

student loan.context: 你上大学学费不够，找银行贷了一笔款，说毕业工作后再还，朋友问你压力大不大，这时就会用到 student loan。
student loan.translation: 朋友：你这大学四年钱怎么凑的 你：办了 student loan 毕业工作再还 朋友：那刚工作压力挺大 你：没事 慢慢还呗
student loan.example: Friend: How did you cover four years of university? You: I took out a student loan, I pay it back after graduation. Friend: That means pressure once you start working. You: It is okay, I will pay it off slowly.

student welfare.context: 你最近学习压力大失眠，辅导员建议你去找学校心理中心聊聊，朋友说学校有专门管学生心理的部门，这时就会用到 student welfare。
student welfare.translation: 朋友：你最近睡不好 跟谁说了 你：辅导员让我去找 student welfare 中心聊聊 朋友：那里面的人专业吗 你：是心理老师 聊完舒服多了
student welfare.example: Friend: Who did you talk to about your bad sleep? You: The counsellor sent me to the student welfare centre. Friend: Are the people there professionals? You: They are psychology teachers, I felt much better after.

stuff.context: 你搬家时打包了一堆没用的东西，朋友问你这些旧物件还留着干嘛，该扔的扔，这时就会用到 stuff。
stuff.translation: 朋友：你这箱子里装的都是啥 你：一些旧 stuff 舍不得扔 朋友：没用的就扔了吧 你：行 我收拾收拾该丢的丢
stuff.example: Friend: What is in that box? You: Some old stuff I cannot bring myself to throw away. Friend: Toss the useless things. You: Okay, I will sort through and throw what I do not need.

stuff one's face.context: 朋友聚餐时你一个人吃了三盘肉两碗饭，朋友笑你吃得真多，像饿了三天，这时就会用到 stuff one's face。
stuff one's face.translation: 朋友：你今晚怎么吃这么多 你：中午没吃饭 晚上 stuff my face 一下 朋友：你这是饿狠了 慢慢吃别撑着 你：没事 我胃大
stuff one's face.example: Friend: Why are you eating so much tonight? You: I skipped lunch, now I am stuffing my face. Friend: You are really hungry, slow down do not burst. You: No worries, my stomach is big.

stuff yourself silly.context: 自助餐上你每样菜都夹一大盘，最后撑得走不动，朋友笑你吃太多，这时就会用到 stuff yourself silly。
stuff yourself silly.translation: 朋友：自助餐你拿了多少盘了 你：每样都尝一点 吃个痛快 朋友：你这是 stuff yourself silly 别撑坏了 你：行 我再拿个冰淇淋就收
stuff yourself silly.example: Friend: How many plates have you taken at the buffet? You: A bit of everything, eating to my heart's content. Friend: You are stuffing yourself silly, do not make yourself sick. You: Okay, one more ice cream and I stop.

stuffed material.context: 你买的沙发外面摸着是皮的，朋友问里面是什么，你说里面是软的填充材料，这时就会用到 stuffed material。
stuffed material.translation: 朋友：你这沙发外面是皮的 里面呢 你：里面是软 stuffed material 坐着挺舒服 朋友：坐上去确实软 你：对 陷进去不想起来
stuffed material.example: Friend: The outside of your sofa is leather, what about inside? You: The inside is soft stuffed material, it is comfy to sit on. Friend: It does sink right in. You: Right, you do not want to get up.

stumble across.context: 你周末在旧书店淘书，偶然翻到一本绝版老画册，惊喜得不行，朋友问你怎么找到的，这时就会用到 stumble across。
stumble across.translation: 朋友：你这本老画册哪儿淘的 你：周末在旧书店 stumble across 的 找了好几年 朋友：这种绝版书真难得 你：对 花小钱捡了个大漏
stumble across.example: Friend: Where did you dig up this old art book? You: I stumbled across it at a used bookshop this weekend, I have looked for years. Friend: An out-of-print book like this is rare. You: Right, a real steal for little money.

stumbling block.context: 你做项目时一直卡在一个数据问题上，朋友说这个难题就是你最大的绊脚石，跨过去就顺了，这时就会用到 stumbling block。
stumbling block.translation: 朋友：你项目怎么进度这么慢 你：卡在一个数据问题上 是最大的 stumbling block 朋友：找同事帮你一起看 你：对 我们明天开会讨论
stumbling block.example: Friend: Why is your project moving so slowly? You: I am stuck on a data problem, it is the biggest stumbling block. Friend: Get a coworker to look at it with you. You: Right, we will discuss it in a meeting tomorrow.

stump up.context: 朋友聚餐吃完大家AA，你发现自己钱包没带够，不好意思地说这顿先欠着，回头补给他，朋友笑你每次都不情愿掏钱，这时就会用到 stump up。
stump up.translation: 朋友：这顿咱们AA 你出你那份 你：我今天没带够钱 下次我 stump up 双倍 朋友：你每次都推 你：哎呀 真没带
stump up.example: Friend: We split the bill, pay your share. You: I do not have enough on me today, I will stump up double next time. Friend: You always stall. You: Oh, I really did not bring enough.

subconscious memory.context: 你看到一个广告说能提高记忆力，朋友提醒你别全信，说很多东西其实是藏在潜意识里的记忆，这时就会用到 subconscious memory。
subconscious memory.translation: 朋友：那个广告说吃这能提高记忆力 你：我看很多回忆都在 subconscious memory 里 朋友：那吃补剂真有用吗 你：也就图个心理安慰
subconscious memory.example: Friend: That ad says this pill boosts memory. You: I think many memories live in the subconscious memory. Friend: Do supplements really work then? You: Just a psychological comfort.

subject to.context: 新员工入职要经历各种培训和考核，朋友说这是新人必须经受的考验，这时就会用到 subject to。
subject to.translation: 朋友：新员工这两周都干嘛 你：subject to 各种培训和考核 朋友：挺累的 熬过去就好 你：对 过了试用期就轻松
subject to.example: Friend: What do new staff do these two weeks? You: They are subject to all kinds of training and tests. Friend: Tiring, but it ends once you pass. You: Right, after probation it is easier.

subjective well-being.context: 你看心理研究说一个人觉得自己生活过得好不好，主要看他主观上满不满意，聊到这种主观的幸福感，这时就会用到 subjective well-being。
subjective well-being.translation: 朋友：幸福感到底怎么衡量 你：心理学上看 subjective well-being 自己觉得开心就行 朋友：那跟有钱没钱关系大吗 你：不大 心态好最重要
subjective well-being.example: Friend: How do you measure happiness? You: In psychology it is subjective well-being, feeling content yourself. Friend: Does money matter much? You: Not much, a good mindset matters most.

subscription model.context: 你现在用的视频网站每个月扣会员费，朋友说这种包月订阅模式比买碟划算，这时就会用到 subscription model。
subscription model.translation: 朋友：你这会员每个月扣钱 不亏吗 你：subscription model 比买盘划算 随时看 朋友：那你 cancel 方便吗 你：App里一键就能退
subscription model.example: Friend: Does the membership fee every month not feel like a loss? You: The subscription model is cheaper than buying discs, watch anytime. Friend: Is it easy to cancel? You: One tap in the app.

succulent ferns.context: 你在植物园看到一片胖乎乎的多肉植物，朋友说这些多汁的植物特别好养，这时就会用到 succulent ferns。
succulent ferns.translation: 朋友：这些胖乎乎的植物叫啥 你：是 succulent ferns 多肉植物 朋友：多长时间浇一次水 你：两周一次就行 特别好养
succulent ferns.example: Friend: What are these chubby plants called? You: They are succulent ferns, the fleshy kind. Friend: How often do you water them? You: Once every two weeks, really easy to keep.

such an event.context: 朋友说下周六要办婚礼，问你能不能来，你说这么大的事我一定到，聊到那个活动，这时就会用到 such an event。
such an event.translation: 朋友：下周六我婚礼 你来吗 你：such an event 我当然到 几点开始 朋友：中午十二点 你：行 我提前到
such an event.example: Friend: My wedding is next Saturday, can you come? You: Of course I will for such an event, what time? Friend: Twelve noon. You: Okay, I will be there early.

such that.context: 他英语说得太流利了，简直像母语一样，朋友问他学了多久，你说流利到旁人都听不出口音，这时就会用到 such that。
such that.translation: 朋友：他英语说得真地道 你：他说得这么好 such that 别人都以为是本地人 朋友：他到底学了多少年 你：从小就在国外长大
such that.example: Friend: His English is so native. You: He speaks it so well, such that people think he is local. Friend: How many years has he studied? You: He grew up abroad.

suck in.context: 你看一部悬疑剧，看着看着就沉迷进去，三集连播停不下来，朋友说你被剧情吸进去了，这时就会用到 suck in。
suck in.translation: 朋友：你昨晚看剧看到几点 你：剧情太抓人 一下就被 suck in 进去了 朋友：三集连播了吧 你：对 看到三点才睡
suck in.example: Friend: How late did you watch the show last night? You: The plot is so gripping, I got sucked right in. Friend: You binged three episodes. You: Right, I did not sleep till three.

suck out.context: 医生用仪器把伤口里的脓血抽出来，说要把脏东西吸干净才能愈合，这时就会用到 suck out。
suck out.translation: 朋友：医生在你伤口上干嘛呢 你：他在用针 suck out 里面的脓血 朋友：这一下就不那么肿了吧 你：对 抽出来舒服多了
suck out.example: Friend: What is the doctor doing to your wound? You: He is using a needle to suck out the pus inside. Friend: That should bring the swelling down. You: Right, I feel much better after.

suffer with.context: 你最近老咳嗽，医生问你咳多久了，你说咳了一个月特别难受，医生让你少抽烟，这时就会用到 suffer with。
suffer with.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老咳嗽 你：suffer with 咳嗽一个月了 朋友：医生怎么说 你：让我少抽烟 多喝温水
suffer with.example: Friend: Why do you keep coughing lately? You: I have suffered with a cough for a month. Friend: What did the doctor say? You: Cut down smoking and drink warm water.

sugar addiction.context: 你发现自己一紧张就想吃蛋糕奶茶，越吃越胖，朋友说你这是嗜糖成瘾了，得控制，这时就会用到 sugar addiction。
sugar addiction.translation: 朋友：你怎么下午又点奶茶蛋糕 你：我一焦虑就想吃甜的 朋友：你这是 sugar addiction 得控制 你：行 我这周换成水果
sugar addiction.example: Friend: Why bubble tea and cake again this afternoon? You: I crave sweets the moment I get anxious. Friend: That is sugar addiction, you have to control it. You: Okay, I will switch to fruit this week.

sugary snacks.context: 你下班路上总想买点饼干糖果当零食，朋友说你买的这些全是含糖零食，吃多了不好，这时就会用到 sugary snacks。
sugary snacks.translation: 朋友：你购物车里怎么全是饼干糖果 你：下班饿了就馋 sugary snacks 朋友：吃多了蛀牙还胖 你：行 我换成坚果
sugary snacks.example: Friend: Why is your cart full of cookies and candy? You: I crave sugary snacks when I am hungry after work. Friend: Too many spoil your teeth and make you fat. You: Okay, I will switch to nuts.

suit for.context: 你朋友找工作纠结选大公司还是小公司，你说这种节奏和氛围都适合他，朋友问你指什么，这时就会用到 suit for。
suit for.translation: 朋友：我去大公司还是小公司好 你：这种氛围 suit for 你这种爱自由的人 朋友：那我选小公司 你：行 灵活一点适合你
suit for.example: Friend: Should I go to a big company or a small one? You: That kind of vibe suits someone as free-spirited as you. Friend: Then I will pick the small one. You: Right, more flexibility fits you.

suit to.context: 你想做个旅行行程，朋友问你想安排得紧一点还是松一点，你说按你的节奏来就合适，这时就会用到 suit to。
suit to.translation: 朋友：你这行程想排多紧 你：按我节奏 suit to 就行 别太赶 朋友：那我一天就安排两个景点 你：对 慢慢玩才舒服
suit to.example: Friend: How packed do you want the itinerary? You: Suit it to my pace, do not rush. Friend: Then I will schedule two sights a day. You: Right, taking it slow is best.

suit up.context: 明天你要去面试，朋友提醒你穿正装，把衬衫西裤都换上，这时就会用到 suit up。
suit up.translation: 朋友：明天面试 你穿什么去 你：我 suit up 衬衫西裤都换上 朋友：记得刮胡子打领带 你：行 我今晚把衣服烫好
suit up.example: Friend: What will you wear to tomorrow's interview? You: I will suit up, shirt and trousers on. Friend: Remember to shave and wear a tie. You: Okay, I will iron the clothes tonight.

summer break.context: 你说孩子们最盼着六月放暑假，一放假就到处玩，朋友问暑假有多长，这时就会用到 summer break。
summer break.translation: 朋友：孩子们什么时候最开心 你：放 summer break 的时候 一放假就撒欢 朋友：暑假放多久 你：两个月呢
summer break.example: Friend: When are kids the happiest? You: During the summer break, the moment it starts they run wild. Friend: How long is the summer break? You: Two months.

summer-born effect.context: 班里九月份出生的孩子比同班八月份的孩子小近一岁，老师说这种年龄差会影响表现，朋友问这是什么现象，这时就会用到 summer-born effect。
summer-born effect.translation: 朋友：同是一个班 有的孩子成绩差一截 你：因为 summer-born effect 他们小近一岁 朋友：那下半年生的孩子吃亏 你：对 尤其是低年级明显
summer-born effect.example: Friend: In the same class, some kids score lower. You: Because of the summer-born effect, they are nearly a year younger. Friend: Then kids born later in the year are at a disadvantage. You: Right, obvious especially in early grades.

sunflower seed.context: 你看电影时手里捧着一把炒瓜子边看边嗑，朋友说这葵花籽吃着真上头，这时就会用到 sunflower seed。
sunflower seed.translation: 朋友：你看电影怎么老嗑东西 你：抓了把 sunflower seed 边看边嗑 朋友：这一袋子够嗑整场电影 你：对 嘴巴闲不住
sunflower seed.example: Friend: Why are you munching during the movie? You: I grabbed a bag of sunflower seeds to shell while watching. Friend: That bag lasts the whole film. You: Right, I cannot keep my mouth still.

sunk right down.context: 你公司这个季度业绩大跌，老板说营收一下子掉了好多，朋友问有多惨，你说直接掉到谷底，这时就会用到 sunk right down。
sunk right down.translation: 朋友：你们这季度业绩怎样 你：sunk right down 比上季度少了一半 朋友：这么惨 老板急不急 你：天天开会骂人
sunk right down.example: Friend: How was your quarter's results? You: It sank right down, half of last quarter. Friend: That bad, is the boss panicking? You: Meetings every day, yelling.

superfine thread.context: 你看科普视频说有一种特别细的真菌丝，细到肉眼看不见，朋友问这是什么，这时就会用到 superfine thread。
superfine thread.translation: 朋友：纪录片里那些细细的丝是什么 你：是 superfine thread 真菌的丝 朋友：肉眼能看见吗 你：看不见 显微镜下才清楚
superfine thread.example: Friend: What are those thin threads in the documentary? You: They are superfine threads of fungus. Friend: Can you see them with the naked eye? You: No, only under a microscope.

supermarket chain.context: 你家楼下那家超市开了一家又一家，朋友说整条街都被这一家连锁占了，这时就会用到 supermarket chain。
supermarket chain.translation: 朋友：怎么一条街上全是同一家超市 你：那是个大 supermarket chain 到处开店 朋友：那小便利店都开不下去 你：对 被挤得关门了
supermarket chain.example: Friend: Why is the same supermarket on every street? You: It is a big supermarket chain, opening everywhere. Friend: Then small corner shops cannot survive. You: Right, they get forced to close.

support pillow.context: 你坐久了腰疼，朋友建议你买个靠垫放在椅子上撑腰，聊到这种靠腰的枕头，这时就会用到 support pillow。
support pillow.translation: 朋友：你怎么坐久了老揉腰 你：椅子太硬 我想买个 support pillow 靠 朋友：那种靠垫真能缓解 你：对 垫着腰舒服多了
support pillow.example: Friend: Why do you rub your back after sitting long? You: The chair is too hard, I want a support pillow. Friend: That kind of cushion really helps. You: Right, my back feels better with it.

surf casually.context: 你周末不干活，就窝在沙发上漫无目的刷手机，朋友问你在干嘛，你说随便上网看看，这时就会用到 surf casually。
surf casually.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么过的 你：在家 surf casually 刷手机 啥也没干 朋友：这样躺一天也挺舒服 你：对 偶尔摆烂一天
surf casually.example: Friend: How did you spend the weekend? You: At home surfing casually on my phone, did nothing. Friend: Lying around all day feels nice too. You: Right, sometimes you just chill.

surf the internet.context: 你晚上回家吃完饭就躺沙发上刷手机看视频，朋友问你在干嘛，你说上网呢，这时就会用到 surf the internet。
surf the internet.translation: 朋友：你晚上一般干嘛 你：吃完晚饭就 surf the internet 看视频 朋友：别老看手机 出去走走 你：行 我看完这集就出去
surf the internet.example: Friend: What do you usually do in the evening? You: After dinner I surf the internet watching videos. Friend: Stop staring at your phone, go outside. You: Okay, I will go out after this episode.

surface mining.context: 你看新闻说山上露天挖煤把整片山都挖平了，聊到这种露天开采方式，这时就会用到 surface mining。
surface mining.translation: 朋友：新闻里那座山怎么被挖平了 你：是 surface mining 露天挖煤 朋友：那环境破坏多大 你：是啊 树都没了
surface mining.example: Friend: Why was that mountain flattened in the news? You: It is surface mining for coal. Friend: That must wreck the environment. You: Right, all the trees are gone.

surge in demand.context: 疫情期间帐篷一下卖断货，朋友说大家都抢着买，需求一下暴涨，这时就会用到 surge in demand。
surge in demand.translation: 朋友：怎么帐篷一下卖这么贵 你：露营热 一下 surge in demand 断货了 朋友：那涨价涨了多少 你：翻了一倍
surge in demand.example: Friend: Why are tents so expensive all of a sudden? You: Camping is hot, there is a surge in demand and they sold out. Friend: How much did the price rise? You: It doubled.

surplus food.context: 食堂每天倒掉好多饭菜，朋友说这些剩下的食物其实还能给需要的人，聊到多余的食材，这时就会用到 surplus food。
surplus food.translation: 朋友：食堂怎么每天倒那么多饭 你：剩下好多 surplus food 都浪费了 朋友：其实可以捐给需要的人 你：对 倒掉太可惜
surplus food.example: Friend: Why does the canteen throw out so much food? You: There is so much surplus food that gets wasted. Friend: It could go to people in need. You: Right, throwing it away is such a pity.

surround sound.context: 你家客厅装了环绕音响，看电影时声音从四面八方来，朋友说跟影院一样，这时就会用到 surround sound。
surround sound.translation: 朋友：你家看电影怎么跟影院似的 你：装了 surround sound 声音从四面来 朋友：那看动作片太爽了 你：对 爆炸声像在身后
surround sound.example: Friend: Why is watching a movie at your place like a cinema? You: I installed surround sound, the sound comes from all sides. Friend: Action films must be amazing. You: Right, explosions feel right behind you.

survival rate.context: 医生说这种病经过治疗后五年还活着的比例有多高，朋友问那治愈率怎么样，这时就会用到 survival rate。
survival rate.translation: 朋友：医生说这病严重吗 你：五年 survival rate 还挺高的 朋友：那就别太担心 积极治疗 你：对 我按时吃药
survival rate.example: Friend: Does the doctor say this illness is serious? You: The five-year survival rate is fairly high. Friend: Then do not worry too much, treat it actively. You: Right, I take my meds on time.

survived through.context: 你奶奶经历过战争和饥荒，还是把三个孩子拉扯大，朋友说她真是熬过了最苦的日子，这时就会用到 survived through。
survived through.translation: 朋友：你奶奶这一辈子真不容易 你：她 survived through 战争和饥荒 把三个孩子拉扯大 朋友：真是了不起 你：对 她总说现在是最好的时候
survived through.example: Friend: Your grandmother has really had a hard life. You: She survived through wars and famines and raised three children. Friend: She is remarkable. You: Right, she always says now is the best time.

susceptible to.context: 你皮肤一到春天就过敏起疹子，医生说你这种体质容易对花粉敏感，这时就会用到 susceptible to。
susceptible to.translation: 朋友：你春天怎么老起疹子 你：我皮肤 susceptible to 花粉过敏 朋友：那出门戴个口罩 你：行 我包里常备药
susceptible to.example: Friend: Why do you break out in rashes every spring? You: My skin is susceptible to pollen allergy. Friend: Then wear a mask outside. You: Okay, I keep medicine in my bag.

sustain life.context: 医生说人三天不喝水就活不下去，水是维持生命最基本的东西，聊到维持生命，这时就会用到 sustain life。
sustain life.translation: 朋友：人多久不吃饭还能活 你：一周不吃饭行 但三天不喝水就 sustain life 不了 朋友：那水比饭还重要 你：对 人身体一大半是水
sustain life.example: Friend: How long can a person go without food? You: A week without food, but three days without water you cannot sustain life. Friend: So water matters more than food. You: Right, most of our body is water.

sustainable approach.context: 你看到城市里到处是一次性塑料杯，朋友说我们得想办法用环保的方式生活，不然地球要遭殃，这时就会用到 sustainable approach。
sustainable approach.translation: 朋友：街上怎么这么多塑料杯 你：我们得换个 sustainable approach 少用一次性 朋友：自带杯子买咖啡 你：对 我这周开始带
sustainable approach.example: Friend: Why are there so many plastic cups on the street? You: We need a more sustainable approach, less disposables. Friend: Bring your own cup for coffee. You: Right, I will start this week.

sustainable development.context: 新闻说各国在讨论怎么让经济发展不破坏环境，聊到这种长期发展的目标，这时就会用到 sustainable development。
sustainable development.translation: 朋友：新闻里老说的可持续发展是啥 你：就是 sustainable development 发展同时保护环境 朋友：那以后后代才能过得好 你：对 不能只顾现在
sustainable development.example: Friend: What is that sustainable development they keep saying on the news? You: It is sustainable development, growing the economy while protecting the environment. Friend: Then future generations can live well. You: Right, we cannot only think of today.

sustainable diet.context: 你朋友开始吃素，不点外卖，自己做饭少肉多菜，朋友说这是一种对地球友好的饮食方式，这时就会用到 sustainable diet。
sustainable diet.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天自己做饭 你：我在试 sustainable diet 少吃肉多吃菜 朋友：对身体也好 对地球也好 你：是 我两周下来轻了两斤
sustainable diet.example: Friend: Why do you cook for yourself every day lately? You: I am trying a sustainable diet, less meat more veg. Friend: Good for you and good for the planet. You: Right, I have lost two pounds in two weeks.

sustainable dressing.context: 你最近买衣服都选耐穿的基础款，不追快时尚，朋友说你这是在尝试环保的穿衣方式，这时就会用到 sustainable dressing。
sustainable dressing.translation: 朋友：你怎么不追新款了 你：我在试 sustainable dressing 少买 买耐穿的 朋友：这样省钱又环保 你：对 衣柜也清爽
sustainable dressing.example: Friend: Why are you not chasing new styles anymore? You: I am trying sustainable dressing, buy less, buy durable. Friend: That saves money and is greener. You: Right, the wardrobe is cleaner too.

sustainable fabric.context: 你买T恤时看标签，选那种不用农药种出来的棉，朋友问你为什么这么讲究，聊到环保面料，这时就会用到 sustainable fabric。
sustainable fabric.translation: 朋友：你买衣服怎么还看标签 你：我选 sustainable fabric 不打农药的棉 朋友：这种棉对皮肤也好 你：对 穿着舒服还环保
sustainable fabric.example: Friend: Why do you read the labels when buying clothes? You: I pick sustainable fabric, cotton grown without pesticides. Friend: That is also gentler on the skin. You: Right, comfy and green.

sustainable food source.context: 你担心过度捕捞以后没鱼吃，朋友说我们得找能一直吃下去的食物来源，聊到可持续的食物，这时就会用到 sustainable food source。
sustainable food source.translation: 朋友：以后海鲜会不会越来越少 你：过度捕捞 我们得找 sustainable food source 朋友：那养殖是不是算一个 你：对 但也得科学养
sustainable food source.example: Friend: Will seafood become scarcer later? You: With overfishing, we need a sustainable food source. Friend: Is farming one? You: Right, but it has to be done scientifically.

sustainable future.context: 你参加环保活动，大家一起聊怎么让以后的孩子也能看见蓝天绿树，聊到可持续的未来，这时就会用到 sustainable future。
sustainable future.translation: 朋友：你们环保活动都聊啥 你：聊怎么给孩子留个 sustainable future 朋友：那现在开始减塑 你：对 从小事做起
sustainable future.example: Friend: What do you talk about at the eco events? You: How to leave a sustainable future for the kids. Friend: Then start by cutting plastic now. You: Right, every small thing counts.

sustainable lifestyle.context: 你开始自带购物袋、少点外卖、骑车上下班，朋友说你这是在过一种环保的生活，这时就会用到 sustainable lifestyle。
sustainable lifestyle.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么自带袋子还骑车上班 你：我在过 sustainable lifestyle 能少浪费就少 朋友：这样坚持下来不容易 你：对 习惯了就好
sustainable lifestyle.example: Friend: Why do you bring bags and cycle to work lately? You: I am living a sustainable lifestyle, wasting less. Friend: Keeping that up is not easy. You: Right, once it is a habit it is easy.

sustainable packaging.context: 你点外卖发现餐盒换成了纸盒，商家说这样更环保，朋友说这就是在包装上做改变，这时就会用到 sustainable packaging。
sustainable packaging.translation: 朋友：你这外卖盒怎么是纸的 你：商家换成 sustainable packaging 了 朋友：比塑料盒环保多了 你：对 还能直接回收
sustainable packaging.example: Friend: Why is your takeaway box made of paper? You: The restaurant switched to sustainable packaging. Friend: Much greener than plastic. You: Right, it goes straight into recycling.

sustainable settlement.context: 你看新闻说在沙漠里建了一片能自给自足的小镇，聊到这种能长期居住的社区，这时就会用到 sustainable settlement。
sustainable settlement.translation: 朋友：新闻里那沙漠里的小镇真神奇 你：那是个 sustainable settlement 自己发电自己种粮 朋友：以后能复制到别的沙漠吗 你：对 先试点看看
sustainable settlement.example: Friend: That town in the desert in the news is amazing. You: It is a sustainable settlement, making its own power and growing food. Friend: Can we copy it in other deserts? You: Right, pilot it first.

sustainable tourism.context: 你去旅游发现热门景点人挤人，朋友说以后得搞那种不破坏环境的旅游方式，这时就会用到 sustainable tourism。
sustainable tourism.translation: 朋友：那个景点人挤人 草都踩没了 你：得搞 sustainable tourism 别破坏环境 朋友：那限流是不是有用 你：对 每天限量进人
sustainable tourism.example: Friend: That scenic spot is so crowded the grass is gone. You: We need sustainable tourism that does not wreck the place. Friend: Would limiting numbers help? You: Right, a daily cap on visitors.

swamped with.context: 你刚换工作，第一天邮箱就被几百封邮件塞满，朋友说你这下忙坏了，被活埋了，这时就会用到 swamped with。
swamped with.translation: 朋友：你新工作第一天感觉怎样 你：邮箱一下 swamped with 几百封邮件 朋友：那你慢慢回 别着急 你：行 我今天先整理一下
swamped with.example: Friend: How was your first day at the new job? You: My inbox was swamped with hundreds of emails. Friend: Take your time replying, do not rush. You: Okay, I will sort through them today.

sweat gland.context: 你夏天一动就出汗，朋友说你汗腺特别发达，一热就出好多汗，这时就会用到 sweat gland。
sweat gland.translation: 朋友：你怎么一动就一身汗 你：我 sweat gland 特别发达 朋友：那夏天出门太难受了 你：对 走两步就湿
sweat gland.example: Friend: Why do you break into a sweat the moment you move? You: My sweat glands are overactive. Friend: That must be miserable in summer. You: Right, two steps and I am soaked.

sweat profusely.context: 你夏天跑完五公里，衣服全湿透了，朋友说你出了好多汗，像从水里出来一样，这时就会用到 sweat profusely。
sweat profusely.translation: 朋友：你跑个步怎么浑身湿透 你：我 sweat profusely 衣服都能拧出水 朋友：那你跑完赶紧换干衣服 你：行 我包里备了一件
sweat profusely.example: Friend: Why are you soaked after a run? You: I sweat profusely, my clothes are wringing wet. Friend: Then change into dry clothes right after. You: Okay, I have a spare in my bag.

sweep sb off their feet.context: 你朋友第一次约会就被对方迷得神魂颠倒，天天跟你讲ta多好，你说他是被彻底迷住了，这时就会用到 sweep sb off their feet。
sweep sb off their feet.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天笑 你：我认识了一个人 把我 sweep off my feet 了 朋友：看你这样子 是真爱上了 你：对 满脑子都是ta
sweep sb off their feet.example: Friend: Why are you grinning all the time lately? You: I met someone who swept me off my feet. Friend: The way you look, you are really in love. You: Right, they are all I think about.

sweep under the rug.context: 公司出了个事故，领导开会说别声张，先把这事捂住，朋友说这是想把问题盖起来，这时就会用到 sweep under the rug。
sweep under the rug.translation: 朋友：上次那个事故 公司怎么处理的 你：领导想 sweep under the rug 不让客户知道 朋友：那以后还是会爆出来 你：对 纸包不住火
sweep under the rug.example: Friend: How did the company handle that accident last time? You: The manager wants to sweep it under the rug and keep the client from knowing. Friend: It will come out later anyway. You: Right, you cannot hide forever.

sweet spot.context: 你调咖啡机磨豆度，太粗太细都不好喝，试了半天找到一个最合适的度，朋友说这就是最佳口感，这时就会用到 sweet spot。
sweet spot.translation: 朋友：你调这个磨豆度调了半天 你：终于找到 sweet spot 不苦不酸 朋友：那以后就固定这个度 你：对 这个刻度最好喝
sweet spot.example: Friend: Why have you been tuning the grind level for so long? You: I finally found the sweet spot, not bitter not sour. Friend: Then lock in this setting. You: Right, this level tastes best.

sweet tooth.context: 你看到甜品柜就走不动路，奶茶蛋糕一个不落，朋友说你真是爱吃甜的，这时就会用到 sweet tooth。
sweet tooth.translation: 朋友：你怎么每次出来都点甜品 你：我天生 sweet tooth 见了甜的就走不动 朋友：小心吃多了长胖 你：唉 控制不住嘛
sweet tooth.example: Friend: Why do you order dessert every time we go out? You: I have a sweet tooth, I cannot resist sweets. Friend: Watch out, you will gain weight. You: Sigh, I just cannot help it.

swept-back do.context: 你去参加正式活动，看到大家都把头发往后梳得一丝不苟，朋友说这种后梳发型特别精神，这时就会用到 swept-back do。
swept-back do.translation: 朋友：你今天这发型挺精神啊 你：我特意弄了个 swept-back do 朋友：这种后梳头显得人特别利落 你：对 配衬衫刚刚好
swept-back do.example: Friend: Your hairstyle looks sharp today. You: I did a swept-back do on purpose. Friend: That swept-back look makes you look crisp. You: Right, it matches the shirt well.

swipe right.context: 你用交友软件刷照片，看到合眼缘的就往右滑，朋友问你怎么刷呢，这时就会用到 swipe right。
swipe right.translation: 朋友：你在交友软件上干嘛呢 你：看到合眼缘的就 swipe right 朋友：滑到现在有匹配的吗 你：有两个 聊得还不错
swipe right.example: Friend: What are you doing on that dating app? You: I swipe right on anyone I find cute. Friend: Any matches so far? You: Two, we are chatting okay.

switch out.context: 你手机摄像头坏了，想把旧镜头拆下来换个新的，朋友问你这是干嘛，你说把坏的换下来，这时就会用到 switch out。
switch out.translation: 朋友：你拆手机后盖干嘛 你：摄像头坏了 想 switch out 一个新的 朋友：你还会自己修手机 你：网上看教程试一下
switch out.example: Friend: Why are you taking the back off your phone? You: The camera is broken, I want to switch out a new one. Friend: You can fix your own phone? You: I am following a tutorial online.

switch out for.context: 你原来那把椅子坐久了腰疼，朋友建议你换把带腰靠的新椅子，聊到把旧的换成新的，这时就会用到 switch out for。
switch out for.translation: 朋友：你那把椅子怎么不换了 坐久了腰疼 你：我想 switch out for 一把带腰靠的 朋友：换个好椅子对腰好 你：对 我这周下单
switch out for.example: Friend: Why not replace that old chair, your back aches sitting on it. You: I want to switch out for one with back support. Friend: A good chair is better for your back. You: Right, I will order one this week.

switch up.context: 你每天早上都喝黑咖啡，想换个口味，朋友建议你今天改成喝拿铁，聊到把一个换成另一个，这时就会用到 switch up。
switch up.translation: 朋友：你天天喝黑咖啡不腻吗 你：是啊 我想 switch up 换个口味 朋友：今天试试拿铁吧 你：行 我去点一杯
switch up.example: Friend: Are you not bored of black coffee every morning? You: Yeah, I want to switch it up and try something else. Friend: Try a latte today. You: Okay, I will order one.

switching to.context: 你最近天天早上跑步，朋友说你怎么突然改作息了，你说想换一换别总老一套，这时就会用到 switching to。
switching to.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么天天早起跑步 你：我在 switching to 早起的作息 朋友：那你晚上几点睡 你：十点就上床 不刷手机了
switching to.example: Friend: Why are you up running early every day lately? You: I am switching to an early schedule. Friend: Then what time do you sleep? You: In bed by ten, no more phone scrolling.

swoop across.context: 你在高架上开车，旁边一辆车没打灯突然变道插到你前面，朋友吓一跳说这车怎么乱变道，这时就会用到 swoop across。
swoop across.translation: 朋友：刚才那车怎么突然插过来 你：没打灯就 swoop across 我们车道 朋友：这种司机太危险了 你：对 赶紧离他远点
swoop across.example: Friend: Why did that car suddenly cut in? You: It swooped across our lane without signalling. Friend: That driver is so dangerous. You: Right, stay far away from them.

symbolic status.context: 你朋友当了个闲职，工资不高但天天坐办公室，别人说他这位置就是个摆着看的名头，聊到象征地位的身份，这时就会用到 symbolic status。
symbolic status.translation: 朋友：你朋友那个闲职 工资高吗 你：不高 但就是个 symbolic status 摆着好看 朋友：那他图啥呢 你：图个名头好听
symbolic status.example: Friend: Is that easy job your friend has well paid? You: Not really, it is just a symbolic status to look good. Friend: Then what does he get out of it? You: A fancy title.

sympathetic nervous system.context: 你看科普视频说人一紧张身体就自动准备应战或逃跑，这是神经系统的反应，朋友问这是什么系统，这时就会用到 sympathetic nervous system。
sympathetic nervous system.translation: 朋友：为什么一紧张心跳就加速 你：是 sympathetic nervous system 让身体备战 朋友：那深呼吸能压下来吗 你：对 慢慢呼吸就缓了
sympathetic nervous system.example: Friend: Why does my heart race when I am nervous? You: It is the sympathetic nervous system prepping the body for fight or flight. Friend: Does slow breathing calm it down? You: Right, breathe slowly and it eases.

synaptic pruning.context: 你看育儿书说小孩大脑在发育时会自动剪掉没用的神经连接，朋友问这是什么意思，这时就会用到 synaptic pruning。
synaptic pruning.translation: 朋友：书里说小孩大脑会剪掉连接 是什么意思 你：是 synaptic pruning 没用的连接自动清掉 朋友：那这样脑子更高效吗 你：对 留有用的就够了
synaptic pruning.example: Friend: What does the book mean by the child's brain pruning connections? You: It is synaptic pruning, the brain clears unused links. Friend: Does that make the brain more efficient? You: Right, keeping only the useful ones.

sync up.context: 你和异地恋对象时差不一样，每次聊天都凑不上时间，朋友说你们得调一下同步作息，这时就会用到 sync up。
sync up.translation: 朋友：你俩时差聊天老凑不上 你：是 得 sync up 一个共同在线时间 朋友：那定个每晚十点的点 你：行 我这边正好是晚上
sync up.example: Friend: You two never seem to be online at the same time across the time zones. You: Right, we need to sync up a shared online time. Friend: Then set ten every night. You: Okay, that is evening for me.

synthetic chemical.context: 你买护肤品时特意看成分，朋友说别老选带人工化学原料的，对皮肤不好，这时就会用到 synthetic chemical。
synthetic chemical.translation: 朋友：你买护肤品怎么还看成分表 你：我怕里面有 synthetic chemical 伤皮肤 朋友：那选成分简单的 你：对 越简单越安心
synthetic chemical.example: Friend: Why do you read the ingredients when buying skincare? You: I am wary of synthetic chemicals that hurt the skin. Friend: Then pick the simple formulas. You: Right, simpler feels safer.

synthetic fibre.context: 你买衣服看标签选纯棉的，不选化纤料子，朋友问为什么，你说合成纤维穿着不透气，这时就会用到 synthetic fibre。
synthetic fibre.translation: 朋友：你买衣服怎么只选棉的 你：合成纤维 synthetic fibre 不透气 穿着难受 朋友：那夏天穿棉的确实舒服 你：对 吸汗又透气
synthetic fibre.example: Friend: Why do you only pick cotton clothes? You: Synthetic fibre is not breathable, it feels uncomfortable. Friend: Cotton is indeed comfortable in summer. You: Right, it absorbs sweat and breathes.

systematic review.context: 你写毕业论文时老师让你把几十篇研究综合分析一下，聊到这种把已有研究汇总的做法，这时就会用到 systematic review。
systematic review.translation: 朋友：你毕业论文怎么写那么长 你：老师让做 systematic review 把几十篇文献汇总 朋友：那得读多少论文啊 你：一百多篇 头都大了
systematic review.example: Friend: Why is your thesis so long? You: The professor wants a systematic review, pulling together dozens of studies. Friend: How many papers must you read? You: Over a hundred, my head hurts.

tackle sadness.context: 你最近失恋心情低落，朋友带你去爬山看海，说做点能让自己忙起来的事排解难过，这时就会用到 tackle sadness。
tackle sadness.translation: 朋友：你失恋这几天怎么过的 你：天天在家躺着 更难受 朋友：出去 tackle sadness 别憋着 你：行 你带我去爬个山
tackle sadness.example: Friend: How have you been since the breakup? You: Lying at home every day, feeling worse. Friend: Go tackle your sadness, do not bottle it up. You: Okay, take me hiking.

tactile feedback.context: 你打游戏时按手柄震手，朋友说这就是游戏里的震动反馈，让你感觉真的打中了，这时就会用到 tactile feedback。
tactile feedback.translation: 朋友：你打游戏怎么老震手 你：手柄有 tactile feedback 打中就震一下 朋友：这种震动手感真爽 你：对 像真的在打
tactile feedback.example: Friend: Why does your controller vibrate in your hands? You: It has tactile feedback, it buzzes when you hit something. Friend: That rumble feels great. You: Right, like you are really in the game.

tai chi.context: 你爷爷每天早上在公园慢慢打太极，朋友问这是什么运动，看着慢悠悠的，这时就会用到 tai chi。
tai chi.translation: 朋友：你爷爷在公园慢悠悠打的啥 你：是 tai chi 太极 锻炼身体的 朋友：看着慢 其实挺累的吧 你：对 一套打完全身都活动开了
tai chi.example: Friend: What is your grandfather doing so slowly in the park? You: It is tai chi, an exercise for health. Friend: It looks slow, but it must tire you out. You: Right, one set moves the whole body.

tailor for.context: 你做培训时把课程内容按不同岗位的需要改成不同版本，领导说这才是针对客户定制的，这时就会用到 tailor for。
tailor for.translation: 朋友：你这课件怎么改了好几版 你：按不同岗位 tailor for 他们的需求 朋友：这样大家听着才有用 你：对 通用版没人听
tailor for.example: Friend: Why have you revised the slides several times? You: I tailor them for different roles and their needs. Friend: Then everyone finds it useful. You: Right, a one-size-fits-all version nobody listens to.

tailor to.context: 你给孩子报兴趣班时发现孩子喜欢画画，就专门按他的爱好安排课程，朋友问你怎么选的，这时就会用到 tailor to。
tailor to.translation: 朋友：你给孩子报那么多班干嘛 你：就 tailor to 他喜欢画画 报美术班 朋友：那他喜欢吗 你：对 每周都盼着去
tailor to.example: Friend: Why did you sign your kid up for so many classes? You: I tailor them to his love of drawing, art classes. Friend: Does he like it? You: Right, he looks forward to it every week.

take.context: 你朋友来你家做客，你递给他一杯水，朋友说谢谢，你说不客气拿着喝，这时就会用到 take。
take.translation: 朋友：你家有矿泉水吗 有点渴 你：有 take 这瓶 刚开的 朋友：谢谢啊 你：客气啥 自己拿
take.example: Friend: Do you have any mineral water, I am thirsty. You: Yes, take this bottle, it is just opened. Friend: Thanks. You: No worries, help yourself.

take a leaf from.context: 你看同事做事特别有条理，想学他的方法，朋友说你就照着他那套做，学他的样子，这时就会用到 take a leaf from。
take a leaf from.translation: 朋友：你做事怎么突然变有条理了 你：我 take a leaf from 小李 学他列清单 朋友：那方法确实管用 你：对 每天列三件事
take a leaf from.example: Friend: Why have you suddenly got organized? You: I took a leaf from Xiao Li and learned his to-do list. Friend: That method really works. You: Right, three things a day.

take a leaf out of one's book.context: 你朋友每天早起读书十年如一日，你说要向他学习这个好习惯，朋友笑说你也翻他的老黄历吧，这时就会用到 take a leaf out of one's book。
take a leaf out of one's book.translation: 朋友：你怎么也开始早起读书了 你：我 take a leaf out of 你的 book 学你这好习惯 朋友：哈哈 你坚持得住吗 你：先试一个月
take a leaf out of one's book.example: Friend: Why are you waking up early to read now too? You: I took a leaf out of your book, learning your good habit. Friend: Haha, can you keep it up? You: Let me try a month first.

take a liking to.context: 你以前不爱吃香菜，最近突然爱吃了，朋友问你口味怎么变了，你说自己慢慢喜欢上了，这时就会用到 take a liking to。
take a liking to.translation: 朋友：你以前不是不吃香菜吗 你：我也不知道 最近突然 take a liking to 了 朋友：口味变得真快 你：对 现在吃火锅都要多加
take a liking to.example: Friend: Did you not used to hate cilantro? You: I do not know, I suddenly took a liking to it. Friend: Your taste changed fast. You: Right, I ask for extra in hot pot now.

take a nap.context: 你下午困得不行，趴在桌上眯了二十分钟，朋友问你干嘛去了，你说去小睡了一会儿，这时就会用到 take a nap。
take a nap.translation: 朋友：你刚才趴桌上睡着了 你：太困了 take a nap 二十分钟 朋友：那现在精神点没 你：对 一下就清醒了
take a nap.example: Friend: Did you just fall asleep at your desk? You: I was too sleepy, I took a twenty-minute nap. Friend: Do you feel more awake now? You: Right, wide awake now.

take a plunge.context: 你想辞职去环游世界，朋友说这可是个大决定，你得真想好了再跳这一步，这时就会用到 take a plunge。
take a plunge.translation: 朋友：你真要辞职去旅行啊 你：想了半年 决定 take the plunge 朋友：回来再找工作来得及吗 你：先玩了再说
take a plunge.example: Friend: Are you really quitting your job to travel? You: I thought about it half a year, now I will take the plunge. Friend: Will you find a job when you return? You: Let me enjoy the trip first.

take a step back.context: 你陷在感情问题里越想越乱，朋友劝你退一步站远一点看，别钻牛角尖，这时就会用到 take a step back。
take a step back.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天为这点事烦 你：越想越乱 不知道怎么办 朋友：你 take a step back 站远点看 朋友：行 我这周先不想了
take a step back.example: Friend: Why do you keep fretting over this? You: The more I think the more confused, I do not know what to do. Friend: Take a step back and look at it from afar. You: Okay, I will stop thinking about it this week.

take account of.context: 你做计划时朋友提醒你别忘了预算和时间，要把这些因素都考虑进去，这时就会用到 take account of。
take account of.translation: 朋友：你做旅行计划怎么不算预算 你：我忘了 take account of 路费和住宿 朋友：那你重新算一下 别超支 你：行 我今晚重新做表
take account of.example: Friend: Why did you not include the budget in your travel plan? You: I forgot to take account of transport and lodging. Friend: Then recalculate so you do not overspend. You: Okay, I will redo the sheet tonight.

take advice.context: 你朋友给你推荐了一家面馆，你听了他的建议第二天就去吃了，朋友问味道如何，这时就会用到 take advice。
take advice.translation: 朋友：我上次推荐的面馆你去了吗 你：take your advice 第二天就去了 朋友：味道怎么样 你：真好吃 谢谢你推荐
take advice.example: Friend: Did you try that noodle shop I recommended? You: I took your advice and went the next day. Friend: How did it taste? You: Really good, thanks for the tip.

take along.context: 你周末去爬山，朋友提醒你带瓶水，山上没地方买，你说放心我带上，这时就会用到 take along。
take along.translation: 朋友：爬山记得 take along 一瓶水 山上没卖的 你：放心 我背包里装了 朋友：再带件外套 山上风大 你：行 我塞一件薄的
take along.example: Friend: Take along a bottle of water on the hike, there is none on the mountain. You: Relax, I have one in the bag. Friend: Bring a jacket too, it is windy up there. You: Okay, I will pack a thin one.

take away from.context: 你觉得加班多了反而效率下降，朋友说干太多活会减损你真正的产出，这时就会用到 take away from。
take away from.translation: 朋友：你天天加班到十点 不觉得累吗 你：累但觉得充实 朋友：其实反而 take away from 真正的效率 你：也是 我周末得休息
take away from.example: Friend: You work overtime till ten every day, are you not tired? You: Tired but I feel productive. Friend: It actually takes away from real efficiency. You: Right, I need rest on weekends.

take comfort.context: 你奶奶一个人住，你每周去看她一次，她见你就开心，朋友说老人就盼着孩子来，这就是一种安慰，这时就会用到 take comfort。
take comfort.translation: 朋友：你奶奶最近精神怎么样 你：我每周去看她 她就 take comfort 在我身上 朋友：老人就盼着孩子 你：对 多陪陪她
take comfort.example: Friend: How is your grandma's mood lately? You: I visit her weekly, she takes comfort in me coming. Friend: Old people just look forward to their kids. You: Right, keep her company.

take comfort from.context: 你一个人在大城市打拼，给爸妈打电话时听到他们声音就觉得安心，朋友说家人的声音就是一种安慰，这时就会用到 take comfort from。
take comfort from.translation: 朋友：你一个人在那边想家吗 你：每周跟爸妈视频就 take comfort from 他们的声音 朋友：距离远 声音也是安慰 你：对 打完电话就不孤单了
take comfort from.example: Friend: Do you miss home living alone in that big city? You: Video-calling my parents weekly, I take comfort from their voices. Friend: From afar, a voice is also comfort. You: Right, after the call I do not feel lonely.

take comfort in.context: 你在国外工作压力大，朋友说工作再难也别怕，慢慢来，你说自己因为这份稳定的收入才安心，这时就会用到 take comfort in。
take comfort in.translation: 朋友：你在国外一个人扛得住吗 你：我 take comfort in 这份稳定收入 心里踏实 朋友：有份工作就有底气 你：对 再难也能撑下去
take comfort in.example: Friend: Can you manage alone abroad? You: I take comfort in this steady income, it gives me peace. Friend: A job gives you confidence. You: Right, I can get through anything.

take effort.context: 朋友学一门新技能总问你难不难，你说做好这件事需要花功夫，没有捷径，这时就会用到 take effort。
take effort.translation: 朋友：学吉他真的那么难吗 你：当然 take effort 每天练 朋友：那我没天赋能学会吗 你：能 就看你肯不肯下功夫
take effort.example: Friend: Is learning the guitar really that hard? You: Of course, it takes effort to practise daily. Friend: Can someone without talent learn it? You: Yes, it depends on how much effort you put in.

take hold.context: 你老家过年贴春联的习俗已经流行了上千年，朋友问这习惯从什么时候开始的，你说早就扎根在生活里了，这时就会用到 take hold。
take hold.translation: 朋友：你们老家过年贴春联 多少年了 你：这习俗早就 take hold 上千年了 朋友：每年都贴 挺有仪式感 你：对 不贴不像过年
take hold.example: Friend: How long has your family hung spring couplets? You: The custom took hold over a thousand years ago. Friend: Hanging them every year is quite a ritual. You: Right, it does not feel like New Year without them.

take into confidence.context: 你跟好朋友共事多年，有什么秘密都告诉对方，因为你信得过ta，朋友说你们这是把彼此当自己人，这时就会用到 take into confidence。
take into confidence.translation: 朋友：你俩怎么什么话都讲 你：我 take her into confidence 啥事都聊 朋友：这种信任真难得 你：对 认识十年了
take into confidence.example: Friend: Why do you two talk about everything? You: I take her into my confidence, we discuss everything. Friend: That kind of trust is rare. You: Right, we have known each other ten years.

take its course.context: 你感冒了发烧，医生说别乱吃药，让它自己好，朋友问怎么办，医生说让病程自然发展，这时就会用到 take its course。
take its course.translation: 朋友：我感冒一周了还不好 你：医生说让它 take its course 别乱吃药 朋友：那我多喝温水睡觉 你：对 七天就好
take its course.example: Friend: My cold has not gone in a week. You: The doctor says let it take its course, do not take random meds. Friend: Then I will drink warm water and sleep. You: Right, it clears in seven days.

take its cue.context: 你做产品时观察用户喜欢什么就跟着调整方向，朋友说你们这是跟着用户的需求走，聊到这种顺势调整，这时就会用到 take its cue。
take its cue.translation: 朋友：你们产品怎么老改方向 你：我们 take its cue from 用户反馈 他们喜欢啥做啥 朋友：那这样才不会做错方向 你：对 用户说了算
take its cue.example: Friend: Why does your product keep changing direction? You: We take our cue from user feedback, build what they like. Friend: Then you do not go the wrong way. You: Right, users decide.

take its toll.context: 你连续加班三个月，身体开始出小毛病，朋友说长期累下来身体总要还账的，这时就会用到 take its toll。
take its toll.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老头疼 你：连续加班三个月 身体 take its toll 了 朋友：你得休息 别硬撑 你：对 我下周请两天假
take its toll.example: Friend: Why have you had headaches lately? You: Three months of overtime, it is taking its toll. Friend: You need rest, do not push on. You: Right, I will take two days off next week.

take its toll on.context: 你熬夜一个月，免疫力下降开始感冒发烧，朋友说身体终于扛不住了，长期透支开始找你算账，这时就会用到 take its toll on。
take its toll on.translation: 朋友：你怎么一下感冒发烧了 你：熬夜一个月 take its toll on 身体了 朋友：这下老实了 别再熬夜 你：对 我今晚十点就睡
take its toll on.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly come down with a fever? You: A month of staying up late took its toll on my body. Friend: Now you have learned, stop the late nights. You: Right, I will sleep by ten tonight.

take long.context: 朋友问你做完这个报告要多久，你说做细点得花一周，急不来，这时就会用到 take long。
take long.translation: 朋友：你这报告什么时候能写完 你：做得细点 take long 得一周 朋友：那下周三要来得及吗 你：行 我今晚就开始
take long.example: Friend: When will you finish the report? You: Done properly it takes long, about a week. Friend: Will next Wednesday be in time? You: Okay, I will start tonight.

take note.context: 你朋友开车时走错路，你提醒他注意导航上的红色标志，别错过出口，这时就会用到 take note。
take note.translation: 朋友：前面是不是要转弯了 你：你 take note 导航上那个红标 就是出口 朋友：好 我打灯准备并线 你：慢点开
take note.example: Friend: Do we need to turn ahead? You: Take note of that red marker on the navigation, that is the exit. Friend: Okay, I will signal and merge. You: Drive slowly.

take note of.context: 老师上课时反复提醒大家考试时间，让大家留意时间别做不完题，这时就会用到 take note of。
take note of.translation: 朋友：老师今天反复说什么 你：让我们 take note of 考试时间 别做不完 朋友：那做选择题快点 你：对 留时间写作文
take note of.example: Friend: What did the teacher keep repeating today? You: To take note of the exam time and not run out. Friend: Then speed up the multiple choice. You: Right, leave time for the essay.

take notice.context: 你刷到健康科普视频说久坐不好，朋友说你别光看，得真把这事放心上，站起来动一动，这时就会用到 take notice。
take notice.translation: 朋友：你刷到那个说久坐有害的视频没 你：看到了 但没太 take notice 朋友：你每小时站起来走两分钟 你：行 我设个闹钟
take notice.example: Friend: Did you see that video about sitting being bad? You: I saw it, but I did not really take notice. Friend: Stand up and walk every hour. You: Okay, I will set a timer.

take off one's shoulders.context: 你同时管三个项目，忙得快扛不住，领导看到后分了两个给别人，说这下你肩上轻了，这时就会用到 take off one's shoulders。
take off one's shoulders.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么看着没那么累了 你：领导把两个项目 take off my shoulders 了 朋友：早该这样 你一个人扛三个 你：对 这下轻松多了
take off one's shoulders.example: Friend: Why do you look less tired lately? You: The manager took two projects off my shoulders. Friend: That was long overdue, carrying three alone. You: Right, it is much lighter now.

take on board.context: 领导给你提了改进意见，你认真听了还真照着改了，同事说你能听得进建议，这时就会用到 take on board。
take on board.translation: 朋友：领导上次说你那方案要改 你改了吗 你：我 take on board 他的意见 重新做了 朋友：能听进去就容易进步 你：对 骂得对就改
take on board.example: Friend: Did you revise the proposal the boss flagged? You: I took his advice on board and redid it. Friend: Taking feedback helps you improve. You: Right, if the criticism is fair I change.

take one's mind off.context: 你失恋后在家难过，朋友拉你去逛街看电影，说做这些能让你暂时不想那事，这时就会用到 take one's mind off。
take one's mind off.translation: 朋友：你这两天在家哭了吧 你：一闲下来就想他 难受 朋友：出去 take your mind off 这事 看个电影 你：行 你带我出去走走
take one's mind off.example: Friend: Have you been crying at home these two days? You: The moment I am free I think of them, it hurts. Friend: Go out to take your mind off it, watch a movie. You: Okay, take me out for a walk.

take out of.context: 你做奶茶想减糖，朋友让你把半勺糖从配方里去掉，说这样更健康，这时就会用到 take out of。
take out of.translation: 朋友：这奶茶太甜了 你：那 take out of 半勺糖 少点甜 朋友：这样喝着不腻 你：对 下次就这么做
take out of.example: Friend: This milk tea is too sweet. You: Take out of it half a spoon of sugar, less sweet. Friend: Then it does not feel cloying. You: Right, do that next time.

take over from.context: 老经理要退休了，公司选了新同事接手他的位置，朋友问谁来接班，这时就会用到 take over from。
take over from.translation: 朋友：老经理退休 谁接他的位置 你：小李 take over from 他 接手整个部门 朋友：小李够格吗 你：跟老经理学了三年了
take over from.example: Friend: The old manager is retiring, who takes over? You: Xiao Li will take over from him, running the whole department. Friend: Is Xiao Li ready? You: He learned from the old manager for three years.

take ownership of.context: 你做项目时主动把最难的部分扛下来，同事说你真敢担责任，这时就会用到 take ownership of。
take ownership of.translation: 朋友：最难那部分你接了 不怕做砸吗 你：我 take ownership of 这块 负责到底 朋友：你真有担当 我配合你 你：行 我们一起搞定
take ownership of.example: Friend: You took on the hardest part, not afraid of messing up? You: I take ownership of this piece, I will own it through. Friend: You really take responsibility, I will support you. You: Okay, we will nail it together.

take part in digital detox.context: 你决定周末把手机放一边一天，不看消息不刷视频，朋友说你这是在做数字排毒，这时就会用到 take part in digital detox。
take part in digital detox.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么手机都不开 你：我在 take part in digital detox 一天不看手机 朋友：那你干嘛 你：看书 出去走路 特舒服
take part in digital detox.example: Friend: Why is your phone off this weekend? You: I am taking part in a digital detox, no phone for a day. Friend: What do you do then? You: Read and walk outside, so relaxing.

take step to.context: 发现小区老人走路越来越容易摔，你跟朋友说我们得想办法做点什么，比如装扶手，这时就会用到 take step to。
take step to.translation: 朋友：小区那几个老人老在楼梯上摔 你：我们得 take step to 解决这事 朋友：装个扶手怎么样 你：行 我去跟物业说
take step to.example: Friend: Those old folks in the complex keep falling on the stairs. You: We have to take steps to fix this. Friend: How about installing a handrail? You: Okay, I will talk to the property.

take steps.context: 你发现外卖盒污染严重，朋友说不能光抱怨，得真采取行动，比如自己带饭盒，这时就会用到 take steps。
take steps.translation: 朋友：外卖盒污染这么严重 光骂有用吗 你：我们得 take steps 自己带饭盒 朋友：对 一人一点改变 你：行 我明天开始带
take steps.example: Friend: Takeout boxes pollute so much, is complaining useful? You: We have to take steps, bring our own lunchbox. Friend: Right, one small change each. You: Okay, I start tomorrow.

take stock.context: 你工作五年了，年底停下来回头看看这一年做了什么，朋友问你在干嘛，你说在盘点一下自己的生活，这时就会用到 take stock。
take stock.translation: 朋友：你这周末怎么一个人坐着发呆 你：年底了 take stock 一下这一年 朋友：觉得收获多吗 你：有得有失 明年继续加油
take stock.example: Friend: Why are you sitting alone zoning out this weekend? You: It is year end, I am taking stock of the year. Friend: Did you gain a lot? You: Some wins some losses, keep going next year.

take the initiative.context: 组里讨论问题时没人敢先开口，你第一个站出来说想法，同事说你真主动带头，这时就会用到 take the initiative。
take the initiative.translation: 朋友：开会时怎么没人说话 你：我 take the initiative 先抛个想法 朋友：你一开口大家就跟着聊了 你：对 总得有人先说话
take the initiative.example: Friend: Why does nobody speak at the meeting? You: I took the initiative and threw out an idea first. Friend: The moment you spoke, everyone joined in. You: Right, someone has to start.

take the leap.context: 你犹豫了半年要不要学吉他，今天终于报了班，朋友说你这一下决心迈出去了，这时就会用到 take the leap。
take the leap.translation: 朋友：你不是一直想学吉他吗 报班了没 你：今天 take the leap 报了 朋友：早该报了 别再拖 你：对 想做就做
take the leap.example: Friend: You always wanted to learn guitar, did you sign up? You: Today I took the leap and signed up. Friend: You should have done it long ago, stop delaying. You: Right, just do it.

take the plunge.context: 你朋友攒了两年钱终于买了房，你说他这一下决心真干成了，朋友说就是得敢跳，这时就会用到 take the plunge。
take the plunge.translation: 朋友：我终于攒够钱买了房 你：你这一下 take the plunge 真干成了 朋友：想了三年 终于下手了 你：恭喜啊 周末暖房
take the plunge.example: Friend: I finally saved enough for a flat. You: You took the plunge and really did it. Friend: Thought about it three years, finally went for it. You: Congrats, housewarming this weekend.

take the world by storm.context: 你追的那个国产综艺一下火到国外，好几国都买了版权，朋友说这节目真厉害，一下风靡全球，这时就会用到 take the world by storm。
take the world by storm.translation: 朋友：那个综艺怎么国外都在播 你：一下 take the world by storm 卖了好几个国家 朋友：国产节目真长脸 你：对 文化输出了
take the world by storm.example: Friend: Why is that variety show airing abroad? You: It took the world by storm, sold to several countries. Friend: Chinese shows are making us proud. You: Right, it is cultural export.

take their toll on.context: 你连续加班半年，身体开始出毛病，朋友说长期这样硬扛，身体迟早要找你算账，这时就会用到 take their toll on。
take their toll on.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老感冒 你：加班半年 take their toll on 身体了 朋友：赶紧休假 别再硬扛 你：对 我下周休五天
take their toll on.example: Friend: Why do you keep catching colds lately? You: Half a year of overtime took its toll on my body. Friend: Take time off, do not push on. You: Right, I will take five days next week.

take time.context: 朋友学新菜问你多久能做好，你说这菜得慢慢炖，急不得，朋友问是不是得好几个小时，这时就会用到 take time。
take time.translation: 朋友：这红烧肉得炖多久 你：得慢慢炖 take time 急不得 朋友：是不是得两小时 你：对 一个半小时以上才入味
take time.example: Friend: How long does this braised pork need to stew? You: It takes time to stew slowly, you cannot rush. Friend: Is it two hours? You: Right, over an hour and a half for flavour.

take time off work.context: 你最近太累想请假一周在家休息，朋友说跟领导请个假，这时就会用到 take time off work。
take time off work.translation: 朋友：你脸色怎么这么差 你：太累了 我想 take time off work 一周 朋友：跟领导请个假 在家躺几天 你：行 明天就提申请
take time off work.example: Friend: Why do you look so worn out? You: I am so tired, I want to take time off work for a week. Friend: Ask the boss for leave, rest at home a few days. You: Okay, I will put in the request tomorrow.

take to the skies.context: 你出门旅游嫌坐火车太慢，朋友说那我们直接飞过去，坐飞机更快，聊到选择坐飞机出行，这时就会用到 take to the skies。
take to the skies.translation: 朋友：坐火车过去要二十小时 太久了 你：那我们 take to the skies 飞过去 朋友：机票比火车贵不少 你：但省一天时间
take to the skies.example: Friend: The train takes twenty hours, too long. You: Then we will take to the skies and fly. Friend: Flights cost much more than the train. You: But it saves a day.

take turn.context: 大家轮流做值日，朋友问今天谁扫地，你说咱们一个一个来，别乱，这时就会用到 take turn。
take turn.translation: 朋友：今天值日谁扫地啊 你：咱们 take turn 一人一天 朋友：那我扫周一 你：行 排个表贴墙上
take turn.example: Friend: Who is sweeping today on the rota? You: We take turns, one person a day. Friend: Then I will take Monday. You: Okay, we will post a chart on the wall.

take-home pay.context: 你拿到工资单，发现扣完税和社保后实际到手的钱比谈的工资少一截，朋友问这是怎么回事，这时就会用到 take-home pay。
take-home pay.translation: 朋友：你 offer 写一万 到手多少 你：扣完税 就七千多 take-home pay 朋友：税扣得真多 你：对 看着多 到手少
take-home pay.example: Friend: Your offer said ten thousand, how much do you actually get? You: After tax, my take-home pay is only seven thousand. Friend: Tax takes so much. You: Right, it sounds high but you get less.

take...out of the equation.context: 你买东西时纠结颜色和大小，朋友说干脆两个都不要，直接把选择这一步免了，聊到去掉某个环节，这时就会用到 take...out of the equation。
take...out of the equation.translation: 朋友：你纠结颜色纠结半天 你：是啊 哪个都不完美 朋友：take color out of the equation 就看大小 你：对 大小合适就行
take...out of the equation.example: Friend: You have been fussing over the colour for ages. You: Yeah, none is perfect. Friend: Take colour out of the equation, just look at size. You: Right, as long as it fits.

takeaway delivery apps.context: 你半夜饿了不想下楼，打开手机点外卖，十五分钟就送到楼下，朋友说现在真方便，这时就会用到 takeaway delivery apps。
takeaway delivery apps.translation: 朋友：半夜饿了怎么办 你：用 takeaway delivery apps 点个烧烤 朋友：多久能送到 你：十五分钟就到楼下
takeaway delivery apps.example: Friend: What do we do hungry at midnight? You: Order BBQ on one of those takeaway delivery apps. Friend: How long till it arrives? You: Fifteen minutes downstairs.

takeaway food.context: 你加班到九点不想做饭，朋友说点个外卖吃完赶紧睡，这时就会用到 takeaway food。
takeaway food.translation: 朋友：今晚还做饭吗 你：太累了 点 takeaway food 吧 朋友：那点个黄焖鸡 你：行 我马上点
takeaway food.example: Friend: Still cooking tonight? You: Too tired, let us order takeaway food. Friend: Then get braised chicken. You: Okay, I will order now.

takeaway meal.context: 你周末不想出门，就打电话叫了个炒饭送到家，边吃边看剧，朋友说这日子真舒服，这时就会用到 takeaway meal。
takeaway meal.translation: 朋友：你周末怎么吃的 你：点了个 takeaway meal 边看剧边吃 朋友：这样真舒服 不用做饭 你：对 偶尔懒一下
takeaway meal.example: Friend: What did you eat this weekend? You: I ordered a takeaway meal, eating it while watching a show. Friend: That is the life, no cooking. You: Right, being lazy once in a while.

takeaway menu.context: 你想点外卖但不知道这家有什么菜，让服务员把菜单拍给你，朋友问你要什么，这时就会用到 takeaway menu。
takeaway menu.translation: 朋友：你要吃哪家外卖 你：我不确定 让服务员发个 takeaway menu 朋友：那你选好告诉我 你：行 我看完点两份
takeaway menu.example: Friend: Which takeaway do you want? You: I am not sure, let them send the takeaway menu. Friend: Tell me once you decide. You: Okay, I will order two things after looking.

taken together.context: 朋友说你这次考试复习得很充分，你说把所有资料一起看下来，整体看还是准备得不错的，这时就会用到 taken together。
taken together.translation: 朋友：你这次复习得怎么样 你：taken together 所有资料都看了一遍 朋友：那应该没问题 你：希望吧 明天上考场
taken together.example: Friend: How was your revision this time? You: Taken together, I have gone through all the materials. Friend: Then you should be fine. You: Hope so, exam tomorrow.

taking a whiff of.context: 你刚进咖啡店就闻到一股浓郁的咖啡香，忍不住深吸一口气，朋友说你看你馋得都开始闻味儿了，这时就会用到 taking a whiff of。
taking a whiff of.translation: 朋友：你一进门就深呼吸干嘛 你：taking a whiff of 这咖啡太香了 朋友：你这是馋了吧 你：对 快给我来一杯
taking a whiff of.example: Friend: Why are you taking a deep breath the moment you walk in? You: Taking a whiff of the coffee, it smells amazing. Friend: You are craving it, right? You: Right, get me a cup quickly.

taking action.context: 你看到有人乱扔垃圾，朋友说光说没用，得真采取行动去捡起来，聊到采取行动，这时就会用到 taking action。
taking action.translation: 朋友：路边垃圾这么多 光骂有用吗 你：taking action 捡起来才有用 朋友：那我们一起动手 你：行 一人一半
taking action.example: Friend: All that litter on the roadside, does complaining help? You: Taking action to pick it up is what counts. Friend: Then let us do it together. You: Okay, we split it.

taking steps to.context: 你看到河水被污染，跟朋友说不能光叹气，得采取措施让工厂达标排放，这时就会用到 taking steps to。
taking steps to.translation: 朋友：河水怎么这么脏 你：得 taking steps to 让工厂处理污水 朋友：那我们跟环保局反映 你：对 一起打电话
taking steps to.example: Friend: Why is the river so dirty? You: We need to take steps to make factories treat their waste water. Friend: Then report it to the environment bureau. You: Right, call together.

taking to the skies.context: 飞机起飞时慢慢离开地面冲上天空，朋友指着窗外说这一下就飞起来了，聊到飞机腾空而起，这时就会用到 taking to the skies。
taking to the skies.translation: 朋友：你看窗外 飞机离地了 你：taking to the skies 一下就冲上云了 朋友：每次起飞还是有点激动 你：对 看着地面越来越小
