taking to the skies.example: Friend: Look out the window, the plane is lifting off. You: Taking to the skies, it climbs right into the clouds. Friend: I still get excited every takeoff. You: Right, watching the ground shrink.

talk at.context: 你妈一回家就开始数落你，根本不听你解释，朋友说你妈这不是跟你说话，是单向输出，这时就会用到 talk at。
talk at.translation: 朋友：你妈今天又骂你了 你：她 talk at 我半小时 一句不让我插 朋友：那你妈也太急了 你：我等她说完再解释
talk at.example: Friend: Did your mother scold you again today? You: She talked at me for half an hour, did not let me cut in. Friend: Your mom is too impatient. You: I will explain once she is done.

talk back to.context: 你妈说你两句你就顶嘴反驳，朋友说你这样对长辈说话不太好，这时就会用到 talk back to。
talk back to.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么跟你妈顶嘴了 你：她冤枉我 我 talk back to 了两句 朋友：对长辈别这样 有话好好说 你：行 我等她消气再讲
talk back to.example: Friend: Why did you talk back to your mother just now? You: She blamed me wrongly, I talked back a bit. Friend: Do not do that to elders, speak calmly. You: Okay, I will wait till she cools down.

talk over.context: 你和朋友纠结周末去哪儿，两个人坐下来把利弊一条条商量清楚，最后定下来去爬山，这时就会用到 talk over。
talk over.translation: 朋友：周末到底去爬山还是看电影 你：咱们 talk over 一下再定 朋友：爬山吧 天气好 你：行 就这么定了
talk over.example: Friend: Should we hike or watch a movie this weekend? You: Let us talk it over before deciding. Friend: Hike, the weather is nice. You: Okay, decided.

talk therapy.context: 你最近压力大睡不好，医生建议你去找咨询师聊聊，说说话本身就能缓解情绪，这时就会用到 talk therapy。
talk therapy.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老失眠 你：压力太大 医生建议做 talk therapy 朋友：聊一聊真有用吗 你：对 把烦心事说出来就轻松
talk therapy.example: Friend: Why have you been losing sleep? You: Too much pressure, the doctor suggested talk therapy. Friend: Does just talking really help? You: Right, saying the worries out loud lightens them.

talking of.context: 你们正聊旅行的事，朋友突然说对了，说到旅行，你上次去云南玩得怎样，聊到提到某事，这时就会用到 talking of。
talking of.translation: 朋友：我们周末去哪儿玩呢 你：talking of 旅行 你上次去云南好玩吗 朋友：特别好 我推荐你去 你：行 我查查机票
talking of.example: Friend: Where should we go this weekend? You: Talking of trips, how was your Yunnan trip? Friend: Amazing, I recommend it to you. You: Okay, I will check flights.

tally up.context: 聚餐吃完大家AA，服务员拿来账单，朋友掏出手机一笔笔算，把每个人该出的钱加出来，这时就会用到 tally up。
tally up.translation: 朋友：咱们这顿一共多少钱 你：我 tally up 一下 一共三百二 朋友：四个人AA 一人八十 你：行 我发收款码
tally up.example: Friend: How much was the whole meal? You: Let me tally up, three hundred twenty in total. Friend: Split four ways, eighty each. You: Okay, I will send the payment QR.

tap into.context: 你做产品时发现用户特别喜欢某功能，就顺着这个需求再深入做，朋友说你这是挖到了用户的真实需求，这时就会用到 tap into。
tap into.translation: 朋友：你新功能怎么突然火了 你：我 tap into 了 用户真正的痛点 朋友：抓到需求就成功一半 你：对 用户自己都不知道要啥
tap into.example: Friend: Why did your new feature suddenly take off? You: I tapped into a real user pain point. Friend: Nailing the need is half the battle. You: Right, users do not even know what they want.

tap on.context: 你用手机屏幕时轻轻点一下就打开App，朋友问你怎么不按重一点，你说触屏轻点就行，这时就会用到 tap on。
tap on.translation: 朋友：你点屏幕怎么那么轻 你：tap on 一下就开了 不用使劲按 朋友：那我下次轻点试试 你：对 屏幕娇气 别按坏了
tap on.example: Friend: Why do you tap the screen so lightly? You: Just tap on it once and it opens, no need to press hard. Friend: Then I will tap lightly next time. You: Right, the screen is delicate, do not break it.

tap water.context: 你做饭时没买矿泉水，朋友说直接烧自来水喝就行，聊到水龙头出来的水，这时就会用到 tap water。
tap water.translation: 朋友：家里没矿泉水了 喝什么 你：烧 tap water 就行 我一直喝这个 朋友：那得烧开了再喝 你：对 我烧一壶
tap water.example: Friend: We are out of bottled water, what to drink? You: Just boil tap water, I always drink that. Friend: Then boil it properly first. You: Right, I will boil a pot.

tap-and-go card.context: 你买咖啡时不用掏钱包，拿手机碰一下读卡器就付了，朋友说你这卡真方便，聊到非接触支付，这时就会用到 tap-and-go card。
tap-and-go card.translation: 朋友：你怎么手机碰一下就付了 你：我这是 tap-and-go card 一碰就付 朋友：那丢了会不会被人乱刷 你：小额才免密 大额要密码
tap-and-go card.example: Friend: How did you just pay by tapping the phone? You: It is a tap-and-go card, one tap and it pays. Friend: If you lose it, could someone rack it up? You: Only small amounts are password-free, big ones need a PIN.

tape player.context: 你翻出爷爷家一台老磁带机，放进去一盘老歌，声音沙沙的，朋友说这都是小时候的回忆，这时就会用到 tape player。
tape player.translation: 朋友：你翻出这老古董干嘛 你：这是我爷爷的 tape player 放老磁带 朋友：沙沙的声音真有年代感 你：对 一听就回到小时候
tape player.example: Friend: Why dig out this old antique? You: It is my grandfather's tape player, playing old cassettes. Friend: That hissy sound is so nostalgic. You: Right, one listen and I am a kid again.

target at.context: 你做广告时明确瞄准年轻人，把广告投放在他们常看的视频网站上，朋友问你这广告给谁看，你说就是给年轻人看的，这时就会用到 target at。
target at.translation: 朋友：你这广告投放在哪儿 你：target at 年轻人 放视频网站上 朋友：那文案得潮一点 你：对 用他们的梗
target at.example: Friend: Where are you running the ad? You: Targeted at young people, on video platforms. Friend: Then the copy has to be trendy. You: Right, use their memes.

targeted advertising.context: 你刷手机时发现你刚搜过球鞋，购物App就给你推球鞋广告，朋友说这广告是盯着你兴趣来的，这时就会用到 targeted advertising。
targeted advertising.translation: 朋友：你怎么老收到球鞋广告 你：他们做 targeted advertising 盯着我的搜索记录 朋友：这也太准了 你：对 刚搜完就推
targeted advertising.example: Friend: Why do you keep getting sneaker ads? You: They do targeted advertising based on my search history. Friend: That is scary accurate. You: Right, right after I search.

task at hand.context: 领导催你赶紧把手头这个活做完，别分心，你说我专心做着呢，这时就会用到 task at hand。
task at hand.translation: 朋友：领导刚才催你什么 你：让我专心把 task at hand 做完 别管别的 朋友：那你先做这个方案 你：行 我今天就把它写完
task at hand.example: Friend: What did the boss just push you about? You: Focus on the task at hand and ignore other things. Friend: Then finish this proposal first. You: Okay, I will write it today.

taste bud.context: 你吃了很辣的火锅，舌头都麻了，朋友说你味蕾都被辣到了，聊到舌头上尝味道的小突起，这时就会用到 taste bud。
taste bud.translation: 朋友：你舌头怎么红红的 你：吃太辣 刺激到 taste buds 了 朋友：那过会儿就好 你：对 辣劲过去就不麻了
taste bud.example: Friend: Why is your tongue red? You: Too spicy, it irritated my taste buds. Friend: It will be fine in a bit. You: Right, once the heat fades the numbness goes.

tax flights.context: 你朋友说要减少坐飞机出行，政府应该对机票加税，这样能鼓励大家坐火车，聊到对航班征税，这时就会用到 tax flights。
tax flights.translation: 朋友：怎么减少飞机碳排放 你：政府应该 tax flights 让机票变贵 朋友：那大家就坐火车了 你：对 长途的也得便宜才行
tax flights.example: Friend: How do we cut flight carbon emissions? You: The government should tax flights to make tickets pricier. Friend: Then people will take the train. You: Right, but long-distance tickets have to stay cheap.

tea aficionado.context: 你朋友懂茶，能一口喝出是什么山头的茶，朋友说他是个品茶行家，这时就会用到 tea aficionado。
tea aficionado.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么一口就尝出这茶哪产的 你：他是个 tea aficionado 喝了二十年 朋友：那他舌头也太灵了 你：对 平时天天喝
tea aficionado.example: Friend: How did your friend taste the tea's origin in one sip? You: He is a tea aficionado, drinking for twenty years. Friend: His palate is incredible. You: Right, he drinks it every day.

tea bag.context: 你早上到办公室泡一杯红茶，把茶包扔进杯子里等三分钟，朋友问你怎么不直接喝茶粉，这时就会用到 tea bag。
tea bag.translation: 朋友：你泡茶怎么用个小袋子 你：那是 tea bag 扔进去等三分钟就行 朋友：比泡茶叶方便 你：对 办公室喝不麻烦
tea bag.example: Friend: Why are you steeping with a little bag? You: That is a tea bag, just toss it in for three minutes. Friend: More convenient than loose leaves. You: Right, no hassle at the office.

tea enthusiast.context: 你朋友周末必去茶馆喝茶，还自己买茶具，朋友说他就是个爱茶的人，这时就会用到 tea enthusiast。
tea enthusiast.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么周末都在茶馆 你：他是个 tea enthusiast 家里全是茶具 朋友：那他对茶研究得挺深 你：对 聊起茶就停不下来
tea enthusiast.example: Friend: Why is your friend always at the teahouse on weekends? You: He is a tea enthusiast, his home is full of tea sets. Friend: Then he really knows tea. You: Right, he cannot stop talking about it.

tea leaves.context: 你去茶庄买茶，老板给你抓了一把干叶子闻香，朋友说这就是茶叶，回家泡开就能喝，这时就会用到 tea leaves。
tea leaves.translation: 朋友：老板给你抓的这一把是什么 你：是 tea leaves 干茶叶 回家泡开就行 朋友：闻着挺香 你：对 泡开满屋都是茶香
tea leaves.example: Friend: What did the shop owner hand you? You: It is tea leaves, just steep them at home. Friend: It smells lovely. You: Right, the whole room smells of tea once brewed.

teach fiscal sense.context: 你说现在年轻人花钱大手大脚，学校该从小教孩子怎么管钱，培养理财观念，这时就会用到 teach fiscal sense。
teach fiscal sense.translation: 朋友：现在大学生一有钱就花光 你：学校该 teach fiscal sense 从小教管钱 朋友：那这样以后才不会月光 你：对 财商得从小培养
teach fiscal sense.example: Friend: College students spend all their money the moment they get paid. You: Schools should teach fiscal sense, money habits from young. Friend: Then they will not live paycheck to paycheck. You: Right, financial sense starts early.

team bonding.context: 公司组织大家出去团建玩游戏，同事之间通过活动拉近了关系，朋友问这种活动有什么用，聊到团队凝聚，这时就会用到 team bonding。
team bonding.translation: 朋友：公司团建爬山有意思吗 你：就是 team bonding 让大家熟一点 朋友：跟同事关系好了 干活也顺 你：对 比天天坐办公室强
team bonding.example: Friend: Was the company hiking retreat fun? You: It is team bonding, getting coworkers closer. Friend: Better relations make work smoother. You: Right, better than sitting in the office all day.

team building.context: 公司新员工入职第一天，老板组织大家做破冰游戏，朋友说这就是为了让新人快速融入，这时就会用到 team building。
team building.translation: 朋友：新员工第一天就做游戏 你：是 team building 让大家快点熟 朋友：这样新人不尴尬 你：对 比直接坐工位强
team building.example: Friend: New staff are playing games on day one? You: It is team building to help them settle in fast. Friend: Then the new hires do not feel awkward. You: Right, better than sitting at a desk.

team player.context: 你在公司干活从不抢功，同事有困难都帮一把，老板说你是个特别好合作的人，聊到这种团队型的人，这时就会用到 team player。
team player.translation: 朋友：老板怎么老夸你 你：我就是个 team player 大家一起把活干完就行 朋友：你不抢功劳 同事都喜欢你 你：对 团队好才真的好
team player.example: Friend: Why does the boss keep praising you? You: I am just a team player, getting the work done together. Friend: You do not grab credit, coworkers like you. You: Right, a good team matters most.

team up with.context: 你一个人做项目忙不过来，找另一个部门的同事一起合作，朋友问你怎么突然拉人入伙，这时就会用到 team up with。
team up with.translation: 朋友：你这项目怎么多了个人 你：我 team up with 另一个部门一起做 朋友：两个人效率高多了 你：对 他懂技术我懂市场
team up with.example: Friend: Why is there someone new on your project? You: I teamed up with another department to do it together. Friend: Two people are much more efficient. You: Right, he knows tech, I know the market.

tear down.context: 你看老城区那栋破楼被拆了要建新商场，朋友说这是把旧楼推倒，聊到拆掉建筑，这时就会用到 tear down。
tear down.translation: 朋友：那栋老楼怎么被拆了 你：要 tear down 建新商场 朋友：那可是三十年前的老楼 你：是啊 拆了挺可惜
tear down.example: Friend: Why is that old building being demolished? You: They will tear it down to build a new mall. Friend: That was a thirty-year-old building. You: Right, a pity to tear it down.

tear one's hair out.context: 你赶报告赶了三天还没写完，急得抓头发，朋友说你别急，慢慢写，这时就会用到 tear one's hair out。
tear one's hair out.translation: 朋友：你怎么抓头发呢 你：报告明天要交 我还没写完 急得 tear my hair out 朋友：别急 今晚熬夜写 我陪你 你：行 你给我带杯咖啡
tear one's hair out.example: Friend: Why are you pulling your hair? You: The report is due tomorrow and I am not done, I am tearing my hair out. Friend: Do not panic, pull an all-nighter, I will keep you company. You: Okay, bring me a coffee.

tearing their hair out.context: 你赶项目赶了三天三夜，眼睛都红了，朋友说你这是急得抓头发，别太拼了，这时就会用到 tearing their hair out。
tearing their hair out.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么红成这样 你：项目上线前 bug 一堆 大家 tearing their hair out 朋友：别熬夜熬出病 你：行 今晚先睡三小时
tearing their hair out.example: Friend: Why are your eyes so bloodshot? You: Bugs everywhere before launch, everyone is tearing their hair out. Friend: Do not burn yourselves out. You: Okay, I will sleep three hours tonight.

tech company.context: 你朋友毕业后去了一家互联网公司做程序员，聊天时说他们公司在科技园里，聊到科技公司，这时就会用到 tech company。
tech company.translation: 朋友：你朋友现在在哪上班 你：在一家 tech company 写代码 朋友：工资高吧 你：还行 就是加班多
tech company.example: Friend: Where does your friend work now? You: At a tech company writing code. Friend: Good pay? You: Okay, just lots of overtime.

technical fault.context: 你开线上会议时麦克风突然没声了，急得你拍电脑，朋友说这是设备出故障了，这时就会用到 technical fault。
technical fault.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么突然没声了 你：电脑出了 technical fault 麦克风失灵了 朋友：那你现在好了吗 你：重启了一下 又能说话了
technical fault.example: Friend: Why did you suddenly cut out? You: The computer had a technical fault, the mic died. Friend: Are you back now? You: I restarted it, I can speak again.

technical glitch.context: 你直播时画面突然卡住，观众在评论区问怎么不动了，朋友说这是小技术问题，这时就会用到 technical glitch。
technical glitch.translation: 朋友：你直播怎么突然卡住了 你：出了点 technical glitch 画面卡了 朋友：那你重启一下 你：行 我调试一下马上回来
technical glitch.example: Friend: Why did your stream suddenly freeze? You: There was a technical glitch, the video stalled. Friend: Then restart it. You: Okay, I will be right back.

technical skill.context: 找工作时你发现岗位要求会用各种设计软件，朋友说除了这些硬技术能力，还要会沟通，聊到专业技能，这时就会用到 technical skill。
technical skill.translation: 朋友：你简历上都写了啥 你：各种软件操作 technical skill 朋友：除了技术 还要写沟通能力 你：对 软硬都得有
technical skill.example: Friend: What did you put on your CV? You: All the software operations as technical skills. Friend: Besides tech, write communication skills. You: Right, both hard and soft.

technological advancement.context: 你看科幻片里未来人能跟机器人对话，朋友说这都是几十年科技进步带来的，聊到技术发展，这时就会用到 technological advancement。
technological advancement.translation: 朋友：现在手机功能真多 你：都是 technological advancement 几十年的成果 朋友：几十年前谁想到能视频通话 你：对 科技发展太快
technological advancement.example: Friend: Phones do so much now. You: It is the result of decades of technological advancement. Friend: Decades ago nobody imagined video calls. You: Right, tech moves so fast.

technological advances.context: 你爷爷说他小时候家里没电灯，现在什么都智能，朋友说几十年科技进步真改变了生活，这时就会用到 technological advances。
technological advances.translation: 朋友：你爷爷小时候什么样 你：没电灯 点蜡烛 朋友：现在 technological advances 全智能了 你：对 一代人享受到了变化
technological advances.example: Friend: What was your grandfather's childhood like? You: No electric light, just candles. Friend: Now technological advances made everything smart. You: Right, one generation saw it all.

technological breakthrough.context: 新闻说某国在电池技术上取得重大突破，充电十分钟能跑一千公里，朋友说这是真正的技术突破，这时就会用到 technological breakthrough。
technological breakthrough.translation: 朋友：新闻里说电池充十分钟跑一千公里 你：这是个 technological breakthrough 真厉害 朋友：那以后电动车真普及了 你：对 续航不再是问题
technological breakthrough.example: Friend: The news says a ten-minute charge goes a thousand kilometres. You: That is a real technological breakthrough, impressive. Friend: Then electric cars will really take off. You: Right, range is no longer a problem.

technological development.context: 你看纪录片讲人类从算盘到超算，朋友说这就是技术一步步发展的结果，聊到技术发展，这时就会用到 technological development。
technological development.translation: 朋友：这纪录片讲的啥 你：从算盘到超算 technological development 朋友：几十年变化真大 你：对 一步一步发展过来
technological development.example: Friend: What is this documentary about? You: Technological development from abacus to supercomputers. Friend: Huge change in decades. You: Right, it developed step by step.

tedious tasks.context: 你每天要整理一堆发票、录入数据，做这些重复枯燥的活，朋友说你这工作真无聊，这时就会用到 tedious tasks。
tedious tasks.translation: 朋友：你每天上班都干嘛 你：整理发票录数据 全是 tedious tasks 朋友：这种活做久了人都麻了 你：对 像机器人一样
tedious tasks.example: Friend: What do you do at work every day? You: Filing invoices and entering data, all tedious tasks. Friend: Doing that day after day numbs you. You: Right, like a robot.

teem with.context: 夏天去河边玩，发现水里鱼多得很，水草里全是虫，朋友说这地方生命力真旺盛，这时就会用到 teem with。
teem with.translation: 朋友：这河里怎么这么多鱼 你：水里 teem with 鱼和水草 生态特别好 朋友：那真适合钓鱼 你：对 一下午能钓半桶
teem with.example: Friend: Why are there so many fish in this river? You: The water teems with fish and plants, the ecosystem is great. Friend: Then it is perfect for fishing. You: Right, half a bucket in an afternoon.

television screen.context: 你周末在家看剧，盯着屏幕看了三小时，眼睛都花了，朋友说你看太久屏幕了，这时就会用到 television screen。
television screen.translation: 朋友：你这两天看了多少集剧 你：盯着 television screen 看了八集 眼睛都花了 朋友：看一小时歇五分钟 你：行 我闭眼休息会儿
television screen.example: Friend: How many episodes have you watched these two days? You: Eight episodes staring at the television screen, my eyes hurt. Friend: Rest five minutes every hour. You: Okay, I will close my eyes.

tell me about it.context: 朋友抱怨今天上班挤地铁挤了一小时快迟到了，你深有体会地说可不是嘛，我天天也这样，这时就会用到 tell me about it。
tell me about it.translation: 朋友：今天地铁挤死了 我都差点迟到 你：tell me about it 我每天都这样 朋友：这通勤真不是人过的 你：对 搬家是迟早的事
tell me about it.example: Friend: The metro was packed today, I almost was late. You: Tell me about it, that is my daily life. Friend: This commute is not human. You: Right, moving closer is a matter of time.

temperature control.context: 你看食品包装上写着储存温度，说夏天要放冰箱不然容易坏，朋友说这种温度控制很重要，这时就会用到 temperature control。
temperature control.translation: 朋友：这酸奶夏天不放冰箱会坏吗 你：会 得靠 temperature control 保持新鲜 朋友：那我赶紧放进去 你：对 不然今天就酸了
temperature control.example: Friend: Will this yoghurt go bad if not in the fridge in summer? You: Yes, it needs temperature control to stay fresh. Friend: Then I will put it in now. You: Right, it will sour today otherwise.

temperature fluctuation.context: 你看天气预报说明天一会晴一会雨，气温忽高忽低，朋友说这天气变化真反复，这时就会用到 temperature fluctuation。
temperature fluctuation.translation: 朋友：明天穿什么衣服合适 你：气温 fluctuation 大 穿脱方便的外套 朋友：早上冷中午热 你：对 洋葱式穿法
temperature fluctuation.example: Friend: What should I wear tomorrow? You: The temperature fluctuation is big, wear layers you can shed. Friend: Cold morning, hot noon. You: Right, onion layering.

temporary defeat.context: 你创业第一年亏了钱，但朋友说这只是暂时的失利，坚持下来以后会好，这时就会用到 temporary defeat。
temporary defeat.translation: 朋友：你创业第一年亏了多少 你：亏了十万 心里挺难受 朋友：这只是 temporary defeat 坚持下去 你：对 我不放弃
temporary defeat.example: Friend: How much did you lose in your first year of business? You: Lost a hundred thousand, it really hurts. Friend: It is just a temporary defeat, keep going. You: Right, I will not give up.

temporary fright.context: 你第一次上台演讲腿发抖，但讲完两分钟就好了，朋友说那只是一时的紧张，过会儿就没事，这时就会用到 temporary fright。
temporary fright.translation: 朋友：你上台那会怎么脸白了 你：一下紧张 但很快就好 朋友：那只是 temporary fright 大家都这样 你：对 后来就放开了
temporary fright.example: Friend: Why did your face go pale on stage? You: I got nervous for a second, but it passed. Friend: That is just temporary fright, everyone feels it. You: Right, I loosened up later.

temporary lapse.context: 你平时记得很熟的同事名字，开会时突然想不起来，尴尬得不行，朋友说谁都有脑子短路的时候，这时就会用到 temporary lapse。
temporary lapse.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么叫不出那个同事名字 你：一下 temporary lapse 想不起来了 朋友：正常 老了都这样 你：对 名字就在嘴边
temporary lapse.example: Friend: Why could you not recall that coworker's name just now? You: I had a temporary lapse and could not remember. Friend: Normal, everyone gets that at our age. You: Right, it was on the tip of my tongue.

tempt fate.context: 你下雨天还要骑电动车不戴头盔，朋友劝你别这样玩命，容易出事，这时就会用到 tempt fate。
tempt fate.translation: 朋友：你雨天骑车不戴头盔 太危险 你：没事 雨不大 朋友：别 tempt fate 万一摔了呢 你：行 我明天戴上
tempt fate.example: Friend: Riding in the rain without a helmet is dangerous. You: It is fine, the rain is light. Friend: Do not tempt fate, what if you fall? You: Okay, I will wear it tomorrow.

tend to be.context: 朋友到了新地方，发现这里的人说话都偏慢、做事不急，你说这地方的生活节奏就是这样，朋友问是不是普遍现象，这时就会用到 tend to be。
tend to be.translation: 朋友：这城市人走路怎么都慢悠悠 你：这边节奏 tend to be 慢 朋友：那生活挺舒服 你：对 不卷
tend to be.example: Friend: Why do people walk so slowly in this city? You: The pace here tends to be slow. Friend: Then life is comfortable. You: Right, no rat race.

tends to.context: 你说你早上喝咖啡，晚上就睡不着，朋友说你就是一喝咖啡就容易失眠，这时就会用到 tends to。
tends to.translation: 朋友：你晚上怎么又睡不着 你：下午喝了杯咖啡 我就 tends to 这样 朋友：那你下午别喝了 你：对 以后只早上喝
tends to.example: Friend: Why can you not sleep again tonight? You: I had a coffee in the afternoon, I tend to react like that. Friend: Then do not drink it in the afternoon. You: Right, only in the morning from now on.

term paper.context: 期末老师布置了一篇长论文，占期末成绩一半，朋友问这作业难不难，你说得花两周查资料，这时就会用到 term paper。
term paper.translation: 朋友：期末你们有啥大作业 你：要写一篇 term paper 占一半成绩 朋友：那得查多少资料 你：至少十篇文献
term paper.example: Friend: Any big assignments this finals? You: We have to write a term paper worth half the grade. Friend: How many sources must you read? You: At least ten papers.

terminal hair.context: 医生说青春期前和青春期后长出来的头发不一样，粗的那种叫终毛，朋友问什么意思，这时就会用到 terminal hair。
terminal hair.translation: 朋友：为什么小时候头发细软 现在变粗了 你：长大长出来的是 terminal hair 不一样 朋友：那是正常的发育 你：对 每个人都这样
terminal hair.example: Friend: Why was my hair fine as a child but coarse now? You: The hair that grows after puberty is terminal hair, it is different. Friend: That is normal development. You: Right, everyone goes through it.

test against.context: 你做新配方时把新方案跟老方案做对比测试，看哪个效果好，朋友问你在干嘛，你说在做对照试验，这时就会用到 test against。
test against.translation: 朋友：你实验室里在忙什么 你：把新配方 test against 老配方 看哪个好 朋友：结果出来了吗 你：新的效果好一倍
test against.example: Friend: What are you doing in the lab? You: Testing the new formula against the old one to see which is better. Friend: Are the results out? You: The new one works twice as well.

test competencies.context: 公司招聘时除了看简历还要现场做题，测一下大家实际动手能力，朋友问面试怎么这么难，你说就是考核能力，这时就会用到 test competencies。
test competencies.translation: 朋友：这公司面试怎么还要考试 你：他们要 test competencies 看真本事 朋友：那你过了吗 你：过了 下周入职
test competencies.example: Friend: Why does this company give a test in the interview? You: They test competencies to see real skills. Friend: Did you pass? You: Yes, I start next week.

test group.context: 公司推出新软件前先找一组人试用，让他们提意见，聊到这组试用的人，这时就会用到 test group。
test group.translation: 朋友：你们新软件上线前有多少人用过 你：有个 test group 两百人先试 朋友：他们反馈好吗 你：整体不错 改了几个bug
test group.example: Friend: How many people tried your new app before launch? You: We had a test group of two hundred. Friend: Was their feedback good? You: Mostly good, fixed a few bugs.

text corpora.context: 语言学课上老师说做研究要用到大量真实文本，叫语料库，朋友问那是什么，这时就会用到 text corpora。
text corpora.translation: 朋友：语言学课上老师说的语料库是啥 你：就是 text corpora 一大堆真实文本 朋友：要那干嘛 你：研究语言规律用
text corpora.example: Friend: What is that corpus the linguistics teacher mentioned? You: It is text corpora, a huge pile of real texts. Friend: What for? You: To study language patterns.

text friends.context: 你跟朋友不在一个城市，平时就发消息联系，朋友问你怎么不打电话，你说打字方便，这时就会用到 text friends。
text friends.translation: 朋友：你俩异地怎么联系 你：就 text friends 发消息 朋友：那也见不到面啊 你：周末视频一下
text friends.example: Friend: How do you two stay in touch long distance? You: We just text each other. Friend: But you cannot see each other. You: We video call on weekends.

text messages.context: 你手机存了几百条短信，都是跟家人聊天记录，朋友说你存这么多干嘛，你说都是回忆，这时就会用到 text messages。
text messages.translation: 朋友：你手机怎么存了几百条短信 你：都是跟家人的 text messages 舍不得删 朋友：那都是回忆 你：对 我换手机都导过来
text messages.example: Friend: Why do you keep hundreds of messages on your phone? You: They are text messages with family, I cannot delete them. Friend: Those are memories. You: Right, I transfer them when I switch phones.

textile waste.context: 新闻说旧衣服堆成山，很多衣服直接烧掉或填埋，聊到这种纺织废料，这时就会用到 textile waste。
textile waste.translation: 朋友：旧衣服都去哪儿了 你：好多变成 textile waste 烧掉或填埋 朋友：那污染多大 你：对 快时尚太浪费
textile waste.example: Friend: Where do old clothes go? You: A lot becomes textile waste, burned or buried. Friend: That is so polluting. You: Right, fast fashion is so wasteful.

that.context: 你跟朋友聊电影，朋友问你喜欢哪个导演，你说就那个，拍过《让子弹飞》的，朋友说哦原来是他，这时就会用到 that。
that.translation: 朋友：你最喜欢哪个导演 你：就 that 个 拍过让子弹飞的 朋友：哦 姜文啊 你：对 他的片子都好看
that.example: Friend: Which director do you like most? You: That one who made Let the Bullets Fly. Friend: Oh, Jiang Wen. You: Right, all his films are great.

that being said.context: 你朋友说虽然这家餐厅有点贵，但味道真的值，朋友说虽然贵但确实好，聊到转折，这时就会用到 that being said。
that being said.translation: 朋友：这家餐厅真挺贵的 你：是啊 but that being said 味道确实好 朋友：偶尔吃一顿还行 你：对 周末犒劳一下
that being said.example: Friend: This restaurant is really pricey. You: Yeah, but that being said, the taste is really good. Friend: Once in a while is fine. You: Right, as a weekend treat.

that make sense.context: 你朋友解释了半天他为什么迟到，你听完点点头说这听起来有道理，这时就会用到 that make sense。
that make sense.translation: 朋友：我迟到是因为地铁停了 你：嗯 that makes sense 下次早点出门 朋友：行 我以后留半小时余量 你：对 别卡点
that make sense.example: Friend: I was late because the metro stopped. You: Okay, that makes sense, leave earlier next time. Friend: Okay, I will leave half an hour buffer. You: Right, do not cut it close.

that said.context: 你朋友说虽然加班多，但钱多，你说虽然累但确实收入高，聊到转折，这时就会用到 that said。
that said.translation: 朋友：这工作加班多 但工资高 你：that said 钱多也是真的 朋友：年轻拼几年 你：对 攒点钱再换轻松的
that said.example: Friend: This job has lots of overtime but good pay. You: That said, the money is really good. Friend: Grind a few years while young. You: Right, save up then switch to something easier.

that sort of thing.context: 朋友问你周末想干嘛，看电影逛街还是喝咖啡，你说就那些事随便哪个都行，聊到诸如此类，这时就会用到 that sort of thing。
that sort of thing.translation: 朋友：周末想干嘛 看电影逛街 你：就 that sort of thing 随便哪个 朋友：那去看电影吧 你：行
that sort of thing.example: Friend: What do you want this weekend, a movie or shopping? You: That sort of thing, any of them. Friend: Then a movie. You: Okay.

the clock is ticking.context: 考试快到了，你还在玩游戏，朋友催你说时间不多了，再不去复习就晚了，这时就会用到 the clock is ticking。
the clock is ticking.translation: 朋友：还有一周就考试 你怎么还玩游戏 你：没事 时间还多 朋友：the clock is ticking 你得抓紧 你：行 我今晚就开始复习
the clock is ticking.example: Friend: The exam is in a week, why are you still gaming? You: It is fine, there is still time. Friend: The clock is ticking, you have to get moving. You: Okay, I will start revising tonight.

the done thing.context: 你去别人家做客，不知道该带什么礼物，朋友说带点水果点心就合乎礼数，这就是常规做法，这时就会用到 the done thing。
the done thing.translation: 朋友：第一次去人家做客 带啥合适 你：带点水果点心 the done thing 朋友：不用太贵重 你：对 心意到就行
the done thing.example: Friend: What should I bring to my first visit? You: Fruit and snacks are the done thing. Friend: Nothing too pricey. You: Right, the thought counts.

the economic and political hub.context: 你到了一个新城市，发现这里既是金融中心又是旅游热门地，朋友说这就是这个城市的地位，这时就会用到 the economic and political hub。
the economic and political hub.translation: 朋友：这城市怎么又多银行又多游客 你：它是 the economic and political hub 啥都集中 朋友：那机会肯定多 你：对 大家都往这儿挤
the economic and political hub.example: Friend: Why are there both banks and tourists in this city? You: It is the economic and political hub, everything is concentrated here. Friend: Then there are lots of opportunities. You: Right, everyone crowds in.

the equivalent of.context: 你做兼职一小时二十块，朋友说这相当于大学生兼职的平均价，聊到等于什么，这时就会用到 the equivalent of。
the equivalent of.translation: 朋友：你兼职一小时赚多少 你：二十块 是 the equivalent of 一顿午饭 朋友：那一个月也不少 你：对 够零花
the equivalent of.example: Friend: How much do you make per hour at your part-time? You: Twenty yuan, the equivalent of a lunch. Friend: That adds up over a month. You: Right, enough for pocket money.

the good old days.context: 你爷爷老说以前东西便宜、人也单纯，回忆小时候的日子，朋友说他又在念旧了，这时就会用到 the good old days。
the good old days.translation: 朋友：你爷爷又在说以前了 你：他总怀念 the good old days 朋友：老人们都这样 你：对 觉得过去好
the good old days.example: Friend: Is your grandfather reminiscing again? You: He always misses the good old days. Friend: Old folks are all like that. You: Right, they think the past was better.

the great outdoors.context: 周末你约朋友去爬山露营，朋友说周末就该去户外呼吸新鲜空气，别老待家里，聊到大自然后，这时就会用到 the great outdoors。
the great outdoors.translation: 朋友：周末别老待家里 你：那去哪儿 朋友：去 the great outdoors 爬山露营 你：行 我收拾帐篷
the great outdoors.example: Friend: Stop staying home on weekends. You: Then where? Friend: Into the great outdoors, hiking and camping. You: Okay, I will pack the tent.

the hard way.context: 你朋友创业踩过坑才学会怎么识人，你说这学费交得真贵，朋友说都是吃了亏才学会的，这时就会用到 the hard way。
the hard way.translation: 朋友：你怎么学会识人这么准 你：我是 learn it the hard way 被坑过几次 朋友：那真花钱买教训 你：对 吃过亏才长记性
the hard way.example: Friend: How did you learn to read people so well? You: I learned it the hard way, got burned a few times. Friend: That is an expensive lesson. You: Right, setbacks teach you.

the here and now.context: 你朋友说别老想未来的事，也别后悔过去，把眼下这一刻过好就行，聊到活在当下，这时就会用到 the here and now。
the here and now.translation: 朋友：你怎么天天焦虑未来 你：怕以后过不好 朋友：别想那么多 活在 the here and now 你：行 我今天就先好好吃饭
the here and now.example: Friend: Why are you always anxious about the future? You: Afraid I will not have a good life later. Friend: Stop overthinking, live in the here and now. You: Okay, I will just eat well today.

the human race.context: 你看纪录片讲从古到今人类怎么生存发展，朋友说整个人类走到今天不容易，聊到人类这个整体，这时就会用到 the human race。
the human race.translation: 朋友：这纪录片讲的啥 你：讲 the human race 从古到今怎么活下来 朋友：几万年真不简单 你：对 一路走到今天
the human race.example: Friend: What is this documentary about? You: It is the human race, how we survived from ancient times. Friend: Tens of thousands of years is no small feat. You: Right, we made it this far.

the increasing number of.context: 你发现城里养宠物的人越来越多，朋友说养宠物的数量一直在涨，聊到越来越多的人，这时就会用到 the increasing number of。
the increasing number of.translation: 朋友：小区里怎么那么多遛狗的 你：the increasing number of 养宠物的人 朋友：那狗屎也变多了 你：对 大家要自觉捡
the increasing number of.example: Friend: Why are there so many dog walkers in the complex? You: The increasing number of people keeping pets. Friend: Then dog poo has gone up too. You: Right, owners have to pick it up.

the lack of.context: 你做项目失败了，朋友说你不是能力差，就是缺经验，别太自责，聊到缺的东西，这时就会用到 the lack of。
the lack of.translation: 朋友：项目失败你别太自责 你：是不是我能力不行 朋友：是 the lack of 经验 多做几次就好 你：行 下次我注意
the lack of.example: Friend: Do not blame yourself for the project failing. You: Is it because I am not good enough? You: It is the lack of experience, you will get better with time. You: Okay, I will watch out next time.

the life and soul of the party.context: 聚会上你朋友最能活跃气氛，大家都喜欢他，朋友说他就是全场的开心果，这时就会用到 the life and soul of the party。
the life and soul of the party.translation: 朋友：今天聚会谁最逗 你：小李啊 他是 the life and soul of the party 朋友：有他在就不冷场 你：对 大家都爱跟他玩
the life and soul of the party.example: Friend: Who was the funniest at today's party? You: Xiao Li, he is the life and soul of the party. Friend: With him around it never gets awkward. You: Right, everyone loves being around him.

the list goes on.context: 朋友给你列举周末能做的事：看电影、逛街、打球、喝咖啡……列了半天说还有好多，聊到不胜枚举，这时就会用到 the list goes on。
the list goes on.translation: 朋友：周末可以做的事太多了 看电影逛街打球 你：the list goes on 还有好多 朋友：那我们选哪个 你：就看电影吧
the list goes on.example: Friend: There are so many weekend things to do, movies, shopping, sports. You: The list goes on, there are more. Friend: Then which do we pick? You: Just a movie.

the middle ages.context: 你看历史片讲欧洲古代没有电灯、没有机器，跟现在差别大，聊到那个一千多年前的时期，这时就会用到 the middle ages。
the middle ages.translation: 朋友：这古装片背景是啥时候 你：the middle ages 中世纪 没电灯 朋友：那时候人怎么过日子 你：种地 打打小仗
the middle ages.example: Friend: What era is this costume drama set in? You: The Middle Ages, no electric light. Friend: How did people live back then? You: Farming and small wars.

the next time.context: 你朋友约你下周六吃饭，你说行，下次见面再聊，聊到下一次，这时就会用到 the next time。
the next time.translation: 朋友：今天聊得真开心 你：the next time 我们再约 朋友：下周六老地方 你：行 不见不散
the next time.example: Friend: Today's chat was so fun. You: The next time we meet up again. Friend: Same place next Saturday. You: Okay, see you then.

the popular saying goes.context: 你朋友说常言道人多力量大，聊到那句俗话怎么说，这时就会用到 the popular saying goes。
the popular saying goes.translation: 朋友：一个人搬不动这桌子 你：the popular saying goes 人多力量大 朋友：那我们三个人一起抬 你：行 一二三
the popular saying goes.example: Friend: One person cannot move this table. You: As the popular saying goes, many hands make light work. Friend: Then the three of us lift it. You: Okay, one two three.

the same is true.context: 你朋友说广东人爱喝茶，福建人也一样爱喝茶，你说这个道理在哪儿都通用，聊到同样适用，这时就会用到 the same is true。
the same is true.translation: 朋友：广东人天天喝茶 你：the same is true 福建人 也天天喝 朋友：南方人都爱喝茶 你：对 早茶晚茶
the same is true.example: Friend: People in Guangdong drink tea every day. You: The same is true of Fujian, they drink it daily too. Friend: Southerners all love tea. You: Right, morning and evening tea.

the same time.context: 你跟朋友同时想到一家面馆，同时开口说周末去吃，朋友说真巧，想到一块儿了，聊到同时发生，这时就会用到 the same time。
the same time.translation: 朋友：周末我们吃什么 你：我正想那个面馆呢 朋友：我也是 the same time 想到的 你：那太巧了 走吧
the same time.example: Friend: What do we eat this weekend? You: I was just thinking about that noodle shop. Friend: I thought of it at the same time. You: How coincidental, let us go.

the same with.context: 你朋友说北京冬天干冷，他老家东北也一样冷，你说那种冷是一样的，聊到同样的，这时就会用到 the same with。
the same with.translation: 朋友：北京冬天真干冷 你：the same with 东北 也是冷得不行 朋友：那你怎么受得了 你：习惯了 穿厚点就行
the same with.example: Friend: Beijing winter is so dry and cold. You: The same with the Northeast, it is freezing there too. Friend: How do you stand it? You: You get used to it, just dress warm.

the seat of power.context: 你朋友问政府大楼为什么建在市中心，你说那是权力所在的位置，朋友说这就是权力中心，这时就会用到 the seat of power。
the seat of power.translation: 朋友：为什么政府大楼都建在市中心 你：那是 the seat of power 权力中心 朋友：那办事都去那边 你：对 找部门都去那一片
the seat of power.example: Friend: Why are government buildings always in the city centre? You: That is the seat of power, the centre of authority. Friend: Then all the offices are there. You: Right, you find every department over there.

the sky's the limit.context: 你朋友刚毕业，你鼓励她别设限，她年轻未来什么都可能，聊到潜力无限，这时就会用到 the sky's the limit。
the sky's the limit.translation: 朋友：我刚毕业 不知道能干啥 你：你年轻 the sky is the limit 想做啥做啥 朋友：真的吗 我怕做不好 你：别怕 大胆试
the sky's the limit.example: Friend: I just graduated, I do not know what I can do. You: You are young, the sky's the limit, do whatever you want. Friend: Really, I am afraid I will mess up. You: Do not be afraid, just try.

the sky’s the limit.context: 你朋友问这个年轻人未来能做到什么位置，你笑着说没上限，年轻人潜力无限，这时就会用到 the sky's the limit。
the sky’s the limit.translation: 朋友：你觉得这小伙子以后能到啥位置 你：年轻人 the sky's the limit 说不定 朋友：那好好培养 你：对 是个好苗子
the sky’s the limit.example: Friend: Where do you think this young man will end up? You: For a young person the sky's the limit, who knows. Friend: Then nurture him well. You: Right, he is promising.

the sky＇ s the limit.context: 你朋友问这个公司未来发展上限在哪儿，你笑着说没上限，一切皆有可能，这时就会用到 the sky＇ s the limit。
the sky＇ s the limit.translation: 朋友：这公司以后能做多大 你：真没准 the sky's the limit 朋友：那值得投资 你：对 赛道好就涨得快
the sky＇ s the limit.example: Friend: How big can this company get? You: Hard to say, the sky's the limit. Friend: Then it is worth investing. You: Right, a good sector grows fast.

the smart money is on.context: 你朋友问这几个新人里谁最有前途，你说押注那个最努力的准没错，聊到看好谁，这时就会用到 the smart money is on。
the smart money is on.translation: 朋友：这几个新人里你看好谁 你：the smart money is on 那个最努力的 朋友：为什么是他 你：他天天加班学东西
the smart money is on.example: Friend: Which of these new hires do you back? You: The smart money is on the hardest worker. Friend: Why him? You: He stays late every day learning.

the solar system.context: 孩子上天文课，老师教太阳和围着它转的几大行星，朋友问孩子学什么，你说在学太阳系，这时就会用到 the solar system。
the solar system.translation: 朋友：你家孩子今天天文课学啥了 你：学 the solar system 几大行星 朋友：他分得清吗 你：对 水星金星地球
the solar system.example: Friend: What did your kid learn in astronomy class today? You: The solar system and the planets. Friend: Can he tell them apart? You: Right, Mercury, Venus, Earth.

the start of.context: 你朋友说新工作刚开始最难，你说这就是开始的阶段，熬过去就好了，聊到……的开始，这时就会用到 the start of。
the start of.translation: 朋友：新工作第一周好难 你：the start of 都这样 熬过去就好 朋友：那多久能上手 你：一个月左右
the start of.example: Friend: The first week at the new job is so hard. You: The start is always like this, it gets easier. Friend: How long till I get the hang of it? You: About a month.

the sum of.context: 你朋友问这些年他所有努力加起来算什么，你说这就是他人生经历的总和，聊到总和，这时就会用到 the sum of。
the sum of.translation: 朋友：我这十年打拼值吗 你：the sum of 这些经历都是你的财富 朋友：虽然累 但值了 你：对 都是以后的底子
the sum of.example: Friend: Was my ten years of grind worth it? You: The sum of all those experiences is your wealth. Friend: Tiring but worth it. You: Right, it is your foundation.

the supply chain.context: 你朋友问一个产品从原料到手里要经过多少环节，你说要经过好多工厂和运输，聊到整条链条，这时就会用到 the supply chain。
the supply chain.translation: 朋友：这手机怎么从国外造好到我手里 你：要走 the supply chain 工厂运输层层环节 朋友：那中间好长 你：对 全球分工
the supply chain.example: Friend: How does this phone reach me from abroad? You: It goes through the supply chain, factories and shipping. Friend: That is a long chain. You: Right, global division of labour.

the total number of.context: 你朋友问班里多少人考了九十分以上，你说总数大概三十个，聊到总数，这时就会用到 the total number of。
the total number of.translation: 朋友：这次考试九十分以上有多少人 你：the total number of 大概三十个 朋友：那比例挺高 你：对 大家都复习得好
the total number of.example: Friend: How many scored above ninety this exam? You: The total number is about thirty. Friend: That is a high rate. You: Right, everyone revised well.

the vast majority of.context: 你朋友问你们公司多少员工是大学学历，你说绝大多数都是，只有少数不是，聊到绝大部分，这时就会用到 the vast majority of。
the vast majority of.translation: 朋友：你们公司多少人是大学生 你：the vast majority of 都是 没几个不是 朋友：那学历要求挺高 你：对 基本都本科以上
the vast majority of.example: Friend: How many in your company have a degree? You: The vast majority do, very few do not. Friend: So the education bar is high. You: Right, mostly bachelor's or above.

the world is your oyster.context: 你朋友刚毕业，你鼓励她世界那么大，机会都是她的，大胆去闯，这时就会用到 the world is your oyster。
the world is your oyster.translation: 朋友：我刚毕业 好迷茫 你：别怕 the world is your oyster 机会到处都有 朋友：真的吗 我怕找不到方向 你：先试再说 错了再来
the world is your oyster.example: Friend: I just graduated, I am so lost. You: Do not be afraid, the world is your oyster, opportunities are everywhere. Friend: Really, I am afraid I have no direction. You: Just try first, reset if wrong.

the writing on the wall.context: 你朋友公司最近连着出问题，你说这是早有预兆，坏消息都写在墙上了，聊到不祥之兆，这时就会用到 the writing on the wall。
the writing on the wall.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道这公司要垮 你：the writing on the wall 早有征兆 福利都砍了 朋友：那我们赶紧找下家 你：对 别等裁员
the writing on the wall.example: Friend: How did you know the company would fail? You: The writing on the wall was there, they cut benefits already. Friend: Then we should find the next job fast. You: Right, do not wait for layoffs.

theatrical industry.context: 你朋友在话剧团工作，最近团里排新戏，你问他这行忙不忙，聊到戏剧行业，这时就会用到 theatrical industry。
theatrical industry.translation: 朋友：你最近话剧团忙吗 你：the theatrical industry 最近挺火 新戏一场接一场 朋友：那收入怎么样 你：稳定但不算多 就是热爱
theatrical industry.example: Friend: Is your theatre company busy lately? You: The theatrical industry is hot, one play after another. Friend: How is the pay? You: Steady but not much, just passion.

theatrical release.context: 你朋友拍了部新片，先上院线还是先上网，朋友说先在影院上映几个月再上网，聊到院线公映，这时就会用到 theatrical release。
theatrical release.translation: 朋友：你那部新片哪儿能看 你：先 theatrical release 在影院放两个月 朋友：那之后才上网流媒体 你：对 先冲票房
theatrical release.example: Friend: Where can I see your new film? You: First a theatrical release in cinemas for two months. Friend: Then it hits streaming. You: Right, box office first.

theory of mind.context: 小朋友看别人哭自己也跟着哭，老师说这是孩子理解别人情绪的能力在发展，聊到这种读心能力，这时就会用到 theory of mind。
theory of mind.translation: 朋友：你家孩子怎么看别人哭也跟着哭 你：他 theory of mind 在发展 能体会别人情绪 朋友：那这种能力挺珍贵 你：对 慢慢长起来的
theory of mind.example: Friend: Why does your kid cry when others cry? You: His theory of mind is developing, he feels others' emotions. Friend: That ability is precious. You: Right, it grows over time.

theory of relativity.context: 你看科普片讲爱因斯坦怎么想出时空可以弯曲的理论，朋友问那是什么理论，聊到相对论，这时就会用到 theory of relativity。
theory of relativity.translation: 朋友：片里说的那个时空理论是啥 你：是 theory of relativity 爱因斯坦提的 朋友：那一般人能听懂吗 你：挺难 我也半懂
theory of relativity.example: Friend: What is that spacetime theory in the show? You: It is the theory of relativity by Einstein. Friend: Can ordinary people understand it? You: Pretty hard, I half get it.

therapeutic benefits.context: 你看医生说园艺和运动对身心都好，朋友问为什么，你说这些活动有疗养效果，聊到治疗好处，这时就会用到 therapeutic benefits。
therapeutic benefits.translation: 朋友：医生为什么让你多种花 你：园艺有 therapeutic benefits 对心情好 朋友：那比吃药舒服 你：对 天天看着花心情就好
therapeutic benefits.example: Friend: Why did the doctor tell you to grow flowers? You: Gardening has therapeutic benefits, it lifts the mood. Friend: Nicer than pills. You: Right, looking at flowers every day cheers me up.

therapeutic treatment.context: 你腰伤后做物理治疗，医生用热敷按摩帮你恢复，朋友问你在做什么，你说在做理疗，这时就会用到 therapeutic treatment。
therapeutic treatment.translation: 朋友：你腰伤好点没 你：在做 therapeutic treatment 热敷加按摩 朋友：那多久能好 你：医生说再做一个月
therapeutic treatment.example: Friend: Is your back injury better? You: I am on therapeutic treatment, heat packs and massage. Friend: How long till it heals? You: The doctor says another month.

therapeutic value.context: 你奶奶每天去公园打太极，医生说这种温和运动对老人身体特别有好处，聊到治疗价值，这时就会用到 therapeutic value。
therapeutic value.translation: 朋友：你奶奶怎么天天去公园 你：医生说太极有 therapeutic value 适合老人 朋友：那她现在精神头挺好 你：对 比以前硬朗
therapeutic value.example: Friend: Why does your grandma go to the park every day? You: The doctor says tai chi has therapeutic value, good for the elderly. Friend: She does look well now. You: Right, sturdier than before.

therapy dog.context: 你去医院做治疗，医生说抚摸温顺的狗也能帮病人放松，朋友问这是什么疗法，聊到治疗犬，这时就会用到 therapy dog。
therapy dog.translation: 朋友：医院怎么还有狗 你：是 therapy dog 治疗犬 陪病人玩 朋友：那病人看到狗真会开心 你：对 尤其是老人小孩
therapy dog.example: Friend: Why is there a dog in the hospital? You: It is a therapy dog, visiting patients. Friend: Do patients really cheer up seeing it? You: Right, especially old people and kids.

there is a british proverb that goes.context: 你跟朋友聊中国有句老话叫磨刀不误砍柴工，朋友问英国有没有类似的谚语，聊到那句英国谚语，这时就会用到 there is a british proverb that goes。
there is a british proverb that goes.translation: 朋友：你们中文说磨刀不误砍柴工 你：there is a British proverb that goes 类似的意思 朋友：怎么说 你：工欲善其事 必先利其器嘛
there is a british proverb that goes.example: Friend: You Chinese say sharpen the knife before chopping wood. You: There is a British proverb that goes the same idea. Friend: How does it go? You: A workman blames his tools.

there is growing evidence that.context: 你朋友说最近好多研究都证明久坐伤身，你说确实证据越来越多，聊到越来越多的证据，这时就会用到 there is growing evidence that。
there is growing evidence that.translation: 朋友：久坐真的那么有害吗 你：there is growing evidence that 久坐伤腰 朋友：那我得每小时起来走 你：对 别久坐
there is growing evidence that.example: Friend: Is sitting really that harmful? You: There is growing evidence that sitting long hurts the back. Friend: Then I will stand up every hour. You: Right, do not sit long.

there was a time when.context: 你爷爷老说他小时候整条街都能一起玩，现在都住高楼不串门了，朋友问真的吗，聊到曾经有段时间，这时就会用到 there was a time when。
there was a time when.translation: 朋友：你爷爷真那么念旧吗 你：there was a time when 整条街都一起玩 朋友：现在都是关上门谁也不认识谁 你：对 高楼把人隔开了
there was a time when.example: Friend: Is your grandfather really that nostalgic? You: There was a time when the whole street played together. Friend: Now everyone stays behind closed doors. You: Right, high rises wall people off.

there's a catch.context: 你朋友介绍了个工作说特别好，工资高还轻松，你觉得太好得不对劲，问是不是有什么坑，聊到有陷阱，这时就会用到 there's a catch。
there's a catch.translation: 朋友：我给你介绍个工作 工资高还轻松 你：听着太好 是不是 there's a catch 朋友：就是要长期出差 你：那我考虑下
there's a catch.example: Friend: I have a job for you, high pay and easy. You: Sounds too good, is there a catch? Friend: It requires long business trips. You: Then I will think about it.

there's a method to the madness.context: 你朋友做事看起来乱七八糟，但结果特别好，你说他这一套看似离谱其实有道理，聊到看似疯实则有理，这时就会用到 there's a method to the madness。
there's a method to the madness.translation: 朋友：他怎么乱写一通 结果还挺好 你：there's a method to the madness 他心里有数 朋友：看来怪人有怪招 你：对 别小看人
there's a method to the madness.example: Friend: He just jots things down, yet it works well. You: There is a method to the madness, he knows what he is doing. Friend: Weird people have weird ways. You: Right, do not underestimate them.

there's no such thing as a free lunch.context: 你朋友说天下没有免费的午餐，别老想占便宜，你说对，哪有那么多好事，聊到没有免费午餐，这时就会用到 there's no such thing as a free lunch。
there's no such thing as a free lunch.translation: 朋友：群里说扫码就送手机 你：别信 there's no such thing as a free lunch 朋友：那是诈骗 你：对 贪便宜就上当
there's no such thing as a free lunch.example: Friend: The group says scan the code and get a free phone. You: Do not believe it, there is no such thing as a free lunch. Friend: That is a scam. You: Right, greed gets you scammed.

thermal clothing.context: 你冬天去北方旅行，朋友让你多穿点，说要保暖内衣加厚毛衣，聊到保暖衣，这时就会用到 thermal clothing。
thermal clothing.translation: 朋友：北方冬天到底多冷 你：零下十几度 得穿 thermal clothing 保暖 朋友：那羽绒服得买厚的 你：对 不然冻透
thermal clothing.example: Friend: How cold is winter in the north? You: Minus ten, you need thermal clothing. Friend: Then a thick down jacket. You: Right, otherwise you freeze through.

thermal imaging.context: 救援队在搜救时用热成像设备找废墟下的人，朋友说这种技术能看到体温，聊到热成像，这时就会用到 thermal imaging。
thermal imaging.translation: 朋友：救援队怎么在黑夜里找人 你：用 thermal imaging 热成像 能看到体温 朋友：那废墟下的人也能找到 你：对 比肉眼强
thermal imaging.example: Friend: How do rescuers find people in the dark? You: They use thermal imaging to see body heat. Friend: So they can find people under rubble? You: Right, way better than the eye.

think about how to use time.context: 你朋友工作忙得没空想怎么安排时间，你说他该静下来想想怎么用时间，别老瞎忙，这时就会用到 think about how to use time。
think about how to use time.translation: 朋友：我天天忙得脚不沾地 你：你得 think about how to use time 别瞎忙 朋友：那怎么安排才好 你：先列优先级
think about how to use time.example: Friend: I run off my feet every day. You: You should think about how to use time, do not just rush. Friend: How to arrange it then? You: List priorities first.

think again.context: 你朋友说这事就这么定了，你说再想想，别着急下结论，聊到重新考虑，这时就会用到 think again。
think again.translation: 朋友：我决定辞职了 你：你 think again 别急着定 朋友：为啥 你：想清楚下一步再辞
think again.example: Friend: I have decided to quit. You: Think again, do not decide in a rush. Friend: Why? You: Figure out the next step before quitting.

think for itself.context: 你朋友买了个扫地机器人，说它能自己识别房间绕开桌子，朋友说这小东西还会自己思考，聊到自主判断，这时就会用到 think for itself。
think for itself.translation: 朋友：这扫地机器人真聪明 自己会绕桌子 你：它能 think for itself 识别障碍 朋友：那以后真能代替人 你：对 越来越智能
think for itself.example: Friend: This robot vacuum is so smart, it avoids tables by itself. You: It can think for itself, spotting obstacles. Friend: Then it can really replace people. You: Right, getting smarter.

think outside the box.context: 老板让大家想个新方案，别老用老思路，你说这就是要跳出框框思考，聊到打破常规，这时就会用到 think outside the box。
think outside the box.translation: 朋友：老板让想个新营销点子 你：别老套路 得 think outside the box 朋友：那想个什么新招 你：搞个短视频挑战
think outside the box.example: Friend: The boss wants a new marketing idea. You: No old tricks, think outside the box. Friend: What new angle? You: A short-video challenge.

think twice.context: 你朋友想冲动辞职去旅行，你劝他先想清楚，别头脑一热就做决定，聊到三思，这时就会用到 think twice。
think twice.translation: 朋友：我明天就辞职去旅行 你：你 think twice 想清楚再说 朋友：怎么了 你：辞职后钱花完怎么办
think twice.example: Friend: I am quitting tomorrow to travel. You: Think twice before you do. Friend: Why? You: What happens when the money runs out?

think twice about.context: 你朋友想买个贵包，你劝他别脑子一热就买，先想想是不是真需要，聊到三思，这时就会用到 think twice about。
think twice about.translation: 朋友：我想买个两万的包 你：你 think twice about 是不是真需要 朋友：好看啊 你：但你一个月工资才一万
think twice about.example: Friend: I want to buy a twenty-thousand bag. You: Think twice about whether you really need it. Friend: It looks great. You: But your monthly pay is only ten thousand.

thinking outside of the box.context: 老板开会说这次方案要换个思路，别老一套，朋友说老板就是要我们跳出常规思考，这时就会用到 thinking outside of the box。
thinking outside of the box.translation: 朋友：老板今天又说要创新 你：就是要我们 thinking outside of the box 朋友：那老办法为什么不行 你：不新没人看
thinking outside of the box.example: Friend: The boss talked about innovation again today. You: He wants us thinking outside of the box. Friend: Why are old ways not okay? You: Nothing new means nobody cares.

thirst for knowledge.context: 你朋友爱读书爱问问题，你说他就是有强烈的求知欲，聊到对知识的渴望，这时就会用到 thirst for knowledge。
thirst for knowledge.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么天天泡图书馆 你：他有 thirst for knowledge 就想多学 朋友：那以后肯定有出息 你：对 爱学的人不会差
thirst for knowledge.example: Friend: Why does your friend live in the library? You: He has a thirst for knowledge, he just wants to learn more. Friend: Then he will go far. You: Right, curious people do.

thrift shop.context: 你周末逛二手店淘衣服，朋友说这种慈善店又便宜又环保，聊到这种二手店，这时就会用到 thrift shop。
thrift shop.translation: 朋友：你这毛衣哪儿买的 真便宜 你：thrift shop 二手店淘的 五十块 朋友：那还挺环保 你：对 旧物利用
thrift shop.example: Friend: Where did you get this cheap sweater? You: A thrift shop, second-hand, fifty yuan. Friend: That is also eco-friendly. You: Right, reusing old things.

thrive in.context: 你把一盆绿植放在阳台，它长得特别旺，朋友说这植物真适合这儿的气候，越养越好，聊到茁壮成长，这时就会用到 thrive in。
thrive in.translation: 朋友：你这盆花怎么养这么好 你：它 thrive in 阳台这种通风的地方 朋友：我家那盆怎么老死 你：可能你那儿太晒
thrive in.example: Friend: How do you keep this plant so lush? You: It thrives in the airy balcony spot. Friend: Why does mine keep dying? You: Maybe yours gets too much sun.

thrive on.context: 你朋友是个爱折腾的人，越是有挑战的工作他越来劲，你说他就是靠挑战活着，聊到越挑战越来劲，这时就会用到 thrive on。
thrive on.translation: 朋友：他怎么天天接最难得项目 你：他 thrive on 挑战 越难越兴奋 朋友：一般人早崩溃了 你：对 他就是那种人
thrive on.example: Friend: Why does he always take the hardest projects? You: He thrives on challenge, the harder the more excited. Friend: Most people would break down. You: Right, he is that kind of person.

through the process.context: 你朋友问你这三年具体怎么过来的，你说一路上不管多难都坚持下来了，聊到整个过程，这时就会用到 through the process。
through the process.translation: 朋友：这三年你怎么熬过来的 你：through the process 没放弃 朋友：那真不容易 你：对 一步步走过来
through the process.example: Friend: How did you get through these three years? You: Through the process I never gave up. Friend: That is really tough. You: Right, step by step.

throughout history.context: 你朋友问人类从古到今是不是一直都在打仗，你说历史上战争确实没停过，聊到纵观历史，这时就会用到 throughout history。
throughout history.translation: 朋友：人类是不是一直都在打仗 你：throughout history 战争就没停过 朋友：那和平真是难得 你：对 这几十年算好的
throughout history.example: Friend: Have humans always been at war? You: Throughout history, wars have never stopped. Friend: Then peace is rare. You: Right, these decades have been good.

throw a party.context: 你朋友生日要到了，你打算请一帮朋友来家里吃饭玩游戏，朋友说你要办个派对啊，这时就会用到 throw a party。
throw a party.translation: 朋友：你生日怎么过 你：我想 throw a party 叫朋友来家里玩 朋友：那我带个蛋糕过去 你：行 晚上七点
throw a party.example: Friend: How will you spend your birthday? You: I want to throw a party, invite friends over. Friend: Then I will bring a cake. You: Okay, seven at night.

throw some shapes.context: 朋友拉你去夜店，音乐一响他就站起来扭动身体跳舞，你说他一到这种场合就开始蹦，聊到跳舞，这时就会用到 throw some shapes。
throw some shapes.translation: 朋友：他怎么一下场就开始扭 你：音乐一响他就 throw some shapes 朋友：跳得还挺嗨 你：对 就爱蹦
throw some shapes.example: Friend: Why does he start moving the moment he gets on the floor? You: The music hits and he throws some shapes. Friend: He is really into it. You: Right, he loves dancing.

throw up.context: 你朋友昨晚喝多了，今早起来说自己昨晚吐了一路，聊到呕吐，这时就会用到 throw up。
throw up.translation: 朋友：你昨晚喝多了吗 你：回到家就 throw up 难受死了 朋友：让你别喝那么多 你：对 以后少喝点
throw up.example: Friend: Did you drink too much last night? You: I threw up the moment I got home, it was awful. Friend: I told you not to drink so much. You: Right, less next time.

throwaway culture.context: 你朋友买东西用完就扔，瓶子盒子全丢，你说这样下去地球都要被垃圾埋了，聊到这种用完就丢的文化，这时就会用到 throwaway culture。
throwaway culture.translation: 朋友：你怎么攒那么多旧瓶子 你：我不想跟大家一样 throwaway culture 全扔了 朋友：那你留着干嘛 你：洗干净当收纳瓶
throwaway culture.example: Friend: Why do you keep so many old bottles? You: I do not want to be like everyone in throwaway culture tossing everything. Friend: What do you keep them for? You: Wash them for storage.

thrown into.context: 你朋友刚辞职准备考研，结果家里老人突然生病，一下打乱他所有计划，聊到被扔进窘境，这时就会用到 thrown into。
thrown into.translation: 朋友：他不是要考研吗 你：家里老人生病 他一下 thrown into 窘境 计划全乱 朋友：那真倒霉 你：对
thrown into.example: Friend: Was he not about to start grad school? You: A family member fell ill, he was thrown into a tough spot, all plans upended. Friend: That is bad luck. You: Right.

throws a spanner in the works.context: 你朋友刚做好的计划突然被一件意外事打乱，大家都愣了，聊到这种打乱安排的意外，这时就会用到 throws a spanner in the works。
throws a spanner in the works.translation: 朋友：我们周末露营都订好了 你：结果天气预报说有大雨 朋友：这一下 throws a spanner in the works 你：那只能改期了
throws a spanner in the works.example: Friend: Our camping trip this weekend is all booked. You: The forecast says heavy rain. Friend: That really throws a spanner in the works. You: Then we have to reschedule.

throws curveballs at.context: 工作中总会遇到计划外的事，你朋友说你永远猜不到生活下一个给你什么难题，聊到意外打击，这时就会用到 throws curveballs at。
throws curveballs at.translation: 朋友：这项目怎么老出意外 你：生活就是 throws curveballs at 你 朋友：那怎么应对 你：随机应变呗
throws curveballs at.example: Friend: Why does this project keep throwing surprises? You: Life keeps throwing curveballs at you. Friend: Then how do you cope? You: Just adapt as it comes.

tick.context: 你等红灯时脚轻轻踩着拍子计时，朋友问你干嘛呢，你说数秒，聊到嘀嗒计时，这时就会用到 tick。
tick.translation: 朋友：你站路口嘴里念叨啥 你：在 tick 数还有几秒变灯 朋友：那你比红绿灯还准 你：对 我脚都打拍子了
tick.example: Friend: What are you muttering at the crossing? You: Ticking off the seconds till the light changes. Friend: You are more accurate than the traffic light. You: Right, my foot is tapping.

tick off.context: 你列了个购物清单，买一样就划掉一样，朋友问你在干嘛，你说在逐项打勾完成，这时就会用到 tick off。
tick off.translation: 朋友：你手里那张纸写啥 你：购物清单 买一样 tick off 一样 朋友：那你买完几样了 你：已经划掉五个了
tick off.example: Friend: What is that paper in your hand? You: A shopping list, I tick off each item as I buy. Friend: How many have you ticked off? You: Five already.

tick over.context: 你车停在那里不熄火，朋友问你怎么不把火关了，你说在原地怠速等个人，聊到引擎慢转，这时就会用到 tick over。
tick over.translation: 朋友：你车怎么不熄火 停这儿干嘛 你：等个人 让引擎 tick over 着 朋友：别等人也别费油 你：就两分钟 马上好
tick over.example: Friend: Why is your engine still running parked here? You: Waiting for someone, leaving it ticking over. Friend: Idling wastes gas even when waiting. You: Just two minutes, almost done.

ticket prices.context: 你朋友想看演唱会，问你票价多少，你说现在票炒得特别贵，聊到票价，这时就会用到 ticket prices。
ticket prices.translation: 朋友：周末演唱会票多少钱 你：ticket prices 被炒到两千了 朋友：这么贵 谁看啊 你：粉丝还是抢
ticket prices.example: Friend: How much is the weekend concert ticket? You: Ticket prices are marked up to two thousand. Friend: That pricey, who goes? You: Fans still grab them.

ticket sale.context: 你朋友在体育场工作，问最近演唱会门票卖得怎样，聊到售票情况，这时就会用到 ticket sale。
ticket sale.translation: 朋友：你那演唱会票卖完了吗 你：ticket sale 上周就结束了 朋友：那加开场次吗 你：在商量 看需求
ticket sale.example: Friend: Did your concert tickets sell out? You: Ticket sale ended last week. Friend: Will they add more shows? You: Discussing it, depending on demand.

tickle my funny bone.context: 你朋友讲了个笑话把你逗得笑出眼泪，你说这真戳中笑点，聊到逗乐，这时就会用到 tickle my funny bone。
tickle my funny bone.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么笑成那样 你：他讲那笑话真 tickle my funny bone 朋友：哪句那么好笑 你：就那句学老板说话
tickle my funny bone.example: Friend: Why were you laughing so hard? You: That joke really tickled my funny bone. Friend: Which line was so funny? You: The part mimicking the boss.

ticks over.context: 你开车等人时不熄火，朋友说这样空转既费油又污染，聊到怠速运转，这时就会用到 ticks over。
ticks over.translation: 朋友：你车停这儿怎么还响着 你：在等人 引擎 ticks over 朋友：那把火关了 费油 你：行 我马上走
ticks over.example: Friend: Why is your car still humming while parked? You: Waiting for someone, the engine is ticking over. Friend: Then turn it off, it wastes gas. You: Okay, I am leaving now.

tide you over.context: 你朋友这月钱不够吃饭了，你借他两百块说先顶着，等发工资再还，聊到临时接济，这时就会用到 tide you over。
tide you over.translation: 朋友：我这月钱不够吃饭了 你：先借你两百 tide you over 到发工资 朋友：那我下周还你 你：行 不急
tide you over.example: Friend: I do not have enough for food this month. You: I will lend you two hundred to tide you over till payday. Friend: I will pay you back next week. You: Okay, no rush.

tidy profit.context: 你做小生意一年净赚了十几万，朋友说你这利润真不错，聊到可观的利润，这时就会用到 tidy profit。
tidy profit.translation: 朋友：你这小生意一年赚多少 你：扣完成本 tidy profit 十几万 朋友：那比上班强 你：对 虽然累点
tidy profit.example: Friend: How much does your small business make a year? You: After costs, a tidy profit of a hundred thousand. Friend: That beats a salary. You: Right, though it is tiring.

tie in to.context: 你朋友工作被项目绑得死死的，天天得坐办公室，你说他被绑住了，聊到受束缚，这时就会用到 tie in to。
tie in to.translation: 朋友：他怎么周末都来加班 你：他 tie in to 项目 走不开 朋友：那也太惨了 你：对 被绑住了
tie in to.example: Friend: Why is he coming in on weekends too? You: He is tied in to the project, cannot get away. Friend: That is miserable. You: Right, he is tied down.

tie in with.context: 你办的活动主题是环保，朋友问怎么安排才配合主题，聊到与……一致，这时就会用到 tie in with。
tie in with.translation: 朋友：咱们这个环保活动怎么安排 你：内容 tie in with 主题 全用二手材料 朋友：那海报也得素一点 你：对 统一风格
tie in with.example: Friend: How do we plan this eco event? You: Tie the content in with the theme, all second-hand materials. Friend: Then the poster should be plain too. You: Right, unified style.

tie the knot.context: 你朋友谈恋爱五年终于要求婚了，你说啥时候办婚礼，朋友笑说快领证结婚了，聊到结婚，这时就会用到 tie the knot。
tie the knot.translation: 朋友：你俩谈了五年 什么时候结婚 你：下个月就 tie the knot 领证 朋友：那恭喜啊 喝喜酒 你：行 一定请你
tie the knot.example: Friend: You two have dated five years, when are you marrying? You: Next month we tie the knot at the registry. Friend: Congrats, I will come to the banquet. You: Okay, definitely invite you.

tied to.context: 你朋友毕业五年还在一家公司，每天做一样的活，你说他被绑死在工位上了，聊到被束缚，这时就会用到 tied to。
tied to.translation: 朋友：他怎么五年不换工作 你：他 tied to 这个岗位 走不开 朋友：那也太稳定了 你：对 不敢动
tied to.example: Friend: Why has he not switched jobs in five years? You: He is tied to this role, cannot leave. Friend: That is really stable. You: Right, he dares not move.

tied up with.context: 你朋友开公司跟一个大厂绑在一起做生意，大厂出问题他也跟着亏，聊到与……有关联，这时就会用到 tied up with。
tied up with.translation: 朋友：他这小公司怎么一下亏了 你：他 tied up with 那个大厂 大厂一出事他也亏 朋友：那风险太大 你：对 太依赖一家了
tied up with.example: Friend: Why did his small company suddenly lose money? You: He is tied up with that big firm, when they stumble he loses too. Friend: That is too risky. You: Right, too dependent on one client.

tighten their belts.context: 你朋友公司效益不好，年终奖金砍了一半，大家说今年得省着点花，勒紧裤腰带过日子，这时就会用到 tighten their belts。
tighten their belts.translation: 朋友：今年奖金怎么少一半 你：公司效益不好 大家得 tighten their belts 朋友：那这个月少点外卖 你：对 节衣缩食
tighten their belts.example: Friend: Why is the bonus half this year? You: Business is bad, everyone has to tighten their belts. Friend: Then less takeout this month. You: Right, scrimp and save.

tightly packed.context: 晚高峰地铁里人挤人，密密麻麻贴在一起，朋友说这车厢挤得一点空隙都没，聊到密集，这时就会用到 tightly packed。
tightly packed.translation: 朋友：这地铁车厢怎么这么挤 你：tightly packed 人贴人 动都动不了 朋友：那下车怎么挤出去 你：慢慢挪吧
tightly packed.example: Friend: Why is this carriage so packed? You: Tightly packed, people pressed against each other, cannot move. Friend: How do we get off? You: Slowly squeeze through.

time bender.context: 你朋友天天拖作业，到最后一天才熬夜赶，你说他就是那种拖到最后一刻的人，聊到拖延的人，这时就会用到 time bender。
time bender.translation: 朋友：他作业怎么又最后一天赶 你：他就是 time bender 拖到最后 朋友：这样多累啊 你：对 但他改不了
time bender.example: Friend: Why is he rushing the assignment on the last day again? You: He is a time bender, leaving it till the end. Friend: That is so tiring. You: Right, but he cannot change.

time blindness.context: 你朋友老是搞错时间，约好三点他四点才到，你说他对时间没概念，聊到时间感知缺失，这时就会用到 time blindness。
time blindness.translation: 朋友：他又迟到了 约三点 你：他 time blindness 对时间没概念 朋友：那每次都得提前约 你：对 跟他说两点
time blindness.example: Friend: He is late again, we said three. You: He has time blindness, no sense of time. Friend: Then we have to tell him earlier. You: Right, tell him two.

time efficiency.context: 你朋友问你怎么一天能干这么多事，你说就是效率高，把时间用好，聊到时间效率，这时就会用到 time efficiency。
time efficiency.translation: 朋友：你怎么一天能干这么多事 你：我讲究 time efficiency 不浪费一分钟 朋友：那你怎么安排的 你：列清单 先做重要的
time efficiency.example: Friend: How do you get so much done in a day? You: I focus on time efficiency, not wasting a minute. Friend: How do you arrange it? You: A list, do the important first.

time flies.context: 跟朋友一年没见，见面时都感叹时间过得真快，一眨眼又一年，聊到时光飞逝，这时就会用到 time flies。
time flies.translation: 朋友：上次见面还是去年呢 你：time flies 一下又一年 朋友：那下次约得勤点 你：对 别隔一年
time flies.example: Friend: The last time we met was last year. You: How time flies, another year gone. Friend: Then let us meet more often. You: Right, not a year apart.

time limit.context: 你做考试卷子时老师说两个小时必须交卷，朋友问时间到了吗，聊到时间限制，这时就会用到 time limit。
time limit.translation: 朋友：考试还有多长时间 你：老师说 time limit 两小时 朋友：那作文还没写完呢 你：快点写 只剩二十分钟
time limit.example: Friend: How much time is left in the exam? You: The time limit is two hours. Friend: I have not finished the essay. You: Hurry, only twenty minutes left.

time lines.context: 你做项目复盘时把每一步按时间顺序列出来，朋友说这时间线真清楚，聊到时间安排，这时就会用到 time lines。
time lines.translation: 朋友：你这项目怎么复盘的 你：把每一步按 time lines 列出来 朋友：那问题出在哪一步一眼就看到 你：对 一目了然
time lines.example: Friend: How did you review the project? You: I laid out the steps on timelines. Friend: Then you see which step had the problem at a glance. You: Right, crystal clear.

time management.context: 你朋友说他每天加班到很晚，你说他该学学怎么管理时间，不然天天这么忙，聊到时间管理，这时就会用到 time management。
time management.translation: 朋友：我天天加班到十点 你：你得学学 time management 提高效率 朋友：那怎么学 你：先列优先级
time management.example: Friend: I work overtime till ten every day. You: You need to learn time management to get more efficient. Friend: How do I learn? You: List priorities first.

time off.context: 你朋友这周特别累，想请几天假在家躺着，你说就该给自己放个假，聊到休假，这时就会用到 time off。
time off.translation: 朋友：我这周太累了 你：请几天 time off 在家躺 朋友：那工作怎么办 你：同事会帮你盯一下
time off.example: Friend: I am so tired this week. You: Take some time off and lie at home. Friend: What about work? You: Coworkers will cover it.

time period.context: 你朋友问你学英语多久了，你说好几年了，朋友问这一段学习期间有没有进步，聊到这段时间，这时就会用到 time period。
time period.translation: 朋友：你学英语多久了 你：这么长 time period 有三年了 朋友：那现在能跟老外聊吗 你：基本对话没问题
time period.example: Friend: How long have you studied English? You: For this time period, three years. Friend: Can you chat with foreigners now? You: Basic conversations are fine.

time slot.context: 你约朋友打球，朋友问几点来，你说就约晚上八点到九点那个时间段，聊到时间段，这时就会用到 time slot。
time slot.translation: 朋友：今晚打球几点 你：定晚上八点那个 time slot 朋友：那场地订好了吗 你：订好了 八点到九点
time slot.example: Friend: What time for ball tonight? You: Booked the eight pm time slot. Friend: Is the court reserved? You: Yes, eight to nine.

time to spare.context: 你朋友问你来得及吗，你说早到了半小时，还有富余时间，聊到多余的时间，这时就会用到 time to spare。
time to spare.translation: 朋友：赶得上火车吗 你：来得及 还有 time to spare 半小时 朋友：那还能买个早餐 你：行 走 顺路
time to spare.example: Friend: Will we make the train? You: We have time to spare, half an hour. Friend: Then we can grab breakfast. You: Okay, let us go, on the way.

time travel.context: 你朋友是科幻迷，说要是真能穿越时空就好了，朋友问你最想去哪个年代，这时就会用到 time travel。
time travel.translation: 朋友：科幻片里你最想要哪种超能力 你：time travel 穿越时空 朋友：那你想回到哪年 你：大学时候
time travel.example: Friend: Which superpower do you want most in sci-fi? You: Time travel. Friend: Which year would you go back to? You: My college days.

time usage.context: 你做时间记录，看自己一天都把时间花在哪了，朋友问你在干嘛，你说在分析时间使用情况，这时就会用到 time usage。
time usage.translation: 朋友：你手机里那个App记啥 你：看我每天 time usage 都花在哪 朋友：那你刷手机占多久 你：三小时 太多了
time usage.example: Friend: What does that app on your phone track? You: It tracks my daily time usage, where the hours go. Friend: How long do you spend on the phone? You: Three hours, way too much.

time waits for no man.context: 你爷爷老说时间不等人，该努力就赶紧努力，聊到岁月不等人，这时就会用到 time waits for no man。
time waits for no man.translation: 朋友：我天天拖延 怎么办 你：time waits for no man 别等了 赶紧做 朋友：那我今天就开始 你：对 别拖
time waits for no man.example: Friend: I keep procrastinating, what to do? You: Time waits for no man, stop waiting and start. Friend: Then I start today. You: Right, do not delay.

timekeeping device.context: 你朋友问古人没有钟表怎么知道时间，你说靠日晷和沙漏这些计时仪器，聊到计时工具，这时就会用到 timekeeping device。
timekeeping device.translation: 朋友：古人没钟表 怎么知道几点 你：靠日晷这种 timekeeping device 朋友：那阴天怎么办 你：用沙漏
timekeeping device.example: Friend: Without clocks, how did ancients tell time? You: By sundials, that kind of timekeeping device. Friend: What about cloudy days? You: An hourglass.

timeless classic.context: 你朋友问你这首歌听了十年还喜欢吗，你说当然，好音乐是经典不会过时，聊到永恒经典，这时就会用到 timeless classic。
timeless classic.translation: 朋友：这歌你听了多少年了 你：十年了 还是喜欢 是 timeless classic 朋友：那新歌唱两年就忘 你：对 经典不过时
timeless classic.example: Friend: How long have you been listening to this song? You: Ten years, still love it, a timeless classic. Friend: New songs are forgotten in two years. You: Right, classics do not age.

timeless design.context: 你朋友说装修时选白墙木桌永远不会过时，你说对，这种经典设计十年后看也不土，聊到永不过时的设计，这时就会用到 timeless design。
timeless design.translation: 朋友：装修选什么风格不会过时 你：白墙木桌 timeless design 十年也不土 朋友：那别搞网红风 你：对 今年流行明年就过时
timeless design.example: Friend: What decor style will not go out of style? You: White walls and wood tables, a timeless design, fine in ten years. Friend: Then skip the viral style. You: Right, trendy this year, dated next.

tinned goods.context: 你朋友问超市里哪种东西最经放不坏，你说罐头食品能存好几年，聊到罐头食品，这时就会用到 tinned goods。
tinned goods.translation: 朋友：家里囤点什么应急 你：囤 tinned goods 罐头 放几年都不坏 朋友：那再囤点水 你：对 米面油也备点
tinned goods.example: Friend: What should we stock at home for emergencies? You: Tinned goods, they last for years. Friend: Then stock up on water too. You: Right, plus rice flour and oil.

tiny detail.context: 你朋友看你做报告连一个数据都没出错，你说做表格就得抠这种小细节，聊到细微之处，这时就会用到 tiny detail。
tiny detail.translation: 朋友：你这报告怎么检查的 一个错都没有 你：每个 tiny detail 都核对了 朋友：那花多长时间 你：一晚上
tiny detail.example: Friend: How did you check this report, not a single error? You: I checked every tiny detail. Friend: How long did that take? You: A whole night.

tip and trick.context: 你朋友问做这个菜有什么诀窍，你说就是几个小技巧，多做就会了，聊到小窍门，这时就会用到 tip and trick。
tip and trick.translation: 朋友：这菜怎么做才嫩 你：几个 tip and trick 先腌十分钟 朋友：还有吗 你：大火快炒 别炒太久
tip and trick.example: Friend: How do you cook this dish tender? You: A few tips and tricks, marinate ten minutes first. Friend: Anything else? You: High heat quick stir, do not overcook.

tip off.context: 你朋友考试前突然被人告密说他作弊，朋友说这消息是哪儿来的，聊到告密，这时就会用到 tip off。
tip off.translation: 朋友：老师怎么知道我带小抄 你：有人 tip off 了老师 朋友：谁这么缺德 你：不知道 反正是被告密了
tip off.example: Friend: How did the teacher know I had cheat notes? You: Someone tipped off the teacher. Friend: Who is that mean? You: I do not know, but someone snitched.

tip over the edge.context: 你朋友连续加班三个月终于垮了，在办公室大哭，你说长期累到一定程度情绪就会失控，聊到情绪崩溃，这时就会用到 tip over the edge。
tip over the edge.translation: 朋友：他今天怎么在办公室哭了 你：连续加班三个月 一下 tipped over the edge 朋友：那该让他休几天 你：对 不然身体要垮
tip over the edge.example: Friend: Why is he crying in the office today? You: Three months of overtime, he finally tipped over the edge. Friend: Then he should take days off. You: Right, or his health will go.

tip sb over the edge.context: 你朋友最近压力太大，一点小事就暴怒，你说再这样下去他就要失控了，聊到让人崩溃，这时就会用到 tip sb over the edge。
tip sb over the edge.translation: 朋友：他今天怎么为一句话就发火 你：压力太大 这事 tipped him over the edge 朋友：让他歇几天 你：对 不然要出事
tip sb over the edge.example: Friend: Why did he blow up over one sentence today? You: The pressure is too much, that thing tipped him over the edge. Friend: Let him rest a few days. You: Right, or something will snap.

tip-top condition.context: 你朋友问你最近状态怎么这么好，运动恢复得特别快，你说我现在身体状态绝佳，聊到完美状态，这时就会用到 tip-top condition。
tip-top condition.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么打球又猛了 你：现在身体 tip-top condition 练了俩月 朋友：那我也得练练 你：对 一起
tip-top condition.example: Friend: Why are you so strong playing ball lately? You: I am in tip-top condition, trained two months. Friend: Then I should train too. You: Right, together.

tipping culture.context: 你朋友去美国旅游吃完饭被服务员盯着要小费，回来跟你吐槽那边什么都要给小费，聊到小费文化，这时就会用到 tipping culture。
tipping culture.translation: 朋友：去美国吃饭什么感受 你：那边 tipping culture 重 不给小费服务员盯着你 朋友：那一顿饭多花不少 你：对 百分之十五
tipping culture.example: Friend: How was eating out in the US? You: The tipping culture is heavy there, waiters stare if you do not tip. Friend: Then a meal costs more. You: Right, fifteen percent.

tips and tricks.context: 你朋友问做这道菜有什么独家秘方，你说都是师傅教的几个窍门，多练就行，聊到技巧，这时就会用到 tips and tricks。
tips and tricks.translation: 朋友：你这菜做的这么好吃 有啥秘诀 你：就是几个 tips and tricks 多练 朋友：那我也学 你：行 周末教你
tips and tricks.example: Friend: Your dish is so tasty, any secret? You: Just a few tips and tricks, practise more. Friend: Then I will learn too. You: Okay, I will teach you this weekend.

tir of.context: 你朋友说他最近对咖啡喝腻了，每天一杯也不想喝了，聊到厌倦，这时就会用到 tir of。
tir of.translation: 朋友：你怎么不天天喝咖啡了 你：我 tir of 了 喝腻了 朋友：那换喝茶 你：对 最近改喝茶
tir of.example: Friend: Why do you not drink coffee every day anymore? You: I am tired of it, I have had enough. Friend: Then switch to tea. You: Right, I drink tea lately.

tit for tat.context: 你朋友抢你东西，你抢回来，他说以牙还牙，谁也不欠谁，聊到针锋相对，这时就会用到 tit for tat。
tit for tat.translation: 朋友：你刚才怎么抢我零食 你：tit for tat 你上次抢我的 朋友：那咱俩扯平 你：对 谁也不欠
tit for tat.example: Friend: Why did you just grab my snack? You: Tit for tat, you took mine last time. Friend: Then we are even. You: Right, nobody owes anyone.

to.context: 你朋友问你怎么走，你说往前走，到路口左转，聊到方向，这时就会用到 to。
to.translation: 朋友：地铁站怎么走 你：一直往前 to 路口左转 朋友：多远 你：五分钟
to.example: Friend: How do I get to the metro? You: Go straight to the crossing then turn left. Friend: How far? You: Five minutes.

to a lesser extent.context: 你朋友问这个问题有多严重，你说严重程度比你想的小一些，聊到较小程度，这时就会用到 to a lesser extent。
to a lesser extent.translation: 朋友：这事影响多大 你：to a lesser extent 比想的小 朋友：那不用太担心 你：对 一点点而已
to a lesser extent.example: Friend: How big is the impact? You: To a lesser extent, smaller than you think. Friend: Then no need to worry too much. You: Right, just a bit.

to account for.context: 你朋友问销售数字里哪个产品占大头，你说三款产品加起来占八成，聊到占比例，这时就会用到 to account for。
to account for.translation: 朋友：这三款产品卖得怎样 你：它们 to account for 总销售的八成 朋友：那其他产品呢 你：就凑个热闹
to account for.example: Friend: How are these three products selling? You: They account for eighty percent of total sales. Friend: What about the others? You: Just make up the numbers.

to an extent.context: 你朋友问这效果到底有多明显，你说有一点，但不是全部，聊到某种程度，这时就会用到 to an extent。
to an extent.translation: 朋友：这药吃了有用吗 你：to an extent 有点用 但不能全靠它 朋友：那还得配合运动 你：对 双管齐下
to an extent.example: Friend: Does this medicine work? You: To an extent, a bit, but you cannot rely on it alone. Friend: Then exercise too. You: Right, both together.

to be.context: 朋友问你明天打算干嘛，你说就是在家待着，聊天聊到要做什么，这时就会用到 to be。
to be.translation: 朋友：明天你想干嘛 你：to be honest 我就想在家躺一天 朋友：那别约了 你：对 周末就该休息
to be.example: Friend: What do you want tomorrow? You: To be honest, I just want to lie at home all day. Friend: Then no plans. You: Right, weekends are for rest.

to be honest.context: 朋友问你这主意真的靠谱吗，你说实话，我觉得有点冒险，聊到说实话，这时就会用到 to be honest。
to be honest.translation: 朋友：你觉得我这辞职计划怎么样 你：to be honest 有点冒险 你想清楚没 朋友：我想了半年了 你：那行
to be honest.example: Friend: What do you think of my quit plan? You: To be honest, it is a bit risky, have you thought it through? Friend: I have thought half a year. You: Then okay.

to carry out.context: 朋友让你去完成那个任务，你问到底要怎么执行，朋友说按计划做就行，聊到执行，这时就会用到 to carry out。
to carry out.translation: 朋友：那个任务你什么时候做 你：to carry out 得三天 朋友：那抓紧 周五要交 你：行 我明天开始
to carry out.example: Friend: When will you do that task? You: To carry it out takes three days. Friend: Then hurry, due Friday. You: Okay, I start tomorrow.

to compensate for.context: 朋友这月超支了，问你怎么补上缺口，你说只能省点花把损失补回来，聊到弥补，这时就会用到 to compensate for。
to compensate for.translation: 朋友：我这月花超了 你：只能省着点 to compensate for 这个缺口 朋友：那我下个月少点外卖 你：对 慢慢补回来
to compensate for.example: Friend: I overspent this month. You: Then spend carefully to compensate for the gap. Friend: Then less takeout next month. You: Right, make it back slowly.

to cope with.context: 朋友问这么多活怎么处理得完，你说一项一项来总能应付，聊到应对，这时就会用到 to cope with。
to cope with.translation: 朋友：这么多活我干不完 你：一项一项来 to cope with 总能做完 朋友：那我加班 你：对 今晚搞完
to cope with.example: Friend: I cannot finish all this work. You: One by one, to cope with it all eventually gets done. Friend: Then I will stay late. You: Right, finish tonight.

to deal with.context: 朋友问这堆乱事该怎么解决，你说一件一件处理，别着急，聊到处理，这时就会用到 to deal with。
to deal with.translation: 朋友：这堆乱事怎么弄 你：to deal with 得一件一件来 朋友：那先处理哪个 你：先处理最急的
to deal with.example: Friend: How do we sort out this mess? You: To deal with it, one thing at a time. Friend: Which first? You: The most urgent.

to do with.context: 朋友问他前任的事你怎么看，你说这跟你有什么关系，别老翻旧账，聊到跟……有关，这时就会用到 to do with。
to do with.translation: 朋友：我前任又找我了 你：这 to do with 我啥 你别跟我说 朋友：行 我自己处理 你：对
to do with.example: Friend: My ex reached out again. You: What has that to do with me, do not tell me. Friend: Okay, I will handle it myself. You: Right.

to make up for.context: 朋友这月花多了，你说下个月省点才能补上这个月的窟窿，聊到弥补，这时就会用到 to make up for。
to make up for.translation: 朋友：我这月花超了三千 你：下个月少买衣服 to make up for 朋友：那我忍两个月 你：对 攒回来
to make up for.example: Friend: I overspent three thousand this month. You: Then buy fewer clothes next month to make up for it. Friend: Then I will endure two months. You: Right, save it back.

to make use of.context: 朋友问这时间怎么用好，你说可以利用这段时间读本书，聊到利用，这时就会用到 to make use of。
to make use of.translation: 朋友：等车这半小时干嘛 你：to make use of 读两页书 朋友：那我也拿手机看看文章 你：对 别浪费时间
to make use of.example: Friend: What do we do in the half hour waiting for the bus? You: Make use of it by reading a few pages. Friend: Then I will read an article on my phone. You: Right, do not waste the time.

to name just a few.context: 朋友问你周末都去哪儿玩，你说爬山、露营、骑车，就举几个例子，还有好多，聊到举例，这时就会用到 to name just a few。
to name just a few.translation: 朋友：周末你都玩什么 你：爬山 露营 骑车 to name just a few 朋友：你活动真多 你：对 闲不住
to name just a few.example: Friend: What do you do on weekends? You: Hiking, camping, cycling, to name just a few. Friend: You have so many activities. You: Right, I cannot sit still.

to some degree.context: 朋友问这汤好不好喝，你说还行吧，有点咸，但凑合能喝，聊到某种程度，这时就会用到 to some degree。
to some degree.translation: 朋友：这汤味道怎么样 你：to some degree 还行 就是有点咸 朋友：那加点水 你：对
to some degree.example: Friend: How does this soup taste? You: To some degree, okay, just a bit salty. Friend: Then add some water. You: Right.

to speak of.context: 朋友问你有啥值得一提的新发现没，你说没什么特别的，聊到值得一提，这时就会用到 to speak of。
to speak of.translation: 朋友：你这周末有啥新鲜事 你：没什么 to speak of 平平淡淡 朋友：那挺好 休息嘛 你：对
to speak of.example: Friend: Anything new this weekend? You: Nothing to speak of, just quiet. Friend: That is good, it is for resting. You: Right.

to that end.context: 朋友想把项目做成，你说为了那个目标，咱们就得周末加班赶出来，聊到为了那个目的，这时就会用到 to that end。
to that end.translation: 朋友：项目要提前交 怎么办 你：to that end 咱们周末加班赶出来 朋友：那我过来 你：行
to that end.example: Friend: The project is due early, what to do? You: To that end, we will work weekends to finish. Friend: Then I will come in. You: Okay.

to the benefit of.context: 你做这个项目，朋友说这对客户有好处，你说对，就是为了让用户受益，聊到对……有好处，这时就会用到 to the benefit of。
to the benefit of.translation: 朋友：你做这软件图啥 你：to the benefit of 用户 让他们方便 朋友：那真有人用吗 你：上线就知道
to the benefit of.example: Friend: What do you get out of making this app? You: To the benefit of users, making things convenient for them. Friend: Will people actually use it? You: We will see when it launches.

to the detriment of.context: 你朋友天天加班不休息，你说再这样下去身体要垮，对健康有害，聊到有害，这时就会用到 to the detriment of。
to the detriment of.translation: 朋友：他天天加班 身体受得了吗 你：to the detriment of 健康 迟早出问题 朋友：那劝劝他 你：对 别拼了命
to the detriment of.example: Friend: He works overtime every day, can his body take it? You: To the detriment of his health, something will break soon. Friend: Then talk some sense. You: Right, do not burn life for work.

to the exclusion of.context: 你做问卷时只挑年轻人问，不问其他年龄的人，朋友说你这是把其他年龄段排除在外了，聊到排除，这时就会用到 to the exclusion of。
to the exclusion of.translation: 朋友：你这调查只问年轻人 你：to the exclusion of 其他年龄 朋友：那结果不准 你：对 样本太单一
to the exclusion of.example: Friend: Your survey only asks young people. You: To the exclusion of other ages. Friend: Then the result is not accurate. You: Right, the sample is too narrow.

to the hilt.context: 朋友玩游戏全力以赴，把所有技巧都用上了，你说他这真是玩到家了，聊到充分，这时就会用到 to the hilt。
to the hilt.translation: 朋友：他打游戏怎么这么拼 你：to the hilt 所有技巧全用上 朋友：那他赢了吗 你：对 拿了第一
to the hilt.example: Friend: Why does he play so hard? You: To the hilt, every trick he knows. Friend: Did he win? You: Right, first place.

to the point that.context: 朋友加班加得累到极点，连饭都不想吃，你说他已经累到那种程度了，得赶紧休息，聊到达到……程度，这时就会用到 to the point that。
to the point that.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么瘦了这么多 你：累 to the point that 饭都吃不下 朋友：那赶紧让他休息 你：对 再拖要住院
to the point that.example: Friend: Why has he lost so much weight lately? You: Tired to the point that he cannot even eat. Friend: Then make him rest fast. You: Right, otherwise he ends up in hospital.

to this day.context: 朋友说他爷爷教的那道菜，到今天他还在做，你说这道菜传到现在都多少年了，聊到直到今天，这时就会用到 to this day。
to this day.translation: 朋友：这道菜谁教你的 你：我爷爷教的 to this day 我还在做 朋友：那真有年头了 你：对 三十年了
to this day.example: Friend: Who taught you this dish? You: My grandfather, and to this day I still cook it. Friend: That is years and years. You: Right, thirty years.

to top it off.context: 朋友今天早上错过班车，上班迟到，中午还被领导骂，下午又把咖啡洒在电脑上，你说最后这一件事最倒霉，聊到更糟的是，这时就会用到 to top it off。
to top it off.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么倒霉 你：错过班车 被领导骂 to top it off 还把咖啡洒电脑上 朋友：那电脑坏了吗 你：对 开不了机
to top it off.example: Friend: Why are you having such bad luck today? You: Missed the bus, got scolded, and to top it off I spilled coffee on the laptop. Friend: Is it broken? You: Right, will not turn on.

to-do list.context: 你朋友每天早上列要做的事，做完一件划一件，聊到那张待办清单，这时就会用到 to-do list。
to-do list.translation: 朋友：你每天怎么记得住那么多事 你：我列个 to-do list 做完一件划一件 朋友：那真管用 你：对 不漏事
to-do list.example: Friend: How do you remember so many things every day? You: I keep a to-do list, tick off each done. Friend: Does it really work? You: Right, nothing slips.

tobacco tax.context: 新闻说政府要加税在香烟上，这样抽烟的人会少，朋友说这税真高，聊到烟草税，这时就会用到 tobacco tax。
tobacco tax.translation: 朋友：新闻说烟要涨价了 你：政府加 tobacco tax 让抽烟的人少点 朋友：那确实能控烟 你：对 越高越少人抽
tobacco tax.example: Friend: The news says cigarettes will go up. You: The government raised tobacco tax to cut smokers. Friend: That really controls smoking. You: Right, pricier means fewer smokers.

toggle between.context: 你看书时一会儿翻实体书一会儿看电子书，朋友说你来回切换真忙，聊到在两种方式间切换，这时就会用到 toggle between。
toggle between.translation: 朋友：你怎么一会儿翻书一会儿看手机 你：toggle between 纸书和电子书 朋友：不累吗 你：还行 躺着看手机 坐桌子看纸书
toggle between.example: Friend: Why do you flip between the book and your phone? You: I toggle between print and e-book. Friend: Is that not tiring? You: It is fine, phone lying down, print at the desk.

tonal language.context: 学中文的时候朋友说中文声调特别难，四声不对意思就变了，聊到这种声调语言，这时就会用到 tonal language。
tonal language.translation: 朋友：中文难在哪儿 你：它是 tonal language 四声不对意思就变 朋友：那老外学得挺难 你：对 声调是最大关
tonal language.example: Friend: What makes Chinese hard? You: It is a tonal language, wrong tone means wrong meaning. Friend: Then foreigners find it tough. You: Right, tones are the biggest hurdle.

tonsil tennis.context: 朋友看偶像剧里男女主角亲嘴，笑着说这就是那种亲密接吻，你说别在这上头纠结，聊到舌吻，这时就会用到 tonsil tennis。
tonsil tennis.translation: 朋友：这剧里亲嘴镜头好久 你：在打 tonsil tennis 呢 朋友：哎呀 少儿不宜 你：对 快进过去
tonsil tennis.example: Friend: That kissing scene in the show is so long. You: They are playing tonsil tennis. Friend: Oh, not for kids. You: Right, fast forward.

too often.context: 你朋友一天刷八次短视频，你说他刷得太频繁了，再这样眼睛要坏，聊到太频繁，这时就会用到 too often。
too often.translation: 朋友：我一天刷八次短视频 你：too often 眼睛要坏了 朋友：那怎么办 你：设个屏幕时间
too often.example: Friend: I check short videos eight times a day. You: Too often, your eyes will break. Friend: Then what? You: Set a screen time limit.

tooth decay.context: 你朋友特别爱吃糖，牙医说这样下去容易长蛀牙，让他少吃甜，聊到蛀牙，这时就会用到 tooth decay。
tooth decay.translation: 朋友：我最近牙疼 你：你糖吃太多 容易 tooth decay 朋友：那怎么办 你：少吃甜 天天刷牙
tooth decay.example: Friend: My tooth has been aching lately. You: You eat too much sugar, easy tooth decay. Friend: Then what? You: Cut the sweets, brush every day.

top dog.context: 公司里最能扛业绩的那个人升了总监，大家说他就是最厉害的那个，聊到掌权者，这时就会用到 top dog。
top dog.translation: 朋友：你们部门谁最厉害 你：那老王 他是 top dog 业绩第一 朋友：那他说了算 你：对 主任都听他的
top dog.example: Friend: Who is the top person in your department? You: Old Wang, he is the top dog, best sales. Friend: Then he calls the shots. You: Right, even the director listens to him.

top of the class.context: 你朋友的孩子每次考试都是年级第一，老师说他就是班里的尖子生，聊到班级第一，这时就会用到 top of the class。
top of the class.translation: 朋友：你儿子成绩怎么样 你：top of the class 年级第一 朋友：那真给你争气 你：对 他自己也努力
top of the class.example: Friend: How is your son doing at school? You: Top of the class, first in the grade. Friend: He really makes you proud. You: Right, he works hard himself.

top of the list.context: 朋友问你最想去的餐厅是哪家，你说那家火锅排第一，朋友说那我们周末去，聊到名单首位，这时就会用到 top of the list。
top of the list.translation: 朋友：你最想吃哪家火锅 你：那家店 top of the list 排队两小时也值 朋友：那周末早点去 你：对 五点就去排
top of the list.example: Friend: Which hot pot do you want most? You: That place is top of the list, worth a two-hour queue. Friend: Then go early this weekend. You: Right, queue at five.

top predator.context: 你看动物世界里狮子站在食物链最顶端，别的动物都怕它，聊到顶级掠食者，这时就会用到 top predator。
top predator.translation: 朋友：草原上狮子怕什么 你：它是 top predator 没天敌 朋友：那它就是老大 你：对 别的都躲着它
top predator.example: Friend: What are lions afraid of on the savanna? You: They are the top predator, no natural enemies. Friend: Then they are the boss. You: Right, everything else hides.

top priority.context: 朋友问你现在最重要的事是什么，你说找工作，别的都往后排，聊到头等大事，这时就会用到 top priority。
top priority.translation: 朋友：你现在最想干嘛 你：找工作是 top priority 别的都先放放 朋友：那投简历了吗 你：天天投
top priority.example: Friend: What do you want most now? You: Finding a job is the top priority, everything else waits. Friend: Have you sent CVs? You: Every day.

top the rankings.context: 新出的手机销量第一，超过所有对手，朋友问排第几，你说它霸榜了，聊到排名第一，这时就会用到 top the rankings。
top the rankings.translation: 朋友：这新手机卖得怎样 你：top the rankings 销量第一 朋友：那真厉害 你：对 性价比高
top the rankings.example: Friend: How is the new phone selling? You: It tops the rankings, number one in sales. Friend: That is impressive. You: Right, great value.

top up.context: 你手机话费快没了，朋友提醒你去充值，把余额补上，聊到充值，这时就会用到 top up。
top up.translation: 朋友：你手机怎么打不出去 你：话费快没了 得 top up 一下 朋友：那去楼下便利店充 你：行 我现在就去
top up.example: Friend: Why can you not make calls? You: The balance is low, I need to top up. Friend: Then top up at the corner store. You: Okay, going now.

topple over.context: 你书架顶上那摞书没放稳，朋友提醒你小心，结果它一下倒下来摔地上，聊到翻倒，这时就会用到 topple over。
topple over.translation: 朋友：你书架那摞书放稳没 你：没太在意 朋友：小心 topple over 倒了 你：哎呀 真倒了 一地书
topple over.example: Friend: Is that stack on top of your shelf stable? You: Not really. Friend: Careful it does not topple over. You: Oh, it did, books everywhere.

tops the rankings.context: 新出的手机销量超过所有对手，朋友问哪款卖得最好，你说那款顶配版霸榜，聊到排名第一，这时就会用到 tops the rankings。
tops the rankings.translation: 朋友：这季哪款手机卖最好 你：那款顶配 tops the rankings 朋友：贵吗 你：贵 但卖得最好
tops the rankings.example: Friend: Which phone sells best this season? You: That top model tops the rankings. Friend: Is it pricey? You: Yes, but it sells best.

tortilla chip.context: 你看球赛中场休息，朋友拿了一袋玉米片出来蘸酱吃，聊到薯片，这时就会用到 tortilla chip。
tortilla chip.translation: 朋友：你看球吃啥呢 你：tortilla chip 蘸莎莎酱 朋友：那挺下酒 你：对 配啤酒正好
tortilla chip.example: Friend: What are you eating during the match? You: Tortilla chips with salsa. Friend: That pairs well with beer. You: Right, perfect.
