toss and turn.context: 你朋友明天考试，紧张得晚上翻来覆去睡不着，朋友说你这是辗转反侧，聊到睡不着，这时就会用到 toss and turn。
toss and turn.translation: 朋友：你昨晚睡好没 你：明天考试 紧张得 toss and turn 一晚上 朋友：那今天更累了 你：对 困得不行
toss and turn.example: Friend: Did you sleep well last night? You: Exam tomorrow, I tossed and turned all night. Friend: Then you are more tired today. You: Right, dead tired.

touch grass.context: 你朋友天天宅家不出门，对着电脑，你说该出去走走，晒晒太阳呼吸下新鲜空气，别老待在室内，聊到出门透气，这时就会用到 touch grass。
touch grass.translation: 朋友：你这三天都没出门 你：在家打游戏 朋友：该 touch grass 出去走 别老对着屏幕 你：行 我下午下楼
touch grass.example: Friend: You have not left home in three days. You: Playing games at home. Friend: Go touch grass, step outside, stop staring at the screen. You: Okay, I will go downstairs this afternoon.

touch on.context: 开会时领导提到了一下你的方案但没细讲，朋友问领导怎么说，你说他就提了一下没展开，聊到提及，这时就会用到 touch on。
touch on.translation: 朋友：领导今天怎么说我的方案 你：他就 touch on 一下 没细讲 朋友：那是没仔细看 你：对 过两天再说
touch on.example: Friend: What did the boss say about my proposal today? You: He just touched on it, did not go deep. Friend: Then he did not read it carefully. You: Right, we talk in a couple of days.

touch screen.context: 你买新手机时店员让你在屏幕上点一下试试手感，说这是触屏，聊到触摸屏，这时就会用到 touch screen。
touch screen.translation: 朋友：你这手机怎么操作 你：touch screen 点一下就行 朋友：那比按键方便 你：对 打字都滑着来
touch screen.example: Friend: How do you operate this phone? You: A touch screen, just tap. Friend: Easier than buttons. You: Right, even typing is swiping.

touchy subject.context: 朋友问你月薪多少，你说这个别问了，工资是敏感话题，聊到敏感话题，这时就会用到 touchy subject。
touchy subject.translation: 朋友：你一个月挣多少 你：这是 touchy subject 别问了 朋友：行 那聊别的 你：对
touchy subject.example: Friend: How much do you make a month? You: That is a touchy subject, do not ask. Friend: Okay, let us talk about something else. You: Right.

tough situation.context: 你朋友刚失业又跟对象分了，你说他现在真是难上加难，聊到艰难处境，这时就会用到 tough situation。
tough situation.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么天天喝酒 你：失业又分手 这种 tough situation 朋友：那他得缓一阵子 你：对 我们多陪陪他
tough situation.example: Friend: Why is he drinking every day lately? You: Lost his job and broke up, such a tough situation. Friend: Then he needs time to recover. You: Right, we will keep him company.

tough time.context: 你朋友刚创业头半年特别难，订单少还赔钱，朋友说他熬过这段苦日子就好了，聊到艰难时期，这时就会用到 tough time。
tough time.translation: 朋友：他创业这半年怎么样 你：tough time 订单少还赔钱 朋友：那坚持下去就好 你：对 过了这阵就顺
tough time.example: Friend: How has his first half year of business been? You: A tough time, few orders and losing money. Friend: Then it gets better after this. You: Right, past this stretch it smooths out.

tour operator.context: 你朋友要去国外玩，问你怎么安排行程，你说可以找旅行社代办，聊到旅行社，这时就会用到 tour operator。
tour operator.translation: 朋友：去国外玩怎么安排 你：找个 tour operator 旅行社全包 朋友：那比自己订票省心 你：对 就是贵点
tour operator.example: Friend: How do we plan a trip abroad? You: Find a tour operator to handle everything. Friend: Easier than booking alone. You: Right, just pricier.

tourette's syndrome.context: 你朋友上课不停抽动眨眼，医生说这是一种抽动的症状，聊到这种病，这时就会用到 tourette's syndrome。
tourette's syndrome.translation: 朋友：他怎么上课不停眨眼 你：医生说这是 tourette's syndrome 一种抽动症状 朋友：那能治吗 你：对 服药控制
tourette's syndrome.example: Friend: Why does he keep blinking in class? You: The doctor says it is Tourette's syndrome, a tic condition. Friend: Can it be treated? You: Right, meds keep it in check.

tourist attraction.context: 你朋友去外地旅游，问你那个城市有什么必去的景点，你说那个湖就是最有名的，聊到旅游景点，这时就会用到 tourist attraction。
tourist attraction.translation: 朋友：去那个城市必去哪 你：那个湖是最大的 tourist attraction 朋友：那门票贵吗 你：不贵 免费
tourist attraction.example: Friend: What must we visit in that city? You: The lake is the biggest tourist attraction. Friend: Is the ticket pricey? You: No, it is free.

tourist congestion.context: 黄金周景点人挤人，朋友说到处都是游客路都走不动，聊到游客太多，这时就会用到 tourist congestion。
tourist congestion.translation: 朋友：国庆景点怎么这么多人 你：tourist congestion 人挤人走不动 朋友：那别去热门景点了 你：对 找冷门地方
tourist congestion.example: Friend: Why is the spot so crowded on National Day? You: Tourist congestion, packed so tight you cannot move. Friend: Then skip the hot spots. You: Right, find a quiet place.

tourist levy.context: 你朋友说他那个城市开始收旅游税了，住酒店都多交钱，聊到这个税，这时就会用到 tourist levy。
tourist levy.translation: 朋友：你那城市酒店怎么贵了 你：开始收 tourist levy 旅游税 朋友：那游客得多花钱 你：对 一晚多收二十
tourist levy.example: Friend: Why are hotels pricier in your city? You: They started a tourist levy. Friend: Then tourists pay more. You: Right, twenty extra a night.

tourist trap.context: 你朋友在景点买了个纪念品又贵又差，你说这就是被坑了，聊到这种专坑游客的地方，这时就会用到 tourist trap。
tourist trap.translation: 朋友：我买这个纪念品花了一百 你：你被 tourist trap 坑了 这破东西值十块 朋友：那以后不在景点买东西 你：对 又贵又差
tourist trap.example: Friend: I paid a hundred for this souvenir. You: You fell for a tourist trap, this junk is worth ten. Friend: Then never buy souvenirs at the spot. You: Right, pricey and bad.

town centre regeneration.context: 新闻说老城中心那片破楼要拆了建新商场和公园，朋友问这是要干嘛，聊到城市中心改造，这时就会用到 town centre regeneration。
town centre regeneration.translation: 朋友：老城那片破楼怎么开始拆了 你：要 town centre regeneration 建新商场和公园 朋友：那以后那儿就热闹了 你：对 老城区要翻身
town centre regeneration.example: Friend: Why are they demolishing the run-down blocks in the old town? You: For town centre regeneration, new malls and parks. Friend: Then the area will be lively. You: Right, the old town is getting a facelift.

toxic compound.context: 你买护肤品时特意看成分表，朋友说别买带有害化学物质的，聊到有害成分，这时就会用到 toxic compound。
toxic compound.translation: 朋友：你买护肤品怎么看那么仔细 你：怕里面有 toxic compound 伤皮肤 朋友：那你选成分简单的 你：对 越干净越好
toxic compound.example: Friend: Why do you read skincare labels so carefully? You: Afraid of toxic compounds that hurt the skin. Friend: Then pick simple ingredients. You: Right, the cleaner the better.

toxic dye.context: 新闻说有些布料用的染料有毒，污染河流，朋友说以后买衣服也得看环保，聊到有毒染料，这时就会用到 toxic dye。
toxic dye.translation: 朋友：河里水怎么变颜色了 你：那工厂用 toxic dye 排废水 朋友：那鱼都活不了 你：对 得管管
toxic dye.example: Friend: Why did the river water change colour? You: That factory used toxic dye in the waste water. Friend: Then the fish cannot survive. You: Right, someone has to regulate.

toxic emotion.context: 你朋友总和人抱怨、记仇，自己也不开心，你说这种负面情绪最伤人，聊到有毒情绪，这时就会用到 toxic emotion。
toxic emotion.translation: 朋友：他怎么天天不开心 你：满脑子 toxic emotion 老记仇 朋友：那他得调整心态 你：对 不然伤自己
toxic emotion.example: Friend: Why is he unhappy every day? You: Full of toxic emotions, always holding grudges. Friend: Then he needs to fix his mindset. You: Right, or it hurts himself.

toy dolls.context: 你妹妹小时候最爱玩那种娃娃，给它做衣服梳头发，朋友问她小时候玩什么，聊到玩具娃娃，这时就会用到 toy dolls。
toy dolls.translation: 朋友：你妹妹小时候玩什么 你：就抱着 toy dolls 给它做衣服 朋友：那是女孩最爱 你：对 一玩一下午
toy dolls.example: Friend: What did your sister play with as a kid? You: Just hugging toy dolls, making clothes for them. Friend: That is every girl's favourite. You: Right, she played all afternoon.

trace their heritage.context: 你做家谱时翻爷爷奶奶的老照片，想知道自己祖上是从哪儿迁来的，朋友问你在研究什么，聊到追溯家族来源，这时就会用到 trace their heritage。
trace their heritage.translation: 朋友：你翻那些老照片干嘛 你：想 trace their heritage 看看祖上从哪迁来 朋友：那翻到什么没 你：祖籍是山东
trace their heritage.example: Friend: Why are you flipping through old photos? You: Tracing my heritage to see where my ancestors moved from. Friend: Did you find anything? You: The ancestral home is Shandong.

tracheal system.context: 你看自然课讲昆虫靠气管呼吸，朋友问虫子没有肺怎么喘气，聊到昆虫的呼吸系统，这时就会用到 tracheal system。
tracheal system.translation: 朋友：虫子没有肺怎么呼吸 你：靠 tracheal system 气管系统 朋友：跟人完全不一样 你：对 自然真神奇
tracheal system.example: Friend: How do insects breathe without lungs? You: Through their tracheal system. Friend: Totally different from humans. You: Right, nature is amazing.

track spending.context: 你朋友记账把每笔开销都记下来，月底一看吓一跳，聊到追踪花钱，这时就会用到 track spending。
track spending.translation: 朋友：你怎么每天都记账 你：track spending 看钱都花哪了 朋友：月底一看吓一跳 你：对 不知不觉花太多
track spending.example: Friend: Why do you keep a ledger every day? You: To track spending and see where the money goes. Friend: Then you get a shock at month end. You: Right, you spend way more than you think.

tracking device.context: 你朋友给老人戴了个小牌子，万一老人走丢了别人能定位，朋友问那是什么，聊到追踪设备，这时就会用到 tracking device。
tracking device.translation: 朋友：你奶奶身上戴的小牌子干嘛 你：是 tracking device 万一走丢能定位 朋友：那挺安全 你：对 老人记性不好
tracking device.example: Friend: What is that little tag on your grandmother? You: It is a tracking device, so if she gets lost we can locate her. Friend: That is really safe. You: Right, her memory is poor.

tracking system.context: 你公司物流车上装了个东西，能看到货走到哪儿了，朋友说这就是追踪系统，聊到追踪系统，这时就会用到 tracking system。
tracking system.translation: 朋友：你怎么知道货到哪儿了 你：车上装了 tracking system 手机上能看 朋友：那真方便 你：对 不用打电话问司机
tracking system.example: Friend: How do you know where the shipment is? You: The truck has a tracking system, I see it on my phone. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right, no need to call the driver.

trade for.context: 你朋友拿他旧手机跟你换耳机，问你换不换，聊到交换，这时就会用到 trade for。
trade for.translation: 朋友：我这旧手机跟你换耳机 你：trade for 你愿意吗 朋友：行啊 我耳机也旧了 你：那成交
trade for.example: Friend: Want to swap my old phone for your headset? You: You want to trade it for the headset? Friend: Sure, my headset is old too. You: Deal.

trade in.context: 你买新车时把旧车卖给经销商抵了一部分钱，朋友问你旧车怎么处理了，聊到折价换购，这时就会用到 trade in。
trade in.translation: 朋友：你旧车怎么处理了 你：trade in 给经销商 抵了新车一部分钱 朋友：那挺划算 你：对 省了几千
trade in.example: Friend: What did you do with your old car? You: Traded it in to the dealer, against the new one. Friend: That is a good deal. You: Right, saved a few thousand.

trade it for.context: 你朋友拿他的书跟你换碟片，问你换不换，聊到用……交换，这时就会用到 trade it for。
trade it for.translation: 朋友：我这碟片跟你那本书换 你：trade it for 你愿意吗 朋友：行 我也想看那本 你：那换吧
trade it for.example: Friend: Swap my disc for your book? You: You want to trade it for the book? Friend: Sure, I want to read that one too. You: Then swap.

trade nexus.context: 新闻说这个城市是几国做生意的中心，货物从这里发往全世界，聊到商贸中心，这时就会用到 trade nexus。
trade nexus.translation: 朋友：这港口城市怎么这么忙 你：它是个 trade nexus 货物集散中心 朋友：那经济肯定好 你：对 生意全在这儿
trade nexus.example: Friend: Why is this port city so busy? You: It is a trade nexus, a hub for goods. Friend: Then the economy must be good. You: Right, all the business is here.

trade off.context: 你朋友纠结买大户型还是近地铁，你说这俩得权衡，大户型但远，近地铁但小，聊到取舍，这时就会用到 trade off。
trade off.translation: 朋友：我选大户型还是近地铁 你：这是个 trade off 看你更看重啥 朋友：我想每天多睡半小时 你：那选近地铁
trade off.example: Friend: Do I pick a big flat or one near the metro? You: That is a trade-off, depends on what matters more. Friend: I want to sleep half an hour more daily. You: Then pick near the metro.

trade route.context: 历史课讲古代商人靠骆驼穿沙漠做生意，朋友说那条路就是丝绸之路，聊到贸易路线，这时就会用到 trade route。
trade route.translation: 朋友：古代商人怎么从中国到欧洲 你：走丝绸之路那条 trade route 穿沙漠 朋友：那路上得走几年 你：对 骆驼队慢慢走
trade route.example: Friend: How did ancient traders get from China to Europe? You: They took the Silk Road, a trade route across the desert. Friend: Did that take years? You: Right, camel trains moved slowly.

trade show.context: 你朋友去参加行业展会，看到好多新公司摆展台，朋友问这是什么活动，聊到行业展览，这时就会用到 trade show。
trade show.translation: 朋友：你这周去哪儿出差 你：去一个 trade show 行业展会 朋友：那能看到好多新产品 你：对 我去看看新方向
trade show.example: Friend: Where are you on business this week? You: A trade show, an industry exhibition. Friend: Then you see lots of new products. You: Right, I am checking new trends.

traditional brewing.context: 你朋友泡茶时用小茶壶慢慢焖，不用茶包，朋友说这才是传统泡法，聊到传统泡茶，这时就会用到 traditional brewing。
traditional brewing.translation: 朋友：你泡茶怎么那么讲究 你：我喜欢 traditional brewing 用茶壶慢慢焖 朋友：比茶包好喝吗 你：对 香多了
traditional brewing.example: Friend: Why are you so particular brewing tea? You: I like traditional brewing, steeping slowly in a pot. Friend: Better than tea bags? You: Right, much more fragrant.

traditional practice.context: 你朋友老家过年要磕头拜年，外地的朋友看着奇怪，你说这就是他们那儿的老传统，聊到传统做法，这时就会用到 traditional practice。
traditional practice.translation: 朋友：你老家过年怎么还磕头拜年 你：这是我们那儿 traditional practice 老规矩 朋友：那挺有仪式感 你：对 一辈辈传下来
traditional practice.example: Friend: Why do you kowtow on New Year back home? You: It is a traditional practice there, an old rule. Friend: That is quite a ritual. You: Right, passed down generations.

traffic congestion.context: 周一早高峰高架上全是车，朋友说这也太堵了，聊到交通堵塞，这时就会用到 traffic congestion。
traffic congestion.translation: 朋友：周一早上怎么堵成这样 你：traffic congestion 全是上班的车 朋友：那坐地铁多好 你：对 周一别开车
traffic congestion.example: Friend: Why is it so jammed Monday morning? You: Traffic congestion, all the commuters. Friend: Then take the metro. You: Right, do not drive on Mondays.

traffic laws.context: 你朋友开车闯红灯被交警拦下，朋友说这是违法的，聊到交通法规，这时就会用到 traffic laws。
traffic laws.translation: 朋友：你怎么闯红灯了 你：没注意灯 朋友：traffic laws 红灯不能走 罚款扣分 你：对 我下次不敢了
traffic laws.example: Friend: Why did you run the red light? You: I did not notice. Friend: Traffic laws say you stop on red, fine and demerit points. You: Right, I will not do it again.

traffic noise.context: 你家住路边，晚上车一过嗡嗡响，睡不着，朋友说这种交通噪音真烦人，聊到交通噪音，这时就会用到 traffic noise。
traffic noise.translation: 朋友：你家晚上怎么睡不好 你：路边 traffic noise 车一过嗡嗡响 朋友：那装隔音窗 你：对 我打算换
traffic noise.example: Friend: Why can you not sleep at home? You: Roadside traffic noise, cars hum past. Friend: Then install soundproof windows. You: Right, I plan to.

traffic noises.context: 你家住高架边，白天晚上都是车过的嗡嗡声，朋友问你怎么能睡着，聊到交通噪音，这时就会用到 traffic noises。
traffic noises.translation: 朋友：你家住高架边怎么睡得着 你：traffic noises 听惯了 朋友：那客人来不觉得吵吗 你：对 我自己倒习惯了
traffic noises.example: Friend: How do you sleep by the elevated road? You: The traffic noises, I got used to them. Friend: Do guests not find it noisy? You: Right, I am used to it myself.

traffic psychology.context: 老师说开车的人路怒、抢道是有规律的，可以研究为什么人一握方向盘就暴躁，聊到交通心理，这时就会用到 traffic psychology。
traffic psychology.translation: 朋友：为什么人一开车就爱发火 你：这是 traffic psychology 研究的 方向盘让人暴躁 朋友：那真有道理 你：对 路上加塞的人都这样
traffic psychology.example: Friend: Why do people get angry behind the wheel? You: That is what traffic psychology studies, the wheel makes people aggressive. Friend: That makes sense. You: Right, the cutters on the road are all like that.

traffic signals.context: 你等红灯时抬头看路口的灯，朋友问怎么看灯过马路，聊到红绿灯，这时就会用到 traffic signals。
traffic signals.translation: 朋友：过马路看哪儿 你：看 traffic signals 绿灯走红灯停 朋友：那黄灯呢 你：别抢 等下一个
traffic signals.example: Friend: What do you look at to cross the road? You: The traffic signals, walk on green, stop on red. Friend: What about amber? You: Do not rush, wait for the next.

trail behind.context: 你朋友跑步总比别人慢半拍，朋友说他在队伍后面跟着，聊到落后，这时就会用到 trail behind。
trail behind.translation: 朋友：他怎么老跑最后 你：他 trail behind 体力跟不上 朋友：那多练练 你：对 他一直在跑
trail behind.example: Friend: Why does he always run last? You: He trails behind, his stamina is not enough. Friend: Then train more. You: Right, he keeps at it.

trample over.context: 你朋友在草坪上乱踩，把刚种的花踩坏了，你说别这样不把别人东西当回事，聊到践踏，这时就会用到 trample over。
trample over.translation: 朋友：你怎么从草坪上踩过去 你：近路嘛 朋友：别 trample over 那些花 刚种的 你：行 我绕路
trample over.example: Friend: Why did you cut across the lawn? You: It is a shortcut. Friend: Do not trample over those flowers, they are newly planted. You: Okay, I will walk around.

trampled over.context: 你朋友在刚铺的草地上踩过去，把草踩坏了，朋友说别这样乱踩，聊到踩坏，这时就会用到 trampled over。
trampled over.translation: 朋友：你怎么从新草坪走 你：近路嘛 朋友：别 trampled over 草刚长好 你：行 我绕路
trampled over.example: Friend: Why are you walking across the new lawn? You: It is a shortcut. Friend: You have trampled over the fresh grass. You: Okay, I will go around.

transferable skill.context: 你换工作时发现以前做客服的经验在新岗位也能用，朋友说这种本事换到哪都行，聊到可迁移技能，这时就会用到 transferable skill。
transferable skill.translation: 朋友：你以前做客服 现在做运营 怎么接上的 你：沟通能力是 transferable skill 到哪儿都能用 朋友：那确实 你：对 软技能最通用
transferable skill.example: Friend: You did customer service before, now you do operations, how did you switch? You: Communication is a transferable skill, useful anywhere. Friend: That is true. You: Right, soft skills transfer.

transformed into.context: 你把老房子改成了书店，朋友说这以前是住宅现在变成书店了，聊到变成，这时就会用到 transformed into。
transformed into.translation: 朋友：你那老房子现在干嘛用 你：改成 transformed into 一家小书店 朋友：那挺有味道 你：对 老房子做书店特别有感觉
transformed into.example: Friend: What do you use the old house for now? You: It was transformed into a little bookshop. Friend: That has real character. You: Right, an old house makes a great bookshop.

translate into.context: 你有好想法但光想不做没用，朋友说得把想法变成行动才有用，聊到转化为，这时就会用到 translate into。
translate into.translation: 朋友：你这想法挺好 但怎么不做 你：得 translate into 行动 不然白想 朋友：那你什么时候开始 你：下周一
translate into.example: Friend: Your idea is great, why not do it? You: It has to translate into action, otherwise it is nothing. Friend: When do you start? You: Next Monday.

translation technology.context: 你朋友去国外旅游，菜单全是外文，靠手机软件翻译，聊到翻译技术，这时就会用到 translation technology。
translation technology.translation: 朋友：你在国外怎么点菜 你：靠 translation technology 手机拍菜单翻译 朋友：那翻得准吗 你：大概能懂
translation technology.example: Friend: How do you order abroad? You: Using translation technology, my phone scans the menu. Friend: Is the translation accurate? You: Good enough to understand.

transport fare.context: 你朋友每天坐地铁上班，问你交通费一个月多少，聊到通勤费，这时就会用到 transport fare。
transport fare.translation: 朋友：你每天坐地铁上班 一个月交通费多少 你：transport fare 一个月两百多 朋友：那也不少 你：对 但比开车便宜
transport fare.example: Friend: You take the metro to work, how much a month? You: The transport fare is over two hundred a month. Friend: That is a lot. You: Right, but cheaper than driving.

transport infrastructure.context: 新闻说政府要建新地铁和公路，朋友说这种大工程修起来能带动发展，聊到交通基础设施，这时就会用到 transport infrastructure。
transport infrastructure.translation: 朋友：新闻里修那么多路和地铁干嘛 你：建 transport infrastructure 方便大家出行 朋友：那以后通勤快了 你：对
transport infrastructure.example: Friend: Why is the news building so many roads and metro lines? You: Building transport infrastructure to make travel easier. Friend: Then commuting gets faster. You: Right.

trap heat.context: 你穿厚羽绒服在屋里，朋友说门窗关严实了，热量跑不出去，聊到锁住热量，这时就会用到 trap heat。
trap heat.translation: 朋友：你家怎么这么暖和 你：窗户关严 trap heat 不跑出去 朋友：那暖气费省了 你：对 厚窗帘也有用
trap heat.example: Friend: Why is your place so warm? You: The windows are sealed to trap the heat inside. Friend: Then heating bills are lower. You: Right, thick curtains help too.

travel along.context: 你朋友说周末沿着海边那条路骑车特别舒服，朋友问走哪条路，聊到沿着某条路走，这时就会用到 travel along。
travel along.translation: 朋友：周末你骑车走哪条路 你：travel along 海边那条道 风特别舒服 朋友：那风景也好 你：对 一路看海
travel along.example: Friend: Which road do you cycle on weekends? You: Travel along that seaside road, the breeze is lovely. Friend: The view is great too. You: Right, the sea the whole way.

travel bug.context: 你朋友旅游回来就想去下一个地方，你说她是得了旅游病，停不下来，聊到爱旅游，这时就会用到 travel bug。
travel bug.translation: 朋友：她刚回来怎么又在订机票 你：她染上 travel bug 了 一停不下来 朋友：那钱够花吗 你：存一点出去一点
travel bug.example: Friend: Why is she booking flights right after coming back? You: She caught the travel bug, cannot stop. Friend: Does she have the money? You: Save a bit, spend a bit.

travel expense.context: 你出差住酒店公司报销，朋友问你出差花多少公司给报，聊到出差费用，这时就会用到 travel expense。
travel expense.translation: 朋友：你出差钱谁出 你：公司报 travel expense 路费住宿 朋友：那挺好 你：对 自己不用花
travel expense.example: Friend: Who pays for your business trips? You: The company covers travel expenses, transport and hotel. Friend: That is nice. You: Right, out of pocket nothing.

travel sick.context: 你朋友坐车就晕，一上高速就想吐，朋友说他是晕车，聊到晕车，这时就会用到 travel sick。
travel sick.translation: 朋友：你怎么一坐车就脸色发白 你：我 travel sick 一上车就晕 朋友：那坐前排开窗 你：对 别玩手机
travel sick.example: Friend: Why do you go pale the moment you get in the car? You: I get travel sick, dizzy in the car. Friend: Then sit up front and open the window. You: Right, and no phone.

travel through.context: 你朋友背包客一个人横穿整个国家，坐火车汽车转了好多地方，聊到穿越旅行，这时就会用到 travel through。
travel through.translation: 朋友：他怎么一个人去那么远 你：travel through 好几个国家 背包客 朋友：那得花多久 你：一个月
travel through.example: Friend: Why is he going so far alone? You: Travelling through several countries, backpacking. Friend: How long does that take? You: A month.

travel time.context: 你朋友每天通勤两小时，朋友说这时间太长了，聊到路上花的时间，这时就会用到 travel time。
travel time.translation: 朋友：你每天上班多久 你：通勤 travel time 两小时 朋友：那也太长了 你：对 我打算搬近点
travel time.example: Friend: How long is your commute? You: The travel time is two hours. Friend: That is really long. You: Right, I plan to move closer.

travels along.context: 你朋友周末骑车沿着河边那条路走，朋友说这条路风景特别好，聊到沿路骑行，这时就会用到 travels along。
travels along.translation: 朋友：他周末骑车走哪条路 你：他 travels along 河边那条路 朋友：那一边走一边看水 真舒服 你：对
travels along.example: Friend: Which road does he cycle on weekends? You: He travels along that riverside road. Friend: Then walking with water on one side is lovely. You: Right.

travels through.context: 你背包客一路穿过好几个省，看了不同的风景，朋友问他路线怎么安排，聊到穿越旅行，这时就会用到 travels through。
travels through.translation: 朋友：他这趟路线怎么安排的 你：他 travels through 好几个省 一路玩过去 朋友：那得换几次交通 你：对 火车汽车轮着来
travels through.example: Friend: How is his route planned? You: He travels through several provinces, playing his way. Friend: Then how many transfers? You: Right, trains and buses back to back.

treasured possessions.context: 你搬家时把家里最值钱的老相框和相册都小心搬着，朋友说这些才是真正珍贵的东西，聊到珍贵物件，这时就会用到 treasured possessions。
treasured possessions.translation: 朋友：你搬家最小心搬什么 你：老照片和相框这些 treasured possessions 朋友：这些都是回忆 你：对 比家具重要
treasured possessions.example: Friend: What do you handle most carefully when moving? You: Old photos and frames, the treasured possessions. Friend: Those are the memories. You: Right, more important than furniture.

trial and error.context: 你学做菜一开始老是做坏，试了好多次才成功，朋友说你这是一点点试出来的，聊到试错，这时就会用到 trial and error。
trial and error.translation: 朋友：你怎么学会做菜的 你：trial and error 做坏好多次才会 朋友：那真不容易 你：对 现在顺手了
trial and error.example: Friend: How did you learn to cook? You: Trial and error, messed up many times before I got it. Friend: That is tough. You: Right, now it is smooth.

trial run.context: 新软件上线前先找一小部分人试用，看看有没有大问题，朋友问这是干嘛，聊到试运行，这时就会用到 trial run。
trial run.translation: 朋友：新软件怎么先发一小部分人 你：做个 trial run 试运行 找bug 朋友：那正式上线就稳了 你：对 先试后发
trial run.example: Friend: Why is the new app rolling out to a small group first? You: A trial run to find bugs. Friend: Then the official launch is stable. You: Right, test first, launch later.

trick into.context: 朋友骗你说中奖了，你差点信了才发现是开玩笑，朋友说他就知道骗不了你，聊到骗某人做某事，这时就会用到 trick into。
trick into.translation: 朋友：我中奖了 请你吃饭 你：你 trick me into 相信了 朋友：哈哈 假的 你：你这家伙
trick into.example: Friend: I won a prize, dinner is on me. You: You tricked me into believing it. Friend: Haha, it is fake. You: You rascal.

tricking themselves.context: 你朋友考试前安慰自己说都会考的，其实没复习，朋友说他这是自己骗自己，聊到自欺，这时就会用到 tricking themselves。
tricking themselves.translation: 朋友：他考前说都会考 不用复习 你：他在 tricking themselves 安慰自己 朋友：那考出来就露馅 你：对 肯定不及格
tricking themselves.example: Friend: He says the exam will be easy, no need to revise. You: He is tricking himself to feel better. Friend: Then the result will show. You: Right, he will fail.

tricky problem.context: 你朋友遇到个特别难搞的问题，查了半天资料也没解决，朋友说这问题真棘手，聊到难题，这时就会用到 tricky problem。
tricky problem.translation: 朋友：你怎么盯着电脑一下午 你：遇到个 tricky problem 查半天资料 朋友：解决了吗 你：还没 太难了
tricky problem.example: Friend: Why have you stared at the screen all afternoon? You: Hit a tricky problem, researched for ages. Friend: Did you solve it? You: Not yet, it is too hard.

trigger sound.context: 你看心理学视频里说有些声音一出来就让人紧张，朋友问这是什么反应，聊到触发声音，这时就会用到 trigger sound。
trigger sound.translation: 朋友：他怎么一听到那声就抖 你：那是 trigger sound 一出来他就紧张 朋友：是以前吓过他 你：对 留下阴影了
trigger sound.example: Friend: Why does he flinch at that sound? You: It is a trigger sound, he tenses up when it hits. Friend: Was he scared by it before? You: Right, a trauma left a mark.

trip chaining.context: 你周末一次出门把买菜、寄快递、理发全办了，朋友说你这一趟出门干了好几件事，聊到把多件事串在一次出门，这时就会用到 trip chaining。
trip chaining.translation: 朋友：你这趟出门办了多少事 你：买菜 寄快递 理发 全串一趟 trip chaining 朋友：那真高效 你：对 一次出门全搞定
trip chaining.example: Friend: How many things did you get done on this trip? You: Groceries, post, haircut, all chained in one trip. Friend: That is efficient. You: Right, one outing, everything done.

trip on.context: 你走路没注意踩到地上的玩具，差点摔倒，朋友说你小心，别绊着，聊到绊倒，这时就会用到 trip on。
trip on.translation: 朋友：你怎么差点摔了 你：地上有个玩具 我 trip on 差点绊倒 朋友：小心点 看着路 你：行 我捡起来
trip on.example: Friend: Why did you almost fall? You: There is a toy on the floor, I tripped on it. Friend: Watch your step. You: Okay, I will pick it up.

tropical cyclone.context: 新闻说南海那边有个大风在形成，朋友说这是热带风暴，会带来大雨，聊到热带气旋，这时就会用到 tropical cyclone。
tropical cyclone.translation: 朋友：新闻说那边在刮大风 你：是 tropical cyclone 热带风暴 朋友：那会下雨吗 你：对 连着下两天
tropical cyclone.example: Friend: The news says a storm is forming out at sea. You: It is a tropical cyclone. Friend: Will it bring rain? You: Right, two days of it.

tropical rainforest.context: 你看纪录片讲热带雨林里有一半物种都住在树上，朋友说这种地方生物真多，聊到热带雨林，这时就会用到 tropical rainforest。
tropical rainforest.translation: 朋友：纪录片里那片林子真绿 你：是 tropical rainforest 物种特别多 朋友：去那儿旅游舒服吗 你：热是热 但风景绝了
tropical rainforest.example: Friend: That forest in the documentary is so green. You: It is a tropical rainforest, so many species. Friend: Is it nice to travel there? You: Hot but the scenery is amazing.

trust factor.context: 你朋友说这家餐厅服务员特别热情，朋友问为什么愿意来第二次，聊到信任，这时就会用到 trust factor。
trust factor.translation: 朋友：你怎么老来这家餐厅 你：服务员特别实在 trust factor 高 朋友：那真的回头客 你：对 不坑人
trust factor.example: Friend: Why do you keep coming to this restaurant? You: The staff are honest, the trust factor is high. Friend: Then it is real repeat business. You: Right, no tricks.

truth bias.context: 你朋友被骗过一次，后来别人说真话他也不信，你说他这是有偏见，聊到这种偏见，这时就会用到 truth bias。
truth bias.translation: 朋友：他怎么老不信人 你：被人骗过一次 有 truth bias 了 朋友：那挺难信任人 你：对 得慢慢建立
truth bias.example: Friend: Why does he not trust anyone? You: He was scammed once, now has a truth bias. Friend: That makes trusting hard. You: Right, it builds back slowly.

try before buy.context: 你朋友在网上买了衣服试一下就退，朋友说他这是先试再决定买不买，聊到试了再买，这时就会用到 try before buy。
try before buy.translation: 朋友：你怎么买衣服都退 你：我 try before buy 试穿不合适就退 朋友：那运费不亏吗 你：七天无理由 不亏
try before buy.example: Friend: Why do you return so many clothes? You: I try before I buy, send back if it does not fit. Friend: Is return shipping not a loss? You: Free returns, no loss.

try one's hand at.context: 你朋友第一次做饭，想试试新学的菜，朋友说你大胆做，聊到第一次尝试，这时就会用到 try one's hand at。
try one's hand at.translation: 朋友：你周末干嘛 你：try my hand at 做新学的菜 朋友：做砸了别难过 你：行 做坏了我请你吃外卖
try one's hand at.example: Friend: What are you doing this weekend? You: Trying my hand at a new dish. Friend: Do not be sad if it flops. You: Okay, if it fails I treat you to takeout.

tuck away.context: 你把零食藏在抽屉最里面，朋友找不到，问你饼干放哪儿了，聊到藏起来，这时就会用到 tuck away。
tuck away.translation: 朋友：你饼干藏哪儿了 你：tuck away 在抽屉最里面 朋友：真隐蔽 我都没找到 你：对 怕别人偷吃
tuck away.example: Friend: Where did you hide the cookies? You: Tucked away at the back of the drawer. Friend: Really hidden, I did not find them. You: Right, afraid of sneaks.

tuck in.context: 妈妈端上热汤面，说赶紧趁热吃，你夹起一大口，朋友说你吃得真香，聊到痛快吃，这时就会用到 tuck in。
tuck in.translation: 朋友：汤面端上来了 快吃 你：我 tuck in 了 趁热 朋友：你慢点 别烫着 你：行 真好吃
tuck in.example: Friend: The noodle soup is served, eat up. You: I am tucking in while it is hot. Friend: Slow down, do not burn yourself. You: Okay, it tastes great.

tuck into.context: 朋友一上餐桌就大吃起来，把一盘饺子全包了，你说他真能吃，聊到大吃，这时就会用到 tuck into。
tuck into.translation: 朋友：饺子刚端上来他就 tuck into 了 你：一盘全让他吃了 朋友：他真饿坏了 你：对 中午没吃
tuck into.example: Friend: The dumplings just came out and he tucked in. You: He ate the whole plate. Friend: He must be really hungry. You: Right, skipped lunch.

tuck under.context: 你睡觉前把被子边掖在身子下面，朋友说你这样更暖和，聊到掖被子，这时就会用到 tuck under。
tuck under.translation: 朋友：你睡觉怎么把被子塞那么紧 你：把被边 tuck under 身子 不漏风 朋友：那冬天确实暖和 你：对 我从小就这样
tuck under.example: Friend: Why do you tuck the blanket so tight? You: I tuck the edges under my body, no draught. Friend: Then it is really warm in winter. You: Right, I have done this since I was small.

tug on one's heartstrings.context: 你看公益广告里小朋友抱着旧玩具送灾区，一下就被感动了，朋友说这广告真打动人，聊到触动心弦，这时就会用到 tug on one's heartstrings。
tug on one's heartstrings.translation: 朋友：你怎么看广告看哭了 你：那小朋友抱着旧玩具 真 tug on my heartstrings 朋友：这广告真会拍 你：对 一下就哭了
tug on one's heartstrings.example: Friend: Why are you crying at the ad? You: That kid hugging an old toy really tugged on my heartstrings. Friend: They shot the ad well. You: Right, I just broke down.

tug on your heartstring.context: 你看流浪猫在雨里躲着，一下心疼得不行，朋友说你就是心软，聊到让人感动，这时就会用到 tug on your heartstring。
tug on your heartstring.translation: 朋友：你怎么把那流浪猫带回家了 你：它在雨里抖 一下 tug on my heartstring 朋友：你真心软 你：对 舍不得
tug on your heartstring.example: Friend: Why did you bring that stray home? You: It was shivering in the rain, it tugged on my heartstring. Friend: You are so soft-hearted. You: Right, I could not leave it.

tugs on your heartstrings.context: 你看公益片里山区孩子走路上学，朋友说这片子真打动人，看哭了，聊到让人动容，这时就会用到 tugs on your heartstrings。
tugs on your heartstrings.translation: 朋友：这纪录片你怎么看哭了 你：那孩子走路上学的镜头 tugs on your heartstrings 朋友：真实的故事最打动人 你：对
tugs on your heartstrings.example: Friend: Why are you crying at this documentary? You: The scene of that kid walking to school tugs on your heartstrings. Friend: True stories move people most. You: Right.

tuition fee.context: 你朋友上大学一年学费好几万，聊到上学要花的钱，这时就会用到 tuition fee。
tuition fee.translation: 朋友：你上大学一年花多少 你：tuition fee 加起来好几万 朋友：那真不少 你：对 还好有奖学金
tuition fee.example: Friend: How much does university cost a year? You: The tuition fee adds up to tens of thousands. Friend: That is a lot. You: Right, lucky I have a scholarship.

tuition firm.context: 你朋友下班还去课外班教课，赚外快，朋友说那是培训机构，聊到培训机构，这时就会用到 tuition firm。
tuition firm.translation: 朋友：你下班还去哪 你：去 tuition firm 课外班教课 朋友：那挺累 你：对 但赚外快
tuition firm.example: Friend: Where do you go after work? You: To a tuition firm, teaching extra classes. Friend: That is tiring. You: Right, but it is extra money.

tummy rumbling.context: 你早上没吃饭，到中午肚子咕咕叫，朋友说你肚子都在响了，聊到肚子饿，这时就会用到 tummy rumbling。
tummy rumbling.translation: 朋友：你肚子怎么咕咕响 你：早上没吃饭 tummy rumbling 饿了 朋友：那赶紧吃饭 你：对 我中午多吃点
tummy rumbling.example: Friend: Why is your stomach growling? You: I skipped breakfast, my tummy is rumbling. Friend: Then eat fast. You: Right, I will eat a lot at lunch.

tune in.context: 你每晚九点准时听那个广播节目，到点就打开收音机，朋友问你在干嘛，聊到收听节目，这时就会用到 tune in。
tune in.translation: 朋友：你晚上九点干嘛呢 你：tune in 那个广播节目 朋友：天天听 不腻吗 你：对 就爱听那个主持人
tune in.example: Friend: What do you do at nine every night? You: I tune in to that radio show. Friend: Every night, not bored? You: Right, I just love the host.

tuning in to.context: 你朋友每次出新剧都第一时间追，朋友说她特别关注这个剧，聊到关注，这时就会用到 tuning in to。
tuning in to.translation: 朋友：她怎么天天等更新 你：tuning in to 那个新剧 追得紧 朋友：那剧情真那么好看 你：对 我也在追
tuning in to.example: Friend: Why does she wait for updates every day? You: Tuning in to that new show, following it tight. Friend: Is the plot really that good? You: Right, I am following it too.

tunnel vision.context: 你朋友只盯着眼前这一件事，连旁边有人走过来都没看见，你说他视野太窄了，聊到视野局限，这时就会用到 tunnel vision。
tunnel vision.translation: 朋友：他怎么没看见我们走过去 你：他 tunnel vision 只盯眼前那事 朋友：太专注了 你：对 别的都看不见
tunnel vision.example: Friend: Why did he not see us walk over? You: He has tunnel vision, only staring at the thing in front. Friend: Too focused. You: Right, he sees nothing else.

turn a blind eye to.context: 你朋友上班迟到五分钟，领导装没看见，你说领导这是故意放过，聊到视而不见，这时就会用到 turn a blind eye to。
turn a blind eye to.translation: 朋友：他迟到领导怎么没说 你：领导 turn a blind eye to 老员工了 朋友：那新员工迟到就罚 你：对 看人下菜碟
turn a blind eye to.example: Friend: Why did the boss not mention him being late? You: The boss turned a blind eye, he is a long-timer. Friend: Then new hires get fined. You: Right, depends who.

turn away.context: 餐厅门口排队太长，服务员让你改天再来，你说这都不接待客人吗，聊到拒绝，这时就会用到 turn away。
turn away.translation: 朋友：我们排了半小时怎么让走 你：人太多 turn away 不接待了 朋友：那换一家 你：行 别在这耗
turn away.example: Friend: We queued half an hour and they turn us away? You: Too busy, they turn people away. Friend: Then switch to another place. You: Right, do not waste time.

turn bitter.context: 你煮咖啡煮太久，喝起来苦苦的，朋友说这味道都变苦了，聊到变苦，这时就会用到 turn bitter。
turn bitter.translation: 朋友：这咖啡怎么这么苦 你：煮太久 turn bitter 了 朋友：下次煮两分钟就好 你：行 我记着
turn bitter.example: Friend: Why is this coffee so bitter? You: It turned bitter from brewing too long. Friend: Next time brew only two minutes. You: Okay, I will remember.

turn of the millennium.context: 你朋友回忆两千年刚到大城市时到处都是工地，朋友说那是千禧年刚开始的时候，聊到那个年代，这时就会用到 turn of the millennium。
turn of the millennium.translation: 朋友：你两千年刚来的时候 啥样 你：到处都是工地 那是 turn of the millennium 朋友：现在变化真大 你：对 二十年了
turn of the millennium.example: Friend: What was it like when you first came in 2000? You: Construction everywhere, that was the turn of the millennium. Friend: So much change since. You: Right, twenty years.

turn one's hand to.context: 你朋友以前是会计，现在开始学画画，朋友说她怎么什么都想试，聊到尝试新领域，这时就会用到 turn one's hand to。
turn one's hand to.translation: 朋友：她以前是会计 怎么开始画画 你：她 turn her hand to 啥都想试试 朋友：那学得怎么样 你：画得还挺好
turn one's hand to.example: Friend: She was an accountant, why is she painting now? You: She turns her hand to whatever she wants to try. Friend: How is she doing? You: Paints quite well.

turn one's nose up.context: 你朋友请你吃路边摊，你嫌不卫生，朋友说你别这么挑三拣四，聊到嫌弃，这时就会用到 turn one's nose up。
turn one's nose up.translation: 朋友：请你吃路边摊 你别嫌弃 你：我 turn my nose up 这种不卫生 朋友：那你想吃啥 你：找个干净馆子
turn one's nose up.example: Friend: Treating you to street food, do not turn your nose up. You: I turn my nose up at that, not hygienic. Friend: Then what do you want? You: Find a clean restaurant.

turn one's stomach.context: 你朋友说闻到油腻的红烧肉就想吐，聊到让人反胃，这时就会用到 turn one's stomach。
turn one's stomach.translation: 朋友：你怎么一口红烧肉都不吃 你：那味道 turn my stomach 反胃 朋友：那你点个青菜 你：行
turn one's stomach.example: Friend: Why do you not eat any braised pork? You: That smell turns my stomach. Friend: Then order greens. You: Okay.

turn over a new leaf.context: 你朋友以前爱乱花钱，现在每月攒钱，你说他像换了个人，朋友说他是改过自新了，聊到重新开始，这时就会用到 turn over a new leaf。
turn over a new leaf.translation: 朋友：他以前月光 现在怎么开始存钱 你：他 turn over a new leaf 改过自新了 朋友：那真难得 你：对 长大了
turn over a new leaf.example: Friend: He used to spend everything, why is he saving now? You: He turned over a new leaf. Friend: That is rare. You: Right, he grew up.

turn upside down.context: 你朋友搬家把家里翻得乱七八糟，东西到处都是，聊到彻底打乱，这时就会用到 turn upside down。
turn upside down.translation: 朋友：你家怎么跟被打劫了一样 你：搬家 turn upside down 东西到处都是 朋友：收拾完就好 你：对 今天先收一半
turn upside down.example: Friend: Why does your place look ransacked? You: Moving turned it upside down, stuff everywhere. Friend: It will be fine after tidying. You: Right, half done today.

turned.context: 你朋友把椅子转过来坐，跟你面对面聊天，朋友问你怎么坐法变了，聊到转身，这时就会用到 turned。
turned.translation: 朋友：你怎么把椅子转过来坐 你：这样 turned 过来跟你面对面聊天 朋友：那比侧着坐舒服 你：对
turned.example: Friend: Why did you turn your chair around? You: Turned it around to face you while we chat. Friend: That is comfier than sitting sideways. You: Right.

tv show.context: 你周末晚上窝在沙发上看剧，朋友问你在干嘛，你说追个电视节目，聊到电视节目，这时就会用到 tv show。
tv show.translation: 朋友：你今晚干嘛呢 你：追个 tv show 周末放松 朋友：好看吗 你：对 刚出的
tv show.example: Friend: What are you doing tonight? You: Watching a TV show, relaxing on the weekend. Friend: Is it good? You: Right, just out.

twilight years.context: 你爷爷退休后种种花散散步，朋友说老人晚年日子过得真舒服，聊到晚年，这时就会用到 twilight years。
twilight years.translation: 朋友：你爷爷退休后怎么过的 你：种种花散散步 twilight years 挺舒服 朋友：那真幸福 你：对 别操心就是福
twilight years.example: Friend: How does your grandfather spend retirement? You: Growing flowers, walking, his twilight years are comfortable. Friend: That is true happiness. You: Right, no worries is a blessing.

twists and turn.context: 你朋友说这部电影剧情一波三折，看着特别绕，聊到曲折变化，这时就会用到 twists and turn。
twists and turn.translation: 朋友：这电影好看在哪 你：剧情 twists and turns 反转特别多 朋友：那看得人晕不晕 你：不晕 刺激
twists and turn.example: Friend: What is good about this movie? You: The plot has twists and turns, so many reversals. Friend: Is it confusing? You: No, it is exciting.

type diabetes.context: 你朋友体检说血糖偏高，医生让他少吃甜的，聊到二型糖尿病，这时就会用到 type diabetes。
type diabetes.translation: 朋友：你体检结果怎么了 你：血糖偏高 有点 type 2 diabetes 朋友：那少吃甜的 你：对 以后奶茶改无糖
type diabetes.example: Friend: What did your check-up show? You: Blood sugar high, a bit of type 2 diabetes. Friend: Then cut the sweets. You: Right, sugar-free milk tea from now on.

type note.context: 你上课用键盘敲笔记，比手写快多了，朋友问你怎么记得那么快，聊到打字记录，这时就会用到 type note。
type note.translation: 朋友：你怎么笔记记得那么快 你：我 type note 用键盘敲 朋友：那比手写快多了 你：对 老师讲完我也记完
type note.example: Friend: How do you take notes so fast? You: I type notes on the keyboard. Friend: That is much faster than handwriting. You: Right, done by the time the teacher finishes.

typical of.context: 你朋友说他最近总爱熬夜，这就是他一贯的样子，聊到典型特征，这时就会用到 typical of。
typical of.translation: 朋友：他又熬夜到两点 你：typical of 他 天天这样 朋友：那身体受得了吗 你：对 劝他也不听
typical of.example: Friend: He stayed up till two again. You: Typical of him, every day like this. Friend: Can his body take it? You: Right, he does not listen when we tell him.

ultimate goal.context: 你朋友问你工作这么拼最终是为了什么，你说就是想实现那个最终目标，聊到终极目标，这时就会用到 ultimate goal。
ultimate goal.translation: 朋友：你这么拼命到底图啥 你：ultimate goal 就是想有自己的小店 朋友：那加油 你：对 再攒两年钱
ultimate goal.example: Friend: Why are you grinding so hard? You: My ultimate goal is to have my own shop. Friend: Then keep going. You: Right, save for two more years.

ultimate running challenge.context: 朋友说你要跑完一百公里越野，你说这就是挑战自己的极限，朋友说这真够拼的，聊到极限挑战，这时就会用到 ultimate running challenge。
ultimate running challenge.translation: 朋友：你要跑一百公里越野 图啥 你：这是个 ultimate running challenge 挑战自己 朋友：那你练了多久 你：半年
ultimate running challenge.example: Friend: Why run a hundred-kilometre trail? You: It is an ultimate running challenge, pushing myself. Friend: How long did you train? You: Half a year.

ultra-processed food.context: 医生说薯片香肠这些东西都是超加工食品，吃多了不好，朋友说以后得少吃，聊到超加工食品，这时就会用到 ultra-processed food。
ultra-processed food.translation: 朋友：医生怎么说 你：让我少碰 ultra-processed food 薯片香肠 朋友：那你以后吃什么 你：自己做饭 新鲜菜
ultra-processed food.example: Friend: What did the doctor say? You: Cut back on ultra-processed food, chips and sausages. Friend: Then what will you eat? You: Cook for myself, fresh veg.

ultra-processed foods.context: 你朋友去超市买零食全是薯片饼干，医生说这些都是超加工食品，聊到这类食物，这时就会用到 ultra-processed foods。
ultra-processed foods.translation: 朋友：你买这么多薯片饼干干嘛 你：医生说 ultra-processed foods 要少吃 朋友：那你还买 你：我就是解个馋
ultra-processed foods.example: Friend: Why buy so many chips and biscuits? You: The doctor said ultra-processed foods should be eaten less. Friend: Then why buy them? You: Just a craving.

uncanny valley.context: 你看科幻片里机器人长得像真人一样，但看着别扭，朋友说这种像人又不是人的感觉叫恐怖谷，聊到恐怖谷效应，这时就会用到 uncanny valley。
uncanny valley.translation: 朋友：这机器人看着怪怪的 你：它 uncanny valley 像真人又不是真人 朋友：所以看着不舒服 你：对 太像了反而别扭
uncanny valley.example: Friend: This robot looks off. You: It is the uncanny valley, almost human but not quite. Friend: So it feels creepy. You: Right, too close to real is eerie.

unconventional interview.context: 公司面试不考专业，让大家现场聊兴趣爱好，朋友问这是什么面试，你说挺特别，聊到非常规面试，这时就会用到 unconventional interview。
unconventional interview.translation: 朋友：今天面试怎么不考专业 你：搞了个 unconventional interview 聊兴趣 朋友：那挺特别 你：对 看人的性格
unconventional interview.example: Friend: Why did today's interview not test skills? You: They ran an unconventional interview, chatting about hobbies. Friend: That is unusual. You: Right, looking at personality.

undealt-with situation.context: 你朋友有个事一直没解决，拖了半年，你说这事再不管就一直悬着，聊到悬而未决的事，这时就会用到 undealt-with situation。
undealt-with situation.translation: 朋友：那个问题他怎么还没解决 你：一直拖着 undealt-with situation 半年了 朋友：那再拖就严重了 你：对 赶紧处理
undealt-with situation.example: Friend: Why has he not fixed that problem? You: It has been left as an undealt-with situation for half a year. Friend: Then it gets worse if left. You: Right, handle it now.

under constant threat.context: 新闻说这一带的动物栖息地被破坏，动物随时可能被伤害，朋友说它们一直处于危险中，聊到受威胁，这时就会用到 under constant threat。
under constant threat.translation: 朋友：那边的野生动物怎么了 你：栖息地被毁 under constant threat 朋友：那得赶紧保护 你：对 不然要灭绝
under constant threat.example: Friend: What is happening to the wildlife there? You: Their habitat is destroyed, they are under constant threat. Friend: Then protect them fast. You: Right, or they go extinct.

under its own steam.context: 你朋友没等别人帮忙，自己把车推上坡，朋友说他靠自己就行，聊到靠自己力量，这时就会用到 under its own steam。
under its own steam.translation: 朋友：他怎么不等别人帮忙 你：他 under its own steam 自己推上坡 朋友：挺厉害 你：对 不麻烦人
under its own steam.example: Friend: Why did he not wait for help? You: He did it under his own steam, pushed it up the slope. Friend: Impressive. You: Right, no help needed.

under one roof.context: 你和朋友合租一套房，大家住在同一屋檐下，朋友说住一起真方便，聊到同住，这时就会用到 under one roof。
under one roof.translation: 朋友：你俩合租多久了 你：在 under one roof 住了两年 朋友：那挺方便 你：对 一起做饭
under one roof.example: Friend: How long have you two shared a flat? You: Living under one roof for two years. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right, cook together.

under pressure to.context: 你朋友刚进公司，领导天天催她快点出成果，朋友说她顶着压力干活，聊到压力下，这时就会用到 under pressure to。
under pressure to.translation: 朋友：她新工作怎么天天加班 你：under pressure to 快速出成果 朋友：那压力真大 你：对 一个月瘦了五斤
under pressure to.example: Friend: Why does she work overtime at the new job? You: Under pressure to deliver results fast. Friend: That is a lot of pressure. You: Right, lost five pounds in a month.

under the thumb.context: 你朋友什么都听女朋友的，大事小事都得问她，朋友说他完全被管着，聊到被控制，这时就会用到 under the thumb。
under the thumb.translation: 朋友：他周末怎么不跟我们出来 你：他 under the thumb 老婆不让出门 朋友：那真惨 你：对 啥事都得批准
under the thumb.example: Friend: Why does he not come out with us on weekends? You: He is under the thumb, his wife will not let him out. Friend: That is tough. You: Right, needs approval for everything.

under the weather.context: 你朋友今天有点感冒，头疼没精神，你说他看起来不太舒服，聊到身体微恙，这时就会用到 under the weather。
under the weather.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么脸色不好 你：有点 under the weather 头疼 朋友：那回家休息 你：行 我请个假
under the weather.example: Friend: Why do you look off today? You: A bit under the weather, my head hurts. Friend: Then go home and rest. You: Okay, I will take the day off.

under threat.context: 新闻说那片老房子因为开发要被拆掉了，朋友说这些老建筑一直面临危机，聊到受威胁，这时就会用到 under threat。
under threat.translation: 朋友：那片老胡同怎么封起来了 你：要拆 那些老房子 under threat 好久了 朋友：那真可惜 住了几代人 你：对 拆了就没了
under threat.example: Friend: Why is that old alley blocked off? You: It is slated for demolition, those old houses have been under threat for ages. Friend: That is a shame, people lived there for generations. You: Right, gone once torn down.

under threat of.context: 新闻说有些动物数量越来越少，随时可能灭绝，朋友说它们一直处于灭绝危机中，聊到面临灭绝威胁，这时就会用到 under threat of。
under threat of.translation: 朋友：新闻里那种熊猫现在多吗 你：数量还少 under threat of 灭绝 朋友：那得好好保护 你：对 不然以后只能看照片
under threat of.example: Friend: Are there many of those pandas in the news? You: Still few, under threat of extinction. Friend: Then they need real protection. You: Right, or we only see photos.

underwater construction.context: 新闻说工程师在海底下修隧道，朋友问怎么在水下干活，聊到水下施工，这时就会用到 underwater construction。
underwater construction.translation: 朋友：那海底隧道怎么修的 你：underwater construction 在海底下作业 朋友：那工人怎么呼吸 你：用特殊设备
underwater construction.example: Friend: How do they build that undersea tunnel? You: Underwater construction, working on the seabed. Friend: How do the workers breathe? You: With special gear.

underwater dwelling.context: 科幻片里未来人住在海底玻璃房子里，朋友说那就是水下住宅，聊到水下住宅，这时就会用到 underwater dwelling。
underwater dwelling.translation: 朋友：片里那房子怎么在海底 你：是 underwater dwelling 玻璃罩着 朋友：那真能住人吗 你：科幻里能 现实还早
underwater dwelling.example: Friend: Why is the house in the film under the sea? You: It is an underwater dwelling under a glass dome. Friend: Can people actually live there? You: In sci-fi yes, in reality not yet.

underwater habitat.context: 纪录片里科学家在海底住了一个月做实验，朋友说那就是水下研究站，聊到水下居所，这时就会用到 underwater habitat。
underwater habitat.translation: 朋友：那些科学家在海底住一个月干嘛 你：做实验 住在 underwater habitat 里 朋友：那怎么吃饭睡觉 你：全在那个小舱里
underwater habitat.example: Friend: Why do those scientists live underwater for a month? You: Running experiments in an underwater habitat. Friend: How do they eat and sleep? You: All inside that small pod.

underwater station.context: 纪录片里科学家在海底放了个小舱做研究，朋友问那是什么，聊到水下工作站，这时就会用到 underwater station。
underwater station.translation: 朋友：海底那个小方盒子是啥 你：underwater station 科研站 科学家在里面做实验 朋友：那灯一直亮着 你：对 二十四小时有人
underwater station.example: Friend: What is that little box on the seabed? You: An underwater station, a research pod where scientists run experiments. Friend: The light is always on. You: Right, manned around the clock.

unexpected cost.context: 你装修房子时本来预算十万，结果工人说水管要全换，多出两万，朋友说这就是意外开销，聊到意外成本，这时就会用到 unexpected cost。
unexpected cost.translation: 朋友：你装修花了多少 你：本来十万 结果 unexpected cost 又加两万 朋友：那超预算了 你：对 水管全换了
unexpected cost.example: Friend: How much did your renovation cost? You: Ten thousand planned, but an unexpected cost added another twenty thousand. Friend: Then you went over budget. You: Right, the whole plumbing had to be replaced.

unexpected guests.context: 你正吃饭呢门铃响了，开门一看是好久没来的老同学，朋友说这就是不速之客，聊到突然到访的客人，这时就会用到 unexpected guests。
unexpected guests.translation: 朋友：门铃响了 谁啊 你：开门一看是老同学 unexpected guests 朋友：那赶紧加双筷子 你：对 一起吃
unexpected guests.example: Friend: The doorbell rang, who is it? You: Opened up to old classmates, unexpected guests. Friend: Then add an extra pair of chopsticks. You: Right, eat together.

unexpected prompt.context: 老板开会突然问你对那个客户怎么看，你没准备也得临场回答，朋友说这种突发问题最考验人，聊到临场问题，这时就会用到 unexpected prompt。
unexpected prompt.translation: 朋友：老板今天怎么突然点你 你：他给了个 unexpected prompt 问我对客户怎么看 朋友：你答上来了吗 你：蒙了半天 凑合说
unexpected prompt.example: Friend: Why did the boss suddenly call on you today? You: He threw out an unexpected prompt, asking what I thought of the client. Friend: Did you answer? You: Fumbled for a bit, muddled through.

unfiltered photo.context: 你拍照不爱加滤镜，直接发原图，朋友说你这张无修图真自然，聊到没修的原图，这时就会用到 unfiltered photo。
unfiltered photo.translation: 朋友：你这张照片怎么没加滤镜 你：我就爱发 unfiltered photo 真实 朋友：那你皮肤状态真好 你：对 没修
unfiltered photo.example: Friend: Why is this photo of you unfiltered? You: I love posting an unfiltered photo, it is real. Friend: Then your skin looks great. You: Right, no edits.

unintended consequence.context: 你本来想减肥，结果天天点外卖反而胖了，朋友说这就是节食带来的意外后果，聊到意料之外的结果，这时就会用到 unintended consequence。
unintended consequence.translation: 朋友：你节食怎么还胖了 你：unintended consequence 饿狠了反而暴食 朋友：那别节食了 你：对 正常吃饭
unintended consequence.example: Friend: Why did you gain weight on a diet? You: An unintended consequence, starving made me binge. Friend: Then stop dieting. You: Right, eat normally.

uninvited guest.context: 你家正吃饭呢门铃响了，开门一看是推销的，你说这是不速之客，聊到没被邀请来的人，这时就会用到 uninvited guest。
uninvited guest.translation: 朋友：门口那个人是谁 你：上门推销的 uninvited guest 朋友：那你赶紧打发走 你：对 我关门了
uninvited guest.example: Friend: Who is that person at your door? You: A door-to-door salesperson, an uninvited guest. Friend: Then send them away fast. You: Right, I shut the door.

unique feature.context: 你看科普说企鹅翅膀变成了鳍，这是它独有的特点，朋友问这是什么，聊到独特特征，这时就会用到 unique feature。
unique feature.translation: 朋友：企鹅跟别的鸟有啥不一样 你：它翅膀变成鳍 是 unique feature 朋友：那它就不会飞了 你：对 会游泳
unique feature.example: Friend: How is a penguin different from other birds? You: Its wings became flippers, a unique feature. Friend: Then it cannot fly. You: Right, it swims.

units of alcohol.context: 医生说成年人一天喝多少酒算合适，朋友问酒精单位怎么算，聊到饮酒单位，这时就会用到 units of alcohol。
units of alcohol.translation: 朋友：医生说一天能喝多少酒 你：别超过两个 units of alcohol 酒精单位 朋友：那一瓶啤酒够不够 你：差不多
units of alcohol.example: Friend: How much alcohol does the doctor allow a day? You: No more than two units of alcohol. Friend: Is one bottle of beer okay? You: About that.

university places.context: 新闻说今年高考录取率提高了，大学名额多了，朋友说孩子们上好大学更容易了，聊到大学招生名额，这时就会用到 university places。
university places.translation: 朋友：今年高考分数线怎么降了 你：university places 多了 扩招 朋友：那孩子考大学容易了 你：对
university places.example: Friend: Why did this year's college cutoff drop? You: More university places, expanded intake. Friend: Then it is easier for kids to get in. You: Right.

university wellbeing service.context: 你上大学时压力大失眠，辅导员让你去找学校的心理咨询中心，朋友问那是什么地方，聊到高校心理服务，这时就会用到 university wellbeing service。
university wellbeing service.translation: 朋友：你上大学那会儿睡不好找谁 你：找 university wellbeing service 心理中心 朋友：那免费吗 你：对 学生免费
university wellbeing service.example: Friend: Who did you go to when you could not sleep at university? You: The university wellbeing service, the counselling centre. Friend: Is it free? You: Right, free for students.

unnecessary item.context: 你整理房间时翻出一堆从来不用的旧东西，朋友说这些就是闲置杂物，该扔就扔，聊到没用的东西，这时就会用到 unnecessary item。
unnecessary item.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里这些旧电池干嘛 你：都是 unnecessary item 留着也不用 朋友：那扔了吧 你：对 清一清
unnecessary item.example: Friend: What are these old batteries in your drawer? You: All unnecessary items, never used. Friend: Then throw them out. You: Right, clear them out.

unnecessary possession.context: 你搬家时收拾出一大堆旧书旧杯子，朋友说这些就是闲置物件，带不走就捐了，聊到不用的东西，这时就会用到 unnecessary possession。
unnecessary possession.translation: 朋友：你这堆旧书怎么办 你：都是 unnecessary possession 带不走 朋友：那捐了吧 你：对 送社区
unnecessary possession.example: Friend: What will you do with this pile of old books? You: All unnecessary possessions, cannot take them. Friend: Then donate them. You: Right, give to the community.

unorthodox hiring.context: 有些公司招人不看学历，直接看作品和能力，朋友说这种招聘方式很特别，聊到非常规招聘，这时就会用到 unorthodox hiring。
unorthodox hiring.translation: 朋友：那家公司怎么不看学历 你：unorthodox hiring 直接看作品 朋友：那对没学历的人公平 你：对 凭本事
unorthodox hiring.example: Friend: Why does that company not care about degrees? You: Unorthodox hiring, they look at the portfolio. Friend: Then it is fair for non-graduates. You: Right, by skill.

unpaid debt.context: 你朋友做生意欠了别人钱一直没还，朋友说他那笔欠款拖了两年，聊到没还的债，这时就会用到 unpaid debt。
unpaid debt.translation: 朋友：他那笔钱还了吗 你：没还 一笔 unpaid debt 拖了两年 朋友：那对方不催吗 你：对 天天催
unpaid debt.example: Friend: Has he paid that money back? You: No, an unpaid debt dragging on for two years. Friend: Is the other side not chasing? You: Right, chasing every day.

unpaid overtime.context: 你朋友天天加班到很晚，公司不给加班费，朋友说这就是无偿加班，聊到没薪加班，这时就会用到 unpaid overtime。
unpaid overtime.translation: 朋友：你天天加班有加班费吗 你：没有 unpaid overtime 白加 朋友：那公司太坑 你：对 但不敢辞
unpaid overtime.example: Friend: Do you get paid for all that overtime? You: No, unpaid overtime, free hours. Friend: That company rips you off. You: Right, but I dare not quit.

unproven claims.context: 网上有人说吃某药能治百病，医生说这些都是没证据的说法，聊到未经证实的说法，这时就会用到 unproven claims。
unproven claims.translation: 朋友：网上说那药能治脱发 你：都是 unproven claims 没证据 朋友：那有人买吗 你：有 贪便宜
unproven claims.example: Friend: The internet says that pill cures baldness. You: All unproven claims, no evidence. Friend: Do people buy it? You: Yes, they want a cheap fix.

unrealistic beauty standard.context: 女孩们都觉得自己不够瘦不够美，朋友说这种审美标准根本不现实，聊到不切实际的审美，这时就会用到 unrealistic beauty standard。
unrealistic beauty standard.translation: 朋友：她怎么天天减肥 还说自己胖 你：被 unrealistic beauty standard 洗脑了 朋友：那真该自信点 你：对
unrealistic beauty standard.example: Friend: Why is she always dieting, calling herself fat? You: Brainwashed by an unrealistic beauty standard. Friend: Then she should be more confident. You: Right.

unrealistic sense of danger.context: 有些孩子总觉得周围有危险，其实什么事都没有，朋友说他们有没来由的紧张感，聊到无端危机感，这时就会用到 unrealistic sense of danger。
unrealistic sense of danger.translation: 朋友：他怎么老觉得有人跟踪他 你：他有 unrealistic sense of danger 其实没人 朋友：那是心理问题 你：对 得看医生
unrealistic sense of danger.example: Friend: Why does he feel followed all the time? You: He has an unrealistic sense of danger, there is nobody. Friend: Then it is a mental thing. You: Right, needs a doctor.

unsaturated fat.context: 医生说做菜用橄榄油比猪油好，因为橄榄油是不饱和脂肪，对心血管好，聊到健康脂肪，这时就会用到 unsaturated fat。
unsaturated fat.translation: 朋友：医生让我少吃猪油 换什么油 你：换橄榄油 它是 unsaturated fat 对血管好 朋友：那炒菜也用它 你：对
unsaturated fat.example: Friend: The doctor told me to cut lard, what oil to switch to? You: Olive oil, it is unsaturated fat, good for blood vessels. Friend: Then cook with it too. You: Right.

up.context: 你早上起床把窗户打开透气，朋友问你干嘛，你说把帘子拉起来，让太阳照进来，聊到向上，这时就会用到 up。
up.translation: 朋友：你早上起来干嘛呢 你：把窗帘拉 up 让太阳进来 朋友：那你真勤快 你：对 晒晒太阳舒服
up.example: Friend: What are you doing first thing in the morning? You: Pulling the curtains up to let the sun in. Friend: You are really diligent. You: Right, sunshine feels good.

up on the right side of bed.context: 你朋友今天一早起来就笑呵呵，说睡得特别香，朋友说他今天心情真好，聊到心情好起床，这时就会用到 up on the right side of bed。
up on the right side of bed.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么开心 你：睡了个好觉 up on the right side of bed 朋友：那今天肯定顺利 你：对 心情好
up on the right side of bed.example: Friend: Why are you so cheerful today? You: Slept great, woke up on the right side of the bed. Friend: Then today will go smoothly. You: Right, good mood.

up one's game.context: 你英语考试上次才考六十分，这次考了八十五，你说这段时间把水平提上去了，聊到提升水平，这时就会用到 up one's game。
up one's game.translation: 朋友：你这次英语怎么进步这么多 你：这俩月猛练 up my game 了 朋友：那继续保持 你：对
up one's game.example: Friend: Why did your English improve so much? You: Two months of grinding, I upped my game. Friend: Keep it up. You: Right.

up to scratch.context: 你交上去的方案领导说不行，还差得远，让你改到达标，朋友说你的水平还不够格，聊到达标，这时就会用到 up to scratch。
up to scratch.translation: 朋友：领导怎么说你方案 你：说不 up to scratch 得改到及格 朋友：那你再调调 你：对 明天交
up to scratch.example: Friend: What did the boss say about your proposal? You: Not up to scratch, revise it to a passing level. Friend: Then tweak it more. You: Right, due tomorrow.

up to us.context: 朋友问周末是看电影还是爬山，你说都行，看你想干嘛，朋友说这由你定，聊到由你决定，这时就会用到 up to us。
up to us.translation: 朋友：周末去看电影还是爬山 你：都行 你定 up to us 朋友：那爬山吧 好久没动了 你：行
up to us.example: Friend: Movies or hiking this weekend? You: Either, up to us. Friend: Then hiking, have not moved in ages. You: Okay.

up your street.context: 你朋友数学特别好，你说那你做财务肯定行，这活儿适合你，聊到正合某人所长，这时就会用到 up your street。
up your street.translation: 朋友：我想换个工作 不知道干啥 你：你数学那么好 财务 up your street 朋友：那我投投简历 你：对
up your street.example: Friend: I want to switch jobs, not sure what. You: You are so good at math, finance is up your street. Friend: Then I will send CVs. You: Right.

upcycled material.context: 你朋友做衣服用旧牛仔裤改成包包，朋友说这种改造材料就是升级再用，聊到回收再利用的材料，这时就会用到 upcycled material。
upcycled material.translation: 朋友：你这包哪儿买的 真特别 你：旧牛仔裤改的 upcycled material 朋友：那挺环保 你：对 旧物利用
upcycled material.example: Friend: Where did you get this bag, so unique? You: Made from old jeans, upcycled material. Friend: That is eco-friendly. You: Right, reusing old stuff.

update status on social media.context: 你朋友早上起来就发朋友圈，拍早餐加定位，朋友说她天天在社交网上发状态，聊到更新动态，这时就会用到 update status on social media。
update status on social media.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么天天发朋友圈 你：她爱 update status on social media 吃个饭也发 朋友：那真闲 你：对
update status on social media.example: Friend: Why does your friend post on Moments every day? You: She loves to update status on social media, even posts her meals. Friend: She is so free. You: Right.

uphill battle.context: 你创业头一年赔了不少钱，朋友说万事开头难，撑过去就好了，聊到艰难的斗争，这时就会用到 uphill battle。
uphill battle.translation: 朋友：你这店开得怎么样 你：uphill battle 头一年全在赔 朋友：那坚持下去 你：对 第二年就好了
uphill battle.example: Friend: How is your shop doing? You: An uphill battle, losing money the whole first year. Friend: Then keep going. You: Right, year two turned around.

uplift mood.context: 你周末去看了个画展，回来心情特别好，朋友说艺术作品真能让人心情好，聊到提振心情，这时就会用到 uplift mood。
uplift mood.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么高兴 你：看了个画展 特别 uplift mood 朋友：那以后多去 你：对 比喝酒舒服
uplift mood.example: Friend: Why are you so happy today? You: Saw an art show, it really uplifts the mood. Friend: Then go more often. You: Right, nicer than drinking.

upper chamber.context: 新闻说英国议会有上议院和下议院，朋友问上议院是干嘛的，聊到上议院，这时就会用到 upper chamber。
upper chamber.translation: 朋友：英国议会分两院 上院干嘛 你：upper chamber 上议院 审议法案 朋友：那有实权吗 你：对 否决议案
upper chamber.example: Friend: Britain has two houses, what does the upper one do? You: The upper chamber reviews bills. Friend: Does it have real power? You: Right, it can veto.

ups and downs.context: 你朋友这五年换了三份工作分了两次手，你说人生就是起起落落，朋友说确实，聊到起伏，这时就会用到 ups and downs。
ups and downs.translation: 朋友：这五年你过得怎样 你：ups and downs 有好有坏 朋友：那别太在意 你：对 往前看
ups and downs.example: Friend: How have these five years been? You: Ups and downs, good and bad. Friend: Then do not dwell on it. You: Right, look ahead.

upset stomach.context: 你昨天吃了坏海鲜，今天肚子一直难受，朋友说你胃不舒服，聊到闹肚子，这时就会用到 upset stomach。
upset stomach.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么不吃东西 你：早上吃了坏东西 现在 upset stomach 朋友：那喝点热水 你：对 没胃口
upset stomach.example: Friend: Why are you not eating today? You: Had something bad this morning, now an upset stomach. Friend: Then drink some hot water. You: Right, no appetite.

urban congestion.context: 新闻说大城市一到上下班就堵得走不动，朋友说这种城市交通拥堵太严重，聊到城市拥堵，这时就会用到 urban congestion。
urban congestion.translation: 朋友：这城市一到下班怎么就堵死 你：urban congestion 太严重 朋友：那骑车比开车快 你：对 二十分钟路开一小时
urban congestion.example: Friend: Why does the city gridlock at rush hour? You: Urban congestion is severe. Friend: Then cycling beats driving. You: Right, a twenty-minute trip takes an hour by car.

urban design.context: 新闻说这城市修了好多步行道和公园，朋友说这就是城市规划设计，聊到城市设计，这时就会用到 urban design。
urban design.translation: 朋友：这城市怎么到处是步行街 你：好的 urban design 让人多走路 朋友：那真舒服 你：对 比全是车道强
urban design.example: Friend: Why are there so many pedestrian streets in this city? You: Good urban design makes people walk more. Friend: That feels nice. You: Right, better than all roads.

urban environment.context: 你周末在城里转，发现到处是钢筋玻璃，没几棵树，朋友说这就是城市环境，聊到城市环境，这时就会用到 urban environment。
urban environment.translation: 朋友：你觉得这城市住着舒服吗 你：urban environment 全是高楼 没几棵树 朋友：那还是老家舒服 你：对
urban environment.example: Friend: Do you find this city comfortable to live in? You: The urban environment is all towers, hardly any trees. Friend: Then the hometown is cozier. You: Right.

urban exodus.context: 疫情那阵好多人从大城市搬到乡下，朋友说这是大家逃离城市，聊到搬离城市，这时就会用到 urban exodus。
urban exodus.translation: 朋友：疫情那阵怎么那么多人搬出城 你：一场 urban exodus 都去乡下了 朋友：那城里冷清了 你：对
urban exodus.example: Friend: Why did so many people leave the city during the pandemic? You: An urban exodus, everyone moved to the countryside. Friend: Then the city went quiet. You: Right.

urban green space.context: 你家楼下有个小公园，中午能去散步，朋友说城市里能有片绿地真难得，聊到城市绿地，这时就会用到 urban green space。
urban green space.translation: 朋友：你午休去哪儿散步 你：楼下那个 urban green space 小公园 朋友：那真方便 你：对 走两步就到
urban green space.example: Friend: Where do you walk during lunch? You: The urban green space downstairs, a small park. Friend: That is really convenient. You: Right, two steps away.

urban heat island.context: 夏天城里比乡下热好几度，朋友说这就是城市热岛效应，聊到热岛，这时就会用到 urban heat island。
urban heat island.translation: 朋友：怎么城里比老家热好几度 你：urban heat island 钢筋水泥吸热 朋友：那晚上也凉快不了 你：对
urban heat island.example: Friend: Why is the city several degrees hotter than my hometown? You: The urban heat island, concrete absorbs heat. Friend: Then it does not cool off at night either. You: Right.

urban heat island effect.context: 夏天城里晚上比乡下热，朋友问为什么，你说这就是城市热岛效应，聊到热岛效应，这时就会用到 urban heat island effect。
urban heat island effect.translation: 朋友：夏天晚上城里怎么也不凉快 你：urban heat island effect 散热慢 朋友：那开空调也没用 你：对 外面比里面还热
urban heat island effect.example: Friend: Why is the city not cool at night in summer? You: The urban heat island effect, slow to release heat. Friend: Then the AC does not help. You: Right, outside is hotter than inside.

urban jungle.context: 你朋友说大城市人挤人到处是楼，像丛林一样，朋友说这种地方就是城市丛林，聊到拥挤都市，这时就会用到 urban jungle。
urban jungle.translation: 朋友：你住的地方怎么样 你：跟 urban jungle 一样 人挤人全是楼 朋友：那你不觉得闷吗 你：习惯了
urban jungle.example: Friend: How is the place you live? You: Like an urban jungle, packed with people and towers. Friend: Do you not feel stifled? You: Used to it.

urban life.context: 你朋友在大城市上班，每天地铁外卖加班，你说这就是城市生活，聊到都市生活，这时就会用到 urban life。
urban life.translation: 朋友：你在大城市过得怎样 你：urban life 就是地铁外卖加班 朋友：那累不累 你：对 但机会多
urban life.example: Friend: How is life in the big city? You: Urban life is metro, takeout, overtime. Friend: Is it tiring? You: Right, but more opportunities.

urban mobility.context: 新闻说市政府要建专用自行车道，方便市民短途出行，朋友说这就是改善城市交通，聊到城市出行，这时就会用到 urban mobility。
urban mobility.translation: 朋友：新闻里修自行车道干嘛 你：改善 urban mobility 让骑车更方便 朋友：那以后骑车上班 你：对
urban mobility.example: Friend: Why is the news building bike lanes? You: To improve urban mobility, make cycling easier. Friend: Then cycle to work. You: Right.

urban planning.context: 新闻说这城市规划要在东边建个大公园，朋友说这就是政府在做城市规划，聊到城市规划，这时就会用到 urban planning。
urban planning.translation: 朋友：新闻说东边要建大公园 你：那是 urban planning 城市规划 朋友：那真让人期待 你：对
urban planning.example: Friend: The news says a big park in the east. You: That is urban planning. Friend: Then I am looking forward to it. You: Right.

urban sprawl.context: 新闻说城市往外一圈圈盖房子，把农田都占了，朋友说这就是城市无序扩张，聊到城市蔓延，这时就会用到 urban sprawl。
urban sprawl.translation: 朋友：怎么城郊全是新小区 你：urban sprawl 城市往外扩 朋友：那农田都没了 你：对
urban sprawl.example: Friend: Why are there new housing estates all over the suburbs? You: Urban sprawl, the city spreading out. Friend: Then the farmland is gone. You: Right.

usb stick.context: 你拷文件用个小U盘，插电脑上就能传，朋友说这小东西真方便，聊到U盘，这时就会用到 usb stick。
usb stick.translation: 朋友：你怎么传这文件 你：拷在 usb stick 里 插电脑就行 朋友：那比发邮件快 你：对 几个G秒传
usb stick.example: Friend: How do you transfer this file? You: On a usb stick, plug into the computer. Friend: Faster than email. You: Right, gigabytes in seconds.

use as.context: 你朋友把旧快递盒改成收纳盒，朋友说这盒子能当收纳用，聊到用作，这时就会用到 use as。
use as.translation: 朋友：你这收纳盒哪儿买的 你：旧快递盒 use as 收纳盒 朋友：那真省钱 你：对 不用买
use as.example: Friend: Where did you buy this storage box? You: An old shipping box used as a storage box. Friend: That saves money. You: Right, no need to buy.

use-by date.context: 你买牛奶时看包装上写着几月几日前喝完，朋友说这就是保质期，聊到食用截止日，这时就会用到 use-by date。
use-by date.translation: 朋友：这牛奶还能喝吗 你：看 use-by date 今天到期 朋友：那赶紧喝 你：对 不然坏了
use-by date.example: Friend: Is this milk still okay? You: Check the use-by date, it is due today. Friend: Then drink it fast. You: Right, or it goes off.

used to be.context: 你朋友小时候这条街全是小店，现在都变成商场了，朋友说这里以前不是这样的，聊到过去曾经，这时就会用到 used to be。
used to be.translation: 朋友：这条街怎么全是连锁店 你：used to be 全是小店 现在都拆了 朋友：那变化真大 你：对
used to be.example: Friend: Why is this street all chain stores? You: It used to be full of small shops, now they are gone. Friend: Big change. You: Right.

user review.context: 你买东西前先上网看别人评价，朋友说你真谨慎，聊到用户评价，这时就会用到 user review。
user review.translation: 朋友：你买这个吹风机怎么看那么久 你：先看 user review 用户评价 不好就不买 朋友：那真稳妥 你：对
user review.example: Friend: Why do you stare at this hairdryer for so long? You: First read the user reviews, skip if bad. Friend: That is really careful. You: Right.

uv torch.context: 你朋友拿个小紫灯照钞票验真假，朋友说这是紫外线手电，聊到紫外线灯，这时就会用到 uv torch。
uv torch.translation: 朋友：你拿紫灯照钱干嘛 你：是 uv torch 紫外线手电 验钞 朋友：那真验得出来 你：对 照水印
uv torch.example: Friend: Why are you shining a purple light at the bill? You: It is a uv torch, ultraviolet light to check notes. Friend: Does it really work? You: Right, it shows the watermark.

vacant premises.context: 你逛街看到路边那家店关了好久，朋友说那是个空铺子，聊到空置店铺，这时就会用到 vacant premises。
vacant premises.translation: 朋友：那家店怎么关门半年了 你：一直 vacant premises 空着没人租 朋友：那房租多贵 你：对
vacant premises.example: Friend: Why has that shop been closed half a year? You: It is vacant premises, empty, no tenant. Friend: Rent must be high. You: Right.

valuable lesson.context: 你上次吃了亏，后来学聪明了，朋友说这是宝贵经验，聊到宝贵教训，这时就会用到 valuable lesson。
valuable lesson.translation: 朋友：你怎么不随便借钱给人了 你：上次吃了亏 学了个 valuable lesson 朋友：那以后就懂了 你：对
valuable lesson.example: Friend: Why do you not lend money freely now? You: I got burned once, it was a valuable lesson. Friend: Then you learned. You: Right.

valuable metals.context: 你朋友收藏金币银币，说这些贵金属保值，朋友问他收藏什么，聊到贵金属，这时就会用到 valuable metals。
valuable metals.translation: 朋友：你收藏那些金币干嘛 你：valuable metals 保值 金价涨就赚 朋友：那挺稳 你：对
valuable metals.example: Friend: Why do you collect those gold coins? You: Valuable metals hold value, gain when gold rises. Friend: That is stable. You: Right.

value version.context: 你买手机预算不够，选了便宜的那款，朋友说这是基础款，聊到平价款，这时就会用到 value version。
value version.translation: 朋友：你怎么没买顶配 你：太贵 选了 value version 平价款 朋友：那够用吗 你：对 日常用够了
value version.example: Friend: Why did you not get the top model? You: Too expensive, picked the value version. Friend: Is it good enough? You: Right, fine for daily use.

variable cost.context: 你开个小店，房租水电是固定的，进货钱随销量变，朋友说那进货就是浮动成本，聊到可变成本，这时就会用到 variable cost。
variable cost.translation: 朋友：你开店成本怎么算 你：房租固定 进货是 variable cost 卖得多进得多 朋友：那销量高成本也高 你：对
variable cost.example: Friend: How do you calculate shop costs? You: Rent is fixed, stock is a variable cost, buy more when you sell more. Friend: Then costs rise with sales. You: Right.

varied and wide-ranging.context: 你朋友的爱好特别多，摄影、滑雪、弹吉他，朋友说他兴趣真广，聊到多样，这时就会用到 varied and wide-ranging。
varied and wide-ranging.translation: 朋友：他周末怎么天天不重样 你：他兴趣 varied and wide-ranging 啥都玩 朋友：那真厉害 你：对
varied and wide-ranging.example: Friend: Why is his weekend always different? You: His interests are varied and wide-ranging, he tries everything. Friend: That is impressive. You: Right.

varied from.context: 你问不同人减肥效果怎么不一样，朋友说因体质而异，聊到因人而异，这时就会用到 varied from。
varied from.translation: 朋友：他减了十斤 我才两斤 你：效果 varied from 人到人体质 朋友：那我也不焦虑了 你：对
varied from.example: Friend: He lost ten pounds, I only two. You: Results varied from person to person, body types differ. Friend: Then I will not stress. You: Right.

varies from person to person.context: 你问不同人喝咖啡会不会失眠，朋友说有的人喝了没事有的人睁眼到天亮，聊到因人而异，这时就会用到 varies from person to person。
varies from person to person.translation: 朋友：你喝咖啡失眠吗 你：vary from person to person 我喝了没事 朋友：我喝了睁眼到天亮 你：对
varies from person to person.example: Friend: Does coffee keep you up? You: It varies from person to person, I am fine. Friend: I stay up all night. You: Right.

varieties of.context: 超市里零食架上摆着薯片饼干果冻，各种各样，朋友说这货架真丰富，聊到各种各样的，这时就会用到 varieties of。
varieties of.translation: 朋友：零食架上怎么这么多 你：varieties of 薯片饼干果冻 啥都有 朋友：那挑花眼 你：对
varieties of.example: Friend: Why is the snack shelf so full? You: Varieties of chips, cookies, jelly, everything. Friend: Then it is hard to pick. You: Right.

vary considerably.context: 你问不同人工作效率差多少，朋友说有的人一小时干完你一天的活，聊到差异很大，这时就会用到 vary considerably。
vary considerably.translation: 朋友：你们组谁干活最快 你：效率 vary considerably 老王一小时顶我一天 朋友：那真厉害 你：对
vary considerably.example: Friend: Who works fastest in your group? You: Efficiency varies considerably, Old Wang does a day of mine in an hour. Friend: Impressive. You: Right.

vary from.context: 不同地方的早餐不一样，南方吃米北方吃面，朋友说各地饮食不同，聊到不同于，这时就会用到 vary from。
vary from.translation: 朋友：南方早餐吃什么 你：vary from 北方 那边吃米我们吃面 朋友：那豆腐脑甜咸也吵 你：对
vary from.example: Friend: What do people eat for breakfast in the south? You: It varies from the north, rice there, noodles here. Friend: Even sweet vs salty tofu pudding. You: Right.

vast expanse.context: 你坐火车穿过大草原，一眼望不到边，朋友说这就是辽阔的大地，聊到广袤空间，这时就会用到 vast expanse。
vast expanse.translation: 朋友：窗外那片草地真宽 你：a vast expanse 一眼望不到边 朋友：那真敞亮 你：对
vast expanse.example: Friend: That grassland outside the window is so wide. You: A vast expanse, as far as the eye sees. Friend: That feels open. You: Right.

veer off.context: 你朋友聊工作聊到一半突然开始聊周末去哪玩，你说他跑题了，聊到偏离，这时就会用到 veer off。
veer off.translation: 朋友：咱们刚才说什么来着 你：你 veer off 了 刚说工作 现在聊周末 朋友：哈哈 我走神了 你：对
veer off.example: Friend: What were we talking about? You: You veered off, work, then weekends. Friend: Haha, I got sidetracked. You: Right.

vegan burger.context: 你朋友吃素，去快餐店点了个素汉堡，朋友说这就是植物做的汉堡，聊到素汉堡，这时就会用到 vegan burger。
vegan burger.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么吃汉堡了 你：vegan burger 素的 没肉 朋友：那跟真的像吗 你：对 味道差不多
vegan burger.example: Friend: Why are you eating a burger today? You: A vegan burger, plant-based, no meat. Friend: Does it taste like the real thing? You: Right, pretty close.

vegan diet.context: 你朋友全素饮食，不吃肉蛋奶，朋友说这种饮食对身体要求高，聊到纯素饮食，这时就会用到 vegan diet。
vegan diet.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么只吃菜 你：vegan diet 全素 肉蛋奶都不碰 朋友：那蛋白质够吗 你：对 吃豆制品
vegan diet.example: Friend: Why does your friend only eat greens? You: A vegan diet, no meat, dairy, eggs. Friend: Is protein enough? You: Right, from soy.

vegan ice cream.context: 你朋友不吃奶制品，买冰淇淋也买纯素的，朋友说那是植物做的冰淇淋，聊到纯素冰淇淋，这时就会用到 vegan ice cream。
vegan ice cream.translation: 朋友：你这冰淇淋怎么不凉 你：vegan ice cream 椰子做的 没奶 朋友：那味道怪吗 你：对 还行
vegan ice cream.example: Friend: Why is this ice cream not creamy? You: Vegan ice cream, made from coconut, no dairy. Friend: Does it taste odd? You: Right, okay.

vegan makeup.context: 你朋友买化妆品只选不做动物实验的，朋友说这就是纯素彩妆，聊到无动物实验化妆品，这时就会用到 vegan makeup。
vegan makeup.translation: 朋友：你这化妆品什么牌子 你：vegan makeup 纯素 不做动物实验 朋友：那真良心 你：对
vegan makeup.example: Friend: What brand is this makeup? You: Vegan makeup, no animal testing. Friend: That is really ethical. You: Right.

vellus hair.context: 婴儿脸上一层细细的小绒毛，朋友说那是胎毛，聊到细软汗毛，这时就会用到 vellus hair。
vellus hair.translation: 朋友：婴儿脸上那层小绒毛是啥 你：vellus hair 胎毛 长大就掉 朋友：那真可爱 你：对
vellus hair.example: Friend: What is that fine fuzz on the baby's face? You: Vellus hair, baby fuzz, falls out as they grow. Friend: So cute. You: Right.

venture into.context: 你朋友辞职去开了个咖啡店，朋友说他敢进入全新行业，聊到涉足新领域，这时就会用到 venture into。
venture into.translation: 朋友：他怎么不开公司去开咖啡店 你：他 venture into 餐饮 从零开始 朋友：那真需要勇气 你：对
venture into.example: Friend: Why did he leave the firm to open a cafe? You: He ventured into the food business, from scratch. Friend: That takes courage. You: Right.

verbal abuse.context: 你朋友在公司被领导当众骂哭，朋友说这就是言语伤害，聊到辱骂，这时就会用到 verbal abuse。
verbal abuse.translation: 朋友：她今天怎么哭着出来 你：被领导 verbal abuse 当众骂 朋友：那太过分了 你：对
verbal abuse.example: Friend: Why did she come out crying? You: Verbal abuse from the boss, yelled at in public. Friend: That is too much. You: Right.

verbal agreement.context: 你和朋友口头说好了周末一起搬家，没写合同，朋友说那就这么定了，聊到口头约定，这时就会用到 verbal agreement。
verbal agreement.translation: 朋友：搬家那事说好了吗 你：verbal agreement 口头说定了 周末 朋友：那别变卦 你：对
verbal agreement.example: Friend: Is the moving day settled? You: A verbal agreement, said it for the weekend. Friend: Then do not back out. You: Right.

verbal threat.context: 你朋友在街上被人指着鼻子骂，他说那人没动手但语言威胁他，聊到言语威胁，这时就会用到 verbal threat。
verbal threat.translation: 朋友：那人怎么惹你了 你：对我 verbal threat 骂我 没动手 朋友：那也够烦 你：对
verbal threat.example: Friend: How did that person bother you? You: A verbal threat, yelling at me, no physical act. Friend: That is annoying too. You: Right.

vertical farming.context: 新闻说楼顶一层一层种菜，不用土地，朋友说这就是垂直农业，聊到垂直种植，这时就会用到 vertical farming。
vertical farming.translation: 朋友：新闻里那些菜怎么在楼里种 你：vertical farming 垂直农业 一层一层叠着 朋友：那真省地 你：对
vertical farming.example: Friend: How are vegetables grown in the building in the news? You: Vertical farming, stacked in layers. Friend: That saves land. You: Right.

vertical take-off.context: 电影里飞机不用跑道直接垂直起飞，朋友说那是垂直起降技术，聊到垂直起飞，这时就会用到 vertical take-off。
vertical take-off.translation: 朋友：那飞机怎么不用跑道就起来了 你：vertical take-off 垂直起降技术 朋友：那真科幻 你：对
vertical take-off.example: Friend: How did that plane take off without a runway? You: Vertical take-off technology. Friend: That is so sci-fi. You: Right.

video assistant referee.context: 足球比赛进球了教练说越位，裁判回看录像确认，朋友说这就是视频裁判，聊到VAR，这时就会用到 video assistant referee。
video assistant referee.translation: 朋友：裁判怎么看个屏幕 朋友：video assistant referee 视频助理裁判 朋友：那真改判了 你：对
video assistant referee.example: Friend: Why is the referee staring at a screen? Friend: Video assistant referee, VAR review. Friend: Did they overturn the call? You: Right.

video chat.context: 你跟外地的朋友用手机视频聊天，一边吃一边聊，朋友说这比打电话强，能看见脸，聊到视频通话，这时就会用到 video chat。
video chat.translation: 朋友：你周末跟朋友怎么联系 你：video chat 视频聊天 一边吃一边聊 朋友：那比打电话强 你：对
video chat.example: Friend: How do you stay in touch with your out-of-town friend? You: Video chat, eating while talking. Friend: That beats a call. You: Right.

viewed as.context: 你做事特别认真，同事都说你是个靠谱的人，聊到被看作，这时就会用到 viewed as。
viewed as.translation: 朋友：大家怎么评价你 你：viewed as 靠谱的人 交给我的事都办好 朋友：那真难得 你：对
viewed as.example: Friend: What do people think of you? You: Viewed as reliable, things given to me get done. Friend: That is rare. You: Right.

vintage clothing.context: 你朋友在古着店买了件二十年的旧皮衣，说这是复古衣服，聊到复古服装，这时就会用到 vintage clothing。
vintage clothing.translation: 朋友：你这件皮衣真有味道 你：vintage clothing 二十年的老货 朋友：那比新的还有型 你：对
vintage clothing.example: Friend: This leather jacket of yours has character. You: Vintage clothing, a twenty-year-old piece. Friend: Better than new for style. You: Right.

vintage garment.context: 你朋友收藏了件七十年代的旧裙子，说这是复古衣物，聊到古着，这时就会用到 vintage garment。
vintage garment.translation: 朋友：你柜子里那条老裙子哪儿来的 你：vintage garment 七十年代的老货 朋友：那真有年头 你：对
vintage garment.example: Friend: Where did that old dress in your closet come from? You: A vintage garment from the seventies. Friend: That has real history. You: Right.

vintage toy.context: 你朋友抽屉里留着小时候的铁皮小汽车，说这是他最珍贵的老玩具，聊到复古玩具，这时就会用到 vintage toy。
vintage toy.translation: 朋友：你抽屉里那个小汽车是啥 你：小时候的 vintage toy 老铁皮车 朋友：那留到现在真不容易 你：对
vintage toy.example: Friend: What is that little car in your drawer? You: A vintage toy from childhood, an old tin car. Friend: Keeping it till now is rare. You: Right.

virtual assistant.context: 你手机里装了个语音助手，帮你设闹钟查天气，朋友说这就是虚拟助手，聊到AI助手，这时就会用到 virtual assistant。
virtual assistant.translation: 朋友：你手机里那个小声音是啥 你：virtual assistant 虚拟助手 帮我设闹钟 朋友：那真方便 你：对
virtual assistant.example: Friend: What is that little voice on your phone? You: A virtual assistant, sets my alarms. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

virtual books.context: 你用平板看书，书里不是纸而是电子版，朋友说这就是电子书，聊到虚拟图书，这时就会用到 virtual books。
virtual books.translation: 朋友：你这平板里怎么装了几百本书 你：virtual books 电子版 不占地方 朋友：那比书架方便 你：对
virtual books.example: Friend: Why are there hundreds of books on your tablet? You: Virtual books, electronic versions, no shelf space. Friend: Handier than a bookshelf. You: Right.

virtual currency.context: 你玩游戏赚了金币能换装备，朋友说那就是游戏里的虚拟钱，聊到虚拟货币，这时就会用到 virtual currency。
virtual currency.translation: 朋友：你游戏里那些金币能换啥 你：virtual currency 换装备 朋友：那能提现吗 你：不行
virtual currency.example: Friend: What can you trade those gold coins in the game for? You: Virtual currency for gear. Friend: Can you cash it out? You: No.

virtual friend.context: 你在网上聊了个很投机的朋友，从没见过面，朋友说这就是网友，聊到网友，这时就会用到 virtual friend。
virtual friend.translation: 朋友：你天天跟谁聊天呢 你：一个 virtual friend 网友 没见过面 朋友：那真靠谱吗 你：对 聊得来
virtual friend.example: Friend: Who are you chatting with every day? You: A virtual friend online, never met. Friend: Are they really reliable? You: Right, we click.

virtual online world.context: 你玩网络游戏，一进游戏就像进了另一个世界，朋友说这就是虚拟网络世界，聊到网游世界，这时就会用到 virtual online world。
virtual online world.translation: 朋友：你怎么一下班就玩那个游戏 你：在 virtual online world 里跟朋友一起玩 朋友：那真像另一个世界 你：对
virtual online world.example: Friend: Why do you jump into that game right after work? You: In the virtual online world, playing with friends. Friend: It feels like another world. You: Right.

virtual reality.context: 你戴个眼镜玩游戏，感觉人就在游戏里，朋友说这就是虚拟现实，聊到VR，这时就会用到 virtual reality。
virtual reality.translation: 朋友：你戴那个眼镜干嘛 你：virtual reality 虚拟现实 人就在游戏里 朋友：那真晕吗 你：对 玩久了
virtual reality.example: Friend: What are you doing with those glasses? You: Virtual reality, you are inside the game. Friend: Does it make you dizzy? You: Right, after a while.

virtual teacher.context: 现在有AI老师在线教课，朋友说那就是虚拟老师，聊到AI教师，这时就会用到 virtual teacher。
virtual teacher.translation: 朋友：你这英语课是真人教吗 你：virtual teacher AI 虚拟老师 二十四小时能问 朋友：那真方便 你：对
virtual teacher.example: Friend: Is your English class taught by a real person? You: A virtual teacher, AI, ask anytime. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

virtual team.context: 你跟外地同事一起做项目，从没见过面，全靠线上开会，朋友说这就是远程团队，聊到虚拟团队，这时就会用到 virtual team。
virtual team.translation: 朋友：你们同事见过面吗 你：没见过 virtual team 全线上开会 朋友：那怎么配合 你：对 靠文档
virtual team.example: Friend: Have you met your coworkers? You: No, a virtual team, all online calls. Friend: How do you coordinate? You: Right, by docs.

virtual world.context: 你玩个游戏，进去像活在另一个世界里，朋友说这就是虚拟世界，聊到虚拟世界，这时就会用到 virtual world。
virtual world.translation: 朋友：你玩那游戏怎么那么投入 你：进去像另一个 virtual world 朋友：那真容易上瘾 你：对
virtual world.example: Friend: Why are you so immersed in that game? You: It feels like another virtual world once you enter. Friend: That is addictive. You: Right.

virtuous circle.context: 你早睡早起，精神好工作效率高，加班少了，朋友说这就是良性循环，聊到良性循环，这时就会用到 virtuous circle。
virtuous circle.translation: 朋友：你最近状态怎么这么好 你：早睡早起 virtuous circle 效率高不加班 朋友：那真难得 你：对
virtuous circle.example: Friend: Why is your state so good lately? You: Early nights, a virtuous circle, efficient, no overtime. Friend: That is rare. You: Right.

visceral fat.context: 你体检说肚子上肥肉多，医生说那是内脏脂肪，聊到内脏脂肪，这时就会用到 visceral fat。
visceral fat.translation: 朋友：医生说我哪儿胖 你：肚子上 visceral fat 内脏脂肪 危险 朋友：那怎么减 你：对 少吃多动
visceral fat.example: Friend: Where did the doctor say I am fat? You: Visceral fat around the belly, dangerous. Friend: How to lose it? You: Right, eat less, move more.

visual chaos.context: 你房间里堆了书衣服外卖盒，看着乱，朋友说这就是视觉杂乱，聊到视觉混乱，这时就会用到 visual chaos。
visual chaos.translation: 朋友：你房间怎么那么乱 你：到处堆东西 visual chaos 看着就烦 朋友：那收拾一下 你：对
visual chaos.example: Friend: Why is your room so messy? You: Stuff everywhere, visual chaos, it stresses me. Friend: Then tidy up. You: Right.

visual development.context: 你朋友的孩子三岁了还不会追视物体，医生说要检查视力发育，朋友问这是什么，聊到视觉发育，这时就会用到 visual development。
visual development.translation: 朋友：你家孩子怎么不追着东西看 你：医生说要查 visual development 视力发育 朋友：那早发现早好 你：对
visual development.example: Friend: Why does your kid not track objects? You: The doctor wants to check visual development. Friend: Early detection is better. You: Right.

visual health.context: 你天天对着电脑看一天，眼睛干涩，医生说要注意视力健康，聊到视觉健康，这时就会用到 visual health。
visual health.translation: 朋友：你眼睛怎么老干涩 你：天天对电脑 visual health 差 朋友：那一小时远眺一次 你：对
visual health.example: Friend: Why are your eyes always dry? You: Staring at the screen all day, poor visual health. Friend: Then look away every hour. You: Right.

visual system.context: 你看科普讲眼睛怎么看到东西，朋友问这是什么系统，聊到视觉系统，这时就会用到 visual system。
visual system.translation: 朋友：眼睛怎么就能看到东西 你：靠 visual system 视觉系统 眼睛加大脑 朋友：那真神奇 你：对
visual system.example: Friend: How do eyes actually see? You: Through the visual system, eyes and brain working together. Friend: That is amazing. You: Right.

visually demanding.context: 你朋友做设计天天对着屏幕画图，眼睛酸得不行，医生说这种活儿特别费眼，聊到费眼的工作，这时就会用到 visually demanding。
visually demanding.translation: 朋友：你做设计眼睛怎么老酸 你：这活儿 visually demanding 天天盯屏幕 朋友：那多滴眼药水 你：对
visually demanding.example: Friend: Why are your eyes always sore doing design? You: The work is visually demanding, staring at the screen all day. Friend: Then use more eye drops. You: Right.

visually impaired.context: 你朋友眼睛看不见，靠盲杖走路，朋友说那就是视障人士，聊到视障，这时就会用到 visually impaired。
visually impaired.translation: 朋友：那个人怎么拿根棍子走路 你：他 visually impaired 视障 靠盲杖 朋友：那我们过马路让让他 你：对
visually impaired.example: Friend: Why is that person walking with a cane? You: They are visually impaired, using a white cane. Friend: Then let them cross. You: Right.

vital oil.context: 医生说皮肤要靠自身油脂保护，洗太干净反而干，朋友问那是什么油脂，聊到皮肤油脂，这时就会用到 vital oil。
vital oil.translation: 朋友：我脸怎么越洗越干 你：皮肤那层 vital oil 被你洗掉了 朋友：那怎么办 你：对 少用洗面奶
vital oil.example: Friend: Why does my face get drier the more I wash? You: You washed off the skin's vital oil. Friend: Then what? You: Right, use less cleanser.

vital sign.context: 护士给病人量血压脉搏体温，朋友说这是在查生命体征，聊到生命体征，这时就会用到 vital sign。
vital sign.translation: 朋友：护士天天来量什么 你：量血压脉搏 查 vital sign 生命体征 朋友：那真负责 你：对
vital sign.example: Friend: What does the nurse measure every day? You: Blood pressure and pulse, checking vital signs. Friend: That is really thorough. You: Right.

vitamin d.context: 医生说多晒太阳补维生素D，朋友问为什么要补，聊到维生素D，这时就会用到 vitamin d。
vitamin d.translation: 朋友：医生为什么让我多晒太阳 你：晒太阳能补 vitamin d 对骨头好 朋友：那阴天怎么办 你：对 吃补剂
vitamin d.example: Friend: Why did the doctor tell me to sunbathe? You: Sunlight gives vitamin D, good for bones. Friend: What about cloudy days? You: Right, take supplements.

vivid dream.context: 你昨晚做了个特别真实的梦，梦里在飞，朋友问你怎么了，聊到栩栩如生的梦，这时就会用到 vivid dream。
vivid dream.translation: 朋友：你早上起来咋一脸懵 你：做了个 vivid dream 梦见自己在飞 朋友：那真爽 你：对 醒来还失落
vivid dream.example: Friend: Why do you look dazed this morning? You: I had a vivid dream, I was flying. Friend: That must feel great. You: Right, I was disappointed waking up.

vocal cord.context: 你朋友唱歌唱多了嗓子哑，医生说他声带肿了，聊到声带，这时就会用到 vocal cord。
vocal cord.translation: 朋友：你嗓子怎么哑了 你：唱K唱多了 vocal cord 肿了 朋友：那别再唱了 你：对 喝胖大海
vocal cord.example: Friend: Why is your voice gone? You: Sang too much at karaoke, my vocal cord is swollen. Friend: Then stop singing. You: Right, drink luo han guo.

vocal range.context: 你朋友唱歌特别高，能唱高音，朋友说他音域真宽，聊到音域，这时就会用到 vocal range。
vocal range.translation: 朋友：他怎么能唱那么高 你：他 vocal range 宽 高音随便上 朋友：那真羡慕 你：对
vocal range.example: Friend: How can he sing so high? You: He has a wide vocal range, hits high notes easily. Friend: I envy that. You: Right.

vocational qualification.context: 你朋友考了个电工证，说有了证就能上岗，朋友问这是什么证，聊到职业资格证，这时就会用到 vocational qualification。
vocational qualification.translation: 朋友：你新考的那个证干嘛用 你：vocational qualification 职业证书 上岗用 朋友：那好找工作 你：对
vocational qualification.example: Friend: What is that new certificate you studied for? You: A vocational qualification, needed for the job. Friend: Then it helps with jobs. You: Right.

voice assistant.context: 你手机里那个小语音助手能帮你设提醒，朋友问它叫什么，聊到语音助手，这时就会用到 voice assistant。
voice assistant.translation: 朋友：你手机里那个小声音能干嘛 你：voice assistant 语音助手 帮我设提醒 朋友：那真方便 你：对
voice assistant.example: Friend: What can that little voice on your phone do? You: A voice assistant, sets my reminders. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

voice message.context: 你打电话没人接，留了言让对方回电，朋友说那就是语音留言，聊到语音信箱留言，这时就会用到 voice message。
voice message.translation: 朋友：你打电话找到他没 你：没人接 留了 voice message 让他回电 朋友：那他会回吗 你：对 看到就回
voice message.example: Friend: Did you reach him on the phone? You: No answer, left a voice message asking him to call back. Friend: Will he call back? You: Right, once he sees it.

voice note.context: 你朋友发微信不打字，一条一条语音发过来，朋友说这就是语音条，聊到语音消息，这时就会用到 voice note。
voice note.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么不打字 你：爱发 voice note 一条六十秒 朋友：那听着累 你：对
voice note.example: Friend: Why does your friend not type? You: Loves sending voice notes, a minute each. Friend: That is tiring to listen to. You: Right.
