volatile oils.context: 精油打开瓶子就闻到香味，朋友说这就是挥发性的精油，聊到挥发油，这时就会用到 volatile oils。
volatile oils.translation: 朋友：你这精油一打开就香 你：它含 volatile oils 挥发油 朋友：那得盖紧 你：对 不然散了
volatile oils.example: Friend: Why does this essential oil smell the moment you open it? You: It contains volatile oils that evaporate. Friend: Then keep it sealed. You: Right, or the scent fades.

vote on.context: 公司问大家周五下午要不要提前下班，让大家投票，朋友说这是大家投票决定，聊到投票，这时就会用到 vote on。
vote on.translation: 朋友：公司说周五下午提前下班 真的吗 你：大家 vote on 投票决定 朋友：那我投赞成 你：对
vote on.example: Friend: Is it true the company lets us leave early Friday afternoon? You: We vote on it as a group. Friend: Then I vote yes. You: Right.

vulnerable core.context: 你朋友外表看着特别坚强，其实内心很脆弱，朋友说他就是外强中干，聊到脆弱内心，这时就会用到 vulnerable core。
vulnerable core.translation: 朋友：他看着那么坚强 怎么也哭了 你：他外表 tough 但 vulnerable core 内心脆弱 朋友：那我们多陪他 你：对
vulnerable core.example: Friend: He looks so tough, why is he crying? You: Tough on the outside but a vulnerable core inside. Friend: Then we keep him company. You: Right.

wag its tail.context: 你一回家狗就跑过来摇尾巴，朋友说它真开心，聊到摇尾巴，这时就会用到 wag its tail。
wag its tail.translation: 朋友：你家狗怎么一开门就蹦 你：看见我开心 wag its tail 朋友：那真热情 你：对
wag its tail.example: Friend: Why does your dog jump up the moment the door opens? You: Happy to see me, wagging its tail. Friend: That is so warm. You: Right.

wage increase.context: 新闻说公司今年涨工资了，朋友说这就是工资增长，聊到加薪，这时就会用到 wage increase。
wage increase.translation: 朋友：今年公司效益怎么样 你：给大家涨工资了 一个 wage increase 朋友：那你多挣多少 你：五百
wage increase.example: Friend: How is the company doing this year? You: A wage increase for everyone. Friend: How much more do you make? You: Five hundred.

wage increases.context: 新闻说经济好，企业纷纷涨工资，朋友说今年工资增长普遍，聊到多次加薪，这时就会用到 wage increases。
wage increases.translation: 朋友：今年是不是都涨工资了 你：经济好 到处 wage increases 朋友：那你也该涨 你：对
wage increases.example: Friend: Is everyone getting a raise this year? You: Economy is good, wage increases everywhere. Friend: Then you should too. You: Right.

wait it out.context: 外面下大暴雨出不去，朋友说那就等雨停了再说，聊到熬过去，这时就会用到 wait it out。
wait it out.translation: 朋友：外面下大暴雨 还出去吗 你：wait it out 等雨停 朋友：那就在家喝茶 你：对
wait it out.example: Friend: It is pouring outside, still going out? You: Wait it out till the rain stops. Friend: Then have tea at home. You: Right.

wait out.context: 你航班延误了三小时，朋友说就在机场坐着等吧，聊到等过去，这时就会用到 wait out。
wait out.translation: 朋友：航班延误了 你：wait out 这段延误 三小时 朋友：那在机场干嘛 你：对 看书
wait out.example: Friend: The flight is delayed. You: Wait out the delay, three hours. Friend: What to do at the airport. You: Right, read a book.

waiting for.context: 你在车站等朋友，朋友问你干嘛呢，你说在等人，聊到等待，这时就会用到 waiting for。
waiting for.translation: 朋友：你在车站站着干嘛 你：waiting for 朋友 他晚到十分钟 朋友：那你别着急 你：对
waiting for.example: Friend: Why are you standing at the station? You: Waiting for a friend, he is ten minutes late. Friend: Then do not rush. You: Right.

wake up startled.context: 你昨晚做噩梦，半夜突然惊醒，朋友问你怎么了，聊到惊醒，这时就会用到 wake up startled。
wake up startled.translation: 朋友：你昨晚怎么叫了一声 你：做噩梦 wake up startled 吓醒了 朋友：那没事吧 你：对 缓了一会
wake up startled.example: Friend: Why did you cry out last night? You: A nightmare, woke up startled. Friend: Are you okay? You: Right, took a while to settle.

wake up to.context: 你朋友最近才意识到熬夜伤身体，开始早睡，朋友说他终于明白了，聊到意识到，这时就会用到 wake up to。
wake up to.translation: 朋友：他怎么开始早睡了 你：他终于 wake up to 熬夜伤身 开始改 朋友：那早该这样 你：对
wake up to.example: Friend: Why is he going to bed early now? You: He finally woke up to how bad late nights are, now he is changing. Friend: Should have done it long ago. You: Right.

wake-up call.context: 你朋友上次考砸了，那事给他敲响警钟，现在开始拼命学，朋友说那是个教训，聊到警钟，这时就会用到 wake-up call。
wake-up call.translation: 朋友：他怎么突然拼命学习 你：上次考砸是个 wake-up call 警钟 朋友：那早该努力 你：对
wake-up call.example: Friend: Why is he suddenly studying hard? You: The last failure was a wake-up call. Friend: He should have worked hard earlier. You: Right.

walk down.context: 你吃完饭沿着街慢慢散步，朋友问你去哪，你说随便走走，聊到沿街散步，这时就会用到 walk down。
walk down.translation: 朋友：你饭后去哪儿 你：walk down 这条街 消消食 朋友：那慢慢走 别跑 你：对
walk down.example: Friend: Where are you going after dinner? You: Walk down this street to digest. Friend: Then take it slow, no running. You: Right.

walk down the street.context: 你周末没事干，一个人沿街溜达看橱窗，朋友说你在逛街，聊到沿街走，这时就会用到 walk down the street。
walk down the street.translation: 朋友：你周末一个人去哪了 你：walk down the street 沿街溜达 看橱窗 朋友：那挺舒服 你：对
walk down the street.example: Friend: Where did you go alone this weekend? You: Walked down the street, window-shopping. Friend: That is relaxing. You: Right.

walk in the footsteps of.context: 你朋友爸爸是医生，他也学医，朋友说他追随父亲的脚步，聊到追随前人，这时就会用到 walk in the footsteps of。
walk in the footsteps of.translation: 朋友：他怎么也当医生了 你：他 walk in the footsteps of 他爸 也是医生 朋友：那子承父业 你：对
walk in the footsteps of.example: Friend: Why did he become a doctor too? You: He walked in the footsteps of his father, also a doctor. Friend: Then he followed his dad. You: Right.

walk into.context: 你刚进公司第一天，走错会议室撞到领导，朋友说你刚进来就出洋相，聊到不小心陷入，这时就会用到 walk into。
walk into.translation: 朋友：你今天第一天上班怎么了 你：walk into 错会议室 撞到领导 朋友：那真尴尬 你：对
walk into.example: Friend: What happened on your first day? You: Walked into the wrong meeting room, bumped the boss. Friend: That is awkward. You: Right.

walk out.context: 开会时领导说话太难听，他一拍桌子走了出去，朋友说他这是退场抗议，聊到愤然离开，这时就会用到 walk out。
walk out.translation: 朋友：他怎么开会走了 你：领导说话难听 他 walk out 了 朋友：那领导生气吗 你：对
walk out.example: Friend: Why did he leave the meeting? You: The boss spoke harshly, he walked out. Friend: Is the boss angry? You: Right.

walk out of.context: 电影演到一半太烂了，朋友说咱们走吧，两人直接离场，聊到愤然离开，这时就会用到 walk out of。
walk out of.translation: 朋友：这电影太烂了 还看吗 你：walk out of 电影院 不看了 朋友：那票钱白花 你：对
walk out of.example: Friend: This film is terrible, still watching? You: Walk out of the cinema, done with it. Friend: Then the ticket money is wasted. You: Right.

walk through.context: 新员工入职，老员工带他一步一步讲怎么用系统，朋友说这就是手把手教，聊到带教，这时就会用到 walk through。
walk through.translation: 朋友：新员工多久能上手 你：老员工带他 walk through 每一步 朋友：那真负责 你：对
walk through.example: Friend: How long till the new hire is up to speed? You: A senior walks them through every step. Friend: That is really helpful. You: Right.

walking pace.context: 医生看一个老人走路速度，说走得慢说明衰老快，朋友问这是什么指标，聊到步速，这时就会用到 walking pace。
walking pace.translation: 朋友：医生为什么看你走路快慢 你：walking pace 是衰老指标 走得慢老得快 朋友：那多走路 你：对
walking pace.example: Friend: Why did the doctor watch how fast you walk? You: Walking pace is an aging marker, slow means faster aging. Friend: Then walk more. You: Right.

wander away.context: 你朋友带小孩去公园，一转眼孩子不见了，朋友说孩子走丢了，聊到走失，这时就会用到 wander away。
wander away.translation: 朋友：你孩子怎么不见了 你：他 wander away 了 一眨眼就没影 朋友：那赶紧找 你：对
wander away.example: Friend: Where did your kid go? You: He wandered away, gone in a blink. Friend: Then find him fast. You: Right.

wander round.context: 你周末没事在老街上闲逛，朋友问你去哪，你说随便走走，聊到闲逛，这时就会用到 wander round。
wander round.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪了 你：wander round 老街 随便走 朋友：那真自在 你：对
wander round.example: Friend: Where did you go this weekend? You: Wandered round the old town, just strolling. Friend: That is free and easy. You: Right.

wander through.context: 你逛博物馆一间一间慢慢看，朋友说你在馆里穿梭，聊到闲逛，这时就会用到 wander through。
wander through.translation: 朋友：你在博物馆看了多久 你：wander through 一间一间看 三小时 朋友：那真过瘾 你：对
wander through.example: Friend: How long did you spend in the museum? You: Wandered through hall after hall, three hours. Friend: That is a blast. You: Right.

warehouse-style stores.context: 你去那种大超市，像仓库一样堆着货，朋友说这就是仓储式商店，聊到大卖场，这时就会用到 warehouse-style stores。
warehouse-style stores.translation: 朋友：你去的那个超市怎么像仓库 你：warehouse-style stores 仓储式 货堆一地 朋友：那真便宜 你：对
warehouse-style stores.example: Friend: Why does that supermarket look like a warehouse? You: Warehouse-style stores, goods stacked on pallets. Friend: Then it is really cheap. You: Right.

warm indoor activity.context: 冬天太冷不想出门，在家看书喝茶，朋友说这种室内活动真暖和，聊到室内暖身活动，这时就会用到 warm indoor activity。
warm indoor activity.translation: 朋友：冬天你周末干嘛 你：看书喝茶 warm indoor activity 不出门 朋友：那真舒服 你：对
warm indoor activity.example: Friend: What do you do on winter weekends? You: Reading and tea, a warm indoor activity, no going out. Friend: That is cozy. You: Right.

warms up.context: 你跑步前先慢走两圈活动关节，朋友说这是热身，聊到热身，这时就会用到 warms up。
warms up.translation: 朋友：你跑步前先干嘛 你：先慢走两圈 warms up 关节 朋友：那真专业 你：对 防止拉伤
warms up.example: Friend: What do you do before running? You: Brisk walk two laps to warm up the joints. Friend: That is really professional. You: Right, prevents strains.

warn of.context: 新闻说气象台发布台风预警，朋友说这是在警示大家，聊到预警，这时就会用到 warn of。
warn of.translation: 朋友：新闻说台风要来了 你：气象台 warn of 大风暴雨 朋友：那别出门 你：对
warn of.example: Friend: The news says a typhoon is coming. You: The meteorological office warns of strong winds and rain. Friend: Then stay indoors. You: Right.

warning sign.context: 你朋友最近老头疼还失眠，医生说这是身体报警的信号，聊到警示信号，这时就会用到 warning sign。
warning sign.translation: 朋友：他最近怎么老头疼 你：医生说这是 warning sign 身体在报警 朋友：那他得休息 你：对
warning sign.example: Friend: Why has he had headaches lately? You: The doctor says it is a warning sign from the body. Friend: Then he needs rest. You: Right.

warning signs.context: 医生说血压高、血糖高都是身体出问题的信号，聊到警示信号，这时就会用到 warning signs。
warning signs.translation: 朋友：体检报告怎么看 你：血压高血糖高都是 warning signs 朋友：那得注意 你：对
warning signs.example: Friend: How do you read the check-up report? You: High blood pressure and sugar are warning signs. Friend: Then take care. You: Right.

warts and all.context: 你朋友给你介绍他弟弟，说人有点小毛病但总体不错，聊到不完美的全貌，这时就会用到 warts and all。
warts and all.translation: 朋友：我弟弟人怎么样 你：warts and all 有点小毛病 但总体靠谱 朋友：那行 你：对
warts and all.example: Friend: How is my brother? You: Warts and all, a few flaws but overall reliable. Friend: Okay then. You: Right.

was jailed for.context: 新闻说那个人因为诈骗被判了五年，聊到因罪入狱，这时就会用到 was jailed for。
was jailed for.translation: 朋友：新闻里那人怎么了 你：was jailed for 诈骗 判了五年 朋友：那罪有应得 你：对
was jailed for.example: Friend: What happened to that person in the news? You: He was jailed for fraud for five years. Friend: Serves him right. You: Right.

wash into.context: 暴雨把山上的泥冲进河里，朋友说这就是被水冲下来的，聊到冲入，这时就会用到 wash into。
wash into.translation: 朋友：河里那黄泥哪来的 你：暴雨 wash into 河里的 山上冲下来的 朋友：那水都浑了 你：对
wash into.example: Friend: Where did the mud in the river come from? You: Washed into the river by the storm, off the hills. Friend: Then the water is all muddy. You: Right.

wash up.context: 海边冲上来好多贝壳，朋友说这是被浪打上岸的，聊到被冲上岸，这时就会用到 wash up。
wash up.translation: 朋友：海滩上那些贝壳哪来的 你：被浪 wash up 上岸的 朋友：那捡点回家 你：对
wash up.example: Friend: Where did all those shells on the beach come from? You: Washed up by the waves. Friend: Then collect some. You: Right.

wash up on.context: 海边冲上来一只大海龟，朋友说这是被浪打上岸的，聊到冲上岸，这时就会用到 wash up on。
wash up on.translation: 朋友：海滩那只大海龟怎么上来的 你：wash up on 岸 被浪打上来的 朋友：那送回海里 你：对
wash up on.example: Friend: How did that big turtle get on the beach? You: Washed up on shore by the waves. Friend: Then send it back. You: Right.

waste diversion.context: 社区搞垃圾分类，把能回收的单独分出来，朋友说这就是垃圾分流，聊到垃圾分类回收，这时就会用到 waste diversion。
waste diversion.translation: 朋友：社区搞垃圾分类干嘛 你：waste diversion 把能回收的分出来 朋友：那真环保 你：对
waste diversion.example: Friend: Why is the community sorting waste? You: Waste diversion, separating recyclables. Friend: That is really eco-friendly. You: Right.

waste energy.context: 你家电充电器插着不拔，朋友说这样白白耗电，聊到浪费电，这时就会用到 waste energy。
waste energy.translation: 朋友：你充电器怎么老插着 你：忘了拔 朋友：那白 waste energy 浪费电 你：对 我拔掉
waste energy.example: Friend: Why is your charger always plugged in? You: Forgot to unplug. Friend: That just wastes energy. You: Right, I will pull it out.

waste manpower.context: 你公司那个项目招人一堆，其实三个人就能干完，朋友说这是浪费人力，聊到浪费人力，这时就会用到 waste manpower。
waste manpower.translation: 朋友：那项目怎么招了十个人 你：三个人就够 waste manpower 朋友：那老板真不会算 你：对
waste manpower.example: Friend: Why did that project hire ten people? You: Three would do, it wastes manpower. Friend: Then the boss cannot count. You: Right.

waste product.context: 工厂排烟里有化学废渣，朋友说那就是生产废料，聊到废弃物，这时就会用到 waste product。
waste product.translation: 朋友：工厂排的那烟里有啥 你：有 waste product 生产废料 朋友：那真污染 你：对
waste product.example: Friend: What is in the factory smoke? You: Waste product from production. Friend: That is really polluting. You: Right.

waste reduction.context: 公司搞减包装，少用塑料袋，朋友说这就是减废，聊到减量化，这时就会用到 waste reduction。
waste reduction.translation: 朋友：公司怎么把包装改简了 你：waste reduction 减少废料 朋友：那真环保 你：对
waste reduction.example: Friend: Why did the company simplify the packaging? You: Waste reduction, cutting down on trash. Friend: That is eco-friendly. You: Right.

waste stream.context: 你看垃圾分厨余可回收其他三类，朋友说这就是城市垃圾流，聊到垃圾流，这时就会用到 waste stream。
waste stream.translation: 朋友：垃圾怎么还分三类 你：那是 waste stream 不同垃圾分开处理 朋友：那真科学 你：对
waste stream.example: Friend: Why is rubbish sorted into three? You: That is the waste stream, different waste handled differently. Friend: That is really scientific. You: Right.

watch for.context: 你在路口等车，盯着来的车看是不是自己要坐的，朋友问你干嘛，聊到留意等，这时就会用到 watch for。
watch for.translation: 朋友：你在路口盯着啥 你：watch for 我那班车 来了没 朋友：那车快来了 你：对
watch for.example: Friend: What are you staring for at the stop? You: Watching for my bus, whether it is coming. Friend: It is almost here. You: Right.

water cooler.context: 办公室大家都爱在饮水机旁边聊天传八卦，朋友说那就是茶水间八卦点，聊到饮水机旁闲聊，这时就会用到 water cooler。
water cooler.translation: 朋友：你们同事爱在哪聊天 你：water cooler 饮水机旁边 传八卦 朋友：那真热闹 你：对
water cooler.example: Friend: Where do your coworkers love to chat? You: Around the water cooler, gossiping. Friend: That is lively. You: Right.

water leaking.context: 你家天花板一下雨就滴水，朋友说这是屋顶漏水，聊到漏水，这时就会用到 water leaking。
water leaking.translation: 朋友：你家怎么摆个盆接水 你：屋顶 water leaking 下雨就滴 朋友：那得修 你：对
water leaking.example: Friend: Why is there a bucket catching drips? You: The roof has water leaking every rain. Friend: Then fix it. You: Right.

water pollution.context: 新闻说这条河边上工厂排废水，水都变臭了，朋友说这就是水污染，聊到水污染，这时就会用到 water pollution。
water pollution.translation: 朋友：这河水怎么那么臭 你：边上工厂排废水 water pollution 朋友：那鱼都死了 你：对
water pollution.example: Friend: Why does this river smell so bad? You: Factories upstream dump waste, water pollution. Friend: Then the fish are dead. You: Right.

water system.context: 你住的城市自来水来自山上水库，朋友问这城市供水从哪来，聊到供水系统，这时就会用到 water system。
water system.translation: 朋友：你们城市自来水哪来的 你：山上水库 water system 流下来的 朋友：那水质好吗 你：对
water system.example: Friend: Where does your city's tap water come from? You: A reservoir on the hill, the water system pipes it down. Friend: Is the water quality good? You: Right.

waterlogged pitch.context: 下了几天雨，足球场全是积水，比赛踢不了，朋友说这球场泡汤了，聊到积水场地，这时就会用到 waterlogged pitch。
waterlogged pitch.translation: 朋友：今天球怎么踢不了 你：下了一周雨 waterlogged pitch 全是水 朋友：那改天踢 你：对
waterlogged pitch.example: Friend: Why is today's ball game off? You: A week of rain, the pitch is waterlogged. Friend: Then play another day. You: Right.

watery spray.context: 你洗澡时花洒喷出来细细的水雾，朋友说这淋浴真舒服，聊到花洒喷水，这时就会用到 watery spray。
watery spray.translation: 朋友：你这淋浴头真舒服 你：细细 watery spray 喷在身上 朋友：那比老式大花洒强 你：对
watery spray.example: Friend: This showerhead feels great. You: A fine watery spray on the skin. Friend: Better than the old big nozzle. You: Right.

wave sb off.context: 你朋友出国念书，你去机场送他，挥手道别，朋友说这就是送行，聊到送别，这时就会用到 wave sb off。
wave sb off.translation: 朋友：你今天去机场干嘛 你：送同学 wave him off 他出国留学 朋友：那真舍不得 你：对
wave sb off.example: Friend: Why are you going to the airport today? You: Seeing a classmate off, waving him off to study abroad. Friend: That is hard to say goodbye. You: Right.

way ahead of time.context: 你提前两周就把演唱会票买好了，朋友说你准备得真早，聊到提前很久，这时就会用到 way ahead of time。
way ahead of time.translation: 朋友：你演唱会票买了吗 你：way ahead of time 两周前就买了 朋友：那真稳 你：对
way ahead of time.example: Friend: Did you get the concert tickets? You: Way ahead of time, bought them two weeks ago. Friend: That is really safe. You: Right.

way off.context: 你猜今天三十度，结果一下降到二十度，朋友说你猜得差太远了，聊到差得远，这时就会用到 way off。
way off.translation: 朋友：你猜今天多少度 你：我猜三十度 朋友：way off 才二十度 你：那我穿多了
way off.example: Friend: What do you guess today's temperature? You: I guessed thirty. Friend: Way off, only twenty. You: Then I am overdressed.

we are what we eat.context: 医生说你天天吃外卖不胖才怪，人吃啥就是啥，聊到饮食决定体质，这时就会用到 we are what we eat。
we are what we eat.translation: 朋友：我怎么老胖 你：you are what you eat 你天天吃外卖 朋友：那我得自己做饭 你：对
we are what we eat.example: Friend: Why am I always gaining weight? You: We are what we eat, you live on takeout. Friend: Then I will cook. You: Right.

wear and tear.context: 你这手机用了五年，壳也花了屏也裂了，朋友说这就是正常损耗，聊到磨损，这时就会用到 wear and tear。
wear and tear.translation: 朋友：你这手机怎么这么旧 你：用了五年 normal wear and tear 壳花屏裂 朋友：该换了 你：对
wear and tear.example: Friend: Why is your phone so beat up? You: Five years of normal wear and tear, case scratched, screen cracked. Friend: Time to replace. You: Right.

wearable tech.context: 你戴个智能手表能测心率，朋友说这就是可穿戴设备，聊到可穿戴技术，这时就会用到 wearable tech。
wearable tech.translation: 朋友：你手腕上戴的啥 你：智能手表 wearable tech 测心率 朋友：那真方便 你：对
wearable tech.example: Friend: What are you wearing on your wrist? You: A smartwatch, wearable tech, tracks heart rate. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

wearable technology.context: 你戴个智能手环天天看走了多少步，朋友说这就是可穿戴技术，聊到可穿戴设备，这时就会用到 wearable technology。
wearable technology.translation: 朋友：你手环天天记步 你：wearable technology 可穿戴 看数据 朋友：那真能管住自己 你：对
wearable technology.example: Friend: Your band tracks steps every day. You: Wearable technology, watching the data. Friend: That really keeps you in check. You: Right.

weather conditions.context: 明天要爬山，朋友说先看看天气怎么样，聊到天气状况，这时就会用到 weather conditions。
weather conditions.translation: 朋友：明天爬山看天气了吗 你：weather conditions 晴 二十度 朋友：那真合适 你：对
weather conditions.example: Friend: Did you check the weather for tomorrow's hike? You: Weather conditions look clear, twenty degrees. Friend: That is perfect. You: Right.

weather front.context: 天气预报说有个冷空气前锋要过来，明天降温，朋友说这就是天气锋面，聊到锋面，这时就会用到 weather front。
weather front.translation: 朋友：明天怎么突然降温 你：有个 weather front 冷空气前锋过来 朋友：那多穿点 你：对
weather front.example: Friend: Why is it suddenly colder tomorrow? You: A weather front, cold air moving in. Friend: Then dress warm. You: Right.

weather modification.context: 新闻说有些地方人工降雨抗旱，朋友说这就是人工影响天气，聊到人工控雨，这时就会用到 weather modification。
weather modification.translation: 朋友：干旱那地方怎么下雨了 你：人工 weather modification 人工降雨 朋友：那真管用 你：对
weather modification.example: Friend: Why did it rain in that drought area? You: Artificial weather modification, seeding rain. Friend: That really works. You: Right.

weather system.context: 新闻说一个大型天气系统要过来，下周连阴雨，朋友说这就是天气系统，聊到天气系统，这时就会用到 weather system。
weather system.translation: 朋友：下周天气怎么样 你：一个大 weather system 过来 连阴雨 朋友：那出门带伞 你：对
weather system.example: Friend: What is the weather next week? You: A big weather system coming, rain all week. Friend: Then bring an umbrella. You: Right.

wedding gift.context: 朋友结婚你送了个红包，朋友说这就是结婚礼物，聊到结婚礼物，这时就会用到 wedding gift。
wedding gift.translation: 朋友：你朋友结婚你送啥 你：包了红包 wedding gift 朋友：那随多少 你：五百
wedding gift.example: Friend: What did you give your friend for the wedding? You: A red envelope as a wedding gift. Friend: How much? You: Five hundred.

wedding guest.context: 你去参加朋友婚礼，同桌都是不认识的人，朋友说这些都是婚礼宾客，聊到婚礼来宾，这时就会用到 wedding guest。
wedding guest.translation: 朋友：婚礼上你认识几个人 你：就认识新郎 其他 wedding guest 全陌生 朋友：那跟旁边人聊聊 你：对
wedding guest.example: Friend: How many people do you know at the wedding? You: Just the groom, all the other wedding guests are strangers. Friend: Then chat with your table. You: Right.

wedding season.context: 春天好多人结婚，酒店排不上，朋友说这就是婚礼旺季，聊到结婚季，这时就会用到 wedding season。
wedding season.translation: 朋友：怎么这个月这么多婚礼 你：wedding season 春天结婚多 朋友：那红包随不过来 你：对
wedding season.example: Friend: Why are there so many weddings this month? You: Wedding season, spring is peak. Friend: Then the red envelopes pile up. You: Right.

weekly payout.context: 妈妈每周给孩子发零花钱，朋友说那就是每周零用钱，聊到每周零花钱，这时就会用到 weekly payout。
weekly payout.translation: 朋友：你妈给你零花钱怎么算 你：weekly payout 每周发一次 朋友：那你省着点花 你：对
weekly payout.example: Friend: How does your mom give you pocket money? You: A weekly payout, once a week. Friend: Then spend it carefully. You: Right.

weigh down.context: 你肩膀扛了一天重东西，压得肩膀酸，朋友说这就是被压垮了，聊到压得难受，这时就会用到 weigh down。
weigh down.translation: 朋友：你肩膀怎么那么酸 你：扛了一天重东西 被 weigh down 朋友：那揉揉 你：对
weigh down.example: Friend: Why are your shoulders so sore? You: Carried heavy stuff all day, weighed down. Friend: Then rub them. You: Right.

weighed up against.context: 你买房把新房跟旧房比，价格位置都权衡一遍，朋友说你这是把两边放一起比较，聊到权衡比较，这时就会用到 weighed up against。
weighed up against.translation: 朋友：你怎么选的那套房 你：把两套 weighed up against 比价格位置 朋友：那这套划算 你：对
weighed up against.example: Friend: How did you pick that flat? You: Weighed it up against the other one on price and location. Friend: Then this one is the deal. You: Right.

weight gain.context: 你这两个月天天吃夜宵，体重涨了五斤，朋友说这就是增重，聊到长胖，这时就会用到 weight gain。
weight gain.translation: 朋友：你怎么胖了一圈 你：两个月夜宵 weight gain 五斤 朋友：那别吃夜宵了 你：对
weight gain.example: Friend: Why have you put on weight? You: Two months of late-night snacks, a weight gain of five pounds. Friend: Then stop the snacks. You: Right.

weight loss.context: 你朋友天天跑步，三个月瘦了十斤，朋友说这就是减肥见效了，聊到减脂，这时就会用到 weight loss。
weight loss.translation: 朋友：你朋友怎么瘦那么多 你：天天跑步 weight loss 十斤 朋友：那真厉害 你：对
weight loss.example: Friend: Why has your friend lost so much weight? You: Running every day, a weight loss of ten pounds. Friend: That is impressive. You: Right.

weight loss professional.context: 你朋友请了个私教带他减肥，朋友说那就是减脂教练，聊到减脂专家，这时就会用到 weight loss professional。
weight loss professional.translation: 朋友：你怎么瘦的 你：请了个 weight loss professional 减脂专家 带我练 朋友：那花钱吗 你：对
weight loss professional.example: Friend: How did you lose weight? You: Hired a weight loss professional to train me. Friend: Does that cost money? You: Right.

weight management.context: 医生说减肥不是节食，是长期的体重管理，朋友说这就是体重管理，聊到体重管理，这时就会用到 weight management。
weight management.translation: 朋友：减肥怎么才不反弹 你：靠 weight management 体重管理 长期控制 朋友：那不是饿肚子 你：对
weight management.example: Friend: How do you keep the weight off? You: Through weight management, long-term control. Friend: So not starving. You: Right.

welcome relief.context: 下了一周雨终于晴了，朋友说这太阳真让人开心，聊到令人欣慰的事，这时就会用到 welcome relief。
welcome relief.translation: 朋友：这星期终于出太阳了 你：welcome relief 下了一周雨 朋友：那出去走走 你：对
welcome relief.example: Friend: The sun finally came out this week. You: A welcome relief after a week of rain. Friend: Then go out for a walk. You: Right.

welfare benefits.context: 新闻说失业的人能领政府救济金，朋友说这就是福利金，聊到社会福利，这时就会用到 welfare benefits。
welfare benefits.translation: 朋友：失业了没钱怎么办 你：领 welfare benefits 政府救济金 朋友：那够吃饭吗 你：对
welfare benefits.example: Friend: What to do when unemployed and broke? You: Claim welfare benefits from the state. Friend: Is that enough for food? You: Right.

welfare system.context: 新闻说北欧国家看病上学都不花钱，朋友说这就是福利体系好，聊到福利制度，这时就会用到 welfare system。
welfare system.translation: 朋友：北欧看病上学真不花钱 你：那是 welfare system 福利体系好 朋友：那真羡慕 你：对
welfare system.example: Friend: Is it true healthcare and school are free in the Nordics? You: That is a strong welfare system. Friend: That is enviable. You: Right.

well-used expression.context: 老师老说熟能生巧，你说这是常用俗语，聊到老话，这时就会用到 well-used expression。
well-used expression.translation: 朋友：老师老说熟能生巧 你：那是个 well-used expression 老俗话 朋友：那真有道理 你：对
well-used expression.example: Friend: The teacher always says practice makes perfect. You: That is a well-used expression, an old saying. Friend: That makes sense. You: Right.

wellbeing app.context: 你朋友焦虑时打开手机上那个冥想App，聊十分钟就平静了，朋友说这就是心理健康App，聊到心理App，这时就会用到 wellbeing app。
wellbeing app.translation: 朋友：你焦虑时干嘛 你：打开 wellbeing app 冥想十分钟 朋友：那真管用 你：对
wellbeing app.example: Friend: What do you do when anxious? You: Open a wellbeing app, meditate ten minutes. Friend: Does it really work? You: Right.

wellbeing boost.context: 你周末去徒步，回来心情特别好，朋友说运动真能提升状态，聊到身心提升，这时就会用到 wellbeing boost。
wellbeing boost.translation: 朋友：你今天怎么这么开心 你：徒步一天 wellbeing boost 心情好 朋友：那多出去 你：对
wellbeing boost.example: Friend: Why are you so happy today? You: A day of hiking, a real wellbeing boost. Friend: Then go out more. You: Right.

wellness programme.context: 公司给员工免费健身房和瑜伽课，朋友说这就是公司健康项目，聊到企业健康计划，这时就会用到 wellness programme。
wellness programme.translation: 朋友：你们公司福利有啥 你：免费健身房 wellness programme 健康项目 朋友：那真不错 你：对
wellness programme.example: Friend: What benefits does your company give? You: Free gym, a wellness programme. Friend: That is really nice. You: Right.

wet behind the ears.context: 你朋友刚毕业进公司，啥事都问，同事说他太嫩了，聊到没经验，这时就会用到 wet behind the ears。
wet behind the ears.translation: 朋友：他怎么啥事都问 你：刚毕业 wet behind the ears 没经验 朋友：那慢慢带 你：对
wet behind the ears.example: Friend: Why does he ask everything? You: Just graduated, wet behind the ears, no experience. Friend: Then mentor him. You: Right.

what 's more.context: 你朋友不仅工资高，还免费出差住好酒店，聊到而且，这时就会用到 what 's more。
what 's more.translation: 朋友：他那工作怎么样 你：工资高 what's more 出差住好酒店 朋友：那真羡慕 你：对
what 's more.example: Friend: How is his job? You: High pay, and what is more, business trips in nice hotels. Friend: That is enviable. You: Right.

what have you.context: 你朋友家里有沙发电视冰箱洗衣机那些，问你还缺点啥，聊到之类的，这时就会用到 what have you。
what have you.translation: 朋友：我家沙发电视冰箱都齐了 你：what have you 还有洗衣机那些 朋友：对 都买了 你：行
what have you.example: Friend: My sofa, TV, fridge are all set. You: What have you, like the washer and those things. Friend: Right, bought them all. You: Okay.

what’s more.context: 你朋友不仅长得帅，还特别会说话，聊到而且，这时就会用到 what's more。
what’s more.translation: 朋友：他这人怎么样 你：长得帅 what's more 还特别会说话 朋友：那真受欢迎 你：对
what’s more.example: Friend: What is he like? You: Good-looking, and what's more, really smooth with words. Friend: Then he is popular. You: Right.

wheelie bin.context: 你家门口那个大绿桶带轮子，每周二收垃圾，朋友说这就是轮式垃圾桶，聊到带轮垃圾桶，这时就会用到 wheelie bin。
wheelie bin.translation: 朋友：门口那个大绿桶是啥 你：wheelie bin 带轮垃圾桶 每周二收 朋友：那真方便 你：对
wheelie bin.example: Friend: What is that big green bin by the door? You: A wheelie bin, emptied every Tuesday. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

when it came to.context: 朋友问你要让你选工作还是旅行，你说一说到旅行我就停不下来，聊到当说到，这时就会用到 when it came to。
when it came to.translation: 朋友：让你选工作还是旅行 你：when it came to 旅行 我毫不犹豫选玩 朋友：那真贪玩 你：对
when it came to.example: Friend: Pick work or travel? You: When it came to travel, I picked it without a second thought. Friend: You really love to travel. You: Right.

whet your appetite.context: 你朋友放了个美食视频给你看，看完你就饿了想去吃，朋友说这就是勾食欲，聊到勾起食欲，这时就会用到 whet your appetite。
whet your appetite.translation: 朋友：看完这个视频怎么饿了 你：那菜太香 whet your appetite 朋友：那下楼吃 你：对
whet your appetite.example: Friend: Why are you hungry after that video? You: The dishes looked so good they whet your appetite. Friend: Then head down to eat. You: Right.

whether that be.context: 你问朋友周末干嘛，朋友说不管是爬山还是看电影都行，聊到不管是哪种，这时就会用到 whether that be。
whether that be.translation: 朋友：周末我们干嘛去 你：爬山 whether that be 还是看电影 都行 朋友：那爬山吧 你：对
whether that be.example: Friend: What do we do this weekend? You: Hiking, whether that be a film, anything is fine. Friend: Then hiking. You: Right.

whip.context: 老师拿鞭子抽马让它跑快点，朋友说这就是用鞭子赶，聊到鞭子，这时就会用到 whip。
whip.translation: 朋友：电影里那人拿鞭子干嘛 你：whip 抽马让它跑快点 朋友：那真残忍 你：对
whip.example: Friend: What is that person doing with a whip in the film? You: Whipping the horse to make it run faster. Friend: That is cruel. You: Right.

whip up.context: 你朋友十分钟就做了三道菜，朋友说她快手菜做得真快，聊到快速做，这时就会用到 whip up。
whip up.translation: 朋友：你十分钟怎么做出三道菜 你：whip up 快手菜 炒两下就好 朋友：那真厉害 你：对
whip up.example: Friend: How did you make three dishes in ten minutes? You: Whip up quick stir-fries, done in a flash. Friend: That is impressive. You: Right.

white lie.context: 你不想告诉朋友他新发型难看，说挺好看的，朋友说这就是善意的谎言，聊到善意小谎，这时就会用到 white lie。
white lie.translation: 朋友：我这新发型怎么样 你：挺好看 朋友：你别哄我了 你：就一个 white lie 善意的谎言
white lie.example: Friend: How is my new haircut? You: It looks great. Friend: Do not sugarcoat it. You: Just a white lie.

white-collar workers.context: 你朋友天天坐办公室对着电脑，朋友说那就是白领，聊到上班族，这时就会用到 white-collar workers。
white-collar workers.translation: 朋友：你做什么工作 你：办公室对着电脑 white-collar workers 一族 朋友：那真坐得腰疼 你：对
white-collar workers.example: Friend: What do you do for work? You: Office desk job, one of the white-collar workers. Friend: That gives you back pain. You: Right.

whole food.context: 医生让你少吃加工食品，多吃天然食物，朋友说那就是天然食品，聊到未加工食物，这时就会用到 whole food。
whole food.translation: 朋友：医生让你多吃什么 你：whole food 天然未加工 蔬菜水果 朋友：那别吃薯片了 你：对
whole food.example: Friend: What does the doctor tell you to eat more of? You: Whole food, unprocessed, veg and fruit. Friend: Then skip the chips. You: Right.

whole grain.context: 医生让你吃全麦面包别吃白面包，朋友说那是全谷物，聊到粗粮，这时就会用到 whole grain。
whole grain.translation: 朋友：医生为什么让我吃全麦面包 你：whole grain 全谷物 比白面包健康 朋友：那口感粗 你：对
whole grain.example: Friend: Why did the doctor tell me to eat wholemeal bread? You: Whole grain is healthier than white. Friend: The texture is coarse. You: Right.

whole lot.context: 你朋友一次买了二十斤橘子，朋友说他买了一大堆，聊到一大堆，这时就会用到 whole lot。
whole lot.translation: 朋友：你怎么买这么多橘子 你：whole lot 二十斤 朋友：那吃得完吗 你：对 分给邻居
whole lot.example: Friend: Why buy so many oranges? You: A whole lot, twenty pounds. Friend: Can you finish them? You: Right, share with neighbors.

why bother.context: 你朋友天天纠结要不要辞职，又不敢辞，你说既然犹豫就别折腾了，聊到何苦，这时就会用到 why bother。
why bother.translation: 朋友：我要不要辞职 你：why bother 想了半年也没辞 朋友：那我继续干 你：对
why bother.example: Friend: Should I quit? You: Why bother, you have been thinking half a year without acting. Friend: Then I will stay. You: Right.

widening gap.context: 新闻说贫富差距越来越大，朋友说这就是差距拉大，聊到鸿沟扩大，这时就会用到 widening gap。
widening gap.translation: 朋友：新闻说有钱人越有钱 你：贫富 widening gap 差距拉大 朋友：那真不公平 你：对
widening gap.example: Friend: The news says the rich are getting richer. You: A widening gap between rich and poor. Friend: That is unfair. You: Right.

wild camping.context: 你朋友周末背上帐篷去山里野营，不在营地，朋友说这就是野外露营，聊到野营，这时就会用到 wild camping。
wild camping.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪儿露营 你：wild camping 野外 没营地 朋友：那没水没电 你：对
wild camping.example: Friend: Where are you camping this weekend? You: Wild camping, out in the wild, no site. Friend: Then no water or power. You: Right.

wild swimming.context: 你朋友周末去河里游泳，不在泳池，朋友说这就是野外游泳，聊到天然水域游泳，这时就会用到 wild swimming。
wild swimming.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪儿游泳 你：wild swimming 河里游 朋友：那水冷不冷 你：对 夏天正好
wild swimming.example: Friend: Where do you swim on weekends? You: Wild swimming in the river. Friend: Is the water cold? You: Right, perfect in summer.

wildlife park.context: 你周末带孩子去野生动物园，开车看狮子老虎，朋友说这就是野生动物园，聊到野生动物园，这时就会用到 wildlife park。
wildlife park.translation: 朋友：周末带孩子去哪儿 你：wildlife park 野生动物园 开车看动物 朋友：那真开心 你：对
wildlife park.example: Friend: Where to take the kid this weekend? You: A wildlife park, drive through to see the animals. Friend: That will be fun. You: Right.

win over.context: 你朋友上台演讲，讲得特别好，台下人都鼓掌，朋友说他真能赢得人心，聊到赢得支持，这时就会用到 win over。
win over.translation: 朋友：他演讲怎么样 你：讲得特别好 win over 全场 朋友：那真有一套 你：对
win over.example: Friend: How was his speech? You: Really good, won over the whole crowd. Friend: He has a way. You: Right.

wind back the clock.context: 你朋友说真怀念小时候，要是能回到十年前就好了，朋友说这就是想时光倒流，聊到想回到过去，这时就会用到 wind back the clock。
wind back the clock.translation: 朋友：你最近怎么老说小时候好 你：想 wind back the clock 回到十年前 朋友：那不可能 你：对 想想而已
wind back the clock.example: Friend: Why do you keep talking about your childhood? You: I want to wind back the clock, go back ten years. Friend: That is impossible. You: Right, just daydreaming.

wind down.context: 你睡前泡脚听轻音乐，慢慢放松下来，朋友说这就是睡前放松，聊到放松准备睡觉，这时就会用到 wind down。
wind down.translation: 朋友：你睡前干嘛呢 你：泡脚听音乐 wind down 放松 朋友：那真容易睡着 你：对
wind down.example: Friend: What do you do before bed? You: Foot bath and soft music, winding down. Friend: Then you sleep easy. You: Right.

wind power.context: 新闻说那山上装了好多大风车发电，朋友说这就是风力发电，聊到风能，这时就会用到 wind power。
wind power.translation: 朋友：那山上一排大风车干嘛 你：wind power 风力发电 朋友：那真环保 你：对
wind power.example: Friend: What are those rows of windmills on the hill? You: Wind power, generating electricity. Friend: That is eco-friendly. You: Right.

wind system.context: 新闻说一个风系天气要过来，明天大风，朋友说这就是风系，聊到风系天气，这时就会用到 wind system。
wind system.translation: 朋友：明天怎么刮大风 你：一个 wind system 风系过来 朋友：那别出门 你：对
wind system.example: Friend: Why is it windy tomorrow? You: A wind system moving in. Friend: Then stay indoors. You: Right.

window ledge.context: 你窗台上摆了一排多肉，朋友说这窗台真好看，聊到窗台，这时就会用到 window ledge。
window ledge.translation: 朋友：你窗台上摆的啥 你：window ledge 上一排多肉 朋友：那真好看 你：对
window ledge.example: Friend: What is lined up on your window? You: A row of succulents on the window ledge. Friend: That looks lovely. You: Right.

window shop.context: 你周末没事在街上逛橱窗，啥也不买，朋友说你这是只逛不买，聊到逛橱窗，这时就会用到 window shop。
window shop.translation: 朋友：你周末一个人去哪 你：街上 window shop 逛橱窗不买 朋友：那真省钱 你：对
window shop.example: Friend: Where do you go alone on weekends? You: Window shopping on the street, browsing without buying. Friend: That saves money. You: Right.

wine pairing.context: 餐厅里服务员说牛排配红酒、鱼配白酒，朋友说这就是餐酒搭配，聊到葡萄酒配餐，这时就会用到 wine pairing。
wine pairing.translation: 朋友：这牛排配什么酒 你：wine pairing 牛排配红酒 朋友：那真讲究 你：对
wine pairing.example: Friend: What wine with this steak? You: Wine pairing says red wine with steak. Friend: That is fancy. You: Right.

winter blues.context: 冬天你天天睡不醒没精神，朋友说这就是冬季情绪低落，聊到冬季抑郁，这时就会用到 winter blues。
winter blues.translation: 朋友：你冬天怎么老没精神 你：winter blues 冬季情绪差 朋友：那多晒太阳 你：对
winter blues.example: Friend: Why are you low on energy in winter? You: The winter blues, low mood. Friend: Then sunbathe more. You: Right.

winter wonderland.context: 下雪后整片城市白皑皑的，朋友说这就是冬日仙境，聊到雪景，这时就会用到 winter wonderland。
winter wonderland.translation: 朋友：下雪后这城市真好看 你：whole winter wonderland 白白的 朋友：那拍照片去 你：对
winter wonderland.example: Friend: The city looks so pretty after snow. You: A real winter wonderland, all white. Friend: Then take photos. You: Right.

wipe out.context: 那场海啸把整个村子都冲没了，朋友说这就是彻底摧毁，聊到消灭，这时就会用到 wipe out。
wipe out.translation: 朋友：新闻里那个村子怎么没了 你：海啸 wipe out 整个村子 朋友：那真惨 你：对
wipe out.example: Friend: Why is that village gone in the news? You: The tsunami wiped out the whole village. Friend: That is tragic. You: Right.

wire for.context: 你装修房子时提前在墙上埋好网线，朋友说这是预埋线路，聊到布线，这时就会用到 wire for。
wire for.translation: 朋友：你装修怎么在墙里埋线 你：wire for 以后装网线 朋友：那真有远见 你：对
wire for.example: Friend: Why are you burying wires in the wall during reno? You: Wired it for future internet cables. Friend: That is forward-looking. You: Right.

wire into.context: 你公司新装的电脑直接连上网线就能用，朋友说这是接入系统，聊到接线接入，这时就会用到 wire into。
wire into.translation: 朋友：你新电脑怎么联网的 你：直接 wire into 网线接口 就能用 朋友：那真方便 你：对
wire into.example: Friend: How does your new PC connect to the net? You: Just wired into the network port, ready to go. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

wise quote.context: 你爷爷常说吃得苦中苦方为人上人，朋友说这就是老辈的智慧话，聊到明智老话，这时就会用到 wise quote。
wise quote.translation: 朋友：你爷爷常说啥 你：吃得苦中苦 方为人上人 一个 wise quote 朋友：那真有道理 你：对
wise quote.example: Friend: What does your grandfather always say? You: A hard life builds character, a wise quote. Friend: That makes sense. You: Right.

wish for.context: 你过生日时许愿希望明年能去旅行，朋友说你想要什么礼物，聊到想要，这时就会用到 wish for。
wish for.translation: 朋友：生日你想要啥礼物 你：我 wish for 一次旅行 朋友：那真省钱 你：对
wish for.example: Friend: What gift do you want for your birthday? You: I wish for a trip. Friend: That saves money. You: Right.

wishful thinking.context: 你以为他会追你，结果人家根本没那意思，朋友说你这就是一厢情愿，聊到痴心妄想，这时就会用到 wishful thinking。
wishful thinking.translation: 朋友：他怎么还不找我 你：我以为他喜欢我 朋友：你那是 wishful thinking 一厢情愿 你：对
wishful thinking.example: Friend: Why does he not reach out? You: I thought he liked me. Friend: That is just wishful thinking. You: Right.

wistful for.context: 你路过老校门口想起上学时光，朋友说你这是怀念过去，聊到怀念，这时就会用到 wistful for。
wistful for.translation: 朋友：你站校门口干嘛 你：wistful for 上学那几年 朋友：那真怀念 你：对
wistful for.example: Friend: Why are you standing by the school gate? You: Wistful for my school days. Friend: That is nostalgic. You: Right.

with all due respect.context: 你跟领导意见不一样，想说又怕不礼貌，朋友说你可以说恕我直言，聊到恕我直言，这时就会用到 with all due respect。
with all due respect.translation: 朋友：你怎么跟领导提不同意见 你：with all due respect 恕我直言 这样说 朋友：那真礼貌 你：对
with all due respect.example: Friend: How do you disagree with the boss? You: Start with with all due respect. Friend: That is really polite. You: Right.

with flying colours.context: 你朋友考试全满分毕业，朋友说他优秀毕业，聊到出色通过，这时就会用到 with flying colours。
with flying colours.translation: 朋友：他毕业成绩怎么样 你：with flying colours 全满分 朋友：那真厉害 你：对
with flying colours.example: Friend: How was his graduation? You: Passed with flying colours, full marks. Friend: That is impressive. You: Right.

with that.context: 你朋友说完拜拜挂了电话，立马去洗澡，朋友说他挂了电话就去洗，聊到接着就，这时就会用到 with that。
with that.translation: 朋友：他挂电话干嘛去了 你：with that 他立马去洗澡 朋友：那真快 你：对
with that.example: Friend: What did he do after hanging up? You: With that, he went straight to shower. Friend: That was quick. You: Right.

with that in mind.context: 明天要下雨，你带了伞出门，朋友说你考虑周到，聊到考虑到这点，这时就会用到 with that in mind。
with that in mind.translation: 朋友：你怎么带伞了 你：明天有雨 with that in mind 我带了 朋友：那真稳 你：对
with that in mind.example: Friend: Why did you bring an umbrella? You: Tomorrow is rainy, with that in mind I brought one. Friend: That is really prepared. You: Right.

with the addition of.context: 你在白米饭上加了点杂粮，朋友说这就是在白米基础上加了杂粮，聊到加上，这时就会用到 with the addition of。
with the addition of.translation: 朋友：你这米饭怎么有颜色 你：with the addition of 杂粮 白米加糙米 朋友：那真健康 你：对
with the addition of.example: Friend: Why is your rice colored? You: With the addition of mixed grains, brown rice in white. Friend: That is healthy. You: Right.

with the rise of.context: 你说现在短视频越来越火，朋友说随着短视频兴起，大家都不看电视了，聊到随着兴起，这时就会用到 with the rise of。
with the rise of.translation: 朋友：现在怎么没人看电视了 你：with the rise of 短视频 大家都刷手机 朋友：那电视真没人看了 你：对
with the rise of.example: Friend: Why does nobody watch TV now? You: With the rise of short videos, everyone scrolls their phone. Friend: Then TV is dead. You: Right.

with this in mind.context: 明天要早起赶火车，你今晚早睡，朋友说你考虑周到，聊到考虑到这点，这时就会用到 with this in mind。
with this in mind.translation: 朋友：你今晚怎么早睡 你：明天赶火车 with this in mind 我早睡 朋友：那真稳 你：对
with this in mind.example: Friend: Why are you going to bed early tonight? You: Catching a train tomorrow, with this in mind I sleep early. Friend: That is really prepared. You: Right.

within walking distance.context: 你公司离地铁站走路十分钟，朋友说那真近，步行可达，聊到步行距离内，这时就会用到 within walking distance。
within walking distance.translation: 朋友：你公司离地铁多远 你：within walking distance 走路十分钟 朋友：那真方便 你：对
within walking distance.example: Friend: How far is your office from the metro? You: Within walking distance, ten minutes on foot. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

witty remark.context: 你朋友开会时说了句笑话，全场都笑了，朋友说他真会说话，聊到风趣话，这时就会用到 witty remark。
witty remark.translation: 朋友：他怎么一句话把大家逗笑 你：一句 witty remark 风趣话 朋友：那真有幽默感 你：对
witty remark.example: Friend: How did he make everyone laugh with one line? You: A witty remark. Friend: He has a real sense of humor. You: Right.

wonder about.context: 你朋友最近老不回消息，你想知道他是不是生气了，聊到想知道，这时就会用到 wonder about。
wonder about.translation: 朋友：他怎么老不回消息 你：我 wonder about 他是不是生气了 朋友：那打个电话问问 你：对
wonder about.example: Friend: Why is he not replying? You: I wonder about whether he is mad. Friend: Then call and ask. You: Right.

wood wide web.context: 科普片说森林里树根之间靠菌丝联网传养分，朋友笑说这就是森林万维网，聊到地下网络，这时就会用到 wood wide web。
wood wide web.translation: 朋友：森林里树怎么互相传养分 你：靠菌丝联网 wood wide web 森林万维网 朋友：那真像互联网 你：对
wood wide web.example: Friend: How do trees in a forest share nutrients? You: Through fungal threads, the wood wide web. Friend: That is like the internet. You: Right.

woodland clearance.context: 新闻说那片树林被砍光了，朋友说这就是林地砍伐，聊到砍林，这时就会用到 woodland clearance。
woodland clearance.translation: 朋友：那片树林怎么没了 你：woodland clearance 被砍光了 朋友：那真可惜 你：对
woodland clearance.example: Friend: Why is that woods gone? You: Woodland clearance, cut down. Friend: That is a shame. You: Right.

woodland walk.context: 你周末在林子里散步，空气特别好，朋友说这就是林间漫步，聊到林中散步，这时就会用到 woodland walk。
woodland walk.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪了 你：woodland walk 林子里散步 空气好 朋友：那真舒服 你：对
woodland walk.example: Friend: Where did you go this weekend? You: A woodland walk in the trees, fresh air. Friend: That is lovely. You: Right.

word of mouth.context: 你那小店没打广告全靠老顾客介绍，朋友说这就是口碑传播，聊到口碑，这时就会用到 word of mouth。
word of mouth.translation: 朋友：你那小店怎么有那么多客人 你：没打广告全靠 word of mouth 口碑 朋友：那真难得 你：对
word of mouth.example: Friend: How does your small shop get so many customers? You: No ads, all by word of mouth. Friend: That is rare. You: Right.

words of wisdom.context: 你爷爷常跟你说身体是本钱，朋友说这就是老人家的金玉良言，聊到忠告，这时就会用到 words of wisdom。
words of wisdom.translation: 朋友：你爷爷常跟你说啥 你：身体是本钱 几句 words of wisdom 朋友：那真对 你：对
words of wisdom.example: Friend: What does your grandfather always tell you? You: Health is wealth, a few words of wisdom. Friend: That is so true. You: Right.

work away.context: 你朋友周末在家一直打字赶报告，朋友说他连轴转，聊到埋头干，这时就会用到 work away。
work away.translation: 朋友：他周末怎么不出来 你：在家 work away 赶报告 朋友：那真拼 你：对
work away.example: Friend: Why is he not coming out this weekend? You: Working away at home on the report. Friend: That is grinding. You: Right.

work diary.context: 你朋友每天写工作日志记干了啥，朋友说这就是工作日志，聊到工作日志，这时就会用到 work diary。
work diary.translation: 朋友：你每天写那本子干嘛 你：work diary 工作日志 记每天干了啥 朋友：那真清楚 你：对
work diary.example: Friend: What is that notebook you write in every day? You: A work diary, logging what I do each day. Friend: That is organized. You: Right.

work experience.context: 你朋友大学时在公司实习了半年，朋友说那就是实习经历，聊到工作经验，这时就会用到 work experience。
work experience.translation: 朋友：你找工作有优势吗 你：大学时 work experience 实习了半年 朋友：那真加分 你：对
work experience.example: Friend: Do you have an edge in job hunting? You: Six months of work experience in college. Friend: That is a plus. You: Right.

work force.context: 新闻说这城市有一半人在服务业上班，朋友说这就是劳动力，聊到劳动力，这时就会用到 work force。
work force.translation: 朋友：这城市多少人在上班 你：一大半 work force 在服务业 朋友：那真多 你：对
work force.example: Friend: How many people work in this city? You: Most of the work force in services. Friend: That is a lot. You: Right.

work from home.context: 疫情那阵你在家对着电脑上班，朋友说这就是居家办公，聊到远程办公，这时就会用到 work from home。
work from home.translation: 朋友：你疫情那阵怎么上班 你：work from home 在家对着电脑 朋友：那真省通勤 你：对
work from home.example: Friend: How did you work during the pandemic? You: Work from home at the computer. Friend: That saves commuting. You: Right.

work like a dog.context: 你朋友天天加班到半夜，朋友说他真是拼命工作，聊到拼命干，这时就会用到 work like a dog。
work like a dog.translation: 朋友：他怎么天天半夜才下班 你：work like a dog 拼命干 朋友：那身体受得了吗 你：对
work like a dog.example: Friend: Why does he not leave till midnight? You: Working like a dog, grinding hard. Friend: Can his body take it? You: Right.

work mate.context: 你公司那个跟你一起吃饭的老大哥，朋友问是谁，你说那是同事，聊到同事，这时就会用到 work mate。
work mate.translation: 朋友：跟你吃饭那是谁 你：work mate 同事 一起三年了 朋友：那真熟 你：对
work mate.example: Friend: Who is that you are eating with? You: A work mate, three years together. Friend: That is close. You: Right.

work of art.context: 你朋友画了幅油画送你，朋友说这就是件艺术品，聊到艺术品，这时就会用到 work of art。
work of art.translation: 朋友：你墙上挂的那幅画哪来的 你：朋友画的 work of art 送我的 朋友：那真值钱 你：对
work of art.example: Friend: Where did that painting on your wall come from? You: A work of art a friend painted and gave me. Friend: That is precious. You: Right.

work scenario.context: 老师让大家模拟客户打电话的场景练习，朋友说这就是工作场景演练，聊到工作场景，这时就会用到 work scenario。
work scenario.translation: 朋友：你们上课练什么呢 你：模拟打电话 work scenario 工作场景 朋友：那真实用 你：对
work scenario.example: Friend: What are you practicing in class? You: Simulating calls, a work scenario. Friend: That is practical. You: Right.

work schedule.context: 你公司排班表上写着早九晚六周末双休，朋友说这就是工作时间表，聊到排班，这时就会用到 work schedule。
work schedule.translation: 朋友：你们公司几点上下班 你：work schedule 早九晚六 双休 朋友：那真规律 你：对
work schedule.example: Friend: What are your hours at the company? You: The work schedule is nine to six, weekends off. Friend: That is regular. You: Right.

work situation.context: 你朋友换了个工作，同事都特别好，朋友说那就是工作环境好，聊到工作环境，这时就会用到 work situation。
work situation.translation: 朋友：你新工作怎么样 你：work situation 同事都好 领导也好说话 朋友：那真难得 你：对
work situation.example: Friend: How is the new job? You: The work situation is great, kind coworkers, easy boss. Friend: That is rare. You: Right.

work task.context: 领导给你派了个写报告的活，朋友说这就是你的工作任务，聊到工作任务，这时就会用到 work task。
work task.translation: 朋友：领导今天给你派啥活 你：写个报告 work task 明天交 朋友：那真忙 你：对
work task.example: Friend: What did the boss assign you today? You: A work task, write a report, due tomorrow. Friend: Then you are busy. You: Right.

work through.context: 你朋友跟对象吵架，两人坐下来把问题聊开了，朋友说这就是把问题解决了，聊到慢慢解决，这时就会用到 work through。
work through.translation: 朋友：他俩吵架和好了吗 你：坐下来 work through 把问题聊开 朋友：那真成熟 你：对
work through.example: Friend: Did they make up after the fight? You: Sat down and worked through the issues. Friend: That is mature. You: Right.

work up a sweat.context: 你跑了半小时步，浑身是汗，朋友说你练得真猛，聊到练出汗，这时就会用到 work up a sweat。
work up a sweat.translation: 朋友：你怎么一身汗 你：跑了半小时 work up a sweat 朋友：那真锻炼到了 你：对
work up a sweat.example: Friend: Why are you all sweaty? You: Ran half an hour, worked up a sweat. Friend: That is a real workout. You: Right.

work with.context: 你朋友跟一个设计师合作做项目，朋友说那就是跟设计师一起工作，聊到合作，这时就会用到 work with。
work with.translation: 朋友：你新项目跟谁合作 你：work with 一个设计师 做界面 朋友：那真搭 你：对
work with.example: Friend: Who are you working with on the new project? You: Working with a designer on the interface. Friend: That is a good match. You: Right.

work-from-home burnout.context: 你朋友天天在家办公，时间长了分不清上下班，朋友说他这就是居家办公倦怠，聊到居家倦怠，这时就会用到 work-from-home burnout。
work-from-home burnout.translation: 朋友：他怎么天天在家还累 你：work-from-home burnout 居家办公倦怠 朋友：那得换环境 你：对
work-from-home burnout.example: Friend: Why is he tired even working from home? You: Work-from-home burnout. Friend: Then change the setting. You: Right.

work-life balance.context: 你朋友不加班周末也出去玩，朋友说他这就是工作生活平衡，聊到平衡，这时就会用到 work-life balance。
work-life balance.translation: 朋友：你怎么不加班 周末还出去玩 你：要 work-life balance 工作生活平衡 朋友：那真难得 你：对
work-life balance.example: Friend: Why do you not work overtime, going out on weekends? You: I want a work-life balance. Friend: That is rare. You: Right.

working conditions.context: 你公司夏天有空调冬天有暖气，朋友说这工作条件真不错，聊到工作条件，这时就会用到 working conditions。
working conditions.translation: 朋友：你们公司上班舒服吗 你：working conditions 有空调暖气 朋友：那真好 你：对
working conditions.example: Friend: Is it comfortable at your company? You: Good working conditions, AC and heating. Friend: That is nice. You: Right.

working life.context: 你朋友干了三十年同一行，朋友说那就是他整个工作生涯，聊到职业生涯，这时就会用到 working life。
working life.translation: 朋友：你爸干这行多久了 你：whole working life 三十年 朋友：那真资深 你：对
working life.example: Friend: How long has your dad done this job? You: His whole working life, thirty years. Friend: That is really senior. You: Right.

working memory.context: 你同时记两个电话号码转头就忘，朋友说这就是工作记忆不够用，聊到工作记忆，这时就会用到 working memory。
working memory.translation: 朋友：你怎么刚说的号就忘 你：working memory 工作记忆不够 同时记两个就乱 朋友：那写下来 你：对
working memory.example: Friend: Why did you forget the number just now? You: My working memory is weak, two numbers at once gets muddled. Friend: Then write it down. You: Right.

working population.context: 新闻说这个国家一半人在上班，朋友说这就是劳动人口，聊到劳动人口，这时就会用到 working population。
working population.translation: 朋友：这国家多少人上班 你：一半 working population 劳动人口 朋友：那真多 你：对
working population.example: Friend: How many people work in this country? You: Half the working population. Friend: That is a lot. You: Right.

workout routine.context: 你朋友每周一三五去健身房，朋友说这就是他的健身日程，聊到锻炼计划，这时就会用到 workout routine。
workout routine.translation: 朋友：你每周怎么健身 你：一三五去 gym workout routine 固定 朋友：那真规律 你：对
workout routine.example: Friend: How do you work out every week? You: Mon Wed Fri at the gym, a fixed workout routine. Friend: That is regular. You: Right.

workplace regulation.context: 你公司规定上班不能迟到，迟到扣钱，朋友说这就是公司规章，聊到公司规定，这时就会用到 workplace regulation。
workplace regulation.translation: 朋友：你们公司迟到扣钱吗 你：workplace regulation 迟到扣五十 朋友：那真严 你：对
workplace regulation.example: Friend: Does your company fine lateness? You: Workplace regulation, fifty per late arrival. Friend: That is strict. You: Right.

workplace tech.context: 你公司用钉钉开会在线文档，朋友说这就是办公科技，聊到办公技术，这时就会用到 workplace tech。
workplace tech.translation: 朋友：你们远程怎么开会 你：靠 workplace tech 在线文档会议 朋友：那真方便 你：对
workplace tech.example: Friend: How do you hold remote meetings? You: Through workplace tech, online docs and calls. Friend: That is convenient. You: Right.

world meteorological organisation.context: 新闻说联合国那个气象组织发了全球气候报告，朋友说那就是世界气象组织，聊到WMO，这时就会用到 world meteorological organisation。
world meteorological organisation.translation: 朋友：新闻里那气候报告谁发的 你：world meteorological organisation 世界气象组织 朋友：那权威 你：对
world meteorological organisation.example: Friend: Who issued that climate report in the news? You: The World Meteorological Organisation. Friend: That is authoritative. You: Right.

worried about.context: 你朋友出门没带伞，淋了雨怕感冒，朋友说他在担心感冒，聊到担心，这时就会用到 worried about。
worried about.translation: 朋友：你怎么老看天气预报 你：worried about 淋雨感冒 朋友：那带伞 你：对
worried about.example: Friend: Why do you keep checking the forecast? You: Worried about catching a cold in the rain. Friend: Then bring an umbrella. You: Right.

worry oneself sick.context: 你朋友考试前怕考不好，担心得吃不下饭，朋友说他这是愁坏了，聊到担心得病，这时就会用到 worry oneself sick。
worry oneself sick.translation: 朋友：他怎么考前吃不下饭 你：worry oneself sick 愁考不好 朋友：那劝他放松 你：对
worry oneself sick.example: Friend: Why can he not eat before the exam? You: Worrying himself sick about failing. Friend: Then tell him to relax. You: Right.

worth one's time.context: 你朋友说那展览值得一看，花半天时间也值，朋友说这趟没白来，聊到值得花时间，这时就会用到 worth one's time。
worth one's time.translation: 朋友：那展览值得看吗 你：worth one's time 半天值 朋友：那去看看 你：对
worth one's time.example: Friend: Is that exhibition worth it? You: Worth your time, half a day well spent. Friend: Then go see it. You: Right.

worthy cause.context: 你朋友给贫困山区捐钱，朋友说这是做善事，聊到公益事业，这时就会用到 worthy cause。
worthy cause.translation: 朋友：你那钱捐给谁了 你：捐给贫困山区 worthy cause 公益 朋友：那真有意义 你：对
worthy cause.example: Friend: Who did you donate that money to? You: To poor mountain schools, a worthy cause. Friend: That is meaningful. You: Right.

wrap up.context: 会议开了两小时终于结束了，朋友说咱们收尾吧，聊到结束，这时就会用到 wrap up。
wrap up.translation: 朋友：这会开多久了 你：两小时了 咱们 wrap up 收尾吧 朋友：那赶紧散会 你：对
wrap up.example: Friend: How long has this meeting gone on? You: Two hours, let us wrap up. Friend: Then wrap it. You: Right.

wrap your head around.context: 你朋友讲那个复杂数学题，讲了三遍你还没听懂，朋友说你这脑子转不过来，聊到搞明白，这时就会用到 wrap your head around。
wrap your head around.translation: 朋友：这题我讲三遍了你还不懂 你：我 wrap my head around 不了 太绕 朋友：那我再讲一遍 你：对
wrap your head around.example: Friend: I explained this problem three times and you still get it? You: I cannot wrap my head around it, too twisted. Friend: Then I will explain again. You: Right.

write about.context: 你朋友写博客记录自己旅行的见闻，朋友问他写什么，聊到写，这时就会用到 write about。
write about.translation: 朋友：你博客写什么 你：write about 旅行见闻 朋友：那真有意思 你：对
write about.example: Friend: What do you write about on your blog? You: I write about my travels. Friend: That is interesting. You: Right.

write home about.context: 你朋友说那家饭馆好吃到值得专门推荐，朋友说这就是值得大书特书，聊到值得写，这时就会用到 write home about。
write home about.translation: 朋友：那家饭馆真那么好吃 你：特别 write home about 值得专门推荐 朋友：那我也去 你：对
write home about.example: Friend: Is that restaurant really that good? You: Really something to write home about. Friend: Then I will go too. You: Right.

write off.context: 你朋友那笔坏账收不回来了，干脆当损失算了，朋友说这就是一笔勾销，聊到注销，这时就会用到 write off。
write off.translation: 朋友：那笔账怎么处理 你：收不回 write off 当损失 朋友：那真亏 你：对
write off.example: Friend: How do you handle that debt? You: Cannot collect, write it off as a loss. Friend: That is a loss. You: Right.

write review.context: 你买东西后写个评价告诉别人好不好，朋友说这就是写评价，聊到写点评，这时就会用到 write review。
write review.translation: 朋友：你买完东西干嘛写那么多 你：write review 写评价 帮别人参考 朋友：那真热心 你：对
write review.example: Friend: Why do you write so much after buying? You: Write a review to help others. Friend: That is really helpful. You: Right.

write up.context: 你朋友把开会内容整理成正式文档发出来，朋友说这就是整理记录，聊到整理写成文，这时就会用到 write up。
write up.translation: 朋友：你把开会内容整理成啥了 你：write up 成正式文档 发邮件 朋友：那真清楚 你：对
write up.example: Friend: What did you do with the meeting notes? You: Wrote them up into a formal doc, emailed out. Friend: That is clear. You: Right.

year on year.context: 新闻说今年销售额比去年涨了两成，朋友说这就是同比增长，聊到逐年，这时就会用到 year on year。
year on year.translation: 朋友：今年销售比去年好吗 你：year on year 涨了两成 朋友：那真不错 你：对
year on year.example: Friend: Is this year's sales better than last? You: Up twenty percent year on year. Friend: That is nice. You: Right.

year round.context: 你朋友那家咖啡店全年都开，不放假，朋友说这就是全年营业，聊到全年，这时就会用到 year round。
year round.translation: 朋友：你那家咖啡店过年放假吗 你：year round 全年都开 朋友：那真辛苦 你：对
year round.example: Friend: Does your coffee shop close over New Year? You: Open year round. Friend: That is tough. You: Right.

you can’t cross the same river twice.context: 你朋友说回不到过去的学校了，河水都变了，朋友说人不能两次踏进同一条河，聊到不能两次过河，这时就会用到 you can't cross the same river twice。
you can’t cross the same river twice.translation: 朋友：真想回到大学时候 你：you can not cross the same river twice 回不去 朋友：那珍惜现在 你：对
you can’t cross the same river twice.example: Friend: I really want to go back to college. You: You cannot cross the same river twice, it is gone. Friend: Then cherish now. You: Right.

you name it.context: 你朋友问他需要带什么，说啤酒零食电影，啥都有，聊到凡是你说得出的，这时就会用到 you name it。
you name it.translation: 朋友：聚餐要带啥 你：啤酒零食电影 you name it 啥都有 朋友：那我带人就行 你：对
you name it.example: Friend: What to bring to the dinner? You: Beer, snacks, movies, you name it, everything is there. Friend: Then I will just bring myself. You: Right.

yuck factor.context: 你朋友看到臭豆腐捏鼻子说这味道真上头，朋友说这就是让人反胃的感觉，聊到恶心感，这时就会用到 yuck factor。
yuck factor.translation: 朋友：臭豆腐怎么那么臭 你：那 yuck factor 上头的味道 朋友：那你还吃 你：对 闻着臭吃着香
yuck factor.example: Friend: Why is stinky tofu so smelly? You: That yuck factor smell. Friend: Then why eat it? You: Right, smells bad, tastes good.

zero gravity.context: 宇航员在空间站飘起来，朋友说那就是失重，聊到零重力，这时就会用到 zero gravity。
zero gravity.translation: 朋友：宇航员怎么在舱里飘着 你：zero gravity 零重力 飘起来 朋友：那真好玩 你：对
zero gravity.example: Friend: Why are the astronauts floating in the capsule? You: Zero gravity, floating. Friend: That looks fun. You: Right.

zero in on.context: 警察调查案子，锁定了嫌疑人，朋友说他们盯上了目标，聊到聚焦目标，这时就会用到 zero in on。
zero in on.translation: 朋友：警察查到谁了 你：zero in on 一个嫌疑人 锁定了 朋友：那快破案了 你：对
zero in on.example: Friend: Who did the police focus on? You: Zeroed in on a suspect. Friend: Then the case is near done. You: Right.

zero-hours contract.context: 新闻说那种临时工合同没保底，有活才叫你，朋友说这就是零工时合同，聊到零时合同，这时就会用到 zero-hours contract。
zero-hours contract.translation: 朋友：那种临时工怎么签的 你：zero-hours contract 零工时合同 有活才叫 朋友：那真没保障 你：对
zero-hours contract.example: Friend: How is that temp contract? You: A zero-hours contract, called in when needed. Friend: That is insecure. You: Right.

zero-waste design.context: 设计师做产品全用可回收材料，零废弃，朋友说这就是零废弃设计，聊到零废弃设计，这时就会用到 zero-waste design。
zero-waste design.translation: 朋友：你这产品包装怎么全是纸 你：zero-waste design 零废弃设计 用可回收料 朋友：那真环保 你：对
zero-waste design.example: Friend: Why is your product packaging all paper? You: Zero-waste design, recyclable materials. Friend: That is eco-friendly. You: Right.

zombie boot camp.context: 你朋友周末参加那种模拟打僵尸的训练营，朋友说这就是丧尸训练营，聊到僵尸训练营，这时就会用到 zombie boot camp。
zombie boot camp.translation: 朋友：你周末去哪儿玩 你：zombie boot camp 模拟打僵尸训练营 朋友：那真刺激 你：对
zombie boot camp.example: Friend: Where are you going this weekend? You: A zombie boot camp, simulating fighting zombies. Friend: That is thrilling. You: Right.

zoning out.context: 你开会时脑子飘到周末去哪玩，朋友说你走神了，聊到发呆，这时就会用到 zoning out。
zoning out.translation: 朋友：你刚才开会干嘛呢 你：zoning out 走神想周末去哪玩 朋友：那领导看见没 你：对 被点名了
zoning out.example: Friend: What were you doing in the meeting? You: Zoning out, thinking about the weekend. Friend: Did the boss notice? You: Right, called out.

zoom in on.context: 你看照片细节太小，放大看那个人是谁，朋友说这就是放大聚焦，聊到放大细看，这时就会用到 zoom in on。
zoom in on.translation: 朋友：这照片里那个人是谁 你：zoom in on 放大看 是我老同学 朋友：那真认出来了 你：对
zoom in on.example: Friend: Who is that person in the photo? You: Zoom in on it, that is my old classmate. Friend: You really recognized them. You: Right.
